translations.translation: saxelit`a allahisa, mocqalisa, mcqalobelisa.
dideba allahs, g'mert`s samqarot`a;
mocqalesa, mcqalobelsa;
gankit`xvis dg'is ganmgebs.
mxolod shen get`aqvanebit` da mxolod shen gt`xovt` daxmarebas.
gvich`vene scori gza;
- gza imat`i, visac` cqaloba uqavi, da ara - sherisxult`a da gzaac`denilt`a;
elip` laam miim[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] cm. quranis 29 sura,,al-hurup`u'l-muqatta'a (lHrwf lmqT`@ ) - t`i, anu cqvetila asobgerebit` icqeba, romlebic` inic`ialis msgavsad t`avt`aviant`i saxelebit` ikit`xebian, t`umc`a surat`a dasacqisshi mat`i mot`avsebis sibrz'ne da danishnuleba uzenaesi allahis garda danamdvilebit` aravin ic`is. mup`essirebi sxvadasxva ganmartebebit` c`diloben mat`i mnishvnelobebis axsnas, t`umc`a qvela ganmarteba savaraudoa, radganac` allahsa da mis shuamavals am asobgerebis shesaxeb arap`eri ut`k`vamt`.

translations.translation: ai, cigni: echvi ar aris masshi da scori gzis mach`venebelia g'vt`ismoshisht`at`vis.
- romelt`ac` scamt` uxilavisa, ag'asruleben namazs da gaig'eben[1] imas, rac` vucqalobet` sazrdod;
translations.footnotes: [1] g'vt`ivsat`nod

translations.translation: aseve isini, romelt`ac` scamt` - rac` ch`amogevlina da rac` shenamde ch`amovlenila... da g'rmad scamt` ukanaskneli dg'isa.
ai, t`aviant`i g'mert`is mier mit`it`ebul cheshmarit gzaze mdgomni, - egeni arian gadarch`enilni.
uechvelad, - romelt`ac` ar ircmunes, mat`t`vis sulert`ia, gaap`rt`xileb t`u ar gaap`rt`xileb, - mainc` ar ircmuneben;
- bechedi daasva allahma gulebsa da sasmenelze, sap`arveli ak`vt` t`valebzec`... da mat`t`visaa didi sasjeli.
adamiant`a shoris arian iset`nic`, romlebic` amboben - vircmunet` allahi da dg'e ukanasknelio, magram isini ar arian morcmuneni;
- c`diloben, moatquon allahi da isini, romelt`ac` ircmunes, t`umc`a ver ac`nobiereben, rom veravis moatqueben, garda sakut`ari t`avisa;
sneulebaa mat` gulebshi da allahma uaresad daasneula... da mat`t`visaa mcare sasjeli, vinaidan c`ruobdnen;
da roc`a ut`xres - k`veqnad uket`urebas nu ecevit`o, mat` miuges: uechvelad, ch`ven pirik`it`, - gamomscorebelni[1] vart`o.
translations.footnotes: [1] uket`urebisa - siket`isaken

translations.translation: dae, ic`odet`, rom scored egeni ecevian uket`urebas, magram ar sheigneben.
da roc`a ut`xres - ircmunet` ise, rogorc` ircmuna xalxmao, mat` miuges:,,nut`u vircmunot` ise, rogorc` scamt` chkuasustebs?"... ic`odet`, rom scored egeni arian chkuasustebi, t`umc`a ar ic`ian.

da roc`a morcmuneebs shexvdebian, amboben, ch`venc` vircmunet`o, xolo rodesac` t`aviant` satanebt`an[1] ganmartovdebian, eubnebian: ra t`k`ma unda, ch`ven t`k`vens gverdit` vart` da rag'a t`k`ma unda, mat`i damc`inavni vart`o.
translations.footnotes: [1] urcmunoebt`an

translations.translation: - allahi dasc`inebs mat` da xetials gauxangrz'livebs t`aviant` zg'vargadasulobashi.
egeni arian, romelt`ac` gzaac`deniloba iqides cheshmariti gzis p`asad, magram ar moigo mat`ma vachrobam da arc` cheshmarit gzaze mdgarni qop`ilan.
mat`i sak`c`ieli hgavs imis magalit`s, vinc` c`ec`xli daant`o da, roc`a am c`ec`xlma irgvliv sinat`le mohp`ina, - allahma cartac`a mat` mxedveloba da bnelet`shi datova usinat`lod.
- qruni, munjni da brmani... egeni ar mobrundebian.

- an, magalit`s - cqvdiad g'ameshi t`avsxma cvimisa da chek`a-k`uxilis k`vesh moqolilt`as, mexis dros rom t`it`ebs qurebshi ic`oben - sikvdilis shishit` moc`ulni, t`umc`a urcmunoebs - allahi garemoic`avs[1];
translations.footnotes: [1] t`avisi z'levamosilebit`

translations.translation: - lamis cartac`os elvam mxedveloba; rogorc` ki gaielvebs, mashinve masshi[1] amoz'ravdebian da, sibnele rom ch`amocveba, - umal iquch`eben. allahs rom eneba, auc`ileblad caart`mevda smenasac` da xedvasac`. uechvelad, allahi qovlisshemz'lea.
translations.footnotes: [1] sinat`leshi

translations.translation: ei, adamianebo! t`k`vens g'mert`s et`aqvanet`, gagach`inat` romelmac` - t`k`ven da t`k`enze adre mqop`ni; - ik`neb ridi gk`ondet`;

- romelmac` t`k`vent`vis gap`ina dedamica sacolivit`, xolo zec`a saburvelad aago, shemdeg c`idan cqali gadmoadina da mosavali ag'moac`ena t`k`vens sazrdod. ase rom, ar gauch`inot` allahs t`anaziarni, shegnebulad.

t`uki raime dagaechvebt` imashi, rac` ch`vens mona-morch`ils[1] ch`amovuvlinet`, mashin mouxmet` qvela t`k`vens mocmes, garda allahisa, da imisi scori t`undac` ert`i sura moitanet`, t`u xart` mart`alni.
translations.footnotes: [1] muhammeds

translations.translation: da t`u ver shez'lot`, - da ra t`k`ma unda ver shez'lebt`, - mash, geshinodet` c`ec`xlis, - mzamzareulisa urcmunot`at`vis, romlis sacvavic` adamianebi da k`vebia.

da axare imat`, vinc` ircmunes da hk`mnes ket`ili, rom mat`t`visaa samot`xeebi, romelt`a k`veshac` - dian mdinareni. isini, qovelt`vis, roc`a ik`auri xilit` isazrdoeben, ase itqvian - es isaa, rac` ucin[1] gvesazrdovao, t`umc`ag'a amisi msgavsi eboz'at` mxolod; ik` ik`nebian umcikvlo meug'leebic`, - maradzhams damkvidrebulni.
translations.footnotes: [1] dedamicaze qop`nisas

translations.translation: uechvelad, allahs ar erideba igavi moiqvanos kog'osi an kidev masze upiratesi arsebis shesaxeb. vinc` ircmunes, ic`ian, rom igi[1] cheshmaritebaa mat`i g'mert`isgan, xolo isini, vinc` ar ircmunes, itqvian - ra unda (et`k`va) allahs am igavit`o? - am igavit` gzas aac`dens bevrs da cheshmarit gzas uch`venebs mravals amit`ve... da gzidan aravis gadaiqvans, t`u ara ug'irsebs.
translations.footnotes: [1] igavi

translations.translation: - romelnic` arg'veven allahis ag't`k`mas misi ganmtkic`ebis shemdeg da cqveten im kavshirebs, romelt`a gamqarebac` brz'ana allahma, da k`veqnad t`esaven uket`urebas... egeni arian, namdvilad, - cagebulni.
rogor uarhqop`t` allahs, roc`a mkvdarni iqavit` da man moganichat` sic`oc`xle, shemdeg isev mogakvdinebt`, shemdeg ki dagac`oc`xlebt` da mas daubrundebit`.
- igia, qvelap`eri t`k`vent`vis vinc` gaach`ina, rac` ki dedamicaze arsebobs, shemdeg zec`isken mieshura da shvid c`ad ganalaga isini[1]; - igia qovlismc`odne.
translations.footnotes: [1] c`ebi

translations.translation: aki, shenma g'mert`ma angelozebs ut`xra: auc`ileblad unda gavach`ino xalip`a[1] dedamicazeo. mat` miuges:,,nut`u ik` gaach`en iset`s, vinc` sisxls dag'vris da ik`ms uket`urebas, roc`a ch`veni g'ag'adisi shens didebashia da sul shens sicmindesa da unakloebas vag'iarebt`?". (allahma) ut`xra: uechvelad, me vic`i is, rac` t`k`ven ar ic`it`o.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,xalip`a" (khlyf@): pirdapiri mnishvnelobit` nac`vals nishnavs. scavlulebi ramdenime gansxvavebul versias gadmogvc`emen imast`an dakavshirebit`, t`u ra igulisxmeba am sitqvit` am konkretul aiat`shi. magalit`ad, t`ap`siru'l-muesser:,,xalxi, romlebic` ert`manet`s ch`aanac`vleben"; t`ap`siru'l-jelalein:,,g'vt`is nac`vali, romelic` dedamicaze allahis brz'anebebs gaatarebs"; t`ap`siru'l-beg'avi:,,xalip`a iqo adami, romelic` ch`aanac`vlebda jinebs, radganac` mat` shemdeg gach`nda. amavdroulad, is iqo allahis carmomadgeneli dedamicaze, romelic` ag'asrulebda mis dadgenilebebs da gaatarebda mis rch`evebs";

translations.translation: da adams qvela (misi k`mnilebis) saxeli sheascavla, shemdeg isini (k`mnilebebi) angelozebs carudgina da ubrz'ana: aba, maucqet` amat`i saxelebi, t`uki mart`alni xart`o.
(angelozebma) t`k`ves: shena xar mxolod qovlad unaklo, xolo ch`ven ar vp`lobt` sxva c`odnas, garda imisa, rac` shen giscavlebia, cheshmaritad, - shena xar brz'eni - qovlismc`odneo.

(allahma) brz'ana:,,adam, aucqe mat` imat`i saxelebi!"... da roc`a aucqa (mat` imat`i saxelebi), - ut`xra: gana ar git`xarit`, rom me namdvilad vic`i uxilavt`a shesaxeb c`at`a da dedamicisa, aseve, vic`i, rasac` amxelt` an rasac` malavt`o?
aki, vubrz'anet` angelozebs, rom adamist`vis sejdeze[1] t`avdaxriliqvnen, da umal sejdeze ch`aemxnen, garda iblisisa[2], romelmac` gadidgulda, uarze dadga da gaxda urcmunot`agani.
translations.footnotes:
[1] originali -,,sejde" (sjd@): uzenaesi allahis cinashe muxlmodrekit`a da k`edis moxrit` morch`ilebisa da t`aqvanisc`emis gamomxatveli mok`medebaa. sejde shvidi organos - p`exis t`it`ebis, muxlebis, xelis gulebis da c`xvir-shublis z'irs shexebit` sruldeba. sejde qiblas mimart`ulebit` unda shesruldes, romlis drosac` xelis t`it`ebic`a da p`exis t`it`ebic` qiblas mimart`ulebit` unda iqos mimart`ulni.
[2] originali -,,iblisi" (blys): satanas saxelia, romelic` carmomavlobit` jinia, t`umc`a t`avisi ganscavlulobisa da damsaxurebis gamo angelozebt`an ert`ad imqop`eboda. aset`ma pativma iblisi imdenad gaaqoqoch`a, rom g'vt`is mimart` siurch`e gamoavlina.

translations.translation: da vut`xarit`:,,adam! shen da sheni c`oli samot`xeshi dasaxldit` da uxvad miirt`vit`, sadac` ra genebot`, t`umc`a am xes nu miuaxlovdebit`, t`orem t`k`ven ik`nebit` usamart`lot`aganni".

mere ac`duna isini satanam da gamoaz'eva ik`idan, sadac` imqop`ebodnen. ch`ven mat` vut`xarit`:,,(k`veqnad) daeshvit` mtrebad ert`urt`isa! droebit`i samkvidro da sabadebeli t`k`vent`vis -dedamicazea".
da adamma sheiscavla sitqvebi[1] t`avisi g'mert`isagan da g'mert`mac` - miuteva; cheshmaritad, - isaa mimtevebeli, mcqalobeli.
translations.footnotes: [1] es sitqvebi moc`emulia sura a'rap`is 23-e aiat`shi:,,g'mert`o ch`veno! uechvelad, usamart`lod movek`ec`it` sakut`ar sulebs ch`ven orivem. t`u ar gvapatieb da ar shegvicqaleb, ch`ven auc`ileblad ganadgurebult`agani vik`nebit`."

translations.translation: vubrz'anet`:,,daeshvit` ik`idan qvela ert`ianad! vinc` gahqveba ch`emgan nach`veneb cheshmarit gzas mashin, roc`a scori gzis mach`venebeli mogevlinebat`, - mat`t`vis arc` shishi ik`neba, arc`a mcuxareba";
- xolo isini, vinc` ar ircmunes da c`rud miich`nies ch`veni aiat`ebi, ai, isini arian c`ec`xlis mkvidrni da ik` ik`nebian maradzhams.

ei, israelis modgmav! ch`emi cqaloba gaixsenet`, romelic` t`k`vent`vis miboz'ebia, da ch`ems cinashe dadebul ag't`k`mas uert`gulet`, rom ag'gisrulot` t`k`venze danapirebic`; (t`k`ven) mxolod ch`emi shishi gk`ondet`.

da ircmunet` is (qurani), rac` ch`amovavline t`k`vent`an arsebulis (t`oras) damamocmeblad, nu ik`nebit` misi pirveli uarmqop`elni da nurc` gaqidit` ch`ems aiat`ebs mc`ire p`asis sanac`vlod. ase rom, mxolod ch`emi ridi gk`ondet`.
ar shemosot` sic`ruit` cheshmariteba da arc` damalot` igi, shegnebulad.
ag'asrulet` namazi, gaig'et` zek`at`i[1] da moixaret` ruk`u'ze - ruk`u'ze[2] mqop`ebt`an ert`ad.
translations.footnotes:
[1] orignali -,,al-zek`at`i" (lzk@): savaldebulo mocqalebaa, romelic` garkveuli k`onebis mk`one muslimma g'aribebs unda daurigos.
[2] originali -,,ruk`u'" (rkw`): namazis ert`-ert`i mok`medebaa, romelic` g'vt`is morch`ilebisa da t`aqvanic`emis nishnad celshi moxras gulisxmobs. ruk`u'i-s mok`medeba 90o-it` celshi moxrit`a da xelebis muxlebze dacqobit` sruldeba.

translations.translation: nut`u xalxs siket`isken moucodebt`, sakut`ar t`avt` ki daivicqebt`, mit`umetes, roc`a cigns (t`oras) kit`xulobt`; nut`u gonebas ar mouxmobt`?
mot`minebit`a da namazit` ez'iet` g'vt`isshemceoba, - rt`ulia ut`uod, og'ond ara g'vt`ismoshisht`at`vis.
- romelt`ac` guldajerebit` scamt`, rom t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe carsdgebian; rom mas daubrundebian.
ei, modgmav israelisa! ch`emi cqaloba gaixsenet`, romelic` t`k`vent`vis miboz'ebia, roc`a me t`k`ven samqarot`a cinashe gamogarch`iet`;
da ridi gk`ondet` im dg'isa, roc`a suli sxva suls verap`ershi emagivreba, arc` misi shuamdgomloba miig'eba, arc`a sadamxsnelo da verc` sxvisgan miig'ebs daxmarebas.

aki, gixsenit` p`araonis xalxisgan, - gsjidnen roc`a, usastikesi sasjelit`: t`avebs ac`lidnen t`k`vens vazhebs da c`oc`xlad tovebdnen t`k`vens k`alishvilebs; - t`k`veni g'mert`isgan gansac`deli iqo amashi, udidesi.
aki, t`k`vent`vis zg'va gavapet` da gadagarch`inet`, xolo p`araonis xalxi davaxrch`vet` da t`k`venc` - shesc`k`erodit` (momxdars).
aki, ormoc`i g'ame[1] ag'vut`k`vit` musas, misi casvlis shemdeg ki xbo daidginet` t`aqvansac`emad (kerpad); - usamart`loni xart` amitom.
translations.footnotes: ]1] vahis ch`amovlineba

translations.translation: amis miuxedavad mere gapatiet`, rom ik`neb madlierni qop`iliqavit`.
aki, cigni da p`urqani[1] vuboz'et` musas, ik`neb cheshmarit gzas dasdgomodit` t`k`ven.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,al-p`urqan" (lfrqn): mup`essirebi am sitqvis ganmartebisas ramdenime gansxvavebul versiaze saubroben: a. umravlesobis azrit`, esaa cheshmaritisa da sic`ruis, halalisa da haramis ganmasxvavebeli nichi; b. mujahidis azrit`, es t`oras meore saxelia; g. k`isais azrit`, es cignis zedsart`avi saxelia, anu halalisa da haramis ganmasxvavebeli cigni; d. iaman bin raianis azrit`, es zg'vis gapobis sascaulia. ix. t`ap`siru'l-beg'avii.

translations.translation: aki, musam t`avis xalxs mimart`a: ei, xalxo! uechvelad, xbos (kerpad) dadgenit`, sakut`ar sulebs uqavit` usamart`loba, amitom: moinaniet` igi t`k`veni gamch`enis cinashe da daxoc`et` ert`manet`i[1], radgan es up`ro xeiriania t`k`vent`vis, t`k`venive gamch`enis cinasheo. shemdeg man esec` gapatiat`. cheshmaritad, - isaa mimtevebeli, mcqalobeli.
translations.footnotes: [1] mat`, vinc` ar qop`ilan xbos mot`aqvaneni, - sikvdilit` dasajon isini, vinc` iqvnen xbos mot`aqvaneni.

translations.translation: aki ut`xarit`: ei, musa! aravit`ar shemt`xvevashi ar dagijerebt`, vidre ashkarad ar vixilavt` allahso. mashinve mexi dagemxot` da t`k`venc` - shesc`k`erodit` (momxdars).
mere ag'gadginet` sikvdilis shemdgom, - ik`neb madlierni qop`iliqavit`;

- da mogich`rdilet` g'rubeli mag'lidan da zec`iuri manana[1] da mcqeric` ch`amogivlinet`. miirt`vit` imat`gan, rac` sup`t`aa (halali) da rac` t`k`vent`vis sarch`od gvicqalobebia... ch`ven ki ar mogvk`c`evian usamart`lod, - isini t`aviant` sulebs moek`c`nen usamart`lod.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,al-mann" (lmn): k`art`ulshi damkvidrebulia, rogorc` c`iuri manana. mup`essirebi ramdenime gansxvaebul versiaze saubroben, t`u ra igulisxmeba ag'nishnul sitqvashi: a. es aris g'vt`isgan boz'ebuli qvela sakvebis zogadi saxelcodeba, rac` qovelgvari sirt`ulisa da dag'lilobis gareshe moipoveba;b. es iqo t`ap`livit` tkbili sanovage, romelic` xeze moipoveboda; g. cqlit` gazavebuli dasalevi, romelic` t`ap`livit` tkbili iqo.

translations.translation: aki, git`xarit`:,,shedit` am k`alak`shi da uxvad miirt`vit`, sadac` ra genebot`; shedit` (am k`alak`is) karibcheshi k`edmoxrilni da t`k`vit` -,,shendoba!""... - shegindobt` t`k`vens c`odvebs da (cqalobas) gavuzrdit` - sak`mit` ket`ilsa da rcmenit` ihsanis mk`onet`[1];
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,al-muhsin" (lmHsn): t`it`k`mis qvela t`argmanshi moc`emulia, rogorc` ket`ilismk`mneli. es sitqva carmoebulia,,ihsan" zmnis p`uz'isgan, rac` sak`mis sauket`eso da unaklo p`ormit` shesrulebas nishnavs.,,ihsani" aseve rcmenis gansakut`rebuli xarisxis gamomxatveli terminia. rogorc` jibril mt`avarangelozisa da muhammed shuamavlis dialogidan vgebulobt`,,,ihsani" aris c`xovrebis qvela nabijze iset`i shegnebis shenarch`uneba, t`it`k`os allahs xedavde. ra t`k`ma unda, shen mas ver dainaxav, t`umc`a unda gaxsovdes, rom is shen qovelt`vis gxedavs. quranis bevr aiat`shi,,muhsinebi", anu sak`mit` ket`ili da rcmenit` ihsanis mk`oneni, - k`ebit` moixsenebian.

translations.translation: - magram mat`, vinc` usamart`lobdnen, (ch`ven mier davalebuli) sitqva shec`vales imit`, rac` ar hk`ondat` davalebuli, da vinc` usamart`lod moik`c`a, c`idan sasjeli ch`avuvlinet`, vinaidan urch`obdnen.

aki, it`xova musam darcquleba t`avisi xalxisa da mas vut`xarit` - dahkari kldes sheni joxit`o, da mashinve t`ormetma cqarom amoxet`k`a ik`idan. qvela gvarma gaigo amgvarad - t`aviant`i dasarcqurebeli adgili. chamet` da svit` allahis mier boz'ebuli sazrdodan da nu iborotebt` k`veqnad uket`urebi.

aki, t`k`vit`:,,ei, musa! veg'ar movit`ment` ert`i da igive saxeobis sakvebze qop`nas da shens g'mert`s sheevedre, ag'mogvic`enos is, rac` micaze amodis: bostneuli, kitri, niori, ospi da xaxvi". (musam) gipasuxat`:,,nut`u gsurt`, shec`valot` up`ro c`udit` is, rac` uket`esia? (mash) ch`adit` k`alak`shi da, uechvelad, qvelap`eria ik` t`k`vent`vis, rasac` it`xovt`". (ik` ki) t`avs daatqdat` damc`ireba, sig'aribe da risxva allahisa, ramet`u uarqop`dnen allahis aiat`ebs/sascaulebs da usamart`lod xoc`avdnen shuamavlebs. es qvelap`eri imist`vis miezg'ot`, rom urch`obdnen da zg'vargadasulobdnen.

cheshmaritad, mat`t`vis, vinc` ircmuna, da mat`t`visac`, vinc` iqo iudeveli, nazareveli da sabieli[1], vinc` ircmuna - allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli da aket`a siket`e, - scored mat`t`visaa jildo - g'mert`t`an t`aviant`isa... da arc` shishi ek`nebat`, arc`a damcuxrdebian (isini).
translations.footnotes: [1] sabielni: mup`essirebi sabielt`a vinaobis shesaxeb ramdenime gansxvavebul azrs gamot`k`vamen: a. cignboz'ebult`a ert`-ert`i ganshtoeba b. varskvlavt` mot`aqvaneni g. xalxi, romlebic` arc`ert`i religiis ag'msarebelni ar iqvnen, arc` carmart`obdnen da shenarch`unebuli hk`ondat` spetaki bunebac`, anu,,p`itrat`i". d. xalxi, romlebmac` carsul shuamavalt`agan romelimes shariat`i shemoinaxes; allahis ert`oba da gankit`xvis dg'is cheshmariteba scamdat`.

translations.translation: aki, avig'et` t`k`vengan ag't`k`ma da mt`a[1] ag'vmart`et` t`k`vens zemot`. mt`eli simtkic`it`a da gulisxmierebit` aig'et` is, rac` (t`evrat`is saxit`) gadmogec`it` da gaxsovdet`, rac`aa masshi, - ik`neb ridi gk`ondet`.
translations.footnotes: [1] sina

translations.translation: mere, piri ibrunet` mainc` amis[1] shemdeg da, rom ara allahis madli da cqaloba t`k`venda, - ut`uod ik`nebodit` ganadgurebult`agan.
translations.footnotes: [1] ag't`k`mis

translations.translation: vp`ic`av, kargad ucqit` imat`ze, rom shabat`i[1] daarg'vies; rom mat` vut`xarit` - saz'agel maimunebad gadaik`ec`it`o.
translations.footnotes: [1] t`evzaobis akrz'alvis ag't`k`ma - shabat`obit`

translations.translation: shemdeg, samagalit`od vak`c`iet` igi mat`i t`anamedrovenisa da shemdgomi t`aobebist`vis, aseve, shegonebad - g'vt`ismoshisht`at`vis.
aki, t`avis xalxs ut`xra musam - cheshmaritad, allahi gibrz'anebt`, rom daklat` z'roxao. mat` miuges:,,nut`u masxrad gvigdeb?''. ut`xra: g'mert`ma damip`aros, rom viqo uvic`t`aganio.

mat` t`k`ves: sheevedre ch`vent`vis shens g'mert`s, rom gagvarkvios, - rogoria igi. miugo:,,cheshmaritad, is(allahi) ambobs, rom uechvelad, igia z'roxa: arc` xnieri da arc` dekeuli, aramed amat` shoris - sashualo xnisa. mash, ag'asrulet` igi, rac` gebrz'anat`".
mat` t`k`ves: sheevedre ch`vent`vis shens g'mert`s, rom gagvarkvios, - ra p`erisaa igio. miugo:,,cheshmaritad, is ambobs, rom igia z'roxa -xasxasa qvit`eli p`erisa, romelsac` shehxarian mnaxvelni".

mat` t`k`ves: sheevedre ch`vent`vis shens g'mert`s, rom (uket`) gagvarkvios - rogoria igi, radganac` bevria ch`vent`vis igivenairi z'roxa da, allahi t`u inebebs, uechvelad, ch`ven vik`nebit` cheshmarit gzaze mdgomnio;

- miugo: cheshmaritad, is ambobs, rom igia z'roxa: ara damc`robili - micis xvnasa da nat`esis rcqvashi; qovlad uvnebeli, romelsac` raime t`valsach`ino lak`a ar gaach`niao. mat` t`k`ves:,,ai, axla moxvedi cheshmaritebit`''. bolos dakles igi, t`umc`a, c`otac` da veg'ar shez'lebdnen[1] (povnas).
translations.footnotes: [1] maxasiat`ebelt`a ch`amonat`vali imdenad gamravalric`xovnda, rom z'alze shemc`irda msgavsi z'roxis povnis shesaz'lebloba, rat`a daeklat` igi.

translations.translation: aki, ert`i kac`i mokalit` da mere ert`manet`s gadaabralet`, arada, rasac` malavdit`, - allahia gamomaashkaravebi.
da vut`xarit`:,,dakluli z'roxis zogiert`i nacili mic`valebuls sheaxet`"... ase ac`oc`xlebs allahi mic`valebulebs, ase gich`venebt` t`avis aiat`ebs/sascaulebs, ik`neb gons moegot`.

mere mainc`, - gulni gagixdat` sali kldesavit` an kidev up`ro sheug'ceveli, vinaidan: kldet`agania is, saidanac` mdinareebi moch`xrialeben; mat`ganic`aa, ranic` skdebian da gadmosch`k`ep`en shignidan cqlebi; kidev mat`gani, ranic` allahis shishisgan gorvit` k`veeshvebian... - xolo allahi ugulisquro araa imis mimart`, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
nut`u imedovnebt`, rom t`k`vensas ircmuneben (iudevelni)? uechvelad, mat`gan ert`-ert`ni allahis sitqvebs ismendnen da, roc`a gaiazrebdnen xolme, - mas shemdgom shegnebulad asxvap`erebdnen.

da roc`a murcmuneebs shemoxvdebian, amboben, rom ch`venc` vircmunet`o, xolo rodesac` ert`manet`t`an ganmartovdebian, eubnebian: nut`u uambobt` imas, rac` allahs t`k`vent`vis uc`nobebia, mere t`k`veni g'mert`is cinashe rom mogiqvanon mtkic`ebulebad;[1] nut`u gonebas ar mouxmobt`o?
translations.footnotes: [1] munap`iqi iudevelebi, romlebic` morcmuneebt`an shexvedrisas ambobdnen: ch`venc` t`k`vensavet` gvcams, rom muhammedi cheshmaritad allahis shuamavaliao, xolo rodesac` t`anamoz'meebt`an ganmartovdebodnen, isini eubnebodnen: nut`u uambobt` imas, rom allahma ch`vens cminda cignshi muhammedis shuamavloba cinascar gvac`noba, rasac` shemdeg t`k`vens cinaag'mdeg sakamat`o mtkic`ebulebad gamoiqeneben, rogorc` am k`veqnad, ise - g'vt`is cinashe.

translations.translation: gana ar ic`ian, rom allahma ic`is qvelap`eri, rasac` malaven da rasac` ac`xadeben?!
da mat`gan arian cera-kit`xvis uc`odinarni, romelt`ac` arap`eri gaegebat` cignis shesaxeb, garda shet`xzuli ambebisa da isini mxolod varaudoben.

vai imat`, romelnic` sakut`ari xelebit` ceren cigns da mere amboben, allahisganaao, rat`a mc`ire sap`asurad gaqidon igi. vai imat` imist`vis, rac` daceres mat`ma xelebma da vai imat` imist`vis, rac` ase moixveches.

da t`k`ves:,,ver shegvexeba c`ec`xli ch`ven, garda gat`vlili dg'eebisa". ut`xari:,,xom ar agig'iat` ag't`k`ma allahisgan? - allahi xom ar gadava t`avisi ag't`k`midan, aravit`ar shemt`xvevashi, - t`u, allahis shesaxeb imas amtkic`ebt`, rac` t`k`ven ar ic`it`?".
- pirik`it`! vinc` siaveni moixvecha da vinac` c`odvebma garemoic`va, ai, isini arian c`ec`xlis mkvidrni da ik` ik`nebian maradzhams.
xolo isini, romelt`ac` ircmunes da hk`mnes ket`ili, ai, isini arian samot`xis mkvidrni da ik` ik`nebian maradzhams.

aki, ag't`k`ma avig'et` israelis modgmisgan, rom aravis et`aqvanot` garda allahisa, siket`e uket`et` mshoblebs, nat`esavebs, oblebs, g'atakebs, tkbilad esaubret` xalxs,namazi ag'asrulet` da zek`at`i gaec`it`. t`k`ven ki shemdeg piri ibrunet` mainc`, garda mc`irednisa; t`k`ven sul zurgshek`c`eulni xart`.
aki, ag't`k`ma avig'et` t`k`vengan, rom ar dag'varot` ert`manet`is sisxli da ar gaqarot` ert`manet`i sakut`ari saxlebidan. es qvelap`eri shemdeg ag'iaret` da t`k`venve mocmobt` amaze.

amis shemdeg, t`k`ven ert`manet`s xoc`avt` mainc` da az'evebt` sakut`ari saxlebidan zogiert`s da zurgs umagrebt` mat` cinaag'mdeg ert`manet`s, mtrobit`a da borotebit`. da t`u tqveebad mogividnen, gamosasqids it`xovt` mat`gan, arada mat`i gaz'eveba akrz'aluli gk`ondat` t`k`ven. nut`u cignis nacili gcamt` da nacils uarqop`t`? da ra ik`neba sazg'auri, romeli t`k`venganic` amas sch`adis, t`u ara damc`ireba am k`veqniur c`xovrebashi, da gankit`xvis dg'esac` umkac`res sasjels miec`emian, radgan allahi araa ugulisquro imis mimart`, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
egeni arian, vinc` amk`veqniuri c`xovreba iqides im k`veqnis p`asad. amitom ar sheumsubuk`debat` magat` sasjeli da arc` daxmareba gaecevat`.

da, ra t`k`ma unda, - musas mivec`it` cigni da shemdeg mivadevnet` shuamavlebi. c`xadi mtkic`ebulebani vuboz'et` meriemis z'e 'isasac` da cminda sulit`[1] ganvamtkic`et` igi. gana qovelt`vis, roc`a mogdiodat` shuamavalni iset`i gzavnilebit`, rac` iqo mouconari t`k`veni gemovnebist`vis, - t`k`ven ar medidurobdit` da mat`gan nacils c`rud ar rac`xavdit` da nacils ar xoc`avdit`?
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,ruhu'l-qudus" (rwH lqds): islamis t`eologebi ramdenime gansxvavebul versias gadmogvc`emen imast`an dakavshirebit`, t`u ra igulixmeba am sitqvit`. mup`essirt`a umravlesoba t`vlis, rom es aris jibril mt`avarangelozi. ibni abbasisa da sad bin jubeiris azrit`, es uzenaesi allahis qvelaze mt`avari saxelia (sm l'`Zm), rit`ac` 'isa shuamavali mic`valebulebs ac`oc`xlebda da xalxs sxvadasxva saoc`rebebs ach`venebda. ert`-ert`i versiis t`anaxmad es iqo injili (saxareba), rac` 'isa shuamavlis suls carmoadgenda, rogorc` qurani iqo muhammed shuamavlis suli, radganac` qurani mudam xarobda mis gulshi. aseve ert`-ert`i versiis t`anaxmad, esaa imani (rcmena), rit`ac` uzenaesi allahi morcmuneebs az'lierebs. ix. t`ap`siru'l-beg'avi da t`eisiru'l-k`eriimi'l-mennan p`ii t`ap`siiri'l-quraan.

translations.translation: da t`k`ves: ch`vens gulebs adevs sap`arvelio. - pirik`it`, allhama t`aviant`i urcmunoebis gamo dascqevla da, ai, - umc`iresia, rasac` isini rcmunoben.

da roc`a mat`t`an arsebulis (t`evrat`is) damamocmebeli cigni (qurani) miuvidat` allahisgan, - uarhqves igi, arada manamde daxmarebas elodnen[1] urcmunot`a cinaag'mdeg. roc`a miuvidat` is, rasac` ukve (t`evrat`idan) ic`nobdnen, - ag'ar ircmunes da, allahis cqevla urcmunoebs, - amitom!
translations.footnotes: [1] momavali shuamavlisgan, am cignit`

translations.translation: raoden c`udia is, ris gamoc` t`aviant`i sulebi gaqides: shurdat`, rom allahi t`avis madls ch`amoavlens im msaxurebze, inebebs viszec`, - da ar ircmunes is, rac` ch`amoavlina, ris gamoc` risxvaze risxva[1] daimsaxures... da urcmunot`at`visaa sasjeli damamc`irebeli.
translations.footnotes: [1] ibni abbasma da mujahidma t`k`ves: pirveli risxva mashin daimsaxures, rodesac` t`evrat`shi c`vlilebebi sheitanes, xolo meore mashin, rodesac` muhammedi da qurani uarqves. qat`adem t`k`va: pirveli risxva mashin daimsaxures, rodesac` 'isa da injili uarqves, xolo meore mashin, rodesac` muhammedi da qurani uarqves. suddim t`k`va: pirveli iqo, rodesac` xbos daucqes t`aqvanisc`ema, xolo meore mashin, rodesac` muhammedi uarqves. ix. t`ap`siru'l-beg'avi.

translations.translation: - da rodesac` ut`xres, ircmunet` is, rac` allahma ch`amoavlinao, miuges: gvcams is, rac` ch`venzea ch`amovlenilio da, mis garda sxva danarch`ens - uarqop`en. arada is (qurani) mat`t`an arsebulis damamocmebeli cheshmaritebaa. ut`xari: mash, rad xoc`avdit` allahis mac`neebs, t`uki iqavit` (t`evrat`is) morcmuneni?
cheshmaritad, musa movida t`k`vent`an c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebit`, mere ki xbo daidginet` kerpad mas shemdeg[1] da gaxdit` usamart`loni.
translations.footnotes: [1] misi arqop`nis dros

translations.translation: aki, avig'et` ag't`k`ma t`k`vengan da ag'vmart`et` mt`a (sinasi) t`k`vens zemot`; (gibrz'anet` rom:) - mt`eli simtkic`it`a da gulisxmierebit` aig'et`, rac` (t`evrat`is saxit`) gadmogec`it` da sheisminet`. mat` t`k`ves - gvesma da veurch`et`o, radgan t`aviant`i urcmunoebis gamo xbos t`aqvanisc`emit` hk`ondat` gulebi gazhg'ent`ilni. ut`xari:,,ra c`udia is, rasac` t`k`veni rcmena gibrz'anebt`, t`uki t`k`ven xart` morcmuneni".
ut`xari:,,t`uki allaht`an, sxva xalxis gareshe, - (mxolod) t`k`vent`visaa gankut`vnili imk`veqniuri samkvidrebeli[1], mashin sikvdili isurvet`, t`u xart` namdvilad gulcrp`elni".
translations.footnotes: [1] samot`xe

translations.translation: - magram amas arasodes isurveben imis gamo, rac` ukve ch`audeniat` mat` xelebs... allahi ic`nobs usamart`loebs.

vp`ic`av, ut`uod hpovo egeni, - sic`oc`xlis mimart` qvelaze daxarbebulni, im xalxze charbadac` ki, romlebic` g'mert`s ut`anaziareben[1]. qovel mat`gans surs, at`asi celi ic`oc`xlos, t`umc`a xangrz'livi sic`oc`xlec` ver ganaridebs mat` sasjelisgan. qvelap`ers xedavs allahi, rasac` isini aket`eben.
translations.footnotes: [1] ert`adert`i g'mert`is garda sxva arsebasac` ag'mert`eben

translations.translation: ut`xari imas, vinc`a mteria jibrilisa, - rom cheshmaritad, allahis nebit` man (jibrilma) ch`amoavlina igi[1] shens gulze: damamocmeblad imisa, rac` iqo adre; cheshmariti gzis mach`veneblad da xarebad morcmunenisa.
translations.footnotes: [1] cm.qurani

translations.translation: - vinc`a mteria allahisa, misi angelozebisa, (misi) shuamavlebisa, jibrilisa da mik`ailisa, - uechvelad, allahic` mteria urcmunonisa.
cheshmaritad, ch`ven ch`amogivlinet` nat`eli aiat`ebi/sascaulebi da mat` aravin uarqop`s, garda ug'irsebisa.
rodesac` ag't`k`mas dadebdnen, nacili mat`i mudam arg'vevda; up`ro metic`, - umravlesobas ara scams.

da roc`a miuvidat` mat` allahisgan shuamavali, - imis damamocmebeli, rac` iqo mat`t`an (t`evrat`i), - mat`ma nacilma, visac` (es) cigni eboz'a, - zurgs ukan moisrola allahis cigni, vit`omc` ar ic`odnen (misi shinaarsi)[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] t`it`k`os ar ic`odnen - t`evrat`shi/t`orashi rom muhammedis mosvla iqo nacinascarmetqvelebi.

translations.translation: - da gahqvnen imas, rasac` uqvebodnen satanebi suleimanis samep`os shesaxeb. - suleimani ki ar qop`ila urcmuno (jadosani), - satanebi iqvnen urcmunoni. isini xalxs ascavlidnen jadosnobasa da imas, rac` or angelozs - harut`sa da marut`s ch`amoevlinat` babilonshi. es orni ar ascavlidnen ise aravis, t`u ar etqodnen, rom cheshmaritad, ch`ven vart` sac`durad da (jadosnobis shescavlit`) nu ik`c`evit` urcmunoebado. xalxi mat`gan imas scavlobda, rac` gaashorebda kac`s t`avisi c`olisgan. - veravis avnebdnen amit` isini, rom ara - neba allahisa. isini scavlobdnen imas, rac` mavne iqo mat`t`vis da ar qop`ila sargeblis momtani. vp`ic`av, mat` ic`odnen, rom amas[1] vinc` sheiz'enda, aranairi xvedri ar ergeboda mas imk`veqnad. neta sc`odnodat`, t`u ra c`udia is, ris sanac`vlodac` gaqides sulebi, t`aviant`i;
translations.footnotes: [1] amgvar c`odnas

translations.translation: neta sc`odnodat`, rom rcmena da ridi t`u ek`nebodat`, - allahis cinashe damsaxurebuli madli ut`uod uket`esia.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`, ag'ar carmot`k`vat` sitqva,,ra'inaa" (dagvmcqemse), aramed t`k`vit` -,,unzurnaa"[1] (shemogvxede da ch`veni mdgomareoba gait`valiscine) da sheisminet`, xolo urcmunot`at`vis - mcare sasjelia.
translations.footnotes: [1] sitqva,,ra'inaa" (r`n) carmoebulia,,ra'a" (r`~) p`uz'idan, rac` mzeris mipqrobas, mzrunvelobas, quradg'ebasa da momcqemsvas nishnavs. aseve, sitqva,,unzurnaa" (nZrn) carmoebulia,,nazara" (nZr) p`uz'isgan, rac` shexedvas, mzeris mipqrobasa da lodins nishnavs. gadmoc`emebis t`anaxmad, t`avdapirvelad, rodesac` sahabeebi shuamavalt`an midiodnen da mas st`xovdnen, rom quradg'eba mat`ken miepqro, - isini mimart`avdnen sitqvit`,,ra'inaa." es sitqva medinashi mc`xovreb iudevelt`a enaze an mat`shi gavrc`elebul arabul dialek`tze c`udi mnishvnelobit` gamoiqeneboda da amgvarad, mat` gauch`ndat` muhammed shuamavlis ashkarad lanz'g'vis sashualeba, romelsac` manamde p`arulad aket`ebdnen. isini mas mimart`avdnen sitqvit`,,ra'inaa" da ch`umad xit`xit`ebdnen. amitom uzenaesma allahma morcmuneebs moucoda, rom es sitqva ag'ar gamoeqenebinat` da mis nac`vlad misi sinonimit` -,,unzurnaa" - t`i miemart`at` shuamavlist`vis.

translations.translation: ar isurveben isini, vinc` ar ircmuna cignboz'ebult`agan[1] da arc` carmart`ni, rom t`k`venze siket`e ch`amoevlinos t`k`veni g'mert`isgan. allahi ki mxolod mas miakut`vnebs t`avis cqalobas, visac` moisurvebs. - allahia mp`lobeli udidesi cqalobisa.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,ahli'l-k`it`aab" (hl lktb): am terminshi igulisxmeba xalxi, romlebic` xelmz'g'vaneloben quranze adre ch`amovlenili g'vt`iuri cerilebit`. eseni arian iudevelebi da k`ristianebi: iudevelebi - t`evrat`is anu t`oras, xolo k`ristianebi injilis anu saxarebis xalxi arian. ert`-ert`i versiis t`anaxmad, g'vt`iurcignboz'ebult`a xalxis ric`xvshi shedian sabielebic`

translations.translation: romel aiat`sac` vauk`mebt`/vc`vlit`[1] an vavicqebinebt`, ch`ven mogvak`vs xolme imis scori an masze uket`esi. gana ar ic`odi, rom allahi namdvilad qovlisshemz'lea?!
translations.footnotes: [1] k`ronologiurad, shemdgom ch`amovlenili aiat`i shesaz'lebelia up`ro adre ch`amovlenili aiat`is brz'anebas an akrz'alvas auk`mebdes, an kidev axali dadgenilebit` c`vlides. am proc`ess,,nasxi" (nskh) ecodeba. arsebobs gamauk`mebeli/shemc`vleli,,nasixi" (nskh) da gauk`mebul/shec`vlili,,mansuxi" (mnskh) aiat`ebi. uzenaesi allahi kac`obriobis soc`ialur-kulturuli ganvit`arebisa da am ganvit`arebis shedegad carmok`mnili sachiroebebis shesabamisad axal shuamavlebasa da cignebs agzavnida, romlebic` cinandel brz'anebebsa da dadgenilebebs auk`mebdnen an c`vlidnen. cminda quranis ch`amovlenis drosac` zogiert` aiat`shi moc`emuli brz'anebebis an akrz'alvebis axali aiat`ebit` shec`vla/gauk`meba xdeboda. aset`i aiat`ebis raodenoba sakmaod mc`irea da z'irit`adad halal-harams da sxva c`xovrebiseul sakit`xebs exeba.,,nasix-mansuxi" ar shexebia iset` aiat`ebs, razec` islamis mrcamsia agebuli.

translations.translation: gana ar ic`i, rom mart`lac` allahs ekut`vnis c`at`a da dedamicis xelmcip`eba? - ase rom, aravinaa t`k`veni k`omagi da damxmare, garda allahisa.
an ik`neb gsurt`, rom (uadgilo da p`uchi) kit`xvebi dausvat` t`k`vens shuamavals ise, - ucin rom musas ekit`xebodnen? - ut`uod, scor gzas asc`ildes igi, vinc` rcmena gac`valos urcmunoebashi.

bevria msurveli cignboz'ebult`agan, rom t`k`veni rcmenis shemdgom (isev) urcmunoebad ukugak`c`ion, t`aviant` sulebshi damkvidrebuli shuris gamo - cheshmariteba rom gauc`xaddat`. mash, miutevet` da ganeridet`, vidre ar mova brz'aneba allahisa. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlisshemz'lea.
sheasrulet` namazi, gaec`it` zek`at`i da, t`k`veni sulebist`vis ra siket`esac` cinascar gaimzadebt`, - imasve hpovebt` allahis cinashe. cheshmaritad, allahi xedavs, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
da t`k`ves: veravin sheva samot`xeshi, garda imisa, vinc`aa iudeveli an nazarevelio. es mxolod oc`nebaa mat`i. ut`xari:,, t`uki namdvilad gulcrp`elni xart`, mash, moitanet` c`xadi mtkic`ebulebani''.

pirik`it`: - mist`vis, vinc` allahs daumorch`ila mt`eli t`avisi pirovnuloba da vinc` t`avad ars ket`ilmok`medi, - scored mist`visaa jildo t`avisi g'mert`is cinashe da arc` shishi ek`neba, arc`a mcuxareba.

aranair cheshmaritebas ar adganan nazarevelnio, - t`k`ves iudevelebma; aranair cheshmaritebas ar adganan iudevelnio, - t`k`ves nazarevelebmac`. arada isini (g'vt`iur) cigns kit`xuloben (sadac` msgavsi arap`eri uceriat`) da, mat`i sitqvis msgavsad imat`ma t`k`ves, - romelt`ac` arap`eri ic`ian (g'vt`iuri cignebis shesaxeb c`odna ar miug'iat`)... da gankit`xvis dg'es allahi gansjis mat` shoris imas, rashic` ut`anxmoebdnen.

vinaa imaze up`ro usamart`lo, romelic` abrkolebs samloc`veloebshi, rom ik` allahis saxeli ixseniebodes da miiltvis mat` dasak`c`evadac`. egeni sxvanairni ver unda shediodnen masshi, t`u ara shishit` shepqrobilni da, mat`t`visaa: amk`veqnad damc`ireba da imk`veqnad - sasjeli udidesi.
allahisaa ag'omsavlet`ic`a da dasavlet`ic` da, sait`kenac` mimobrundebit`, - ik` hpovebt` (kmaqop`il) saxes allahisa, cheshmaritad, - allahia qovlismc`odne, uuxvescqalobiani.
da t`k`ves: allahma shvili iqoliao. is qovlad unakloa[1]! - pirik`it`, - misia qvelap`eri, rac`aa c`at`a shina da dedamicaze; mas udreks k`eds qovelive;
translations.footnotes: [1] is aris srulqop`ili da gamoric`xulia, rom shvilis qola an sxva ram esachiroebodes.

translations.translation: - gamch`enelia c`at`a da dedamicisa da ris k`mnasac` gadacqvets, mas mxolod etqvis -,,iqav" da mashinve ik`neba.

da t`k`ves mat`, romelt`ac` arap`eri ic`odnen: ch`ven dagvlaparakeboda allahi an ert`i aiat`i mainc` mogvsvlodao. mat`ze adre mqop`nic` ase ambobdnen, amgvari sitqvebit`, da mat`i gulebic` - ert`manet`s daemsgavsnen... - mart`lac` nat`elvqavit` ch`ven aiat`ebi - g'rmadmorcmune xalxisat`vis.
uechvelad, ch`ven cargagzavnet` shen cheshmaritebit`, - xarebada da gap`rt`xilebad da, ar mogekit`xeba shen - c`ec`xlis binadart`a shesaxeb.

arc` iudevelni da arc` nazarevelni ar ik`nebian shenit` kmaqop`ilni, - vidre imat` rjuls ar gahqvebi. ut`xari:,,cheshmaritad, allahis mier mit`it`ebuli gzaa - gza cheshmariti". vp`ic`av, t`uki dahqvebi imat` gemovnebas mas shemdeg, rac` c`odna[1] mogivida, - ar geqoleba shen allahisgan arc`a k`omagi, arc`a damxmare.
translations.footnotes: [1] qurani

translations.translation: imat`, - vist`visac` cigni gviboz'ebia da g'irseuli kit`xvit` kit`xuloben mas, - scored imat` scamt` misi, xolo romelnic` uarqop`en, - egeni arian cagebulni.
ei, modgmav israelisa! ch`emi cqaloba gaixsenet`, romelic` t`k`vent`vis miboz'ebia, roc`a me t`k`ven samqarot`a[1] cinashe gamogarch`iet`.
translations.footnotes: [1] imdroindelisa

translations.translation: da ridi gk`ondet` im dg'isa, roc`a suli sxva suls verap`ershi emagivreba, arc` misi shuamdgomloba miig'eba, arc`a sadamxsnelo da verc` sxvisgan miig'ebs daxmarebas.

aki, zogi sitqvit`/brz'anebit` gamosc`ada ibrahimi t`avisma g'mert`ma da manac` sheasrula isini. g'mert`ma ut`xra: cheshmaritad, me shen dagadgen xalxis cinamz'g'vrado. ibrahimma ut`xra (st`xova) - ch`emi sht`amomavlebidanac`o (daadgineo). g'mert`ma miugo:,,ch`emi ag't`k`ma ar exeba usamart`lot`".

aki, es saxli (k`aaba) xalxis t`avsheqrisa da usap`rt`xoebis adgilad davadginet`, mash, ibrahimis nadgomidan[1] daidginet` samloc`velo. da ch`ven davavalet` ibrahimsa da isma'ils, rom ch`emi saxli ganecmindat`(kerpebisgan) imat`t`vis, vinc` tavap`s[2] aket`ebs, g'vt`ismasuxebas miec`a an ruk`ug'it`a da sejdet`ia dakavebuli.
translations.footnotes:
[1] originali -,,maqaamu ibrahiim" (mqm brhym): mup`essirt`a umravlesobis azrit`, es aris lodi, romelsac` ibrahim shuamavali `lyh lslm k`aabas kedlebis msheneblobis dros shemosadgomad iqenebda. dg'es es adgili k`aabas gverdit` sagangebo nishnit`aa ag'nishnuli da momloc`velebi ik` dadgomasa da loc`vas c`diloben. sxva versiis t`anaxmad, savaraudod, ak` igulisxmeba mt`eli mesjidi haramis teritoria da hajobis g'vt`ismsaxurebis shesasrulebeli sxva mnishvnelovani adgilebi, rogoric`aa arap`ati, muzdelip`a, jamarat`i, sap`a-merva da sxva.
[2] originali -,,tavap`" (Twf): k`aabas garshemovlis rituali. sunnet`is t`anaxmad, tavap`i k`aabas im kut`xidan icqeba, sadac` hajeru'l-asvadidia ch`atanebuli da sul shvidi shemovla ket`deba.

translations.translation: aki, t`k`va ibrahimma: g'mert`o, ak`c`ie es (mek`k`a) usap`rt`xo k`alak`ad da misi mkvidrni asazrdove (sxvadasxva) xileulit`, isini, vinc` allahsa da ukanasknel dg'es ircmunebeno. g'mert`ma miugo: mc`iredit`[1] imat`ac` vasargebleb, romelt`ac` (rcmena) uarqves, mere ki c`ec`xlis sasjelshi shesvlas vaiz'uleb... da ra c`udi samqop`elia mat`i saboloo misak`c`ieli.
translations.footnotes: [1] urcmunoebic` sazrdooben g'vt`isagan naboz'ebi amk`veqniuri sarch`ot`i, t`umc`a es sazrdo z'alze mc`iredia, vidre imk`veqniuri samot`xis udidesi cqalobani.

translations.translation: aki, ibrahimi da isma'ili rom saxlis (k`aabas) saz'irkvlebs amag'lebdnen (t`an ambobdnen): g'mert`o ch`veno, miig'e es ch`vengan, - cheshmaritad, shena xar qovlismsmeni, qovlismc`odneo.

g'mert`o ch`veno! dae, gvamqop`e (ch`ven orni) shenda morch`ilnad/muslimebad da shendami morch`ili/muslimi amqop`e t`emi - ch`veni sht`amomavlebisac`, gvich`vene ch`veni movaleobebi da mogviteve ch`ven, cheshmaritad, shena xar mimtevebeli da mcqalobeli.

g'mert`o ch`veno! cargzavne mat`t`an shuamavali mat`ive cridan, vinc` caukit`xavs shens aiat`ebs, ascavlis cignsa da sibrz'nes[1] da gancmindavs mat`. cheshmaritad, shena xar z'levamosili, brz'ent`a brz'eni.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,al-hik`met`" (lHkm@): misi pirdapiri shesatqvisia sibrz'ne. scavlult`a shoris ramdenime gansxvavebuli azri sup`evs hik`met`is raobast`an dakavshirebit`: 1. quranidan, dogmatikis shemc`veli aiat`ebis garda danarch`eni aiat`ebi, romlebic` religiur da amk`veqniur t`emebt`an dakavshirebit` sasargeblo c`nobebs sheic`aven. 2. hik`met`i aris sunnet`i 3. vahis gagebisa da prak`tikashi gatarebis undari 4. shuamavlist`vis damaxasiat`ebeli azrovnebisa da gansjis unari 5. shariat`iseuli dadgenilebebis c`odna da qvelap`risat`vis shesabamisi adgilisa da t`anrigis minicheba.

translations.translation: da vin ganudga ibrahimis rjuls, t`u ara is, vinc` ugunurad moek`c`a suls t`avisives? vp`ic`av, ch`ven is[1] amk`veqnad amovarch`iet` da usat`uod, is imk`veqnadac` sat`not`agania.
translations.footnotes: [1] ibrahimi

translations.translation: aki, mas ut`xra t`avisma g'mert`ma: iqavi morch`ilio/muslimio. man miugo: morch`ili/muslimi var samqarot`a g'mert`isao.

amit`ve daariga t`avisi shvilebi ibrahimma da ia'qubmac`:,,ei, ch`emo z'eno! cheshmaritad, t`k`vent`vis allahma (islamis) rjuli amoarch`ia, dae, nu mokvdebit` ise, rom t`k`ven ar iqot` muslimebi/morch`ilebi".

nut`u mocmeni iqavit`,[1] roc`a sikvdili ecvia ia'qubs? - rodesac` ut`xra t`avis shvilebs - vis et`aqvanebit` ch`ems shemdego? (mat`) miuges: ch`ven (mxolod) shens g'mert`s vet`aqvanebit`, - g'mert`s sheni mama-papisa, ibrahimis, isma'ilis da ishaqisa; - g'mert`s ert`adert`isa, da ch`ven misi morch`ilni/muslimni vart`o.
translations.footnotes: [1] aiat`i ch`amoevlina iudevelt`a pasuxad, rodesac` isini muhammed shuamavals eubnebodnen: nut`u shen ar ic`i, ia'qubi rom iudeveli iqo da t`avis shvilebsac` igive uanderz'ao.

translations.translation: eg aris t`emi - ac gardasuli. mat`ia is, rac` moixveches da t`k`venia is, rac` moixvechet`. ar mogekit`xebat` t`k`ven is, rasac` isini aket`ebdnen.
da t`k`ves:,,iqavit` iudevelni an nazarevelni, rom daadget` gzas cheshmaritebisa". ut`xari: - pirik`it`, - (unda iqo) hanip`i[1], ibrahimis rjulis mimdevari! is ar qop`ila carmart`t`aganio.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,hanip`i" (Hnyf): qovelgvari c`ru rcmenisgan da carmart`uli sak`misagan gandegili da urqevi monot`eizmit` cheshmaritebisken mltolvare.

translations.translation: ut`xarit`: vircmunet` allahi da is, rac`, ch`venze ch`amoevlina, aseve, rac` ibrahims, isma'ils, ishaqs, ia'qubs da (mis) sht`amomavlobas ch`amoevlina, rac` musasa da 'isas miec`at`, aseve, rac` mac`neebs miec`at` - t`aviant`i g'mert`isagan; mat`gan arc`ert`s ar ganvasxvavebt` da ch`ven misi morch`ilni/muslimebi vart`o.

t`u ise ircmunes, rogorc` t`k`vena gcamt` misi, mashin namdvilad cheshmarit gzas dasdgomian, xolo t`u piri ibrunes, uechvelad, did c`ilobashi ik`nebian. imat` cinashe - shent`vis allahi sakmarisia, ramet`u isaa qovlismsmeneli, qovlismc`odne.
allahis sag'ebavi[1]... - aba, vinaa sag'ebavis mp`lobeli - mjobni allahisaze? da ch`ven vart` - misi mot`aqvaneni.
translations.footnotes: [1] ibni abbasi ambobs: es aris allahis sarcmunoeba, romelic` allahma moixsenia, rogorc`,,sag'ebavi", radganac` morcmunes iolad sheemch`neva sarcmunoebis kvali ise, rogorc` samoss sheemch`neva sag'ebavis kvali. ix. t`ap`siru'l-beg'avi.

translations.translation: ut`xari: nut`u allahis (da misi rjulis) shesaxeb gvekamat`ebit`, is xom ch`veni da t`k`veni g'mert`ia? ch`venia ch`veni namok`medari da t`k`veni - t`k`veni namok`medari, xolo ch`ven - misi ert`gulni vart`o.

ik`neb ambobt`, rom ibrahimi, isma'ili, ishaqi, ia'qubi da (misi) sht`amomavlebi - iudevelni an nazarevelni iqvnen? ut`xari:,,t`k`ven uket` ic`it` t`u allahma"? vinaa imaze usamart`lo, vinc`a mocmoba damala, romelic` allahisgan iqo mast`an? xolo allahi araa ugulisquro imis mimart`, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
eg aris t`emi - ac gardasuli. mat`ia is, rac` moixveches da t`k`venia is, rac` moixvechet`. ar mogekit`xebat` t`k`ven is, rasac` isini aket`ebdnen.

xalxt`agan chkuasustni itqvian: ram sheabruna isini t`aviant`i qiblisgan,[1] romliskenac` iqvnen mimart`ulni?[2] miuge:,,allahisaa ag'mosavlet`ic`a da dasavlet`ic`; visac` moisurvebs, mas daakvalianebs gzisken - cheshmariti".
translations.footnotes:
[1] originali -,,qibla" (qbl@): loc`vis mimart`uleba; muslimt`a loc`vis mimart`uleba - k`aabas cminda samloc`veloa.
[2] allahis shuamavali t`avisi mk`adagebluri misiis pirvel clebshi mek`k`ashi qop`nisas namazis ag'sasruleblad ise dgeboda, rom k`aabac` da ierusalimshi mdebare aqsas mech`et`ic` mis cin qop`iliqo, xolo medinashi gadasaxlebis (anu hijret`is) shemdeg 16-17 t`vis ganmavlobashi - aqsas mech`et`is mimart`ulebit` loc`ulobda. hijret`is meore cels ch`amovlenili aiat`ebis sap`uz'velze ki muslimt`a qiblad (anu loc`vis mimart`ulebad) k`aabas cminda mech`et`i ganisazg'vra.

translations.translation: da amgvarad, zomier t`emad gak`c`iet`, rat`a mocmeni iqot` xalxis shesaxeb da shuamavalic` - t`k`vens shesaxeb iqos mocme. sxva arap`rist`vis dagvidgenia is qibla, romliskenac` iqavit` mimart`ulni, - t`u ara imist`vis, rom nat`elgveqo[1]: vin damqolia shuamavlisa da vin - ukan mibrunda, t`avisive k`uslebis mimrt`ulebit` (urcmunoebashi). didi sirt`ulea igi ut`uod, t`umc`a ara imat`t`vis, vinac` allahma cheshmariti gzit` daakvaliana. allahi ar dagikargavt` t`k`vens rcmenas,[2] cheshmaritad, allahi adamianebis mimart` usazg'vrod mcqalobeli da shembralebelia.
translations.footnotes:
[1] uzenaesi allahist`vis cinascar nat`elqop`ilia qovelive, vidre moxdebodes, t`umc`a am c`odnis gamo aravin miig'ebs sasjels an jildos, vidre t`vit`on adamiani ar moiqvans sisruleshi im kerz'o mok`medebas, razec` sasjeli an jildoa gat`valiscinebuli. ak` igulisxmeba am kerz'o sak`mis sisruleshi moqvana da cinascari c`odnis dadastureba, rac` sasjelis an jildos auc`ileblobas gamoicvevs.
[2] igulisxmeba aqsas mech`et`is mimart`ulebit` shesrulebuli namazebi.

translations.translation: ra t`k`ma unda, ch`ven vxedavt` sheni saxis zec`isken mimobrunebas da, rag'a t`k`ma unda, - migabrunebt` qiblisken, romlit`ac` kmaqop`ili ik`nebi. mash, aci saxe mesjidi haramisken[1] miak`c`ie; sadac` ar unda imqop`ebodet`, - (loc`vis dros) t`k`veni saxeebi misi mimart`ulebit` miapqarit`! da isini, romelt`ac` cigni eboz'at`, zustad ucqian, rom es[2] uzustesi cheshmaritebaa mat`i g'mert`isgan, xolo allahi ugulisquro araa imis mimart`, rasac` isini aket`eben.
translations.footnotes:
[1] originali -,,mesjid al-haram" (msjd lHrm): nakrz'ali mech`et`i; - igulisxmeba k`aabas cminda samloc`velo.
[2] qiblas shec`vla

translations.translation: da vp`ic`av, qvela mtkic`ebuleba romc` ach`veno, mainc` ar mihqvebian shens qiblas cignboz'ebulni[1]; arc` shena xar mat`i qiblis mimqoli; arc` ert`manet`is qiblas mihqvebian isini; vp`ic`av, t`uki ahqvebi imat` gemovnebas imis shemdeg, rac` ukve c`odnit` ag'ichurve, mashin, ut`ud, shen ik`nebi usamart`lot`agani.
translations.footnotes: [1] iudevelni da nazarevelni

translations.translation: isini, romelt`ac` cigni vuboz'et`, ise ic`noben mas[1], rogorc` sakut`ar shvilebs ic`noben. uechvelad, mat`gan zogiert`i shegnebulad malavs cheshmaritebas.
translations.footnotes: [1] muhammeds; mis shuamavlobas.

translations.translation: cheshmariteba sheni g'mert`isganaa da ar iqo imat`gani, vinc` orchop`obs.

qvelas t`avisi mxare (qibla) ak`vs, romliskenac` saxes miak`c`evs. mash, siket`isqop`ashi sheejibret` ert`manet`s. qvelas ert`ad shegkrebt` allahi, sadac` ar unda imqop`ebodet`; - cheshmaritad, allahi qovlisshemz'lea.

sadac` ar unda gaxvide (gzashi mqop`ma), saxe mimart`e mesjidi haramisken (loc`visas), - uechvelad, cheshmaritebaa igi sheni g'mert`isgan da allahic` - ugulisquro araa imis mimart`, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

sadac` ar unda gaxvide (gzashi mqop`ma), saxe mimart`e mesjidi haramis mxares (loc`visas) da sadac` ar unda iqot`, - misken miak`c`iet` t`k`veni saxeebi, rat`a (sakamat`o) sababi ag'ar hk`ondes xalxs t`k`vens cinaag'mdeg, garda imat`i, vinc` mat` shoris usamart`loa, da ar sheushindet` mat`, (mxolod) ch`emi geshinodet`, rat`a srulvqo ch`emi cqaloba t`k`vendami... da ik`neb cheshmarit gzas dasdgomodit` t`k`ven.

- rogorc` carmovgzavnet` t`k`vent`an shuamavlad ert`-ert`i t`k`venganive, romelic` gikit`xavt` ch`vens aiat`ebs, gcmendt` (qovelgvari uket`urebisgan) da gascavlit` cignsa da sibrz'nes, - gascavlit` imas, rac` ar ic`odit`.
mash, gamixsenet` da gagixsenebt`; memadlieret` da ar meumadurot`!
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! mot`minebit`a da namazit` ez'iet` g'vt`isshemceoba; - namdvilad, allahi momt`menebt`an ert`adaa.
da nu moixseniebt` mkvdrebad imat`, vinc` allahis gzaze daig'upnen. pirik`it`, isini c`oc`xlebi arian, t`umc`a t`k`ven ver gaac`nobierebt`.
vp`ic`av, ch`ven rag'ac`it` auc`ileblad gamogc`dit`: shishit`, shimshilit`, k`onebis, sult`a da naqop`t`a naklulobit`; - momt`ment` ki axare.
- romlebic` t`avs damtqdari ubedurebis zhams amboben: cheshmaritad, ch`ven allahs vekut`vnit` da ut`uod, ch`ven isev mas mivbardebit`o.
ai, egeni arian, viszec`aa mat`i g'mert`is loc`vani da cqaloba, da scored egeni arian cheshmarit gzaze mdgarni.

cheshmaritad, sap`a da merva[1] allahis (morch`ilebis) nishant`agannia. vinc` (k`aabas cminda) saxls ecveva hajobisa an 'umrast`vis, imist`vis c`odva ar ik`neba am oriveze (ces-ch`veulebisamebr) garsshemovla, xolo vinc` t`avisi survilit` izams siket`es, cheshmaritad, allahi madlieria, qovlismc`odnea.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,as-sap`a ve al-merva" (lSf w lmrw@): k`aabas maxloblad, mis ag'mosavlet`it` mdebare ori shemag'lebuli adgilis saxelebia. am mag'lobebs shoris mimosvla hajobisa da 'umras g'vt`ismsaxurebis ert`-ert`i mnishvnelovani ces-ch`veulebaa.

translations.translation: uechvelad, mat`, vinc` ch`ven mier ch`amovlenil c`xad mtkic`ebulebebsa da cheshmarit gzas malaven mas shemdeg, rac` xalxs cignshi ganvumartet` igi, - scored mat` scqevlis allahi da scqevlian macqevarni.
- imat` garda, vinc` moinanies (shec`domebi), gamoascores da gamoaashkaraves (rasac` malavdnen). ai, imat` mivuteveb, radganac` me var mimtevebeli da mcqalobeli.
uechvelad, imat`ze, vinc` ar ircmunes da urcmunoebadve daixoc`nen, - ai, scored imat`zea cqevla allahisa, angelozebisa da adamianebisa, qvelasi.
- mudmivad masshi[1] ik`nebian. mat` arc` sasjeli sheumsubuk`debat` da arc` shesvenebas daac`dian.
translations.footnotes: [1] cqevlashi.

translations.translation: da g'mert`i t`k`veni - ert`i g'mert`ia. ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda misi - mocqalisa, mcqalobelisa.

uechvelad, - c`at`a da dedamicis gach`enashi, dg'et`a da g'amet`a mimok`c`evashi, xalxis saket`ildg'eod zg'vad mimomc`urav gemebshi da imashic`, allahma rom c`idan cqlad ch`amoasxura da imis[1] sikvdilis shemdeg misit`[1] rom mica gamoac`oc`xla da qovelgvari suldgmuli masze mimop`ina, da c`asa da dedamicas shoris mimomk`rol k`arebsa da morch`ilad mimomsvlel g'rublebshi - nadmvilad sascaulebia gonieri xalxist`vis.
translations.footnotes:
[1] micis
[2] cqlit`

translations.translation: adamiant`a shoris arian iset`nic`, vinc` daidgines sxva t`anaziarnic`, garda allahisa, da ise uqvart` isini, rogorc` uqvart` allahi; xolo vinc` ircmunes, mat` uqvart` allahi - zeag'savsebit`. neta imat`, vinc` usamart`lod ik`c`evian, (ak`ve) - daenaxat` mt`eli z'alaup`leba, rogorc` sasjelis mig'ebisas dainaxeven. uechvelad, allahi mz'imesasjelosania.
roc`a isini, visac` hmorch`ilebdnen,[1] ganudgebian imat`, vinac` hmorch`ilebdnen; sasjels ixilaven da mat`i kavshirebic` daimsxvreva, -
translations.footnotes: [1] kerpebi da c`ru cinamz'g'vrebi, romlebsac` allaht`an at`anabebdnen.

translations.translation: mashin, vinc` hmorch`ilebdnen, isini amoiz'axeben: neta gvk`onoda ukan dabrunebis shesaz'lebloba da mat`gan t`avi shors dagvechira, rogorc` t`vit`on gangvidgneno. allahi imat` amgvarad uch`venebs t`aviant` namok`medars - mat`ive sananeblad, magram ver gamoag'ceven isini c`ec`xlidan.
ei, adamianebo! chamet` is, rac` sup`t`a da halalia dedamicaze da ar gahqvet` satanis nakvalevs, uechvelad, ashkara mteria is t`k`veni.
- is gibrz'anebt` mxolod avzneobasa da uket`urebas, da allahis shesaxeb imis t`k`mas, rac` t`k`ven ar ic`it`.

da roc`a mat` ut`xres: mihqevit` imas, rac` allahma ch`amoavlinao, miuges: aranairad! - ch`ven mivqvebit` imas, razedac` vpovet` ch`veni mamebio... - gana mainc`, mat` mamebs rom arap`eri gaegebodet` da arc` cheshmarit gzaze idgnen?
urcmunot`a mdgomareoba hgavs imis magalit`s, vinc` imas uqviris, visac` arap`eri esmis, garda moxmobisa da z'axilis gauazrebeli xmebisa.[1] qruni, munjni da brmani - egeni ver azrovneben.
translations.footnotes: [1] rogorc` c`xovels ch`aesmis mcqemsis xma, magram ar esmis misi sitqvebis shinaarsi.

translations.translation: ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! miirt`vit` is, rac` sup`t`aa (halali) da sazrdod gvicqalobebia t`k`vent`vis, da madliereba gamoxatet` allahis mimart`, t`u xart` t`k`ven misi t`aqvanismc`emelni.

is gikrz'alavt` mxolod leshs, sisxlsa da g'oris xorc`s, da imasac`, rac` sxvist`vis daikla, garda allahisa; xolo vinc` iz'ulebuli sheik`mnas da ar iurch`os da ar gadaametos, - mas c`odvad ar ek`mnas (akrz'alulis chama). cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobelia.

uechvelad, isini, vinc` malaven imas, rac` allahma ch`amoavlina cignit` da umc`ires sap`asurs g'ebuloben amit`, - ai, isini sxva verap`rit` amoiz'g'oben muc`lebs, garda c`ec`xlisa. amitom gankit`xvis dg'es ar daelaparakeba, ar gancmends mat` allahi... da mcare sasjeli - mat`t`vis!
egeni arian, vinc` gzaac`deniloba iqides cheshmariti gzis p`asad da sasjeli - shecqalebis p`asad... da ra momt`menebi qop`ilan c`ec`xlis mimart`!
- es imist`vis (daimsaxures), rom allahma cigni cheshmaritebit` ch`amoavlina, xolo isini, vinc` (am) cignis t`aobaze ut`anxmoeben, mart`lac` ushori-shores c`ilobashi imqop`ebian.

siket`e is ki araa, rom ag'mosavlet`it` an dasavlet`it` miak`c`iot` t`k`veni saxeebi, aramed isaa siket`e: vinc` ircmuna allahi, dg'e ukanaskneli, angelozebi, cigni, mac`neebi, da miuxedavad imisa, rom z'lier uqvars k`oneba, - mainc` urigebs - nat`esavebs, oblebs, g'atakebs, mgzavrebsa da mat`xovrebs, da gaig'eben tqveebis gamosasqidadac`; ag'asruleben namazs, gasc`emen zek`at`s da ert`guloben ag't`k`mas - rodesac` deben pirobas, da momt`menni arian - gasachirisa, avadmqop`obisa da omis sirt`uleebisa. ai, egeni arian ert`gulni da g'vt`ismoshishni.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! valdebulebad dacerilia t`k`venze - qisasi[1] (saigiveo) moklult`at`vis: t`avisup`ali t`avisup`lis cil, mona monis cil, k`ali k`alis cil. xolo visac` imisi z'misgan (moklulis chirisup`lisgan) epatios, - misi valia ket`ilad morch`ileba da sauket`eso saxit` anazg'aureba. es cqaloba da shemsubuk`ebaa t`k`veni g'mert`isgan, xolo amis shemdeg vinc` zg'vars gadava da usamart`lod moik`c`eva, - mcare sasjeli mist`vis.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,qisaas" (qSS): lek`sikonuri mnishvnelobit` igive p`ormit` samagieros gadaxdas an sasjels nishnavs. rogorc` termini - qisasi - danashaulisa da sasjelis t`anabrobas gulisxmobs, shariat`is t`anaxmad ki mkvlelis - moklulis sanac`vlod sikvdilit` dasjas; chrilobis miqenebis an organos mokvet`is shemt`xvevashi - damnashavis igivenairad dasjas nishnavs. qisasi - ag'nishnuli danashaulis ganzrax ch`adenisa da dazaralebulis mxridan sruli ag'srulebis mot`xovnis shemt`xvevashi xdeba auc`ilebeli. dazaralebuls sheuz'lia: qisasze uari t`k`vas, sisxlis gamosasqidi t`anxa moit`xovos an usasqidlod apatios.

translations.translation: ei, gonierno! t`k`vent`vis sic`oc`xlea saigiveos cesit` dasjadobashi (qisasi), - ik`neb ridi gk`ondet`.

t`k`venda savaldebulod dacerilia, rom t`u romelime t`k`vengani, sikvdilmoceuli (momakvdavi), tovebs sakmao k`onebas, - gonivrulad uanderz'os (dautovos) igi mshoblebsa da nat`esavebs; - valia es, g'vt`ismoshisht`a.
da vinc` mas shec`vlis imis shemdeg, rac` ukve moismina, uechvelad, - mat` ekisrebat` amis c`odva, vinc` mas shec`vlian. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlis msmeni da mc`odnea.

xolo vinc` shishobs moanderz'is mxridan (unebur) shec`domaze an usamart`lobaze da mat` shoris arsebul gaurkvevlobas gamoascorebs, - mas (es) c`odvad ar daekisros. cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! t`k`venda savaldebulod dacerilia marxva, - rogorc` dacerila t`k`venze adre mqop`t`at`vis, ik`neb ridi gk`ondet`.

(es marxva) gansazg'vruli dg'eebia, da t`u romelime t`k`vengani avad an mgzavrad mqop`ia, man imdenive dg'e sxva dg'eebshi imarxos; xolo mat`, visac` g'one shescevt` masze[1] (magram ar marxuloben), gamosasqidad ekisrebat` upovart`a dapureba; xolo vinc` damatebit` (dakisrebulze charb) ik`ms siket`es, es mist`visaa uket`esi... da rom ic`odet`: t`u imarxavt`, es t`k`vent`vis ik`neba umjobesi.
translations.footnotes: [1] originalshi -,,iutiiquunehu" (yuTyquwnahu): sitqvis pirdapiri mnishvnelobaa - shesaz'leblobis k`ona, shez'leba, g'onis shecevna. am sitqvis mnishvnelobast`an dakavshirebit` mup`essirebi ramdenime gansxvavebul azrs gamot`k`vamen. umravlesobis azrit`, es cinadadeba aris mansuxi, anu z'aladakarguli. sahabet`agan am azrze arian abdullah bin omari, seleme bin ek`va' da sxvebi. am shexedulebis t`anaxmad, islamis pirvel clebshi morcmuneebi arch`evanis cinashe idgnen: visac` surda - marxulobda, visac` surda - marxvis nac`vlad upovrebs apurebda. shemdeg ch`amoevlina momdevno aiat`i:,,t`k`vengan vinc` moescros am mt`vares, marxvit` gaataros igi." aiat`shi moc`emulma axalma cesma shec`vala z'veli da gaauk`ma arch`evanis dashvebuloba. qat`ades azrit`, es iqo g'rmad moxuc`ebult`a shesaxeb, romlebsac` sheez'lot` marxva, t`umc`a amit` did sirt`ules acqdebodnen. mat` hk`ondat` arch`evanis sashualeba, t`umc`a shemdeg es cesi gauk`mda. hasan al-basris azrit`, es iqo avadmqop`ebis shesaxeb: visac` avadmqop`obit` gamocveul sirt`uleebt`an ert`ad marxvac` sheez'lo, mat` hk`ondat` arch`evanis sashualeba - imarxavdnen, chama-smas gaagrz'elebdnen t`u gamosasqidis saxit` upovrebs daapurebdnen, t`umc`a es cesi shemdeg gauk`mda. scavlult`a nacili p`ik`robs, rom am cess ar daukargavs z'ala da es aris imat` shesaxeb, visac` axalgazrdobashi marxvis g'one shescevdat`, t`umc`a xandazmulobisas gauchirdat`. mat` marxvis nac`vlad upovart`a dapureba sheuz'liat`. ibni abbasi am sitqvas kit`xulobda, rogorc`,,iutevviquunehu" (yuTawWiquwnahu), rac` nishnavs - visac` marxva uchirs an z'livs shescevs amis g'one. sa'd bin jubeiris t`k`mit`, ak` igulisxmebian g'rmad moxuc`ebulebi da avadmqop`ebi, romelt`a gamojanmrt`elebis imedic` ar arsebobs. mat` evalebat` marxva, t`umc`a g'one ar shescevt`, amitom mat` sheuz'liat` gatexon marxva da qoveli dg'is sanac`vlod upovari daapuron. es ukanasknelebi amgvari ganmartebit` aiat`shi arsebul cess z'alashi mqop`ad miich`nevs. ix. beg'avisa da taberis t`ap`sirebi.

translations.translation: ramadanis mt`varea is, romelshic` qurani ch`amoevlina - adamiant`at`vis cheshmariti gzis mach`veneblad da scori gzis (mrudesgan) ganmasxvavebel c`xad mtkic`ebulebad. vinc` moescros am mt`vares t`k`vengan, - marxvit` gaataros igi, xolo vinc` avad an mgzavrad mqop`ia, man imdenive dg'e sxva dg'eebshi imarxos. ar unda allahs t`k`vent`vis siz'nele, - mas sheg'avat`i surs t`k`vent`vis, rat`a (iolad) ag'asrulebdet` gat`vlili odenobit` (gansazg'vrul dg'eebshi) da allahs ganadidebdet` imist`vis, rit`ac` cheshmarit gzaze dagaqenat`, ik`neb madlierni qop`iliqavit`.

da t`u ch`emi msaxurni ch`ems shesaxeb gkit`xaven, (ut`xari, rom) - cheshmaritad, me axlos var, shevismen mavedreblis vedrebas, roc`a shemt`xovs. mash, misminon me da scamdet` ch`emi, ik`neb scor gzas daadgnen.

marxvis g'ameebshi neba dagert`ot` t`k`vens k`alebt`an siaxlovisa. isini samoselnia t`k`veni da t`k`venc` samoselni xart` mat`i. allahma ic`oda, rom sakut`ar sulebs ug'alatebdit` (t`u nebas ar dagrt`avdit`, mainc` iurt`iert`ebdit`) t`k`ven, amitom miig'o t`k`veni sinanuli da mogitevat`. aci shegiz'liat` et`anac`xovrot` mat` da ez'iot` igi, rac` allahma dagicerat`. chamet` da svit`, vidre gant`iadis t`et`ri z'ap`i shavi z'ap`isagan[1] ganirch`eodes t`k`vent`vis da shemdeg sag'amomde marxva daic`avit`, da nu et`anac`xovrebit` mat`, roc`a t`k`ven i't`ik`ap`s[2] asrulebt` mech`et`ebshi... - eseni allahis sazg'vrebia da nu miuaxlovdebit` mat`. ase ganumartavs allahi xalxs t`avis aiat`ebs, rom ik`neb ridi hk`ondet` mat`.
translations.footnotes:
[1] aiat`shi xsenebuli shavi da t`et`ri z'ap`i dilis sinat`lesa da g'amis sibneles gulisxmobs.
[2] originali -,,i't`ik`ap`" (`tkf): ramadanis bolo at` dg'eshi ert`i an ramdenime dg'it` mech`et`shi g'vt`ismsaxurebist`vis ganmartoeba. i't`ik`ap`is shemsrulebeli mt`el dg'eebs g'vt`ismsaxurebashi atarebs, ik`ve chams, svams da z'inavs. mxolod sapirp`areshos, abdesisa da didi abdesist`vis sheuz'lia mech`et`idan gamosvla. i't`ik`ap`is shemsrulebeli amk`veqniur sak`meebs ivicqebs da mt`el dros loc`vas, quranis kit`xvas, zik`rs/allahis xsenebas da vedrebas ut`mobs.

translations.translation: ar sheuchamot` ert`manet`s k`oneba usamart`lod da ar mimart`ot` misi (k`rt`amis) gamoqenebit` mosamart`leebs - imist`vis, rom miit`visot` xalxis k`onebis nacili borotebit`, - ise, rom ic`odet` (rom es haramia).

gekit`xebian shen naxevarmt`varet`a shesaxeb. ut`xari, rom igia drois sazomi xalxist`vis da hajobist`vis. sat`noeba is ki araa, ukana mxridan shexvidet` saxlebshi,[1] aramed sat`nod is ik`c`eva, vinc` mokrz'alebulia. amitom saxlebshi shesasvleli karidan shedit` da allahis ridi gk`ondet`, rat`a bedniereba hpovot`.
translations.footnotes: [1] carmart` arabebshi gavrc`elebuli c`rurcmenis t`anaxmad, roc`a adamiani hajobis an umrast`vis ihrams sheimosavda, mist`vis am periodshi saxlshi karidan shesvla ar sheiz'leboda. amisat`vis isini saxlis ukana mxares arsebuli p`anjridan an sagangebo xvrelidan shediodnen.

translations.translation: allahis gzaze eomet` imat`, vinc` t`k`ven geomebat`, magram zg'vars ar gadaxvidet`,[1] cheshmaritad, allahs ar uqvars zg'vargadasulni.
translations.footnotes: [1] omis camocqebit`, k`alebis, bavshvebis, moxuc`ebis, umceoebis, mshvidobis momxreebisa da sasuliero pirebis daxoc`vit`

translations.translation: sadac` caacqdebit`, ik`ve daxoc`et` da gaqaret` ik`idan, saidanac` t`vit`on gamogqares, - p`it`na[1] uaresia, vidre daxoc`va, da ar eomot` mat` mesjidi haramt`an, vidre t`vit`on ar geomon ik`, xolo t`u isini dagicqeben xoc`vas, mashin t`k`venc` - daxoc`et`. aset`ia urcmunot`a sasjeli.
translations.footnotes: [1] urcmunooba, allahis nac`vlad kerpebis t`aqvanisc`ema da mek`k`adan muslimt`a gaz'eveba.

translations.translation: - xolo t`u shecqveten (p`it`nas), cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.
da manam eomet` mat`, vidre ar ag'moip`xvreba p`it`na da mt`lianad allahs ar miez'g'vneba sarcmunoeba, xolo t`u shecqveten (p`it`nas), mashin mtrobac` ag'ar gagrz'eldes, garda usamart`lot`a mimart`.

nakrz'ali mt`vare[1] nakrz'ali mt`varis samagieroa,[2] nakrz'alt`a darg'veva[3] ki qisass sachiroebs. vinc` t`k`ven shemogiteven, t`k`venc` igivenairad sheutiet`, rogorc` t`vit`on shemogities. ridi gk`ondet` allahisa da ic`odet`, rom cheshmaritad, allahi g'vt`ismoshishebt`anaa.
translations.footnotes:
[1] originali -,,al-shehr al-haram" (lshhr lHrm): nakrz'ali mt`vare; - saubaria konkretul mt`vareebze, romelshic` akrz'alulia omi, sisxlisg'vra da qovelgvari siave. mt`varis kalendaris mixedvit` esenia: pirveli - muharemis, meshvide - rejebis, met`ert`mete - zilqa'des da met`ormete - zilhijjes mt`vareebi.
[2] allahis shuamavali umras shesrulebis miznit` hijret`is meek`vse cels mek`k`asken gaemart`a. mek`k`as maxloblad hudeibias velze urcmunoebma cinaag'mdegoba gaucies da k`alak`shi shesvlis neba ar misc`es. gac`xarebuli kamat`is shemdeg muslimebsa da mushrik`ebs shoris islamis istoriashi metad mnishvnelovani sazavo xelshekruleba gap`ormda, romelsac` saxelad hudeibias sazavo xelshekruleba ecoda. ag'nishnuli xelshekrulebis ert`-ert`i muxlis t`anaxmad, muslimebi im cels mek`k`ashi ar unda shesuliqvnen, xolo momaval cels igive nakrz'al mt`vareshi muslimebs k`aabas monaxulebisa da umras shesrulebis neba miec`emodat`. uzenaesi allahis cqalobit`, meore cels muslimebs isev nakrz'al mt`vareshi umras shesrulebis shesaz'lebloba miec`at`, amgvarad, nakrz'ali mt`vareshi ag'srulebuli umra cina cels gac`denili nakrz'ali mt`varis samagierod ik`c`a.
[3] arsebobs ramdenime nakrz'ali, romelt`a xelsheuxeblobasac` ic`avs islami, nakrz'ali dro - esaa nakrz'ali mt`vareebi; nakrz'ali adgili - esaa k`aabas samloc`velo da misi shemogareni; nakrz'ali mdgomareoba esaa, rodesac` adamiani ihramit`aa shemosili da hajobis an umras ritualebs asrulebs; adamianis sic`oc`xlec` - aris xelsheuxebeli (nakrz'ali) da misi xelqop`is shemt`xvevashi qisasi xdeba auc`ilebeli. mushrik`ebma ag'nishnuli cesi daarg'vies da nakrz'al mt`vareebshi muslimebis shevicroeba daicqes, rit`ac` muslimebs qisasis cesit` t`avdac`visa da pasuxis gac`emis neba miec`at`.

translations.translation: xarjet` allahis gzaze da damg'upvel sap`rt`xeshi ar ch`aigdot` t`avi t`k`venive xelit`[1] da siket`e aket`et`, cheshmaritad, allahs uqvars ket`ilmorcmuneni.
translations.footnotes: [1] z'uncobit`, mocqalebis gaug'eblobit`, g'vt`is mimart` uimedobit`a da allahis gzaze brz'olaze uaris t`k`mit` sakut`ar sulebs damg'upveli sap`rt`xis cinashe nu daaqenebt`

translations.translation: mash, ag'asrulet` hajoba da 'umra allahist`vis, xolo t`u rame dagabrkolebt`[1] (mgzavrobisas), mashin shesaciri saklavi gagzavnet`, romelic` geadvilebat`[2], da ar gaiparsot` t`avi manamde, vidre ag'srulebis adgils ar miag'cevs shesaciri, xolo visac` t`avis ch`ivili ak`vs an avadaa (da gadaiparsavs), man marxvit`, mocqalebit` an shecirvit` gamoisqidos, da t`u t`avs igrz'nobt` usap`rt`xod da romelime t`k`vengani hajobamde 'umras sheasrulebs, man shesaciri daklas, romelic` eadvileba, xolo vinc` (shesaciris saxsrebi) ver hpovos, man sruli at`i dg'e imarxos: sami hajobis dg'eebshi da shvidi - roc`a dabrundeba (shin). es mat`t`visaa, visi ojaxic` ar c`xovrobs mesjidi haramt`an. ridi gk`ondet` allahisa da ic`odet`, rom uechvelad, allahi mkac`rsasjeliania.
translations.footnotes:
[1] mteri, avadmqop`oba da msgavsi uz'leveli mizezebi.
[2] ak`lemi, z'roxa an c`xvari.

translations.translation: hajoba garkveul mt`vareebshia[1]. vinc` mat`shi hajoba itvirt`os (ihramis shemosvit`), man ar miuaxlovdes k`als, ar iurch`os da ar ich`xubos hajobisas. ra siket`esac` ik`mt`, - ic`is allahma. mash, sagzali gaimzadet`, cheshmaritad, g'vt`ismoshishobaa sagzali sauket`eso. ei, gonierno, ch`emi ridi gk`ondet`.
translations.footnotes: [1] shevvali, zilqa'de da zilhijjes pirveli at`i dg'e.

translations.translation: c`odvad ar dagedot`, t`k`veni g'mert`is cqaloba t`u ez'iet` (hajobisas vachrobit`), xolo roc`a 'arap`at`idan[1] gaemart`ebit`, mash'ari haramt`an (nakrz'al nishnult`an)[2] allahi axsenet`.[3] mash, axsenet` igi, rogorc` uch`venebia t`k`vent`vis, ramet`u manamde t`k`ven iqavit` gzaac`denilni;
translations.footnotes:
[1] 'arap`at`is mt`a; qurban bairamis cina dg'es mzis amosvlidan mzis ch`asvlamde drois monakvet`is 'arap`at`is mt`aze loc`va-vedrebashi gatareba hajobis g'vt`ismsaxurebis ert`-ert`i auc`ilebeli ritualia.
[2] originali -,,al-mash'ari al-haram" (lmsh`r lHrm): pirdapiri t`argmanit` nakrz'al nishnuls nishnavs. es adgili aris muzdelip`a, sadac` hajobis ert`-ert`i ritualis shesabamisad hajebi/piligrimebi g'ames at`even, amitom es adgili aris nakrz'ali teritoria, sadac` akrz'alulia qvela is mok`medeba, rac` ekrz'aleba ihramit` shemosil hajis.
[3] sag'amos da z'ilis cina namazebi sheaert`et` da dilis namazis shemdeg gulmxurvaled evedret` allahs.

translations.translation: shemdeg gaemart`et` ik`it`ken, sait`ac` xalxi miemart`eba[1] da patieba shest`xovet` allahs. cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.
translations.footnotes: [1] shemdeg muzdelip`adan ik`it` gaemart`et`, sait`ac` ibrahim shuamavlidan moqolebuli, dg'emde miemart`eba xalxi, rat`a k`vebi isrolon, shesaciri daklan, sheasrulon tavap`i da sa'i anu sap`asa da mervas mag'lobebs shoris sirbilit` mimosvla, minashi gaataron t`ashriqis anu bairamis dg'eebi da ag'asrulon hajobis danarch`eni cesebi.

translations.translation: roc`a morch`ebit` t`k`vens ces-ch`veulebebs, mashin axsenet` allahi ise, rogorc` t`k`vens mamebs axsenebdit`, an up`ro amag'lebulad. adamiant`a shoris bevria iset`i, vinc` ambobs: g'mert`o ch`veno, mogvmadle (siket`e) amk`veqnado, da mas arap`eri ergeba imk`veqnad.
da mat` shoris bevria iset`ic`, vinc` ambobs:,,g'mert`o ch`veno, mogvmadle siket`e amk`veqnad da siket`e - imk`veqnadac`, da dagvip`are satanjvelisgan c`ec`xlisa".
scored mat`t`visaa xvedri imisa, rac` moig'vaces, da allahi mscrap`langarishmgebia.

da axsenet` allahi gat`vlil dg'eebshi[1]. vinc` ich`k`aros da or dg'eshi daasrulos (minashi ag'savleni g'vt`ismsaxurebani), mas c`odvad ar daedos, da vinc` gadados (mesame dg'ist`vis), arc` mas daedos c`odvad. es mist`vis, visac` ridi ak`vs allahisa. ic`odet`, rom mis cinashe ik`nebit` shekrebilni, usat`uod.
translations.footnotes: [1] kerz'od - bairamis cina dg'is dilis loc`vidan zilhijjes mt`varis c`ammetis samxrobis loc`vis ch`at`vlit` qoveli savaldebulo loc`vis shemdeg, k`vebis srolisas, shesaciravis dakvlisas da zogadad, am dg'eebis ganmavlobashi.

translations.translation: adamiant`a shoris bevria iset`ic`, visi sitqvebic` gxiblavs amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis shesaxeb da (vinc`) allahs imocmebs imaze, rac` mis gulshia, arada igi qvelaze ulmobelia mtrobashi.
- da gac`list`anave uket`urebas escrap`vis k`veqnad da c`dilobs, gaanadguros nat`esic`a da sht`amomavalic`. allahs ar uqvars uket`ureba.
da roc`a etqvian -,,geshinodes allahisa", - c`odva sheipqrobs ampartavnebit`urt`. mist`vis jojoxet`i sakmarisia! - da ra c`udi sarec`elia igi.
da adamiant`a shoris bevria iset`ic`, vinc` t`avis sulsac` ki gaig'ebs -allahis kmaqop`ilebis molodinit`. allahi t`avis msaxurt`a mimart` usazg'vrod mcqalobeli da shembralebelia.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! shedit` islamis srul morch`ilebashi da nu gahqvebit` eshmakis nakvalevs. uechvelad, igi ashkara mteria t`k`veni[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] gadmoc`emebis t`anaxmad, es aiat`i ch`amoevlina im cignboz'ebult`a shesaxeb, romlebmac` islami miig'es, t`umc`a mainc` agrz'elebdnen cina religiis zogiert`i cesis dac`vas.ix:t`ap`sirul tabari.

translations.translation: t`u (morch`ilebis gzidan) mainc` gadauk`c`evt` imis shemdeg, rac` ukve c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebi mogividat`, mashin ic`odet`, rom cheshmaritad, allahi uz'levelia, brz'enia.
nut`u marto imas moelian, rom allahi gamoec`xadebat` g'rubelt`a sach`rdilobelshi, da angelozebic`, - rat`a ganech`inos mat`i sak`meni? - sak`me qoveli allahs ubrundeba!
hkit`xe israelis modgmas, t`u ramdeni c`xadi aiat`i/sascauli gviboz'ebia mat`t`vis, da vinc` c`vlis allahis cqalobas, mas shemdeg, rac` miuvida igi, - cheshmaritad, allahi mkac`rsasjeliania.

vinc` ar ircmunes, - amk`veqniuri c`xovreba shemkobilia (mimzidvelia) mat`t`vis da vinc` ircmunes, masxrad igdeben mat`gan zogiert`s[1], da gankit`xvis dg'es amag'ldebian mat`ze isini, vinc` g'vt`ismoshishia, da visac` inebebs, allahi ucqalobebs sazrdos - ganuzomels.
translations.footnotes: [1] masxrad igdeben g'arib da uz'lur morcmuneebs. konkretulad es aiat`i ch`amoevlina abdullah bin mes'udis, iasir bin ammaris, suheib rumis, bilali xabeshis, habba bin eret`is da msgavsi g'aribi da uz'luri sahabeebis shesaxeb, romlebic` t`aviant`i sig'aribisa da uz'lurobis gamo gansakut`rebit` did shevicroebasa da damc`irebas acqdebodnen, vidre danarch`eni morcmuneebi. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: kac`obrioba iqo ert`iani t`emi, shemdeg allahma mac`neebi cargzavna - maxaroblebad da gamap`rt`xileblebad, da cigni ch`amoavlina mat`t`an cheshmaritebit`, rat`a adamianebs shoris ganesaja is, rashic` ut`anxmoebdnen, da sxva aravin ut`anxmoebda mat`shi arsebuli shuris gamo, t`u ara isini, visac` eboz'at` igi mas shemdeg, rac` miuvidat` c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebi. allahma morcmuneebs t`avisi nebit` scori mimart`uleba uch`vena im cheshmaritebisken, razec` isini ut`anxmoebdnen... da cheshmarit gzaze, visac` inebebs, - allahi imas daakvalianebs.

nut`u ggoniat`, rom samot`xeshi shexvalt` ise, rom ar mogescrebat` imis msgavsi, rac` t`k`venze adre mqop`t` moescrot`? - mat` t`avs daatqdat` ubedureba da ziani, da (ise) sheirqnen, rom shuamavali da mast`an ert`ad morcmuneebi ambobdnen:,,rodis ik`neba allahis daxmareba?"... da ic`odet`, rom allahis shecevna axlosaa.

gekit`xebian shen, t`u ra gaig'on mocqalebad, - miuge: ra mocqalebac` gaig'ot` k`onebis saxit`, - is iqos mshobelt`a, axlobelt`a, obolt`a, g'atakt`a da mgzavrt`at`vis; ra mocqalebac` gaig'ot` siket`is saxit`, - cheshmaritad, ic`is is allahma.

t`k`venda savaldebulod dacerilia omi, arada is mouconaria t`k`vent`vis, magram shesaz'loa, ar mogcondet` rag'ac` da is sasargeblo iqos t`k`vent`vis, da shesaz'loa, giqvardet` rag'ac` da is saziano iqos t`k`vent`vis. allahma ic`is, t`k`ven ki ar ic`it`.

gekit`xebian shen nakrz'al mt`vareshi omis shesaxeb, - miuge: masshi omi didi c`odvaa; (magram) allahis gzidan (xalxis) c`duneba/dabrkoleba; mis mimart` da mesjidi haramis mimart` urcmunoeba da ik`idan mis mkvidrt`a gaz'eveba - up`ro didi c`odvebia allahis cinashe, - p`it`na[1] up`ro didi c`odvaa, vidre kvla. (urcmunoebi) manam ar shecqveten oms t`k`vens cinaag'mdeg, vidre t`k`veni rjulidan ar gadagiqvaneben, t`uki shez'les, da t`k`vengan vinc` t`avis rjuls gadauxvios da mokvdes urcmunod, - scored mat`i nag'vaci gadaik`c`es ushedegod - amk`veqnadac` da imk`veqnadac`. ai, isini arian c`ec`xlis mkvidrni da ik` ik`nebian maradzhams.
translations.footnotes: [1] urcmunoeba, allahis nac`vlad kerpebis t`aqvanisc`ema da mek`k`adan muslimt`a gaz'eveba.

translations.translation: uechvelad, mat`, vinc` ircmunes, hijra[1] gaaket`es da allahis gzaze ibrz'oles, - ai, mat` ak`vt` imedi allahis cqalobisa. allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,al-hijrah" (lhjr@): sitqvis pirdapiri mnishvnelobaa gadasaxleba, emigrac`ia. islamis literaturashi es termini gamoxatavs ch`veni celt`ag'ric`xvit` 622 cels rcmenisa da ag'msareblobis t`avisup`lebis mopovebis miznit` muslimebis mek`k`adan medinashi gadasaxlebas. muslimebma medinashi gadasaxlebamde hijra orjer et`iopiashic` gaaket`es. islamis literaturashi aseve damkvidrebulia, hijras moraluri mxare, romelic` qvela muslims moet`xoveba, esaa: qovelgvari borotisgan gandegiloba. rogorc` muhammed shuamavali brz'anebs:,,muhajiri aris is, vinc` zurgi ak`c`ia im qvelap`ers, rac` allahma aukrz'ala mas"(buxari, iman 4/10.).

translations.translation: gekit`xebian shen g'vinisa[1] da azartuli t`amashebis shesaxeb, - miuge: oriveshi aris didi c`odva da (mc`ire) sargebelic` xalxist`vis, magram c`odva up`ro didia mat`shi, vidre sargebeli; da gekit`xebian, t`u ra gaig'on mocqalebad, - upasuxe: rac` gabadiat` qoveldg'iur sachiroebebze meti. allahi ase c`xadqop`s t`k`vent`vis aiat`ebs, rom ik`neb dap`ik`rebuliqavit`.
translations.footnotes: [1] ak` saquradg'eboa saxelcodeba g'vinis p`uz'e, romelic` originalshia gamoqenebuli. originalshi moc`emulia,,al-xamr" (lkhmr), rac` z'irit`adad g'vinos nishnavs da asec` vt`argmnet`. t`umc`a es sitqva carmoebulia,,x-m-r" (khmr) p`uz'isgan, rac` dap`arvas, gadap`arebas an damalvas nishnavs. g'vinos scored ak`edan gamomdinare ecoda xamri, anu sag'i gonebis damp`arveli an mat`robela. scored am garemoebis gat`valiscinebit`, qoveli mat`robela, rac` adamians jansag'i gonebisa da gansjis unars ukargavs, igivenairad p`asdeba, rogorc` g'vino. miuxedavad imisa, es mat`robela sasmelis saxit` miig'eba, sachmlis, nemsis t`u sasunt`k`i gzebit`.

translations.translation: - (allahi t`k`vent`vis c`xadqop`s aiat`ebs, rat`a gep`ik`rat`) amk`veqanasa da imk`veqnaze. da gekit`xebian shen, obolt`a shesaxeb, - upasuxe: mat`t`vis zrunva siket`ea da t`u gauert`iandebit`,[1] - z'mebi arian t`k`veni. allahi arch`evs uket`urs ket`ilisagan da mas rom ndomoda, gagirt`ulebdat` (mat`t`an urt`iert`obas). cheshmaritad, allahi uz'levelia; brz'enia.
translations.footnotes: [1] t`u ket`ili zraxvebit` gauert`iandebit`, t`k`vent`an ert`ad ac`xovrebt`, mat` k`onebas mat`i ket`ildg'eobist`vis daxarjavt` an t`k`vens k`onebast`an ert`ad mat` k`onebasac` gamoiqenebt` momgebian operac`iebshi da danazogs gauzrdit`.

translations.translation: ar sheirt`ot` carmart`i k`alebi, vidre ar ircmuneben[1], - morcmune mxevali umjobesia, vidre carmart`i k`ali, t`undac` t`k`vent`vis mosaconi; da arc` carmart` kac`ebs miat`xovot`, vidre ar ircmuneben, - morcmune mona umjobesia, vidre carmart`i kac`i, t`undac` t`k`vent`vis mosaconi. isini c`ec`xlisken moucodeben, xolo allahi samot`xisa da patiebisken moucodebs t`avisi nebit`, da c`xadqop`s xalxist`vis t`avis aiat`ebs, rat`a ik`neb sheignon da ar daivicqon.
translations.footnotes: [1] maide suras me-5 aiat`it`:,,t`k`vent`vis halalia patiosani k`alebi, mat`gan, visac` t`k`venze adre cigni eboz'at`"; muhammed shuamavlis sitqvit`:,,ch`ven virt`avt` cignboz'ebult`a k`alebs, t`umc`a isini ver sheirt`aven ch`vens k`alebs". muslimt`a saert`o azris t`anaxmad, am zogad dadgenilebashi ar shedis kerz'od - cignboz'ebult`a k`alebis mnishvneloba. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: gekit`xebian shen dedat`a cesis shesaxeb, - miuge: satkivaria igi, amitom moshordit` k`alebs dedat`a cesis dros da manamde ar miuaxlovdet` mat`, vidre ar gasup`t`avdebian, xolo rodesac` ganicmindebian, mashin mat`t`an midit` ik`it`ken, sait`kenac` allahma gibrz'anat`. cheshmaritad, allahs uqvars monanulni da uqvars gancmendilnic`.

t`k`veni k`alebi sat`esia t`k`vent`vis, amitom ise eaxelit` t`k`vens sat`est`, rogorc` genebot`[1] da t`k`veni sulebist`vis cinascar gaimzadet` (ket`ili sak`meebi). ridi gk`ondet` allahisa da ic`odet`, rom mis cinashe uechvelad carsdgebit`; morcmunet` ki axare.
translations.footnotes: [1] t`k`vens sat`ess, rogorc` genebot` ise eaxlet`, magram im gzit` eaxlet`, romelic` ik`neba naqop`ieri da sht`amomavlis momc`emi, rogorc` sat`esi.

translations.translation: nu moimizezebt` allahs - siket`is ket`ebis, g'vt`ismoshishobisa da xalxshi arsebuli ut`anxmoebebis gamoscorebis dabrkolebad - t`k`veni p`ic`is gamo, romelic` allahis saxelit` daip`ic`et`. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlis msmeni da mc`odnea.
translations.footnotes: [1] aiat`i ch`amoevlina mat` shesaxeb, vinc` allahze daip`ic`es, rom ama t`u im pirovnebast`an aravit`ar shemt`xvevashi ag'ar gaagrz'elebdnen urt`iert`obas da ar gaumart`avdnen mat` xels. shemdeg mizezad mohqavdat` allahis saxelit` dadebuli es p`ic`i da amit` amart`lebdnen siket`is k`mnaze t`aviant` t`avshekavebulobas.

translations.translation: ar gakisrebt` allahi pasuxismgeblobas p`uchsitqvovan (gauc`nobierebel) p`ic`ze, t`umc`a pasuxismgeblobas gakisrebt` imaze, rac` moixvecha t`k`venma gulebma. allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, lmobieri.
vinc` daip`ic`on, rom t`aviant` c`olebs ag'ar et`anac`xovrebian, - mat`t`vis lodini - ot`xi t`ve, xolo t`u daubrundnen, cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.
da t`u gaqra gadacqviton, cheshmaritad, allahi qovlis msmeni da mc`odnea.

k`margac`ilebulma k`alebma t`avi sheikavon (k`orcinebisgan) sami c`iklis vadit`[1]. mat`t`vis, - t`uki scamt` allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli, - nebadart`uli ar aris, aranairad, - imis damalva, rac` allahma gaach`ina t`aviant` sashvilosnoebshi[2]. am droshi mat`t`an dabrunebas t`aviant`i k`mrebi up`ro imsaxureben, t`uki gamoscorebas moindomeben. mat` (c`olebs) ak`vt` garkveuli up`lebebi, imis t`anabari, rogori pasuxismgeblobebic` akisriat` (k`mrebis cinashe), t`umc`a mamakac`ebi mat`ze mag'al sap`exurs p`loben[3]. allahi uz'levelia; brz'enia.
translations.footnotes:
[1] originali -,,quru'" (qrw): es sitqva vt`argmnet`, rogorc` c`ikli, radganac` mas ori mnishvneloba ak`vs - dedat`a cesis c`ikli da sup`t`ad qop`nis c`ikli. ak`edan gamomdinare es sitqva sahabet`a nacilma ganmarta, rogorc` dedat`a cesis c`ikli, nacilma ki sup`t`ad qop`nis c`ikli, rac` scavlulebsa da mezhebebs shoris azrt`a sxvadasxvaobas daedo sap`uz'vlad. ag'nishnulis gat`valiscinebit`, aiat`is t`argmanis mnishvnelobaik`neba - k`margac`ilebulma k`alebma k`orcinebisgan t`avi sheikavon dedat`cesobis an sup`t`ad qop`nis sami c`iklis vadit`.
[2] p`exmz'imoba an dedat`a cesi.
[3] es mag'ali sap`exurebia: ojaxis mmart`veloba da p`inansuri uzrunvelqop`a; jihadi da usap`rt`xoebist`vis zrunva; imamoba; memkvidreobidan ert`it` meti cili da msgavsi sakit`xebi, rac` mxolod mamakac`ebist`visaa dacesebuli.

translations.translation: gaqra (ukandabrunebis up`lebamosilebit`) orjeraa (nebadart`uli). amis shemdeg (k`marma): unda sheinaxos samart`lianad anda gaushvas siket`it`. imisgan (sach`uk`rebisgan), rac` mat`t`vis (c`olebist`vis) migic`iat`, arap`ris ukan ag'eba halali ar aris t`k`vent`vis, garda im shemt`xvevisa, t`uki orive shishobs, rom ver daic`aven allahis mier dadgenil sazg'vrebs[1], da t`u shishoben, rom ver daic`aven allahis mier dadgenil sazg'vrebs, mashin c`odvad ar daedebat` imis gamo, rit`ac` k`alma t`avi daixsna. ai, esaa allahis mier dadgenili sazg'vrebi da nu gadalaxavt` mas. vinc` allahis mier dadgenili sazg'vrebi gadalaxes, scored isini arian usamart`loni.
translations.footnotes: [1] t`u xasiat`t`a sheut`avseblobis gamo k`als ar uqvars k`mari da shishobs, rom mast`an darch`enis shemt`xvevashi ver daic`avs allahis mier dacesebul sazg'vrebs; aseve, k`maric` c`olis amgvari sak`c`ielis gamo shishobs, rom mast`an amgvarad c`xovrebis gagrz'elebis shemt`xvevashi ver daic`avs allahis mier dadgenil sazg'vrebs, - mashin k`mars sheuz'lia ukan daibrunos mt`liani an nacili mehrisa da c`ols gaeqaros.
