translations.translation: xolo imis shemdeg, - t`u k`als gaeqreba (mesamedac`), - mist`vis halali ag'ar ik`neba is (ukan daibrunos), vidre sxva k`mari ar sheirt`avdes, da t`u (es kac`ic`) gaeqreba mas, mashin mat` c`odvad ag'ar daedot` ert`manet`t`an dabruneba - t`uki p`ik`roben, rom (amis shemdeg) allahis mier dadgenil sazg'vrebs daic`aven. ai, esaa allahis mier dadgenili sazg'vrebi, rasac` c`xadqop`s xalxist`vis, romlebmac` ic`ian.

rodesac` k`alebs gaeqrebit` (pirvelad an meored) da t`aviant` vadas daasruleben[1], - an sheinaxet` isini samart`lianad an samart`lianad gaushvit`. ar sheinaxot` isini sazianod - zg'vars rom gadaxvidet` da up`lebebi sheulaxot`. vinc` es ch`aidinos, man mart`lac` usamart`lod moek`c`es sakut`ar t`avs. masxrad ar aigdot` allahis aiat`ebi da gaixsenet` allahis cqaloba, romelic` t`k`venze moig'o da cignisa da sibrz'nis saxit` rac` ch`amoavlina t`k`vent`vis da shegonebebs gikit`xavt` misit`. ridi gk`ondet` allahisa da ic`odet`, rom allahi, usat`uod, - qovlismc`odnea.
translations.footnotes: [1] 228-e aiat`shi xsenebuli k`orcinebisgan t`avshekavebis vada

translations.translation: rodesac` k`alebs gaeqrebit` da t`aviant` vadas daasruleben isini, mashin (k`alis meurveebma) ar shezg'udot`, rom kvlav sheirt`on t`aviant`ma (qop`ilma) k`mrebma, - t`u isev shet`anxmdebian cesisamebr da urt`iert`kmaqop`ilebas gamoxataven. shegonebaa es mat`t`vis, t`k`vengan romelt`ac` scamt` allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli. t`k`vent`vis es cmindaa da uket`esi, da allahma ic`is, t`k`ven ki ar ic`it`.

dedebi t`aviant` shvilebs srul or celicads acoveben z'uz'us, - mat`t`vis, visac` (romel gashorebul k`marsac`) surs, rom z'uz'ut`i srulad gamoikvebos. mama valdebulia, shemosos da gamokvebos isini (k`alebi) shez'lebisdagvarad. arc`ert` suls ar ekisreba imaze meti, rac` mas sheuz'lia. arc` deda dazaraldes t`avisi shvilis gamo da arc` mama... amis msgavsi akisria (bavshvis mimart`) memkvidresac` (mamis gardac`valebis shemt`xvevashi)... da t`u imsjeleben da urt`irt`shet`anxmebit` bavshvis z'uz'udan mocqvetas isurveben oriveni, es mat` c`odvad ar daedebat`. da t`u isurvebt`, rom t`k`veni shvilebi sxvisi z'uz'ut`i gamokvebot`, arc` amit` dagedebat` c`odvad, t`uki gadauxdit` imas, rac` misac`emi gak`vt` cesisamebr. ridi gk`ondet` allahisa da ic`odet`, rom usat`uod, - allahi xedavs imas, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

da vinc` gardaic`vlebian t`k`vengan da ukan datoveben c`olebs, mat` (k`vrivebma) ot`xi t`ve da at`i dg'e t`avi unda sheikavon[1], xolo rodesac` t`aviant` vadas daasruleben, - t`k`ven c`odvad ar dagedot` imis gamo, rasac` isini t`vit`on izmen (ag'nishnuli akrz'alvebidan) cesierebis sazg'vrebshi... da allahma ic`is is, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
translations.footnotes: [1] isini am drois manz'ilze unda moeridon: k`mris saxlis mitovebas, sunamosa da mort`ulobebis gamoqenebas, k`orcinebasa da k`orcinebaze saubars.

translations.translation: c`odvad ar dagedot` imis gamo, rom xelis t`xovnaze mianishnot` (gansazg'vruli - 4 t`ve da 10 dg'e - vadis gasvlamde) k`alebs an t`k`vens gulebshi gaip`ik`rot` (is). allahma ic`oda, rom t`k`ven mainc` gaixsenebdit` mat`... da arap`eri dahpirdet` p`arulad, garda imisa, rac` ut`xrat` cesierebis sazg'vrebshi, da ar moicadinot` sheug'lebis kavshiri, vidre ar dasruldeba ukve dacerili vada, da ic`odet`, rom allahma qvelap`eri ic`is, rac`aa t`k`vens sulebshi. mash, up`rt`xildit` mas da ic`odet`, rom allahi mart`lac` usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, lmobieri.

c`odvad ar dagedot`, t`u gaeqarot` k`alebs, romlebsac` jer ar shexebixart` an ar dagidgeniat` mat`t`vis mehri[1], magram raime sargebeli miec`it` mat`. gonivruli sargebeli rom gaig'on: shez'lebulma - t`avisi shesaz'leblobit` da g'aribmac` - t`avisi shesaz'leblobit`, - valia es ket`ilmorcmunet`a.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,mehr" (mhr): p`uli an/da sxva k`oneba, romelic` patarz'als sak`mrosgan gadaec`ema. sheug'lebast`an dakavshirebuli islamis cesebis mixedvit`, mxaret`a shet`anxmebit` gansazg'vruli mehri patarz'lis sakut`reba xdeba ert`pirovnulad da masshi veravin sheec`ileba.

translations.translation: t`u k`alebs manamde gaeqaret`, vidre mat` sheexebodet`, magram mat`t`vis mehri ukve dadgenili gak`vt`, mashin naxevari mat`ia imisa, rac` dagidgeniat`, garda im shemt`xvevisa, t`u (k`alebi) dat`moben an dat`mobs is, vis xelshic`aa sheug'lebis naskvi[1]. dat`moba da patieba up`ro axloa g'vt`ismoshishobast`an, da t`k`vens shoris arsebuli siket`e ar daivicqot`. cheshmaritad, allahi xedavs, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
translations.footnotes: [1] scavlult`a umravlesobis t`anaxmad, ag'nishnuli aiat`i sheug'lebis naskvis, anu sheug'lebis shet`anxmebis mp`lobelshi gulisxmobs k`mars, t`umc`a ibni abbasis mosazrebit`, ak` igulisxmeba k`alis meurve.

translations.translation: daic`avit` namazebi da (gansakut`rbit`) shua namazi[1], da morch`ilad dadek`it` allahis cinashe.
translations.footnotes: [1] scavlult`a umravlesoba miich`nevs, rom shua namazi aris samxrobis anu ik`indis loc`va. am shexedulebas amqarebs sahihi hadisic`, romelic` xendeqis brz'olis shesaxeb c`nobebs gadmogvc`ems. am ahdisshi, gadmoc`emis t`anaxmad, gac`xarebul omshi ch`art`ulma shuamavalma mzis ch`asvlamde samxrobis namazis shesruleba ver moaxerxa da damcuxrebulma carmot`k`va:,,dagvabrkoles shua namazisgan", ix. buxari, 4533, muslim, 627, abu davud, 409, ibni maje, 686. garda amisa, ramdenime gansxvavebuli mosazrebebic` arsebobs, romelt`a t`anaxmadac` zogi miich`nevs, rom esaa dilis loc`va, zogic` shuadg'is, sag'amos da z'ilis cina loc`vebs miut`it`ebs. amat` garda, arsebobs kidev ert`i sakmaod saintereso da sauket`eso mosazreba, romlis t`anaxmadac`, shua namazi t`avisi madlianobit` qoveldg'iur xut` namazs shoris qvelaze gamorch`euli namazia, t`umc`a uc`nobia, t`u romelia igi. uc`nobia, rat`a morcmuneebma ez'ion igi da sxva namazebsac` msgavsi gansakut`rebuli quradg'ebit` moekidon. magalit`ad, shariat`shi ramdenime aset`i saidumlo arsebobs: qadiris g'ame damalulia ramadanis mt`vareshi; qoveli vedrebis axdenis saat`i damalulia paraskev dg'eshi; al ismul azami, anu allahis uzenaesi saxeli - damalulia allahis 99 saxelshi, romelic` vedrebashi gamoqenebis shemt`xvevashi vedrebis axdenis mizezia. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: da t`u shishis k`vesh imqop`ebit` (mtris, mtac`ebeli c`xovelis an msgavsisa), mashin iloc`et` p`exit` mavalma an amxedrebulma, xolo roc`a t`avs usap`rt`xod igrz'nobt`, mashin ise axsenet` allahi, rogoc` mas t`k`vent`vis uscavlebia, rac` t`k`ven adre ar ic`odit`.

da vinc` gardaic`vlebian da ukan c`olebs datoveben, - mat`gan anderz'ia t`aviant`i c`olebist`vis - ert`i clis ganmavlobashi iqvnen uzrunvelqop`ilni saxlidan gausvlelad, xolo t`uki t`vit`on gavlen, t`k`ven c`odva ar gedebat` imis gamo, rasac` isini t`vit`on izmen cesierebis sazg'vrebshi[1]. allahi uz'levelia; brz'enia.
translations.footnotes: [1] scavlult`a umravlesoba miich`nevs, rom am aiat`shi mit`it`ebuli ert`cliani lodinis vada 234-e aiat`shi mit`it`ebuli ot`xi t`ve da at`i dg'it` sheic`vala, xolo ert`i clis ganmavlobashi qvela sachiroebit` uzrunvelqop`is valdebuleba memkvidreobis aiat`ma ch`aanac`vla.

translations.translation: gashorebul k`alebs ergebat` gonivruli sargebeli da es valia g'vt`ismoshisht`a.
ase c`xadqop`s allahi t`k`vent`vis t`avis aiat`ebs, - ik`neb gons mogebuliqavit`.

nut`u ar ginaxavs isini, vinc` iqvnen at`asobit` da (shavi chirit` an omit` mosalodneli) sikvdilis shishit` t`aviant`i samsholo miatoves? mashin allahma ut`xra mat`:,,daixoc`et`!", shemdeg isev gaac`oc`xla isini[1]. cheshmaritad, allahi mcqalobelia adamiant`a mimart`, t`umc`a adamiant`a umravlesoba umaduria.
translations.footnotes: [1] rogorc` scavlulebi gadmogvc`emen, es ambavi israelis modgmas gadaxda t`avs. didi albat`obit`, es unda miut`it`ebdes t`orashi gadmoc`emul ambavs, romelsac` qveba ezekiel shuamavali. ix. t`ora, ezekieli, 37/1-14.

translations.translation: mash, iomet` allahis gzaze da ic`odet`, rom cheshmaritad, allahi qovlis msmeni da mc`odnea.
vinaa igi, vinc` allahs asesxos sesxi[1] - sauket`eso? shemdeg gadauxdis charbit` - ut`valavmag. kvec`avs da ganavrc`obs allahi da t`k`ven mas daubrundebit`.
translations.footnotes: [1] g'vt`ivsat`nod gaig'os k`oneba an sic`oxle

translations.translation: nut`u ar ginaxavs mocinaveni israelis modgmidan, romlebmac` musas (gardac`valebis) shemdeg t`aviant` mac`nes[1] ut`xres: dagvidgine mep`e, rat`a allahis gzaze viomot`o. miugo: omi rom savaldebulod dagicesdet`, siurch`es xom ar gamoich`ent` - omze uaris t`k`mit`? mat` t`k`ves:,,ra unda dagvemart`os, rom allahis gzaze ar viomot` mashin, roc`a mogvglijes ch`vens shvilebsa da samshoblos?"... da roc`a omi savaldebulod daucesdat`, mashin piri ibrunes, garda mc`irednisa, t`umc`a allahi ic`nobs usamart`loebs.
translations.footnotes: [1] mup`essirebi ag'nishnul mac`nes vinaobast`an dakavshirebit` ramdenime gansxvavebul azrs ap`ik`sireben: qat`ades azrit`, es iqo iusha' bin nuun bin ep`raim bin iusup`i; suddis azrit`, es iqo shem'uuni; xolo mup`essirebi t`vlian, rom es iqo eshmuili (samoeli). ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: da ut`xra mat` t`aviant`ma mac`nem: cheshmaritad, t`k`ven mep`ed allahma talut`i dagidginat`o. mat` miuges:,,ch`ven rogor gvimep`ebs is, ch`ven xom masze metad vimsaxurebt` mep`obas, t`an arc` k`onebrivi siuxve mihmadlebia mas". (mac`nem) ut`xra: cheshmaritad, gamoarch`ia is t`k`venze allahma da z'lierebac` shehmata c`odnasa da sxeulshio... allahi mep`obas mas mianichebs, visac` inebebs; - allahia siuxvis momnichebeli, qovlismc`odne.

da ut`xra mat` t`aviant`ma mac`nem: cheshmaritad, misi mep`obis nishania kidobnis t`k`vent`an dabruneba,[1] masshia t`k`veni g'mert`isgan momavali simshvide; da musasa da harunis ojaxis danatovrisgan shemorch`enilni, romelsac` angelozebi moitanen. cheshmaritad, esaa t`k`vent`vis sascauli, t`u xart` t`k`ven morcmuneni.
translations.footnotes: [1] saubaria ag't`k`mis kidobanze, romelshic` t`ora da sxva cminda relik`viebi inaxeboda. israelis modgma am kidobans omebshi t`an daatarebda. rodesac` p`ilistimelebt`an brz'olashi damarc`xdnen, kidobani jalut`ma caig'o da didxans mat`t`an iqo datqvevebuli. talut`is mep`obis dros jalut`i daamarc`xes da talut`is mep`obis dasturad angelozebma kidobani mis samep`oshi daabrunes.

translations.translation: rodesac` talut`i jarit`urt` gamovida (k`alak`idan), t`k`va: cheshmaritad, allahi gamogc`dit` t`k`ven mdinarit`: vinc` dalevs ik`idan, is araa ch`emt`agan, xolo vinc` ert`i peshvis garda ar igemebs, scored isaa ch`emt`agano. magram mainc` dalies ik`idan, garda mat`gan mc`irednisa; da roc`a (mdinare) gadalaxa man da mast`an ert`ad mqop`ma morcmuneebmac`, - mat` t`k`ves:,,dg'es ch`ven jalut`sa da mis jarze (sherkinebis) g'one ar shegvcevs"; xolo visac` scamdat`, rom ut`uod shexvdebodnen allahs, mat` t`k`ves: allahis nebit`, ramden mc`ireric`xovan jars uz'levia mravalric`xovani jarist`viso... da allahi momt`menebt`an ert`adaa.
da roc`a jalut`sa da mis jars pirispir gauscordnen, t`k`ves: g'mert`o ch`veno! mot`minebit` ag'gvavse, p`exebi gagvimdgrade da urjulo xalxis cinaag'mdeg shegvecieo.

da allahis nebit` sz'lies mat`. mokla davudma jalut`i[1] da allahma mas mep`oba da sibrz'ne uboz'a, aseve, ascavla is, rac` mas surda. allahs rom ar sheekavebina xalxi - zogiert`it` zogiert`i, - ut`uod uket`ureba aiklebda k`veqnierebas, magram didad mcqalobelia allahi samqarot`a mimart`.
translations.footnotes: [1] didi albat`obit`, es miut`it`ebs t`orashi mot`xrobil brz'olas, sadac` davit`ma goliat`i daamarc`xa. ix. t`ora, I mep`et`a, 17.

translations.translation: es aris allahis aiat`ebi, rasac` shen gikit`xavt` cheshmaritebit`. cheshmaritad, shena xar shuamavalt`agani.

ai, shuamavlebi! upiratesvqavit` mat`gan zogiert`i - zogiert`is mimart`. mat` shoris arian iset`ni, visac` allahi esaubra da mat` nacils pativic` aumag'la, da meriemis z'e 'isasac` vuboz'et` c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebi da cminda sulit` (jibril angelozit`) ganvamtkic`et` igi. allahs rom eneba, ar daxoc`avdnen ert`manet`s mat` shemdgom mqop`ni, imis mere, rac` ukve miig'es c`xadi mtkic`ebulebani, t`umc`a ut`anxmoebashi ag'moch`ndnen, da mat` shoris arian iset`ni, vinc` ircmunes, da mat` shoris arian - vinc` uarqves. allahs rom eneba, ar daxoc`avdnen ert`manet`s isini, magram allahi ik`ms imas, rasac` inebebs.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! vidre dadgebodes dg'e, romelshic` arc` vachroba gachris, arc` megobroba da arc` shuamdgomloba, manam gaig'et` g'vt`ivsat`nod is, rac` t`k`vent`vis sarch`od gvicqalobebia. rac` sheexebat` urcmunoebs, - isini arian usamart`loni.

allahi... - ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda misi - marad c`oc`xlisa da msup`evisa; mas arc` ch`ast`vlems, arc` ch`aez'ineba; mis kut`vnilebashia, rac`aa c`at`a shina da k`veqanasa zeda; mis cinashe vin ishuamdgomlebs misive nebis gareshe?! man ic`is, rac` iqo mat` ucin da rac` ik`neba mat` shemdgom; mis c`odnashi verap`ers shescvdebian, garda imisa, rasac` t`vit`on inebebs; misi k`ursi[1] c`at`a da k`veqanas garemoic`avs da mas ar umz'ims dac`va mat`i; isaa uzenaesi da ubadlod didebuli.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,al-k`urs" (lkrsy): pirdapiri mnishvnelobit` esaa dasajdomi sashualeba, taxti, ert`manet`ze shemocqobili sap`exurebi, tribuna. allahis k`urst`an dakavshirebit` mraval sxvadasxva ganmartebebas vpoulobt`, romelt`agan mxolod ramdenimes moqvanit` shemovip`arglebit`, romelic` sahabeebsa da pirveli t`aobis scavlulebs ekut`vnit`: 1. abdullah ibni abbasisa da sa'd bin jubeiris gadmoc`emis t`anaxmad, es aris allahis c`odna; imami taberic` am shexedulebas irch`evs. 2. abu musas, suddis, dahhak`isa da muslim al-batiinis gadmoc`emis t`anaxmad, es aris adgili, sadac` g'mert`s p`exebi udevs. 3. hasan al-basris gadmoc`emis mixedvit`, k`ursi igivea, rac` 'arshi. ix. t`ap`siru taberi.

translations.translation: sarcmunoebashi iz'uleba ar arsebobs, ukve gamoerch`ia cheshmariteba c`domilebisgan. xolo vinc` uarqos tag'ut`i[1] da ircmunos allahi, is mart`lac` ch`aechidos mtkic`e rgols, romelsac` gacqveta ar uceria. allahi qovlis msmeni da mc`odnea.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,al-tag'ut`" (lTGwt): sitqvis p`uz'is mnishvnelobaa zg'varsgadasuloba, urch`oba an urch`obis gamomcvevi mizezi. z'irit`adad gamoiqeneba satanis, kerpis da qovelive imis ag'sanishnavad, rac` adamians g'vt`isken mimaval gzaze eg'obeba da g'vt`is nac`vlad t`avisi morch`ilebis arch`evans uk`mnis an am morch`ilebisken ubz'gebs; an imis ag'sanishnavad, rac` sheiz'leba gaxdes zg'vargadasulobisa da urch`obis mizezi.

translations.translation: allahi megobaria mat`i, bnelet`idan sinat`leshi gahqavs isini, - vinc` ircmunes, xolo vinc` ar ircmunes, mat`i megobari tag'ut`ia da sinat`elidan bnelet`isken mihqavs isini. ai, isini arian c`ec`xlis mkvidrni; isini ik`nebian masshi maradzhams.

nut`u ar ginaxavs igi, vinc` ibrahims t`avis g'mert`ze ekamat`eboda, raki allahma mas mep`oba ucqaloba? - roc`a ibrahimma ut`xra: ch`emi g'mert`i is aris, vinc` ac`oc`xlebs da akvdinebso, man miugo:,,mec` vac`oc`xleb da vakvdineb". ibrahimma ut`xra: cheshmaritad, allahs mze ag'mosavlet`idan amohqavs, shen ki dasavlet`idan amoiqvaneo. mashin gacbilda igi - urcmuno (ena ch`auvarda mas)... da ut`uod, ar daakvalianebs allahi usamart`lo xalxs cheshmarit gzaze.

an imis msgavsi (ar gsmenia), vinc` nasop`lars ch`auara, romelic` iqo dak`c`euli da ukac`rieli, da t`k`va: rogor gaac`oc`xlebs amas allahi sikvdilis shemdgom? mere ki allahma asi clit` moakvdina igi, shemdeg gaac`oc`xla da hkit`xa: ramden xans dahqavi? - miugo: ert`i dg'e an up`ro naklebio. ut`xra: ara, shen asi celi dahqavi. aba, shexede shens sachmelsa da sasmels, arc` gap`uchebula, da shexede shens saxedarsac`, (mogakvdinet` da gagac`oc`xlet`) rat`a sascaulad gk`mnat` xalxist`vis, da shexede z'vlebs, t`u rogor camovaqenebt` da xorc`s shevasxamt`... da roc`a mist`vis c`xadi sheik`mna, - t`k`va: uechvelad, vic`i, rom allahi qovlisshemz'leao.

aki, t`k`va ibrahimma: g'mert`o, mich`vene, t`u rogor ac`oc`xleb mkvdrebso. - ut`xra:,,nut`u ar gircmunia?" t`k`va: rogor ara, magram gulis dasamshvideblado. - ut`xra:,,mash, aig'e ot`xi p`rinveli, isini shent`an miich`vie, shemdeg daanacevre da mat`i nakucebi qovel goraze mimop`ante, shemdeg mouxme mat` da isini scrap`adve movlen shent`an. ic`ode, rom cheshmaritad, allahi uz'levelia, brz'enia."

mat`i sak`me, vinc` t`aviant` k`onebas allahis gzaze xarjaven, im marc`vlis magalit`s hgavs, romelmac` shvidi t`avt`avi gamoisxa - t`it`o t`avt`avshi asi marc`vlit`... - gaumravalkec`ebs allahi imas, visac` moisurvebs; - allahia uxvmcqalobi, qovlismc`odne.

mat`t`vis, vinc` allahis gzaze xarjaven t`aviant` k`onebas da cqenasa da qvedrebas ar miaceven imas, rac` gaig'es, - mat`t`visaa jildo t`aviant` g'mert`t`an, da arc` shishi elit`, arc`a damcuxrdebian (isini).
ket`ili sitqva da patieba umjobesia, vidre mocqaleba, romelsac` t`an sdevs cqena. allahi lmobieria, qovladmdidari.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar gaabat`ilot` t`k`veni mocqalebani cqenit`a da daqvedrebit`, imis msgavsad, vinc` xalxis dasanaxad xarjavs t`avis k`onebas da ar scams allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli. misi sak`me hgavs im sipi kldis magalit`s, romelzec` mica iqo c`otaodeni. shemdeg gadarec`xa kokispirulma cvimam da molipuli k`va datova mxolod. egeni arap`ers p`loben imisgan, rac` mat` mouxvechavt`. allahi urcmuno xalxs ar daakvalianebs cheshmarit gzaze.

mat`i sak`me, vinc` t`aviant` k`onebas allahis kmaqop`ilebis mosapoveblad da t`aviant`i sulebis gamqarebist`vis xarjaven, - hgavs magalit`s mag'lobze gashenebuli bag'isa, romelsac` uxvad acvims da ormagad met naqop`s iz'leva, xolo uxvad t`u ar acvims, mashin et`k`oreba. allahi xedavs, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

nut`u isurvebda romelime t`k`vengani, rom p`inikisa da vazis bag'i hk`onoda qovelgvari naqop`it`, romlis k`veshac` nakadulebi miedinebian, t`umc`a sibere mosceoda, sht`amomavlobac` umceo hqoloda, c`ec`xlovani k`arborbala dastqdomoda uec`rad da gadaecva (qovelive)? allahi ase c`xadqop`s t`k`vent`vis aiat`ebs, rom ik`neb dap`ik`rebuliqavit`.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! sauket`esot`agan gaig'et` mocqalebad - rac` moixvechet` da rac` micidan ag'movac`enet` t`k`vent`vis; ar daapirot` gac`ema mat`gan uvargisisa, risi amg'ebic` t`vit`on ara xart`, t`u t`vals ar daxuchavt` masze. ic`odet`, rom allahi k`ebulia, qovladmdidari.
eshmaki sig'aribit` gashinebt` da avzneobisken[1] mogicodebt`, xolo allahi patiebasa da cqalobas gpirdebat` t`avisi ciag'idan. allahia uxvmcqalobi, qovlismc`odne.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,al-p`ahshaau" (lfHsh): vt`argmnet`, rogorc` avzneoba. k`elbi ambobs, rom quranshi am aiat`is garda qvelgan, sadac` es sitqvaa gamoqenebuli, - mrushoba igulisxmeba. ix. t`ap`siru bag'avi.

translations.translation: - sibrz'nes anichebs mas, visac` inebebs, xolo visac` sibrz'ne eboz'a, uechvelad, mas bevri siket`e miec`a, t`umc`a amaze sxva aravin dap`ik`rdeba, garda goniert`a.
ra mocqalebac` gagig'iat` an ra ag't`k`mac` dagidviat`, cheshmaritad, -allahma ic`is qvelap`eri, xolo usamart`lot`a damxmare - aravinaa.

mocqalebas t`u ashkarad gaig'ebt`, es - kargi, xolo t`u mas p`arulad gasc`emt` g'aribebze, es - sauket`eso ik`neba t`k`vent`vis, da dap`aravs t`k`vens uket`urebebs. allahi mc`odnea im qvelap`risa, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

ar gakisria shen mat`i cheshmarit gzaze daqeneba, aramed allahi daaqenebs cheshmarit gzaze mas, visac` inebebs. ra siket`ec` gaig'ot` mocqalebad, is mxolod t`k`veni sulebist`visvea. sxva rogor gaig'ebt` t`k`ven mocqalebas, t`u ara allahis kmaqop`ili saxis molodinit`. ra siket`ec` gaig'ot` mocqalebad, unaklod aginazg'aurdebat`, da ar shegexebat` usamart`loba.

(mocqaleba) g'aribebist`visaa, romelnic` mxolod allahis gzit` shemop`arglulan da (sarch`os maz'ieblebad) dedamicis zurgze ver gauvliat`. mat`i (g'aribt`a) mokrz'alebulobis gamo uvic`ebs hgoniat`, rom isini mdidrebi arian. shen mat` t`aviant`i saxeebit` gamoic`nob - isini ar st`xoven[1] xalxs t`avxedurad... da ra siket`esac` gaig'ebt` mocqalebad, cheshmaritad, - ic`is is allahma.
translations.footnotes: [1] es aiat`i ch`amoevlina ahli sup`p`as shesaxeb: isini 400 kac`i iqvnen muhajirt`agan. mat` sakut`ari c`xovreba quranis sibrz'nis shescavlas da allahis gzaze brz'olas miuz'g'vnes. g'amit` - quranis shescavlit`, xolo dg'isit` - brz'olit` iqvnen dakavebulni. ak`edan gamomdinare, aiat`i vrc`eldeba qvela mebrz'olsa da islamis scavlulze, romlebsac` am cminda da diadi sak`mis gamo mosagebshi da sashovarshi casvla ar sheuz'liat`. ix. t`ap`siru'l-jelalein da t`ap`siru izz bin abdu's-selam.

translations.translation: - romelnic` mocqalebas gasc`emen t`aviant`i k`onebidan - dg'isit` da g'amit`; p`arulad da ashkarad, - scored mat` g'mert`t`anaa jildo t`aviant`i, da mat` arc` shishi elit`, arc`a damcuxreba.

xolo isini, vinc` chams vaxshs, (gankit`xvis dg'es) sxvanairad ar camodgebian, t`u ara msgavsad[1] - eshmakis dartqmis shedegad chkuasheshlilebisa. es mxolod imitom, rom mat` t`k`ves - uechvelad, vachroba vaxshis msgavsiao, arada allahma vachroba sc`no nebadart`ulad, vaxshi ki akrz'ala... da mas, vinc` shegoneba miig'o t`avisi g'mert`isgan da xeli aig'o (mevaxsheobaze), - sherch`eba is, rac` iqo carsulshi da misi sak`me allahzea, xolo vinc` ukan daubrundes (mevaxsheobas), scored isini arian c`ec`xlis mkvidrni; isini ik`nebian ik` maradzhams.
translations.footnotes: [1] es adgili shesaz'lebelia orgvarad ganimartos: 1. mevaxsheebi gankit`xvis dg'es sap`lavebidan eshmakisgan dartqmis shedegad chkuasheshlilt`a msgavsad camodgebian. 2. mevaxsheebi, vaxshis ag'ebasa da met shemosavalze daxarbebulni, eshmakis dartqmis shedegad chkuasheshlilt`a msgavsad, cin dauxedavad da sheubraleblad c`diloben xalxis naop`lari groshebis ushromelad mit`visebas.

translations.translation: akninebs vaxshs allahi da amravlebs mocqalebas[1]. ar uqvars allahs arc`ert`i urcmuno da c`odvili.
translations.footnotes: [1] allahi akninebs da anadgurebs mevaxsheobit` mogebul haram k`onebas, romelsac` aranairi xvavi-barak`a ar moak`vs; xolo zek`at`isa da mocqalebis gemg'ebis halal k`onebas amravlebs da barak`as hmatebs.

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, romelt`ac` ircmunes, hk`mnes ket`ili, ag'asrules namazi da gaig'es zek`at`i, - mat` g'mert`t`anaa jildo t`aviant`i, da mat` arc` shishi elit`, arc`a damcuxreba.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` icmunet`! ridi gk`ondet` allahisa da miatovet` vaxshi, rac` dagrch`at` (asag'ebi), t`u xart` t`k`ven morcmuneni.

- da t`u mainc` ar moishalot`, mashin ic`odet` allahisa da misi shuamavlis mxridan gamoc`xadebuli omis shesaxeb; xolo t`u moinaniebt`, t`k`veni k`onebis z'iri - t`k`veni kut`vnilebaa. arc` sxvas moek`c`et` usamart`lod da arc` t`k`ven iqot` msxverpli usamart`lobisa.
t`uki siduxchireshia (mevale), mashin manamde adrovet`, vidre gadaxdis unari ek`nebodes, da t`u samocqalod dautovebt` (vals an mis nacils), es up`ro xeiriania t`k`vent`vis, rom ic`odet`.
geshinodet` im dg'isa, roc`a allaht`an ik`nebit` dabrunebulni. shemdeg qovel suls miegeba igi, rac` mas mouxvechavs, da ar sheexebat` mat` usamart`loba.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! t`u vals daidebt`[1] garkveuli droit`, mashinve ch`aiceret` igi. auc`ilebelia, t`k`ven shoris arsebuli garigeba ch`amcerma gaap`ormos samart`lianad. ar gadauxvios ch`amcerma imgvarad ch`aceras, rogorc` allahma ascavla mas. - ch`aceros, xolo ukarnaxos man, vinc` vali daido. eshinodes t`avisi g'mert`isa, allahisa, da arap`eri miaklos mas (scorad ch`aceras). xolo t`u chkuasustia an uz'luri, an kidev karnaxi ar sheuz'lia mas, vinc` vali daido, mashin misma meurvem ukarnaxos samart`lianad. ori kac`ic` daimocmet` t`k`vengan (garigebisas), xolo t`u ori kac`i ar ik`neba, mashin ert`i kac`i da ori k`ali, - im mocmet`agan, romelt`a mimart`ac` xart` kmaqop`ilni. t`u shec`deba ert`i-ert`i mat`gani (im ori k`alidan), - meorem sheaxsenos. ar shedrknen mocmeebi, rodesac` miicveven da arc` ch`acera daizaron valisa t`avisi vadit` - mc`ire ik`neba t`u didi. qvelaze samart`liania es allahis cinashe, qvelaze z'lieri - mocmobist`vis da up`ro xelsaqreli, rat`a echvi ar gagich`ndet`. xolo t`u xelze ivachrebt` ert`manet`shi, mashin c`odva ar gek`nebat`, t`u ar ch`aicert` mas. vachrobisas mocmeni daimocmet` imgvarad, rom arc` mcerals evnos da arc` mocmes, xolo t`u amgvarad ar ik`mt`, uechvelad, eg ik`neba ug'irsi sak`c`ieli t`k`vengan. allahis ridi gk`ondet`; - allahi gascavlit` t`k`ven; - allahia qovlismc`odne.
translations.footnotes: [1] vachrobis, sesxis an shekvet`is shedegad.

translations.translation: xolo t`u mgzavrobashi imqop`ebit` da ver poulobt` ch`amcers, mashin (valis sanac`vlod) mig'ebuli sacindaric` sakmarisia. t`u t`k`ven ert`manet`s endet`[1], mashin man, visac` endnen, ukan daabrunos amanat`i da ridi hk`ondes misi g'mert`is, allahisa. da ar damalot` mocmoba. vinc` mas damalavs, uechvelad, misi guli c`odvilia. ic`is allahma qvelap`eri, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
translations.footnotes: [1] t`u mevale endoba mas, visac` misi hmart`ebs da xelshekrulebis, mocmeebis an sacindris (giraos) gareshe andobs t`avis up`lebebs.

translations.translation: allahs ekut`vnis qvelap`eri, rac`aa c`at`a shina da rac`aa k`veqanasa zeda. t`und gaac`xadot`, rac`aa t`k`vens sulebshi, t`und damalot` igi, - allahi pasuxs gagebinebt` masze: apatiebs mas, visac` inebebs da dasjis mas, visac` inebebs[1]. allahi qovlisshemz'lea.
translations.footnotes: [1] patieba ik`neba misi cqalobis gamovlineba, xolo sasjeli - samart`lianobis shedegi.

translations.translation: shuamavalma ircmuna is, rac` mas t`avisi g'meg't`isgan ch`aevlina, - aseve morcmuneebmac` (ircmunes). ircmuna qvelam allahi, misi angelozebi, misi cignebi da mis mier carmogzavnili shuamavlebi. ar ganvasxvavebt` mis mier carmogzavnil shuamavalt`agan arc`ert`s. mat` t`k`ves:,,shevisminet` da davemorch`ilet`[1], g'meg't`o ch`veno, shegvicqale, shent`anaa saboloo misak`c`ieli".
translations.footnotes: [1] shevisminet` sheni sitqva da vmorch`ilebt` shens brz'anebas.

translations.translation: arc`ert` suls ar akisrebs allahi imaze mets, rac` mas sheuz'lia. mis sargod ik`neba, rac` moipova (siket`it`) an mis sacinaag'mdegod ik`neba, rac` moixvecha (uket`urebit`). g'mert`o ch`veno! ar gvagebino pasuxi, t`uki dagvavicqda an shevc`odet`. g'mert`o ch`veno! nu dagvdeb (ise) mz'ime tvirt`s, rogorc` dasde ch`venze adre mqop`t`. g'mert`o ch`veno! nu gvatvirt`av imas, risi zidvac` ar z'algviz's. mogviteve, shegvinde da shegvicqale ch`ven. shena xar ch`veni shemce da urcmuno xalxze gvamarjve.
elip` laam miim.
allahi... - ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda misi - marad c`oc`xlisa da msup`evisa.
nacil-nacil ch`amoavlina shenze cigni (qurani) cheshmaritebit`, damamocmeblad imisa, rac`aa mis ucinares; da ch`amoavlina t`evrat`ic` da injilic`.

- adre, - cheshmariti gzis mach`veneblad adamianebist`vis; da ch`amoavlina p`urqanic`[1]. cheshmaritad, vinc` uarqves allahis aiat`ebi, mat`t`visaa mz'ime satanjveli. da allahi uz'levelia, sazg'aurmgebi.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,al-p`urqan" (lfrqn): cheshmaritebis mc`darisgan, simart`lis tquilisgan, ket`ilis borotisgan, halalis haramisgan - ganmasxvavebeli mtkic`ebulebebi da nichi. ag'nishnuli daxasiat`ebidan gamomdinare, p`urqani aris quranis ert`-ert`i saxeli.

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, arap`eria dap`aruli allahist`vis - arc` dedamicaze da arc` zec`ashi.
igia, vinc` ise gsaxavt` sashvilosnoebshi, rogorc` nebavs. ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda misi - uz'levelis, brz'enisa[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] es aiat`i najraneli k`ristianebis sapasuxod ch`amoevlina, romlebic` amtkic`ebdnen, rom isa (ieso) iqo z'e g'vt`isa. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: igia, vinc` ch`amoavlina shenze cigni, masshia muhk`emi[1] aiat`ebi, rogorc` cignis dedaboz'i, da danarch`eni - mut`eshabihi[2]. isini ki, visac` gulebshi uzit` simrude, - p`it`nas gamocvevist`visa da mat`i ganmartebis survilit` mxolod im nacils mihqvebian, rac` mut`eshabihia[3], romlis axsnac` aravin ic`is, garda allahisa. g'rmadmc`odneni amboben: ch`ven gvcams is (qurani), qvela ch`veni g'mert`isganaao (muhk`emic` da mut`eshabihic`). sxva vin gaiazrebs amas, t`u ara gonierni.
translations.footnotes:
[1] originali -,,muhk`em" (mHkm): mqari, mtkic`e an urqevi. cminda quranshi muhk`emad icodeba qvela is sitqva da aiat`i, romelt`a mnishvnelobebic` imdenad c`xadia, rom damatebit`i ganmartebebis gareshec` gasagebia qvelast`vis da es t`avisive sic`xade gamoric`xavs gansxvavebuli ag'k`ma-gamoxatvis shesaz'leblobas.
[2] originali -,,mut`ashabih" (mtshbh): msgavsi. cminda quranshi mut`eshabihad icodeba qvela is sitqva da aiat`i, romlebic` damatebit`i ganmartebis gareshe, pirdapiri mnishvnelobit`, ar aixsneba; an qvela is sitqva da aiat`i, romelt`a axsnac` allahis garda aravin ic`is. es sitqvebi da aiat`ebi xshirad ert`droulad ramdenime gansxvavebuli axsna-gamoxatvis sashualebas iz'leva, ris gamoc` mas mut`ashabihi, anu msgavsi ecodeba. msgavseba imashi mdgomareobs, rom t`avisi mnishvnelobit` ramdenime sakit`xs ert`droulad emsgavseba da mat` shoris arch`evanis gaket`eba rt`uldeba.
[3] aiat`shi xsenebult`a vinaobis shesaxeb mup`essirebma ramdenime gansxvavebuli azri daap`ik`sires: rabi'i ambobs: eseni arian adamiant`a jgup`i najranisa, romlebic` muhammed shuamavals 'isa `lyh lslm shuamavlis shesaxeb ekamat`ebodnen. mat` aset`i kit`xva dasves: gana t`k`ven ar ambobt`, rom is aris allahis sitqva da suli misgan? rodesac` shuamavalma ut`xra - diaxo, mat` t`k`ves: ch`vent`vis es sakmarisia. es aiat`i scored am dialogis shemdeg ch`amoevlina. k`elbis gadmoc`emis t`anaxmad, eseni iudevelebi arian, romlebic` mut`ashabih aiat`ebze daqrdnobit` am ummet`is sic`oc`xlis xangrz'livobis gamoc`nobas c`dilobdnen. qat`ade, rodesac` am aiat`s kit`xulobda, ambobda, rom eseni ar vic`i sxva vin unda iqvnen, t`u ara xarijitebio. aseve, ert` ert`i versiis t`anaxmad, am aiat`shi qvela mobidat`e igulisxmeba. ix. t`ap`sirul beg'avi.

translations.translation: g'mert`o ch`veno! ar gagvimrudo gulebi, mas shemdeg, rac` cheshmarit gzaze dagvaqene[1], da cqaloba moig'e ch`venze sheni ciag'idan, cheshmaritad, shena xar uxvmcqalobi.
translations.footnotes: [1] mas shemdeg, rac` sheni cignis mimart`, muhk`emisa da mut`eshabihis ganusxvaveblad, mtkic`e rcmena gvicqalobe.

translations.translation: g'mert`o ch`veno! uechvelad, shen xar shemkrebi xalxisa im dg'ist`vis, romelshic` echvi ar arsebobs. cheshmaritad, ar daarg'vevs ag't`k`mas allahi.
cheshmaritad, mat`, vinc` ar ircmunes, t`aviant`i k`oneba da shvilebi verap`ers argeben allahis cinashe, da c`ec`xlis sacvavni ik`nebian isini.
msgavsad p`araonis modgmisa da imat`i, vinc` iqvnen mat`ze adre. mat` uarqves ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi, mere allahma sasjelit` sheipqro isini, t`aviant`i c`odvebis gamo. allahi mkac`rsasjeliania.
ut`xari mat`, vinc` ar ircmunes:,,auc`ileblad damarc`xdebit` da jojoxet`shi sheirekebit`!"... da ra c`udi sarec`elia igi.

mart`lac` saoc`reba iqo t`k`vent`vis im or jgup`shi, romlebic` ert`manet`s daupirispirdnen. mat`gan ert`i jgup`i allahis gzaze ibrz'oda, meore ki iqo urcmuno. isini t`aviant`i t`valit` xedavdenen, rom orjer metni iqvnen, magram allahi mas gaaz'lierebs shemceobit`, visac` inebebs. cheshmaritad, t`valsach`ino magalit`ia es mat`t`vis, visac` ganchvreta sheuz'lia[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] saubaria 624 clis 13 marts (hijret`is meore celi 17 ramadani) datrialebul brz'olaze, sadac` muslimt`a razmi 313 mebrz'olisgan shedgeboda, xolo mek`k`eli mushrik`ebi 900 kac`iani jarit` ibrz'odnen. es ori jari rogorc` ric`xobrivad, aseve samxedro ag'churvit`ac` iqo arat`anabari: muslimebs 2 c`xeni da 70 ak`lemi hqavdat`, xolo mushrik`ebs 100 c`xeni da 170 ak`lemi. muslimebi sabrz'olo iarag'ebisa da jachvis perangebis naklebobasac` ganic`didnen, t`umc`a allahis daxmarebit` am brz'olashi mainc` mushrik`ebi damarc`xdnen.

translations.translation: mokazmula da mimzidvelad k`c`eula adamianebist`vis k`alebis, shvilebis, ut`valavi ok`ro-verc`xlis, lamazi c`xenebis, shinauri pirutqvisa da saxnav-sat`esis mimart` siqvaruli. es qvelap`eri amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis droebit`i sargebelia, sauket`eso misak`c`ieli ki allaht`anaa.

ut`xari: gindat` gac`nobot` amaze uket`esis shesaxeb? vinc` (g'vt`is) moshishia, mat`t`vis samot`xeebi t`aviant` g'mert`t`anaa, romlis k`veshac` mdinareebi miedinebian da ik` ik`nebian maradzhams - gancmendili meug'leebit`a da allahis kmaqop`ilebit`. allahi msaxurt`a mxedvelia.
- mat`, romelnic` amboben:,,g'mert`o ch`veno! vircmunet` ch`ven, gvapatie ch`veni c`odvebi da dagvip`are c`ec`xlis satanjvelisgan".
momt`ment`, mart`alt`, morch`ilebs, mocqalebist`vis mxarjvelebs da gant`iadisas patiebis mavedreblebs.

daamocma allahma, rom ar arsebobs mis garda sxva g'vt`aeba, aseve amocmeben angelozebi da c`odnis mp`lobelni, romlebic` mtkic`ed ic`aven samart`lianobas. ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda misi - z'levamosilis, brz'enisa.

cheshmaritad, allahis cinashe (mig'ebuli) sarcmunoeba aris islami. visac` cigni eboz'at`, mat` moshurneobit` mxolod mas shemdeg gamoavlines ut`anxmoeba, rac` c`odna miec`at`[1]. da vinc` uarqop`s allahis aiat`ebs, cheshmaritad, allahi mscrap`langarishmgebia.
translations.footnotes: [1] k`elbim t`k`va: es aiat`i iudevelebisa da k`ristianebis shesaxeb ch`amoevlina, radganac` mat` islams zurgi sheak`c`ies. cignboz'ebult`a cinascar iqo namaxaroblebi muhammedis shuamavloba da es c`odna mat` ukve mig'ebuli hk`ondat`. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: da t`u shemogedaon, mashin upasuxe: pirovnuloba ch`emi - allahs davumorch`ile, da imat`ac` (daumorch`iles), vinc` ch`emi mimdevariao. da ut`xari mat`, visac` cigni eboz'at`, aseve, ucignurebs (carmart`ebs):,,t`k`venc` daemorch`ilet`?" - da t`u daemorch`ilnen, mashin c`xadia, cheshmarit gzaze damdgaran[1], xolo t`u piri ibrunes, cheshmaritad, sheni movaleoba mxolod micvdenaa. allahi msaxurt`a mxedvelia.
translations.footnotes: [1] rodesac` shuamavalma es aiat`i caikit`xa, cignboz'ebulebma t`k`ves, rom ch`venc` davemorch`ilet`o. am dros shuamavalma iudevelebs ut`xra: daamocmebt` rom 'uzeiri allahis msaxuri da shuamavalia? mat` t`k`ves: g'mert`ma dagvip`aros, rom 'uzeiri allahis msaxurad vag'iarot`o. aseve ut`xra k`ristianebsac`: daamocmebt`, rom 'isa aris allahis sitqva, misi msaxuri da shuamavali? mat` t`k`ves: g'mert`ma dagvip`aros, rom 'isa allahis msaxurad vag'iarot`o. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, vinc` uarqop`en allahis aiat`ebs, usamart`lod xoc`aven mac`neebs da xoc`aven im adamianebsac`, vinc` samart`lianobisken moucodebs, - miaxare mat` mcare satanjveli.
zustad egeni arian, romelt`a namok`medaric` uk`mad gadaik`c`a - amk`veqnadac` da imk`veqnadac`, da aravin hqavt` damxmare.
gana ver xedav imat`, visac` xvedri ergot` cignisa? aki, moixmes isini allahis cignt`an, rat`a mas ganesaja mat` shoris[1]? shemdeg piri ibruna ert`ma nacilma, da isini arian zurgshemk`c`evni.
translations.footnotes: [1] qat`ades shexedulebit`, es cigni iqo qurani, romlit` msajulobiskenac` moucoda muhammed shuamavalma iudevelebs, t`umc`a mat` amaze uari ganac`xades. ibni abbasis shexedulebit`, es cigni iqo t`evrat`i. muhammed shuamavalma mat` t`evrat`it` msajulobisken moucoda, t`umc`a mat` amas ar miuaxlovdnen, radganac` amit` mat`i interesebi ziandeboda. ix. t`ap`sirul beg'avi.

translations.translation: ase imitom ik`c`evian, rom t`k`ves: ver shegvexeba c`ec`xli ch`ven, garda ramdenime gat`vlili dg'isao[1]. amrigad, mat`ive shet`xzulma c`iliscamebam sheac`dina isini t`aviant` rcmenashi.
translations.footnotes: [1] mat`i t`k`mit`, es is ormoc`i dg'ea, rodesac` t`aviant`ma cinaprebma xbos kerps et`aqvannen.

translations.translation: da ra ik`neba mashin, roc`a shevkrebt` mat` im dg'es, romelshic` echvi ar aris, qvela suls srulad miezg'veba imis shesabamisad, rac` mas mouxvechavs, - da mat` ar sheexebat` usamart`loba (siket`eebis dakargvit` an daumsaxurebeli sasjelis matebit`)?

t`k`vi: g'mert`o ch`emo, mp`lobelo samp`lobelot`a! mas az'lev xelmcip`ebas, visac` inebeb da mas art`mev xelmcip`ebas, visac` inebeb; mas acinaureb, visac` inebeb da mas ak`veit`eb, visac` inebeb; shens xelt`aa siket`e qovelmxrivi, cheshmaritad, shena xar qovlisshemz'le.
g'ame shegqavs dg'eshi da dg'e shegqavs g'ameshi[1]; da c`oc`xali gamogqavs mkvdrisgan da mkvdari gamogqavs c`oc`xlisgan[2]; da ut`valav sazrdos ucqalobeb mas, visac` inebeb.
translations.footnotes:
[1] anu zap`xulshi dg'eebs agrz'eleb g'amis xarjze da zamt`arshi - g'ameebs agrz'eleb dg'is xarjze.
[2] ibni mes'udi, sa'id bin jubeiri, mujahidi da qat`ade ganmartaven: sic`oc`xle ch`ndeba spermis meshveobit`, rac` ar p`lobs sic`oc`xles, xolo sperma gamodis c`oc`xali arsebidan; ik`rime da k`elbii ganmartaven: c`oc`xali cicila gamodis usulo kverc`xisgan, xolo usulo kverc`xi gamodis c`oc`xali p`rinvelisgan; hasanma da 'atam ganmartes: morcmune gamodis k`aap`irisgan, aseve k`aap`iri gamodis morcmunisgan; zejjaji ganmartavs: mc`enare ag'moc`endeba gamxmari marc`vlidan, xolo gamxmar marc`vals iz'leva nedli mc`enare. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: ar daimegobron morcmuneebma urcmunoebi, nac`vlad morcmuneebisa, xolo mas, vinc` amas izams, - ag'aranairi kavshiri ek`neba allaht`an, garda im shemt`xvevisa, roc`a p`rt`xilobt` mat`mier xip`at`ze. da allahi gaxsenebt` sip`rt`xiles misdami[1], da allaht`anaa saboloo misak`c`ieli.
translations.footnotes: [1] misi sasjelis mimart`

translations.translation: ut`xari: gind damalet` da gind gamoamzhg'avnet`, allahma mainc` ic`is imis shesaxeb, rac` gak`vt` gulebshi; da isic` ic`is, rac`aa c`at`a shina da dedamicaze. allahi qovlisshemz'lea.

qovel suls, im dg'es, - cin daxvdeba t`avisi namok`medari, rac` t`u kargi uket`ebia da c`udi ch`audenia, da inatrebs, rom imasa[1] da mas shoris iqos usasrulo sishore. allahi gaxsenebt` sip`rt`xiles misdami; allahi t`avis msaxurt`a mimart` usazg'vrod mcqalobeli da shembralebelia.
translations.footnotes: [1] c`udi namok`medari

translations.translation: ut`xari[1]:,,t`u giqvart` t`k`ven allahi, mashin me gamomqevit`, rat`a uqvardet` allahsac` da mogitevot` c`odvebi. allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli[2] ".
translations.footnotes:
[1] ut`xari iudevelebsa da k`ristianebs, romlebmac` t`k`ves:,,ch`ven g'vt`is shvilebi da misi moqvareebi vart`"; da carmart`ebs, romlebmac` t`k`ves:,,kerpebs sxva arap`rist`vis vet`aqvanebit`, t`u ara allaht`an siaxlovis mosapoveblad"; aseve mat`, vinc` c`ru rcmenebze daqrdnobit` allahis siqvaruls ich`emebs.
[2] rodesac` es aiat`i ch`amoevlina, munap`iqt`a (p`arisevelt`a) t`avkac`ma abdullah bin ubeim t`avis megobrebs ut`xra:,,muhammedma misi siqvaruli allahis siqvarult`an gaat`anabra da gvibrz'anebs, ise gviqvardes igi, rogorc` k`ristianebma gadaacharbes meriemis z'e 'isas mimart` siqvarulshi". mat` aset` saubars mohqva momdevno aiat`is ch`amovlineba, sadac` allahma morcmuneebs misi da misi shuamavlis morch`ileba ubrz'ana. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: ut`xari:,,daemorch`ilet` allahsa da shuamavals", da t`u piri ibrunes, cheshmaritad, allahs ar uqvars urcmunoebi[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] abu hureira gadmogvc`ems, rom allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,ch`emi ummet`idan qvela samot`xeshi sheva, garda imisa, vinc` ampartavania. ik` mqop`ebma ikit`xes: o, allahis shuamavalo! vinaa ampartavani? man ut`xra: vinc` ch`emi morch`ilia, is samot`xeshi sheva, xolo vinc` meurch`eba, uechvelad, is ampartavnobs" (buxari, i't`isam 2/7280.).

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, allahma amoarch`ia (imdroindel) samqarot`a cinashe adami da nuhi, aseve, ibrahimisa da imranis modgma.
- rogorc` sht`amomavloba ert`manet`isa. allahi qovlis msmeni da mc`odnea.

aki, imranis k`alma t`k`va: g'mert`o! cheshmaritad, shent`vis shemomiciravs is, rac` ch`ems muc`elshia, vinc`, sxva qvelap`risagan gat`avisup`lebuli, - mxolod sheni msaxurebit` dakavdeba. mash, miig'e igi ch`emgan. cheshmaritad, shena xar qovlismsmeni, qovlismc`odne.

da roc`a dabada, t`k`va: g'mert`o! cheshmaritad, me davbade mdedrio. allahma kargad ic`is, rac` dabada. vazhi ar aris mdedris msgavsi da me mas davark`vi mariami. cheshmaritad, shemogap`areb shen, - masa da mis sht`amomavlobas, - gandevnili eshmakisagan.

iqabula t`avisma g'mert`ma ket`ili qabulobit`, ag'zarda igi mshvenieri mc`enaresavit` da daakisra masze mzrunveloba zek`erias. qovelt`vis, roc`a zek`eria mihrabshi shedioda mast`an, - sarch`os poulobda mis cin. sheekit`xa:,,o, meriem, shen es saidan gak`vs?" upasuxa:,,es allahisganaa". cheshmaritad, allahi uric`xv sarch`os ucqalobebs imas, visac` inebebs[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] zek`eria meriemis deidas k`mari iqo. rogorc` aiat`shia moc`emuli, cminda samloc`velos shecirul meriemze shuamavali zek`eria mzrunvelobda. meriemist`vis samloc`velos shignit` gamoqop`ili iqo patara ot`axi, sadac` z'irit`ad dros atarebda. aiat`shi es ot`axi moxsenebulia, rogorc` mihrabi. zek`eria rodesac` meriemis sanaxavad mihrabshi shedioda, mas ik` xvdeboda xili, romelic` im are-mareshi ar modioda. kidev up`ro gasaoc`ari is iqo, rom zamt`ris xili zap`xulshi da zap`xulis xili zamt`arshi xvdeboda. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: mashin t`avis g'mert`s sheevedra zek`eria[1]:,,g'mert`o, micqalobe sheni ciag'idan spetaki sht`amomavloba. cheshmaritad, shen xar shemsmeni vedrebisa".
translations.footnotes: [1] zek`eria shuamavals ar hqavda shvili, t`an am droisat`vis ukve sakmaod asakovani iqo. amitom p`ik`robda, rom mas shvili ag'ar gauch`ndeboda. am ambis shemdeg dap`ik`rda: g'mert`s, romelmac` mariams sezonis gasvlis miuxedavad sxvadasxva xileuli ucqaloba, ch`emt`visac` sheuz'lia, asakis gasvlis shemdeg shvili miboz'oso.

translations.translation: shemdeg, roc`a mihrabshi loc`ulobda, angelozebma[1] sheatqobines: cheshmaritad, allahi gmaxaroblobs iahias[2], rogorc` allahis mier movlenili sitqvis[3] damamocmebels, cinamz'g'ols, t`avshekavebuls da mac`nes sat`not`agano.
translations.footnotes:
[1] mt`avarangelozi jibrili.
[2] am saxelis dark`mevis mizezt`an dakavshirebit` scavlulebisgan ramdeni gansxvavebuli shexedulebaa gadmoc`emuli. saxeli iahia (yHy~) sic`oc`xles nishnavs, ak`edan gamomdinare, ibni abbasis azrit`, g'mert`ma es saxeli imitom daark`va, rom dedamisis unaqop`o da xandazmul sxeulshi axali sic`oc`xle ch`aisaxao; qat`ades azrit`, amis mizezi is gaxldat`, rom allahi mis guls rcmenit` ac`oc`xlebdao; zogis azrit`, mas es saxeli daerk`va, radganac` is sic`oc`xlis bolos shahidad ag'esrula, shahidebi ki c`oc`xlebad it`vlebiano. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi. k`ristianul cqaroebshi mac`ne iahia moxsenebulia, rogorc` ioane nat`lismc`emeli ix. luka, 1/5-24.
[3] umravlesobis mixedvit` ak` igulisxmeba 'isa z'e meriemisa. 'isas ert`-ert`i saxelia allahis sitqva, radganac` is umamod gach`nda allahis sitqvit`, rodesac` mas ubrz'ana,,gach`ndi" da isic` gach`nda. abu ubeidas azrit`, es aris allahis cigni da misi aiat`ebi. t`umc`a ar aris gamoric`xuli orives ert`ad gulisxmobdes. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: - t`k`va[1]:,,g'mert`o, vazhi rogor meqoleba, me xom sibere mecia da ch`emi c`oli unaqop`oa?" miugo:,,asea, allahi ik`ms imas, rasac` inebebs".
translations.footnotes: [1] gaoc`ebulma da gaxarebulma

translations.translation: (zek`eriam) t`k`va:,,g'mert`o, nishani momec`i". ut`xra: sheni nishani is aris, rom sam dg'es ar unda esaubro xalxs, garda minishnebebisa. xshirad axsene sheni g'mert`i da mis unakloebaze ig'ag'ade dg'is bolosa da dasacqisshi.
aki, angelozebma[1] ut`xres: ei, meriem! uechvelad, agirch`ia shen allahma, gangcminda da samqarot`a k`alebs shoris gamogarch`ia[2].
translations.footnotes:
[1] mt`avarangelozma jibrilma.
[2] meriemis t`avisi drois k`alebisgan gamorch`euloba imashi mdgomareobda, rom is gancmendili iqo dedat`a cesis, c`udi zneobisa da c`odvebisagan. man umamod, sascaulebrivad gaach`ina shvili. is iqo ert`adert`i k`ali, romelic` g'vt`is saloc`avs miuz'g'vnes, rogorc` t`avisup`ali g'vt`ismsaxuri.

translations.translation: ei, meriem! mocicebit` hmorch`ilebde shens g'mert`s, daemxe sejdeze da moixare ruk`u'ze - ruk`u'ze mqop`ebt`an ert`ad.

(o, muhammed!) esaa (shent`vis) uxilav ambavt`agan, romelsac` vahit` gac`nobebt`. ar qop`ilxar shen momscre, roc`a isini kalmebs isvrodnen imis cilisqrist`vis, t`u romeli ikisrebda meriemis mzrunvelobas; da arc` mashin iqavi mat`t`an ert`ad, rodesac` ut`anxmoebdnen.

aki angelozebma[1] ut`xres: ei, meriem! cheshmaritad, allahi gmaxaroblobs t`avis sitqvas, romlis saxelia mesihi 'isa z'e meriemisa. ik`neba is g'irseuli amk`veqnadac` da imk`veqnadac`, da ert`-ert`i - daaxloebult`agan (g'mert`t`an).
translations.footnotes: [1] mt`avarangelozi jibrili.

translations.translation: - igi xalxs daelaparakeba akvanshic`[1] da zrdasrul asakshic`[2], da ik`neba ert`-ert`i sat`not`agan.
translations.footnotes:
[1] axalshobilma 'isam (`lyh lslm) sascaulebrivad amoidga ena da mariamis umcikvloeba g'ag'ad hqo, aseve, man ganac`xada, rom is iqo allahis msaxuri; rom allahi mas cigns uboz'ebda da mac`ned ag'amag'lebda.
[2] originali -,,k`ahl" (khl): es sitqva zrdisa da ganvit`arebis dasasruls mig'ceul, z'alg'onit` savse asakobriv periods gamoxatavs. arabebi am sitqvit` im adamianis asakobriv mdgomareobas ag'nishnaven, vinc` 30-dan 40 clamde asakshi imqop`eba. zogiert`i scavlulis shep`asebit`,,,k`ehl"-i 40-dan 50 clamde asaks gulisxmobs. aiat`i gvamc`nobs, rom,,is xalxs daelaparakeba rogorc` akvanshi, aseve zrdasrul asakshic`." scavlulebi ramdenime savaraudo ganmartbas gvt`avazoben imast`an dakavshirebit`, t`u ras sheiz'leba migvanishnebdes es sitqvebi: 1. g'mert`ma amit` 'isas (`lyh lslm) dedas, anu mariams axara, rom misi shvili shuaxnis asakamde ic`oc`xlebda; 2. esaa misi samomavlo shuamavlobis cinascarmetqveleba; 3. es aiat`i gvesaubreba sascaulze, magalit`ad, ch`vilis saubari namdvilad didi sascaulia, xolo shuxnis asakshi mqop`i adamianis saubari ch`veulebrivi movlena, rom ara - misi zec`idan dashveba da xalxis kvlav cheshmaritebisken mocodeba. 'isa shuamavali daaxloebit` 30 - 33 clis asakshi amag'lda, xolo k`ahlis periodi amis shemdeg icqeba.

translations.translation: (gakvirvebulma) t`k`va:,,g'mert`o, rogor meqoleba vazhi, roc`a kac`i ar shemxebia?" ut`xra: asea, - imas gaach`ens, rasac` inebebs; allahi, ris k`mnasac` gadacqvets, - mxolod etqvis mas:,,iqav!" - da umalve sheik`mneba.
ascavlis mas - cignsa da sibrz'nes; t`evrat`sa da injils.

- da shuamavlad carigzavneba israelis modgmast`an (da etqvis mat`): cheshmaritad, t`k`vent`an me t`k`venive g'mert`is sascaulit` movedi; cheshmaritad, talaxidan shevk`mni ch`itis gamosaxulebas, ch`avberav masshi suls da ch`itad ik`c`eva nebit` allahisa; da allahis nebit` ganvkurnav brmad dabadebulebs, ket`rovnebs, gavac`oc`xleb mkvdrebs, gaucqebt`, t`u ras miirt`mevt` da ras inaxavt` saxlebshi. cheshmaritad, eseni t`k`vent`vis sascaulebia, t`u xart` t`k`ven morcmuneni.

aseve (movedi) imis damamocmeblad, rac` iqo t`evrat`shi ch`emamde, da mat`gan nacilis halalad damceseblad, - rac` gk`ondat` akrz'aluli. sascaulebit` movedi t`k`venive g'mert`isgan, mash, ridi gk`ondet` allahisa da me damemorch`ilet`.
cheshmaritad, allahia ch`emi g'mert`ic` da t`k`veni g'mert`ic`, amitom mas et`aqvanet`, esaa scori gza.

roc`a sheamch`nia mat`shi 'isam urcmunoeba, hkit`xa:,,vin ik`nebian ch`emi damxmareni allahisken mimaval gzaze?" - mocap`eebma miuges: ch`ven vart` allahis damxmareni[1], vircmunet` allahi da daamocme shenc`, rom ch`ven vart` muslimebi/morch`ilebio.
translations.footnotes: [1] misi brz'anebebisa da akrz'alvebis ert`guli shemsrulebelni da misi cheshmaritebis mk`adagebelni.

translations.translation: g'mert`o ch`veno! vircmunet` is, rac` ch`amoavline da mivqevit` shuamavals, mash, ch`agvcere (cheshmaritebis) dammocmebelt`a rigebshi!
translations.footnotes: p`urqani: mup`essirebi am sitqvis ganmartebisas ramdenime gansxvavebul versiaze saubroben: a. umravlesobis azrit` esaa cheshmaritisa da sic`ruis; halalisa da haramis ganmasxvavebeli nichi. b. muhjahidis azrit` es t`oras meore saxelia. g. k`asais azrit` es cignis zedsart`avi saxelia, anu halalisa da haramis ganmasxvavebeli cigni. d. iaman bin raianis azrit` esa zg'vis gapobis sascauli. ix. t`ap`siru'l-beg'avii.

translations.translation: veraguli maxe gaamzades[1], da allahmac` gaamzada maxe (veragt`a sacinaag'mdegod), da allahia sauket`eso mat`gan, vinc` maxe gaamzades (- veragt`ave sacinaag'mdegod rom sheatrialebs maxes).
translations.footnotes: [1] 'isas mosaklavad

translations.translation: aki, allahma ut`xra: ei, 'isa! me var sheni momkvdinebelic`, ch`ems cinashe amamag'lebelic`a da urcmunot`agan mxsnelic`[1]. xolo mat`, vinc` sheni mimqolia, umag'lesvqop` urcmunoebze - dg'emde gankit`xvisa, bolos ki ch`emt`an dabrundebit` da ganvsji t`k`ven shoris imas, razec` ut`anxmoebdit`.
translations.footnotes: [1] rodesac` iudevelebi 'isas `lyh lslm sic`oc`xlis xelqop`as mzakvrulad gegmavdnen, allahma am sitqvebit` 'isas amc`no, rom mas mxolod allahi moakvdenda da sxva veras daaklebda. scavlult`a umravlesobis ganmartebit`, aiat`shi xsnebuli mokvdineba, zec`ashi amag'leba da urcmunoebisgan xsna-gancmenda k`ronologiuri t`anmimdevrobit` ar aris mot`xrobili. islamis scavlebis t`anaxmad, 'isa `lyh lslm zec`ashi sult`an da sxeult`an ert`ad, c`oc`xali amag'lda. is bolo zhams dedamicaze daeshveba da shemdeg moxdeba misi mokvdineba ise, rogorc` sxva adamianebi kvdebian. aseve aris ramdenime gansxvavebuli ganmartebac`, romlebic` sitqva,,mut`evep`p`iik`e"-s (mtwfyk) shesaz'lo sxva mnishvnelobebs eqrdnobian. am sitqvis pirdapiri da z'irit`adi mnishvnelobaa gardac`valeba. garda amisa, kontek`stis mixedvit`, shesaz'lebelia gamoqenebuli ik`nas shemdegi mnishvnelobebit`ac`:,,srulad ag'eba" an,,daz'ineba". ag'nishnuli mnishvnelobebidan gamomdinare mup`essirt`a nacili p`ik`robs, rom ak` igulisxmeba 'isas `lyh lslm dedamicidan sxeulit`a da sulit` mt`lianad ag'eba da zec`ashi amag'leba, scavlult`a nacils ki miach`nia, rom 'isam `lyh lslm g'vt`is nebit` daiz'ina da mz'inare mdgomareobashi moxda misi amag'leba. sura en'am-is 60-e aiat`shi allahi brz'anebs:,,igia, romelic` gakvdinebt` g'amit`", rac` igulisxmobs:,,igia, romelic` z'ils ggvrit` g'amit`".

translations.translation: xolo mat`, vinc` ar ircmunes, umkac`resad davsji amk`veqnadac` da imk`veqnadac`, da aravin hqavt` damxmare.
xolo isini, vinc` ircmunes da hk`mnes ket`ili, unaklod miig'eben t`aviant` sazg'aurs. allahs ar uqvars usamart`loni.
translations.footnotes: arabulad al-mann, k`art`ulshi damkvidrebulia, rogorc` c`iuri manana. mup`essirebi ramdenime gansxvaebul versiaze saubroben t`u ra igulisxmeba ag'nishnul sitqvashi. a. es aris g'vt`is boz'ebuli qvela sakvebis zogadi saxelcodeba, rac` qovelgvari sirt`ulisa da dag'lilobis gareshe moipoveba. a. es iqo t`ap`livit` tkbili sanovage, romelic` xeze moipoveboda. g. cqlit` gazavebuli dasalevi, romelic` t`ap`livit` tkbili iqo.

translations.translation: amgvaria brz'nuli shegoneba da aiat`ebi[1], rasac` shen gikit`xavt`.
translations.footnotes: [1] quranisa

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, allahist`vis 'isas mdgomareoba msgavsia adamis mdgomareobisa: micisgan shek`mna igi, shemdeg ut`xra -,,iqav!" - da igic` ik`mna[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] gadmoc`emebis t`anaxmad, es aiat`i najranel k`ristiant`a sapasuxod ch`amoevlina. mat` gaaprotestes 'isas `lyh lslm shesaxeb islamis scavleba, rom is allahis msaxuri da shuamavalia. mat` miach`ndat`, rom misi amgvarad shep`aseba, misi statusis dak`veit`eba da damc`ireba iqo. isini 'isas `lyh lslm umamod gach`enis p`ak`tze daqrdnobit` amtkic`ebdnen, rom is up`ro g'vt`aeba iqo, vidre adamiani, radganac` adamianebi umamod ar ch`ndebiano. scored amis sapasuxod ch`amoevlina ag'nishnuli aiat`i, romelic` mat` mc`dar shexedulebas abat`ilebs. g'mert`ma adami umamod da udedod gaach`ina, ase rom, mist`vis sheuz'lebeli arap`eria da arc` 'isas `lyh lslm umamod gach`ena gauchirdeboda.

translations.translation: cheshmariteba sheni g'mert`isganaa, mash, nu ik`nebi daechvebult`agan.

xolo mas, vinc` imis ('isas) shesaxeb shegedavos, mas shemdeg, rac` c`odna geboz'a, ut`xari:,,modit`, movuxmot` ch`vens vazhebsa da t`k`vens vazhebs, ch`vens k`alebsa da t`k`vens k`alebs, da ch`venc`a da t`k`venc` mxurvale vedreba ag'vavlinot`, rat`a allahis cqevla vaciot` matquarebs[1] ".
translations.footnotes: [1] gadmoc`emebis t`anaxmad, es aiat`i rom ch`amoevlina, shuamavalma gaiqvana t`avisi k`alishvili p`atima, siz'e - ali, shvilishvilebi - hasani da huseini, da najranel k`ristianebs ag'nishnuli vedrebisken moucoda, romlebic` 'isas shesaxeb shuamavals ekamat`ebodnen, t`umc`a najranelebma es ver gabedes. mat` bolos jizias gadaxdis pirobit` muslimt`a mmart`veloba ag'iares.

translations.translation: eseni cheshmaritad, mart`lac` namdvili ambebia. ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda allahisa da, uechvelad, allahia z'levamosili, brz'eni.
xolo piri t`u ibrunes, cheshmaritad, allahi ic`nobs uket`urebs.

ut`xari:,,ei, cignboz'ebulno! modit` shevt`anxmdet` sitqvaze, romelic` saert`oa ch`vensa da t`k`vens shoris, - rom aravis vet`aqvanot`, garda allahisa; arap`eri vut`anaziarot` da ar gavag'mert`ot` - vinmem vinme, - nac`vlad allahisa". xolo t`u piri ibrunes, mashin ut`xarit`: daamocmet`, rom ch`ven vart` muslimebi/morch`ilebio[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] es aiat`i mashin ch`amoevlina, rodesac` iudevelebic` amtkic`ebdnen, rom ibrahimi `lyh lslm iqo iudeveli da ch`ven misi gzis mimdevrebi vart`o, da k`ristianebic` amtkic`ebdnen, rom ibrahimi `lyh lslm iqo k`ristianio.

translations.translation: ei, cignboz'ebulno! ratom kamat`obt` ibrahimis shesaxeb? t`evrat`ic` da injilic` xom mxolod mis shemdeg ch`amoevlinnen, nut`u gonebas ar mouxmobt`?
ai, isini xart` t`k`ven, vinc` imis shesaxeb kamat`obdit`, rac` ukve ic`odit`, da ratomg'a kamat`obt` imis shesaxeb, ris c`odnasac` ar p`lobt`?[1] allahma ic`is, t`k`ven ki ar ic`it`.
translations.footnotes: [1] t`k`ven p`lobt` musa, 'isa da muhammed shuamavlebis `lyhm lslm shesaxeb c`odnas, romelic` t`k`venive cminda cignebshia moc`emuli, magram mainc` ver t`anxmdebit` da ar gcamt` sat`anadod; amis miuxedavad, ibrahim shuamavlis `lyh lslm (rjulis) shesaxebac` kamat`obt`, romelze c`odnac` ar gagach`niat` an shedarebit` naklebi ic`it`.

translations.translation: ibrahimi arc` iudeveli qop`ila da arc` nazareveli, aramed is iqo hanip`i muslimi/morch`ili, da ar qop`ila g'mert`ze t`anamziarebelt`agan.
cheshmaritad, ibrahimt`an qvelaze axlos mqop`ni is adamianebi arian, - vinc` mimdevaria misi; da am mac`nisa (muhammedisa); da isinic`, vinc` ircmunes. allahi megobaria morcmuneebisa.
cignboz'ebult`a ert` jgup`s t`k`veni c`duneba ganuzraxavs, magram ver ac`nobiereben, rom sxvas veravis ac`duneben, garda sakut`ari sulebisa.
ei, cignobz'ebulno! ratom uarqop`t` allahis aiat`ebs mashin, roc`a t`k`ven xart` mocmeni?
ei, cignboz'ebulno! ratom mosavt` cheshmaritebas sic`ruit` da malavt` mashin, roc`a t`k`ven ic`it`?
da t`k`va nacilma cignboz'ebult`agan: dg'is dasacqisshi ircmunet` is, rac` morcmuneebs ch`amoevlinat`, xolo dg'is bolos uarqavit` igi, ik`neb ukumoik`c`neno.

da aravis ercmunot` mat` garda, vinc` t`k`veni rjulis mimdevaria. (o, muhammed) ut`xari: uechvelad, cheshmariti gza allahis mier mit`it`ebuli gzaa. radgan sxvasac` (muhammeds) miec`a imis msgavsi, rac` (ert` dros) t`k`venc` mogec`at`, an radgan gedavebian da t`k`veni g'mert`is cinashe gamxelen, - ase imitom ik`c`evit`?[1] ut`xari: cheshmaritad, madli allahis xelt`aa da ucqalobebs mas, visac` inebebs. allahi uxvmcqalobia, qovlismc`odne.
translations.footnotes: [1] radgan cinadadeba pirdapir ar gvich`venebs, rom es sitqvebi iudevelebs ekut`vnis t`u muhammed shuamavals, -shesaz'lebelia aiat`is am cinadadebis ori gansxvavebuli mnishvnelobit` gageba da shesabamisad t`argmna. ch`ven mivich`niet`, rom es iqo muhammed shuamavlis sitqvebis gagrz'eleba da vt`argmnet` shesabamisad. meore versiis t`anaxmad, am cinadadebis t`argmani ik`neboda aset`i:,,arc` is ircmunot`, rom vinmes miec`a imis msgavsi, rac` t`k`ven mogec`at` da arc` is, rom gedavebian da gamxelen t`k`veni g'mert`is cinashe".

translations.translation: t`avis cqalobas is mxolod mat` miakut`vnebs, visac` moisurvebs. allahi udidesi cqalobis mk`onea.

cignboz'ebult`a shoris aris iset`i, visac` ut`valavi simdidre rom miando, - uklebliv dagibrunebs; da mat`ganaa iset`ic`, visac` ert`i dinaric`[1] rom miando, ar dagibrunebs mas, t`u t`avze ar daadek`i. ase imitom ik`c`evian, rom mat` t`k`ves: c`odvad ar dagvedeba, t`uki ucignurebs cavart`mevt`o. da shegnebulad tquian allahis shesaxeb.
translations.footnotes: [1] ok`ros moneta.

translations.translation: diax, vinc` uert`gula t`avis ag't`k`mas da iqo g'vt`ismoshishi, cheshmaritad, - uqvars allahs g'vt`ismoshishni.

cheshmaritad, vinc` mc`ire sap`asurze qidian allahis cinashe dadebul ag't`k`masa da p`ic`s, - isini veranair xvedrs ecevian imk`veqnad; gankit`xvis dg'es ar daelaparakeba mat` allahi, arc` shexedavs da arc` gancmends, da mcare sasjeli - mat`t`vis!

cheshmaritad, mat`shia (cignboz'ebult`a shorisaa) jgup`i, - t`aviant`i enit` rom c`vlian (g'vt`iur) cigns, rat`a cignierad gegonot` (mat`i sitqvebi), magram ar aris igi (g'vt`iuri) cigniseuli; da amboben, rom igi allahismieriao, t`umc`a ar aris allahismieri, da shegnebulad tquian allahis shesaxeb.

kac`ma, visac` allahma cigni, sibrz'ne da shuamavloba uboz'a, - gamoric`xulia, ut`xras xalxs, rom allahis nac`vlad ch`emi msaxurni iqavit`o; aramed (itqvis): rasac` cignze daqrdnobit` ascavlit` da mec`adineobt`, misi pirnat`lad shemsrulebeli scavlulni iqavit`o[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] es aiat`i najraneli k`ristianebis pasuxad ch`amoevlina, romlebic` amtkic`ebdnen, rom 'isam `lyh lslm mat` misdami t`aqvanisc`emisken moucoda da t`it`k`os amitom gaag'mert`es igi. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: arc` imas gibrz'anebt`, rom mac`neni da angelozni daidginot` g'mert`ebad. gana urcmunoebas gibrz'anebt` mas shemdgom, rac` ukve muslimebi/morch`ilebi xart`?

aki, mac`neebisgan aig'o ag't`k`ma allahma, rom t`k`vent`vis boz'ebuli (qoveli) cignisa da sibrz'nis shemdeg t`k`vent`an movidoda (axali) shuamavali, - dammocmebeli imisa, rac`aa t`k`vent`an, - romelzec` ut`uod unda dagejerat` da daxmarebodit`. (shemdeg) ut`xra: et`anxmebit` da g'ebulobt` am ag't`k`mas ch`emgan - t`k`venze pirobad camoqenebuls? t`k`ves: vet`anxmebit`o. t`k`va: mash daamocmet` da mec` vik`nebi t`k`vent`an ert`ad dammocmebelio.
- xolo vinc` piri ibruna shemdgom amisa, - scored isini arian ug'irsebi.
nut`u allahis rjulis garda sxva rjulsac` ez'eben, roc`a nebit` t`u uneburad mas hmorch`ilebs, rac` aris c`at`a shina da dedamicaze, da mast`an ik`nebian mibrunebulni?

ut`xarit`: vircmunet` allahi da is, rac` ch`venze ch`amoevlina, da isic`, rac` ibrahims, isma'ils, ishaqs, ia'qubs da (mis) sht`amomavlebs ch`amoevlinat`, rac` miec`a musas da 'isas, da rac` miec`at` mac`neebs, t`aviant`i g'mert`isgan. mat`gan arc`ert`s ar ganvasxvavebt`, da ch`ven morch`ilni/muslimni vart` misi.
xolo vinc` islamis garda sxva rjuli ez'ios, - ar miig'eba igi misgan da gankit`xvis dg'es is ik`neba cagebult`agan.

rogor uch`venebs allahi scor gzas - xalxs, romlebmac` rcmena uarqves mas shemdeg, rac` ircmunes, daamocmes shuamavlis cheshmariteba da miig'es c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebi. allahi usamart`lo xalxs ar daakvalianebs cheshmarit gzaze.
scored mat`i sasjelia is, rom mat`zea cqevla allahisa, angelozebisa da adamianebisa, qvelasi.
- mudmivad masshi[1] ik`nebian. mat` arc` sasjeli sheumsubuk`debat` da arc` shesvenebas daac`dian.
translations.footnotes: [1] cqevlashi.

translations.translation: - garda mat`i, vinc` moinanies da gamoascores shemdgomshi. cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.
cheshmaritad, ar miig'eba mat`i monanieba[1], vinc` jer ircmunes, shemdeg uarqves rcmena da shemdeg umates urcmunoebasac`. scored isini arian gzaac`denilni.
translations.footnotes: [1] sikvdilis piras

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, mat`, vinc` uarqves rcmena da daixoc`nen urcmunod, - dedamicis avsebamde ok`ros gag'ebac` rom sheez'lot` gamosasqidad, - ar miig'eba igi arc`ert`i mat`ganisagan. scored mat`t`visaa mcare sasjeli da aravinaa mat`i damxmare.
siket`es[1] manamde ver ecevit`, sanam ar gaig'ebt` imisgan, rac` z'alian giqvart`, xolo ra mocqalebac` gaig'ot`, cheshmaritad, ic`is allahma imis shesaxeb.
translations.footnotes: [1] ibni abbasi, ibni mesu'udi da mujahidi gadmogvc`emen, rom ag'nishnuli siket`e aris samot`xe, xolo muqat`il bin haianis mixedvit`, ak` siket`eshi igulisxmeba g'vt`ismoshishoba. ix. t`ap`sirul beg'avi.

translations.translation: israelis z'et`at`vis t`evrat`is ch`amovlinebamde qovelgvari sachmeli iqo halali, garda imisa, rac` t`avad aikrz'ala israelma (i'aqubma). ut`xra:,,mash, moitanet` t`evrat`i da caikit`xet`, t`uki namdvilad gulcrp`elni xart`[1] ".
translations.footnotes: [1] gadmoc`emebis t`anaxmad, iudevelebma muhammed shuamavals ut`xres:,,shen amtkic`eb, rom ibrahimis `lyh lslm gzas adgaxar, t`umc`a ibrahimi `lyh lslm arc` ak`lemis xorc`s miirt`mevda da arc` mis nacvels, xolo shen miirt`mev mat`. ak`edan gamomdinare, shen ar adgaxar ibrahimis gzas; dg'es ch`ven rasac` haramad mivich`nevt`, is mashin ibrahimist`visac` `lyh lslm harami iqo, vidre ch`venamde ar moag'cevda." amis sapasuxod ch`amoevlina ag'nishnuli aiat`i, rom akrz'alva ia'qubma `lyh lslm t`vit`on daicesa, manamde, vidre allahi musas `lyh lslm t`evrat`s ch`amouvlenda, xolo es akrz'alva t`evrat`shi naxsenebi ar aris. ix. t`ap`sirul bag'avi.

translations.translation: xolo amis shemdeg sic`ruis shet`xzvit` vinc` c`ili dascama allahs, scored isini arian usamart`loni.
ut`xari: simart`le t`k`va allahma, mash, mihqevit` rjuls hanip`i[1] ibrahimisa, - ar qop`ila is carmart`t`agani.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,hanip`i" (Hnyf): qovelgvari c`ru rcmenisgan da carmart`uli sak`misgan gandegili da urqevi monot`eizmit` cheshmaritebisken mltolvare.

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, pirveli (samloc`velo) saxli, romelic` xalxist`vis ik`na agebuli, - bek`k`ashi (mek`k`ashi) arsebuli barak`iani da samqarot`at`vis cheshmariti gzis mach`venebeli samloc`veloa (mek`k`a)[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] gadmoc`emebis t`anaxmad, es aiat`i mashin ch`amoevlina, rodesac` iudevelebi da muslimebi kamat`obdnen t`aviant`i mt`avari samloc`veloebisa da loc`vis mimart`ulebis siz'virp`aseze. iudevelebi ambobdnen, rom ierusalimis samloc`velo aris ch`veni qibla (loc`vis mimaert`uleba) da is up`ro z'virp`asi da uz'velesia, vidre k`aaba, radganac` es aris shuamavalt`a dedak`alak`io. muslimebi ki sapirispiros amtkic`ebdnen. am aiat`is ch`amovlinebam c`xadqo, rom dedamicis zurgze ert`adert`i g'mert`is t`aqvanisc`emisat`vis agebuli pirveli samloc`velo - k`aaba iqo.

translations.translation: masshia c`xadi sascaulebi, nadgomi[1] ibrahimisa, da vinc` masshi sheva, is ik`neba usap`rt`xod. adamianebs, visac` ik` misasvleli gzis dap`arva sheuz'liat`, allahisgan daekisrat` am saxlshi hajobis shesruleba, xolo vinc` uarqop`s, cheshmaritad, allahi imdenad mdidaria, rom is arap`ers sachiroebs samqarot`agan.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,maqaamu ibrahiim" (mqm brhym): mup`essirt`a umravlesobis azrit`, es aris lodi, romelsac` ibrahim shuamavali `lyh lslm k`aabas kedlebis msheneblobis dros shemosadgomad iqenebda. es adgili dg'es k`aabas gverdit` spec`ialuri nishnit`aa ag'nishnuli da momloc`velebi ik` dadgomasa da loc`vas c`diloben. sxva versiis t`anaxmad, ak` igulisxmeba mt`eli mesjidi haramis adgili da hajobis g'vt`ismsaxurebis shesasrulebeli sxva mnishvnelovani adgilebi, rogoric`aa arap`ati, muzdelip`a, jamarat`i, sap`a-merve da sxva.

translations.translation: ut`xari: ei, cignboz'ebulno! ratom uarqop`t` allahis aiat`ebs/sascaulebs? - allahi mocmea imisa, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

ut`xari: ei, cignboz'ebulno! ratom gindat`, rom scori gza allahisa mruded carmoach`inot` da aac`dinot` misgan isini, vinc` ircmunes, amave dros, t`k`ven mocmeni xart` amisa; da allahi ugulisquro araa imis mimart`, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! t`u cignboz'ebult`agan romelime jgup`s daemorch`ilebit`, isev urcmunoebad gak`c`even, mas shemdeg, rac` ircmunet`.
rogor ar unda ircmunot`, rodesac` gekit`xebat` allahis aiat`ebi da t`k`vens shorisaa misi shuamavali? vinc` allahs (mis sarcmunoebas) ch`aechideba, mas ech`veneba scori gza, usat`uod.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, rogorc` mas sheep`ereba[1], da nu ag'esrulebit` sxvanairad, garda - muslimebad/morch`ilebad.
translations.footnotes: [1] ch`aechidet` mis sarcmunoebas, ag'iaret` misi ert`oba da arap`eri ut`anaziarot`; iqavit` misi morch`ilni da ar iqot` urch`ebi; iqavit` misi madlierni da ar iqot` umadurni; gaxsovdet` igi da ar daivicqot`.

translations.translation: qvelam ert`ad ch`aechidet` t`oks allahisa (quransa da sunnet`s) da nu daiqop`it`. gaixsenet` allahis cqaloba t`k`venze, roc`a mtrebi iqavit`, mere man gulebi mogilbot` ert`manet`is mimart` da misive cqalobit` ik`ec`it` z'mebad, manamde ki c`ec`xlis up`skrulis piras iqavit` da (allahma) ik`idan gixsnat`[1]. t`k`vent`vis allahi ase c`xadqop`s t`avis aiat`ebs, rom ik`neb cheshmarit gzas dadgomodet` t`k`ven.
translations.footnotes: [1] islamamdel periodshi medinashi arabt`a ori carmart`i gvari c`xovrobda - evsi da xazraji. isini ert`manet`is mosisxle mtrebi iqvnen, islamis mig'ebis shemdeg am gvarebs shoris iset`i z'moba ch`amoqalibda, rom ert`manet`s siket`eshi ejibrebodnen. am aiat`ebit` allahma mat` is cqaloba sheaxsena, romelic` islamis meshveobit` daimsaxures da gaap`rt`xila, rom cignboz'ebult`a c`dunebas ar ahqolodnen da isev z'vel urjuloebashi ar dabrunebuliqvnen.

translations.translation: da iqos ert`i jgup`i t`k`venshi (qovelt`vis), romlebic` siket`isken moucodeben da dagmoben borotebas; - scored egeni arian gadarch`enilni.
da nu ik`nebit` msgavsi mat`i, romlebic` danacevrdnen da ut`anxmoebdnen, mas shemdeg, rac` miuvidat` c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebi; scored mat`t`visaa sasjeli[1] udidesi.
translations.footnotes: [1] mup`essirt`a umravlesoba ganmartavs, rom ak` igulisxmebian iudevelebi da k`ristianebi, xolo zogiert`ebis azrit`, eseni arian islamis mimdevari mobidat`eebi. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: im dg'es, rodesac` gabrcqindebian saxeebi da gashavdebian[1] saxeebi, - visi saxeebic` gashavdeba, mat` etqvian: nut`u mas shemdeg uarqavit`, rac` ukve ircmunet`? mashin igemet` imis sasjeli, rasac` uarqop`dit`[2].
translations.footnotes:
[1] gankit`xvis dg'es morcmuneebis saxeebi gabrcqindeba, xolo urcmunoebisa da p`arisevlebis saxeebi gashavdeba. ibni abbasma t`k`va: im dg'es sunnet`is mimdevart`a saxeebi gabrcqindeba, xolo mobidat`eebis saxeebi gashavdeba. ix. t`ap`sirul beg'avi.
[2] t`u gach`nda kit`xva, rom urcmunoebs, romlebic` arasdros qop`ilan morcmuneebi, ratom hkit`xaven ase? amis pasuxad nat`k`vamia, rom ak` igulisxmeba cinascar dadebuli ag't`k`ma, romelic` adamianis gach`enamde mat`ma sulebma dades t`aviant`i gamch`enis cinashe. hasan al-basrim t`k`va: eseni arian munap`iqebi, romlebic` enit` morcmuneobas amtkic`ebdnen, xolo gulit` uarqop`dnen. 'ik`rimem t`k`va: eseni arian cignboz'ebulni, romlebmac` ircmunes t`aviant`i mac`neebi da t`aviant` cignebshi namaxaroblevi muhammed shuamavali, xolo misi shuamavlad carmogzavnis shemdeg - uarqves igi. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: xolo romelt`ac` saxeebi gaubrcqindebat`, allahis cqalobashi (samot`xeshi) ik`nebian isini da ik` darch`ebian maradzhams.
es aris allahis aiat`ebi, romelt`ac` gikit`xavt` shen cheshmaritebit` da ar nebavs allahs usamart`loba samqarot`at`vis.
allahisaa qvelap`eri, rac`aa c`at`a shina da rac`aa k`veqanaze, da qoveli sak`me isev allahs daubrundeba.

sauket`eso t`emad xart` t`k`ven movlenili kac`obriobist`vis: moucodebt` siket`isken, gmobt` borotebas da gcamt` allahi. t`uki cignboz'ebulnic` ircmuneben, es scored mat`t`vis ik`neba kargi. arian mat`shi morcmuneebic`, t`umc`a mat`i umravlesoba ug'irsia.
- veras gavneben isini, garda shecuxebisa, xolo t`uki geomebian, mashin (damarc`xebulni) zurgs mogak`c`even (da gaik`c`evian), shemdeg ki ag'ar gaecevat` mat` daxmareba;

- sadac` ar unda iqvnen, t`avs damc`ireba daatqdebat`, garda - t`u allahis t`oks (sarcmunoebas) an xalxis t`oks (mp`arvelobas) sheekedlebian. allahis risxva daimsaxures da sig'aribe daatqdat` t`avs. es imitom, rom uarqop`dnen allahis aiat`ebs/sascaulebs da xoc`avdnen mac`neebs usamart`lod. es imist`vis, rasac` urch`obdnen da zg'vargadasulobdnen.
qvela ert`i araa cignboz'ebult`aganac`. mat` shoris aris mtkic`e jgup`i, vinc` g'amis saat`ebshi allahis aiat`ebs kit`xulobs da sejdes ag'asrulebs[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] ibni abbasi da muqat`ili gadmogvc`emen: rodesac` abdullah bin selamma da misma megobrebma islami miig'es, iudevelt`a xaxamebma t`k`ves: muhammedis shuamavloba mxolod imat` ircmunes, vinc` ch`vens shoris qvelaze c`udebi iqvnen. ase rom ar qop`iliqo, isini t`aviant` cinapart`a religias ar miatovebdneno. uzenaesma allahma amis sapasuxod es aiat`i ch`amoavlina. ix. t`ap`sirul beg'avi.

translations.translation: mat` scamt` allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli; siket`isken moucodeben, borotebas gmoben da xeirian sak`meebshi ert`manet`s ejibrebian. scored egeni arian sat`not`aganni.
da ar daekargebat` - siket`is saxit` rasac` moimok`medeben. allahma qvelap`eri ic`is g'vt`ismoshisht`a shesaxeb.
cheshmaritad, mat`, vinc` ar ircmunes, t`aviant`i k`oneba da shvilebi verap`ers argeben allahis cinashe; isini arian c`ec`xlis mkvidrni da ik` darch`ebian maradzhams.

magalit`i, rasac` isini amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi samocqalod xarjaven, - hgavs magalit`s qinulovani k`arishxlisa, romelmac` ekvet`a da gaanadgura - t`aviant`i sulebis mimart` usamart`lo xalxis nat`esebi. allahi ki ar moek`c`a mat` usamart`lod, aramed sakut`ar sulebs t`vit`on ek`c`evian usamart`lod.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! sxvas nu gaixdit` mesaidumled, garda t`k`venianisa, radganac` isini arap`ers daishureben t`k`vens sazianod, da natroben imas, rac` urt`ulesia t`k`vent`vis, da siz'ulvili gadmodis mat`i bageebidan, da is up`ro didia, rasac` mat`i gulebi malaven. sakmarisad nat`elvqet` t`k`vent`vis aiat`ebi, t`uki gons moegebit`.

ai, giqvart` t`k`ven isini, magram mat` ar uqvarxart`, miuxedavad imisa, rom t`k`ven srulad gcamt` (qvela g'vt`iuri) cigni; t`k`vent`an shexvedrisas amboben, vircmunet`o, magram rodesac` ganmartovdebian, t`it`is cverebs ikvneten t`k`ven mimart` siz'ulvilisgan. ut`xari:,,daixoc`et` t`k`venive siz'ulvilit`". cheshmaritad, unaklod ic`is allahma gulebshi arsebulis shesaxeb.

t`uki siket`es gadaeqrebit`, samcuxaroa mat`t`vis, xolo t`uki ubedureba dagatqdebat`, mashin - uxariat`. da t`u moit`ment` da g'vt`ismoshishobas gamoich`ent`, veras gavnebt` mat`i veragoba. cheshmaritad, allahi garemoic`avs qvelap`ers, rasac` isini aket`eben.
aki, gaxvedi dilaadrianad ojaxidan da sabrz'olo mcqobrshi amagrebdi[1] morcmuneebs. allahi qovlis msmeni da mc`odnea.
translations.footnotes: [1] uhudis mt`ast`an

translations.translation: aki, shishma sheipqro[1] ori jgup`i t`k`vengan, arada allahi iqo mat`i shemce. morcmuneebi mxolod allahs miendon!
translations.footnotes: [1] uhudis brz'olashi shuamavalma marjvena da marc`xena p`rt`ebze xazrejis tomidan selemes gvaris, xolo evsis tomidan haarises gvaris xalxi ganalaga, romlebic` mtert`an pirispir shexvedris da brz'olis shishma sheipqro. bolos abdullah bin ubeim, romelic` 300 kac`ian jars xelmz'g'vanelobda, t`k`va - sakut`ari t`avi da shvilebi ris gulist`vis ch`avagdo sap`rt`xeshio da jart`an ert`ad ukan dabrunda.

translations.translation: diaxac` shegeciat` allahi bedirshi[1], - roc`a uz'lurni iqavit`. mash, ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, ik`neb madlierni qop`iliqavit` t`k`ven.
translations.footnotes: [1] bediri - mek`k`asa da medinas shoris mdebare adgilis saxelia, sadac` hijret`is meore cels mek`k`el carmart`ebsa da medinel muslimebs shoris pirveli brz'ola gaimart`a. am brz'olashi carmart`t`a jari 950 mebrz'ols sheadgenda, romlebsac` t`an hk`ondat` sruli sabrz'olo ag'churviloba, xolo muslimt`a jari 305 mebrz'ols it`vlida, romelic` ganic`dida iarag'isa da sxva samxedro ag'churvilobis naklebobas. miuxedavad carmart`t`a ric`xobrivi da ag'churvit`i upiratesobisa, brz'ola mainc` muslimt`a sasargeblod dasrulda.

translations.translation: aki, morcmuneebs eubnebodi:,,nut`u t`k`veni g'mert`is mier (c`idan) ch`amovlenili sami at`asi angelozit` shecevna t`k`vent`vis ar aris sakmarisi[1]?"
translations.footnotes: [1] g'vt`is cqalobit`, bediris omshi zec`idan sami at`asi angelozi ch`amoevlina da morcmuneebt`an ert`ad carmart`ebis cinaag'mdeg ibrz'odnen.

translations.translation: - ra t`k`ma unda (sakmarisia)! t`u moit`ment` da ridi gek`nebat`, uec`radac` rom dagesxnen t`avs, t`k`veni g'mert`i (shemced) danishnuli xut`i at`asi angelozit`ac` shegecevat`.
- sxva arap`rist`vis uk`mnia es allahs, garda samaxaroblod da dasamshvideblad t`k`veni gulebisa. aranairi shecevna ar arsebobs, garda brz'eni da z'levamosili allahismierobisa.
- (aseve imist`vis shegeciat`) rat`a moekvet`a mat`i nacili, vinc` ar ircmunes an daemarc`xebina da gacbilebulni ukuk`c`euliqvnen.
- (shuamavalo!) shen ar gekut`vnis am sak`mis gadacqvetileba: an miig'ebs monaniebas, an kidev, dasjis mat` allahi. ut`uod, - isini arian usamart`loni[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] enes bin maalik`i gadmogvc`ems, rom uhudis brz'olashi allahis shuamavals kbili mostexes da t`avi gautexes; is am mdgomareobashi sisxls icmendda da t`an ambobda:,,rogor unda gadarch`es xalxi, romelmac` shuamavali dachra da kbili mostexa; shuamavali, romelic` mat` allaht`an epatizheba." scored am sitqvebis gamo ch`amoavlina uzenaesma allahma es aiat`i. ix. muslim, jihad 37/1791.

translations.translation: allahisaa qvelap`eri, rac`aa c`at`a shina da rac`aa k`veqanaze. is apatiebs mas, visac` inebebs da dasjis mas, visac` inebebs[1]. allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.
translations.footnotes: [1] patieba ik`neba misi cqalobis gamovlineba, xolo sasjeli -samart`lianobis shedegi.

translations.translation: ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar chamot` vaxshi, mravalmagad gaz'virebuli; ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, ik`neb gadarch`et`.
mash, geshinodet` c`ec`xlisa, romelic` urcmunoebist`visaa gamzadebuli.
mash, daemorch`ilet` allahsa da shuamavals, rom ik`neb shecqalebuliqavit`.
da iscrap`et` t`k`veni g'mert`is patiebisa[1] da samot`xisaken, romlis ukideganobac` hgavs c`ebisa da dedamicisas da gamzadebulia g'vt`ismoshisht`at`vis.
translations.footnotes: [1] iscrap`et` iset`i mok`medebebis shesrulebisken, romlebic` patiebis sacindaria. ibni abbasma t`k`va, rom es aris islami. misganvea gadmoc`emuli, rom esaa monanieba; igive t`k`va ik`rimemac`; ali bin abu talibma t`k`va: esaa p`arz'ebis shesruleba; dahhak`ma t`k`va, rom esaa jihadi; muqat`ilis azrit`, es aris qoveli ket`ili sak`me. ix. t`ap`sirul beg'avi.

translations.translation: - mat`t`vis, vinc` g'vt`ivsat`nod xarjaven simdidresa t`u siduxchireshi, brazs sz'leven da mpatiebelni arian xalxis mimart`. allahs uqvars ket`ilmorcmuneni.

da mat`, vinc` avzneoba[1] ch`aidines an t`aviant` sulebs usamart`lod moepqrnen da, (mashinve) allahi gaixsenes da patieba shest`xoves t`aviant`i c`odvebist`vis, - vin apatiebs c`odvebs, t`u ara allahi? - t`u kvlav ar daizhineben igives shegnebulad, rac` mat` ch`audeniat`.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali-,,al-p`ahishet`u" (lfHsh@): z'irit`adad uzneo sak`c`iels nishnavs, romelic` miug'ebelia rogorc` religiuri, ise arareligiuri sazogadoebist`vis. quransa da zogadad, islamis literaturashi, es termini mrushobast`an asoc`irdeba, t`umc`a shesaz'lebelia igulisxmebodes mrushobis garda sxva uzneo sak`c`ielic`, amitom vt`argmnet`, rogorc` avzneoba. mup`essirebi am aiat`shi sitqva,,al-p`ahishet`u"-s shemdegnairad ganmartaven: jabiris ganmartebit`, ak` mrushoba igulisxmeba, xolo sakut`ari sulebis mimart` usamart`lod mopqroba aris sxva danarch`eni, rogoric`aa xvevna-koc`na, shexeba, shexedva da a.sh.; muqat`ilisa da k`elbis shep`asebit`, ak` igulisxmeba mrushobis garda sxva qvela urt`iert`oba, rac` araa halali, rogorebic`aa - xvevna-koc`na, shexeba, shexedva da a.sh. xolo sakut`ari sulebis mimart` usamart`lod mopqroba aris sxva danarch`eni c`odvebi. aseve nat`k`vamia, rom,,al-p`ahishet`u" aris didi c`odvebi, xolo sakut`ari sulis mimart` usamart`lod mopqroba - patara c`odvebi. ix. t`ap`sirul beg'avi.

translations.translation: patiebaa mat`i sazg'auri t`aviant`i g'mert`isgan da samot`xeebi, romlis k`veshac` mdinareebi miedinebian, da ik` ik`nebian maradzhams... da ra mshvenieria mshromelt`a sazg'auri.
t`k`venamde mart`lac` mravali ces-ch`veuleba[1] gardasula. mash, ch`amoiaret` dedamicaze da dainaxet`, t`u ra bedi eciat` c`rud shemrac`xvelebs.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,sunen" (snn): sitqva,,sunnet`"-is (sn@) mravlobit`i p`ormaa, romelic` shemdegi mnishvnelobebis matarebelia: gza, biliki, adat`i, ces-ch`veuleba, kanoni, samagalit`o nimushi. mup`essirebi am aiat`shi sitqva,,sunen"-s ramdenime gansxvavebul mnishvnelobas anicheben: atas azrit`, ak` igulisxmeba shariat`ebi; k`elbi: ak` igulsixmeba qvela t`emist`vis gankut`vnili gza da met`odi, romlis mimdevart`agan allahi kmaqop`ili ik`neboda; mujahidi: t`k`venamde mart`lac` bevrma ces-ch`veulebam ganvlo imat`i ganadgurebit`, vinc` iqvnen c`rud shemrac`xvelni; aseve, ert`-ert`i shexedulebis t`anaxmad, ak` igulixmeba sxvadasxva t`emi, romlebic` ac gardasuli shuamavlebis mimdevrebi iqvnen. ix. t`ap`sirul beg'avi.

translations.translation: es (qurani) aris c`xadeba adamiant`at`vis da cheshmariti gzis mimart`uleba da shegoneba - g'vt`ismoshisht`at`vis.
xels nu ch`aik`nevt` (nu dauz'lurdebit`) da nurc` damcuxrdebit`, radganac` t`uki (namdvil) morcmuneobas gamoich`ent`, mashin gamarjvebulic` t`k`ven ik`nebit`.

(uhudis brz'olashi) t`u chrilobebi igemet` (amit` guli ar gaitexot`), - aset`i chrilobebi sxva xalxsac` (mek`el qureishelebs) ugemiat` (bediris brz'olashi).adamianebshi aset` (marc`xian) dg'eebs monac`vleobit` vadgent` xolme, rat`a allahma gamoamzhg'avnos isini, romlebmac` ircmunes, da mocmeebi/shahidebi aiqvanos t`k`ven shoris. allahs ar uqvars usamart`loni (t`undac` gz'lion).
aseve imist`visaa (aset`i marc`xiani dg'eebi), rom allahma gancmindos isini, vinc` ircmunes, da gaanadguros urcmunoebi[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] t`avs damtqdari ubedurebebi morcmunet`at`vis gamoc`daa. vinc` am gamoc`das mot`minebit` shexvdeba an vinc` allahis gzaze shahidad daec`ema, mat` c`odvebi epatiebat`. namdvili da c`ru morcmuneni (munaap`iqni) scored gansac`delis dros gamomzhg'avndebian. amitom aset`i dg'eebi morcmuneebs, rogorc` c`odvebisgan, aseve p`arisevlebisganac` gancmends; xolo urcmunoebi t`u daixoc`ebian, mat`t`vis es ganadgurebaa, radganac` mat` c`odvebi ar mietevebat`.

translations.translation: nut`u p`ik`robdit`, - ise shexvidodit` samot`xeshi, rom ar gamoamzhg'avnebda allahi mat`, romlebmac` ibrz'oles, da ar gamoamzhg'avnebda momt`ment`?
t`k`ven mart`lac` natrobdit` sikvdils (shahidobas) manamde, vidre (uhudis brz'olashi) mis cinashe ag'moch`ndebodit`. uechvelad, xedavdit` mas da shesc`k`erodit`[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] gadmoc`emebis t`anaxmad, vinc` bediris brz'olashi monacileoba ver miig'es, isini im didebuli madlis mopovebis survilma sheipqro, rac` shahidebma moipoves, amitom natrobdnen msgavsi dg'is gameorebas, romelshic` allahis gzaze shahidobis sashualeba miec`emodat`. mat` nanatri sashualeba uhudis brz'olashi gauch`ndat`, t`umc`a mat`gan nacili shedrka da ak`et`-ik`it` mimoip`anta, xolo nacilma mot`mineba gamoich`ina da sheupovrad ibrz'oda. scored am movlenis shesaxeb ch`amoevlina ag'nishnuli aiat`i, romelic` gak`c`eulebs kic`xavda da momt`menebs ak`ebda. ix. t`ap`siru taberi.

translations.translation: muhammedi sxva aravinaa, t`u ara shuamavali, uechvelad, masze cinac` ganvles shuamavlebma; da t`u mokvda an mokles, mashin ukan mibrundebit` - t`k`venive k`uslebis mimart`ulebit` (urcmunoebashi)? da vinc` ukan mibrundeba t`avisi k`uslebis mimart`ulebit` (urcmunoebashi), - verap`ers avnebs igi allahs. allahi - madlierebs daajildovebs.

sheuz'lebelia, romelime suli mokvdes allahis nebis gareshe - gansazg'vruli droist`vis dacerilisa. visac` amk`veqniuri sargebeli scaddes, ch`ven mas mivagebt` misgan, xolo visac` imk`veqniuri jildo scaddes, ch`ven masac` mivagebt` misgan da madlierebs davajildovebt`.
ramden mac`nest`an ert`ad ibrz'oda mravali g'vt`isnieri da ar shemdrkalan imis gamo, rac` t`avs daatqdat` allahis gzaze, arc` sisuste gamouvleniat` da arc` danebebulan. allahs uqvars momt`menni.

mat`i sitqva sxva arap`eri qop`ila, t`u ara es g'ag'adisi:,,g'mert`o ch`veno! gvapatie ch`veni c`odvebi da gadac`domebi ch`vens sak`meebshi; p`exebi gagvimdgrade da shegvecie urjulo xalxis cinaag'mdeg".
