amgvarad, ucqaloba mat` allahma: sazg'auri - amk`veqniuri[1] da sauket`eso jildo - imk`veqniuri[2]. allahs uqvars ket`ilmorcmuneni.
translations.footnotes:
[1] daxmarebis saxit`
[2] samot`xis saxit`

translations.translation: ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! t`uki urcmunoebs daemorch`ilebit`, mashin isini ukan migabruneben - t`k`veni k`uslebis mimart`ulebit` (urcmunoebashi) da cagebulebad gadaik`c`evit`.
diaxac`, allahia t`k`veni mp`arveli da damxmaret`agan - igia sauket`eso.

shishs ch`avagdebt` urcmunot`a gulebshi, radganac` allahs imat` ut`anaziareben, romelt`a shesaxebac` aranairi mtkic`ebuleba ar ch`avlenila mat`t`an. c`ec`xlia mat`i t`avshesap`ari, da raoden c`udia usamart`lot`a samqop`eli.

cheshmaritad, allahma ert`gulad ag'gisrulat` t`avisi ag'k`ma, roc`a misi nebit` xoc`avdit` mat`, vidre daudevrad moik`c`eodit`: kamat`s daicqebdit` misi (shuamavlis) brz'anebis t`aobaze da siurch`es gamoavlendit`, mas shemdeg, roc`a gich`venat` is (gamarjveba), rac` z'alian gindodat`. t`k`venshi arian iset`ebi, visac` surs es k`veqana da t`k`venshi arian iset`ebic`, visac` surs is k`veqana. gamoc`dis miznit`, am qvelap`ris shemdeg (allahma) mat`gan ukugak`c`iat`, magram bolos mainc` shegicqalat`. allahi didi cqalobis mk`onea morcmunet`a mimart`[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] roc`a muslimebma uhudis brz'olashi marc`xi ganic`ades, medinashi dabrunebulma daicqes bchoba t`u ratom daemart`at` es, mat` xom allahma daxmareba ag'ut`k`va? am mdgomareobis sapasuxod es aiat`i ch`amoevlina, romelmac` marc`xis mizezebi ganmarta. allahis shuamavalma uhudis brz'olis strategia shemdegnairad sheimushava: uhudis mt`a zurgs ukan moik`c`ia, pirit` medinasken dadga. am pozic`iashi 'aineinis mag'lobi (shemdgomshi meisreebis mag'lobi) mat` marjvniv rch`eboda. shuamavalma ag'nishnul mag'lobze abdullah bin jubeiris sardlobit` 50 meisre ganalaga da ubrz'ana, zurgi gagvimagret`; t`u dainaxavt`, rom gavimarjvet` da nadavlis shegrovebas shevudek`it`, ar shemogviert`det` da arc` ch`vens dasaxmareblad ch`amoxvidet`, t`undac` xedavdet`, t`u rogor vixoc`ebit`o. brz'olis pirvel nacilshi morcmuneebma carmart`ebs strategiulad sz'lies da iset`i marc`xi acvnies, rom iz'ulebulni sheik`mnen, gak`c`euliqvnen. carmart`t`a jaris ukan gak`c`evam meisreebis nacils ap`ik`rebina, rom ukve brz'ola dasrulda da mat`i movaleobac` dasrulebuli iqo, ramac` mat` shoris kamat`i gamoicvia, unda darch`eniliqvnen t`aviant` pozic`iebze t`u sulier z'mebs sheert`ebodnen? meisret`a didma nacilma t`aviant`i pozic`ia miatova da dabla daeshva, xolo mag'lobze abdullah bin jubeiri 10 meisrest`an ert`ad darch`a. am dros mtris jari ukan dabrunda, mag'lobze mqop`i 10 meisre daxoc`a da muslimt`a jari alqashi moak`c`ia. amgvarad, morcmuneebma uhudis brz'olashi marc`xi t`aviant`i daudevrobis shedegad ganic`ades, xolo c`oc`xali vinc` gadarch`a, es allahis cqaloba iqo mat`t`vis.

translations.translation: aki (uhudis kalt`ebze) ag'ma garbodit` da aravisken ixedebodit`, xolo shuamavali uknidan gixmobdat`, da mcuxarebaze mcuxareba dagematat`, rom ar dag'onebuliqavit` imist`vis, rac` dakarget` an t`avs dagatqdat`. allahi mc`odnea qovelivesi, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] es aiat`i brz'olis meore etapze damarc`xebuli muslimebis mdgomareobas ag'cers, rodesac` zogi mat`gani uhudis kalt`ebisken garbodnen, zogma ki medinisken aig'es gezi. am dros allahis shuamavali talha bin ubeidullaht`an da sxva 11 sahabest`an ert`ad mtris cinaag'mdeg t`avdauzogavad ibrz'oda da gak`c`eulebs:,,allahis msaxurno ch`emsken gamoik`ec`it`, ch`emsken"-o, uxmobda. am brz'olashi 70-mde muslimi daig'upa da bevri daichra. gavrc`elda xmebi, rom dag'upult`a shoris muhammed shuamavalic` iqo. allahis shuamavalma ik` cina kbili dakarga, tuch`ze da loqazec` chrilobebi miig'o. am qvelap`erma muslimt`a p`izikur marc`xs p`sik`ologiuri marc`xic` daumata, ramac` jarshi panika ch`amoagdo.

translations.translation: mcuxarebis shemdeg (allahma) t`k`venshi z'ilis momgvreli simshvide ch`amoavlina, romelmac` ert`i jgup`i moic`va t`k`vengan, xolo meore jgup`s mxolod t`aviant`i sulebi adardebdat`. isini allahis shesaxeb usamart`lod p`ik`robdnen - umec`rul p`ik`rebs auqvnen da ambobdnen:,,gana vp`lobt` ch`ven rames am sak`meshi?" ut`xari: cheshmaritad, es sak`me mt`lianad allahs ekut`vniso. (isini) t`aviant` sulebshi malaven imas, rasac` shen ar gimxelen. (gulshi) amboben: ch`veni nebit` rom qop`iliqo raime am sak`meshi, mashin ak` ar davig'upebodit`o. ut`xari:,,sakut`ar saxlebshic` rom qop`iliqavit`, vist`visac` sikvdili iqo dacerili, isini mainc` gavidodnen ik`, sadac` unda dag'upuliqvnen". t`k`vens mkerdebshi arsebulis gamosac`delad da t`k`vens gulebshi arsebulis gansacmendad hk`mna allahma es qovelive. allahi mc`odnea t`k`veni gulisxmisa[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] uhudis brz'olashi, im sashineli garemos, chrilobebisa da tkivilebis miuxedavad, uzenaesma allahma gulcrp`el morcmuneebs msubuk`i z'ili mouvlina, rit`ac` mat`i gulebi daamshvida, shishi gauk`ro da up`ro gaamxneva. rogorc` abu talha gadmogvc`ems, brz'olis velze z'ilmoreulobis gamo ramdenjerme xmali xelidan dauvarda (buxari, t`ap`siir, h.n. 4562.). bunebriv mdgomareobashi, adamians z'lieri shishis gamo z'ili arc` miekareba, t`umc`a morcmuneebi uzenaesma allahma aset`i cqalobit` daajildova. aset` situac`iashi z'ilis moreva mat`i gulebis simshvideze metqvelebs. magalit`ad, uzenaesi allahi enp`aal suras 11-e aiat`shi, badris brz'olis shesaxebac` igives brz'anebs:,,man t`vlema moggvarat` simshvided" ix. t`ap`siiru ibn k`esiir. munaap`iqebi morcmuneebisgan gansxvavebit` shishit` daz'rcodnen. isini mxolod sakut`ar sulebze da nadavlis mopovebaze p`ik`robdnen.

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, ori jgup`is shexvedris dg'es, vinc` t`k`vengan gaik`c`nen, eshmakma ac`duna isini zogi sak`c`ielis gamo, rac` mat` ch`aedinat`. mart`lac` apatia mat` allahma. cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, lmobieri[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] omar bin xattabi uhudis dg'es ase ixsenebda:,,uhudis dg'es marc`xi vigemet`. mec` gak`c`eulebs shoris viqavi. t`avi uhudis kalt`ebs shevap`aret`, jixvebivit` avdiodit` mt`is kldovan kalt`ebze. muhammedi daig'upao, xmebi gavrc`elda. me gaviz'axodi:,,vinc` itqvis,muhammedi mokvdao, mas ar vac`oc`xleb". shemdeg gak`c`eulebma mt`is p`erdobze shevikribet`. es aiat`i scored amis shesaxeb ch`amoevlina". ix. t`ap`siru taberi; aseve, gak`c`eulebs shoris iqo osman bin ap`p`anic`. man ert`xel ase upasuxa im pirovnebas, vinc` amis gamo mas kic`xavda: diax, eg ch`veni shec`doma iqo, t`umc`a allahma es gvapatiao. ix. t`ap`siru razi.

translations.translation: ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! nu ik`nebit` msgavsni mat`i, romlebmac` ar ircmunes da samogzaurod an sabrz'olvelad casuli t`aviant`i z'mebis shesaxeb t`k`ves: ch`vent`an ert`ad rom darch`eniliqvnen, arc` mokvdebodnen da arc` daixoc`ebodneno. (ase amboben) rat`a allahma es sinanulad uk`c`ios t`aviant` gulebshi. allahia mac`oc`xlebelic` da makvdinebelic`, da qvelap`ers xedavs allahi, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
vp`ic`av, allahis gzaze t`u daig'upebit` an mokvdebit`, - allahis miteveba da cqaloba mart`lac` umjobesia, vidre is, rasac` ixvechen (am k`veqnad qop`nit`).
vp`ic`av, t`uki mokvdebit` an daig'upebit`, - allahis cinashe sheikribebit`, usat`uod.

lmobieri iqavi mat` mimart` - cqalobit` allahismieri. shen rom uxeshi da gulk`va qop`iliqavi, mashin irgvliv mqop`ni ut`uod gagec`lebodnen. mash, apatie, patieba it`xove mat`t`vis da mat`i azric` moismine (amk`veqniuri) sakit`xebis shesaxeb. roc`a rames gadacqvet, mxolod allahs miende. cheshmaritad, allahs uqvars misdami mindobilni.
allahi t`u dagexamrebat`, mashin veravin dagamarc`xebt`; xolo t`uki daxmarebas shegicqvett`, mashin vinaa iset`i, vinc` amis shemdeg dagexmarebat`? mash, mxolod allahs miendon morcmuneebi[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis mimart` mindobilobaa, rodesac` allahis garda aravis uxmob mshvelelad an damxmared, arvisgan eli sarch`os da aravis dasanaxad ar mok`medeb.

translations.translation: sheuz'lebelia, mac`ne rames malulad g'ebulobdes nadavlidan, xolo vinc` rames malulad aig'ebs nadavlidan, gankit`xvis dg'es t`an moitans imas, rac` aig'o[1]; shemdeg qvela suls srulad miezg'veba imis shesabamisad, rac` mas mouxvechia da isini ar gadaeqrebian usamart`lobas (siket`eebis dakargvit` an daumsaxurebeli sasjelis matebit`).
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis shuamavali brz'olis velze monapovar sabrz'olo iarag'ebs, pirutqvs da sxva nivt`ebs, romelic` mtris jarma dakarga, samart`lianad qop`da muslim mebrz'olebs shoris. aset` dros zogiert`ebi c`dilobdnen, morcmuneebs shoris echvi ch`amoegdot` imis shesaxeb, rom t`it`k`os shuamavali usamart`lod qop`da nadavls an zogiert`i nivt`i cinascar t`avist`vis aig'o, vidre gaqop`da. scored am c`ru braldebis sapasuxod ch`amoevlina es aiat`i. ix. abu davud, h.n. 3971; t`irmizi, h.n. 3009.

translations.translation: gana, vinc` allahis kmaqop`ilebis mimqolia, is iset`ivea, vinc` allahis risxva daimsaxura da jojoxet`ia misi t`avshesap`ari? ra c`udi samqop`elia mat`i saboloo misak`c`ieli.
sxvadasxva xarisxs p`loben isini allahis cinashe[1]. qvelap`ers xedavs allahi, rasac` isini aket`eben.
translations.footnotes: [1] ibni abbasma t`k`va: vinc` allahis kmaqop`ilebas daemorch`ileba, is uag'resad did madls da cqalobas miig'ebs; xolo vinc` allahis risxvas daimsaxurebs, isic` mcare sasjels miig'ebs. ix. t`ap`sirul bag'avi.

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, cqaloba moig'o allahma morcmuneebze, rodesac` t`aviant`i cridan cargzavna mat`t`an shuamavali, romelic` ukit`xavda mis (allahis) aiat`ebs, gancmendda (c`ru rcmenebisgan) da cignsa (qurans) da sibrz'nes (sunnet`s) ascavlida, miuxedavad imisa, rom isini manamde iqvnen c`xad gzaac`denilobashi.

nut`u (uhudshi) t`avs damtqdar ubedurebas kit`xulobt`, es saidan gvecviao? t`k`ven xom (bedirshi) mat` orjer meti ubedureba daatexet`[1]. ut`xari: es (ubedureba) t`k`veni mxridanaa[2]. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlisshemz'lea.
translations.footnotes:
[1] bediris brz'olashi muslimebma 70 carmart`i daxoc`es da 70 tqved aiqvanes, xolo uhudshi carmart`ebt`an brz'olashi 70 muslimi daec`a shahidad.
[2] mat` ar gait`valiscines shuamavlis brz'aneba da ar imok`medes cinascar gansazg'vruli samxedro gegmis shesabamisad, rac`, sabolood, marc`xis mizezi ag'moch`nda.

translations.translation: rac` t`avs dagatqdat` ori jgup`is shexvedris dg'es, - allahis nebit` iqo qovelive, rat`a morcmuneebi gamoemzhg'avnebina.

- da rom gamoemzhg'avnebina isinic`, vinc` p`arisevlobdnen. ut`xres:,,camodit`, allahis gzaze ibrz'olet` an t`avi daic`avit`". mat` miuges: ch`ven rom vic`odet`, brz'ola gaimart`eba, auc`ileblad shemogiert`debodit`o. isini im dg'es, urcmunoebast`an up`ro axlos iqvnen, vidre rcmenast`an. pirit` imas ambobdnen, rac` gulebshi ar hk`ondat`. uket` ic`is allahma, rasac` isini malaven.
mat`, vinc` (saxlebshi) isxdnen da t`aviant` z'mebze ambobdnen - ch`vent`vis rom daejerebinat`, ar daixoc`ebodneno, - ut`xari:,,mash, sikvdili aic`ilet` t`avidan, t`uki mart`la xart` gulcrp`elni".
isini, vinc` allahis gzaze daig'upnen, ar ip`ik`ro, mkvdrebi ariano, - aranairad. pirik`it`, c`oc`xlebi arian da t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe sazrdooben.

- im sixarulit` ag'savseni, rac` allahma uboz'a t`avisi cqalobis nishnad. da axareben imat`, romlebic` mat` ukan imqop`ebian (c`oc`xlebi) da jer ar sheert`ebian, - rom mat` arc` shishi elit`, arc`a mcuxareba.
- axareben allahisgan boz'ebul madlsa da cqalobas; rom ar caaxdens allahi morcmunet`a sazg'aurs.

- allahisa da misi shuamavlis mocodebas mat` mashinac` dadebit`ad upasuxes, roc`a chriloba da tkivili ganic`ades[1]. t`it`oeuli mat`ganist`vis, vinc` siket`es aket`ebs da visac` g'vt`is shishi ak`vs, - sazg'auria udidesi.
translations.footnotes: [1] gadmoc`emebis t`anaxmad, muslimebma marc`xis shemdeg z'alebi isev shemoikribes da mek`k`asken mimaval carmart`t`a jars ukan daedevnen. mat`,,hamrau'l-asad"-mde misdies, bolos ubrz'olvelad ukan dabrundnen.

translations.translation: mat`, romelt`ac` xalxma ut`xres: uechvelad, xalxi t`k`vens cinaag'mdeg sheikriba da geshinodet` mat`io,[1] - rcmena sheematat` da t`k`ves:,,ch`vent`vis allahi sakmarisia; ra kargi vek`ilia igi".
translations.footnotes: [1] mek`k`asken mimaval carmart`t`a jars gzad beduinebi shemoxvdat`, romlebic` sxvadasxva sach`uk`rebit` daasach`uk`res da daabares:,,gzad muhammedi t`u shemogxvda, ut`xari, rom mis cinaag'mdeg axali z'alebi unda shevagrovot` da auc`ileblad davbrundebit`o". ix. t`ap`siru taberi.

translations.translation: allahis cqalobisa da madlis meshveobit`, isini ukan ise dabrundnen, rom c`udi arap`eri mosvliat` da gahqvnen - allahis kmaqop`ilebas. allahi udidesi cqalobis mk`onea.
es mxolod eshmakia, rom t`avisi megobrebit` gashinebt`, da nu sheushindebit` mat`, ch`emi ki geshinodet`, t`uki xart` t`k`ven morcmuneni.
da nu dagamcuxreben isini, vinc` miiscrap`vian urcmunoebisken. cheshmaritad, verap`ers daakleben allahs isini. allahs nebavs, rom arap`eri ergot` mat` imk`veqnad; mat`t`vis mxolod tanjvaa udidesi.
cheshmaritad, verap`ers avneben allahs isini, romlebmac` rcmenis p`asad iqides urcmunoeba, da mat`t`visaa mcare sasjeli.
aranairad ar ip`ik`ron urcmunoebma, rom t`uki davac`adet`, kargia es mat`t`vis[1]. uechvelad, ch`ven mat` davac`adet`, rat`a umaton c`odvebs, da mat`t`visaa sasjeli damamc`irebeli.
translations.footnotes: [1] urcmunod da usamart`lod c`xovreba davac`adet` amk`veqnad da mashinve ar davsajet`.

translations.translation: ararsebulia, ise datovos allahma morcmuneebi, ra mdgomareobashic` t`k`ven imqop`ebit` da ar ganasxvavos usup`t`uri sup`t`isgan[1]. da ararsebulia, allahma uxilavi gac`odinot`, magram allahi imas irch`evs shuamavlad, visac` inebebs. mash ircmunet` allahi da misi shuamavalni. t`uki (namdvilad) gcamt` da (misi) ridi gak`vt`, t`k`vent`visaa sazg'auri udidesi.
translations.footnotes: [1] scavlulebi am aiat`s ornairad martaven: ibni abbasis, dahhak`is, muqat`ilis, k`elbisa da mup`essirt`a umravlesobis azrit`, aiat`i mimart`avs urcmunoebs/p`arisevlebs, rom allahi morcmuneebs ar datovebs im gzaze, romelzec` t`k`ven xart` da mat` auc`ileblad gamoarch`evs t`k`vengano. scavlult`a nacilis azrit` ki es aiat`i mimart`avs morcmuneebs, rom allahi morcmuneebs urcmunoebt`an/p`arisevlebt`an shereuls/ganusxvavebels ar datovebs. is sxvadasxva sirt`uleebit` gamosc`dis mat` da auc`ileblad gamoarch`evs morcmuneebs p`arisevlebisgan, rogorc` moxda uhudis brz'olashi. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: da nu egonebat` imat`, romelnic` z'uncoben imashi, rac` allahma t`avisi cqalobit` uboz'a, - rom es kargia mat`t`vis; pirik`it`, es mat`t`vis ubedurebaa. gankit`xvis dg'es kiserze shemoexvevat` is qovelive, rist`visac` z'uncobdnen[1]. allahisaa c`at`a da dedamicis memkvidreoba da mc`odnea allahi im qvelap`risa, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
translations.footnotes: [1] rac` daishura zak`at`is an mocqalebis saxit` allahis gzaze dasaxarjad, is qvelap`eri gankit`xvis dg'es gvelis saxit` kiserze shemoexveva da dakbens zevidan p`exebis mimart`ulebit`, an kiserze c`ec`xlis rgolebis saxit` ch`amoekdebat`. mujahidi:,,gankit`xvis dg'es mas im k`onebis motana daevaleba, rac` daishura"; ibni abbasi:,,es aiat`i iudevelt`a scavlulebis shesaxeb ch`amoevlina, romlebmac` t`aviant` cignebshi arsebuli muhammed shuamavlis daxasiat`eba damales da xalxist`vis cheshmaritebis gandoba daishures". ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: vp`ic`av, esma allahs mat`i sitqvebi, romlebmac` t`k`ves: uechvelad, g'aribia allahi, ch`ven ki mdidrebi vart`o[1]. ch`ven ch`avicert`: imas, rac` t`k`ves; ambavs mat` mier usamart`lod daxoc`ili mac`neebisas, da vetqvit`:,,igemet` mcveli sasjeli".
translations.footnotes: [1] roc`a ch`amoevlina aiat`i:,,vinaa is, vinc` allahs sauket`eso sesxs asesxebs" (baqara, 2/245.), - iudevelebma t`k`ves, rom allahi g'aribia ch`ven ki mdidrebi vart` da amitom it`xovs ch`vengan sesxso. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: es (sasjeli) imist`visaa, rac` t`k`vens xelebs ch`audenia. cheshmaritad, allahi araa usamart`lo msaxurt`a mimart`.

vinc` t`k`ves:cheshmaritad, allahma gvibrz'ana, rom ar gvercmuna (arc` ert`i) shuamavali, vidre ch`vent`an ar movidoda shesaciravit`, romelsac` (qabulobis nishnad c`idan ch`amosuli) c`ec`xli miirt`mevso[1], - ut`xari:,,t`k`vent`an ch`emze adre mart`lac` movidnen shuamavalni c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebit`a da imit`, rac` t`k`vit`. mash, ratom daxoc`et` isini[2], t`uki namdvilad gulcrp`elni xart`?"
translations.footnotes:
[1] aiat`i mashin ch`amoevlina, rodesac` ramdenime iudeveli muhammed shuamavalt`an mivida da ut`xra: o, muhammed! shen amtkic`eb, rom allahma shuamavlad carmoggzavna da cigni ch`amogivlina? - arada allahma t`evrat`shi gvibrz'ana, rom ise aravis vercmunot`, vinc` amtkic`ebs, rom allahis shuamavalia, -vidre ar mova shesaciravit`, romelsac` c`ec`xli sht`ant`k`avs misi shuamavlobis dasturado. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.
[2] zak`aria, iahia da sxva shuamavlebi.

translations.translation: xolo t`u mainc` c`rud migich`nies, - shenze adrec` xom miich`nies c`rud shuamavlebi, romlebic` c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebit`, cerilebit`a da ganmanat`lebeli cignit` movidnen.

qoveli suli sikvdils igemebs. cheshmaritad, gankit`xvis dg'es srulad mogegebat` t`k`veni sazg'auri. da vinc` ik`neba (jojoxet`is) c`ec`xlisgan ganridebuli da samot`xeshi sheqvanili, is mart`lac` mogebulia. amk`veqniuri c`xovreba sxva arap`eria, t`u ara sargebeli - carmavali da mac`duri.

vp`ic`av, t`k`veni k`onebit`a da sulebit` gamoic`debit` auc`ileblad. visac` t`k`venze adre cigni eboz'at` da vinc` arian carmart`ebi, - ut`uod bevri sheurac`xqop`a mogesmebat` mat`gan, xolo t`u moit`ment` da (allahis) ridi gek`nebat`, cheshmaritad, es mt`eli mondomebit` shesasrulebeli sakit`xebidanaa.

aki, allahma ag't`k`ma daadebina imat`, visac` cigni eboz'at`, rom xalxs auc`ileblad unda ganuc`xadot` igi (cminda cigni) da ar damalot`o. t`umc`a imat` zurgs ukan moisroles igi da mc`ire p`asad gaqides. ra c`udia, rasac` qiduloben.

ar gegonos, rom sasjels gadaurch`ebian isini, vinc` xaroben t`aviant`i namok`medarit` (avi sak`meebit`) da undat`, imist`vis ak`ebdnen, rac` ar gauket`ebiat`. diax, ar ip`ik`ro mat`ze ase; - mcare sasjelia mat`t`vis.
allahs ekut`vnis c`at`a da dedamicis ganmgebloba. allahi qovlisshemz'lea.
cheshmaritad, c`at`a da dedamicis gach`enashi da dg'e-g'amis monac`vleobashi - t`valsach`ino sascaulebia goniert`at`vis.

- romelnic` allahs moixsenieben - mdgomareni, mjdomareni t`u mxarze mcolareni[1], da c`at`a da dedamicis gach`enaze p`ik`roben. g'mert`o ch`veno! tquil-ubralod ar gagich`enia shen es qovelive! shen qovlad unaklo xar! dagvip`are c`ec`xlis satanjvelisgan!
translations.footnotes: [1] ali bin abu talibis, ibni abbasis, naxaa'isa da qat`aades azrebit`, am aiat`shi igulisxmeba namazi. adamianma savaldebulo namazi t`avisi p`izikuri shesaz'leblobis shesabamisad - mdgomare, mjdomare an mxarze camocolil mdgomareobashi, auc`ileblad unda sheasrulos; xolo danarch`eni mup`essirebis azrit`, am aiat`shi,,zik`ri", anu allahis k`eba-didebit` moxseneba igulisxmeba. mat` t`aviant`i shexedulebis argumentad sura nisas 103-e aiat`i mohqavt`. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: g'mert`o ch`veno! cheshmaritad, visac` shen c`ec`xlshi sheiqvan, mart`lac` samarc`xvino mdgomareobashi ch`aagdeb mas. da aravinaa damxmare - usamart`lot`a.

g'mert`o ch`veno! cheshmaritad, mogvesma ch`ven xma mk`adageblisa, romelic` rcmenisken mogvicodebda, rom t`k`veni g'mert`i ircmunet`o, da ch`venc` vircmunet`. g'mert`o ch`veno! gvapatie ch`veni c`odvebi, dagvip`are ch`ven mier ch`adenili uket`urebani da ket`il xalxt`an ert`ad mogvakvdine!
g'mert`o ch`veno! mogvec`i is, rac` sheni shuamavlebis meshveobit` ag'gvit`k`vi da ar ch`agvagdo gankit`xvis dg'es samarc`xvino mdgomareobashi. cheshmaritad, ar daarg'vev shen ag't`k`mas.

t`aviant`ma g'mert`ma dadebit`ad upasuxat`: cheshmaritad, ar davkargav g'vacls me t`k`vensas, - arc`ert`i mshromelisas - kac`i ik`neba t`u k`ali, - t`k`ven (srulmk`mneli) nacilni xart`[1] ert`manet`isa. xolo mat`, vinc` hijra gaaket`es (sarcmunoebis gamo), t`aviant`i samshoblodan ganidevnen, ch`ems gzaze gasachirshi ag'moch`dnen, ibrz'oles da daig'upnen, - auc`ileblad davup`arav t`aviant` uket`urobebs (carsulshi ch`adenils). auc`ileblad sheviqvan mat` samot`xeebshi, romelt`a k`veshac` mdinareebi miedinebian, - allahismieri jildos saxit`. cheshmaritad, allaht`anaa jildo - sauket`eso.
translations.footnotes: [1] arabul enashi zmnebi da saxelebi mdedrobit`i da mamrobit`i sk`esis mixedvit` ert`manet`isgan gansxvavebuli p`ormebit` gamoixateba. cminda quranis zogiert` aiat`shi moc`emuli brz'anebebi sheiz'leba mamrobit`i sk`esis p`ormashi iqos moc`emuli, t`umc`a brz'aneba orive sk`esis carmomadgenelze vrc`eldebodes. zogiert`ma sahabem allahis shuamavals ut`xra: ch`ven quranis aiat`ebshi vxedavt`, rom allahi hijrast`an dakavshirebit` mxolod mamakac`ebs axsenebs da k`alebi arsad ar arian naxsenebio. am ambis shemdeg ch`amoevlina aiat`is is nacili, sadac` xazgasmit`aa nat`k`vami, rom arc` kac`s da arc` k`als ar daekargeba t`avisi g'vacli, t`k`ven ert`manet`is srulmk`mneli nacilebi xart` da c`odva-madlis an sasjelisa da jildos sakit`xshi qvelani t`anabarni xart`o.

translations.translation: ar shegashinos urcmunoebis ert`i k`veqnidan meoreshi z'rcolam[1]!
translations.footnotes: [1] es aiat`i im mushrik`ebis shesaxeb ch`amoevlina, romlebic` muslimebisgan gansxvavebit` p`up`unebashi c`xovrobdnen, mshvidad dadiodnen sxvadasxva k`veqanashi da vachrobdnen. zogiert`ma sahabem t`k`va, rom allahis mtrebi sruli simshvidit`a da p`up`unebit` c`xovroben, ch`ven ki gadarch`enist`vis vibrz'vit`o. ix. t`ap`sirul beg'avi.

translations.translation: - (amk`veqniuri ket`ildg'eoba) mc`ire/carmavali sargebelia. jojoxet`ia mat`i t`avshesap`ari, da raoden c`udi sarec`elia igi.

xolo mat`t`vis, visac` ridi hk`ondat` t`aviant`i g'mert`is, - allahisgan, nishnad pativisc`emisa, - samot`xeebia momzadebuli, romelt`a k`veshac` mdinareebi miedinebian. ik` ik`nebian maradzhams. da rac` allahis cinashea, uket`esia is ket`ilshobilt`at`vis.

cheshmaritad, cignboz'ebult`a shoris arian iset`nic`, visac` scamt` allahi; rac` shen ch`amogevlina da rac` mat` ch`amoevlinat`; shishi ak`vt` allahisa da mc`ire sap`asurad ar qidian[1] allahis aiat`ebs. scored isini arian, jildos rom p`loben t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe. cheshmaritad, allahi mscrap`langarishmgebia[2].
translations.footnotes:
[1] amk`veqniuri interesebist`vis ar c`vlian g'vt`iur cignshi moc`emul brz'anebebs da ar malaven muhammed shuamavlis daxasiat`ebas, romelic` mat`t`an arsebul cerilebshi iqo namaxaroblebi.
[2] ibni abbasi, jabiri, enesi da qat`ade gadmogvc`emen, rom es aiat`i et`iopiis mep`is, najashis shesaxeb ch`amoevlina; atas shexedulebit`, es aiat`i 40 najranelis, 32 et`iopelis da 8 romealis shesaxeb ch`amoevlina, romlebic` 'isa shuamavlis rjulze iqvnen da muhammedis shuamavloba ircmunes. ix. t`ap`sirul beg'avi.

translations.translation: ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! moit`minet`, gamz'leoba gamoich`inet`, srul mzadqop`nashi iqavit`[1] da allahis ridi gk`ondet`, - ik`neb gadarch`et`.
translations.footnotes:
[1] originali -,,raabituu" (rbTw): es sitqva carmoebulia,,ribat" (rbT) p`uz'idan, romlis lek`sikonuri mnishvnelobaa dabma, mibma. islamis scavlulebi ganmartebisas ag'nishnul aiat`shi arsebul brz'anebas, romelic`,,ve raabituu" p`ormit`aa moc`emuli, ori mnishvnelobit` ganmartaven:
1. muslimt`a usap`rt`xoebis sadarajoze sagushago morigeobis p`xizlad dac`va. am mok`medebas,,ribati" ecodeba, radganac` gushagi ise ert`gulad da p`exismouc`vlelad dgas sadarajoze, rom t`it`k`os ik` dabmulia. am mnishvnelobas amqarebs sura enp`aalis 8/60-e aiat`ic`, sadac` mtris,,gulis gasaxet`k`ad" mudmivad c`xenebisa da sxva sabrz'olo ag'churvilobis gamzadebaa mocodebuli. allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,allahis gzaze ert`i dg'e ribati, anu sagushago morigeobis dac`va uket`esia, vidre mt`eli dedamica da masze mqop`i arsebebi" (buxari, jihad 73/22892.);,,ert`i dg'e-g'amis ribatshi, anu sagushago morigeobis dac`vashi gatareba uket`esia, vidre ert`i t`ve marxva da g'ameebis g'vt`ismsaxurebashi gatareba" (muslim, iman 50/1913.)
2. mt`eli sulit`a da gulit` g'vt`ismsaxurebebze, gansakut`rebit` ki namazze mijachvuloba, qoveli shesrulebuli namazis shemdeg momdevno namazis mzadmqop`ad molodini. allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,xomar gascavlot` iset`i ram, rit`ac` allahi shec`domebs cashlis da xarisxebs aamag'lebs?" ik` mqop`ebma ut`xres: ra t`k`ma unda, allahis shuamavalo. man t`k`va:,,sirt`ulis miuxedavad abdesis ag'eba, mech`et`isken meti nabijis gadadgma da ert`i namazis shemdeg momdevno namazis molodini. ai esaa ribati"(muslim, taharet` 14/251.). aiat`shi moc`emuli,,rabituu" brz'aneba vt`argmne, rogorc` sruli mzadqop`na, radganac` amit` muslimt`a usap`rt`xoebis sadarajoze mzadqop`nac` shegviz'lia vigulisxmot`, namazist`vis mzadqop`nac` da zogadad, nebismieri brz'anebis shesrulebis an akrz'alulisgan moridebit`vis mzadqop`nac`, rit`ac` morcmune allahis kmaqop`ilebas daimsaxurebs.

translations.translation: ei, adamianebo! ridi gk`ondet` t`k`veni g'mert`isa, romelmac` gagach`inat` ert`i sulisagan, shemdeg misgan misi meug'le gaach`ina da mat`gan uamravi kac`i da k`ali gaamravla. ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, romlis saxelit`ac` survilebs uc`xadebt` ert`manet`s, da nat`esauri kavshiris gacqvetasac` up`rt`xildit`. ut`uod, allahi gmet`valqureobt`.

miec`it` oblebs t`aviant`i k`oneba (roc`a srulclovanni gaxdebian), ar gadac`valot` [1] spetaki (halali) ucmindurshi (haramit`) da arc` k`oneba miirt`vat` mat`i - t`k`vens k`onebast`an ert`ad. ut`uod, didi c`odvaa eg.
translations.footnotes: [1] mat`i k`onebis kargi nacili t`k`veni uvargisi k`onebit` ar ch`aanac`vlot`.

translations.translation: da t`u shishobt`, rom ver daic`avt` samart`lianobas[1] oblebt`an (k`vrivt`an k`orcinebis shemt`xvevashi), mashin im k`alebidan, vinc` halalia t`k`vent`vis, - sheirt`et` ori, sami an ot`xi; xolo t`u shishobt`, rom ver daic`avt` samart`lianobas (mat` shoris), mashin - ert`i (ikmaret`) an is, rasac` p`lobs t`k`veni marjvena[2]. es qvelaze kargi xerxia, rom ar gadaixarot` (usamart`lobisken).
translations.footnotes:
[1] t`ap`sirebshi am aiat`is ganmartebis ramdenime versia arsebobs: 1. rodesac` morcmunet`a dedas, aishas rDy llh `nh, am aiat`is shesaxeb hkit`xes, man ase ganmarta:,,aiat`shi xsenebuli oboli meurvis mzrunvelobis k`vesh mqop`i oboli gogoa, romelic` amavdroulad meurves k`onebis mecilea. oblis k`onebasa da silamazes daxarbebuli meurve c`dilobs, naklebi mehrit`a da sxva pasuxismgeblobebit` sheirt`os igi da mis k`onebas daepatronos. es aiat`i krz'alavs amgvari zraxvebit` oblebis c`olad shert`vas (buxari, t`ap`sir, h.n. 4574.).
2.islamamdel periodshi arabebshi gavrc`elebuli mravalc`olianobis ces-ch`veulebas sazg'vari ar hk`onda. zogiert`ebs at`i da up`ro meti c`oli qavda. amitom es aiat`i mat` mimart`avs: ei, adamianebo! rogorc` oblebt`an mimart`ebashi shishobt`, rom mat`i k`onebis gankargvisas samart`lianad ver moik`c`evit`, aseve k`alebis mimart`ac` allahis shishi ik`oniet`. mat`gan mxolod imdeni sheirt`et`, romelt`a shorisac` samart`lianad mopqrobas shez'lebt`. es sheiz'leba iqos ori, sami an araumetes ot`xi; xolo t`u shishobt` rom ver shez'lebt` mat` shoris samart`lian mopqrobas, - ert`i ikmaret`; an t`u amasac` ver shez'lebt`, mashin mxevalit` dakmaqop`ildit` (ix. t`ap`siru taberi.).
[2] mxevali.

translations.translation: mash, ket`ili nebit` miec`it` k`alebs t`aviant`i mehri, xolo isini t`u t`aviant`i nebit` ik`idan rames dagit`moben, mashin shergebulad miirt`vit` igi.
nu miandobt` t`k`vens (meurveobashi mqop`) k`onebas chkuasustebs[1], risi gankargvac` allahs t`k`vent`vis moubarebia; daapuret` da shemoset` imit` da ket`ili sitqva ut`xarit` mat`.
translations.footnotes: [1] mc`ireclovnebsa da gansjis unaris uk`onelt`

translations.translation: gamosc`adet` oblebi sheug'lebis asakamde da roc`a darcmundebit` mat` zrdasrulobashi, - mashin daubrunet` t`aviant`i k`oneba. ar shechamot` igi nach`k`arevad - mp`langvelobit`a da mat`i zrdasrulobis shishit`. vinc` mdidaria, t`avi sheikavos, xolo vinc` g'aribia, man zomierad miirt`vas[1]. roc`a t`aviant` k`onebas ukan daubrunebt`, mocme t`an iqoliet`... da allahi kmara angarishmgebad.
translations.footnotes: [1] rac` auc`ilebelia mat`i mzrunvelobis an sameurveo jamagirist`vis.

translations.translation: vazhishvilebs cili ergebat` mshoblebisa da nat`esavebis danatovaridan; da k`alishvilebs cili ergebat` mshoblebisa da nat`esavebis danatovridan, miuxedavad imisa, c`ota ik`neba t`u bevri; - garkveuli cili auc`ilebelia.
roc`a memkvidreobis gaqop`as escrebian nat`esavebi, oblebi da upovrebi[1], - mat`ac` uciladet` imisgan da ket`ili sitqva ut`xarit`.
translations.footnotes: [1] romlebsac` memkvidreobidan cili ar ergebat`.

translations.translation: (oblebt`an dakavshirebit`) shishi hk`ondet`[1] imat`, romelnic` dardoben, rom vait`u (gardavic`valot` da) ukan uz'luri sht`amomavloba dagvrch`eso. ridi hk`ondet` allahisa da mxolod ket`ili sitqva t`k`van.
cheshmaritad, isini, vinc` usamart`lod chamen obolt`a k`onebas, - mxolod c`ec`xls shechamen t`aviant` muc`lebshi da c`ec`xlshi shevlen isini, agizgizebulshi.

shvilebt`an dakavshirebit` allahi gicesebt`: vazhs - ori k`alishvilis cilis t`anabari ergeba; xolo t`u k`alishvilebi orze metni ik`nebian (da arc`ert`i vazhi), mashin mat` memkvidreobis ori mesamedi ergebat`; xolo t`u mxolod ert`i k`alishvilia, mashin mas naxevari ergeba; t`u shvili hqavs (gardac`vlils), mashin mis mshoblebs, t`it`oeuls, - memkvidreobis meek`vsedi; xolo t`u ar hqavs (shvili) da mxolod mshoblebi arian misi memkvidreebi, mashin dedas mesamedi ergeba (danarch`eni mamas darch`eba); da t`u dedmamishvilebic` hqavs (gardac`vlils), mashin deda meek`vseds miig'ebs. es qovelive mxolod anderz'is ag'srulebis[1] an valis gastumrebis shemdeg unda shesruldes. t`k`ven ar ic`it`, vin up`ro sargebliania t`k`vent`vis - t`k`veni mamebi t`u t`k`veni shvilebi. es qvelap`eri allahis dadgenili valdebulebebia. cheshmaritad, allahi brz'enia, qovlismc`odne[2].
translations.footnotes:
[1] muslims anderz'it` t`avisi danazogis mxolod ert`i mesamedis gadac`ema sheuz'lia t`avis sasurvel pirebze, danarch`eni - auc`ilebelia, memkvidreebze gadanacildes.
[2] islamis memkvidreobit`i samart`ali mimart`ulia samemkvidreo cilebsa da saojaxo pasuxismgeblobebs shoris balansis damqarebaze; visac` meti xarjvit`i valdebulebebi akisria, is - mets, xolo visac` naklebi xarjvit`i valdebulebebi akisria, is - nakleb cils g'ebulobs. islamis saojaxo samart`lis t`anaxmad, k`orcinebisas, mahri da sxva sak`orcino xarjebi - mamakac`ma unda gaig'os. k`orcinebis shemdegac`, meug'leze, shvilebze da gachirvebul axlo nat`esavebze zrunva, mat`i shemosva, dapureba, dabinaveba, jandac`va da ganat`leba - mamakac`s ekisreba. ag'nishnuli mizezebis gat`valiscinebit`, memkvidreobidan mamakac`i k`alt`an shedarebit` met cils g'ebulobs.

translations.translation: t`k`ven gergebat` t`k`veni c`olebis danatovris naxevari, t`u ar hqavt` mat` shvili; xolo t`u shvili hqavt`, mashin gergebat` mat`i danatovris meot`xedi - mas shemdeg, roc`a ag'sruldeba anderz'i an/da moixdeba valebi; aseve: mat` ergebat` t`k`veni danatovris meot`xedi, t`u shvili ar gqavt`; xolo t`u shvili gqavt`, mashin mat` ergebat` t`k`veni danatovris mervedi - mas shemdeg, roc`a ag'sruldeba anderz'i an/da moixdeba valebi; t`u kac`s an k`als ise ememkvidreebian, rogorc` k`elaale[1], da mas hqavs (dedit`) z'ma an da[2], mashin t`it`oeul mat`gans meek`vsedi ergeba; xolo t`u amaze (ert`ze) meti ik`nebian, mashin isini t`anaziarni ik`nebian mesamedshi - mas shemdeg, roc`a t`it`oeulis dauzaraleblad ag'sruldeba anderz'i an moixdeba valebi: - (es) allahis mier dacesebuli normebia; allahi qovlismc`odnea, lmobieri.
translations.footnotes:
[1] rodesac` gardac`vlils arc` shvilebi qavs, arc` mshoblebi da mat` garda sxva nat`esavebi ememkvidreebian. t`ap`sirebshi am terminis ganmartebisas, ramdenime gansxvavebul versias vxvdebit`: 1. am sitqvit` gardac`vlili moixseneba; 2. es gamoxatavs memkvidres, romelic` aset` vinmes ememkvidreba; 3. esaa samemkvidreo k`oneba. ix. t`ap`siru bag'avi.
[2] ak` igulisxmeba dedit` z'ma an da, xolo ded-mamit` z'mis an dis mdgomareoba amave suras 176-e aiat`shi ik`neba ganxiluli.

translations.translation: amgvaria sazg'vrebi allahisa, xolo vinc` hmorch`ilebs allahsa da mis shuamavals, (allahi) mas sheiqvans samot`xeebshi, romlis k`veshac` mdinareebi miedinebian. ik` ik`nebian maradzhams. ai, esaa mig'ceva - udidesi.
xolo vinc` eurch`eba allahsa da mis shuamavals da sc`deba mis (allahis) sazg'vrebs, - c`ec`xlshi sheiqvans (allahi) mas, ik` ik`neba maradzhams da mist`visaa - sasjeli damamc`irebeli.

mat`, vinc` imrusheben t`k`veni k`alebidan, - mocmed dauqenet` ot`xi t`k`vengani; da t`u daamocmeben, mashin saxlebshi sheakavet`, vidre sikvdili ar miibarebs mat` an sxva gamosavals ar daadgens allahi.
romeli oric` amas ch`aidens t`k`vengan, orive mat`gani sasjelit` daamcuxret`; xolo t`u moinanies, mashin moeshvit`! cheshmaritad, allahi monanult`a usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] mup`essirt`a umravlesobis azrit`, am or aiat`shi (15;16) moc`emuli sasjelis p`ormebi islamis pirvel clebshi mok`medebda, vidre mrushobis sasjeli saboloo p`ormas miig'ebda. sabolood, sura nur-is me-2 aiat`is ch`amovlinebit`a da shuamavlis ganmartebebit`, ag'nishnul aiat`ebshi moc`emuli sasjelis p`ormebi gauk`mda. axali dadgenilebis t`anaxmad, dauk`orcinebel memrusheebs asi rozgi da ert`cliani gadasaxleba, xolo dak`orcinebulebs - ch`ak`olva emuk`rebodat`. scavlult`a ert`i jgup`i t`vlis,(ix: t`ap`siir mep`aat`iihul g'aib/p`axruddin ar-razi), rom am aiat`ebshi moc`emuli sasjelis p`ormebi ar gauk`mebula. mat`i azrit`, sasjelis es p`ormebi ert`sk`esiant`a urt`iert`obebs exeba, amat`gan pirveli - k`alebis, xolo meore - kac`ebis sasjelia.

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, allahi iqabulebs imat` sinanuls, romelnic` umec`rebit` sch`adian uket`urobas, mere ki maleve nanoben; scoredac` iqabulebs allahi mat` sinanuls. allahi brz'enia, qovlis mc`odne.

ar miig'eba sinanuli imat`i, romlebic` uket`urebas sch`adian, vidre romelime mat`gans sikvdili ar mouscrebdes da shemdeg itqodes, rom cheshmaritad, axla movinanieo; da arc` imat`i, romlebic` urcmunoebad daixoc`nen. scored mat`t`vis gavamzadet` mcare sasjeli.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar aris t`k`vent`vis halali, rom iz'ulebit` moik`c`iot` k`alebi memkvidreobashi[1] da k`orcinebis up`leba sheuzg'udot`, rat`a caart`vat` imis nacili, rac` mat`t`vis migic`iat` (mehris saxit`), garda im shemt`xvevisa, t`uki ashkara uzneoba ch`aidines. ket`ilad moepqarit` mat`, t`undac` ar mogcondet` isini. shesaz'loa, ar mogcondet` rag'ac`, magram allahs masshi didi siket`e hk`ondes ch`adebuli.
translations.footnotes: [1] islamamdel periodshi k`ali nivt`isgan arap`rit` gansxvavdeboda. gardac`vlilis c`oli gadadioda memkvidreebis mp`lobelobashi, rogorc` samemkvidreo k`oneba. amis shemdeg, memkvidreebis xelshi iqo mat`i bedi - c`olad sheirt`avden, sxvas miat`xovebden t`u mt`lianad sheuzg'udavden k`orcinebis up`lebas.

translations.translation: da t`u moicadinebt`, rom ert`i c`olis nac`vlad sheirt`od meore, da mat`gan pirvelist`vis[1] t`undac` ut`valavi simdidre gk`ondet` mic`emuli, - ik`idan arap`eri gamoart`vat`! nut`u caart`mevt` mas c`iliscamebit`a da c`xadi borotebit`?
translations.footnotes: [1] romelt`anac` gaqra gcadiat`.

translations.translation: an rogorg'a caart`mevt` (rogor ikadrebt` cart`mevas), roc`a t`k`ven ukve ganumartovdit` ert`manet`s da mat`ac` mtkic`e piroba aig'es t`k`vengan?
ar sheirt`ot` is k`alebi, romlebic` t`k`vens mamebs hqavdat` shert`uli, garda imisa, rac` ukve carsuls ch`abarda. uechvelad, uzneoba (g'vt`is) cqromis mizezia da c`udi gzaa igi.

t`k`vent`vis haramia (rom sheirt`ot`): t`k`veni dedebi, k`alishvilebi, debi, mamidebi, deidebi, z'mis k`alishvilebi, dis k`alishvilebi, (is) z'iz'ebi, romlebmac` z'uz'u gacovat`, z'uz'umte debi, t`k`veni c`olebis dedebi, (is) geri k`alishvilebi, romlebic` t`k`vens saxlshi izrdebian, - im c`olebidan, romlebsac` ukve et`anac`xovret`, xolo t`u mat`t`an ar gic`xovriat` (da ise gaeqaret`), mashin (mat`i shert`va) ar aris c`odva t`k`vent`vis. aseve (t`k`vent`vis haramia), t`k`vens sht`amomaval vazht`a c`olebi da ori da rom ert`doulad sheirt`ot`[1], garda imisa, rac` ukve carsuls ch`abarda. cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia; mcqalobeli.
translations.footnotes: [1] aseve, allahis shuamavalma akrz'ala k`alisa da misi mamidis an deidis ert`droulad, ert`i k`mris k`orcinebashi qop`na. ix. buxari, nik`ah 27/1509; muslim, nik`ah 4/1408.

translations.translation: (gekrz'alebat`) aseve gat`xovili k`alebi, garda imisa, rac` moipova t`k`venma marjvenam[1]. es qvelap`eri allahis mier t`k`venze dakisrebuli valdebulebebia, xolo ak` ch`amot`vlilis mig'ma rac` darch`a, - t`u t`k`veni k`onebit` ez'iebt` patiosnurad (shert`vas) da ara siz'vis miznit`, mashin halalia. ra sargebelic` miig'ot` mat`gan (sheug'lebit`), shesabamisi gadasaxadic` miec`it` (mehri). gansazg'vruli gadasaxadis mic`emis shemdeg t`u morigdebit` urt`iert`kmaqop`ilebit`, - amashi c`odva ar dagedebat`. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismc`odne brz'enia.
translations.footnotes: [1] brz'olis velze tqved aqvanili urcmuno k`alebi

translations.translation: xolo romel t`k`vengansac` ar qop`nis saxsrebi t`avisup`ali morcmune k`alebis shesart`avad, - is morcmune gogo sheirt`os, rac` moipova misma marjvenam. allahma uket` ic`is t`k`veni rcmenis shesaxeb, t`k`ven xom ert`i-meorisgan xart`. mash, t`u ik`nebian patiosnad da aravis gaich`enen memrushed da saqvarlad, - sheirt`et` isini t`aviant`i meurveebis t`anxmobit` da gadauxadet` mehri cesisamebr, xolo sheug'lebis shemdeg t`u imrushes, - mat`i sasjeli t`avisup`ali k`alebis sasjelis naxevaria. es mat`t`visaa,[1] visac` siz'vis eshinia; rom moit`minot`, up`ro xeiriania t`k`vent`vis. allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia; mcqalobeli.
translations.footnotes: [1] mxevlis shert`va.

translations.translation: allahs unda, rom c`xadad gangimartot`[1], dagaqenot` t`k`venze adre mqop`t`a gzebze da iqabulos t`k`veni sinanuli. allahi qovlis mc`odne brz'enia.
translations.footnotes: [1] t`avisi brz'anebebi da akrz'alvebi

translations.translation: allahs unda, rom t`k`veni sinanuli iqabulos, xolo vnebebs aqolilt` undat`, rom didi c`domilebit` gadaixarot` (cheshmaritebisgan).
allahs unda, rom shegimsubuk`ot`, - adamiani xom sust arsebadaa shek`mnili.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar shechamot` ert`manet`is k`oneba usamart`lod, urt`iert`kmaqop`ilebit` vachrobis gareshe, da arc` t`k`veni sulebi daxoc`ot`[1]. cheshmaritad, allahi mocqalea t`k`ven mimart`.
translations.footnotes: [1] arc` t`avi moiklat` da arc` ert`manet`i daxoc`ot`

translations.translation: xolo vinc` es ch`aidinos mtrobit`a da usamart`lobit`, - c`ec`xlshi sheviqvant` mas. es ki iolia allahist`vis.
t`u did c`odvebs moeridebit`, romlebic` gekrz'alebat`, - mashin davp`aravt` t`k`vens (mc`ire) uket`urobebs da siuxvit` gamorch`eul shesasvlelshi shegiqvant`.

da ar isurvot` is, rit`ac` allahma t`k`ven shoris zogiert`i zogiert`ze upirateshqo[1]. kac`ebi miig'eben xvedrs ik`idan, rac` mouxvechavt`; da k`alebic` miig'eben xvedrs ik`idan, rac` mouxvechavt`[2]. mash, allahs st`xovet` cqaloba, cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismc`odnea.
translations.footnotes:
[1] zogiert`ma k`alma t`k`va: mamakac`ebi brz'olis velze ibrz'vian, isini memkvidreobidan orjer met cils p`loben, vidre ch`ven; neta ch`venc` kac`ebad gavch`eniliqavit`, mat` msgavsad gvebrz'ola da memkvidreobidan ch`venc` igive cili migveg'o, rasac` isini g'ebulobeno. amis sapasuxod ag'nishnuli aiat`i ch`amoevlina, romelic` morcmuneebs ascavlis, rom ar sheshurdet` sxvis xelt` arsebuli siket`eebi, romelic` allahma ucqaloba mat`. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.
[2] imk`veqniur sakit`xebshi k`ali da kac`i t`anascoria, qvelas t`avisi namok`medaris shesabamisad miezg'veba, ganusxvaveblad sk`esisa.

translations.translation: ch`ven t`it`oeuls davudginet` memkvidreoba imashi, rac` mshoblebsa da nat`esavebs dautovebiat` mat`t`vis. xolo vist`anac` p`ic`i dagidviat`, mat`ac` miec`it` kut`vnili cili[1]. cheshmaritad, allahi qvelap`ris mocmea.
translations.footnotes: [1] arabebshi gavrc`elebuli adat`is t`anaxmad, ert`manet`t`an daaxloebuli pirebi shemdegi shinaarsis p`ic`s debdnen: ch`emi sisxli sheni sisxlia, ch`emi shurisz'ieba sheni shurisz'iebaa, ch`emi omi sheni omia, ch`emi mshvidoba sheni mshvidobaa, shen xar ch`emi memkvidre da me var sheni memkvidre, me movit`xov shengan da shen moit`xov ch`emgan, shen ch`emgan chkua gescavleba da me shengan chkua mescavlebao. aset`nairad shep`ic`ulebi ert`manet`is memkvidreebad it`vlebodnen. es adat`i islamis pirvel clebshic` grz'eldeboda garkveuli periodis manz'ilze, vidre sura enp`alis 75-e aiat`i ch`amoevlineboda, romelmac` memkvidreoba nat`esauri kavshirit` gansazg'vra. ix. t`ep`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: mamakac`ebi k`alebis meurveebi arian imit`, rac` allahma mat`ze meti ucqalobat`[1] da imit`, rasac` xarjaven t`aviant`i k`onebidan. patiosani k`alebi morch`ilni arian da t`valsmip`arebul mdgomareobashic` ki ic`aven imas, rac` allahis mxridanaa dac`uli[2], xolo romelt`a t`avxedobasac` shishobt`, mat` jer sheagonet`[3], shemdeg sacolidan ganuc`alkevdit`, bolos ki (t`u cina mc`delobebma shedegi ar gamoig'o) msubuk`ad daartqit`[4], da t`u dagmorch`ildebian, - nug'ar daicqebt` mizezebis z'iebas mat` sacinaag'mdegod. cheshmaritad allahi uzenaesi da udiadesia.
translations.footnotes:
[1] z'lieri p`izikuri ag'nagoba da usap`rt`xoebis uzrunvelqop`is unari
[2] namusi, c`ol-k`mruli saidumloebani da k`oneba
[3] allahis shishi da k`mris cinashe arsebuli pasuxismgeblobebi sheaxsenet`
[4] t`u zemot` ag'nishnuli shegoneba da sacolis ganc`alkeveba ushedegod ch`aivlis, mashin ukve msubuk`ad dartqma gank`orcinebis t`avidan ac`ileblebis bolo mc`delobaa, radganac` gank`orcineba gac`ilebit` meti zianis momtania, vidre msubuk`ad dartqma. es ar gulisxmobs p`izikur gascorebas, shurisz'iebas an dasjas; aramed es aris gons mogebisa da gamop`xizlebis mc`deloba mashin, roc`a mdgomareobam ukve piks mig'cia da ojaxis ert`ianobas uk`mnis sap`rt`xes. allahis shuamavali brz'anebs:,,k`alebis shesaxeb allahis geshinodet`, radganac` t`k`ven isini allahis amanat`ad gqavt` aqvanili da misive sitqvit`ve mat`t`an t`anac`xovrebis up`leba moipovet`. t`k`veni up`lebaa, rom t`k`veni ojaxis g'irseba aravis shealaxvinon, rac` mouconaria t`k`vent`vis. da t`u mainc` ase moik`c`evian, mashin msubuk`ad daartqit`" (muslim, haj, 19/1218.). sahabeebis, t`abiinebisa da scavlulebis ganmartebebshi ag'nishnulia, rom msubuk`ad dartqma gulisxmobs t`it`ebit`, misvak`it` an mogrz'od dakec`ili c`xvirsaxoc`it` shexebas da dartqmis imitirebas, romelsac` ar axlavs motexiloba, tkivili da kvali. akrz'alulia msubuk`i dartqma saxis an sxeulis sxva sat`ut`i adgilebis mimart`ulebit`. allahis shuamavali brz'anebs:,,c`ols aravit`ar shemt`xvevashi saxeshi ar gaartqat` da ar daamc`irot`!" (abu davud, nik`ah 42/2142.). samcuxarod, rogorc` adre, aseve dg'esac`, xshiria ojaxuri z'aladobis p`ak`tebi, romelic` c`olk`mruli ut`anxmoebis p`onze vit`ardeba. quranis am aiat`shi, ert`is mxriv, ojaxis dangrevis prevenc`iis mc`delobas vxedavt`, meores mxriv ki c`olk`mruli ut`anxmoebis mcvervalia moc`emuli, romlis ik`it`ac` aravit`ar shemt`xvevashi ar unda gadaizardos. ag'nishnuli zg'varis zevit` gank`orcinebis garda sxva nebismieri mok`medeba danashaulia. rogorc` ukve ag'vnishnet`, es aris ert`gvari zg'vari, sadamdec` sheiz'leba mivides c`olk`mruli ut`anxmoeba, t`umc`a allahis shuamavals esec` ar miach`nda kargi muslimis sak`c`ielad da ambobda:,,t`k`ven shoris qvelaze xeirianebi, c`olebze xels ar ag'mart`aven." (beihaqi, sunen al-k`ubraa, h.n. 14776.).,,t`k`ven shoris qvelaze xeiriani isaa, vinc` qvelaze kargia t`avisi c`olis mimart` da c`olis mimart` qvela t`k`venganze kargi urt`iert`obis mk`one me var." (ibni maje, nik`ah, h.n. 2053.). is aseve brz'anebs:,,romelime t`k`venganma k`ali monasavit` ar garozgos, romelt`anac` dg'is bolos dacolas apirebs." (buxari, nik`ah 93/5204.). morcmunet`a deda aisha gadmogvc`ems:,,allahis shuamavals aravit`ar shemt`xvevashi ar daurtqams arc` k`alist`vis, arc` mosamsaxuresat`vis da arc` c`xovelisat`vis." (muslim, p`edail 20/2328.)

translations.translation: da t`u shishobt`, rom mat` shoris moxdeba ganxet`k`ileba, mashin cargzavnet` ert`i msajuli k`mris ojaxidan da meore msajuli c`olis ojaxidan. t`uki orive gamoscorebas isurveben, allahi mat` t`anxvedrashi moiqvans. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismc`odnea; qovlismc`nobi.

mash, iqavit` allahis mot`aqvaneni da arap`eri ut`anaziarot`... da ket`ili iqavit` mshobelt`a, axlobelt`a, obolt`a, g'atakt`a, axlo mezobelt`a[1], shoreul mezobelt`a[2], gverdshi mdgom megobart`a[3], mgzavrt`a da imat` mimart`, visac` p`lobs t`k`veni marjvena. cheshmaritad, allahs ar uqvars igi, vinc` t`avmomcone da mediduria.
translations.footnotes:
[1] mezobeli, romelic` amave dros nat`esavi an muslimia.
[2] mezobeli, romelic` ar aris nat`esavi an ar aris muslimi.
[3] t`anamgzavri an meug'le.

translations.translation: - romelnic` z'uncoben da xalxsac` siz'unces moucodeben; malaven imas, rac` mat`t`vis allahs uboz'ebia t`avisi cqalobidan. amitom damamc`irebeli sasjeli gavamzadet` urcmunoebist`vis;
- da isinic`, romelnic` k`onebas xalxis dasanaxad xarjaven da ar scamt` allahi, arc` dg'e ukanaskneli; aseve is, visac` megobrad eshmaki eqoleba. raoden c`udi megobaria igi.
ra simz'imed daacvebodat`, t`uki ircmunebdnen allahsa da ukanasknel dg'es, da gaig'ebdnen ik`idan, rac` allahma ucqaloba? allahma xom qvelap`eri ic`is mat` shesaxeb.
cheshmaritad, allahi ert` saxe usamart`lobasac` ar izams, xolo vinc` raime siket`es izams, - gaumravalkec`ebs mas da udides jildos miagebs t`avisi ciag'idan.
mashin ki ra moxdeba, roc`a mocmeebs moviqvant` qoveli t`emidan da shenc` mogiqvant` mocmed amat` cinaag'mdeg?!
- im dg'es, vinc` ar ircmunes da shuamavals eurch`nen, isini inatreben, rom micad k`c`euliqvnen... da mat` allahs ert`i sitqvac` ki ver daumalon.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar miuaxlovdet` namazs mashin, roc`a xart` mt`vrali, - manam, vidre ar gagegebat`, t`u ras ambobt`; da arc` ucmindurobisas[1], sanam ar ganibanebit`, garda mgzavrebisa[2]; xolo t`u avad ik`nebit`, an mgzavrobashi, an sapirp`areshodan gamoxvalt`, an kidev k`alebs sheexebit`[3] da cqals ver ipovit`, mashin sup`t`a micit` t`eimmumi[4] gaaket`et` da saxesa da xelebze ch`amoisvit`. cheshmaritad, allahi mocqalea; usazg'vrod mpatiebeli.
translations.footnotes:
[1] usup`t`aoba, romelic` carmoik`mneba: sk`esobrivi kavshirit`, z'ilis dros an sxva gzit` spermis gadmog'vrisas; mshobiarobisa da dedat`a cesis shemdeg
[2] mgzavrs t`u ar ak`vs ganbanvis sashualeba, mashin t`eimmumi unda gaaket`os da namazi ise sheasrulos
[3] sk`esobrivi miznit` shexeba an ushualo kavshiri
[4] ucqlobis an arsebuli cqlis gamosaqeneblad araxelsaqrel vit`arebashi, sup`t`a micaze an micis nacarmze xelis gulebit` orjer shexeba da shemdeg saxisa da mkvlavebis gacmenda

translations.translation: gana ver xedav imat`, visac` cili xvda cignisa? gzaac`denilobas qiduloben da undat`, rom t`k`venc` asc`det` gzas.
allahma uket` ic`is t`k`veni mtrebi; kmara allahi mp`arvelad da kmara allahi damxmared.

iudevelt`agan zogiert`ni adgils uc`vlian sitqvebs da amboben: movisminet` da veurch`et`; mogvismine da aramc` gsmenodes; ra'ina[1] - ase amaxinjeben mat`i enit`, rat`a sheurac`xqon sarcmunoeba. mat` rom et`k`vat`, movisminet` da davemorch`ilet`; mogvismine da mogvxedeo, rat`k`maunda es mat`t`visve up`ro xeiriani da samart`liani ik`neboda. magram dascqevla isini allahma t`aviant`i urcmunoebis gamo da ar ircmuneben, garda mc`iredisa.
translations.footnotes: [1] sitqva -,,ra'inaa" (r`n) carmoebulia,,ra'a" (r`~) p`uz'idan, rac` mzeris mipqrobas, mzrunvelobas, quradg'ebasa da momcqemsvas nishnavs. es sitqva medinashi mc`xovreb iudevelt`a enaze an mat`shi gavrc`elebul arabul dialek`tze c`udi mnishvnelobit` gamoiqeneboda da, amgvarad, mat` gauch`ndat` muhammed shuamavlis ashkarad lanz'g'vis sashualeba, romelsac` manamde p`arulad aket`ebdnen. isini mas mimart`avdnen sitqvit`,,ra'inaa", romelic` orazrovania: t`it`k`os dadebit`i mnishvnelobit` eubnebodnen, arada misi masxrad agdeba k`ondat` ganzraxuli.

translations.translation: ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` cigni geboz'at`! ircmunet` is (qurani), rac` t`k`vent`an arsebulis (t`oras) damamocmeblad ch`amovavlinet`, vidre (t`k`veni) saxeebi cagvishlia da uku shegvibrunebia, an vidre dagvicqevlia ise, rogorc` shabat`is xalxi davcqevlet`. allahis brz'aneba ag'srulebadia.
cheshmaritad, ar apatiebs allahi, roc`a mas ut`anaziareben, da amis garda qvelap`ers patiobs mat`, visac` moisurvebs. da vinc` allahs ut`anaziara, man mart`lac` didi c`odva dascama.
gana ar ginaxavs isini, romelt`ac` t`avi uc`odvelebad moak`vt`? - pirik`it`, allahi gancmends mas, visac` isurvebs, da p`et`ilisodena[1] usamart`lobasac` ki ar gadaeqrebian.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,al-p`et`iil" (lftyl): p`inikis kurkis g'arshi gadakruli cvrili z'ap`i, romelsac` raime mnishvnelovani cona, moc`uloba da g'irebuleba ar gaach`nia. aiat`i gveubneba, rom isini iotisodena usamart`lobasac` ki ar gadaeqrebian.

translations.translation: shexede, rogor t`xzaven sic`rues allahis shesaxeb, da es sakmarisia ashkara c`odvis dadebist`vis.
gana ver xedav mat`, remelt`ac` cili xvdat` cignidan, - jibt`isa[1] da tag'ut`isa[2] scamt` da urcmunot`a shesaxeb amboben, rom eseni up`ro cheshmarit gzaze dganan, vidre isini, vinc` ircmuneso?!
translations.footnotes:
[1] originali -,,al-jibt`" (ljbt): mup`essirebi am sitqvas ramdenime gansxvavebuli mnishvnelobit` ganmartaven, magalit`ad: es aris qureishelt`a ert`-ert`i kerpis saxeli, allahis nac`vlad sxva nebismieri sat`aqvaneblis zogadi saxeli, jado, jadok`ari, mkit`xavi, eshmaki an is qvelap`eri, rac` allahma akrz'ala. zogadad, es sitqva asoc`irdeba, jadost`an, jadok`art`an, mkit`xavt`an da msgavs rammeebt`an. ix. t`ap`sirul beg'avi.
[2] originali -,,al-tag'ut`" (lTGwt): sitqvis p`uz'is mnishvnelobaa urch`oba an urch`obis gamomcvevi mizezi. z'irit`adad gamoiqeneba eshmakis, kerpis da im qvelap`eris ag'sanishnavad, rac` adamians g'vt`isken mimaval gzaze eg'obeba da g'vt`is nac`vlad mis morch`ilebas avalebs, an rac` sheiz'leba gaxdes zg'vargadasulobisa da urch`obis mizezi.

translations.translation: egeni arian isini, vinc` allahma dacqevla da allahma vinc` dacqevlos, mist`vis veravin hpovo damxmared.
an ik`neb cili ekut`vnit` xelmcip`ebashi? - ase rom qop`iliqo, xalxist`vis naqirsac`[1] ki ar gaimetebdnen.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,al-naqiir" (lnqyr): p`inikis kurkaze arsebuli patara certili, saidanac` kvirti icqebs gag'vivebas da shemdeg qlorti ag'moc`endeba. 49-e aiat`is msgavsad, ak`ac` zomit`, conit`a da g'irebulebit` z'alian patara da umnishvnelo ramezea saubari, og'ond naqiri p`et`ilt`an shedarebit` kidev up`ro patara nacilia p`inikis kurkisa. anu mt`eli samqaros xelmcip`eba rom iqos urcmunot`a xelshi, ik`idan morcmunet`at`vis aset` patara da umnishvnelo nacilsac` ki ar gaimeteben.

translations.translation: an ik`neb shurt` xalxisa, imis gamo, rac` allahma t`avisi cqalobidan mihmadla? cheshmaritad, ibrahimis modgmas ch`ven cigni da sibrz'ne mivec`it` da uzarmazari xelmcip`ebac` vuboz'et`.
mat`gan arian, vinc` ircmunes igi da mat`gan arian isini, vinc` zurgi sheak`c`ies. jojoxet`i sakmarisia mat`t`vis (urcmunoebist`vis) agizgizebuli c`ec`xlit`.

cheshmaritad, vinc` ar ircmunes ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi, - bolos mat` c`ec`xlshi sheviqvant`; qovel jerze, rogorc` ki kani daecvebat`, axali kanit` ch`avunac`vlebt`, rat`a kargad igemon mat`i sasjeli. cheshmaritad, allahi brz'enia, z'levamosili.

xolo romelt`ac` ircmunes da hk`mnes ket`ili, mat` sheviqvant` samot`xeebshi, romlt`a k`veshac` - dian mdinareni. ik` ik`nebian maradzhams. ik` arian mat`t`vis umcikvlo meug'leebi da ch`rdilshi sheviqvant` - maradiul sach`rdilobelshi.

cheshmaritad, allahi gibrz'anebt`, rom amanat`i patrons daubrunot` da roc`a adamianebs shoris msajulobt`, samart`lianad imsajulet`. mart`lac`, ra mshvenieria is, rit`ac` allahi shegagonebt`. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlis msmeni da mxedvelia[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] k`aabas cminda samloc`velos movla-patronoba da hajebis gamaspinz'leba carmart`i arabebist`visac` cminda da sapatio sak`med it`vleboda. amitom ag'nishnult`an dakavshirebuli movaleobebi qureishelt`a gvarebs shoris iqo gadanacilebuli, romelic` t`aobidan t`aobas gadaec`emoda. k`aabas ag'ebis periodshi (sidane) k`aabas mzrunveloba da misi gasag'ebi osman bin talhas xelshi iqo. rodesac` shuamavali mek`k`ashi shevida, osmanma k`aabas karebi ch`aketa da shuamavlis shignit` sheshvebas ar apirebda. shuamavalma k`aabas gasag'ebi rom it`xova, osmanma ase t`k`va: rom mc`odnoda, rom is mart`lac` allahis shuamavalia, mashin k`aabas shignit` shesvlaze xels ar shevushlidi. am dros 'ali bin abutalibi mast`an mivida, gasag'ebi xelidan z'alad gamoglija, k`aabas karebi gaxsna da shuamavali shignit` sheushva. shuamavalma k`aabas shignit` ori muxli namazi sheasrula da isev gamovida, garet` gamosul shuamavals t`avisma biz'am abbasma st`xova, rom k`aabas gasag'ebi mist`vis gadaec`a. is am dros (siqae) hajebis dacqurebit` iqo pasuxismgebeli da undoda k`aabas movla-patronobis sak`mec` mas ekisra. am dros allahma es aiat`i ch`amoavlina, razec` allahis shuamavalma osmanist`vis gasag'ebis dabrunebisa da bodishis moxdis brz'aneba gasc`a. 'ali bin abu talibi asec` moik`c`a, osmanma ki mas ase ut`xra: jer uxeshad momek`ec`i, damamc`ire da axla moxvedi da bodishs mixdi? 'ali bin abu talibma ut`xra, rom allahma shens shesaxeb quranis aiat`i ch`amoavlinao da ag'nishnuli aiat`i caukit`xa. amaze osmanma shemdegi sitqvebi carmot`k`va:,,eshhedu ellaa ilaahe illellah ve eshhedu enne muhammede'r-rasuulullah" (vamocmeb, rom ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba garda allahisa, aseve vamocmeb, rom muhammedi misi shuamavalia). amgvarad, k`aabas gasag'ebi mast`an darch`a, misi gardac`valebis shemdeg ki gasag'ebi mis z'mas gadaec`a da ase gadaec`emat` mat` sht`amomavlobas t`aobidan t`aobaze k`aabas movla-patronobis cminda samsaxuri. ix. t`ap`sirul beg'avi.

translations.translation: ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! daemorch`ilet` allahs, daemorch`ilet` shuamavals da t`k`ven shoris mqop` met`aurebs[1], xolo t`u romelime sakit`xshi ut`anxmoeba mogividet`, mashin allaht`an da mis shuamavalt`an miitanet` igi. t`uki gcamt` allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli, es up`ro xeiriani da umshvenieresi shedegis momtani ik`neba.
translations.footnotes: [1] quranis scavlult`a shoris azrt`a sxvadasxvaobaa met`aurt`a vinaobast`an dakavshirebit`. z'irit`adad gvxvdeba ot`xi shexeduleba, rom ak` isini arian: 1. mmart`velebi 2. scavlulebi 3. sahabeebi 4. abu bek`iri da omari. ix. t`ap`siru taberi.

translations.translation: gana ver xedav imat`, romlebic` amtkic`eben, rom scamt` is, rac` shen ch`amogevlina da rac` ch`amoevlinat` shenze adre? mat` undat`, rom tag'ut`is cinashe ganisajon[1], arada misi uarqop`a k`ondat` nabrz'anebi. eshmaks unda, rom scori gzidan shors gadaiqvanos, gzaabnevashi[2].
translations.footnotes:
[1] tag'ut`t`an ez'eben samart`als.
[2] gadmoc`emis t`anaxmad, medinashi ert`-ert` iudevelsa da munaap`iqs (p`arisevels) ut`anxmoeba mouxdat`, sadavo sakit`xis mosagvareblad msajult`an misvla da problemis mogvareba iqo sachiro. iudevels undoda, muhammed shuamavalt`an misuliqvnen da msajulobist`vis miemart`at`, radganac` ic`oda, rom is samart`lianobidan aravit`ar shemt`xvevashi ar gadauxvevda da arc` k`rt`ams aig'ebda. munaap`iqi, iudevelis shemot`avazebas ar t`anxmdeboda da sakit`xis ert`-ert`i iudevelis cinashe ganxilvas it`xovda, radganac` ic`oda, rom iudeveli msajuli k`rt`ams aig'ebda da mis mosqidvas shez'lebda. bolos oriveni iudevelis msajulobaze shet`anxmdnen. am ambis shesaxeb me-60 da momdevno ramdenime aiat`i ch`amoevlina.
aiat`i konkretuli movlenis shesaxeb ch`amoevlina, t`umc`a is zogadad qvelas exeba, vinc` shariat`is dadgenilebebs ar moiconebs. konkretulad aiat`shi,,tag'ut`"-ad moxsenebulia iudeveli msajuli k`a'b bin ashrap`i, t`umc`a es aris zogadi c`neba, rit`ac` shariat`is mart`lmsajulebis mig'ma mqop`i qvela sxva alternativa moixsenieba.
es aiat`i amavdroulad gvich`venebs, rom gulcrp`eli rcmenis dasturi, allahis shariat`is da masshi arsebuli qoveli brz'anebis morch`ilebaa. vinc` amtkic`ebs, rom is aris morcune, t`umc`a allahis gadacqvetilebebs tag'ut`is gadacqvetilebebi urch`evnia, is matquaraa.

translations.translation: roc`a etqvian: modit` imast`an, rac` allahma ch`amoavlina, da shuamavalt`ano, mashin dainaxav, t`u rogor ibruneben pirs shengan da gagec`lebian - p`arisevelni.

da ra ik`neba mashin, roc`a gansac`deli ecevat` imis gamo, rac` ch`aidines mat`ma xelebma; shemdeg shent`an movlen da allahis dap`ic`ebas daicqeben, rom ch`ven amit` sxva arap`eri gvsurda, garda siket`isa da t`anxmobisao?
egeni arian, romelt`a shesaxebac` ic`is allahma, t`u ra aris mat` gulebshi. mash, moeride mat`, sheagone da sulshich`amcvdomi sitqva ut`xari.

ch`ven qvela shuamavali mxolod imist`vis carmovgzavnet`, rom allahis nebit` mas damorch`ilebodnen. roc`a isini (p`arisevelni) usamart`lod moek`c`nen t`aviant` sulebs, - mashinve rom shent`an mosuliqvnen da allahist`vis patieba et`xovat`, da shuamavalic` rom mat`i patiebist`vis vedrebas ag'avlenda, isini ut`uod hpovebdnen allahs - monanult`a usazg'vrod mpatiebels, mcqalobels.

- ara da ara! vp`ic`av shens g'mert`s, rom ise ver ircmuneben, sanam ar agirch`even msajulad imashi, rashic` ut`anxmoebaa mat` shoris, da sanam savsebit` ar damorch`ildebian shen mier mig'ebul ganach`ens ise, rom mc`iredi sachochmanoc` ver hpovon t`aviant` gulebshi.

t`undac` dagvekisra mat`t`vis, rom daxoc`et`[1] ert`manet`i an miatovet` t`k`veni samshobloo, amas mc`iredis garda arc`ert`i mat`gani ar izamda. ra rch`evebsac` g'ebulobdnen[2] isini, mart`lac` rom sheesrulebinat`, ra t`k`ma unda, up`ro meti xeiri da simtkic`e ik`neboda es mat`t`vis.
translations.footnotes:
[1] rogorc` musa shuamavlis dros israelis modgmas vubrz'anet`: mat`, vinc` ar qop`ilan xbos mot`aqvaneni, - sikvdilit` dasajon isini, vinc` iqvnen xbos mot`aqvaneni.
[2] shumavlis morch`ilebisa da tag'ut`is uarqop`is shesaxeb.

translations.translation: da mashin ch`veni ciag'idan auc`ileblad mivagebdit` mat` udides jildos (samot`xes).
da ut`uod, scori gzit` davakvalianebdit` mat`.

xolo vinc` morch`ilia allahisa da shuamavlisa, scored egeni ik`nebian imat`t`an ert`ad, viszec` cqaloba moig'o allahma: mac`neebt`an, ert`gulebt`an, shehidebt`an da sat`noebt`an. ra mshvenieri t`anmxlebni arian isini[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] ert`i kac`i mac`nest`an mivida da ut`xra:,,o, allahis shuamavalo! allahs vp`ic`av, me shen sakut`ar sulze metad miqvarxar. cheshmaritad, me shen ch`ems meug'leze da k`onebaze metad miqvarxar, shen ch`emt`vis ch`ems shvilze up`ro saqvareli xar. roc`a saxlshi var da shen maxsendebi, shent`an t`u ar movedi da ar shemogxede, ise ver vz'leb. maxsendeba, rom ert` dg'es mec` movkvdebi da shenc`. vic`i, shen rom samot`xeshi shexval, mac`neebt`an amag'ldebi. amitom vshishob (da guli mcqdeba), rom samot`xeshi t`u shevedi, ik` veg'ar shevz'leb shens danaxvas". rasac` moqva ag'nishnuli aiat`is ch`amovlineba (taberani, mu'jemu's-sag'iir, h.n. 52.).

translations.translation: esaa madli allahisa da kmara allahi qovlismc`odned.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! (sabrz'olo mzadqop`na da) sip`rt`xile moikribet` da (mtris cinaag'mdeg) jgup`-jgup`ad gaemart`et` an ert`ianad gaeshuret`.

uechvelad, auc`ileblad ik`neba t`k`venshi vinme iset`i, vinc` p`exs ait`revs (brz'olisas). xolo t`u ubedureba shegemt`xvat`, mashin itqvis: cheshmaritad, allahma cqaloba moig'o ch`emze, rom mat`t`an ert`ad ar viqavi imis momscre.
da t`u cqaloba gxvdat` allahisgan, mashin ise itqvis, t`it`k`os t`k`vensa da mas shoris sulac` ar qop`iliqo siqvaruli:,,mat`t`an ert`ad rom vqop`iliqavi, mec` did carmatebas movipovebdi"-o.
mash, allahis gzaze iomon mat`, romlebic` amk`veqniur c`xovrebas imk`veqniuris p`asad qidian. xolo vinc` iomos allahis gzaze da mokvdes an gaimarjvos, - mas mivagebt` udides jildos.
translations.footnotes: [1] jihadshi causvlelobis c`odvebi moinanion, muslimebs mxarshi amoudgnen da allahis gzaze ibrz'olon.

translations.translation: da ra gemart`ebat`, rom allahis gzaze ar omobt` mashin, roc`a uz'luri kac`ebi, k`alebi da bavshvebi amboben:,,g'mert`o ch`veno! gvixseni am k`alak`idan, romlis mkvidrnic` mch`agvrelebi arian, sheni ciag'idan mogvivline mxsneli da sheni ciag'idanve dagvidgine damxmare."
isini, vinc` ircmunes, allahis gzaze omoben, xolo isini, vinc` ar ircmunes, tag'ut`is gzaze omoben. mash, eomet` eshmakis momxreebs. cheshmaritad, eshmakis xrikebi ususuria.

gana ver xedav imat`, romlebsac` ut`xres: xeli aig'et` (brz'olaze), namazi ag'asrulet` da zek`at`i gaec`it`o. xolo rodesac` savaldebulod dadginda mat`ze omi, mashin, mat` nacils ise sheeshindat` xalxis, rogorc` allahisa eshinodat`, an up`ro z'lierma shishma sheipqro, da t`k`ves:,,g'mert`o ch`veno! ratom dagvidgine omi savaldebulod? netav axlo momavlamde gadagevadebina igi ch`vent`vis[1] ''. ut`xari: amk`veqniuri sargebeli mc`irea, xolo imk`veqniuri umjobesia mist`vis, vinc` g'vt`ismoshishia, xolo t`k`ven p`et`ilisodena[2] usamart`lobasac` ki ar gadaeqrebit`.
translations.footnotes:
[1] zogi muslimi islamis pirvel clebshi carmart`ebs gamomcvevad elaparakebodnen da allahis shuamavals eubnebodnen: o, allahis shuamavalo, mat` cinaag'mdeg bz'olis neba mogvec`i, radganac` isini t`aviant`i sitqvit`a da sak`mit` gvacuxeben. shuamavali mat` ase pasuxobda: brz'olaze xeli aig'et`, ramet`u me mat` cinaag'mdeg brz'olis brz'aneba ar mimig'ia. hijret`is shemdeg, rodesac` allahma mushrik`ebis cinaag'mdeg brz'olisa da t`avdac`vis shesaxeb aiat`ebi ch`amoavlina, zogiert`ebs amgvari brz'aneba ert`ulat` da cucuni daicqes, g'mert`ma brz'olis valdebuleba ratom dagvicesao. ix. t`ap`isru beg'avi.
[2] originali,,al-p`et`iil" (lftyl) p`inikis kurkis g'arshi gadakruli cvrili z'ap`ia, romelsac` raime mnishvnelovani cona, moc`uloba da g'irbuleba ar gaach`nia. aiat`i gveubneba rom isini iotisodena usamart`lobasac` ki ar gadaeqrebian.

translations.translation: sadac` ar unda iqot`, sikvdili mainc` mogcvdebat`, - t`undac` mtkic`e da mag'al c`ixesimagreebshi... - da t`u siket`e xvdat`, amboben:,,es allahisganaa"; xolo t`u ubedureba sheemt`xvat`, mashin amboben:,,es sheni bralia (muhammed)''. ut`xari: qvelap`eri allahisganaa. ra chirs am xalxs, rom ar c`diloben sitqvis shesmenas.
-,,ra siket`ec` gxvda, allahisganaa, xolo ra ubedurebac` shegemt`xva, - shengan": ch`ven carggzavnet` shuamavlad xalxist`vis da kmara mocmed allahi[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] zogiert`ma scavlulma es aiat`i ase axsna:,,ra chirs am xalxs, rom ar c`diloben sitqvis shesmenas da kidev amboben, rom ra siket`ec` gxvda, allahisganaa, xolo ra ubedurebac` shegemt`xva - shengano? ix. t`avp`isru qurtubi.

translations.translation: vinc` hmorch`ilebs shuamavals, is ut`uod, morch`ilia allahisa, xolo vinc` pirs ibrunebs, - ra t`k`ma unda, ch`ven ar carmogvigzavnixar mat` met`valqured.

(p`arisevelni) morch`ilebas gic`xadeben, magram roc`a shengan midian, mat`i nacili sul sxvas gegmavs g'amit`, vidre shen ambob. allahi icers qvelap`ers, rasac` isini g'amit` gegmaven. mash, ganudek`i mat` da allahs miende... da kmara allahi vek`ilad.
nut`u qurans ar gaiazreben? igi sxvagnidan rom mosuliqo, garda allahisa, - auc`ileblad hpovebdnen uamrav sheusabamobas.

da roc`a raime c`noba ag'cevs mat`t`an usap`rt`xoebis an sap`rt`xis shesaxeb, - mashinve avrc`eleben mas[1]. magram shuamavalt`an an t`aviant` mmart`velebt`an (scavlulebt`an) rom mietanat` igi, ut`uod dakvaliandebodnen[2] isini, romlebsac` misi sat`anado shep`asebis unari gaach`niat`. allahis siket`e da cqaloba rom ar qop`iliqo t`k`venze, ut`uod eshmaks gahqvebodit`, garda mc`iredisa.
translations.footnotes:
[1] munaap`iqebi qvela axal ambavs mourideblad avrc`elebdnen xalxshi ise, rom arc` mis simart`les amocmebdnen da arc` imas kit`xulobdnen, es inp`ormac`ia saidumlo xom ar iqo.
[2] shuamavali, mmart`velebi an scavlulebi scor darigebebs misc`emdnen mat`, t`u rogor unda mok`c`euliqvnen.

translations.translation: mash, ibrz'ole allahis gzaze; aravin aiz'ulo, garda sakut`ari t`avisa, da sheaguliane morcmuneebi (sabrz'olvelad)! ra t`k`ma unda, sheakavebs allahi mat` z'alas, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes. allahi qvelaze didi z'alisa da sasjelis mk`onea.
vinc` ket`ilad ishuamdgomlebs, mas xvedri ek`neba misgan; xolo vinc` borotad ishuamdgomlebs, masac` ek`neba cili[1]. uzenaesi allahi qovlismxedvelia.
translations.footnotes: [1] ibni abbasma t`k`va: ket`ili shuamdgomloba, adamianebs shoris daz'abuli urt`iert`obebis gamoscorebis mc`delobaa; xolo boroti shuamdgomloba, adamianebs shoris xmebis mitan - motanaa. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: da roc`a gesalmebian, t`k`ven uket`esad miesalmet` an igivenairad. cheshmaritad, allahi ag'mric`xvelia qovelivesi.
allahi... - ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda misi, - auc`ileblad shegkrebt` igi gankit`xvis dg'es, rashic` echvi ar arsebobs... da vinaa allahze up`ro sitqva-mart`ali?

da ra gemart`ebat`, rom p`arisevlebt`an mimart`ebashi or jgup`ad iqop`it`? allahma ukuak`c`ia isini imist`vis, rac` mat` moixveches[1]. gindat`, rom scor gzaze daaqenot` is, vinc` gzas aac`dina allahma? visac` aac`dens allahi, (shen) veranair gamosavals gamonaxav imat`t`vis![2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] t`aviant`i p`arisevluri mok`medebebis gamo allahis cinashe urcmunoebad shep`asdnen.
[2] arsebobs ramdenime versia, t`u vis shesaxeb ch`amoevlina ag'nishnuli aiat`i. ert`-ert`i versiit`, es aiat`i im munaap`iqebis shesaxeb ch`amoevlina, romlebmac` uhudis brz'olas t`avi daarides da shua gzidan ukan mibrundnen. brz'olis dasrulebis shemdeg sahabet`a nacili mat` cinaag'mdeg galashk`rebis momxre iqo, radganac` isini munap`iqebad miach`ndat`; xolo meore nacili mat`i patiebis momxre iqo, radganac` isini mxolod sitqvierad ambobdnen, rom muslimebi vart`o. kidev ert`i versiis t`anaxmad, es aiat`i qureishelt`a shesaxeb ch`amoevlina, romlebic` medinashi ch`avidnen da islami miig'es. xanmokle muslimanobis shemdeg islami uarqves, t`umc`a shuamavals mat`i gulis zraxvebi ar gaumxiles da vachrobis miznit` mek`k`ashi dabrunebis neba st`xoves. mek`k`ashi dabrunebulebma medinashi ag'ar dabrundnen. garkveuli drois shemdeg medinel muslimebt`an ambavi mivida, rom ag'nishnuli xalxi savachro k`aravnit` shamis mimart`ulebit` miemgzavrebodnen. amast`an dakavshirebit` muslimebi bchobdnen, t`u rogori damokidebuleba k`onodat` mat` mimart`: nacili ambobda, rom t`avs davesxat`, davxoc`ot` da mat`i k`oneba nadavlis saxit` camovig'ot`o; meore nacili amis cinaag'mdegi iqo da ambobda, rom rogor unda daxoc`ot` t`k`veni t`anamorcmuneebi mxolod im mizezit`, rom mat` ar miatoves t`aviant`i samshoblo da hijret`i ar gaaket`eso. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: - natroben, neta t`k`venc` urcmunod gadaik`c`et`, rogorc` t`vit`on ar ircmunes, da iqot` mat`i t`anascorni. amitom aravin aiqvanot` mat`gan megobrad, vidre hijras[1] ar gaaket`eben allahis gzaze, xolo t`u piri ibrunes, mashin sheipqarit` da daxoc`et`, sadac` caacqdebit`. arc` megobari iqoliot` mat`gan da arc` damxmare.
translations.footnotes: [1] 'ik`rimem t`k`va, ak` sul sxva hijret`i igulisxmebao da ganmarta: 1. hijret`i islamis pirvel clebshi. 2. mot`minebit`a da samagieros allahisgan molodinit` allahis shuamavalt`an ert`ad sabrz'olvelad casvla. am aiat`shi scored es igulisxmeba. es aiat`i, amavdroulad, morcmuneebs munaap`iqebt`an megobrobas ukrz'alavs, vidre isini morcmuneebt`an ert`ad allahis gzaze brz'olist`vis ar gaeshurebian. 3. moraluri hijret`i, romelic` qvela muslims moet`xoveba. esaa qovelgvari borotisgan gandegiloba, rogorc` brz'anebs muhammed shuamavali:,,muhajiri aris is, vinc` zurgi ak`c`ia im qvelap`ers, rac` allahma aukrz'ala mas." (buxari, iman 4/10.) ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: - garda imat`i, romlebic` t`avs ap`areben xalxs, romlebt`anac` (samshvidobo) shet`anxmeba gak`vt`, an imat`i, romlebic` movidnen da guli ar miudit` omze t`k`vent`an an t`aviant` xalxt`an. allahs rom eneba, isini ut`uod gaz'lierdebodnen t`k`venze da geomebodnen kidec`[1]. amitom, t`uki gagec`lebian, xels aig'eben omze t`k`vens cinaag'mdeg da mshvidobas shemogt`avazeben, - allahi ar gaz'levt` gzas mat` cinaag'mdeg (sabrz'olvelad).
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis nebit`, mushrik`ebis gaz'lierebisa da muslimebze gamarjvebis mizezi muslimebs shoris gavrc`elebuli uket`urebebisa da g'vt`is mimart` siurch`is sasjelia, an kidev mat`i gamoc`da. ix. qurtubi, al-jaami'u li ahk`aami'l-qu'raan.

translations.translation: aseve hpovebt` sxvebs, romlebsac` usap`rt`xoeba surt` - t`k`venganac` da t`aviant`i xalxisganac`. qovelt`vis, roc`a p`it`nasken moucodeben, mashinve c`vivdebian masshi[1]. t`uki ar gagec`lebian, ar shemogt`avazeben mshvidobas da ar moishlian xelis ag'mart`vas, mashin daichiret` da ik`ve daxoc`et`, sadac` caacqdebit`. scored egeni arian, vis cinaag'mdegac` ashkara samxili mogvic`ia t`k`vent`vis[2].
translations.footnotes:
[1] shirk`is an muslimt`a cinaag'mdeg brz'olisken vinc` moucodebs, qvelas dadebit`ad pasuxoben.
[2] aiat`shi saubaria p`arisevlebze, romlebic` ert`is mxriv, muslimebs ep`ic`ebodnen z'mobas da t`anamorcmuneobas, meores mxriv, mushrik`ebs, rat`a orive mxridan mosalodneli sap`rt`xisgan guldamshvidebulni qop`iliqvnen da orive mxares arsebuli sxvadasxva siket`it` t`u privilegiit` advilad esargeblat`. ibni abbasis gadmoc`emit`, ak` asadisa da g'atap`anis gvaris munap`iqebzea saubari. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: daushvebelia, morcmunem moklas morcmune, garda shec`domisa. xolo vinc` shec`domit` moklas morcmune, misi valia, morcmune monis gat`avisup`leba da (moklulis) ojaxist`vis sisxlis gamosasqidis gadaxda, t`uki (moklulis ojaxma) mocqalebis saxit` ar apatia. xolo t`u (mokluli) im xalxidanaa, romelic` t`k`veni mteria, magram t`vit`on morcmunea, mashin (mxolod) morcmune monis gat`avisup`leba. xolo t`u im xalxidanaa, romelt`anac` zavi dagidviat`, mashin misi ojaxist`vis sisxlis gamosasqidis gadaxda da morcmune monis gat`avisup`leba. xolo visac` ar moepoveba (gamosasqidis sashualeba), man ori t`ve ucqvetliv imarxos, allahis cinashe sinanulis nishnad. allahi qovlis mc`odne brz'enia.
da vinc` ganzrax moklas morcmune, - misi sasjeli jojoxet`ia da ik` ik`neba maradzhams. allahi gaucqra mas, dascqevla da udidesi sasjeli gaamzada mist`vis.
translations.footnotes: [1] gadmoc`emebis t`anaxmad, iudevelebma muhammed shuamavals ut`xres:,,shen amtkic`eb, rom ibrahimis `lyh lslm gzas adgaxar, t`umc`a ibrahimi `lyh lslm arc` ak`lemis xorc`s miirt`mevda da arc` mis nacvels, xolo shen miirt`mev mat`. ak`edan gamomdinare, shen ar adgaxar ibrahimis gzas; dg'es ch`ven rasac` haramad mivich`nevt`, is mashin ibrahimist`visac` `lyh lslm harami iqo, vidre ch`venamde ar moag'cevda." amis sapasuxod ch`amoevlina ag'nishnuli aiat`i, rom akrz'alva ia'qubma `lyh lslm t`vit`on daicesa, manamde, vidre allahi musas `lyh lslm t`evrat`s ch`amouvlenda, xolo es akrz'alva t`evrat`shi naxsenebi ar aris. ix. t`ap`sirul bag'avi.

translations.translation: ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! roc`a allahis gzaze (sabrz'olvelad) gaemart`ebit`, kargad ganasxvavet` (morcmune da urcmuno), da vinc` mogesalmebat`, amk`veqniuri sargeblis miznit` ar ut`xrat` mas - shen ar xar morcmuneo. allahis cinashea uric`xvi alap`i (nadavli). adre t`k`venc` ase iqavit`[1] da shemdeg allahma madli moig'o t`k`venze. ase rom, kargad gaarkviet`. cheshmaritad, ic`is allahma, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
translations.footnotes: [1] adre t`k`venc` gzaabneulni iqavit`, shemdeg islami miig'et`, magram t`k`veni gvaris xalxs umalavdit` da mxolod,,laa ilaaha illallah"-is ag'iarebis gamo muslimebi t`aviant` z'mebad gt`vlidnen. bolos allahis cqalobit` medinashi gadasaxldit` da islami ashkarad ganac`xadet`.

translations.translation: morcmunet`a shoris umizezod shin msxdomni ver ut`anascordebian mat`, vinc` allahis gzaze t`aviant`i k`onebit`a da sulebit` ibrz'vian. t`aviant`i k`onebit`a da sulit` mebrz'olni - upirateshqo allahma shin msxdomebze. allahma orives siket`e ag'ut`k`va, t`umc`a mebrz'olebi shin msxdomebt`an shedarebit` udidesi jildot`i upirateshqo.
misganaa sxvadasxva xarisxi, patieba da cqaloba. allahi usazg'vrod mimtevebeli da mcqalobelia.

cheshmaritad, roc`a miibares angelozebma isini, romlebic` usamart`loni iqvnen t`aviant`i sulebis mimart`, - hkit`xes: rit` iqavit` dakavebulni? mat` t`k`ves: uz'lurni viqavit` dedamicazeo. (angelozebmac`) ut`xres: gana allahis dedamica ar iqo ganieri, rom sxvagan gadasaxlebuliqavit`? ai, mat`i samqop`elia jojoxet`i, da ra c`udi misak`c`ielia igi.
- garda uz'luri kac`ebis, k`alebis da bavshvebisa, romlebsac` moxerxeba ar hqop`nit`, rom raime gzas daadgnen.
- ai, mat`t`visaa imedi, rom allahi apatiebs; allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia; mimtevebeli.

da vinc` hijras gaaket`ebs allahis gzaze, is hpovebs dedamicaze mraval t`avshesap`arsa da siuxves; da vinc` t`avisi saxlidan gava, rogorc` allahisa da misi shuamavlisken mimavali muhajiri, shemdeg ki (gzashi) sikvdili eceva, uechvelad, misi madli allahzea; allahi usazg'vrod mimtevebelia, mcqalobeli.

da roc`a k`veqnad samogzaurod gaeshurebit`, c`odva ar dagedebat`, namazi rom sheamoklot`, t`uki mat` t`avdasxmas shishobt`, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes[1]. cheshmaritad, ashkarad gmtroben t`k`ven urcmunoebi.
translations.footnotes: [1] rodesac` abdullah bin omars ut`xres, rom cminda quranshi sap`rt`xis k`vesh da ch`veulebriv mdgomareobashi namazis shesrulebis shesaxeb ganmartebebi arsebobs, t`umc`a mgzavrobisas shesasrulebeli namazis shesaxeb verap`ers vpoulobt`o, man ase upasuxa: o, ch`emo z'mishvilo! uechvelad, uzenaesma allahma ch`vent`an muhammedi carmogzavna, (manamde) ch`ven arap`eri vic`odit`, ch`ven mxolod ise vik`c`evit`, rogorc` misgan davinaxet`. (muvatta, qasru salat`, 2/7)

translations.translation: roc`a mat` shoris ik`nebi da mat`t`vis loc`vis cinamz'g'vrobas daapireb, shent`an ert`ad ert`i jgup`i dadges imat`gan, - t`an iarag'ebi echirot`; roc`a sejdes ag'avlenen, shemdeg t`k`vens ukan gadavidnen, xolo meore jgup`i, romelsac` jer ar uloc`avs, movides da shent`an ert`ad iloc`os, t`an sip`rt`xile ik`onios da iarag'ic`; urcmunoebi natroben, rom quradg'eba moscqvitot` iarag'sa da sachiro nivt`ebs, rat`a moulodneli t`avdasxma mogicqon. c`odvad ar dagedebat`, cvimit` an avadmqop`obit` shecuxebulni t`u iarag's ch`amoixsnit`, magram sip`rt`xile mainc` gmart`ebt`[1]. cheshmaritad, allahma damamc`irebeli sasjeli gaamzada urcmunoebist`vis.
translations.footnotes: [1] ert`-ert`i gadmoc`emis t`anaxmad, allahis shuamavals loc`vis dros xmali xurmis xeze k`onda ch`amokidebuli. urcmunot`agan g'avras bin harisi shuamavalt`an xmalgashishvlebuli mivida, t`avze daadga da ut`xra: axla vin gixsnis ch`emi xelidan? shuamavalma:: allahio. urcmunos moulodnelad xelidan xmali dauvarda (ert`-ert`i versiis t`anaxmad, g'avram zurgshi z'lieri dartqma igrz'no da pirk`ve daemxo, t`umc`a vinc` daartqa, is uxilavi arseba iqo). shuamavalma xmals mashinve dastac`a xeli da ut`xra: axla shen vin gixsnis ch`emi xelidan? g'avram: iqavi is, vinc` borots siket`it` pasuxobs. shuamavalma ut`xra: daamocmeb, rom ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba garda allahisa? man ut`xra: ara, t`umc`a sitqvas gaz'lev, rom amieridan shens cinaag'mdeg ag'ar vibrz'oleb da arc` im xalxis mxardamcheri vik`nebi, vinc` shen gebrz'vis. shuamavalma am kac`s gza misc`a da gaushva. is t`avis megobrebt`an mivida da ut`xra: me t`k`vent`an adamiant`a shoris qvelaze kargisgan movdivar. (ahmed, al-musned, h.n. 14929-15190) scored am shemt`xvevis shemdeg uzenaesma allahma 102-e aiat`i ch`amoavlina, sadac` ag'cerilia sap`rt`xis k`vesh namazis shesrulebis cesebi.

translations.translation: xolo rodesac` (sap`t`xis k`vesh) loc`vas morch`ebit`, axsenet` allahi - dgomisas, jdomisas t`u mxarze camocolilni, da roc`a guls daimshvidebt` usap`rt`xoebit`, mashin (srulad) ag'avlinet` namazi. cheshmaritad, gansazg'vrul droebshi namazi savaldebuloa morcmunet`at`vis.

t`avs nu daisustebt` (momtro) xalxis devnashi: t`k`ven t`u gtkivat`, ut`uod, mat`ac` stkivat`; (magram) t`k`ven gak`vt` allahisgan imis molodini, risi molodinic` mat` ar gaach`niat`. allahi qovlismc`odne brz'enia.
uechvelad, ch`ven es cigni ch`amogivlinet` cheshmaritebit`urt`, rat`a adamiant`a shoris gansajo imit`, rac` allahma gich`vena, da nu ik`nebi mog'alatet`a k`omagi[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] ibni abbasis gadmoc`emis mixedvit`, es aiat`i ert`-ert`i ensarelis, tu'me bin uveiriqis shesaxeb ch`amoevlina. ag'nishnuli gadmoc`emis t`anaxmad, tu'mem p`ari moipara, p`k`vilian tomarashi ch`ado da ert`-ert` iudevelt`an sheinaxa. p`aris patroni gzad daqrili p`k`vilis kvals gaqva, jer tu'mas kars miadga, magram tu'mas p`ari ar ag'moach`nda da t`an allahze ip`ic`eboda, rom man amis shesaxeb arap`eri ic`oda. bolos p`ari iudevels ag'moach`nda. shuamavalmac` ip`ik`ra, rom iudeveli iqo damnashave, rasac` am aiat`is ch`amovlineba moqva. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: da shest`xove allahs patieba. cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia; mcqalobeli.
da nurc` mat` dasac`avad gairjebi, sakut`ar sulebs rom g'alatoben. cheshmaritad, allahs ar uqvars, vinc` veragi da c`odvilia.

isini xalxs umalaven, t`umc`a allahs verap`ers daumalaven, radgan is mat`t`anaa (mashinac`), roc`a g'am-g'amobit` ch`um-ch`umad bchoben imaze, rac` mist`vis mouconaria. namdvilad, allahia qovlis garemomc`veli, rasac` isini sch`adian.
diax, c`dilobt`, t`k`ven daic`vat` isini amier sop`elshi, magram allahis cinashe vin daic`avs an vin ik`neba mat`i vek`ili gankit`xvis dg'es?
da vinc` uket`urebas ch`aidens an usamart`lod moek`c`eva sakut`ar suls, - t`u shemdeg allahs patiebas shest`xovs, is allahs hpovebs usazg'vrod mpatiebelsa da mcqalobels.
da c`odvas vinc` moixvechs, - igi mxolod t`avisi sulis sacinaag'mdegod moixvechs. allahi qovlis mc`odne brz'enia.
da vinc` shec`domas daushvebs an c`odvas ch`aidens, shemdeg ki udanashaulos gadaabralebs, uechvelad, igi c`iliscamebasa da c`xad c`odvas itvirt`avs.

allahis madli da cqaloba rom ara shendami, - mat` ert` jgup`s sheni c`duneba mart`lac` ecada, magram sxvas veravis sheac`denen, garda sakut`ari sulisa, da verc` verap`ers gavneben. allahma shen cigni da sibrz'ne[1] ch`amogivlina da gascavla is, rac` ar ic`odi... da madli allahisa udidesia shendami.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,al-hik`met`" (lHkm@): misi pirdapiri shesatqvisia sibrz'ne. scavlult`a shoris ramdenime gansxvavebuli azri sup`evs hik`met`is raobast`an dakavshirebit`: 1. dogmatikis shemc`veli aiat`ebis garda danarch`eni aiat`ebi quranidan, romlebic` religiur da amk`veqniur t`emebt`an dakavshirebit` sasargeblo c`nobebs sheic`aven. 2. hik`met`i aris sunnet`i 3. vahis gagebisa da prak`tikashi gatarebis unari 4. shuamavlist`vis damaxasiat`ebeli azrovnebisa da gansjis unari 5. shariat`iseuli dadgenilebebis c`odna da qvelap`risat`vis shesabamisi adgilisa da t`anrigis minicheba.

translations.translation: uxeiroa mat` saidumlo bchobat`agan umetesoba, garda imisa, vinc` adamianebs mocqalebis gag'ebis, an siket`is ket`ebis, an kidev urt`iert`obebis gamoscorebisken[1] moucodebs, da vinc` amas allahis kmaqop`ilebis mopovebis miznit` gaaket`ebs, ch`ven mas udides jildos mivagebt`.
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis shuamavali brz'anebs:,,matquara ar aris is, vinc` adamianebs shoris urt`iert`obebis gamosascoreblad kargs ambobs an kargi ambebis mimtan-momtania." (muslim, birr ve sila, 27/2605.)

translations.translation: da vinc` shuamavals sheec`ilos, mas shemdeg, rac` ukve gac`xadda mist`vis gza cheshmariti, da gauqves im gzas, romelic` ar aris morcmuneebisa, - mivak`c`evt` mas ik`it`, sait`kenac` gezi aig'o da shevuz'axebt` jojoxet`shi... da ra c`udi samqop`elia igi.
cheshmaritad, ar apatiebs allahi, roc`a mas ut`anaziareben, amis garda ki qvelap`ers patiobs mat`, visac` moisurvebs, da vinc` allahs ut`anaziara, man mart`lac` didi c`ilobit` gadasc`da scori gzidan.
mxolod k`alg'mert`ebs et`aqvanebian, nac`vlad misi (allahisa), da mxolod utip`ar eshmaks evedrebian.
dascqevla igi (eshmaki) allahma, man ki miugo: garkveul xvedrs auc`ileblad mivig'eb shens msaxurt`agan;

- vac`duneb mat` auc`ileblad, gavart`ob amk`veqniuri oc`nebebit`, vubrz'aneb, rom qurebi daachran sak`onels da saxe uc`valon allahis k`mnilebas... da vinc` eshmaki airch`ia mp`arvelad, nac`vlad allahisa, scored man caago c`xadi cagebit`.
