- abrmavebs mat` oc`nebebit` da dapirebebit`, magram eshmaki (sinamdvileshi) sxva arap`ers hpirdeba, garda motquebisa.
scored imat`i samqop`elia jojoxet`i da gasak`c`evsac` ver naxaven ik`idan.

da mat`, vinc` ircmunes da hk`mnes ket`ili, samot`xeebshi sheviqvant`, romelt`a k`veshac` - dian mdinareni, da ik` ik`nebian maradzhams. allahis ag't`k`ma cheshmaritebaa... da vin aris allahze up`ro sitqvamart`ali?!
arc` t`k`veni oc`nebit` da arc` cignboz'ebult`a oc`nebit`[1], aramed: vinc` uket`urebas gaaket`ebs, mas miezg'veba - igive, da verc` mp`arvels hpovebs da verc` damxmares, garda allahisa.
translations.footnotes: [1] aiat`i c`xadqop`s, rom samot`xeshi moxvedra arc` marto oc`nebit` ik`neba da arc` c`arieli sitqvebit`, aramed sak`mit` damsaxurebaa mt`avari. masruqi, qat`ada da dahhak`i gadmogvc`emen, rom aiat`i ch`amoevlina cignboz'ebult`a da muslimt`a sapasuxod, romlebic` t`aviant`i sarcmunoebit` ikvexnidnen da upiratesobis damtkic`ebas c`dilobdnen. cignboz'ebulebma t`k`ves: ch`veni shuamavali t`k`vens shuamavalze adre iqo, aseve, ch`veni cigni t`k`vens cignze adrea ch`amovlenili, amitom ch`ven up`ro upiratesni vart` allahis cinasheo. muslimebma upasuxes: ch`veni shuamavali bolo shuamavalia, ch`venma cignma gaauk`ma sxva danarch`eni cignebi, ch`ven t`k`veni cignic` gvcams, magram t`k`ven ar gcamt` ch`veni cigni, amitom ch`ven up`ro upiratesni vart`o. mujahidma t`k`va: cignboz'ebulebma t`k`ves:,,ver shegvexeba c`ec`xli ch`ven, garda gat`vlili dg'eebisa"; mat` ekut`vnit` shemdegi sitqvebic`:,,veravin sheva samot`xeshi, garda imisa, vinc`aa iudeveli an nazareveli"-o. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: xolo qoveli kac`i t`u k`ali, vinc` siket`es gaaket`ebs da morcmunec` ik`neba, scored egeni shevlen samot`xeshi, da naqirisodena usamart`lobasac`[1] ar gadaeqrebian.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,al-naqiir" (lnqyr): p`inikis kurkaze arsebuli patara certili, saidanac` kvirti icqebs gag'vivebas da shemdeg qlorti ag'moc`endeba, anu zomit`, conit` da g'irebulebit` z'alian patara da umnishvnelo ram. mt`eli samqaros xelmcip`eba urcmunot`a xelshi rom iqos, ik`idan morcmunet`at`vis aset` patara da umnishvnelo nacilsac` ki ar gaimetebeno.amave aiat`shi isic` c`xadad ch`ans, rom imk`veqniuri anazg'aureba kac`sa da k`als ek`nebat` unaklod, - amk`venad gaket`ebuli siket`is da ara sk`esis mixedvit`.

translations.translation: mash, vinaa imaze uket`esi sarcmunoebis mk`one, vinc` allahs daumorch`ila mt`eli t`avisi pirovnuloba, ket`ilismk`mnelia da gahqva hanip`i[1] ibrahimis rjuls? da ibrahimi allahma airch`ia megobrad.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,hanip`i" (Hnyf): qovelgvari c`ru rcmenisa da carmart`uli sak`misagan gandegili da urqevi monot`eizmit` cheshmaritebisken mltolvare.

translations.translation: allahisaa qvelap`eri, rac`aa c`at`a shina da rac`aa k`veqanaze, da allahia qvelap`ris garemomc`veli.

ganmartebas gt`xoven k`alebis shesaxeb, - ut`xari: allahi gangimartavt` mat` shesaxeb da imazec`, rac` cignshi gekit`xebat` -oboli k`alebis shesaxeb, romlebsac` ar az'levt` imas, rac` dagekisrat` da ise c`dilobt` mat` shert`vas, da uz'luri bavshvebis shesaxebac`, - samart`liani rom unda iqot` oblebis mimart`. xolo ra siket`esac` gaaket`ebt`, cheshmaritad, - ic`is is allahma.

da t`u k`ali k`mrisgan t`avxedobas an zurgis shek`c`evas shishobs, mat` ar daedebat` c`odvad, t`uki morigdebian da dazavdebian; - zavi uket`esia. sulebs sixarbec` t`an sdevs xolme. t`u ket`ilad moek`c`evit` da rids gamoich`ent`, cheshmaritad, - ic`is allahma, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

t`undac` moicadinot`, mainc` ver shez'lebt` c`olebis mimart` samart`lianad mok`c`evas, amitom ar gadaixarot` mt`eli ltolvit` ert`isken da ar miatovot` meore, rogorc` ugulebelqop`ili. t`uki morigdebit` da rids gamoich`ent`, cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebeli da mcqalobelia.
da t`u gaiqrebian, - orive mat`gans simdidres ucqalobebs allahi t`avisi siuxvidan. allahi uuxvescqalobiani, brz'enia.

allahisaa qvelap`eri, rac`aa c`at`a shina da rac`aa k`veqanaze... - da ch`ven vuanderz'et` mat`, romlebsac` t`k`venze adre miec`at` cigni, da t`k`venc`, rat`a ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, da t`u uarqop`t`, cheshmaritad, allahisaa qvelap`eri, rac`aa c`at`a shina da rac`aa k`veqanaze, da allahi k`ebulia, qovladmdidari.
allahisaa qvelap`eri, rac`aa c`at`a shina da rac`aa k`veqanaze, da kmara allahi vek`ilad.
ei, adamianebo! is t`u inebebs, - t`k`ven cagiqvant` da sxvebs moiqvans, - sheuz'lia es allahs.
visac` amk`veqniuri ket`ildg'eoba surs, - allaht`anaa ket`ildg'eoba - amk`veqniuric` da imk`veqniuric`; allahia qovlismsmeneli da qovlismxedveli.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! samart`lianobis ag'mdgeni mocmeebi iqavit` allahist`vis, t`und iqot` cinaag'mdeg sakut`ari t`avis, an mshoblebis, an nat`esavebis mimart`, mdidari ik`neba t`u g'aribi, - allahi up`ro axlosaa orivest`an; da ar ahqvet` gemovnebas, rom ar moik`c`et` usamart`lod; da t`u gaamrudebt` an zurgs auk`c`evt` (mocmobas), cheshmaritad, - ic`is is allahma, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! allahi ircmunet`, misi shuamavali da cigni, romelic` t`avis shuamavals ch`amouvlina, da cigni, romelic` adre ch`amoavlina[1]; xolo vinc` ar ircmunebs allahs, mis angelozebs, cignebs, shuamavlebsa da ukanasknel dg'es, is mart`lac` gadasc`deba scori gzidan didi c`ilobit`.
translations.footnotes: [1] dahhak`is ganmartebit`, es aiat`i moucodebs iudevelebsa da k`ristianebs da misi shinaarsi shemdegia:,,ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet` musa da 'isa, ircmunet` muhammedi da qurani!"; mujahidis ganmartebit`, es aiat`i munaap`iqebs (p`arisevlebs) moucodebs da misi shinaarsi shemdegia:,,ei t`k`ven, romelnic` enit` gaiz'axit`, rom ircmunet`, - gulit` ircmunet`!"; abu 'alies ganmartebit`, es aiat`i moucodebs morcmuneebs da misi shinaarsi shemdegia:,,ei t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`, iqavit` mtkic`eni t`k`vens rcmenashi!" ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: uechvelad, imat`, romelt`ac` ircmunes, shemdeg uarqves, shemdeg isev ircmunes, shemdeg isev uarqves da shemdeg gadaacharbes urcmunoebashi, - ar apatiebs allahi da arc` gzas gaukvlevs.
axare p`arisevlebs, rom mat`t`visaa mcare sasjeli!
morcmuneebis nac`vlad rom urcmunoebs imegobreben, - nut`u isini g'irsebas ez'eben mat`t`an? cheshmaritad, g'irseba - allahs ekut`vnis mt`lianad.

man am cignshi[1] nat`lad ch`amogivlinat`, rom allahis aiat`ebis uarqop`a da mat`i masxrad agdeba t`u mogesmebat`, nu dasxdebit` mat`t`an ert`ad, vidre sxva saubrit` ar dakavdebian. cinaag'mdeg shemt`xvevashi t`k`venc` mat`nairi ik`nebit`. uechvelad, allahi ert`ad shemkrebia p`arisevlebisa da urcmunoebisa - jojoxet`shi.
translations.footnotes: [1] ix. sura en'am, 6/68.

translations.translation: - romelnic` t`k`vens molodinshi arian: allahisgan t`u gamarjveba gergebat`, getqvian:,,gana t`k`vent`an ert`ad ar viqavit`?", xolo t`uki urcmunoebs ergebat`, mashin etqvian:,,gana t`k`ven ar gexmarebodit` da ar gic`avdit` morcmuneebisgan?". allahi gansjis t`k`vens shoris gankit`xvis dg'es da allahi ar misc`ems gzas urcmunoebs - mormunet`a cinaag'mdeg.
uechvelad, p`arisevlebi allahs atqueben, magram isaa mat`i momtquebeli[1]. roc`a namazze dgebian, - dgebian zantad, xalxis dasanaxad da ar axseneben/ixseneben allahs, garda mc`iredisa.
translations.footnotes: [1] p`arisevlebi t`aviant`i p`ormaluri rcmenit` allahis motquebas c`diloben, mgram ver xvdebian, rom allahi amit` ar motquvdeba, amit` mxolod sakut`ar t`avs atqueben da amas mxolod mashin mixvdebian, rodesac` allahisgan mcare sasjels miig'eben.

translations.translation: - merqevni arian - arc` amat`ken da arc` imat`ken. - visac` allahi aac`dens, veranair gamosavals ver hpoveb mist`vis!
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar daimegobrot` urcmunoebi morcmuneebis sanac`vlod. nut`u gindat`, c`xadi samxili misc`et` allahs t`k`vens cinaag'mdeg?
uechvelad, p`arisevlebi qvelaze dabla ik`nebian c`ec`xlshi da ver hpoveb mat`t`vis damxmares.

- garda imat`i, romlebmac` moinanies, gamoascores (t`aviant`i sak`c`ieli), allahs miejachvnen da t`aviant`i rcmena xalasad miuz'g'vnes allahs, ai, isini ik`nebian morcmuneebt`an ert`ad. shemdeg allahi udides jildos miagebs morcmuneebs.
ratom unda dagsajot` allahma, t`uki ik`nebit` madlierni da ircmunebt`?! allahi madlieria; qovlismc`odnea.
ratomac` ar unda vircmunot` allahi da is, rac` cheshmaritebidan movida ch`vent`an? - ch`ven xom molodini gvak`vs, rom ch`veni g'mert`i sat`no xalxt`an ert`ad shegviqvans (samot`xeshi).
shemdeg mihmadla mat` allahma t`aviant`i (gulcrp`eli) sitqvebist`vis samot`xeebi, romlis k`veshac` mdinareebi miedineba, masshi ik`nebian maradzhams da esaa ket`ilmorcmunet`a sazg'auri.
- xolo isini, vinc` ar ircmunes da c`rud miich`nies ch`veni aiat`ebi, ai, isini arian jojoxet`is mkvidrni.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar aikrz'alot` is siket`eni, rac` halalhqo t`k`vent`vis allahma da arc` zg'vars gadaxvidet`; uechvlad, allahs ar uqvars zg'vargadasulni.
mash, miirt`vit` ik`idan, rac` halal da sup`t`a sazrdod gicqalobat` allahma. da ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, romlis morcmunenic` xart`.

allahi ar gakisrebt` pasuxismgeblobas (im) dap`ic`ebulze, romelic` camogc`dat` (gauc`nobiereblad), t`umc`a pasuxismgeblobas gakisrebt` imaze, rac` shegnebulad daip`ic`et`. da amis gamosasqidia: at`i g'atakis gamokveba - sashualod imit`, rasac` miart`mevt` xolme t`k`vens ojaxs; an mat`i shemosva; an ert`i monis gat`avisup`leba. xolo visac` (es) ar moepoveba, maszea (dakisrebuli) sami dg'is marxva. esaa gamosasqidi t`k`veni p`ic`isa, t`uki gatexavt`. mash, daic`avit` t`k`veni p`ic`i! ase gangimartavt` allahi t`avis aiat`ebs, - ik`neb madlierni qop`iliqavit`.
ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! uechvelad, g'vino, qumari, kerpebi da (samkit`xao) isrebi[1] satanis saz'agel sak`met`aganaa da ganeridet` mas - ik`neb gadarch`et`.
translations.footnotes: [1] mkit`xaobis ert`-ert`i met`odi: isrebis gamoqeneba, roc`a c`dilobdnen t`aviant`i cilis/xvedris gansazg'vras. igive statuss ek`vemdebareba bank`o, zari da sxva atributebi, rac` mkit`xaobisas an azartuli t`amashebisas gamoiqeneba.

translations.translation: satanas mxolod is unda, rom mtroba da siz'ulvili ch`aagdos t`k`ven shoris g'vinit`a da qumarit`; dagashorot` allahis didebas/xsenebas da namazs. mash, xom ik`nebit` amis damt`mobni?
mash, daemorch`ilet` allahs, daemorch`ilet` shuamavals da sip`rt`xile gamoich`inet`, xolo t`uki gadaixrebit`, mashin ic`odet`, rom ch`vens shuamavals mxolod c`xadi gzavnilis micvdena akisria.

romelt`ac` ircmunes da siket`e aket`es, mat` ar daedebat` c`odva imashi, rac` (adre) ugemiat`,[1] t`u (axla) g'vt`ismoshishebas ich`enen, scamt` da siket`es aket`eben; shemdeg isev g'vt`ismoshishebas ich`enen da scamt`; shemdeg isev g'vt`ismoshishebas ich`enen da siket`es aket`eben. allahs uqvars ket`ilismk`mnelni.
translations.footnotes: [1] enes ibn maalik`i gadmogvc`ems: ert`xel me, abu talha, abu ubeida bin al-jerrahi, muaz bin jebeli, suheil ibn beida da abu dujane ert`ad vk`eip`obdit`. me viqavi melik`ip`e. sup`ris cevrebi sakmaod shezarxoshebulni iqvnen da t`avi sup`risken caexarat`, roc`a k`uch`idan xma shemogvesma:,,quradg'ebit`, amieridan g'vino ukve haramia!'' amis gagonebaze, ch`ven, sanam vinme garet` gavidoda an garedan vinme shemovidoda, mashinve davg'varet` g'vino, rac` iqo darch`enili, da g'vinis churcheli davamsxvriet`. zogiert`ma ch`venganma abdesi aig'o, zogiert`ebmac` tani daibana. ummu suleimis sunamo cavisvit` da shuamavlis mech`et`s mivashuret`. am dros allahis shuamavali sura maides (90-92-e) aiat`ebs kit`xulobda. amis mosmenis shemdeg ert`ma kac`ma ikit`xa: o, allahis shuamavalo! ra bedi ecevat` mat`, romlebic` adre g'vinos miirt`mevdnen da am aiat`is ch`amovlinebamde gardaic`valen? am kit`xvis sapasuxod uzenaesma allahma shemdegi aiat`i ch`amoavlina:,,romelt`ac` ircmunes da ket`ili hk`mnes, mat` c`odva ar ak`vt` imashi, rac` ugemiat`..." ix. t`ap`siru tabari.

translations.translation: ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! allahi auc`ileblad gamogc`dit` nadirit`,[1] romelsac` scvdeba t`k`veni xelebi da shubebi, rat`a gamoamzhg'avnos, t`u vis ak`vs misi shishi - roc`a veravin xedavs mas, garda allahisa. xolo vinc` shemdgom zg'vars gadava, scored mist`visaa mcare sasjeli.
translations.footnotes: [1] es aiat`i hudeibias samshvidobo zavis cels ch`amoevlina, rodesac` morcmuneebi ihramit` iqvnen shemosilni. uzenaesma alahma ihramit` shemosilebs nadiroba aukrz'ala da amgvarad gamoc`ada isini. im celicads mat` irgvliv imdeni gareuli c`xoveli imqop`eboda, rom mat` banakshic` ki gadaadgildebodnen, amitom zogiert` mat`gans nadirobis survili uch`ndeboda. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar moklat` nadiri[1] mashin, roc`a ihramit` xart` shemosilni. da vinc` moklavs gaazrebulad, misi sasjeli: k`aabashi shesacirad gagzavnaa shinauri c`xovelisa, mis mier moklulis msgavsis, rasac` t`k`ven shoris ori samart`liani kac`i gansazg'vravs; an gamosasqidad g'aribebis dapureba; an sanac`vlod marxvaa, rat`a pasuxismgebloba igrz'nos t`avisi sak`c`ielis. allahma sheundo, rac` ukve moxda, xolo t`u kvlav daubrundeba, allahi shurs iz'iebs masze. allahi uz'levelia, shurismgebia.
translations.footnotes: [1] aisha gadmogvc`ems, rom allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,xut`i saxis mavne sulieri arsebobs, romelt`a mokvla ihramit` shemosil mdgomareobashic` ki sheiz'leba. esenia: qvavi, z'era, morieli, t`agvi da c`op`iani z'ag'li." (buxari, jezau'l-said, 7/1829.)

translations.translation: neba mogec`at` zg'vis nadirobaze (t`evzaoba) da amit` danaqrebaze, mgzavrt`a da t`k`venda sasargeblod, xolo agekrz'alat` saxmelet`o nadiroba, manam, vidre ihramit` ik`nebit` shemosilni. ridi gk`ondet` allahis, romlis cinashec` ik`nebit` ag'dgenilni.

allahma adamiant`a sasiket`od k`aaba, anu nakrz'ali saxli, nakrz'ali mt`vare, shesaciri da girlandashebmuli samsxverploebi daadgina, rat`a gc`odnodat`, rom allahi ucqis, rac`aa c`at`a shina da rac`aa k`veqanaze, da is (gc`odnodat`), rom allahi qovlismc`odnea.
ic`odet`, rom uechvelad, allahi mkac`rsasjeliania da cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobelia.
shuamavals mxolod micvdena akisria (xalxze - am moz'g'vrebis), allahma ki ic`is, rasac` t`k`ven amxelt` da malavt`.
ut`xari: ucminduri da sup`t`a araa t`anascori[1], t`undac` ucmindurobis simravlem t`avi mogaconos! mash, gonierno, geshinodet` allahis, ik`neb gadarch`et`.
translations.footnotes: [1] sup`t`a da ucminduri, halali da harami, morcmune da urcmuno, morch`ili da urch`i, mc`odne da uvic`i, ket`ili da boroti, mobidat`e da sunnet`is mimdevari - ert`manet`is t`anascori ar aris.

translations.translation: ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar ikit`xot` iset`i rameebi, romlebic` dagamcuxrebt`, t`u gagemartebat`[1]; da t`u ikit`xavt` quranis ch`amovlinebisas, - gagemartebat`. (rac` ukve ikit`xet`) allahma shegarch`inat`[2]. allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, lmobieri.
translations.footnotes:
[1] akrz'alulia zedmeti da usargeblo kit`xvebi an iset`i kit`xvebi, romelt`a ganmartebasac` damatebit`i pasuxismgeblobebi da mcuxareba moqveba. magalit`ad: ert`ma kac`ma, romlis mamac` islamis miug'eblad gardaic`vala, allahis shuamavals kit`xa: o, allahis shuamavalo! mamach`emi sad aris? man upasuxa: c`ec`xlshi. rodesac` kac`i camodga da casvlas apirebda, shuamavalma ukan ixmo da ut`xra: uechvelad, sheni mamac` da ch`emi mamac` c`ec`xlshi arian. (muslim, iman 88/203.) ert`xel allahis shuamavalma xutbaze t`k`va: ei, xalxo! allahma hajoba p`arz'ad dagicesat`, mash, sheasrulet` hajoba! ert`ma kac`ma ikit`xa: o, allahis shuamavalo! qovel celicads? shuamavali manamde dumda, vidre im kac`ma igive kit`xva samjer ar gaimeora, shemdeg ki upasuxa: rom vt`k`va -,,diax'', - mashin ut`uod savaldebulo gaxdeba, xolo t`u savaldebulo gaxdeba, rasakvirvelia, amas t`k`ven ver shez'lebt`. shemdeg man ase gaagrz'ela: sadac` me t`k`vent`vis t`avisup`leba mak`vs moc`emuli, ik` mec` momec`it` t`avisup`leba. uechvelad, t`k`venze adre mqop`ebi bevri (usap`uz'vlo) kit`xvebit`a da shuamavlebisgan gansxvavebulad mok`medebit` daig'upnen. rodesac` me t`k`ven rames gibrz'anebt`, is shez'lebisdagvarad sheasrulet`, xolo rasac` agikrz'alavt`, is miatovet` (muslim, hajj 73/1337.)
[2] rac` ak`amde gikit`xavt`; an rac` allahs quranshi da mis shuamavals sunnet`shi ar ganuc`xadebia, is c`odvad ar ch`aget`vlebat`.

translations.translation: t`k`venamdec` ikit`xa xalxma mis shesaxeb, shemdeg - mis gamo urcmunoebad gadaik`c`nen[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] upirvelesad, unda ganvmartot`, rom arabul enashi zmna saala (se e le) rogorc` kit`xvis dasmas, aseve mot`xovnasac` nishnavs, romelic` ch`vens t`argmanshi qvelaze gavrc`elebuli p`ormit` - kit`xvis dasmis saxit` vt`argmnet`. vin iqo xalxi, romlebmac` kit`xva dasves an rame moit`xoves da t`aviant` kit`xvaze rom pasuxi gaec`at` an sat`xovari sheusruldat`, amis sap`uz'velze urcmunoebad gadaik`c`nen? amis shesaxeb cminda quranshi ramdenime magalit`ia moqvanili: 1. salih shuamavlis xalxi, romlebmac` sascaulis nishnad ak`lemi moit`xoves, xolo shemdeg umadurad moik`c`nen da ak`lemi dakles. ix. a'rap`, 7/73-80. 2. musa shuamavlis xalxi, romlebmac` t`aviant` shuamavals most`xoves, allahi dagvanaxeo. ix. baqara 2/55. 3. 'isa shuamavlis xalxi, romlebmac` ikit`xes, sheez'lo t`u ara g'mert`s zec`idan sup`ris ch`amovlineba. ix. maide 5/112-15. 4. aseve baqara suras 246-251 aiat`ebshi mot`xrobili talut`isa da jalut`is ambavic` amis magalit`ia, rodesac` xalxma mep`e inatra, rat`a cin gaz'g'olodat` da mast`an ert`ad allahis gzaze eomat`, t`umc`a mep`is movlinebis shemdeg t`aviant`i sitqva ar sheasrules.

translations.translation: ar daudgenia allahs arc` bahira, arc` saibe, arc` vasila da arc` hami,[1] t`umc`a isini, vinc` ar ircmunes, c`ils scameben allahs da sic`rues t`xzaven mis shesaxeb, t`anac` mat`i umravlesoba verc` ki azrovnebs.
translations.footnotes: [1] bahira, saibe, vasila da hami islamamdel periodshi carmart`i arabebis mier kerpebist`vis c`oc`xlad sheciruli shinauri c`xovelebia. zemot` ch`amot`vlili shesaciris qvela saxeoba t`aviseburi t`visebebit` gamoirch`eoda, romlebic` xelsheuxeblad it`vleboda da t`aviant` nebaze iqvnen saz'ovarze gashvebuli. arc` mat`i xorc`it`, arc` nacvelit`, arc` becvit` sargeblobdnen da arc` transportad gamoiqenebdnen.

translations.translation: da roc`a ut`xres: modit` imaze, rac` allahma ch`amoavlinao, da (modit`) shuamavalt`ano, mat` t`k`ves: ch`vent`vis isic` sakmarisia, razedac` vpovet` ch`veni mama-papani... - t`undac` mat` mamebs arap`eri gagebodat` da arc` scor gzaze mdgariqvnen?!

ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! t`k`ven gakisriat` t`k`veni t`avis pasuxismgebloba. veras gavnebt` is, vinc` gzaac`denilia, t`u t`k`ven scor gzas daadgebit`[1]. allaht`anaa qvela t`k`venganis saboloo misak`c`ieli da is gamc`nobt` imis shesaxeb, rasac` aket`ebdit`.
translations.footnotes:
[1] abu bek`ir as-siddiqisgan gadmogvc`emen, rom mas ut`k`vams: ei, xalxo! t`k`ven kit`xulobt` aiat`s:,,ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! t`k`ven gakisriat` t`k`veni t`avis pasuxismgebloba. veras gavnebt` is, vinc` gzaac`denilia, t`u t`k`ven scor gzas daadgebit`''. uechvelad, me allahis shuamavlisgan movismine, rom is ambobda:,,uechvelad, rodesac` xalxi xedaven usamart`lo mch`agvrels da xels ar ushlian mas, z'alian advili shesaz'lebelia, rom allahma qvela mat`ganze ganavrc`os amis sasjeli." (t`irmizi, p`it`an 8/2168.)
abu umeie ash-sha'banii gadmogvc`ems: abu sa'laba al-xushanies vkit`xe: ei, abu sa'laba! shen rogor ganmartav shemdeg aiat`s:,,t`k`ven gakisriat` t`k`veni t`avis pasuxismgebloba"? man mit`xra: allahs vp`ic`avar, shen zustad mc`odnes kit`xe es sakit`xi. me amis shesaxeb allahis shuamavals vkit`xe da man mit`xra:,,siket`isken moucodet` da uket`ureba dagmet`, vidre ixilavt` iset` dros, rodesac` adamianebs siz'unce daimonebs, vnebebs auqvebian, es k`veqana qvelap`ers erch`ivnebat` da qvela sakut`ari mosazrebit` t`avs moiconebs. aset` dros sheni valia sakut`ari t`avis mixedva. moeride xalxze aqolas. uechvelad, cin gak`vt` mot`minebis dg'eebi. mashin mot`mineba shishveli xelit` nakverch`xlis dacheras hgavs. im dros vinc` scor sak`c`iels gamoavlens, is imden madls moigebs, ramdensac` igive sak`c`ielit` ormoc`daat`i kac`i." sxva gadmomc`emma damatebit` t`k`va: vig'ac`am ikit`xa: o, allahis shuamavalo! t`aviant`i drois ormoc`daat`i kac`is namok`medari madlis toli? man upasuxa:,,ormoc`daat`i t`k`vent`aganis madlis toli." (abu davud, malahim 17/4341.)
jubeir bin nup`eiri gadmogvc`ems: ert`-ert` mejlisze vimqop`ebodi, sadac` allahis shuamavlis sahabeebi iqvnen. me mat` shoris qvelaze umc`rosi viqavi. mat` ket`ilis mocodebasa da borotis dagmobaze daicqes saubari. am dros me vt`k`vi: gana allahi ase ar ambobs t`avis cignshi:,,ei t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! t`k`ven gakisriat` t`k`veni t`avis pasuxismgebloba, veras gavnebt` is, vinc` gzaac`denilia - t`uki scor gzas daadgebit`"? amaze qvelam ert`xmad mipasuxes: shen quranidan mogqavs aiat`i, romlis shesaxeb arap`eri ic`i da arc` misi ganmarteba gagegeba?! amis gamo vinatre, netav saert`od xma ar amomeg'o. mat` isev gaagrz'eles saubari. bolos casvlis cin mit`xres: shen jer axalgazrda xar da mogqavs aiat`i, romlis shesaxebac` arap`eri ic`i. albat` moescrebi im dros, rodesac` naxav siz'uncis monebs, vnebebs aqolilebs, da sakut`ari azrit` t`avmomconeebs; ai scored aset` dros sheni valia sakut`ar t`avs mixedo da mashin veras gavnebs is, vinc` gzas amc`daria, - t`uki scor gzas daadgebi. ix. t`ap`siiru taberi.

translations.translation: ei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! roc`a sikvdili geaxlebat`, anderz'is mocme iqos ori samart`liani t`k`ven shoris an ori arat`k`vengant`agani, t`uki mgzavrad imqop`ebit` da sikvdilis ubedureba dagatqdat`. t`u echvi shegeparat` mat`shi, - loc`vis shemdeg sheaqovnet` orive mat`gani da g'mert`ze daip`ic`on:,,t`u ramis sap`asurad gavqidit` mas, t`undac` nat`esavt`a sasargeblod, da davmalavt` allahis cinashe dadebul mocmobas, mashin ch`ven c`odvilt`agan viqot`o''.

xolo t`uki gamoashkaravda rom am orma (c`rumocmobit`) c`odva daimsaxures, mashin sxva orni daikaveben mat` adgils, imat`gan, romlebic` (moanderz'est`an) siaxlovis upiratesobas p`loben da allahze daip`ic`eben, rom ch`veni mocmoba up`ro sandoa mat` mocmobaze da ar gavt`elavt` mas, cinaag'mdeg shemt`xvevashi ch`ven vik`nebit` usamart`lot`aganio.

es umjobesia, rat`a cesisamebr ag'sruldes mocmoba an eshinodet`, rom uarqop`ili ik`neba mat`i p`ic`i, mas shemdeg, rac` daip`ic`es. mash, ridi gk`ondet` allahisa da sheisminet`. cheshmaritad, ug'irs xalxs ar daakvalianebs allahi cheshmarit gzaze.
ert` dg'esac` allahi shekrebs shuamavlebs da kit`xvaze -,,ra pasuxi miig'et`?'' - etqvian: ch`ven aranair c`odnas ar vp`lobt`, cheshmaritad, shen xar uxilavt`a unaklod mc`odne![1]
translations.footnotes: [1] gankit`xvis dg'es allahi shuamavlebs hkit`xavs, t`u ra pasuxi miig'es t`aviant`i ummet`ebisgan, rodesac` isini ert`g'mert`ianobisken moipatizhes. mat`i amgvari pasuxi ramdenime mizezit` aixsneba: 1. shuamavalt`a mokrz'aleba, qovlis mc`odne allahis cinashe; 2. mat` t`aviant`i ummet`is mxolod mc`ireds moescrnen, up`ro didi nacili mat`i gardac`valebis shemdeg c`xovrobda; 3. isini morcmuneebs mxolod garegnuli sak`c`ielit` c`nobdnen, xolo mat` gulebshi arsebuli - uxilavi iqo mat`t`vis, radgan es allahis garda aravin ic`is.

translations.translation: roc`a allahi itqvis: ei, 'isa, z'eo meriemisa! gaixsene ch`emi cqaloba shendami da sheni dedis mimart`, - roc`a gangamtkic`e cminda sulit` (jibril angelozit`) da elaparake xalxs akvanshic`[1] da zrdasrul asakshic`;[2] roc`a gascavle cigni[3] da sibrz'ne,[4] t`evrat`i da injili; roc`a ch`emi nebit` t`ixisgan ch`itis p`ormas z'ercavdi, shemdeg masshi suls beravdi da ch`emive nebit` ch`itad ik`c`eoda; ch`emi nebit`ve t`andaqolil brmebsa da ket`rovnebs kurnavdi; roc`a mkvdrebi amogqavda (c`oc`xlad, samaridan); roc`a israelis modgma gangaride mashin, c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebit` rom mixvedi mat`t`an da urcmunoebma t`k`ves (mat`gan): uechvelad, es mxolod ashkara jadoa.
translations.footnotes:
[1] axalshobilma 'isam (`lyh lslm) sascaulebrivad amoidga ena da mariamis umcikvloeba ig'ag'ada, aseve, man ganac`xada, rom is iqo allahis msaxuri; rom allahi mas cigns uboz'ebda da mac`ned ag'amag'lebda.
[2] originali -,,k`ahl" (khl): es sitqva zrdisa da ganvit`arebis dasasruls mig'ceul, z'alg'onit` savse asakobriv periods gamoxatavs. arabebi am sitqvit` im adamianis asakobriv mdgomareobas ag'nishnaven, vinc` 30-dan 40 clamde asakshi imqop`eba. zogiert`i scavlulis shep`asebit`,,,k`ahl"-i 40-dan 50 clamde asaks gulisxmobs. aiat`i gvamc`nobs, rom,,is xalxs daelaparakeba rogorc` akvanshi, aseve zrdasrul asakshic`." scavlulebi ramdenime savaraudo ganmartbas gvt`avazoben imast`an dakavshirebit`, t`u ras sheiz'leba migvanishnebdes es sitqvebi: 1. g'mert`ma amit` 'isas (`lyh lslm) dedas, anu mariams axara, rom misi shvili shuaxnis asakamde ic`oc`xlebda; 2. esaa misi samomavlo shuamavlobis cinascarmetqveleba; 3. es aiat`i gvesaubreba sascaulze, magalit`ad, ch`vilis saubari namdvilad didi sascaulia, xolo shuaxnis asakshi mqop`i adamianis saubari - ch`veulebrivi movlena, rom ara - misi zec`idan dashveba da xalxis kvlav cheshmaritebisken mocodeba. 'isa shuamavali daaxloebit` 30 - 33 clis asakshi amag'lda, xolo k`ahlis periodi amis shemdeg icqeba.
[3] cera-kit`xva.
[4] c`odnis shemec`nebis unari.

translations.translation: aki, sht`avagone shens mocap`eebs, rom gcamdet` ch`emi da ch`emi shuamavlisa, da mat` t`k`ves: vircmunet`, dae daamocme, rom ch`ven vart` muslimni/morch`ilni.
aki t`k`ves mocap`eebma: o, 'isa, z'eo mariamisa! ch`vent`vis shens g'mert`s zec`idan sup`ris ch`amovlineba sheuz'lia? man miugo: ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, t`uki t`k`ven xart` morcmuneni.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ibni abbasi gadmogvc`ems: 'isa shuamavalma israelis shvilebs ut`xra: allahist`vis oc`daat` dg'es t`u imarxebt` da shemdeg sheevedrebit`, allahi qvelap`ers mogc`emt`, rasac` st`xovt`. uechvelad, mushis jamagiri mas ekut`vnis, vinc` daasak`ma igi. israelis shvilebi asec` moik`c`nen da shemdeg ut`xres: o, siket`is mascavlebelo! uechvelad, mushis jamagiri mas ekut`vnis, vinc` daasak`ma igi. oc`daat`i dg'e marxva gvibrz'ane da ch`venc` shevasrulet`. vinmest`an oc`daat`i dg'e rom gvemushava, auc`ileblad dagvapurebda, rogorc` ki movrch`ebodit`. shens g'mert`s zec`idan ch`venze sup`ris ch`amovlineba sheuz'lia? 'isam miugo: ridi gk`ondet` allahisa, t`uki t`k`ven xart` morcmuneni. mat` ut`xres: gvinda rom mivirt`vat` misgan, gulebi davimshvidot`, vic`odet` rom namdvilad simart`les gveubnebi da viqot` amis mocmeni. am dialogis shemdeg zec`idan mop`rindnen angelozebi da moitanes sup`ra. sup`raze shvidi t`evzi da shvidi puri elaga. 'ammar bin iasirisgan gadmoc`emis t`anaxmad ki ag'nishnul sup`raze samot`xis xilic` elaga. ix. t`ap`siru taberi.

translations.translation: t`k`ves: gvinda, rom mivirt`vat` misgan, gulebi davimshvidot`, vic`odet`, rom namdvilad simart`les gveubnebi da viqot` amis mocmeni.

mariamis z'e 'isam t`k`va: o, allah, g'mert`o ch`veno! zec`idan sup`ra ch`amogvivline, romelic` ik`neba dg'esascauli ch`vent`vis, rogorc` pirvelt`a, ise ukanasknelt`at`vis, da sascauli shengan, mash, mogvmadle sazrdo, ramet`u shen xar sauket`eso msazrdoebeli!
allahma upasuxa: cheshmaritad, me ch`amogivlent` mas, magram vinc` amis shemdegac` ar ircmunebs, mas ut`uod iset`i sasjelit` davsji, romlis msgavsit`ac` aravin damisjia samqaroshi.

roc`a etqvis allahi: ei, 'isa, z'eo meriemisa! shen ut`xari xalxs, rom me da dedach`emi allahis garda kidev or g'vt`aebad agvirch`iet`o? miugo: shen qovlad unaklo xar! ar shemep`ereboda imis t`k`ma, risi up`lebac` ar mak`vs. eg romc` met`k`va, ut`uod gec`odineboda. shen ucqi, rac`aa ch`emshi, xolo me ar vic`i, rac`aa shenshi. cheshmaritad, shena xar uxilavt`a unaklod mc`odne!

arap`eri mit`k`vams mat`t`vis, garda imisa, rac` mibrz'ane, rom t`aqvani ec`it` allahsa, ch`ems g'mert`sa da t`k`vens g'mert`so. mat`i mocme viqavi, vidre mat` shoris viqavi. xolo roc`a mimibare, shen iqavi mat`i met`valqure. da shen xar mocme qovelivesi.
t`uki mat` dasji, uechvelad, sheni msaxurni arian; xolo t`u miuteveb,[1] cheshmaritad, shen xar z'levamosili, brz'eni.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] taberi am aiat`is ganmartebisas cers: t`uki mat`, - vinc` ase moik`c`nen, - am rcmenit` moakvdineb da dasji,,,uechvelad, sheni msaxurni arian" da shenze ik`nebian damorch`ilebulni, iz'ulebulni ik`nebian ch`ahbardenen shens gadacqvetilebas da verc` t`avis dac`vas shez'leben; xolo t`u sikvdilamde scor gzaze daadgen, monaniebas ucqalobeb da miuteveb,,,cheshmaritad, shen xar z'levamosili, brz'eni." ramet`u shen qovlis shemz'le xar, dasji mas, visac` inebeb, cinaag'mdegobas veravin gagicevs; aseve, shen xar brz'eni da ucqi, t`u vin imsaxurebs scor gzaze dgomasa da mitevebas. ix. t`ap`siiru taberi.
[2] abu zerri gadmogvc`ems: ert`xel gavigone allahis shuamavali namazze dilamde ert`idaigive aiat`s kit`xulobda, amave aiat`it` asrulebda ruk`u'sac` da sejdesac`. es aiat`i iqo:,,t`uki mat` dasji, uechvelad, sheni msaxurni arian; xolo t`u miuteveb, cheshmaritad, shena xar z'levamosili, brz'eni." mas vut`xari: o, allahis shuamavalo! shen dilamde am aiat`s imeorebdi. man mit`xra: g'mert`s ch`emi ummet`ist`vis shep`aat`i shevevedre da momec`a igi. is mxolod mat` shexvdebat`, visac` allahist`vis arap`eri t`anauziarebiat`. (ahmed, al-musned, h.n. 21328.)

translations.translation: allahi brz'anebs: esaa dg'e, roc`a mart`alni sargebels hpoveben t`aviant`i simart`lisas: mat`t`visaa samot`xeebi, romelt`a k`veshac` mdinareebi miedineba; ik` ik`nebian maradzhams. kmaqop`ilia mat`gan allahi da t`vit`onac` kmaqop`ili arian misit`. ai, esaa mig'ceva - udidesi (didi gamarjveba).
allahs ekut`vnis c`at`a da dedamicis ganmgebloba da (imis,) rac`aa mat`shi. igia qovlisshemz'le.
dideba allahs, romelmac` gaach`ina c`ani da dedamica, daadgina nat`eli da bneli. urcmunoebi, amis miuxedavad, t`aviant` g'mert`s sxvebs ut`anabreben.
igia, vinc` t`ixisgan gagach`inat`, shemdeg daadgina ajali da mis cinashea ajali gansazg'vruli.[1] am qvelap`ris shemdeg t`k`ven mainc` echvi geparebat`.
translations.footnotes: [1] hasan al-basris, qat`adesa da dahhak`is ganmartebit`, pirveli ajali aris dabadebidan sikvdilamdeli, xolo meore ajali - sikvdilidan ag'dgomamde drois monakvet`i. mat`i es ganmarteba ibni abbasi shemdeg sitqvebs eqrdnoba: qvela adamians ak`vs ori ajali: ajali dabadebidan sikvdilamde da ajali sikvdilidan ag'dgomamde. t`uki is ik`neba ket`ili, g'vt`ismoshishi da nat`esauri urt`iert`obebis gamgrz'elebeli, mas ag'dgomis ajalidan amk`veqniuri sic`oc`xlis ajalze daemateba; xolo t`uki c`odvili da nat`esauri urt`iert`obebis gamcqveti ik`neba, mashin amk`veqniuri sic`oc`xlis ajalidan ag'dgomis ajalze daemateba. mujahidisa da sa'iid bin jubeiris ganmartebis t`anaxmad, pirveli ajali aris amk`veqniuri c`xovrebist`vis gansazg'vruli dro; xolo meore ajali - imk`veqniuri c`xovrebist`vis gansazg'vruli droa. ix. t`ap`siiru bag'avi.

translations.translation: igia allahi c`at`a shina da k`veqanaze[1], ic`is t`k`veni p`arulic` da c`xadic`, aseve ic`is, rasac` t`k`ven moixvecht`.
translations.footnotes: [1] igi ert`adert`i cheshmariti sat`aqvanebelia k`veqanazec` da zec`ashic`.

translations.translation: mat` t`aviant`i g'mert`is aiat`t`agan/sascault`agan, ra aiat`ic`/sascaulic` miuvidat`, qvelasgan piri ik`c`ies.
mart`lac` c`rud sherac`xes cheshmariteba, rodesac` mat` miuvidat`, t`umc`a shemdeg miuvat` ambavi imisa, rasac` abuch`ad igdebdnen.

nut`u ver xedaven, t`u ramdeni t`aoba gagvinadgurebia mat`ze adre, romlebsac` amk`veqnad iset`i sashualebebi vuboz'et`, rac` t`k`vent`vis ar gviboz'ebia; zec`idan uxvi nalek`i ch`amovuvlinet` da mdinareebi davadginet` mat` k`vemot` mdeni, shemdeg t`aviant`i c`odvebis gamo gavanadguret` da mat` shemdeg sxva t`aoba gavach`inet`.
t`undac` p`urc`elze dacerili cigni ch`amogvevlina shent`vis da t`aviant`i xelebit` shexebuliqvnen, mainc` itqodnen isini, - vinc` ar ircmunes, - rom es mxolod ashkara jadoao.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] k`elbisa da muqat`ilis ganmartebis t`anaxmad, es aiat`i nadr bin al-harisis, abdullah bin bani umeiasa da navp`al bin hudairis shesaxeb ch`amoevlina. mat` t`k`ves: o, muhammed! manamde ar dagijerebt`, vidre allahisgan cigns ar mogvitan, romelsac` ot`xi angelozi exleba da daamocmeben, rom es cigni alllahisganaa da shen misi shuamavali xaro. ix. t`ap`siiru bag'avi.

translations.translation: mat` t`k`ves: nut`u angelozi ar unda ch`amovleniliqo mast`an? mast`an rom angelozi ch`amogvevlina, mashin ut`uod gadacqdeboda mat`i sak`me da shemdeg ag'arc` edrovebodat`[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] rodesac` urcmunoebi it`xovdnen sascauls da misi ag'srulebis miuxedavad mainc` jiutad agrz'elebdnen urcmunoebas, mat` qovelt`vis gamanadgurebeli sasjeli eceodat`. am aiat`shic` allahi scored amaze amaxvilebs quradg'ebas, rom muhammed shuamavalt`an mat`t`vis xiluli angelozebic` rom ch`amogvevlina, isini mainc` ar ircmunebdnen, amitom mat`i ganadgurebis sak`me mashinve gadacqdeboda, arc` monaniebis da arc` t`avis mart`lebis dro ag'ar miec`emodat`o.

translations.translation: t`undac` angelozad dagvedgina igi, ut`uod kac`ad davadgendit`[1] da mainc` igive mdgomareobashi ag'movach`endit`, ra mdgomareobashic` axla imqop`ebian.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] mat`t`vis angelozic` rom cargvegzavna, masac` adamianis p`ormit` carvgzavnidit`, radganac` adamianebs ar sheuz'liat` angelozebis xilva t`aviant`i namdvili p`ormit`.
[2] rogorc` axla amboben, rogor gavigot`, shen mart`lac` allahis shuamavali xar t`u ert`i ch`veulebrivi ch`venganio, mashinac` imas itqodnen - rogor gavigot`, shen mart`lac` angelozi xar t`u adamianio.

translations.translation: uechvelad, shenze adrec` aigdes masxrad shuamavlebi, shemdeg vinc` mat` dasc`inodnen, - imit`ve ik`mnen shepqrobili, rist`visac` dasc`inodnen.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] t`vit`onve ag'moch`ndnen sasac`ilo mdgomareobashi da es iqo mat`i sasjeli shuamavalt`a dac`invis gamo.

translations.translation: ut`xari: ch`amoiaret` dedamicaze da dainaxet`, t`u ra bedi eciat` c`rud shemrac`xvelebs.

ut`xari: visia is, rac`aa c`at`a shina da dedamicaze? upasuxe: allahisaa, man mocqaleoba t`avis valad sc`no. vp`ic`av, rom is mart`lac` shegkrebt` gankit`xvis dg'es, romelshic` echvi ar aris. xolo romelt`ac` sakut`ar sulebs avnes (urcmunoebit`), isini mainc` ar ircmuneben.
misia qoveli, rac` mkvidrobs g'amit` da dg'isit`; da isaa qovlismsmeneli, qovlismc`odne.

ut`xari: gana allahis garda sxvas avirch`ev mp`arvelad - gamch`enisa c`at`a da dedamicis? da igia dampurebeli, xolo t`vit`on ar sachiroebs dapurebas. ut`xari: cheshmaritad, me mebrz'ana, rom pirveli viqo, vinc` daemorch`ila da ar iqo carmart`t`aganio.
ut`xari: cheshmaritad, me vshishob, rom t`u veurch`ebi ch`ems g'mert`s, t`avs damatqdeba udidesi dg'is sasjeli.
im dg'es, vinc` ik`neba misgan[1] ganridebuli, mas (allahi) mart`lac` sheicqalebs da es ik`neba c`xadi carmateba.
translations.footnotes: [1] sasjelisgan.

translations.translation: t`uki allahma uket`ureba shegamt`xvia, mis garda veravin agaridebs; xolo t`uki siket`e shegamt`xvia, igia qovlis shemz'le.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ibni abbasi gadmogvc`ems: ert` dg'es, shesajdom pirutqvze allahis shuamavalis ukan vijek`i da mit`xra: ei, axalgazrda! ramdenime sitqvit` minda dagarigo: allahi (misi brz'anebebi da akrz'alvebi) daic`avi, rom manac` shen dagic`vas. daic`avi allahi, rom sait`ac` mibrundebi, ik` hpovo igi. t`u rame sat`xovari gek`neba, allahs st`xove. t`uki daxmareba gchirdeba, allahs sheevedre. ic`ode, rom mt`eli kac`obrioba shens sasargeblod rom gaert`iandes, verap`ers gargeben imaze mets, rac` allahs shent`vis dauceria; aseve, mt`eli kac`obrioba rom shens cinaag'mdeg gaert`iandes, verap`ers gavneben imaze mets, rac` allahs shent`vis dauceria, (bedisceris ch`amceri) kalmebi aqrilia da p`urc`lebi gamshralia. (t`irmizi, h.n. 2516.)

translations.translation: is aris z'levamosili, t`avis msaxurebze qovlad amag'lebuli da igia brz'eni, qovlismc`odne.

ut`xari: romelia qvelaze didi mocmoba? aseve, ut`xari, rom ch`em da t`k`ven shoris allahia mocme[1], da es qurani zesht`amegona, rat`a misit` gagap`rt`xilot` t`k`ven da isini, vist`anac` miag'cevs.[2] t`k`ven mart`lac` amocmebt`, rom allaht`an ert`ad sxva g'vt`aebebic` arsebobs?[3] ut`xari: me ar vamocmeb! ut`xari: cheshmaritad, is ert`adert`i g'mert`ia da uechvelad, me shors var imisgan, rasac` ut`anaziarebt`!
translations.footnotes:
[1] k`albi gadmogvc`ems: mek`k`eli carmart`ebi allahis shuamavalt`an mividnen da ut`xres: aba vin amocmebs, rom shen allahis shuamavali xar? veravis vpoulobt` iset`s, vinc` shens shuamavlobas daamocmebs. ch`ven iudevelebsa da k`ristianebsac` vkit`xet` shenze, t`umc`a mat` t`aviant` cminda cerilshi verap`eri hpoves shens shesaxeb. amis shemdeg allahma ch`amoavlina:,,ut`xari: romelia qvelaze didi mocmoba?" t`u ver gipasuxes, upasuxe:,,ch`emsa da t`k`vens shoris allahia mocme." ix. t`ap`siru bag'avi.
[2] muhammed bin k`a'b al-qurazi gadmogvc`ems:,,vist`anac` qurani miag'cevs, man t`it`k`os t`vit`on shexvda mac`nes (da misgan moismina)." ix. t`ap`siru taberi.
abdullah bin amri gadmogvc`ems, rom mac`nem t`k`va:,,ch`emgan (sxvebs) gadaec`it` - t`undac` ert`i aiat`i. aseve, shegiz'liat` gadmosc`et` israelis modgmisgan, es ar aris c`odva; xolo vinc` ch`ems shesaxeb shegnebulad ic`ruos, man (jojoxet`is) c`ec`xlshi t`avisi adgilsamqop`eli airch`ios." (buxari, h.n. 3461.)
[3] qureisheli carmart`ebi allahis shuamavalt`an mividnen da ut`xres: o, muhammed! ar ic`i, rom allaht`an ert`ad sxva g'vt`aebebic` arsebobs? man upasuxa: ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda allahisa! me amit` var carmogzavnili da amasve movucodeb. amis shemdeg allahma es aiat`i ch`amoavlina. ix. t`ap`siru taberi.

translations.translation: visac` cigni vuboz'et`, ise ic`noben mas (muhammeds), rogorc` ic`noben sakut`ar shvilebs. romelt`ac` t`aviant`i sulebi caricqmides, isini ar ircmuneben.
mash, vinaa imaze usamart`lo, vinc` sic`rues t`xzavs[1] allahze an c`rud miich`nevs mis aiat`ebs? uechvelad, ver gadarch`ebian usamart`loni.
translations.footnotes: [1] vinaa imaze didi urcmuno, vinc` allahs ut`anaziarebs vinmes, vinc` t`xzavs, rom allahs moziare hqavs.

translations.translation: im dg'es mat` qvelas ert`ad shevqrit` da vetqvit` mat`, romlebic` ut`anaziarebdnen: sad arian ch`emi t`anaziarni, romlebic` t`k`ven momich`inet`?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] romlebic` g'vt`is t`anascorebad da t`anamoziareebad migach`ndat`.

translations.translation: shemdeg sxva verap`ers moimizezeben, garda imisa, rom itqvian: ch`vens g'mert`s, allahs vp`ic`avt`, rom ch`ven ar viqavit` carmart`ebi!
naxe, rogor c`ruoben sakut`ar sult`a cinaag'mdeg da ganudgnen mat`, rasac` t`xzavdnen[1] (g'mert`ebad rac`xavdnen).
translations.footnotes: [1] kerpebi verap`ers ushvelian t`avian t`aqanismc`emlebs.

translations.translation: da mat`gan arian iset`ebic`, romlebic` gismenen, magram mat` gulebs saburveli gadavap`aret`, rat`a ver gaigon, qurebshic` simz'ime davugubet`: t`undac` qvela aiat`i/sascauli ixilon, mainc` rom ar ircmunon[1]; up`ro metic`, shent`an t`u movlen isini, vinc` ar ircmunes, kamat`s dagicqeben da itqvian: uechvelad, es mxolod cinapart`a zg'aprebiao.
translations.footnotes: [1] allahma isini amgvrad dasaja mat`i xangrz'livi urch`obis gamo, da imis gamoc`, rom man ic`is, rom isini ver ircmuneben.

translations.translation: amgvarad, isini misgan sxvebs abrkoleben da t`vit`onac` shordebian mas; ase mxolod sakut`ar sulebs anadgureben da verc` ki xvdebian.
netav genaxa, rodesac` c`ec`xlis cinashe daaqeneben da itqvian:,,oh, netav ukan davbrundebodet` da c`rud ag'ar shevrac`xavdet` ch`veni g'mert`is aiat`ebs da vik`nebodet` morcmunet`agani''.
ara! mat` ukve gaec`xadat` igi, rasac` manamde[1] malavdnen; romc` daabrunon, egeni mainc` imas daubrundebian, rac` ekrz'alebodat`. uechvelad, egeni matquarebi arian.
translations.footnotes: [1] dedamicaze qop`nisas.

translations.translation: da t`k`ves: ch`veni sic`oc`xle mxolod amk`veqniuria da arc` mkvdret`it` ag'vdgebit` ch`ven.
translations.footnotes: [1] arsebobs am aiat`is ganmartebis ori versia: 1. isini gardac`valebamde ambobdnen ase, uarqop`dnen imk`veqniur c`xovrebas da gankit`xvas. 2. gardac`valebis shemdeg, amk`veqnad dabrunebis sashualeba rom miec`et`, mainc` ase itqvian, radganac` matquarebi arian da sitqvas ar upatroneben. ix: t`ap`siiru tabari.

translations.translation: netav genaxa, rodesac` t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe daaqeneben da etqvis: gana es ar aris cheshmariteba?[1] isini etqvian: diax, ch`vens g'mert`s vp`ic`avt`. isic` etqvis: mash, igemet` sasjeli imis, rasac` uarqop`dit`.
translations.footnotes: [1] sikvdilis shemdeg gac`oc`xleba da gankit`xva, rasac` t`k`ven uarqop`dit`.

translations.translation: mart`lac` cacqmedilan isini, romelnic` c`rud t`vlidnen allaht`an shexvedras, vidre ar mouscrebdat` zhami uec`rad da ar itqodnen:,,vai, ch`venda, im daudevrobis gamo, rac` ik` ch`avidinet`!" - t`anac` zurgit` ezidebian t`aviant` c`odvebs. raoden c`udia igi, rac` mat` utvirt`avt`!
t`amashisa da gart`obis garda sxva arap`eria cut`isop`eli; xolo isk`veqana umjobesia mat`t`vis, vinc` g'vt`ismoshishia. nut`u gonebas ar mouxmobt`?

rat`k`maunda vic`it`, rom didad gamcuxrebs, rasac` isini (shen shesaxeb) amboben. magram, cheshmaritebaa, rom (sinamdvileshi) shen ki ar grac`xaven c`rud, aramed allahis aiat`ebs uarqop`en usamart`loni[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] 'ali gadmogvc`ems, rom abu jahilma ut`xra mac`nes: uechvelad, ch`ven c`rud ar migich`nevt`, aramed ch`ven c`rud migvach`nia is, rit`ac` shen moxvedi. amast`an dakavshirebit` uzenaesma allahma es aiat`i ch`amoavlina. (t`irmizi, t`ap`siir, h.n. 3064.)

translations.translation: uechvelad, shenamdec` c`rud sherac`xulan shuamavalni, mat` ki mot`mineba gamouch`eniat` c`rud sherac`xvisa da shevicroebis cinashe, vidre ch`veni shecevna ar miuvidat`. ar arsebobs shemc`vleli allahis sitqvebisa. cheshmaritad, shen mogivida ambavi shuamavalt`a.

t`u gimz'ims mat`gan shen mimart` zurgis shek`c`eva, mashin ec`ade, t`u gz'aluz's, xvreli ipovo micis sig'rmeebisken an kibe - zec`it` ag'mart`uli, rat`a mat` sascauli miutano. allahs rom eneba, auc`ileblad shekrebda mat` cheshmarit gzaze. ase rom, nu ik`nebi umec`art`agani![1]
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis shuamavali z'alian cuxda da nerviulobda imis gamo, rom xalxs ar sjeroda mis mier nak`adagebi sarcmunoebisa. uzenaesma allahma am aiat`it` sheagona, rom misi z'alisxmevit`a da nerviulobit` veravin daadgeboda cheshmarit gzas - t`uki ar ik`neboda allahis neba. amitom umjobesi iqo mot`mineba gamoech`ina, rat`a mas ar sheep`ereboda am cheshmaritebis armc`odnis msgavsad mok`c`eva.

translations.translation: (shens mocodebas) qurad ig'eben mxolod isini, romelnic` ismenen; xolo mkvdrebs allahi ag'adgens mkvdret`it` da shemdeg mast`an ik`nebian mibrunebulni.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] aiat`shi -,,qurad ig'eben mxolod isini, romelnic` ismenen" - morcmuneebi igulisxmeba, romlebmac` sheismines cheshmariteba da miig'es ert`guli morch`ilebit`, xolo mkvdrebshi - urcmunoebi igulisxmebian, romelt`a smena da xedva mkvdaria cheshmaritebis mimart`.

translations.translation: da t`k`ves: gana ert`i sascaulic` ar unda ch`amovleniliqo masze misive g'mert`isgan? ut`xari: cheshmaritad, allahs z'aluz's, rom sascauli ch`amoavlinos, t`umc`a mat`ma umravlesobam ar ic`is.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] mat`ma umravlesobam ar ic`is, rom allahi qovlis shemz'lea da arc` is ic`is, t`u ra pasuxismgeblobebi mohqveba sascaulis moxdenas: t`uki sascaulis xilvis miuxedavad t`aviant` sijiutes ar moishlidnen da mainc` ar ircmunebdnen, mashin auc`ileblad g'vt`is risxva daatqdebodat` t`avs.

translations.translation: ar arsebobs dedamicaze iset`i c`xoveli; an p`rinveli, romelic` t`avisi p`rt`ebit` dap`rinavs, - rom t`k`ven msgavsad t`emebad ar iqvnen (daqop`ili). ch`ven cignshi arap`eri gamogvrch`enia, shemdeg t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe ik`nen shekrebilni.
xolo romelt`ac` c`rud miich`nies ch`vei aiat`ebi, - qruni da munjni arian bnelet`shi.[1] allahi, visac` inebebs, mas aac`dens (scori) gzidan da visac` inebebs, mas daaqenebs scor gzaze.
translations.footnotes: [1] qruni arian - ar sheismenen cheshmaritebas; munjni arian - ar carmot`k`vamen cheshmarit sitqvas, da umec`rebis bnelet`shi imqop`ebian.

translations.translation: ut`xari: aba mit`xarit`, t`uki allahis sasjeli geciat` an (k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis) zhami dagidgat`, mainc` sxvas daucqebt` vedrebas, nac`vlad allahisa, - t`u xart` namdvilad gulcrp`elni?
ara, - mxolod mas sheevedrebit`, da t`u inebebs, gixsnit` im mdgomareobidan, rist`visac` mas evedrebit` da daivicqebt` imat`, rasac` ut`anaziarebdit`.
cheshmaritad, shenamde ch`ven sxvadasxva xalxt`an carvgzavet` shuamavlebi da shevipqarit` isini sirt`uleebit`a da ubedurebebit`[1], - rom ik`neb t`avdamc`irebit` shevedrebuliqvnen.
translations.footnotes: [1] mag:sig'atakit` da sxva da sxva daavadebebit`.

translations.translation: mashin xom mainc` unda shemvedrebodnen t`avdamc`irebit`, - rodesac` ch`vengan sirt`ule ecviat`? t`umc`a gulebi gauk`vavdat` da satanam moukazma igi, rasac` sch`adiodnen.

rodesac` daivicqes igi, rit`ac` iqvnen shegonebuli[1], mashin gavuxsenit` qvelap`ris karebi; da roc`a gaixares imit`, rac` mat` miec`at`, - moulodnelad shevipqarit` da mashinve gaxdnen imedgac`ruebuli.
translations.footnotes: [1] sig'atake da avadmqop`oba

translations.translation: ase amoiz'irkva im xalxis modgma, vinc` usamart`lobas eceoda; k`eba-dideba allahs, - g'mert`s samqarot`a.

ut`xari: rogor p`ik`robt`, allahma rom smena da mxedveloba cagart`vat` da bechedi dagasvat` gulebze, - romeli g'vt`aeba dagibrunebt` mas, garda allahisa? shexede ra nair-nairad vmartavt` aiat`ebs, shemdeg ki mainc` pirs ibruneben egeni.
ut`xari: rogor p`ik`robt`, uec`rad an ashkarad rom allahis sasjeli gecviot`, gana usamart`lo xalxis garda vinme sxva daig'upeba?!
ar carvgzavnit` ch`ven shuamavlebs, t`u ara maxarobleblad da gamp`rt`xilebleblad, xolo vinc` ircmuna da gamoascora (z'veli urcmunoeba), - mat`t`vis arc` shishi ik`neba da arc` damcuxreba.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] mat` arc` imk`veqnad moelit` sashishroeba, da arc` imist`vis damcuxrdebian, rac` dat`mes amk`veqnad.

translations.translation: xolo mat`, romelt`ac` c`rud miich`nies ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi, scored mat` sheexebat` sasjeli imisa, rasac` zg'vargadasulobdnen.

ut`xari: me t`k`ven ar geubnebit`, rom ch`emt`anaa allahis saunjeni, arc` uxilavis shesaxeb vic`i da arc` imas geubnebit`, rom me var angelozi. me mxolod imas mivqvebi, rac` zemevlineba. ut`xari: gana t`anascoria brma da mxedveli?[1] nut`u ar dap`ik`rdebit`?
translations.footnotes: [1] gana t`anascoria urcmuno, romelic` brmaa allahis aiat`ebis mimart` da morcmune, romelic` allahis aiat`ebshi cheshmaritebas xedavs?

translations.translation: da misit`[1] gaap`rt`xile isini, romelt`ac` eshiniat`, rom shekreba moucevt` t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe da mis garda arc` damxmare eqolebat` da arc` k`omagi, - ik`neb ridi hk`ondet` mat`.
translations.footnotes: [1] quranit`.

translations.translation: da ar gandevno isini, romlebic` dila-sag'am t`aviant` g'mert`s evedrebian da misi (kmaqop`ili) saxe surt`. mat`i angarishidan shen arap`eri dagekisreba da arc` mat` daekisrebat` sheni angarishidan rame. t`uki gandevni mat`, mashin shen ik`nebi usamart`lot`agani.[1]
translations.footnotes:
[1] xabbabi gadmogvc`ems: ert` dg'es aqra' bin haabis at`-t`amiimii da 'ueine bin hisn al-p`azarii movidnen da naxes, rom allahis shuamavali suheibis, bilalis, 'ammaris, xabbabisa da msgavs morcmunet`agan ubralo adamianebs shoris zis. rodesac` isini shuamavlis irgvliv dainaxes, iukadrises. bolos miuaxlovdnen, mast`an ganmartovdnen da ut`xres: ch`ven gvinda, rom ch`vent`vis c`alke sxdomebi moacqo, romlit`ac` mt`eli arabebi ch`vens upiratesobas gaec`noba. shent`an arabt`a sxvadasxva carmomadgenlebi movlen da ch`ven shegvrc`xveba, t`uki am monebt`an ert`ad gvixiles. rodesac` ch`ven movalt`, isini shengan ganaride da roc`a cavalt`, mat`t`an ert`ad mere dajek`i, t`uki inebeb. shuamavalma (mat`i gamuslimanebis didi survilis gamo) upasuxa: diax. mat` ut`xres: amis damamocmeblad rame cerili dagvicere. shuamavalma k`ag'aldi it`xova da 'ali daibara, rat`a mist`vis cerili daecera; ch`ven am dros moshorebit` vijek`it`. ch`amovida jibril angelozi da shemdegi aiat`i caukit`xa:,,da ar gandevno isini, romlebic` dila-sag'am t`aviant` g'mert`s evedrebian da misi (kmaqop`ili) saxe surt`. mat`i angarishidan shen arap`eri dagekisreba da arc` mat` daekisrebat` sheni angarishidan rame. t`uki gandevni mat`, mashin shen ik`nebi usamart`lot`agani."
shemdeg aqra' bin haabisi da 'ueine bin hisni axsena da es aiat`i caikit`xa:,,amgvarad, gamovc`adet` zogiert`i mat`gani zogiert`it`, rom et`k`vat`: nut`u allahma amat` mihmadla siket`e - ch`ven shoris? gana allahi uket` ar ucqis madliert`?" shemdeg caikit`xa:,,da rodesac` shent`an movlen isini, romelt`ac` scamt` ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi, ut`xari: mshvidoba t`k`venda! t`k`venma g'mert`ma sakut`ar t`avs mocqaleba daucera."
amis shemdeg ch`ven mast`an imdenad axlos vsxdebodit`, rom ch`veni muxlebi mis muxlebs exeboda da allahis shuamavali sul ch`vent`an ert`ad ijda. rodesac` casvlas daapirebda, adgeboda da ch`ven gvtovebda. mere allahma shemdegi aiat`i ch`amoavlina:,,mot`minebit` dahqavi mat` gverdit`, romlebic` dila-sag'am t`aviant` g'mert`s evedrebian da misi (kmaqop`ili) saxe surt`. amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis mimzidvelobis gamo t`vali ar moarido mat`. (didebulebt`an ar dajde) da ar dahqve mas, visi gulic` ugulisqurod movakidet` ch`vens gaxsenebas, (anu 'ueina alaqra'is) sakut`ar survilebs ahqolia da misi sak`me zg'vars gadasula." (k`ehp`, 18/28.) anu 'ueina al-aqra'is sak`me damg'upvelia. shemdeg allahma ori kac`isa da amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis magalit`ad igavi moiqvana (anu sura k`ehp`is 32-44 aiat`ebshi).
xabbabma gaagrz'ela: mas shemdeg ch`ven sul mac`nest`an ert`ad visxedit`, xolo rodesac` misi casvlis dro movidoda, jer ch`ven cavidodit` da mas martod vtovebdit`, rom t`vit`onac` casuliqo. (ibni maaje, zuhd 7/4127.)

translations.translation: amgvarad, gamovc`adet` zogiert`i mat`gani zogiert`it`,[1] rom et`k`vat`: nut`u ch`ven shoris allahma mxolod amat` mihmadla siket`e? gana allahi uket` ar ucqis madliert`?
translations.footnotes: [1] anu gamovc`adet` mdidari g'aribit` da z'lieri sustit`. shuamavalt`a mocodebas pirvelad qovelt`vis sazogadoebis dabali p`ena g'ebulobda da isini rcmenis mimart` up`ro meti ert`gulebit` gamoirch`evodnen. rodesac` mek`k`is mdidrebi da z'lierebi xedavdnen, rom shuamavlis mocodeba z'irit`adad g'aribebma da sustebma miig'es da rcmenit` mat` gauscres, - ambobdnen: nut`u g'mert`ma amat`ze moig'o siket`e, gamoarch`ia da rcmenit` daajildova, rodesac` ch`ven gac`ilebit` upiratesni vart`o.

translations.translation: da roc`a movlen shent`an isini, romelt`ac` scamt` ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi, ut`xari: mshvidoba t`k`venda! t`k`venma g'mert`ma sakut`ar t`avs mocqaleba daucera. amgvarad, vinc` uket`urebas ik`ms uvic`obit`, mere ki moinaniebs da shemdeg gamoscordeba, - cheshmaritad, igi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mocqalea!
ase dacvrilebit` ganvmartavt` aiat`ebs, - c`odvilt`a gza rom gamoashkaravdes.

ut`xari: uechvelad, amekrz'ala me, t`aqvani vc`e imat`, rasac` t`k`ven evedrebit`, nac`vlad allahisa. ut`xari: ar avuqvebi t`k`vens gemovnebas, radgan namdvilad avc`debi cheshmarit gzas da me ar vik`nebi scor gzaze mdgomt`agani.

ut`xari: cheshmaritad, me ch`emi g'mert`isgan movlenil c`xad mtkic`ebulebebs veqrdnobi, t`k`ven ki mas uarqop`t`; me ar vp`lob imas, rasac` t`k`ven ch`k`arobt`.[1] gadacqvetileba mxolod allahs ekut`vnis, is mogit`xrobt` cheshmaritebis shesaxeb da igia kargi ganmc`alkevebeli.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] urcmunoebi shuamavals k`vebis gacvimebas da k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis zhamis dach`k`arebas st`xovdnen.
[2] samart`liani gadacqvetilebit` ganac`alkevebs cheshmaritebasa da sic`rues.

translations.translation: ut`xari: me rom vp`lobde imas, rasac` t`k`ven ch`k`arobt`, mashin ut`uod gadacqdeboda sak`me ch`emsa da t`k`vens shoris, xolo allahma uket` ic`is usamart`loni.

da mast`anaa uxilavis gasag'ebni,[1] mis garda igi aravin ic`is, man ic`is, rac`aa xmelet`ze da zg'vashi, ert`i p`ot`olic` ar ch`amovardeba ise, rom man ar ic`odes. ert`i marc`valic` ki ar arsebobs dedamicis jurg'mulebshi, - arc` nedli da arc` xmeli, - rom c`xad cignshi ar iqos gac`xadebuli.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,uxilavt`a gasag'ebi xut`ia: cheshmaritad, allahi p`lobs k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis saat`is c`odnas, is ch`amoavlen cvimas, man ic`is, rac` aris sashvilosnoebshi, verc`ert`i suli ver gaigebs, t`u ras moigebs xval da verc`ert`i suli ver mixvdeba, t`u romel micaze daig'upeba. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlis mc`odne da mc`nobelia." (buxari, t`ap`siir h.n. 4627.)
[2] allahis cinashe dac`uli deda cigni, romelshic` dasabamidan dasarulamde mt`eli samqaros shesaxeb qvelanairi inp`ormac`iaa ag'ric`xuli, mat` shoris adamiant`a bediscera, mosaxdeni ambebi da cminda quranic` im deda cignidan aris ag'ebuli.

translations.translation: da igia, romelic` gakvdinebt` g'amit` da ic`is, rasac` moixvecht` dg'isit`, shemdeg ag'gadgent` masshi, rat`a ag'sruldes ajali[1] gansazg'vruli, shemdeg - mast`anaa t`k`veni misak`c`ieli, mere ki gaucqebt`, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebdit`.
translations.footnotes: [1] igulisxmeba amk`veqniuri sic`oc`xlist`vis gankut`vnili dro.

translations.translation: igi zeag'matebulia t`avis msaxurebze da mc`velebs (angelozebs) agzavnis t`k`vent`an; xolo visac` sikvdili ecveva, - mas moakvdineben ch`veni cargzavnilebi da isini (t`aviant` sak`meshi) nakls ar daushveben.
shemdeg allahs daubrundebian - t`aviant` namdvil baton-patrons. gaxsovdet` rom, mas ekut`vnis msjavri da isaa uscrap`esi ganmkit`xveli.
ut`xari: vin gixsnit` xmelet`isa da zg'vis sibneleebidan, roc`a gulis sig'rmeshi, t`avdamc`irebit` sheevedrebit`: vp`ic`avt`, t`uki gvixsni ak`edan, usat`uod vik`nebit` madliert`agani.
- ut`xari: allahi gixsnit` imisgan da qvela sxva sadardeblisgan, shemdeg ki t`k`ven mas mainc` ut`anaziarebt`.

ut`xari: igi z'levamosilia, sasjeli mogivlinot` zemodan an t`k`vens p`ext`a k`vemodan, an kidev mxareebad gak`c`iot`[1] da t`k`venma ert`ma nacilma igemos meoris z'aladoba. shexede, ra dacvrilebit` vmartavt` aiat`ebs, ik`neb (ase mainc`) gaigon.
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,g'mert`s sami ram vt`xove, mat`gan ori shemisrula da ert`i ara. vt`xove, rom ch`emi ummet`i shimshilit` ar daexoc`a, man es t`xovna shemisrula; aseve vt`xove, rom ch`emi ummet`i cqaldidobebshi daxrch`obit` ar gaenadgurebina, man es t`xovnac` shemisrula; da vt`xove, rom ch`ems ummet`s ert`manet`i ar daexoc`a, man es t`xovna ar shemisrula." (muslim, p`it`an 5/2890.)

translations.translation: shenma xalxma c`rud miich`nia igi,[1] arada is aris cheshmariteba. ut`xari: me ar var t`k`veni met`valqure.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] scavlult`a ert`i nacilis azrit`, ak` igulisxmeba qurani, xolo meore nacilis mixedvit`, ak` igulisxmeba sasjeli, romelzec` cina aiat`shia saubari. ix. t`ap`siiru bag'avi.
[2] anu me mxolod shuamavali var, romlis valic` am cheshmaritebis t`k`venamde motana da shegonebaa.

translations.translation: qvela ambavs gansazg'vruli dro ak`vs (ag'srulebisa) da amas shemdgomshi sheitqobt`.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] cminda quranshi gadmoc`emuli qoveli ambisa da sitqvist`vis garkveuli dro da adgilia gansazg'vruli, romelic` uc`vlelia da drois mosvlast`an ert`ad t`andat`an gamoashkaravdeba - cheshmariteba qop`ila t`u tquili. nacili amk`veqnad gamoashkaravdeba, nacilic` imk`veqnad da t`k`venc` sheitqobt` mis shesaxeb. ix. t`ap`siiru beg'avi.

translations.translation: roc`a dainaxav, rom damc`inavad saubroben ch`veni aiat`ebis shesaxeb (romlebic` ch`amogevlina ), mashinve gaec`ale mat`, - vidre sxva sitqvit` ar dakavebulan. xolo t`uki satanam dagavicqa, mashin gaxsenebist`anave gaeride am usamart`lo xalxt`an dajdomas.
xolo mat`, romelnic` g'vt`ismoshishoben, arap`eri moekit`xebat` imat`i angarishidan; mat`ze mxolod shegonebaa - ik`neb g'vt`ismoshishoba gamoich`inon.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ibni abbasis gadmoc`emis mixedvit`, rodesac` ch`amoevlina aiat`i:,,rodesac` dainaxav mat`, romlebic` damc`inavad saubroben ch`veni aiat`ebis shesaxeb, mashinve gaec`ale mat`", - muslimebma ch`ivili daicqes: rogor unda davsxdet` k`aabas mech`et`shi da tavap`i shevasrulot`, rodesac` isini sul damc`inavad saubroben? gansxvavebuli versiis t`anaxmad mat` t`k`ves: rodesac` ch`ven vtovebt` mat`i t`avsheqris adgils da ar vushlit` aset` saubars, gveshinia, c`odva ch`venc` ar shegvexos. amis shesaxeb uzenaesma allahma es aiat`i ch`amoavlina, rom urcmunot`a c`odvebi mat` ar moekit`xebodat` da mat`i movaleoba mxolod shegoneba iqo.ix.t`ap`siiru beg'avi.

translations.translation: moshordi mat`, romlebic` xumrobit` da gart`obit` ekidebian t`aviant` sarcmunoebas da vinc` amk`veqniur c`xovrebas uc`dunebia! da misit`[1] sheagone, rom ar dag'upos suli t`avisi monapovrit`; rom ar gaach`nia mas arc` damxmare da arc` k`omagi, garda allahisa. qvelanairi gamosasqidic` rom gaig'os, - ar miig'eba is misgan. scored egeni arian, vinc` t`aviant`i monapovrit` daig'upnen, mat`t`visaa mdug'are sasmeli da mcare sasjeli - imis gamo, rasac` uarqop`dnen.
translations.footnotes: [1] quranit`.

translations.translation: ut`xari: gana allahis garda sxvas vevedrot`, romelic` veras gvargebs da verc` gvavnebs[1], da ukan mivbrundet`, ch`venive k`uslebis mimart`ulebit`, mas shemdeg, rac` allahma cheshmarit gzaze dagvakvaliana? imis msgavsad, vinc` gaabriqves satanebma da datoves k`veqnad t`avgzaabneuli, t`anac` mat` hqavt` megobrebi, romlebic` cheshmariti gzisken uxmoben: modit` ch`vent`ano.[2] ut`xari:,,cheshmaritad, allahis mier mit`it`ebuli gzaa - gza cheshmariti da ch`ven gvebrz'ana, rom samqarot`a g'mert`s vmorch`ilebdet`".
translations.footnotes:
[1] arc` mat`i t`aqvanisc`emit` gvek`neba sargebeli da arc` mat`i mitovebit` - zarali.
[2] 'abdullah bin 'abbasi ganmartavs: es aris igavi, romelic` allahma, kerpebis t`aqvanisc`emisken momcodebelt`a da allahis t`aqvanisc`emisken momxmobt`a magalit`ad moiqvana. shedarebulia kac`ze, romelic` cheshmarit gzas ac`da da t`avgzaabneuli darch`a. ert`i mxriv, mc`dari gzisken ez'axian, meore mxriv megobrebi qavs, romlebic` cheshmariti gzisken uxmoben da veg'ar xvdeba, sait` cavides. t`uki pirvel momcodebels daujerebs, damg'upvel up`skrulshi gadavardeba, xolo t`u mat` daujerebs, vinc` cheshmariti gzisken uxmoben, mashin cheshmaritebas eziareba. ix. t`ap`siiru taberi.

translations.translation: aseve (gvebrz'ana), shevasrulot` namazi da mis (allahis ) mimart` ridi vik`oniot`. igia, romlis cinashec` ik`nebit` ag'dgenili.

da igia, romelmac` c`ani da dedamica gaach`ina cheshmaritebit` da im dg'es itqvis:,,iqav", da isic` umalve ik`mneba, - cheshmaritebaa misi sitqva. misia meup`eba im dg'isa, roc`a bukshi ch`aibereba[1], mc`odnea xilulisa da uxilavisa, da igia brz'eni, qovlismc`odne.
translations.footnotes: [1] islamis scavlebis mixedvit`, k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis cin, angelozi israp`ili bukis magvar saqvirshi ch`aberavs, rac` sic`oc`xlis dasasrulis zhamis dadgomas mianishnebs da mashin qoveli c`oc`xali arseba sikvdils igemebs. ch`vent`vis uc`nobi drois shemdeg, angelozi saqvirshi meored ch`aberavs da suli daubrundeba qvela mic`valebuls, isini sap`lavebidan camodgebian, ert`iani t`avsheqris adgilisken gaemart`ebian da g'mert`is cinashe ganikit`xebian.

translations.translation: aki ibrahimma t`avis mamas, azars ut`xra: nut`u kerpebs ag'iareb g'mert`ebad!? uechvelad, vxedav, rom shen da sheni xalxi xart` ashkara gzaac`denilobashi.
amgvarad vach`venet` ibrahims c`at`a da k`veqnierebis meup`eba, rat`a qop`iliqo guldajerebul morcmunet`agani.
- g'amit`, rodesac` igi bindma garemoic`va da varskvlavi dainaxa, t`k`va:,,esaa ch`emi g'mert`i"; xolo rodesac` gak`ra, dasz'ina: me ar miqvars is, rac` k`reba.[1]
translations.footnotes:
[1] ibrahim shuamavlis amgvari mok`medeba islamis scavlult`a shoris p`art`o ganxilvis sakit`xia. misi sitqvebis ganmartebebs shoris qvelaze gamokvet`ilad t`valshi gvxvdeba ot`xi komentari:
pirveli: ibrahim shuamavals amgvari dialogit` t`avisi xalxi nabij-nabij mihqavda simart`lisken da c`dilobda, mat`i shec`domebi da umec`ari sak`c`ieli ech`venebina. radganac` is xalxi varskvlavebs adidebdnen da mat` et`aqvanebodnen, p`ik`robdnen, rom samqaroshi qvelap`ers varskvlavebi ganagebdnen. is jer c`dilobda, ise mok`c`euliqo, rom t`it`k`os t`vit`onac` ik` ez'ebda cheshmaritebas, sadac` misi xalxi ez'ebda: rodesac` varskvlavebi k`reboda, mat` quradg'ebas varskvlavt`a naklovanebaze amaxvilebda da amgvarad usabut`ebda, rom naklis mk`one g'mert`i ver ik`neboda.
meore: ibrahim shuamavali mat` kit`xvis p`ormit` mimart`avda,,esaa ch`emi g'mert`i?" misi kit`xva, uarqop`is shinaarsis matarebeli iqo anu,,gana sheiz'leba aset`i iqos g'mert`i?" ak`edan gamomdinare is gulisxmobda,,es ch`emi g'mert`i ar aris."
mesame: man es sitqvebi mat`t`an kamat`is dros gamoiqena da gulisxmobda shemdegs:,,t`k`veni azrit`, esaa ch`emi g'mert`i". xolo rodesac` varskvlavi gak`ra, miugo:,,es rom g'mert`i qop`iliqo, ar gak`reboda."
meot`xe: shesaz'loa quranis aiat`shi iqos p`aruli shinaarsi. am shexedulebis mk`onet`a azrit`, ibrahim shuamavlis sitqvebshi igulisxmeba shemdegi:,,amboben, rom esaa ch`emi g'mert`i", rogorc` sura baqaras 127-e aiat`shi gvxvdeba:,,aki, ibrahimi da isma'ili saxlis (k`aabas) saz'irkvlebs amag'lebdnen (t`an ambobdnen): g'mert`o ch`veno, miig'e es ch`vengan". aiat`is originalshi ch`ven mier p`rch`xilebshi ch`asmuli (t`an ambobdnen) ar aris, magram igulisxmeba, rom isini ambobdnen amas. ix. t`ap`siiru bag'avi.

translations.translation: da roc`a amomavali mt`vare dainaxa, t`k`va:,,esaa ch`emi g'mert`i", xolo rogorc` ki ch`avida, man t`k`va: t`uki ch`emma g'mert`ma ar damakvaliana cheshmariti gzisken, usat`uod me vik`nebi gzasac`denil xalxt`agani.

xolo roc`a amomavali mze dainaxa, t`k`va:,,esaa ch`emi g'mert`i, es up`ro didia"; xolo rogorc` ki ch`avida, man t`k`va: o, ch`emo xalxo! cheshmaritad, me shors var imisgan, rasac` t`k`ven ut`anaziarebt`!
cheshmaritad, me saxe vibrune hanip`ad[1] imisken, romelmac` shek`mna c`ani da dedamica, da me ar var carmart`t`agani.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,hanip`i" (Hnyf): qovelgvari c`ru rcmenisa da carmart`uli sak`misagan gandegili da urqevi monot`eizmit` cheshmaritebisken mltolvare.

translations.translation: da sheedava misi xalxi, man ki ut`xra: nut`u allahis shesaxeb mec`ilebit`, roc`a man damakvalina cheshmarit gzaze? me ar meshinia imis, rasac` t`k`ven ut`anaziarebt` mas, garda imisa, t`uki ch`emma g'mert`ma ineba rame.[1] ch`emi g'mert`i qovelives c`odnit` garemoic`avs, nut`u ar gaiazrebt`?
translations.footnotes: [1] xalxi mas kerpebit` ashinebda, rom t`u gaagrz'elebda mat` gmobas da damc`irebas, mashin t`avs ubedureba daatqdeboda. amaze ibrahim shuamavlis pasuxi es iqo: me ar meshinia im kerpebis, rasac` allahs ut`anaziarebt` da isini verap`ers mavneben, t`uki allahi ar inebebs ch`ems vnebaso.

translations.translation: da rogor unda meshinodes imis, rasac` t`k`ven ut`anaziarebt` (allahs ), mashin, roc`a t`k`ven ar geshiniat`, rom allahs ut`anaziarebdet` imas, ris shesaxebac` t`k`vent`vis aranairi mtkic`ebuleba ar ch`amouvlenia? da am ori mxridan romeli up`ro imsaxurebs usap`rt`xoebas[1], t`u ic`it`?
translations.footnotes: [1] am ori mxaredan romels up`ro unda eshinodes g'vt`is risxvis an romeli unda grz'nobdes t`avs usap`rt`oxod - ert`g'meg't`ianebi t`u carmart`ebi?

translations.translation: mat`t`vis, vinc` ircmunes da ar sheuries t`aviant` rcmenas usamart`loba,[1] scored mat`t`visaa usap`rt`xoeba da egeni arian cheshmarit gzaze mdgomni.
translations.footnotes: [1] rodesac` es aiat`i ch`amoevlina:,,vinc` ircmunes da ar sheuries t`aviant` rcmenas usamart`loba ", - allahis shuamavlis sahabeebs z'alian emz'imat` misi shinaarsi da t`k`ves: romeli ch`vengani ar vurevt` rcmenashi usamart`lobas? amaze ki shuamavalma ut`xra: ise ar aris, rogorc` ggoniat`. gana ar isment` luqman shuamavlis sitqvebs t`avisi shvilis mimart`:,,uechvelad, shirk`i didi usamart`lobaa." (buxari, t`ap`siir, h.n. 4776.)

translations.translation: ai, esaa ch`veni mtkic`ebuleba, romelic` ibrahims vuboz'et` t`avisi xalxis sacinag'mdegod. xarisxobrivad vamag'lebt` mas, visac` vinebebt`. cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i brz'enia, qovlis mc`odne.

da vucqalobet` mas ishaqi da ia'qubi, orive cheshmarit gzaze davakvalianet`, aseve, up`ro adre nuhic` davakvalianet` da misi sht`amomavlobidan - davudi, suleimani, aiubi, iusup`i, musa da haruni. amgvarad vajildovebt` ket`ilismk`nelebs.
zek`eria, iahia, 'isa da iliasi, - qvelani iqvnen sat`not`aganni.
aseve, isma'ili, iese'i, iunusi da luti, - qvela mat`gani gamovarch`iet` samqarot`a cinashe.
aseve amovarch`iet` mat` mamat`agan, sht`amomavalt`agan da z'mat`agan, da scor gzaze davakvalianet`.
esaa allahis gza - cheshmariti: masze t`avis msaxurt`agan akvalianebs mat`, visac` inebebs; xolo t`u mainc` ut`anaziareben, mashin usat`uod gac`amtverdeba, rasac` isini aket`ebdnen.
egeni[1] arian, visac` vuboz'et` cigni, sibrz'ne da mac`neoba. t`uki isini[2] uarqop`en mas,[3] usat`uod, mas iset` xalxs gadavabarebt`, romlebic` ar uarqop`en.
translations.footnotes:
[1] zemot` ch`amot`vlili shuamavlebi.
[2] qureisheli carmart`ebi, an zogadad, vist`anac` miva islamis moz'g'vreba da t`avs sheikavebs mis ag'iarebaze.
[3] qurans da zogadad, islamis moz'g'vrebas.

translations.translation: ai, egeni arian, vinc` allahma cheshmarit gzaze daakvaliana da shenc` mat` cheshmarit gzas sheudek`i. ut`xari: imis[1] sanac`vlod ar vit`xov t`k`vengan gasamrjelos, aramed is mxolod shegonebaa samqarot`at`vis.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] quranis.
[2] kac`t`a da jint`a samqarot`at`vis.

translations.translation: da mat` ver sheic`nes allahi qadrianad, rogorc` mas sheep`ereba, rodesac` t`k`ves: allahs adamianist`vis arap`eri ch`amouvlenia. (shenc`) ut`xari: mash, vin ch`amoavlina cigni, - sinat`leda da cheshmariti gzis mach`veneblad adamiant`at`vis, - romlit`ac` musa movida da romelsac` p`urc`lebze cert`, nacili - gamogak`vt` saashkaraoze, umetess ki malavt`?[1] da gescavlat`[2] is, rac` ar ic`odit` - arc` t`k`ven da arc` t`k`vnma cinaprebma. upasuxe - allahmao (ch`amoavlinao),[3] shemdeg ki miatove mat`i amao saubrit` gart`ulni.
translations.footnotes:
[1] malavt` t`evrat`shi (t`ora) gadmoc`emul nishnebs, romlit`ac` muhammedis shuamavloba iqo nacinascarmetqvelevi - mrushis sasjels da msgavs sakit`xebs, risi gamzhg'avnebac` ar mogcont`.
[2] quranis meshveobit` gescavlat`.
[3] allahma ch`amoavlina t`evrat`i, romelsac` t`k`venc` ag'iarebt`, magram raki quranis ag'iareba ar gindat`, mzad xart` t`k`vens rcmenasac` daupirispirdet` da t`k`vat`, rom allahs adamianist`vis arap`eri ch`amouvleniao.

translations.translation: da es daloc`vili cigni ch`amovavlinet` damamocmeblad imisa, rac` iqo masze cinat`, aseve k`alak`t`a dedis[1] da mis garshemo mqop`t`a gasap`rt`xileblad. xolo visac` scamt` saik`io, mat` esec` (quranic`) scamt` da isini t`aviant` namazsac` gulmodgined ic`aven.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali,,umm al-qura" (m lqr~) pirdapiri mnishvnelobit` sop`lebis an k`alak`ebis dedas nishnavs da igulisxmeba cminda k`alak`i mek`k`a. anu cminda qurani k`alak` mek`k`ashi mc`xovreb muhammed shuamavals ch`amoevlina da pirvelad scored am k`alak`is mkvidr xalxs gaac`no, xolo t`andat`anobit` mis garshemo mqop`ebshic` gavrc`elda da ase gagrz'eldeba k`veqnierebis dasasrulamde, vidre mt`el msop`lios ar moic`avs ag'mosavlet`idan dasavlet`amde.

translations.translation: da vin aris imaze didi usamart`lo, romelmac` sic`rue shet`xza allahis shesaxeb an t`k`va, rom vahi (g'vt`iuri shetqobineba) mivig'eo; arada mas arap`eri miug'ia; aseve, vinc` t`k`va: mec` ch`amovavlen imis msgavss, rac` allahma ch`amoavlinao. netav genaxa sult`mobrz'avi usamart`loni, rodesac` angelozebi xelebgacvdilni eubnebian: ganutevet` sulebi! dg'es mogezg'vebat` sasjeli damamc`irebeli, im usamart`lobist`vis, rasac` allahis shesaxeb ambobdit` da misi aiat`ebis mimart` medidurobdit`!

da vp`ic`av, ch`ven cinashe ise eulad moxvedit`, rogorc` pirvelad gagach`inet`.[1] da zurgsukan migitovebiat`, rac` t`k`vent`vis gviboz'ebia,[2] veg'arc` t`k`vens k`omagebs vxedavt` t`k`vent`an ert`ad, romlebic`, gjerodat`, rom iqvnen (allahis) t`anaziarni. ukve gacqda kavshiri t`k`ven shoris da gandegila is t`k`vengan, rasac` amtkic`ebdit` (usap`uz'vlod).
translations.footnotes:
[1] rogori shishveli da uk`onelic` moevlinet` am k`veqanas, iseve shishveli da materialurad uk`oneli caxvalt` ukan. allahis shuamavali brz'anebs:,,uechvelad, t`k`ven allahis cinashe p`exshishveli, ch`auc`meli, k`veit`ad da cinadauc`vet`elni cardgebit`." (buxari, riqaq 45/6524.)
[2] k`oneba, nat`esavebi, t`anamdeboba da a.sh.

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, allahia marc`vlisa da kurkis gampob-gamg'ivebeli, c`oc`xali mkvdrisgan gamohqavs da c`oc`xlisganac` - mkvdari. ai, es aris allahi da t`k`ven rogor ganeridebit`?
- gamg'vivebeli alionisa, romelmac` daadgina g'ame mosasveneblad, mze da mt`vare ki (drot`a) gamosat`vlelad. aset`ia gangeba z'levamosilis, qovlis mc`odnisa.

da igia, vinc` t`k`vent`vis dasxa varskvlavebi, rat`a mat`it` gza gagekvliat` xmelet`isa da zg'vis cqvdiadebshi. uechvelad, ch`ven dacvrilebit` ganvmartet` aiat`ebi - im xalxist`vis, romlebmac` ic`ian.
da igia, romelmac` shegk`mnat` ert`i sulisgan; shemdgom (dagidginat`) mosakalat`ebeli da misabarebeli.[1] uechvelad, ch`ven detalurad ganvmartet` aiat`ebi - im xalxist`vis, romlebic` gamgebia.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,must`aqarrun" (mstqr) da,,must`avda'un" (mstwd`): pirvelis pirdapiri t`argmani - samqop`eli, adgili, sadac` sap`uz'vlianad mot`avsda da garkveul dros dahqop`s, lek`sikonuri mnishvnelobisa da kontek`sturi shinaarsis gat`valiscinebit` vt`argmnet`, rogorc` mosakalat`ebeli adgili. xolo meoris pirdapiri mnishvnelobaa adgili, sadac` rames miabareben. islamis scavlulebi ag'nishnul sitqvebs sxvadasxva shinaarsit` xsnian, romelsac` mokled gadmogvc`ems imami taberi:,,uzenaesi allahi am aiat`shi zogadad gvamc`nobs, rom adamianebi ert`i sulisgan (adem shuamavlisgan) gaach`ina, shemdeg mat` garkveul samqop`elsa da misabarebelshi dahqves. adamiant`a nacili dedis muc`elshia mokalat`ebuli, nacili ki mamis sxeulshi - amanat`ad mibarebuli. adamiant`a macili dedamicazea mokalat`ebuli, meore nacili ki sap`lavshia mibarebuli." (ix. t`ap`siiru taberi.)

translations.translation: igia, romelmac` zec`idan cqali ch`amoavlina; da ag'movac`enet` misit` qvelanairi mc`enare, amovzardet` misgan mcvanobi, imisgan ki marc`vlebi[1] - ert`manet`ze asxmuli, xolo p`inikis kokrisgan - ch`amokidebuli mtevnebi, aseve qurz'nis bag'ebi, zet`isxili da broceuli - ert`manet`is msgavsic` da gansxvavebulic`. shexedet` mis naqop`s, romelic` isxams da mcip`deba. cheshmaritad, am qvelap`ershi mart`lac` sascaulebia morcmune xalxist`vis.
translations.footnotes: [1] t`avt`avi.

translations.translation: da allahs jinebi ut`anaziares, arada man gaach`ina isini; aseve, uvic`ad dascames z'eebi da asulebi. igi qovlad unaklo da uzenaesia imisgan, rogoradac` axasiat`eben.
- igi c`at`a da dedamicis arap`risgan shemk`mnelia da shvili saidan eqoleba, rodesac` c`oli ar hqolia? da man gaach`ina qvelap`eri, igia qovlis mc`odne.
igia allahi - g'mert`i t`k`veni, ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba garda misi, qovlis gamch`enisa. mash, t`aqvani ec`it` mas, - igia qovlis met`valqure.
- ver shescvdebian imas mzerani,[1] t`vit`on ki mcvdomia mzerat`a, da isaa lmobieri, qovlismc`odne.
translations.footnotes: [1] amk`veqniuri t`valt`axedvist`vis sheuz'lebelia misi xilva. imk`veqnad - qvela morcmune ixilavs mas, t`umc`a t`valis cvdomas sc`deba misi namdvili raobis ag'k`misa da ganchvretis shesaz'lebloba. amitom veravis t`valebi ver ch`ascvdeba mas, is ki scvdeba qvela t`vals, arap`eria misi c`odnis mig'ma, sheuc`nobeli da dap`aruli mist`vis. allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,cheshmaritad, t`k`ven c`xadad ixilavt` t`k`vens g'mert`s." (buxari, t`avhid 24/7435.)

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, t`k`veni g'mert`isgan mogividat` t`valsach`ino mtkic`ebulebani; ase rom, vinc` t`vals gaaxels - misive sulis sargod, xolo vinc` caubrmavebs - misda sazianod. da ar var me t`k`veni met`valqure.
amgvarad vmartavt` aiat`ebs qovelmxriv, isini ki mainc` itqvian:,,giscavlia",[1] rat`a c`xadgveqo xalxist`vis, romlebmac` ic`ian.
translations.footnotes: [1] aiat`is am nacilis ganmartebisas islamis scavlulebi ramdenime gansxvavebul versias gvt`avazoben, ris sashualebasac` arabuli ena iz'leva: a) amgvarad, qovelmxriv vmartavt` aiat`ebs, rom et`k`vat` - giscavliao. b) amgvarad, qovelmxriv vmartavt`, rom ar et`k`vat` - giscavliao. g) amgvarad, qovelmxriv vmartavt` aiat`ebs, magram isini mainc` itqvian - giscavliao. mek`k`el carmart`ebs ar sjerodat`/ar ag'iarebdnen, rom muhammed shuamavali allahisgan g'ebulobda shetqobinebebs; amitomac` ambobdnen, rom man cignboz'ebulebt`an mec`adineobit` miig'o is c`odna da sibrz'ne, rasac` k`adagebda.ix:t`ap`siir tabari.

translations.translation: mihqevi imas, rac` zemogevlina sheni g'mert`isgan; ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba garda misi, da zurgi ak`c`ie carmart`ebs.
allahs rom eneba, ar ut`anaziarebdnen, da shen arc` mc`velad[1] dagvidgenixar da arc` vek`ili xar mat`i.
translations.footnotes: [1] met`valqured da mat`i c`odvebis ag'mric`xvelad

translations.translation: da ar galanz'g'ot` isini, visac` allahis nac`vlad evedrebian, radgan isinic` allahs daucqeben lanz'g'vas - mtrobit`, c`odnis gareshe. ase movukazmet` qvela t`ems t`aviant`i sak`meni, shemdeg t`aviant` g'mert`t`anaa mat`i misabrunebeli da is (allahi) ac`nobebt` mat` imis shesaxeb, rasac` aket`ebdnen.

allahs ip`ic`ebian mt`eli t`avgamodebit`, rom t`uki ert`i sascauli mievlinebat`, mashin auc`ileblad ircmuneben mas. ut`xari: cheshmaritad, sascaulebi allahis gankargulebashia, t`k`ven (morcmuneno) ki ar ic`it`, rom sascaulebi romc` movides, egeni mainc` ar ircmuneben!
da shevak`c`evt` mat` gulebsa da xedvebs, rogorc` ar ircmunes t`avdapirvelad[1], da mivatovebt` t`aviant` zg'vargadasulobashi, t`avgzaabneulebs.
translations.footnotes: [1] raki urcmunoeba airch`ies da gajiutdnen, ch`venc` davabrmavebt` mat` t`valebsa da gulebs cheshmaritebis mimart`. mat`ive sasurveli sascaulebic` rom movavlinot`, isini mainc` ar ircmuneben, rogorc` ar ircmunes t`avdapirvelad, da iseve darch`ebian - urcmunoebashi gzaabneulni.

translations.translation: allahi brz'anebs: esaa dg'e, roc`a mart`alni sargebels hpoveben t`aviant`i simart`lisas: mat`t`visaa samot`xeebi, romelt`a k`veshac` mdinareebi miedineba; ik` ik`nebian maradzhams. kmaqop`ilia mat`gan allahi da t`vit`onac` kmaqop`ili arian misit`. ai, esaa mig'ceva - udidesi (didi gamarjveba).
allahs ekut`vnis c`at`a da dedamicis ganmgebloba da (imis,) rac`aa mat`shi. igia qovlisshemz'le.
dideba allahs, romelmac` gaach`ina c`ani da dedamica, daadgina nat`eli da bneli. urcmunoebi, amis miuxedavad, t`aviant` g'mert`s sxvebs ut`anabreben.
igia, vinc` t`ixisgan gagach`inat`, shemdeg daadgina ajali da mis cinashea ajali gansazg'vruli.[1] am qvelap`ris shemdeg t`k`ven mainc` echvi geparebat`.
translations.footnotes: [1] hasan al-basris, qat`adesa da dahhak`is ganmartebit`, pirveli ajali aris dabadebidan sikvdilamdeli, xolo meore ajali - sikvdilidan ag'dgomamde drois monakvet`i. mat`i es ganmarteba ibni abbasi shemdeg sitqvebs eqrdnoba: qvela adamians ak`vs ori ajali: ajali dabadebidan sikvdilamde da ajali sikvdilidan ag'dgomamde. t`uki is ik`neba ket`ili, g'vt`ismoshishi da nat`esauri urt`iert`obebis gamgrz'elebeli, mas ag'dgomis ajalidan amk`veqniuri sic`oc`xlis ajalze daemateba; xolo t`uki c`odvili da nat`esauri urt`iert`obebis gamcqveti ik`neba, mashin amk`veqniuri sic`oc`xlis ajalidan ag'dgomis ajalze daemateba. mujahidisa da sa'iid bin jubeiris ganmartebis t`anaxmad, pirveli ajali aris amk`veqniuri c`xovrebist`vis gansazg'vruli dro; xolo meore ajali - imk`veqniuri c`xovrebist`vis gansazg'vruli droa. ix. t`ap`siiru bag'avi.

translations.translation: igia allahi c`at`a shina da k`veqanaze[1], ic`is t`k`veni p`arulic` da c`xadic`, aseve ic`is, rasac` t`k`ven moixvecht`.
translations.footnotes: [1] igi ert`adert`i cheshmariti sat`aqvanebelia k`veqanazec` da zec`ashic`.

translations.translation: mat` t`aviant`i g'mert`is aiat`t`agan/sascault`agan, ra aiat`ic`/sascaulic` miuvidat`, qvelasgan piri ik`c`ies.
mart`lac` c`rud sherac`xes cheshmariteba, rodesac` mat` miuvidat`, t`umc`a shemdeg miuvat` ambavi imisa, rasac` abuch`ad igdebdnen.

nut`u ver xedaven, t`u ramdeni t`aoba gagvinadgurebia mat`ze adre, romlebsac` amk`veqnad iset`i sashualebebi vuboz'et`, rac` t`k`vent`vis ar gviboz'ebia; zec`idan uxvi nalek`i ch`amovuvlinet` da mdinareebi davadginet` mat` k`vemot` mdeni, shemdeg t`aviant`i c`odvebis gamo gavanadguret` da mat` shemdeg sxva t`aoba gavach`inet`.
t`undac` p`urc`elze dacerili cigni ch`amogvevlina shent`vis da t`aviant`i xelebit` shexebuliqvnen, mainc` itqodnen isini, - vinc` ar ircmunes, - rom es mxolod ashkara jadoao.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] k`elbisa da muqat`ilis ganmartebis t`anaxmad, es aiat`i nadr bin al-harisis, abdullah bin bani umeiasa da navp`al bin hudairis shesaxeb ch`amoevlina. mat` t`k`ves: o, muhammed! manamde ar dagijerebt`, vidre allahisgan cigns ar mogvitan, romelsac` ot`xi angelozi exleba da daamocmeben, rom es cigni alllahisganaa da shen misi shuamavali xaro. ix. t`ap`siiru bag'avi.

translations.translation: mat` t`k`ves: nut`u angelozi ar unda ch`amovleniliqo mast`an? mast`an rom angelozi ch`amogvevlina, mashin ut`uod gadacqdeboda mat`i sak`me da shemdeg ag'arc` edrovebodat`[1].
translations.footnotes: [1] rodesac` urcmunoebi it`xovdnen sascauls da misi ag'srulebis miuxedavad mainc` jiutad agrz'elebdnen urcmunoebas, mat` qovelt`vis gamanadgurebeli sasjeli eceodat`. am aiat`shic` allahi scored amaze amaxvilebs quradg'ebas, rom muhammed shuamavalt`an mat`t`vis xiluli angelozebic` rom ch`amogvevlina, isini mainc` ar ircmunebdnen, amitom mat`i ganadgurebis sak`me mashinve gadacqdeboda, arc` monaniebis da arc` t`avis mart`lebis dro ag'ar miec`emodat`o.

translations.translation: t`undac` angelozad dagvedgina igi, ut`uod kac`ad davadgendit`[1] da mainc` igive mdgomareobashi ag'movach`endit`, ra mdgomareobashic` axla imqop`ebian.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] mat`t`vis angelozic` rom cargvegzavna, masac` adamianis p`ormit` carvgzavnidit`, radganac` adamianebs ar sheuz'liat` angelozebis xilva t`aviant`i namdvili p`ormit`.
[2] rogorc` axla amboben, rogor gavigot`, shen mart`lac` allahis shuamavali xar t`u ert`i ch`veulebrivi ch`venganio, mashinac` imas itqodnen - rogor gavigot`, shen mart`lac` angelozi xar t`u adamianio.

translations.translation: uechvelad, shenze adrec` aigdes masxrad shuamavlebi, shemdeg vinc` mat` dasc`inodnen, - imit`ve ik`mnen shepqrobili, rist`visac` dasc`inodnen.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] t`vit`onve ag'moch`ndnen sasac`ilo mdgomareobashi da es iqo mat`i sasjeli shuamavalt`a dac`invis gamo.

translations.translation: ut`xari: ch`amoiaret` dedamicaze da dainaxet`, t`u ra bedi eciat` c`rud shemrac`xvelebs.

ut`xari: visia is, rac`aa c`at`a shina da dedamicaze? upasuxe: allahisaa, man mocqaleoba t`avis valad sc`no. vp`ic`av, rom is mart`lac` shegkrebt` gankit`xvis dg'es, romelshic` echvi ar aris. xolo romelt`ac` sakut`ar sulebs avnes (urcmunoebit`), isini mainc` ar ircmuneben.
misia qoveli, rac` mkvidrobs g'amit` da dg'isit`; da isaa qovlismsmeneli, qovlismc`odne.

ut`xari: gana allahis garda sxvas avirch`ev mp`arvelad - gamch`enisa c`at`a da dedamicis? da igia dampurebeli, xolo t`vit`on ar sachiroebs dapurebas. ut`xari: cheshmaritad, me mebrz'ana, rom pirveli viqo, vinc` daemorch`ila da ar iqo carmart`t`aganio.
ut`xari: cheshmaritad, me vshishob, rom t`u veurch`ebi ch`ems g'mert`s, t`avs damatqdeba udidesi dg'is sasjeli.
im dg'es, vinc` ik`neba misgan[1] ganridebuli, mas (allahi) mart`lac` sheicqalebs da es ik`neba c`xadi carmateba.
translations.footnotes: [1] sasjelisgan.

translations.translation: t`uki allahma uket`ureba shegamt`xvia, mis garda veravin agaridebs; xolo t`uki siket`e shegamt`xvia, igia qovlis shemz'le.[1]
