translations.footnotes: [1] ibni abbasi gadmogvc`ems: ert` dg'es, shesajdom pirutqvze allahis shuamavalis ukan vijek`i da mit`xra: ei, axalgazrda! ramdenime sitqvit` minda dagarigo: allahi (misi brz'anebebi da akrz'alvebi) daic`avi, rom manac` shen dagic`vas. daic`avi allahi, rom sait`ac` mibrundebi, ik` hpovo igi. t`u rame sat`xovari gek`neba, allahs st`xove. t`uki daxmareba gchirdeba, allahs sheevedre. ic`ode, rom mt`eli kac`obrioba shens sasargeblod rom gaert`iandes, verap`ers gargeben imaze mets, rac` allahs shent`vis dauceria; aseve, mt`eli kac`obrioba rom shens cinaag'mdeg gaert`iandes, verap`ers gavneben imaze mets, rac` allahs shent`vis dauceria, (bedisceris ch`amceri) kalmebi aqrilia da p`urc`lebi gamshralia. (t`irmizi, h.n. 2516.)

translations.translation: is aris z'levamosili, t`avis msaxurebze qovlad amag'lebuli da igia brz'eni, qovlismc`odne.

ut`xari: romelia qvelaze didi mocmoba? aseve, ut`xari, rom ch`em da t`k`ven shoris allahia mocme[1], da es qurani zesht`amegona, rat`a misit` gagap`rt`xilot` t`k`ven da isini, vist`anac` miag'cevs.[2] t`k`ven mart`lac` amocmebt`, rom allaht`an ert`ad sxva g'vt`aebebic` arsebobs?[3] ut`xari: me ar vamocmeb! ut`xari: cheshmaritad, is ert`adert`i g'mert`ia da uechvelad, me shors var imisgan, rasac` ut`anaziarebt`!
translations.footnotes:
[1] k`albi gadmogvc`ems: mek`k`eli carmart`ebi allahis shuamavalt`an mividnen da ut`xres: aba vin amocmebs, rom shen allahis shuamavali xar? veravis vpoulobt` iset`s, vinc` shens shuamavlobas daamocmebs. ch`ven iudevelebsa da k`ristianebsac` vkit`xet` shenze, t`umc`a mat` t`aviant` cminda cerilshi verap`eri hpoves shens shesaxeb. amis shemdeg allahma ch`amoavlina:,,ut`xari: romelia qvelaze didi mocmoba?" t`u ver gipasuxes, upasuxe:,,ch`emsa da t`k`vens shoris allahia mocme." ix. t`ap`siru bag'avi.
[2] muhammed bin k`a'b al-qurazi gadmogvc`ems:,,vist`anac` qurani miag'cevs, man t`it`k`os t`vit`on shexvda mac`nes (da misgan moismina)." ix. t`ap`siru taberi.
abdullah bin amri gadmogvc`ems, rom mac`nem t`k`va:,,ch`emgan (sxvebs) gadaec`it` - t`undac` ert`i aiat`i. aseve, shegiz'liat` gadmosc`et` israelis modgmisgan, es ar aris c`odva; xolo vinc` ch`ems shesaxeb shegnebulad ic`ruos, man (jojoxet`is) c`ec`xlshi t`avisi adgilsamqop`eli airch`ios." (buxari, h.n. 3461.)
[3] qureisheli carmart`ebi allahis shuamavalt`an mividnen da ut`xres: o, muhammed! ar ic`i, rom allaht`an ert`ad sxva g'vt`aebebic` arsebobs? man upasuxa: ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda allahisa! me amit` var carmogzavnili da amasve movucodeb. amis shemdeg allahma es aiat`i ch`amoavlina. ix. t`ap`siru taberi.

translations.translation: visac` cigni vuboz'et`, ise ic`noben mas (muhammeds), rogorc` ic`noben sakut`ar shvilebs. romelt`ac` t`aviant`i sulebi caricqmides, isini ar ircmuneben.
mash, vinaa imaze usamart`lo, vinc` sic`rues t`xzavs[1] allahze an c`rud miich`nevs mis aiat`ebs? uechvelad, ver gadarch`ebian usamart`loni.
translations.footnotes: [1] vinaa imaze didi urcmuno, vinc` allahs ut`anaziarebs vinmes, vinc` t`xzavs, rom allahs moziare hqavs.

translations.translation: im dg'es mat` qvelas ert`ad shevqrit` da vetqvit` mat`, romlebic` ut`anaziarebdnen: sad arian ch`emi t`anaziarni, romlebic` t`k`ven momich`inet`?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] romlebic` g'vt`is t`anascorebad da t`anamoziareebad migach`ndat`.

translations.translation: shemdeg sxva verap`ers moimizezeben, garda imisa, rom itqvian: ch`vens g'mert`s, allahs vp`ic`avt`, rom ch`ven ar viqavit` carmart`ebi!
naxe, rogor c`ruoben sakut`ar sult`a cinaag'mdeg da ganudgnen mat`, rasac` t`xzavdnen[1] (g'mert`ebad rac`xavdnen).
translations.footnotes: [1] kerpebi verap`ers ushvelian t`avian t`aqanismc`emlebs.

translations.translation: da mat`gan arian iset`ebic`, romlebic` gismenen, magram mat` gulebs saburveli gadavap`aret`, rat`a ver gaigon, qurebshic` simz'ime davugubet`: t`undac` qvela aiat`i/sascauli ixilon, mainc` rom ar ircmunon[1]; up`ro metic`, shent`an t`u movlen isini, vinc` ar ircmunes, kamat`s dagicqeben da itqvian: uechvelad, es mxolod cinapart`a zg'aprebiao.
translations.footnotes: [1] allahma isini amgvrad dasaja mat`i xangrz'livi urch`obis gamo, da imis gamoc`, rom man ic`is, rom isini ver ircmuneben.

translations.translation: amgvarad, isini misgan sxvebs abrkoleben da t`vit`onac` shordebian mas; ase mxolod sakut`ar sulebs anadgureben da verc` ki xvdebian.
netav genaxa, rodesac` c`ec`xlis cinashe daaqeneben da itqvian:,,oh, netav ukan davbrundebodet` da c`rud ag'ar shevrac`xavdet` ch`veni g'mert`is aiat`ebs da vik`nebodet` morcmunet`agani''.
ara! mat` ukve gaec`xadat` igi, rasac` manamde[1] malavdnen; romc` daabrunon, egeni mainc` imas daubrundebian, rac` ekrz'alebodat`. uechvelad, egeni matquarebi arian.
translations.footnotes: [1] dedamicaze qop`nisas.

translations.translation: da t`k`ves: ch`veni sic`oc`xle mxolod amk`veqniuria da arc` mkvdret`it` ag'vdgebit` ch`ven.
translations.footnotes: [1] arsebobs am aiat`is ganmartebis ori versia: 1. isini gardac`valebamde ambobdnen ase, uarqop`dnen imk`veqniur c`xovrebas da gankit`xvas. 2. gardac`valebis shemdeg, amk`veqnad dabrunebis sashualeba rom miec`et`, mainc` ase itqvian, radganac` matquarebi arian da sitqvas ar upatroneben. ix: t`ap`siiru tabari.

translations.translation: netav genaxa, rodesac` t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe daaqeneben da etqvis: gana es ar aris cheshmariteba?[1] isini etqvian: diax, ch`vens g'mert`s vp`ic`avt`. isic` etqvis: mash, igemet` sasjeli imis, rasac` uarqop`dit`.
translations.footnotes: [1] sikvdilis shemdeg gac`oc`xleba da gankit`xva, rasac` t`k`ven uarqop`dit`.

translations.translation: mart`lac` cacqmedilan isini, romelnic` c`rud t`vlidnen allaht`an shexvedras, vidre ar mouscrebdat` zhami uec`rad da ar itqodnen:,,vai, ch`venda, im daudevrobis gamo, rac` ik` ch`avidinet`!" - t`anac` zurgit` ezidebian t`aviant` c`odvebs. raoden c`udia igi, rac` mat` utvirt`avt`!
t`amashisa da gart`obis garda sxva arap`eria cut`isop`eli; xolo isk`veqana umjobesia mat`t`vis, vinc` g'vt`ismoshishia. nut`u gonebas ar mouxmobt`?

rat`k`maunda vic`it`, rom didad gamcuxrebs, rasac` isini (shen shesaxeb) amboben. magram, cheshmaritebaa, rom (sinamdvileshi) shen ki ar grac`xaven c`rud, aramed allahis aiat`ebs uarqop`en usamart`loni[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] 'ali gadmogvc`ems, rom abu jahilma ut`xra mac`nes: uechvelad, ch`ven c`rud ar migich`nevt`, aramed ch`ven c`rud migvach`nia is, rit`ac` shen moxvedi. amast`an dakavshirebit` uzenaesma allahma es aiat`i ch`amoavlina. (t`irmizi, t`ap`siir, h.n. 3064.)

translations.translation: uechvelad, shenamdec` c`rud sherac`xulan shuamavalni, mat` ki mot`mineba gamouch`eniat` c`rud sherac`xvisa da shevicroebis cinashe, vidre ch`veni shecevna ar miuvidat`. ar arsebobs shemc`vleli allahis sitqvebisa. cheshmaritad, shen mogivida ambavi shuamavalt`a.

t`u gimz'ims mat`gan shen mimart` zurgis shek`c`eva, mashin ec`ade, t`u gz'aluz's, xvreli ipovo micis sig'rmeebisken an kibe - zec`it` ag'mart`uli, rat`a mat` sascauli miutano. allahs rom eneba, auc`ileblad shekrebda mat` cheshmarit gzaze. ase rom, nu ik`nebi umec`art`agani![1]
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis shuamavali z'alian cuxda da nerviulobda imis gamo, rom xalxs ar sjeroda mis mier nak`adagebi sarcmunoebisa. uzenaesma allahma am aiat`it` sheagona, rom misi z'alisxmevit`a da nerviulobit` veravin daadgeboda cheshmarit gzas - t`uki ar ik`neboda allahis neba. amitom umjobesi iqo mot`mineba gamoech`ina, rat`a mas ar sheep`ereboda am cheshmaritebis armc`odnis msgavsad mok`c`eva.

translations.translation: (shens mocodebas) qurad ig'eben mxolod isini, romelnic` ismenen; xolo mkvdrebs allahi ag'adgens mkvdret`it` da shemdeg mast`an ik`nebian mibrunebulni.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] aiat`shi -,,qurad ig'eben mxolod isini, romelnic` ismenen" - morcmuneebi igulisxmeba, romlebmac` sheismines cheshmariteba da miig'es ert`guli morch`ilebit`, xolo mkvdrebshi - urcmunoebi igulisxmebian, romelt`a smena da xedva mkvdaria cheshmaritebis mimart`.

translations.translation: da t`k`ves: gana ert`i sascaulic` ar unda ch`amovleniliqo masze misive g'mert`isgan? ut`xari: cheshmaritad, allahs z'aluz's, rom sascauli ch`amoavlinos, t`umc`a mat`ma umravlesobam ar ic`is.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] mat`ma umravlesobam ar ic`is, rom allahi qovlis shemz'lea da arc` is ic`is, t`u ra pasuxismgeblobebi mohqveba sascaulis moxdenas: t`uki sascaulis xilvis miuxedavad t`aviant` sijiutes ar moishlidnen da mainc` ar ircmunebdnen, mashin auc`ileblad g'vt`is risxva daatqdebodat` t`avs.

translations.translation: ar arsebobs dedamicaze iset`i c`xoveli; an p`rinveli, romelic` t`avisi p`rt`ebit` dap`rinavs, - rom t`k`ven msgavsad t`emebad ar iqvnen (daqop`ili). ch`ven cignshi arap`eri gamogvrch`enia, shemdeg t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe ik`nen shekrebilni.
xolo romelt`ac` c`rud miich`nies ch`vei aiat`ebi, - qruni da munjni arian bnelet`shi.[1] allahi, visac` inebebs, mas aac`dens (scori) gzidan da visac` inebebs, mas daaqenebs scor gzaze.
translations.footnotes: [1] qruni arian - ar sheismenen cheshmaritebas; munjni arian - ar carmot`k`vamen cheshmarit sitqvas, da umec`rebis bnelet`shi imqop`ebian.

translations.translation: ut`xari: aba mit`xarit`, t`uki allahis sasjeli geciat` an (k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis) zhami dagidgat`, mainc` sxvas daucqebt` vedrebas, nac`vlad allahisa, - t`u xart` namdvilad gulcrp`elni?
ara, - mxolod mas sheevedrebit`, da t`u inebebs, gixsnit` im mdgomareobidan, rist`visac` mas evedrebit` da daivicqebt` imat`, rasac` ut`anaziarebdit`.
cheshmaritad, shenamde ch`ven sxvadasxva xalxt`an carvgzavet` shuamavlebi da shevipqarit` isini sirt`uleebit`a da ubedurebebit`[1], - rom ik`neb t`avdamc`irebit` shevedrebuliqvnen.
translations.footnotes: [1] mag:sig'atakit` da sxva da sxva daavadebebit`.

translations.translation: mashin xom mainc` unda shemvedrebodnen t`avdamc`irebit`, - rodesac` ch`vengan sirt`ule ecviat`? t`umc`a gulebi gauk`vavdat` da satanam moukazma igi, rasac` sch`adiodnen.

rodesac` daivicqes igi, rit`ac` iqvnen shegonebuli[1], mashin gavuxsenit` qvelap`ris karebi; da roc`a gaixares imit`, rac` mat` miec`at`, - moulodnelad shevipqarit` da mashinve gaxdnen imedgac`ruebuli.
translations.footnotes: [1] sig'atake da avadmqop`oba

translations.translation: ase amoiz'irkva im xalxis modgma, vinc` usamart`lobas eceoda; k`eba-dideba allahs, - g'mert`s samqarot`a.

ut`xari: rogor p`ik`robt`, allahma rom smena da mxedveloba cagart`vat` da bechedi dagasvat` gulebze, - romeli g'vt`aeba dagibrunebt` mas, garda allahisa? shexede ra nair-nairad vmartavt` aiat`ebs, shemdeg ki mainc` pirs ibruneben egeni.
ut`xari: rogor p`ik`robt`, uec`rad an ashkarad rom allahis sasjeli gecviot`, gana usamart`lo xalxis garda vinme sxva daig'upeba?!
ar carvgzavnit` ch`ven shuamavlebs, t`u ara maxarobleblad da gamp`rt`xilebleblad, xolo vinc` ircmuna da gamoascora (z'veli urcmunoeba), - mat`t`vis arc` shishi ik`neba da arc` damcuxreba.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] mat` arc` imk`veqnad moelit` sashishroeba, da arc` imist`vis damcuxrdebian, rac` dat`mes amk`veqnad.

translations.translation: xolo mat`, romelt`ac` c`rud miich`nies ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi, scored mat` sheexebat` sasjeli imisa, rasac` zg'vargadasulobdnen.

ut`xari: me t`k`ven ar geubnebit`, rom ch`emt`anaa allahis saunjeni, arc` uxilavis shesaxeb vic`i da arc` imas geubnebit`, rom me var angelozi. me mxolod imas mivqvebi, rac` zemevlineba. ut`xari: gana t`anascoria brma da mxedveli?[1] nut`u ar dap`ik`rdebit`?
translations.footnotes: [1] gana t`anascoria urcmuno, romelic` brmaa allahis aiat`ebis mimart` da morcmune, romelic` allahis aiat`ebshi cheshmaritebas xedavs?

translations.translation: da misit`[1] gaap`rt`xile isini, romelt`ac` eshiniat`, rom shekreba moucevt` t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe da mis garda arc` damxmare eqolebat` da arc` k`omagi, - ik`neb ridi hk`ondet` mat`.
translations.footnotes: [1] quranit`.

translations.translation: da ar gandevno isini, romlebic` dila-sag'am t`aviant` g'mert`s evedrebian da misi (kmaqop`ili) saxe surt`. mat`i angarishidan shen arap`eri dagekisreba da arc` mat` daekisrebat` sheni angarishidan rame. t`uki gandevni mat`, mashin shen ik`nebi usamart`lot`agani.[1]
translations.footnotes:
[1] xabbabi gadmogvc`ems: ert` dg'es aqra' bin haabis at`-t`amiimii da 'ueine bin hisn al-p`azarii movidnen da naxes, rom allahis shuamavali suheibis, bilalis, 'ammaris, xabbabisa da msgavs morcmunet`agan ubralo adamianebs shoris zis. rodesac` isini shuamavlis irgvliv dainaxes, iukadrises. bolos miuaxlovdnen, mast`an ganmartovdnen da ut`xres: ch`ven gvinda, rom ch`vent`vis c`alke sxdomebi moacqo, romlit`ac` mt`eli arabebi ch`vens upiratesobas gaec`noba. shent`an arabt`a sxvadasxva carmomadgenlebi movlen da ch`ven shegvrc`xveba, t`uki am monebt`an ert`ad gvixiles. rodesac` ch`ven movalt`, isini shengan ganaride da roc`a cavalt`, mat`t`an ert`ad mere dajek`i, t`uki inebeb. shuamavalma (mat`i gamuslimanebis didi survilis gamo) upasuxa: diax. mat` ut`xres: amis damamocmeblad rame cerili dagvicere. shuamavalma k`ag'aldi it`xova da 'ali daibara, rat`a mist`vis cerili daecera; ch`ven am dros moshorebit` vijek`it`. ch`amovida jibril angelozi da shemdegi aiat`i caukit`xa:,,da ar gandevno isini, romlebic` dila-sag'am t`aviant` g'mert`s evedrebian da misi (kmaqop`ili) saxe surt`. mat`i angarishidan shen arap`eri dagekisreba da arc` mat` daekisrebat` sheni angarishidan rame. t`uki gandevni mat`, mashin shen ik`nebi usamart`lot`agani."
shemdeg aqra' bin haabisi da 'ueine bin hisni axsena da es aiat`i caikit`xa:,,amgvarad, gamovc`adet` zogiert`i mat`gani zogiert`it`, rom et`k`vat`: nut`u allahma amat` mihmadla siket`e - ch`ven shoris? gana allahi uket` ar ucqis madliert`?" shemdeg caikit`xa:,,da rodesac` shent`an movlen isini, romelt`ac` scamt` ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi, ut`xari: mshvidoba t`k`venda! t`k`venma g'mert`ma sakut`ar t`avs mocqaleba daucera."
amis shemdeg ch`ven mast`an imdenad axlos vsxdebodit`, rom ch`veni muxlebi mis muxlebs exeboda da allahis shuamavali sul ch`vent`an ert`ad ijda. rodesac` casvlas daapirebda, adgeboda da ch`ven gvtovebda. mere allahma shemdegi aiat`i ch`amoavlina:,,mot`minebit` dahqavi mat` gverdit`, romlebic` dila-sag'am t`aviant` g'mert`s evedrebian da misi (kmaqop`ili) saxe surt`. amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis mimzidvelobis gamo t`vali ar moarido mat`. (didebulebt`an ar dajde) da ar dahqve mas, visi gulic` ugulisqurod movakidet` ch`vens gaxsenebas, (anu 'ueina alaqra'is) sakut`ar survilebs ahqolia da misi sak`me zg'vars gadasula." (k`ehp`, 18/28.) anu 'ueina al-aqra'is sak`me damg'upvelia. shemdeg allahma ori kac`isa da amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis magalit`ad igavi moiqvana (anu sura k`ehp`is 32-44 aiat`ebshi).
xabbabma gaagrz'ela: mas shemdeg ch`ven sul mac`nest`an ert`ad visxedit`, xolo rodesac` misi casvlis dro movidoda, jer ch`ven cavidodit` da mas martod vtovebdit`, rom t`vit`onac` casuliqo. (ibni maaje, zuhd 7/4127.)

translations.translation: amgvarad, gamovc`adet` zogiert`i mat`gani zogiert`it`,[1] rom et`k`vat`: nut`u ch`ven shoris allahma mxolod amat` mihmadla siket`e? gana allahi uket` ar ucqis madliert`?
translations.footnotes: [1] anu gamovc`adet` mdidari g'aribit` da z'lieri sustit`. shuamavalt`a mocodebas pirvelad qovelt`vis sazogadoebis dabali p`ena g'ebulobda da isini rcmenis mimart` up`ro meti ert`gulebit` gamoirch`evodnen. rodesac` mek`k`is mdidrebi da z'lierebi xedavdnen, rom shuamavlis mocodeba z'irit`adad g'aribebma da sustebma miig'es da rcmenit` mat` gauscres, - ambobdnen: nut`u g'mert`ma amat`ze moig'o siket`e, gamoarch`ia da rcmenit` daajildova, rodesac` ch`ven gac`ilebit` upiratesni vart`o.

translations.translation: da roc`a movlen shent`an isini, romelt`ac` scamt` ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi, ut`xari: mshvidoba t`k`venda! t`k`venma g'mert`ma sakut`ar t`avs mocqaleba daucera. amgvarad, vinc` uket`urebas ik`ms uvic`obit`, mere ki moinaniebs da shemdeg gamoscordeba, - cheshmaritad, igi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mocqalea!
ase dacvrilebit` ganvmartavt` aiat`ebs, - c`odvilt`a gza rom gamoashkaravdes.

ut`xari: uechvelad, amekrz'ala me, t`aqvani vc`e imat`, rasac` t`k`ven evedrebit`, nac`vlad allahisa. ut`xari: ar avuqvebi t`k`vens gemovnebas, radgan namdvilad avc`debi cheshmarit gzas da me ar vik`nebi scor gzaze mdgomt`agani.

ut`xari: cheshmaritad, me ch`emi g'mert`isgan movlenil c`xad mtkic`ebulebebs veqrdnobi, t`k`ven ki mas uarqop`t`; me ar vp`lob imas, rasac` t`k`ven ch`k`arobt`.[1] gadacqvetileba mxolod allahs ekut`vnis, is mogit`xrobt` cheshmaritebis shesaxeb da igia kargi ganmc`alkevebeli.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] urcmunoebi shuamavals k`vebis gacvimebas da k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis zhamis dach`k`arebas st`xovdnen.
[2] samart`liani gadacqvetilebit` ganac`alkevebs cheshmaritebasa da sic`rues.

translations.translation: ut`xari: me rom vp`lobde imas, rasac` t`k`ven ch`k`arobt`, mashin ut`uod gadacqdeboda sak`me ch`emsa da t`k`vens shoris, xolo allahma uket` ic`is usamart`loni.

da mast`anaa uxilavis gasag'ebni,[1] mis garda igi aravin ic`is, man ic`is, rac`aa xmelet`ze da zg'vashi, ert`i p`ot`olic` ar ch`amovardeba ise, rom man ar ic`odes. ert`i marc`valic` ki ar arsebobs dedamicis jurg'mulebshi, - arc` nedli da arc` xmeli, - rom c`xad cignshi ar iqos gac`xadebuli.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,uxilavt`a gasag'ebi xut`ia: cheshmaritad, allahi p`lobs k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis saat`is c`odnas, is ch`amoavlen cvimas, man ic`is, rac` aris sashvilosnoebshi, verc`ert`i suli ver gaigebs, t`u ras moigebs xval da verc`ert`i suli ver mixvdeba, t`u romel micaze daig'upeba. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlis mc`odne da mc`nobelia." (buxari, t`ap`siir h.n. 4627.)
[2] allahis cinashe dac`uli deda cigni, romelshic` dasabamidan dasarulamde mt`eli samqaros shesaxeb qvelanairi inp`ormac`iaa ag'ric`xuli, mat` shoris adamiant`a bediscera, mosaxdeni ambebi da cminda quranic` im deda cignidan aris ag'ebuli.

translations.translation: da igia, romelic` gakvdinebt` g'amit` da ic`is, rasac` moixvecht` dg'isit`, shemdeg ag'gadgent` masshi, rat`a ag'sruldes ajali[1] gansazg'vruli, shemdeg - mast`anaa t`k`veni misak`c`ieli, mere ki gaucqebt`, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebdit`.
translations.footnotes: [1] igulisxmeba amk`veqniuri sic`oc`xlist`vis gankut`vnili dro.

translations.translation: igi zeag'matebulia t`avis msaxurebze da mc`velebs (angelozebs) agzavnis t`k`vent`an; xolo visac` sikvdili ecveva, - mas moakvdineben ch`veni cargzavnilebi da isini (t`aviant` sak`meshi) nakls ar daushveben.
shemdeg allahs daubrundebian - t`aviant` namdvil baton-patrons. gaxsovdet` rom, mas ekut`vnis msjavri da isaa uscrap`esi ganmkit`xveli.
ut`xari: vin gixsnit` xmelet`isa da zg'vis sibneleebidan, roc`a gulis sig'rmeshi, t`avdamc`irebit` sheevedrebit`: vp`ic`avt`, t`uki gvixsni ak`edan, usat`uod vik`nebit` madliert`agani.
- ut`xari: allahi gixsnit` imisgan da qvela sxva sadardeblisgan, shemdeg ki t`k`ven mas mainc` ut`anaziarebt`.

ut`xari: igi z'levamosilia, sasjeli mogivlinot` zemodan an t`k`vens p`ext`a k`vemodan, an kidev mxareebad gak`c`iot`[1] da t`k`venma ert`ma nacilma igemos meoris z'aladoba. shexede, ra dacvrilebit` vmartavt` aiat`ebs, ik`neb (ase mainc`) gaigon.
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,g'mert`s sami ram vt`xove, mat`gan ori shemisrula da ert`i ara. vt`xove, rom ch`emi ummet`i shimshilit` ar daexoc`a, man es t`xovna shemisrula; aseve vt`xove, rom ch`emi ummet`i cqaldidobebshi daxrch`obit` ar gaenadgurebina, man es t`xovnac` shemisrula; da vt`xove, rom ch`ems ummet`s ert`manet`i ar daexoc`a, man es t`xovna ar shemisrula." (muslim, p`it`an 5/2890.)

translations.translation: shenma xalxma c`rud miich`nia igi,[1] arada is aris cheshmariteba. ut`xari: me ar var t`k`veni met`valqure.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] scavlult`a ert`i nacilis azrit`, ak` igulisxmeba qurani, xolo meore nacilis mixedvit`, ak` igulisxmeba sasjeli, romelzec` cina aiat`shia saubari. ix. t`ap`siiru bag'avi.
[2] anu me mxolod shuamavali var, romlis valic` am cheshmaritebis t`k`venamde motana da shegonebaa.

translations.translation: qvela ambavs gansazg'vruli dro ak`vs (ag'srulebisa) da amas shemdgomshi sheitqobt`.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] cminda quranshi gadmoc`emuli qoveli ambisa da sitqvist`vis garkveuli dro da adgilia gansazg'vruli, romelic` uc`vlelia da drois mosvlast`an ert`ad t`andat`an gamoashkaravdeba - cheshmariteba qop`ila t`u tquili. nacili amk`veqnad gamoashkaravdeba, nacilic` imk`veqnad da t`k`venc` sheitqobt` mis shesaxeb. ix. t`ap`siiru beg'avi.

translations.translation: roc`a dainaxav, rom damc`inavad saubroben ch`veni aiat`ebis shesaxeb (romlebic` ch`amogevlina ), mashinve gaec`ale mat`, - vidre sxva sitqvit` ar dakavebulan. xolo t`uki satanam dagavicqa, mashin gaxsenebist`anave gaeride am usamart`lo xalxt`an dajdomas.
xolo mat`, romelnic` g'vt`ismoshishoben, arap`eri moekit`xebat` imat`i angarishidan; mat`ze mxolod shegonebaa - ik`neb g'vt`ismoshishoba gamoich`inon.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ibni abbasis gadmoc`emis mixedvit`, rodesac` ch`amoevlina aiat`i:,,rodesac` dainaxav mat`, romlebic` damc`inavad saubroben ch`veni aiat`ebis shesaxeb, mashinve gaec`ale mat`", - muslimebma ch`ivili daicqes: rogor unda davsxdet` k`aabas mech`et`shi da tavap`i shevasrulot`, rodesac` isini sul damc`inavad saubroben? gansxvavebuli versiis t`anaxmad mat` t`k`ves: rodesac` ch`ven vtovebt` mat`i t`avsheqris adgils da ar vushlit` aset` saubars, gveshinia, c`odva ch`venc` ar shegvexos. amis shesaxeb uzenaesma allahma es aiat`i ch`amoavlina, rom urcmunot`a c`odvebi mat` ar moekit`xebodat` da mat`i movaleoba mxolod shegoneba iqo.ix.t`ap`siiru beg'avi.

translations.translation: moshordi mat`, romlebic` xumrobit` da gart`obit` ekidebian t`aviant` sarcmunoebas da vinc` amk`veqniur c`xovrebas uc`dunebia! da misit`[1] sheagone, rom ar dag'upos suli t`avisi monapovrit`; rom ar gaach`nia mas arc` damxmare da arc` k`omagi, garda allahisa. qvelanairi gamosasqidic` rom gaig'os, - ar miig'eba is misgan. scored egeni arian, vinc` t`aviant`i monapovrit` daig'upnen, mat`t`visaa mdug'are sasmeli da mcare sasjeli - imis gamo, rasac` uarqop`dnen.
translations.footnotes: [1] quranit`.

translations.translation: ut`xari: gana allahis garda sxvas vevedrot`, romelic` veras gvargebs da verc` gvavnebs[1], da ukan mivbrundet`, ch`venive k`uslebis mimart`ulebit`, mas shemdeg, rac` allahma cheshmarit gzaze dagvakvaliana? imis msgavsad, vinc` gaabriqves satanebma da datoves k`veqnad t`avgzaabneuli, t`anac` mat` hqavt` megobrebi, romlebic` cheshmariti gzisken uxmoben: modit` ch`vent`ano.[2] ut`xari:,,cheshmaritad, allahis mier mit`it`ebuli gzaa - gza cheshmariti da ch`ven gvebrz'ana, rom samqarot`a g'mert`s vmorch`ilebdet`".
translations.footnotes:
[1] arc` mat`i t`aqvanisc`emit` gvek`neba sargebeli da arc` mat`i mitovebit` - zarali.
[2] 'abdullah bin 'abbasi ganmartavs: es aris igavi, romelic` allahma, kerpebis t`aqvanisc`emisken momcodebelt`a da allahis t`aqvanisc`emisken momxmobt`a magalit`ad moiqvana. shedarebulia kac`ze, romelic` cheshmarit gzas ac`da da t`avgzaabneuli darch`a. ert`i mxriv, mc`dari gzisken ez'axian, meore mxriv megobrebi qavs, romlebic` cheshmariti gzisken uxmoben da veg'ar xvdeba, sait` cavides. t`uki pirvel momcodebels daujerebs, damg'upvel up`skrulshi gadavardeba, xolo t`u mat` daujerebs, vinc` cheshmariti gzisken uxmoben, mashin cheshmaritebas eziareba. ix. t`ap`siiru taberi.

translations.translation: aseve (gvebrz'ana), shevasrulot` namazi da mis (allahis ) mimart` ridi vik`oniot`. igia, romlis cinashec` ik`nebit` ag'dgenili.

da igia, romelmac` c`ani da dedamica gaach`ina cheshmaritebit` da im dg'es itqvis:,,iqav", da isic` umalve ik`mneba, - cheshmaritebaa misi sitqva. misia meup`eba im dg'isa, roc`a bukshi ch`aibereba[1], mc`odnea xilulisa da uxilavisa, da igia brz'eni, qovlismc`odne.
translations.footnotes: [1] islamis scavlebis mixedvit`, k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis cin, angelozi israp`ili bukis magvar saqvirshi ch`aberavs, rac` sic`oc`xlis dasasrulis zhamis dadgomas mianishnebs da mashin qoveli c`oc`xali arseba sikvdils igemebs. ch`vent`vis uc`nobi drois shemdeg, angelozi saqvirshi meored ch`aberavs da suli daubrundeba qvela mic`valebuls, isini sap`lavebidan camodgebian, ert`iani t`avsheqris adgilisken gaemart`ebian da g'mert`is cinashe ganikit`xebian.

translations.translation: aki ibrahimma t`avis mamas, azars ut`xra: nut`u kerpebs ag'iareb g'mert`ebad!? uechvelad, vxedav, rom shen da sheni xalxi xart` ashkara gzaac`denilobashi.
amgvarad vach`venet` ibrahims c`at`a da k`veqnierebis meup`eba, rat`a qop`iliqo guldajerebul morcmunet`agani.
- g'amit`, rodesac` igi bindma garemoic`va da varskvlavi dainaxa, t`k`va:,,esaa ch`emi g'mert`i"; xolo rodesac` gak`ra, dasz'ina: me ar miqvars is, rac` k`reba.[1]
translations.footnotes:
[1] ibrahim shuamavlis amgvari mok`medeba islamis scavlult`a shoris p`art`o ganxilvis sakit`xia. misi sitqvebis ganmartebebs shoris qvelaze gamokvet`ilad t`valshi gvxvdeba ot`xi komentari:
pirveli: ibrahim shuamavals amgvari dialogit` t`avisi xalxi nabij-nabij mihqavda simart`lisken da c`dilobda, mat`i shec`domebi da umec`ari sak`c`ieli ech`venebina. radganac` is xalxi varskvlavebs adidebdnen da mat` et`aqvanebodnen, p`ik`robdnen, rom samqaroshi qvelap`ers varskvlavebi ganagebdnen. is jer c`dilobda, ise mok`c`euliqo, rom t`it`k`os t`vit`onac` ik` ez'ebda cheshmaritebas, sadac` misi xalxi ez'ebda: rodesac` varskvlavebi k`reboda, mat` quradg'ebas varskvlavt`a naklovanebaze amaxvilebda da amgvarad usabut`ebda, rom naklis mk`one g'mert`i ver ik`neboda.
meore: ibrahim shuamavali mat` kit`xvis p`ormit` mimart`avda,,esaa ch`emi g'mert`i?" misi kit`xva, uarqop`is shinaarsis matarebeli iqo anu,,gana sheiz'leba aset`i iqos g'mert`i?" ak`edan gamomdinare is gulisxmobda,,es ch`emi g'mert`i ar aris."
mesame: man es sitqvebi mat`t`an kamat`is dros gamoiqena da gulisxmobda shemdegs:,,t`k`veni azrit`, esaa ch`emi g'mert`i". xolo rodesac` varskvlavi gak`ra, miugo:,,es rom g'mert`i qop`iliqo, ar gak`reboda."
meot`xe: shesaz'loa quranis aiat`shi iqos p`aruli shinaarsi. am shexedulebis mk`onet`a azrit`, ibrahim shuamavlis sitqvebshi igulisxmeba shemdegi:,,amboben, rom esaa ch`emi g'mert`i", rogorc` sura baqaras 127-e aiat`shi gvxvdeba:,,aki, ibrahimi da isma'ili saxlis (k`aabas) saz'irkvlebs amag'lebdnen (t`an ambobdnen): g'mert`o ch`veno, miig'e es ch`vengan". aiat`is originalshi ch`ven mier p`rch`xilebshi ch`asmuli (t`an ambobdnen) ar aris, magram igulisxmeba, rom isini ambobdnen amas. ix. t`ap`siiru bag'avi.

translations.translation: da roc`a amomavali mt`vare dainaxa, t`k`va:,,esaa ch`emi g'mert`i", xolo rogorc` ki ch`avida, man t`k`va: t`uki ch`emma g'mert`ma ar damakvaliana cheshmariti gzisken, usat`uod me vik`nebi gzasac`denil xalxt`agani.

xolo roc`a amomavali mze dainaxa, t`k`va:,,esaa ch`emi g'mert`i, es up`ro didia"; xolo rogorc` ki ch`avida, man t`k`va: o, ch`emo xalxo! cheshmaritad, me shors var imisgan, rasac` t`k`ven ut`anaziarebt`!
cheshmaritad, me saxe vibrune hanip`ad[1] imisken, romelmac` shek`mna c`ani da dedamica, da me ar var carmart`t`agani.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,hanip`i" (Hnyf): qovelgvari c`ru rcmenisa da carmart`uli sak`misagan gandegili da urqevi monot`eizmit` cheshmaritebisken mltolvare.

translations.translation: da sheedava misi xalxi, man ki ut`xra: nut`u allahis shesaxeb mec`ilebit`, roc`a man damakvalina cheshmarit gzaze? me ar meshinia imis, rasac` t`k`ven ut`anaziarebt` mas, garda imisa, t`uki ch`emma g'mert`ma ineba rame.[1] ch`emi g'mert`i qovelives c`odnit` garemoic`avs, nut`u ar gaiazrebt`?
translations.footnotes: [1] xalxi mas kerpebit` ashinebda, rom t`u gaagrz'elebda mat` gmobas da damc`irebas, mashin t`avs ubedureba daatqdeboda. amaze ibrahim shuamavlis pasuxi es iqo: me ar meshinia im kerpebis, rasac` allahs ut`anaziarebt` da isini verap`ers mavneben, t`uki allahi ar inebebs ch`ems vnebaso.

translations.translation: da rogor unda meshinodes imis, rasac` t`k`ven ut`anaziarebt` (allahs ), mashin, roc`a t`k`ven ar geshiniat`, rom allahs ut`anaziarebdet` imas, ris shesaxebac` t`k`vent`vis aranairi mtkic`ebuleba ar ch`amouvlenia? da am ori mxridan romeli up`ro imsaxurebs usap`rt`xoebas[1], t`u ic`it`?
translations.footnotes: [1] am ori mxaredan romels up`ro unda eshinodes g'vt`is risxvis an romeli unda grz'nobdes t`avs usap`rt`oxod - ert`g'meg't`ianebi t`u carmart`ebi?

translations.translation: mat`t`vis, vinc` ircmunes da ar sheuries t`aviant` rcmenas usamart`loba,[1] scored mat`t`visaa usap`rt`xoeba da egeni arian cheshmarit gzaze mdgomni.
translations.footnotes: [1] rodesac` es aiat`i ch`amoevlina:,,vinc` ircmunes da ar sheuries t`aviant` rcmenas usamart`loba ", - allahis shuamavlis sahabeebs z'alian emz'imat` misi shinaarsi da t`k`ves: romeli ch`vengani ar vurevt` rcmenashi usamart`lobas? amaze ki shuamavalma ut`xra: ise ar aris, rogorc` ggoniat`. gana ar isment` luqman shuamavlis sitqvebs t`avisi shvilis mimart`:,,uechvelad, shirk`i didi usamart`lobaa." (buxari, t`ap`siir, h.n. 4776.)

translations.translation: ai, esaa ch`veni mtkic`ebuleba, romelic` ibrahims vuboz'et` t`avisi xalxis sacinag'mdegod. xarisxobrivad vamag'lebt` mas, visac` vinebebt`. cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i brz'enia, qovlis mc`odne.

da vucqalobet` mas ishaqi da ia'qubi, orive cheshmarit gzaze davakvalianet`, aseve, up`ro adre nuhic` davakvalianet` da misi sht`amomavlobidan - davudi, suleimani, aiubi, iusup`i, musa da haruni. amgvarad vajildovebt` ket`ilismk`nelebs.
zek`eria, iahia, 'isa da iliasi, - qvelani iqvnen sat`not`aganni.
aseve, isma'ili, iese'i, iunusi da luti, - qvela mat`gani gamovarch`iet` samqarot`a cinashe.
aseve amovarch`iet` mat` mamat`agan, sht`amomavalt`agan da z'mat`agan, da scor gzaze davakvalianet`.
esaa allahis gza - cheshmariti: masze t`avis msaxurt`agan akvalianebs mat`, visac` inebebs; xolo t`u mainc` ut`anaziareben, mashin usat`uod gac`amtverdeba, rasac` isini aket`ebdnen.
egeni[1] arian, visac` vuboz'et` cigni, sibrz'ne da mac`neoba. t`uki isini[2] uarqop`en mas,[3] usat`uod, mas iset` xalxs gadavabarebt`, romlebic` ar uarqop`en.
translations.footnotes:
[1] zemot` ch`amot`vlili shuamavlebi.
[2] qureisheli carmart`ebi, an zogadad, vist`anac` miva islamis moz'g'vreba da t`avs sheikavebs mis ag'iarebaze.
[3] qurans da zogadad, islamis moz'g'vrebas.

translations.translation: ai, egeni arian, vinc` allahma cheshmarit gzaze daakvaliana da shenc` mat` cheshmarit gzas sheudek`i. ut`xari: imis[1] sanac`vlod ar vit`xov t`k`vengan gasamrjelos, aramed is mxolod shegonebaa samqarot`at`vis.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] quranis.
[2] kac`t`a da jint`a samqarot`at`vis.

translations.translation: da mat` ver sheic`nes allahi qadrianad, rogorc` mas sheep`ereba, rodesac` t`k`ves: allahs adamianist`vis arap`eri ch`amouvlenia. (shenc`) ut`xari: mash, vin ch`amoavlina cigni, - sinat`leda da cheshmariti gzis mach`veneblad adamiant`at`vis, - romlit`ac` musa movida da romelsac` p`urc`lebze cert`, nacili - gamogak`vt` saashkaraoze, umetess ki malavt`?[1] da gescavlat`[2] is, rac` ar ic`odit` - arc` t`k`ven da arc` t`k`vnma cinaprebma. upasuxe - allahmao (ch`amoavlinao),[3] shemdeg ki miatove mat`i amao saubrit` gart`ulni.
translations.footnotes:
[1] malavt` t`evrat`shi (t`ora) gadmoc`emul nishnebs, romlit`ac` muhammedis shuamavloba iqo nacinascarmetqvelevi - mrushis sasjels da msgavs sakit`xebs, risi gamzhg'avnebac` ar mogcont`.
[2] quranis meshveobit` gescavlat`.
[3] allahma ch`amoavlina t`evrat`i, romelsac` t`k`venc` ag'iarebt`, magram raki quranis ag'iareba ar gindat`, mzad xart` t`k`vens rcmenasac` daupirispirdet` da t`k`vat`, rom allahs adamianist`vis arap`eri ch`amouvleniao.

translations.translation: da es daloc`vili cigni ch`amovavlinet` damamocmeblad imisa, rac` iqo masze cinat`, aseve k`alak`t`a dedis[1] da mis garshemo mqop`t`a gasap`rt`xileblad. xolo visac` scamt` saik`io, mat` esec` (quranic`) scamt` da isini t`aviant` namazsac` gulmodgined ic`aven.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali,,umm al-qura" (m lqr~) pirdapiri mnishvnelobit` sop`lebis an k`alak`ebis dedas nishnavs da igulisxmeba cminda k`alak`i mek`k`a. anu cminda qurani k`alak` mek`k`ashi mc`xovreb muhammed shuamavals ch`amoevlina da pirvelad scored am k`alak`is mkvidr xalxs gaac`no, xolo t`andat`anobit` mis garshemo mqop`ebshic` gavrc`elda da ase gagrz'eldeba k`veqnierebis dasasrulamde, vidre mt`el msop`lios ar moic`avs ag'mosavlet`idan dasavlet`amde.

translations.translation: da vin aris imaze didi usamart`lo, romelmac` sic`rue shet`xza allahis shesaxeb an t`k`va, rom vahi (g'vt`iuri shetqobineba) mivig'eo; arada mas arap`eri miug'ia; aseve, vinc` t`k`va: mec` ch`amovavlen imis msgavss, rac` allahma ch`amoavlinao. netav genaxa sult`mobrz'avi usamart`loni, rodesac` angelozebi xelebgacvdilni eubnebian: ganutevet` sulebi! dg'es mogezg'vebat` sasjeli damamc`irebeli, im usamart`lobist`vis, rasac` allahis shesaxeb ambobdit` da misi aiat`ebis mimart` medidurobdit`!

da vp`ic`av, ch`ven cinashe ise eulad moxvedit`, rogorc` pirvelad gagach`inet`.[1] da zurgsukan migitovebiat`, rac` t`k`vent`vis gviboz'ebia,[2] veg'arc` t`k`vens k`omagebs vxedavt` t`k`vent`an ert`ad, romlebic`, gjerodat`, rom iqvnen (allahis) t`anaziarni. ukve gacqda kavshiri t`k`ven shoris da gandegila is t`k`vengan, rasac` amtkic`ebdit` (usap`uz'vlod).
translations.footnotes:
[1] rogori shishveli da uk`onelic` moevlinet` am k`veqanas, iseve shishveli da materialurad uk`oneli caxvalt` ukan. allahis shuamavali brz'anebs:,,uechvelad, t`k`ven allahis cinashe p`exshishveli, ch`auc`meli, k`veit`ad da cinadauc`vet`elni cardgebit`." (buxari, riqaq 45/6524.)
[2] k`oneba, nat`esavebi, t`anamdeboba da a.sh.

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, allahia marc`vlisa da kurkis gampob-gamg'ivebeli, c`oc`xali mkvdrisgan gamohqavs da c`oc`xlisganac` - mkvdari. ai, es aris allahi da t`k`ven rogor ganeridebit`?
- gamg'vivebeli alionisa, romelmac` daadgina g'ame mosasveneblad, mze da mt`vare ki (drot`a) gamosat`vlelad. aset`ia gangeba z'levamosilis, qovlis mc`odnisa.

da igia, vinc` t`k`vent`vis dasxa varskvlavebi, rat`a mat`it` gza gagekvliat` xmelet`isa da zg'vis cqvdiadebshi. uechvelad, ch`ven dacvrilebit` ganvmartet` aiat`ebi - im xalxist`vis, romlebmac` ic`ian.
da igia, romelmac` shegk`mnat` ert`i sulisgan; shemdgom (dagidginat`) mosakalat`ebeli da misabarebeli.[1] uechvelad, ch`ven detalurad ganvmartet` aiat`ebi - im xalxist`vis, romlebic` gamgebia.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,must`aqarrun" (mstqr) da,,must`avda'un" (mstwd`): pirvelis pirdapiri t`argmani - samqop`eli, adgili, sadac` sap`uz'vlianad mot`avsda da garkveul dros dahqop`s, lek`sikonuri mnishvnelobisa da kontek`sturi shinaarsis gat`valiscinebit` vt`argmnet`, rogorc` mosakalat`ebeli adgili. xolo meoris pirdapiri mnishvnelobaa adgili, sadac` rames miabareben. islamis scavlulebi ag'nishnul sitqvebs sxvadasxva shinaarsit` xsnian, romelsac` mokled gadmogvc`ems imami taberi:,,uzenaesi allahi am aiat`shi zogadad gvamc`nobs, rom adamianebi ert`i sulisgan (adem shuamavlisgan) gaach`ina, shemdeg mat` garkveul samqop`elsa da misabarebelshi dahqves. adamiant`a nacili dedis muc`elshia mokalat`ebuli, nacili ki mamis sxeulshi - amanat`ad mibarebuli. adamiant`a macili dedamicazea mokalat`ebuli, meore nacili ki sap`lavshia mibarebuli." (ix. t`ap`siiru taberi.)

translations.translation: igia, romelmac` zec`idan cqali ch`amoavlina; da ag'movac`enet` misit` qvelanairi mc`enare, amovzardet` misgan mcvanobi, imisgan ki marc`vlebi[1] - ert`manet`ze asxmuli, xolo p`inikis kokrisgan - ch`amokidebuli mtevnebi, aseve qurz'nis bag'ebi, zet`isxili da broceuli - ert`manet`is msgavsic` da gansxvavebulic`. shexedet` mis naqop`s, romelic` isxams da mcip`deba. cheshmaritad, am qvelap`ershi mart`lac` sascaulebia morcmune xalxist`vis.
translations.footnotes: [1] t`avt`avi.

translations.translation: da allahs jinebi ut`anaziares, arada man gaach`ina isini; aseve, uvic`ad dascames z'eebi da asulebi. igi qovlad unaklo da uzenaesia imisgan, rogoradac` axasiat`eben.
- igi c`at`a da dedamicis arap`risgan shemk`mnelia da shvili saidan eqoleba, rodesac` c`oli ar hqolia? da man gaach`ina qvelap`eri, igia qovlis mc`odne.
igia allahi - g'mert`i t`k`veni, ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba garda misi, qovlis gamch`enisa. mash, t`aqvani ec`it` mas, - igia qovlis met`valqure.
- ver shescvdebian imas mzerani,[1] t`vit`on ki mcvdomia mzerat`a, da isaa lmobieri, qovlismc`odne.
translations.footnotes: [1] amk`veqniuri t`valt`axedvist`vis sheuz'lebelia misi xilva. imk`veqnad - qvela morcmune ixilavs mas, t`umc`a t`valis cvdomas sc`deba misi namdvili raobis ag'k`misa da ganchvretis shesaz'lebloba. amitom veravis t`valebi ver ch`ascvdeba mas, is ki scvdeba qvela t`vals, arap`eria misi c`odnis mig'ma, sheuc`nobeli da dap`aruli mist`vis. allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,cheshmaritad, t`k`ven c`xadad ixilavt` t`k`vens g'mert`s." (buxari, t`avhid 24/7435.)

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, t`k`veni g'mert`isgan mogividat` t`valsach`ino mtkic`ebulebani; ase rom, vinc` t`vals gaaxels - misive sulis sargod, xolo vinc` caubrmavebs - misda sazianod. da ar var me t`k`veni met`valqure.
amgvarad vmartavt` aiat`ebs qovelmxriv, isini ki mainc` itqvian:,,giscavlia",[1] rat`a c`xadgveqo xalxist`vis, romlebmac` ic`ian.
translations.footnotes: [1] aiat`is am nacilis ganmartebisas islamis scavlulebi ramdenime gansxvavebul versias gvt`avazoben, ris sashualebasac` arabuli ena iz'leva: a) amgvarad, qovelmxriv vmartavt` aiat`ebs, rom et`k`vat` - giscavliao. b) amgvarad, qovelmxriv vmartavt`, rom ar et`k`vat` - giscavliao. g) amgvarad, qovelmxriv vmartavt` aiat`ebs, magram isini mainc` itqvian - giscavliao. mek`k`el carmart`ebs ar sjerodat`/ar ag'iarebdnen, rom muhammed shuamavali allahisgan g'ebulobda shetqobinebebs; amitomac` ambobdnen, rom man cignboz'ebulebt`an mec`adineobit` miig'o is c`odna da sibrz'ne, rasac` k`adagebda.ix:t`ap`siir tabari.

translations.translation: mihqevi imas, rac` zemogevlina sheni g'mert`isgan; ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba garda misi, da zurgi ak`c`ie carmart`ebs.
allahs rom eneba, ar ut`anaziarebdnen, da shen arc` mc`velad[1] dagvidgenixar da arc` vek`ili xar mat`i.
translations.footnotes: [1] met`valqured da mat`i c`odvebis ag'mric`xvelad

translations.translation: da ar galanz'g'ot` isini, visac` allahis nac`vlad evedrebian, radgan isinic` allahs daucqeben lanz'g'vas - mtrobit`, c`odnis gareshe. ase movukazmet` qvela t`ems t`aviant`i sak`meni, shemdeg t`aviant` g'mert`t`anaa mat`i misabrunebeli da is (allahi) ac`nobebt` mat` imis shesaxeb, rasac` aket`ebdnen.

allahs ip`ic`ebian mt`eli t`avgamodebit`, rom t`uki ert`i sascauli mievlinebat`, mashin auc`ileblad ircmuneben mas. ut`xari: cheshmaritad, sascaulebi allahis gankargulebashia, t`k`ven (morcmuneno) ki ar ic`it`, rom sascaulebi romc` movides, egeni mainc` ar ircmuneben!
da shevak`c`evt` mat` gulebsa da xedvebs, rogorc` ar ircmunes t`avdapirvelad[1], da mivatovebt` t`aviant` zg'vargadasulobashi, t`avgzaabneulebs.
translations.footnotes: [1] raki urcmunoeba airch`ies da gajiutdnen, ch`venc` davabrmavebt` mat` t`valebsa da gulebs cheshmaritebis mimart`. mat`ive sasurveli sascaulebic` rom movavlinot`, isini mainc` ar ircmuneben, rogorc` ar ircmunes t`avdapirvelad, da iseve darch`ebian - urcmunoebashi gzaabneulni.

translations.translation: ch`ven rom angelozebi ch`amogvevlina mat`t`vis an mkvdrebi dagvelaparakebina, da mat` cinashe shegvekriba qovelive, - isini mainc` ar ircmunebdnen, garda imisa, t`uki allahi inebebda (rcmenas); magram mat`i umravlesoba uvic`obs.

amgvarad, qvela mac`nes mivuch`inet` mtrebi - satanebi - adamiant`a da jint`agan,[1] romlebic` ert`manet`s enamokazmulad sht`aagoneben mac`dur sitqvebs. shens g'mert`s rom eneba, isini ase ar moik`c`eodnen. mash, miatove isini da isic`, ra sic`ruesac` t`xzaven.
translations.footnotes: [1] abu zerri gadmogvc`ems: ert`xel mech`et`shi shevedi, allahis shuamavalic` ik` imqop`eboda, mivedi da mast`an axlos davjek`i. man mit`xra: o, abu zarr! jint`a da adamiant`a satanebis siavisgan mp`arveloba t`u sheevedre allahs? me vut`xari: adamiant`aganac` arian satanebi? man mit`xra: diax. (nasai, ist`i'aza 48/5507.)

translations.translation: rat`a gadaixaros mat`i gulebi, romelt`ac` ar scamt` isk`veqana, ijeron guli misit` da moixvechon igi, rasac` ixvechen.

(ut`xari:) gana, allahis garda sxva msajulis z'ebnas davicqeb mashin, roc`a igia, vinc` detalurad ganmartebuli cigni ch`amoavlina t`k`vent`an? xolo romelt`ac` cigni vuboz'et`, kargad ic`ian, rom igi sheni g'mert`isgan cheshmaritebit`aa ch`amovlenili. mash, nu ik`nebi imat`gan, vinc` orchop`obs!
da sicrp`elit`a da samart`lit` ag'srulda sheni g'mert`is sitqvebi, ar arsebobs am sitqvebis shemc`vleli da igia qovlismsmeni, qovlismc`odne.
da t`u dahqvebi dedamicaze mqop`t`a umravlesobas, egeni agac`denen allahis gzas, ramet`u marto varauds misdeven da mxolod c`ruoben.
cheshmaritad, shenma g'mert`ma uket` ic`is, t`u vin ac`da mis gzas, da man uket` ucqis cheshmarit gzaze mqop`ni.
mash, miirt`vit` is (xorc`i), razec` (dakvlisas) naxsenebia allahis saxeli, - t`u xart` misi aiat`ebis/sascaulebis morcmuneni.

da ra gemart`ebat`, rom ar miirt`mevt` imas, razec` (dakvlisas) allahis saxelia naxsenebi? man xom detalurad ganmarta t`k`vent`vis (is qvelap`eri), rac` akrz'ala,[1] garda im shemt`xvevisa, roc`a misken gasachiri gibiz'gebdat`. cheshmaritad, bevri t`aviant` gemovnebaze aqolit` da uc`odinrad, mart`lac` sc`debian scori gzidan. cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i qvelaze kargad ic`nobs zg'vargadasulebs.
translations.footnotes: [1] ix. sura maides me - 3 da me - 4 aiat`ebi.

translations.translation: mash, moeshvit` c`odvas, ashkarasac` da p`arulsac`! uechvelad, vinc` c`odvas ixvechaven, daisjebian imist`vis, rasac` moixvechen.

da ar miirt`vat` is, razec` (dakvlisas) allahis saxeli ar xsenebula;[1] cheshmaritad, morch`ilebisgan gasvlaa igi. uechvelad, satanebi sht`aagoneben t`aviant` megobrebs, rom gekamat`on;[2] xolo t`u dahqvebit`, mashin carmart`ebi ik`nebit` t`k`venc`.[3]
translations.footnotes:
[1] morcmunet`a deda 'aisha gadmogvc`ems: xalxma ikit`xes: o, allahis shuamavalo! shirk`idan axal gamosul xalxs ch`vent`an xorc`i moak`vt`, t`umc`a ch`ven ar vic`it` masze alahis saxels axseneben t`u ara. man upasuxa: t`k`ven t`vit`on axsenet` allahis saxeli da ise miirt`vit`. (buxari, t`avhid 13/7398.)
ibni abbasi gadmogvc`ems: t`u saklavi muslimma dakla da allahis saxelis xseneba daavicqda, misi chama sheiz'leba, radganac` muslimi shinaganad atarebs allahis saxels. (beihaqi, sunenu'l-k`ubra, h.n. 18892.)
tavusi t`avisi mamis ganmartebas gadmogvc`ems: muslims qovelt`vis t`an axlavs allahis xseneba, amitom t`uki daklavs da allahis saxelis xseneba daavicqdeba, mashin chamis cin moixseneba allahis saxeli da ise ichmeba. xolo mazdeanma allahis saxeli romc` axsenos, misi dakluli mainc` ar ichmeba. (abdurrazzaq, h.n. 8539.)
imami taberi ganmartavs: uzenaesma allahma am aiat`it` ganmarta, rom ar sheiz'leba mivirt`vat` iset`i c`xovelis/p`rinvelis xorc`i, romelic` kerpebist`vis daikla, an daklamde mokvda, an kidev iset`ma vinmem dakla, visi daklulic` ar ichmeba. ix. t`ap`siiru taberi.
sura maides 5-e aiat`is sap`uz'velze cignboz'ebult`a dakluli am aiat`shi xsenebuli zogadi mdgomareobis mig'ma rch`eba.
[2] ibni abbasi gadmogvc`ems: carmart`ebi allahis shuamavals sheedavnen da ut`xres: rac` allahma dakla (moakvdina), imas ar miirt`mevt`, magram rasac` t`k`ven klavt`, imas miirt`mevt`. (nesai, dahaia 40/4437.)
[3] imami zejjaji ganmartavs: es sitqvebi mocmobs, rom vinc` allahis mier haramad dacesebuls halalad gamoac`xadebs an pirik`it` - is mushrik`i/carmart`i gaxdeba. ix. t`ap`siiru beg'avi.

translations.translation: gana is, vinc` (sulierad) mkvdari iqo da (rcmenit`) gamovac`oc`xlet`; gamovac`oc`xlet` da mivmadlet` nat`eli, rit`ac` xalxshi daiareba, - msgavsia imisa, romlis magalit`ic` bnelet`shi mqop`isas hgavs, saidanac` ar aris gamomsvleli? amgvarad mokazmula urcmunot`at`vis is, rasac` aket`eben.
da amgvarad, qvela k`alak`shi ik`auri braleulni davadginet` t`avkac`ebad, rat`a emzakvrat` masshi, magram veravis umzakvreben, garda sakut`ari sulebisa, da verc` ki ac`nobiereben.

da roc`a aiat`i miuvidat`, mat` t`k`ves: ar vircmunebt` manamde, sanam ar mogvec`ema imis msgavsi, rac` allahis shuamavlebs miec`at`. uket` ic`is allahma, t`u vis daakisros shuamavluri misia, braleulebi ki allahis cinashe damc`irebas da mis mkac`r sasjels gadaeqrebian, imis gamo, rasac` mzakvrobdnen.

allahi, vis cheshmarit gzaze daakvalianebasac` inebebs, - guls gauxsnis mas islamist`vis;[1] xolo vis gzaabnevasac` inebebs, - ch`aaxshobs mis guls da sheavicrovebs, t`it`k`os zec`ashi adiodes.[2] allahi ase miuch`ens sibilces mat`[3], romelt`ac` ar ircmunes.
translations.footnotes:
[1] rodesac` es aiat`i ch`amoevlina, sahabeebma ikit`xes: o, allahis shuamavalo! adamianis guli rogor gaixsneba? man upasuxa: rodesac` mis gulshi nat`eli daisadgurebs, misi gulic` gaixsneba, anu mzad ik`neba islamis cheshmaritebis misag'ebad. sahabeebma isev ikit`xes: am mdgomareobas t`u ak`vs nishnebi, rit`ac` misi gamoc`noba shesaz'lebeli ik`neba? man upasuxa: diax, maradiuli samkvidrosken ltolva, mac`dur k`veqanaze zurgis shek`c`eva da sikvdilis dadgomamde sikvdilist`vis mzadeba. ix. t`ap`siru taberi.
[2] ibni abbasma am aiat`is ganmartebisas t`k`va:,,allahi, vis cheshmarit gzaze daakvalianebasac` inebebs, - guls gauxsnis mas islamist`vis", - anu guls uxsnis rcmenisa da t`avhidist`vis;,,xolo vis gzaabnevasac` inebebs, - ch`aaxshobs mis guls da sheavicrovebs, t`it`k`os zec`ashi adiodes" - anu echvit` shepqrobils.,,t`it`k`os zec`ashi adiodes", - rogorc` ert`uleba da ar sheuz'lia adamians zec`ashi asvla, ise ver shez'lebs t`avis gulshi t`avhidisa da rcmenis gag'vivebas - t`uki allahma ar sheuqvana igi gulshi. ix. suiuti, durru'l-mansuur.
[3] ibni abbasis ganmartebis mixdevit`, ak` xsenebul,,sibilceshi" - satana, k`albis azrit` - c`odva, xolo zejjajis mixedvit` - amk`veqnad cqevla da imk`veqniuri sasjeli igulisxmeba. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: da esaa sheni g'mert`is scori gza. cheshmaritad, ch`ven detalurad ganvmartet` aiat`ebi xalxist`vis, romelnic` gaiazreben.
mat`t`visaa mshvidobis samkvidro g'mert`t`an, da igia shemce imist`vis, rasac` aket`ebdnen.

da ert` dg'es qvelas ert`ad shehqris (da etqvis): ei, jint`a krebulo! mart`lac` bevri ac`dunet` adamiant`agan. da mat`i megobrebi adamianebi itqvian: g'mert`o ch`veno! sargebels vg'ebulobdit` ert`manet`isgan da amasobashi mogviscro ch`venma ajalma, romelic` dagvidgine. ut`xra (allahma): c`ec`xlia t`k`veni samqop`eli, romelshic` darch`ebit` samaradisod, - garda imisa, rasac` allahi inebebs. cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i brz'enia, qovlismc`odne.
amgvarad davaamxanagebt` zogiert` usamart`loebs zogiert`ebt`an,[1] imist`vis, rasac` moixvechdnen.
translations.footnotes: [1] qat`ada ganmartavs: ch`ven mart` urt`iert` megobrebad vadgent`, morcmune megobaria morcmunesi, xolo urcmuno megobaria urcmunosi, sadac` arunda iqos. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: ei, jint`a da adamiant`a krebulo! gana ar mogsvliat` shuamavlebi t`k`venive ciag'idan, romlebic` gikit`xavdnen ch`ems aiat`ebs da gap`rt`xilebdnen am dg'is shexvedraze? t`k`ves: vmocmobt` ch`venive sulebis cinaag'mdeg. isini amk`veqniurma c`xovrebam ac`duna da sakut`ari sulebis cinaag'mdeg daamocmes, rom iqvnen urcmunoebi.
asea, radganac` sheni g'mert`i ar aris k`alak`ebis usamart`lod damak`c`eveli ise, rom misi mkvidri iqos gaup`rt`xilebeli.
qvelas t`aviant`i namok`medaris shesabamisi xarisxebi gaach`niat` da sheni g'mert`i ugulisquro araa imis mimart`, rasac` aket`eben.

da qovlad mdidaria g'mert`i sheni, usazg'vrod mocqale. t`uki inebebs, cagiqvant` t`k`ven da t`k`vens shemdeg ch`aanac`vlebs mat`, visac` inebebs - rogorc` t`k`ven shegk`mnat` sxva xalxis sht`amomavlad.
cheshmaritad, rac` ag'get`k`vat`[1], ut`uod mogecevat` da ver ag'udgebit` mas.
translations.footnotes: [1] imk`veqniuri sasjeli.

translations.translation: ut`xari: ei, ch`emo xalxo! aket`et` is, rac` giket`ebiat`, uechvelad, mec` vig'cvi, da shemdegshi gaigebt`, t`u visi ik`neba imiersop`lis sasurveli shedegi. cheshmaritad, ver gadarch`ebian usamart`loni.

da daudgines cili allahs, im mosavlidan da sak`onlidan, rac` man gaach`ina, da t`k`ves:,,es allahisaa", es ki,,ch`veni t`anaziarebisa". rac` t`aviant`i t`anaziarebist`vis hk`ondat` gadadebuli, ik`idan allahs arap`eri xvdeboda; xolo rac` allahist`vis hk`ondat` gankut`vnili, isic` t`anaziarebs xvdebodat`.[1] raoden c`udia is, rasac` gansjian!
translations.footnotes: [1] carmart`ebi mosavlidan da ot`xp`exa sak`onlidan garkveul cils gamoqop`dnen xolme allahisa da kerpebisat`vis shesacirad. allahist`vis gamoqop`ili cilit` stumrebsa da g'atakebs asargeblebdnen, xolo kerpebist`vis gamoqop`il cils ki kerpebisa da mat`i mosamsaxureebist`vis xarjavdnen. t`uki allahist`vis gankut`vnili cilidan, kerpebis cilshi rame sheereoda, mas xels ag'ar axlebdnen da ambobdnen:,,allahi mdidaria, mas arap`ershi chirdeba"; magram t`u kerpebist`vis gankut`vnili cilidan, allahis cilshi rame sheereoda, mas auc`ileblad kerpebs daubrunebdnen da itqodnen:,,mat` up`ro schirdebat`". t`uki allahist`vis gankut`vnili cilidan rame ganadgurdeboda an daikargeboda, mas quradg'ebas ar ak`c`evdnen, magram t`u kerpebist`vis gankut`vnil cils rame mouvidoda, mas allahis cilidan sheavsebdnen xolme. qat`ade ganmartavs: gachirvebis dros allahist`vis gankut`vnil cils miirt`mevdnen, xolo kerpebist`vis gankut`vnil cils xels ar axlebdnen. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: amgvarad, t`aviant`ma t`anaziarebma[1] mraval carmart`s sakut`ari shvilebis xoc`va moukazmes, rat`a gaenadgurebinat` isini da aemg'vriat` mat`t`vis t`aviant`i rjuli. allahs rom eneba, amas ar izamdnen. mash, miatove isini da isic`, rasac` c`ilismcamebloben.
translations.footnotes: [1] mujahidi ganmartavs: t`aviant` t`anaziarebshi satanebi igulisxmeba; satanebma mat` sig'aribis shishit` ch`vili k`alishvilebis c`oc`xlad damarxva moukazmes da karg sak`c`ielad moach`venes; satanebi moxsenebulni arian, rogorc` mat`i t`anaziarebi, radganac` isini allahis t`anaziarebad t`vit`on daadgines. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: da t`k`ves: xelsheuxebelia esa da es sak`oneli da mosavali, mas veravin miirt`mevs, garda imisa, visac` vinebebt`o; aseve t`k`ves pirutqvze, romelt`a zurgebsac` nakrz'alad t`vlidnen, da sak`onelze, romlebzec` (dakvlisas) ar axsenebdnen allahis saxels[1]. - c`ils scamebdnen da (allahi) dasjis imis gamo, rasac` c`ilismcameblobdnen.
translations.footnotes: [1] t`aviant`i gemovnebit` shet`xzuli cesebis t`anaxmad kerpebist`vis shesacirad gankut`vnili mosavlis an pirutqvis xorc`is chama mxolod garkveul jgup`s sheez'lo; aseve, sheciruli pirutqvis zurgze amxedreba an misit` tvirt`is tareba akrz'aluli hk`ondat` da sheciruli sak`onlis dakvlisas allahis saxelis nac`vlad kerpebis saxelebs axsenebdnen. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: da t`k`ves: rac`aa am sak`onelt`a muc`lebshi, is gankut`vnilia mxolod ch`veni kac`ebist`vis da akrz'aluli - ch`veni k`alebist`vis, xolo t`uki mkvdari ag'moch`ndeba, mashin qvelani moziareni ik`nebian masshi.[1] amgvari shep`asebisa da c`ilismcameblobis gamo dasjis mat` (allahi); cheshmaritad, igi brz'enia, qovlismc`odne.
translations.footnotes: [1] t`uki kerpebist`vis sheciruli sak`oneli damakdeboda, misi nashieris xorc`s mxolod mamakac`ebi miirt`mevdnen da k`alebs ekrz'alebodat`, xolo t`u mkvdari daibadeboda, mashin k`alebic` da kac`ebic` t`anabrad miirt`mevdnen. ix.t`ap`siru taberi.

translations.translation: mart`lac` carcqmedilan isini, romelt`ac` daxoc`es t`aviant`i shvilebi[1] ugunurobit`a da uc`odinrobit`, da allahze c`iliscamebit` akrz'ales is, rac` allahma ucqalobat` sazrdod; mart`lac` gadavidnen scori gzidan da arc` iqvnen cheshmarit gzaze mdgomni.
translations.footnotes: [1] carmart`uli cesebis t`anaxmad, k`alishvilis gach`ena sirc`xvilad it`vleboda, amitom axalshobilebs c`oc`xlad marxavdnen.

translations.translation: da igia, vinc` shek`mna bag'nari - z'irs gart`xmuli da ganurt`xmeli, p`iniki da qanebi - sxvadasxvagvari naqop`is mk`one, zet`isxili da broceuli - ert`manet`is msgavsi da gansxvavebuli. miirt`vit` misi naqop`i, roc`a moisxams, da gaig'et` misi cili mosavlis ag'ebis dg'es[1], da arc` p`uchad xarjot`, cheshmaritad, mas ar uqvars p`uchad mxarjvelni.
translations.footnotes: [1] mc`enareuli mosavlis zek`at`i, romelic` gansazg'vrulia 1/10-is odenobit` da c`nobilia oshuris saxelcodebit`. oshuris odenobas allahis shuamavlis shemdegi hadisebi gansazg'vravs:,,rasac` rcqavs zec`a an cqaroebi, an kidev, mxolod p`esvebit` sazrdoobs, masshi meat`edi, xolo rac` garkveuli amagit` ircqveba masshi meat`edis naxevari unda gaig'ot`." (buxari, zek`at` 55/1483).,,xut` vesqze nakleb mc`enareul mosavalze zek`at`i ar aris." (buxari, zek`at` 32/1447.). vesq (wsq), ase moixsenebdnen ert`i ak`lemis sazid tvirt`s. es medinas mkvidrt`a sazomi ert`eulia, rac` 60 saa' (lS`)-s sheadgens. (saa', im dros gavrc`elebuli mc`enareuli mosavlis sacqao churcheli.) hijazisa da eraqis regionebshi gamoqenebadi saa'-is moc`uloba ert`manet`isgan gansxvavdeboda. ak`edan gamomdinare, mezhebis scavlult`a shep`asebebis mixedvit` garkveuli sxvaobebi sheinishneba sacqaos moc`ulobasa t`u conashi. hanep`i mezhebis scavllt`a shep`asebit`, 1 veesqi aris 60 saa', xolo 60 saa' aris 185,7 kg; shap`i'i da hanbeli mezhebis mixedvit`, 1 veesqi aris 60 saa', xolo 60 saa' aris 122,4 kg; xolo malik`i mezhebis mixedvit`, 1 veesqi aris 60 saa', xolo 60 saa' aris 122 kg. ix:t`urk`et`is dianet`is islamis enc`iklopedia, nisab,t.33.139;oshur, t. 34,gv.98;vesq, t. 43,gv.70.

translations.translation: aseve (gaach`ina) pirutqvebi - tvirt`mzidad da sak`veshagebod.[1] miirt`vit` ik`edan, rac` allahma gicqalobat` sazrdod, da ar gauqvet` satanis nakvalevs! cheshmaritad, c`xadi mteria is t`k`veni.
translations.footnotes: [1] tvirt`mzidi anu shesajdomad, da tvirt`is sazidad gamosadegi pirutqvi, rogoric`aa ak`lemi, c`xeni, viri, jori, xari da a.sh. xolo k`veshagebshi igulisxmeba dabali ag'nagobis shinauri c`xovelebi: t`xa, c`xvari, z'roxa da mat`i nashieri, romlebic` gamosadegia matqlis, tqavis da xorc`is mosapoveblad. ix. t`ap`siru taberi.

translations.translation: (carmart`t`a mtkic`ebit` xelsheuxebeli pirutqvi) rva cqvilia: ori c`xvris da oric` t`xis. hkit`xe: ori mamali agikrz'alat`, ori dedali[2] t`u is, rasac` sheic`avs ori mdedris sashvilosnoebi? c`odnit` mipasuxet`, t`uki namdvilad gulcrp`elni xart` (t`u mart`lebi xart`).
translations.footnotes: [2] ori mamali - anu mamali c`xvari da mamali t`xa; ori dedali - anu dedali c`xvari da dedali t`xa.

translations.translation: aseve, ori ak`lemis da oric` z'roxis. hkit`xe: ori mamali agikrz'alat`, ori dedali,[1] t`u is, rasac` sheic`avs ori mdedris sashvilosnoebi? t`u momscreni iqavit` (im ambis), rodesac` allahma es gibrz'anat`? mash, ving'aa imaze up`ro usamart`lo, vinc` allahis shesaxeb sic`rues t`xzavs, rat`a ac`dunos xalxi uc`odinrobit`?! cheshmaritad, allahi usamart`lo xalxs ar daakvalianebs cheshmarit gzaze.
translations.footnotes: [1] ori mamali - anu mamali ak`lemi da mamali z'roxa; ori dedali - anu dedali ak`lemi da dedali z'roxa.

translations.translation: ut`xari: ch`emt`vis zesht`agonebit` ch`amovlenilshi verap`ers vpoulob akrz'aluls, rasac` mchameli miirt`mevs, garda mkvdaris an dag'vrili sisxlis, andac` g'oris xorc`isa, romelic`, uechvelad, sibilcea, an kidev sisaz'aglisa, romelic` allahis nac`vlad sxvist`vis daikla.[1] xolo vinc` iz'ulebuli sheik`mnas, og'ond ar iurch`os da arc` gadaametos, - cheshmaritad, allahi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobelia.
translations.footnotes: [1] garda ak` ch`amot`vlilebisa, sunnet`shic` aris moxsenebuli ramdenime akrz'alulis shesaxeb, magalit`ad: ibni abbasi gadmogvc`ems: allahis shuamavalma qoveli eshviani mtac`ebeli da qoveli klanchiani p`rinveli akrz'ala. (muslim, said 3/1934.) aseve jabir bin abdullahi gadmogvc`ems, rom allahis shuamavalma xaibaris dg'es shinauri saxedris xorc`i akrz'ala, xolo c`xenis xorc`ze neba dart`o. (muslim, said 6/1941.)

translations.translation: mat` ki, romelnic` iudevelni arian, avukrz'alet` qoveli ch`lik`gauqop`eli,[1] xolo z'roxisa da c`xvrisgan - k`oni avukrz'alet`[2], - garda imisa, rac` ak`vs zurgze an shigneulze, an kidev z'valze sherch`enili. ase mivuzg'it` t`aviant`i zg'vargadasulobist`vis da ch`ven mart`lac` mart`lebi vart`.
translations.footnotes:
[1] ak`lemisa da sirak`lemas msgavsi, romlebsac` cqvili ch`lik`i ar axasiat`ebt`.
[2] allahis shuamavalma mek`k`as ag'ebis dg'es ganac`xada:,,cheshmaritad, allahma da misma shuamavalma akrz'ala g'vinis, mkvdari c`xovelisa da kerpebis gaqidva. ik` mqop`ebma ut`xres: o, allahis shuamavalo! ras p`ik`robt` mkvdari c`xovelis k`onze, misit` navebs g'ebaven, tqavebs aprialeben da xalxi chrak`s ant`ebs. man upasuxa:,,ara, is haramia!" shuamavalma amis shemdeg t`k`va:,,allahma dascqevlos ebraelebi! rodesac` allahma k`oni aukrz'ala, mat` igi gadaadnes da gaqides, shemdeg ki misi sap`asuri shechames." (buxari, buiu' 112/2236.)

translations.translation: xolo t`uki c`rud shegrac`xes, mashin ut`xari: t`k`veni g'mert`i usazg'vrod mocqalea, magram misi sasjeli sheuk`c`evadia c`odvili xalxisgan.

ase itqvian isini, romlebmac` ut`anaziares: allahs rom eneba, arc` ch`ven vut`anaziarebdit` da arc` ch`veni cinapebi, da arc` arap`ers avkrz'alavdit`. amgvaradve c`rud sherac`xes imat`ac`, vinc` iqvnen mat`ze adre, vidre ch`veni risxva ar igemes. ut`xari: gana t`k`ven p`lobt` utquar c`odnas da shegiz'liat` carmogvidginot` igi? magram t`k`ven mxolod varauds eqrdnobit` da t`k`ven mxolod c`ruobt`.
ut`xari: allahs ki marcmunebeli mtkic`ebuleba ak`vs da rom eneba, qvela t`k`vengans daakvalianebda cheshmarit gzaze.

ut`xari: moiqvanet` t`k`veni mocmeni, romlebic` daamocmeben, rom allahma akrz'ala es! xolo t`uki (c`rud) daamocmeben, shen ar daamocmo mat`t`an ert`ad da ar dahqve mat` gemovnebas, romlebmac` c`rud sherac`xes ch`veni aiat`ebi, da imat`, romelt`ac` ar scamt` imk`veqnisa, da isini t`aviant` g'meg't`s sxvebs ut`anabreben.

ut`xari: modit`, cagikit`xot`, rac` t`k`venma g'mert`ma agikrz'alat`: - is, rom arap`eri ut`anaziarot` mas, siket`e gamoich`inot` mshobelt`a mimart` da ar daxoc`ot` shvilebi sig'aribis gamo, - ch`ven gapurebt` t`k`venc` da mat`ac`; aseve is, rom ar miuaxlovdet` avzneobas - arc` ashkaras da arc` p`aruls; arc` suli moakvdinot`, rac` allahma akrz'ala, - garda samart`lis ag'dgenisa.[1] ai, amat` gibrz'anebt` (g'mert`i), ik`neb gons moegot`.
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,muslimis sisxli halali ar aris, romelic` amocmebs, rom ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba garda allahisa da me allahis shuamavali var. gamonaklisi mxolod sami mdgomareobaa: mkvlelobis sanac`vlod sikvdilit` dasja, dak`orcinebulis mrushoba an is, rodesac` sarcmunoebas miatovebs da jama'at`s ganudgeba." (buxari, diat` 6/6878.)

translations.translation: da ar miuaxlovdet` oblis k`onebas, garda sauket`eso p`ormit` (miaxloebisa), - isic` manam, vidre srulclovnebas miag'cevdes; da samart`lianad uert`gulet` sazomsa da sacons.[1] arc`ert` suls ar vatvirt`avt`, imaze mets, rac` mas sheuz'lia. rodesac` saubrobt`, iqavit` samart`lianni - t`undac` t`k`venive nat`esavebis cinaag'mdeg, da ert`gulad daic`avit` allahis ag't`k`ma. amas gibrz'anebs t`k`ven, ik`neb gaiazrot` da ar daivicqot`.
translations.footnotes: [1] abdullah ibn abbasisgan gadmoc`emulia, rom man mzomavebsa da mconavebs (vachrebs) ut`xra:,,uechvelad, t`k`ven adgaxart` sak`mes, ramac` t`k`venze cin mqop`i xalxebi dag'upa." (t`irmizi, buiu', 9/1217.)

translations.translation: da uechvelad, esaa ch`emi gza - cheshmariti; mash, mihqevit` mas da nu gahqvebit` sxva gzebs, t`orem daganacevrebs t`k`ven misi gzidan. es gianderz'at` t`k`ven, ik`neb ridi gk`ondet`.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] jabir bin 'abdulahi gadmogvc`ems: ert`xel mac`nest`an ert`ad viqavit`, man micaze xazi gaavlo, shemdeg mis marjvniv da marc`xniv ori xazi gaavlo, shemdeg shua xazs xeli daado da t`k`va:,,es aris allahis gza". shemdeg es aiat`i caikit`xa. (ibni maje, muqaddime, 1/11.)

translations.translation: shemdeg cigni vuboz'et` musas srulobad - im siket`is gamo, rac` hk`mna, qoveli sak`mis ganmartebad, cheshmariti gzis mach`veneblad da cqalobad, - rom ik`neb ercmunat` t`aviant` g'mert`t`an shexvedra.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ibni abbasi ganmartavs:,,ik`neb mat` ercmunat` gankit`xvis dg'es ag'dgoma, jildo da sasjeli." ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: da es cigni (qurani), ch`vens mier ch`amovlenili, daloc`vilia. mash mihqevit` mas da ridi gamoich`inet` - ik`neb shecqalebuliqavit`.
- rom ar t`k`vat`: ch`venamde or jgup`ze[1] ch`amoevlina cigni, xolo ch`ven moklebulni viqavit` mat` scavlebas.
translations.footnotes: [1] iudevelebi da k`ristianebi.

translations.translation: an ar get`k`vat`: netav ch`venac` ch`amogvvlenoda cigni, mashin ut`uod mat`ze uket` davadgebodit` cheshmarit gzas. diaxac`, t`k`veni g'mert`isgan mogividat` c`xadi mtkic`ebuleba, cheshmariti gzis mach`venebeli da mcqalobeli. xolo vinaa imaze up`ro usamart`lo, vinc` allahis aiat`ebi/sascaulebi c`rud sherac`xa da ganerida/ganarida mas. mz'ime sasjelit` davsjit` mat`, romlebic` ganeridebian/ganarideben ch`vens aiat`ebs/sascaulebs - imis gamo, rasac` ganeridebodnen/ganaridebdnen.

nut`u mxolod imas elodebian, rom angelozebi mividnen mat`t`an, an sheni g'mert`i mivides, an kidev sheni g'mert`is zogiert`i sascaulebi miuvidet`? im dg'es, roc`a sheni g'mert`is zogiert`i sascaulebi[1] moevlinebat`, rcmena ar argebs suls, vinc` manamde ar ircmuna an aranairi siket`e ar mouxvechavs t`avisi rcmenis sasargeblod.[2] ut`xari: mash daelodet`, ch`venc` momlodineni vart`!
translations.footnotes:
[1] k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis nishnebi.
[2] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,k`veqniereba ise ar daik`c`eva, vidre mze ik`idan ar amova, saidanc` ch`adis. rodesac` xalxi amas naxavs, qvela ircmunebs, magram es is droa, rodesac` rcmena ar argebs suls. shemdeg es aiat`i caikit`xa." (buxari, t`ap`siir, h.n. 4636.),,rodesac` t`avs ich`ens sami ram, mashin rcmena ar argebs suls - romelmac` manamde ar ircmuna an aranairi siket`e ar mouxvechavs t`avisi rcmenis sasargeblod: mzis amosvla ik`idan, saidanac` ch`adis, dejjali da k`vesknelis c`xoveli." (muslim, iman 72/158.),,vinc` mzis dasavlet`idan amosvlamde moinaniebs, allahi miig'ebs mis sinanuls." (muslim, zik`r ve du'a, 12/2703.)

translations.translation: uechvelad, romelt`ac` daanacevres t`aviant`i rjuli da ik`c`nen jgup`ebad,[1] shen mat`t`an arap`eri gak`vs saert`o. cheshmaritad, mat`i sak`me allahzea, ac`nobebs mat` imas, rasac` sch`adiodnen.
translations.footnotes: [1] 'irbad bin sarie gadmogvc`ems: allahis shuamavalma ert`xel dilis loc`vis shemdeg ise sulshich`amcvdomad gvik`adaga, rom t`avalebi agvic`remlda da gulebi agvich`uqda. ert`ma kac`ma ut`xra: o, allahis shuamavalo! es k`adageba gamosamshvidobebel k`adagebas hgavs, ras dagvibareb ch`ven? man t`k`va:,,me t`k`ven girch`evt`: allahis rids, smenasa da morch`ilebas, t`undac` et`iopieli monis mimart`. uechvelad, t`k`vengan vinc` (ch`ems shemdeg) ic`xovrebs, is z'alian bevri ut`anxmoebis momscre ik`neba. me t`k`ven gap`rt`xilebt` shemdgom gamogonili sak`meebis mimart`, uechvelad gzaac`denilobaa igi. xolo vinc` amas moescreba, misi valia ch`emi sunnet`i da cheshmarit gzaze mdgomi rashidi xalip`eebis sunnet`i. sag'echi kbilebit` ch`aechidet` mas." (t`irmizi, 'ilim 16/2676.) aseve allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,ch`emi ummet`i igive mdgomareobashi ag'moch`ndeba, rac` mouvida israelis modgmas. rogorc` c`ali p`exsac`meli hgavs meores, ise daemsgavsebian mat`. imdenad, rom mat`gan t`u ik`neba vinme iset`i, vinc` sakut`ar dedast`an saashkaraod dacveba, ch`emi ummet`idanac` gamoch`ndeba vinme iset`i, vinc` amas ch`aidens. israelis modgma samoc`dat`ormetad daiqo, xolo ch`emi ummet`i samoc`dac`ametad daiqop`a. qvela mat`gani c`ec`xlshia, garda ert`isa. ik` mqop`ebma ikit`xes: o, allahis shuamavalo! vin aris is ert`i? man upasuxa: razec` me da ch`emi sahabeebi vadgavart`." (t`irmizi, iman 18/2641.),,cheshmaritad, sitqvat`agan sauket`eso allahis sitqvaa, gzat`agan sauket`eso muhammedis gzaa, qvelaze c`udi sak`me shemdgom gamogonili sak`meebia, xolo qoveli bidat`i (shemgom gamogonili) gzaac`denilobaa." (muslim, juma 13/867.)

translations.translation: vinc` (ch`ven cinashe) siket`it` cardgeba, miergeba at`magad, xolo vinc` uket`urebit` cardgeba, mas mxolod shesabamisad miezg'veba[1], da ar sheexebat` usamart`loba.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,rodesac` adamiani islams miig'ebs da karg muslimad ch`amoqalibdeba, allahi mas qvela uket`urobas apatiebs, rac` manamde ch`audenia, xolo amis shemdeg qoveli mok`medebist`vis sanac`vlo miegeba; siket`eebis sanac`vlod at`idan samoc`daat`magamde, xolo uket`urebis sanac`vlod mxolod ert`i sanac`vlo, garda imisa, t`uki isic` apatia allahma." (buxari, iman 31/41.) aseve allahis shuamavali gadmogvc`ems: uzenaesi allahi brz'anebs:,,vinc` (ch`em cinashe) mova siket`it`, mas ergeba at`i imdeni da kidev davumateb. vinc` mova c`udi sak`mit`, misi sasjeli c`odvis t`anap`ardi ik`neba an vapatieb. vinc` me damiaxlovda ert`i c`ida, me mas davuaxlovdebi ert` cqrt`as; vinc` me damiaxlovda ert`i cqrt`a, me mas davuaxlovdebi ert` arshins; vinc` ch`emsken daicqebs svlas, me mas sirbilit` mivegebebi, xolo vinc` ch`emt`an dedamicisodena shec`domebit` mova, t`umc`a shirk`i ar ch`audenia, me mas imdenive patiebit` davxvdebi." (muslim, iman 6/2687.)
[2] arc` siket`eebis dakargvit` da arc` daumsaxurebeli sasjelit`.

translations.translation: ut`xari: cheshmaritad, me ch`emma g'mert`ma scor gzaze damakvaliana, - mtkic`e sarcmunoebaze - hanip`i[1] ibrahimis rjulze, da is ar iqo carmart`t`agani.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,hanip`i" (Hnyf): qovelgvari c`ru rcmenisgan da carmart`uli sak`misgan gandegili da urqevi monot`eizmit` cheshmaritebisken mltolvare.

translations.translation: ut`xari: cheshmaritad, ch`emi namazic`, qurbanic`, sic`oc`xlec` da sikvdilic` samqarot`a g'mert`s - allahs ekut`vnis.
translations.footnotes: [1] es qvelap`eri mxolod ert`i allahist`vis da misi saxelit`.

translations.translation: mas ar hqavs (aravit`ari) t`anaziari, es mebrz'ana[1] me da me var pirveli morch`ilt`agani/muslimt`agani.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] anu t`avhidit`/ert`g'mert`ianobit` var davalebuli.
[2] am ummet`is pirveli morch`ilt`agani.

translations.translation: ut`xari: gana allahis garda sxva g'mert`i vez'io, rodesac` is aris g'mert`i qovlisa? rasac` qoveli suli moixvechs, mxolod maszea igi, da arc`ert`i c`odvili ar itvirt`avs sxvis c`odvas.[1] bolos t`k`vens g'mert`t`anaa t`k`veni misak`c`ieli da is gamc`nobt` imis shesaxeb, razec` c`ilobdit`.
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,ukanonod shobils mshobelt`a c`odvidan arap`eri miezg'veba." (haak`im, al-must`adrak`, h.n. 7053.)

translations.translation: da igia, romelmac` monac`vleebad dagadginat` dedamicaze (t`k`venze adre mqop`ebis), aseve zogiert`i t`k`vengani, zogiert`t`an shedarebit` ramdenime sap`exurit` aamag'la, rat`a gamoec`adet` imit`, rac` t`k`vent`vis uboz'ebia. uechvelad, sheni g'meg't`i mscrap`lsasjeliania da cheshmaritad, igi mart`lac` usazg'vrod mpatiebelia, mcqalobeli.
elip` laam miim saad.
(ai), cigni shent`vis ch`amovlenili - (urcmunot`a) gasap`rt`xileblad da morcmunet`a shesagoneblad, - ase rom, nu ik`neba shens gulshi mis mimart` sivicrove (echvi).
mihqevit` imas, rac` ch`amogevlinat` t`k`veni g'mert`isgan da nu gahqvebit` mis nac`vlad sxva megobrebs[1]. z'alian c`otaa, rasac` shegonebidan it`valiscinebt`.
translations.footnotes: [1] romelnic` mogicodeben, rom allahis magier kerpebs sc`et` t`aqvani.

translations.translation: da ramdeni k`alak`i gagvinadgurebia, romlebsac` ch`veni risxva dastqdomia t`avs - g'amit` an dg'isit`.
rodesac` ch`veni risxva daatqdat` t`avs, mat`i godeba -,,ch`ven mart`lac` usamart`loni viqavit`" - t`k`mis meti arap`eri qop`ila.
auc`ileblad movkit`xavt` mat`, visac` shuamavlebi caregzavnat` da, ut`uod, movkit`xavt` mat`ac`, vinc` shuamavlebad carigzavnen.
auc`ileblad vuambobt` mat` c`odnit`, - da ch`ven ar vqop`ilvart` dauscrebelni.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] gankit`xvis dg'es auc`ileblad vuambobt` t`aviant`i mok`medebebis shesaxeb ch`veni sheuc`domeli c`odnit`, da arasdros vqop`ilvart` mat`i mok`medebebis c`odnas mocqvetilni.

translations.translation: da im dg'es (mok`medebebis) aconva cheshmaritebaa, xolo visi asaconic` mz'ime ag'moch`ndeba, scored egeni arian gadarch`enilni.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,uechvelad, uzenaesi allahi ch`emi ummet`idan ert` kac`s danarch`eni k`mnilebebisgan gamoarch`evs da mat` cin daaqenebs. shemdeg mas cauqeneben 99 davt`ars, (romlebic` misi namok`medari uxeiro sak`meebit`aa savse). t`it`oeulis zoma sc`deba t`valsaciers. shemdeg uzenaesi mas kit`xavs: amat`gan romelimes uarqop`? usamart`lod xom ar mogek`c`nen sheni namok`medaris ag'mric`xveli angelozebi? is itqvis: ara, g'mert`o. mas isev kit`xavs: t`avis gasamart`lebeli raime sapatio mizezi gak`vs? is etqvis: ara, g'mert`o. shemdeg g'mert`i etqvis: ch`ven cinashe mig'ebuli ert`i siket`e gak`vs shen. uechvelad, dg'es shen cinaag'mdeg aranairi usamart`loba ar ik`neba. shemdeg carmoadgenen patara p`urc`els, romelzec` ceria: eshhedu el-laa ilaahe illallah ve eshhedu enne muhammeden 'abduhu ve rasuuluhu" (vamocmeb, rom ar arsebobs cheshmariti sat`aqvanebeli, garda allahisa; aseve vamocmeb, rom muhammedi misi mona da moc`ik`ulia). uzenaesi etqvis: shen t`vit`on acone sheni namok`medari. is itqvis: g'mert`o! sad es patara p`urc`eli da sad amodena davt`rebi? g'mert`i etqvis: uechvelad, shen usamart`lobas ar gadaeqrebi. shuamavalma t`k`va: shemdeg daalageben c`odvebit` savse davt`rebs sascoris ert` t`ep`shze da im patara p`urc`els meore t`ep`shze. davt`rebit` savse t`ep`shi mag'la camoiceva, xolo patara p`urc`eli up`ro mz'ime ik`neba da gadaconis mas. allahis saxelis cinashe arap`ers ak`vs cona da simz'ime." (t`irmiz, iman 17/2639.)

translations.translation: xolo visi asaconic` mch`ate ag'moch`ndeba, scored egeni arian, romelt`ac` sulebi caricqmides - imis gamo rasac` usamart`loobdnen ch`veni aiat`ebis/sascaulebis mimart`.
vp`ic`av, ch`ven dagamkvidret` dedamicaze da ik` shevk`menit` t`k`vent`vis c`xovrebis pirobebi. z'alian c`otaa, ra madlierebasac` gamoxatavt`.
vp`ic`av, ch`ven gagach`inet`, shemdeg gamogsaxet`, mere vut`xarit` angelozebs: sejde[1] ag'asrulet` adamist`vis! umalve sejdeze daemxnen, garda iblisisa,[2] is ar qop`ila sejdes ag'msrulebelt`agani.
translations.footnotes:
[1] originali -,,sejde" (sjd@): uzenaesi allahis cinashe muxlmodrekit`a da k`edis moxrit` morch`ilebisa da t`aqvanisc`emis gamomxatveli mok`medebaa. sejde shvidi organos - p`exis t`it`ebis, muxlebis, xelis gulebis da c`xvir-shublis z'irs shexebit` sruldeba. sejde qiblas mimart`ulebit` unda shesruldes, romlis drosac` xelis t`it`ebic`a da p`exis t`it`ebic` qiblas mimart`ulebit` unda iqos mimart`ulni.
[2] originali -,,iblisi" (blys): satanas saxelia, romelic` carmomavlobit` jinia, t`umc`a t`avisi ganscavlulobisa da damsaxurebis gamo angelozebt`an ert`ad imqop`eboda. aset`ma pativma iblisi imdenad gaaqoqoch`a, rom g'vt`is mimart` siurch`e gamoavlina.

translations.translation: (g'mert`ma) ut`xra: ram dagabrkola, rom ar ag'asrule sejde - rodesac` gibrz'ane? man ut`xra: me masze uket`esi var; me c`ec`xlisgan shemk`meni, xolo is micisgan gqavs shek`mnili.
(g'mert`ma) ut`xra: mash, daeshvi ik`, sadac` ar gek`neba medidurobis up`leba, axlave gadi ik`idan! uechvelad, shen xar damdablebult`agani (damc`irebult`agani).
(satanam) ut`xra: (mkvdret`it`) ag'dgomis dg'emde madrove.
(g'mert`ma) ut`xra: uechvelad, shen xar gadavadebult`agan.
(satanam) ut`xra: raki ase mac`dune, me mat` auc`ileblad ch`avusap`rdebi shens scor gzaze.
shemdeg auc`ileblad veaxlebi mat` - cinidan da uknidan, marjvnidan da marc`xnidan, da ver hpoveb madliers mat` umravlesobas.
(g'mert`ma) ut`xra: gadi ik`idan, sherc`xvenilma da gandevnilma! xolo vinc` shen gamogqveba, - auc`ileblad avavseb jojoxet`s qvela t`k`venganit`!
ei, adam! ic`xovret` shen da shenma meug'lem samot`xeshi da miirt`vit`, rac` genebot`, mxolod am xes ar miuaxlovdet`, t`orem t`k`ven ik`nebit` usamart`lot`agani!

am dros satanam ch`asch`urch`ulat`, rat`a xiluli gamxdariqo mat`t`vis sxeulis uxerxuli adgilebi, rac` hk`ondat` dap`aruli, da ut`xra: t`k`venma g'mert`ma mxolod imitom agikrz'alat` es xe, rom angelozebi ar gamxdariqavit` an ukvdavebad ar k`c`euliqavit`.
da daup`ic`a orives: uechvelad, me t`k`vent`vis var mart`lac` ket`ilis msurvelt`agani!

am motquebam gamoicvia mat`i dac`ema da roc`a im xisgan igemes, orives xilulad ek`c`at` t`aviant`i sxeulis uxerxuli adgilebi da mashinve sxeulis dap`arvas sheudgnen samot`xis p`ot`lebit`. am dros mat`ma g'mert`ma dauz'axa: gana ar agikrz'alet` es xe da ar git`xarit`, rom cheshmaritad, satana c`xadi mteria t`k`veni?
orivem t`k`ves: g'mert`o ch`veno! cheshmaritad, oriveni usamart`lod movek`ec`it` sakut`ar sulebs, da t`u ar gvapatieb da ar shegvicqaleb, ut`uod, ch`ven vik`nebit` ganadgurebult`agani/cagebult`agani.
(g'mert`ma) ut`xra:,,(k`veqnad) daeshvit` ert`manet`is mtrebad! droebit`i samkvidro da sabadebeli t`k`vent`vis -dedamicazea".
ut`xra: ik` ic`xovrebt`, ik` daixoc`ebit` da misi ciag'idanac` amoxvalt` (gankit`xvist`vis).

ei, adamis shvilno! uechvelad, ch`ven ch`amogivlinet` samoseli, romelic` p`aravs t`k`veni sxeulis uxerxul adgilebs, - da mosart`av - mosakazmavi (sruli tanisamosi); xolo eg, g'vt`ismoshishebis samoseli, - scored eg aris uket`esi.[1] es allahis sascaulebidanaa, ik`neb gaiazron da ar daivicqon.
translations.footnotes: [1] carmart` arabebshi arsebuli rcmenis t`anaxmad, k`aabas gars shemovlis rituals anu tavap`s, shishveli asrulebdnen, radganac` mat` ar undodat` tavap`i im samosit` shemosilebs sheesrulebinat`, romelshic` c`odva ch`aidines. ak`edan gamomdinare iqo tavap`is ori c`vla dg'is da g'amis. dg'isit` mamakac`ebi asrulebdnen tavap`s xolo g'amis sibneleshi k`alebi. scored am arascori sak`c`ielis gamosascoreblad ch`amoavlina uzenaesma allahma es aiat`i. ix. t`p`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: ei, adamis shvilno! ar gac`dunot` satanam, rogorc` t`k`veni cinaprebi gamoiqvana samot`xidan; gaxada mat` samosi, rat`a ert`manet`is sxeulis uxerxuli adgilebi ech`venebina. uechvelad, is da misi modgma gxedavt` t`k`ven, t`k`ven ki ver xedavt` mat`. uechvelad, ch`ven satanebi davumegobret` mat`, romelt`ac` ar scamt`.

xolo rodesac` avzneobas sch`adian, amboben: ch`ven am sak`meshi vpovet` ch`veni mamebi da allahma gvibrz'ane es. ut`xari: cheshmaritad, allahi ar brz'anebs avzneobas[1]. nut`u allahis shesaxeb imas ambobt`, rac` ar ic`it`?
translations.footnotes: [1] k`aabis irgvliv shishveli shemovlas, da sxva avzneobasa da sibilces.

translations.translation: ut`xari: ch`emma g'mert`ma brz'ana samart`ali, da misken miapqarit` t`k`veni saxeebi qovel samloc`velost`an,xalasad miuz'g'venit` t`k`veni rjuli da ise evedret` mas; rogorc` shegk`mnat` t`avdapirvelad, iseve ik`nebit` ukumibrunebulni.

(allahma, adamiant`a) ert`i jgup`i cheshmarit gzaze daakvaliana, xolo meore jgup`ma c`domilebashi qop`na daimsaxura. uechvelad, allahis nac`vlad mat` satanebi daimegobres da p`ik`roben, rom chemarit gzaze mdgomni arian.
ei, adamis shvilno! samos-samshvenisebit` sheimket` qovel samloc`velost`an; chamet` da svit`,[1] magram ar xarjot` p`uchad. cheshmaritad, mas ar uqvars p`uchad mxarjvelni.
translations.footnotes: [1] carmart`ebis rcmenis mixedvit`, tavap`is dros, sishishvlest`an ert`ad, sakvebic` ar unda mieg'ot`. scored amaze miut`it`ebs es aiat`i, rom chamet` da svit` p`uchad xarjvis gareshe. ix. t`ap`siru bag'avi.

translations.translation: ut`xari: vin akrz'ala allahis mier misi msaxurebist`vis gach`enili samos-samshvenisebi da halali sarch`o?[1] ut`xari: igi mat`t`visaa, vinc` ircmunes - amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi, gansakut`rebit` ki gankit`xvis dg'is. ase detalurad ganvmartavt` aiat`ebs xalxist`vis, romlebmac` ic`ian.
translations.footnotes: [1] vin akrz'ala tavap`is dros allahis mier dadgenili samos-samshvenisebit` shemosva da halali sakvebis mig'eba?

translations.translation: ut`xari: cheshmaritad, ch`emma g'meg't`ma akrz'ala avzneobani - ashkarac` da p`arulic`; uket`ureba da z'aladoba usamart`lobit`; aseve is, rom allahs ut`anaziarot` - razec` aranairi mtkic`ebuleba ar ch`amouvlenia; da allahis shesaxeb t`k`vat` is, rac` ar ic`it`.
qvela t`ems ak`vs t`avisi ajali, da roc`a dadgeba t`aviant`i zhami, ert` saat`sac` ver gadaavadeben da verc` daach`k`areben.

ei, adamis shvilno! rodesac` t`k`vent`an shuamavlebi movlen t`k`venive ciag'idan da mogit`xroben ch`ems aiat`ebs/sascaulebs (daemorch`ilet` mat`), da vinc` ridi gamoich`ina da (sak`c`ieli) gamoascora, - mat`ze arc` shishia mosalodneli da arc` damcuxreba.
xolo isini, romelt`ac` c`rud sherac`xes ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi da mediduroben mat` mimart`, scored isini arian c`ec`xlis mkvidrni da ik` ik`nebian maradzhams.

da vinaa up`ro usamart`lo, vinc` sic`rues t`xzavs allahis shesaxeb an c`rud rac`xavs mis aiat`ebs/sascaulebs, ai, scored mat` scvdebat` cignidan[1] t`aviant`i xvedri, da rodesac` miakit`xaven ch`veni cargzavnilebi,[2] rat`a moakvdinon isini, hkit`xaven: sad arian isini, romlebsac` allahis nac`vlad evedrebodit`? isini upasuxeben: gadgnen ch`vengan. da t`vit`onve daamocmes t`aviant`i sulebis cinaag'mdeg, rom iqvnen urcmunoni.
translations.footnotes:
[1] allahis cinashe dac`uli deda cigni, romelshic` dasabamidan dasarulamde mt`eli samqaros shesaxeb qvelanairi inp`ormac`iaa ag'ric`xuli, mat` shoris adamiant`a bediscera, mosaxdeni ambebi, da cminda quranic` im deda cignidan aris ag'ebuli.
[2] sikvdilis angelozi da mast`an ert`ad mqop`i sxva angelozebi.

translations.translation: (g'mert`i) brz'anebs: shedit` c`ec`xlshi, t`k`venze adre gardasul jint`a da adamiant`a mraval t`ems shoris! qovel t`ems shesvlist`anave scqevlis misive t`anamorjule; up`ro metic`, rogorc` ki ik` qvelani ert`ad sheiqrebian, mashinve camoiz'axebs mat`gan ukanaskneli pirvel mat`gant`a shesaxeb:[1] g'mert`o ch`veno! ai, amat` gadagviqvanes arascor gzaze, amitom mat` c`ec`xlis ormagi sasjeli miuzg'e! (g'mert`i) itqvis: qvelast`vis ormagia (sasjeli), t`umc`a t`k`ven ar ic`it`.
translations.footnotes: [1] rigit`i mimdevari cinamz'g'vris an lideris shesaxeb.

translations.translation: da itqvis mat` shoris pirveli ukanasknelt`a shesaxeb[1]: arap`rit` iqavit` ch`venze uket`esi,[2] mash, igemet` sasjeli imisa, rasac` moixvechdit`.
translations.footnotes:
[1] cinamz'g'vari an lideri rigit`i mimdevris shesaxeb.
[2] rogorc` ch`ven ar vircmunet`, ise ar ircmunet` t`k`venc`, amitom ch`ven t`anabari viqavit` urcmunoebashi da sasjelshic` t`anabari unda viqot`. ix. t`ap`siru bag'avi.

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, romelt`ac` c`rud sherac`xes ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi da mediduroben mat` mimart`, ar gaexsnebat` c`at`a karebi da ver shevlen samot`xeshi, vidre ak`lemi ar gaz'vreba nemsis quncshi. ai ase mivuzg'avt` damnashaveebs (c`odvilebs).
mat`t`visaa jojoxet`is (c`ec`xlis) sarec`eli da zed saburveli, ai, ase vsjit` usamart`loebs.
xolo isini, romelt`ac` ircmunes da hk`mnes ket`ili, arc`ert` suls ar vatvirt`avt` imaze mets, rac` mas sheuz'lia - ai, isini arian samot`xis mkvidrni da ik` ik`nebian maradzhams.

da gavac`alet`, t`u rame boroteba hk`ondat` gulebshi, mat` k`vemot` mdinareebi miedineba da amboben: dideba allahs! romelmac` dagvakvaliana am gzaze; ch`ven t`vit`on verasgzit` gavikvlevdit`, allahs rom ar davekvalianebinet`. vp`ic`avt`, rom ch`veni g'mert`is shuamavlebi cheshmaritebit`urt` movidnen. am dros mouxmoben mat`, rom esaa samot`xe, romelsac` daemkvidrebit` imis sanac`vlod, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebdit`.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis shuamavalma es aiat`i ase ganmarta:,,(samot`xis mkvidrt`) ase mouxmoben: ak` t`k`vent`vis aris maradiuli janmrt`eloba da ag'arasdros daavaddebit`; ak` t`k`vent`vis aris maradiuli sic`oc`xle da ag'arasdros mokvdebit`; ak` t`k`vent`vis aris maradiuli axalgazrdoba da ag'arasdros moxuc`debit`; ak` t`k`vent`vis ut`valavi cqalobaa da ag'arasdros gecevat` gasachiri!" (muslim, jannat` 8/2837.)
