translations.translation: da samot`xis mkvidrni c`ec`xlis mkvidrebs gasz'axeben: ch`ven mart`lac` vnaxet`, rom cheshmaritebaa, rac` ag'gvit`k`va ch`venma g'mert`ma, da t`u naxet` t`k`ven, rom rasac` gpirdebodat` t`k`veni g'mert`i, mart`lac` cheshmaritebaa? upasuxes: diax. am dros ganac`xadebs mat`t`an ganmc`xadebeli, rom allahis cqevla iqos usamart`loebze.
romlebic` abrkoleben (sakut`ar t`avs da sxvebsac` ) allahis gzaze da misi gamrudeba surt`, aseve, ar scamt` mat` imk`veqnisa.

mat` shoris zg'udea, mag'lobze dganan kac`ebi, romlebic` qvelas (samot`xis an jojoxet`is mkvidrebs ) sc`noben t`aviant`i saxeebit`[1] da gasz'axeben samot`xis mkvidrebs: salami t`k`venda! isini jer ar shesulan masshi, magram imedovneben.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] morcmunet`a saxeebi t`et`ri da nat`elia, xolo urcmunot`a saxeebi shavi da bneli, rogorc` aris shemdeg aiat`shi:,,im dg'es, rodesac` gabrcqindebian saxeebi da gashavdebian saxeebi" (ali imran, 3/106.)
[2] samot`xisa da jojoxet`is zg'udis t`avze, shemag'lebul adgilze mqop`t`a vinaobis shesaxeb mup`essirt`a shoris at`amde gansxvavebuli mosazreba p`ik`sirdeba. ak` mxolod qvelaze gavrc`elebuli ert`i versiis gadmoc`ema vikmaret`, romlis t`anaxmadac`, eseni arian xalxi, romelt`a siket`eebi da uket`urobebi t`anabari ag'moch`nda. siket`eebma daabrkola mat`i jojoxet`shi moxvedra, xolo uket`urobebis gamo samot`xeshi ver moxvdnen. allahis shuamavals a'rap`is mkvidrt`a shesaxeb kit`xes, man ase upasuxa:,,isini allahis msaxurebi arian, romelt`a sak`mec` qvelaze bolos ganixileba. rodesac` samqarot`a g'mert`i msaxurt`a angarishscorebas morch`eba, mat` etqvis: t`k`ven xart` xalxi, romlebic` t`aviant`ma siket`eebma jojoxet`is c`ec`xlidan ixsna, t`umc`a samot`xeshic` ver shexvedit`. amieridan t`avisup`lebi xart`, sadac` gindat` ik` daikavet` adgili - samot`xeshi!" ix. t`ap`siiru taberi.

translations.translation: xolo rodesac` mat`i mzera c`ec`xlis mkvidrt`a mxares miek`c`eva, amboben: g'mert`o ch`veno! nu gagvamceseb usamart`lo xalxt`an ert`ad!
mag'lobze mdgomni gasz'axeben kac`ebs, romlebsac` sc`noben t`aviant`i saxeebit`: verap`ershi gargot` verc` t`k`venma dagrovilma da verc` iman, roc`a medidurobdit`!
eseni ar arian isini, romlebzec` ip`ic`ebodit`, rom ar sheeceoda cqalobit` allahi?[1] shedit` samot`xeshi! arc` shishia t`k`venze da arc` damcuxreba.
translations.footnotes: [1] kit`xva mimart`ulia jojoxet`is mkvidrt`a mimart`, romlebic` morcmuneebs dasc`inodnen da ip`ic`ebodnen, rom allahi mat` ar sheicqalebda da samot`xeshi ver moxvdebodnen.

translations.translation: jojoxet`is binadrebma samot`xis mkvidrebs asz'axes, rom cqali gadmogvasxit` an ik`idan (mogvec`it`), rac` sarch`od ucqalobebia allahs t`k`vent`viso. mat` ut`xres: cheshmaritad, allahma orive akrz'ala urcmunot`at`vis.

- romelt`ac` t`aviant`i rjuli gart`obad da masxrad aigdes da amk`veqniurma c`xovrebam ac`duna. dg'es ch`venc` davivicqebt` mat`, rogorc` t`vit`on daivicqes dg'evandeli es shexvedra, - aseve imis gamo, rom ch`vens aiat`ebs/sascaulebs uarqop`dnen.
vp`ic`av, ch`ven mat` cigni mivacodet`, romelic` c`odnit` ganvmartet` detalurad, - cheshmariti gzis mach`venebelad, da cqalobad (movuvlinet` ) morcmune xalxs.

nut`u mxolod mis gac`xadebas elian?[1] im dg'es, rodesac` dadgeba sic`xade misi, isini, romlebmac` manamde daivicqes, itqvian: ch`veni g'mert`is shuamavlebi mart`lac` cheshmaritebit`urt` mosulan! nut`u aravinaa shuamdgomeli, romelic` gvishuamdgomlebs, an ukan ar mivbrundebit`, rom ag'ar vaket`ot` is, rasac` vaket`ebdit`? mart`lac` caricqmides sulebi da daekargat` is, rasac` t`xzavdnen[2].
translations.footnotes: [1] nut`u mxolod imas elodebian, rom quranshi danapirebi sasjeli urcmunoebs t`avs daatqdebat` da ise ircmuneben? [2] kerpebma verap`eri ushveles mat` imk`veqnad.

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, t`k`veni g'mert`i allahia, igia, romelmac` ek`vs dg'eshi gaach`ina c`ani da dedamica, shemdeg ki 'arshze[1] amag'lda;[2] g'ames buravs dg'it`, romelic` sheudgomeli mdevaria misi; da mze, mt`vare da varskvlavebi srulad hmorch`ileben mis brz'anebas. gana masa ar ekut`vnis gach`ena da mbrz'anebloba?! raoden didia allahi, samqarot`a g'mert`i!
translations.footnotes:
[1] originali -,,'arsh" (`rsh): lek`sikonuri mnishvnelobit` es aris mag'ali adgili, mcvervali, taxti, didebult`a dasajdomi adgili da a.sh. zogjer sammart`velo taxtidan gamomdinare, gadatanit`i mnishvnelobit`,,,'arsh"-i gaigivebulia saxelmcip`ost`an, xelmcip`obast`an da mmart`velobast`an. quransa da sunnet`shi xsenebuli uzenaesi allahis,,'arsh"-is namdvili raoba sheucvdomelia adamiant`a gonebist`vis, ak`edan gamomdinare, saxelis msgavsebis gamo, daushvebelia misi sammart`velo taxtze mimsgavseba da ise interpretireba. ch`veni valia, vag'iarot` im p`ormit`, rogorc` quransa da hadisebshia moc`emuli, t`avi shevikavot` misi raobisa da rogorobis shesaxeb ganmartebebisgan.
[2] originali -,,ist`ava" (stw~): lek`sikonuri mnishvnelobit` amag'lebas, gat`anabrebas, gascorebas, gamqarebas an dak`vemdebarebas nishnavs. cminda quranshi uzenaesi allahis mok`medebad xsenebuli,,ist`ava" pirveli t`aobis muslimt`a ganmartebebisa da sitqvis pirdapiri mnishvnelobis shesabamisad vt`argmnet`, rogorc` amag'leba. rac` sheexeba amag'lebis raobasa da rogorobas, rogorc` uzenaesi allahis sxva t`visebebi, ise am mok`medebis namdvili raoba adamiant`a gonebist`vis sheucvdomelia. pirveli t`aobis muslimebi uzenaesi allahis saxel-t`visebebsa da mok`medebebs qovelt`vis im p`ormit` g'ebulobdnen, ra p`ormit`ac` moc`emulia cminda quransa t`u sando hadisebshi. mat` bid'at`ad (siaxled) da k`up`rad (urcmunoeba) miach`ndat` allahis saxel-t`visebebisa da mok`medebebis ise interpretireba, romelic` shordeba, auk`mebs an c`vlis originalshi moc`emul shinaarss, an sheic`avs allahis k`mnilebebze mimsgavsebas da misdami sxeulis misadagebas. cminda qurani mkap`iod gamoric`xavs uzenaesi allahis k`mnilebebt`an msgavsebas:,,arap`eria misi msgavsi da igia qovlis mxedveli, qovlis mc`odne." (shuura, 42/11),,mash, ar ez'iot` allahis sadari! cheshmaritad, allahma ic`is, xolo t`k`ven ar ic`it`." (nahl, 16/74.) ak`edan gamomdinare, ch`ven gvcams da vag'iarebt` moc`emuli sitqvebis pirdapir mnishvnelobas, mat`i raobis ganmartebis, k`mnilebebt`an shedarebis, sxeulis misadagebisa da z'ireuli mnishvnelobis uarqop`is gareshe. gvjera, rom misi t`visebebi da mok`medebebi ar aris iset`i, rogorc` k`mnilebat`a t`visebebi da mok`medebebia, aramed iset`ia, rogoric` sheep`ereba mis sidiades, da ar ch`ait`vleba mis mimart` naklad. am t`emast`an dakavshirebit`, pirveli t`aobis muslimt`a sitqvebia: shuamavlis meug'lem da morcmunet`a dedam ummu selemem sura tahas 20/5-e aiat`shi,,rahmani (mocqale) 'arshze amag'lda"-s shesaxeb t`k`va:,,amag'lebis raoba adamiant`a gonebist`vis sheucvdomelia, t`umc`a amag'leba c`nobilia; misi ag'iareba rcmenis nacilia, xolo uarqop`a urcmunooba." (ibni batta, al-ibaanat`u al-k`ubra, t.3, gv.162, h.n.120.) gadmoc`emis t`anaxmad, ert`i kac`i imam malik`t`an mivida, sura tahas 5-e aiat`i,,rahmani (mocqale) 'arshze amag'lda", caikit`xa da ut`xra: rogor amag'lda? imam malik`ma amgvari shekit`xva ar moicona, gabrazda da xangrz'livi dumilis shemdeg upasuxa:,,raoba sheucvdomelia adamianis gonebist`vis, amag'leba c`nobilia, amis rcmena auc`ilebelia, xolo misi raobis shesaxeb kit`xvis dasma bid'at`ia, vshishob, rom shen gzaac`denili xar." shemdeg ik` mqop`ebs ubrz'ana da is kac`i ganarides mejliss (lalek`ai, sherhu usuli i't`iqadi ahli sunna,3/441.) nu'aim bin hammad al-huza'im t`k`va:,,vinc` allahi miamsgavsa k`mnilebebs, man urcmunooba gamoavlina; vinc` uarqo igi, rit`ac` allahma sakut`ari t`avi daaxasiat`a, man urcmunooba gamoavlina; rit`ac` allahma sakut`ari t`avi daaxasiat`a, mat`shi k`mnilebebze mimsgavseba ar sheiz'leba." (al-maqdisi, al-iqt`isadu p`ii'li't`iqad, gv. 217.) aseve imam malik`s ekut`vnis shemdegi sitqvebic`:,,gaup`rt`xildit` bidat`ebs!" ik` mqop`ebma kit`xes: ra aris bidat`i? man upasuxa:,,mobidat`eebi arian isini, vinc` saubroben allahis saxel-t`visebebis, misi sitqvis, c`odnisa da bedisceris shesaxeb da ar duman iset` sakit`xebze, razec` dumdnen sahabeebi da mat`i sauket`eso mimdevarni." (herevi, zemmu'l-k`elam, 4/114.)

translations.translation: evedret` t`k`vens g'mert`s t`avdamc`irebit` (xvecnit` ) da gulis sig'rmidan (ch`umi xmit`). cheshmaritad, mas ar uqvars zg'vargadasulni.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] abu musa gadmogvc`ems: ch`ven ert`-ert`i mogzaurobis dros mac`nest`an ert`ad viqavit`. rodesac` mt`is mag'lobebze avdiodit` xmamag'la t`ak`birebs carmovt`k`vamdit`, man gvit`xra:,,ei, adamianebo! sakut`ari sulebi sheibralet` (t`ak`birebis xmamag'la carmot`k`mit` nu daiz'abebit`) t`k`ven arc` qrus evedrebit` da arc` shors mqop`s. t`k`ven qovlis msmenels, qovlis mxedvelsa da axlos mqop`s evedrebit`." shemdeg ch`emt`an movida, me am dros dabali xmit` ase vambodi:,,laa hevle ve laa quvvet`e illa billah" (ar arsebobs g'one da z'liereba, garda allahisa). man ase mit`xra:,,ei, abdullah bin qais! t`k`vi: laa havla va laa quvvat`a illa billah, ramet`u eg samot`xes xazinat`agan ert`-ert`ia." (buxari, t`avhid 9/7386.)

translations.translation: da nu ecevit` uket`urebas dedamicaze, misi gamoscorebis shemdeg![1] mash, evedret` mas shishit`a da sasoebit`! cheshmaritad, allahis cqaloba axlosaa ket`ilismk`mnelebt`an.
translations.footnotes: [1] muhammedis shuamavluri misiit` carmogzavnis shemdeg, roc`a shirk`i - t`avhidma, bnelet`i - nat`elma, buroteba - siket`em da mtroba - siqvarulma ch`aanac`vla.

translations.translation: da isaa, vinc` gzavnis k`arebs maxaroblad, t`avisi cqalobis cin, roc`a itvirt`avs mz'ime g'rublebs, ch`ven mas carvmart`avt` k`veqnis mkvdari kut`xisken, ch`amovavlent` misgan cqals da ag'movac`enebt` misit` qvelanair naqop`s. amgvarad ag'vadgent` mkvdrebsac`, ik`neb gaiazrot` da ar daivicqot`.

da xeiriani kut`xis micaze uxvad xarobs mc`enareuloba - t`avisi g'mert`is nebit`; xolo romelic` uxeiroa, ik` c`otasa da uvargisis meti arap`eri modis.[1] amgvarad, qovelmxriv vmartavt` aiat`ebs madlieri xalxist`vis.
translations.footnotes: [1] uzenaes allahs ak` morcmunesa da urcmunos magalit`ad, xeiriani da uxeiro micis igavi mohqavs. msgavs shedarebas aket`ebs muhammed shuamavalic`:,,allahis mier ch`emt`an ert`ad gamogzavnili cheshmariti gza da c`odna uxv cvimas hgavs, romelic` dedamicas acvims. arsebobs micis nakvet`i, romelic` cvimis cqals sheicovs da uxv mosavals iz'leva. aseve, arsebobs micis nakvet`i, romelic` unaqop`oa, cvimis cqals ar sheicovs da zedapirze rch`eba. allahi am cqals xalxs asargeblebs. zogs t`vit`on svamen, zogs pirutqvs asmeven da zogit`ac` mindvrebs rcqaven. aseve, arsebobs micis iset`i nakvet`ic`, romelsac` acvims, magram arc` cqals inaxavs da arc` mosavaliania. ai, amgvar magalit`s carmoadgens is, vinc` allahis rjulshi ch`axedulia da allahis mier ch`emt`an ert`ad carmogzavnili cheshmariti gzit`a da c`odnit` sargeblobs, scavlobs da sxvasac` ascavlis, da is, vinc` allahis mier ch`emt`an ert`ad carmogzavnil cheshmarit gzas ecinaag'mdegeba, qurs ar ugdebs mas da ar et`anxmeba." (buxari, ilim 20/79.)

translations.translation: vp`ic`av, ch`ven nuhi (noe) carvgzavnet` t`avis xalxt`an; da ut`xra: ei, xalxo ch`emo! t`aqvani ec`it` allahs, ar gagach`niat` mis garda sxva g'vt`aeba. uechvelad, me t`k`vent`vis im didebuli dg'is sasjelze vshishob.
t`avisi xalxis didebulebma ut`xres: mart`lac`, gxedavt`, rom shen xar c`xad gzaabnevashi.
man ut`xra: ei, ch`emo xalxo! me ar var gzaabneuli, aramed me var shuamavali samqarot`a g'mert`isgan.
ch`emi g'meg't`is gzavnils gaucqebt` da garigebt` t`k`ven, aseve, allahisgan vic`i me is, rac` t`k`ven ar ic`it`.
nut`u gikvirt`, rom t`k`veni g'mert`isgan shegoneba mogividat` t`k`ven shoris ert`i-ert`i kac`is meshveobit`, rat`a gagap`rt`xilot` da ridi gamoich`inot`, rom ik`neb shecqalebuliqavit`.

magram c`rud sherac`xes mat`, ch`ven ki gadavarch`inet` is da isinic`, vinc` gemshi iqvnen mast`an ert`ad, xolo davaxrch`vet` isini, vinc` c`rud sherac`xes ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi. uechvelad, isini brmebi iqvnen (cheshmaritebis mimart`).
da (carvgzavnet`) 'adis xalxt`an mat`i z'ma hudi (romelmac`), ut`xra: ei, xalxo ch`emo! t`aqvani ec`it` allahs, ar gagach`niat` mis garda sxva g'vt`aeba. nut`u mokrz'alebas ar gamoich`ent`?
misi xalxis didebulebma, romlebmac` ar ircmunes, ut`xres: uechvelad, ch`ven mart`lac` chkuasustobas gamch`nevt` da ch`ven mart`lac` ert`-ert`i matquara gvgonixar.
man ut`xra: ei, ch`emo xalxo! ar var me chkuasusti, aramed me var shuamavali samqarot`a g'mert`isgan.
me ch`emi g'meg't`is gzavnils gaucqebt` da sando damrigebeli var t`k`vent`vis.

nut`u gikvirt`, rom t`k`veni g'mert`isgan shegoneba mogividat` t`k`ven shoris ert`i-ert`i kac`is meshveobit`, - rat`a gagap`rt`xilot`? gaixsenet`, rodesac` nuhis xalxis shemdeg[1] monac`vleebad dagadginat` da shegmatat` tanadoba; mash, gaixsenet` allahis siket`eni, ik`neb sruli bedniereba moipovot`.
translations.footnotes: [1] mat`i dag'upvis shemdeg pativi dagdot` da mat`i adgili daikavet` dedamicaze.

translations.translation: ut`xres: gana imist`vis moxvedi, rom mxolod allahs vc`et` t`aqvani da mivatovot` is, rasac` ch`veni mama - papani et`aqvanebodnen? (t`u asea), mash, gvacvnie igi, rit`ac` gvemuk`rebi, t`uki shen xar mart`alt`agani!

ut`xra: mart`lac` gardauvali gaxda t`k`vent`vis sasjeli da risxva t`k`veni g'mert`isgan! nut`u im saxelebis (kerpebis) shesaxeb mekamat`ebit`, romlebic` t`k`ven da t`k`venma mama - papebma daark`vit`? - allahs mat` shesaxeb aranairi mtkic`ebuleba ar ch`amouvlenia. mash, daelodet`, cheshmaritad, mec` t`k`vent`an ert`ad var momlodinet`agani!

shemdeg, ch`veni cqalobit`, vixsenit` igi da isinic`, vinc` iqvnen mast`an ert`ad, da ukanasknelis ch`at`vlit` qvela amovcqvitet`, romlebic` c`rud rac`xavdnen ch`vens aiat`ebs/sascaulebs da ar iqvnen morcmuneni.

da (carvgzavnet`) semudis xalxt`an mat`i z'ma salihi, (romelmac`) ut`xra: ei, xalxo ch`emo! t`aqvani ec`it` allahs, ar gagach`niat` mis garda sxva g'vt`aeba. cheshmaritad, t`k`ven miig'et` c`xadi mtkic`ebulebani t`k`veni g'mert`isgan. esec`, sascaulad t`k`vent`vis allahis ak`lemia, daac`adet`, ibalaxos allahis micaze da arap`eri avnot` mas, t`orem mcare sasjeli dagatqdebat`![1]
translations.footnotes: [1] jabir bin adbullahi d gadmogvc`ems: t`abuk`is brz'olashi mimavalma shuamavalma, rodesac` nak`alak`ar hegrast`an (al-hijri) dabanakda, p`exze camodga da xalxs mimart`a:,,ei, xalxo! t`k`veni mac`nisgan ar moit`xovot` sascauli! es (nak`alak`ari) aris salih shuamavlis xalxis. mat`, t`aviant`i mac`nisgan moit`xoves ak`lemi (romelic` sascaulebrivad kldisgan unda shobiliqo). allahma moaxdina mat`t`vis sasurveli sascauli. is ai, am gzit` movidoda da cqlis marags mt`lianad svamda. (xalxi da ak`lemi cqals morigeobit` svamdnen) rodesac` ak`lems ergeboda cqlis dalevis up`leba, im dg'es mosaxleoba ak`lemisgan zustad imden rz'es cvelavda, ramden cqalsac` g'ebulobdnen t`aviant`i rigis dros da amgvarad, rz'it` ikmaqop`ilebdnen sasmeli cqlis sachiroebas. shemdeg ak`lemi isev am gzas gaudgeboda da cavidoda. bolos (xalxs mobezrda amgvari morigeoba) t`aviant`i g'mert`is brz'aneba daarg'vies da ak`lemi dakles. allahma mat` sami dg'e adrova, - allahis danapirebi arasdros gac`ruvdeba, - shemdeg (k`vemodan micisz'vram da zemodan) gausaz'lisma xmaurma sheipqro isini da qvelani daixoc`nen, vinc` ki iqvnen (am teritoriaze) zec`asa da dedamicas shoris, garda ert`i kac`isa, romelic` allahis nakrz'al teritoriaze imqop`eboda. allahis nakrz'al teritoriaze qop`nis gamo mas ar shexebia allahis sasjeli...." (taberani, al-mujam' al-avsat, h.n. 9069.)

translations.translation: da gaixsenet`, roc`a monac`vleebad dagadginat` - 'adis xalxis shemdeg, da dagabinavat` dedamicaze, romlis velebzec` sasaxleebs agebdit` da (kldovan) mt`ebs saxlebad kvet`dit`. mash, gaixsenet` allahis siket`eni da nu iborotebt` k`veqnad uket`urebi.

t`avisi xalxidan didebulebma, romlebic` medidurobdnen, ut`xres mat`, visac` dabal p`enad miich`nevdnen da romlebmac` ircmunes: gana mart`la ic`it`, rom salihi t`avisi g'mert`is mier carmogzavnili shuamavalia? mat` upasuxes: cheshmaritad, ch`ven gvcams is, rit`ac` carmogzavnilia igi!
t`k`ves mat`, romelnic` medidurobdnen: uechvelad, ch`ven vart` urcmunoni imis mimart`, rac` t`k`ven ircmunet`!

shemdeg dakles (is) dedali ak`lemi da k`edmag'lurad daarg'vies t`aviant`i g'mert`is brz'aneba, shemdeg ki ase t`k`ves: ei, saalih! aba gvacvnie is (sasjeli), rit`ac` gvemuk`rebodi, t`u namdvilad xar shuamavalt`agani!
am dros (xmaurianma) micisz'vram sheipqro isini da t`aviant` saxlebshi pirk`ve damxobilni daixoc`nen.

shemdeg (saalihi) ganerida mat` da t`k`va: ei, ch`emo xalxo! vp`ic`av, me t`k`ven gaucqet` ch`emi g'mert`is gzavnili da dagariget` t`k`venda sasargeblod, magram t`k`ven ar giqvart` ket`ildamrigebelni.
aseve (gaixsene/carvgzavnet`) luti, - aki ut`xra t`avis xalxs: nut`u ik`mt` iset` avzneobas, romelic` t`k`venamde samqarot`a shoris aravis ch`audenia?
uechvelad, t`k`ven vnebit` eaxlebit` kac`ebs k`alebis nac`vlad; up`ro metic`, t`k`ven xart` ag'viraxsnili xalxi.
da ar qop`ila misi xalxis pasuxi, garda am nat`k`vamisa: gaaz'evet` egeni t`k`veni k`alak`idan, uechvelad, egeni arian xalxi, romlebsac` umankod moak`vt` t`avi!
shemdeg vixsenit` is da misi ojaxi, garda misi c`olisa, romelic` ukan darch`a - ganadgurebult`a shoris.
bolos zemodan (k`vebis) cvima davacvimet` mat`, shexede, rogori iqo c`odvilt`a bolo![1]
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis shuamavali sxvadasxva hadisebshi ambobs:,,cqeulia is, vinc` lutis xalxis sak`mes aket`ebs." (ahmed, al-musned, h.n. 1875.),,visac` naxavt`, rom igive sak`mit` aris dakavebuli, rasac` aket`ebda lutis xalxi, mokalit` - ak`tiuric` da pasiuric`." (ibni maje, hudud 12/2561.),,qvela ert`ad ch`ak`olet`, zemot` mqop`ic` da k`vemot` mqop`ic`." (ibni maje, hudud 12/2562.) p`iqhis scavlult`a umravlesobis mixedvit`, sodomuri c`odvis ch`amdeni igives sasjels imsaxurebs, rac` mrushobis shemt`xvevashia gat`valiscinebuli, radganac` cminda quranshi mrushobac` da sodomuri c`odvac` avzneobadaa daxasiat`ebuli. imami shap`i'isa da hanep`i mezhebidan, imam muhamedisa da abu iusup`is mixedvit`, mrushis msgavsad daisjeba sodomuri c`odvis ch`andeni anu t`u dak`orcinebulia - ch`ak`olvit`, xolo t`u dauk`orcinebelia, mashin 100 rozgit`. shap`i'i mezhebis mixedvit`, ag'nishnuli c`odvis ch`amdens, t`u dasak`orcinebelia, rozgt`an ert`ad gadasaxlebac` miesjeba. imam malik`isa da ahmed bin hanbelis mixedvit`, allahis shuamavlis hadisis t`anaxmad, sadac` sodomuri c`odvis ch`amdenis sikvdilit` dasjaze an ch`ak`olvazea saubari, - dak`orcinebulisa da dasak`orcineblis ganurch`evlad ch`ak`olvas it`valiscineben. imami abu hanip`a am c`odvas mrushobis msgavsad ar ap`asebs da sxvadasxva kategoriebad qop`s. misi shep`asebit`, es gansxvavebuli danashaulia da shesabamisad, sasjelic` igive ar unda iqos. imam abu hanip`as mixedvit`, sodomuri c`odvis ch`amdenis sasjeli saxelmcip`os kompetenturma pirebma unda gansazg'vron. rac` sheexeba ag'nishnuli c`odvis damtkic`ebas, scavlult`a umravlesobis mixedvit`, rogorc` mrushobis shemt`xvevashi, ak`ac` an piradi ag'iarebit`, an 4 sando mocmis damocmebit` xdeba. ix. dianet`is islamis enc`iklopedia, t. 27, gv. 199.

translations.translation: da (carvgzavnet`) medainis xalxt`an mat`i z'ma shu'aibi, (romelmac`) ut`xra: ei, xalxo ch`emo! t`aqvani ec`it` allahs, ar gagach`niat` mis garda sxva g'vt`aeba. cheshmaritad, t`k`ven miig'et` c`xadi mtkic`ebulebani t`k`veni g'mert`isgan. mash, uert`gulet` sazom-sacons da ar miaklot` xalxs t`aviant`i k`oneba.[1] aseve, nu ecevit` uket`urebas dedamicaze, misi gamoscorebis shemdeg![2] es up`ro sasiket`oa t`k`vent`vis, t`uki t`k`ven xart` morcmuneni.
translations.footnotes:
[1] ibn abbaasma mzomavebs da mconavebs (vachrebs) ut`xra:,,uechvelad, t`k`ven adgaxart` (or) sak`mes, romelmac` t`k`venze cin mqop`i xalxebi dag'upa." (t`irmizi, buiu', 9/1217.)
[2] nu sheec`debit` k`veqnad urcmunoebit`a da urch`obit` uket`urebis t`esvas da cesrigis moshlas, romelic` ukve ganvlilma shuamavlebma da mac`neebma gamoascores.

translations.translation: da ar ch`aujdet` qoveli gzis sat`aveshi, rat`a (ashinebdet` da) abrkolebdet` allahis gzisgan mas, vinc` ircmuna igi da gindat` misi mruded carmoch`ineba.[1] gaixsenet`, rom c`ota iqavit` da man gagamravlat`! mash, shexedet`, t`u rogori iqo uket`urebis mt`esvelt`a bolo!
translations.footnotes: [1] urcmunoebi adamianebs gzaze eg'obebodnen da eubnebodnen, rom shu'aibi matquaraa da ar shegac`dinot`o. ix. t`ap`siru bag'avi.

translations.translation: da t`u t`k`venshi ik`neba jgup`i, romelsac` scams is, rit`ac` var carmogzavnili, da jgup`ic`, romelsac` ar scams, mashin moit`minet` (urcmunoebo ), vidre allahi ar gansjis ch`ven shoris, da is msajult`a shoris sauket`esoa.

t`avisi xalxidan didebulebma, romlebic` medidurobdnen, ut`xres: ei, shu'aib! auc`ileblad gagaz'evebt` ch`veni k`alak`idk`an shen da mat`, vinc` ircmunes shent`an ert`ad an ut`uod dagabrunebt` ch`vens rjulze! man t`k`va: t`undac` rom ar gvindodes?

ut`uod allahis mimart` c`ilis mcamebelni vik`nebit`, t`uki davubrundet` t`k`vens rjuls, mas shemdeg rac` allahma gvixsna misgan. sheuz'lebelia ch`ven mas davubrundet`, garda imisa t`uki ineba allahma, ch`venma g'mert`ma.[1] ch`veni g'mert`i qvelap`ers garemoic`avs c`odnit`.[2] ch`ven allahs mivendet`. g'mert`o ch`veno! ch`vensa da ch`vens xalxs shoris cheshmaritebit` gansaje da shen xar msajult`a sauket`eso!
translations.footnotes:
[1] t`uki allahma ch`vens bediscerashi samomavlod msgavsi ram daushva, romlis shesaxebac` ch`ven cinascari c`odna ar gagvach`nia.
[2] man qvelap`eri ic`is carsulic` da momavalic`. mxolod man ic`is t`u ra mdgomareobashi vik`nebit` momavalshi. ch`ven ki dg'evandeli gadmosaxedidan geubnebit`, rom arasodes mivig'ebt` t`k`vens rjuls, t`undac` rom gvaiz'ulot`.

translations.translation: xolo t`avisi xalxidan didebulebma, romlebmac` ar ircmunes, t`k`ves: vp`ic`avt`, t`uki shu'aibs gahqvebit`, mashin t`k`ven auc`ileblad ik`nebit` cagebulni.
am dros (xmaurianma) micisz'vram sheipqro isini da t`aviant` saxlebshi pirk`ve damxobilni daixoc`nen.
romelt`ac` c`rud sherac`xes shu'aibi, mat` t`it`k`os ik` arasodes uc`xovriat`.[1] romelt`ac` shu'aibi c`rud sherac`xes t`vit`on ag'moch`dnen cagebulni.
translations.footnotes: [1] ise ganadgurdnen da ag'igaven pirisagan micisa, rom mat`i kvalic` ag'ar darch`a.

translations.translation: shemdeg (shu'aibi) ganerida mat`[1] da t`k`va: ei, ch`emo xalxo! vp`ic`av, me t`k`ven gaucqet` ch`emi g'mert`is gzavnilebi da dagariget` t`k`venda sasargeblod, mash rogorg'a unda vcuxde urcmuno xalxze?!
translations.footnotes: [1] mas shemdeg rac` darcmunda rom allahis risxva daimsaxures da axlos iqo misi sasjelis movlineba.

translations.translation: da romelime k`alak`shi ise ar cargvigzavnia mac`ne, rom misi xalxi sirt`ulit`a da zianit` ar shegvepqro,[1] rat`a ik`neb siamaqe daet`mot`.
translations.footnotes: [1] sirt`ule anu gachirveba, ziani anu avadmqop`oba.

translations.translation: shemdeg uket`urebis adgilas siket`e ch`avunac`vlet`,[1] ise rom imates[2] da bolos t`k`ves: ch`vens cinaprebsac` sheexot` chiri da lxini.[3] mere uec`rad (sasjelit`) shevipqarit` isini da t`vit`on azrzec` ar iqvnen
translations.footnotes:
[1] t`avs damtqdari gachirveba da sneuleba, lxinit` shevuc`valet`.
[2] gaumravldat` shvilebi da gaubevrdat` k`oneba.
[3] t`andat`an daivicqes allahis sasjeli. mat`i azrit` is ar iqo allahis sasjeli, aramed is ch`veulebrivi bunebis kanonzomiereba iqo, romelsac` chiric` axlavs da lxinic`.

translations.translation: im k`alak`is mkvidrt` rom ercmunat` da ridi hk`onodat`, ut`uod gavuxsnidit` zec`isa da dedamicis barak`as,[1] magram mat` c`rud sherac`xes[2] da ch`venc` (sasjelit`) shevipqarit` isini, imis gamo rasac` ixvechdnen.
translations.footnotes:
[1] zec`idan cvimas uxv cvimas ch`amovuvlendit` da micidan barak`ian mosavals mivmadlidit`.
[2] shuamavalt`a moz'g'vreba.

translations.translation: nut`u t`avs usap`rt`xo grz'nobdnen im k`alak`t`a mkvidrni, rom g'amit` ar ecevodat` ch`veni risxva, roc`a mat` sz'inavdat`?
an ik`neb t`avs usap`rt`xo grz'nobdnen im k`alak`t`a mkvidrni, rom dilit` ar ecevodat` ch`veni risxva, roc`a isini ert`obodnen?
nut`u t`avs usap`rt`xod grz'nobdnen allahis maxisgan? camxdari xalxis garda allahis maxisgan t`avs usap`rt`xod aravin igrz'nobs.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] aiat`shi xsenebuli maxe gulisxmobs mat` dalxenil da uzrunvelqop`il c`xovrebas, romelmac` gamch`eni daavicqat`. mat` sulac` ar up`ik`riat`, rom es qvelap`eri shesaz'loa gamoc`da qop`iliqo mat`t`vis. isini p`ik`robdnen, rom g'vt`is cinashe gansakut`rebuli pativi hk`ondat` da mitom miec`at` es qvelap`eri. ara da es qvelap`eri mat`t`vis gamosac`delad mic`emuli dro da pativi iqo, romlis ugulebelqop`it`ac` nabij-nabij allahis risxvas uaxlovdebodnen da verc` ki ac`nobierebdnen. islamshi aset` mdgomareobas ist`idraji ecodeba, roc`a adamiani g'vt`is mimart` siurch`is miuxedavad mainc` dalxenilad c`xovrobs am k`veqnad. misi es mdgomareoba imaze kiar miut`it`ebs, rom g'vt`is cinashe dap`asebuli msaxuria, aramed imaze rom g'mert`ma mas garkveuli droit` adrova, rat`a sakut`ari xelit` gamoimushavos up`ro meti sasjeli da up`ro metad dauaxlovdes allahis risxvas.

translations.translation: nut`u kidev ar aris c`xadi imat`t`vis, vinc` cinandel mkvidrt`a (ganadgurebis) shemdeg mkvidroben dedamicas, rom t`uki vinebebt` t`aviant`i c`odvebis gamo mat`ac` (ubedurebebs) shevamt`xvevt`, gulebs davubechdavt` da veg'arap`ers sheismenen?!

ai k`alak`ebi, romelt`a ambebsac` git`xrobt` shen.[1] cheshmaritad, mat`t`an mividnen t`aviant`i shuamavlebi c`xadi mtkic`ebulebit`urt`, t`umc`a isini ar iqvnen imis damjerebelni, rasac` manamde ukve sic`dued miich`nevdnen.[2] amgvarad bechdavs allahi urcmunot`a gulebs.
translations.footnotes:
[1] saubaria zemot` mot`xrobili k`alak`ebis shesaxeb, sadac` c`xovrobdnen nuhis, hudis, salihis, lutis da shu'aibis xalxi.
[2] rac` manamde c`rud sherac`xes mat`ma cinamorbedma, mat` msgavsad urcmuno xalxma.

translations.translation: da ver vpovet` umravles mat`ganshi ag't`k`ma, t`umc`a vnaxet`, rom mat`i umravlesoba iqo ug'irsi.

mere, mat` shemdeg p`araonsa da mis didebulebt`an carvgzavnet` musa aiat`ebit`urt`/sascaulebit`urt`, mat` ki usamart`lod miudgnen mas (aiat`ebs/sascaulebs). mash shexede rogoria uket`urebis mt`esvelt`a bolo.
da ut`xra musam: ei, p`araon! me var var shuamavali, carmogzavnili samqarot`a g'mert`is mier.

ch`emi valia, allahis shesaxeb cheshmaritebis garda arap`eri vt`k`va. cheshmaritad, t`k`vent`an c`xadi mtkic`ebulebit` movedi t`k`veni g'mert`isgan. mash, ch`emt`an ert`ad gamoushvi israelis modgma.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] romlebic` p`araonbis monobashi imqop`ebodnen.

translations.translation: (p`araonma) ut`xra: t`uki sascaulit` xar mosuli, mashin gvach`vene igi - t`uki shen xar mart`alt`agani!
musam daagdo t`avisi joxi da umalve ashkara gvelad ik`c`a.
shemdeg xeli amoig'o (ubidan) da is iqo (elvare) t`et`ri mxedvelt`at`vis.
p`araonis didebulebma t`k`ves: uechvelad, es aris jadok`ari mc`odne.
mas t`k`veni gaz'eveba unda t`k`venive samshoblodan. aba ras mirch`evt`?
ut`xres: sheaqovne is da misi z'ma da k`alak`ebshi (jadok`art`a) shemkrebelni gagzavne.
rat`a moggvaron qvela mc`odne jadok`ari.
p`araont`an jadok`rebi mividnen da ut`xres: uechvelad, didi jildo gvergos t`uki ch`ven ag'movch`ndet` gamarjvebulni!
miugo: diax, t`k`ven ut`uod ik`nebit` daaxloebult`agani.
mat` ut`xres: ei, musa! an shen gadaagde (joxi) an ch`ven vik`nebit` gadamgdebelni.
(musam) ut`xra: gadaagdet`! xolo rodesac` daqares, xalxs t`valebi moujadoves, sheaz'rcunes isini da z'lieri jadosnobit` movidnen.
da zesht`avagonet` musa, rom gadaagde sheni joxi. ai isic` ch`aqlapavs qvelap`ers, rasac` isini mzakvroben.
amgvarad gamoashkaravda cheshmariteba da p`uchad ik`c`a is rasac` isini aket`ebdnen.
ik`ve damarc`xdnen da damc`irebulad gardaik`c`nen.
mashinve daec`nen jadok`rebi sejdes mket`ebelni.
t`k`ves: vircmunet` samqarot`a g'mert`i,
g'mert`i musas da harunisa!

p`araonma t`k`va: nut`u manamde ircmunet` misi vidre me dagrt`avdet` nebas? uechvelad, es aris mzakvroba, romelic` dagegmet` am k`alak`shi, rat`a misgan gaiqvanot` misi mkvidrni, shemdeg gaigebt` (rac` mogelit`).
ut`uod dagachrit` xelebs da p`exebs urt`iert` sapirispirod, shemdeg ki jvarze gagakravt` qvelas.
miuges: cheshmaritad, ch`ven davbrundebit` ch`vensave g'mert`t`an!
mxolod imist`vis gcadia shuriiz'io ch`venze, raki vircmunet` ch`veni g'mert`is sascaulebi, romelic` ch`vent`an movida! g'mert`o, ag'gvavase mot`minebit` da muslimebad/morch`ilebad migvibare!

p`araonis xalxidan didebulebma t`k`ves: nut`u daanebeb musas da mis xalxs, rom uket`ureba t`eson dedamicaze, migatovon shen da sheni g'vt`aebebi?! miugo: davxoc`avt` mat` vazhebs da davzogavt` k`alebs, ch`ven xom mz'leni vart` mat`ze.

ut`xra musam t`avis xalxs: shecevna st`xovet` allahs da mot`mineba gamoich`inet`! cheshmaritad, es k`veqana allahs ekut`vnis da mas umemkvidrebs imas, visac` inebebs t`avis msaxurt`agan, xolo kargi bolo g'vt`ismoshit`at`visaa.

ut`xres: manamdec` vitanjebodit` vidre moxvidodi ch`vent`an da mas shemdegac` rac` shen moxvedi. (musam) ut`xra: ik`neb t`k`venma g'mert`ma moasps mteri t`k`veni da mat` nac`vlad t`k`ven dagamkvidrot` am k`veqnad da dagakvirdet` t`u rogor moik`c`evit`.
da mart`lac` shevipqarit` p`araonis saxleuli mravalcliani gvalvit`a da nakleb mosavlianobit`, ik`neb gaiazron da ar daivicqon.

rodesac` siket`e ecviat`, t`k`ves: es aris ch`vent`vis (romelic` davimsaxuret`), da t`u ubedureba daatqdat`, mashin (am uig'blobas) musas da mast`an ert`ad mqop`ebs miacerdnen. ic`odet` rom, cheshmaritad, mat`i ig'bali allaht`anaa, magram mat`i umravlesoba ar ucqis.
mat` ut`xres: ch`vens mosajadoeblad ramdeni sascaulic` ar unda moitano, ch`ven mainc` ar dagijerebt`!
shemdeg mat`t`an c`alkeul sascaulebad carvgzavnet` g'varc`op`i, kaliebi, mcerebi, baqaqebi da sisxli,[1] magram isini ogamedidurdnen da c`odvil xalxad ik`c`nen.
translations.footnotes: [1] mat` garkveuli periodulobit` t`avs atqdebodat` saxvadasxvagvari sasjeli g'vt`isgan, g'varc`op`ma caleka mat`i sac`xovreblebi, kaliebma gadachames mat`i mosavali, mcerebma dakbines mosaxleoba, baqaqebit` gaivso mat`i churchlebi da sacolebi, sisxli sheeria mat` sasmel cqlebs.

translations.translation: da roc`a t`avs daatqdat` sasjeli, mat` t`k`ves: o, musa! ch`vent`vis sheevedre shens g'mert`s, rac` ag'git`k`va![1] vp`ic`avt`, rom t`uki agvac`ileb am sasjels, ut`uod gircmunebt` da shent`an ert`ad auc`ileblad carmovgzavnit` israelis modgmas.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] rom t`uki movinaniebt` da gircmunebt` sasjels mogvixsnis.
[2] romlebic` ch`vens monobashi imqop`ebian.

translations.translation: magram, rogorc` ki sasjeli vac`ilet`, garkveuli droit` - romelsac` t`vit`onve uaxlovdebodnen[1] - mashinve arg'vevdnen sitqvas.
translations.footnotes: [1] t`aviant`i urcmunoobit`a da arascori sak`c`ielit` uaxlovdebodnen im gadavadebul sasjels, romelic` bolos p`araonisa da misi momxreebis zg'vashi daxrch`obit` dasrulda.

translations.translation: bolos shuri viz'iet` mat`ze da zg'vashi davaxrch`vet` isini, imis gamo rom mat` c`rud sherac`xes ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi da mat` mimart` iqvnen ugulisquroni.

da ch`vens mier daloc`vili k`veqnis ag'mosavlet`isa da dasavlet`is memkvidreebad vak`c`iet` xalxi, romlebic` ich`agrebodnen, amgvarad ag'srulda sheni g'mert`is ket`ili sitqva israelis modgmisadmi, imis gamo rac` moit`mines. xolo davak`c`iet` is qvelap`eri, rasac` aket`ebda p`araoni da misi xalxi da rac` agebdnen.

da israelis modgma zg'vaze gadaviqvanet`. maleve gadaeqarnen xalxs, romlebic` t`aviant` kerpebs et`aqvanebodnen.[1] mat` t`k`ves: ei musa! ch`vent`visac` daadgine g'vt`aebebi, rogori g'vt`aebebic` mat` hqavt`. (musam) ut`xra: uechvelad, t`k`ven xart` xalxi, umec`rad ik`c`evit`.
translations.footnotes: [1] ert`-ert`i gadmoc`emis t`anaxmad, mat` z'roxis kerpebi hk`ondat` gamoz'ercili da imias et`aqvanebodnen.

translations.translation: uechvelad, damg'upvelia igi, rashic` egeni imqop`ebian da p`uchia isic`, rasac` aket`eben.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] damg'upvelia kerpt`aqvanismc`emluri rmena, romelshic` egeni imqop`ebian da p`uchia is g'vt`ismsaxurebac`, romelsac` egeni aket`eben.

translations.translation: (musam) ut`xra: gana allahis garda sxva g'vt`aeba unda vez'io t`k`vent`vis, rodesac` man gamogarch`iat` samqarot`a cinashe?!

aki gixsenit` p`araonis saxleulisgan, romlebic` sastik tanjvas gacevinebdnen, xoc`avden t`k`vens vazhishvilebs da zogavdnen t`k`vens k`alishvilebs, da am qvelap`ershi iqo didi gansac`deli t`k`vent`vis.

da ag'vut`k`vit` musas oc`daat`i g'ame, shemdeg srulvk`menit` igi at`it`;[1] bolos ag'srulda t`avisi g'mert`is mier dadgenili vada ormoc`i g'ame. musam t`avis z'mas, haruns ut`xra:[2] iqavi ch`emi nac`vali ch`ems xalxshi, aseve iqavi moket`e da ar gahqve uket`urebis mt`esvelt`a gzas.
translations.footnotes:
[1] musas ag'vut`k`vit`, rom mt`el am dros sinas mt`aze marxvasa da vedrebashi gaatarebda, bolos ki g'mert`i daelaparakeboda da cignis saxit` gadaec`emoda g'vt`iuri brz'anebebi da akrz'alvebi israelis modgmisat`vis.
[2] sinas mt`aze g'mert`t`an dadebuli ag't`k`mis shesasruleblad casvlis cin.

translations.translation: xolo rodesac` movida musa, ch`vens mier dat`k`muli vadis ag'sasruleblad da mas daelaparaka misi g'mert`i, man t`k`va: g'mert`o damenaxe, rom shemogxedo shen! man ut`xra: (amk`veqnad) verasodes daminaxav me, magram shexede mt`as, t`uki is uz'ravad darch`eba t`avis adgilze, mashin shenc` daminaxav! xolo rogorc` ki misi g'mert`i mt`as gamoec`xada, mashinve mtvrad ak`c`ia igi da musac` ugonod daec`a. rodesac` gons moego, t`k`va: shen qovlad unaklo xar, vinanieb shens cinashe da me var pirveli morcmunet`agani.

(g'mert`ma) ut`xra: ei, musa! uechvelad me shen gamogarch`ie adamiant`a shoris ch`ems mier monichebuli shuamavliri misiit`a da ch`emi sitqvit`, mash aig'e is, rac` shent`vis miboz'ebia da iqav madliert`agani!

ch`ven mas p`ilebze[1] davuceret` qovelgvari rch`eva-darigeba[2] da qvela detali.[3] mash aig'e igi mt`eli seriozulobit` da shens xalxsac` ubrz'ane, sheudges mis sauket`eso p`ormit` ag'srulebas! male gich`venebt` ug'irst`a samqop`els.
translations.footnotes:
[1] es iqo p`ilebi, sadac` dacerili iqo t`evrat`i.
[2] religiuri shegonebani.
[3] amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis, samart`lis, vachrobis da memkvidreobis shesaxeb.

translations.translation: ch`ems aiat`ebs/sascaulebs davashoreb mat`, romelnic` usamart`lod mediduroben dedamicaze, mat` qvela aiat`ic`/sascaulic` rom dainaxon mainc` ar ircmuneben mas, rom dainaxon scori gza, gzad ar daidgenen mas; mrude gzas t`uki naxaven, gzad airch`even mas, imitom rom mat` uarqves ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi da ugulisquroni iqvnen mis mimart`.
xolo romelt`ac` c`rud sherac`xes ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi da shexvedra ukanaskneli,[1] amaod ik`c`a mat`i namok`medari,[2] gana sxva ram miezg'vebat` garda imisa rasac` sch`adiodnen?!
translations.footnotes:
[1] mkvdret`it` ag'dgomda, imk`veqnad g'vt`is ciashe carsdgoma da gankit`xva.
[2] amaoa mat`i namok`medari samadlo sak`meebi, radganac` es qvelap`eri damokidebulia rcmenaze, rcmenis ar k`onis an arascori rcmenis shemt`xvevashi arap`eri ar ik`neba mig'ebuli g'vt`is cinashe.

translations.translation: musas xalxma mis shemdeg,[1] t`aviant`i (ok`ros) samkaulebisgan daidgines xbos sxeuli,[2] romelic` bg'avoda.[3] nut`u ver xedaven, rom mas ar sheuz'lia mat`t`an saubari da verc` cheshmarit gzaze daakvalianebs mat`?! (sat`aqvaneblad) airch`ies igi da iqvnen usamart`loni.[4]
translations.footnotes:
[1] misi mt`aze asvlis shemdeg.
[2] sat`aqvanebeli kerpi.
[3] es iqo usulo sxeuli, romelsac` shignit` k`onda sic`ariele, rodesac` k`ari uberavda z'roxis bg'avilis msgavs xmebs gamosc`emda.
[4] mat` amis c`odna mig'ebuli k`ondat` t`aviant`i shuamavlisgan, rom ert`adert`i allahis garda aravisi t`aqvanisc`ema ar sheiz'leba. mat` amis miuxedavad ver gauz'les c`dunebas, kerpt`aqvanismc`emel xalxs mibaz'es da ik`c`nen usamart`loebad anu urcmunoebad.

translations.translation: xolo roc`a moinanies[1] da naxes rom mart`lac` gzaabnevashi imqop`ebian, t`k`ves: t`u ar shegvicqalebs ch`veni g'mert`i da ar gvapatiebs, ut`uod ch`ven vik`nebit` cagebult`agnni!
translations.footnotes: [1] musas dabrunebis shemdeg.

translations.translation: da rodesac` musa t`avis xalxt`an ganrisxebul-damcuxrebuli dabrunda, t`k`va: ra c`udi nac`vloba gamiciet` ch`ems arqop`ashi! daascarit` t`k`veni g'mert`is brz'anebas ara?![1] am dros man daqara p`ilebi da t`avis z'mas t`avshi scvda, t`avisken ek`ach`eboda. (harunma) ut`xra: dedach`emis z'eo! uechvelad, xalxma me damjabna da is is iqo mklavdnen, amitom mteri ar gaaxaro ch`emze da ug'irs xalxt`a shoris ar ch`amt`valo!
translations.footnotes: [1] ver daelodet` is ag't`k`muli 40 dg'e da ase mokle xanshi kerpi t`anauziaret` mas, vidre t`evrat`is saxit` mis brz'anebebs movitandi t`k`venamde.

translations.translation: (musam) t`k`va: g'mert`o, shemicqale me da ch`emi z'mac` da shegviqvane sheni cqalobis ciag'shi. shen xom mocqalet`a umocqalesi xar!
uechvelad, isini romelt`ac` xbo daidgines (kerpad), t`aviant`i g'mert`isgan shexvdebian risxvas da damc`irebas am k`veqniur c`xovrebashi da amgvarad davsjit` (g'vt`is mimart`) c`ilismcamebelt`.
xolo romelt`ac` uket`urebebi aket`es, mere moinanies mas shemdeg da ircmunes, cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i amis shemdegac` ut`uo mpatiebeli da mocqalea.
da rodesac` musas brazi ch`auc`xra, p`ilebi aig'o.[1] mis ert`-ert` nusxashi iqo cheshmaritebis gzamkvlevi da cqaloba mat`t`vis, romelt`ac` shishi ak`vt` t`aviant`i g'mert`is mimart`.
translations.footnotes: [1] romlebic` brazmoreulobisas daqara.

translations.translation: shemdeg musam ch`vens mier dadgenili droist`vis t`avisi xalxidan samoc`daat`i kac`i amoarch`ia,[1] rodesac` z'lierma rqevam sheipqro isini,[2] (musam) g'ag'ad hqo: g'mert`o, rom geneba mat` ak`amdec` gaanadgurebdi da mec`![3] nut`u gagvanadgureb imis gamo, rac` ch`aidines chkuasustebma ch`vengan? es mxolod gamoc`daa shengan, misit` imas ac`duneb, vist`visac` inebeb da cheshmarit gzaze daakvalianeb mas, vist`visac` gnebavs. shen ch`veni mp`arveli xar, dae gvapatie ch`ven da shegvicqale, shen mpatiebelt`a shoris qvelaze xeiriani xar!
translations.footnotes:
[1] es samoc`daat`i kac`i iqo imat`gan, romlebsac` xbos kerpis mimart` t`aqvanisc`emashi monacileoba ar miug'iat`. allahma moses a ubrz'ana israelis modgmidan amoerch`ie zogiert`ebi, mat`i xalxis carmomadgenlebad, mis mier mit`it`ebul dros sinas mt`aze asuliqvnen da t`aviant`i xalxis saxelit` bodishi moexadat` da sinanuli gamoexatat`. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.
[2] ibni jureijisa da muhammed bin k`a'bis ganmartebit` sinas mt`aze asulebi chek`a-k`uxilma da z'lierma rqevebma sheipqro, radganac` mat` arap`eri moimok`medes, rodesac` mat`ma xalxma xbo daidgines sat`aqvaneblad, arc` boroti dagmes da arc` siket`e moucodes. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.
[3] suddi ganmartavs: am dros musam a daicqo vedreba: g'mert`o ra vut`xra ch`ems xalxs, romlebic` metqvian rom caiqvane ch`vengan rch`euli adamianebi da qvela ert`ianad gaanadgureo? shen rom mat`i ganadgureba geneba, manamde gaanadgurebdi mat` rodesac` isini t`aviant` xalxt`an ert`ad iqvnen da mec` mat`t`an ert`ad viqavio. ix. t`ap`siru taberi.

translations.translation: da amk`veqnad dagvicere siket`e aseve imk`veqnadac`, uechvelad, ch`ven sisanulit` movik`ec`it` shenskn. (g'mert`ma) t`k`va: ch`ems sasjels vacev mas, vist`visac` vinebeb, xolo ch`emi cqaloba (amk`veqnad) garemoic`avs qvelap`ers, xolo mas (imk`veqnda) davucer imat`, romlebic` g'vt`is moshishni arian, zek`at`s gasc`emen da romelt`ac` ch`veni aiat`ebis/sascaulebis scamt`.

romlebic` mihqvebian shuamavals, cera-kit`xvis uc`odinar mac`nes,[1] romelsac` t`avist`an pouloben ch`acerils t`evrat`sa da injilshi,[2] is mat` ubrz'anebs siket`es da ukrz'alav uket`urebas, halalad ucesebs spetaksa da haramad ucesebs ucmindursa, aseve mat` at`avisup`lebs sirt`ulisa da ug'lisgan, romelic` mat` edgat`,[3] da romlebmac` ircmunes misi, daap`ases igi, mxarshi daudgnen da gahqvnen im nat`els, romelic` mast`an ert`ad ch`amoevlina,[4] scored egeni arian gadarch`enilni.
translations.footnotes:
[1] muhammed shuamavali, romelmac` cera-kit`xva ar ic`oda da aranairi ganat`leba ar miug'ia. is ert`-ert` hadisshi ambobs:,,ch`ven gaunat`lebeli sazogadoeba vart`, arc` cera vic`it` da arc` angarishi." (buxari, savm 13/1913.)
[2] 'ata bin iesari gadmogvc`ems: ert`xel 'abdullah bin omars shevxvdi da vut`xari: allahis shuamavlis daxasiat`ebis shesaxeb miambe, romelic` t`evrat`shia ag'cerili. man mit`xra: kargi, allahs vp`ic`avar, rom is t`evrat`shi zogiert`i im t`visebebit`aa daxasiat`ebuli, romlebit`ac` qquranshia. o, mac`neo! uechvelad ch`ven carggzavnet` mocmed, maxaroblad, gamp`rt`xileblad da cera-kit`xvis uc`odinart`a (ug'onot`a) mp`arvelad. shen ch`emi msaxuri xar, amast`anave ch`emi shuamavali, me shen mut`evek`k`ili gicode. is ar aris ukmexi arc` uxeshi, is ar qviris bazrebshi, is borotebas borotebit`ve ar pasuxobs, t`umc`a mimtevebeli da mpatiebelia. allahi manamde ar miibarebs mis suls, vidre misi meshveobit` mrude gzaze mqop` sazogadoebas ar gamoascorebs da ar itqvian, rom ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba garda allahisa. misi meshveobit` gaaxels brma t`valebs, gaxsnis qrut`a smenas da daxshul gulebs. (buxari, buiu' 50/2125.)
[3] sxvadasxva brz'anebebi da akrz'alvebi, romlebic` mat` religiurad k`ondat` dakisrebuli da garkveul sirt`uleebs sheic`avda mat`i dac`va da shesruleba.
[4] qurani.

translations.translation: ut`xari: ei adamianebo! cheshmaritad, me var allahis shuamavali qvela t`k`vengant`an carmogzavnili,[1] romlsac` ekut`vnis c`at`a da dedamicis xelmcip`eba. ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba garda misi, is ac`oc`xlebs da akvdinebs. mash ircmunet` allahi da misi shuamavali, cera-kit`xvis uc`odinari mac`ne, romelsac` t`avadac` scams allahi da misi sitqvebi. mash mihqevit` mas, ik`neb cheshmarit gzas dasdgomodit` t`k`ven.
translations.footnotes: [1] ara mxolod arabebist`vis an romelime konkretuli erist`vis, aramed mt`lianad adamianebist`vis carmogzavnili shuamavali.

translations.translation: aseve musas xalxshic` aris jgup`i, romlebic` (xalxs) cheshmaritebit` akvalianeben da misit` adgenen samart`als.

shemdeg davqavit` isini t`ormet shtod, jgup`ad da zesht`avagonet` musas, rom t`u misi xalxi darcqulebas it`xovs, mashin dahkari kldes sheni joxio, mashinve amoxet`k`a ik`edan t`ormetma cqarom da qvela xalxma ic`oda t`aviant`i sarcqulebeli. mat` aseve g'rublit` movuch`rdilet` mag'lidan da zec`iuri manana[1] da mcqeri ch`amovuvlinet`. miirt`vit` imat`gan, rac` sup`t`aa (halali) da rac` t`k`vent`vis sarch`od gvicqalobebia... ch`ven ki ar mogvk`c`evian usamart`lod, - isini t`aviant` sulebs moek`c`nen usamart`lod.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] originali -,,al-mann" (lmn): k`art`ulshi damkvidrebulia, rogorc` c`iuri manana. mup`essirebi ramdenime gansxvaebul versiaze saubroben, t`u ra igulisxmeba ag'nishnul sitqvashi: a. es aris g'vt`isgan boz'ebuli qvela sakvebis zogadi saxelcodeba, rac` qovelgvari sirt`ulisa da dag'lilobis gareshe moipoveba;b. es iqo t`ap`livit` tkbili sanovage, romelic` xeze moipoveboda; g. cqlit` gazavebuli dasalevi, romelic` t`ap`livit` tkbili iqo.
[2] amdeni siket`is mimart` umadurobit` mxolod sakut`ar t`avs avnes.

translations.translation: aki ut`xres mat`: ic`xovret` am k`alak`shi da miirt`vit` misi ciag'idan, sadac` ra genebot`; da t`k`vit`,,shendoba!"", shedit` (am k`alak`is) karibcheshi k`edmoxrilni - shegindobt` t`k`vens c`odvebs da (cqalobas) gavuzrdit` - sak`mit` ket`ilsa da rcmenit` ihsanis mk`onet`;[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,al-muhsin" (lmHsn): t`it`k`mis qvela t`argmanshi moc`emulia, rogorc` ket`ilismk`mneli. es sitqva carmoebulia,,ihsan" zmnis p`uz'isgan, rac` sak`mis sauket`eso da unaklo p`ormit` shesrulebas nishnavs.,,ihsani" aseve rcmenis gansakut`rebuli xarisxis gamomxatveli terminia. rogorc` jibril mt`avarangelozisa da muhammed shuamavlis dialogidan vgebulobt`,,,ihsani" aris c`xovrebis qvela nabijze iset`i shegnebis shenarch`uneba, t`it`k`os allahs xedavde. ra t`k`ma unda, shen mas ver dainaxav, t`umc`a unda gaxsovdes, rom is shen qovelt`vis gxedavs. quranis bevr aiat`shi,,muhsinebi", anu sak`mit` ket`ili da rcmenit` ihsanis mk`oneni, - k`ebit` moixsenebian.

translations.translation: - magram, romeli mat`ganic` usamart`lobdnen, mat` (ch`ven mier davalebuli) sitqva shec`vales imit`, rac` ar hk`ondat` davalebuli, amitomac` c`idan sasjeli gavgzavnet` mat`ze, vinaidan usamart`lod ik`c`evodnen.

mash zg'vispira k`alak`is shesaxeb hkit`xe mat`, roc`a arg'vevdnen shabat`is zg'vars, aki shabat`obit` t`evzebi cqlis zedapirze amodiodnen; xolo im dg'es, roc`a t`avs ar ikavebdnen - ar amodiodnen. am gvarad vc`didit` mat`, radganac` isini ug'irsad ik`c`evodnen.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] mat` shabat`obit` mushaoba akrz'aluli k`ondat`, t`umc`a t`evzis siuxvis gamo c`dunebas ver uz'lebdnen da arg'vevdnen am cess.

translations.translation: aki mat`gan ert`ma jgup`ma t`k`va: rist`vis sheagonebt` xalxs, romlebic` allahma unda gaanadguros an dasajos sastiki sasjelit`? (meoreebma) t`k`ves: rom gvk`ondes sapatio mizezi t`k`veni g'mert`is cinashe da ik`neb ridi hk`ondet` mat`.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] am aiat`shi quradg'eba gamaxvilebulia qoveli muslimis ert`-ert` mnnishvnelovan pasuxismgeblobaze, romelsac` siket`is mocodeba da borotebis dagmoba ecodeba. muslimi gulgrili ver ik`neba, rodesac` xedavs uket`urebas, is qovelt`vis unda c`dilobdes gamoascoros uket`ureba da xalxi siket`isken daakvalianos, rogorc` brz'anebs muhammed shuamavali:,,romeli t`k`venganic` dainaxavs uket`urebas, man igi gamoascoros sakut`ari xelit`, t`uki ver shez'lebs mashin t`avisi enit`, t`uki amasac` ver shez'lebs mashin gulit` dagmos; es ki rcmenis qvelaze susti gamovlinebaa." (muslim, iman 20/49.)

translations.translation: rogoc` ki daivicqes is rac` ch`aegonat`[1] - gadavarch`inet` isini, romlebic` gmobdnen uket`urebas da sastiki sasjelit` shevipqarit` isini, romlebic` usamart`lod moik`c`nen, radganac` isini ug'irsad ik`c`evodnen.
translations.footnotes: [1] rch`eva-darigeba, romelic` sheic`avda siket`is mocodebas da gmobda uket`urebas.

translations.translation: xolo rodesac` qovelgvar zg'vars gadavidnen, rac` ekrz'alebodat`, ch`ven mat` vut`xarit`: aramzada maimunebad ik`ec`it`!

aki ganac`xada shenma g'mert`ma, rom gankit`xvis dg'emde ut`uod carugzavnida mat`, vinc` sazarel tanjvas agemebinebt`. cheshmaritad, sheni g'meret`i mart`lac` mscrap`lsasjeliania[1] da uechvelad is mart`lac` usazg'vrod mpatiebeli, mcqalobelia.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] urch`t`a mimart`.
[2] monanult`a mimart`.

translations.translation: aseve davqavit` isini t`emebad, mat`gan arian sat`noni da mat`gan arian isinic` vinc` aset`i ar aris, aseve gamovc`adet` isini lxinit`a da chirit`, ik`neb ukumok`c`euliqvnen.

mere mat` shemdeg movida t`aoba, romlebmac` memkvidreobad miig'es cigni,[1] t`umc`a ixvechdnen amk`veqniur siket`eebs carmavalsa, up`asursa[2] da ambobdnen: gvepatieba ch`ven.[3] magram t`uki isev gauch`ndebat` msgavsi carmavali siket`is mopovebis sashualeba, imasac` aig'eben. gana cigniseuli ag't`k`ma ar iqo mat`gan ag'ebuli, rom arap`ers itqodnen allahis shesaxeb, garda cheshmaritebisa da kit`xulobdnen imas, rac` iqo masshi. imk`veqniuri samkvidrebeli umjobesia mat`t`vis, vinc` g'vt`ismoshishia, nut`u gons ar mouxmoben?
translations.footnotes:
[1] t`evrat`i/t`ora.
[2] romelic` aris harami.
[3] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,gonieria is, vinc` sakut`ari t`avi mot`oka da ishroma imist`vis, rac` aris gardac`valebis shemdeg; xolo uniat`oa is, vinc` sakut`ar vnebebs auqva da (gardac`valebis) shemdeg (gadarch`enas) allahisgan moelis." (ibni maje, zuhd 31/4260; t`irmizi, sip`at`u'l-qiamet` 25/2459.)

translations.translation: xolo romelnic` ch`aechidnen cigns da asruleben namazs, cheshmaritad, ch`ven ar davukargavt` jildos, sak`mit` ket`ilsa da rcmenit` ihsanis mk`onet`.

aki, mt`a ag'vmart`et` t`k`vens zemot`, rogorc` sach`rdilobeli, mat` ki egonat` rom t`avs daemxobodat`. (da vut`xarit`:) mt`eli simtkic`it`a da gulisxmierebit` aig'et` is, rac` (t`evrat`is saxit`) gadmogec`it` da gaxsovdet`, rac`aa masshi, - ik`neb ridi gk`ondet`.

aki shenma g'mert`ma adamis z'et`a zurgebidan amoiqvana mat`i sht`amomavlebi da t`aviant`i sulebis shesaxeb daamocmebina:,,gana me ar var t`k`veni g'mert`i?!" (ut`xres:),,ra t`k`ma unda, vamocmebt`!" - rat`a gankit`xvis dg'es ar et`k`vat`, rom uechvelad, ch`ven amis sesaxeb arap`eri vic`odit`o.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] omar bin xattabi gadmogvc`ems rom allahis shuamavals hkit`xes am aiat`is shesaxeb da man ase upasuxa:,,cheshmaritad, allahma adami gaach`ina, shemdeg mas zurgze marjvenat`i sheexo da misgan gamoiqvana sht`amomavalt`a ert`i jgup`i da t`k`va: eseni samot`xisat`vis gavach`ine da samot`xis mkvidrt`at`vis shesap`erisi sak`meebit` dakavdebian. shemdeg isev sheexo mis zurgs da misgan gamoiqana sht`amomavalt`a kidev ert`i jgup`i da t`k`va: eseni c`ec`xlist`vis gavach`ine da c`ec`xlis mkvidrt`at`vis shesap`erisi sak`meebit` dakavdebian." am dros ert`ma kac`ma ikit`xa: o, allahis shuamavalo! mash g'vt`ismsaxureba rist`visaa? allahis shuamavalma upasuxa:,,uchvelad, rodesac` allahi t`avis msaxurs gaach`ens samot`xisat`vis mas samot`xis mkvidrt`at`vis shesap`erisi sak`meebit` asak`mebs, ise rom im sak`mit` gardaic`vleba da misit` sheva samot`xeshi. aseve, rodesac` msaxurs gaach`ens c`ec`xlist`vis, mas c`ec`xlis mkvidrt`at`vis shesap`erisi sak`meebit` asak`mebs, ise rom am sak`mit` gardaic`vleba da misit` sheva c`ec`xlshi." (abu davud, sunnet` 17/4703; t`irmizi, t`ap`siir 8/3075.)

translations.translation: an rom ar get`t`k`vat`: uechvelad, t`avdapirvelad ch`venma cinaprebma t`anauziares,[1] xolo ch`ven mat` shemdgomi t`aoba viqavit`. nut`u gagvanadgureb imis gamo rac` ch`aidines camxdenlebma?
translations.footnotes: [1] allaht`an ert`ad sxva sat`aqvaneblebi daidgines da amgvarad g'vt`ismsaxurebashi g'mert`s moziareebi sheuk`mnes.

translations.translation: ase dacvrilebit` ganvmartavt` aiat`ebs da ik`neb ukumoik`c`nen.
da caukit`xe mat` imis ambavi, visac` ch`veni aiat`ebi vuboz'et` da man ganerida mas, shemdeg satanam gaiqola igi da amgvarad gaxda gzaabneult`agani.

rom gvesurva mas auc`ileeblad avamag'lebdit` misit`,[1] t`umc`a man cut`isop`els ch`aechida da sakut`ar gemovnebas auqva.[2] misi magalit`i z'ag'lis magalit`s hgavs, romelsac` t`ukisgaucqrebi enas agdebs da t`u t`avis nebaze miushveb mainc` enas agdebs; es im xalxis magalit`ia, romlebmac` c`rud sherac`xes ch`veni aiat`ebi.[3] mash uambe es ambebi, ik`neb dap`ik`rdnen isini.
translations.footnotes:
[1] im aiat`ebit` da c`odnit`, rac` mas eboz'a.
[2] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,ori mshieri mgeli, romelic` c`xvris p`arashi seichra - iset` zians ver miaqenebs mat`, ramdenadac` kac`i t`avis rcmenas avnebs k`onebisa da pativis mimart` dauokebeli ltolva." (t`irmizi, zuhd 43/2376.)
[3] sulert`ia mat`t`vis cheshmaritebisken moucodeb t`u ara, mainc` ar ircmuneben da seriozulad ar miudgebian, rom gaiazron.

translations.translation: raoden c`udis magalit`ia xalxi, romlebmac` c`rud sherac`xes ch`vnei aiat`ebi/sascaulebi da (amit`) usamart`lod moek`c`nen sakut`ar sulebs.
visac` allahi daakvalianebs cheshmarit gzaze, isaa cheshmarit gzaze mdgomi; xolo romelt`ac` gzidan aac`dens, scored isini airan cagebulni.

da vp`ic`av, rom ch`ven jojoxet`ist`vis gavach`inet` bevri jint`a da adamiant`agan,[1] mat` ak`vt` gulebi magram ar sheigneben misit`; mat` ak`vt` t`valebi magram ar dainaxaven misit`; mat` ak`vt` qurebi magram ar sheismenen misit`, egeni c`xovelebivit` arian, up`ro metad gzasac`denilnic` ki, scored egeni arian ugulisquroni.
translations.footnotes: [1] morcmunet`a deda 'aisha gadmogvc`ems: ert`xel bavshvi gardaic`vala da mis shesaxeb vt`k`vi: netavi mas, is xom samot`xis ch`itt`agan ert`-ert`i ch`itia. amaze allahis shuamavalma mit`xra: gana ar ic`i, rom allahma samot`xe da jojoxet`i gaach`ina, aseve gaach`ina ert`is mkvidric` da meoresic`? (muslim, qader 6/2662.)

translations.translation: da allahisaa umshvenieresi saxelebi,[1] mash mat`it` evedret` mas da ganeridet` imat` romlebic` mrudoben mis saxelebshi. male daisjebian imis gamo, rasac` sch`adiodnen.
translations.footnotes:
[1] abu hureira gadmogvc`ems, rom mac`nem t`k`va:,,allahs ak`vs ot`xmoc`dac`xrameti saxeli, vinc` mat` daizepirebs is sheva samot`xeshi. cheshmaritad allahi kentia da mas uqvars kenti." (muslim, zik`r ve du'a 2/2677.)
allahis saxelebi quransa da sunnet`shia gadmoc`emuli, romlebic` allahis gac`nobashi gvexmareba da mis unaklo t`visebebs/atributebs gvamc`nobs, rogorebic`aa: mocqale, mcqalobeli, gamch`eni, masazrdoebeli, mimtevebeli, lmobieri, msc`oc`xlebeli da a.sh. misi saxelebis shescavlit` ch`ven vtqobilobt`, rom allahi aris qvelap`ris gamch`eni, misi cqaloba qvelap`ers moic`avs, isaa sarch`os mboz'ebi, mpatiebeli, qovlis mxedveli, qovlis msmeneli da mist`vis sasurveli ramis misive survilisamebr gamch`eni g'mert`i.

translations.translation: da ch`vens k`mnilebat`a shoris aris jgup`i, romlebic` (xalxs) cheshmaritebit` akvalianeben da misit` adgenen samart`als.
xolo romelt`ac` c`rud sherac`xes ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi, nabij-nabij miviqvant` dag'upvamde,[1] ise rom verc`ki gaigon.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,ist`idraj" (stdrj), ch`ven es sitqva aiat`shi vt`argmnet` rogorc` nabij-nabij dag'upvamde miqvana. istqvas lek`sikonuri mnishvnelobaa sap`exur-sap`exur, nabij-nabij svla. rogorc` termini,,ist`idraji" gamoiqeneba im adamianis mdgomareobis gamosaxatad, romelic` urcmunoobis mcvervalze imqop`eba da sxvadasxva carmatebebit` t`u amk`veqniuri siket`eebit` gat`amamebuli, nabij-nabij, sheumch`nevlad ep`loba urcmunoobasa da urch`obashi, rasac` sulierad srul dag'upvamde mihqavs.

translations.translation: da t`anac` vadroveb[1] mat`, uechvelad ch`emi maxe aris mtkic`e.
translations.footnotes: [1] mat` mashinve ar davsjit`, garkveuli droit` vadrovebt`, ris gamoc` kidev up`ro zg'vars gadavlen da ise gaek`anebian damg'upveli shedegisken, rom verc` ki sheamch`neven.

translations.translation: nut`u ar dap`ik`rdebian, rom mat` megobars[1] aranairi sheshliloba ar axasiat`ebs, is mxolod c`xadi gamp`rt`xilebelia.
translations.footnotes: [1] muhammed shuamavals, romelic` mat`i t`anamoz'me, nat`esavi da zogist`vis megobari iqo da qvelam kargad ic`oda rom mas sheshliloba ar axasiat`ebda.

translations.translation: nut`u ar uqureben (mis) xelmcip`ebas zec`asa da dedamicaze da im qvelap`ers, rac` allahma gaach`ina? (ratom ar p`ik`roben) ik`neb mart`lac` moaxloebula mat`i ajali da mis[1] shemdeg romeli sitqva unda ircmunon?
translations.footnotes: [1] quranis shemdeg.

translations.translation: visac` allahi aac`dens, aravinaa misi damkvalianebeli da miatovebs t`aviant` zg'vargadasulobashi, t`avgzaabneulebs.

gekit`xebian shen k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis saat`is shesaxeb, rodis moxdeba igio. ut`xari: cheshmaritad, misi c`odna ch`ems g'mert`t`anaa. mis garda veravin ganac`xadebs mis dros. mz'imea igi c`at`a shina da dedamicaze. uec`rad gecevat` igi t`k`ven. ise gekit`xebian t`it`k`os ic`ode mis shesaxeb. ut`xari: cheshmaritad, misi c`odna allaht`anaa, t`umc`a xalxis umravlesobam ar ic`is.

ut`xari: sakut`ari t`avist`vis arc` sargebels vp`lob da arc` siaves, garda imisa rac` ineba allahma. uxilavi rom mc`odnoda auc`ileblad movimravlebdi sargebels da verc` usiamovneba shemexeboda. uechvelad, me mxolod gamp`rt`xilebeli da maxarobeli var morcmune xalxist`vis.

igia romelmac` gagach`inat` ert`i sulisgan da misgan shek`mna misi c`oli, rat`a mshvidad t`anaec`xovra mast`an. xolo rodesac` (kac`i) daeup`la mas, msubuk`i tvirt`i itvirt`a k`alma,[1] ase atara igi garkveuli droit`, xolo rodesac` damz'imda,[2] orivem t`aviant` g'mert`s, allahs sheevedra: t`uki gviboz'eb sat`nos, ch`ven ut`uod vik`nebit` madliert`agani!
translations.footnotes:
[1] muc`lad iqo naqop`i, romelic` t`avdapirvelad msubuk`i da sheumch`neveli iqo.
[2] rodesac` mshobiaroba moaxlovda da p`exmz'imoba sruli simz'imit` sheigrz'no.

translations.translation: xolo roc`a mat` sat`no (shvili) uboz'a, mat` t`anamoziareebi sheuk`mnes (g'mert`s) imit` rac` mat` uboz'a, t`umc`a allahi mag'alia imaze, rasac` mas t`anauziareben.
nut`u (g'mert`s) t`anauziareben imas, rac` verap`ers ach`ens, xolo t`vit`n k`mnilebebi arian
da arc` mat`i daxmareba sheuz'liat` da verc` sakut`ar t`avs sheecevian.
t`uki cheshmariti gzisken mouxmobt` mat`, isini ar gamogqvebian, t`k`vent`vis sulert`ia mat` moucodebt` t`u mdumareni ik`nebit`.
uechvelad, t`k`vennairi mona-msaxurebi/k`mnilebebi arian, isini romlebsac` allahis nac`vlad evedrebit`, mash mouxmet` mat` dae gipasuxon t`uki t`k`ven xart` namdvilad gulcrp`elni!

gana mat` ak`vt` p`exebi, romlit`ac` dadian? an mat` ak`vt` xelebi, rit`ac` icheren? an mat` ak`vt` t`valebi, romlit`ac` xedaven? an mat` ak`vt` qurebi romlit`ac` ismenen? ut`xari: mouxmet` t`k`vens t`anaziarebs,[1] shemdeg ki maxe damiget` da arc` damac`adot`!
translations.footnotes: [1] romlebsac` allahs t`anauziarebt`.

translations.translation: uechvelad, ch`emi shemcea allahi, romelmac` cigni ch`amoavlina da is sat`not`a mp`arvelia.
xolo imat`, visac`/rasac` mis garda evedrebit`, mat` t`k`veni daxmareba ar sheuz'liat` da arc` sakut`ari t`avis daxmareba z'aluz't`.
t`uki cheshmariti gzisken mouxmobt` mat`, isini ar sheismenen da xedav rom shemogqureben magram ver gxedaven.
(o, shuamavalo!) mpatiebloba airch`ie, siket`e moucode da ganeride umec`rebs![1]
translations.footnotes: [1] rodesac` morcmunet`a dedas 'aishas shuamavlis moralis shesaxeb kit`xes, man ase daaxasiat`a:,,is ar iqo uxeshi da arc` ukmexi, is ar qviroda bazrebshi, borotebas borotebit`ve ar pasuxobda, aramed iqo mpatiebeli da toleranti." (t`irmizi, birr 69/2016.)

translations.translation: da t`uki satanam c`dunebisken gibiz'gos, t`avi allahs sheap`are, cheshmaritad is qovlis msmeni da mc`odnea.
uechvelad imat`, romelt`ac` g'vt`is ridi ak`vt`, rodesac` satanis sac`duri exebat`, umalve ixsenebn (g'mert`is brz'anebebsa da akrz'alvebs) da mashinve it`valiscineben.
xolo mat` z'mebs isini (satanebi) zg'vargadasulobashi ek`ach`ebian, shemdeg arc`ki moeshvebian.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] k`elbi ganmartavs, rom qvela urcmunos satanebisgan ert`i megobari hqavs, romelic` t`avs ar anebebs da qovelt`vis c`odvis morevshi miat`revs mas. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: da t`u ver miutan (mat`t`vis sasurvel) aiat`s/sascauls, getqvian: netav shen t`vit`on sheget`xza. ut`xari: uechvelad, me mxolod imas mivqvebi, rac` zemomevlina ch`emi g'mert`isgan.[1] esaa t`valsach`ino mtkic`ebulebebi t`k`veni g'mert`isgan, cheshmariti gza da cqaloba morcmune xalxist`vis.
translations.footnotes: [1] k`elbi ganmartavs: mek`k`eli carmart`ebi droda da dro shuamavalt`an midiodnen da garkveul kit`xvebs usvamdnen an sascaulebis moxdenas st`xovdnen, ara imist`vis rom ercmunat`, aramed imist`vis rom shuamavali uxerxul situac`iashi ch`aeqenebinat`. t`uki sascauli an aiat`i daigvianebda damc`inavad eubnebodnen netav shent`vit`on sheget`xzao. amaze ch`amoevlina es aiat`i, romelic` mat` pasuxobs, rom shuamavali mxolod imis mixedvit` mok`medebs, ra gamoc`xadebasac` miig'ebda samqarot`a g'mert`isgan. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: da roc`a ikit`xeba qqurani, quri ugdet` mas da gach`umdit`, ik`neb shecqalebuliqavit`.
dilt`a da sag'amot`i gulshi axsene sheni g'mert`i mokrz'alebit`a da shishit`, xmamag'ali sitqvis gareshe da ar iqo ugulisqurot`agani.
cheshmaritad, isini, romelnic` shens g'mert`t`an imqop`ebian,[1] ar t`akiloben misdami t`aqvanisc`emas da mis unakloebas g'ag'adeben, aseve sejdeze emxobian mist`vis.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] angelozebi.
[2] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,cheshmaritad, shens mier shesrulebul qoveli sejdes meshveobit` allahi agamag'lebs da qovel t`it`o c`odvas gapatiebs." (ibni maje, iqamet`u salat` 201/1422.)

translations.translation: gekit`xebian shen alap`is shesaxeb,[1] ut`xari: allahi allahis da misi shuamavlisaa.[2] mash ridi gk`ondet` allahis da gamoascoret` t`k`vens shoris arsebuli ut`anxmoebebi, daemorch`ilet` allahs da mis shuamavals t`uki t`k`ven xart` morcmuneni.[3]
translations.footnotes:
[1] hijret`is meore cels muslimebsa da mek`k`el carmart`ebs shoris gaimart`a bediris brz'ola. bediris brz'ola muslimebist`vis pirveli brz'ola iqo da misi carmatebit` dasrulebis shemdeg mebrz'olebs gauch`ndat` kit`xvebi t`u rogor unda gaeqot` am brz'olashi mopovebuli nadavli.
[2] alap`i allahisa da misi shuamavlis gankargulebashia da mat`i mit`it`ebis shesabamisad unda gaiqot`. alap`is gaqop`ast`an dakavshirebit` detaluri inp`ormac`ia amave suras 41-e aiat`shia ganmartebuli.
[3] ramet`u morch`ilebisken mogicodebt`.

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, (namdvili) morcmuneebi isini arian, romlebsac` allahis xsenebaze gulebi ut`rt`it`, xolo rodesac` mis aiat`ebs ukit`xaven rcmena ematebat` da t`aviant` g'mert`s miendobian,
romlebic` namazs ag'asruleben da gaig'eben[1] imas, rac` vucqalobet` sazrdod,
translations.footnotes: [1] g'vt`ivsat`nod.

translations.translation: scored egeni arian namdvili morcmuneebi, mat`t`visaa sxvadasxva xarisxis sap`exurebi t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe aseve aris usazg'vro patieba da uxvi sarch`o.
iseve rogorc`[1] shenma g'mert`ma simart`lit` gamogiqvana sheni saxlidan[2] da morcmunet`a nacils es mart`lac` ar mosconda.
translations.footnotes:
[1] zogiert`ebi iset`ive ukmaqop`ilebas avlens bediris brz'olashi monapovari nadavlis gaqop`is sak`meshi da uadgilo pretenziebit` gamodian, rogorc` dasacqisshi ar undodat` bedirshi carmart`ebt`an shexvedra da mat`t`an sherkineba. magram rogorc` xedav saboloo shedegit`a anu gamarjvebit`a da g'vt`is shecevnit` qvela kmaqop`ilia. g'mert`ma ic`is, magram t`k`ven ar ic`it`, sabolood ras moqveba t`k`vent`vis uket`esi shedegi, amitomdaemorch`ilet` g'vt`is nebas.
[2] bedirshi carmart`ebt`an dasaxvedrad.

translations.translation: gekamat`ebian im cheshmaritebis shesaxeb rac` ukve gac`xadda,[1] t`it`k`os sikvdilze mierekebian da t`vit`on amas uqureben.
translations.footnotes: [1] rom mat`t`an brz'ola aris gardauvali.

translations.translation: aki allahi gpirdebodat`, rom ori razmidan ert`-ert`i t`k`veni ik`neboda[1] da t`k`ven gindodat` rom sheuiarag'ebeli[2] qop`iliqo t`k`veni, t`umc`a allahs t`avisi sitqvebit`[3] cheshmaritebis ag'sruleba da urcmunot`a ukanasknelamde amoz'irkva undoda.
translations.footnotes:
[1] qureisheli carmart`ebi muslimebs imdenad avicroebdnen, rom shuamavali iz'ulebili gaxda t`anamorcmuneebt`an ert`ad medinashi gadasaxlebuliqo, t`umc`a am gadasaxlebidan anu hijret`idan ori clis shemdegac` carmart`ebi muslimebs mosvenebas ar az'levdnen. mat` miitac`es muslimt`a ak`lemebi, romlebic` medinas maxloblad balaxobdnen. medinas liderebs cerdnen, rom muhammedi moeklat` an medinadan gaez'evebinat`, cinaag'mdeg shemt`xvevashi isini t`avs daesxnen medinas. meore mxriv, damaskoshi didi savachro k`aravani gagzavnes, romelic` medinashi gaxiznul muslimt`a k`onebasac` sheic`avda da misit` muslimta cinaag'mdeg mebrz'oli jaris ag'churvas apirebdnen. muslimebi am sap`rt`xis mimart` unda qop`iliqvnen p`xizlad da raime zomebi mieg'es. allahis shuamavalma damaskodan momavali savachro k`aravnis dabrkoleba gadacqvita. ag'nishnuli miznis gansaxorc`ieleblad 305 kac`ian jart`an ert`ad, abu sup`ianis t`anxlebit` damaskodan momavali k`aravnis dasaxvedrad gavida. rodesac` es ambavi qureishelma carmart`ebma gaiges, mat`ac` 950 kac`iani lashk`rit` medinas mimart`ulebit` daiz'rnen. muslimebi medinadan ara sabrz'olvelad aramed ag'nishnuli k`aravnis dasabrkoleblad da carmart`t`a gegmebis ch`asashlelad cavidnen. t`umc`a mogvianebit` sheitqves, rom muslimt`a cinaag'mdeg sabrz'olvelad mek`k`adan carmart`t`a jari moemart`eboda. muslimt`a nacils carmart`ebt`an brz'olis survili ar k`onda, magram shuamavalma sahabeebt`an msjelobis shemdeg carmart`ebt`an sherkineba gadacqvita. g'mert`is shecevnit` muslimebma mat`ze samjer mag'al ric`xovani jari daamarc`xes. es ambavi hijret`is meore cels istoriashi bediris brz'olad aris c`nobili, igi hijret`is meore cels 17 ramadans (13 marti 624 c.) moxda. detaluri inp`ormac`iist`vis ixilet` islamis istoria, bediris brz'ola.
[2] savachro k`aravani.
[3] sitqvebit`, romelic` t`k`vent`vis qqureishel carmart`ebt`an sherkinebis brz'anebas sheic`avda.

translations.translation: rat`a ag'sruldes cheshmariteba da dasruldes sic`rue, t`undac` rom c`odvilebs ar moscondet`.
aki (bedirshi) daxmarebas evedrebodit` t`k`vens g'mert`s[1] da man gipasuxat`, rom me var t`k`veni damxmare ert`manet`ze miqolebuli at`asi angelozit`o.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] omar bin xattabma gviambo: allahis mac`nem bediris dg'es carmart`t`a razms shexeda da naxa rom isini iqvnen at`asi kac`i, xolo misi sahabeebis raodenoba samas kac`s ramdenime at`eulit` ag'emateboda. allahis mac`ne qiblasken mibrunda, xelebi mag'la ag'apqro da g'mert`s vedreba daucqo:,,g'mert`o ch`emo, ag'asrule is rac` ag'mit`k`vi! g'mert`o ch`emo, momec`i is, rac` dampirdi! g'mert`o ch`emo, t`u am ert` mucha islamis mimdevrebs gaanadgureb dedamicaze sheni mot`aqvane ag'aravin darch`eba!" g'mert`s qiblisken mibrunebuli da xeleb apqrobili imdenxans evedreboda, rom mxrebidan mosasxami ch`amouvarda. shemdeg abu bek`iri eaxla, mosasxami aig'o da isev mxrebze moasxa, mis ukan mdgomma ut`xra: o, allahis mac`nev! g'mert`t`an amdeni vedreba geqop`a, uechvelad allahi mogc`ems imas, rac` dagpirda. amaze uzenaesma allahma es aiat`i ch`amoavlina. (t`irmizi, t`ap`siir 9/3081.)
[2] aseve ixilet` sura ali 'imranis 123-125 aiat`ebi.

translations.translation: allahs es (shecevna) sxva arap`rist`vi daudgenia t`u ara xarebad, aseve rom dajerebuli misit` t`k`veni gulebi. ar arsebobs daxmareba garda allahis mxridan. cheshmaritad, allahi uz'levelia brz'enia.

aki misi ciag'idan t`vlema moggvarat` simshvided[1] da zec`idan t`k`venze cqals avlenda, rat`a ganecmindet` misit`, sataniseuli sibinz'ure[2] ch`amoec`ilebina t`k`vengan da gaemqarebina t`k`veni gulebi, aseve misit` (t`k`vent`vis) p`exebi rom ganemtkic`ebina.[3]
translations.footnotes:
[1] normalur vit`arebashi aset` dros adamians t`vlema ar moereva, magram es iqo im simshvidisa da usap`rt`xoebis ganc`dis gamovlineba, rac` allahma mat` gulebs miuvlina.
[2] satanis ch`urch`uli mat`i gulebis mimart`, romelic` mat` shishsa da orchop`s uch`enda.
[3] mtkic`ed da mamac`ad rom mdgariqavit` mtris cinashe.

translations.translation: aki sheni g'mert`i sht`aagonebda angelozebs, rom me t`k`vent`an var, mash ganamtkic`et` isini, romelt`ac` ircmunes, me shishs ch`avunergav gulebshi imat`, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes, mash dahkarit` kisrebze da urtqit` t`it`is cverebzeo.
es qvelap`eri iman gamoicvia, rom mat` eurch`nen allahsa da mis shuamavals. xolo vinc` eurch`os allahsa da mis shuamavals, uechvelad allahismkac`rsasjeliania.
amgvaria t`k`veni sasjeli,[1] mash igemet` igi da ic`odet` rom urcmunoebs c`ec`xlis sasjeli elit`.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] amgvaria t`k`veni amk`veqniuri sasjeli, marc`xi, sikvdili da tqved ch`avardna.
[2] mat` aseve imk`veqnadac` elit` sasjeli jojoxet`is c`ec`xlshi.

translations.translation: hei t`k`ven morcmuneebo! roc`a shexvdebit` mcqobrad mosul razms, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes, mat` zurgi ar ak`c`iot`![1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ar sheushindet` da brz'olis velidan ar gaik`c`et`!

translations.translation: vinc` aset` dg'es mat` zurgs sheak`c`evs - garda sabrz'olo tak`tikis shemc`vlelis[1] an sxva razmt`an shesaert`eblad camsvlelisa[2] - man allahis risxva mart`lac` daimsaxura da jojoxet`ia misi samqop`eli, ra c`udi samqop`elia mat`i saboloo misak`c`ieli.
translations.footnotes:
[1] romelmac` ukan daxevit` mteri shec`domashi sheiqvana, sabrz'olo strategie shec`vala da axali sheteva camoicqo.
[2] romelic` muslimt`a sxva razmt`an shesaert`eblad gavida brz'olis velidan.

translations.translation: t`k`ven ar xoc`avdit` mat`, aramed allahma daxoc`a isini[1] da arc` shen ar gisvria (shuamavalo), roc`a isvrodi,[2] aramed allahma esrola, rat`a gamoec`ada morcmuneebi kargi gamoc`dit`.[3] cheshmaritad, allahi qovlis msmeni da mc`odnea.
translations.footnotes:
[1] mujahidi am aiat`is ch`amovlinebis mizezs shemdeg ambavs ukavshirebs: bediris brz'olis dasrulebis shemdeg morcmunet`agan zogiert`ebma ukan mimaval gzaze trabaxi daicqes, ert`ma t`k`va me esa da es movkali, meorem t`k`va me mavani movkalio da amaze uzenaesma allahma es aiat`i ch`amoavlina, rom t`k`ven t`k`veni z'alit` da moxerxebit` ar dagixoc`avt` isini, aramed allahma daxoc`a, rodesac` shegeciat`, g'one gicqalobat` da angelozebi carmogigzavnat`. ix. suiuti, durru'l-mansuur.
[2] allahis shuamavalma bediris brz'olis dacqebamde ert`i mucha k`visha aig'o da qureishelt`a razmis mimart`ulebit` isrola. carmart`t`a razmidan ar darch`enila ert`i mebrz'olic`, rom am k`vishidan mis t`valshi, c`xvirshi an qurshi rame ar moxvedriliqo. scored amaze miut`it`ebs aiat`i, rom normalur pirobebshi sheuz'lebelia ert`i mucha k`visha mt`eli jaris qvela cevramde miscvdes, magram allahma miacvdina da amit` carmart`eb shishi da uimedoba ch`augdo gulebshi, rac` mat`i marc`xis ert`-ert`i mizezi gaxda. ix. sirat`u ibni hisham, 1/116.
[3] allahis gamoc`da rogorc` sheiz'leba iqos sirt`uleebst`a da gansac`delit` aseve shesaz'lebelia iqos siket`is cqalobit`a da carmatebit`. am shemt`xvevashi daxasiat`ebulia rogorc` kargi gamoc`da, radganac` mat` allahisgan cqalobad miig'es daxmareba, gamarjveba, nadavli da tqveebi carmart`t`a razmidan. gamoc`da imashi mdgomareobs t`u ramdenad gaac`nobiereben im cqalobas, romelmac` g'mert`ma moig'o mat`ze da ramdenad madlierni ik`nebian mis mimart`.

translations.translation: asea radganac` allahi uechvelad amaod mk`mnelia urcmunot`a xrikebis.

t`u gamarjvebas it`xovt`, t`k`vent`an mart`lac` movida gamarjveba,[1] t`uki moeshvebit` eg uket`esia t`k`vent`vis,[2] xolo t`u dabrundebit` ch`venc` davbrundebit`[3] da versa gargebt` t`k`veni razmi t`undac` rom iqos mravalric`xovani. cheshmaritad allahi morcmuneebt`an ert`adaa.[4]
translations.footnotes:
[1] mimart`va exeba carmart`ebs, romlebic` brz'olis cin g'mert`s st`xovdnen rom uket`urebis mt`esveli daesaja da samart`als ezeima. gadmoc`emis mixedvit` bediris dg'es abu jehilma brz'olis cin shemdegi vedreba carmot`k`va: g'mert`o gaanadgure is, vinc` daaeg'via nat`esavuri kavshirebi da movida iset`i moz'g'vrebit`, rac` ch`vent`vis uc`nobi da miug'ebelia. (ix. sirat`u ibni hisham, 1/628.) mas am sitqvebit` sakut`ari t`avis cinaag'mdeg gamouvida gamarjvebis t`xovna, radganac` samart`ali mashin izeimebda t`u qureishelt`a razmi marc`xs ganic`dida da gamarjveba muslimt`a sasargeblod ik`neboda.
[2] t`u moeshvebit` urcmunoebas da muslimt`a mimart` mtrobas.
[3] t`uki isev daubrundebit` muslimt`a mimart` mtrobas da devnas, ch`venc` dagibrundebit` muslimt`a samart`liani gamarjvebit` da t`k`veni damamc`irebeli marc`xit`.
[4] allahi mrocmuneebt`an ert`adaa t`avisi shecevnit`, smenit`, xedvit`, c`odnit` da gamarjvebit`.

translations.translation: hei t`k`ven morcmuneebo! daemorch`ilet` allahs da mis shuamavals da piri ar ibrunot` misgan, roc`a t`k`ven isment`![1]
translations.footnotes: [1] roc`a t`k`ven isment` qurans, shuamavlis darigebebs, ar ugulebelqot` es qvelap`eri da misi brz'anebebis an akrz'alvebis sapirispirod mok`medebit` misgan piri ar ibrunot`.

translations.translation: da nu ik`nebit` imat` msgavsi, vinc` t`k`ves gvesmiso, t`umc`a mat` ar sheismines.
uechvelad, allahis cinashe suliert`a shoris qvelaze saz'raxisni arian qruni[1] da munjni,[2] romlebic` ver azrovneben.
translations.footnotes:
[1] romlebsac` qurebi daxshuli ak`vt` cheshmaritebis mimart`.
[2] romlebsac` ena dabmuli ak`vt` cheshmaritebis mimart`.

translations.translation: allahs mat`shi mc`iredi xeiris natamalic` rom enaxa, auc`ileblad sheasmenda, magram isini mainc` pirs ibrunebdnen da ik`nebodnen zurgshek`c`eulni.

hei t`k`ven morcmuneebo! morch`ilebit` upasuxet` allahsa da shuamavals, rodesac` mogicodebt` imisken, rac` t`k`ven sic`oc`xles ganichebt`![1] aseve ic`odet`, rom allahi shedis kac`sa da mis guls shoris[2] da ic`odet`, rom mis cinashe ik`nebit` shekrebilni.
translations.footnotes:
[1] allahisa da misi shuamavlis mocodebebis gat`valiscineba adamians amk`veqnad shergebul sic`oc`xles, xolo imk`veqnad maradiul sic`oc`xles anichebs.
[2] allahi ganagebs t`k`vens gulebs, man ic`is t`k`vens gulebshi arsebuli zraxvebi da rcmenis xarisxi. enes bin malik`i gadmogvc`ems, rom allahis shuamavali xshirad imeorebda shemdeg sitqvebs:,,o, gulebze mimart`ulebis mimc`emo! ch`emi guli shens rjulze ganamtkic`e. mas hkit`xes: o, allahis shuamavalo! ch`ven gvcams sheni da im qvelap`risa, rit`ac` shen moxvedi. amis miuxedavad ch`venze shishob? man ut`xra: diax. uechvelad, gulebi allahis t`it`ebidan or t`it`s shoris imqop`eba da sait`ac` is moisurvebs ik`et` miabrunebs." (t`irmizi, qader 7/2140.)

translations.translation: geshinodet` gansac`delisa, romelic` mxolod imat` ar sheexebat`, romeli t`k`venganic` usamart`lod moik`c`nen,[1] aseve ic`odet`, rom allahi mkac`rsasjeliania.
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,romeli t`k`venganic` dainaxavs uket`urebas, man igi gamoascoros sakut`ari xelit`, t`uki ver shez'lebs mashin t`avisi enit`, t`uki amasac` ver shez'lebs mashin gulit` dagmos; es ki rcmenis qvelaze susti gamovlinebaa." (muslim, iman 20/49.),,uechvelad, rodesac` xalxi xedaven usamart`lo mch`agvrels da xels ar ushlian mas, z'alian advili shesaz'lebelia, rom allahma qvela mat`ganze ganavrc`os amis sasjeli." (t`irmizi, p`it`en 8/2168.),,vp`ic`av mas visac` mas visac` xelt` upqria ch`emi sic`oc`xle, rom an siket`es moucodebt` da borotebas dagmobt` an ara da mosalodnelia allahma sasjeli mogivlot`. shemdeg mas daucqebt` vedrebas, magram t`k`veni vereba ag'ar miig'eba." (t`irmizi, p`it`en 9/2169.)

translations.translation: mash gaixsenet` roc`a k`veqnad (mek`k`ashi) iqavit` c`otani da ch`agrulni, geshinodat` rom (urcmuno) xalxis xelshi ar ch`avardniliqavit`, (aset` dros) man shegip`arat` (medinashi) da misi daxmarebit` zurgi gagimagrat` (bedirshi), aseve sxvadasxva siket`eebi gicqalobat`, ik`neb madlierni qop`iliqavit`.
hei t`k`ven morcmuneebo! shegnebulad ar ug'alatot` allahs da shuamavals da arc` t`k`vendami mondobil anabars![1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ak` anabarshi rogorc` nvt`ieri anabari aseve gandobili saidumloc` igulisxmeba. zuhri da k`elbi gadmogvc`emen, rom es aiat`i ch`amoevlina abu lubabe harun bin abdulmunizr al-ansaris shesaxeb. allahis shuamavals beni quraizas gvaris ebraelebi 21 g'amis ganmavlobashi alqashi qavda mok`c`euli. alqashi mok`c`eulebma allahis shuamavals sheut`vales, rom t`anaxma iqvnen igive pirobebze, ra pirobebit`ac` beni nadris ebraelebs sheut`anxmda. isini damaskos mimart`ulebit` ezra'at`sa da erihashi gadaasaxles. allahis shuamavalma mat` sheut`vala, rom mxolod sa'd bin muazis mier mig'ebul gadacqvetilebas dat`anxmebuliqvnen, t`umc`a mat` amas ar dat`anxmdnen da mat`t`an mosalaparakeblad abu lubabe bin abdulmunziris gagzavna it`xoves, radganac` mas mat`t`an kargi urt`iert`oba k`onda. abu lubabes mat`t`an kargi urt`iert`obis mizezi, is iqo rom misi k`onebac` da shvilebic` mat`t`an imqop`eboda. allahis shuamavalma mis gagzavnas dat`anxmda. rodesac` abu lubabe mat`t`an mivida mat` kit`xes: o, abu lubabe, ras gvirch`ev sa'd bin muazis mier mig'ebul gadacqvetilebas davt`anxmdet`? abu lubabem xelit` qeli mianishna anu mis mier mig'ebuli gadacqvetileba t`k`veni sikvdilit` dasja ik`nebao. anu mat` mianishna, rom am shemot`avazebas ar dat`anxmebuliqvnen. abu lubabem t`k`va: allahs vp`ic`avar, es rom gavaket`e, jer kidev ert`i nabijic` ar gadamedga, mashinve gavac`nobiere, rom me amit` allahsa da mis shuamavals vug'alate. shemdeg abu lubabe mitrialda da cavida, t`umc`a allahis shuamavalt`an ag'ar misula da mech`et`shi ert`-ert` boz'ze sakut`ari t`avi t`avisive xelit` miaba da t`k`va: allahs vp`ic`avar rom sikvdilamde arap`ers shevcham an vidre allahisar mapatiebs. rodesac` misi ambavi allahis shuamavalt`an miag'cia shuamavalma t`k`va:,,pirdapir ch`emt`an rom mosuliqo misi patiebist`vis viloc`ebdi, magram axla vidre allahi ar apatiebs me arap`ris gaket`eba ar shemiz'lia." abu lubabes shvidi dg'is ganmavlobashi arc` uchamia da arc` usmia. shemdeg goni dakarga da bolos allahma apatia. rodesac` mas ut`xres, rom ukve gepatiao, misi pasuxi aset`i iqo: ara, vidre allahis shuamavali ar mova da ar amishvebs me ch`ems t`avs ar avushveb. shemdeg allahis shuamavali mivida da t`avisi xelit` aushva. shemdeg abu lubabem allahis shuamavals ut`xra: o, allahis shuamavalo! ch`emi sinanulis srulqop`isat`vis minda mivatovo is mamapapuri mica, romelzec` es c`odva ch`avidine da sxvagan gadavsaxlde, aseve mt`eli ch`emi k`oneba unda movishoro anu mocqalebad davarigoo. allahis shuamavalma mas ut`xra, rom amisat`vis k`onebis ert`i mesamedis gag'eba sakmarisi ik`neboda. ix. t`ap`siiru beg'avi.

translations.translation: da ic`odet`, rom t`k`veni k`oneba da shvilebi sac`duria,[1] aseve ic`odet`, rom allahis cinashea udidesi jildo![2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] allahi gc`dit` mat`it`, mat`i siqvaruli gz'levt` t`u allahis morch`ileba.
[2] amk`veqniuri carmavali k`onebisa da shvilebis c`dunebam ar dagakargvinos is udidesi da maradiuli jildo, romelic` allahis cinashea.

translations.translation: hei t`k`ven morcmuneebo! t`uki allahis ridi gek`nebat`, chemaritebisa da mc`daris ganmasxvavebeli nichit` dagajildovebt`, dagip`aravs t`k`vens uket`urobebs da mogitevebt` t`k`ven. allahia mp`lobeli udidesi cqalobisa.

aki mzakvrulad maxes gigebdnen isini, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes, rom sheeboche an moekali an gaez'evebine (mek`k`adan). maxes agebdnen isini, aseve maxes agebda allahic` da allahi qvelaze kargi maxis damgebia.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] rodesac` muhammed shuamavlis moz'g'vrebas dg'it`i dg'e up`ro meti adamiani g'ebulobda da qureisheli carmart`ebi amas cin veg'ar udgebodnen, sheikribnen qureishelt`a qvela gvaris carmomadgenlebi da islamis gavrc`elebis ag'sakvet`ad sxvadasxva gegmebis ganxilvas sheudgnen. isini msjelobdnen shuamavali muhammedi sheepqrot` da daepatimrebines, moekles t`u k`alak`idan gaez'evebines. allahma mat`i mzakvruli gegmebis shesaxeb shuamavals ac`noba da g'amit` abu bek`irt`an ert`ad medinasken hijret`is gzas gaudga. mdevarist`vis kvalis asabnevad da medinashi usap`rt`xod ch`asasvlelad jer sevris mt`aze ert`-ert` gamok`vabuls sheap`ares t`avi, sadac` sami dg'e dahqves da shemdeg medinashi ch`avidnen. ix. ibni ishaq, 380-484. rogorc` aiat`shia nat`k`vami carmart`ebi shuamavlis cinaag'mdeg mzakvrul gegmebs acqobdnen, magram allahsac` k`onda t`avisi gegma, romelsac` veravin ajobebs.

translations.translation: da rodesac` mat` ukit`xaven ch`vens aiat`ebs, isini amboben: (msgavsi) adrec` mogvismenia, rom mogvendomebina ut`uod shevt`xzavdit` amis msgavss. es xom mxolod cinapart`a legendebia.
aki ambobdnen: g'mert`o, es[1] t`u shengan movlinebuli cheshmaritebaa, mashin zec`idan t`avze k`vebi gvacvime an mogvivline mcare sasjeli.
translations.footnotes: [1] qurani da zogadad muhammed shuamavlis moz'g'vreba.

translations.translation: da ar ik`neba allahma dasajos isini,[1] roc`a shen imqop`ebi mat` shoris, aseve ar ik`neba allahi mat`i damsjeli, rodesac` isini patiebas it`xoven.
translations.footnotes: [1] igulisxmeba gamanadgurebeli sasjeli, romelsac` it`xovdnen k`vebis cvima an msgavsi risxva, romelic` qvelas ert`ianad ag'gvida pirisagan micisa. xolo amk`veqniuri patara sasjelebi mat` araert`xel icvnies t`avze, rogoric`aa bediris marc`xi, tqved ch`avardna, muslimebis mxridan mek`k`as ag'eba da sxva.

translations.translation: da ratom ar unda dasajos[1] allahma isini, rodesac` mesjid al-haramisgan[2] abrkoleben (morcmuneebs), miuxedavad imisa, rom ar arian meurveni? cheshmaritad, misi meurveni mxolod g'vt`ismoshishebi arian, t`umc`a mat`ma umravlesobam ar ic`is.
translations.footnotes:
[1] igulisxmeba patara sasjelebi, romlebic` konkretulad carmart`ebs sheexot` da ar iqo mashtaburi, qvelap`ris gamanadgurebeli.
[2] originali -,,mesjid al-haram" (msjd lHrm): nakrz'ali mech`et`i; - igulisxmeba k`aabas cminda samloc`velo.

translations.translation: mat`i loc`va-vedreba sxva stvenis da tashisc`emis meti arap`eri iqo,[1] mash igemet` imis sasjeli, rasac` rasac` uarqop`dit`.
translations.footnotes: [1] rogorc` 'abdullah bin 'abbasi p` gadmogvc`ems, qureishelebi tavap`s anu k`aabas irgvliv gars semovlis rituals shishvel mdgomareobashi asrlebdnen, ustvendnen da t`ashssc`emdnen. ix. t`ap`siru taberi.
