translations.translation: uechvelad, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes, t`aviant` k`onebas xarjaven, rat`A (xalxi) allahis gzisgan daabrkolon da daxarjaven kidec`. shemdeg (aset`i danaxarjebi) sinanulad ek`c`evat`, bolos ki damarc`xdebian da romelt`ac` ar ircmunes jojoxet`shi ik`nebian shekrebilni.
rat`a allahma ucminduri gamoarch`ios spetakisgan, shemdeg ucmindurebi ert`manet`ze daacqos da amgvarad qvela ert`ad jojoxet`shi shehqaros. scored egeni arian cagebulni.
ut`xari mat`, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes, rom t`u dasruleben[1] epatiebat` is, rac` ukve iqo carsulshi, xolo t`u isev daubrundebian mashin igive moelit`, rac` mat` ucin mqop`ebs daemart`at`.
translations.footnotes: [1] t`u daasruleben urcmunoebas, muslimt`a cinaag'mdeg brz'olas da mat` allahis gzidan dabrkolebas.

translations.translation: mash eomet` mat`, vidre ag'ar ik`neba gansac`deli[1] da rjuli mt`lianad allahis ar ik`neba.[2] xolo t`u daasruleben, cheshmaritad, allahi xedavs, rasac` isini aket`eben.
translations.footnotes:
[1] vidre ar dasruldeba religiuri z'aladoba, allahis gzidan dabrkoleba da mis morch`ilad c`xovrebis msurvelt`a shezg'udva.
[2] rodesac` morcmunes mxolod allahis shishi ek`neba, misi morch`ilebis gamo veravin shezg'udavs da misi c`xovrebis qvela nabijs allahis nebas daukavshirebs, mas miuz'g'vnis.

translations.translation: xolo t`u piri ibrunes,[1] ic`odet` rom allahia t`k`veni mp`arveli. is ra kargi mp`arveli da ra kargi damxmarea.
translations.footnotes: [1] t`uki uari t`k`ves muslimt`a cinaag'mdeg brz'olaze, xaslxis allahis gzidan dabrkolebaze da cheshmarit rcmenaze.

translations.translation: da ic`odet`, (morcmuneno) rom t`u allahis gzaze brz'olisas rames xelshi ch`aigdebt` (rogorc` nadavls), mashin masshi ert`i mexut`edi ekut`vnis allahs [anu ixarjeba islamis saert`o sak`mist`vis] da moc`ik`uls [moc`ik`uli muhammadi ig'ebda am nacils sakut`ari sachiroebebisa da t`avisi meug'leebis cliuri uzrunvelqop`ist`vis], da moc`ik`ulis nat`esavebs [banu hashimisa da banu al-muttalibis tomebs, radgan allahma mat` aukrz'ala zak`at`is ag'eba, amitom am nacilit` aunazg'aurdebodat`], da axloblebs, g'aribebsa da gachirvebulebs (muslimebs shoris), da mgzavrs, (romelsac` daelia sashualeba t`avisi gzis gasagrz'eleblad). t`u t`k`ven gcamt` allahis da imisa, rac` ch`ven gardmovuvlinet` ch`vens monas (muhammads ) gangsxvavebis dg'es im dg'es, roc`a ert`manet`s shexvdnen ori lashk`ari (morcmunet`a da mravalg'mert`iant`a), [anu badris brz'olis dg'es]. cheshmaritad, allahs z'ala shescevs qoveliveze (igi qovlisshemz'lea)

(da gaixsenet`) rogor iqavit` [ganlagebuli] xeobis axlo mxareze (medinast`an), xolo isini [t`k`veni mtrebi] shoreul mxareze, da (savachro) k`aravani (imqop`eboda) t`k`vens k`vemot` (cit`eli zg'vis napiris mxareze). da romc` t`k`ven cinascar shet`anxmebuliqavit` (mravalg'mert`ianebt`an) [brz'olis droisa da adgilis danishvnaze], t`k`ven (o, morcmuneno) udavod gaip`antebodit` (radgan t`k`ven c`otani iqavit`, xolo isini mravalni). magram (ise moxda, rom allahma shegkribat` cinascari shet`anxmebis gareshe) imisat`vis, rom allahs ag'esrulebina sak`me, romelic` iqo gansazg'vruli [ukve cinascar] (da es aris morcmunet`a gamarjveba allahis momxreebis gamarjveba da misi mtrebis sirc`xvilit` sikvdilit`a da tqveobit`). (da qvelap`eri es moxda imist`vis,) rat`a dag'upuliqo (urcmunoebashi) is, vinc` unda dag'upuliqo (mat`gan) romelic` [c`xadad ac`nobierebda, rom imaze, razedac` mravalg'mert`ianebi arian urcmunoebaa, tquili da gzaabneulobaa] (da mas ag'ar ek`neba gamart`leba), xolo ec`oc`xlebina (rcmenit`) is, romelic` ic`oc`xlebda [c`xadad ac`nobierebda, rom allahi cheshmaritebaa, islami cheshmaritebaa, moc`ik`uli cheshmaritebaa, maradiuli c`xovrebac` cheshmaritebaa, radgan allahma uch`vena mat` sascaulebi, romlebic` amisken miut`it`ebdnen].
cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismomsmenia (sakut`ari monebis sitqvebis), (da) qovlismc`odne (mat`i sak`meebisa).

da gaxsovdes (o moc`ik`ulo muhammad ), rogor gich`vena shen allahma isini [sheni mtrebi] shens sizmarshi mc`ireric`xovnebad, (da roc`a es aucqe morcmuneebs, mat` gabeduleba da simtkic`e miec`at`) xolo rom allahs ech`venebina isini shent`vis mravlad, t`k`ven namdvilad daec`emodit` sulit` da auc`ileblad daicqebdit` am sak`meze [brz'olaze] kamat`s. magram allahma dagic`vat` [moraluri sisustisgan] da gadagarch`inat` amis shedegebs, radgan cheshmaritad, man ucqis, rac` gulebshia [adamiant`a sulebshi]

da gaixsenet` (o moc`ik`ulo da miso t`anxmlebno), rogor gach`venat` t`k`ven allahma isini [t`k`veni mtrebi], roc`a shexvdit` (brz'olis velze): mc`ireric`xovanad mogach`venat` isini t`k`vens t`valshi (da aman gambedaoba shegmatat`), da t`k`venc` mc`ireric`xovnad mogach`venat` mat` t`valshi (rat`a isini seriozulad ar momzadebuliqvnen brz'olist`vis da ukan ar daexiat`). es iqo imisat`vis, rom allahs ganexorc`ielebina sak`me, (romelic` ukve iqo gansazg'vruli) da (cheshmatitad) allahs ubrundeba qovelive sak`me (es sheexeba rogorc` am k`veqniur, ise saik`io c`xovrebas), (da t`it`oeuls allahi misc`ems imas, rac` daimsaxura!)

hei t`k`ven romelt`ac` ircmunet`! roc`a shexvdebit` (omshi) urcmunot`a jars (momzadebulebs t`k`vent`an brz'olisat`vis), mashin iqavit` mtkic`eni [nu gamoich`ent` sisustesa da mxdalobas] da xshirad moixsenet` allahi (t`xovnit`a da vedrebit`, rat`a man mogc`et` daxmareba da gamarjveba mtrebze), rom miag'ciot` carmatebas (mogebas amk`veqnad da samot`xes maradiul c`xovrebashi)

da (qovelt`vis) daemorch`ilet` allahs da mis moc`ik`uls, da nu daicqebt` kamat`s [urt`iert`dapirispirebas], t`orem daec`emit` sulit` (radgan t`k`ven shoris ert`oba ag'ar darch`eba) da dakargavt` t`k`vens z'alas [dasustdebit` ut`anxmoebis gamo]. moit`minet` (allahist`vis), radgan cheshmaritad, allahi momt`menebt`anaa [is mat` exmareba da anichebs t`avis mxardacheras]!

nu daemsgavsebit` imat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs], romlebic` gamovidnen t`aviant`i sac`xovreblidan [mek`k`adan] (miemart`ebodnen medinisaken) ampartavnebit` (imist`vis, rom sht`abechdileba moexdinat` adamianebze), allahis gzidan [mt`lianad morch`ilebisgan] ac`dendnen sxvebs (da xels ushlidnen cheshmariti rcmenis gavrc`elebas) xolo allahi qovlismc`odnea mat`i sak`meebis shesaxeb (da male miuzg'avs mat` rogorc` amk`veqnad, ise saik`ioshi)

da sheulamaza satanam mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] mat`i sak`meebi da ut`xra mat`: dg'es veravin adamiant`agan ver shez'lebs t`k`veni damarc`xebas, da cheshmaritad, me t`k`vent`an axlos var [dagexmarebit`], magram roc`a orive jarma [mravalg'mert`ianebma satanast`an ert`ad da morcmuneebma angelozebt`an ert`ad] dainaxes ert`manet`i, satana ukuk`c`evit` cavida da ut`xra mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs]: cheshmaritad, me t`k`vent`an saert`o arap`eri mak`vs! namdvilad vxedav imas, rasac` t`k`ven ver xedavt` [angelozebs, romlebic` allahma moavlina morcmunet`a dasaxmareblad]. namdvilad me meshinia allahis, xolo allahi z'lieri aris sasjelshi [is sastikad dasjis mat`, vinc` daemorch`ileba satanas da gulcrp`elad ar moinaniebs]

da ai ambobdnen t`valt`mak`c`ni da isini, romelt`a gulshic` senia [echvi rcmenashi]: isini [morcmuneebi] t`aviant`ma rcmenam sheac`dina [dabrmavebulni arian t`aviant`i rcmenit`], (radgan rom ara es, isini ar gamovidodnen mat` cinaag'mdeg, vinc` mat`ze up`ro mravalric`xovania da uket` sheiarag'ebuli) magram (am orpirebs ar esmit`, rom) vinc` endoba allahs (da jeravs mis dapirebuli daxmarebis), (imas allahi arasodes miatovebs) cheshmaritad, allahi qovlisshemz'lea da brz'eni t`avis ganch`inebebsa da sak`meebshi!
da rom genaxa (o, shuamavalo) mashin isini romelt`ac` ar ircmunes t`u rogor xdian mat` sulebs angelozebi; sc`emen mat` saxeebze da zurgebze, amboben: daagemovnet` c`ec`xlis mcveli sasjeli!

es [sasjeli] geciat` imis gamo, rac` t`k`venma xelebma moamzada [t`k`veni urcmunoebis, usamart`lobis, borotebis da c`odvebis gamo], da ic`odet`, rom allahi ar aris usamart`lo t`avisi monebist`vis (allahi samart`liania, da es aris misi samart`liani ganch`ineba)

(mat`i urcmunoeba da mast`an ert`ad mosuli sasjeli) hgavs p`araonis xalxs [rogorc` es moxda p`araont`an da mis t`anmxlebebt`an] da (hgavs) im xalxs, romlebic` mat` cin c`xovrobdnen. isini urcmunoni gaxdnen allahis sascaulebisadmi [uarqves cheshmariteba, romelsac` allahi ugzavnida mat`], da allahma dasaja isini mat`i c`odvebis gamo [mat`i urcmunoebisa da jiutobis gamo]. cheshmaritad, allahi z'lieria da mkac`ria sasjelshi (mat` mimart`, vinc` ar inaniebs urcmunoebasa da misi brz'anebebis daumorch`ileblobas)

es [aris is, rom allahma dasaja jiuti urcmunoebi, romlebic` mat` cin c`xovrobdnen] imis gamo, rom allahi ar aris iset`i, rom shec`valos [an caart`vas] cqaloba [mshvidoba, ket`ildg'eoba], romelic` man xalxs uboz'a, sanam isini (t`avad) ar shec`vlian imas, rac` mat`shia [sanam ar daicqeben urcmunoebas, borotebas da c`odvebs] (am shemt`xvevashi allahi uzenaesi shec`vlis mat` mshvidobas shishit`, ket`ildg'eobas gasachirit`) da es (moxdeba) imitomac`, rom allahi qovlismsmeni, da qovlismc`odne [ic`is mat`i mdgomareoba da sak`meebi].

mat`i urcmunoeba da k`c`eva hgavs p`araonis t`anamoz'met`a (p`araonosa da misi momxreebis) ch`veulebebs, aseve im xalxt`a ch`veulebebs, romlebic` mat`amde c`xovrobdnen. mat` uarqves t`aviant`i g'mert`is sascaulebi [uarqves ashkara mtkic`ebulebebi, romlebic` allahma mouvlina], amitom allahma gaanadgura isini mat`i c`odvebis gamo [mat`i urcmunoebisa da jiutobis gamo]. da allahma male dasaja isini mat`i c`odvebis gamo [mat`i urcmunoebisa da jiutobis gamo]. ch`ven p`araonis t`anamoz'eni ch`avz'iret` zg'vashi, da isini qvelani iqvnen usamart`lo borotmok`medni (isini, vinc` g'alatobdnen allahs, uarqop`dnen ch`vens sascaulebs da c`ru braldebebs uqenebdnen allahis moc`ik`ulebs).

cheshmaritad, allahis cinashe qvelaze uaresi micaze mavalt`a (adamiant`a da c`xovelt`a) shoris arian isini, vinc` urcmuno gaxdnen da isini ar ircmuneben [agrz'eleben t`aviant` urcmunoebashi jiutobas].

isini, romlebt`anac` shen, (o moc`ik`ulo), dade shet`anxmeba (rom ar iomebdnen shens cinaag'mdeg da ar daexmarebodnen shens mtrebs), shemdeg ki qovel jerze arg'veven am shet`anxmebas da ar eshiniat` allahis sasjelis [ar up`rt`xian mas]

t`u brz'olashi shexvdebi mat` (vinc` shent`an dadebul xelshekrulebas arg'veven) dasaje isini ise mkac`rad, rom mat`i ukan mdgomni sheshindnen da gaik`c`nen rat`a egebis sheigonon (da gansakut`rebit` ukan mdgom urcmunoebist`vis) (sascavlo magalit`i da mat` ag'ar gabedon msgavsi k`medeba).

t`u shen (o, moc`ik`ulo) shishob romelime xalxis g'alats, mashin gaauk`me es shet`anxmeba mat`t`an t`anascorad: sheatqobine mat` amis shesaxeb, rat`a orive mxarem ic`odes, rom shet`anxmeba ag'ar mok`medebs. cheshmaritad, allahs ar uqvars mog'alateni (vinc` arg'veven t`aviant` shet`anxmebebs)
da nurc` ip`ik`reben isini, vinc` urcmunoebi gaxdnen, t`it`k`os gadaurch`nen (allahis sasjels), cheshmaritad, isini ver daamarxc`eben [ver daag'ceven t`avs allahis sasjels, igi usat`uod daecevat`].

da moamzadet` mat`t`vis (o, morcmuneno) imdeni z'ala, ramdensac` shez'lebt` iarag'i da c`xenosant`a razmebi, rat`a amit` sheashinot` allahis mteri da t`k`veni mteri, agret`ve sxva mtrebi mat` garda da isini, romelt`ac` t`k`ven ar ic`nobt`, magram allahi ic`nobs mat`. da rac` ar unda daxarjot` allahis gzaze (ik`neba es k`oneba t`u z'ala, bevri t`u c`ota) allahi srulad dagibrunebt` amas, da t`k`ven ar daich`agrebit` (t`k`veni sazg'auri ar shemc`irdeba arc` saik`ioshi).
da t`u isini (urcmunoebi) midrekilni ik`nebian mshvidobisken, mashin shenc` daet`anxme mas (mshvidobas) da miende allahs uechvelad, is aris qovlismsmeni da qovlismc`odne.

da t`u isini, vist`anac` dadebuli gak`vs shet`anxmeba, isurveben motquebas (o, moc`ik`ulo), cheshmaritad sakmarisia shent`vis allahi (is dagic`avs mat` c`bierebisagan). isaa romelmac` mxari dagichira t`avisi daxmarebit` da morcmuneebit`

da man (allahma) gaaert`iana mat`i gulebi. vinaidan, (t`uki shen, o moc`ik`ulo), daxarjavdi im qvelap`ers, rac` dedamicazea, ver shez'lebdi mat`i gulebis gaert`ianebas, magram allahma t`vit`on gaaert`iana isini. uechvelad, is z'levamosilia, brz'enia.
hei, moc`ik`ulo! shent`vis sruliad sakmarisia allahi da (aseve sakmarisia is) mat`t`vis, vinc` gagqva shen morcmunet`agan

hei, moc`ik`ulo! caak`eze morcmuneni brz'olist`vis. t`u t`k`vens shoris ik`neba oc`i mot`minebit` gamorch`euli (morcmune), isini daamarc`xeben oras urcmunos, xolo t`u t`k`vens shoris ik`neba asi (momt`meni), isini daamarc`xeben at`as urcmunos, radgan isini ver xvdebian (simart`lesa da namdvil mizans romlist`visac` morcmuneni ibrz'vian,da ver xvdebian t`o rogor exmareba allahi t`avis momxreebs)

axla allahma shegimsubuk`at` t`k`ven, [morcmuneno], da man ic`is, rom t`k`venshi aris sisuste. amitom, t`u t`k`ven shoris ik`neba asi mot`minebit` gamagrebuli (morcmune), isini daamarc`xeben orass, xolo t`u t`k`ven shoris ik`neba at`asi, isini daamarc`xeben ori at`as urcmunos allahis nebit`. da allahi momt`ment`anaa

ar sheep`ereba moc`ik`uls, rom mas hqavdes tqveebi, sanam is (da morcmuneni mast`an ert`ad) ar ganamtkic`eben z'alas da gavlenas micaze (da ar daamarc`xeben urcmunoebs xoc`vit`). t`k`ven ki gsurt` amk`veqniuri sargebeli (badris brz'olis tqveebis gamosasqidis mig'ebit`), xolo allahs surs t`k`vent`vis saik`io. da allahi z'levamosilia, brz'enia.

rom ar qop`iliqo allahisgan dadgenili (e.i. nadavlisa da tqveebis gamosasqidis mig'ebis nebart`va am t`emist`vis), mashin imis gamo, rac` t`k`ven aig'et` (badris tqveebis gamosasqidis saxit`), auc`ileblad shegexebodat` mz'ime sasjeli.
chamet` is, rac` nadavlad aig'et` (urcmunoebisgan) rogorc` nebadart`uli da kargi da geshindet` allahis. cheshmaritad, allahi mimtevebelia, mcqalobelia.

o, moc`ik`ulo! ut`xari im tqveebs, romlebic` t`k`vens xelt` arian t`u allahi dainaxavs t`k`vens gulebshi siket`es, moganichebt` imaze uket`ess, rac` t`k`vengan ik`na ag'ebuli, da shegindobt` t`k`ven. cheshmaritad, allahi qovladmpatiebeli da qovladmocqalea.
xolo t`u shens g'alats ganizraxaven (badris brz'olashi aqvanili tqveebi), mat` xom ug'alates allahs ucin da man mogc`a mat`ze z'alaup`leba. da allahi qovlismc`odnea, brz'enia.

cheshmaritad, isini, romelt`ac` ircmunes da gadasaxldnen (gadavidnen mek`adan medinashi allahis moc`ik`ult`an ert`ad, rat`a emsaxuron da t`aqvani sc`en ert`adert` allahs), da ibrz'oles t`aviant`i k`onebit`a da sic`oc`xlit` allahis gzaze, da aseve isini, romelt`ac` misc`es t`avshesap`ari da daxmareba (muhajirebs) isini arian ert`manet`is megobrebi da mp`arvelni. rac` sheexeba mat`, romelt`ac` ircmunes, magram ar gadasaxlebulan (urcmunot`a k`veqnidan morcmunet`a k`veqanashi) t`k`ven ar gekisrebat` valdebuleba mat`ze daxmarebis, sanam isini ar gadmosaxldebian. da t`u isini it`xoven t`k`vengan daxmarebas sarcmunoebashi, t`k`venzea mat`i daxmareba garda im shemt`xvevisa, roc`a es ik`neba im xalxis cinaag'mdeg, vist`anac` t`k`ven gak`vt` dadebuli shet`anxmeba (mshvidobis an mekavshireobis shesaxeb). da allahi xedavs imas, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`

romelnic` gaxdnen urcmunoni, isini ert`manet`is mp`arveli da (damxmareni) arian. t`u t`k`ven morcmuneno, ar moik`c`evit` ase (e.i. ar daexmarebit` da ar daudgebit` mxarshi morcmuneebs rcmenashi da brz'olashi), mashin dedamicaze ik`neba didi (areuloba, c`duneba).

da mat`, romelt`ac` ircmunes da gadasaxldnen (gadavidnen allahis moc`ik`ult`an medinashi) da ibrz'oles allahis gzaze, da mat`, romelt`ac` misc`es t`avshesap`ari (muhajirebs) da daexmarnen (allahis religias, moc`ik`uls da morcmuneebs), ai isini arian cheshmariti morcmuneni.
mat` ek`nebat` miteveba da g'irseuli sazg'auri (samot`xe).

xolo romelt`ac` ircmunes shemdgom, gadasaxldnen da ibrz'odnen t`k`vent`an ert`ad, isini t`k`venganni arian. xolo nat`esavebi ert`manet`t`an up`ro axloni arian (memkvidreobis sakit`xebshi) rogorc` es allahis cignshia dadgenili. uechvelad, allahi qvelap`ris mc`odnea.
uarqop`a allahisgan da misi shuamavlisgan im carmart`t`at`vis, romlebt`anac` shet`anxmeba gk`ondat` dadebuli (da romlebmac` t`avad daarg'vies igi).

imogzauret` (o mravalg'mert`ianno) micaze ot`xi t`vis ganmavlobashi (rodesac` usap`rt`xod ik`nebit` morcmunet`agan) da ic`odet`, rom t`k`ven ver daasustebt` allahs (ver gadaurch`ebit` mis sasjels) da agret`ve ic`odet`, rom allahi shearc`xvens urcmunoebs (tqveobit`a da mokvlit` amk`veqnad, da maradiul c`xovrebashi -- jojoxet`is mkvidrebad ak`c`evs mat`)

mocodeba allahisa misi shuamavlisgan xalxisadmi didi hajis dg'es imis t`aobaze, rom allahi emijneba mravalg'mert`ianebs da misi shuamavalic`. da t`u moinaniebt`, uket`esia t`k`vent`vis, xolo t`u zurgs sheak`c`evt`, mashin ic`odet`, rom t`k`ven ver daasustebt` allahs (ver aic`ilebt` mis sasjels). aucqe (o, moc`ik`ulo) imat`, vinc` urcmuno gaxda (islams zurgi ak`c`ia), mtanjveli sasjelis shesaxeb.

(es dadgenileba) ar exeba im mravalg'mert`ianebs, romlebt`anac` t`k`ven, morcmuneebo, dadet` shet`anxmeba (gansazg'vruli vadit`), da shemdeg mat` arap`ershi ar daarg'vies is (shet`anxmeba) t`k`vens cinashe da arc` aravis (t`k`veni mtrebidan) gaucies daxmareba t`k`ven cinaag'mdeg brz'olashi. amitom sheasrulet` shet`anxmeba mat`t`an mat`i vadis amocurvamde, cheshmaritad allahs uqvars g'vt`is moshishni (romelnic` up`lisgan ganrisxebis shishit` ic`aven t`avs) (vinc` asrulebs mis brz'anebebs da erideba imas, rac` man aukrz'ala)

xolo roc`a akrz'aluli t`veebi gava, daxoc`et` mravalg'mert`ianni, sadac` ki naxot` isini, sheipqarit` isini da alqashi moak`c`iet`, da ch`ausap`rdit` mat` qvela sap`arshi. xolo t`u moinanieben, ag'asruleben loc`vas da gaig'eben zek`at`s, mashin gaushvit` isini t`aviant` gzaze. cheshmaritad, allahi mimtevebelia, shemcqalebelia.

xolo t`u vinme mravalg'mert`t`agan t`avshesap`ars gt`xovs, sheip`are igi, rat`a moisminos allahis sitqva. shemdeg miiqvane igi t`avis usap`rt`xo adgilas. imitom, rom isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] arian adamianebi, romlebic` ar ic`noben (islamis namdvil arss) (da shesaz'loa ircmunon, roc`a moismenen mis cheshmaritebas)

rogor sheiz'leba hk`ondet` ag't`k`ma carmart`ebs allaht`an da mis shuamavalt`an, garda imat`i, romelt`ac` ag't`k`ma daudet` akrz'alul mech`et`t`an? da vidre isini t`k`vens cinashe pirdapirni ik`nebian, t`k`venc` pirdapirni iqavit` mat` cinashe[nu daarg'vevt` ag't`k`mas ]. uechvelad, allahs uqvars g'vt`ismoshishni.

rogor sheiz'leba am mravalg'mert`ianebs shet`anxmeba hk`ondet` allaht`an da misi moc`ik`ult`an, roc`a isini t`uki t`k`venze imarjveben (o, morcmuneebo) arc` t`k`vens nat`esaur valdebulebebs ic`aven da arc` shet`anxmebis pirobebs? amitom nu motquvdebit` mat`i mimart`vit`, roc`a eshiniat` t`k`vengan. isini c`diloben dagakmaqop`ilon t`aviant`i sitqvebit` [lamazi saubrit`], xolo mat`i gulebi grz'noben zizg's (amis mimart`) da mat`i umravlesoba urch`ia [arg'vevs shet`anxmebebs da gamodian allahis morch`ilebidan]

mat` gaqides allahis sascaulebi umnishvnelo p`asad [gadac`vales allahis sitqva amk`veqniur droebit` sargebelze] da ac`dendnen (xalxs) mis gzas [islamis gzas]. cheshmaritad amazrzenia is, rasac` isini sch`adiodnen!
es [mravalg'mert`ianebi] arc` ert`i morcmunis mimart` ar ic`aven arc` nat`esaur valdebulebebs da arc` shet`anxmebis pirobebs. da aset`ni arian zg'vargadasulni (arg'vevs sakut`ar shet`anxmebebs)
xolo t`u isini moinanieben da ag'asruleben loc`vas da gaig'eben zek`at`s, mashin isini t`k`veni z'mebi arian sarcmunoebashi, da ch`ven ganvmartavt` aiat`ebs mc`odne xalxist`vis.

xolo t`u daarg'veven t`aviant` p`ic`s t`aviant`i ag't`k`mis shemdeg da sheurac`xqop`en t`k`vens sarcmunoebas, mashin ebrz'olet` urcmunoebis cinamz'g'olebs. ramet`u mat`t`vis ar arsebobs p`ic`i, egebis shecqviton.

nut`u ar sheebrz'olebit` xalxs, romelt`ac` daarg'vies t`aviant`i p`ic`i da ganizraxes shuamavlis gaz'eveba, da mat` pirvelad dagicqes t`k`ven (brz'ola)? nut`u mat`i geshiniat`? allahi up`ro g'irsia, rom misi geshinodet`, t`uki morcmuneni xart`.
ebrz'olet` mat`! allahi dasjis mat` t`k`veni xelebit`, daamc`irebs mat` da gamarjvebas mogc`emt` mat`ze, da gankurnavs morcmune xalxis gulebs.
da gandevnis mat` gult`agan risxvas. da allahi miutevebs, inebebs visac`. da allahi qovlismc`odnea, brz'enia.

nut`u t`k`ven (morcmuneebo) p`ik`robt`, rom ik`nebit` mitovebulni (gamoc`dis gareshe), roc`a allhma jer ar gamoavlina t`k`vengani isini, vinc` ibrz'vis mis gzaze da ar ig'ebs axlo megobrebad aravis, garda allahisa, misi moc`ik`ulisa da morcmunet`a. namdvilad, allahi srulad ucqis qvelap`ers, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt` (da mogagebt` amis mixedvit`)

ar ekadrebat` mravalg'mert`ianebs, rom aashenon allahis mech`et`ebi[da t`aqvanisc`emis ritualebi aket`on], roc`a t`avadve mocmoben sakut`ar urcmunoebas. amat`i sak`meebi p`uchi gaxda da c`ec`xlshi ik`nebian isini samudamod.

uechvelad, allahis mech`et`ebs mxolod is aashenebs, visac` scams allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli, da ag'avlens loc`vas, gasc`ems zek`at`s da aravisi eshinia, garda allahisa. scored isini arian cheshmarit gzaze mdgarni.

nut`u t`k`ven, mravalg'mert`ovnebo p`ik`robt`, rom mloc`velt`a cqlit` darcqluleba da akrz'aluli mech`et`is movla udris imas, vinc` ircmuna allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli da ibrz'vis allahis gzaze? isini ar arian t`anascorni allahis cinashe. da allahi ar daadgens cheshmarit gzaze usamart`lo xalxs.
isini, romelt`ac` ircmunes, gadasaxldnen da ibrz'odnen allahis gzaze t`aviant`i k`onebit`a da sulebit`, udidesi xarisxi ak`vt` allaht`an. da scored isini arian gamarjvebulni.
axarebs mat` mat`i g'mert`i t`avisi cqalobit`a da kmaqop`ilebit`, da samot`xeebit`, sadac` mat`t`vis maradiuli netarebaa.
samudamod darch`ebian ik`. cheshmaritad, allaht`anaa diadi sazg'auri.

hei t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ar aiqvanot` t`k`veni mamebi da z'mebi megobrebad, t`uki mat` urcmunoeba arch`ies rcmenas. da vinc` mat` aiqvans megobrebad t`k`vengan, scored isini arian usamart`loni.

ut`xari: t`u t`k`veni mamebi, t`k`veni shvilebi, t`k`veni z'mebi, t`k`veni meug'leebi, t`k`veni sagvareulo, k`oneba, romelic` moipovet`, vachroba, romlis dakargvis geshiniat` da sac`xovreblebi, romlebic` mogcont`, up`ro saqvarelia t`k`vent`vis, vidre allahi, misi shuamavali da brz'ola mis gzaze, mashin daelodet`, sanam allahi ar moavlens t`avis brz'anebas. da allahi ar daadgens scor gzaze urch` xalxs

uechvelad, allahma gamarjveba giboz'at` mraval adgilas da hunainis dg'es, roc`a t`k`veni simravle gaoc`ebdat`, magram verap`rit` dagexmarat`[t`k`veni simravle] da dedamica, miuxedavad t`avisi sivrc`isa, vicrod gech`venat`, shemdeg ki zurgi ak`c`iet` da gaik`ec`it`.

shemdeg gardmoavlina allahma t`avisi simshvide t`avis shuamavalze da morcmuneebze, da gardmoavlina lashk`ari, romelsac` t`k`ven ver xedavdit`, da dasaja isini, romelnic` gaxdnen urcmunoni. da es aris urcmunot`a sazg'auri.
shemdeg, (amis mere), allahi miutevebs, visac` inebebs. da allahi mimtevebeli, shemcqalebelia.

hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! cheshmaritad, mravalt`mert`ianebi bilcni arian. amitom nu miuaxlovdebian cminda mech`et`s am clis shemdeg. da t`u sig'aribis geshiniat`, allahi gagamdidrebt` t`avisi guluxvobit`, t`u inebebs. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismc`odnea, brz'enia.

ebrz'olet` mat` (o, morcmuneno) romelt`ac` ar scamt` allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli, da ar t`vlian akrz'alulad imas, rac` akrz'ala alahma da misma shuamavalma, da ar ic`aven cheshmarit sarcmunoebas [islamis kanonebs] imat`gan, visac` miec`a cigni {iudevelni da k`ristianni], sanam isini ar gadaixdian xarks sakut`ari xelit`, damc`irebulni da morch`ilni (rogorc` damarc`xebulni)

da t`k`ves iudevelebma: uzairi g'vt`is z'eao da t`k`ves k`ristianebma: mesia (ieso) g'vt`is z'eao. es mat`i sitqvebia, mat`i bageebidan carmot`k`muli[argumentis gareshe]. isini imeoreben imat` sitqvebs, romelnic` gaxdnen urcmunoni ucin[ucindeli mravalg'mert`ianebi ambobdnen rom angelozebi allahis k`alishvilebi ariano ]. allahma dag'upos isini (qvela mravalt`mert`iani)! ramdenad arian isini moshorebulni (simart`lisgan)

(mat`) [iudevelebma da k`ristianebma] aiqvanes t`aviant`i mcignobrebi [t`aviant`i rjulis scavlulni] da berebi t`aviant` g'mert`ad (rogorc` iset`ni, vinc` mat`t`vis adgenen rcmenisa da shariat`is kanonebs) allahis garda da agret`ve mesia [shuamavali ieso], mariamis z'e (aiqvanes rogorc` g'mert`i da t`aqvans sc`emen mas). (isini ig'vcian adamianebis mier mogonil cesebshi da toveben imas, rac` allahma daudgina mat`.) t`umc`a mat` ebrz'anat` (allahisgan), rom t`aqvani ec`at` da emsaxurat` mxolod ert`ad-ert`i cheshmariti g'mert`ist`vis [allahist`vis], romlis garda ar arsebobs sxva g'mert`i. is [allahi] cmindaa da didebuli imaze, rac` [mravalg'mert`ianebma da urcmunoebma] daudgines mas t`anamoziared

isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi da cignis xalxi] qvelanairad c`diloben ch`aak`ron allahis nat`eli [dap`aron an uarqon is cheshmariteba, romelsac` allahi az'levs mat`] t`aviant`i pirebit`, magram allahi ar daushvebs arap`ers, garda imisa, rom t`avisi nat`eli srulqos [is ise moacqobs, rom islami sheik`mnas srulqop`ilad da misi sitqva iqos umag'lesi], t`undac` urcmunoebs es sz'uldet`
isaa (allahi), vinc` carmogzavna t`avisi shuamavali cheshmariti gzit`a da cheshmariti sarcmunoebit`, rat`a ag'matebul hk`mnas igi qvela rcmenaze, t`undac` es mouconari iqos mravalg'mert`iant`at`vis

hei t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! cheshmaritad, cignis xalxidan bevri scavluli da beri usamart`lod chams adamiant`a k`onebas [ig'eben imas, rac` ar aris mat`t`vis nebadart`uli], da ac`denen adamianebs allahis gzidan. xolo isini, romelnic` agroveben ok`rosa da verc`xls da ar xarjaven mas allahis gzaze, axare mat` mtanjveli sasjeli.

im dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es], rodesac` jojoxet`is c`ec`xlshi gaac`xeleben mat` [ok`rosa da verc`xls], da amit` amoicveba mat`i shublebi, gverdebi da zurgebi! da mat` et`k`mebat`: ai, es aris is, rasac` t`k`ven agrovebdit` sakut`ari t`avebist`vis (amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi). axla igemet` sasjeli imis gamo, rasac` agrovebdit`!

cheshmaritad, t`vet`a ric`xvi allaht`an t`ormetia allahis cignshi, im dg'idan, roc`a man shek`mna c`ani da mica. mat`gan ot`xi akrz'alulia. esaa scori sarcmunoeba. mash, nu izamt` usamart`lobas t`k`veni t`avis mimart` [am akrz'alul t`veebshi]. da ebrz'olet` mravalg'mert`ianebs ert`ianad, rogorc` isini gebrz'vian t`k`ven ert`ianad. da ic`odet`, rom allahi g'vt`ismoshishebt`anaa.

celicadis t`veebis gadadeba [akrz'aluli t`vis gadatana sxva dros] --ar aris arap`eri, garda urcmunoebis gazrdisa.
(satana amit` ac`dunebs mat`, vinc` urcmuno gaxda) isini ert` cels xdian mas nebadart`ulad, xolo meore cels krz'alaven, rat`a t`it`k`osda sheesabamebodes (t`aviant`i kalendari) im t`veebis raodenobas, rac` allahma akrz'ala. amrigad, isini nebadart`ulad xdian imas, rac` allahma akrz'ala. shealamaza mat`t`vis (satanam) mat`i boroti sak`meebi,
xolo allahi ar carmart`avs mart`al gzaze urcmuno xalxs [ vinc` jiutad rch`eba urcmunoebashi].

hei t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ra gemart`ebat`, roc`a geubnebian: gamodit` allahis gzaze [cadit` brz'olashi t`k`veni mtrebis cinaag'mdeg] rato ekvrebit` micas? nut`u amk`veqniuri c`xovreba arch`iet` imk`veqniurs? amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis siame xom mc`iredia imk`veqniurt`an shedarebit`.

t`u ar gailashk`rebt` (t`k`veni mtrebis cinaag'mdeg), igi dagtanjavt` mtanjveli sasjelit` (am k`veqnadac` da maradiul c`xovrebashi) da shegc`vlit` t`k`ven sxva xalxit` (romelnic` ik`nebian misi da misi shuamavlis morch`ilni), da verap`ers avnebt` mas. da allahi qovlisshemz'lea.

t`u t`k`ven, (o sahabebo), ar daexmarebit` mas [moc`ik`ul muhammads], allahma xom ukve sheecia mas, roc`a urcmunoebma [mravalg'mert`ianebma] gandevnes igi (mek`k`adan), roc`a orni iqvnen, rodesac` isini gamok`vabulshi iqvnen, da rodesac` t`avis megobars[abuu bak`rs] ut`xra: ar damcuxrde, allahi ch`vent`anaa. mashin allahma gardmoavlina t`avisi simshvide masze [moc`ik`ul muhammadze] da gaaz'liera igi im jarebit` [angelozebit`], romlebic` t`k`ven ar ginaxavt`. da allahma ganak`arva urcmunot`a sitqva [mravalg'mert`ianobis sitqva]
gaak`ro igi da daamdabla, xolo allahis sitqva [ert`g'mert`ianobis sitqva] amag'lebulia da umag'lesi darch`a. vinaidan allahi z'levamosilia da brz'enia (t`avis batonobashi) (brz'anebebsa da gadacqvetilebebshi).

gailashk`ret` (o, morcmuneno) msubuk`ad [axalgazrdebo da g'aribebo] da mz'imed (xandazmulebo da shez'lebulebo), da ibrz'olet` t`k`veni k`onebit`a da t`k`veni sulebit` allahis gzaze. es uket`esia t`k`vent`vis, rom ic`odet` t`k`ven.

t`u is lashk`roba, romelzec` shen moucodeb mat`, axlo ik`neboda da nadavli -- advilad misag'cevi,
mashin isini [orpirebi] uechvelad gamogqvebodnen shen (o, moc`ik`ulo), [t`umc`a mat`i gamosvla ar ik`neboda allahis kmaqop`ilebist`vis, aramed mxolod nadavlis mig'ebis miznit`.] magram mat` es gza shorad moech`venat`, da roc`a t`k`ven dabrundebit` am lashk`robidan, isini allahit` daip`ic`eben, da itqvian: t`u shegvez'leboda, auc`ileblad gamovidodit` t`k`vent`an ert`ad! t`umc`a isini t`vit`onve g'upaven sakut`ar t`avs [t`aviant`i sic`ruit`a da orpirobit`], da allahi ucqis, rom isini namdvilad matquarni arian
allahma gapatia shen! ratom miec`i mat` neba, sanam shent`vis c`xadi gaxdeboda, vinc` mart`ali iqo da gec`no matquarebi.

isini, romelt`ac` scamt` allahisa da ukanaskneli dg'is, ar gt`xoven nebart`vas, rom ibrz'olon t`aviant`i k`onebit`a da sulebit` (allahis gzaze) da allahi mc`odnea g'vt`ismoshisht`a[anu eseni shin dasarch`enad mizezs ar ez'eben da nebas ar gt`xoven].

cheshmaritad, nebart`vas gt`xoven isini, romelt`ac` ar scamt` alahis da ukanaskneli dg'is, da visi gulebic` sheipqro echvma [islamis cheshmaritebashi, romlit`ac` shen moxvedi mat`t`an] da isini t`aviant` echvebshi merqeoben.
da rom gasvla ndomebodat`, ut`uod, moemzadebodnen amist`vis, magram allahma ar isurva mat`i casvla da sheach`era isini, da et`k`vat`: dajek`it` mjdomiarebt`an ert`ad!

rom isini [orpirebi] t`k`vent`an ert`ad gamosuliqvnen (o, morcmuneno), arap`ers shegmatebdnen, garda areulobisa, da isini imoz'ravebdnen t`k`vens shoris, rat`a daet`esat` shug'li da ganxet`k`ileba t`k`vens shoris. da t`k`vens shoris arian iset`ebic`, vinc` usmenen mat`. magram allahi ucqis am usamart`lot`a [orpirt`a] vinaobas [da is miuzg'avs mat` mat`i k`medebebis shesabamisad]
isini manamdec` c`dilobdnen ganxet`k`ilebis ch`amogdebas da shens cinaag'mdeg atrialebdnen sak`meebs, sanam ar movida cheshmariteba da ar gac`xadda allahis brz'aneba, t`umc`a mat` es sz'uldat`.

da mat` shoris arian iset`ebic`, romlebic` amboben: neba momec`i[shin darch`enisa] da nu gamomc`di. ic`odet`, rom isini ukve ch`avarddnen c`dunebashi. da uechvelad, jojoxet`i gars shemoertqmeba urcmunoebs.

t`u shens (o, moc`ik`ulo) (lashk`robebshi) raime kargi geceva [mogeba an nadavli], es mat` [orpirebs] cqent` xolo t`u ubedureba geceva [marc`xi an zarali], isini amboben:,,ch`ven cinascar vizrunet` sakut`ar sak`meebze [rom es ubedureba ar shegvexo] da midian, bednierad (imit`, rac` ch`aidines da rac` shen dagemart`a)
t`k`vi (o, shuamavalo): arasdros shegvemt`xveva ch`ven, garda imisa, rac` allahma dagvicera. is aris ch`veni mp`arvelia, da dae allahs, miendon morcmuneni.

ut`xari (o, moc`ik`ulo) (am orpirebs): nut`u t`k`ven elit`, rom ch`venze moxdeba mxolod ori siket`et`agan (ert`-ert`i an allahis daxmareba, an sikvdili allahis gzaze?) xolo ch`ven velit`, (rom t`k`ven orpirebs) allahis dagsjit` t`vit`on, an ch`veni xelebit` [gagsjit`]. daelodet`, da ch`venc` t`k`vent`an ert`ad davelodebit`
ut`xari (o, shuamavalo) (am orpirebs): gaig'ebt` (t`k`veni k`onebidan) nebit` t`u iz'ulebit`, mainc` ar ik`neba mig'ebuli t`k`vengan, ramet`u t`k`ven xart` xalxi urch`ni.
da ra ushlit` xels, rom mig'ebul ik`nas mat`gan mat`i shesaciri, garda imisa, rom mat` uarqves allahi da misi shuamavali, da ar midian loc`vaze, t`u ara zantad, da ar xarjaven, t`u ara iz'ulebit`.
dae, nu gagaoc`ebs mat`i k`oneba da shvilebi. allahs surs, rom amit` dasajos isini amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi da amoxdes mat`i sulni urcmunoebis mdgomareobashi.

da isini (orpirni) allahs ip`ic`eben, rom namdvilad t`k`venganni arian, magram isini t`k`venganni ar arian, aramed xalxi romelt`ac` eshianiat` (rom t`k`ven mat` daxoc`avt`, ise rogorc` mravalg'mert`ianebs xoc`avt`) (da scored amitom isini garegnobit` t`avs carmoach`enen morcmuneebad).
rom (t`valt`mak`c`ebs) epovat` t`avshesap`ari, an gamok`vabulebi, an shesaz'romi, misken gaeshurebodnen t`avk`udmoglejilebi.
da mat` shoris arian iset`ni, romlebic` gakritikeben shen mocqalebis gamo t`u mat` misgan cili miec`emat`, kmaqop`ilni arian, xolo t`u ar miec`emat` misgan, mashin isini brazdebian.

da kmaqop`ilni rom qop`iliqvnen imit`, rac` uboz'a mat` alahma da misma shuamavalma, da et`k`vat`: sakmarisia ch`vent`vis alahi! gviboz'ebs ch`ven allahi t`avisi cqalobit` da misi shuamavalic` cheshmaritad, ch`ven allahisken mscrap`velni vart`

uechvelad, mocqalebani g'aribt`at`visaa da upovart`at`vis, da misi shemgroveblebist`vis, da mat`t`vis, vis gulebic` miizideba islamisken [im imedit`, rom isini miig'eben islams, an moutanen sargebels morcmuneebs, an am gzit` moishoreba morcmunet`agan ziani], da monebis gasat`avisup`leblad, da movalet`at`vis, da allahis gzaze, da mgzavrt`at`vis. es allahis mier dadgenili valdebulebaa. da allahi qovlismc`odnea, brz'enia.

da mat` (orpirt`a) shoris arian iset`ebic`, romlebic` (t`aviant`i sitqvebit`) aqeneben tkivils shuamavals da amboben:,,is quria! [vinc` qvelap`ers ijerebs, rac` mas eubnebian] ut`xari [mat`]: is t`k`vent`vis sasiket`o quria, scams mas allahi da endoba morcmuneebs da cqalobaa t`k`vengan morcmunet`at`vis. xolo mat`, romlebic` tkivils aqenebel (t`aviant`i enit`) allahis shuamavals, mat`t`visaa mcare sasjeli.
isini (orpirni) allahs gep`ic`ebian, rat`a t`k`ven iqot` mat`it` kmaqop`ili. arada, allahi da misi shuamavali up`ro g'irsni arian, rom mat`i kmaqop`ilebist`vis iscrap`odnen, t`uki morcmuneni arian.
nut`u (orpirebma) ar ic`ian, rom vinc` ecinaag'mdegeba allahsa da mis shuamavals, mist`visaa jojoxet`is c`ec`xli, romelshic` samudamod darch`ebian? esaa udidesi damc`ireba.
t`valt`mak`c`ni (orpirni) shishoben, rom mat`ze sura ar gadmovides, romelic` mat` gulebshi arsebuls gamoavlens. ut`xari: dasc`inet`, magram allahi gamoavlens imas, rasac` shishobt`.

da t`u hkit`xav mat` (t`valt`mak`c`t`), ut`uod getqvian: ch`ven ubralod vsaubrobdit` da vert`obodit` [es mxolod sitqvebi iqo, da ch`ven arap`ers borots ar vgulisxmobdit`] ut`xari:,,gana allahs da mis aiat`ebs da mis shuamavals dasc`inodit`?!
nu moibodishebt`! t`k`ven ukve uarqavit` t`k`veni rcmenis shemdeg. t`uki shevundobt` t`k`vengan ert` jgup`s, davsjit` meore jgup`s, radgan isini c`odvilni iqvnen.

t`valt`mak`c`i kac`ebi da t`valt`mak`c`i k`alebi ert`manet`isgan arian [da isini ar ekut`vnian morcmunet`a ric`xvs], isini brz'aneben borotebas da krz'alaven siket`es, da xelmocherilni arian. mat` daivicqes allahi, amitom manac` daivicqa isini. uechvelad, t`valt`mak`c`ebi arian urch`ni.

allahma ag'ut`k`va t`valt`mak`c` kac`ebsa da k`alebs da urcmunoebs jojoxet`is c`ec`xli, sadac` maradiulad darch`ebian. igi sakmarisi ik`neba mat`t`vis. dacqevla allahma isini da mat`t`visaa mudmivi sasjeli.

(da t`k`venc`, o orpiroebo), t`k`veni sak`meebit`a da mdgomareobit` hgavxart` imat` (urcmunoebs), romlebic` iqvnen t`k`venamde! isini up`ro z'lierebi iqvnen t`k`venze (sxeulis) z'alit` da mdidarni (metad) k`onebit`a da shvilebit`, da mat`ac` iseve isargebles t`aviant`i cilit` (amk`veqniuri sargeblisagan). t`k`venc` isargeblet` t`k`veni cilit`, rogorc` isargebles mat`, romlebic` iqvnen t`k`venamde, t`aviant`i cilit` da t`k`venc` iseve ch`aep`alit` amaoebashi, rogorc` isini ch`aep`lnen. ai, mat`, romelt`a sak`meebic` amk`veqnadac` da imk`veqnadac` p`uchi gaxda. da ai, isini arian cagebulni.

gana ar mosula mat`t`an ambavi imat`i, vinc` mat`ze ucin iqvnen - nuhis xalxisa, adisa da semudisa, da ibrahimis xalxisa, da madianelebisa da amotrialebult`a (dasaxlebisa)? mat`t`an mividnen mat`i shuamavlebi c`xadi sascaulebit`.da araa allahi iset`i, rom usamart`lod moek`c`es mat`, aramed isini t`avad moek`c`nen t`aviant` t`avs usamart`lod [urcmunoebit`a da borotmok`medebit`].

morcmune kac`ebi da morcmune k`alebi ert`manet`is megobrebi da mp`arvelebi arian. isini brz'aneben imas, rac` siket`ea da krz'alaven imas, rac` borotebaa, ag'asruleben loc`vas da gasc`emen zek`at`s, emorch`ilebian allahsa da mis shuamavals. scored mat` sheicqalebs allahi. cheshamaritad, allahi z'levamosili, brz'enia.

allahma ag'ut`k`va morcmune kac`ebsa da morcmune k`alebs samot`xis bag'ebi, romelt`a z'irsac` mdinareebi ch`amoedineba, sadac` isini samudamod darch`ebian, da mshvenier sadgomebs edemis bag'ebshi. magram alahis kmaqop`ileba qvelaze didia. scored esaa diadi carmateba.

o, moc`ik`ulo! ibrz'ole urcmunot`a (maxvilit`) da orpirt`a (dasabut`ebit`) cinaag'mdeg da iqavi mkac`ri mat`t`an [rogorc` urcmunoebt`an, ise orpirebt`an]. mat`i (samudamo) samqop`eli ik`neba jojoxet`i, da ra sashinelia es dabruneba!

ip`ic`eben allahs, rom ar ut`k`vamt`, magram mat` namdvilad t`k`ves urcmunoebis sitqva da uarqves islamis mig'ebis shemdeg, da ganizraxes is, rasac` ver miag'cies (mat` surdat` moc`ik`uli muhammadis mkvleloba an masze zianis miqeneba). da isini (orpirebi) shurs iz'ieben mxolod imis gamo, rom allahma da misi moc`ik`ulma (muhammadma) t`aviant`i uxvi cqalobit` gaamdidres isini. t`u isini moinanieben, es uket`esi ik`neba mat`t`vis, magram t`u zurgs sheak`c`even, allahi dasjis mat` mtanjveli sasjelit` amk`veqnad da imk`veqnad. da ar eqolebat` mat` dedamicaze arc` mp`arveli da arc` shemce.
mat` (t`valt`mak`c`t`a) shoris arian iset`nic`, romelt`ac` ag't`k`ma daudes allahs: t`uki is t`avisi madlit` mogvmadlis, ut`uod mocqalebas gavc`emt` da ut`uod vik`nebit` mart`alt`a shoris.
xolo roc`a uboz'a mat` t`avisi madlit`, iz'unces da zurgi ak`c`ies, da zurgi ak`c`ies mat`, ganeridnen (morch`ilebas allahisadmi).
da shedegad, man mat` gulebshi t`valt`mak`c`oba ch`aunerga im dg'emde, vidre mas shexvdebian, imis gamo, rom daarg'vies allahist`vis mic`emuli ag't`k`ma da imis gamo, rom c`ruobdnen.
nut`u ar ic`ian, rom allahma ic`is mat`i saidumlo da mat`i p`aruli saubari, da rom allahi qovlismc`odnea dap`arulisa?

isini (orpirebi), romlebic` akritikeben morcmunet`agan mat`, vinc` nebaqop`lobit` aket`ebs shesacirs (amboben, rom isini bevrs gasc`emen moch`venebit`), da (aseve akritikeben) mat`, visac` mxolod sakut`ari z'alisxmevit` [z'alit` pouloben, rasac` shesciravdnen] sheuz'lia rame shesciros, da dasc`inian mat` [g'arib morcmuneebs], (amboben, t`it`k`os isini mxolod xalxis quradg'ebis mosapoveblad aket`eben amas) allahi dasc`inebs mat` [orpirebs], da mat`t`vis gamzadebulia mtanjveli sasjeli!

shendoba st`xove mat`t`vis (t`valt`mak`c`t`at`vis), an nu st`xov, samoc`daat`jerac` rom st`xovo mat`t`vis shendoba, allahi mainc` ar miutevebs mat`, es imitom, rom mat` uarqves allahi da misi shuamavali da allahi ar daadgens cheshmarit gzaze urch` xalxs.

uxarodat` shin darch`enilt`, rom allahis shuamavlis zurgs ukan dasxdnen da sz'uldat`, ebrz'olat` t`aviant`i k`onebit`a da sulebit` allahis gzaze da t`k`ves: sic`xeshi nu gailashk`rebt`! ut`xari: jojoxet`is c`ec`xli up`ro c`xelia! rom xvdebodnen
dae, isini (ukan darch`enili orpirebi) c`otaxani ic`inon (am c`xovrebashi) da (jojoxet`is c`ec`xlshi) mravalad itiron, sanac`vlod imisa, rac` moipoves (urcmunoebit`a da orpirobit`).

t`u allahi dagabrunebs mat`gan romelime jgup`t`an da isini gt`xoven nebart`vas (salashk`rod) casasvlelad, ut`xari: verasdros camoxvalt` ch`emt`an ert`ad da verasdros ibrz'olebt` ch`emt`an ert`ad mtris cinaag'mdeg, radgan t`k`ven pirvel jerze saxlshi darch`ena arch`iet`, amitom darch`it` ukan darch`enilebt`an ert`ad.
da arasdros iloc`o (o, moc`ik`ulo) mat`gan romelime gardac`vlilze da ar dadge mis sap`lavt`an, ramet`u mat` uarqves allahi da misi shuamavali da gardaic`valnen, roc`a isini urch`ni iqvnen.

da nu mogxiblavs shen (o, moc`ik`ulo) mat`i k`oneba da mat`i shvilebi, allahs mxolod is surs, mat`i amit` dasja amk`veqnad (isini ig'lebian am k`onebis shegrovebit` da amis gamo mat` uch`ndebat` sirt`uleebi) da rom mat`i sulebi amovides (gardaic`valon) urcmunod.
da roc`a gardmoevlineba sura, rom ircmunot` allahi da ibrz'olot` mis shuamavalt`an ert`ad, nebart`vas gt`xoven mat`gan mdidarni da t`k`ves: dagvtove, rat`a viqot` shin msxdomt`a shoris!
isini (es orpirni) dasjerdnen, rom darch`enilebt`an ert`ad qop`iliqvnen. da ik`na dabechdili mat` gulebi, ase rom, isini verap`ers xvdebian.
magram shuamavali da romelt`ac` ircmunes mast`an ert`ad, ibrz'odnen t`aviant`i k`onebit`a da sulebit`. scored mat`t`visaa siket`eni da scored isini arian netarni.
allahma moumzada mat` samot`xis bag'ebi, romelt`a k`veshac` mdinareebi moedineba, sadac` maradiulad darch`ebian. ai, esaa diadi carmateba.

da movidnen (allahis moc`ik`ult`an) bodishis momxdelt`agani bediunt`agan (romlebic` medinas maxloblad c`xovrobdnen), rat`a mat` nebadart`uli hk`onodat` darch`ena. xolo isini, vinc` allahsa da mis moc`ik`uls tquili ut`xres [visac` ar hk`ondat` arc` ert`i namdvili mizezi], darch`nen mjdomared [arc` ki movidnen t`aviant`i gamart`lebis sat`k`melad] [amit` ach`venes t`aviant`i t`avxedoba allahis moc`ik`ulis cinashe] male moicvevs mat`, vinc` urcmunoni gaxdnen, mtkivneuli sasjeli [amk`veqnadac` da momaval c`xovrebashic`]

ar aris c`odva uz'lurt`at`vis, arc` sneult`at`vis da arc` mat`t`vis, vinc` ver poulobs, raime daxarjos, t`u isini gulcrp`elni arian allahisa da misi shuamavlis mimart`. ket`ilismk`mnelt`a cinaag'mdeg ar arsebobs gza. da allahi mimtevebeli, shemcqalebelia.

da arc` imat`ze, romlebic` shent`an movidnen, rat`a omshi casaqvanad pirutqvi migec`a mat`t`vis, da shen ut`xari: arap`eri gamach`nia, rom cagiqvanot` da mat`i t`valebi savse iqo c`remlit` sevdisagan radgan ver ipoves, rom daexarjat` (rom mieg'ot` monacileoba am g'irseul sak`meshi, rat`a moepovebinat` didi jildo).

saqveduri [c`odva da dasaz'raxi] mxolod imat`zea, vinc` it`xovs shengan (o, moc`ik`ulo) nebart`vas darch`enist`vis, mashin roc`a t`vit`on mdidarni arian. isini [es mdidari orpirebi] kmaqop`ilni darch`nen imit`, rom darch`nen mat`t`an ert`ad, vinc` darch`a [k`alebt`an, bavshvebt`an da mat`t`an, visac` hk`ondat` gamart`leba], da mat` gulebze daido bechedi (orpirobisa), amitomac` ar ic`ian (ra mz'ime sasjeli elit` allahis gzis mitovebis mc`delobis gamo).

isini mogibodisheben, roc`a mat`t`an dabrundebit`. ut`xari: nu moibodishebt`, ch`ven arasdros dagijerebt`. allahma ukve gvamc`no t`k`veni ambebi da allahi da misi shuamavali ixilaven t`k`vens sak`meebs, shemdeg daubrundebit` uxilavisa da xilulis mc`odnes, da is gamc`nobt`, rasac` sch`adiodit`.

isini (orpirni) allahs daip`ic`eben, roc`a mat`t`an dabrundebit`, rat`a t`avi daanebot` mat`. mash, t`avi daanebet` mat`! uechvelad, isini bilcni arian da mat`i t`avshesap`ari jojoxet`ia, imis sazg'aurad, rac` moipoves [t`aviant`i urcmunoebit`a da orpirobit`]!
gep`ic`ebian t`k`ven (es orpirni), rat`a kmaqop`ilni darch`et` mat`gan. xolo t`u kmaqop`ilni darch`ebit` mat`gan, uechvelad, allahi ar ik`neba kmaqop`ili urch`i xalxit`.

bediunebi [udabnos momt`abareebi] up`ro z'lier arian urcmunoebasa da orpirobashi (vidre k`alak`shi mc`xovrebi xalxi), (radgan isini up`ro mkac`rni da uxeshni arian da shors arian mc`odne adamianebisgan), da isini qvelaze naklebad ic`noben im sazg'vrebs, rac` allahma daudgina t`avis moc`ik`uls [shariat`is kanonebsa da dadgenilebebs].
radgan allahi qovlismc`odnea da brz'enia (t`avis sak`meebshi).
da beduint`agan zogiert`i iset`ia, rom rasac` xarjavs, zaralad miich`nevs da t`k`vent`vis ubedurebas moelis, mat`ze iqos borotebis cre! da allahi qovlismsmenia, qovlismc`odnea.

da arian beduint`agan, romelt`ac` scamt` allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli, da rasac` xarjaven, miich`neven allaht`an daaxloebis sashualebad da moc`ik`ulis vedreba [rom moc`ik`ulma allahs shest`xovos mat`t`vis] cheshmaritad, es mat`t`vis daaxloebaa. allahi mat` sheiqvans t`avis cqalobashi. cheshmaritad, allahi mimtevebelia, mcqalobelia.

xolo isini, vinc` sxvebs gauscres (rcmenashi) da iqvnen pirvelni muhajirebidan (romlebic` gadasaxldnen rcmenist`vis medinashi) da ansarebidan [medinis mobinadreebidan, romlebmac` daexmarnen allahis moc`ik`ul muhammads], da aseve isini, vinc` sando gulcrp`elobit` (rcmenit`, sitqvit`a da k`medebit`) gahqvnen mat`
allahi kmaqop`ilia mat`it`, da isinic` kmaqop`ilni arian allahit` da mat`t`vis moamzada man (samot`xis) bag'ebi, sadac` mat` k`vesh (mat` sasaxleebs k`vemot`) miedineba mdinareebi, da ik` maradiulad damkvidrdebian. es aris udidesi carmateba!

da mat` shoris, vinc` t`k`vens garshemoa beduint`agan, arian t`valt`mak`c`ni da medinelt`aganac` arian iset`ni, romelnic` gajiutdnen t`valt`mak`c`obashi shen ar ic`nob mat`, ch`ven vic`nobt` mat`. ch`ven mat` orjer davsjit`, shemdeg ki dabrunebulni ik`nebian diad sasjelt`an.
da sxvebmac` ag'iares t`aviant`i c`odvebi. mat` ket`ili sak`me c`uds sheuries. imedia, allahi apatiebs mat`. uechvelad, allahi mimtevebelia, mcqalobelia.

aig'e mat`i k`onebidan mocqaleba, rat`a amit` gancmindo isini (c`odvis bilcebisgan) da gamoascoreb mat` [orpirobis mdgomareobidan gulcrp`el rcmenamde miiqvan] da iloc`e mat`t`vis. uechvelad, sheni loc`va simshvidea mat`t`vis. da allahi qovlismsmenia, qovlismc`odnea.
nut`u ar ic`ian, rom allahi g'ebulobs monaniebas t`avis msaxurt`agan da ig'ebs mocqalebas, da rom allahi aris shemndobi, shemcqalebeli?

da ut`xari (o, moc`ik`ulo) mat` [vinc` darch`nen da ar gavidnen lashk`robaze]: aket`et` (sak`meebi), romlebic` allahis kmaqop`ilebamde migiqvant` da allahi, misi moc`ik`uli da morcmuneni ixilaven t`k`vens k`medebebs! da male (sasjelis dg'es) dabrundebit` mist`an, vinc` ic`is dap`aruli da ashkara [allaht`an], da is shegatqobinebt` imas, rasac` aket`ebdit` (da miig'ebt` sazg'aurs t`k`veni sak`meebis mixedvit`)

da (lashk`robaze argamosult`agan) arian sxvanic`, romelt`ac` allahma misc`a vada [manamde, sanam masze gadacqvetilebas gamoitans]: an dasjis mat`, an miig'ebs mat` monaniebas.
namdvilad, allahi qovlismc`odnea da brz'enia

xolo isini (orpirebi), romlebmac` aages mech`et`i imist`vis, rom ziani mieqenebinat` morcmunet`at`vis, gaez'lierebinat` urcmunoeba, ganxet`k`ileba sheetanat` morcmunet`a shoris da gaexadat` igi t`avshesap`rad im adamianist`vis, vinc` adre ebrz'oda allahsa da mis moc`ik`uls isini auc`ileblad daip`ic`eben: ch`ven mxolod siket`e gvindoda! t`umc`a allahi mocmobs, rom uechvelad isini matquarebi arian.

(o, shuamavalo) arasodes ar dadge ik` saloc`avad! mech`et`i (quba), romelic` dap`uz'nebulia g'vt`ismoshishobaze pirvelive dg'idan, up`ro g'irsia, rom ik` idge saloc`avad. ik` arian kac`ebi, romelt`ac` uqvart` gancmenda. allahs ki uqvars ganmcmendelni.

nut`u uket`esia is, vinc` t`avisi nageboba aashena allahis shishsa da mis kmaqop`ilebaze, t`u is, vinc` t`avisi nageboba daap`uz'na ch`amoshlili p`erdobis napiras da mast`an ert`ad ch`avarda jojoxet`is c`ec`xlshi? allahi ar carmart`avs scor gzaze usamart`lo xalxs

mat`i nageboba, romelic` mat` [orpirebma] aages, ar shecqvets echvshi qop`nas mat` gulebshi, sanam mat`i gulebi ar ch`aip`shvneba [sanam ar mokvdebian an ar daig'upebian]. radgan allahi qovlismc`odne da brz'enia

cheshmaritad, allahma morcmunet`agan iqida mat`i sic`oc`xle da k`oneba im sanac`vlod, rom mat`t`vis gankut`vnilia samot`xe. isini ibrz'vian allahis gzaze xoc`aven da t`avadac` ixoc`ebian. es aris cheshmariti ag't`k`ma, dadasturebuli t`orashi, injilshi da quranshi da vin aris up`ro sando t`avisi ag't`k`mis shesrulebashi, vidre allahi? gixarodet`, morcmuneno, im vachrobisa, romelic` allaht`an dadet`, radgan scored es aris udidesi carmateba!

momnaniebelni, t`aqvanismc`emelni, mak`ebarni, mmarxvelni, k`edismomxrelni, sajdas amg'srulebelni, ket`ilis mbrz'anebelni da uket`urebis amkrz'alavni, da allahis sazg'vrebis damc`velni. da axare morcmuneebs
ar ekadreba shuamavalsa da morcmuneebs, patieba it`xovon carmart`t`at`vis, t`undac` isini axlo nat`esavebi iqvnen, mas shemdeg, rac` mat`t`vis c`xadi gaxda, rom isini jojoxet`is binadarni arian.

da ibrahimis mier mamamisist`vis patiebis t`xovna mxolod dapirebis gamo iqo, romelic` mas misc`a. magram roc`a mist`vis c`xadi gaxda, rom igi allahis mteri iqo, igi ganudga mas. cheshmaritad, ibrahimi mloc`veli da shemcqnarebeli iqo.
allahi ar aris iset`i, rom xalxi gzaabnevashi sheiqvanos mas shemdeg, rac` mart`al gzaze daaqena isini, sanam ar ganumartavs mat`, risgan unda ip`rt`xilon. cheshmaritad, allahma qvelap`eri ic`is!
cheshmaritad, allahs ekut`vnis c`at`a da micis meup`eba. igi ac`oc`xlebs da akvdinebs. da t`k`ven ar gqavt` allahis garda arc` mp`arveli da arc` shemce.

allahma ukve miig'o shuamavalis monanieba (imis gamo, rom man orpirebs neba dart`o darch`eniliqvnen da ar mieg'ot` monacileoba lashk`robashi), aseve muhajirebisa [morcmunet`a, romlebic` gadmosaxldnen medinashi] da ansarebis [medinis muslimt`a], romlebic` mihqvnen mas (shuamavals) (t`abuk`is lashk`robashi) siz'nelis zhams [sic`xeshi, sakvebis da satransporto sashualebebis naklebobis dros],
mas shemdeg, rac` mat`gan zogiert`t`a gulebma t`it`k`mis gadauxvies (rom ar gavidnen lashk`robashi). shemdeg man miig'o mat`i monanieba, radgan namdvilad, igi mat` mimart` mocqale da shembralebelia.

(allahma miig'o monanieba da miuteva) im sam kac`sac`,
romlebic` darch`nen [vinc` droebit` darch`nen allahis gadacqvetilebis molodinshi]. roc`a mat`t`vis mica shevicrovda, miuxedavad t`avisi siganisa, da mat`i sulebic` sheikumshnen [gulshi mz'ime cuxili igrz'nes], da mixvdnen, rom allahisgan t`avshesap`ari araa, garda imisa, rom masve daubrundnen (monaniebit`), shemdeg allahma miig'o mat`i monaniebac`, rat`a mat` shez'les gulcrp`eli monanieba.
cheshamritad, allahi mpatiebeli da shemcqalebelia!
hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! geshinodet` allahisa da iqavit` mart`alt`a ert`ad

medinis mac`xovreblebsa da mat`, vinc` mat` garshemo c`xovroben bediunt`agan, ar shehp`eris allahis moc`ik`ulisgan ch`amorch`ena [lashk`robidan darch`ena] da sakut`ari t`avis mjobineba masze [roc`a t`avad mshvidad arian, xolo moc`ik`uli itans siz'neles]. radgan roc`a mat` moic`avt` cqurvili, dag'liloba an shimshili allahis gzaze, an gadadgamen nabijs, romelic` gaag'izianebs urcmunoebs, da qoveli ziani, romelsac` isini miaqeneben mters ch`aicereba mat`t`vis ket`ilsak`med. cheshmaritad, allahi ar daukargavs sazg'aurs ket`ilismk`mnelt`!

da rac` ar unda mc`ire t`u didi shesaciri gaig'on mat` allahis gzaze, da romeli xeobac` ar unda gadakvet`on (lashk`robisas) qvelap`eri es ch`aicereba mat`t`vis,
rat`a allahma miuzg'os mat` imaze uket`esit`, vidre isini aket`ebdnen.

morcmuneebs ar shehp`eris qvelas ert`ad gasvla (omshi mtert`an), iseve rogorc` qvelas ert`ad darch`ena da uk`mad qop`na allahis gzaze, netav ratom ar gamova mat`i qoveli jgup`idan ert`i nacili, rat`a sheiscavlon religia (da allahis shariat`i), da roc`a dabrundebian t`aviant` xalxt`an, ascavlon da sheagonon isini (rat`a mat` shishi hk`ondet` allahis sasjelis misi brz'anebebis shesrulebit` da akrz'alult`agan ganridebit`)
hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ibrz'olet` im urcmunot`a cinaag'mdeg, romlebic` t`k`vens axlos arian, da ach`venet` mat` t`k`veni simkac`re. da ic`odet`, rom allahi g'vt`ismoshishebt`anaa

da roc`a romelime sura gardmoevlineba (allahisgan), mat` shoris arian iset`ebic`, romlebic` amboben: romel t`k`vengans shehmata aman rcmena? xolo mat`, romelt`ac` ircmunes, shehmata mat` rcmena da isini xaroben.

rac` sheexeba mat`, visi gulebic` sneulebit`aa shepqrobili (echvit` an orpirobit`), es [gardmovlenili sura] mxolod mat` shehmatebs borotebas [echvsa t`u orpirobas] mat` ukve arsebul borotebast`an ert`ad, da isini gardaic`valnen urcmunoebad.

nut`u ver xedaven, rom isini gamoic`debian qovel cels ert`xel an orjer, shemdeg mat` ag'ar moinanies da ag'ar sheigoneben (mocodebebs) [da ag'ar ig'eben sargebels allahis im sascaulebidan, romlebic` sakut`ari t`valit` naxes].

rodesac` gardmoevlineba raime sura (romelshic` gamomzhg'avnebulia orpirt`a sak`meebi), zogiert`ni mat`gan [orpirt`agan, vinc` moc`ik`ulis shekrebashi zis] ert`manet`s shexedaven da itqvian: gxedavt` vinme (morcmunet`agan)? shemdeg ki zurgs ak`c`even [dgebian da midian]. allahma ganashoros mat`i gulebi (rcmenasa da scor gzas) imis gamo, rom isini arian adamianebi, romlebic` ver xvdebian (simart`les da ar p`ik`roben masze)
uechvelad, mogividat` t`k`ven shuamavali t`k`venganve. mz'imea mist`vis t`k`veni tanjva, zrunavs t`k`venze, morcmunet`a mimart` ki t`anamgrz'nobi, mocqalea.
xolo t`u isini [orpirebi da mravalg'mert`ianebi] zurgs ik`c`even, shen ut`xari: ch`emt`vis allahi kmara! ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba mis garda. mas mivende da igia diadi taxtis up`ali
alip`. laam. raa. esaa brz'nuli cignis aiat`ebi.

gana gasakviria xalxist`vis, rom ch`ven sht`avagonet` mat`gan (ert`) kac`s: gaap`rt`xile xalxi (allahis sasjelis shesaxeb) da axare morcmuneebs, rom mat`t`vis mat`i up`lis cinashe momzadebulia didi jildo? magram urcmunoebma t`k`ves: cheshmaritad, es [muhammadi] ashkarad jadok`aria!

cheshmaritad, t`k`veni g'mert`i (o xalxo), aris allahi. is, vinc` shek`mna c`ani da mica ek`vs dg'eshi(miuxedavad imisa, rom mas sheez'lo isini ert`i sitqvit` iqav! camebshi sheek`mna), shemdeg ki amag'lda taxtze (ise, rogorc` sheep`ereba mxolod mis sidiades), da ganagebs qvela sak`mes. aravinaa iset`i, vinc` shez'lebs shuamdgomlobas mis cinashe, garda im shemt`xvevisa, roc`a t`vit`on is nebas misc`ems. ai aset`i aris allahi, t`k`veni up`ali t`aqvani ec`it` mxolod mas! nut`u ar moegebit` gons da ar dap`ik`rdebit`?

xolod mast`an ik`neba t`k`veni dabruneba (gansjis dg'es) allahis cheshmariti ag't`k`misamebr. cheshmaritad, is icqebs k`mnas [shek`mnas arap`ridan] da shemdeg kvlav ag'adgens mas [t`avisi z'lierebit`], rat`a samart`lianad daajildovos isini, romelt`ac` ircmunes da ket`ili sak`meebi aket`es [allahis gulist`vis, misi da misi moc`ik`ulis brz'anebebis mixedvit`]. xolo isini, vinc` urcmunoni gaxdnen, mat`t`vis gamzadebulia adug'ebuli cqali dasalevad da mtanjveli sasjeli mat`i urcmunoebis gamo

mxolod isaa (allahi), romelmac` hk`mna mze manat`obelad (nat`ebis cqarod shek`mna), xolo mt`vare shuk`ad [romelic` mzis sinat`les ireklavs], da ganusazg'vra mas sadgurebi (p`azebi), rat`a ic`odet` clebis raodenoba da drois ag'ric`xva [mze gansazg'vravs dg'eebs, xolo mt`vare t`veebsa da celicadebs]. allahma es qvelap`eri cheshmaritad [sibrz'nit`a da mizanit`] shek`mna. is ganmartavs t`avis sascaulebs im xalxist`vis, romelt`ac` ic`ian
uechvelad, g'amisa da dg'is monac`vleobashi da imashi, rac` g'mert`ma shek`mna c`at`a shina da k`veqanazed, sascaulebia xalxist`vis, romelt`ac` eshiniat`

cheshmaritad, isini, romelnic` ar imedovneben ch`vent`an shexvedras [ar scamt` gansjis dg'is], da kmaqop`ilni arian amk`veqniuri c`xovrebit` da masshi nugeshs pouloben [srulad ez'levian am c`xovrebas], da isini, vinc` uquradg'eboni arian ch`veni sascaulebis mimart`,
mat`i samqop`eli c`ec`xlia imis sanac`vlod, rasac` isini imkidnen [mat`i c`odvebis da urcmunoebis gamo].
cheshmaritad, romelt`ac` ircmunes da hk`mnes ket`ili sak`meni, mat`i g'mert`i carmart`avs mat` mat`ive rcmenit`. mat` k`vesh idineben mdinareebi netarebis bag'ebshi.
mat`i vedreba [samot`xeshi ik`neba: dideba shenda, o, allah! da mat`i misalmeba ik` ik`neba mshvidoba! da mat`i moxmobis dasasruli ik`neba: k`eba allahs, samqarot`a g'mert`s!

da allahs rom daech`k`arebina adamiant`at`vis boroteba ise, rogorc` isini siket`es iscrap`vian, mashin mat`i vada (bedi) ukve gadacqvetili ik`neboda (isini ukve gardaic`vlebodnen). magram ch`ven mivatovebt` mat`, romelnic` ch`vent`an shexvedras ar imedovneben, t`aviant` usamart`lobashi, brmad iaron t`aviant` shec`domasa da gzaabneulobashi.

rodesac` adamians ubedureba sheexeba, is mogvixmobs mcoliare, mjdomare an mdgomare mdgomareobashi. magram roc`a ch`ven movashorebt` mas mis gasachirs, is midis ise, t`it`k`os arasodes mouxmia ch`vent`vis ubedurebis dros. amgvarad mort`ulad da mshvenivrad ech`venebat` zg'vargadasult` rasac` aket`eben [rasac` aket`eben t`aviant`i k`medebebi].

da ch`ven ukve gavanadguret` t`aobebi t`k`venamde, roc`a mat` usamart`loba ch`aidines da movidnen mat`t`an mat`i shuamavlebi c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebit`, magram mat` ar ircmunes. ase mivuzg'avt` ch`ven damnashave xalxs.
shemdeg ch`ven gk`menit` t`k`ven (o xalxo), mat` shemdeg dedamicis memkvidreebad, rat`a davinaxot`, rogor moik`c`evit` (ra sak`meebs ch`aident` da shemdeg mogagot` t`k`veni k`medebebis shesabamisad)

roc`a mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] caukit`xaven ch`vens nat`el da mkap`io sascaulebs [quranis aiat`ebs], isini, vinc` ar imedovneben ch`vent`an shexvedras [ar sjerat` sasjelis dg'is], amboben: mogvitane sxva qurani, amisgan gansxvavebuli [iset`i, sadac` ar ik`neba is, rac` ch`ven ar mogvcons], an shec`vale igi, ut`xari mat` (o, shuamavalo): me ar mak`vs up`leba, t`vit`neburad shevc`valo igi. me mxolod imas mivqvebi, rac` zesht`amegona (allahisgan). cheshmaritad, t`u ch`ems up`als veurch`ebi, me meshinia diadi dg'is [gankit`xvis dg'is]

ut`xari mat` (o, moc`ik`ulo): t`u allahi isurvebda, me ar cagikit`xavdit` mas [qurans] da arc` t`k`ven gek`nebodat` c`odna mis shesaxeb, me xom mt`eli ch`emi c`xovreba t`k`ven shoris gavatare [sanam gamoc`xadeba ar gadmovida]. nut`u ar dap`ik`rdebit`?
da vinaa up`ro usamart`lo imaze, vinc` sic`rues t`xzavs allahis shesaxeb an c`rud rac`xavs mis aiat`ebs/sascaulebs? cheshmaritad, ar ik`nebian carmatebulni damnashaveni [mravalg'mert`ianni]

da isini t`aqvans sc`emen allahis garda imas, rac` ver avnebs mat` da ver sargebels moutans, da amboben: eseni arian ch`veni shuamdgomlebi allaht`an! ut`xari mat` (o, moc`ik`ulo): nut`u allahs atqobinebt` imas, rasac` man ar ucqis c`at`a shina da micaze? cminda da didebulia igi im qvelap`erze, rasac` mas ut`anaziareben!

da ar iqvnen adamianebi, garda ert`i t`emisa(rcmenisa), magram isini gaiqvnen. da rom ara sitqva, romelic` cin uscrebda sheni g'mert`isgan, mat` shoris ukve gadacqvetili ik`neboda is, razec` isini davoben.

isini [urcmunoni] amboben: ratom ar gardmoevlina mas (muhammads) sascauli misi g'mert`isgan? ut`xari: cheshmaritad, uxilavi mxolod allahs ekut`vnis. mash, daelodet` (roc`a allahi gansjis ch`vens shoris), da mec` t`k`vent`an ert`ad vik`nebi mat` shoris, vinc` elodeba

da roc`a adamianebs vagemebinebt` cqalobas gasachiris shemdeg, romelic` mat` sheexo, mashinve isini mzakvroben ch`veni aiat`ebis cinaag'mdeg. ut`xari: allahi up`ro scrap`ia xrikebshi. cheshmaritad, ch`veni moc`ik`ulni [angelozebi] iceren t`k`vens qvela zraxvas.

is aris (allahi), vinc` gamgzavrebt` xmelet`sa da zg'vaze. vidre ar ag'moch`ndebit` xomaldebshi, romlebic` sasiamovno k`arit` miapoben talg'ebs da isini amit` xaroben, moevlineba mas mz'vinvare k`arishxali da qoveli mxridan talg'ebi moadgebat`, da ip`ik`reben, rom garshemortqmulni arian, mashin isini gulcrp`eli rcmenit` sheg'ag'adeben allahs: t`uki gvixsni am gansac`delisgan, ut`uod, madliert`agani vik`nebit`!

xolo roc`a ixsna isini, mashinve isini usamart`lod borotmok`medeben dedamicaze. hei, xalxo! t`k`veni usamart`loba mxolod t`k`vensave sulebs vnebs. amk`veqniuri c`xovreba droebit`i siamovnebaa. shemdeg ch`vent`anaa t`k`veni dabruneba, da gaucqebt` t`k`ven, rasac` sch`adiodit`.

amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis magalit`i im cqals hgavs, romelic` ch`ven zec`idan gardmovavlinet`, romlit`ac` ag'moc`enda micis mc`enareuloba, romlit`ac` ikvebebian adamianebi da pirutqvi. da roc`a mica sheimosa t`avisi samkaulit` da damshvenda, da misma mc`xovreblebma ip`ik`res, rom isini arian misi mp`lobelebi, moevlina mas ch`veni brz'aneba g'amit` an dg'isit`, da ch`ven is momkulad [ganadgurebuld] vak`c`iet`, t`it`k`os gushin arc` ki uxarebia. ai, ase ganvmartavt` ch`ven aiat`ebs im xalxist`vis, romelnic` p`ik`roben.
g'mert`i mouxmobs mshvidobis samqop`elisken (samot`xisaken) da daadgens, visac` inebebs, scor gzaze.

vinc` gulcrp`elni iqvnen (allahisadmi t`aqvanisc`emashi), mat`t`vis gamzadebulia sauket`eso [samot`xe] da damateba [allahis saxis xilva]. da ar dap`aravs mat` saxeebs mtveri da damc`ireba (rogorc` es moxdeba jojoxet`is binadart`a shemt`xvevashi). isini arian samot`xis binadarni, sadac` isini ik`nebian samudamod

xolo romelt`ac` moixveches siaveni [gaxdnen urcmunoni], siavis sazg'auri misi msgavsia da dap`aravs mat` damc`ireba. ar eqolebat` mat` allahisgan damc`veli. t`it`k`osda mat`i saxeebi dap`arulia bneli g'amis nacilebit`. ai, isini arian c`ec`xlis mkvidrni. isini ik` samudamod darch`ebian.

mouqevi mat` (o, shuamavalo) im dg'eze, roc`a ch`ven shevkrebt` mat` qvelas [qvela k`mnilebas] angarishis da sazg'aurisat`vis. shemdeg vetqvit` mat`, romelt`ac` daudgines t`anaziari (allahs): darch`it` t`k`vens adgilas t`k`ven da t`k`veni t`anamoziareni [isini, visac` t`aqvans sc`emdit`]! da ch`ven gavqop`t` mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs imat`gan, visac` isini t`aqvans sc`emdnen], xolo mat`i t`anamoziareni (kerpebi)etqvian: t`k`ven ch`ven ar gvc`emdit` t`aqvans (amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi)
kmara allahi mocmed ch`vensa da t`k`vens shoris, rom ch`ven uc`odinarni viqavit` [ar vic`odit`] t`k`veni t`aqvanisc`emis shesaxeb.

ik` [gankit`xvis adgilze] qoveli suli ixilavs da gamoc`dis imas, rac` man cinascar moimok`meda, da mas daubrundeba sazg'auri misi sak`meebis mixedvit`. isini dabrundebian allaht`an t`aviant` cheshmarit mp`arvelt`an, da gauch`inardeba mat`gan qvelap`eri, rac` mat` gamoigones [is c`ru g'mert`ebi, romelt`a shuamdgomlobasac` elodnen]

ut`xari: vin gaz'levt` sarch`os t`k`ven c`idan da micidan, an vin p`lobs smenasa da mxedvelobas, da vis gamohqavs c`oc`xali mkvdridan da gamohqavs mkvdari c`oc`xlidan, da vin ganagebs sak`mes? isini itqvian: allahi! mashin ut`xari: nut`u ar shegeshindebat`?

ai, aset`ia allahi t`k`veni cheshmariti up`ali! mash, ra darch`a cheshmaritebis shemdeg, t`u ara gzaabneuloba? rogor ak`c`evt` zurgs cheshmaritebas (mas shemdeg, rac` igi gaxda c`nobili t`k`vent`vis)?
ase gamart`lda sheni up`lis sitqva mat`ze, vinc` urch`obda, rom isini ar ircmuneben.

ut`xari: aris t`u ara t`k`vens t`anaziarebs shoris [romelsac` t`aqvans sc`emt` allahis garda] iset`i, vinc` k`mnis pirvelad [k`mnis arap`ridan], shemdeg ki ag'adgens mas [sikvdilis shemdeg]? ut`xari: allahia is, vinc` icqebs k`mnas [k`mnis arap`ridan] da shemdeg kvlav ag'adgens mas t`avisi z'lierebit` [t`avisi z'alaup`lebit`]. nut`u amdenad shordebit` (cheshmarit gzas)

t`k`vi: gana t`k`vens t`anaziart`a shoris aris vinme? vinc` ucinamz'g'vrebs cheshmaritebisken? t`k`vi: allahi ucinamz'g'vrebs cheshmaritebisken. is, vinc` cheshmaritebisken ucinmz'g'vrebs, up`ro g'irsia, rom mas misdion, t`u is, vinc` t`vit`on ver poulobs cheshmarit gzas, t`u mas ar ucinamz'g'vreben? ra gemart`ebat`? rogor gansjit`?

da mat`i umravlesoba mxolod varauds misdevs. cheshmaritad, varaudi verap`rit` shec`vlis cheshmaritebas. uechvelad, allahi qovlismc`odnea imisa, rasac` isini sch`adian.
mat`gan umetesoba [am mravalg'mert`iant`agan] mxolod varauds mihqveba (roc`a p`ik`robs, rom mat`i kerpebi daaxloeben mat` allaht`an). cheshmaritad, varaudi ver ch`aanac`vlebs simart`les, t`undac` nacilobriv. namdvilad, allahi ucqis qvelap`ers, rasac` isini aket`eben [mat`i urcmunoeba da gzaabneuloba].

es qurani ver ik`neboda mogonili vinmes mier allahis garda. igi gadmoic`a imis dasamocmeblad, rac` adre iqo gamoc`xadebuli [cignebi, romlebic` gaegzavnat` cina shuamavlebs], da rogorc` cignis ganmarteba [rcmenisa da shariat`is debulebat`a nat`eli axsna muhammadis t`emist`vis]. ar aris echvi imashi, rom is samqarot`a up`lisganaa.

an ik`neb isini amboben: (muhammadma) t`avad moigona igi [qurani]? ut`xari mat` (o, moc`ik`ulo): mash, moitanet` ert`i sura, msgavsi misi [quranisa], da mouxmet` visac` shegiz'liat`, allahis garda, t`u mart`alt`agani xart`! (t`u t`k`ven qvelas ert`ad ar shegiz'liat` ert`i suris shedgena, mashin rogor shez'lo muhammadma, ubralo adamianma, mt`eli quranis mogoneba?)

magram mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebma] uarqves is [qurani], romlis c`odnas ver ch`acvdnen [ver ch`acvdnen mis mnishvnelobas da ver dap`ik`rdnen masze], da romlis ganmartebac` [shegonebis shesruleba da ag'sruleba] jer ar mosvliat`. zustad aseve uarqves (gamoc`xadeba) mat`amde mc`xovrebma t`emebmac`. shexede t`u rogori iqo usamart`lot`a dasasruli
da mat` shoris arian iset`ni, romelt`ac` scamt` igi, da mat` shoris arian iset`nic`, romelt`ac` ar scamt` igi. da sheni g'mert`i qvelaze uket` ic`nobs borotebismk`mnelt`.

t`u isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] c`rud shegrac`xaven shen (o, shuamavalo), ut`xari mat`: me mak`vs ch`emi sak`me [da ch`emi sazg'auri ch`emi sak`meebist`vis], xolo t`k`ven gak`vt` t`k`veni sak`meebi [da t`k`veni sazg'auri t`k`veni k`medebebist`vis].
t`k`ven ar gak`vt` kavshiri imast`an, rasac` me vaket`eb, da mec` ar mak`vs kavshiri imast`an, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`
da mat`(mravalg'mert`ianebs) shoris arian iset`ebic`, romlebic` gismenen shen(quranis kit`xvisas). gana shen qrus gaagoneb, t`undac` rom verap`ers xvdebodnen?
da mat` shoris arian iset`ebic`, romlebic` shemogc`k`erian. magram gana shen daadgen brmebs scor gzaze, t`undac` isini ver xedavdnen?!
cheshmaritad, allahi usamart`lod ar moepqroba xalxs arap`ershi, aramed xalxi t`vit`on epqroba sakut`ar t`avs usamart`lod.

da im dg'es [sasjelis dg'es], roc`a allahi shekrebs mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs], mat` moech`venebat`, t`it`k`os da ert`i saat`i gautarebiat` amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi, da isini ert`manet`s ic`noben (ise, rogorc` ic`nobdnen micier c`xovrebashi). cheshmaritad, zarali naxes mat`, vinc` allaht`an shexvedra sic`rued ch`at`vala [vinc` ar ircmuna ag'dgomisa da gansjis dg'e], isini ar iqvnen scor gzaze mavalni

(rogoric` ar unda iqos,) ch`ven gich`venebt` shen (o, moc`ik`ulo) im sasjelt`agan nacils, rasac` vpirdebit` mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs], anda mogakvdinebt` shen (sanam amas ixilav), rogorc` ar unda moxdes, mat`i dabruneba ch`vent`an ik`neba (gankit`xvis dg'es). shemdeg allahi ik`neba mocme imisa, rasac` isini aket`ebdnen

qovel t`ems (romelic` t`k`venamde iqo, o xalxno) hqavda t`avisi moc`ik`uli. da roc`a mova mat`i moc`ik`uli (gankit`xvis dg'es) [t`it`oeuli t`emi mova t`avisi moc`ik`ulit`, sak`meebis cignit` da angeloz-mcerlebit`, romlebic` ik`nebian mocmeebi mat`t`vis], mashin mat` shoris ganach`eni gamoitaneba samart`lianad, da isini ar daich`agrebian [aravin daisjeba umizezod]
da isini amboben [shens xalxt`agan mravalg'mert`ianni]: rodis shesruldeba es dapireba [gankit`xvis dg'e], t`u t`k`ven (o, muhammad da t`k`veni mimdevrebi) mart`als ambobt`?

ut`xari mat` (o, moc`ik`ulo): me ar vp`lob z'alas ch`emi t`avist`vis arc` zianze da arc` sargebelze garda imisa, rasac` allahi esurvebs. [me ar shemiz'lia t`avidan avic`ilo ziani an movipovo sargebeli, t`u amas allahi ar inebebs.]
qovel t`ems ak`vs t`avisi vada [dro, romelic` allahma ganusazg'vra]. roc`a dadgeba mat`i vada, isini ver sheaqovneben mas ert` camsac` ki da ver daach`k`areben mis mosvlas ert`i camit`ac`

ut`xari (o, shuamavalo) am [mravalg'mert`ianebs]: rogor p`ik`robt`, t`u misi sasjeli mogevlinebat` g'amit` an dg'isit`, ris dach`k`arebas it`xoven misgan( sasjelisgan) damnashaveni [mravalg'mert`ianni]?

nut`u mashin, roc`a sasjeli dagatqdebat` (o, mravalg'mert`ianebo), ircmunebt` mas [sasjels]?
(mat` et`k`mebat`): axla ircmunet`, mashin roc`a manamde t`vit`onve ach`k`arebdit` mis mosvlas [sasjels it`xovdit`]?

shemdeg et`k`mebat` mat`, vinc` usamart`lod moik`c`a (sakut`ari t`avis mimart`) t`avisi urcmunoebit`: igemet` maradiulobis sasjeli! gana gezg'vebat` rame sxva, garda imisa, rasac` t`avad moimok`medet`? [t`k`ven gezg'vebat` mxolod t`k`veni urcmunoebist`vis.]

isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] gekit`xebian shen (o, shuamavalo): mart`alia es [sasjeli]? ut`xari mat` (o, moc`ik`ulo): diax, vp`ic`av ch`ems up`als, es uechvelad cheshmaritebaa! da t`k`ven verasodes ver daamarc`xebt` allahs [ver daz'vrebit` ag'dgomisgan, gankit`xvisa da sazg'aurisgan].

da rom t`it`oeul suls, romelmac` ch`aidina usamart`loba [mravalg'mert`ianoba da urcmunoeba], k`onoda qvelap`eri, rac` dedamicazea, igi uechvelad moindomebda amit` gamosqidvas (jojoxet`is maradiuli tanjvisgan) gankit`xvis dg'es. magram roc`a dainaxaven sasjels, damalaven t`aviant` sinanuls. da mat` shoris gamoitaneba ganach`eni samart`lianad, da isini ar daich`agrebian [veravin daisjeba umizezod]

diax! cheshmaritad, allahs marto mas ekut`vnis qvelap`eri, rac` c`at`a shinaa da micazea! cheshmaritad, allahis ag't`k`ma cheshmaritebaa (ag't`k`ma shexvedrisa mast`an da mravalg'mert`iant`a dasjisa), magram mat`gan umetesoba ar ucqis!
is ac`oc`xlebs da akvdinebs da mast`an ik`nebit` dabrunebulni
hei, adamianebo! uechvelad, mogividat` t`k`ven shegoneba t`k`veni g'mert`isgan da gankurneba imisa, rac` mkerdshia, da scor gzad da cqalobad morcmunet`at`vis.

ut`xari (o, shuamavalo) (qvela xalxs): allahis siket`it`a [quranis gamogzavnit`] da misi mocqalebit` [islamis minichebit`] amit` uxarodet` mat`! es [qurani da islami] uket`esia imaze, rasac` isini agroveben [amk`veqniur simdidreze].
ut`xari: ras itqvit` im sarch`oze, romelic` allahma giboz'at`, da t`k`ven misi nacili akrz'alulad sherac`xet`, nacili ki nebadart`ulad? ut`xari: allahma dagrt`ot` neba, t`u allahs c`ils scamebt`?

da ras p`ik`roben isini, vinc` allahze sic`rues t`xzaven, gankit`xvis dg'es? cheshmaritad, allahi aris uxvi cqalobis mp`lobeli [netarebis momnichebeli] adamianebis mimart` [is ar ch`k`arobs dasajos isini, vinc` mis cinaag'mdeg sic`rues igonebs], magram mat`i umravlesoba ar aris madlieri [rac` man mat` uboz'a, da xdebian urcmunoni].

da romel sak`meshi ar unda iqo (o, shuamavalo), an rac` ar unda caikit`xo misgan [allahisgan] gadmoc`emuli quranidan, da rac` ar unda aket`ot` t`k`ven (o, adamianebo), ch`ven vik`nebit` mocmeebi t`k`vent`vis, roc`a am sak`meshi xart` ch`art`ulni. da sheni up`lisgan ver daimaleba verc` mtvris conad mc`ire ram rac` micazea da rac` c`ashi, da rac` imaze pataraa da rac` imaze didi, radgan es qovelive ukve ch`acerilia c`xad cignshi [dac`ul dap`aze]
diax! [ic`odet`, xalxo, rom] cheshmaritad, allahis megobrebs ar daeup`lebat` shishi (gankit`xvis dg'es, roc`a allahi dasjis urcmunoebs), da isini ar damcuxrdebian (imaze, rac` amk`veqnad dakarges)
romelt`ac` ircmunes da iqvnen allahis moshishni (asrulebdnen mis brz'anebebs da shors icherdnen t`avs imisgan, rac` man akrz'ala)

mat`t`vis aris sasixarulo ambavi (allahisgan) amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi [mart`al sizmrad, ket`il c`nobad da shemceobad] da maradiul c`xovrebashi [c`nobad imisa, rom isini samot`xis binadarni arian]. allahis sitqvebs c`vlileba ar ak`vs [is ar arg'vevs da ar c`vlis t`avis ag't`k`mas]. es aris didi carmateba!
nu dagcuxebs mat`i [mravalg'mert`iant`a] sitqva (o, shuamavalo) [sic`rue, romelsac` isini allahze igoneben]. cheshmaritad, qvela dideba ekut`vnis allahs, is aris qovlismsmeni da qovlismc`odne

ic`odet`, rom allahisaa qoveli, rac` c`at`a shinaa da k`veqanaze zeda. isini, romelnic` allahis garda sxva t`anaziart` mouxmoben, ar misdeven mat`. isini mxolod varauds misdeven da isini mxolod c`ruoben.
is aris, romelmac` dagidginat` g'ame, rat`a masshi daisvenot`, da dg'e nat`eli. cheshmaritad, amashi sascaulebia xalxist`vis, romelnic` ismenen.

isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] amboben:,,allahma shvili aiqvana. is didebulia da cmindaa qovelgvari naklisgan! is t`vit`kmaria da arap`ershi schirdeba! mas ekut`vnis qvelap`eri, rac` c`at`a shinaa da micazea. [rist`vis unda shvili mas, roc`a qvelap`eri isedac` mas ekut`vnis?] t`k`ven ar gak`vt` amaze aranairi mtkic`ebuleba! nut`u allahze ambobt` imas, rac` ar ic`it`?
t`k`vi: cheshmaritad, isini, vinc` allahze sic`rues t`xzaven, ver ik`nebian carmatebulni

(nu egonebat`, rom isargebleben t`aviant`i urcmunoebit`) es ik`neba mxolod droebit` amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi shemdeg isini dabrundebian ch`vent`an (angarishisa da sazg'aurisat`vis), ch`ven vagemebinebt` mat` mz'ime sasjels imis gamo, rac` amk`veqnad urcmunoeba ch`aidines.

da caukit`xe mat` ambavi noesi, roc`a ut`xra t`avis xalxs:,,hei, ch`emo xalxo! t`u t`k`vent`vis mz'imea ch`emi ak` dgoma da ch`emi shexseneba allahis aiat`ebisa, me allahs var mindobili. gaaert`ianet` t`k`veni sak`me [sheikribet` ert`ad] da moixmet` t`k`veni t`anamonacileebi [t`k`veni g'mert`ebi], shemdeg nu dap`aravt` t`k`vens ganzraxvas ch`emt`an dakavshirebit` [imok`medet` g'iad], shemdeg ki gadacqvitet` ch`ems cinaag'mdeg qvelap`eri, rac` shegiz'liat`, da nu momc`emt` gadadebas (arc` ert`i camit`)
xolo t`u zurgs ak`c`evt`, me t`k`vengan aranairi sazg'auri ar mit`xovia. ch`emi sazg'auri mxolod allahzea da me nabrz'anebi mak`vs, rom viqo muslimt`agan(misdami morch`ilt`agan).

magram mat` is matquarad sherac`xes, da ch`ven gadavarch`inet` is da vinc` mast`an ert`ad iqo kidobanshi, da isini davadginet` memkvidreebad, da davaxrch`vet` isini, romelt`ac` uarqves ch`veni sascaulebi, rogori iqo dasasruli [ra sasjeli daeciat`] mat`, vinc` shegonebulni iqvnen [romelnic` allahis sasjelis shesaxeb gaap`rt`xiles]
mere mis shemdgom carvgzavnet` shuamavlebi t`aviant` xalxt`an da miutanes mat` c`xadi sascaulebi, magram mat` ar ircmunes is, rac` uarqves manamde. ase davbechdavt` gulebs zg'vargadasult`a

mat` shemdeg [cina shuamavlebis shemdeg] gavugzavnet` musa da haruni p`araons da mis mt`avrebs ch`veni sascaulebit`, magram mat` [p`araonma da misma amalam] ampartavnoba gamoavlines simart`lis cinashe da ag'moch`ndnen borotmok`med xalxad [urcmuno mravalg'mert`ianebad].
xolo roc`a moevlinat` mat` cheshmariteba ch`vengan, t`k`ves: ut`uod, es c`xadi jadok`robaa!

musam ut`xra mat` (gaoc`ebulma mat`i sitqvebit`):
nut`u ase ambobt` simart`leze, roc`a is ukve movida t`k`vent`an? nut`u es jadok`robaa? xolo jadok`rebi ver ik`nebian carmatebulni (arc` amk`veqnad da arc` maradiul c`xovrebashi)
mat` t`k`ves: gana imist`vis moxvedi, rom gzidan agvac`dino imisgan, razec` ch`veni mamebi vipovet`, da rom t`k`ven ors gk`ondet` sidiade am k`veqanaze? ch`ven ar gicamebt` t`k`ven!
da ut`xra p`araonma: momiqvanet` qoveli mc`odne jadok`ari!
roc`a movidnen jadok`rebi, ut`xra mat` musam: gadaagdet` is, ris gadagdebasac` apirebt` [t`k`veni t`okebi da kvert`xebi]
roc`a mat` gadmoqares, musam t`k`va: is, rac` t`k`ven moitanet`, jadok`robaa. uechvelad, allahi mas gaabat`ilebs. cheshmaritad, allahi ar gamoascorebs areulobis mt`esvelt`a sak`meebs.
da alahi amkvidrebs cheshmaritebas t`avisi sitqvebit`, t`undac` sz'uldet` es borotmok`medebs.

musasi ar ircmunes garda mc`iredi sht`amomavlebisa (axalgazrdebisa) misive xalxidan, p`araonisa da misi amalis shishit`, rom ar daesajat` isini [da amit` ar gadaexviat` rcmenisgan].
cheshmaritad, p`araoni iqo ampartavani dedamicaze da namdvilad iqo sazg'vrebs gadasuli [romelt`ac` gadalaxes qoveli zg'vari urcmunoebashi da z'aladobashi].
da t`k`va musam: hei, ch`emo xalxo! t`u t`k`ven ircmunet` allahi, mashin mas miendet`, t`u t`k`ven xart` muslimebi.
da t`k`ves: allahs mivendet`. up`alo ch`veno! nu gvak`c`ev sac`durad usamart`lo xalxist`vis.
da gvixseni sheni cqalobit` urcmuno xalxisgan

da sht`avagonet` musasa da mis z'mas: airch`iet` t`k`veni xalxist`vis sac`xovreblebi egvipteshi da t`k`veni saxlebi gaxadet` saloc`av mimart`ulebad [loc`ulobdet` t`k`vens saxlebshi]. sheasrulet` (savaldebulo) loc`va droulad da axare, o musa, morcmuneni [axare mat` allahis shemceobisa da didi sazg'auris ambavi mat`i mtrebis cinaag'mdeg].

da t`k`va musam: g'mert`o ch`veno! shen miec`i p`araonsa da mis didebulebs mort`uloba da k`oneba amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi, g'mert`o ch`veno, rat`a mat` [adamianebi] aac`dinon shens gzas. g'mert`o ch`veno! gaanadgure mat`i k`oneba da gauk`vave gulebi, rat`a ar ircmunon, sanam ar ixilaven mcare tanjvas.
(didebulma allahma) t`k`va: shesmenil ik`na t`k`veni vedreba! mash, mtkic`ed idek`it` da ar gahqvet` gzas imat`isas, romelt`ac` ar ic`ian!

da gadaviqvanet` israelis z'eni zg'vaze, da daedevna mat` p`araoni da misi lashk`ari usamart`lod da mtrulad. vidre, roc`a daxrch`obam mouscro, t`k`va: vircmune, rom ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda imisa, romelic` ircmunes israelis z'et`a, da me var muslimt`agani(allahis morch`ilt`agani).
axla?!(roc`a sikvdili dagecia) arada manamde urch`obdi da iqavi ert`-ert`i borotebismk`mnelt`agani
dg'es ch`ven gadagarch`ent` sheni sxeulit`, rat`a iqo sascauli mat`t`vis, vinc` shens shemdeg mova. da cheshmaritad, adamiant`agan mravali ch`vens sascaulebs ugulebelqop`s.

[da ai, p`araonis dag'upvis shemdeg], ch`ven davasaxlet` israilis sht`amomavloba cheshmaritebis samqop`elshi [shamsa da egvipteshi] da movanichet` mat` siket`eni [nebadart`uli sazrdo da barak`iani micis netari p`up`uneba]. da isini [iudevelebi, romlebic` c`xovrobdnen muhammadis dros] ar azrt`asxvaobdnen, sanam mat`t`an ar movida c`odna [qurani da nat`eli dadastureba imisa, rom muhammadi cheshmaritad aris allahis moc`ik`uli]. cheshmaritad, sheni up`ali gansjis mat` ag'dgomis dg'es imashi, rashic` isini azrt`asxvaoben [urcmunoebs sheiqvans c`ec`xlshi, xolo morcmuneebs samot`xeshi]

da t`u echvi gepareba imashi, rac` shen zegardmogivlinet`, mashin hkit`xe mat`, romlebic` shenamde cigns kit`xulobdnen. uechvelad, shent`an movida cheshmariteba sheni g'mert`isagan da nu ik`nebi daechvebult`agani
da nu ik`nebi (o, shuamavalo) imat`gani, romelt`ac` allahis sascaulebi c`rud sherac`xes, t`orem cagebult`agan ik`nebi.
cheshmaritad, isini, romelt`a mimart`ac` sheni up`lis sitqva gamart`lda, ar ircmuneben
t`undac` qvela aiat`i(sascauli, an quranis aiat`i) moevlinos mat`, sanam mcare sasjels ar ixilaven.

ar qop`ila arc` ert`i sop`eli, romelmac` ircmuna da sargebeli epova t`avisi rcmenisgan, garda iunusis xalxisa? roc`a mat` ircmunes, ch`ven avac`ilet` mat` damamc`irebeli sasjeli amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi da vuboz'et` mat` droebit`i siame.
da rom eneba shens g'mert`s, ircmunebda qvela, vinc` k`veqanazea, ert`ianad. nut`u shen aiz'uleb xalxs, rom gaxdnen morcmuneni?
verc` ert`i adamiani ver ircmunebs allahis nebis (da shemceobis) gareshe. da igi daacesebs sasjels mat`ze, romlebic` ar iazreben (mis brz'anebebsa da akrz'alvebs)
ut`xari (o, shuamavalo): shexedet` (daakvirdit`), ra aris c`at`a shina da k`veqanasa zeda. magram sascaulebi da shegoneba verap`ers argebs im xalxs, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes

nut`u isini sxvas rames elian, garda im dg'eebisa, romlebic` mat`ze adre mc`xovrebt` xvdat` cilad? ut`xari:mash, dae, daelodet` (roc`a t`k`venze allahis sasjeli mova), da mec` vik`nebi t`k`vent`an ert`ad momlodinet`agani
shemdeg ch`ven vixsnit` ch`vens shuamavlebs da mat`, romelt`ac` ircmunes. aseve, valdebulebaa ch`venze morcmunet`a xsna.

t`k`vi: hei, xalxo, t`u ch`ems sarcmunoebashi echvi geparebat`, me ar vc`em t`aqvans imat`, visac` t`k`ven allahis nac`vlad et`aqvanebit`, aramed t`aqvans vc`em allahs, romelic` mogakvdinebt`. da me mebrz'ana, rom viqo morcmunet`agani.
moapqari sheni saxe (mxolod) cheshmarit sarcmunoebas [daic`avi mxolod igi], iqavi hanip`i [ert`g'mert`iani] da ar iqo (arasodes) mravalg'mert`iannt`agani

da ar mouxmo allahis garda imas, rac` verc` sargebels mogitans da verc` zians mogaqenebs. xolo t`u ase moik`c`evi(t`u mouxmob sxvebs), mashin usat`uod usamart`lot`agani ik`nebi [mravalg'mert`iant`agani].

da t`u allahi shegexeba shen (o, adamiano) raime zianit`, mashin aravinaa misi momshorebeli, garda t`avad misi. da t`u isurvebs shent`vis siket`es, mashin veravin ukuagdebs mis cqalobas. is uboz'ebs mas t`avis monat`agan imas, visac` inebebs. da is mpatiebeli, shemcqalebelia.

ut`xari: hei adamianebo! t`k`vent`an movida cheshmariteba (qurani) t`k`veni g'mert`isagan. da vinc` scor gzas daadgeba, t`avis sasargeblod daadgeba, da vinc` gzas
asc`deba, mxolod t`avis sazianod asc`deba. da me ara var t`k`veni zedamxedveli(ar vicer t`k`vens k`medebebs rat`a pasuxi gagebinot`)
da mihqevi imas, rac` shen gec`xadeba da moit`mine, sanam allahi ar gansjis. da is sauket`esoa msajult`agan.

alip`. laam. raa. cigni, romlis aiat`ebic` (srulqop`ilad) dadgenilia [ar sheic`avs aravit`ar shec`domas, an nakls], xolo shemdeg nat`lad ganmartebulia (misi qoveli debuleba) brz'enisa da qovlismc`odnis (allahis mier).
rom ar et`aqvanot` aravis, garda allahisa. cheshmaritad, me t`k`vent`vis misgan gamp`rt`xilebeli (misi sasjelisa) da maxarobeli (samot`xis) var.

da rom shest`xovot` patieba (c`odvebist`vis) t`k`vens g'mert`s, shemdeg moinaniot` mis cinashe, is moganichebt` t`k`ven mshvenier sarch`os dat`k`mul dromde da miagebs qovel g'irseuls t`avis g'irsebas. xolo t`u pirs ibrunebt`, mashin me meshinia t`k`vent`vis didi dg'is sasjelisa.
allaht`anaa t`k`veni dabruneba da igi qovlisshemz'lea

diax! cheshmaritad, isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi], roc`a cinascarmetqveli kit`xulobs qurans, mkerdebs muc`elze icheren, t`it`k`os ar esmit` allahis shegoneba da surt` damalon t`aviant`i urcmunoeba misgan. magram ara! mashinac` ki, roc`a (g'amit`) t`aviant`i tansac`mlit` ip`arebian, allahma ic`is, ras malaven mat` sulebshi da ras sch`adian g'iad (dg'isit`). cheshmaritad, man -- ucqis is, rac` gulebshia.
