ar arsebobs dedamicaze arc` ert`i c`oc`xali arseba, romlis sazrdoc` allaht`an ar iqos. man ic`is misi sac`xovrebeli adgili (sic`oc`xlis ganmavlobashi) da misi gansvenebis adgili (sikvdilis shemdeg). es qovelive allaht`an aris ch`acerili nat`el cignshi [dac`ul p`irp`itaze]

is aris, romelmac` shek`mna c`ani da mica ek`vs dg'eshi da misi taxti cqalze iqo, rat`a gamogc`adot`, t`u romeli t`k`vengani uket`esi iqo sak`mit`. da t`u shen etqvi: cheshmaritad, t`k`ven ag'dgenilni ik`nebit` sikvdilis shemdeg, uechvelad itqvian isini, romelnic` gaxdnen urcmunoni(allahisa da gac`oc`xlebis mimart`): es(qurani) sxva arap`eria, t`u ara c`xadi jadok`roba.

da t`u ch`ven gadavuvadebt` mat` sasjels gansazg'vrul dromde, ut`uod itqvian: ra akavebs mas [sasjels]? vai, im dg'es, roc`a is mat` ecveva, ar ik`neba mat`gan aridebuli da gars shemoertqmebat` mat` is(tanjva-cameba), rasac` isini dasc`inodnen.
da t`u ch`ven adamians vagemovnebinebt` cqalobas ch`vengan, shemdeg ki cavart`mevt` mas, uechvelad, igi sasocarkvet`ili da umaduria.

da t`u ch`ven mas (adamians) vagemebinebt` siket`es gachirvebis shemdeg, romelic` mas sheexo, uechvelad itqvis: ubedurebani gamshorda! (allahs ki madlobas ar uz'g'vnis )cheshmaritad, igi gaxarebulia da amaqi.
garda imat`, romelt`ac` moit`mines da hk`mnes ket`ili sak`meni. mat`t`visaa shendoba da didi sazg'auri.

ik`neb shen (o,moc`ik`ulo) miatovo nacili imisa, rac` shen gec`xadeba da amis gamo sheni guli shevicrovebulia, rom isini amboben: nut`u ar gardmoevlina mas saganz'uri an angelozi ar mohqva mas?! shen mxolod shemgonebeli xar. xolo allahia qovelives mp`arveli.

an ik`neb isini [mek`is mravalg'mert`ianebi] amboben: (muhammadma t`vit`onve moigona igi [qurani]).
ut`xari mat` (o, shuamavalo): (t`u es asea,) moitanet` at`i mogonili sura, msgavsi misisa [quranisa], da mouxmet`, visac` shez'lebt`, garda allahisa, t`u mart`als ambobt` (t`k`vens sitqvebshi).
xolo t`u ar gipasuxeben, mashin ic`odet`, rom igi allahis c`odnit`aa zemovlenili da rom ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda misi. mash, ar gaxdebit` morch`ilni (muslimebi) misi?
visac` surs amk`veqniuri c`xovreba da misi silamaze(sitkboeba), ch`ven srulad mivuzg'avt` mat` t`aviant`i sak`meebist`vis masshi da arap`eri daakldebat`.
ai, isini arian, romelt`ac` saik`ioshi c`ec`xlis garda arap`eri elit`. da amao ik`neba, rac` ik` moimok`medes, da p`uchia, rasac` aket`ebdnen.

gana is, vinc` t`avisi up`lisgan moc`emul c`xad sascauls [damadasturebel mtkic`ebulebas] eqrdnoba [nagulisxmebia shuamavali], da mas mohqveba mocme [jibrili] misi mxridan [allahisgan], da masze cin musas cignic` [t`ora], rogorc` gzamkvlevi da cqaloba, sheiz'leba iqos msgavsi urcmunosi? mart`lac`, imat` scamt` misi [quranis].
xolo vinc` mas [qurans] uarqop`s sxvadasxva jgup`t`agan, c`ec`xli [jojoxet`i] aris mat`i danishnuli adgili.
amitom nu ik`nebi masshi [quranshi] echvmitanili, radgan cheshmaritad, igi [qurani] aris simart`le sheni up`lisgan, magram adamiant`a umravlesobas ar scams.

da vin aris imaze usamart`lo, vinc` allahs sic`rues miacers? isini cardgebian t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe da mocmeebi itqvian: ai, isini, romelt`ac` ic`rues t`aviant` g'mert`ze. uechvelad, dae (iqos) allahis cqevla usamart`loebs [mravalg'mert`ianebze]
isini, romelnic` ac`dendnen sxvebs allahis gzidan [mt`lianad morch`ilebisgan misadmi], da c`dilobdnen am gzis damaxinjebas [misi motquebit` carmodgenas], da ar scamdat` maradiuli c`xovreba!

aset`ebi (urcmunoebi) verasodes sheasusteben allahis sasjels dedamicaze (ver gaek`c`evian mas), da ar hqavt` mat` allahis garda mp`arvelebi (vinc` shez'lebda mat` dac`vas misi sasjelisgan). gaormagebuli ik`neba mat`t`vis sasjeli. mat` ar sheez'lot` mosmena da verc` xedavdnen
aset`ebi arian isini, romelt`ac` sakut`ari t`avebi caages, da daekargat` mat` is, rac` moigones [c`ru g'mert`ebi, romelt`a shuamdgomlobas imedovnebdnen]
echvgareshea, rom saik`ioshi scored isini ik`nebian qvelaze metad cagebulni.
uechvelad, romelt`ac` ircmunes, da ket`ili sak`meebi aket`es, da morch`ilni iqvnen t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe, scored isini arian samot`xis mkvidrni. isini ik` samudamod darch`ebian.

magalit`i orive jgup`ist`vis brma da qru [urcmunos magalit`i] da mxedveli da msmeneli [morcmunis magalit`i].
nut`u isini tolni arian ert`manet`is magalit`it`?
nut`u ar sheigonebt` [da ar miig'ebt` sargebels ak`edan]?
da ch`ven carvgzavnet` nuhi (noe) t`avis xalxt`an (man ut`xra mat`): me t`k`vent`vis c`xadi shemgonebeli var
rom ar et`aqvanot` aravis, garda (ert`adert`i) allahisa. cheshmaritad, me meshinia t`k`vent`vis mtanjveli dg'is sasjelisa.

da t`k`ves misma xalxma, romelt`ac` uarqves: ch`ven ver gxedavt` sxvas, garda ch`vennairi adamianisa, da ver vxedavt`, rom vinme mogqveba, garda ch`vens shoris qvelaze ubadrukebisa. da ver vxedavt` t`k`venshi raime upiratesobas ch`venze. pirik`it` ch`ven vp`ik`robt`, rom t`k`ven matquarebi xart`

t`k`va (shuamavalma nuhma): hei, ch`emo xalxo! ras itqvit`, t`u me ch`emi g'mert`isgan c`xad mtkic`ebulebaze var da man t`avisi cqaloba mommadla, magram is t`k`vent`vis dap`aruli darch`a? gana gaiz'ulebt` mis mig'ebas, mashin, roc`a t`k`ven igi gz'ult`?

hei, ch`emo xalxo! me (nuhi) ar gt`xovt` t`k`ven amist`vis k`onebas. ch`emi sazg'auri mxolod allahzea. da me ar ganvdevni mat`, romelt`ac` ircmunes. cheshmaritad, isini shexvdebian t`aviant` g'mert`s, magram me gxedavt` t`k`ven, rogorc` umec`ar xalxs.
hei, ch`emo xalxo! vin damic`avs allahisgan, t`u me mat` (morcmuneebs) ganvdevni? nut`u ar dap`ik`rdebit`?

da ar geubnebit` t`k`ven, rom ch`emt`anaa allahis saganz'urebi, da arc` dap`arulis vic`i, da arc` imas vambob, rom angelozi var. da arc` vetqvi imat`ze, visac` t`k`veni t`valebi sheurac`xqop`it` uqureben [sacqal da sust morcmuneebs], rom allahi mat` siket`es ar miagebs. allahma uket` ic`is, rac` mat` sulebshia. mashin me usat`uod usamart`lot`agani vik`nebodi.
ut`xres [c`nobilma xalxma]:,,hei, nuh! shen gvekamat`ebodi da gaaxshire ch`veni kamat`i. mash, mogvivline is, rit`ac` gvemuk`rebi, t`u xar mart`alt`agani.
ut`xra (nuhma): mas mxolod allahi mogivlent`, t`u inebebs, da t`k`ven ver daag'cevt` t`avs.

da ar gamogadgebat` ch`emi rch`eva, t`undac` rom mindodes t`k`vent`vis rch`evis moc`ema, t`u allahs t`k`veni gzaabneva surs(t`k`veni urch`obisa da jiutobis gamo). igia t`k`veni g'mert`i da mast`an ik`nebit` dabrunebulni.

[mravalg'mert`anebi sheni xalxisgan itqvian o, shuamavalo muhmmad] an itqvian, man (muhammadma) shet`xzao (qurani) ut`xari: t`u me shevt`xze, ch`emze iqos ch`emi c`odva, da me t`avisup`ali var imisgan, rashic` t`k`ven sc`odavt` [t`k`veni urcmunoebisagan].
da sht`aegona nuhs, rom sheni xalxidan aravin ircmunebs, garda imat`i, romelt`ac` ukve ircmunes. amitom nu damcuxrdebi imis gamo, rasac` isini sch`adiodnen.
aage kidobani ch`veni met`valqureobit`a da sht`agonebit`, da nug'arap`ers metqvi usamart`lot`a shesaxeb, radgan isini unda daixrch`on.

da agebda kidobans. da qovelt`vis, roc`a mis gverdit` ch`aivlidnen misi xalxis carch`inebulni, dasc`inodnen mas. man t`k`va: t`u t`k`ven dagvc`init`, ch`venc` dagc`inebt` t`k`ven, iseve, rogorc` t`k`ven dagvc`init`.
male gaigebt`, vis moevlineba damamc`irebeli sasjeli da vis daatqdeba t`avs maradiuli sasjeli

da roc`a movida ch`veni brz'aneba (urcmunot`a dag'upvis shesaxeb) da adug'da t`one, vut`xarit`: sheiqvane masshi [gemshi] qoveli saxeobidan t`it`o cqvili [mamrobit`i da mdedrobit`i], agret`ve sheni ojaxi, garda mat`isa, romelt`ac` ukve sheexo sitqva [garda sheni shvilisa da c`olisa], da (sheiqvane gemshi) isini, romelt`ac` ircmunes. magram mast`an ert`ad [nuht`an] mxolod mc`iredma ircmunes
da ut`xra (nuhma) (morcmuneebs): ch`asxedit` masshi, allahis saxelit`aa misi svlac` da misi gach`erebac`. uechvelad, ch`emi g'mert`i mimtevebeli, shemcqalebelia.

da miedineboda igi [gemi] mat`t`an ert`ad talg'ebze, romlebic` mt`ebs hgavda. da mimart`a nuxma t`avis shvils, romelic` ganc`alkevebit` iqo [morcmunet`agan]: o, shvilo ch`emo, shemodi ch`vent`an ert`ad (gemshi) da nu ik`nebi urcmunoebt`an (romlebic` qvela daixrch`vebian)

[shvilma ut`xra] (shuamaval nuhs): mt`as shevep`arebi, romelic` damic`avs cqlisgan. ut`xra: dg'es ar arsebobs damc`veli allahis brz'anebisgan, garda imisa, visac` is sheicqalebs. da mat` shoris talg'a ch`adga da is iqo ert`-ert`i daxrch`obilt`agani.

da it`k`va (allahis mier), mas shemdeg rac` qvela urcmuno daixrch`o: o micav! sht`ant`k`e sheni cqali! da o c`ao! shech`erdi [gaach`ere cvima]! da cqali daec`a (daicia), da ag'srulda allahis brz'aneba, da [gemi] gach`erda al-judis mt`aze.
da it`k`va: shors [allahis cqalobisgan] usamart`loni [urcmunoni]!
da mouxmo nuhma t`avis g'mert`s da ut`xra:,,g'mert`o ch`emo! cheshmaritad, ch`emi shvili ch`emi ojaxidanaa, da sheni ag't`k`ma cheshmaritia, da shen xar qvelaze brz'eni msajult`agan

brz'ana (didebulma allahma): hei, nuh! is sheni ojaxidan ar aris. uechvelad, is ara scori sak`mea(es sheni t`xovna ara scoria imitom, rom is urcmuno sheni ojaxidan ar it`vleba). amitom nu mt`xov imas, ris shesaxebac` c`odna ar gagach`nia. me garigeb shen, rat`a ar iqo umec`art`a shoris.
t`k`va (nuhma): up`alo ch`emo! me shen shemogp`arebivar, rat`a ar gt`xovo is, ris shesaxebac` c`odna ar gamach`nia. da t`u ar momiteveb da ar shemicqaleb, vik`nebi cagebult`a shoris.

t`k`va (allahma): o, nuh! ch`amodi (gemidan) ch`veni mshvidobit` da barak`it` shenze da mat`ze, vinc` shent`an ert`ad aris,
magram ik`nebian iset`i t`emebic`, romlebsac` ch`ven mivc`emt` siket`eebs (mxolod am cut`isop`elshi), xolo shemdeg mat` moecevat` ch`vengan mtanjveli sasjeli (gansjis dg'es)

es [rasac` ch`ven giambet`] im uxilavi ambebat`agania, romlebic` ch`ven sht`agonebit` gic`xadet`, (o, moc`ik`ulo) arc` shen da arc` shenma xalxma ic`odit` isini ak`amde. moit`mine, mash, (is tanjva da ziani), rasac` sheni xalxi gaqenebs! cheshamritad, kargi dasasruli xvt`ismoshisht`at`visaa (vinc` up`lis sasjels up`rt`xildeba)

adielebt`an (carvgzavnet` ch`ven) mat`i z'ma hudi. ut`xra (shumavalma hudma): hei, xalxo ch`emo! t`aqvani ec`it` (mxolod mas) allahs! t`k`vent`vis ar arsebobs sxva g'vt`aeba, garda misi. t`k`ven mxolod c`ilismcameblebi xart`(allahis garda c`rud g'mert`ebs rom igonebt`).
hei, ch`emo xalxo! ar gt`xovt` amaze sazg'aurs. ch`emi sazg'auri mxolod maszea (allahze), vinc` shemk`mna. nut`u ver xvdebit`?

o, ch`emo xalxo! it`xovet` shendoba t`k`veni up`lisagan (t`k`veni urcmunoebist`vis), shemdeg ki moinaniet` mis cinashe t`k`veni c`odvebi da (t`u ase moik`c`evit`) is gamogigzavnit` c`idan uxv nalek`s da shegmatebt` z'alas t`k`vens z'alaze (gagamravlebt` da gaz'lierebt`), da nu gaemijnebit` (im mocodebas, riskenac` gicvevt`), meamboxed [urcmunod]
mat` ut`xres: hei, hud! shen ch`vent`vis aranairi c`xadi mtkic`ebuleba ar mogitania, da ch`ven ar mivatovebt` ch`vens g'mert`ebs sheni sitqvis gamo, da ch`ven sheni ar gvcams.

ch`ven mxolod imas vambobt`, rom zogiert`ma ch`venma g'vt`aebam borotebit` shegexo shen. man t`k`va: me vamocmeb allahs da t`k`venc` daamocmet`, rom me shors var imisgan, rasac` t`k`ven t`anaziarad udgent` mas(allahs).(e.i.me ar vag'iareb kerpebs)
mis(allahis) garda. mash, mtrulad momek`ec`it` qvelani ert`ad [t`k`ven da t`k`veni c`ru g'vt`aebebi] da shemdeg nu momc`emt` dros [nu damac`dit`]!

me allahs mivende, ch`ems g'mert`s da t`k`vens g'mert`s. ar arsebobs arc` ert`i c`oc`xali arseba, romelic` ar iqos misi xelshi [misi z'alaup`lebis k`vesh]. cheshmaritad, ch`emi up`ali aris scor gzaze [is samart`liania t`avis gadacqvetilebebshi da siket`es siket`it`ve ajildoebs, da is me damic`avs t`gvengan]

xolo t`u zurgs sheak`c`evt`, me ukve gamc`net` is, rit`ac` movlinebuli viqavi t`k`vent`an. da ch`emi g'mert`i t`k`vens nac`vlad sxva xalxs moiqvans da t`k`ven mas verap`ers avnebt`. cheshmaritad, ch`emi g'mert`i qovlismp`arvelia.
da roc`a movida ch`veni brz'aneba, gadavarch`inet` hudi da romelt`ac` ircmunes mast`an ert`ad ch`veni cqalobit`, da vixsenit` isini sastiki sasjelisgan.
ai, adelebi, romlebmac` uarqves t`aviant`i g'mert`is sascaulebi, ar daemorch`ilnen mis shuamavlebs da gahqvnen qoveli jiuti tiranis brz'anebas.
da daedevnat` mat` amk`veqnad cqevla da ag'dgomis dg'esac`. cheshmaritad, aadis tomi gaxda urcmuno t`avisi g'mert`is! dae dashordnen [allahis cqalobas] adis xalxi hudis eri!

da samudis xalxs(gavugzavnet`), mat`i z'ma saalihi. man ut`xra: hei, ch`emo xalxo! t`aqvani ec`it` allahs. t`k`vent`vis ar arsebobs sxva g'vt`aeba, garda misi. man gagach`inat` t`k`ven micisgan da dagasaxlat` masze. mash, st`xovet` mas shendoba, shemdeg ki moinaniet` mis cinashe. namdvilad, ch`emi up`ali axloa da pasuxobs (is pasuxobs vedrebas, roc`a mas evedrebian)!

ut`xres (samudianelebma): hei, salih! shen ch`ven shoris imedis momc`emi iqavi(pativisc`emas imsaxurebdi, chkviani da sag'i azris mk`one iqavi) amaze cin. nut`u gvikrz'alav, rom vet`aqvanot` imas, rasac` ch`veni mamebi(cinaprebi) et`aqvanebodnen? da cheshmaritad, ch`ven g'rma, echvshi vart` imis shesaxeb, riskenac` shen gvixmob (ert`adert` allahs t`aqvani vc`et`).

(saalihma) ut`xra: hei, ch`emo xalxo! aba, dap`ik`rdit`, t`u me ch`emi g'mert`isgan c`xad mtkic`ebulebaze var da man t`avisi cqaloba mommadla, vin damic`avs allahisgan, t`u me mas veurch`ebi? t`k`ven ki zaralis mets verap`ers shemmatebt`.
hei, xalxo ch`emo, es allahis ak`lemia, t`k`vent`vis sascaulad. miushvit`, z'ovos allahis micaze da borotad ar sheexot` mas, t`orem mogevlinebat` axlo sasjeli.
magram mat` dakles igi. mashin man (shuamavalma saalihma) ut`xra mat`: isiamovnet` t`k`vens saxlebshi sami dg'e. es aris ag't`k`ma(im ubedurebisa rac` t`avs dagatqdebat`), romelic` ar ik`neba c`ru.
da roc`a movida ch`veni brz'aneba, ch`veni cqalobit` vixsenit` saalihi da mast`an ert`ad morcmuneni, da im dg'is sirc`xvilisgan. cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i qovladz'lieria z'levamosilia.
da usamart`loebs moevlinat` z'lieri xma da(ris shedegadac`) ag'moch`ndnen isini t`aviant` sac`xovreblebshi dagdebulni [mkvdarni].
t`it`k`os arc` ki uc`xovriat` ik`. uechvelad, samudis xalxi gaxda urcmuno t`avisi up`lis mimart`. dae, iqvnen shors (allahis cqalobas) samudelebi!

da ch`veni moc`ik`ulebi (angelozebi) eaxlnen ibrahims sasixarulo c`nobit`. mat` ut`xres: mshvidoba! manac` upasuxa: mshvidoba! da ar daaqovna, rom moetana shemcvari xbo(is ver mixvda rom isini angelozebi iqvnen adamianuri garegnobit`).

da roc`a man (ibrahimma) dainaxa, rom mat`i [angelozebi, romlebic` adamianebis saxit` movidnen] xelebi ar miekareboda mis [sapativc`emulo sachmels], ver ic`no isini (daechvda mat`shi) da shishi igrz'no mat`gan (ip`ik`ra, rom mtrebi an k`urdebi iqvnen), (roc`a dainaxes, rom shishma moic`va igi, angelozebma) ut`xres: nu geshinia! ch`ven mosuli vart` lutis xalxt`an (imisat`vis, rom davasjat` isini)

da misi c`oli [sara] idga (esmoda es saubari) da gaic`ina
da ch`ven vaxaret` mas ishaaqis shesaxeb [rom igi shobs z'es, romelsac` daark`meven ishaaqs], da ishaaqis shemdeg iaqubis shesaxeb [rom ishaaqs sheez'ineba z'e iaqubi].

(am ambavit` gakvirvebulma saram)t`k`va:vai ch`emda simcare! nut`u me shvili shemez'ineba mashin, roc`a ukve moxuc`i var, da es ch`emi k`mari berikac`ia?
namdvilad, es saoc`ari ram aris
(angelozebma) ut`xres: gana allahis brz'aneba gakvirvebs? allahis cqaloba da misi kurt`xeva iqos t`k`venze, o, am saxlis [shuamavlebis ojaxis] binadarno! namdvilad, is (allahi) k`ebulia da didebulia
roc`a ibrahims shishma gauara da sasixarulo ambavi eucqa, lutis xalxis gamo dagvicqo dava(ik`neba da gadaak`mevinos mat`i ganadgureba).
namdvilad, ibrahimi iqo uechvelad mot`minebit` savse [sasjels ar ach`k`arebda], morch`ili (allahis cinashe) da mudam momnanie.
(angelozebma ut`xres): hei, ibrahim, t`avi daanebe amas! ramet`u ukve movida sheni g'mert`is brz'aneba da uechvelad, mat` gardauvali sasjeli ecevat`.

da roc`a movidnen ch`veni moc`ik`ulni [angelozebi] lutt`an, damcuxrda is mat` gamo (radgan ar ic`oda, rom isini angelozebi iqvnen da sheeshinda, rom misi xalxi mat` c`udi miznebit` miadgeboda), da igrz'no uz'lureba [verap`rit` sheez'lo t`avisi stumrebis dac`va], da t`k`va: es mz'ime dg'ea

da mivida mast`an [lutt`an] misi xalxi, scrap`ad da ach`k`arebit` (imist`vis, rom misi stumrebi sibilcisken caexelebinat`) da manamde isini ch`adiodnen borot sak`meebs [mamakac`ebt`an sk`esobriv kavshirs]. ut`xra (shuamavalma lutma) t`avis xalxs: o, ch`emo xalxo! ai, eseni ch`emi k`alishvilebi [t`k`veni k`alebi], isini up`ro cmidani arian t`k`vent`vis (t`u gsurt` k`orcineba), vidre is sibilce, rasac` apirebt`. geshinodet` allahis (da moshordit` imas, rac` man akrz'ala), da nu shemarc`xvent` ch`ems stumart`a cinashe. nut`u t`k`vens shoris arc` ert`i gonieri adamiani ar moiz'ebneba, vinc` shegach`erebt` am borotebidan?
mat` ut`xres: shen xom ic`i, rom shens asulebze aranairi up`leba ar gvak`vs(ar gvsurs k`alebi) da uechvelad ic`i, rac` ch`ven gvinda(shen kargad ic`i rom ch`ven mxolod kac`ebi gvinda).
t`k`va: netav mk`ondes t`k`vens cinaag'mdeg z'ala, an t`avi shevap`aro mtkic`e saqrdens [nat`esavebs] (auc`ileblad shegach`erebdit`)

ut`xres: hei, lut! cheshmaritad, ch`ven sheni g'mert`is moc`ik`ulebi (angelozebi) vart`. isini shen verap`ers dagakleben. gaiqvane sheni ojaxi g'amis ert` nacilshi da arc` ert`ma t`k`venganma ukan ar moixedos, sheni c`olis garda. cheshmaritad, masac` igive eceva, rac` mat`. cheshmaritad, mat`i dat`k`muli dro dilaa. gana dila axlos ar aris?
xolo roc`a movida ch`veni brz'aneba, ch`ven gadavak`c`evinet` misi [mat`i k`alak`is] zemo nacili k`vemod da gavacvimed masze gamomcvari t`ixis k`vebi, p`ena-p`enad dacqobili(ert`imeoreze miqolebit`).

(da es k`vebi iqo) shens up`alt`an nishandebuli [es ar iqo ubralo k`vebi]. da isini [igive sasjeli] ar arian shors usmart`lot`agan [urcmunot`agan], (vinc` ar ag'iarebs shens moc`ik`ulobas, o muhammad)

da madianshi (ch`ven cargvzavnet`) mat`i z'ma shuaibi. man ut`xra:,,hei, ch`emo xalxo! t`aqvani ec`it` allahs! t`k`ven ar gqavt` sxva g'vt`aeba, garda misi. da nu daaklebt` sacqaosa da sascors. uechvelad, me gxedavt` t`k`ven ket`ildg'eobashi da uechvelad, me meshinia t`k`vent`vis qovlismomc`veli dg'is sasjelisa.

hei, ch`emo xalxo! srulad daic`avit` zoma da cona samart`lianad [iqavit` mart`alni am sak`meshi], da nu daaklebt` xalxs t`aviant` kut`vnils, da nu ivlit` micaze ucesrigobis t`esvit` [nu gaaket`ebt` imas, rac` allahma akrz'ala].
is, rac` alahma dagitovat` [nebadart`uli mogeba], uket`esia t`k`vent`vis, t`uki morcmuneni xart`. da me t`k`venze mc`veli rodi var.

mat` ut`res: hei, shuaib! gana sheni loc`va gibrz'anebs, rom mivatovot` is, rasac` ch`veni mama-papa et`aqvaneboda, an ch`vens k`onebas ise ar movek`c`et`, rogorc` ch`ven gvsurs? cheshmaritad, shen xar momt`meni, gonieri!(es t`k`ves ironiis saxit`.ix. ibn k`asiiris ganmarteba)

(shuamavalma shuaibma) ut`xra: hei, ch`emo xalxo! t`u gip`ik`riat`, t`u me ch`emi g'mert`isgan c`xad mtkic`ebulebaze var da man momc`a t`avisgan mshvenieri sarch`o? da ar msurs, rom shegecinaag'mdegot` imashi, rasac` gikrz'alavt`. me mxolod gamoscoreba msurs, ramdenadac` shemiz'lia. da ch`emi carmateba mxolod allahisganaa. masze var mindobili da mxolod mas mivmart`av (monaniebit`).

hei, ch`emo xalxo, ch`emt`an ut`anxmoebam ar gaiz'ulot`, rom t`k`venc` igive geciot`, rac` ecia nuhis xalxs, an hudis xalxs, an salihis xalxs. da lutis xalxi xom t`k`vengan shors ar aris(didi xnis cin ar iqvnen).

st`xovet` patieba t`k`vens up`als (im c`odvebist`vis, romlebic` ukve ch`agideniat`), shemdeg ki moinaniet` mis cinashe. cheshmaritad, ch`emi up`ali shemcqalebeli, moqvarulia (imat` mimart`, vinc` mas monaniebit` mimart`avs).

mat` ut`xres: hei, shuaib! ch`ven ver vigebt` bevrs, rasac` shen ambob. da ch`ven namdvilad gxedavt` ch`vens shoris sustad. da rom ara sheni gvareuloba, ut`uod ch`agk`olavdit`. da shen ch`vent`vis z'virp`asi ar xar.

(shuamavalma shuaibma) ut`xra: hei, ch`emo xalxo! nut`u ch`emi sagvareulo up`ro z'virp`asia t`k`vent`vis, vidre allahi? da t`k`ven is zurgs ukan miatovet`. uechvelad, ch`emi g'mert`i qovlismomc`velia imisa, rasac` t`k`ven sch`adixart`!

hei, ch`emo xalxo! imok`medet` t`k`veni shesaz'leblobebisamebr, mec` vimok`medeb. male gaigebt`, vis moevlineba sasjeli, romelic` shearc`xvens mas, da vin aris matquara. daelodet`, mec` t`k`vent`an ert`ad davelodebi.

da roc`a movida ch`veni brz'aneba, ch`veni cqalobit` vixsenit` shuaibi da mast`an ert`ad morcmuneni. xolo usamart`loni sheipqro sazarelma xmam da isini t`aviant` saxlebshi pirk`ve damxobilni ag'moch`ndnen.
ise, t`it`k`os isini ik` arasodes qop`ilan. o, diax! dae, dashordnen (allahis cqalobas) madianelebi, ise rogorc` dashordnen samudevelebi
da vp`ic`av, ch`ven carvgzavnet` musa ch`veni sascaulebit`a da c`xadi xelmcip`ebit`.
p`araont`an da mis didebulebt`an. da isini daemorch`ilnen p`araonis brz'anebas, da p`araonis brz'aneba ar iqo scori.
is t`avis xalxs gauz'g'veba ag'dgomis dg'es da c`ec`xlshi miiqvans mat`. da ra sazarelia is adgili, sadac` miiqvanes!
da t`an sdevdat` cqevla amk`veqnadac` da ag'dgomis dg'esac`.da ra sashinelia is boz'ebuli jildo, romelic` mat` ez'levat`!(cqevla amk`veqnadac` da imk`veqnadac` zedi zed)
es im dasaxlebat`a ambebidanaa, romelsac` giambobt` shen (o, shuamavalo). zogi mat`gani kvlav dgas, zogi ki ganadgurebulia.

ch`ven ar dagvich`agravs isini, aramed mat` t`aviant`i t`avebi dach`agres. da verap`rit` ushveles mat` t`aviant`ma (c`ru) g'vt`aebebma, romlebsac` allahis garda uxmobdnen, roc`a sheni g'mert`is brz'aneba movida. da arap`eri shemates mat`, garda dag'upvisa.
aset`ia sheni g'mert`is sasjeli, roc`a is sjis usamart`lo sop`lebs. uechvelad, misi sasjeli mtanjveli da mkac`ria!
cheshmaritad, amashia sascauli imist`vis, visac` eshinia imk`veqniuri sasjelis. es is dg'ea, roc`a shekrebili ik`neba xalxi, da es aris dg'e, romelsac` qvela ixilavs.
da ch`ven mas ar gadavdebt`, garda dat`k`muli vadist`vis.
im dg'es, roc`a is (gankit`xvis dg'e) dadgeba, verc`ert`i suli ver ilaparakebs, garda misi nebart`visa. mat` shoris ik`nebian ubedurni da bednierni.
xolo ubedurni c`ec`xlshi ik`nebian, da ik` mat`t`vis ik`neba mot`k`ma [tanjvis kvnesa] da g'riali.

maradiulad ik`nebian ik`, sanam iarsebebs c`a da mica,garda imisa, t`u sheni up`ali inebebs (sxvagvarad) [radgan jojoxet`idan gamoiqvans qvela morcmunes, vis gulshic` t`undac` mtvris cilze mc`ire rcmena hk`ondat`] vinaidan, namdvilad, sheni up`ali ag'asrulebs qvelap`ers, rasac` inebebs!
xolo bednierni samot`xeshi ik`nebian, samudamod damkvidrdebian ik`, vidre iarsebeben c`ani da mica, garda imisa, rasac` inebebs sheni g'mert`i. es aris jildo, romelic` arasodes shecqdeba.

nu ik`nebi (o, moc`ik`ulo) echvshi imis shesaxeb, rasac` eseni [mravalg'mert`ianebi] t`aqvans sc`emen, isini t`aqvans sc`emen mxolod ise, rogorc` mat`i mamebi [cinaprebi] sc`emdnen manamde. namdvilad, ch`ven srulad mivagebt` mat` mat` cils raime shemc`irebis gareshe!

ch`ven namdvilad mivec`it` (shuamaval) musas cigni [t`ora], da mis xalxshi gach`nda ut`anxmoeba mis shesaxeb [t`oras shinaarsisa da kanonebis mimart`]. [zogma ircmuna t`ora, xolo sxvebma uarqves igi.] (igive gza airch`ia shenma xalxmac`, o, muhammad, quranis mimart`.) da rom ara sheni up`lis sitqva (misi cinascar dadgenili ganch`ineba, rom ar ach`k`arebs sasjels),
auc`ileblad ukve gadacqdeboda mat` shoris [urcmunoni daisjebodnen, xolo morcmuneni gadarch`ebodnen]. t`umc`a isini [urcmuno iudevelebi da mravalg'mert`ianebi] namdvilad imqop`ebian dabneul da shemaz'rcunebel echvshi amast`an dakavshirebit` [qurant`an].
da uechvelad, sheni g'mert`i qvelas srulad miuzg'avs t`aviant`i namok`medarist`vis. cheshmaritad, igi ucqis, rasac` isini sch`adian.
mash, idek`i scorad(scor gzaze), rogorc` nabrz'anebi gak`vs, shen da vinc` shent`an ert`ad moinania. da zg'vars nu gadaxvalt`. uechvelad, igi xedavs imas, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

da nu daeqrdnobit` usamart`lot`a [nu miemxrobit` mat` siqvarulit`], radgan amis gamo sheiz'leba c`ec`xli shegexot`. da ar geqolebat` allahis garda mp`arvelebi, shemdeg ki t`k`ven dac`uli ar ik`nebit`!
da ag'avline loc`va dg'is or bolos(dg'is dasacqisshi da dasasrulshi) da g'amis dasacqisshi. cheshmaritad, ket`ili sak`meebi shlian c`ud sak`meebs. es shegonebaa momxsenebelt`at`vis.
da moit`mine (o, shuamavalo) (is tkivili da sheurac`xqop`a, rasac` mravalg'mert`ianebi gaqeneben), radgan allahi ar ak`arcqlebs jildos imat`s, vinc` ket`ili sak`me gulcrp`elad sheasrula

o, netav qop`iliqvnen t`k`venamde mc`xovreb t`aobebshi iset`i adamianebi, romlebic` rcmenit`a da gonierebit` ik`nebodnen gamorch`eulni, da romlebic` sheakavebdnen xalxs borotebisgan micaze [urcmunoebisgan da c`odvisgan]!
(ase isini migascavlidnen xsnis gzas allahis sasjelisgan) magram aset`i adamianebi c`otani ag'moch`ndnen mxolod mc`iredni mat`gan, visac` ch`ven gadavarch`inet`.
(mat`gan ki c`otani usmendnen, da kidev up`ro c`otani misdevdnen mat`), xolo vinc` usamart`lobas sch`adiodnen, mihqvnen im p`up`unebas, romlit`ac` iqvnen dajildoebulni [micier siamovnebebsa da amk`veqniur c`xovrebas miec`nen]
da gaxdnen borotmok`medni [urcmunoni].
da ar aris sheni up`ali iset`i, rom gaanadguros k`alak`ebi usamart`lod, roc`a mat`i mc`xovrebni ket`ilismk`mnelni arian.
shens g'mert`s rom ndomeboda, igi qvela adamians ert` t`emad ak`c`evda, magram isini kvlavac` azrt`a sxvadasxvaobashi arian

garda imat`i, vinc` sheicqala shenma g'mert`ma. da amist`vis gaach`ina isini. da ag'srulda sheni g'mert`is sitqva: auc`ileblad avavseb jojoxet`s jinebit`a da adamianebit`, qvelat`i ert`ad [mat`, romelnic` satanas mihqvebian]
da qovelives, rasac` giambobt` shuamavalt`a ambebidan (o, shuamavalo), imist`visaa, rom gangimtkic`ot` guli. da movida shent`an am [surashi] cheshmariteba, darigeba da shegoneba morcmunet`at`vis.
da ut`xari (o,shuamavalo) mat`, romelt`ac` ar scamt`: imok`medet` t`k`veni z'alisamebr [rogorc` t`vlit` scorad], da, uechvelad, ch`venc` vimok`medebt` (rogorc` gvibrz'ana ch`venma up`alma)
da daelodet` (da naxavt`, rogor dasruldeba ch`veni sak`me), da ch`venc` davelodebit` (t`u rogor dasruldeba t`k`veni sak`me)

da allahs ekut`vnis c`at`a da micis uxilavi, da mast`an brundeba qoveli sak`me. mash, t`aqvani (mxolod) mas ec`i da (mxolod) mas miende. da sheni up`ali ar aris uquradg'ebo imis mimart`, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
alip`. laam. raa. es c`xadi cignis aiat`ebia.
cheshmaritad, ch`ven gardmovavlinet` igi arabul quranad, rat`a dap`ik`rdet` (mis mnishvnelobaze).

ch`ven mogit`xrobt` shen (o, shuamavalo) sauket`eso ambavs imit`, rac` sht`agagonet` shen am quranit`, da uechvelad, shen iqavi ugulisxmot`a [vinc` ar ic`oda masshi arsebuli darigeba da ashkara sascaulebi] shoris
aha, ut`xra iusup`ma t`avis mamas: hei, mamach`emo! me vnaxe t`ert`meti varskvlavi da mze da mt`vare. vnaxe, isini sajdashi ch`ems cinashe(sizmarshi naxa rom, isini mis cinashe micaze t`avs debdnen )
ut`xra (iaqubma): shvilo ch`emo, ar uambo sheni sizmari shens z'mebs, t`orem maxes dagigeben shen. uechvelad, eshmaki adamianist`vis c`xadi mteria.

ase gamogarch`evs sheni g'mert`i, gascavlis sizmrebis axsnas da srulqop`s t`avis cqalobas shenze da iaqubis sht`amomavlobaze, rogorc` srulqo igi ucin shens or mamaze ibrahimsa da ishaqze. uechvelad, sheni g'mert`i qovlismc`odne, brz'enia.
cheshmaritad, iusup`sa da mis z'mebshi iqo sascaulebi mkit`xvelt`at`vis.
roc`a t`k`ves: iusup`i da misi z'ma mamach`venist`vis ch`venze up`ro saqvarelni arian, mashin roc`a ch`ven z'lieri jgup`i vart`. uechvelad, mamach`veni ashkara gzaabneulobashia.
mokalit` iusup`i an gadaagdet` igi shoreul micaze, rat`a mamat`k`venis saxe mxolod t`k`ven gekut`vnodet` da amis shemdeg ket`ilmsaxurni gaxdit` (moinaniebt` allaht`an da mamasac` patiebas st`xovt`).

ert`ma mat`ganma t`k`va: nu moklavt` iusup`s, aramed ch`aagdet` igi chis sig'rmeshi, da aiqvans mas romelime gamvleli k`aravani (da isini shors caiqvanen mas t`k`vengan da mamisgan), t`u ukve gadacqvitet` amis gaket`eba
mat` t`k`ves: hei, mamao ch`veno! rad ar gvandob iusup`s, da ch`ven xom misi ket`ilismsurvelni vart`?!
xval ch`vent`an ert`ad gamoushvi, rat`a datkbes (gemrieli xilit`a da kenkrebit`) da it`amashos, da uechvelad, ch`ven misi mc`velebi vik`nebit`.
t`k`va (iaqubma): cheshmaritad, mamcuxrebs, rom caiqvant` mas da meshinia, rom mgelma ar shechamos igi, roc`a t`k`ven uquradg'ebod ik`nebit` mis mimart`.
mat` t`k`ves: t`uki mas mgeli shechams, roc`a ch`ven aset`i z'lieri jgup`i vart`, mashin xom cagebulebi vik`nebit`.
da roc`a caiqvanes igi da gadacqvites, rom chis sig'rmeshi ch`aegdot`, ch`ven sht`avagonet` mas: shen ut`uod amc`nob mat` am mat`i sak`c`ielis shesaxeb, mashin, roc`a isini verc` ki mixvdebian.
da sag'amo xans movidnen mamast`an atirebulni.
mat` ut`xres: hei, mamach`veno! ch`ven cavedit`, rom shevjibrebodit` da iusup`i ch`vens nivt`ebt`an davtovet`, da igi mgelma shechama. shen ki ar gvijereb, t`undac` simart`les vambobdet`.

da moitanes misi perangi c`ru sisxlit`. t`k`va: ara, t`k`venma sulebma shegilamazat` es sak`me. amitom, mshvenieria mot`mineba. allahs unda vt`xovo daxmareba (imast`an dakavshirebit`), rasac` t`k`ven ag'cert`

da movidnen (chast`an) mgzavrebi [k`aravani, romelic` egviptisken miemart`eboda]. man ch`aushva t`avisi vedro da t`k`va: o, sasixarulo ambavia! aha, qmacvili! da damales igi, rogorc` sak`oneli. da alahi qovlismc`odnea, rasac` isini sch`adian.
da gaqides igi (egvipteshi) z'alian mc`ire p`asad, dat`vlil dirhemebad, radgan surdat` (ubralod) t`avidan moeshorebinat` igi

da t`k`va iman, vinc` iqida is egviptidan, t`avis c`ols: pativi ec`i mis sadgoms, ik`neb sargebeli mogvitanos an shvilad aviqvanot`. da ase davamkvidret` iusup`i im micaze da rat`a gvescavlebina mist`vis sizmrebis axsna. xolo allahi srulqop`ilad ag'asrulebs t`avis sak`mes, magram adamiant`a umravlesobam ar ic`is.
da roc`a man miag'cia srulqop`ilebis asaks, ch`ven mas mivanichet` sibrz'ne da c`odna. da ase mivagebt` ch`ven ket`ilismk`mnelt`.

da k`alma [egvipteli veziris c`oli], romlis saxlshic` is iqo, misi c`duneba ganizraxa, ch`aketa karebi da ut`xra: modi ch`emt`an (me ukve movemzade shent`vis!)! man (iusup`ma) ut`xra: g'mert`s shevap`areb t`avs! cheshmaritad is ch`emi batonia, romelmac` ket`ilad mimig'o(amitom mas ver vug'alateb). usamart`loni verasdros miag'ceven bednierebas.

da uechvelad, k`als vneba ag'ez'ra mis mimart` da masac` ag'ez'vreboda vneba mis mimart`, rom ar exila t`avisi g'mert`is nat`eli mtkic`ebuleba. ai, ase, rat`a agveridebina mist`vis boroteba da garqvnileba. uechvelad, igi ch`vens rch`eul msaxurt`agan iqo.

da oriveni karisken gaik`c`nen da ch`amoaxia man(k`alma) perangi misi zurgidan(roc`a iusup`is shech`ereba sc`ada). da kart`an t`aviant` batons caacqdnen. t`k`va (k`alma): ra aris sasjeli im adamianist`vis, vinc` boroteba indoma sheni ojaxis mimart`, garda c`ixisa an mtkivneuli sasjelis?

(misma k`marma ut`xra: o, iusup`! shen daapire uket`ureba ch`ems ojaxze, momatque da mzakvroba ixmare, t`it`k`os xar siket`ismk`nenlt`agani) (iusup`i gag'izianda da) t`k`va: man shemac`dina. da (ert`ma) mocmem misive(k`alis) ojaxis mxridan daadastura: t`u misi (iusup`is) samosi cinidanaa daxeuli, mashin mart`alia is (k`ali), xolo is matquart`agania
xolo t`u misi (iusup`is) perangi zurgidanaa ch`amoxeuli, mashin is c`ruobs da igi mart`alt`agania.
roc`a man (k`marma) dainaxa, rom misi (iusup`is) perangi zurgidan iqo gaxeuli, ut`xra: (c`ols) cheshmaritad, es t`k`veni mzakvrobaa! cheshmaritad, t`k`veni mzakvroba didia!
iusup`, t`avi daanebe amas [aravin ar gaigos amis shesaxeb]! shen ki shendoba it`xove sheni c`odvist`vis. uechvelad, shen c`odvilt`agani xar
da k`alak`shi k`alebma t`k`ves: veziris c`oli t`avis qmas ac`dunebs. uechvelad, misdami siqvarulma misi guli sheipqro. cheshmaritad, ch`ven mas ashkara gzaabnevashi vxedavt`.

roc`a gaigo mat`i mzakvrobis shesaxeb, gaugzavna mat` (xalxi) mouxmo mat` da gaumzada mat` nadimi, da t`it`oeul mat`gans(k`als) dana misc`a da ut`xra (iusup`s): gamodi mat` cinashe! roc`a(k`alebma) dainaxes, ganadides igi da xelebi daichres da t`k`ves: g'mert`o didebulo! es adamiani ar aris. es mxolod cminda angelozia.

(roc`a is k`alebi gonze movidnen da dainaxes, rom t`aviant`i xelebi t`vit`onve dauchriat`,) man t`k`va [mt`avris c`olma]: ai, es aris is, vis gamoc` msaqvedurobdit`. da me vc`dilobdi mis shec`denas, magram man t`avi sheikava. da t`u is ar gaaket`ebs, rasac` me vubrz'aneb, uechvelad sapqobileshi ik`neba ch`asmuli, da usat`uod ik`neba damc`irebult`a shoris.
t`k`va (iusup`ma): g'mert`o ch`emo! sapqrobile up`ro sasurvelia ch`emt`vis, vidre is, riskenac` mixmoben. da t`u shen ar amarideb mat` mzakvrobas, me mat`ken gadavixrebi da ugunurt`agan vik`nebi.
mashin sheismina misi vedreba up`alma da ganarida mas mat`i mzakvroba. cheshmaritad, is qovlismsmeni, qovlismc`odnea.
mas shemdeg, rac` ixiles nishnebi(argumentebi iusup`is udanashaulobis), mat` gadacqvites, rom igi garkveuli droit` ch`aesvat` c`ixeshi.

da mast`an ert`ad sapqrobileshi shevida ori chabuki. ert`ma mat`ganma t`k`va: me vnaxe, rom g'vinos vcuravdi. meorem ki t`k`va: me vnaxe, rom t`avze puri medo, romelsac` p`rinvelebi chamdnen. gvaucqe ch`ven amis axsna. uechvelad, ch`ven gxedavt` shen ket`ilismk`mnelt`a shoris.

ut`xra: ar mogivat` sachmeli, romelic` gergebat`, rom ar gamc`not` misi axsna, vidre t`k`venamde moag'cevdes. es imisganaa, rac` ch`emma g'mert`ma mascavla. me mivatove im xalxis sarcmunoeba, romelt`ac` ar scamt` allahi da romlebic` imk`veqniur c`xovrebas uarqop`en.

da me mivqevi ch`ems mama-papat`a sarcmunoebas ibrahimis, ishaqisa da iaqubisas. ch`vent`vis daushvebelia, rom allahs rame gavuziarot`. es allahis cqalobaa ch`vendami da adamianebisadmi, magram adamiant`a umravlesoba umaduria.
o, ch`emo c`ixis megobrebo! mravali sxvadasxva g'mert`i sjobs t`u ert`ad-ert`i, qovlismpqrobeli allahi?

t`k`ven ki mis garda [allahis garda] mxolod saxelebs sc`emt` t`aqvans (gamogonil,,g'mert`ebs"), romlit`ac` t`k`ven da t`k`veni mamebi ucodebt` mat`. allahs ar gamougzavnia mat`ze aranairi mtkic`ebuleba (rom mat` unda ecodos g'mert`ebi da mat` unda emsaxurebodet`). gankarguleba ekut`vnis mxolod allahs [mxolod is cqvets, vis unda et`aqvanon]. man brz'ana, rom ar et`aqvanot` aravis, mis garda. es aris scori rcmena (da scori gza), magram adamiant`a umetesobam es ar ic`is.

o, ch`emo c`ixis oro megobaro! (ai t`k`veni sizmrebis axsna): t`k`vengan ert`-ert`i t`avis batons(mep`es) daalevinebs g'vinos, xolo meore gakruli ik`neba (jvarze) da p`rinvelebi daukortnian t`avs. dasrulebulia(auc`ileblad ac`xaddeba) is sak`me, rasac` t`k`ven kit`xulobdit`.

da ut`xra (iusup`ma) mat`gan im ert`s, viszec` ic`oda, rom gadarch`eboda: 'momixsenie sheni mep`is cinashe!' magram eshmakma daavicqebina mas amis gaxseneba t`avis batont`an, da iusup`i darch`a c`ixeshi ramdenime clis ganmavlobashi.

da (ert` dg'es) t`k`va mep`em (egviptis): "cheshmaritad, me vxedav (sizmarshi) shvid msuk`an z'roxas, da shvid gamxdar z'roxas, romlebic` mat` chamen(ga mxdrebi msuk`nebs chamen); da shvid mcvane t`avt`avs, da sxvas -- shvid gamxmar t`avt`avs. o, ch`emo didebulno! amixsenit` ch`emi xilva, t`u shegiz'liat` xilvebis (sizmrebis) axsna!"
mat` t`k`ves: "es areuli sizmrebia da ch`ven sizmrebis axsnashi mc`odneni ara vart`".

da t`k`va mat`gan im ert`ma (mep`is msaxurt`agan), romelic` gadarch`a, iusup`i rom gaixsena (misi t`xovna gaixsena) didi xnis shemdeg: "me mogit`xrobt` am sizmris axsnas -- gammgzavnet` (mast`an, vinc` shez'lebs mis axsnas)!"

(g'vinis msxmeli cavida iusup`t`an da ut`xra mas):"o, iusup`! o, simart`lis matarebelo! agvixseni (es sizmari) im shvid msuk`an z'roxaze, romlebsac` shvidi gamxdari z'roxa chams, da shvid mcvane t`avt`avze da sxvebze -- (kidev shvid) gamxmar t`avt`avze, rat`a davbrunde xalxt`an [mep`est`an, mis garemoc`vast`an da scavlulebt`an], romlebic` sheikribnen sizmris axsnist`vis, da rat`a mat` ic`odnen (misi mnishvneloba da ag'iaron sheni g'irseba)".

(iusup`ma) ut`xra: "(ai, am sizmris axsna): t`k`ven dat`esavt` (xorbalsa da k`ers) shvidi clis ganmavlobashi, gulmodgined shromit`. rasac` moimkit`, datovet` t`avt`avshi [sheinaxet` mosavali t`avt`avebianad, rat`a uket` sheinaxos], garda im mc`ire nacilisa, rasac` t`avad shechamt`.
(am mosavliani clebis) shemdeg mova shvidi mz'ime [umosavlo] celi, romlebic` shechamen qvelap`ers, rac` mat`t`vis cinascar moimaraget`, garda im mc`ire nacilisa, rasac` datovebt` (t`eslist`vis).
amis shemdeg mova celi, roc`a xalxs uxvi cvima moevlineba da isini gamocuraven (qurz'ens, zet`s da sxva naqop`ebs)".

(g'vinis msxmeli dabrunda mep`est`an da uambo mas, t`u rogor auxsna iusup`ma es sizmari). mep`em misag'ebad ch`at`vala es ganmarteba da t`k`va: "momiqvanet` igi! [is, vinc` ch`emi sizmari ganmarta]". roc`a mast`an [iusup`t`an] movida mep`is gzavnili da gadasc`a misi mocodeba, iusup`ma ar moisurva ach`k`areba da gadacqvita lodini, vidre misi udanashauloba damtkic`deboda. iusup`ma ut`xra moc`ik`uls:"daubrundi shens batons [mep`es] da hkit`xe mas:
'ra mouvida im k`alebs, (vis gverdit`ac` egviptis veziris c`olma moucoda da) romlebmac` xelebi gaichres?' --
radgan cheshmaritad, ch`emma up`alma ic`is mat`i xrikebi!"

(mep`em mouxmo im k`alebs, mat` shoris -- veziris c`ols, da) ut`xra mat`:"ra iqo t`k`veni sak`me? [ra moxda mashin], roc`a iusup`is sheqoleibas c`dilobdit` (mis shec`denas da c`odvisken caqvanas)?" mat` t`k`ves: "allahma dagvip`aros, ch`ven masshi arap`eri c`udi ar shegvimch`nevia". veziris c`olma t`k`va: "axla gamoashkaravda cheshmariteba: me viqavi is, vinc` sc`ada misi shec`dena, (magram is mtkic`ed dadga da darch`a mart`ali). da is namdvilad mart`alt`agania [igi iqo mart`ali, roc`a uarqop`da c`ils da ambobda, rom udanashauloa, xolo damnashave -- me var]!"

(imis shemdeg, rac` g'vinis msxmeli dabrunda c`ixeshi, iusup`ma t`k`va): "es [ch`emi uari c`ixidan gamosvlaze] imist`visaa, rom (vezirma) ic`odes, rom me ar shemic`denia igi mis zurgs ukan [mis ar qop`nashi], da rom allahi ar miuz'g'veba scor gzaze mog'alatet`a xrikebs [ver miag'cevs carmatebas is, vinc` ar inaxavs ndobas]".

(iusup`ma t`k`va): da ar vamart`leb ch`ems suls [ar vambob, rom ch`emi suli dac`ulia shec`domisa da c`odvisgan], radgan suli ubiz'gebs borotebisken [adamianis suli bunebit` midrekilia borotebisken, advilad emorch`ileba c`dunebas da amkobs c`uds], t`u ara ch`emi up`lis cqaloba [garda imat`isa, visac` allahi sheicqalebs da daic`avs borotebisa da c`odvisgan]. cheshmaritad, ch`emi up`ali mapatiebeli da shemcqalebelia

(roc`a iusup`is udanashauloba gamoashkaravda, mep`em ubrz'ana, mist`vis mieqvanat` igi, radgan gadacqvita, ert`-ert` t`avis ndobit` mosil adamianad daenishna.) da t`k`va mep`em: momiqvanet` igi! me ch`emt`vis aviqvan. da roc`a man [mep`em] iusup`s esaubra, ut`xra: cheshmaritad, dg'es shen ch`vent`vis pativc`emuli da sando adamiani xar

iusup`ma t`k`va: damaqene k`veqnis saunjeebze [saxelmcip`os maragebsa da ganz'eulebze] zedamxedvelad, radgan me var damc`veli [shemiz'lia sauket`eso p`ormit` davic`va da shevinaxo k`oneba] da mc`odne [vp`lob unars, movagvaro da vmart`o saxelmcip`o sak`meebi]

(mep`em danishna iusup`i ministrad). amgvaradve gavamqaret` iusup`is mdgomareoba am k`veqanashi, rat`a ec`xovra ik`, sadac` isurvebda, ch`ven vunacilebt` ch`vens mocqalebas visac` vinebebt`, da ar vkargavt` ket`ilshemok`medt`a jildos
da uechvelad saik`ios sazg'auri uket`esia mat`t`vis, romelt`ac` ircmunes da g'vt`ismoshishni iqvnen
da mividnen iusup`is z'mebi da shevidnen mast`an. man (iusup`ma) ic`no isini, mat` ki ver ic`nes igi.

roc`a man [iusup`ma] ag'churva isini sursat`it` [t`it`oeul mat`gans ak`lemze ch`aulaga cili], ut`xra: momiqvanet` t`k`veni z'ma mamidan (biniamini). gana ver xedavt`, rom me srulad gaz'levt` cils [zustad mogc`emt` sazoms da ar gatquebt`] da me sauket`eso var mimg'ebt`a shoris [sauket`eso maspinz'eli var]?
t`u ar moiqvant` mas ch`emt`an, mashin t`k`ven ag'ar gek`nebat` ch`emt`an cili [ar miig'ebt` ch`emgan sursat`s], da ag'ar momiaxlovdet` [ag'ar moxvidet` ch`emt`an].
(z'mebma) ut`xres: ch`ven dazhinebit` vt`xovt` mamas mis gamo (rat`a gamogvaqolos igi ch`ven), da uechvelad ase movik`c`evit`.

ut`xra (iuusup`ma) t`avis msaxurebs: daubrunet` mat`i sak`oneli (rac` mat` sursat`ist`vis gadaixades) mat`ve bargshi, rat`a ic`odnen, roc`a dabrundebian t`aviant` ojaxt`an [roc`a saxlamde miag'ceven da ag'moach`enen], da rat`a isev dabrundnen (darcmunebulni imashi, rom me vasruleb ch`ems dapirebebs)

da roc`a (z'mebi) dabrundnen mamast`an, ut`xres: o, mamach`veno! (shemdegshi) agvekrz'aleba cili [sursat`s ar mogvc`emen],[t`u egvipteshi mis gareshe mivalt`]. gamogzavne ch`veni z'ma ch`vent`an ert`ad, da mashin mivig'ebt` ch`vens cils. da, namdvilad, ch`ven auc`ileblad davic`avt` mas [aravit`ar z'alas ar davishurebt` mis dasac`vad]

(iaqubma) t`k`va: rogor gandot` igi t`k`ven, gana ise ki ara, rogorc` ert`xel ukve gandet` misi z'ma? [rogor dagijerot` axla, roc`a ert`xel t`k`ven ukve ver daic`avit` misi z'ma?] xolo allahi aris sauket`eso mc`veli [mxolod allahs sheiz'leba ando vinmes dac`va], da igi mocqalet`agan qvelaze mocqalea

da rodesac` mat` gaxsnes sakut`ari k`oneba [bargi], naxes, rom mat`i sak`oneli (rac` mat` sursat`ist`vis gadaixades) mat`ve daubrunes. da t`k`ves: o, mamach`veno! rag'a unda visurvot`? ai, ch`veni sak`oneli, ch`venve dagvibrunda, movamaragebt` ch`vens ojaxs, davic`avt` ch`vens z'mas da davumatebt` kidev ert`i ak`lemis cils. es -- advili cilia [t`it`oeul mosuls az'levdnen mxolod ert`i ak`lemis tvirt`is sazoms, amitom z'mis caqvana zrdida sursat`is raodenobas ert`i ak`lemis tvirt`it`.]

(iaqubma) t`k`va: "ar gavushveb mas t`k`vent`an ert`ad, sanam allahis saxelit` dadebul p`ic`s ar momitant`, rom auc`ileblad damabrunebt` mas, garda im shemt`xvevisa, t`u rame ubedureba dagatqdebat`". roc`a mat` [z'mebma] mis cinashe dades es p`ic`i, man (iaqubma) t`k`va: "allahia ch`veni sitqvebis mocmea!"

da t`k`va (iaqubma): "o, shvilebo! nu shexvalt` (egvipteshi) ert`i karidan; shedit` sxvadasxva karidan (rom ar miik`c`iot` adamiant`a quradg'eba, romlebmac` ziani sheiz'leba mogaqenon). me verap`rit` dagixsnit` allahisgan. gadacqvetileba mxolod allahs ekut`vnis. mxolod mas vendobi, da dae, mxolod mas miendon mindobilni".

da roc`a isini shevidnen ise, rogorc` mat` mamam ubrz'ana [sxvadasxva karit`], es verap`ershi ver ixsnida mat` allahisgan [verap`ers shec`vlida allahis nabrz'anebidan], aramed es mxolod im survilis dakmaqop`ileba iqo, rac` iaqubs gulshi hk`onda - da gadacqvetileba, romelic` t`avad miig'o. radgan iaqubi p`lobda c`odnas im cqalobit`, rac` ch`ven mivanichet` mas, magram adamianebis umravlesobam ar ic`is [ar p`loben im c`odnas, rom allahze daeqrdnon da sip`rt`xilec` sheinarch`unon].

da roc`a isini movidnen iusup`t`an (da iusup`ma ket`ilad miig'o isini) da man t`avist`an miiqvana t`avisi z'ma (biniamini), ut`xra mas: "namdvilad, me sheni z'ma var; amitom ag'ar dagcqdes guli imaze, rasac` isini sch`adiodnen (ch`ven mimart`)".

da mashin, roc`a (iusup`ma) moamzada isini da uzrunvelqo sachiro sursat`it`, man t`avisi z'mis tvirt`shi ch`ado sasmisi(romlit`ac` marc`vleuls conidnen an zomavdnen). shemdeg mac`nem xmamag'la moucoda: 'o, k`aravano! t`k`ven, namdvilad, k`urdebi xart`!'
(iusup`is z'mebma) t`k`ves, roc`a mat`t`an mividnen: 'ra dagekargat`?'
(msaxurebma) t`k`ves: 'ver poulobt` mmart`velis sasmiss; vinc` mogvitans imas - (miec`ema jildod) ert`i ak`lemis tvirt`i. da me vig'eb pasuxismgeblobas am dapirebaze'.
(iusup`is z'mebma) t`k`ves: 'vp`ic`avt` allahs! t`k`ven kargad ic`it`, rom ch`ven ar movsulvart` borotebis ch`asadenad am micaze, da ch`ven ar vqop`ilvart`(rodesme) k`urdebi'.
ut`xres: 'mash, ra ik`neba misi sasjeli, t`uki matquarebi xart`?'
(iusup`is z'mebma) t`k`ves: 'sasjeli im adamians, romlis tvirt`shic` igi (sasmisi) ag'moch`ndeba -- t`vit`onve ik`neba [anu is t`vit`on darch`eba]. ase vsjit` ch`ven borotmok`medebs!'

da daicqo mat`i tomrebis ch`xreka, vidre t`avisi z'mis tomaras sheudgeboda. shemdeg ki t`avisi z'mis tomridan amoig'o igi. ai, ase vascavlet` iusup`s xerxi. mas ar sheez'lo mep`is kanonit` daetovebina t`avisi z'ma, allahs rom ar ndomeboda. ch`ven avamag'lebt` xarisxebit`, inebebs visac`. da qovel mc`odneze umc`odnesi dgas

(z'mebma, t`avis gasamart`leblad) t`k`ves: t`u is [biniaminma] moipara, mashin adre misma z'mamac` (romelt`ac` mama da deda ert`ni hqavdat` iusup`ma) moipara. (iusup`is bavshvobashi moxda shemt`xveva, roc`a igi shec`domit` k`urdad ch`at`vales) iusup`ma es sitqvebi gulshi damala da ar ach`vena mat` [ar daanaxva, rom es gaigona]. t`vit`on ki (t`avist`vis) t`k`va: c`ud mdgomareobashi xart` t`k`ven [t`k`ven t`vit`on up`ro mz'ime mdgomareobashi xart`] imaze metad, vidre visac` abralebt` da allahma uket` ic`is is, ras ag'cert`

(z'mebma) ut`xres: o, didebulo! mas xom moxuc`i, xandazmuli mama hqavs, amitom ert`-ert`i ch`vengani daitove mis (beniaminis) nac`vlad. mart`lac`, ch`ven gxedavt`, rom shen xar ket`ilismk`mnelt`agani.
man t`k`va: "allahma dagvip`aros imisgan, rom aviqvanot` vinme, garda imisa, vist`anac` ch`veni nivt`i vipovet`. mashin ch`ven, uechvelad, usamart`loni vik`nebodit`".(t`u udanashaulos davsjidit`)

da roc`a mat` imedi gadaecurat` masze [z'maze, rom gaat`avisup`lebdnen], ganc`alkevdnen (ert`manet`shi) sat`at`birod.
mat`ma up`rosma t`k`va: "nut`u ar ic`it`, rom mamam t`k`vengan aig'o allahis cinashe ag't`k`ma (rom daic`avdit` z'mas da dabrunebdit` mast`an ert`ad)? da manamde t`k`ven usamart`lod moik`ec`it` iusup`t`an. me ar davtoveb am micas [egviptes], sanam mama ar damrt`avs (dabrunebis) nebas, an sanam allahi ar damrt`avs nebas (z'mis gat`avisup`lebit`). da xom ic`it`, rom scored igi - uzenaesi - aris sauket`eso ganmsjeli, [(radgan) misi gadacqvetileba qvelaze scoria] da is - qvelaze samart`liania".

"dabrundit` t`k`vens mamast`an (da mouqevit` mas, rac` moxda) da ut`xarit`: "o, mamao ch`veno! sheni vazhi [biniamini] k`urdobashi
daadanashaules; ch`ven mxolod imas vadasturebt`, rac` vic`it` [ch`ven ar gvinaxavs, rogor moxda es, mxolod is vixilet`, rom mis tvirt`shi t`asi ag'moach`ines]; ch`ven ar vart` damp`aravni saidumlosi (c`odnis)".

(o, mamao ch`veno,) hkit`xe im sop`lis (xalxs), sadac` viqavit` [egvipteshi], da im k`aravans, t`an rom movdiodit` [k`anaanelebs, romlebt`anac` ert` k`aravanshi viqavit`]; da namdvilad, ch`ven -- uechvelad -- mart`alni vart` (imashi, rac` mogiqevit`)".

t`k`va (iaqubma): "ara, t`k`venma sulebma shegilamazes es sak`me. amitom, me (mmart`ebs) mshvenieri mot`mineba! imedia, allahi qvela mat`gans ert`ad damibrunebs. cheshmaritad, is qovlismc`odnea, brz'enia".
da zurgi ak`c`ia mat` da t`k`va: "vai, ch`ems mcuxarebas iusup`is gamo!" da t`valebi gaut`et`rda(daubnelda) mcuxarebisgan, da is ikavebda t`avis dards.

(iaqubis z'eebma) t`k`ves: "vp`ic`avt` allahs, t`u shen ar shecqvet iusup`is gaxsenebas, sheni mcuxareba mxolod gaizrdeba da amis gamo an z'alas dakargav [daavaddebi], an kidev dag'upult`a shoris ag'moch`ndebi [gardaic`vlebi]!"

man [iaqubma] mat` upasuxa: "me ch`ems mcuxarebas da tkivils mxolod allahs vuch`ivi. cheshmaritad, me allahisgan vic`i is, rac` t`k`ven ar ic`it` [rom iusup`is is sizmari cheshmariti iqo da amitom is c`oc`xalia]!"

"o, ch`emo shvilebo! cadit` (ukan egvipteshi) da gamoikvliet` iusup`isa da misi z'mis shesaxeb da nu dakargavt` imeds allahis cqalobis mimart`. cheshmaritad, allahis cqalobis imeds mxolod urcmuno xalxi kargavs (visac` ar scams, rom mas qovelgvari z'ala ak`vs)!"

(da z'mebi kvlav gaeshurnen egvipteshi.) rodesac` isini mividnen mast`an [iusup`t`an], ut`xres: "o, azizo(veziro)! ch`ven da ch`vens ojaxs ubedureba dagvatqda [gvalvisa da shimshilis gamo]. ch`ven movedit` mc`ire da aramnishvnelovani sak`onlit` (romelic` c`otaa da uxarisxo). mogvig'e sruli cili [iset`i, rasac` adre gvaz'levdi, roc`a kargi sak`onlit` vixdidit`] da gviboz'e ch`ven mocqaleba. namdvilad, allahi miagebs mocqale adamianebs (vins mocqalebas gsc`ems)."
man [iusup`ma], [mat`i shebralebit`], t`k`va: "ic`it` t`u ara, ra gauket`et` iusup`s da mis z'mas [binamians] (da ra mouvidat` bolos), roc`a umec`arni iqavit`?"

mat` [z'mebma] t`k`ves: "nut`u mart`la shen xar iusup`i?" iusup`ma t`k`va: "me var iusup`i, da es aris ch`emi z'ma. allahma mogvmadla cqaloba (da es aris scored is, rom xangrz'livi ganshorebis shemdeg kvlav shevxvdit` ert`manet`s). namdvilad, vinc` erideba [c`odvebs] da it`mens [sachiroebis da gansac`delis dros]... allahi ar dakargavs ket`ilmok`medt`a sazg'aurs!"

mat` t`k`ves: "vp`ic`avt` allahs! uechvelad, allahma upiratesoba moganicha ch`venze (moganicha simdidre, c`odna da z'ala). da cheshmaritad, ch`ven shemc`dart`a shoris viqavit` (shevc`dit` shens cinashe)".

(iusup`ma) ut`xra: "dg'es t`k`venze ar ik`neba saqveduri! allahma mogitevot`, - radgan namdvilad igi aris qvelaze mocqale mocqalet`agan (gansakut`rebit` mat` mimart`, vinc` moubrundeba mas, moinaniebs ch`adenil c`odvebs da c`dilobs srulad daemorch`ilos mas)!"

(shemdeg man hkit`xa mat` mamaze, da mat` ut`xres, rom is iusup`ze tirilit` dabrmavda), iusup`ma t`k`va: "cadit` [dabrundit`] ch`emi am perangit` da daap`arit` igi mamach`ems saxeze -- da mas daubrundeba t`valis ch`ini. shemdeg ki modit` ch`emt`an t`k`veni mt`eli ojaxit` ([k`alebit`, shvilebit` da shvilishvilebit`], rat`a gat`avisup`ldet` mz'ime c`xovrebisgan)".

da roc`a k`aravani gaeshura (egviptidan), mat`ma mamam [iaqubma, romelic` palestinashi imqop`eboda], garshemomqop`ebs ut`xra: "cheshmaritad, me vgrz'nob iusup`is surnels. netav, t`k`ven ar gegonot`, rom me goneba damekarga( da rac` ar vic`i imas vlaparakob)!".
t`k`ves: "allahs vp`ic`avt`, mart`lac`, shen shens z'vel gzaabnevashi xar".

roc`a movida sasixarulo ucqebis momtani, man iusup`is moc`emuli perangi mamas saxeze daap`ina, da is kvlav t`valxiluli gaxda. iaqubma t`k`va: "nut`u ar geubnebodit`, rom allahisgan vic`i is [rom misi cqaloba sheuzg'udavia], rac` t`k`ven ar ic`it`?"

(iaqubis shvilebma) t`k`ves: "o, ch`veno mamao! st`xove allahs, rom mogvitevos ch`veni c`odvebi. namdvilad, ch`ven mart`lac` c`odvilebi viqavit` (roc`a ase movek`ec`it` iusup`s da mis g'viz'l z'mas)".
t`k`va: "shevevedrebi ch`ems up`als t`k`vent`vis patiebas. cheshmaritad, is aris qovlismimtevebeli, mcqalobeli".

da roc`a isini (egvipteshi ch`asuli) iusup`t`an shevidnen, man t`avisi mshoblebi miig'o t`avist`an da ut`xra: "shemodit` egvipteshi, t`u allahi inebebs, usap`rt`xod (qvela amk`veqniuri sirt`ulisgan dac`ulni)!"

da aiqvana t`avisi mshoblebi taxtze da isini mis cinashe muxlebze daemxnen. da man t`k`va: "hei, mamach`emo! es aris ch`emi z'veli sizmris axsna. ch`emma g'mert`ma is cheshmaritebad ak`c`ia. da man siket`e miqo, roc`a sapqrobilidan gamomiqvana da udabnodan t`k`venc` mogiqvanat`, mas shemdeg, rac` satanam me da ch`ems z'mebs shoris shug'li ch`amoagdo. cheshmaritad, ch`emi g'mert`i mocqalea, rist`visac` inebebs. cheshmaritad, is aris qovlismc`odne, brz'eni".

# "up`alo ch`emo! shen miboz'e me z'alaup`leba da mascavle sizmrebis axsna. c`at`a da micis shemok`medo! shena xar ch`emi mp`arveli amk`veqnadac` da imk`veqnadac`. mimibare muslimad(shendami morch`ilad) da shemaert`e mart`alt`a ric`xvs".

es [cinascarmetqvel iusup`is (iosebis) ambavi] aris uxilavis ambebidan ert`-ert`i (romelic` mxolod allahma ic`is), (da) romlit`ac` ch`ven shen (o, cinascarmetqvelo) sht`agagonebt`. da shen (o, muhammad) ar qop`ilxar mat`t`an [iusup`is z'mebt`an] ert`ad, rodesac` mat` t`aviant`i gegma sheimushaves, mashin, roc`a iusup`is cinaag'mdeg intriganobdnen.
da sheni eris umetesoba, t`undac` shen (o, shuamavalo) did z'alisxmevas ich`ende (imisat`vis, rom mat` cheshmariteba da rcmena miutano), morcmuneni ar arian! (amitom mat`i urcmunoeba nu gagamcarebs.)
da shen (o, shuamaval) mat`gan [adamianebisgan] amis [sarcmunoebisken mocodebis] sanac`vlod arap`ers it`xov. es [qurani] mxolod shexsenebaa samqaroebist`vis.
da ramdeni sascaulia c`ashi da dedamicaze (romlebic` allahis sidiadeze miut`it`eben), romlebsac` isini (daup`ik`reblad) ugulebelqop`en da zurgs ak`c`even!
da umetesoba mat`gani [vinc` zurgs ak`c`evs] ar ircmunebs allahis (romelmac` isini shek`mna da arch`ens) da mast`an ert`ad sxvebs ar et`aqvaneba!

nut`u isini usap`rt`xod arian imisgan, rom allahis sasjeli daatqdebat` (da moic`avs mat`), an is saat`i (da sasamart`lo dg'e) moulodnelad daatqdebat` (da dadgeba) ise, rom verc` ki sheamch`neven [ver igrz'noben]?

t`k`vi (o, shuamavalo): <<es aris ch`emi gza (romelsac` mivqvebi) allahisken mocodebashi, mak`vs c`xadi mtkic`ebuleba (allahisgan) - me da ch`ems mimdevrebs (am gzaze). da allahi didebulia/unakloa, da me ar var mravalg'mert`iant`agani!>>

da shenamde (o, muhammad) ch`ven mxolod kac`ebi (da ara angelozebi) gamovgzavnet` (sop`lebisa da) k`alak`ebis mc`xovrebt`agan (da ara udabnoebidan), romlebsac` ch`ven ch`amovuvlinet` zesht`agoneba [allahisgan]. gana ar imogzaures mat` [mek`k`is urcmunoebma da sxvebma] dedamicaze [gana ar iqvnen isini iemensa da shamshi] da ar ixiles, ra bolo eciat` mat` [xalxebs, romlebic` ar emorch`ilebodnen allahs], vinc` mat` cin iqo [ra daemart`at` adis da samuds]? da cheshmaritad, saukuno sac`xovrebeli [samot`xe] uket`esia mat`t`vis, vinc` p`rt`xilobda (allahis sasjelis). gana ar gesmit` [ar p`ik`robt` amaze]?

(urcmunoebma aseve uarqves cina cinascarmetqvelebi da shuamavlebi, da sak`me ik`amde mivida, rom) rodesac` (cina) shuamavlebi (ukve) sasocarkvet`ilni (rom xalxi, romelsac` moucodebdnen, daijerebda) da p`ik`robdnen, rom uarqop`ilni iqvnen [moc`ik`ulebi darcmunebulni iqvnen, rom mat` xalxs ar surda urcmunoebis datoveba], (mxolod mashin) miig'es [moc`ik`ulebma] ch`veni daxmareba [sasjeli mat`t`vis, vinc` urcmunoebashi dazhinebit` rch`eboda, da xsna morcmuneebist`vis] da isini, vinc` ch`ven gvsurda [cinascarmetqvelebi da isini, vinc` mat` cheshmaritebit` mihqvnen], gadarch`nen. da ch`veni sasjeli ver ik`neba mogeriebuli urcmunoebis mier.

mat` shesaxeb ambavshi [iusup`isa da misi z'mebis] aris gakvet`ili goniert`at`vis; es ar iqo gamogonili ambavi, aramed (es ambavi ik`na movlenili) im simart`lis dasadastureblad, rac` (movlenili iqo) mis cin (cina cerilebshi), rat`a ganemarta (msaxurt`at`vis) qovelives shesaxeb, saxelmz'g'vanelo (gzasac`denisgan t`avis dasag'cevad) da cqaloba mat`t`vis, vinc` ircmunebs.

alip` laam miim raa. es [aris is, rac` ikit`xeba] - cignis (allahis) aiat`ebi. da is, rac` shen gardmogevlina (o, shuamavalo) sheni up`lisgan [qurani], aris cheshmariteba, magram adamiant`a umetesobas ar scams.

allahi - (is) aris igi, vinc` zec`ebi ag'amag'la [shvidi zec`a] svetebis gareshe, rogorc` xedavt`, shemdeg amag'lda 'arshze (rogorc` es mxolod mis sidiades sheshvenis) da daimorch`ila mze da mt`vare: t`it`oeuli mat`gani [mze da mt`vare] moz'raobs danishnul vadamde [gankit`xvis dg'emde, rodesac` es samqaro arsebobas shecqvets]. is ganagebs [qovelive arsebulis sak`meebs] (t`avisi sibrz'nisamebr), xsnis (xalxist`vis) (t`avis) nishnebs (romlebic` miut`it`ebs mis z'alasa da imaze, rom mxolod is aris cheshmariti g'mert`i), rat`a darcmundet` t`k`vens up`alt`an shexvedrashi!

da is [allahi] aris is, vinc` gashala mica [gaxada igi sic`oc`xlist`vis shesap`erisi] da ag'mart`a masze mqari mt`ebi da mdinareebi, da qoveli saxis xilidan masze [micaze] ori saxeoba [mamri da mdedri]. is dg'es g'amit` [misi sibnelit`] p`aravs. cheshmaritad, amashi nishnebia [mit`it`ebebi da mtkic`ebulebebi] mat`t`vis, vinc` p`ik`robs!

micaze arian ert`manet`is mezoblad mdebare nakvet`ebi (iset`i, rom ert`ze mc`enareebi izrdeba, xolo meoreze, romelic` mariliani an kldovania, arap`eri izrdeba), da (aseve maszea) venaxebi, da mosavali, da (iset`i) palmebi (romlebic` ert` jgup`ad izrdebian) ert`i p`esvidan da (iset`i palmebi, romlebic`) ara ert`i p`esvidan [c`al-c`alke izrdebian], romlebsac` ert`i cqlit` rcqaven. da zogiert` mat`gans [am mc`enareebs] ch`ven sakvebad sxvebze uket`ess vk`mnit` [vanichebt` mat` uket`es gemos, surnels, garegnobas,...]. cheshmaritad, amashi [teritoriebs, xilisa da misi sxva t`visebebis gansxvavebulobashi] - nat`eli sascaulebia gonieri xalxist`vis!

da t`u shen (o, shuamavalo) gaoc`ebuli xar (imit`, rom am argumentebisa da mtkic`ebulebebis shemdeg ar surt` ircmunon), mashin (kidev up`ro) gasaoc`aria urcmunot`a sitqvebi: "rodesac` (sikvdilis shemdeg) ch`ven micad vik`c`evit` [sruliad gaxrcnilni], namdvilad ag'vdgebit` axal k`mnilebashi [mkvdret`it` ag'mdgarni]?!" aset`ebi [isini arian], vinc` ar ircmuna t`avisi up`lis (romelmac` isini shek`mna). da isini (arian), visac` (gankit`xvis dg'es) (c`ec`xlovani) borkilebi ek`nebat` kisrebze. da isini - (arian) c`ec`xlis [jojoxet`is] mkvidrni, (da) isini ik` maradzhams darch`ebian.

isini [urcmunoebi] gibiz'geben (o, shuamavalo) ubedurebis dach`k`arebit` [ironiit`, it`xoven, rom daatexo mat` t`avs sasjeli, romelic` mat` urcmunoebis gamo emuk`rebat`] siket`emde [imis nac`vlad, rom ircmunon da amit` gadaarch`inon t`avi]. da cheshmaritad, mat`ze cin ukve iqo saquradg'ebo sasjelebi. da cheshmaritad, t`k`veni up`ali namdvilad mimtevebelia adamianebisadmi (rodesac` isini moinanieben), miuxedavad mat`i usamart`lobisa! da namdvilad, t`k`veni up`ali sastik sasjeliania!

xolo urcmunoni amboben: "ratom ar gamougzavnes mas [muhammads] misi up`lisgan (xiluli) sascauli (rogoric`aa moses joxi an salihis ak`lemi)?" (magram sascaulebs shen ki ar axden, o, shuamaval, aramed mxolod allahi) cheshmaritad, shen (o, shuamavalo) mxolod gamap`rt`xilebeli xar da qovel xalxs hqavs megzuri (romelic` mat` allahis kmaqop`ilebis gzas uch`venebs)!

allahma ic`is, ras atarebs qoveli k`ali (sashvilosnoshi) [mamakac`s t`u k`als, bednieri ik`neba t`u ubeduri] (da mxolod man ic`is), ramdenad ikumsheba da ramdenad p`art`ovdeba sashvilosno [moxdeba muc`lis moshla, naadrevad imshobiarebs an vadaze gaach`ens shvils]. radgan mast`an qvelap`ers ak`vs t`avisi sazg'vari da t`avisi vada.
(is) - uxilavisa da xilulis mc`odne, diadi (t`avis arsebashi, saxelebsa da t`visebebshi), uzenaesi (romelic` t`avisi arsebit`a da z'alit` qvela t`avis k`mnilebaze mag'la dgas)!

t`k`ven shoris (adamianebs shoris) t`anascorni arian:
isini, vinc` damalavs saubars da is, vinc` g'iad saubrobs, da isic`, vinc` (t`avis sak`meebs) g'amit` malavs da dg'isit` g'iad mok`medebs(p`arulic` da ashkarac` allahis cinashe ernairia).

mas [allahs] hqavs (angelozebi), romlebic` pirdapir mis [kac`is] cin da ukan mihqvebian da allahis brz'anebit` ag'ric`xaven mis (sak`meebs). cheshmaritad, allahi ar c`vlis (mdgomareobas), (romelshic` adamianebi imqop`ebian) sanam isini t`vit`onve ar shec`vlian imas, rac` mat`t`anaa [mdgomareobas, romelshic` imqop`ebian] (kargisken, an c`udisken). da t`u allahma moisurva romelime xalxist`vis ubedureba (sasjelis saxit`), mashin verap`eri shez'lebs mis mogeriebas, da mat` mas garda aravit`ari mp`arveli ar hqavt` (romelic` mat`gan mis sasjels moigeriebda)!

is [allahi] aris is, vinc` gach`venebt` chek`a-k`uxils (rogorc` t`avis ert`-ert` nishans) (da t`k`ven xedavt` mas) shishit` (rom is dagartqamt`) da imedit` (rom cvima mova). da is [allahi] carmoshobs mz'ime g'rublebs (romlebic` t`k`vens sasiket`od cvima moak`vt`).

da k`uxili ganadidebs mas [alahs], da angelozebi (ganadideben mas) misi shishit`. da is gzavnis mexebs da urtqams mat`, visac` is inebebs. da isini [urcmunoni] kamat`oben allahis shesaxeb, magram igi z'levamosilia z'alit`a (da sasjelit` mat`ze, vinc` mas ar emorch`ileba)!

da cheshmariti vedreba mas ekut`vnis. da isini (g'vt`aebebi), romlebsac` uxmoben mis garda [vedrebit` mimart`aven], arap`rit` ar pasuxoben mat`. garda imisa, rom isini im [mcqurvalis] msgavsni arian, romelic` xels shors, cqlisken icvdis, rat`a pirt`an miitanos, magram [cqali] mis [pirs] ver ag'cevs. da namdvilad, urcmunot`a vedreba mxolod gzaabneilobashia!

da allahis cinashe sajdas asruleben (t`aviant`i morch`ilebis gamosaxatavad) isini, vinc` zec`ashi arian [angelozebi] da isini, vinc` dedamicaze arian, (da simdablit` ixrebian mis cinashe) nebaqop`lobit` (morcmuneebi) da unebliet` (urcmunoebi da t`valt`mak`c`ebi), da mat`i ch`rdilebi [arsebebis] dg'is dasacqissa da mis bolos.

t`k`vi (o, shuamavalo): "vin aris c`at`a da micis up`ali?" ut`xari mat` (mravalg'mert`ianebs): "allahi!" t`k`vi: "nut`u mis garda sxva mp`arvelebi aiqvanet`, romelt`ac` ar z'aluz't` arc` sargeblis motana da arc` zianis miqeneba t`aviant`i t`avist`vis?" t`k`vi: "gana brma da t`valxiluli ert`ia? gana sibnele da sinat`le ert`ia? an ik`neb allahs moziareebi daudgines, romelt`ac` shek`mnes iseve, rogorc` man shek`mna, da mat`t`vis k`mnileba ert`manet`s daemsgavsa?" t`k`vi: "allahia qovelives shemk`mneli. da igia ert`adert`i, qovlisshemz'le".

man gardmoavlina cqali [cvima] c`idan - da velebi aivso [cqlit`] t`avisi zomis shesabamisad [t`it`oeuli veli t`avisi zomis mixedvit`]. da (am) cqaldidobam caig'o k`ap`i, romelic` (zedapirze) amovida. {am magalit`shi, cqali cheshmaritebaa, k`ap`i -- sic`rue, xolo xeobebi -- adamiant`a sulebi} da im [ok`ro, verc`xli, spilenz'i]-dan, romelsac` isini [adamianebi] c`ec`xlshi ac`xeleben (rodesac` adnoben), samkaulebisa da iarag'ebis gasaket`eblad (sak`mes) [sachreli iarag'i], (aseve ch`ndeba) aset`i k`ap`i. {am magalit`shi, lit`oni aris cheshmariteba, xolo k`ap`i -- sic`rue.} amgvarad, allahi carmoach`ens cheshmaritebasa da sic`rues (magalit`ebis saxit`). rac` sheexeba k`ap`s, is gadaigdeba, xolo is, rac` sasargebloa xalxist`vis [cqali da lit`oni], dedamicaze rch`eba. ase iz'leva allahi magalit`ebs (xalxist`vis).

isini, vinc` t`aviant` up`als upasuxes [mt`lianad daemorch`ilnen mas] - sauket`eso [samot`xe], da isini, vinc` mas ar upasuxes [urcmunoebi], t`undac` mat` micaze hk`onodat` qvelap`eri [mt`eli simdidre] da kidev imdenive, (mashin) isini (sasamart`lo dg'es) uechvelad gamoisqididnen t`avs amit` (geenis sasjelisgan). aset`t`at`vis sashineli angarishi ik`neba da (maradiuli) t`avshesap`ari -- geena, da (ra) sashinelia is (mxurvale) sacoli!

gana is, vinc` ic`is, rom shent`vis (o, shuamavalo) sheni up`lisgan gamoc`xadebuli cheshmaritebaa (da sjera misi), igivea, rac` is, vinc` cheshmaritebist`vis brmaa [vinc` mas ver xedavs da, shesabamisad, ar sjera misi]? magram mxolod gonierni ismenen (gap`rt`xilebebs) [da sargebloben mat`gan].
romlebic` allahis ag't`k`mas [mast`an shet`anxmebas] ert`gulad ic`aven da ar arg'veven t`aviant` pirobebs;

da isini, vinc` imas aert`ianeben, rac` allahma daakavshira [inarch`uneben ojaxur kavshirebs da kargad ek`c`evian g'aribebs], da eshiniat` t`aviant`i up`lis (rodesac` c`odvas sch`adian), da eshiniat` c`udi angarishscorebis (gankit`xvis dg'es); da isini, vinc` mocqalebas gasc`emen mxolod allahis kmaqop`ilebis saz'ieblad da visi gulebic` shp`ot`aven [t`aviant`i c`odvebis gamo],

da isini, vinc` mot`minebas ich`endnen (allahis morch`ilebashi, c`odvebisgan t`avis shekavebasa da gasachirshi), ez'ebdnen t`aviant`i up`lis saxes [mis kmaqop`ilebas], da ag'asrulebdnen (savaldebulo) loc`vas (sat`anadod) [droulad, mokrz'alebit` up`lis cinashe], da gasc`es (savaldebulo da nebaqop`lobit`i mocqaleba) imisgan, rac` ch`ven mivec`it` mat` [mat`i k`onebidan], p`arulad da g'iad, da moigeries boroteba siket`it`. mat`t`visaa saboloo(sak`ebari) samqop`eli

(samot`xis) edemis bag'ebi, romlebshic` isini shevlen t`aviant`i mamebis [mshoblebis], meug'leebisa da sht`amomavlebis mart`lebt`an ert`ad(im nat`esavebt`an ert`ad romelnic` scor gzas gahqvnen). da angelozebi (samot`xeshi) mat` qvela karidan miudgebian (da etqvian):
"mshvidoba t`k`venda imisat`vis, rac` moit`minet` (alahisadmi morch`ilebis gamoch`enisas)!" da ra mshvenieria (es) ukanaskneli samqop`eli!

da isini, romelnic` arg'veven t`aviant` ag't`k`mas allaht`an
ert`gulebis pirobis dadebis shemdeg (romelic` adamiant`a sulebma dades allaht`an amk`veqnad mosvlamde, rom mxolod allahs ag'iarebdnen t`aviant` g'mert`ad)
da cqveten imas, risi gamqarebac` allahma brz'ana [isini cqveten morcmuneebs shoris nat`esaur da megobrul kavshirebs], da t`esaven areulobas [c`odvebs] dedamicaze, aset`t`at`vis (ag't`k`mulia) cqevla [isini ver miig'eben allahis cqalobas] da mat`t`vis aris c`udi
sac`xovrebeli [jojoxet`i]!

(mxolod) allahi ap`art`oebs [zrdis] sazrdos imist`vis, vist`visac` moisurvebs (t`avisi msaxurebidan), da zg'udavs sazrdos) (vist`visac` moisurvebs). da isini [urcmunoebi] xaroben amk`veqniuri c`xovrebit`, magram amk`veqniuri c`xovreba mxolod (droebit`i) siamovnebaa imast`an shedarebit`, rac` momaval c`xovrebashia!

xolo urcmunoni [mek`k`is mravalg'mert`ianni] amboben: "ratom ar ch`amouvlina [muhammeds] t`avisi up`lisgan (xiluli) sascauli (iset`i, rogoric` moc`ik`ulma mosem da iesom, moitanes)?" (shen) ut`xari (mat`): "allahi gzas aubnevs, visac` moisurvebs (da sascaulis xilva ar daexmareba), xolo misken(allahisken mimaval) cheshmarit gzaze miuz'g'veba mat`, vinc` mas(allahs) miubrundeba (c`odvebis monaniebit`)!"

(da is cheshmarit gzaze miuz'g'veba) mat`, vinc` ircmunebs da visi gulebic` allahis xsenebit` simshvides pouloben. diax! radgan gulebi allahis xsenebit` [misi morch`ilebit`, misi mogonebit`a da mis mier dapirebuli sazg'aurit`] simshvides pouloben.

xolo vinc` ircmuna da ket`ili sak`meebi gaaket`a [aket`ebda imas, rasac` allahi ubrz'anebda da t`avs aridebda imas, rasac` krz'alavda] - mat` ek`nebat` ket`ili c`xovreba [bedniereba da simshvide] da ulamazesi saukuno samqop`i [samot`xe].

ase rom [rogorc` cin cavgzavnet` shuamavlebi] ch`ven shen (o, muhammad) gamoggzavnet` sazogadoebashi, romelt`a cinac` ukve iqvnen (sxva bevri ) sazogadoeba, rat`a shen (o, shuamavalo) caukit`xo mat`t`vis [am sazogadoebist`vis] is, rac` ch`ven sht`agagonet` [qurani], rodesac` mat` urcmunoeba gamoavlines shemcqnareblis mimart`. ut`xari (mat`) (o, shuamavalo): "is [mocqale allahi] ch`emi up`alia! ar arsebobs g'mert`i [t`aqvanisc`emis g'irsi] mis garda. mas vendobi da mast`anaa ch`emi dabruneba monaniebit`!"

da rom qop`iliqo raime cigni, romlis cakit`xvisasac` mt`ebi daiz'vrebodnen, an mica gaixsneboda (da masshi cqaroebi amoxet`k`avdnen) (rogorc` es iqo moses joxis shemt`xvevashi), an mkvdrebi ilaparakebdnen (ag'dgomis shemdeg) (rogorc` es iqo iesos shemt`xvevashi) (mashin aset`i cigni namdvilad qurani ik`neboda). (magram t`u urcmunoebze ar mok`medebs es qurani, romelic` t`avist`avad sascaulia, mashin isini ar ircmuneben, t`undac` sxva sascaulebi ixilon). magram allahs z'aluz's qovelive! [t`uki sascauli xdeba, is mxolod misi nebit` xdeba.] gana ar ic`ian morcmuneebma, rom allahs rom eneba, mas sheez'lo qvela adamiani cheshmarit gzaze moeqvana (sascaulebis gareshec` ki)? da urcmunot`a ubedurebs ar cqdeba imis gamo, rac` mat` [t`aviant`i urcmunoebis gamo] ch`aidines, an is [ubedureba] mat` saxlebt`an axlos shech`erdeba, vidre ar ag'sruldeba allahis ag't`k`ma. cheshmaritad, allahi ar c`vlis (sakut`ar) ag't`k`mas!

da ukve (carsulshi ase iqo, rom) isini dasc`inodnen shenamde (o, muhammad) mosul shuamavlebs (iseve, rogorc` sheni xalxi dasc`inis im cheshmaritebas, romelsac` mat` acvdi), da me gadavuvade imat`, vinc` urcmuno gaxda. shemdeg me davsaje isini (ch`emi sasjelit`), da rogori iqo ch`emi sasjeli?

gana is, vinc` xedavs qoveli sulis namoxvechars [rac` gaaket`a]? da (t`aviant` umec`rebashi) mat` allahs miuceres t`anaziarebi (romlebsac` sc`emen t`aqvans). t`k`vi (o, shuamaval): "daasaxelet` isini (maxasiat`eblebi, romlebic` mat` g'mert`ebad mich`nevis g'irss gaxdida)! t`u sheatqobinebt` mas rames [t`it`k`os sxva g'mert`ebic` arseboben] dedamicaze, rac` man ar ic`is, t`u es [codeba allahis garda sxvis g'mert`ad sherac`xva] mxolod c`arieli sitqvebia?" diax, (satanam) mort`o urcmunot`a mzakvroba da isini gzas aac`dina! xolo visac` allahi gzas aac`dens, mas ar hqavs scor gzaze damqenebeli!
mat` [urcmunoebs] amk`veqnad sasjeli elit`, xolo ag'dgomis dg'is sasjeli uechvelad, up`ro mz'ime ik`neba. da mat` allahisgan veravin daic`avs!

# (samot`xis) bag'is magalit`i, romelic` (allahisgan) ag't`k`mulia mat`t`vis, visac` (allahisa) eshinia: mat`(samot`xis) k`vesh mdinareebi miedineba, misi(samot`xis) sachmeli(sasmelic` da xileulic`) mudmivia da misi ch`rdilic`(mudmivia) (romelic` ar k`reba da ar mc`irdeba). es aris sazg'auri mat`t`vis, vinc` p`rt`xilobda (allahis sasjelis), xolo urcmunot`a sazg'auri aris c`ec`xli.

xolo isini, visac` ch`ven cigni mivec`it`, xaroben imit`, rac` shen (o, muhammad) gardmogevlina (qur'ani) (radgan masshi pouloben dadasturebas imisa, rac` mat` cignebshia dacerili). magram jgup`ebs [iudevelebsa da k`ristianebs] shoris arian iset`ebi, romlebic` uarqop`en mis(quranis) nacils. ut`xari (mat`): "me brz'aneba momec`a, rom vemsaxuro mxolod allahs da ar davudgino mas t`anaziari. me misken (allahisken) movucodeb (xalxs) da misken aris dabruneba!"

da amgvarad, ch`ven is [qurani] gardmovavlinet` (allahis) brz'anebat`a krebulad arabul enaze. t`u shen (o, shuamavalo) mihqvebi mat` [mravalg'mert`iant`a] survilebs (loc`vashi), mas shemdeg, rac` (cheshmariti) c`odna (allahisgan) mogec`a, shen ar geqoleba arc` damxmare da arc` mp`arveli allahisgan!

(mravalg'mert`ianebi amboben: "t`u shen allahis shuamavali xar, ratom irt`av c`ols?") magram ch`ven shenamde (o, muhammad) gamovgzavnet` shuamavlebi (kac`t`agan) da vuboz'et` mat` meug'leebi [c`olebi] da sht`amomavloba [shvilebi]. (da mravalg'mert`ianebi aseve amboben: "t`u shen allahis shuamavali xar, mashin ratom ar gvich`veneb im sascaulebs, romlebsac` shengan vit`xovt`?") magram ar qop`ila, rom romelime shuamavals allahis nebart`vis gareshe sascauli moetana. qoveli gansazg'vruli vada [movlena] - (dadgenili allahis mier) - t`avis cignshia [t`avis droshia].
allah shlis [auk`mebs] imas, rasac` nebavs [ganach`enebsa da sxva rameebs], da amtkic`ebs (imas, rasac` nebavs); da mast`an aris deda cigni [dac`uli dap`a].

ch`ven (o, shen, shuamavalo) rom gich`venot` misi (sasjelis) nacili, romelic` ch`ven mat` vpirdebit` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] (amk`veqnad), an mogakvdinot` (misi naxvis cin), mashin sheni movaleoba mxolod (cheshmaritebisken mocodebis) mitanaa, xolo ch`vent`anaa angarishscoreba (da sazg'auri)!
nut`u ar dainaxes, rom ch`ven dedamicas vadgebit` da mis sazg'vrebs vamc`irebt`? da allahi ig'ebs gadacqvetilebas da veravin gaauk`mebs mis gadacqvetilebas, da is scrap`ia angarishscorebashi!
da mat`ze adre mqop`nic` xrikebs mimart`avdnen, magram qvela xriki allahs ekut`vnis. man ic`is, ras moixvechs qoveli suli. da urcmunoni male gaigeben, visia saboloo(kargi) samqop`eli.

xolo urcmunoebi amboben: "shen (o, muhammad) ar xar (allahis) mier cargzavnili!" ut`xari (mat`) (o, shuamavalo): "allahi sakmarisia mocmed ch`emsa da t`k`vens shoris, da (aseve) sakmarisia mocmed isini (iudevelni da k`ristianebi), visac` c`odna ak`vs cignis [isini, vinc` t`aviant`i cignebidan ic`ian ukanaskneli cinascarmetqvelisa da shuamavlis shesaxeb]!"

alip` laam raa. cigni [qurani], romelic` ch`ven shen gardmogivlinet` (o, shuamavalo), rat`a xalxi gamoiqvano sibnelidan (uc`odinroba da urcmunoeba) nat`elshi (cheshmariteba da rcmena) mat`i up`lis nebit`, qovlad didebulis da sak`ebaris gzisken
allahis(gzisken), romlis sakut`rebac` aris (qvelap`eri), rac` c`at`a shina da rac` k`veqanazea. da ubedureba [mkac`ri sasjeli] (elis) urcmunot`a mtkivneuli sasjelisgan,
romlebsac` amk`veqniuri c`xovreba maradiulze metad uqvart` da (xalxs) allahis gzidan ac`denen, c`diloben, daamaxinjon igi [allahis gza]! aset`i (xalxi) shor c`domilebashia.

da ch`ven shuamavalni mxolod t`aviant`i xalxis enaze gamovgzavnet`, rat`a mat` es (allahis religia) mat`t`vis nat`lad ganemartat`. allahi gzas uc`dens, visac` moisurvebs, da gzas uch`venebs, visac` moisurvebs. da (cheshmaritad) igi aris didebuli (da) brz'eni!

da (aha) ch`ven ukve gamovgzavnet` mose (israelis sht`amomavlobast`an) (da gavaz'lieret` igi) ch`veni sascaulebit`: gamoiqvane sheni xalxi sibnelidan sinat`leze (cheshmaritebisa da rcmenis) da sheaxsene mat` allahis dg'eebi [dg'eebi, rodesac` allahma mat` siket`it` savse c`xovreba uboz'a da dg'eebi, rodesac` cina t`emebi allahis sasjelit` itanjebodnen]. cheshmaritad, amashi [allahis dg'eebis gaxsenebashi] nat`eli sascaulebia qoveli momt`meni (da) madlieri (allahisadmi) adamianist`vis.

da (gaixsene o, shuamavalo, imis shesaxeb), t`u rogor ut`xra musam t`avis xalxs [israelis sht`amomavlebs]: "gaixsenet` allahis cqaloba (romelic` mogagot`), rodesac` man gixsnat` p`araonis jarisgan [p`araonisa da misi msaxurebisgan], (rodesac` isini zg'vashi daaxrch`o), (romelmac`) mkac`ri sasjeli dagakisrat` [sashinlad gagcirat`], xoc`avda t`k`vens vazhebs da tovebda c`oc`xlad t`k`vens k`alebs (rat`a momsaxureebad gamoeqenebinat`). da (amashi) iqo t`k`vent`vis didi gansac`deli t`k`veni up`lisgan!

da ase gamoac`xada t`k`venma up`alma: "t`u madlieri ik`nebit` (im cqalobebist`vis, rac` me giboz'et`), me ut`uod gavamravleb mat` t`k`vent`vis; magram t`u umadurni ik`nebit`... cheshmaritad, ch`emi sasjeli mkac`ria".

da ut`xra mosem (israelis sht`amomavlobas): "t`u t`k`ven da qovelive amk`veqniurni umadurni gaxdebit`, mashin
allahi cheshmaritad t`vit`kmaria [mas aravin da arap`eri schirdeba,t`k`ven daziandebit` amit`] (da) qovladk`ebulia!"

gana ar moag'cia t`k`venamde (o, muhammadis sazogadoebav) - noes, adis, samudisa da mat` shemdeg mosult`a shesaxeb? mat`i ric`xvi, allahis garda, aravin ic`is. mat`i shuamavlebi mividnen mat`t`an [im xalxebt`an] c`xadi nishnebit` [allahis gamoc`xadebit`a da mtkic`ebulebebit`], magram mat` pirshi xelebi ch`aicqves (cheshmariti rcmenisadmi sibrazisa da siz'ulvilisgan) da ut`xres (t`aviant` shuamavlebs): "cheshmaritad, ch`ven ar gvcams is, rac` shen gamogegzavna, da (namdvilad) ch`ven ashkarad damabnevel echvshi vart` imis mimart`, riskenac` mogvicodeb".

mat`ma shuamavlebma ut`xres mat`: "gana echvi geparebat` allahshi, c`at`a da micat`a shemok`medshi?" is [allahi] gixmobt`, rom mogitevot` zogiert`i t`k`veni c`odva [is, rac` rcmenamde ch`aidinet`] da gadados t`k`veni [sikvdili] da [gaaxangrz'livos t`k`veni sic`oc`xle] gansazg'vrul dromde [rat`a amk`veqnad ar dagsajot`]. mat` t`k`ves: "t`k`ven mxolod ch`vennairi adamianebi xart`. t`k`ven gsurt`, rom uarvqot` is, rasac` ch`veni mamebi sc`emdnen t`aqvans. mogvitanet` c`xadi mtkic`ebuleba (rom t`k`ven mart`lac` allahis shuamavlebi xart`)!"

(amis gagonebisas) mat`ma shuamavlebma ut`xres mat`: "(diax, namdvilad) ch`venc` t`k`vennairi adamianebi vart`, magram allahi t`avis cqalobas anichebs, visac` moisurvebs (da irch`evs mas t`avis shuamavlad). da ch`ven ar shegvez'lo aranairi argumentis cardgena allahis nebart`vis gareshe. da dae, morcmuneebi (mxolod) allahs miendon!"
da ra up`lebit` ar unda mivendot` allahs, roc`a man gvich`vena ch`veni gzebi? da ch`ven ut`uod movit`ment` im zians, romelsac` t`k`ven gvaqenebt`. dae, allahs miendon mindobilni.

da urcmunoebma ut`xres t`aviant` shuamavlebs: "auc`ileblad gamogasaxlebt` ch`veni micidan, anda daubrundebit` ch`vens rcmenas". da mat`ma up`alma sht`aagona mat` [moc`ik`ulebs]: "ch`ven ut`uod gavanadgurebt` usamart`loebs(mch`agvrelebs)".

da ch`ven namdvilad dagamkvidrebt` t`k`ven (o, shuamavlo, shen da sheni mimdevrebi) mat` shemdeg am micaze [mas shemdeg, rac` urcmunoebs gavanadgurebt`]. es (damkvidrebuli gadacqvetilebaa) mat`t`vis, vinc` ch`ems cinashe (gankit`xvis dg'es) dgomis da ch`emi [sasjelis] muk`aris eshinia!
da mat` [moc`ik`ulebma] st`xoves (t`aviant` up`als) gamarjveba (mtrebze), da damarc`xda qoveli jiuti mch`agvreli [is, vinc` ar ig'ebs cheshmaritebas].
mis [urcmunos] cin jojoxet`i udevs da mas sasmelad ch`irk`s misc`emen (romelic` jojoxet`shi tanjuli sulebis sxeulebidan gamodis).

is mas qlupebit` dalevs, magram z'livs gadaqlapavs, da sikvdili qoveli mxridan moevlineba, magram ar mokvdeba (am satanjvelebisgan gat`avisup`lebist`vis), da mis cin mcvave
sasjeli elis.

mat`, vinc` t`aviant`i up`alis ar ircmuna, mat`i sak`meebi [mat`i siket`eebi...] hgavs p`erp`ls, romelsac` k`arian dg'es z'lieri k`ari (dap`antavs). isini [urcmunoebi] verap`ers moipoveben imisgan, rac` moixveches. ai is aris shoreuli gzaabneuloba!

gana ar ginaxavt`, rom allahma shek`mna c`ani da mica (da qvelap`eri mat`shi) cheshmaritebit` [srulqop`ili saxit`]; t`u is moisurvebs, cagart`mevt` da moiqvans axal k`mnilebas [sxvebs, romlebic` mas sruliad daemorch`ilebian].
da es allahist`vis z'neli ar aris.

da (gankit`xvis dg'es) isini g'vt`is cinashe cardgebian. da uz'lurni etqvian mat`, vinc` [t`aviant`i cinamz'g'olebis mimart`] ampartavnobdnen: "cheshmaritad, ch`ven t`k`veni mimdevrebi viqavit`, axla xom gvixsnit` (dg'es) allahis sasjelisgan (rogorc` gpirdebodit`) t`undac` mc`iredit`?" isini [gzasac`denilt`a cinamz'g'olebi] itqvian: "allahs rom (cheshmarit) gzaze [rcmenaze] daveqenebinet`, ch`ven namdvilad dagaqenebdit` t`k`venc`. ch`vent`vis ert`ia, viglovot` t`u vitanjot` - ch`vent`vis (allahis sasjelisgan) t`avis dag'cevis gza ar arsebobs".

da t`k`va satanam, rodesac` sak`me gadacqda [mas shemdeg, rac` allahma t`avisi angarishi gaascora da t`avisi msaxurebi samot`xeshi da jojoxet`shi sheushva]: "cheshmaritad, allahma mogc`at` cheshmariti ag't`k`ma (rom ik`neba ag'dgoma da sazg'auri), me ki mogec`it` ag't`k`ma (rom arap`eri ik`neba aset`i), magram me mogatquet` [t`k`vent`vis c`ru ag't`k`ma gavec`i]. da ar mk`onda z'ala t`k`venze, garda imisa, rom mogatquet`. da me ar mk`onda t`k`venze [urcmunoebze] z'alaup`leba, garda imisa, rom me mogixmet` (urcmunoebasa da gzasc`denilebashi), da t`k`venc` shemomiert`dit` [gamomqevit`]. amitom, nu damadanashaulebt`, aramed daadanashaulet` sakut`ari t`avi (t`k`veni c`odvebis gamo). me ver dagexmarebit` (allahis sasjelisgan t`avis dag'cevashi), t`k`venc` ver damexmarebit`. cheshmaritad, uarvqop` imas, rasac` [amk`veqnad] ch`ems t`anaziarad (allaht`an) gamxadet`. cheshmaritad, usamart`loebi [romlebmac` zurgi ak`c`ies cheshmaritebas da mihqvnen sic`rues] isini arian, romlebsac` elit` mtkivneuli sasjeli!

xolo isini, vinc` ircmunes da siket`e k`mnes, sheqvanilni ik`nebian samot`xis bag'ebshi, (sadac`) mat` k`vemot` mdinareebi miedineba [sasaxleebisa da xeebis k`vesh], da isini marad ik` dabinavdebian [samot`xis bag'ebshi] t`aviant`i up`lis nebart`vit` (da z'alit`). mat`i misalmeba ik` [samot`xeshi] ik`neba: salaam "mshvidoba!"

gana ar ic`odi (o, shuamavalo), rogor mohqavs allahs magalit`ad ket`ili sitqva [ "ar arsebobs g'mert`i [t`aqvanisc`emis g'irsi] allahis garda"]? is [sitqva] hgavs karg xes [palmas]: misi p`esvi mtkic`ea, xolo misi totebi c`ashia.
is [xe] t`avisi naqop`s qovel cams g'vt`is nebit` isxams. da allahi magalit`ebs iz'leva xalxist`vis, rat`a mat` gaixsenon)!

xolo boroti sitqvis magalit`i borot xes hgavs (romlis naqop`ic` mcarea), romlis amoz'irkvac` shesaz'lebelia dedamicis pirisgan - mas ar ak`vs simqare [g'rma p`esvebi] (da arc` totebi, romlebic` c`as scvdeba).

allahi ganamtkic`ebs morcmuneebs mtkic`e sitqvit` [cminda sitqvit`: "ar arsebobs g'mert`i [t`aqvanisc`emis g'irsi] allahis garda da muhammadi allahis shuamavalia"] amk`veqnad da saik`ioshi [sikvdilisas da sap`lavshi angelozebis mier kit`xvebis dasmisas]. da allahi gzas aubnevs usamart`loebs, da allahi aket`ebs imas, rac` nebavs.
gana ar ginaxavs isini, romlebmac` allahis cqaloba urcmunoebaze gac`vales, da t`aviant`i xalxi dag'upvis savaneshi daasaxles.
jojoxet`i, romelshic` isini daicvebian? da (ra) sashineli ik`neba is samqop`eli!
da daudgines allahs t`anascorni, rat`a (adamianebi) misi gzidan aac`dinon. ut`xari: "igemet` (am t`k`veni c`xovrebit`), radgan t`k`veni dabruneba c`ec`xlt`an [jojoxet`t`an] aris!

ut`xari (o, shuamaval) ch`ems morcmune msaxurebs, rom ag'asrulon loc`va (sat`anadod) [droulad, mokrz'alebit`] da (rom) gasc`en imisgan, rac` ch`ven mat` mivanichet`, sanam mova dg'e [gankit`xvis], rodesac` ar ik`neba arc` vachroba [vinme
ver shez'lebs sasjelis gamosqidvas] da arc` megobroba [aranairi megobruli kavshiri ar ushvelis].

allahi - is aris, vinc` shek`mna c`ani da mica, da ch`amoavlina cqali [cvima] c`idan, da misit` gamoig'o [sxvadasxva] naqop`i t`k`vent`vis sazrdod, da dagimorch`ilat` gemebi, rat`a mat` imoz'raon zg'vashi misi brz'anebit`, da dagimorch`ilat` mdinareebi,

da dagimorch`ilat` t`k`vent`vis mzec` da mt`varec`, mudmivi moz'raobit`, da dagimorch`ilat` t`k`vent`vis g'ame (rat`a masshi moisvenot`) da dg'e (rat`a ez'iot` misgan boz'ebuli siket`eebi da irch`inot` t`avi).

da man mogc`at` qvelap`eri, rac` ki st`xovet`, da t`u allahis cqalobebs dait`vlit`, ver ch`amot`vlit` mat`. cheshmaritad, adamiani ut`uod usamart`loa (sakut`ari t`avis mimart`) da umaduria (t`avisi up`lis mimart`).

da (gaixsene) (o, shen, shuamavalo) rodesac` ibrahimma (t`avisi vazhi ismaili da misi deda hajari mek`k`is velze daasaxla) t`k`va: "ch`emo up`alo! ak`c`ie es k`alak`i [mek`k`a] usap`rt`xod da damic`avi me da ch`emi shvilebi kerpt`a t`aqvanisc`emisgan".

up`alo! cheshmaritad, mat` [kerpebma] bevri adamiani ac`dunes, xolo vinc` ch`ems gzas mihqveba, namvilad is ch`emgania. xolo vinc` me ar memorch`ileba (miuxedavad imisa, rom morcmunea)... mashin uechvelad, shen xom mimtevebeli (da) mocqale xar!
