ch`veno up`alo! namdvilad, me davasaxle ch`emi sht`amomavlobis nacili unaqop`o xeo bashi(mek`ashi), sadac` arc` ert`i nat`esebiani qana ar aris da cqalic` ar aris, sheni cminda saxlis maxloblad. ch`veno up`alo! (es sheni brz'anebit` gavaket`e), rat`a mat` loc`va ag'asrulon. da xalxis gulebi [morcmuneebis] mat`dami ket`ilgancqobilni gaxade da am adgilas naqop`it` uzrunvelqavi, rat`a shendami madlierni iqvnen!
ch`veno up`alo! namdvilad, shen ic`i, rasac` ch`ven vmalavt` (ch`vens gulebshi) da rasac` ch`ven vac`xadebt` [g'iad]. da arap`eria micaze da zec`ashi, rac` allahist`vis p`arulia!
k`eba-dideba allahs, romelmac` sibereshi mach`uk`a ismaili da ishaqi! cheshmaritad, ch`emi up`ali ismens vedrebas!
o, up`alo! gamxade is, vinc` loc`ulobs (mudmivad da scorad), da ch`emi sht`amomavlobidanac`. ch`veno up`alo! da miig'e ch`emi vedreba.
ch`veno up`alo! momiteve me, ch`ems mshoblebs da (qvela) morcmunes im dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es], rodesac` dadgeba angarishscorebis dg'e!

da ar gegonos (o, shuamavalo), rom allahi uquradg'eboa imis mimart`, t`u ras aket`eben usamart`loebi [urcmunoebi]. is mxolod aqovnebs mat` [sasjels] im dg'emde [gankit`xvis dg'emde], rodesac` (sruli shishisgan) t`valebi gauc`ec`debat`.

(da ag'mdgarni) gaich`k`areben (shekrebis adgilas) [arap`ers ak`c`even quradg'ebas] t`avaceulebi. mat`i t`valebi mat` ar ubrundebat`(t`valebgasheshebulni shishisgan), da mat`i gulebi c`arielia [shishisgan].

da gaap`rt`xile (o, shuamavalo) (isini), vist`anac` shen xar cargzavnili, im dg'is shesaxeb, rodesac` sasjeli daatqdebat` t`avs! da usamart`lod mopqrobilni (sakut`ari t`avis mimart`) itqvian (rodesac` sasjels ixilaven): "ch`veno up`alo! mogvec`i mc`iredi gadadeba, rat`a vupasuxot` shens mocodebas, davijerot` sheni da gavqvet` shens shuamavlebs." (da et`k`mebat` mat`): "gana ar ip`ic`ebop`it`, rom t`k`vent`vis ar ik`neboda ag'dgoma?"

da t`k`ven dasaxldit` mat` sac`xovreblebshi, vinc` sakut`ar t`avs usamart`lod moek`c`a [cina t`aobat`a urcmunoebs], da t`k`vent`vis c`xadi gaxda, t`u rogor movek`ec`it` mat` [hudis da salihis xalxs], da ch`ven mogec`it` magalit`ebi (quranshi), (magram t`k`ven ar gait`valiscinet`).

da amgvarad mat` moip`ik`res xriki (allahis shuamavlis mokvla an misi dazianeba), magram (cheshmaritad) allaht`anaa mat`i mt`eli xrikebi [mat` cinaag'mdeg miak`c`ia], t`undac`, rom mat`i xrikebi iset`i iqos, rom mt`ebsac` ki daz'ravda.

da sulac` nu ip`ik`reb (o, shuamavalo), rom allahi daarg'vevs t`avis (mic`emul) ag't`k`mas t`avis shuamavlebt`an: (radgan) cheshmaritad, allahi didebulia, (da) shurismgebeli (t`avisi mtrebis cinaag'mdeg).
im dg'es, roc`a mica sxva micad sheic`vleba da c`anic`. da carsdgebian isini allahis, ert`adert`is, qovlismpqrobelis cinashe.
da ixilav c`odvilebs im dg'es, borkilebshi gadabmult`.
mat`i samoseli p`isisganaa da mat` saxeebs c`ec`xli p`aravs.
rat`a allahma qovel suls miuzg'os is, rac` man moixvecha. uechvelad, allahi scrap`ia angarishscorebashi.

es [qurani] ganc`xadebaa(gac`nobierebaa) xalxist`vis, da rat`a misit` ik`nen gap`rt`xilebulni, da rat`a ic`odnen, rom is ert`adert`i g'mert`ia, da rat`a gonierebma quradg'eba miak`c`ion [da sargebeli miig'on misgan]!
alip`. lam. ra. es aris cignis da c`xadi quranis aiat`ebi

moinatreben isini, romelnic` urcmunoni gaxdnen, rom morch`ilni [muslimebi] qop`iliqvnen.[mat`i es amao natvra ik`neba gankit`xvis dg'es, roc`a darcmundebian imashi, rom mat`ma urcmunoobam isini dag'upa]
miatove isini, chamon da datkbnen da amao imedma gaitac`os isini, xolo male sheitqoben.[roc`a allahis cinashe carsdgebian]
da ar gagvinadgurebia ch`ven arc` ert`i dasaxleba, t`u ara hk`onda mas dadgenili vada[ anu qvelas t`avisi dro hk`onda gansazg'vruli, t`u rodis ik`neboda ganadgurebuli ].
verc` ert`i t`emi ver gauscrebs sakut`ar gansazg'vrul dros da verc` sheaqovnebs mas.
da t`k`ves: hei, shen, viszec` ik`na gardmoevlenili shexseneba, cheshmaritad, sheshlili xar!
ratom ar mogviqvan angelozebs, t`u mart`alt`agan xar?

ch`ven zr gardmogvivlenia angelozni, t`u ara cheshmaritebit`, da mashin mat`[ mek`k`elebs, romlebmac` angelozebis gardmovlena moit`xoves] ar miec`emat` gadavadeba[aramed ganadgurdeba t`u manamde ar ircmuneben].

cheshmaritad, ch`ven [allahi] gardmovavlinet` shegoneba [qurani] da, cheshmaritad, ch`ven vart` misi damc`velni[mis shec`vlas, masshi raimes damatebas an daklebas ver shez'leben, radgan is allahma daic`va. es gamocveva z'alashia manamde sanam qurani am k`veqnad iarsebebs].
cheshmaritad, ch`ven shenamdec` carvgzavnet` cinandelt`a t`emebshi[anu shenamdec` bevri shuamavali ik`na c`rud sherac`xuli ].
da ar mosula mat`t`an [cinandel sazogadoebebt`an] arc` ert`i moc`ik`uli, rom isini [urcmunoebi] masze ar dasc`inodnen.
ase vagdebt` mas [urcmunoebas] borotmok`medt`a [mravalg'mert`iant`a] gulebshi![mat`i siurch`is gamo]
ar icameben isini mas [qurans], mashin roc`a ukve ganvlo magalit`i cinandelt`a (sazogadoebebis romelnic` urcmunoobis gamo gavanadguret`).
da t`undac` ch`ven gagveg'o mat`t`vis [urcmunoebist`vis] c`is kari da ramdenic` ar unda asuliqvnen ik`,
auc`ileblad itqodnen: <<ch`veni t`valebi mxolod shepqrobilia [mojadoebulia], da up`ro metic` -- ch`ven vart` moajadoebuli xalxi (muhammadis mier)!>>
da ukve movacqvet` c`ashi koshkebi [t`anavarskvlavedebi] da shevamket` isini (varskvlavebit`) maqurebelt`at`vis.[rat`a varskvlavebit` gaikvlion gza, da g'amit` c`as silamazesac` az'leven]
da ch`ven davic`avit` igi [c`a] qoveli ch`ak`olili satanisgan [romelic` allahis cqalobas aris dashorebuli],
garda mxolod imisa, vinc` moismens (angelozt`a saubars) p`arulad. magram (shemdeg) mis kvaldakval daedevneba c`xadi, moelvare ali[ da klavs an cvavs satanas].

da mica gavp`inet` [gavxadet` igi sac`xovreblad gamosadegad], da davamqaret` masze mtkic`e mt`ebi (romlebic` amagreben mas), da ag'movac`enet` masze qovelgvari ram [mc`enareebi] gansazg'vruli zomit` (da conit`).

da movacqet` t`k`vent`vis masze [micaze] saarsebo sashualebebi, da aseve mat`t`vis [t`k`veni shvilebist`vis, monebist`vis da pirutqvist`vis], romlebsac` t`k`ven ar az'levt` sazrdos (aramed allahi uzrunvelqop`s mat` sazrdot`i).
da ar aris arc` ert`i ram, garda imisa, rom ch`vent`an ar iqos misi saganz'uri, da ch`ven vacvdit` mas [im siket`es] mxolod gansazg'vruli zomit` [ramdensac` ch`ven movisurvebt`]
da carmovgzavnet` k`arebi ganmanaqop`iereblad, da gardmovavlinet` zec`idan cqali da gasvit` is, t`k`ven ki ar xart` misi shemnaxvelni.
da cheshmaritad, namdvilad ch`ven vac`oc`xlebt` da vamkvdinebt`, da ch`ven vart` memkvidreni (dedamicis da imis, rac` maszea)
da ch`ven xom vic`it` t`k`vengan isini, vinc` cinascar cavida [ukve gardac`vlilni], da ch`ven vic`it` isini, vinc` ch`amorch`a [vinc` c`oc`xalia da vinc` ic`oc`xlebs]
da cheshmaritad, sheni up`alia is, vinc` shekrebs mat` [gankit`xvis dg'es]. cheshmaritad, is brz'enia, qovlismc`odnea.
da cheshmaritad, ch`ven shevk`menit` adamiani mshrali [xmovani] t`ixisgan sveli da shec`vlili (p`erisa da sunis mxriv) t`ixidan
da jini shevk`menit` up`ro adre [adamis shek`mnamde] ukvamlo [z'alian c`xeli] c`ec`xlisgan
da (sheaxsene mat`) (o, moc`ik`ulo) (is ambavi), roc`a shenma up`alma ut`xra angelozebs: "cheshmaritad, me shevk`mni adamians mshrali [xmovani da shec`vlili sunis mk`one] t`ixisgan".
xolo rodesac` me mas srulqop`il gamosaxulebas mivc`em da ch`avberav masshi ch`emi sulidan, mashin daemxet` mis cinashe pirk`ve [pativisc`emis nishnad]
da umal pirk`ve [sajdaze] daemxnen angelozebi, qvelani ert`ianad.
garda iblisisa, uari t`k`va, rom qop`iliqo muxlmoqrilebt`an ert`ad.[eurch`a allahs]
ut`xra(allahma): hei iblis! ra dagemart`a, rom ar xar muxlmoqrilebt`an ert`ado?
miugo: sajdes ar ag'vasruleb adamianist`vis, romelic` mshrali, shavi shec`vlili talaxisgan gaach`ine.
(allahma) ut`xra: gadi ik`idan [samot`xidan]! uechvelad, shen xar k`vit` ch`asak`oli [dacqevlili da gagdebuli]
da uechvelad, shenzea cqevla gankit`xvis dg'emde[allahis cqalobas dashorebuli]
ut`xra (iblisma): "up`alo ch`emo! miboz'e gadavadeba im dg'emde, roc`a isini [sheni morch`ilni] ag'dgebian [gankit`xvis dg'es]
(allahma) ut`xra: cheshmaritad, shen xar mat` shoris, visac` gadavadeba mienicha
im dg'emde, romlis dro (dadgoma) c`nobilia [allahist`vis]!
ut`xra (iblisma): <<up`alo ch`emo! imis gamo, rom shen me gzas amac`dine, auc`ileblad shevulamazeb mat` [adamis shvilebs] micier c`odvebs da uechvelad, qvela mat`gans shevac`den cheshmariti gzidan>>.
garda sheni monebisa mat`gan, rch`eult`a [vinc` mxolod shen gag'iarebs g'mert`ad]!>>
(allahma) brz'ana: <<esaa ch`emamde momqvani scori gza
cheshmaritad, shen aranairi z'alaup`leba ar gagach`nia ch`ems monebze, garda imat`i, vinc` shen gamogqva gzaabneult`agan>>.
da cheshmaritad, jojoxet`i qvela mat`ganis ag't`k`muli adgilia.
mas [jojoxet`s] shvidi karibche ak`vs, da t`it`oeuli karibchesat`vis mat`gan [iblisis mimdevart`agan] dadgenilia garkveuli nacili (mat`i sak`mis shesabamisad).
cheshmaritad, g'vt`ismoshishni ik`nebian samot`xis bag'ebshi da cqaroebt`an.[isini am k`veqnad allahis morch`ilni iqvnen]
(mat` et`k`mebat`): <<shedit` masshi [samot`xeshi] mshvidobit` da (srul) usap`rt`xoebashi!>>

da ch`ven amovxadet` qvelap`eri, rac` mat` [samot`xis mac`xovrebelt`a] gulebshi iqo borotebidan [siz'ulvili].
(da isini c`xovroben samot`xeshi) z'mebad,(moch`uk`urt`mebul) sarec`elebze, ert`manet`is pirispir (saubroben).
ik` arc` dag'liloba sheexebat` mat` da arc` [arasdros] ik`nebian ik`idan gandevnilni.
ac`nobe [o, moc`ik`ulo] ch`ems msaxurebs, rom me, cheshmaritad, mimtevebeli, shemcqalebeli var
da rom ch`emi sasjeli -- mtanjveli sasjelia
da aucqe mat` ibrahimis stumrebis [angelozebis] shesaxeb

aha, movidnen isini [angelozebi] mast`an [ibrahimt`an] da t`k`ves: << salami/mshvidoba!>> (da roc`a ixila, rom isini ar chamdnen shet`avazebul sup`ras, ibrahimma gulis sig'rmeshi shishi igrz'no mat` mimart` da) t`k`va: <<cheshmaritad, ch`ven t`k`veni gveshinia!>>

t`k`ves: <<nu geshinia! (vinaidan ch`ven vart` angelozebi,
romlebic` allahma gagvagzavna). cheshmaritad, ch`ven gaxarebt` (axal ambavs) mc`odne chabukze [imit`, rom sheni c`oli sara shegiz'ens z'es -- ishaqs, romelic` mc`odne ik`neba allahisa da misi shariat`is shesaxeb]>>.
t`k`va (ibrahimma): nut`u maxarebt` mashin, roc`a sibere shemexo? mash, rag'as maxarebt`?
t`k`ves (angelozebma): <<ch`ven gaxarebt` cheshmaritebit`, mash, nu ik`nebi sasocarkvet`ilt`agan (imashi, rom shen shegez'ineba shvili)!>>
(ibrahimma) t`k`va: <<da vin (kidev) kargavs imeds t`avisi up`lis cqalobisgan, garda (mxolod) gzaabneult`a?>>
(ibrahimma) ut`xra: <<rashia t`k`veni sak`me [mogzaurobis mizani] o, mogzavnilno?>>
t`k`ves [angelozebma]: <<cheshmaritad, ch`ven cargzavnilni vart` borotmok`med [c`odvil] xalxt`an [lutis xalxt`an, romlebmac` uarqves allahis kanoni],
garda lutis ojaxisa - uechvelad, ch`ven mat` qvelas gadavarch`ent`

garda misi c`olisa, (vis shesaxebac`) ch`ven ganvaceset`, rom igi uechvelad ag'moch`ndeba (ric`xvshi) darch`enilt`a [dag'upult`a] (imitom, rom igi kmaqop`ili iqo im saz'ageli sak`meebit`, rasac` misi xalxi sch`adioda, da mat` amashi exmareboda)>>.
xolo roc`a lutis ojaxt`an mividnen gzavnilebi [angelozebi],
(man) ut`xra: <<uechvelad, t`k`ven uc`nobi xalxi xart`>>
t`k`ves: <<pirik`it`, ch`ven movedit` shent`an imit` [sasjelit`], ris mimart`ac` isini [sheni xalxi] echvobdnen>>.
da mogitanet` shen cheshmariteba da, cheshmaritad, ch`ven mart`alni vart`.

gaudek`i gzas shens ojaxt`an ert`ad g'amis nacilis (gasvlis) shemdeg da (shen) (t`vit`on) iare mat` ukan. da t`k`vengan aravin moixedos ukan. da cadit` (im adgilas), sadac` t`k`vent`vis aris nabrz'anebi (allahis mier) (imisat`vis, rom miag'ciot` usap`rt`xo adgils)>>.
da shevatqobinet` ch`ven mas [moc`ik`ul luts] es sak`me, rom dilit` isini sruliad gacqvetilni ik`nebian.
da movidnen k`alak`is mkvidrni (cinascarmetqvel lutt`an), sixarulit` (rodesac` gaiges, rom mis saxlshi gach`erdnen mogzaurebi).
man t`k`va: <<eseni ch`emi stumrebi arian, da nu shemarc`xvent`>>
da geshinodet` allahisa da nu damamc`irebt`[t`k`veni uvargisi sak`mit`]
t`k`ves: nut`u ch`ven ar agikrz'alet` shen (stumrad migeg'o) adamianebi?
(lutma) ut`xra: <<aha, eseni - ch`emi k`alishvilebi (dak`orcindit` mat`ze), t`u ukve t`k`ven sch`adixart` (amas)>>
(me, allahi) vp`ic`av shens sic`oc`xles (o, muhammad)! cheshmaritad, isini [lutis xalxi] uechvelad, brmad daexetebian t`aviant`i t`robashi[gzaabneulobashi].
da sashinelma xmam sheipqro isini [lutis xalxi] mzis amosvlisas.
da ch`ven misi zeda k`vedad vak`c`iet` da davamxet` mat`ze k`vebi gak`vavebuli t`ixisagan.
cheshmaritad, amashi t`valsach`ino sascaulebia gamchriaxt`at`vis.
da, cheshmaritad, igi [sop`eli sadumi, sadac` c`xovrobda cinascarmetqveli luti] (mdebareobs) scor gzaze (romlit`ac` dadian mgzavrebi hijazidan shamshi)!
cheshmaritad, amashi t`valsach`ino sascaulia morcmunet`at`vis.
da, cheshmaritad, al-aik`at`is mac`xovrebelni [cinascarmetqvel shua'ibis xalxi] iqvnen usamart`loni

da ch`ven samagiero mivuzg'et` mat` [davsajet`] da orive isini [lutis sop`eli da shua'ibis sop`eli] uechvelad (mdebareoben) ashkara gzaze (romlit`ac` dadian mogzaurebi da sheuz'liat` ixilon, rac` mat`gan darch`a).
da ukve al-hijris mac`xovreblebma [samudelebma] uarqves mat`t`an gamogzavnilni [cinascarmetqveli salihi]
da movuvlinet` ch`ven mat` [samudelebs] ch`veni nishnebi, xolo isini [am nishnebisgan] zurgs ak`c`evdnen.
da isini [samudelebi] mt`ebshi gamokvet`dnen saxlebs (da c`xovrobdnen mat`shi) usap`rt`xod.
da mieciat` mat` [urcmuno samudelebs] (momakvdinebeli) xmauri (sasjelisa) gant`iadze.
da ver ixsna isini (allahis sasjelisgan) mat`ma monaxvechma [mat`i k`oneba da c`ixesimagreebi mt`ebshi]

da ch`ven ar shevk`menit` c`ani da mica da is, rac` mat` shorisaa, garda cheshmaritebit` [zust da srulqop`il saxed, t`avisi sibrz'nit`, gansazg'vruli miznist`vis], da cheshmaritad, saat`i uechvelad mova [sasamart`los dg'e], (da mashin isini, vinc` ar ircmunes allahis sitqva da ar ag'iares misi moc`ik`uli, miig'eben srul sasjels). (amitom) apatie (o, moc`ik`ulo) mat` (mravalg'mert`iant`) lamazi patiebit`. [nu isurveb urcmunot`at`vis sasjelis dach`k`arebas ].
cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i igia qovlisgamch`eni, qovlismc`odne.
da aha, ukve ch`ven giboz'et` shen (o, moc`ik`ulo) shvidi (xshirad) ganmeorebadi (aiat`i) [sura <<al-p`at`iha>>] da didebuli qurani.

da nu miapqrob shens t`valebs imaze, rac` ch`ven mivanichet` zogiert` mat`gans [mravalg'mert`ianebs] da nu damcuxrdebi mat`ze [imit`, rom isini urcmunoni arian] da daxare sheni p`rt`a [iqavi t`avmdabali] morcmunet`a cinashe.
da ut`xari: <<cheshmaritad, me c`xadi gamap`rt`xilebeli[shemgonebeli]var [c`xadi sasjelisgan>>
[gap`rt`xilebt` iset` sasjelisgan] rogoric` gardmovavlinet` gamqop`ebze [iudevelebsa da k`ristianebs da sxvebze romlebmac` allahis cignebi zogi ircmunes da zogi uarqves],

romelt`ac` qurani nacilebad gaxades [ircmunes zogiert`i nacili, romelic` sheesabameboda mat` cignebs, xolo danarch`eni nacili uarqves. xan ambobdnen[urcmuno mek`k`elebi] quranze: jadoao,an mkit`xaobaao,an poeziaao ].
shens g'mert`s vp`ic`av, ut`uod movkit`xavt` mat` qvelas.
imis shesaxeb, rasac` isini sch`adiodnen[amk`veqnad urcmonoobasa da c`odvebs]
mash, gamoak`veqne is, rac` gebrz'ana da ganeride mravalg'mert`iant` [nu miak`c`ev quradg'ebas mat` sitqvebs]!
cheshmaritad, ch`ven dagixsenit` shen (o, moc`ik`ulo) damc`invelt`agan (quraishelebisgan).
romlebic` k`mnian (t`avist`vis) (allaht`an ert`ad) sxva g'mert`s, da male isini sheitqoben (t`aviant`i sak`mis shedegs).
da cheshmaritad vic`it`, rom guli gekumsheba imis gamo, rasac` isini amboben.[mat`i mxridan urcmunooba, da sitqvieri sheurac`xqop`a]
mash, ganadide sheni g'mert`i da iqavi pirk`ve [sajdaze] damxobilt`a shoris.[rat`a hpovo sulieri simshvide]
da t`aqvani ec`i shens up`als (mt`eli sic`oc`xlis ganmavlobashi), sanam ar mogiva uechveli [sikvdili]!
movida allahis brz'aneba, nu daach`k`arebt` mas; dideba mas! mag'laa igi imaze, rasac` t`anaziarad udgenen.

gardmoavlens t`avisi brz'anebit` angelozebs sulit` [gamoc`xadebit`], viszec` inebebs t`avis msaxurt`agan, rat`a gaap`rt`xilon[xalxi], rom ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba allahis garda, amitom geshinodet` ch`emi[emorch`ilet` ch`ems brz'anebebs da akrz'alvebs].
gaach`ina c`ani da dedamica cheshmaritebit`. amag'lebulia imaze, rasac` t`anaziarad udgenen.
man (allahma) shek`mna adamiani cvet`isgan (spermisgan) da ai, igi - ashkarad pretenziulia, [jiutad daobs] (amtkic`ebs, rom ag'dgoma sheuz'lebelia)!
da pirutqvic` man (allahma) shek`mna; t`k`vent`vis (o, xalxo) masshi [pirutqvshi] (aris) sit`bo [mis becvshi] da (sxva) sargebelia [rz'eshi da tqavis gamoqenebashi], da mat`it` ikvebebit`.
da t`k`vent`vis mat`shi [pirutqvshi] aris silamaze, rodesac` sag'amoobit` [asvenebt`]mat` da rodesac` [dilit`] ushvebt` [saz'ovarze].
da zidaven t`k`vens tvirt`s iset` k`veqanashi, romelsac` ver miag'cevdit`, udidesi cvalebis gareshe. uechvelad, t`k`veni g'mert`i mart`lac` shemcqnarebeli, mcqalobelia.
da gaach`ina c`xenebi, jorebi da virebi, rat`a amxedrdet` mat`ze da samshvenisad. da k`mnis imas, rac` t`k`ven ar ic`it`

allahzea (valdebuleba) (xalxist`vis ganmartos) scori gza [pirdapiri gza] (rat`a isini cheshmarit gzaze iqvnen). magram (aseve) arsebobs (gzebi), romlebic` gadauxveven mas [pirdapiri gzidan]. da t`u is[allahi ]isurvebda, uechvelad caruz'g'veboda cheshmarit gzaze t`k`ven qvelas [gaxdida morcmuneebad]
igia, romelmac` zec`idan cqali ch`amoavlina; misgan gak`vt` sasmeli [cqali] da (is ag'moac`ens) misgan (mc`enareebsa da) xeebs, sadac` t`k`ven mcqemsavt` (t`k`vens pirutqvs).
misit` ag'mogic`enebt` qanebs, zet`isxils, p`iniks, qurz'ens da qovelgvar naqop`s. cheshmaritad, amashi mart`lac` sascaulia moazrovne xalxist`vis.
da dagimorch`ilat` g'ame da dg'e, mze da mt`vare. da varskvlavebic` damorch`ilebulni arian misi brz'anebit`. cheshmaritad, amashi sascaulebia gonieri xalxist`vis.

da (aseve dagimorch`ilat`) is, rac` t`k`vent`vis shek`mna micaze sxvadasxva p`erebshi [c`xovelebi, naqop`i da sasargeblo ciag'ebi]. ra t`k`ma unda, amashi [p`erebis mravalp`erovnebasa da sargeblis siuxveshi] -- uechvelad aris nishani [c`xadi mtkic`ebuleba] im adamianebist`vis, romlebic` sheigoneben (gap`rt`xilebebs)!

da igia, vinc` dagimorch`ilat` zg'va, rat`a misgan chamot` nedli xorc`i da moipovot` samkauli, romelsac` atarebt`; da shen xedav gemebs, romlebic` kvet`en mas [zg'vis zedapirs], da rat`a t`k`ven miig'ot` misi cqalobisagan[qvela sasargeblo ram rac` ki gemis mp`lobels deuz'lia gaaket`os], rat`a t`k`ven iqot` madlierni [uzenaesis) (misi didi cqalobebisat`vis t`k`venze]!

da man daadgina micaze mtkic`e [mt`ebi], rat`a is ar sheirqes (t`k`vent`an ert`ad), da (man shek`mna masze) mdinareebi da gzebi, rat`a t`k`ven shez'lot` (am gzebit`) mihqvet` scor gzas (im adgilebisken, sait`kenac` midixart`).
da (aseve man shek`mna) nishnebi (romlebic` gzebzea, da romlit`ac` t`k`ven gansazg'vravt` gzas), xolo varskvlavit` [varskvlavebit`] isini pouloben gzas (g'amit`).

gana shemok`medi[am qvelap`risa] imis msgavsia, vinc` ar k`mnis? nut`u ar dap`ik`rdebit`[allahis sidiadeze da mis qovlis shemz'leobaze, da imas rom misi t`anascorebi ar arian c`ru g'mert`ebi romelnic` arap`ers ar k`mnian]?!
da t`u dait`vlit` allahis cqalobas, ver ag'ric`xavt`. cheshmaritad, allahi mimtevebeli, mcqalobelia!
xolo allahma ic`is qvelap`eri, rasac` malavt` da rasac` avlent` [is, rasac` ashkarad aket`ebt`].
xolo mat`, romelt`ac` isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] allahis garda evedrebian, arap`eri sheuk`mniat`, aramed t`vit`on arian shek`mnilni [c`ru g'vt`aebebi ].
[qalbi g'mert`ebi] - isini mkvdarni arian, ar arian c`oc`xlebi da mat` ar ic`ian, rodis ag'dgebian [isini, vinc` t`aqvans sc`emdnen mat`].
g'mert`i t`k`veni - ert`i g'mert`ia. xolo isini, visac` ar scamt` saik`iosi, mat`i gulebi uarmqop`elia da isini ampartavnebi arian.
echvgareshea, rom allahma ic`is, rasac` malaven da rasac` ac`xadeben. cheshmaritad, mas [allahs] ar uqvars ampartavnebi.
da rodesac` ekit`xebian mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] [quranis shesaxeb]: <<ra gardmoavlina t`k`venma up`alma?>> - isini pasuxoben: <<[gamogonili] legendebi z'veli xalxebis!>>

(da t`k`ves es sic`rue), rat`a itvirt`on t`aviant`i tvirt`ebi [c`odvebi] srulad ag'dgomis dg'es da tvirt`ebi [c`odvebi] mat`i, vinc` mat` shec`domashi sheiqvanes [t`aviant`i mimdevrebi] qovelgvari (c`odnis) gareshe. ra amazrzenia is, rasac` isini itvirt`aven!

ukve xrikebs acqobdnen (t`aviant`i cinascarmetqvelebis cinaag'mdeg) isini (urcmunoni), romlebic` mat`amde iqvnen [am mravalg'mert`ianebamde], da allahma moglija mat`i shenoba sap`uz'vlidan. da daec`a mat` zemodan saxuravi, da moag'cia mat` sasjelma ik`idan, saidanac` isini arc` ki grz'nobdnen [verc` ki moelodnen].

shemdeg, ag'dgomis dg'es, mat` shearc`xvens da etqvis: <<sad arian ch`emi t`anaziarni, romelt`a gamoc` urch`obas ich`endit`?>> itqvian c`odnis mk`oneni: <<cheshmaritad, sirc`xvili da boroteba am dg'es urcmunot`a t`avsaa>>.

isini, romelt`ac` miibareben angelozebi, [im mdgomareobashi] roc`a t`aviant`i sulebis mimart` usamart`loni arian [t`aviant`i urcmunoebit`], [sikvdilis danaxvisas] morch`ilebas gamoxataven [da itqvian]: <<ch`ven aranair borotebas ar ch`avdiodit`>>. [mat` etqvian]: <<pirik`it`! cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismc`odnea imisa, rasac` t`k`ven sch`adiodit`>>.
<<shedit` jojoxet`is karibcheebshi, sadac` maradzhams darch`ebit`! ra sazarelia ampartavant`a samqop`eli!>>

da sheekit`xebian g'vt`ismoshisht`: <<ra gardmoavlina t`k`venma g'mert`ma?>> miugeben: <<siket`e>>. ket`ilismk`mnelt`at`vis amk`veqnad siket`ea, xolo imk`veqniuri samqop`eli uket`esia. da raoden mshvenieria samqop`eli g'vt`ismoshisht`a.
edemis samot`xeebi, romelshic` shevlen, romelt`a k`veshac` miedinebian mdinareni; ik` ek`nebat`, rasac` inebeben. ase miagebs sazg'aurs allahi g'vt`ismoshisht`.
im ket`ilebs [urcmunoebisgan sup`t`a], romelt`ac` angelozebi miibareben, etqvian: <<mshvidoba t`k`ven! shedit` samot`xeshi imis gamo, rasac` aket`ebdit`>>.

nut`u mxolod imas elodebian [es kerpt`aqvanismc`emlebi], rom angelozebi mividnen mat`t`an[rat`a sulebi axadon mat` c`emit`], an sheni g'mert`is brz'aneba movides[mravalg'mert`iant`a gasanadgureblad]? aseve moik`c`nen isini, vinc` mat`ze ucin iqvnen[mek`el urcmonoebze cin]. da allahi usamart`lod ar mok`c`evia mat`[roc`a mat` ubedureb daatexa t`avs mat`i ganadgurebit`], aramed t`aviant` t`avs ek`c`eodnen usamart`lod.
da mat` t`avs daatqdat` t`aviant`i namok`medaris siave da imit`ve ik`mnen shepqrobilni [sasjelit` romlisac` ar scamdat`], rasac` abuch`ad igdebdnen.

da t`k`ves mravalg'mert`ianebma: "t`u allahs moesurveboda, arc` ch`ven da arc` ch`veni mamebi mis garda arap`ers ar vc`emdit` t`aqvans, da misi nebart`vis gareshe arap`ers ar avkrz'alavdit`". scored ase ik`c`eodnen isini, vinc` mat`amde[mek`el urcmonoebis cin ] iqvnen. nut`u moc`ik`ulebs ekisrebat` rame sxva, garda nat`eli ucqebis gadmoc`emisa?

da ch`ven ukvea mivavlinet` qoveli t`emisat`vis (vinc` iqo adre) (t`avisi) moc`ik`uli (mivec`it` mas brz'aneba, rom et`k`va mat`t`vis): <<t`aqvani sc`et` (mxolod ert`) allahs da eridet` c`ru g'vt`aebebs [tag'ut`s] [nu sc`emt` t`aqvans kerpebs, mkvdrebs da aravis da arap`ers, garda allahisa]>>. da mat` shoris iqvnen isini, visac` allahma caruz'g'va (cheshmarit gzaze), da mat` shoris iqvnen isini, visac` daecera gza shec`domisa [vinc` ach`venes k`edmag'loba da zurgi ubrunes cheshmaritebas]. mash, imogzauret` micaze da shexedet` [miig'et` shegoneba], rogori iqo dasasruli [ra sasjeli moucia] sic`ruis momgoneblebs!
shen romc` ec`ado mat` scor gzaze daqenebas [o, moc`ik`ulo], cheshmaritad, allahi ar daadgens scor gzaze imas, visac` is aubnevs gzas, da mat` ar eqolebat` shemceebi.

da daip`ic`es allahs mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebma] qvelaze z'lieri p`ic`it`, rom allahi ar ag'adgens imas, vinc` mokvda. pirik`it`, (is ag'adgens mkvdrebs) t`avisi cheshmariti ag't`k`mis mixedvit`, magram adamiant`a umetesobam ar ic`is.
rat`a c`xadad ganumartos mat` is, rashic` ver t`anxmdebodnen da rat`a ic`odnen mat`, vinc` ar ircmunes, rom isini matquarebi iqvnen.
ch`veni sitqva (imist`vis, rom shevk`mnat`) raime, roc`a ch`ven vinebebt` (rom) is (sheik`mnas), aris mxolod is, rom vambobt` mas (ert`jer): <<iqav>> - da is (mashinve) ik`mneba [moxdeba].
xolo isini, vinc` gadasaxldnen allahis gzaze, mas shemdeg, rac` ch`agrul ik`nen, uechvelad, ch`ven mat` vuboz'ebt` ket`il samqop`els amk`veqnad; xolo imk`veqniuri sazg'auri up`ro didia, rom ic`odnen
[allahist`vis gadasaxlebulni isini arian] romlebmac` moit`mines da romlebic` sakut`ar up`als eqrdnobian [sruliad masze imedovneben].

da shenamde (o, moc`ik`ulo) ch`ven mivavlinet` (cinat` arsebul t`emebs) mxolod mamakac`ebi (da ara k`alebi an angelozebi), romlebsac` vaz'levdit` gamoc`xadebas. hkit`xet` (o, mravalg'mert`ianebo) shegonebis adamianebs [mat`, visac` ak`vs c`odna t`oradan da injilidan], t`u t`k`ven t`vit`on ar ic`it` (amis shesaxeb).

[carmovagzavnet` cina moc`ik`ulebi] c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebit`a da cerilebit`. da gardmogivlinet` shen shexseneba [qurani], rat`a ganumarto xalxs is, rac` gardmoevlinat` mat`[rat`a qurani ganumarto xalxs quranit`ve], da egebis isini dap`ik`rdnen.

nut`u darcmunebulni arian isini, romlebic` acqobdnen borot intrigebs (moc`ik`ulis cinaag'mdeg), rom allahi ar aiz'ulebs micas sht`ant`k`as isini, an ar moacevs mat` sasjeli ik`idan, saidanac` isini arc` grz'noben [ver elian]?
an sheipqros isini mat`i mimosvlisas, da isini verasgzit` ver daag'ceven t`avs.
an sheipqrobs mat` shishis zhams, ramet`u, cheshmaritad, t`k`veni up`ali lmobieria, mcqalobelia[da ar ch`k`arobs sajelit`, egebis moinanion, da gaxdnen morcmuneni].

nut`u ar unaxavt` mat` [ug'mert`oebs], rom imas, rasac` allahi k`mnis [mt`ebs, xeebs...], mat`i ch`rdili gadaixreba (ert`i drois ganmavlobashi) marjvniv da (sxva drois ganmavlobashi) marc`xniv, damxobilni [sajdaze] da morch`ilni allahis cinashe?
allahis cinashe k`eds ixris c`ashi arsebuli qovelive da micaze qoveli moz'ravi arseba [c`xoveli], da angeloznic`; da isini ar ampartavnoben.
eshiniat` [angelozebs[ t`aviant`i up`lis, romelic` mat` zemot`aa, da aket`eben imas, rac` mat` ebrz'anat`^
da t`k`va allahma: <<ar gaich`inot` ori g'vt`aeba; cheshmaritad, igia ert`adert`i g'vt`aeba, da amitom mxolod ch`emi geshinodet`!>>

da mas [allahs] ekut`vnis is, rac` c`ashia da micaze [is aris qvelap`ris shemok`medi, mp`lobeli da g'mert`i], da misia (mas unda ez'g'vnebodes) t`aqvanisc`ema ganucqvetlad. nut`u vinmesgan, allahis garda, shegeshindebat`?

da rogori cqalobac` ar unda gk`ondet` (ik`neba es rcmena, janmrt`eloba, siuxve, shvilebi,...), (es) - (mxolod) allahisganaa. shemdeg, rodesac` ubedureba [seni, shimshili,...] shegexebat`, mashin (mxolod) mas mimart`avt` mudarit` (tirilit`).
shemdeg ki, roc`a ubedurebas mogashirebt`, mashin t`k`vengan nacili [xelaxla] t`aviant` up`als t`anaziars uch`enen.
imist`vis, rom uarqon (ag'iareba) imisa, rac` ch`ven mivec`it` mat`. (jer-jerobit`) isargeblet` (am cut`isop`lit`), mere ki sheitqobt` (t`k`veni urcmunoebis shedegs)!
da imas, rac` ar ic`ian, cils unacileben imisgan, rit`ic` ch`ven vasazrdoet`. allahs vp`ic`av, auc`ileblad mogekit`xebat` [gankit`xvis dg'es] imis gamo, rasac` t`xzavdit` [allahis cinaag'mdeg].

da isini [urcmunoni] allahs miaceren k`alishvilebs [amboben, rom angelozebi t`it`k`os allahis k`alishvilebi arian]. uzenaesia is [allahi aris amag'lebuli imat`ze, rasac` isini mis shesaxeb amboben]! xolo mat`t`vis imas, rasac` isini (sakut`ar t`avze) isurveben [mat`t`vis asulebi sirc`xvilia, da sakut`ar t`avs z'eebs miaceren].
da roc`a romelime mat`gans asuls axareben, saxe ushavdeba da is mcuxarebit` ivseba[rac` allahs akadres, t`avist`vis sasirc`xvilod miich`nies]

imaleba xalxisgan im sevdis gamo, rit`ac` gaaxares [axali ambit`, rom mas k`alishvili sheez'ina]: sheinarch`unos es [is, rit`ac` gaaxares] damc`irebit` [sherc`xvenilad igrz'nos t`avi t`avis t`anamoz'meebs shoris] t`u damalos [damarxos] igi (c`oc`xali) micashi? o, ra amazrzenad msjeloben isini (allahs k`alishvilebs miaceren, xolo sakut`ar t`avs z'eebs)!

visac` ar scams saik`io c`xovrebis, (mat`t`vis aris) c`udi ag'cera, xolo allahs ekut`vnis umag'lesi ag'cera c`ashi da micaze [is aris amag'lebuli qvelap`erze t`avisi arsebit`, t`avisi saxelebit`a da ag'cerilobebit`]. da is aris didebuli da brz'eni!

t`u allahi sheipqrobda adamianebs [urcmunoebsa da urch`ebs] mat`i borotebis gamo [urcmunoebisa da allahze c`ru ambebis shet`xzvis gamo], mashin ar datovebda masze [micaze] arc` ert` c`xovels [urcmunos]. magram is az'levs mat` gadavadebas garkveul vadamde. xolo roc`a mova mat`i vada (romelic` allahma ganusazg'vra), isini ver daigvianeben (am vadaze) arc` ert`i saat`it` [ar miec`emat` gadavadeba] da ver daach`k`areben (vadas ert`i saat`it`ac` ki) [is ar dadgeba up`ro adre, vidre dadgenilia].

da isini allahs miaceren imas, rasac` t`vit`on sz'ult` [k`alishvilebs], da mat`i enebi ag'ceren [amboben] sic`rues, rom mat`t`vis (mzad aris) sauket`eso [mshvenieri dasasruli]. uechvelad, mat`t`visaa (mzad aris) c`ec`xli. da isini ik` mitovebulni [davicqebulni] ik`nebian!

vp`ic`av allahs, namdvilad ch`ven gavgzavnet` (cinascarmetqvelebi da moc`ik`ulebi) t`emebt`an, romlebic` shenamde iqvnen (o, muhammad), da satanam sheulamaza mat` mat`i sak`meebi [urcmunoeba, mravalg'mert`ianoba da moc`ik`ulebt`an mtroba]. da is [satana] aris mat`i mp`arveli dg'es [amk`veqnad], xolo mat`t`visaa (saukuno c`xovrebashi) mtanjveli sasjeli!
da ar gardmogvivlenia shenze cigni, t`u ara imist`vis, rom ganumarto mat` is, razec` idaves, da xelmz'g'vanelobad da cqalobad morcmune xalxist`vis.

da allahma gardamoavlina c`idan cqali, da gaac`oc`xla masit` [cqlit`] mica mas shemdeg, rac` igi mkvdari iqo. cheshmaritad, amashi uechvelad sascaulia im adamianebist`vis, romlebic` ismenen (da shemdeg p`ik`roben, emorch`ilebian allahs da up`rt`xildebian mis sasjels)!

da, cheshmaritad, t`k`vent`vis t`k`vens pirutqvebshi ert`mnishvnelovnad aris shegoneba. ch`ven gasmevt` imidan, rac` mat` muc`lebshi carmoik`mneba, shigt`avssa da sisxls shoris, - rz'es sup`t`as, sasiamovnos msmelt`at`vis.
da p`inikisa da vazis naqop`isgan ig'ebt` [aket`ebt`] mat`robela sasmels da ket`il sazrdos. cheshmaritad, amashi mart`lac` sascaulia gonieri xalxist`vis.
da sht`aagona shenma up`alma p`utkars: <<daide sac`xovrebeli mt`ebshi, xeebsa da imashi, rasac` isini [adamianebi] asheneben>>.

shemdeg ikvebe qvelanairi naqop`it` da iare sheni up`lis gzebze morch`ilad[ise rom gzebi shent`vis advili savali ik`neba]. mat`i [p`utkrebis] muc`lebidan gamodis sxvadasxva p`eris sasmeli, romelshic` gankurnebaa xalxist`vis. cheshmaritad, amashi sascaulia moazrovne xalxist`vis.

allahma gagach`inat` t`k`ven, shemdeg ki mogakvdinebt`. da t`k`vens shoris arian iset`nic`, visac` daabruneben uz'lur c`xovrebashi [g'rma sibereshi], rat`a ag'ar ic`odes [mas shemdeg rac` hk`onda (axalgazrdobisas) garkveuli c`odna] arap`eri. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismc`odne, qovlisshemz'lea

da allahma mianicha upiratesoba zogiert` t`k`vengans sxvebze (sasic`oc`xlo) sazrdoshi [zogi gaamdidra, xolo sxvebi gaag'ariba; zogi mp`lobeli gaxada, xolo sxvebi monebad ak`c`ia]. da scored isini, visac` upiratesoba mienichat`, ar abruneben sakut`ar sazrdos [ar az'leven imas, rac` allahma uboz'a mat`] mat`, vinc` daipqro mat`ma marjvenaa [sakut`ar monebs], rom isini (shemdeg) amashi gat`anabrebuliqvnen [simdidreshi]. nut`u isini uarqop`en allahis [mat`t`vis naboz'eb] cqalobas?[anu rogorc` batons ar uqvars, rom mona cilshi hqavdes, allahsac` ar hqavs mocile]

da allahma shek`mna t`k`vent`vis meug'leebi t`k`venganve da giboz'at` t`k`veni meug'leebisgan shvilebi da shvilishvilni da dagapurat` siket`enit`. nut`u sic`rues [urcmunoebas] ircmuneben, xolo allahis cqalobas [namdvil rcmenas] uarqop`en?!

da isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] t`aqvans sc`emen allahis garda imas [kerpebsa da sxva c`ru g'vt`aebebs], rac` arap`rit` ar p`lobs mat`t`vis (sasic`oc`xlo) sazrdos (imisat`vis, rom misc`en mat`) zec`idan [ar sheuz'liat` cvimis movlena] da micidan [ar sheuz'liat` nat`esi gazardon], da ar z'aluz't` mat` (arap`ris gaket`eba) (t`undac` rom moisurvon).

(he, adamianebo,) nu utolebt` allahs [nu aqenebt` mas romelime mis k`mnilebast`an t`anascorad] (msaxurebit`a da t`aqvanisc`emit` mast`an ert`ad). cheshmaritad, allahma ic`is (rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`), xolo t`k`ven ar ic`it` (ra c`odvas sch`adixart` amit` da ra sasjeli gekut`vnit` amis gamo)!

allahs igavad mohqavs mona, romelic` sxvis sakut`rebashia da arap`ris z'ala ar shescevs[up`leba shezg'uduli], da is, visac` ch`ven vuboz'et` ket`ili sarch`o, saidanac` igi xarjavs p`arulad da c`xadad. gana t`anascorni arian? k`eba-dideba allahs! magram mat`gan umetesobam ar ic`is.

da allahs mohqavs igavi or kac`ze: ert`i mat`gani munjia, romelsac` arap`eri z'aluz's da tvirt`ad acevs t`avis patrons; sadac` ar unda gagzavnos, siket`es ar moitans. gana t`anascoria igi imast`an, vinc` samart`lianobas brz'anebs da t`avadac` scor gzaze dgas?

allahs ekut`vnis dap`aruli [c`odna] zec`ashi da micaze. xolo shekit`xva saat`is shesaxeb [rodis dadgeba samsjavros dg'e] - (is moxdeba iset`ive siscrap`it`,) rogorc` t`valis daxamxameba, an kidev up`ro axlos [up`ro scrap`ad]. cheshmaritad, allahi qoveli sak`mis z'almosilia
allahma gamogiqvanat` t`k`ven dedat`a muc`lebidan mashin, roc`a arap`eri gagegebodat`, man ki mogc`at` smena, mxedveloba da gulni, rat`a egebis madlierni iqot`.

nut`u isini [urcmunoni] ver xedaven p`rinvelebs, (romlebic`) damorch`ilebulni arian (allahis mier ) (imisat`vis, rom ip`rinon) c`iur haershi? aravin ikavebs mat` (haershi), garda allahisa. cheshmaritad, amashi udaod, sascaulebia morcmune xalxist`vis!

da allahma shegik`mnat` t`k`vent`vis t`k`vens saxlebshi samqop`eli [adgili, sadac` isvenebt` t`k`vens ojaxt`an ert`ad]. da (agret`ve) man shegik`mnat` t`k`vent`vis pirutqvis tqavebidan saxlebi [karvebi da banakis sac`xovreblebi], romlebic` iolia t`k`vent`vis (rat`a gadaitanot` isini) t`k`veni gasvlis dg'es (gzashi) da t`k`veni gach`erebis dg'es. (da mogimzadat` man t`k`vent`vis) mat`i matqlidan, mat`i balnidan da mat`i becvidan (sasargeblo) nivt`ebi [tansac`meli, sacoli, samkauli...] da sargebloba (amit`) gansazg'vruli drois ganmavlobashi [manam, sanam isini ar gac`vdeba].

da allahma gagich`inat` ch`rdilebi imisgan, rac` shek`mna [xeebidan,mt`ebidan..], da gagich`inat` mt`ebshi t`avshesap`rebi, da gagich`inat` samoseli, romelic` gic`avt` sic`xisgan da mogimzadat` t`k`vent`vis samoseli [samxedro javshnebi], romelic` gic`avt` t`k`venive [adamianuri] risxvisgan. amgvarad srulqop`s igi t`avis cqalobas t`k`venadmi, egebis t`k`ven daemorch`ilot`.
xolo t`u piri ibrunes, cheshmaritad, sheni movaleoba [o, moc`ik`ulo] mxolod c`xadi gzavnilis mitanaa [mat`amde].
isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] c`noben (uamrav) cqalobas allahisas, xolo shemdeg uarqop`en mas, da mat`i umravlesoba urcmunoni arian [kvdebian urcmunoebad].

da im dg'es [sasjelis dg'es] ch`ven gamovgzavnit` [gamoviqvant`] qoveli t`emidan mocmed [mat` shuamavals], (romelic` daamocmebs mat` morcmunet`a rcmenas da urcmunot`a urcmunoebas). shemdeg ki ar miec`ema nebart`va imat`, vinc` gaxda urcmuno, (rat`a t`avis imart`los) da ar moit`xoven mat`gan gamart`lebas [rat`a rame gaaket`on mat`i up`lis kmaqop`ilebisat`vis].
da roc`a ixilaven isini, romlebmac` ch`aidines usamart`loba [urcmunoeba], allahis sasjels (maradiul c`xovrebashi), is ar sheemsubuk`ebat` mat`t`vis da ar miec`emat` mat` gadavadeba (sasjelis).

da roc`a ixilaven isini, romlebmac` ch`aidines mravalg'mert`ianoba, t`aviant` t`anamonacileebs [c`ru g'vt`aebebs], itqvian: <<mogvxede, up`alo! ai - ch`veni t`anamonacileebi [g'mert`ebi], romelt`ac` vuxmobdit` [vet`aqvanebodit`] shens garda>>. magram isini [g'mert`ebad mich`neulni] moisroleben mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] sitqvas (da etqvian): <<cheshmaritad, t`k`ven - uechvelad, matquarebi xart`!>> (vinaidan ch`ven ar gibrz'anebdit`, rom t`aqvani gec`at` ch`vent`vis allaht`an ert`ad da arc` vamtkic`ebdit`, rom ch`ven vimsaxurebdit` t`aqvanisc`emas)
im dg'es isini allahs morch`ilebas gamouc`xadeben da gauk`rebat` qovelive, rasac` t`xzavdnen.
vinc` ar ircmunes da (sxvebsac`) abrkolebdnen allahis gzaze, sasjels sasjelze davumatebt`, radganac` uket`urebas sch`adiodnen.

da im dg'es [sasjelis dg'es], rodesac` ch`ven gamovgzavnit` qoveli t`emisat`vis mocmed (romelic` daamocmebs mat` sasargeblod, t`u mat` ircmunes, da) mat` cinaag'mdeg (t`u isini gaxdnen urcmunoni) romelic` ik`neba mat`ganve [es ik`neba mat`t`an gamogzavnili cinascarmetqveli], da mogiqvant` shen (o, muhammed) mocmed mat`ze [sheni t`emis]. da ch`ven gardmogivlinet` cigni [qurani], rat`a ganumarto qvelap`eri da iqos mart`ali gzamkvlevi, cqaloba da sasixarulo ucqeba morch`ilt`at`vis (imis shesaxeb, rom mat` moelit` ket`ili dasasruli).

cheshmaritad, allahi mogicodebt` samart`lianobas, siket`esa da k`velmok`medebas axlobelt`a mimart`, da gikrz'alavt` mrushobas, gasakic`x k`medebasa da shurs, is shegagonebt` t`k`ven, rat`a gaxsovdet` (allahis brz'anebebi) (da sheasrulot` isini)!

da mtkic`ed sheasrulet` ag't`k`ma allaht`an, roc`a t`k`ven (hei, adamianebo) igi dadet`, da nu daarg'vevt` p`ic`ebs mas shemdeg, rac` mat` daadasturebt`, vinaidan t`k`ven allahi gaixadet` t`k`vens zedamxedvelad. cheshmaritad, allahma ic`is, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`!

da (t`k`veni ag't`k`mebis darg'vevit`) nu ik`nebit` im (gonebashezg'udul) k`alivit`, romelmac` dashala [gaxsna] t`avisi z'ap`i mas shemdeg, rac` is mtkic`e k`sovilad iqo shekruli, ak`c`evdit` ra t`k`vens p`ic`ebs motquebad ert`manet`shoris, (rodesac`) ert`i jgup`i up`ro mravalric`xovania vidre meore [rodesac` eqrdnobian t`aviant` simravles]. allahi mxolod gamogc`dit` amit` [brz'anebit`, rom daic`vat` ag't`k`mebi], da auc`ileblad gangimartavt` t`k`ven ag'dgomis dg'es imas, razec` t`k`ven sxvadasxvagvarad p`ik`robdit` (dedamicaze c`xovrebashi).

da rom allahs esurva, cheshmaritad, ert` t`emad gagxdidat` [ert`ian rcmenaze da ert`sa da imave kanonze]. t`umc`a, igi ac`ilebs gzidan, visac` isurvebs [vinc` urcmunoebas airch`evs] da caruz'g'veba scor gzaze, visac` isurvebs [vinc` rcmenas airch`evs]. da t`k`ven (qvelani), uechvelad, (sasjelis dg'es) gamoekit`xebit` imaze, rasac` sch`adiodit`.

da nu gamoiqenebt` t`k`vens p`ic`ebs ert`manet`is mosatqueblad, t`orem dagic`debat` p`exi gamqarebis shemdeg da igemebt` borotebas imis gamo, rom (xalxs) ac`dendit` allahis gzidan; da t`k`vent`visaa sasjeli udidesi.

da nu iqidit` allaht`an dadebul ag't`k`mit` umnishvnelo p`ass [nu gac`vlit` at`k`mas, p`ic`s, xelshekrulebas droebit` micier sargebelze]! cheshmaritad, is, rac` allaht`anaa, uket`esia t`k`vent`vis, t`k`ven rom ic`odet`!
rac` t`k`vent`anaa, carmavalia, xolo rac` allaht`anaa, maradiulia. da ch`ven, uechvelad, mivagebt` mat`, vinc` it`menda, mat` sazg'aurs sauket`esod imaze, rasac` aket`ebdnen.
vinc` kargi sak`me aket`a, kac`ma t`u k`alma, da t`an morcmunec` iqo, usat`uod vac`xovrebt` mat` ket`ili c`xovrebit`, da mivagebt` jildos imaze uket`ess, rasac` aket`ebdnen.
da roc`a caikit`xav qurans sheep`are allahs k`vit` ch`ak`olili satanisgan [misi borotebisgan].
cheshmaritad, mas [satanas] ar ak`vs z'alaup`leba mat`ze, romelt`ac` ircmunes da t`aviant` g'mert`s miendobian.
cheshmaritad, misi [satanis] z'alaup`leba mxolod imat`zea, vinc` airch`ia igi mp`arvelad da vinc` mis gamo arian mravalg'mert`ianni.

da rodesac` ch`ven vc`vlit` (quranshi) ert` aiat`s meorit` (rodesac` gauk`mdeba ert`i aiat`is kit`xva an debuleba), - xolo cheshmaritad allahma uket` ic`is, ras avlens [man ic`is, ra aris uket`esi misi monebist`vis], - isini [urcmunoni] amboben: <<shen (o, muhammad) mxolod momgonebeli xar (romelic` igonebs imas, rac` allahs ar ut`k`vams)!>> (magram) mat`ma umravlesobam ar ic`is[allahma ki ic`is am c`vlilebis mizezi da sibrz'ne]!
ut`xari: ch`amoavlina igi cminda sulma sheni up`lisgan cheshmaritebit`, morcmunet`a gansamtkic`eblad, xelmz'g'vanelobad da samaxaroblod muslimt`at`vis.

da ch`ven ukve vic`it`, rom isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] amboben: <<mart`lac`, mas [moc`ik`uls] ascavlis (qurans) (mxolod) (ch`veulebrivi) adamiani>>. t`umc`a, ena imisa (adamianisa), viszec` isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] miut`it`eben, uc`xoa [arabuli ar aris], xolo es [quranis ena] - c`xadi arabuli enaa.
cheshmaritad, mat`, visac` ar scamt` allahis aiat`ebi, allahi ar ucinamz'g'vrebs da mat`t`visaa mcare sasjeli.
sic`rues mxolod isini t`xzaven, romelt`ac` ar scamt` allahis aiat`ebi, da scored isini arian c`rumetqvelni.[da ara muhamedi allahis moc`ik`uli]

vinc` uarqop`s allahs, mas shemdeg, rac` ircmuna, - garda imisa, vinc` iz'ulebuli iqo, guli ki rcmenit` hk`onda damshvidebuli, - xolo vinc` urcmunoebas gauxsnis guls, mat`zea allahis risxva da mat`t`visaa didi sasjeli.
es imitom, rom mat` amk`veqniuri c`xovreba amjobines imk`veqniurs da rom allahi ar daadgens scor gzaze urcmuno xalxs.
ai, isini, romelt`a gulebi, smena da mxedveloba dabechda allahma; da scored isini arian ugulisquroni.
echvgareshea, rom saik`ioshi scored isini ik`nebian cagebulni.

shemdeg, cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i mat`t`vis, vinc` gadasaxldenen mas shemdeg, rac` gamoic`adnen [gadaitanes cameba] (mravalg'mert`iant`a mxridan), shemdeg ibrz'oles da moit`mines, - cheshmaritad, sheni up`ali amis shemdgom usazg'vrod mpatiebeli, mcqalobelia.
im dg'es, roc`a qoveli suli mova da sakut`ar t`avs gamoesarch`leba, da srulad miezg'veba qovel suls, rac` uk`mnia, da mat` ar sheexebat` usamart`loba.

da allahs mohqavs magalit`ad sop`eli (anu mek`k`a), romelic` iqo usap`rt`xo, mshvidi; modioda mast`an misi sazrdo usap`rt`xod [uxvad da iolad] qvela mxridan, magram isini [am sop`lis mc`xovrebni] ar c`nobdnen allahis cqalobebs (romlit`ac` is anichebda mat`) (ut`anaziarebdnen allahs t`anamonacileebs da ar gamoxatavdnen madlierebas ), da mashin allahma daagemovnebina mas [mek`k`as mc`xovrebt`] shimshilis samosi da shishi (imis gamo, rom mat` k`aravnebze, romlebic` midiodnen shamshi, allahis moc`ik`ulis razmebi daesxmebodnen t`avs) imis gamo, rasac` isini [mek`k`elebi] sch`adiodnen [mat`i urcmunoebisa da mtrobis gamo].

uechvelad, mat` miuvidat` shuamavali mat`ganve, magram mat` c`rud sherac`xes igi, da moic`va isini sasjelma [shimshilma, shishma, mat`i cinamz'g'olebis dag'upvam badrshi...], da iqvnen isini usamart`loni (t`aviant`ive t`avebis mimart`).
mash, miirt`vit` ik`idan, rac` halal da sup`t`a sazrdod gicqalobat` allahma da madlierni iqavit` allahis cqalobisa, t`uki mxolod mas et`aqvanebit`.

man t`k`vent`vis akrz'ala mxolod leshi [is c`xoveli, romelic` mokvda da araa dakluli], da (c`xovelidan gamog'vrili) sisxli, da g'oris xorc`i, da im c`xovelis xorc`i, (romelic`) daklulia allahis garda sxvist`vis. xolo vinc` iz'ulebuli gaxdeba (shimshilis dros, rat`a ar mokvdes), survilisa da zedmetobis gareshe [ar ganic`dis siamovnebas da ar naqrdeba], - mashin (cheshmaritad) allahi mpatiobeli da mocqalea!

da nu itqvit` imaze, rasac` t`k`veni enebi ag'cers, sic`rues: <<es [rac` allahma akrz'ala] - nebadart`ulia, xolo es [rac` allahma nebadart`uli gaxada] - akrz'alulia>>, rat`a (amit`) allahze sic`rue moigonot`. cheshmaritad, isini, vinc` allahze igonebs sic`rues, ver miag'ceven carmatebas (arc` amk`veqnad da arc` maradiul c`xovrebashi)!
(es aris mxolod) mc`ire sargebloba (amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi), xolo mat`t`vis (maradiul c`xovrebashi) (momzadebulia) mtanjveli sasjeli.

da mat`, vinc` gaxda iudeveli, ch`ven avukrz'alet` is, rac` ukve giambet` shen (o, moc`ik`ulo) adre[ ix. suurat` al-an'aam:146]. da ar movk`c`eulvart` ch`ven usamart`lod mat` mimart`, aramed isini t`vit`on moik`c`nen usamart`lod t`aviant`ive t`avebis mimart` (urcmunoebit`a da borotebit`, rit`ac` daimsaxures es akrz'alva).

shemdeg, cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i imat`t`vis, romelt`ac` umec`rebit` ch`aidines uket`ureba, mere ki moinanies amis shemdgom da gamoascores, - cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i amis shemdgom usazg'vrod mpatiebeli, mcqalobelia.
cheshmaritad, ibrahimi iqo cinamz'g'oli, g'vt`ismoshishi [sruliad damorch`ilebuli da morch`ili] allahis cinashe, hanip`i [ert`ig'mert`is morcmune], da ar qop`ila igi mravalg'mert`iant`agan.
madlieri misi cqalobebist`vis; man airch`ia igi (rat`a qop`iliqo ert`-ert`i moc`ik`ult`agani) da daagina igi scor gzaze.
da vuboz'et` mas amk`veqnad siket`e, da cheshmaritad, igi saik`ios mart`alt`agan ik`neba.
shemdgom zesht`agagonet` shen[moc`ik`uli muhammad sallallaahu aleihi vasallam]: rom gahqolodi hanip`i ibrahimis religias, da igi ar qop`ila carmart`t`agani.

shabat`i ganisazg'vra mxolod mat`t`vis [iudevelt`at`vis], romlebmac` ut`anxmoeba gamoavlines mast`an dakavshirebit` (da airch`ies es dg'e paraskevis nac`vlad). da, cheshmaritad, sheni up`ali ganikit`xavs mat` ag'dgomis dg'es imast`an dakavshirebit`, rashic` [rcmenis sakit`xebshi] isini ganasxvavdnen.

moucode sheni g'mert`is gzisken sibrz'nit`a da ket`ili shegonebit`, da ekamat`e mat` imit`, rac` uket`esia [rbilad da ket`ilgancqobit`]. cheshmaritad, shenma g'mert`ma uket` ic`is, t`u vin ac`da mis gzas, da man uket` ucqis cheshmarit gzaze mqop`ni.
da t`u samagieros miagebt`, miaget` imis msgavsad, rit`ac` daisajet`. xolo t`u moit`ment`, es ut`uod uket`esia momt`ment`at`vis.
moit`mine da sheni mot`mineba mxolod allahisganaa. nu damcuxrdebi mat` gamo da nurc` shevicrovdebi imisgan, rasac` isini mzakvroben.
cheshmaritad, allahi imat`t`anaa, visac` g'mert`isa eshinodat`, da vinc` arian siket`ismk`nelni.

didebulia is, vinc` g'amit` gadaiqvana t`avisi mona[shuamavali muhammadi (sulit` d sxeulit`) mesjid al-haramidan(romelic` mdebareobs mek`k`ashi) masjid al-aqsashi romelic` mdebareobs ierusalimshi), romlis garshemoc` davloc`et`, rat`a gvech`venebina mist`vis zogi ch`veni sascauli, cheshmaritad, igi qovlismsmenia, qovlismxedvelia.
da (aseve) mivec`it` [shuamaval] musas cigni[t`ora] da davudginet` igi cheshmarit gzad israelis shvilebs( romelshic` nat`k`vamia): ar daidginot` mp`arvelad ch`ems garda aravin.
hei sht`amomavalno mat`i, romelic` gadaviqvanet`[gadavarch`inet`](kidobanshi) nuht`an ert`ad. cheshmaritad, is madlieri msaxuri iqo.
da davadginet`[vac`nobet`] israelis[shuamavali iaqubi] shvilebs [t`orashi]: orjer ch`aident` areulobas k`veqanaze[palestinashi] da k`edmag'lobit` gamedidurdebit`.

roc`a movida ag't`k`ma oridan pirveli, ch`ven carmovgzavnet` t`k`venze ch`veni msaxurni[z'alis mk`oneni], amgvarad mat` shemoichrnen saxlebamde(gez'ebdnen da gklavdnen ). da gaxda (es) shesrulebuli dapireba.

shemdgom( t`k`veni monaniebis shemdeg) kvlav dagibrunet` t`k`ven( o israilis sht`amomavalno) mat` cinashe. da gagaz'lieret` t`k`ven k`onebit`a da z'eebit` da gk`menit` up`ro mravalric`xovani(da es qvelap`eri t`k`veni gulcrp`elobisa da t`avmdablobis gamo allahis mimart`).

da t`u(o israilis shtamomavalno) siket`e hk`enit`, t`k`veni t`avist`vis hk`enit`(radgan amist`vis mogec`emat` jildo), xolo t`u siave ch`aidinet` t`k`vensave cinaag'mdeg(am borotebis saboloo shedegi t`k`venve dagibrundebat`). da aha movida meore dapireba, rat`a t`k`veni saxeebi daemcuxrebinat` da shesuliqvnen mech`et`shi iseve, rogorc` pirvelad shevidnen, da gaanadgures qvelap`eri, rac` mat` xelshi xvdeboda [qvelap`eri, rac` gzad xvdebodat`]

egeb shegicqalot`( o israelis sht`amomavalno) t`k`venma g'mert`ma (mas shemdeg, rac` shuri iz'ia t`k`venze, t`u moinaniebt` da gamoascorebt` t`k`vens k`medebebs). xolo t`u dabrundebit`(borotebis da ucesrigobis ch`adenisken), ch`venc` davbrundebit` (t`k`veni dasjit`a da damc`irebit`). jojoxet`s urcmunoebist`vis samudamo sapqrobiled vak`c`evt`.

cheshmaritad, es qurani ucinamz'g'vrebs(adamianebs) qvelaze scori gzisken(da es aris sruli damorch`ileba allahze) da axarebs morcmuneebs, romelnic` aket`eben ket`il sak`meebs(asruleben allahis brz'anebebs da t`avs ikaveben misi akrz'aluli sak`misgan), rom scored mat`t`visaa udidesi jildo.
da imat` ki, romelt`ac` ar scamt` saik`io(gankit`xvis dg'e, jojoxet`i da samot`xe), gavamzadet` mat`t`is mtanjveli sasjeli(jojoxet`i).

adamiani moucodebs borotebas( icvevs cqevlas sakut`ar t`avze, shvilze an sakut`rebaze).imgvarad, (gabrazebis dros) rogorc` unda moucodebdes siket`es, da cheshmaritad adamiani sulscrap`ia(allahis ert`-ert`i cqaloba is aris, rom is ar pasuxobs adamians c`ud vedrebaze, radgan man ic`is, rom gulis sig'rmeshi adamiani amas sinamdvileshi ar isurvebs).

davadginet` g'ame da dg'e or sascaulad(rac` allahis ert`adert`obasa da qovlisshemz'leobaze miut`it`ebs): davp`aret` g'amis sascauli(mt`varit`) da sach`ino vqavit` dg'is sascauli(mzit`), rat`a it`xovot` madli t`k`veni g'mert`isgan (mocqobit`a da mart`vit` iqvnen dakavebulni t`k`veni c`xovrebis), rat`a sheitqot` celt`ag'ric`xva da angarishi(dg'eebi it`vleba mzit`, xolo t`veebi da clebi mt`varis mixedvit`). da qovelive c`xadad ganvmartet`.

da qovel adamians ch`amovkidet` kiserze(is k`medebebi, romlebic` man ch`aidina) t`avisi bedi(is agebs pasuxs mxolod t`avisi k`medebebist`vis) da gankit`xvis dg'es carvudgent` mas cigns(romelshic` misi qvela sak`me ik`neba ch`acerili), romelic` daxvdeba gadashlili.
caikit`xe sheni cigni! dg'es sakmarisia, rom shen t`vit`on gansajo sheni k`medebebi!

<<vinc` cavida cheshmariti gzit`[allahis gzit`], mxolod t`avis sasiket`od daadga amas da vinc` ac`da, mxolod t`avis sacinaag'mdegod ac`da. da arc` ert`i mtvirt`veli ar itvirt`avs sxvis tvirt`s, da ch`ven ar dagvisjia vinme, vidre ar carvugzavnidit` shuamavals(sanam mat`amde ar mivida mtkic`ebuleba)!>>

xolo roc`a vinebet` dagveg'upa romelime sop`eli(im borotebebist`vis, rac` mat` ch`aidines), vubrz'anet` p`up`unebit` ganebivrebul mis binadrebs(ch`az'irulni vnebebsa da c`ru gart`obashi)[rat`a gulcrp`elad ircmunon allahi, iqvnen morch`ilni misadmi da ag'iaron misi moc`ik`ulebi da mat`i meshveobit` sxvebmac` ipovon cheshmariteba da mihqvnen mas], magram urch`obdnen masshi(ar daemorch`ilnen allahis brz'anebas)(agrz'elebdnen c`xovrebas urcmunoebasa da c`odvebshi) da auxdat` mat` nat`k`vami da gavanadguret` ganadgurebit`.
da ramdeni t`aoba(mat`ze sasjeli movavlinet`) davg'upet` (shuamavali) nuhis shemdgom; sheni g'mert`i ki sakmarisia t`avis monat`a c`odvebis mc`odned da damnaxvelad
imas, vinc` cut`isop`els isurvebs, davuch`k`arebt` mas ik`, rasac` vinebebt` da vist`visac` vinebebt`. mere ki davudginet` mas jojoxet`i rat`a daicvas igi sherac`xuli da damc`irebuli.

xolo iman, vinc` isurva maradiuli c`xovreba, ig'vaca mist`vis (allahisadmi morch`ilebit`) da morcmune iqo, dap`asebul ik`neba mat`i g'vacli (mat`i ket`ili sak`meebi mat`i up`lis mier ik`neba mig'ebuli da shenaxuli, da mat` miezg'ebat` amist`vis sazg'auri)
srulad mivagebt` amat`ac` da imat`ac` sheni g'mert`is sazg'aurs, da sheni g'mert`is sazg'auri ar aris shezg'uduli (ar aris akrz'aluli arc` morcmunet`at`vis da arc` urcmunot`at`vis)
shexede (o, shuamavalo), rogor (am k`veqnad) vamjobinet` isini (adaminebi) ert`i meores (sazrdosa da sak`meebshi). saik`io (morcmunet`at`vis) up`ro mag'alia xarisxit` da up`ro ag'emateba g'irsebit`.
nu daidgen (o, adamiano) allaht`an ert`ad sxva g'vt`aebas (ar ch`aidino mravalg'mert`ianoba), t`orem darch`ebi (allahis daxmarebis gareshe) gankic`xuli, dakninebuli

da dagidgina (brz'ana) shenma g'mert`ma, rom ar et`aqvanot` (o, adamiano) aravis mis garda, da ket`ilad moek`c`et` mshoblebs (gulcrp`el morch`ilebas avlendnen sitqvit` sak`mit` da k`onebit`). t`uki orive an ert`-ert`i miag'cevs siberes, ar ut`xra mat`: up`p`! - ar uqviro mat` da ut`xari ket`ili sitqva

mat`dami siket`it` daxare (t`k`vens mshoblebt`an) mocqalebis p`rt`ebi (damorch`ildi da rbilad moek`ec`i mat`) da t`k`vi: g'mert`o ch`emo, cqaloba uqav mat` iseve, rogorc` me ag'mzardes (roc`a viqavi) patara.
t`k`venma g'mert`ma uket` ic`is, rac` t`k`vens (o, adamianno) gulebshia (is, riskenac` iscrap`vit`), t`k`ven rom mart`alni qop`iliqavit`, da cheshmaritad, igi aris momnaniet`a mimart` mimtevebeli.

da miec`i (morcmune) axlobels t`avisi kut`vnili (sheinarch`une nat`esauri urt`iert`oba mast`an da gaig'e sheciruloba) aseve (gaig'e zak`at`isa da nebaqop`lobit`i k`velmok`medebisgan), g'ataksa da mgzavrs (mogzauri, romelsac` ag'ar ak`vs gzis gasagrz'elebeli sashualeba), da nu gap`langav gadacharbebulad (nu xarjav shens k`onebas imashi, rac` ar aris allahisadmi morch`ileba, da nu ik`c`evi mp`langvelad).

ramet`u mp`langvelebi [mat`, vinc` xarjavs t`avis k`onebas allahze daumorch`ileblobist`vis] eshmakis z'mebi arian [sakut`ari borotebit`a da areulobis dat`esvit` isini satanas hgvanan]. eshkami ki t`avisi g'mert`is mimart` umaduria

da t`u sheak`c`ev zurgs mat` [iset`ebisgan, viszec` nabrz'anebi gak`vs, rom gasc`e k`oneba] (sakut`ari saxsrebis ark`onis gamo), sheni g'mert`is im mocqalebis cadilit`, rasac` imedovneb, da ut`xari mat` tkbili sitqva [mimart`e allahs vedrebit`, rom ganamdidros isini da gaap`art`oos mat`i sazrdo, da roc`a allahi moganichebs shen sazrdos, shen, uechvelad, gauziareb mat` misgan].

da nu ik`nebi (t`it`k`osda) xelmomchirne [nu daishureb xarjvas siket`ist`vis] da nurc` gashli [shens xels] mas mt`lianad [nu daxarjav gadazedmetebulad], rat`a ar darch`e gankic`xuli, gag'atakebuli [damcuxrebuli imis gamo, rac` p`uchad daxarja]
cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i guluxvad [uzrdis] az'levs sarch`os [misi monebidan], visac` inebebs da umc`irebs. cheshmaritad, igi t`avis msaxurt`a mc`odnea, mxedvelia.
da nu daxoc`avt` [o, adamianno] sakut`ar shvilebs gag'atakebis shishit`. ch`ven vaz'levt` sarch`os mat`ac` da t`k`venc`. cheshmaritad mat`i[shvilebis] mokvla didi c`odvaa.
da nu miuaxlovdebit` mrushobas! [t`avi sheikavet` im mizezebisganac` ki, romlebmac` shesaz'loa ik`amde migiqvanot`] radgan [mrushoba], igi znedac`emuloba da c`udi gzaa

da nu mohklavt` suls, rac` akrz'ala allahma [mokvla], t`u ara - mxolod samart`lianobis ag'sadgenad [mkvleloba rogorc` shurisgeba mkvlelobist`vis, meug'leobashi mqop`i mez'avebis sikvdilit` dasja, religiidan gasvlis gamo dasja sikvdilit`], da vinc` moikla usamart`lod, ch`ven davudginet` mis axlobels [memkvidres] (an mmart`vels)] up`leba(shurisgebisa) [rat`a moit`xovos mkvlelis sikvdilit` dasja an daakisros mas sisxlis gamosasqidis gadaxda] da zg'vars nu gadava mkvlelobashi, da
cheshmaritad, igi shecevnili ik`neba [imashi, rom man misc`a shurisgebis ag'srulebis shesaz'lebloba]

da nu miuaxlovdebit` oblis k`onebas, t`u ara[mxolod] siket`it`, vidre igi srulclovanebas miag'cevdes[gonebriv da p`izikur], da uert`gulet` t`k`vens ag't`k`mas[t`avisi valdebulebebi, rogorc` allahis cinashe, aseve ert`manet`is mimart`], uechvelad ag't`k`ma mogekit`xebat` [ allahi moit`xovs ag't`k`mas ag'sasrulis dg'isas, da t`u adamiani sheasrulebs t`avis ag't`k`mas, allahi daajildoebs mas, xolo t`u daarg'vevs mas, dasjis mas]

da srulad daic`avit` sazomi, [ roc`a sxvebist`vis zomavt`] da aconet` scori sascorit`. es [samart`lianoba zomvasa da conashi] uket`esia t`k`vent`vis [am k`veqnad da mshvenieri rogorc` shedeg maradiul c`xovrebashi].

ar misdio [o adamianno] imas, risi c`odnac` ar gak`vs [nu itqvi, rom naxe, t`u ar ginaxavs da nu itqvi, rom moismine, t`u ar mogismenia]. uechvelad, quris, t`valis da gulisgan, qvelasgan [gankit`xvis dg'es] pasuxi moekit`xeba!
da nu ivli k`veqanaze amaqad, shen ver gaxvret dedamicas (masze siarulit`) da ver acvdebi mt`ebs simag'lit`
qovelive es [imis, rac` ch`amot`vlili iqo], sheni g'mert`is cinashe uket`uri, saz'ulvelia [ is ar aris amit` kmaqop`ili]

es aris [rac` shen gaginmartet`] zesht`agoneba, rac` zesht`agegona sheni g'mert`isgan [o, shuamavalo] da nu daidgen[ o, adamiano sakut`ari t`avist`vis] allaht`an ert`ad sxva g'vt`aebas [ar ch`aidine mravalg'mert`ianoba], t`orem ch`agdebul ik`nebi jojoxet`shi, gankic`xuli, damc`irebuli
nut`u t`k`venma up`alma, [o mravalg'mert`ianno] t`k`ven vazhebit` dagajildovat`, xolo t`avist`vis angelozt`agan k`alishvilebi airch`ia?! uechvelad, t`k`ven did sitqvas ambobt`!
ch`ven ukve ganvmartet` am quranshi (dadgenilebebi, magalit`ebi da shegonebebi), rat`a mat` [adamianebma] shegoneba miig'on, magram [es ganmarteba] mxolod kidev up`ro zrdis mat` zizg's (rcmenisadmi).

ut`xari[o, shuamavalo]: rom qop`iliqvnen mast`an[allaht`an] ert`ad [sxva] g'vt`aebebi - rogorc` amboben[ mravalg'mert`ianni] usat`uod isurvebdnen isini [g'vt`aebebi] taxtrevnis mp`lobelisken saval gzas [ec`debodnen daepatronat` misi sidiade da batonoba, rogorc` mep`eebi c`diloben amas amk`veqnad]
dideba mas! igi uzenaesi, diadi da ag'matebulia imaze, rasac` (masze) amboben didebulia igi da uzenaesia im qvelap`erze, rasac` mis shesaxeb [carmart`ebi] amboben

ganadideben mas [allahs] shvidi zec`a, mica, da qoveli, rac` masshia[ qvela k`mnileba]. da ar aris raime, mas rom k`ebas ar ag'uvlendes, magram t`k`ven [o, adamianno] ar gesmit` mat`i k`eba-dideba. cheshmaritad, igi [ mis monebt`an mimart`ebashi] sat`noa,[ar ch`k`arobs dasajos isini, vinc` eurch`ebian mas] da is, mimtevebelia

da roc`a shen [ o, shuamavalo] caikit`xe qurani [da mas ismenen mravalg'mert`ianni], ch`ven davadginet` uxilavi p`arda shensa da mat` shoris, romelt`ac` ar scamt` saik`io[vinc` ar ircmunes saik`io c`xovreba, mat` cin dgas p`aruli zg'ude t`valist`vis uxilavi, romelic` abrkolebt` quranis scorad gagebas mat`i urcmunoebisa da uarqop`is gamo]

da ch`ven davp`aret` mat`i gulebi sap`arit`, rat`a ver gaegot` igi [qurani], da mat` qurebshi siqrue. da rodesac` shen shens up`als axseneb quranshi, sheni g'mert`is ert`adert`obas [rodesac` ambob, rom g'mert`i mxolod allahia] isini zizg'it` zurgs ibruneben. [es imis gamoa, rom isini ampartavnobit`a da jiutobit` ecinaag'mdegebian cheshmaritebas]

ch`ven uket` vic`it`, rasac` isini [mravalg'mert`ianebis mmart`velni] ismenen, [ra mizani ak`vt`] roc`a shen gismenen[o shuamavalo][isini mxolod imist`vis ismenen, rom dagc`inon], [aseve ch`ven vic`it`] da roc`a isini saidumlod t`at`biroben, aha, amboben usamart`loni: t`k`ven mihqvebit` mxolod
monusxul kac`so [viszec` jadom moaxdina zemok`medeba da goneba sheerqa]!

shexede [o shuamavalo], rogor [urcmunoebs] moak`vt` shent`vis igavebi [shenze iset` tquils amboben, romelic` t`avisi siqalbit` mxolod zg'aprul igavebs caagavs]. cheshmarit gzas asc`debian da [ceshmariti] gzis povnas veg'ar shez'leben.
t`k`ves [mravalg'mert`ianebma] [ag'dgomis uarqop`is gamo]: t`uki z'vlebad da p`erp`lad vik`c`evit` [saert`od gavixrcnebit`], gana mart`lac` ag'dgenil vik`nebit` axal k`mnilebado?!
ut`xari [ mat` o, shuamavalo]:,,k`vadac` rom ik`c`et` an rkinad,

anda, [iset`] k`mnilebad, romelic` didia t`k`vens mkerdshi [romlis ag'dgoma carmosadgenad rt`ulia]. da ikit`xaven: [nut`u kvlav gavc`oc`xldebit` mas shemdeg, rac` gavk`rebit`?] ving'a dagvabrunebs ukano? ut`xari [mat`]: [ iseve dagabrunebt`] igi, vinc` gagach`inat` t`avdapirvelad. t`avs daxrian shens cinashe da gkit`xaven: rodisaa iso? ut`xari: [moxdeba] is [ag'sdgoma] sheiz'leba axlosaa.

dg'e, roc`a igi mogixmobt` t`k`ven [rat`a t`k`ven gamoxvidet` t`k`veni sap`lavebidan]. xolo t`k`ven upasuxebt` [daemorch`ilebit` mis brz'anebas] mas didebit` da gegonebat`, mxolod mc`ire xnit` davqovndit`o [dedamicaze]

da ut`xari ch`ems msaxurebs [morcmuneebs], t`k`van is, rac` kargia [kargi sitqva] [da rbilad, ket`ilad laparakobdnen]. cheshmaritad, eshmaki ganxet`k`ilebas t`esavs mat` [adamianebs] shoris da cheshmaritad, eshmaki adamianis ashkara mteria!

t`k`veni g'mert`i uket`esad gic`nobt` t`k`ven [o, adamianno] [da
man ic`is, vin imsaxurebs morcmune iqos, da vin ar imsaxurebs.]. t`u inebebs, cqalobas moig'ebs(msgavsad, rogorc` anichebs rcmenas da shemdeg - maradiul sic`oc`xles samot`xeshi), anda t`u inebebs, dagsjit`[is gaaket`ebs ise, rom mokvdebit` urcmunoebad da shemdeg samudamod ch`agagdebt` jojoxet`shi.]! xolo shen ar cargvigzavnixar [o shuamavalo] mat` damc`velad.[shen ar gekisreba mat`i rcmenashi z'alit` mok`c`eva] [ shen mxolod allahis mier movlenili moc`ik`uli xar da valdebuli xar miacvdino mat` is, rasac` allahi gibrz'anebs].

shenma g'mert`ma qvelaze uket` ic`is isini, vinc` c`at`a shinaa da vinc` k`veqanasa zedaa. ch`ven vamjobinet` [t`avisi sibrz'nis mixedvit`] zogi shuamavali zogiert`s[ucqaloba gansakut`rebuloba mimdevart`a raodenobit`, cminda cignis gardamosvlit` da sxva msgavsit`...] da vuboz'et` [shuamaval] davuds zeburi(p`salmuni).

ut`xari [o shuamavalo] [am mravalg'mert`ianebs]: mouxmet` imat`, remlebzedac` amtkic`ebdit` [rom t`it`k`os isini g'irsni arian t`aqvanisc`emis.] mis [allahis] garda[da t`it`k`os isini shuamdgomlobas gagiceven mis cinashe.]. mat` ar sheuz'liat` [gadagarch`inon datexili ubedurebisgan] zaralis ac`ileba t`k`vent`vis da arc` shec`vla

<<isini [shuamavlebi, mart`alni da angelozni] romlebic` [mravalg'mert`ianni] uxmoben [t`xovnit`] ez'ieben gzas t`aviant` g'mert`t`an dasaaxloveblad, [qvelanair z'alisxmevas ich`enen, rat`a iqvnen up`ro axlos allahis madlierebast`an] imedovneben mis mocqalebas da eshiniat` misi sasjelisa. sheni g'mert`is sasjeli gasap`rt`xilebelia>>.

ar aris arc`ert`i dasaxleba [romlis binadarnic` arian urcmunoebi], rom ar davg'upot` [dasjis gardamosvlit`] igi gankit`xvis dg'emde [misi mc`xovrebni], anda ar davsajot` mtanjveli sasjelit`. [aset`i gadacqbetilebaa] es [ganach`eni] ukve ch`acerili iqo cignshi [dac`ul dap`aze lavhi mavp`uzshi].

da arap`ers shevukavebivart` ch`ven, rom carmogvegzavna(shuamavlebi) ch`veni sascaulebit` [rasac` it`xoven mravalg'mert`ianebi], garda imisa, rom ucindelebma[sazogadoebam] uarqves isini [nishnebi]. ch`ven ki
vuboz'et` semudevelebs [shuamaval saalihis xalxi] dedali ak`lemi c`xad nishnad, xolo isini usamart`lod moek`c`nen mas[dakles igi] [da ch`ven davg'upet` isini, gardmovavlinet` mat`ze sasjeli].da ch`ven vagzavnit` (cinascarmetqvelebs) ch`veni nishnebit` [sascaulebit`] mxolod imist`vis, rom shevashinot` (ch`veni monebi) [rat`a mat`gan miig'on sargebeli da darigeba]

da aha [ gaixsene o, shuamavalo], rogorc` git`xarit` shen: cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i garemoic`avs xalxs [ t`avisi c`odnit`a da z'levamosilebit`], da sizmaric`, [romelic` gich`venet` sascaulebis xilva], mxolod xalxis gamosac`delad davadginet`, da xec`, dacqevlili quranshi, ch`ven davashinebt`(shevagonebt`) mat`, imat` ki arap`eri
ematebat`, garda didi urch`obisa [gadacharbebuli urcmunoeba da c`domileba]

da aki vut`xarit` angelozebs! sejde ag'asrulet` adamist`vis! [rat`a gamoxatuliqo misdami pativisc`ema da carmoch`eniliqo misi upiratesoba] da sejde ag'asrules [qvela angelozma], iblisis garda(romelmac`) t`k`va: gana sajda gavuket`oo (t`avi movuxaroo ) imas, vinc` t`ixisgan shek`menio?!

man t`k`va [iblisma: satanebis mama]: xedav shen [o, allah], es aris igi[adami], vinc` ch`emze metad daap`ase! t`uki [c`oc`xlad damtoveb] gadamivadeb ag'dgomis dg'emde, me davg'upav mis sht`amomavlobas, mc`iredis gardao [garda mxolod shen mier rch`eul morch`ilt`a, romlebic` aravis sxvas ar c`noben g'mert`ad shens garda]
miugo[allahma](ibliss): cadi da mat`gan, vinc` shen gamogqveba [adamis sht`amomavlobidan] jojoxet`i ik`neba t`k`veni sazg'auri, sruli sazg'auri.

da moxible [c`odvashi] mat`gan isini, visac` shez'leb, sheni xmit`, shekribe mat` cinaag'mdeg sheni mxedroba da k`veit`ni, t`anaziari iqavi mat`i k`onebasa [rodesac` isini ishovian akrz'aluli gzit` da xarjaven akrz'alul sak`meebze] da z'eebshi [rodesac` bavshvebi ibadebian mrushobis shedegad] da dahpirdi [t`avis mimdevrebs]! satana ki arap`ers hpirdeba c`dunebis garda!
cheshmaritad ch`ems msaxurebze ar gagach`nia meup`eba da sakmarisia sheni g'mert`i damc`velad [morcmunet`at`vis] [romelt`ac` ic`avs mat` satanis uket`uri zraxvebisgan da mac`duneblobisgan]

t`k`veni g'mert`i[allahi], [is] romelic` gadaadgilebs xomaldebs zg'vashi, rat`a [t`k`ven] ez'iot` misi siket`e[allahis mier naboz'ebi zg'vis nobat`is mopovebit`a da vachrobit`]. cheshmaritad, t`k`veni g'mert`i[o, allahis monebo] mcqalobelia

da roc`a shegexot` xip`at`i zg'vashi [ aaxloebs dag'upvas], daikarga[t`k`veni gonebidan], visac` mouxmobdit`, mis [allahis] garda [t`k`ven mashinve ivicqebt` qvela kerpsa da g'vt`aebas da mimart`avt` mxolod ert`s, qovlisshemz'le allahs shvelis t`xovnit`.], xolo roc`a napirze gamogiqvanat`, pirs ibrunebt` [rcmenisgan, ert`g'mert`ianobisgan da morch`ilebisgan allahisadmi]. da rogori umaduria adamiani

da gana [o, adamianno][imqop`ebit`] usap`rt`xod grz'nobt` t`avs imisagan [allahisgan], [sheiz'leba] rom gsht`ant`k`os micam [micis sig'rmeshi] an dagatexot` k`vebis grigali [k`vebis mtvirt`veli] da mere veg'ar ipovit` damc`vels [mxardamcheri da mp`arveli]?

an [o adamianno] gana imqop`ebit` usap`rt`xoni imisagan, rom is [allahi] dagabrunebt` masshi [zg'vashi] xelaxla [rodesac` zg'avshi imqop`ebit`], mogivlent` umkac`res k`arishxalxs da dagaxrch`obt` imis gamo, rom iqavit` urcmunoni, mere ki amashi veravis ipovit` ch`vens cinaag'mdeg mimdevars [aravis z'aluz's allahs hkit`xos, ratom dasaja man isini]?

da vp`ic`av! ch`ven vakurt`xet` adamis z'eni [uboz'a mat` goneba da gaugzavna mat` cinascarmetqvelebi], gadaviqvanet` isini xmelet`sa t`u zg'vashi [daumorch`ilet` mat` c`xovelebi da xomaldebi], vucqalobet` siket`eni [naqop`ebit`, marc`vleulit`, rz'it`] da vucqalobet` mravals madlit` imat`gan, vinc` shevk`menit`

[ic`ode shuamavalo] im dg'es [ag'sasrulis dg'es], roc`a mogixmobt` qvela adamians t`aviant` cinamz'g'olebt`an ert`ad [qoveli xalxis jgup`i ik`neba mocodebuli im cinamz'g'olt`an ert`ad, romelsac` isini mihqvebodnen am k`veqniur c`xovrebashi] da is, visac` eboz'eba t`avisi cigni [sak`meebi] marjvenashi, da caikit`xaven t`aviant` cigns [ket`ili sak`meebis ch`anacerebit`] [sixarulit` ag'savseni] da aravin mat` ar dach`agravs [mat`i ket`ili sak`meebi ar daiklebs] ert`z'arg'visodenadac` (ramdenic` p`inikis kurkazea z'ap`ivit` nak`sovi).

da is, vinc` ak`(am c`xovrebashi) iqo brma [ver ixila allahis z'alaup`lebis mtkic`ebuleba][da ar gaxda morcmune], igi saik`ioshic` brma ik`neba da kidev up`ro gzaabneuli [rat`a ipovon gza samot`xisken]

da, kinag'am [mravalg'mert`ianebma] gac`dunes [o, shuamavalo] imisgan, rac` zesht`agagonet` [zogiert`i brz'anebis da akrz'alvisgan], rat`a ch`venze sxva rame mogegonebina da mashin [t`u shen amas gaaket`ebdi] amogirch`evdnen isini megobrad.
da ch`ven rom ar gangvemtkic`ebine [o, shuamavalo][cheshmaritebaze], vp`ic`av, shen mat`ken [dat`anxmde imas, rasac` isini shengan it`xoven] c`otas gadaixrebodi.

mashin [t`uki mc`iredit` mainc` gadaixrebodi mravalg'mert`ianebisaken], ut`uod gagemebdit` shen ormag sasjels [amk`veunad] sic`oc`xleshive da ormags sikvdilis shemdeg [maradiul c`xovrebashi]. da veravis naxavdi ch`vens cinaag'mdeg shemces

da isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] miuaxlovdnen imas, lamis shegavicroes shen [o shuamavalo] am micacqlze [mek`k`ashi], rat`a gaez'evebine misgan, da mashin [t`u isini amas gaaket`ebdnen], shens shemdeg darch`ebodnen ik` mxolod mc`ire xnit` [c`ota droit`].
[da isini daisjebodnen] allahis dadgenili cesisamebr mat`t`an mimart`ebit`, vinc` ch`vens mier iqo movlenili shenamde moc`ik`ulad. da shen ver naxav allahis kanonshi raime c`vlilebas.
dadek`i loc`vad mzis gadaxrisas[zuhri} g'amis dabindebamde [asri] da ikit`xe qurani gamt`eniisas. cheshmaritad, dilis loc`va mocmeobaa(dg'is da g'amis anp`elozebi escrebian).

da g'amis [misi mc`ire nacili] ert` nacilshi ikit`xe [qurani] loc`vashi, shent`vis gansakut`rebuli damatebit`i loc`va. egeb giboz'os [o muhammad] shenma g'mert`ma k`ebuli adgili[rat`a allahma gagxados shuamdgomlad adamianebist`vis samsjavros dg'es, da mashin ik`nebi aset` mdgomareobashi, rodesac` shen shegak`eben rogorc` pirvelni, aseve ukanasknelni.]

da t`k`vi: g'mert`o! shemiqvane me (ik`, sadac` ch`emt`vis siket`ea) cheshmaritebit` [ase, rom is me shemiqvardes], da gamomiqvane me (ik`idan, sadac` ch`emt`vis borotebaa) cheshmaritebit` [is, rom es ganshoreba ch`emt`vis mz'ime ar iqos], da momaniche shengan z'ala [mtkic`e mtkic`ebuleba], romlit`ac` shemecevi (qvela ch`emi mtris cinaag'mdeg)
da ut`xari (hei, moc`ik`ulo) (mravalg'mert`ianebs):,,movida cheshmariteba [islami], da gank`arda sic`rue [mravalg'mert`ianoba]. namdvilad, sic`rue iset`i ramaa, rom k`reba!

gardmovavlent` quranisgan imas, rac` gankurneba[ sulisa da sxeulist`vis] da [aseve] cqalobaa[mizezi allahis madlierebis mosapoveblad ]morcmunet`at`vis, xolo usamart`loebist`vis [urcmunoebist`vis] is [qurani] mxolod zrdis carumateblobas [urcmunoebasa da c`domilebas] [rodesac` ismens mas] [radgan mat` ar scamt` misi]

rodesac` ch`ven vasach`uk`rebt` adamians cqalobebit` [janmrt`elobit`, ket`ildg'eobit` da sxv.], is ki ibrunebs zurgs da ampartavnobit` ichers t`avs (cheshmaritebis mig'ebisgan). xolo rodesac` ubedureba daatqdeba t`avs, mashin sasocarkvet`ilebashi vardeba (allahis cqalobis mimart`).
ut`xari (hei, moc`ik`ulo) (xalxs): qvela mok`medebs t`avisi bunebisamebr [ise, rogorc` sheep`ereba mas], da t`k`venma up`alma uket` ic`is isini, vinc` scor gzazea [cheshmaritebisken]

gekit`xebian [o, shuamavalo] shen [urcmunoni] sulis t`aobaze [sulis arsze]. ut`xari [ mat`]: suli [sulis arsi] ch`emi g'mert`is brz'anebisganaa [mxolod man ic`is mis shesaxeb], t`k`ven [o, adamianno] ki ar gboz'ebiat` c`odna, mc`iredis garda.

da rom gvenebebina [ch`ven], usat`uod cavig'ebdit` imas [ o, muhammad], rac` zesht`agagonet` [ch`ven shegviz'lia qurani amovshalot` sheni gulidan] shemdeg shen ver ipovidi amis gamo ch`vens cinaag'mdeg verc` mp`arvels [damc`vels], verc` shemces (vinc` dagibrunebda qurans)
garda mocqalebit` sheni g'mert`isgan. cheshmaritad, misi madli shendami [o, muhammad] didia [shen mogenicha is, rac` sxva aravist`vis uboz'ebiat`].
ut`xari: t`undac`, [rom] gaert`iandnen adamianebi da jinebi imisat`vis, rom moitanon [shek`mnan] msgavsi am quranisa, ver moitanen mis msgavss [ver shevk`mnidit`], t`undac` ert`imeores daexmaron.
ch`ven ukve moviqvanet` am quranshi qvelanairi magalit`i [rat`a isini mat` mihqolodnen], magram adamiant`a umetesoba uarqop`s qvelap`ers urcmunoebis garda
da mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebma] ut`xres [moc`ik`uls]: ch`ven ar dagijerebt` (o, muhammad), vidre ar gamogviqvan cqaros (mek`is micidan).
an sanam ar gek`neba bag'i palmebit`a da vazit`, romelt`a shorisac` mdinareni idenen ch`uxch`uxit`
an sanam ar ch`amogvigdeb c`as, rogorc` amtkic`eb, naglejebad, an sanam ar moxval allaht`an da angelozebt`an ert`ad ch`vens cinashe.

an ar gek`neba saxli ok`ros ch`uk`urt`mebit`, anda ar axval zemot` c`ashi, da shens amag'lebasac` [c`ad] ar vircmunebt`, vidre ar gardmogvivlen cigns [allahisgan], romelsac` cavikit`xavt`o [da sadac` dacerili ik`neba, rom namdvilad xar misi moc`ik`uli]. ut`xari [o, shuamavalo]: dideba ch`ems up`als! nut`u me mxolod adamiani ar var da amavdroulad moc`ik`uli? [rogor shemiz'lia gavaket`o is, rasac` it`xovt` ch`emgan?]

da rac` ushlis xalxs [urcmunoebs] imis rcmenas, roc`a ukve movida mat`t`an allahisgan cheshmariti xelmz'g'vaneloba [sakmarisi ganmarteba], -- mxolod isaa, rom t`k`ves:
nut`u allahma adamiani gaugzavna moc`ik`ulad?

ut`xari [o, shuamavalo] [mag mravalg'mert`ianebs]: micaze rom angelozni dadiodnen mshvidad, mashin ch`ven namdvilad gardmovuvlendit` mat` zec`idan angelozebs shuamavlad [magram dedamicis binadarni arian adamianebi, da amitom allahis mier mat`t`an moc`ik`ulad ik`na gagzavnili adamiani, rat`a mat` shez'lon mast`an saubari da misi gageba]

ut`xari [mat`]: sakmarisia allahi mocmed ch`emsa da t`k`vens shoris [imashi, rom vambob cheshmaritebas da namdvilad var misi shuamavali]; cheshmaritad, igi t`avis monat`a mc`odne [ic`is mat`i mdgomareoba], mxedvelia [xedavs mat` sak`mes] [da miuzg'avs mat` amisat`vis]

visac` allahi daadgens cheshmarit gzaze, is cheshmariti gzit` midis [mianichebs rcmenasa da morch`ilebas], xolo visac` gzas aubnevs [datovebs misi shecevnis gareshe, mas shemdeg, rac` is t`vit`on airch`evs amas], veravis upovi mat` shemced [damxmared], mis garda [romlebic` daic`avdnen mat` misi sasjelisgan]. da ch`ven shevkrebt` mat` [gazaabneult`] ag'dgomis dg'es t`aviant`i saxeebit` brmebad, munjebad da qrut`. [mat`i saboloo] samqop`eli ik`neba geena [jojoxet`i]: ramdenjerac` igi sheneldeba, imdenjer avumag'lebt`/avugizgizebt` c`ec`xls mat`.

es [aset`i sasjeli] samagieroa mat`t`vis [mravalg'mert`ianebist`vis] imis gamo, rom isini urcmunoni gaxdnen ch`veni sascaulebis da t`k`ves: nut`u, roc`a ch`ven vik`c`evit` z'vlebad da mtvrad [srulad davishlebit`] nut`u mart`la vik`nebit` ag'dgenilni rogorc` axali k`mnileba?

nut`u mat` ar unaxavt` [an ar dap`ik`rebulan], rom allahs, romelmac` shek`mna c`a da mica, sheuz'lia shek`mnas mat`i msgavsni [mas shemdeg, rac` isini daishlebian]? da man [mravalg'mert`ianebist`vis] daadgina vada (mat`i sikvdilisa da sasjelisat`vis), romlis shesaxebac` ar arsebobs echvi [es auc`ileblad moxdeba]. magram usamart`loni [urcmunoni] uarqop`en qvelap`ers urcmunoebis garda.

ut`xari [o, shuamavalo] [am mravalg'mert`ianebs]:
t`uki t`k`ven gek`nebodat` ch`emi up`lis cqalobis saunjeebi [romlebic` arasodes amoicureba], mashinac` ki t`k`ven t`avs sheikavebdit` [raimis mic`emisgan] imis shishit`, rom dageliot` [da gag'aribdet`]. namdvilad, adamiani aris z'unci [garda mat`isa, vinc` allahma rcmenit` daic`va].

da [me allahi] vp`ic`av, mivec`it` [shuamaval] musas c`xra c`xadi sascauli, da hkit`xe [o, muhammad] israelis shvilebs [shuamaval iaqubze], imaze, rogor is, roc`a mivida [shuamavali musa] mat`t`an, ut`xra p`araonma: namdvilad, me vp`ik`rob, rom shen, hei musa, mojadoebuli xar.

[musa] t`k`va: shen [p`araono] t`avad ic`i, rom es (sascaulebi) gardamoavlina mxolod c`at`a da micis up`alma, rogorc` nat`eli mtkic`ebulebebi. da me namdvilad vp`ik`rob, rom shen, p`araono, daig'upebi
da p`araonma isurva, rom gaendevna isini [musa da israilis sht`amomavlebi] micidan [egviptidan], magram ch`ven davaxrch`et` igi da isini, vinc` mast`an ert`ad iqvnen [misi jari], qvelani [zg'vashi].

da ch`ven vut`xarit` mis shemdeg [p`araonis sikvdilis shemdeg] israilis sht`amomavlebs: ic`xovret` am micaze, da roc`a mova maradiuli sic`oc`xlis dapireba [dadgeba samsjavros dg'e], ch`ven shegkrebt` qvelas ert`ad (gankit`xvis adgilze)

ch`ven cheshmaritebit` gardmovavlinet` igi [qurani], da cheshmaritebit`ve ch`amovida igi [qurani] [uc`vlelad] da ch`ven gaggzavnet` shen (o, moc`ik`ulo) mxolod rogorc` maxarobeli (morch`ilt`at`vis, rom allahi mat` samot`xes dahpirda) da rogorc` shemgonebeli (gap`rt`xilebis momtani, rom urcmunoebsa da urch`ebs allahis sasjeli daatqdebat` t`avs).

da [gardmogivlinet` shen],[o, moc`ik`ulo) qurani,
romelshic` ch`ven ganvac`alkevet` [cheshmariteba sic`ruisgan, cheshmariti gza c`domilebisgan, nebadart`uli akrz'alulisgan], rat`a shen cagekit`xa igi xalxist`vis auch`k`areblad, da ch`ven gardmovavlinet` igi [qurani] gardmovlenit` [nacilebad movlenat`a shesabamisad da xalxis sachiroebisamebr, rat`a gangvemarta mat`t`vis garkveuli dadgenilebebi].

ut`xari [o, shuamavalo] [am urcmunoebs]: ircmunebt` mas [qurans] t`u ar ircmunebt` [qurans t`k`veni rcmenit` arap`eri ar daemateba, da arc` t`k`veni urcmunoebit` daakldeba rame] cheshmaritad, isini, visac` eboz'a c`odna masze ucin [scavlulebi, romlebic` ic`noben adre gardamosul cignebs], roc`a [qurani] ekit`xebodat` mat`, pirk`ve [mat`i saxit`] emxobodnen t`aqvanisc`emit`
da amboben: dideba ch`vens up`als! namdvilad, ch`veni up`lis dapireba (shuamavali muhamedis -mshvidoba mas-moc`ik`ulad movlinebaze) uechvelad shesruldeba

da isini eshvebian t`aviant`i nikapebit` [saxeebit`] micaze (sujudshi), tirian (im zemok`medebisgan, rac` quranis shegonebebma moaxdina mat`ze), da es [quranis mosmena] kidev up`ro zrdis mat`shi t`avmdablobas (allahis cinashe)

ut`xari: mouxmet` allahs an mouxmet` mocqales, rogorc` ar unda mimart`ot` mas vedrebit` (ra saxelit`ac` ar unda mouxmot`), is mainc` ert`i da igive up`alia. da mas ekut`vnis ulamazesi saxelebi. da shen [o, moc`ik`ulo] nu carmot`k`vam loc`vas xmamag'la [rom ar gaigonon mravalg'mert`ianebma da ar sheurac`xqon qurani da is, vinc` igi gardamoavlina],
magram arc` ch`urch`ulit` carmot`k`va [rom shenma sahabebma[t`anxmlebma] ver gaigon], aramed airch`ie gza am ors shoris [sashualo xma].

da t`k`vi: k`eba allahs, romelmac` ar aiqvana t`avist`vis shvili, da ar hqavs mas t`anaziari mbrz'aneblobashi, da mas ar hqolia mp`arveli, [rom daec`va allahi] damc`irebisgan
[radgan igi uzenaesia, didebuli da aravisze araa damokidebuli]! da ganadide igi g'irseuli didebit`
[adide igi, t`aqvani ec`i da emsaxure mxolod mas]!
[qoveli] k`eba allahs, romelmac` gardamoavlina t`avis monaze [shuamaval muhammadze] cigni [qurani] da ar uk`mnia masshi [am cignshi] aranairi simrude [gadaxveva cheshmaritebisgan].

scorad [cignad, romelshic` ar aris cinaag'mdegobebi da gamorch`ena], rat`a gaap`rt`xilos (urcmunoni) ch`veni didi risxvis shesaxeb [allahis mkac`ri sasjelis shesaxeb],
da gaaxaros morcmuneni, romlebic` ket`il sak`mes sch`adian, imit`, rom mat`t`vis mzad aris kargi sazg'auri [samot`xe]
sadac` isini darch`ebian samudamod.
da rat`a gaap`rt`xilos isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi], romelt`ac` t`k`ves: allahma aiqvana t`avist`vis shvili [vazhi an k`alishvilebi].

ar ak`vt` mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] amis shesaxeb aranairi c`odna, da arc` mat` mamebs [cinaprebs], [romlebsac` brmad misdeven] [ar hk`oniat` msgavsi c`odna]. ra mz'imea es sitqva, romelic` gamodis mat`i piridan! isini ar amboben arap`ers garda sic`ruisa!
nut`u shen [o, shuamavalo] mzad xar, rom t`avi daig'upo mcuxarebit` mat` gamo [sheni xalxis gamo], radgan imat` ar ircmunes es shegoneba [qurani]?

namdvilad, ch`ven vk`menit` is, rac` micazea [c`xovelebi, mc`enareebi, ciag'iseuli da sxva], misi samkaulad, rat`a gamovc`adot` isini [adamianebi] vin aris mat`gan uket`esi sak`meebit` [up`ro morch`ili allahisa].
da (am k`veqnis dasasruls) ch`ven namdvilad vak`c`evt` imas, [rac` micazea] brtqel velad, sruliad utqeod da umc`enarod

an shen [o, shuamavalo] ggonia, rom gamok`vabulis xalxi da dap`isa [sadac` mat`i saxelebi iqo dacerili] iqo qvelaze saoc`ari ch`ven sascaulebs shoris? [magram c`at`a, micisa da imis shek`mna, rac` mat`shia up`ro didi sascaulia, vidre es ambavi]

ai, [ert` dg'es] morcmune chabukebma [t`aviant`i xalxis mxridan mravalg'mert`ianobis iz'ulebisa da sac`duris shishit`] sheap`ares t`avi gamok`vabuls da t`k`ves: up`alo ch`veno! mogvmadle shengan cqaloba [gagvaz'liere misit` da dagvip`are borotebisgan], da gvich`vene ch`vens sak`meshi siscore [gagvimartive gza, romelic` migviqvans iset`i sak`meebis shesrulebamde, romlebic` shen giqvars, da ch`ven gavxdebit` isini, vinc` scor gzas mihqvebian]
da ch`ven davluk`et` mat`i qurebi [ch`avagdet` g'rma z'ilshi] gamok`vabulshi mravali clebit`
shemdeg gamovag'viz'et` isini, rat`a gagvego, romeli jgup`i [ert`manet`t`an amat` shesaxeb davashi mqop`i] uket` gamoit`vlida ramdeni celi dahqves [gamok`vabulshi]

aha, giambobt` shen [o, shuamavalo] mat` ambavs cheshmaritebit`. isini iqvnen chabukebi [gamok`vabulis mc`xovrebni], romelt`ac` ircmunes t`avisi g'mert`i; xolo ch`ven mivumatet` mat` cheshmariti gza.[mat` shevmatet` rcmena da simtkic`e cheshmaritebaze]

da simtkic`e movavlinet` mat` gulebze [rcmenit`] [da isini ganmtkic`dnen masshi [cheshmaritebashi], roc`a p`exze camodgnen [urcmuno mmart`velis cinashe, romelic` saqvedurobda mat` imis gamo, rom kerpebs t`aqvans ar sc`emdnen), da t`k`ves (am chabukebma]: ch`veni g'mert`i [is ert`adert`ia, visac` ch`ven t`aqvans vc`emt` da is] c`at`a da k`veqnis g'mert`ia! ch`ven ar movuxmobt` mis garda aravis [ ar vuk`mnit` mas t`anaziars t`aqvanisc`emashi]. [da t`u raime sxvas vitqodit`, mashin gamovidoda, rom] ch`ven vt`k`vit` gadacharbebuli da cheshmaritebisgan shors mqop`i.

[shemdeg t`k`ves mat` ert`manet`shi]: am ch`venma xalxma daidgina mis garda g'vt`aebebi [gaxdnen mravalg'mert`ianebi]. ratom ar moitanes mat`t`vis c`xadi mtkic`ebuleba [g'mert`ebad ag'iarebult`a shesaxeb] [t`it`k`os isini g'irsni arian t`aqvanisc`emisa]? da vin aris imaze usamart`lo [c`odvili][qvelaze boroti adamiani] [vidre], vinc` allahze sic`rues t`xzavs?

rakig'a gaemijnet` mat` [t`k`veni xalxisgan] da imas [kerpebs], rasac` isini et`aqvanebian allahis garda, mash t`avi sheap`aret` gamok`vabuls [rat`a t`aqvani ec`et` mxolod ert`adert`i allahist`vis], mogmadlit` g'mert`i t`avis cqalobas da dagidgent` t`k`vens sak`meshi cinamz'g'ols. [gaamartivebs mat`t`vis sazrdos mopovebas am gamok`vabulshi] [da allahma moavlina mat`ze g'rma z'ili da daic`va isini].

da shen [o shemqurebelo] dainaxav, rom mze rodesac` amodis gadaixreba gamok`vabulis xalxis marjvena mxares da roc`a ch`adis - marc`xena mxares. isini ki mis shuashi [gamok`vabulshi] iqvnen. es [is, rac` ase ik`na gaket`ebuli] aris allahis ert`i sascault`agani. da visac` allahi daadgens cheshmarit gzaze [mianichebs rcmenasa da morch`ilebas], is cheshmariti gzit` cava, xolo visac` gzas aubnevs [datovebs mas shecevnis gareshe, mis shemdeg rac` igi t`avad airch`evs amas], shen ver upovi mas shemces [damxmares]
