da shen [o, shemqurebelo] mat` mg'viz'ared miich`nev, mashin, roc`a isini [gamok`vabulis chabukebi] [namdvilad] mz'inareni iqvnen. vabrunebdit` mat` marjvniv da marc`xniv; xolo mat`i z'ag'li t`at`ebcacvdili icva zg'urblze. isini rom dagenaxa, pirs ibrunebdi mat`gan sheshinebuli

amgvarad ag'vadginet` [gavag'viz'et`] isini [imave saxit`, rogorebic` iqvnen.], rat`a ert`urt`isat`vis ekit`xat` [imaze, ramden xans imqop`ebodnen isini gamok`vabulshi]. t`k`va vig'ac`am mat`gan, ramdenxans shevqovndit`o?! t`k`ves: ert` dg'es an dg'is rag'ac` monakvet`io. [sxvebma ki] t`k`ves: t`k`venma g'mert`ma uket` ic`is, ramdenxans sheqovndit`, gagzavnet` ert`i
t`k`vengani am t`k`veni p`ulit` k`alak`shi. shexedos [k`alak`is mc`xovrebt`agan], visi sachmelic` up`ro sup`t`aa da mogitanot` sarch`o misgan. magram sip`rt`xile gamoich`inos da t`k`veni arseboba ar agrz'nobinos aravis

vinaidan, t`u isini shegamch`neven, k`vebit` ch`agk`olaven (sasikvdilod) an z'alit` shegak`c`even t`aviant` rcmenaze [mravalg'mert`ianobaze], da mashin [t`u amas daemorch`ilebit`] veg'arasodes miag'cevt` carmatebas [samot`xeshi ver shexvalt`].

amgvarad vac`nobet` [im chabukebze] mat` [im xalxist`vis, vinc` mat` droshi c`xovrobda], rat`a gaegot`, rom allahis ag't`k`ma [ag'dgomis dg'eze] cheshmaritia, da rom saat`shi [samsjavros dg'is dadgoma] echvi ar aris. da isini kamat`obdnen ert`manet`shi mat`i mdgomareobis shesaxeb. da t`k`ves: aaget` mat` t`avszemot`[ am gamok`vabulis] shenoba [taz'ari] [rat`a man dap`aros isini] [da t`avi daanebet` am chabukebs, radgan] mat`i g'mert`i mat` qvelaze uket` ic`nobso. t`k`ves imat`, romelt`ac` upiratesoba moipoves mat` sak`meshi: usat`uod avagebt` mat` t`avszemot` saloc`avso(mech`et`s).

itqvian isini [im chabukebze davashi mqop`ni]: samni iqvnen, meot`xe z'ag'lio. da itqvian: xut`ni iqvnen, meek`vse ki mat`i z'ag'lio. argumentis gareshe. da amboben: shvidni iqvnen, xolo merve mat`i z'ag'liao. ut`xari [o, shuamavalo]: ch`emma g'mert`ma uket` ic`is mat`i ric`xvi, mat` ki arap`eri ar ic`ian, mc`iredis garda(mat` shesaxeb mxolod c`otam ic`is). da nu ikamat`eb mat` shesaxeb, garda c`xadad, da mat` shesaxeb mat`gan aravis sheekit`xo
da ar t`k`va raimes shesaxeb [raime sak`mis shesaxeb]:,,namdvilad, xval mas gavaket`ebo
garda imisa, rasac` inebebs allahi. da gaixsene sheni g'mert`i roc`a [raime] dagavicqdeba da t`k`vi: egeb, micinamz'g'vros ch`emma g'mert`ma simart`lest`an up`ro axlos, vidre es aris.
da isini [chabukebi] darch`nen t`aviant` gamok`vabulshi (z'ilshi mqop`ni) samasi clis ganmavlobashi da daamates kidev c`xra celi.

ut`xari [o, shuamavalo]: allahma uket` ic`is, ramden xans dahqves. mas ekut`vnis c`odna dap`aruli c`at`a da k`veqnisa. rogor xedavs igi da rogor esmis! mat` ara hqavt` mis garda mp`arveli da igi aravis ch`aiziarebs sakut`ar msjavrshi
da caikit`xe [o, shuamavalo] is, rac` zesht`agegona sheni g'mert`is cignidan [quranidan]. ar arsebobs shemc`vleli misi sitqvisa da veravis ipovi mis garda shemp`arebels.

daimorch`ile sheni suli mat`t`an ert`ad, romelnic` evedrebian t`aviant` g'mert`s dilidan [mzis amosvlidan] sag'amomde [mzis ch`asvlamde], da iltvian misi cqalobisken. da ar aarido t`vali [g'vt`is msaxurebs rat`a mdidar urcmunot`a mimart` gamoich`ino quradg'eba] mat` amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis sitkboebis survilit` da ar mouxaro k`edi mat`, visi gulic` ugulisxmo vak`c`iet` ch`veni xsenebisadmi; da vinc` sakut`ar survilebsaa aqolili, is isedac`, t`avis sak`meshi zg'vars gadasula

da t`k`vi: cheshmariteba t`k`veni g'mert`isganaa, visac` surs, ircmunebs, da visac` surs, ar ircmunebs! cheshmaritad, gavumzadet` usamart`loebs c`ec`xli, romelic`
garemoic`avs mat`. t`uki shvelas it`xoven, mieshvelebian adug'ebuli zet`is msgavsi cqlit` romelic` cvavs saxeebs. ra saz'ageli sasmelia da ra avi t`avshesap`ari [jojoxet`i]
romelt`ac` ircmunes da ket`ili sak`me aket`es, cheshmaritad, ar davukargavt` sazg'aurs imat`, vinc` kargi sak`me aket`a.

scored mat`t`visaa [gamzadebuli] samot`xis bag'ebi, romelt`a z'irs miedinebian mdinareebi. sheimkoben ik` ok`ros samkaulebs da sheimosaven abreshumisa da mcvane atlasis samoss. camocolilni ik`nebian savarz'lebze. ra mshvenieri jildoa da ra mshvenieri t`avshesap`aria [samot`xe].

da mouqevi mat` [o, shuamavalo] [shens xalxshi mqop` urcmunoebs] igavi [magalit`i] ori kac`is shesaxeb [romlebic` ert`-ert`i z'veli t`emidan iqvnen ert`i morcmune iqo, meore ki urcmuno]. ch`ven vhk`menit` ert`-ert` mat`ganis (urcmunos) ori venaxi, garshemovartqit` isini palmis xeebit` da mat` shoris nat`esit`.
orive bag'ma gamoig'o t`avisi naqop`i da arap`eri gaup`uchdat` [naqop`idan]. da ch`ven gavataret` mat` shoris [am or bag's shoris] mdinare [rom bag'ebis da nat`esebis morcqva martivad shesz'lebodat`]

da hk`onda mas [am ori bag'is mp`lobels] naqop`i (da sxva simdidrec`), da man ut`xra t`avis t`anamgzavrs [morcmunes], romelsac` esaubreboda: me meti k`oneba mak`vs, vidre shen, da xalxit`ac` (damxmareebit`) z'lieri var shenze

da shevida igi [bag'is mp`lobeli] t`avis bag'shi, t`vit`onve t`avis t`avs usamart`lod mok`c`euli [imit`, rom ar scamda ag'dgomis da epareboda echvi samsjavros dg'is dadgomashi],
da t`k`va [naqop`it` ag'p`rt`ovanebulma]: ar vp`ik`rob, rom es [bag'i] odesme ganadgurdeba

da ar vp`ik`rob, rom saat`i [samsjavros dg'e] dadgeba. da t`u mainc` davubrundebi ch`ems up`als [rogorc` shen [morcmune] amtkic`eb], mashin, uechvelad, me vpoveb (allaht`an) uket`ess, vidre es [bag'i], dabrunebis shemdeg

ut`xra mas [bag'is mp`lobels] misma [morcmune] t`anamgzavrma, mast`an saubrisas: nut`u shen urcmunoebas gamoxatav imashi, vinc` shegk`mna micisgan, shemdeg cvet`isgan [t`eslis sit`xisgan],
mere ki gagascora da shegk`mna srulqop`il adamianad? [amrigad, vinc` shegk`mna t`avdapirvelad, ma z'aluz's, kvlav shegk`mnas ag'dgomis drosac`]
magram igi, allahi ch`emi g'mert`ia. da me ar davudgen t`anaziarad ch`ems g'mert`s aravis

hoda, ratom ar t`k`vi, roc`a shens bag'shi shediodi [romelic` ase gaxarebda]: es -- is aris, rac` allahma isurva [rom mk`onoda] ar arsebobs z'ala (misi mopovebisa) garda allahisa [mxolod misi shecevnit`]! t`uki shen mxedav me shenze g'aribad, [rogorc`] k`onebit`, aseve shvilebit`,
egebis ch`emma g'mert`ma me miboz'os uket`esi shens bag'ze da moavlinos masze zec`idan mrisxaneba, daik`c`es brtqel da gluv adgilad [gaigivdes micast`an, da ag'arap`eri ag'ar amovides masze]
an ki misi [bag'is] cqali ch`aiz'ireba micis sig'rmeshi, da shen veg'ar shez'leb misi moz'ebnasac` ki.

da (scorad ag'moch`nda is, rac` morcmunem t`k`va) misi [urcmunos] naqop`i(shemosavali) ganadgurebam moic`va, da xelebis k`neva daicqo [mcuxarebit`] im xarjisat`vis rac` gaig'o[t`avis] bag'ist`vis, axla ki is [bag'i] dac`arielda sap`uz'vlianad [daemxo saqrdeni, romelic` vazs echira], da ambobs (qop`ili bag'is mp`lobeli): netav, aravin damedgina t`anaziarad ch`emi g'mert`isat`viso.
da ar hqavda mas adamianebi (vinc` ak`amde eamaqeboda), vinc` daexmareboda mas (allahis sasjelisgan t`avis dag'cevashi), allahis garda, da t`vit`onac` ver shez'lo daxmareba sakut`ar t`avze

ik`(im mdgomareobashi) daxmareba mxolod allahs ekut`vnis, cheshmarits (mxolod mas sheuz'lia shecevna). igi aris sauket`eso, rogorc` jildos mimnichebeli, da sauket`eso, rogorc` saboloo shedegis ganmsazg'vreli
[sakut`ari morcmune monebist`vis, romlebsac` igi t`avis mp`arvelobashi ig'ebs]

da mouqevi mat` [o, shuamavalo] [xalxs] magalit`i amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis shesaxeb, is hgavs cqals, romelic` ch`ven zec`idan gardmovavlinet` [cvimis saxit`] am cqals sheercqa micis mc`enareuloba da amoizarda, da male is ik`c`a gamomshral, mtvrad k`c`eul balaxad, romelsac` k`ari ak`et`-ik`it` p`antavs. namdvilad, allahi qoveli sak`mis zedamxedveli da qovlisshemz'lea.
k`oneba da shvilebi samshvenisia micieri c`xovrebis, xolo caruvali ket`ili sak`meni uket`esia sheni g'mert`is cinashe sazg'aurit` da uket`esia imedit`!

da (gaixsene) is dg'e [samsjavros dg'e], roc`a ch`ven gadavz'ravt` mt`ebs t`aviant` adgilebidan, da shen ixilav micas gashlilad [gamchvirvaled, sadac` qvelap`eri nat`lad ch`ans],
da ch`ven shevkrebt` mat` [pirvelt` da ukanasknelt`] (gankit`xvis adgilze) da aravis ar davtovebt` mat`gan.

da carsdgebian sheni g'mert`is cinashe mckrivebad. vp`ic`av, moxvedit` ch`emt`an iset`ni, rogorc` gagach`inet` t`avdapirvelad. t`k`ven ki ambobdit`, rom ar ag'vasrulebdit` t`k`venze ag't`k`muls. da carsdgebian isini sheni up`lis cinashe mckrivebad.
[da urcmunoebs et`k`mebat`:]ai, t`k`ven moxvedit` ch`vens cinashe [ samagieros misag'ebad], zustad ise, rogorc` shegk`menit` pirvelad dauc`velni, shishvelni da upovarni, ushviloebi. t`k`ven ki [amk`veqnad] amtkic`ebdit` rom ch`ven ar ganvsazg'vravdit` t`k`vent`vis vadas/ adgils [ag'dgomis, sazg'aurisa da samagieros dg'isat`vis].

daideba cigni da naxav c`odvilebs sheshinebult` imisagan, rac` masshia, da itqvian: simcare ch`venda, es ra cignia, arap`eria gamotovebuli, arc` mc`ire, arc` didi, qvelap`eri ag'nusxulia. da naxaven imas, rac` gaaket`es dadebuls mat` cinashe, da aravis moek`c`eva sheni g'mert`i usamart`lod

da aki, vut`xarit` angelozebs: sejde ag'asrulet` adamist`vis! sejde ag'asrules, iblisis garda. igi iqo jint`agani, ar sheasrula t`avisi g'mert`is brz'aneba. nut`u daidgent` mas da mis sht`amomavlobas megobrebad ch`ems magivrad, mashin, roc`a isini t`k`veni mtrebi arian? da usamart`lot`at`vis ra c`udi arch`evania!

ar amiqvania me isini [iblisi da misi sht`amomavloba] mocmeebad [an t`anamonacileebad] c`at`a da micis shek`mnisas,
da arc` mat`i t`aviant`i t`avis shek`mnisas. da ar damidgenia gzaabneulni t`anashemceebad.

da im dg'es etqvis: mouxmet` ch`ems t`anaziarebs, romlebzedac` amtkic`ebdit` [t`it`k`os isini g'irsni arian t`aqvanisc`emisa], mouxmoben, magram isini ar upasuxeben da davadgent` mat` shoris carcqmedas.
dainaxaven c`odvilebi [urcmunoni] c`ec`xls da ip`ik`reben, rom ik` ik`nebian ch`agdebulni. da ver hpoveben ik`idan gamomqvans [isini ik`idan ukve veg'arasodes gamovlen.]

ch`ven ukve moviqvanet` am quranshi qvela saxis magalit`ebi
[rat`a isini mihqolodnen mat`] [rat`a mat`gan mieg'ot` shegoneba da ercmunat`], magram adamiani qvelaze metad [qvela k`mnilebaze metad] midrekilia davisa da shecinaag'mdegebisken!

da xalxs ar abrkolebda arap`eri imisgan, rom ercmunat` da et`xovat` t`aviant`i up`lis miteveba, mas shemdeg rac` mat`t`an movida mart`ali gzis mach`venebeli [qurani], garda imisa, rom isini elodnen an carsul t`emebze mosul sasjelis magalit`s [rac` dac`invit` st`xoves shuamavals], an rom mat` daatqdebodat` sasjeli pirdapir t`valcin.

da ar carmogvigzavnia shuamavlebi, t`u ara maxaroblebad da shemgoneblebad. da sic`ruit` cinag'udgnen isini [daoben sic`rueze dap`uz'nebuli argumentebit`], romelt`ac` ar ircmunes, rat`a amaoek`mnat` misit` cheshmariteba. da masxrad igdebdben ch`ems sascaulebs da imas, rit`ac` sheagonebdnen.

da vin aris imaze usamart`lo [c`odvili], visac` sheaxsenes misi g'mert`is sascaulebi, man ki zurgi ak`c`ia mat` da daivicqa is, rac` gaamzades misma xelebma? ch`ven davadginet` mat` gulebze saburvelni, rat`a ver gaiazron igi da mat` qurebshi - siqrue. da t`u mat` cheshmariti gzisken mouxmoben, scor gzas mainc` ar daadgebian arasodes.

da sheni g'mert`i [o, shuamavalo] mpatiebelia, cqalobis mp`lobeli. rom daesaja isini imisat`vis, rac` moixveches, dauch`k`arebda sasjels, magram mat` dat`k`muli dro ak`vt` [gansjis dg'e] da ver ipovian misgan t`avshesap`ars
da es sop`lebi davg'upet` imisat`vis, rom usamart`lod moik`c`nen da davadginet` zhami mat`i ag'sasrulisa [romelic`, roc`a dgeboda, allahis sasjeli gardmodioda].

da ut`xra [shuamavalma] musam t`avis msaxurs: ar gavch`erdebi, vidre ar mivag'cev ort`ave zg'vis shesart`avs, an vivli clebi (rat`a shevxvde im g'vt`ismosavs, romlisganac` viscavli imas, rac` ar vic`i)
da roc`a miag'cies shesart`avs mat` shoris, daivicqes t`aviant`i t`evzi, da aig'o t`avisi gza [gaeshura] zg'vashi, t`it`k`os igi gvirabshi dac`uravda.
da roc`a gadalaxes (is adgili sadac` t`evzi daavicqdat`) ut`xra t`avis msaxurs: mogvart`vi ch`veni sadili. am mgzavrobit` z'alian davig'alet`

[musas msaxurma] ut`xra: gaxsovs, rogor shevap`aret` t`avi im kldes? namdvilad, me damavicqda (met`k`va shent`vis), rac` t`evzs daemart`a. da mxolod satanam maiz'ula damvicqeboda igi, rat`a ar met`k`va [shent`vis] amis shesaxeb. da t`evzma aig'o t`avisi gza zg'vashi saoc`ari p`ormit`

[shuamavalma musam t`k`va: ai es aris zustad is, rasac` vez'ebdit` [radgan rac` moxda, man mimanishna im adgilze, sadac` unda shevxvde im g'vt`ismosavs]. da orive isini dabrundnen ukan (im kldisken) t`aviant` kvalze mimqolni.

da mat` [musam da iusha'ma] ik` ipoves ert`i ch`veni morch`ili [g'vt`ismosavi xidri], romelsac` ch`ven mivanichet` ch`veni cqaloba da vascavlet` ch`vengan (ert`) c`odnas [mist`vis gavxsenit` dap`aruli, saidumlo c`odna].
da ut`xra musam: sheiz'leba t`u ara, rom shen mogqve, rat`a mascavlo im c`odnidan, rac` shen mogec`a scor gzaze?
(xadrma) ut`xra (musas): namdvilad, shen ver shez'leb ch`emt`an ert`ad sachiro mot`minebis gamovlenas
da rogor shez'leb (o, musa) mot`minebas imaze, rasac` ar p`lob c`odnit` [rac` shen ar ic`i ]?

[shuamavalma musam] ut`xra: shen mpoveb me, inshaallah, mot`minebit` ag'savses [imis mimart`, rasac` shengan vixilav],
da ar shegecinaag'mdegebi arc` ert` shens sak`meshi
xidirma ut`xra [musas]: t`u gamomqvebi, arap`ris shesaxeb ar mkit`xo, vidre t`vit`on ar shegaxseneb
da gaeshurnen, rogorc` ki xomaldze avidnen man gaxvrita igi; hkit`xa: gana imist`vis gaxvrite is, rom ch`agez'ira misi mgzavrebi? namdvilad shen ch`aidine mz'ime sak`me
(xidirma) ut`xra: nut`u ar git`xari, rom ver shez'leb ch`emt`an mot`minebas?
[musam] ut`xra: nu gamkic`xav imis gamo, rom damavicqda, da nu damimateb ch`emi sak`misat`vis simz'imeso

da ganagrz'es gzas [musa da xadiri], da roc`a shexvdnen ert` bichs [romelic` t`amashobda sxva bavshvebt`an ert`ad], man [xadirma] mokla igi, [musam] t`k`va: nut`u shen mokali umanko suli ara samagierod [ara sulis cil]? namdvilad, shen ch`aidine metad gaumart`lebeli da dagmobili sak`me!
(xidirma) ut`xra: nut`u ar git`xari, rom ver shez'leb ch`emt`an mot`minebas?
[musam] t`k`va: t`u amis shemdeg kidev rameze gkit`xav, nu amiqvan shens t`anamgzavrad [damtove] da shen miig'e ch`emgan gamart`leba.

da gaemart`nen [musa da xidri], vidre ert`i sop`lis binadrebs shexvdebodnen. sachmeli st`xoves mis binadart`; mat` ki uari ut`xres, rom gamaspinz'lebodnen. da naxes [dainaxes] ik` kedeli, romelic` ch`amongrevis piras iqo. xolo iman gaascora igi. ut`xra[musam]: t`u shen moindomebdi, namdvilad aig'ebdi amis sanac`vlod anazg'aurebas.
[xidrma] miugo [musas]: es ki namdvilad ganshorebaa ch`emi da sheni, me shen gac`nobeb ganmartebas imisas, risi mot`menac` ver shez'eli
rac` sheexeba xomalds, igi ekut`vnoda g'aribebs, romelnic` mushaobdnen zg'vashi. me msurda xomaldis dazianeba, radgan mat` ukan mep`e iqo, romelic` iz'ulebit` it`visebda qvela xomalds
rac` sheexeba qmacvils, misi mshoblebi morcmuneni iqvnen, da ch`ven shevshindit` [vic`odit`], rom t`u igi [ic`oc`xlebda] moutanda zians mat` zg'vargadasulobit`a da urcmunoebit`
da ch`ven gvsurda, rom sanac`vlod [anu mokvluli qmacvilis sanac`vlod] miec`a mat`t`vis mat` g'mert`s uket`esi sicmindit` da up`ro axlo mocqalebast`an

rac` sheexeba kedels, igi ekut`vnoda or obol qmacvils am k`alak`shi, mis k`vesh ki iqo ganz'i mat`t`vis, mat`i mama mart`ali kac`i iqo da amitomac` shenma g'mert`ma isurva, rom mat` srulclovanebamde mieg'ciat`, mere ki amoeg'ot` t`aviant`i ganz'i mocqalebit` sheni g'mert`isagan. da rac` me gavaket`e -- es ar iqo ch`emi gadacqvetilebit` [sakut`ari survilit`], aramed allahis brz'anebit`. ai, esaa ganmarteba imisa, risi mot`menac` ver shez'eli.
da gekit`xebian [mravalg'mert`ianebi da iudevelebi] shen [o, shuamavalo] zulqarnainis shesaxeb. ut`xari [mat`]: me cagikit`xavt` t`k`ven mis shesaxeb shexsenebas
ch`ven igi [zul-qarnanini] davamkvidret` k`veqanaze da vuboz'et` mas gza qovelivesaken [qvelap`eri, rac` mas schirdeboda t`avisi miznis misag'cevad magalit`ad, c`odna, unarebi, z'ala...].
da is ert` gzas gauqva

vidre mzis dasavals miag'cevda da dainaxa, rom igi ch`adioda c`xel, amg'vreul cqarost`valshi, romelt`anac` naxa xalxi. vut`xarit`: hei zulqarnain, an dasji [t`u ar ircmuneben], an daadgen mat`shi siket`es [moucodeb rcmenisken da ascavlo cheshmariti gza]

[zul-qarnainma] t`k`va: rac` sheexeba imas, vinc` usamart`lod [sakut`ar t`avt`an kerpt`aqvanisc`emlobit`] ik`c`eva, davsjit` [amk`veqnad], shemdgom dabrunebul ik`nebian t`aviant` g'mert`t`an da igi dasjis mas sashineli sasjelit` [jojoxet`it`]
rac` sheexeba imas, vinc` ircmuna da ket`ili sak`meni aket`a, miegeba sauket`eso sazg'auri [samot`xe]. da vetqvit` mas ch`veni brz'anebshi siadviles
shemdeg is [zulqarnaini] gzas gaudga

rodesac` is [zul-qarnaini] mzis amosvlis adgilamde mivida man dainaxa, rom mze amodioda xalxze, vist`visac` ch`ven ar gvk`onia shek`mnili mzisgan dasap`ari arap`eri [ mat` ar hk`ondat` arc` shenobebi, arc` xeebi, romlebic` mzisgan dap`aravdnen]

amrigad [is asamart`lebda xalxs, romlebic` c`xovrobdnen mzis amosvlis mxares, iseve rogorc` mat`, vinc` iqo mzis ch`asvlis mxares]. da ch`ven garemovic`avit` qvelap`eri c`odnit`, rac` mast`an iqo [vic`odit` misi xelmcip`obis lashk`risa da ag'churvilobis shesaxeb]
shemdeg is [zulqarnaini] gzas gaudga
vidre miag'cevda or cinag'obas [mt`as] shoris. da naxa mat` shoris xalxi, romlebsac` z'livs esmodat` [sxva adamiant`a saubari]

mat` ut`xres: hei zulqarnain, cheshmaritad, iajuji da majuji k`veqanaze siaves avrc`eleben [xoc`avdnen adamianebs da anadgurebdnen nat`esebs]. da xom ar shegvekriba shent`vis gadasaxadi, rat`a ag'gemart`a ch`vensa da mat` shoris zg'ude?

[zul-qarnainma] ut`xra: is, razedac` gamamtkic`a ch`emma g'mert`ma [momanicha mmart`veloba da shesaz'leblobebi], uket`esia [vidre t`k`veni k`oneba]. shemeciet` z'alit`[mushaxelit` da samushao iarag'it`] da me ag'vmart`av t`k`vensa da mat` shoris zg'udes.

momitanet` rkinis nachrebi, roc`a ukve ag'avso[gaat`anabra msheneblobit`] or kldis shorisi! t`k`va: dahberet`! da roc`a man ak`c`ia igi c`ec`xlad, t`k`va: momitanet`, gadavasxam amas gamdnar spilenz's!
da ver shez'les [iajuj-majujebma] mis gadalaxva da ver shez'les misi gaxvretac`.

[zul-qarnainma] t`k`va: es aris cqaloba ch`emi g'mert`isgan [adamianebze]. da roc`a ag'sruldeba ag't`k`ma ch`emi g'mert`isa [iajujisa da majujis gamosvlaze], igi mas micast`an gaascorebs, da ch`emi g'mert`is ag't`k`ma cheshmaritebaa

da davtovebt` [iajujsa da majujs,an zogadad adamianebs, an adamianebs da jinebs] mat` im dg'es ert`manet`shi areulebs[rogorc` zg'vis talg'ebi ert`manet`shi], ch`aberil ik`neba saqvirshi, mashin shevkrebt` qvelas ert`ad [qvela k`mnilebas angarishscorebist`vis]
da im dg'es [gansjis dg'es], urcmunoebs jojoxet`s carvudgent`
mat`, romelt`ac` t`valebze edot` saburveli [amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi] ch`emi xsenebisgan da mat` mosmenac` ki ar sheez'lot` [argumentebi, romlebic` cheshmarit rcmenas ut`it`eben gzas]
gana egonat` imat`, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes, rom daidgenen ch`ems msaxurebs ch`ems magivrad mp`arvelebad? cheshmaritad, ch`ven gavumzadet` urcmunoebs jojoxet`i gansasveneblad
ut`xari [o shuamavalo] [xalxs]: xom ar gvec`nobebina t`k`vent`vis sak`meebshi qvelaze up`ro xelmoc`arult`a shesaxeb
romelt`a mc`delobac` amao ik`na amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi, t`umc`a ki t`vit`on miich`neven, rom karg sak`mes aket`eben

scored isini arian, vinc` uarqves t`avisi g'mert`is aiat`ebi da mast`an shexvedra; p`uchi ik`neba mat`i sak`meni da ag'dgomis dg'es mat`t`vis sascors ar gavshlit` [mat`i ket`ili sak`meebi arap`ers aiconian]
es aris mat`i sazg'auri: jojoxet`i, imis gamo, rom ar ircmunes, da ch`emi sascaulebi da shuamavlebi sasac`ilodac` gaixades
cheshmaritad, mat`, romelt`ac` ircmunes da ket`ili sak`meebi aket`es, ek`nebat` p`irdavsis [qvelaze umag'lesi samot`xe] samot`xe samkvidrod
isini ik` [samot`xeshi] darch`ebian samudamod da ar moindomeben ik`idan sxvagan gadasvlas[samot`xis bag'ebidan]

ut`xari [o, shuamavalo]: zg'va rom melnad ik`c`es ch`emi g'mert`is sitqvebist`vis, zg'va manam daishreteboda, vidre ch`emi g'mert`is sitqvebi amoicureboda, t`undac` mas davumatot` kidev ert`i msgavsi zg'va

ut`xari [o, shuamavalo] [mravalg'mert`ianebs]: me mxolod adamiani var. t`k`veni msgavsi da zesht`amegona, rom t`k`veni g'mert`i ert`adert`i g'mert`ia. da iman, vinc` imedovnebs t`avis g'mert`t`an shexvedras, dae mart`ali sak`me aket`os da nuravis daudgens t`anaziarad t`avis g'mert`s t`aqvanisc`emashi [dae, miuz'g'vnas t`avisi msaxureba mxolod ert` allahs]
k`aap`, ha, ia, 'aiin, saad
esa aris gaxseneba sheni g'mert`is mocqalebisa [o, shuamavalo] t`avisi msaxuris zak`ariasadmi
da mouxmo [vedrebit`] man [zak`ariam] t`avis g'mert`s saidumlod.
ut`xra [zak`ariam]: g'mert`o ch`emo, damiuz'lurda z'vlebi da t`avic`[g'rmad] gamichag'aravda, me ki ar vqop`ilvar shendami vedrebisas ubeduri [shen qovelt`vis pasuxobdi ch`ems verebas]

me meshinia ch`emi nat`esavebis ch`ems shemdgom [ch`ems sikvdils shemdeg] [rom isini ag'ar daic`aven shen mier monichebul rcmenas ise, rogorc` sachiroa, da ag'ar moucodeben shens monebs am rcmenisken]. xolo ch`emi c`oli unaqop`oa. mash, gviboz'e sheni ciag'idan sht`amomavali [shvili, romelic` damexmareboda].

romelic` miig'ebs memkvidreobas ch`emsgan [c`odnas, cinascarmetqvelebas da sibrz'nes] da ik`neba memkvidre [shuamavali] ia'qubis saxleulis. ak`c`ie igi [momavali bavshvi], g'mert`o ch`emo, (shendami) kmaqop`ilad [siqvarulit` gamorch`eulad mat`i rcmenisa da zneobis gamo]
hei zak`aria, ch`ven, gaxarebt` shen z'it`, romlis saxelia iahia. ucin ki es saxeli aravis utarebia
miugo [zak`ariam]: g'mert`o ch`emo, rogor meqoleba z'e, roc`a ch`emi c`oli unaqop`oa da me mivag'cie g'rma moxuc`ebulobas?!
ut`xra [angelozma]: amgvarad ambobs sheni g'mert`i, is advilia ch`emt`viso! me aseve shegk`meni shen ucin, roc`a arap`eri iqavi

[zak`ariam] ut`xra: g'mert`o, momec`i me nishani! [imis dasadastureblad, rac` angelozebma mac`nobes cheshmaritad] miugo: sheni nishani ik`neba is, rom ar daelaparakebi xalxs sami g'amis ganmavlobashi, sruliad janmrt`eli

da gamovida [zak`aria] t`avisi xalxis cinashe mihrabidan da sht`aagona mat`[minishnebit`,saubris gareshe]: ganadidet` [allahi] dilit` da sag'amos [madlierebis nishnad misadmi, imis gamo, rom man k`velmok`medeba gamoavlina mis da mat`i mimart` da mouvlina mat` cinascarmetqveli]

[da roc`a iahia gaizarda, uzenaesma allahma ubrz'ana mas] hei iahia, aig'e cigni [t`ora] mtkic`ed [ic`ode misi shinaarsi, ch`acvdit` mis mnishvnelobas da imok`mede shesabamisad]! ch`ven mas [iahias] vuboz'et` sibrz'ne, qrmobashive
[da aseve ch`ven vucqalobet`] lmobiereba [xalxisadmi] ch`veni ciag'idan da silag'e. da igi iqo g'vt`ismoshishi.
ket`ili mshoblebis mimart` da ar qop`ila moz'alade, urch`i [allahisa da shemdeg misi mshoblebis mimart`]
mshvidoba mas [iahias] dg'es, roc`a daibada, dg'es, roc`a mokvdeba, da dg'es, roc`a ag'dgenili ik`neba c`oc`xlad [gankit`xvis dg'es].
da gaaxsene [o, shuamavalo] [mouqevi xalxs] istoria, romelic` cignshi [quranshi] aris moqvanili mariamis shesaxeb. ai, man datova t`avisi ojaxi da cavida ag'mosavlet` mxares mdebare adgilas.
da is daimala mat`gan [xalxisgan] p`ardis mig'ma. shemdeg ki mivavlinet` mast`an ch`veni suli [anu angelozi jibrili], da is carudga mas srulqop`ili adamianis saxit`
ut`xra [mariamma] [ip`ik`ra, rom es iqo kac`i boroti ganzraxvebit`]: me mivekedlebi mocqales [allahs] shengan, t`uki shen xar g'vt`ismoshishi.
man [angelozma jibrilma] t`k`va: me mxolod sheni g'mert`is gzavnili var da movedi, rat`a gach`uk`o spetaki vazhi.
ut`xra [mariamma]: rogor meqoleba z'e, roc`a kac`i ar shemxebia da ar vqop`ilvar garqvnili?
ut`xra mas [jibrilma]: amgvarad t`k`va shenma g'mert`ma es advilia ch`emt`vis. da davadgent` mas sascaulad xalxisat`vis da mocqalebad ch`veni ciag'idan, sak`me ukve gadacqvetilia
da dap`exmz'imda [mariami][mas shemdeg, rac` angelozma jibrilma ch`abera masshi suli misi samosis saxelos meshveobit`] igi da ganmartovda misit` ert` moshorebul adgilas.
da [mariami] mshobiarobis tkivilebma ert`i palmis z'iras miiqvana. t`k`va: netav momkvdariqavi amaze ucin da vqop`iliqav migdebuli, davicqebuli sruliad
da mimart`a man [misma axalshobilma shvilma] mas [mariams] k`vemodan: nu cuxxar! shenma g'mert`ma shens p`exk`vesh [shent`vis] cqaro hk`mna.
shensken miirxie palmis toti, rat`a ch`amoc`vivdes shent`anaxali mcip`e naqop`i [p`iniki]

chame [p`iniki], svi [cqali] da moimxiarule sheni t`valebi[nu cuxxar], xolo t`u shegxvda vinme xalxt`agani, ase ut`xari: me cheshmaritad mocqales mivec`i ag't`k`ma marxvisa da dg'es arc`ert` adamis shvils ar davelaparakebi
da [mariamma] mouqvana igi [ch`vili] t`avis xalxs. ut`xres: hei mariam, gasaoc`ari ram ch`agidenia[bavshvi rom moiqvane gat`xovebis gareshe].
harunis dao, mamasheni avi kac`i ar qop`ila da arc` dedasheni qop`ila gauconascorebeli k`ali [mrushobashi shemch`neuli]
xolo k`alma [mariamma] mat` anishna masze [t`avis shvil isaze]. ut`xres: rogor davelaparakot` imas, vinc` ch`vilia, akvanshio?
ut`xra [shuamavalma isam]: me allahis mona var, man miboz'a cigni [saxareba] da damadgina shuamavlad
da mak`c`ia daloc`vilad [romlisganac` momdinareobs siket`e da sargebeli], sadac` ar unda viqo, da mibrz'ana loc`va da mocqalebis gag'eba, sanam c`oc`xali vik`nebi
da man [ch`emma g'mert`ma] mibrz'ana, rom ket`ili vqop`iliqavi ch`emi dedis mimart` da ar gavmxdariqavi mch`agvreli [ampartavani] ubeduri
mshvidoba im dg'es, roc`a davibade, dg'es, roc`a movkvdebi, da dg'es, roc`a ag'dgenili vik`nebi c`oc`xlad
ai es aris 'isa mariamis z'e - cheshmaritebis sitqva, romelshic` mat` [iudevelebs da k`ristianebs] echvi eparebat`

ar sheshvenis allahs, rom shvili daidginos [cmindaa amisgan]. dideba mas! roc`a gadacqvets sak`mes, sakmarisia ut`xras mas: iqav, da ik`neba [amitom, qovlis shemz'le da qovlad cminda ar sachiroebs shvils].
[ da ut`xra shuamavalma isam,iesom] [t`avis xalxs] cheshmaritad, allahia ch`emi g'mert`ic` da t`k`veni g'mert`ic`, amitom mas et`aqvanet`, esaa scori gza.
da ganxet`k`ilebashi ch`avardnen dajgup`ebebi cignis xalxi ert`manet`t`an (iesos cinascarmetqvelebis shesaxeb). vai urcmunoebs im didi dg'is gamo [roc`a qvelap`eri gamoashkaravdeba da daisjebian]
rogor mkap`iod mousmenen da dainaxaven im dg'es roc`a ch`vens cinashe cardgebian! magram usamart`loni dg'es c`xad gzaabneulobashi arian
da sheagone [o shuamavalo] isini sinanulis dg'it`, roc`a sak`me gadacqvetili ik`neba, magram isini ugulisxmoni arian da ar scamt`
cheshmaritad, ch`ven davimkvidrebt` micas da imat`, vinc` maszea, da isini ch`vent`an ik`nebian dabrunebulni [gankit`xvis dg'es].
da gaxsene [o, shuamavalo] [mouqevi mat`] cignshi [quranshi] moqvanili ambavi ibrahimis shesaxeb. igi iqo cheshmaritad gulcrp`eli shuamavali.
aki ut`xra man [ibrahimma] t`avis mamas: mamach`emo, ratom et`aqvanebi imas [kerpebs], rac` ver ismens, ver xedavs da aranairi sargebeli ar moak`vs shent`vis?
hei mamiko, me meboz'a c`odna [allahisgan], romelic` ar mosula shent`an, momqevi, me gagiz'g'vebi scori gzit`!
hei mamiko! nu et`aqvanebi eshmaks [ar daemorch`ilo mis mocodebas kerpebis t`aqvanisc`emisken]! eshmaki mocqalis mimart` urch`ia
hei mamach`emo! meshinia, rom dagatqdeba sasjeli mocqalisagan da gaxdebi eshmakis megobari [jojoxet`shi]
miugo [ibrahimis mamam]: gana ch`ems g'vt`aebebs ukuagdeb, hei ibrahim?! gons t`u ar moegebi, usat`uod ch`agk`olav, axla ki momc`ildi didi xnit`
ut`xra [ibrahimma]: mshvidoba shenda! me patiebas vit`xov shent`vis ch`emi g'mert`isagan. igi ch`ems mimart` lmobieria.

da me gagec`lebi t`k`ven da imat`, rasac` mouxmobt` allahis magivrad [c`ru g'mert`ebis]. da me shevevedrebi ch`ems g'mert`s. ch`emi g'mert`isadmi vedrebit` ubeduri ar vik`nebi [vimedovneb, rom igi miig'ebs ch`ems vedrebas]
xolo roc`a [ibrahimi] gasc`ilda mat` [mamas da mat` xalxs] da imat`, rasac` isini et`aqvanebodnen allahis magivrad, vuboz'et` mas ishaqi da ia'qubi da oriveni davadginet` shuamavlebad
da ch`ven vucqalobet` mat` [ibrahims, ishaqs, iaqubs da mat` sht`amomavlobas] vuboz'et` mat` ch`veni mocqaleba da mivec`it` mat` simart`lis ena.
da gaixsene [o, shuamavalo] [mouqevi xalxs] cignshi [quranshi] moqvanili istoria musas shesaxeb. namdvilad, is iqo rch`euli shuamavali da mac`ne
da movuxmet` mas turis[mt`is] marjvena mxridan da daviaxlovet` igi saidumlo saubrist`vis [ch`vent`an]
da vuboz'et` ch`veni ciag'idan t`avisi z'ma [musas], haruni, shuamavlad
da axsene [o, shuamavalo] cignshi [quranshi] [shuamavali] isma'ili. igi iqo ag't`k`mis ert`guli da iqo shuamavali, moc`ik`uli.
igi [shuamavali ismaili] ubrz'anebda t`avis xalxs loc`vas da zek`at`s, da man miag'cia t`avis g'mert`t`an kmaqop`ilebas [allahi iqo mat`it` kmaqop`ili]
da axsene [o, shuamavalo] [mouqevi mat`] cignshi [quranshi] moqvanili ambavi idrisis shesaxeb. igi iqo cheshmaritad gulcrp`eli shuamavali.
da ag'vamag'let` igi mag'al adgilze [masze mxolod ket`ils amboben da igi ik`neba mag'al samot`xis bag'ebshi]!

scored eseni arian, visac` cqaloba uboz'a allahma shuamavalt`agan, adamis sht`amomavalt`agan, da[imat`i sht`amomavalt`agan] vinc` gadaviqvanet` nuht`an ert`ad, ibrahimis da isma'ilis
sht`amomavlebidan; imat`gan, vinc` scor gzaze davaqenet` da gamovarch`iet`, roc`a ekit`xebodat` mat` mocqalis aiat`ebi, tirilit` sejdeze emxobodnen
mat` shemdgom movidnen sht`amomavlebi, romelt`ac` miatoves loc`va da ahqvnen vnebebs, male ki gadaeqrebian carumateblobas da dag'upvas jojoxet`shi
imat` garda, vinc` moinania [t`avisi c`odvebi], ircmuna da siket`e aket`a. isini shevlen samot`xeshi da ar sheexebat` usamart`loba [mat`i ket`ili sak`meebi ar daknindeba.]
edemis bag'ebshi, romelt`ac` mocqale dahpirda t`avis msaxurebs uxilavad [radgan mat` ar uxilavt` samot`xe, magram ircmunes allahi da misi sitqva]., da aha, misi ag't`k`ma ag'sruldeba
da ar gaigoneben [samot`xis mkvidrni] ik` amao sitqvas [c`ru da usargeblo sitqvebs], garda mshvidobas! - da ek`nebat` sarch`o dila-sag'amos [mudam, roc`a isurveben]
es samot`xea, romelsac` davumkvidrebt` ch`vens msaxurt`agan imas, vinc` iqo g'vt`ismoshishi [allahis sasjelis shishit` da misi brz'anebebis shesrulebit` imisgan moshorebit`, rac` man akrz'ala].

[o, jibril ut`xari shuamavals] ch`ven mxolod sheni g'mert`is brz'anebit` gardmovevlinebit`. mas [allahs] ekut`vnis, rac` ch`vens cinaa [qvela sak`me, romelic` maradiul c`xovrebashi ik`neba], rac` shemdegaa [is sak`meebi, romlebic` ukve carsulshi darch`a amk`veqnad] da rac` amat` shorisaa, [o shuamavalo] sheni g'mert`i ki ar aris mavicqi [arap`eri avicqdeba].

igia [allahi] g'mert`i [shemk`mneli da mmart`veli] c`at`a da k`veqnisa da imis, rac` amat` shorisaa. t`aqvani ec`i mas da iqavi momt`meni mis t`aqvanisc`emashi. gana ic`i vinme misi msgavsi [vis ek`neboda igive saxelebi da t`visebebi, an msgavsi; t`aqvanis c`emis g'irsi ]?
da ambobs [urcmuno] adamiani [sikvdilis shemdeg ag'dgomis uarqop`it`]: gana roc`a movkvdebi, mere ag'dgenili vik`nebi c`oc`xlad?!
nut`u ar gaixsenebs adamiani, rom ch`ven pirvelad shevk`menit` igi, mashin roc`a manamde igi saert`od ar arsebobda?
da [me allahi] vp`ic`av [o, shuamavalo] shens g'mert`s, usat`uod shevkrebt` mat` da eshmakebs, shemdeg ki, jojoxet`is garshemo moxlis ch`ok`ebze moviqvant` mat`.
da [me allahi vp`ic`av], rom mere gamovqop`t` qoveli jgup`idan imat`, romelnic` umtkic`esi iqvnen mocqalis mimart` urch`obashi
shemdeg ki ch`ven uechvelad qvelaze uket` vic`it` isini, vinc` dacvis g'irsni arian [jojoxet`shi]!

da aravinaa t`k`vengan [o, adamianno], rom ar gaiaros is [jojoxet`i] [qoveli adamiani gaivlis im xidze, romelic` gadachimulia jojoxet`ze, urcmunoni mashinve ch`avardebian jojoxet`shi, xolo morcmuneni mas gadalaxaven iset`i siscrap`it`, rogorac` mat`i ket`ili sak`meebi sheesabameba]. es sheni g'mert`is mier usat`uod gadacqvetilia
shemdeg ki gadavarch`ent` imat` romelnic` [amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi], iqvnen g'vt`ismoshishni, usamart`loebs [urcmunoebs] ki, ik`ve davtovebt` [jojoxet`shi] muxlebze dach`ok`ilt`

da roc`a mat` [adamianebs] ekit`xebat` ch`veni c`xadi aiat`ebi [qurani], eubnebian isini, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes, imat`, vinc` ircmuna, ort`agan [morcmunet`a da urcmunot`a] romeli jgup`ia uket`esi adgilit` da umjobesia shemadgenlobit`o [am k`veqnad]?!
da ramdeni t`aoba davg'upet` [am urcmunoebamde] mat`ze ucin, romelnic` shemadgenlobit`ac` [up`ro mdidarni] da ierit`ac` [ag'nagobit`] uket`esni iqvnen

ut`xari [o, shuamavalo] imat`, vinc` aris gzaabnevashi: mocqale gauxangrz'livebt` dros [gzabnevashi], vidre ar naxaven imas, rac` ag'vut`k`vit` [ag'ut`k`va allahma], an sasjels [am k`veqnad], anda saat`s [gankit`xvis dg'es], da gaigeben, vin aris up`ro c`udi adgilit`a da up`ro susti lashk`rit`.
da miumatebs allahi cheshmaritebas mat`, romelnic` cheshmaritebas mihqvnen, ket`ili sak`meebi uket`esia sheni g'mert`is cinashe jildot`i da uket`esia sazg'aurit`

gana ginaxavs [o, shuamavalo] is, vinc` ar ircmuna ch`veni aiat`ebi [igulisxmeba urcmuno al-'as bin uaili da misnairebi], rodesac` man t`k`va: namdvilad, samaradiso c`xovrebashi mec` ki momenicheba simdidrec` da sht`amomavlobac`!
gana sheitqo man [am urcmunom] dap`aruli, anda mocqalisgan ag't`k`ma miig'o?
ara da ara! ch`avicert` imas, rasac` ambobs, da gavuxangrz'livebt` sasjels gaxangrz'livebit`
ch`ven vimemkvidrebt` imas, rasac` ambobs [misi k`oneba da shvilebi, rac` am k`veqnad hk`onda, ch`vent`an darch`eba], da mova [gankit`xvis dg'es] ch`vens cinashe martod
da daidgines [mravalg'mert`ianebma] allahis garda g'vt`aebebi, rat`a qop`iliqvnen isini [c`ru g'vt`aebebi] damxmareni?

aramc` da aramc`! [ar ik`neba ise, rogorc` isini p`ik`roben]
mat` mier t`aqvanc`emuli [c`ru g'vt`aebebi] uarqop`en mat` t`aqvanisc`emas da gauxdebian mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] mterebad [gankit`xvis dg'es].
nut`u ar ginaxavs [o, shuamavalo] [anu gana ar ic`i], rom ch`ven mivavlinet` eshmakebi urcmunoebze, rat`a isini gamudmebit` ubiz'gebdnen mat` (c`odvebisa da gzakargulobisken)?
da nu ich`k`areb [o, shuamavalo] [mat`i ganadgurebis survilit`] mat` cinaag'mdeg! ch`ven ag'vric`xavt` mat` ric`xvs [vut`vlit`, ramdeni dro darch`at` c`xovrebashi da ramdeni sak`me ch`aidines]
im dg'es, shevkrebt` g'vt`ismoshishebs mocqalis cinashe pativisc`emuli delegac`iit`
da gavdevnit` c`odvilebs [urcmunoebs] jojoxet`shi da gavdevnit` urch`ebs [urcmunoebs] jojoxet`isken, ise rogorc` [sak`onels mierekebian] mdinarisaken.
aravis ek`neba shuamdgomloba imis garda, vinc` miig'o ag't`k`ma mocqalisagan [morcmuneebis garda]
da t`k`ves [urcmunoebma]: mocqalem aiqvana shvili
cheshmaritad didi ram t`k`vit`! [mag nat`k`vamit` sashineli ram ch`aidinet`].
am sitqvebis gamo c`a lamisaa daishalos, mica gaibzaros, da mt`ebi ik`c`es mtvrad
imis gamo, rom mat` [urcmunoebma] mocqales [allahs] shvili miaceres
da ar sheep`ereba mocqales [allahs], rom shvili aiqvanos! [es ar sheep`ereba mis sidiades, is aravis da arap`ers ar sachiroebs].
qoveli, vinc` c`at`a shinaa [qvela angelozi] da k`veqanasa zedaa [qvela adamiani da jini], mocqalis cinashe carsdgeba rogorc` mona.
vp`ic`av, man ag'ric`xa isini da dat`vala dat`vlit` [man ic`is, ramdeni k`mnileba hqavda da eqoleba, da qvelap`eri, rac` mat` ch`audeniat`].
da mat` qvelani mast`an carsdgebian ag'dgomis dg'es t`it`o-t`it`od [t`it`oeuli c`alke].
cheshmaritad, romelt`ac` ircmunes da siket`e aket`es [asrulebdnen imas, rac` allahma ubrz'ana, da eridebodnen imas, rac` man akrz'ala], daajildovebs mocqale mat` siqvarulit`! [t`avis monebs]
ch`ven gavaiolet` igi [qurani] sheni [o, shuamavalo] enit` [arabulad], rat`a axaro misit` g'vt`ismoshishebs da gaap`rt`xilo misit` urch`i xalxi [urcmunoni].
da ramdeni [urcmunot`a] t`aoba gavanadguret` mat`ze ucin! nut`u shen [o, shuamavalo] grz'nob romelime mat`ganis? an gesmis mat`gan t`undac` umc`iresi xmauri?
taha
ar gardmogvivlenia shenze [o, shuamavalo] qurani imist`vis, rom ubeduri iqo [imis gamo, rom ver shez'lebdi misi shesrulebas]
aramed mxolod shegonebad mat`t`vis, visac` eshinia [allahis sasjelis]
[da es qurani carmoadgens] zegardmovlenilia imisgan, vinc` shek`mna mica da c`ani mag'alni.
mocqale [allahi] amag'lda taxtze [rogorc` es sheep`ereba mxolod mis sidiades]
mas ekut`vnis qvelap`eri, rac` c`at`a shinaa da rac` k`veqanasa zedaa, rac` amat` shorisaa, da rac` micis k`veshaa
da t`u shen xmamag'la ambob sat`k`mels, man xom ic`is saidumloc` da qvelaze up`ro dap`arulic`
ar aris g'vt`aeb [t`aqvanisc`emis g'irsi], garda misi allahisa! mas ak`vs umshvenieresi saxelebi!
movida [o, shuamavalo] shenamde [shuamavali] musas ambavi?

ert`xel [g'amit`] [madianidan egvipteshi dabrunebisas] (musam), dainaxa c`ec`xli, mashin ut`xra t`avis ojaxs: ak` darch`it`! uechvelad, me c`ec`xli davinaxe. ik`neb mogitanot` misgan nakverch`xali [c`ec`xlis alit`] an vipovo c`ec`xlt`an scori gza [vkit`xo xalxs, sait` cavide scorad]
roc`a mivida mast`an, xma gaisma: hei, musa
cheshmaritad, me sheni g'mert`i [allahi] var. gaixade sheni ori p`exsac`meli, ramet`u shen imqop`ebi tuvas cminda xeobashi.
me gamogarch`ie shen [o, musa], da sheismine is, rac` zesht`agegoneba
cheshmaritad me var allahi! ar arsebobs [g'irseuli sat`aqvanebeli] g'vt`aeba, ch`ems garda. t`aqvani mec` da loc`vad dadek`i ch`ems saxseneblad!

cheshmaritad, dadgeba is saat`i (ag'dgomis dro), roc`a adamianebi gac`oc`xldebian, da vmalam mis shesaxeb c`nobas, ramet`u unda miegos qvela suls is, riskenac` miiscrap`oden [amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi]
da nu mogcqveten [o, musa] misgan [ag'sasrulis dg'is rcmenisa da am rcmenisamebr k`medebebisgan] isini, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes misi da aqolilia vnebebs, rat`a ar dagg'upon
da ra gak`vs marjvenashi, hei musa? [uzenaesi allahi miut`it`ebs musas mis joxze]
miugo [musam]: es ch`emi kvert`xia, romelsac` veqrdnobi, xet`a p`ot`lebs vubertqav misit` ch`ems c`xvrebs da sxva sargebelnic` aris masshi ch`emt`vis
ut`xra [allahma]: gadaagde igi, hei musa.
gadaagdo da igi [kvert`xi] ik`c`a gvelad da gasrialda.
ut`xra [allahma]: aig'e igi da nu geshinia. ch`ven davubrunebt` mas pirvandel saxes
da shemoicqe [o, musa] xeli ig'liis k`vesh; igi gamova t`et`ri, qovelgvari siavis gareshe, ch`vens[meore] sascaulad
rat`a gich`venot` shen [o, musa] udidesi ch`vens sascault`agan.
cadi [o, musa] p`araont`an, igi zg'vars gadavida
ut`xra [musa]: g'mert`o ch`emo. gamip`art`ove ch`emi guli [amomac`ile qvelap`eri, rac` xels mishlis cinascarmetqveluri movaleobis shesrulebashi da sirt`uleebis atanashi]
da gaadvile ch`emi sak`me
da moxseni dabrkoleba ch`emi enidan.
rat`a gaigon ch`emi nat`k`vami
da damidgine damxmared ch`emi saxleulidan.
haruni, ch`emi z'ma [radgan is up`ro mchevrmetqvelia, vidre me]
da gamimagre [harunis meshveobit`] misit` zurgi
da t`anamonaciled mik`c`ie igi ch`ems sak`meshi [cinascarmetqvelur misiashi da cheshmaritebis k`adagebashi]
rat`a gadidot` shen bevrjer
da gagixsenot` bevrjer
ramet`u shen gvxedav ch`ven
ut`xra [allahma]: hei musa! shen geboz'a [qvelap`eri] is, rac` it`xove.
da vp`ic`av, [o, musa] ch`ven ucinac` cqaloba giqavit`
roc`a zesht`avagonet` dedashens is, rac` zesht`avagonet`.

rom - ch`asvi kidobanshi da ch`aagde mdinareshi; mdinare mas napirt`an gariqavs, rat`a aiqvanos igi iman, vinc` mteria ch`emi da mteria misi. da me gadmovp`ine shenze ch`emi siqvaruli, rat`a ch`amoqalibebuliqavi ch`ems t`valcin.

cavida sheni da, da ut`xra: xom ar mimescavlebina t`k`vent`vis igi, vinc` mas ch`aibarebs? da dagabrunet` dedashent`an, rat`a damshvidebuliqo igi da ar enag'vla. da mokali shen kac`i, xolo ch`ven gixsenit` mcuxarebisgan da gamogc`adet` gansac`delebit`. clebis manz'ilze darch`i medienis xalxshi; mere ki moxvedi dadgenil dros, hei musa
da me gamogarch`ie shen ch`emt`vis! [gamogarch`ie ch`emi sitqvis gadasac`emad]
cadit` shen [o, musa] da sheni z'ma ch`emi sascaulebit` da nu ik`nebit` uz'lurni ch`ems gaxsenebashi [rat`a es iqos t`k`vent`vis mxarshi dgoma]
oriveni cadit` p`araont`an, ramet`u igi zg'vars gadavida
da ut`xarit` mas rbili sitqva, rat`a egebis sheignos an sheshindes [allahis sasjelisgan]
ut`xres [musam da harunma]: [o], g'mert`o ch`veno, vshishobt`, rom [p`araoni] shemogvitevs an zg'vars gadava.
[allahma] miugo [musas da haruns]: nu geshiniat`. me t`k`vent`ana var, me mesmis da vxedav

shedit` mast`an da ut`xarit`: ch`ven sheni g'mert`is carmogzavnilebi vart`. gamoushvi ch`vent`an ert`ad israelis z'eni da nu stanjav mat`. movedit` sascaulit` [o, p`araon] sheni g'mert`isagan da mshvidoba imas, vinc` mihqveba cheshmarit gzas.
zesht`agvegona rom sasjeli imas, vinc` c`rud sherac`xa igi da zurgi ak`c`iao [isalmis mocodebisgan].
ut`xra [p`araonma]: vin aris t`k`veni g'mert`i, hei musa?
[musam] miugo: ch`emi g'mert`ia is, vinc` qovelive uboz'a t`avis k`mnilebas, xolo shemdgom daadgina cheshmarit gzaze
hkit`xa [p`araonma]: da ra mouva ucindel t`aobebs [romlebmac` aseve ar miig'es cheshmariteba allahis shuamavlebisgan]?
[musam] ut`xra: amis c`odna cignshia ch`ems g'mert`t`an. ch`emi g'mert`i arc` shec`deba da arc` daavicqdeba.
isaa [allahi], romelmac` dagidginat` dedamica sarec`lad, gaiqvana t`k`vent`vis masze gzebi, gardmoavlina c`idan cqali da ag'movac`enet` misit` cqvilebad qovelnairi mc`enareebi.
chamet` (o, adamianebo) is, rac` [ch`ven gavzardet` t`k`vent`vis] da mcqemset` t`k`veni sak`oneli; amashi sascaulebia gonebis mk`onet`at`vis
micisgan shegk`menit` t`k`ven [o, adamianno], masshi dagabrunebt` [sikvdilis shemdeg] da misgan gamogiqvant` kidev ert`xel [ag'dgomis dg'es].
da vuch`venet` mas [p`araons] ch`veni qvela sascauli, man ki c`rud sherac`xa da uarqo.
ut`xra: hei musa! gana imisat`vis moxvedi, rat`a gagvaz'evo ch`veni micidan sheni jadok`robit`?
ch`ven [p`araoni da misi garemoc`va] auc`ileblad gach`venebt` shen, o musa, msgavs jadok`robas. dat`k`vi dro ch`veni shexvedrisa, romelsac` ar shevc`vlit` ch`ven da arc` shen, shesap`eris adgilas
[musam] ut`xra [p`araons]: t`k`vent`vis shexvedris dro iqos zinat`is [dg'esascaulis] dg'e, rom sheikribos xalxi dilit`
gabrunda p`araoni da mt`el t`avis mzakvrobas [jadok`rebs] uxmo, mere movida.
ut`xra mat` musam: vai t`k`ven! nu shet`xzavt` allahze sic`rueebs! t`orem gaganadgurebt` igi sasjelit`. mart`lac` caagebs is, vinc` sic`rues t`xzavs
da [jadok`rebma] ganixiles ert`manet`shi t`aviant`i sak`me da saidumlod it`at`bires da t`aviant`i saubari saidumlod sheinaxes
t`k`ves [p`araonis jadok`rebma]: cheshmaritad, am or jadok`ars surs, gagaz'evot` t`k`ven t`k`veni micidan t`aviant`i jadok`robit` da mogishalon t`k`veni gza.
shekribet` t`k`veni mzakvroba [nu idavebt` ert`manet`shi], mere gamodit` mckrivad. carmatebuli ik`neba igi, vinc` dg'es gaimarjvebs
[jadok`rebma] ut`xres: hei musa! an isrole, an ch`ven vik`nebit` pirvelni, vinc` isvris
miugo [musam] [jadok`rebs]: diax isrolet`! roc`a mat`i t`okebi da mat`i kvert`xebi, t`aviant`i jadok`robidan gamomdinare, moech`vena mas, rogorc` muc`elze ch`k`ara mosiarule.
amgvarad musa t`avist`avad sheipqro shishis grz'nobam
[allahma] vut`xarit`: nu geshinia, shen gamarjvebuli xar!
isrole, rac` marjvenashi gichiravs da gadaqlapavs imas, rac` mat` gaaket`es. cheshmaritad, mat`i namok`medari mxolod jadok`ris mzakvrobaa da ar ek`neba carmateba jadok`ars, sadac` cava
mashin sujudze daec`nen jadok`rebi[allahis cinashe]t`aqvanis c`emit` da t`k`ves:vircmunet` g'mert`i harunisa da musasi[da t`u es jadok`roba ik`neboda ver mogvigebdnen].

[p`araonma] t`k`va:nut`u ircmunet` misi sanam me nebas dagrt`avdit`?!uechvelad igi[musa ]t`k`veni up`rosia romelmac` gascavlat` jadok`roba.amitom uechvelad mogkvet`t` xel-p`exs sxvadasxva mxrit`, da palmis xeze gagakravt`, da namdvilad gaigebt` visi tanjva-camebaa up`ro mkac`ri da xangrz'livi.

[jadok`rebma] ut`xres [p`araons]: ar gamjobinebt` c`xad mtkic`ebulebebs romlebic` ch`ven mogvevlina da arc` imas[allahs] romelmac` ch`ven gagvach`ina. gadacqvite, rasac` gadacqvet! shen mxolod amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi gadacqvet
ch`ven ki vircmunet` ch`veni g'mert`i, rat`a mogvitevos ch`veni c`odvebi da is jadok`roba, shen rom [o, p`araon] gvaiz'ulebdi. da allahi uket`esia [ch`vent`vis vidre shen] da maradiuli
cheshmaritad, imas, vinc` c`odvili [urcmuno] carsdgeba t`avisi g'mert`is cinashe, miegeba jojoxet`i. masshi arc` mokvdeba[rat`a daisvenos] da arc` ic`oc`xlebs[kargi sic`oc`xlit`].
xolo is, vinc` carsdgeba mis [allahis] cinashe morcmuned, romelsac` siket`e uket`ebia... scored mat`t`vis aris gamzadebuli umag'lesi sap`exurebi

samot`xis bag'ebi, sadac` miedinebian [dasaxlebuli adgilebisa da xeebis k`vemot`] mdinareebi. ik`nebian ik` maradiulad da es aris mat`i sazg'auri, vinc` ganicminda [vinc` gancminda t`avisi suli, mravalg'mert`ianobisgan da c`odvebisgan].

da vp`ic`av, zesht`avagonet` musas: rom g'amit` caiqvane ch`emi msaxurebi [israilis sht`amomavalt`aganni] [egviptidan] da gaukvale mat` mshrali gza zg'vashi. ar sheushindebi mdevars [p`araonsa da mis jars] da arc` shez'rcundebi. [da shumavalma musam israilis sht`amomavlebt`an ert`ad datova egvipte]
daedevna mat` [musas da israelis sht`amomavalt`] ukan p`araoni t`avisi jarit` da gadaep`arat` mat` zg'visgan is, rac` gadaep`arat` [daep`ara mat` uzarmazari cqlis masa].
p`araonma t`avisi xalxi gzas aac`dina [mat`t`vis urcmunoeba ise carmoach`ina, t`it`k`os siket`e qop`iliqo] da ar ucinamz'g'ra [scori gzit`].
hei israelis shvilebo, ch`ven gixsenit` t`k`veni mtrisagan, shexvedra dagit`k`vit` at-turis [mt`is] marjvena mxares da zegardmogivlinet` manana da mcqeri

chamet` [nebadart`uli] is siket`eni, rac` sarch`od gicqalobet`, da nu gadaacharbebt` neba dart`uls [ da nu shechamt` akrz'aluls, nu gap`langavt` da nu ik`nebit` umadurebi], t`orem dagatqdebat` ch`emi risxva da, visac` ch`emi risxva daatqdeba, daig'upeba.
cheshmaritad, me [allahi] vapatieb mat`, vinc` moinania [urcmunoeba da misi c`odvebi], ircmuna, siket`e aket`a [ircmuna allahi da ag'asrulebda mis sitqvas] da mere scor [ceshmarit] gzas daadga
[da allahma ut`xra]: hei musa! ram dagach`k`ara sheni xalxisgan
[musam] ut`xra: isini modian ch`ems kvaldakval, me ki vich`k`are shenken, g'mert`o ch`emo, rom iqo kmaqop`ili
[uzenaesma allahma] ut`xra: me gamovc`ade sheni xalxi shens shemdgom da samirma ac`duna isini da aubnia gza.

da dabrunda musa t`avis xalxt`an ganrisxebuli, damcuxrebuli. ut`xra [mat`]: o, ch`emo xalxo, gana ar mouc`ia t`k`vent`vis ch`ems g'mert`s mshvenieri ag't`k`ma, gana
xangrz'livi gech`venat` ag't`k`ma an isurvet`, rom dagatqdet` risxva t`k`veni g'mert`isagan da shec`valet` ch`emi piroba [darch`ed mtkic`ed rcmenashi da mihqvet` ch`ems gzas]?

mat` miuges [o, musa]: ar shegvic`vlia sheni piroba ch`veni nebit`, t`umc`a ch`ven datvirt`ulni viqavit` im eris [p`araonis eris] samkaulebit`a da k`onebit`, da ch`venc` scrap`ad movitanet` da movagrovet`. amgvaradve ch`aqara samirmac` [c`ec`xlshi jabrail angelozis c`xenis ch`lik`ida dan mica ]

da gana ver xedavdnen, rom ert` sitqvasac` ki ar upasuxebda igi da ar xelecip`eboda arc` mat`i zarali da arc` sargebeli?da amgvarad gamoz'erca [saamirim]mat`t`vis bg'avana boch`ola, da t`k`ves: es aris t`k`veni g'mert`i da musas g'mert`io, da daavicqda[musas t`avisi g'mert`i ak` t`k`vent`an ].
nu t`u ver xedavdnen [xbos t`aqvanisc`emlebi], rom ert` sitqvasac` ki ar upasuxebda igi da ar xelecip`eboda arc` mat`i zarali da arc` sargebeli?

da ut`xra mat` [israilis z'eebs] harunma, adreve sanam musa dabrundeboda: hei, ero ch`emo! es [xbo] mxolod gamoc`dad mogec`at` rat`a gamoirch`nen morcmuneni da urcmunoni.
mart`lac`, t`k`veni up`ali aris mocqale [allahi]. momqevit` me [mxolod allahis t`aqvanisc`emashi] da daemorch`ilet` ch`ems brz'anebas (misi gankargulebebis shesrulebashi)
[xbos t`aqvanismc`emlebma] t`k`ves: ar shevcqvett` ch`ven mis t`aqvanisc`emas, vidre musa ar dabrundeba ch`vent`an.
[roc`a dabrunda musa]ut`xra: hei harun, ram shegakava roc`a naxe, rom gzas ac`dnen isini,
rom ar gamomqolodi[anu migetovebina xbos mt`aqvanismc`emeli xalxi da gamomqolodi me]? nut`u ch`ems brz'anebas eurch`e?!

[harunma] miugo [roc`a musam marjvena xelit` t`mashi ch`aavlo xeli, xolo marc`xenat`i cvershi]: dedach`emis z'eo, nu damicher me cverit` da t`avit`. cheshmaritad, shemeshinda, rom itqodi ganxet`k`ileba ch`amogigdia israelis z'et`a shoris da ch`emi sitqva ar dagic`avso [musas rch`evebi israilis sht`amomavlobaze zrunvis shesaxeb]
[musam] ut`xra: shen rag'as itqvi, samirian?![ratom gaaket`e is rac` gaaket`e?!]

[samirianma] miugo [gamart`lebit`]: me davinaxe is, rac` mat` ver dainaxes [man ixila angelozi jibrili c`xenze amxedrebuli im dros, rodesac` xalxi gamodioda zg'vidan, xolo p`araoni da misi lashk`ari ixrch`obodnen]. avig'e ert`i mucha [mica] shuamavlis nakvalevidan [jibrilis c`xenis nalis k`vemodan] da ch`avqare masshi, da aseve shemac`dina ch`emma sulmac`.

[musam] ut`xra [samirians]: moshordi! uechvelad, shen amk`veqnad mxolod is gek`nes sat`k`meli, rom iz'axo: ar momekarot`! da shen gek`neba dat`k`muli dro[gankit`xvis dg'e rodesac` am xbos gamo daisjebi]; da shexede shens g'vt`aebas, romelsac` miejachve, uechvelad davcvavt` mas da gadavqrit` mas zg'vashi nac`rad
t`k`veni g'vt`aeba mxolod allahia, ar arsebobs sxva g'vt`aeba mis garda. man garemoic`va qvelap`eri c`odnit`
amgvarad mogit`xrobt` [rogorc` mot`xrobilia musaze, p`araonze da mat` xalxebze] ambebs [o, shuamavalo], rac` ucin momxdara; shen ki giboz'et` ch`veni ciag'idan cigni [qurani]
vinc` zurgs sheak`c`evs mas [qurans] [mis cheshmaritebas ar ag'iarebs da mis brz'anebebs ar daemorch`ileba], cheshmaritad, ag'dgomis dg'es itqvirt`avs mz'ime tvirt`s
maradiulad masshi ik`nebian [sasjelshi], da mat`t`vis raoden c`udi tvirt`ia ag'dgomis dg'es
im dg'es, roc`a ch`aberil ik`neba saqvirshi, c`odvilebs [urcmunoebs] shevkrebt` im dg'es t`valeb galurjebult`.[im mdgomareobashi ik`nebian im dg'is sashinelebis gamo].
ert`manet`shi ich`urch`uleben: ch`ven ik` [sikvdilis shemdeg samareshi] mxolod at`i [g'amit`] davrch`it`o
ch`ven uket` vic`it`, rasac` itqvian. da itqvis mat`gan qvelaze up`ro chkviani: t`k`ven ik` mxolod ert` dg'es dahqavit`o [gankit`xvis dg'est`an shedarebit`]
da gekit`xebian shen [sheni xalxi] [o, shuamavalo] mt`ebis shesaxeb, ut`xari: mtvrad ak`c`evs mat` ch`emi up`ali.
da moscorebul velebad ak`c`evs [im adgils, sadac` adre mt`ebi iqo].
veg'ar ixilavt` verc` mag'lobebs da verc` ch`ag'rmavebas.
im dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es] gahqvebian isini mxmobels[ shesakreb moednisken], romelshic` simrude ar aris. gaikmindeba xmebi mocqalis cinashe da verap`ers gaigoneb, ch`urch`ulis garda
im dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es] ar caadgeba shuamdgomloba aravis, t`u ara imas, visac` nebas misc`ems mocqale da visi sitqvit`ac` kmaqop`ili ik`neba.
man[allahma] ic`is, rac` mat` cinaa [momavali] da rac` mat` ukan iqo carsuli] da [k`mnilebebi] ver ch`ascvdebian mas [allahs]c`odnit`.

daixreba qoveli saxe [allahis cinashi], maradc`oc`xalis cinashe da carcqemdilni ik`nebian isini, vinc` usamart`lobas itvirt`avs [vinc` mravalg'mert`ianoba ch`aidina, vinaidan qvelaze didi usamart`loba mravalg'mert`ianobaa]
imas ki, vinc` gaaket`ebs siket`eebs da t`an morcmunea, nu sheeshindeba usamart`lobisa da nurc` danaklisisgan [mis ket`il sak`meebs arap`eri daakldeba]

amgvarad, ch`ven gardmovavlinet` igi arabul quranad da dacvrilebit` ganvmartet` masshi shegonebani, rat`a egebis, mat` g'mert`is shishi ik`onion anda[quranma] moutanos mat` shegoneba[rat`a aket`on ket`ili sak`meebi].
uzenaesia allahi cheshmariti mep`e! nu ich`k`areb quranit`, vidre ar dasruldeba shent`vis misi zesht`agoneba da t`k`vi:,,g'mert`o ch`emo! shemmate c`odna [rac` shen ukve momaniche]

da cheshmaritad, ch`ven ag't`k`ma mivec`it` adams ucin [roc`a is iqos samot`xeshi] [rom is ar shechamda mit`it`ebul xis naqop`s]; mas ki daavicqda igi da ver vpovet` is mtkic`e [c`dunebis cinaag'mdeg gasamklaveblad]
da [allahma] vut`xarit` angelozebs: sejde ag'asrulet` adamist`vis. da sejde ag'asrules iblisis garda, romelmac` uarqo [sejdis shesruleba]
ch`ven vut`xarit`: o adam, cheshmaritad, is [iblisi] mteria sheni da sheni c`olis. da nu gagaz'evebt` t`k`ven samot`xidan, t`orem ik`nebi ubeduri
[o, aadam] shen ar mogshivdeba ik` da titveli ar ik`nebi
da cheshmaritad, shen ik` arc` cqurvili shegacuxebs [samot`xeshi] da arc` mzis sic`xe

ac`duna igi [adami] eshmakma da ut`xra: hei adam! ginda gach`veno xe maradisobisa da samep`o, romelic` ar gac`amtverdeba [iset`i xea, rom t`u mis naqop`s shecham, ukvdavi gaxdebi da ag'arasdros mokvdebi, da maradiulad [z'ala da mp`lobeloba] gek`neba]?

da mat` [adamma da evam] chames misgan da gamouch`ndat` mat` t`aviant`i sasirc`xo adgilebi. daicqes samot`xis p`ot`lebis mip`areba sxeulze. eurch`a adami t`avis g'mert`s da shec`da [allahma aukrz'ala sheechama im xis naqop`i]
mere gamoarch`ia igi [adami] t`avisma g'mert`ma [shuamavlad], sheundo mas da cheshmarit gzaze daadgina

[allahma] ut`xra [aadams]: daeshvit` misgan [samot`xidan] [dedamicaze] ert`ianad, ert`manet`is mtrebi ik`nebit`, da t`u mogivat` t`k`ven ch`emgan cheshmariti gza, da vinc` gaqveba ch`ems cheshmarit gzas, gza ar aereva da arc` gaubedurdeba.
xolo vinc` zurgs sheak`c`evs ch`ems shexsenebas [ch`emi sitqvebisa da brz'anebebisgan], mas mtanjveli c`xovreba ek`neba, da gankit`xvis dg'es brmad ag'vadgent`
itqvis: g'mert`o ch`emo! rad ag'madgine brmad, me xom ucin [amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi] mxedveli viqavi?
[allahi] etqvis mas: amgvarad! shent`an movida ch`emi sascaulebi, shen ki daivicqe isini da dg'es, shen ik`nebi davicqebuli [jojoxet`shi mitovebulad]
amgvarad davsjit` imas [am k`veqnad], vinc` zg'vars gadavida[c`odvebshi ch`ap`luli iqo ] da ar ircmuna t`avisi g'mert`is aiat`ebi, xolo saik`ios sasjeli up`ro z'lieri da maradiulia

nut`u ar mianicha mat` [mek`is kerpt`mt`aqvanismc`emlebs] cheshmariti gzis danaxva, arada ramdeni t`aoba dagvig'upavs ucin, romelt`a sac`xovreblebzec` axla dadian. cheshmaritad, amashi sascaulebia gonebis mk`onet`at`vis
da rom ara sitqva [sasjelis gadavadebis ag't`k`ma], romelic` ucin mogec`at` sheni g'mert`isagan [allahiasgan], gardauvali ik`neboda gansazg'vruli dro

da moit`mine [o, shuamavalo], rasac` isini amboben, k`ebit` ganadide sheni g'mert`i mzis amosvlis cin da mis ch`asvlamde da aseve g'amis saat`ebshi adide da dilis monakvet`ebshi, rat`a egebis iqo kmaqop`ili

t`vali nu gagek`c`eva imisken, rit`ac` ch`ven vasargeblet` zogi imat`gani [mravalg'mert`iant`agani] micieri c`xovrebis shemkulobanit`, rat`a amit` gamogvec`ada isini. xolo sarch`o sheni g'mert`isa [maradiul c`xovrebashi] up`ro uket`esi da maradiulia!
da ubrz'ane [o, shuamavalo] shens ojaxs loc`vis [shesruleba] da iqavi momt`meni masze. ch`ven ar gt`xovt` sarch`os, sarch`os t`vit`on mogc`emt`. xolo ket`ili bolo g'vt`ismoshishebisaa!is
da t`k`ves [urcmunoebma]: netav moetana ch`vent`vis ert`i sascauli mainc` t`avisi g'mert`isgan. gana ar misvliat` [quranshi] c`xadi sascauli imat`, rac` aris pirvel gragnilebze

da rom dagveg'upa isini [urcmunoni] sasjelit` amaze ucin, itqodnen: g'mert`o ch`veno, shen rom gamogegzavna ch`vent`vis shuamavali, usat`uod mivqvebodit` shens sascaulebs, vidre davmc`irdebodit` da davknindebodit`.
ut`xari [o, shuamavalo] [am mravalg'mert`ianebs]: qvela elodeba da t`k`venc` daelodet`! male sheitqobt`, vin imqop`eboda mart`al gzaze da vin miig'o cheshmariteba scor gzadamkvlevad

mouaxlovda adamianebs angarishscorebis [saat`i] [qvela ch`adenili sak`mist`vis] [sasjelis dg'e], isini [urcmunoni] ki ugulisxmobashi arian da urch`oben [t`it`k`os arc` ki p`ik`robdnen imaze, rac` mat` sheiz'leba sheemt`xvet` sasjelis dg'es], da [t`avs aridebdnen angarishis dg'is gaxsenebas]
rodesac` mat` (urcmunoebs) mosdit` axali shegoneba mat`i up`lisgan [roc`a mohqavt` quranis aiat`i], isini usmenen mas mxolod gulgrilad, dasac`inad

mat`i gulebi ugrz'nobia [quranis mimart` uquradg'ebo], saidumlod ch`urch`uleben isini [urcmunoni], vinc` arian usamart`loni: gana es iset`ive adamiani ar aris [romelic` amtkic`ebs, rom is aris allahis mona da allahis moc`ik`uli], rogoric` t`k`ven [adamiania da ara angelozi]? gana t`k`ven ahqvebit` jadok`robas, mashin, roc`a xedavt` [ic`it`, rom es jadok`robaa]?!
t`k`va [shuamavalma muhammadma]: ch`emma g'mert`ma ic`is sitqva c`ashi da micaze [da is ic`is, razec` p`arulad saubrobt`] da igi qovlisgamgone, qovlismc`odnea.

t`k`ves [urcmunoebma][quranis uarmqop`lebma]: es ag'reuli [areuli] sizmrebia. diax, man [muhammadma] shet`xza, diax, igi poetia. dae mogvitanos sascauli [romlit`ac` ch`ven gvek`neboda shesaz'lebeli dagvenaxa] [sascauli, rogoric` iqo shuamavali salihis ak`lemi an musas joxi], iseve rogorc` ucin carmogzavnilebi modiodnen [adre shuamavlebi]

ar ircmuna mat`ze ucin [mek`k`as mravalg'mert`ianebamde] ert` dasaxlebamac` ki [im dasaxlebis mc`xovrebmac`], romelic` davg'upet`, da gana isini ircmuneben [mek`k`eli mravalg'mert`ianebi] [t`u ch`ven vach`venebt` mat` iset` sascaulebs, rasac` isini it`xoven]?

[pasuxad mat` kit`xvaze: nut`u es kac`i ar aris t`k`vennairi]? uzenaesi allahi ambobs: da aravin cargvigzavnia shenze ucin [o, muhammad], garda mamakac`ebisa [adamiani da ara angelozi], romelt`ac` zesht`avagonet`. t`u t`k`ven ar ic`it` [o, mek`k`as urcmunoebo], hkit`xet` c`odnis mk`onet` [adamianebs, romelt`ac` c`odna ak`vt` adre gardmovlenili cignebis shesaxeb]
ch`ven ar migvic`ia mat`t`vis [cinad mqop`i shuamavalt`at`vis] iset`i sxeuli, rom isini ar chamdnen sachmels, da isini ar qop`ilan ukvdavni.

mere shevasrulet` mat`ze mic`emuli ag't`k`ma, gadavarch`inet` isini da vinc` vinebet`, t`avgasulni ki davg'upet` shemdeg ch`ven shevasrulet` mat`t`vis [shuamavlebisa da mat`i mimdevrebist`vis] mic`emuli dapireba [rom mat` gadavarch`endit` da davg'upavdit` ch`veni sascaulebis uarmqop`elt`), da gadavarch`inet` isini, vinc` gvindoda [vinc` cheshmariteba ag'iara], xolo ugunurni [mravalg'mert`ianebi] davg'upet`.

vp`ic`av, gardmogivlinet` t`k`ven cigni [qurani], masshia t`k`veni xseneba [dideba]. gana ver ket`ilgansjit` [romlit`ac` ch`ven t`k`ven pativi gec`it` imit`, rit`ac` sxvebi ar dagvip`asebia gamogigzavnet` moc`ik`uli da mogec`it` qurani]?
ramdeni sop`eli gavanadguret`, romelt`a mc`xovrebnic` borotmok`medni iqvnen [ar ircmunes is, rac` allahma gamougzavna] da mat` shemdeg sxva xalxi ag'movac`enet` mat` adgilze!
da rodesac` mat` [urcmunoebma] igrz'nes ch`veni risxva [mkac`ri sasjeli], aha, isini garbian ik`idan [sop`lidan]!
[da et`k`va mat` dac`invit`]: nu gaik`c`evit`, daubrundit` mas, sadac` uxvad gk`ondat` naboz'ebi, da t`k`vens saxlebs, ramet`u t`k`ven ganikit`xebit`

[mat ag'iares t`aviant`i c`udi k`medebebi da] t`k`ves: vai ch`ven! ch`ven usamart`loni viqavit`o [mat` ag'iares t`aviant`i borotmok`medeba da] t`k`ves: vai ch`ven, mart`lac` rom ch`ven sakut`ar t`avs vavnet` [ucmindurobit`a da urcmunoebit`]
da mat` ar shecqvetes mat`i es godeba [t`aviant`i borotmok`medebis ag'iareba], vidre vak`c`evdit` mat` gapartaxebul mindorad
da ch`ven ar shegvik`mnia c`a da mica da [qvelap`eri] rac` mat` shorisaa gart`obist`vis

[dae ic`odnen mravalg'mert`ianebma, rom allahi shorsaa imisgan, rom man aiqvanos t`avist`vis c`oli an shvili] rom gvdomeboda gart`obist`vis [c`oli an shvili), udavod avirch`evdit` mas ch`venganve [angelozt`agan an samot`xis huriebisgan] [da ara t`k`vengan] rom saert`od gvdomeboda es sak`me

diax! ch`ven vz'levt` sic`rues cheshmaritebit`, igi mas anadgurebs da k`reba. da t`k`ven [o, mravalg'mert`ianebo] ki simcare [sasjeli] [maradiul c`xovrebashi] imisat`vis, rasac` t`xzavt` [t`k`ven miacert` t`k`vens up`als t`visebebs, romlebic` sruliad ar sheesabameba mis sidiades da arss].

mas [allahs] ekut`vnis, [qvelap`eri] rac` c`at`a shinaa da rac` k`veqanasa zedaa, xolo isini, vinc` mis cinashe arian [angelozebi], ar t`akiloben mis t`aqvanisc`emas da arc` amit` ig'lebian [isini arasdros cqveten allahis k`ebas]. [amitom, rogor sheiz'leba rom sheadarot` mas vinme?]
isini [angelozebi] adideben allahs dg'it`a da g'amit`, arasodes ig'lebian [misi k`ebit`].
nut`u mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebma] airch`ies dedamicidan g'vt`aebebi [ok`rosgan, k`visgan da sxva masalebisgan gamzadebuli], romlebic` ac`oc`xleben [ag'adgenen mkvdrebs]?

rom qop`iliqvnen mat`shi [c`ebsa da dedamicaze] g'vt`aebebi allahis garda, ganadgurdeboda [c`ebi da mica] orive mat`gani. 'arshis gamch`eni allahi [is aris misi shemok`medi da mp`lobeli], shorsaa imisgan, rasac` [mravalg'mert`ianebi da urcmunoebi] miaceren [qvela sic`ruisa da naklisgan].
igi ar aris pasuxismgebeli imis gamo, rasac` ik`ms. mat` ki [qvela gonier k`mnilebas] mohkit`xaven imas, rasac` aket`ebdnen [t`aviant`i k`medebebis gamo]

gana mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebma] daidgines g'vt`aebebi mis garda? ut`xari [mat` o, shuamavalo]: moitanet` t`k`veni mtkic`ebuleba [imist`vis, rom vc`not` vinme g'mert`ad allahis garda] [amis mtkic`ebuleba arsad ar arsebobs]! es aris [qurani] shexseneba mat`t`vis, vinc` ch`emt`an aris da shexseneba mat`t`vis, vinc` ch`emze ucin iqo [t`ora da injili] [romlebshic` aseve ar aris mit`it`eba, rom arsebobs raime sxva g'vt`aeba garda allahisa]. t`umc`a mat` umravlesobam ar ic`is cheshmariteba da pirs ibruneben

da ar gamogvigzavnia shenamde [o, muhammad] arc`ert`i moc`ik`uli, rom ar zesht`agvegonebina mist`vis, rom ar arsebobs aranairi g'vt`aeba [romelic` imsaxurebs t`aqvanisc`ems], garda ch`emi [allahisa]. mash, mxolod me[allahs] mec`it` t`aqvanisc`ema!

da t`k`ves [mravalg'mert`ianebma]: mocqalem shvili aiqvanao! [mravalg'mert`ianebi t`vlidnen, rom angelozebi allahis k`alishvilebi iqvnen] dideba mas! ara, isini [angelozebi] pativc`emuli msaxurni arian
ar daascreben [angelozebi] mas [allahs] sitqvas [saubroben mxolod imas, rac` ubrz'ana mat` allahma] da isini [angelozebi] mok`medeben mxolod misi [allahis] brz'anebis shesap`erisad

man [allahma] ic`is [qvelap`eri], rac` mat` cinashea [angelozebis momavali sak`meebi] da rac` mat` shemdgomaa [mat`i carsuli sak`meebi], isini ki ar shuamdgomloben, t`u ara mxolod imisat`vis, visit`ac` igi [allahi] kmaqop`ilia. da isini [angelozebi] shishisagan misi cinashe kankaleben [eshiniat`] [da eridebian mis urch`obas].

da vinc` mat`gan [angelozebidan] itqvis: cheshmaritad, mec` g'mert`i var mis [allahis] garda! davsjit` mas jojoxet`it`. amgvarad davsjit` usamart`loebs [romlebmac` t`aviant` t`avs ziani miaqenes mravalg'mert`ianobit` da allahze urch`obit`]

gana ver dainaxes imat`, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes, rom c`ani da dedamica iqvnen sheert`ebulni. ch`ven ki gavqavit` isini da shevk`menit` cqlisagan qoveli sulieri. nu t`u [urcmunoni] mainc` ar ircmuneben?

da davadginet` k`veqanaze mtkic`ed mdgomni [mt`ebi], rat`a ar shearqios isini[xalxi], da davadginet` masze [dedamicaze] gasasvleli gzebi. rat`a mat` [xalxs] egeb scor gzaze damdgariqvnen [rogorc` mat`i qoveldg'iuri sachiroebebisaken, ise cheshmaritebisaken]

da ch`ven davadginet` zec`a damc`av saxuravad [dedamicist`vis], magram mat` [urcmunoni], masshi arsebul sascaulebs [rogorebic`aa mze, mt`vare, varskvlavebi, g'amisa da dg'is c`vla] piri ak`c`ies [gana isini ar p`ik`roben am qvelap`ris danaxvisas?]
isaa [allahia], vinc` shek`mna g'ame da dg'e, mze da mt`vare. t`it`oeuli mat`gani t`avis orbitaze dac`uravs
ch`ven ar dagvidgenia arc` ert` adamianst`vis shenamde [o, muhammad] amk`veqniuri ukvdaveba. nut`u, shen mokvdebi, isini ki ik`nebian ukvdavni?!
qoveli [k`mnileba] suli [qoveli adamiani, jini, angelozi, c`xoveli da sxva] igemebs sikvdils, da ch`ven gc`dit` siavit`a da siket`it`. da ch`vent`an ik`nebit` dabrunebulni

da roc`a gxedaven shen [o, shuamavalo] isini, romelnic` gaxdnen urcmunoni, masxrad gigdeben: gana es aris is [adamiani], vinc` t`k`vens g'mert`ebs axsenebs[c`udad]? scored isini arian mocqalis xsenebis uarmqop`elni.

adamiani sheik`mna sulscrap`i [mas axasiat`ebs sich`k`are da mout`menloba]. me gach`venebt` t`k`ven ch`ems sascaulebs [t`k`venze mocevnadi sasjelis saxit`]. ase rom nu daach`k`arebt` [nu it`xovt` sasjelis dach`k`arebas, radgan is auc`ileblad mova am c`xovrebashic` da aseve maradiulshi]
[urcmunoni] [dasc`inian dapirebaze sasjelis shesaxeb] da amboben: rodis ag'sruldeba es dapireba, t`uki mart`als ambobt`?

netavi, rom ic`odnen urcmunoebma, rom auc`ileblad dadgeba is zhami, roc`a isini ver aic`ileben c`ec`xlis [jojoxet`is] shexebas t`avebidan da zurgebidan da veravin shez'lebs mat` daxmarebas [imitom, rom isini jiutad darch`nen urcmunoebashi da ach`k`arebdnen sasjels]!

diax, namdvilad mova igi [sasjelisa da ag'sasrulis dg'e] mat`ze sruliad moulodnelad ise, rom isini gaogndebian. ver shez'leben mis ac`ilebas [c`ec`xlis] da arc` gadauvaddebat` [rat`a moinanion urcmunoeba da urch`oba da daixsnan t`avi jojoxet`is sasjelisgan]
uechvelad, shenze adrec` aigdes masxrad shuamavlebi, shemdeg vinc` mat` dasc`inodnen, imit`ve ik`mnen shepqrobili, risgamoc` dasc`inodnen

ut`xari [o, shuamavalo] [imat`, vinc` dasjas it`xovs da dasc`inis mocodebas]: vin gic`avt` t`k`ven g'amit`a t`u dg'isit` mocqalisagan [allahis sasjelisagan]? - pirik`it` isini t`avisi g'mert`is xsenebas zurgs ak`c`even

nut`u hqavt` mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] g'mert`ebi, romlebic` daic`aven mat` ch`vengan [ch`veni sasjelisgan]? ver shescevt` z'ala [am kerpebs] t`aviant`i t`avis dasac`vadac` ki, da arc` mat` ek`nebat` xsna ch`vengan [ch`veni sasjelisgan].

diax, ch`ven vasargeblet` isinic` da mat`i mamebic`, vidre mat`i sic`oc`xle grz'eldeboda. da gana ver xedaven, rom ch`ven movdivart` micaze da rogor vkvec`t` mis kideebs? da gana isini arian gamarjvebulni? diax! ch`ven mivanichet` amat` [mek`k`el mravalg'mert`ianebs] da mat` mamebs (amk`veqniuri) cqaloba, ise rom gaugrz'eldat` c`xovreba [da moitques t`avi sakut`ari simdidrit`, sic`oc`xlit`a da sht`amomavlobit`] [da ganagrz'obdnen urcmunoebas, arc` ki p`ik`robdnen mat`ze mosalodnel sasjelze]. nut`u ar xedaven isini, rom ch`ven movdivart` k`veqanaze, vaklebt` mas kideebidan? nut`u isini, [urcmunoebi], shez'leben gamarjvebas [mas shemdeg, rac` garshemortqmulni gaxdnen]?

ut`xari [o, shuamavalo] ]imat`, vist`anac` allahma gaggzavna]: me mxolod gamap`rt`xilebeli gaxlavart` t`k`vent`vis (sasjelis shesaxeb) gamoc`xadebit` (allahisgan) [arap`ers vambob sakut`ari survilit`]. magram ar esmit` momcodeblis mocodeba [mocodebis xma] qru xalxs [imat`], [vinc` ar p`ik`robs cheshmaritebis mosmenis shemdeg], roc`a ap`rt`xileben

da t`u sheexeba mat` [urcmunoebs] sheni up`lis sasjelis sul mc`ire niavic` ki, isini uechvelad itqvian:,,vai ch`vens t`avs! namdvilad usamart`loni viqavit` [sakut`ar t`avs t`vit`onve vavnet` mravalg'mert`ianobis ch`adenit`]

da ch`ven ganvacesebt` samsjavros dg'ist`vis samart`lianobis sascorebs [qvelaze zust sascorebs], da arc` ert`i suli ar daich`agreba arap`ershi [ar daakldeba mis ket`il sak`mes da ar daemateba c`ud sak`meebs], da t`u sak`me ik`neba t`undac` mdogvis marc`vlis conis, ch`ven movitant` mas [ch`avt`vlit` masac`]! da sakmarisni vart` ch`ven, rogorc` amg'vnusxvelni!

da ch`ven ukve mivec`it` [shuamaval] musas da [mis z'mas, shuamaval] haruns ganmamsxvavebeli [t`ora, romelic` cheshmaritebas da sic`rues hqop`s], da nat`eli [mart`ali gza, romelic` mat` rcmenisa da kanonmdeblobis sakit`xebshi cheshmaritebisken miuz'g'vit`], da shegoneba [darigeba] g'vt`ismoshist`at`vis [romelt`ac` up`lis sasjelis eshiniat`].

romelt`ac` eshiniat` [emorch`ilebian mas, ar ch`adian akrz'aluls da ar toveben mis brz'anebebs] t`aviant`i g'mert`is [allahis] p`arulad [miuxedavad imisa, rom am k`veqnad ver xedaven allahs], da scored isini arian moshishni im saat`isgan [romelic` dadgeba gankit`xvis dg'es]

es ki daloc`vili shexsenebaa [anu qurani, romelic` savsea siket`it`a da sargeblit`], romelic` ch`ven gardamovavlinet` [igi gardamoavlina mxolod uzenaesma allahma da aravin sxvam]. nut`u t`k`ven uarqop`t` mas [uars ambobt` quranze]?

da cheshmaritad vuboz'et` [shuamaval] ibrahims ucin scori gza [g'mert`is shec`noba, rcmena mis mimart` da im auc`ileblobis gac`nobiereba, rom mxolod mas unda daemorch`ilon] da viqavit` misi mc`odneni [rom igi amist`vis shesap`erisia]

ai, roc`a ut`xra [ibrahimma] t`avis mamas [azars] da t`avis xalxs [gamoxatavda t`avisi uarqop`as]: ra aris es k`andakebebi, romlebsac` t`k`ven t`vit`on amzadebt` da shemdeg gulmodginet` et`aqvanebit` mat`?
mat` upasuxes: ch`ven vnaxet`, rom ch`veni mamebi mat` [am k`andakebebs] et`aqvanebodnen, da ch`venc` mivqvebit` mat` gzas.
ut`xra [ibrahimma] [mat`]: namdvilad, t`k`venc` da t`k`veni mamebic` c`xadi gzaabneulobashi imqop`ebit` [rodesac` am kerpebs et`aqvanebit`]
mat` ut`xres: shen [o, ibrahim] cheshmaritebit` moxvedi ch`vent`an, t`u ert`-ert`i xar mot`amashet`agan [mat`gan, vinc` ubralod laqbobs]?

man [ibrahimma] ut`xra: ara [es ar aris xumroba]! t`k`veni up`ali [romlisadmi morch`ilebas mogicodebt`] aris c`at`a da k`veqnis up`ali, romelmac` isini shek`mna, da me var ert`-ert`i imat`gan, vinc` amaze mtkic`ed miut`it`ebs [vinc` amaze damocmebas aket`ebs]

[ibrahimma t`avist`vis t`k`va]: vp`ic`av allahs, uechvelad ganvaxorc`ieleb ch`ap`ik`rebul gegmas t`k`veni kerpebis cinaag'mdeg [davamtvrev mat`], mis shemdeg, rac` t`k`ven zurgs ak`c`evt` da caxvalt` [roc`a kerpebt`an ag'aravin darch`eba]

shemdeg man [ibrahimma] daamtvria isini [kerpebi] namsxvrevebad, garda mat`i mt`avari kerpisa rat`a mat` [misma xalxma] mast`an [ibrahimt`an] dabruneba moindomon [da man auxsnas mat` t`aviant`i gzaabneuloba da moucodos cheshmariti rcmenisaken].

[rodesac` xalxi dabrunda da dainaxa, rom mat`i kerpebi damtvreuli iqo] mat` t`k`ves [ert`manet`s hkit`xes]: vin gauket`a es ch`vens g'mert`ebs? cheshmaritad [ vinc` es ch`aidina man borotad imok`meda] is usamart`lot`agania
mat` [xalxma] t`k`ves: gavigonet`, rogor axsenebda mat` [kerpebs] ert`i axalgazrda, romelsac` ibrahimi hk`via
mat`ma cinamz'g'olebma t`k`ves: moiqvanet` igi [ibrahimi] xalxis t`valcin, rat`a isini iqvnen mocmeebi [imis, rac` ibrahimma t`k`va mat`i kerpebis shesaxeb]
mat` ut`xres: shen gaaket`e es ch`veni g'mert`ebis mimart`, o ibrahim?
ibrahimma t`k`va: ara, es sak`me gaaket`a mat`gan mt`avarma. hkit`xet` mat`, t`u isini metqveleben.
da mat` [xalxma] t`aviant` t`avs miubrundnen [dap`ik`rdnen] da t`k`ves: namdvilad, t`k`ven t`vit`on xart` borotmok`medni [radgan t`aqvans sc`emdit` imas, visac` laparaki ar sheuz'lia]

mere mat` t`aviant`i t`avebit` gadabrunebulni gaxdnen [anu, simart`lis ag'iarebis shemdeg kvlav maxinj tquilshi dabrundnen] da t`k`ves: [rogor vkit`xot` mat`]? nut`u shen [o, ibrahim] ar ic`odi, rom eseni [kerpebi] ar metqveleben?

man [ibrahimma] t`k`va [kerpebisadmi zizg'is gamoxatvit`]:
nut`u t`k`ven t`aqvans sc`emt` allahis garda imas, rasac` veranairi sargebeli moak`vs t`k`vent`vis [rodesac` mas t`aqvans sc`emt`] da verc` veranair zians mogaqenebt` [t`undac` ar sc`emdet` t`aqvans]?
p`ui t`k`ven da im [kerpebs], rasac` et`aqvanebit` magier allahisa! nut`u ar dap`ik`rdebit` [imaze, t`u ramdenad c`udia is, rasac` aket`ebt`]?

mat` [xalxma] t`k`ves (ert`manet`shi):,,dacvit` igi [ibrahimi] da daexmaret` t`k`vens g'mert`ebs [misi ganadgurebit`], t`u ukve mok`medebt` [mart`la gsurt` t`k`veni g'vt`aebebis dac`va da mat`t`vis t`aqvanisc`emis gagrz'eleba]! [da mat` ch`aagdes ibrahimi uzarmazar koc`onshi, magram allahi daexmara t`avis moc`ik`uls]

ch`ven vt`k`vit`: he, c`ec`xlo! iqavi grili da mshvidobiani [usap`rt`xo] ibrahimist`vis! [da ibrahimi imqop`eboda c`ec`xlshi qovelgvari zianisa da diskomp`ortis gareshe, shemdeg ki allahma gamoiqvana igi ik`idan]
da mat` surdat` ibrahimis cinaag'mdeg xriki [daecvat` c`ec`xlshi], magram ch`ven mat` ganvac`devinet` mz'ime marc`xi.

da ch`ven gadavarch`inet` is [ibrahimi] [mep`e namrudisa da misi xalxisgan] da luti [romelic` iqo shuamavali ibrahimis z'mis shvili da mast`an ert`ad ircmuna] micaze, romelic` davloc`et` [gavxadet` kurt`xeuli] mt`eli samqaroebist`vis [isini gadaixvecnen eraqidan shamis micaze, saidanac` mravali allahis shuamavlebi iqo carmoshobit` da sadac` barak`a da naqop`is siuxvea]
da vuboz'et` mas [shuamaval ibrahims] ishaqi, da iaqubi, rogorc` damateba [damatebit`i cqaloba], da qoveli mat`gani vhk`menit` morch`ili da ket`ilmok`medi [samart`liani da g'vt`ismoshishi].

da davadginet` isini [shuamavlebi: ibrahimi, ishaqi da iaqubi] cinamg'z'olebad [xalxis], romelnic` scori gzit` midiodnen [moucodebdnen xalxs, rom t`aqvani ec`at` mxolod allahist`vis da amorch`ilebodnen mis brz'anebebs] ch`veni brz'anebit`, da zesht`avagonet`, rom siket`e eket`ebinat`, eloc`at`, zek`at`i gaec`at` da isini iqvnen mxolod ch`emi t`aqvanismc`emelni.

da [shuamaval] luts vuboz'et` sibrz'ne da c`odna [allahze da mis kanonze] da vixsenit` im sop`lisagan [sodomisgan], [xalxi] romelic` sisaz'agles aket`ebda [mamat`mavlobas eceodnen]. cheshmaritad, isini iqvnen uzneo da urch`i xalxi
ch`ven sheviqvanet` igi [shuamavali luti] ch`vens mocqalebashi [gadavarch`inet` im sasjelisgan, rac` moevlina mis xalxs], radgan igi mart`alt`agani iqo [damorch`ilebuli allahs].

da [gaixsene, o, shuamavalo] nuhi/noe, rogor uxmo [allahs] adre [ibrahimamde]: [namdvilad, me davmarc`xdi! mash, shemecie!] vupasuxet` mas, da gadavarch`inet` igi da misi ojaxi [c`olisa da ert`i shvilis garda] didi mcuxarebisagan [allahis sasjelisagan]
da ch`ven sheveciet` mas [shuamaval nuhs] im xalxisgan, vinc` uarqo ch`veni sascaulebi. mart`lac`, isini c`udi xalxi iqo, da ch`ven qvela davaxrch`et` [cqaldidobit`]
da [gaixsene] [o, shuamavalo] [shuamavlebi] davudi da suleimani, roc`a mat` ganach`eni gamoitanes qanis shesaxeb, romelic` caaxdina xalxis sak`onelma. da ch`ven mocmeni viqavit` mat`i ganach`enisa.

ch`ven zesht`avagonet` es [samart`liani gadacqveta] sulaimans
[rat`a dac`uliqo orive mxaris interesebi samart`lianad].
da t`it`oeuls mat`gan [davudsac` da sulaimansac`]
vuboz'et` sibrz'ne da c`odna. da davuds davumorch`ilet` mt`ebi, rat`a edidebinat` [allahi] mast`an ert`ad [roc`a davudi adidebda mas], aseve p`rinvelebi da ch`ven viqavit` isini, vinc` es ag'asrula.
da vascavlet` [ shuamaval dauds] mas abjris gaket`eba t`k`vent`vis, rat`a daec`vit` [o, adamianno] misit` sap`rt`xisagan [iarag'is dartqmsagan] da, gana t`k`ven madlierni ara xart`?!

da sulaimans davumorch`ilet` z'lieri k`ari [romelic` emsaxureboda mas], romelic` dak`roda misi [sulaimanis] brz'anebit` im micisken, romelshic` ch`ven davloc`et` [shamisken]. da ch`ven qovelives shesaxeb vic`it`.

da aseve [ch`ven davumorch`ilet` sulaimans] eshmakebisgan iset`ebi, vinc` qvint`avda mist`vis da asrulebdnen amis garda sxva sak`meebsac`. da ch`ven vart` mat`i damc`velni [rat`a ar shez'lebodat` suleimanis morch`ilebaze uaris t`k`ma].
da [gaixsene] [o, shuamavalo] [shuamavali] aiubi: mouxmo t`avis g'mert`s: uechvelad, mecia ubedureba da shena xar [o, allah] mocqalet`agan umocqalesi
da shevisminet` misi [aiubis] vedreba da avashoret` zarali, da vuboz'et` t`avisi ojaxi da mat`i msgavsi, mat`t`an ert`ad, cqalobad ch`veni ciag'idan da shexsenebad msaxurt`at`vis.

da [agret`ve moixsene, o shuamavalo] [shuamavalni]
ismaili, idrisi da zul-k`ip`li qvelani [isini] iqvnen mot`minebis mk`onet`agan vinc` ich`enda mot`minebas allahis morch`ilebashi.
da ch`ven sheviqvanet` isini ch`vens cqalobashi,radgan namdvilad isini iqvnen mart`alt`aganni.

da [moixsene, o shuamavalo] zun-nuuni [shuamavali iunusi].
[igi moucodebda t`avis xalxs allahis rcmenisken, magram isini ar pasuxobdnen mis mocodebas. da iunusma dakarga mot`mineba, miuxedavad imisa, rom allahma ubrz'ana mot`mineba] mash, is gashorda [mat`] risxvit` savse da, ip`ik`ra rom, ch`ven mas ar davsijidit` [imis gamo rom man t`avisi xalxi miatova t`avisi g'mert`is nebis gareshe mat`ze gabrazebulma]. [da rodesac` zg'va gadakvet`a, ag'moch`nda cqalshi da gadaqlapa t`evzma [veshapma]. da man [iunusma] mouxmo [t`avis up`als] sibneleshi [zg'vis, g'amisa da t`evzis muc`lis sibneleshi], moinania da t`k`va: ar arsebobs g'mert`i [romelsac` ekut`vnis t`aqvanisc`ema], garda shenisa! shen xar cmida da uzenaesi! namdvilad, me viqavi usamart`lot`a shoris [vag'iareb ch`ems shec`domas]
da ch`ven vupasuxet` mas [iunuss] [mis vedrebaze] da vixsenit` igi am mcuxarebisagan. da ai ase vixsnit` morcmuneebs

da [agret`ve moixsene] [o, shuamavalo] [shuamavali] zak`aria, rogor mouxmo man t`avis up`als [rodesac` ukve siberes miag'cia], vedrebit`: g'mert`o ch`emo, nu damtoveb marto [mommadle shvili, romelic` memkvidreobit` gaagrz'elebs shens gzas da ganadidebs shens sitqvas adamianebs shoris], radgan shen xar sauket`eso memkvidreobis momc`emi

da ch`ven vupasuxet` mas [zak`arias] [mis vedrebaze] da vuboz'et` mas [sibereshi] shvili iahia/ioane. da shevk`menit` mist`vis misi c`oli shesap`erisad [shesaz'leblad imist`vis, rom eshva shvili],
mas shemdeg, rac` igi iqo ushvilo. namdvilad, isini iscrap`ebodnen ket`ili sak`meebisken, da gvevedrebodnen imedit` [ch`vengan misag'eb sazg'aurze] da shishit` [ch`veni sasjelis mimart`], da iqvnen ch`emdami mokrz'alebulni

da [agret`ve moixsene] [o, shuamavalo] is [mariami, shuamavali isas deda], romelmac` daic`va t`avisi sicminde [misi sxeuli ar shexebia arc` ert` mamakac`s]. da ch`ven [gavugzavnet` mas angelozi jibrili da] ch`avberet` masshi [mis samosshi arsebuli chrilis meshveobit`] ch`veni sulidan [suli, romelsac` ch`ven vp`lobt`] [romelic` moitana jibrilma]. da ch`ven vak`c`evt` mas [mariams] da mis shvils [isas] sascaulad [dasamtkic`eblad allahis z'almosilebisa] samqarot`a xalxt`at`vis.

cheshmaritad, es aris t`k`veni t`emi, [sarcmunoeba] ert`i saert`o t`emi [sarcmunoeba qvela cinascarmetqvelisa ert`ia, ert`g'mert`ianoba]. da me var t`k`veni up`ali [o, adamianno], da met`aqvanet` mxolod me!

xolo isini [adamianebi] daiqvnen t`aviant` sak`meshi [gaiqvnen sarcmunoebashi] [rodesac` gamoigones sxvadasxva c`ru rcmena da gadauxvies ert`g'mert`obas] da t`it`oeuli mat`gani ch`ven dagvibrundeba [ag'dgomis dg'es] [da ara vinme sxvas]

da vinc` gaaket`ebs ket`il sak`mes da morcmune iqo, misi sak`me ar ik`neba uarqop`ili, da amas vicert` mist`vis [angelozebi iceren mis ket`il sak`meebs, morcmunis sat`no k`medebebs],
da igi ixilavs qvelap`ers ch`acerils ag'sasrulis dg'es]
da akrz'alulia im sop`lisat`vis, romelic` gavanadguret` [mat`i urcmunoebis da borotebis gamo], rom dabrundnen. [ ver shez'leben dabrunebas rat`a moinanion t`aviant`i urcmunoeba da borotmok`medeba].

rodesac` iajuji da majuji gaixsnebian da isini qoveli gorakidan t`avs daesxmian da rodesac` gaixsneba [barieri, romlis ukanac` imqop`ebian ori xalxi] iajuji da majuji [sanam ar dadgeba ag'sasrulis dg'e, romelsac` cin uz'g'vis iajujisa da majujis gamoch`ena].
da isini qvela p`erdobidan t`avs daesxmian [da scrap`ad gavrc`eldebian mt`el micaze].

da moaxlovda cheshmariti ag't`k`ma [ag'sasrulis dg'e], da ai, gak`vavda mzera mat`t`vis, vinc` urcmuno iqvnen. [da isini itqvian] vai ch`ven davig'upenit`!, uquradg'ebod viqavit` amis mimart` [ag'sasrulis dg'is shesaxeb] [ar vemzadebodit` mist`vis]! diax, pirik`it` ch`ven viqavit` usamart`loni

namdvilad, t`k`ven [o, urcmunoebo] da [qvelap`eri], rasac` t`k`ven t`aqvans sc`emt` allahis garda [qvela kerpi, agret`ve is adamianebi da jinnebi, romlebic` kmaqop`ilni iqvnen, rom mat` g'mert`ebad ag'iarebdnen], es k`vebi [romelnic` gaxdebian sacvavi] jojoxet`ist`vis, da t`k`ven misken [jojoxet`isken] midixart` [da shexvalt` masshi]

egeni rom g'vt`aebebi qop`iliqvnen [visac` t`aqvans sc`emen magier allahisa], ar shevidodnen masshi [jojoxet`shi] magram isini [t`aqvanismc`emlebic` da mat`i c`ru g'mert`ebic`] qoveli mat`gani maradiulad darch`eba ik` [jojoxet`shi].
mat`t`vis [jojoxet`is binadart`at`vis] masshi [jojoxet`is c`ec`xlshi] ik`neba kvnesa [tanjvisgan gamocveuli], da isini masshi verap`ers gaigoneben
cheshmaritad, isini, visac` ucin ch`vengan siket`e rgebiat`, moshorebulni arian misgan [jojoxet`isgan]
ar gaigoneben isini [samot`xis binadarni] mis [jojoxet`is] xmaursac` ki, da ik`nebian isini imashi [samot`xeshi], rac` isurves mat`ma sulebma samaradzhamod mqop` netarebashi.
ar daamcuxrebt` udidesi shishi [gankit`xvis dg'is], aramed miegebebian mat` angelozebi [sasixarulo ambavit`]: es aris t`k`veni dg'e, romelic` ag't`k`muli gk`ondat` [allahisgan].

im dg'es davgragnit` zec`as ise, rogorc` gragnilebs cignisat`vis [rogorc` ixveva dacerili p`urc`lebi]. rogorc` shevk`menit` pirveli k`mnileba, aseve ag'vadgent` mas [adamians] xelaxla, ch`veni mxridan mic`emuli ag't`k`misamebr.
[namdvilad, ch`ven qovelt`vis ag'vasrulebt` imas, rac` ag'gvit`k`via].

davceret` ch`ven cignshi [qovel cignshi, romelic` adamianebs miec`a] shexsenebis [deda cigni, romelic` allaht`anaa] shemdeg, rom micas daimkvidreben ch`emi mart`ali monebi [isini, vinc` asruleben allahis brz'anebebs da t`avs ikaveben akrz'alulisgan, es aris moc`ik`uli muhammadis ummat`i]

namdvilad, amashi [quranshi] udavod aris gzavnili t`aqvanismc`emeli xalxisat`vis [vinc` t`aqvans sc`emen allahs]
[sakmarisi gzavnili imist`vis, rom mat` samot`xeshi shesvla moipovon]!

da ch`ven gamoggzavnet` shen [o, muhammad] mxolod cqalobad samqarot`aat`vis [vinc` dagijerebs rogorc` allahis moc`ik`uls, igi ik`neba bednieri da carmatebuli am samqaroshic` da maradiul c`xovrebashic`].
