ut`xari [o, shuamavalo]: namdvilad, ch`emt`an modis g'vt`iuri gamoc`xadeba, rom t`k`veni g'mert`i ert`adert`i g'mert`ia (da es aris allahi]. nut`u ar ik`nebit` morch`ilni misi?

xolo t`u isini zurgs sheak`c`even [allahis morch`ilebas],
mashin ut`xari mat`: me gadmogec`it` t`k`vent`vis shetqobineba [is, rac` allahma mibrz'ana] t`anascorad [axla qvelani am c`odnashi t`anascorni vart`]. da me ar vic`i axloa t`u shors is, rac` t`k`ven ag'get`k`vat` [sasjeli]
namdvilad, man [allahma] ic`is xmamag'la nat`k`vami [sitqvebi] da ic`is isic`, rasac` gulshi malavt` [rasac` p`arulad inaxavt` t`k`vens t`avshi].

me ki ar vic`i es sheiz'leba gamoc`daa [sasjelis dagvianeba, rasac` ase ch`k`arobt`] t`k`vent`vis an sargebloba gansazg'vrul vadamde [rat`a kidev up`ro ch`aiz'irot` urcmunoebashi
da shemdeg gezg'ot` up`ro z'lieri sasjeli]
t`k`va [shuamavalma]: g'mert`o ch`emo! gansaje cheshmaritebit` [ch`vensa da urcmunoebs shoris]. da mocqale g'mert`i mp`arvelia ch`veni imisgan, rasac` mas miacert`

o, adamianebo! geshinodet` t`k`veni up`lis [ircmunet`, sheasrulet` misi brz'anebebi da ganeridet` imas, rac` man agikrz'alat`]! udavod, ag'sasrulis zhamis rqeva -- udidesi ramaa [gonebist`vis miucvdomeli da z'nelad carmosadgeni]!

im dg'es, roc`a ixilavt` mas [ag'sasrulis zhamis dadgomas], qoveli mez'uz'uri k`ali daivicqebs bavshvs, romelsac` z'uz'us az'levda, da qoveli muc`ladmqop`i k`ali moishvebs t`avis tvirt`s [mshobiarobas daicqebs]. da shen ixilav adamianebs mt`vralebivit`, t`umc`a isini mt`vralni ar arian -- aramed allahis sasjeli z'lieria (ris gamoc` mat` goneba ekargebat` shishisgan).

adamiant`a shoris arian iset`ebic`, romlebic` allaht`an dakavshirebit` davoben c`odnis gareshe [miaceren mas ararsebuls] da mihqvebian qovel ajanqebul eshmaks [cinamz'g'olebs c`domilebisa, romlebic` ajanqdnen allahis cinaag'mdeg].
cinascar gansazg'vrulia [allahis mier] mis [eshmakis] shesaxeb, rom vinc` airch`evs mas axloblad [gahqveba mas], is [eshmaki] aubnevs mas gzas da miiqvans jojoxet`is c`ec`xlis sasjelamde.

o, adamianebo! t`u geparebat` echvi ag'dgomis shesaxeb [imashi, rom allahi ag'adgens mkvdrebs], mash, ic`odet`, rom namdvilad ch`ven shegk`menit` t`k`ven [t`k`veni mama adami] micisagan, shemdeg ki [misi sht`amomavloba] cvet`isgan [naqop`is cvet`ovani sit`xisgan], shemdeg shededebuli sisxlisgan, shemdeg xorc`is nachrisgan -- srulad p`ormirebulis an daumt`avrebeli naqop`isgan -- rat`a gangimartot` [ch`veni z'almosileba da adamianis shek`mnis etapebi]. ch`ven [da ara vinme sxva] vdebt` [naqop`s] sashvilisnoshi, visac` gvsurs, gansazg'vrul vadamde [dabadebamde]. shemdeg gamogvqavxart` dedis sashvilisnodan ch`vilebad. shemdeg midixart` srulclovanebamde. t`k`vengan arian iset`ebi, vinc` gardaic`vlebian [srulclovnamde], da t`k`vengan arian iset`ebic`, vinc` ic`oc`xleben ukidures siberemde, ise rom ar darch`ebat` c`odna [imisgan, rac` adre ic`odnen]. da xedav micas usic`oc`xlod, magram rodesac` ch`ven vavlent` masze cqals, igi iz'vris [imit`, rom masze ag'moc`endeba mc`enareebi], p`uvdeba da amoizrdeba masze qovelgvari mshvenieri [da sasargeblo] cqvili [mc`enareebisa].

es [aiat`ebi, romlebic` allahis z'lierebas exeba] mocmobs imaze, rom mxolod allahia cheshmariti [is aris arsebobit` cheshmariti, ar ic`vleba da ar k`reba], da rom mxolod is ac`oc`xlebs mkvdrebs, da mxolod mas shescevs z'ala qoveliveze.
da rom ag'sasrulis zhami auc`ileblad dadgeba -- romelshic` ar arsebobs echvi! -- da rom allahi ag'adgens mat`, vinc` sap`lavebshia [gamoiqvans mat` ag'dgomist`vis, angarishisa da sazg'aurist`vis].

adamianebs shoris aris iset`nic` [urcmuno], vinc` davobs allahze [mis arsebaze, mis mier arch`eul mac`nesa da cignis gardamoc`emaze] qovelgvari c`odnis gareshe, qovelgvari [gzismach`venebeli] xelmz'g'vanelobis gareshe da qovelgvari gamanat`lebeli cignis gareshe [romelshic` ik`neboda c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebi].

igi amaqad ibrunebs gverds [siamaqisa da k`edmag'lobis gamo], rat`a ac`dunos sxva adamianebi allahis gzidan [sheach`eros isini islamis mig'ebisa da morch`ilebisgan]. mist`vis am cut`isop`elshi damc`irebaa, xolo ag'dgomis dg'es vagemebt` mas mcveli c`ec`xlis sasjels.
es [sasjeli] imis gamo, rac` gaamzades shenma xelebma [urcmunoeba da urch`oba], da allahi ar aris usamart`lo msaxurt`a mimart`.

adamiant`a shoris arian iset`ebic`, vinc` et`aqvaneba allahs, magram c`valebadi arian. t`uki siket`e ecevat`, kmaqop`ilni arian amit`, xolo t`u gansac`deli ecevat`, ukan ixeven. cagebulni arian am k`veqnadac` da im k`veqnadac` da, scored es aris ashkara cageba
uxmoben allahis garda imas, rac` arc` zians moutant` da arc` sargebels misc`emt`. scored es aris shori gzaabneva
mouxmoben imas, visac` ziani moak`vs, da ar moak`vs sargebeli. uechvelad, c`udia aset`i mp`arveli [c`ru g'mert`i], da uechvelad, c`udia aset`i megobari!

cheshmaritad, allahi sheiqvans mat`, vinc` ircmunes da ket`il sak`mes ag'asrulebdnen, [samot`xis] bag'ebshi, sadac` mis k`vemot` [samot`xis sasaxleebsa da xeebt`a k`vemot`] miedineba mdinareebi. cheshmaritad, allahi aket`ebs imas, rasac` inebebs.

vinc` p`ik`robs, rom allahi ar exmareba [muhammads] saak`aosa da saik`ioshi, mashin miabas t`oki zec`as, mere gadachras da shexedos gaabat`ilebs gana misi xriki imas, ramac` gamoicvia [allahis] risxva
da amgvarad zegardmovavlinet` igi [qurani] ganmartebul aiat`ebad, da [mxolod] allahi daadgens scor gzaze imas, visac` inebebs

cheshmaritad, isini, romelt`ac` ircmunes [morcmuneni],
vinc` iudeveli gaxda, sabielebi [isini, vinc` bunebit` monot`eistebi arian da ar misdeven gansazg'vrul religias], k`ristianebi, c`ec`xlt`aqvanismc`emlebi da isini, romlebmac` allahs t`anaziari daudgines [mravalg'mert`ianebi] da allahi ganac`alkevebs mat` shoris ag'dgomis dg'es [rat`a morcmuneni shevidnen samot`xeshi, xolo urcmunoni jojoxet`shi samudamod]. cheshmaritad, allahi qvelap`ris mocmea [ic`is qvelap`eri da ar avicqdeba arap`eri] [da is qvelas miuzg'avs mis k`medebat`a shesabamisad].

nut`u ver xedav [o, shuamavalo], rom allahis cinashe k`eds ixrian isini, vinc`aa c`at`a shina da k`veqanasa zeda: mze, mt`vare, varskvlavebi, mt`ebi, xeebi, c`xovelebi, adamianebi. xolo mravali mat`gani [urcmunoni] sasjelis g'irsia. aravin miagebs pativs imas, visac` allahi daamc`irebs. cheshmaritad, allahi ik`ms imas, rasac` inebebs!

aha ori mokamat`e mxare [morcmuneni da urcmunoni], romlebic` kamat`oben t`aviant`i g'mert`is t`aobaze imat`t`vis [t`it`oeuli mxare amtkic`ebda, rom scored is iqo mart`ali], romelnic` urcmunoni gaxdnen, c`ec`xlisagan gamouchrian tansac`mels [romelsac` isini ch`aic`vamen], xolo t`avze mdug'ares daasxamen.
misit` daibugeba mat`i shigneuli da kani
da mat`t`visaa [urcmunot`at`vis] gamzadebuli rkinis xelketebi [romlebit`ac` sc`emen angelozebi]
qovelt`vis, roc`a ki moundebat` ik`idan t`avis dag'ceva [jojoxet`idan], dabrunebul ik`nebian masshi: - igemet` tanjva mcveli c`ec`xlisa

cheshmaritad, allahi sheiqvans imat`, romelt`ac` ircmunes da siket`e aket`es, samot`xeshi, romlis k`vemot` mdinareebi moedinebian. daimshveneben ik` ok`ros samkaulebsa da margalitebs, samosad ki ek`nebat` abreshumi
ascavles mat` ket`ili sitqvebi da daaqenes qovladk`ebulis gzaze[islamis gzaze]!

cheshmaritad, romelnic` gaxdnen urcmunoni da sxvebsac` abrkolebdnen allahis gzidan [misdami sruli morch`ilebisgan] da cminda akrz'aluli mech`et`isgan [rodesac` ar sheushves shuamavali da morcmuneni hudaibiis cels] romelic` ch`ven davadginet` [morcmune] xalxisat`vis t`anascorad ganurch`evlad imisa, masshi c`xovroben isini ik` t`u momt`abareoben. da vinc` moisurvebs ik` [akrz'alul mech`et`shi] mart`ali gzisgan gandgomas usamart`lod [allahze urch`obit`], ch`ven vagemovnebt` mas mtkivneul sasjels.

da [gaixsenen] [o, shuamavalo] mivut`it`et` [vach`venet`] ibrahims saxlis [k`aabas] adgili [rat`a aeshenebina igi]: ar damidgino aravin t`anaziarad [sxva c`ru g'vt`aebebi] da cmindad sheinaxe ch`emi saxli [urcmunoebisgan, bid'at`isgan da mravalg'mert`iant`a sibinz'urisgan] garsshemomvlelt`at`vis [vinc` tavap`s ag'asrulebs], [loc`vashi] mdgomt`at`vis, t`aqvanismc`emelt`a da muxlmoqrilt`at`vis
da aucqe [xmamag'la] xalxs [o,ibrahim] hajis shesaxeb [imis shesaxeb, rom is savaldebuloa]. movidnen shent`an p`exit`a da ch`k`armavali ak`lemebit`, movlen qoveli shoreuli mxridan.

rat`a daescron imas, rac` sargebels moutans mat`
[rogoric`aa c`odvebis miteveba, morch`ilebist`visa da ritualebis shesrulebist`vis jildo, vachrobit` sargeblis mig'eba muslimt`a gamaert`ebeli sitqvis t`k`ma da sxva], da axsenon allahis saxeli c`nobil dg'eebshi [zul-hijjas meat`e dg'es da mis shemdeg t`ashriqis dg'eebshi -- me-11, me-12 da me-13 ric`xvebshi],
im pirutqvze, romelic` allahma uboz'a mat` sazrdod [msxverplad shesaciri pirutqvi]. chamet` t`k`ven [t`vit`on] da daapuret` gachirvebuli g'aribi

mere ki daasrulon mat`i danarch`eni[hajobis] ritualebi [ da sheichran t`ma, moichran p`rch`xilebi da datovon ihramis mdgomareoba], uert`gulon ag't`k`mas [romlebic` misc`es msxverplshecirvast`an dakavshirebit` an hajobast`an an umrast`an dakavshirebit` dadebuli ag't`k`ma] da shemouaron [ag'asrulon tavap`i] uz'veles saxls [k`aabas].

es [ihramidan gamosvla, ag't`k`mebis shesruleba da tavap`i k`aabas garshemo] aris is, rac` allahma daacesa,
amitom moepqarit` amas pativisc`emit` [vinc` ag'asrulebs allahis mier dadgenil ritualebs mxolod mis mimart` gulcrp`elad da sauket`eso p`ormit`] amgvarad... vinc` ganadidebs allahis sicmindeebs, es mist`visaa sasiket`o t`avisi g'mert`is cinashe [am k`veqnadac` da maradiul c`xovrebashi]. da nebadart`ulia t`k`vent`vis sak`oneli, imis garda [akrz'alulisa], rac` ch`amoget`vlebat`. moeridet` kerpt`a sibilces da moeridet` c`ru sitqvas [rogoric`aa allahze tquili, mravalg'mert`ianoba da c`ru mocmoba]

darch`it` hanip`ebad (ert`g'mert`ianebad) allahis mimart` [isini asruleben religiur cesebsa da ket`il sak`meebs mxolod allahis gulisat`vis, ar udgenen mas t`anaziars da ar sc`emen t`aqvans aravis, garda allahisa.] da aravin daudginot` mas t`anaziarad. is, vinc`, allahs t`anaziars daudgens [sch`adis mravalg'mert`ianobas], sheik`neba c`idan danarc`xebulis msgavsi, romelsac` ch`itebi caritac`eben, anda ukac`riel adgilas k`arcag'ebulis msgavsi!

[es aris is, rac` brz'ana allahma] amgvarad. vinc` ganadidebs allahis nishnebs [ritualebs, romelic` daadgina allahma], es gult`a g'vt`ismoshishebisganaa [es aris nishani im gulcrp`eli adamianebisa, romlebsac` eshiniat` allahis sasjelis].

t`k`vent`vis mat`shi [msxverplad gankut`vnil c`xovelebshi] aris sargebeli [shesaz'lebelia mat`i becvis, rz'is gamoqeneba an gadaadgilebist`vis gamoqeneba] gansazg'vrul vadamde [anu msxverplshecirvis at`-t`ashriqis dg'eebshi], xolo shemdeg mat`i dakvlis adgili aris z'veli saxlis [k`aabas] maxloblad [anu mt`eli cminda teritoria]

da qovel [cina] t`emist`vis ch`ven davadginet` msxverplshecirvis adgili da rituali, rat`a mat` axsenon allahis saxeli imaze, ra pirutqvic` uboz'a sarch`od. t`k`veni g'mert`i ki [o, adamianno] ert`adert`i g'mert`ia. amitom daemorch`ilet` mas [srulad gulit`ac` da sxeulit`ac`]. xolo shen [o, shuamavalo] axare morch`ilt` [romlebsac` am k`veqnadac` da maradiul c`xovrebashic` siket`e elit`].

[da aset`i morch`ilebi arian mxolod] isini, romelt`ac`, roc`a axseneben allahs, gulebi shishit` ekrt`ebat` [isini asruleben allahis brz'anebebs da t`avs ikaveben akrz'alulisgan], mot`minebas ich`enen (allahis jildos imedit`), asruleben loc`vebs [savaldebulo] [droulad, morch`ilebit`], da imidan, rac` ch`ven mivanichet` mat` [dashvebuli k`onebidan], xarjaven [allahis gzaze rogorc` savaldebulo, ise nebaqop`lobit` mocqalebas]

da msxverplad shesaciri c`xovelebi [romlebsac` cminda teritoriaze miedenebian] ch`ven gavxadet` t`k`vent`vis allahis nishnebat`agani [religiuri cest`agani, romlebic` man daadgina]. t`k`vent`vis [o, allahis kmaqop`ilebis maz'iebelno] mat`shi siket`ea [t`k`ven t`vit`onac` chamt`, mocqalebasac` gasc`emt` da saik`ioshi amist`vis jildos miig'ebt`]. amitom axsenet` allahis saxeli mat`ze, [roc`a daklavt`]. [rac` sheexeba ak`lemebs, isini p`ec`ze borkil dap`ebuli] mdgomare mdgomareobashi, xolo roc`a daec`emian mxarit` [ roc`a daklavt` mat`], chamet` mat`gan [vinc` t`vit`on dakla], daapuret` t`avshekavebuli [romelic` ar it`xovs] da morc`xvad mt`xovneli. ase dagimorch`ilet` isini t`k`ven [shesaciri c`xovelni], rat`a madlierni qop`iliqavit` [allahis mimart`].

allahamde [mis cinashe] ar ag'cevs arc` mat`i [msxverplsheciruli c`xovelebis] xorc`i da arc` mat`i sisxli, aramed mast`an ag'cevs t`k`veni g'vt`ismoshishoba [anu t`k`veni gulcrp`eli zraxva am msxverplshecirvit` mxolod allahis kmaqop`ileba moipovot`, misi brz'aneba sheasrulot` da airidot` is, rac` man akrz'ala]. ase dagimorch`ilat` isini [es c`xovelebi], rat`a allahi gandidot` im xelmz'g'vanelobist`vis, romlit`ac` man gach`venat` cheshmariti gza. xolo shen [o, shuamavalo] axare gulcrp`el ket`ilismqop`elebs [vinc` gulcrp`elia allahis cinashe da siket`es uket`ebs mis k`mnilebebs], [rom isini daimsaxureben ket`il shedegs da carmatebas].

cheshmaritad, allahi ic`avs morcmuneebs [urcmunot`a borotebisgan da xrikebisgan, av xerxebs mat` ch`anap`ik`rebs da gexmarebat` mat` cinaag'mdeg]! cheshmaritad, allahs ar uqvars arc`ert`i mog'alate [vinc` arg'vevs shet`anxmebebs da ver inaxavs mindobils] da umaduri [vinc` uarqop`s t`avis up`als, mis cigns, moc`ik`uls da mis siket`eebs]

nebadart`ulia brz'ola mat`t`vis, vist`anac` ibrz'vian [anu nebadart`ulia morcmunet`at`vis, vis cinaag'mdegac` ibrz'vian mravalg'mert`ianni], [aseve ibrz'vian] radgan isini dach`agrulni iqvnen [mat`i up`lebebi shelaxes] namdvilad, allahs uechvelad z'aluz's mat`i daxmareba

isini usamart`lod gamoaz'eves sac`xovreblebidan, mxolod imitom, rom ambobdnen:,,ch`veni g'mert`i allahiao!" allahs rom ar miec`a neba xalxist`vis, t`avi daec`vat` ert`manet`isgan, daingreoda monastrebi, saqdrebi, sinagogebi da
mech`et`ebi, romlebshic` mravlad ixsenieba allahis saxeli. allahi sheeceva imat`, vinc` mis sarcmunoebas exmareba. allahi z'levamosili, qovlisshemz'lea. isini, vinc` gaz'evebulni ik`nen [mravalg'mert`ianebis mier] sakut`ari saxlebidan qovelgvari up`lebis gareshe [gaumart`leblad], mxolod imis gamo, rom t`k`ves: ch`veni up`ali allahia. da rom allahi ar ic`avdes xalxs ert`t`i - meoret`agan [anu rom ar daeqenebina brz'olis kanoni usamart`lobisa da sic`ruis shesach`ereblad], daingreoda monastrebic`, eklsiebic` [k`ristianebis], sinagogebic` [iudevelt`a] da mech`et`ebic` [ namdvil morcmunet`a], romlebshic` mravlad ixsenieben allahis saxels. da uechvelad, allahi sheeceva mas, vinc` mas exmareba [mis sarcmunoebasa da morcmune msaxurebs], cheshmaitad, allahi qovlad z'lieria da qovlisshemz'lea

imat`, romelt`ac` vuboz'ebt` batonobas k`veqanaze, asruleben [savaldebulo] loc`vas [cesisamebr], gasc`emen zek`at`s [visac` ekut`vnis], ubrz'aneben ket`ilis k`mnas [igulisxmeba qvelap`eri, rac` allahma ubrz'ana mis mimart` da misi msaxurebis mimart`] da krz'alaven borotebas [risi akrz'alvac` allahma brz'ana t`avadac` da t`avisi moc`ik`ulis meshveobit`ac`]. sak`met`a dasasruli allahis xelshia [is t`avad gansjis k`mnilebebs da qvelas miuzg'avs sat`anadod]

xolo t`u isini [sheni xalxi] c`rud shegrac`xaven [o, muhammad], mashin mat` cinac` sherac`xves c`rud [t`aviant`i shuamavalebi] nuhis/noes xalxma, adianelebma [hudis xalxma] da samudianelebma [salihis xalxma]
ibrahimis xalxma da lutis xalxma uarqves [t`aviant`i shuamavlebi]

da madianis mc`xovreblebmac` [shuaibis xalxma] uarqves [shuamavlebi], da musac` ik`na c`rud sherac`xuli. me ki vaz'levdi urcmunoebs vadas [ar vsjidi mat` mqisierad], shemdeg ki davatexe mat` sasjeli. da rogori iqo ch`emi risxva!

da ramdeni sop`eli [misi mkvidrni] gavanadguret` [roc`a sasjeli movuvline mat`], roc`a isini iqvnen borotmok`medni [urcmunoni]! da ai, isini [es k`alak`ebi da sop`lebi] [axla] dangreulni arian z'irp`esvianad [da ag'aravin c`xovrobs mat`shi]! da ramdeni cqaro da ag'mart`uli sasaxlea mitovebuli [im sop`lebis mkvidrt`a dag'upvis gamo]

gana ar daexetebodnen isini [urcmuno mek`k`elebi da sxvani] dedamicaze [gana ar qop`ilan iemensa da shamshi]? gana ar hk`ondat` gulebi, romlit`ac` dap`ik`rdebodnen [roc`a xedavdnen dag'upul xalxt`a kvals]? an qurebi, romlit`ac` mousmendnen [shetqobinebebs carsuli xalxebis shesaxeb, vinc` urcmunoeba gamoich`ina]? namdvilad, ar brmavdeba t`valebi, aramed brmavdeba gulebi, romlebic` mkerdebshia.
[namdvili sibrmave esaa gulis sibrmave, roc`a adamiani ver ac`nobierebs cheshmaritebas.]

da isini [urcmuno quraishebi] gich`k`areben sasjels [o, shuamavalo] [gekit`xebian:,,rodis dadgeba es sasjeli urcmunoebis gamo?], magram allahi ar arg'vevs t`avis ag't`k`mas [sasjeli uechvelad dadgeba]. cheshmaritad, shens up`alt`an ert`i dg'e [ tanjva-camebisa maradiul c`xovrebashi] aris rogorc` at`asi celi imat`gan, rasac` t`k`ven it`vlit` [am k`veqanaze]

da ramden sop`els [mis mc`xovrebt`] mivec`i vada [gadavuvade sasjeli], mashinac` ki, roc`a isini borotmok`medni iqvnen [urcmunoebashi jiutobdnen]! shemdeg ki davatexe mat` sasjeli [am k`veqnad], da ch`emskenaa [ara sxvisken] saboloo dabruneba [gankit`xvis dg'es], [roc`a t`it`oeuli miig'ebs imas, rac` daimsaxura].
ut`xari [o, shuamavalo]: hei, adamianebo! namdvilad, me var t`k`vent`vis c`xadi shemgonebeli [romelic` gacvdit` allahis gzavnils]
romelt`ac` ircmunes da ket`ili sak`me aket`es, mat` [allahisgan] mienichebat` miteveba da g'irseuli sazg'auri [samot`xe]
isini ki, romlebic` c`dilobdnen ch`veni sascaulebis [quranis aiat`ebis] dakninebas [xalxis gashorebas allahis sitqvebisgan], ik`nebian c`ec`xlis mkvidrni.

ar cargvigzavnia shenamde arc` ert`i shuamavali [o, muhammad] an cinascarmetqveli, rom eshmaks ar daert`o t`avisi mis cakit`xulshi[rat`a msmenelshi echvi gach`ndes quranis mimart`]. allahi gaauk`mebs imas, rasac` eshmaki
daurt`avs. mere allahi ganamtkic`ebs t`avis sascaulebs, allahi qovlismc`odne, brz'enia!

[da es ar xdeba t`avad eshmakisgan aramed allahi az'levs amis nebas] igi gadaak`c`evs imas, rasac` eshmaki agebs, sac`duneblad mat`t`vis, romelt`a gulebshic` sneulebaa da romelt`a gulebic` sastikia. usamart`loni shoreul ganxet`k`ilebashi arian [cheshamritebidan da mtrobashi arian mast`an].

[es xdeba imisat`vis, rom] ic`odnen imat`, romelt`ac` eboz'at` c`odna, rom igi cheshmaritebaa sheni g'mert`isagan, ircmunon misi da damorch`ildnen mas mat`i gulebi. cheshmaritad, allahi ucinamz'g'vrebs scori gzit` imat`, vinc` ircmuna [es rcmena da es morch`ileba momdinareobs mxolod allahis cqalobit`a da daxmarebit`].

xolo isini, vinc` arian urcmunoni, kvlav echvshi ik`nebian mis mimart`, vidre daudgebat` zhami uec`rad, anda miecevat` sasjeli im unaqop`o dg'isa [sasjelis] [sasamart`lo] dg'is unaqop`oba, radgan mis shemdeg ag'ar arsebobs sxva dg'eebi].
z'alaup`leba im dg'es mxolod allahis ik`neba, gansjis mat` shoris [morcmuneebs da urcmunoebs] da isini, vinc` ircmuna da siket`e aket`es, damkvidrdebian[maradiulad] samot`xis bag'ebshi
xolo romelt`ac` ar ircmunes da c`rud sherac`xes ch`veni sascaulebi [quranis aiat`ebi], scored mat` miegebat` damamc`irebeli sasjeli [jojoxet`shi].

isini, romelnic` gadasaxldnen allahis gzaze [datoves t`aviant`i saxlebi, rat`a moepovebinat` allahis kmaqop`ileba da daxmarebodnen misi sitqvis damkvidrebashi], mere moklul ik`nen an gardaic`valnen, daasach`uk`rebs mat` allahi ket`ili sarch`ot`i da, cheshmaritad, allahia sauket`eso sarch`os momc`emi
is [allahi] usat`uod sheiqvans mat` shesasvlelshi, romlit`ac` kmaqop`ilni ik`nebian da, cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismc`odne t`avshekavebulia [ar ch`k`arobs dasajos isini, vinc` ar emorch`ileba mas]

ai ase [allahis sitqvebi imaze, rom gadasaxlebuli adamianebi sheqvanilni ik`nebian samot`xeshi, gaxsovdet` es]. xolo vinc` dasaja imis msgavsit`, rit`ac` daisaja, da mere usamart`lod moek`c`nen, allahi usat`uod sheeceva mas [orjer ch`agruls]. cheshmaritad, allahi shemndobi, mimtevebelia
[is, rom allahi daexmareba ch`agruls] es imis gamo, rom allahi [qovlis shemz'lea] shehqavs g'ame dg'eshi da shehqavs dg'e g'ameshi. da allahi qovlisgamgone, qovlismxedvelia

[zemot` xsenebuli allahis qovlisshemz'leoba, misi qovlisc`odneoba da misi daxmareba t`avis morcmune momxreebze] es imis gamo, rom cheshmariteba allahia. xolo is, rasac` mouxmoben [mravalg'mert`ianebi] mis garda sic`ruea [bat`ilia], da imitom, rom allahi uzenaesia, didebulia
[o, shuamavalo] gana ver xedav [nut`u ar ic`i], rom allahi gardmoavlens zec`ic`an cqals da mica mcvandeba? cheshmaritad, allahi ket`ilia [t`avisi monebis mimart`], qovlismc`odnea.
misia [qvelap`eri], rac` c`at`a shinaa da rac` k`veqanasa zedaa. da cheshmaritad, allahi mdidari, qovladk`ebulia

gana ver xedav, rom allahma dagimorch`ilat` t`k`ven qoveli, rac` dedamicazea, da xomaldebic` romlebic` dac`uraven zg'vashi misi brz'anebit`, da ichers zec`as, rom ar daemxos is dedamicas, misi nebis gareshe. cheshmaritad, allahi adamianebis mimart` t`anagrz'nobi da mocqalea

isaa allahi, vinc` giboz'at` sic`oc`xle, shemdeg mogakvdinebt`, shemdgom isev gagac`oc`xlebt`. cheshmaritad adamiani urcmunoa [uarqop`s allahis c`xad sascaulebs, romlebic` miut`it`ebs mis z'lierebaze].
qovel [cinat` mqop`] t`ems davudginet` g'vt`ismsaxurebis cesebi da isini asruleben amas. da ar gekamat`on am sak`meze. mouxme sheni g'mert`isaken. cheshmaritad, shen [o, muhammad] dgaxar scor gzaze
da t`u [o,shuamavalo] shegedavebian [urcmunoni], ut`xari [mat`]: allahma qvelaze uket` ic`is is, rasac` aket`ebt`
allahi gansjis t`k`vens shoris [morcmuneebsa da urcmunoebs shoris] ag'dgomis dg'es imas, razedac` ver t`anxmdebodit`

gana ar ic`i [o, shuamavalo], rom allahma ic`is, is rac` c`at`a shinaa da rac` k`veqanasa zedaa. cheshmaritad, [qvelap`eri] ch`acerilia cignshi [lavhi - mavp`uzshi]. cheshmaritad es allahist`vis iolia

isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] et`aqvanebian allahis garda imas, vist`visac` mas mtkic`ebuleba ar zegardmouvlenia da arc` mat` ak`vt` amis shesaxeb c`odna. usamart`loebs ki ar hqavt` damxmare [rom daip`aron allahis sasjelisgan].

da roc`a mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] ekit`xebat` ch`veni nat`eli aiat`ebi [quranidan], dainaxav uarqop`as imat` saxeze, romlebic` urcmunoni arian.. lamisaa, t`avs daesxnen imas, vinc` ch`vens aiat`ebs ukit`xavt`. ut`xari mat` [o, shuamavalo]: xom ar mec`nobebina t`k`vent`vis amaze up`ro sashineli? es c`ec`xlia! - ag'ut`k`va is allahma imat`, vinc` arian urcmunoni da ra avia es t`avshesap`ari

hei adamianebo! magalit`ist`visaa igavi, mash mousminet`. cheshmaritad, romelt`ac` t`k`ven mouxmobt`, allahis garda, ver shek`mnian [ert`] buzsac` ki, romc` gaert`ianden [c`ru g'vt`aebebi] amisat`vis. t`u buzi raimes mostac`ebs mat`, ver caart`meven ukan. sustia is, vinc` it`xovs, da isic`, visac` st`xoven
ar ap`aseben [mravalg'merianebi] allahs jerovnad. allahi ki qovladz'lieri, z'levamosilia

allahma amoarch`ia angelozt`agan shuamavlebi [romlebsac` ugzavnis t`avis cinascarmetqvelebs] da xalxisagan [romlebic` gadasc`emen allahis zesht`agonebas sxva adamianebs]. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismsmeni, qovlismxedvelia
man ic`is [qvelap`eri] mat`i carsuli da momavali da sak`meni allaht`an ik`neba dabrunebuli
hei t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`, celshi moixaret`, sejde ag'asrulet` da t`aqvani ec`it` [mxolod] t`k`vens g'mert`s [allahs] da siket`e aket`et`, rat`a egebis, netar ik`mnet`

gaisarjet` allahist`vis sat`anado brz'olit` [gaig'et` mt`eli t`k`veni z'ala mis gzaze, mxolod mist`vis] man amogarch`iat` da ar daudgenia t`k`vent`vis aranairi sirt`ule sarcmunoebashi. es mamat`k`venis, ibrahimis religiaa. man [allahma] gicodat` t`k`ven muslimebi ucin da ama cignshi, rat`a iqos shuamavali mocmed t`k`venda, t`k`ven ki mocmeni iqot` xalxisa. dadek`it` loc`vad, gaec`it` zek`at`i da mtkic`ed ch`aechidet` allahs [daic`avit` is rcmena, romelic` man mogc`at`]. igia t`k`veni mp`arveli. ra mshvenieri mp`arvelia! ra mshvenieri damxmare
morcmuneebma ukve carmatebas miag'cies
romlebic` t`aviant` loc`vebshi mokrz'alebulni arian
romlebic` t`avs arideben amao sak`mes [toveben qvela im sak`mes, sitqvas da p`ik`rs, romlebic` ar migviqvans allahis kmaqop`ilebamde]
romlebic` gancmendist`vis [t`avis suls da k`onebas] gasc`emen [ixdian zak`at`s]
romlebic` ic`aven t`aviant` sask`eso organoebs [mrushobisgan da qvela akrz'aluli k`medebebisgan]
garda t`aviant`i c`olebisa da im k`alebisa, romlebic` mat` marjvenas upqriat` [monebi] cheshmaritad, isini ar arian gasakic`xni
xolo vinc` amaze mets moindomebs, mashin isini arian zg'vars gadasulni
romlebic` ic`aven mat` mindobils da [asruleben] t`aviant` shet`anxmebebs.
romlebic` p`rt`xilad ic`aven t`aviant` loc`vebs
scored isini arian memkvidreni
romlebic` daimkvidreben p`irdauss [samot`xis umag'les sap`exurs] da ik` isini samudamod darch`ebian
ch`ven ukve shevk`menit` adamiani [adami] t`ixis arsisgan [t`ixisgan, romelic` qvela micis adgilidan aris ag'ebuli]
shemdeg misi sht`amomavali [adamis shvili] movat`avset` cvet`i [mamakac`is t`esli] usap`rt`xo adgilas [dedis sashvilosnoshi]

shemdeg am cvet`idan shevk`menit` sisxlis shededeba, shemdeg am shededebidan shevk`menit` xorc`is nacheri, shemdeg am xorc`is nachridan shevk`menit` z'vlebi, da shemdeg z'vlebs movavlet` xorc`it`. mere ki gavzardet` igi rogorc` sxva [axali] k`mnileba [ch`avberet` masshi suli]. kurt`xeulia allahi sauket`eso shemk`mneli
mere cheshmaritad, t`k`ven [o, adamianebo] amis shemdeg [ganvit`arebis etapebis gavlisa da sic`oc`xlis vadis amocurvis shemdeg] uechvelad mokvdebit`
shemdeg ki, cheshmaritad, t`k`ven [o, adamianebo] ag'dgomis dg'es kvlav ag'dgebit`
shemdeg, ch`ven gavach`inet` t`k`vens zemot` shvidi gza [shvidi c`a, romlebic` ert`manet`is zemot` aris ganlagebuli] da ar vqop`ilvart` k`mnilebis mimart` ugulisxmoni
da gardmovavlinet` c`idan cqali gansazg'vruli raodenobit`, ganvat`avset` igi micaze da shegviz'lia misi gak`robac`.
da am [cqlit`] gagizardet` bag'ebi p`inikis xeebisa da vazisa [qurz'enis] t`k`vent`visaa mat`shi mravali naqop`i, da mat` [naqop`ebs] t`k`ven chamt`.
da xe, romelic` izrdeba sinas mt`aze, iz'leva zet`s da sag'ebavs mchamelt`at`vis
t`k`vent`vis sak`onelshi shegonebaa. ch`ven garcqulebt` imit`, rac` mat` muc`lebshia [rz'e]. t`k`ven mat`shi gak`vt` mravali sargebeli da mat`gan ikvebebit`
da mat`it` [samgzavro c`xovelebit`], da xomaldebit` gadaadgildebit`
[adre] carvagzavnet` [shuamavali] nuhi t`avis xalxt`an. ut`xra: hei ch`emo xalxo, t`aqvani ec`it` mxolod allahs, ar gqavt` sxva g'vt`aeba mis garda. nut`u ar shegeshindebat`?

t`k`ves didebulebma imat`gan, vinc` gaxdnen urcmunoni: es [nuhi] mxolod kac`ia t`k`veni msgavsi, romelsac` surs, rom t`k`venze ag'matebuli iqos. xolo allahs rom enebebina, gardmoavlenda angelozebs, amaze ki ch`veni cinaprebisgan arap`eri gvsmenia.
es [nuhi] mxolod sheshlili adamiania, dae, daelodet` mas c`ota xans
man [nuhma] t`k`va: o, g'mert`o, damexmare [ch`emi eris cinaag'mdeg], radgan mat`, c`rud shemrac`xes, [roc`a mivutane is, rit`ac` shen gamomigzavne mat`t`an]!

da ch`ven sht`avagonet` mas [nuhs]: ganamzade kidobani [gemi] ch`veni t`valt`axedvis k`vesh [ch`veni dac`vis k`vesh] da ch`veni sht`agonebit` [rogorc` ch`ven gibrz'anebt`]. rodesac` mova ch`veni brz'aneba [sheni eris urcmunoebis gamo dasasjelad] da gadmoxet`k`avs cqali t`onedan [rac` carg'vnis dacqebis nishani ik`neba], mashin sheiqvane masshi [gemshi] t`it`oeuli saxeobidan cqvili da sheni ojaxi [sheni shvilebi da c`oli], garda imat`isa, viszec` ukve ganesazg'vra ch`emi sitqva [sasjelist`vis mat`i urcmunoebis gamo] [garda sheni c`olisa da shvilisa]. da nu damicqeb laparaks imat` [gadarch`enaze], vinc` boroteba ch`aidina: eshmaritad, isini ik`nebian ch`az'irulni.
roc`a axvalt` xomaldze shen [o,nuh] da isini, vinc` shent`an arian, t`k`vi: k`eba-dideba allahs, romelmac` gvixsna usamart`lo [urcmuno] xalxisgan
da t`k`vi [o, nuh]: g'mert`o ch`emo, ch`amomiqvane [xomaldidan] daloc`vil adgilas. shen sauket`eso damsaxlebeli xar.

cheshmaritad, amashi [am ambavshi] aris sascaulebi [miut`it`ebeli allahis z'lierebaze, mis sibrz'nesa da imaze, rom auc`ilebelia misi rcmena da mxolod masze morch`ileba], da cheshmaritad, ch`ven vc`dit` [ch`ven monebs, roc`a vugzavnit` mat` shuamavlebs rat`a, gamovlindes morcmune an urcmuno].
mere ki, ch`ven [shuamavali nuhis xalxis] shemdeg moviqvanet` sxva t`aoba.
da carvagzavnet` mat`shi shuamavlebi mat`ganve - rat`a allahisat`vis t`aqvani ec`at`, ar gqavt` t`k`ven sxva g'vt`aeba mis garda. da gana ar geshiniat`[anu ik`oniet` allahis shishi]?

da t`k`va [c`nobilma] sazogadoebam misive t`emidan romelt`ac` ar ircmunes, da c`rudac` sherac`xes saik`ios shexvedra, da romelt`ac` vuboz'et` ket`ildg'eoba am k`veqnad es sxva aravinaa, t`u ara kac`i t`k`veni msgavsi, romelic` chams imas, rasac` t`k`ven chamt`
xolo t`u daemorch`ilebit` kac`s, t`k`vens msgavss [huds] [da t`aqvans sc`emt` mxolod ert`adert` allahs], cagebulni ik`nebit`
gana [hudi] gpirdebat` igi, rom roc`a mokvdebit` da mtvrad da z'vlebad ik`c`evit`, rom ag'dgenil ik`nebit` [t`k`venive sap`lavebidan c`oc`xlebi [ag'dgenilebi] ik`nebit`]?
shorsaa, shorsaa is, rac` ag'get`k`vat`! [o, adamianebo] [mic`valebult`a ag'dgoma]
es sic`oc`xle arap`eria garda ch`veni amk`veqniuri c`xovrebisa. vkvdebit`[c`oc`xlebi] da vc`oc`xlobt`[anu ibadebian da c`oc`xloben sxvebi] da ar vik`nebit` ag'dgenilnio.
es [hudi] mxolod adamiania, romelmac` moip`ik`ra allahze sic`rue da ch`ven misi ara gvjera
man [nuhma] t`k`va: o, g'mert`o, damexmare [ch`emi eris cinaag'mdeg], radgan mat`, uarmqves me, [roc`a mivutane is, rit`ac` shen gamomigzavne mat`t`an]!
t`k`va man [allahma]: c`ota xnis shemdeg isini [es urcmunoni] auc`ileblad ik`nebian monaniebulni.
da sheipqro [adieli urcmunoebi] isini sashinelma xmam da vak`c`iet` isini niag'vrit` mimop`antul namsxverevebad. dae moisht`on [urcmunoni] usamart`loni
mere avg'zardet` mat` shemdgom sxva t`aobebi.
verc`ert`i eri ver gauscrebs sakut`ari [c`xovrebis] dros da verc` gadaavadebs.

mere carvagzavnet` shuamavlebi ert`manet`is kvaldakval. xolo roc`a ki romelime t`emt`an midioda shuamavali, c`rud rac`xavdnen mas. da mivaqolet` isini ert`manet`s da vak`c`iet` igavebad. dae moisht`os urcmuno xalxi
shemdeg ch`ven movavlinet` [shuamavali] musa da misi z'ma [shuamavali] haruni ch`veni sascaulebit` [c`xra sascaulit`] da mkap`io mtkic`ebulebit`.
p`araont`an da mis carch`inebulebt`an. mat` ki t`avi ganidides, ramet`u iqvnen ampartavani xalxi [sxvebze ag'matebulad t`vlidnen t`avs].
da t`k`ves: rogor vircmunot` ori adamianis, ch`veni msgavsis mashin, roc`a mat` xalxi [israelis xalxi] ch`veni gvemoneba
da mat` uarqves es ori [musa da haruni], da sabolood ag'moch`ndnen ganadgurebult`a shoris [allahis sasjelit`]
da vp`ic`av, vuboz'et` musas cigni [t`ora], rat`a egebis [israelis xalxs] exelmz'g'vanelad [misit`]
da davadginet` mariamis z'e [shuamavali isa] da dedamisi sascaulebad da davasaxlet` mag'lobze, sadac` cqaro moedineboda.
hei, shuamavlebo! chamet` [is sachmeli, rac` aris] ket`ili [dashvebuli] da aket`et` mart`ali sak`meebi. cheshmaritad, me vic`i, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`
cheshmaritad, t`k`veni es religia, [o, shuamavlebo] ert`i da igive religiaa [islami] da me t`k`veni g'mert`i var, ch`emi geshinodet`

xolo mat` [adamianebma] gaqves t`aviant`i sak`me [ert`iani rcmena] nacilebad [daiqvnen rcmenashi], qovela jgup`ma gaixara imit`, rac` ak`vs [p`ik`robs, rom mxolod isini arian cheshmaritebaze, xolo sxvebi gzaabnevashi]
da datove [o, shuamavalo] isini t`aviant` sibec`eshi [mat` gzaabnevashi], gansazg'vrul vadamde.
gana p`ik`roben [es urcmunoni], rom im k`onebit`a da z'eebit`, rit`ac` ch`ven vexmarebit`
[anu, nut`u isini p`ik`roben, rom] ch`ven vch`k`arobt` mat`t`vis siket`eebit` [imit`, rac` mat` daimsaxures]? pirik`it` es aris gamoc`da da sac`duri mat`t`vis, xolo isini ver grz'noben amas.
cheshmaritad, isini, vinc` t`aviant`i up`lis shishit` z'rcian
da mat`, visac` mtkic`ed scamt` t`aviant`i up`lis sascaulebis [quranis aiat`ebis] [da mok`medeben mat` shesabamisad]
da mat`, romelnic` t`aviant` up`als ar udgenen t`anaziars [mxolod ert` allahs emsaxurebian da mxolod mas t`aqvans sc`emen].

da romlebic` gasc`emen gasac`ems [zak`at`s, mocqalebas] da mat` gulebi uc`axc`axebt` imit`, rom t`aviant` g'mert`t`an ik`nebian dabrunebulni [shishoben, rom mat`i sak`meebi ar ik`neba mig'ebuli allahis mier da p`ik`roben, rom es sak`meebi ar eqop`at` sasjelisgan gadasarch`enad]
scored isini ascreben ert`manet`s siket`isaken da amashi mocinaveni arian

da ch`ven ar vakisrebt` arc`ert` suls imaze mets, rac` sheuz'lia. ch`vent`anaa cigni [sadac` angelozebma ch`aceres ch`veni monis sak`meebi], romelic` ambobs simart`les, mat` mimart` [allahis monebis mimart`] da isini ar daich`agrebian

pirik`it`, mat`i [urcmunot`a] gulebi sibneleshia [sig'rmiseul umec`rebashi da sibneleshi] amisgan [cignisgan sadac` mat`i k`medebebia, da quranisgan], da mat` ak`vt` [sxva] sak`meebic` [sxva c`odvebi] amis garda [urcmunoebast`an ert`ad], romlebsac` ch`adian.
roc`a ch`ven davsjit` mat`gan p`up`unebashi mqop`t` sasjelit`, ai mashin daicqeben isini godebas [shvelis t`xovnit`].
nu mot`k`vamt`! dg'es t`k`ven ar mogec`emat` ch`vengan daxmareba.
t`k`ven gekit`xebodat` ch`veni sascaulebi [quranis aiat`ebi], mashin ukuik`ec`it` k`uslebze shemdgari

ampartavnobdit` misi [k`aabis] gamo [p`ik`robdit`, rom veravin dagamarc`xebt`, radgan akrz'aluli micis mek`k`is mkvidrni xart`] da g'ameebs atarebdit` bilc, usargeblo saubarshi. cheshmariteba ki [mitovebuli] gk`ondat`
nut`u es [urcmunoni] ar up`ik`rdebian am sitqvas [quranze]? an eboz'at` is, rac` ar hboz'ebia mat` cinaprebs?
an ar ic`nobdnen t`aviant` shuamavals [muhammads], rom uarqves igi?
anda amboben, rom is [muhammadi] sulelia? pirik`it`, is mivida mat`t`an cheshmaritebit`, t`umc`a umetes mat`gans cheshmariteba sz'uls

cheshmariteba mat` survilebs rom ahqoloda, gap`uchdeboda c`ani, dedamica da is, vinc` mat`shia. magram ch`ven mivutanet` mat` [mek`k`elebs] shegoneba, romelic` mat`ve exeba [qurani, sadac` mat`zea saubari], t`umc`a isini am shegonebisgan [quranisgan] zurgs ik`c`even.
nut`u st`xov [o, shuamavalo] mat` [urcmunoebs] sap`asurs, roc`a sheni g'mert`is jildo uket`esia da scored igi aris sauket`eso sazrdos mimnichebeli
da namdvilad, shen [o, muhammad] moucodeb mat` [shens ers da sxvebsac`] scor gzaze [cheshmarit rcmenaze islamze].
xolo isini, romelt`ac` ar scamt` saik`io [ag'sdgomis, gansjis. jojoxet`is da samot`xis], am gzisgan gadaxrilni arian

da romc` cqaloba mogveg'o mat`ze [mek`k`as mravalg'mert`ianebze] da agveshorebina mat`t`vis is zarali, rac` damart`niat`, mainc` jiutad ch`arch`ebodnen t`aviant` urch`obashi, brmad moxetialeni [urcmunoebashi]
ch`ven shevipqarit` isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] sasjelit` [gvalvit`a da shimshilit`], magram isini ar damorch`ildnen t`aviant` g'mert`s da arc` sheevedres
vidre gavxsnidit` mat`dami [mravalg'mert`ianebisadmi] mkac`rsasjelian karibches [maradiul c`xovrebashi]. mashin isini sasocarkvet`ashi ch`avardnen

mxolod is [allahia], romelmac` mogc`at` qurt`asmena, mxedveloba da guli [azrovneba]. da ra mc`irea
t`k`veni [o, urcmunoebo] madliereba
da [mxolod] igi [allahi] aris is, vinc` shegk`mnat` micaze, da mast`anve ik`nebit` shekrebilni [sasjelis dg'es].
isaa mxolod [allahi], vinc` ac`oc`xlebs da akvdinebs. mas ekut`vnis monac`vleoba dg'isa da g'amisa. gana gons ar mouxmobt`
t`umc`a, mat` [urcmunoebma] igive t`k`ves, rac` t`k`ves pirvelebma [adre mc`xovrebma urcmunoebma]
t`k`ves: [nut`u es shesaz'lebelia] roc`a movkvdebit` da micad da z'vlebad vik`c`evit`, gana namdvilad avg'sdgebit`?
ag'vgvet`k`va ch`ven da ch`vens cinaprebsac` ucin [qvelap`eri is, rasac` gviqvebi shen o, muhammad]. es arap`eria, ucindelt`a zg'aprebis gardao
ut`xari [o, shuamavalo] [mravalg'mert`ianebs, romelt`ac` ar scamt` ag'dgomis da allahis sasjelis]: visia k`veqana da is, rac` maszea, t`u ic`it`?!
getqvian [mravalg'mert`ianebi]: allahisa! ut`xari: gana ver sheigonebt`?
hkit`xe [o, shuamavalo]: vin aris g'mert`i shvidi zec`isa da didebuli taxtrevanis?
itqvian [mravalg'mert`ianebi]: allahi[allahis kut`vnilebaa]! ut`xari: gana ar geshiniat`?
ut`xari [mat`] [o, shuamavalo]: vin aris is, vis xelt`ac`aa meup`eba qoveli sagnisa? da vin aris damc`veli da vin aris, romlisganac` veravin veravis daic`avs [misi sasjelisgan] t`u ic`it`?
itqvian [mravalg'mert`ianebi]: allahis! ut`xari: mash rogor jadovdebit` [tquvdebit`]
t`umc`a, ch`ven mivutanet` mat` [am urcmunoebs] cheshmariteba [qurani] [moc`ik`ulis movlinebit`], da cheshmaritad, isini c`ruoben [t`aviant` sitqvebshi da t`aviant` mocodebashi].

ar auqvania allahs aravin shvilad, da aravinaa [sxva] g'vt`aeba mast`an ert`ad. ase rom qop`iliqo, qoveli g'vt`aeba caig'ebda imas, rac` man shek`mna da amag'ldebodnen ert`imeoreze [ert`manet`s daamarc`xebdnen.] didebulia allahi imaze, rasac` [mravalg'mert`ianebi] miaceren [t`anamoziares da shvils]!
mc`odnea dap`arulisa da c`xadisa. didebulia imaze, rasac` t`anaziarad udgenen [mas]
t`k`vi [o, shuamavalo]: g'mert`o ch`emo, t`u mich`veneb imas, rac` mat` ag'et`k`vat`
g'mert`o ch`emo, ar hk`mna me usamart`lo xalxt`a shoris.
da ch`ven shegviz'lia is, rom gich`venot` [o, shuamavalo] [sasjeli], rac` mat` [mrvalg'mert`ianebs] ag'vut`k`vit`
uarqavi is siave [o, shuamavalo] imit`, rac` uket`esia. ch`ven uket` vic`it` is, rasac` isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] mogvaceren
da t`k`vi [o, shuamavalo]: g'mert`o, shen mogekedlebi eshmakt`a c`dunebisgan.
da shen shegep`arebi [dasac`avad] g'mert`o, rom ar moevlinon ch`emt`an!
da roc`a sikvdili miuaxlovdeba romelime mat`gans [mravalg'mert`ianebs], ambobs: g'mert`o ch`emo, damabrune ukan [am k`veqnad]

rat`a vaket`o ket`ili sak`me, romelic` mivatove [sheiz'leba vircmuno da morch`ili gavxde sheni], magram ara! es mxolod sitqvaa, romelsac` ambobs [aravit`ari sargebeli ar moak`vs mist`vis am sitqvas]. da mat` ukan zg'udea ag'dgomis dg'emde!
da roc`a ch`aibereba saqvirshi [roc`a dadgeba gankit`xvis dg'e] da ag'ar ik`neba nat`esaoba mat` shoris im dg'es da ert`manet`s ar moikit`xaven
da visi sascoric` [allaht`an angarishis gacevis dros] gadaconis, isini netar ik`nebian
xolo [g'mert`is cinashe angarishisas] visi sascoric` msubuk`i ik`neba, scored isini arian, romelt`ac` sakut`ar t`avs ziani miaqenes, jojoxet`shi ik`nebian maradiulad
c`ec`xli cvavs mat` saxeebs, da isini arian masshi usaxod [saxis kanis sruli damcvrobis gamo]
[mat` et`k`mebat`] gana ar gekit`xebodat` ch`emi aiat`ebi [quranidan], t`k`ven ki mat` c`rud rac`xavdit`?
[isini] itqvian [gankit`xvis dg'es]: g'mert`o ch`veno, gvz'lia ch`venive carcqmendilobam da viqavit` gzaabneuli xalxi
g'mert`o ch`veno, gagviqvane ak`edan [jojoxet`idan] da t`u kidev davubrundebit` [urcmunoebasa da c`odvebshi], mashin vik`nebit` usamart`lonio
[is] etqvis [mat`]: eqaret` masshi [jojoxet`shi] da nu damelaparakebit` [da amis shemdeg isini veg'ar shez'leben allahis mimart` shevedrebas da ag'ar ek`nebat` aranairi imedi]!
cheshmaritad, ch`emi msaxurebis ert`i nacili ambobda: g'mert`o ch`veno vircmunet`! mogviteve ch`ven da shegvicqale, ramet`u shena xar shemcqalebelt`agan sauket`eso
da t`k`ven [o, urcmunenno] ki masxrad aigdet` isini ise, rom aman ch`emi xsovnac` ki dagavicqat` mashin, roc`a mat`ze ic`inodit`
cheshmaritad, me [allahma] davajildove isini [morcmuneni] dg'es imisat`vis, rom moit`mines da isini netarni arian
[allahis] etqvis [jojoxet`is mkvidrt`]: ramden xans dahqavit` dedamicaze?
miugeben: ert`i dg'e, an dg'is monakvet`i. da hkit`xe mat`, vinc` it`vlida [angelozebi, romlebic` uzenaesma allahis mier danishnulni arian adamiant`a sak`mis ag'saric`xvad]
[allahi] etqvis [mat`]: ar darch`enilxart`, mc`ire xnis garda, rom ic`odet` t`k`ven
nut`u gegonat`, rom ch`ven tquilubralod shegk`menit` da ch`ems cinashe dabrunebulni ar ik`nebit` [g'mrt`is cinashe angarishisa da samagieros misag'ebad]?
uzenaesia allahi cheshmariti meup`e, ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba mis garda, igia g'mert`i ket`ilshobili taxtrevanisa [taxti carmoadgens qvelaze udides k`mnilebas]

da is, vinc` uxmobs [loc`ulobs] allaht`an ert`ad sxva g'vt`aebas, da amis mtkic`ebuleba ar gaach`nia... misi angarishi mxolod misi g'mert`is cinashea [gankit`xis dg'es]. uechvelad, netar ar ik`nebian urcmunoni [gankit`xvis dg'es]
da t`k`vi [o, shuamavalo]: g'mert`o ch`emo, momiteve da shemicqale. cheshmaritad, shena xar shemcqalebelt`agan sauket`eso.
[es] sura [quranidan], romelic` gardmogivlinet` da davadginet` igi kanonad, da gardmovavlinet` masshi nat`eli aiat`ebi, rat`a egebis sheigonot`.

mrush k`alsa da mrush kac`s, t`it`oeul mat`gans dahkarit` asi mat`raxi. sibralulma ar dagabrkolot` allahis rjulshi, t`uki gcamt` allahi da dg'e ukanaskneli. mat`i dasjis mocme iqos morcmunet`a ert`i jgup`i
mrushi kac`i aravisze dak`orcindeba, t`u ara mrush k`alze an mravalg'mert`ianze. da mez'avi k`ali aravisze gat`xovdeba, t`u ara mez'av kac`ze an mravalg'mert`ianze. es ki akrz'alulia morcmunet`at`vis
da isini, romelnic` c`ils scameben patiosan k`alebs da mere ver moiqvanen ot`x mocmes, dahkarit` mat` ot`xmoc`i mat`raxi da arasodes miig'ot` mat`i mocmeoba. scored isini arian bilcni [urch`ni].
garda mat`i, vinc` moinanies da gamoascores shemdgomshi. cheshmaritad, allahi mpatiebeli, shemcqalebelia.

isini, romelnic` brals dasdeben t`aviant` c`olebs [mrushobashi], ise, rom mat` aravin hqavt` mocme, garda t`aviant`i t`avisa, t`it`oeuli mat`ganis mocmeoba iqos ot`xjer damocmeba allahis cinashe, rom igi cheshmaritad, mart`lis mt`k`melt`agania
da mexut`ed cqevla iqos allahisa masze [k`marze], t`uki igi tquilis mt`k`melt`agania
da dashordeba[asc`deba] k`als [c`ols] sasjeli, t`u ot`xjer daamocma allahis cinashe, rom kac`i c`rut`agania
mexut`e ki iqos risxva allahisa masze [k`alze], t`uki is [kac`i] mart`alt`agania.

da rom ara siket`e allahisa [o,morcmuneno] da misi cqaloba [imit`, rom man daadgina aset`i samart`lebrivi cesi c`olsa da k`mars shoris, roc`a dgeba mrushobis saechvo sakit`xi], allahi mimtevebeli, brz'enia [z'alian male daatqdeboda ert`-ert`s c`ols an k`mars, vinc` itqueboda, is, rac` sakut`ar t`avze moixmo].

cheshmaritad, vinc` moitana es didi c`iliscameba, arian t`k`vengani [ert`i jgup`i morcmuneebshi]. ar ch`at`valot` es t`k`vens sazianod ara, es t`k`vent`vis sasiket`oa. mat`gan t`it`oeuls ergeba is, ra c`odvac` itvirt`a. xolo vinc` aig'o t`avis t`avze am braldebis didi cili, moigona da gaavrc`ela mas udidesi sasjeli elis [maradiul c`xovrebashi]

roc`a es gaigonet` [g'mert`is shuamavalis muhammadis allahis loc`va da mshvidoba mas c`olis, aisha allahi iqos misit` kmaqop`ili c`iliscameba mrushobashi], ratom ar dap`ik`rdnen morcmune kac`ebi da k`alebi t`avist`vis kargad da ar t`k`ves: es c`xadi sic`ruea.
ratom ar moiqvanes [mrushobis dambralebelma] amisi ot`xi mocme? da t`u ot`xi mocme ar mouqvaniat`, isini allahis cinashe matquarebi arian
da rom ara allahis siket`e t`k`venze da misi cqaloba amk`veqnad da imk`veqnad, dagatqdebodat` udidesi sasjeli imis gamo [am c`ru braldebist`vis], rashic` iqavit` ch`ap`lulni
ai, t`k`ven rom xvdebit` mas [am c`ru braldebas] t`k`veni enit` da pirit` ambobdit` imas, risi c`odnac` ar gk`oniat`. da miich`nevdit` amas mc`iredad mashin, roc`a igi udidesia allahis cinashe
ratom ar t`k`vit` roc`a es gaigonet` [sic`rue allahis shuamavlis c`olze]: ar gvekadreba [ar aris nebadart`uli] rom visaubrod amaze, da shen xar cmida [o allah] es aris [z'alian] didi c`iliscameba.
allahi shegagonebt`, rom ag'ar daubrundet` [aset` c`ru braldebas] raime amis msgavss ag'arasodes, t`uki xart` morcmuneni
da c`xadad gich`venebt` allahi t`avis [quranis]aiat`ebs[romlebshic` t`k`vent`vis moralebi da kanonebia] da allahi qovlismc`odnea, brz'enia.

cheshmaritad, imat`, romelt`ac` uqvart`, rom gaavrc`elon sisaz'agle/c`udi zneoba [c`ilis cameba mrushobaze] mat` shesaxeb, vinc` ircmuna, mat`t`visaa mtanjveli sasjeli amk`veqnadac` da imk`veqnadac`. da allahma ic`is, t`k`ven ki ar ic`it`!
da rom ara allahis siket`e t`k`venda da misi cqaloba... cheshmaritad, allahi t`anamgrz'nobi, shemcqalebelia

hei t`k`ven romelt`ac` ircmunet`. nu gahqvebit` satanis kvals [gzas]. da vinc` satanas gahqveba kvalshi igi ubrz'anebs mas sibilces [c`ud sak`mes] da c`odvians. xolo rom ara siket`e allahisa t`k`venda da misi cqaloba, ar ganicmindeboda arc`ert`i t`k`vengani arasodes, magram allahi gancmends imas, visac` inebebs. allahi qovlismsmeni, qovlismc`odnea

visac` gaach`nia g'irseba da simdidre nu daip`ic`eben imaze, rom cqalobas ar gasc`emen axloblebze, g'atakebze da allahis gzaze gadasaxlebulebze,dae apation da ugulebelqon(mat`i sak`c`ieli). gana ar gindat` rom allahma t`k`venc` mogitevot`? da allahi
mimtevebelia, shemcqalebelia

cheshmaritad, isini, romlebic` adanashauleben [mrushobashi] patiosan da mrushobis mimart` uquradg'ebo [k`orcinebashi mqop` namusian k`alebs] morcmune k`alebs, dacqevlil ik`nebian amk`veqnadac` da imk`veqnadac`. da mat`t`visaa udidesi sasjeli
im dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es] mat`i ena, xelebi da p`exebi daamocmeben mat` cinaag'mdeg imas, rasac` isini aket`ebdnen.
im dg'es [gankit`xis dg'es] allahi srulad miuzg'avs mat` samart`lianad t`aviant`i k`medebebis mixedvit` da sheitqoben, rom allahi, scored igia c`xadi cheshmariteba

bilci k`alebi( da sitqvebi,k`medebebi) bilci kac`ebist`vis, bilci kac`ebi ki bilci k`alebist`vis, ket`ili k`alebi(da sitqvebi,k`medebebi) ket`ili kac`ebist`vis,da ket`ili kac`ebi ki ket`ili k`alebist`vis. isini udanashauloni arian imashi, rasac` amboben [c`ru bralmdeblebi], da mat`t`visaa patieba da ket`ili sarch`o

hei t`k`ven romelt`ac` ircmunet`, nu shexvalt` saxlebshi, garda t`k`veni saxlebisa, vidre nebart`vas ar st`xovt` da ar miesalmebit` mat` binadart`. es uket`esia t`k`vent`vis, egebis sheigonot` [imis gamo, rom t`k`ven morcmuneebi xart` da allahma brz'ana, rom sxvis saxlshi shesvlis cin nebart`va unda it`xovot`].

da t`u mat`shi veravis naxavt`, mashin nu shexvalt` shignit`, vidre neba ar mogec`emat`. xolo t`u get`k`vat`, ukan gabrundit`, dae gabrundit`. es [gabruneba] up`ro cmindaa t`k`vent`vis, allahma ki uket` ic`is, rasac` aket`ebt`
c`odva ar gek`net`, t`u shexvalt` saxlebshi, sadac` aravin c`xovrobs, romlebshic` sargebeli t`k`vent`vis. allahma ic`is, rasac` amzhg'avnebt` da rasac` p`aravt`.

ut`xari [o,shuamavalo] morcmune kac`ebs, moaridon mat`i t`valebi (nu shexedaven im k`alebs, romelt`a qureba mat`t`vis akrz'alulia, aseve - sxva mamakac`ebis sxeulis im nacilebs, romlebis qurebac` akrz'alulia) da dae, daic`van t`aviant`i sask`eso organoebi (akrz'alulisgan), es up`ro cmindaa mat`t`vis. cheshmaritad, allahma ic`is rasac` aket`eben

da ut`xari [o, shuamavalo] morcmune k`alebs: daushvan t`aviant`i t`valebi [ar uquron uc`xo mamakac`ebs da im sxeulis nacilebs, romelt`a qurebac` akrz'alulia mamakac`ebisa da k`alebis shemt`xvevashi], da daic`van t`aviant`i sasirc`xvo adgilebi [imisgan, rac` allahis mier akrz'alulia, da nu gamoach`enen mat` sxvebis cinashe]. da nu gamoach`enen t`aviant` silamazes [mamakac`ebist`vis], garda im shemt`xvevisa, rac` bunebrivad moch`ans [imis msgavsi, rac` dap`arva sheuz'lebelia, rogoric`aa tansac`meli da a.sh], dae, gadmoap`aron t`aviant`i saburvelebi gul-mkerdze [rat`a dap`aron t`ma, qeli da mkerdi]. nu ach`venon t`aviant`i silamaze [saxe, qeli, xelebi da sxva], garda t`aviant`i k`mrebisa, an mamebisa, an k`mrebis mamebisa, an t`aviant`i vazhebisa, an k`mrebis vazhebisa, an z'mebis, an z'misshvilebis, an disshvilebis, an t`aviant`i k`alebis [mxolod morcmune k`alebis, magram ara urcmunoebis], an imat`, vinc` mat`i marjvena xelit`aa mp`lobelobashi [morcmune mxevlebist`vis], an im mamakac`t`a msaxurebist`vis, visshic` ar aris sk`esobrivi ltolva, an im bavshvebist`vis, visac` ar gauc`nobierebia k`alt`a sishishvle. da nu daabraxuneben p`exebs siarulis dros, rat`a ar gaigonon mat` mier dap`aruli samkaulebis xma [rom ar miipqron quradg'eba].
moinaniet` allahis cinashe, rat`a egebis netar ik`mnet` [am k`veqnadac` da maradiul c`xovrebashic`].

da daak`orcinet` [o, morcmuneno] dauojaxebeli mamakac`ebi da k`alebi t`k`vens shoris [morcmuneebidan], agret`ve t`k`veni mxevlebidan da monebidan [morcmune da cesieri msaxurebidan] cesierni. t`u isini g'aribni arian allahi mat` gaamdidrebs t`avisi madlit`. [k`orcineba g'aribobisgan gat`avisup`lebis mizezia] mart`lac`, allahia qovlis momc`veli [qvela siket`is mp`lobeli] da qovlismc`odne [t`avisi morch`ilt`a mdgomareobis shesaxeb]

da vinc` ver poulobs sashualebas k`orcinebist`vis dae, sheikavon t`avi [mrushobisgan da akrz'alulisgan], [mot`minebit` da marxvit`], vidre allahi gaamdidrebdes t`avisi cqalobit` [anu sanam ar miig'eben sashualebas k`orcinebist`vis]. xolo imat`gan, vinc` t`k`vens marjvena xelt` gqavt` mp`lobelobashi [monebi da mxevlebi], visac` surs xelshekruleba [t`avisup`lebis gamosasqidad] dadet` mat`t`an xelshekruleba, t`u mat`shi siket`es dainaxavt` [gonierebas, shromisunarianobas da mtkic`e rcmenas], da miec`it` mat` allahis k`onebidan is, rac` allahma t`k`ven moganichat` [anu daexmaret` mat`, k`onebisa mic`emit` an zak`at`is meshveobit`, an im gamosasqidis nacilis dat`mobit`]. da ar aiz'ulot` t`k`veni k`alebi [mxevlebi] bilc sak`c`iels [mrushobasa da garqvnilebas], t`u mat` surt` patiosneba [da ar surt` gaxdnen bilcni], t`k`veni survilisamebr am k`veqnad [micieri c`xovrebis] materialur sargebelze. vinc` ki aiz'ulebs mat` [mrushobas] cheshmaritad, allahi mas shemdeg, rac` isini [mxevlebi] iz'ulebulni gaxdebian, aris mpatiebeli [mat`i mimart`], shemcqalebeli [xolo c`odva imazea, vinc` aiz'ula isini].

ch`ven ukve gardamovavlinet` t`k`vent`vis [o, adamianebo] ganmartebuli aiat`ebi [quranis aiat`ebi], da magalit`i mat`gan, vinc` t`k`venamde iqo [adrindel xalxt`a istoriebi], da shegoneba [sasargeblo darigeba] allahis moshishart`at`vis [visac` eshinia allahis sasjelis].

allahia nat`eli c`at`a da micis, misi nat`eli msgavsia nishisa [kedelshi g'rmulivit` adgilisa], romelshic` aris sanat`i, sanat`i minis shignit`, mina ki t`it`k`os margalitivit` kashkasha varskvlavia. es sanat`i ant`ebulia kurt`xeuli xisgan zet`isxilisgan, romelic` ar aris mxolod ag'mosavluri da arc` mxolod dasavluri misi zet`i, simcmindidan gamomdinare, t`it`k`os mzad aris aaldes, t`undac` c`ec`xli ar sheexos mas, igi sinat`lea sinat`leze! allahi uch`venebs t`avis nat`els (rcmenisa da quranis gzas) visac` inebebs. da allahs xalxist`vis mohqavs magalit`ebi [rat`a dap`ik`rdnen im sibrz'nesa da cheshmaritebaze, rac` mat`shia], da allahi moic`avs c`odnit` qvelap`ers
saxlebshi [mech`et`ebshi], romelt`a ashenebis neba dart`o allahma da romlebshic` ixseneba misi saxeli, adideben mas [allahs] mat`shi dilit` da sag'amos.

kac`ebi, romelt`ac` ver moscqvett` verc` vachroba da verc` qidva-gaqidva allahis xsenebas, loc`vad dadgomasa da zek`at`is gac`emas, romelt`ac` eshiniat` im dg'isa [gankit`xvis dg'is], roc`a amobrundebian gulni da mzera.
rat`a daajildovos isini allahma imaze uket`esit`, rac` gaaket`es da miumatos mat` t`avisi siket`e. allahi sarch`os uboz'ebs imas, visac` inebebs, angarishis gareshe.

xolo romelt`ac`, gaxdnen urcmunoni, mat`i sak`meni msgavsia udabnos mirazhisa, romelic` mcqurvals cqali hgonia, da roc`a miuaxlovdeba, verap`ers ipovis, mis maxloblad ki hpovebs allahs da miagebs [urcmunos]sruli angarishit`. cheshmaritad, allahi scrap`ia angarishscorebisas.

an hgvanan cqvdiads abobok`rebul zg'vashi, romelsac` p`aravs [zg'vis] talg'a zemodan, xolo mat` zemodanac` g'rublebi, ert`i cqvdiadi meoreze! t`u xels amohqop`s, verap`ers dainaxavs. da imas, visac` allahi sinat`les ar daudgens, sinat`le ar ek`neba [mas ukve veravin gauz'g'veba cheshmarit gzaze].

nut`u ver xedav [nut`u shen ar ic`i] [o,shuamavalo], rom allahs ganadidebs qoveli, vinc` arian c`ashi da dedamicaze, da ch`itebi, romlebic` mip`rinaven mckrivad. qvelam ic`is t`avisi loc`va da misi gandideba. da allahma ic`is, rasac` aket`eben
da [mxolod] allahisaa meup`eba c`at`a da k`veqnisa da, cheshmaritad, allaht`anaa dabruneba

nut`u ver xedav [nut`u ar ic`i] [o, shuamavalo], rom [mxolod] allahi gadaadgilebs g'rublebs da shemdgom akavshirebs mat`, mere k`mnis amas sacvimar g'rublad da xedav, t`avsxma gadmodis misi napralebidan. da gardmoavlens c`idan, mt`ebis msgavs g'rublebidan setqvas. t`avs daatexs mas, visac` inebebs, da aaridebs imas, visac` inebebs. mis elvarebam lamis aris mzera daabrmavos
[mxolod] allahi anac`vlebs dg'esa da g'ames. cheshmaritad, amashi shegonebaa mxedvelt`at`vis [goniert`at`vis]

da allahma shek`mna qoveli c`xoveli cqlisagan. mat`gan zogi muc`elze xoxavs, zogi ori p`exit` dadis [adamianebi da ch`itebi] da zogic` ot`xit`. allahi k`mnis imas, rasac` inebebs. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlis shemz'lea
ch`ven gadrmogivlinet` ganmartebuli aiat`ebi, da allahi daadgens scor gzaze imas, visac` inebebs

amboben [t`valt`mak`c`ni]: vircmunet` allahi da shuamavali da davmorch`ildit`o [qvelap`ershi, rasac` ch`ven gvibrz'aneben]. mere ki pirs ibruneben mat`i nacili amis shemdgom da ar arian isini morcmuneni
da roc`a mouxmoben mat` allaht`an da mis shuamavalt`an, rat`a man gansajos mat` shoris, mat`i nacili pirs ibrunebs
t`u simart`le mat` mxaresaa [t`valt`mak`c`ebis sasargeblod], mashin isini modian mast`an [cinascarmetqvelt`an] t`avmdablurad [morch`ileben mis gadacqvetilebas]
an mat` gulebshi sneulebaa [p`arisevloba], an echvoben [rom muhammadi shuamavalia], anda eshiniat`, rom allahi da misi shuamavali usamart`lod gansjian? diax, scored isini arian usamart`loni
xolo morcmunet`a sitqvaa, roc`a mouxmoben allaht`an da mis shuamavalt`an, rat`a gansajos mat` shoris, rom mat` amboben: gavigonet` da davmorch`ildit`! - da scored isini arian netarni.
da is, vinc` emorch`ileba allahsa da mis shuamavals, up`rt`xis allahs da misi eshinia. ai, scored isini arian gamarjvebulni

da [t`valt`mak`c`ebma] daip`ic`es mat` allahi z'lieri p`ic`it`, rom t`u [o, shuamavalo] ubrz'anebdi [lashk`robas], usat`uod gamovidodnen. ut`xari: nu ip`ic`ebt` [tquilze]! morch`ileba c`nobilia, allahma ic`is, rasac` aket`ebt`!

ut`xari [xalxs] [o, shuamavalo]: daemorch`ilet` allahsa da daemorch`ilet` shuamavals! xolo t`u pirs ibrunebt`, masze iqos is, rac` daekisra, da t`k`venze iqos is, rac` dagekisrat`.
t`u damorch`ildebit` mas [shuamavals], scor gzas daadgebit`, shuamavals ki arap`eri akisria, mkap`io shetqobinebis garda.

allahma ag'ut`k`va t`k`vengan imat`, romelt`ac` ircmunes rom uechvelad daaqenebs mat` mmart`velebad am k`veqnad, ise, rogorc` mmart`velebad daaqena mat` cinashe mqop`i morcmuneebi, igi udaod misc`ems mat` sashualebas daamkvidron mat`i sarcmunoeba [islami], romelic` man mat`t`vis moicona da sheuc`vlis mat` shishs usap`rt`xoebit`. isini t`aqvans mc`emen me da aravis midgenen t`anaziarad. xolo vinc` amis shemdgom gaxdeba urcmuno, scored isini arian bilcni[urch`ni].
dadek`it` loc`vad, gaig'et` zak`at`i da daemorch`ilet` shuamavals, rat`a egebis shecqalebul ik`net`!
ar ip`ik`ro, rom urcmunoebi gadarch`ebian k`veqanaze. mat`i t`avshesap`ari c`ec`xli [jojoxet`i] ik`neba. da ra sashineli samqop`elia!

hei t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`, nebart`va it`xovon t`k`vengan imat`, vinc` daumorch`ilebia t`k`vens marjvenas [monebi] da t`k`venianebma, romelt`ac` srulclovanebis asakisat`vis ar miug'ceviat`: dilis loc`vis cin, roc`a tansac`mels ixdit`, shuadg'isas da sag'amos loc`vis shemdeg. t`k`ven sishishvlis sami zhami gak`vt`, am droebis shemdeg t`k`venze da mat`ze c`odva ar aris [t`u nebart`vis gareshe shemovlen], roc`a ert`i-meorest`an shedian sachiroebisamebr, amgvarad gangimartavt` t`k`ven allahi aiat`ebs, da allahi qovlismc`odne, brz'enia.

da roc`a t`k`veni bavshvebi srulclovanebis asaks miag'ceven, dae nebart`va it`xovon ise, rogorc` it`xovdnen isini, vinc` iqvnen mat`ze ucin. amgvarad gangimartavt` allahi aiat`ebs da allahi qovlismc`odnea brz'enia.

c`odvad ar et`vlebat` moxuc` k`alebs, romelt`ac` gat`xovebis imedi ag'ar ak`vt`, zeda samosi gaixadon ise, rom ar gamoach`inon t`avisi samshvenisebi. xolo t`u t`avshekavebas gamoich`enen, umjobesi ik`neba mat`t`vis. da allahi qovlismsmeni qovlismc`odnea

c`odvad ar et`vleba brmas, kochls, avadmqop`s da arc` t`k`ven imis gamo, rom chamot` t`k`veni saxlebidan. an mamat`k`venis saxlebidan, an t`k`veni dedebis saxlebidan, an t`k`veni z'mebis saxlebidan, an t`k`veni debis saxlebidan, an t`k`veni mamis z'mebis saxlebidan, an t`k`veni mamidebis saxlebidan, an t`k`veni dedis z'mebis saxlebidan, an t`k`veni deidebis saxlebidan, an ik`idan, risi gasag'ebebic` t`k`vens xelshia anda t`k`vens megobrebt`an. c`odvad ar get`vlebat`, t`uki shechamt` ert`ad, an c`al-c`alke. da roc`a shexvalt` saxlebshi, miesalmet` ert`manet`s allahis salami kurt`xeulit`a da ket`ilit`. amgvarad gangimartavt` allahi t`avis aiat`ebs, rat`a egebis dap`ik`rdet`.

[cheshmariti] morcmuneni mxolod isini arian, vinc` ircmuna allahi da misi shuamavali. da t`u isini mast`an ert`ad ik`nebian saert`o sak`meze, ar cavlen, vidre nebart`vas ar aig'eben misgan. cheshmaritad, scored mat`, vinc` shen nebart`vas gt`xoven [o, shuamavalo], [cheshmaritad] scamt` allahi da misi shuamavali da, t`u nebart`va gt`xoves zog t`avis sak`meze, neba dart`e mas, visac` isurveb, da st`xove mat`t`vis patieba allahs, ramet`u allahi mpatiebeli, shemcqalebelia

ar mimart`ot` [o, morcmuneno] shuamavals imgavarad, rogorc` ert`manet`s mimart`avt`.allahma ic`is mat`gan [t`valt`mak`c`t`agan] isinic`, romlebic` p`arulad toveben [shuamavalis shekrebas], sxvebis [zurgs amop`arebulni]. dae, gap`rt`xildnen isini, vinc` ecinaag'mdegeba mis [shuamavlis] brz'anebas, rat`a t`avs ar daatqdet` gansac`deli, anda ar daatqdet` mtanjveli sasjeli.

o, diax, cheshmaritad [mxolod] allahs ekut`vnis, rac` c`at`a shinaa da rac` k`veqanasa zedaa. man ic`is, ra qop`ashic` xart` da im dg'es, roc`a dabrunebul ik`nebit` mast`an [gankit`xvis dg'es], gac`nobebt` igi imas, rasac` aket`ebdit`. da allahi, cheshmaritad, mc`odnea qovelivesi

daloc`vilia igi [allahi], romelmac` gardmoavlina p`urqani [qurani, romelic` ganasxvavebs cheshmaritebasa da sic`rues] t`avis msaxurze [muhmmadze], rat`a qop`iliqo [muhmmadi] samqarot`a shemgonebeli [jinebist`vis da adamianebist`vis].
igia, romelsac` ekut`vnis meup`eba c`at`a da k`veqnisa. mas ar hqavs z'e da ar hqolia moziare meup`ebashi. man qoveli k`mnileba shek`mna da t`it`oeuls t`avisi zusti sazomi daucesa

da mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebma] daidgines mis nac`vlad [c`ru] g'vt`aebebi, romelt`ac` arap`eri sheuk`mniat`, aramed t`vit`on arian shek`mnilni. da ar sheuz'liat` t`aviant`i t`avist`visac` arc` zaralis da arc` sargeblis motana, mat` ar ak`vt` z'alaup`leba arc` sikvdilze, arc` sic`oc`xleze da arc` meored ag'dgenaze

da t`k`ves imat`, romelnic` gaxdnen urcmunoni: es [qurani] mxolod sic`ruea, man [muhmmadma] shet`xza da rashic` daexmarnen sxva adamianebio. cheshmaritad, isini [urcmunoni] usamart`lod ik`c`evian da c`ruoben
da t`k`ves [urcmunoebma]: es [qurani] cinapart`a zg'aprebia, romlebic` man [muhmmadma] it`xova rom ch`aceriliqo da isini karnaxoben dilit` da sag'amos.
[o, shuamavalo] ut`xari [am urcmunoebs]: zegardmoavlina igi iman, vinc` ic`is saidumlo c`at`a shina da k`veqanasa zeda. cheshmaritad, igi mimtevebeli, shemcqalebelia

t`k`ves [mravalg'mert`ianebma] [dac`invit`]: es ra shuamavalia [muhammadi], chams sachmels [rogorc` ch`ven] da bazarshi dadis. netav, zegardmovleniliqo masze angelozi da qop`iliqo mast`an ert`ad shemgonebeli.

an ik`neb qop`iliqo da mist`vis [muhammadist`vis] zec`idan ch`amogdebuli raime ganz'i [simdidre]? anda hk`onoda bag'i, romlisganac` shechamda. da t`k`ves [urcmunoebma] usamart`loebma, da t`k`ven [o, morcmuneno] misdevt` mxolod mojadovebul adamians.

shexede [o shuamavalo], rogor [urcmunoebs] moak`vt` shent`vis igavebi [shenze iset` tquils amboben, romelic` t`avisi siqalbit` mxolod zg'aprul igavebs caagavs]. cheshmarit gzas asc`dnen da [cheshmariti] gzis povna veg'ar sheuz'liat`.
daloc`vilia [allahi], romelic`, t`u inebebs, dagimkvidrebs amaze uket`ess bag'ebs, romelt`a ciag'ac` miedinebian mdinareebi, da agigebs sasaxleebs
magram isini uarqop`en saat`s [carg'vnis dg'es], xolo ch`ven movamzadet` mat`t`vis, vinc` mas uarqop`s jojoxet`is c`ec`xli.
roc`a [gankit`xvis dg'es] dainaxavs(c`ec`xli) mat` shoridan, moismenen mis mz'vinvarebasa da g'rials
da roc`a isini ch`aqrilni ik`nebian masshi [jojoxet`shi], vicro adgilas, mouxmoben ik` isini sikvdils [t`aviant`t`avze] [rom jojoxet`is tanjvas t`avi daag'cion]
[da mat` et`k`mebat`] nu uxmobt` dg'es mxolod ert` sikvdils, aramed uxmet` mraval sikvdils
ut`xari mat` [o, shuamavalo]: es [jojoxet`i] uket`esia t`u maradisobis bag'ebi, g'vt`ismoshishebs rom ag'et`k`vat`, da ik`neba mat`t`vis samagiero [mat`i k`medebebisat`vis] da saboloo dabruneba?
da mat`t`visaa, rasac` isurveben, maradiulad. shenma g'mert`ma ag'ut`k`va am t`xovnis shesruleba

im dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es], roc`a [allahi] shekrebs mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] da imat`ac`, rasac` isini et`aqvanebodnen [c`ru g'vt`aebebs], allahis garda, etqvis [c`ru g'vt`aebebs]: t`k`ven aubniet` gza ch`ems monebs t`u t`vit`on aebnat` gza?

itqvian isini [rasac` et`aqvanebodnen magier allahisa]: dideba shenda [o, allah], ar gvekadreboda agverch`ia shens garda mp`arvelebi magram shen miec`i sargebeli mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] da mat` mamebs, vidre ar daivicqes shexseneba [shens shesaxeb]. ase sheik`mnen carcqmedil xalxad

[mravalg'mert`ianebs etqvian: ai isini, visac` allahis magier t`aqvans sc`emdit`] isini c`rud sherac`xaven imas, rasac` ambobt`, da ar shegez'lebat` misi t`avidan ac`ileba da arc` shecevna. imas, vinc` usamart`lod moik`c`eva t`k`vengan, vagemebt` udides sasjels

da ar carmogvigzavnia shenamde [o, muhammad] ch`veni shuamavlebi ise, rom ar echamat` sachmeli da ar evlot` bazarshi. da davadginet` gamoc`dad zogi t`k`vengani zogiert`isat`vis, da moit`ment` amas? da sheni g'mert`i qovlismxedvelia

da t`k`ves imat`, vinc` ch`vent`an shexvedras ar imedovnebs [romelt`ac` ar scamt` ag'dgomis dg'is]: netav
gardmovlenoda angelozni [romlebic` gvetqoden muhammadi cheshmaritebas saubrobso] an [ch`veni t`valebit`] g'mert`i gvenaxa. ampartavnoben t`aviant`i t`avebshi da ich`enen did urch`obas

dg'es, roc`a naxaven angelozebs, im dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es] sasixarulo ambavi ar ek`nebat` c`odvilebs [mravalg'mert`ianebs]. mat` etqvian [angelozebi]: [allahma] sruliad agikrz'alat` [samot`xeshi] shesvla
da mivudgebit` im sak`meebs, rac` mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebma amk`veqnad siket`e] gaaket`es da vak`c`evt` mat` gap`antulad mtvrad.
samot`xis binadrebi im dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es] ik`nebian uket`es samqop`elshi da umshvenieres dasasvenebel adgilas
im dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es], roc`a gaipoba zec`a g'rublebit` da gardmoevlinebian angelozebi zegardmovlenit`

im dg'es [qvela] cheshmariti meup`eba ekut`vnis mxolod mocqales [allahs] [vinaidan im dg'es aravis ek`neba z'alaup`leba, garda misi], da es dg'e z'alian mz'ime ik`neba urcmunot`at`vis [im sasjelis gamo, rac` mat` daatqdebat`].
im dg'es usamart`lo daikbens xelebs da itqvis: netav amerch`ia gza shuamavalt`an ert`ado.
vai ch`ems t`avs! netav ar amerch`ia [urcmuno] megobrad.
radgan man [im megobarma] momashora me shegonebas [qurans], mas shemdeg, rac` is ukve movida ch`emt`an, shaitani [satana] ki adamianis tovebs daxmarebis gareshe(gasachirshi)
da t`k`va shuamavalma: g'mert`o ch`emo, cheshmaritad, ch`emma xalxma miatova es qurani.
ai scored amgvarad davudginet` qovel shuamavals mtrebi c`odvilt`agan [misi xalxisgan], xolo sheni g'mert`i sakmarisia scor gzaze damdgenad da shemced

amboben isini, romelnic` gaxdnen urcmunoni: netav, gardmovleniliqo masze [muhammadze] mt`eli qurani ert`bashad. aset`i (gardmovlinebit`) rat`a gavamtkic`ot` sheni guli misit` [o, shuamavalo], da cavikit`xet` igi t`anmimdevrulad [aiat`i aiat`is shemdeg].
da roc`a mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] moak`vt` shent`an [o, shuamavalo] raime magalit`i [an mis msgavsi], ch`ven mogvqavs pasuxad cheshmariteba da sauket`eso ganmarteba
isini, romelnic` pirk`ve damxobili shekrebil ik`nebian jojoxet`isken, ai isini ik`nebian qvelaze uares adgilas da qvelaze z'lierad ac`denilni gzidan
da [vp`ic`av, rom] ch`ven vuboz'et` musas cigni [t`ora] da davadginet` mast`an ert`ad misi z'ma haruni, [mis] damxmared.
da ch`ven vut`xarit` [shuamaval musas da haruns]: orive cadit` im xalxt`an, romelt`ac` c`rud sherac`xes ch`veni sascaulebi [p`araoni da misi xalxi]. da gavanadguret` isini sruliad
da xalxi [shuamavali] nuhis, roc`a c`rud sherac`xes ch`veni shuamavlebi, davaxrch`et` [davsajet`] da vak`c`iet` sascaulad [shegonebad] xalxisat`vis. usamart`loebs ki gavumzadet` mtanjveli sasjeli.
[ch`ven aseve] [davg'upet`] 'adisa da semudis da ar-rasis mc`xovrebni da mravali t`aoba, romelic` mat` shoris iqo.
qovel mat`gans movutanet` igavebi da gavanadguret` qvelani srulad.
mat` [mek`k`as mravalg'mert`ianebi] mat` ch`auares im dasaxlebas, romelzec` daatqda ubedurebis cvima, gana mat` es ar daunaxavt`? diax, ar imedovneben isini ag'dgomas
rodesac` isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] gxedaven shen [o, shuamavalo]. masxrad gigdeben: gana es aris, vinc` allahma [ch`vent`an] shuamavlad carmogzavnao?!

man [muhammadma] t`it`k`mis gvac`duna ch`veni g'mert`ebidan [t`avisi z'lieri argumentebit`], ch`ven rom mot`mineba ar gamogvech`ina [mat`ze, kerpebze t`aqvanisc`emashi]. da gaigeben, roc`a isini dainaxaven sasjels, vin up`ro gzaabneuli qop`ila
ginaxavs is [o, shuamavalo], vinc` t`avisi vneba ak`c`ia g'vt`aebad, gana ik`nebi shen misi damc`veli?
an gana p`ik`rob [o, muhammad], rom mat`i umetesoba ismenen an iazreben? isini sxva aravin arian, t`u ara msgavsi pirutqvisa. up`ro metic`, isini up`ro gzaabneulni arian( pirutqvebze)
gana ar ginaxavs [o, shuamavalo], rogor ganavrc`o shenma g'mert`ma ch`rdili da, rom enebebina, ak`c`evda mas sheuc`vlelad. mere davadginet` masze mze mis mach`veneblad
da mere nel-nela mivizidavt` [ch`rdils] mas ch`vensken.
igia [mxolod] [allahi], vinc` dagidginat` t`k`ven g'ame samosad, z'ili - mosvenebad da dagidginat` dg'e ag'dgomad [vinaidan z'ili caagavs sikvdils, xolo dg'is dadgoma -- sic`oc`xlis dabrunebas].
igia [mxolod] [allahi], romelmac` carmogzavna k`ari samaxaroblod t`avisi cqalobisa. da gardmovavlinet` c`idan sup`t`a cqali [cvima]
rat`a gavac`oc`xlot` misit` [am cvimit`] mkvdari mica da davarcqulot` misit` sak`oneli da mravali adamiani, romelic` ch`ven shevk`menit`
da igi [cvimis cqali] davanacilet` mat` shoris, rat`a sheigonon. magram adamiant`a umetesoba qvelap`ers uarqop`s, garda urcmunoebisa [umadurobisa]
da rom gvdomeboda, mashin qovel dasaxlebashi gavgzavnidit` shemgonebels

da nu daemorch`ilebi urcmunoebs [t`uki isini c`diloben, rom t`undac` mc`ired ugulebelqo is, rit`ac` allahma gamogagzavna], da ebrz'ole mat` misit` [quranit`] didi brz'olit` [mtkic`ed, daug'alavad da sheuch`ereblad]!
[mxolod] is [allahi] aris, romelmac` ert`ad sheaert`a ori zg'va: ert`i mtknari, meore ki mlashe, xolo mat` shoris (uxilavi) mijna da gadaulaxavi zg'udea!
da [mxolod] is aris [allahi], vinc` shek`mna cqlisagan adamiani da daudgina mas nat`esavni k`ac`is da k`alis mxridan. da sheni g'mert`i qovlisshemz'lea

da isini [urcmunoni] et`aqvanebian magier allahisa imas, vinc` ver daexmarebat` da verc` avnebt`, da urcmuno damxmarea [satanis] sheni g'mert`is cinaag'mdeg [vinac` t`avisi mravalg'mert`ianobit`a da c`odvebit` exmareba satanas]
da ar cargvigzavnixar shen [o, shuamavalo], t`u ara maxaroblad da gamap`rt`xileblad
ut`xari [mat`] [o, shuamavalo]: me t`k`ven arap`ers gt`xovt` sazg'aurad, imis garda, visac` surt` cheshmarit gzaze dadgoma, airch`ion gza t`aviant`i up`lisken
da miende maradc`oc`xals [allahs], romelic` ar mokvdeba, ganadide igi k`ebit` da sakmarisia igi t`avis msaxurt`a c`odvat`a mc`odned
romelmac` gaach`ina c`ani, k`veqana da rac` amat` shorisaa, ek`vs dg'eshi. mere ki amag'lda taxtze ['arshze]. igi mocqalea. mash, hkit`xe[moc`ik`ulo] mis shesaxeb mc`odnes[allahs]

da t`u etqvian [urcmunoebs]: ag'asrulet` sejda mocqalis [allahis] cinashe, isini amboben [ch`ven ar vic`it`]: vin aris mocqale? gana sejde ag'vusrulot` imas [o, muhammad], visac` gvibrz'aneb?! da ematebat` mat` zizg'i [rcmenis mimart`].
kurt`xeulia allahi, vinc` c`ashi moacqo t`anavarskvlavedi, moacqo ik` nat`ura [mze] da kashkasha mt`vare.
is aris [allahi], vinc` g'amesa da dg'es monac`vleobad k`mnis mist`vis, visac` surs gaxseneba [dap`ik`reba] an madlierebis gamoxatva.
xolo mocqalis [allahis] [namdvili] msaxurni isini arian, romelnic` mokrz'alebulad dadian k`veqanaze da roc`a umec`arni mimart`aven mat` sitqvit`, isini pasuxoben [mat`]: mshvidoba
romelnic` g'ames atareben t`aviant`i up`lis cinashe, sejdes ag'mvleni da p`exze mdgomni
romelnic` amboben: g'mert`o ch`veno! agvaride jojoxet`is sasjeli! cheshmaritad, ik` sasjeli gardauvalia
cheshmaritad, igi [jojoxet`i] c`udia rogorc` dasamkvidrebeli da rogorc` maradiuli samqop`eli!
isini, romlebic` t`uki xarjaven, arc` p`langaven da arc` z'uncoben da ik`nebian amat` shoris mqarad[ normas ar acharbeben.

romelnic` ar mouxmoben [ar et`aqvanebian] allahis garda sxva g'vt`aebebs, da ar klaven suls, romelic` akrz'ala allahma, t`u ara mxolod simart`lit`. da ar mrushoben. vinc` ki amas ch`adis, auc`ileblad shexvdeba mis sazg'aurs [maradiul c`xovrebashi]
misi sasjeli ag'dgomis dg'es gaormagdeba da maradiulad ik`neba masshi damc`irebuli
imat` garda, vinc` moinania [allahis cinashe gulcrp`elad], ircmuna da samart`lianad moik`c`eva. mat` c`ud sak`meebs allahi ket`ilit` shec`vlis, ramet`u allahi mimtevebeli, shemcqalebelia
da vinc` moinania da siket`e aket`a, mibrundeba allaht`an shendobili
isini ar mocmeoben sic`rues da roc`a avsitqvaobas sheescrebian, gverds auvlian g'irseulad
xolo roc`a mat` sheagoneben mat`i g'mert`is sascaulebs, ar rch`ebian qruni da brmani
romlebic` amboben: up`alo ch`veno! mogvmadle ch`ven ch`vens c`olebshi da sht`amomavlobashi t`valis nugeshi (gaxareba, simshvide). da gvk`meni ch`ven cinamz'olad g'vt`ismoshisht`at`vis
scored isini dajildovdebian umag'lesi [samot`xis] adgilit`, ramet`u iqvnen momt`menni, da ik` angelozebi miegebebian mat` salamit`a da mshvidobit`
masshi maradiulad ik`nebian: ra mshvenieria es, rogorc` samqop`eli da samkvidro!

ut`xari [o, muhammad] [mravalg'mert`ianebs]: allahi ar mogak`c`evdat` quradg'ebas, rom ara t`k`veni vedreba [romlit`ac` mimart`avt` mas]. magram t`k`ven [o, urcmuneno] uarqavit` [misi shuamavali], da axla es [sasjeli] t`k`vent`vis gardauvalia.
ta siin miim
es [is, rac` caikit`xeba] aris aiat`ebi ganmartebuli cignidan [quranidan romelic` cheshmaritebas ganmartavs]
sheiz'leba da dardisgan t`avic` daig'upo imisat`vis, rom isini [sheni xalxi] ar xdebian morcmuneni
t`u vinebebdit`, gardmovavlendit` zec`idan sascauls da mis cinashe k`eds moixridnen, morch`ilad
ra shexsenebac` ar unda miuvidet` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] mocqalisagan [allahisagan], zurgs ak`c`even.
[mravalg'mert`ianebma] c`rud sherac`xes [qurani] da male miuvat` ambavi imisa, rasac` dasc`inodnen
nut`u isini [urcmunoni] ver xedaven, dedamicaze ramdeni qovelgvari mshvenieri [da sargebliani] cqvili [mc`enareebisa]ag'movac`enet` (t`vit`on allahma)
cheshmaritad, amashi aris sascauli, magram mat`gan umetesni morcmuneni ar arian
da cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i namdvilad didebuli, shemcqalebelia
da [uambe, o shuamavalo] [t`u rogor] ert`xel shenma g'mert`ma uxmo musas: cadi im xalxt`an, romlebic` borotebas sch`adian
p`araonis xalxt`an nut`u ar shishoben isini [allahis sasjelis]?
ut`xra [musam]: g'mert`o ch`emo, vshishob, rom c`rud shemrac`xaven
mkerdi mekumsheba da da ch`emi ena ar gaixsneba. mash, miavline [angelozi jibrili] harunt`an [rat`a iqos ch`emi damxmare].
da mat`t` ch`ems cinaag'mdeg c`odva ak`vt` [ert`-ert`i mat`gani movkali], da meshinia, rom momklaven
[allahma] miugo: sulac` ara[ar mogklaven]. cadit` orive ch`emi sascaulebit`. cheshmaritad, ch`ven t`k`vent`an ert`ad vik`nebit` da qvelap`ers movisment`.
cadit` [orive] p`araont`an da ut`xarit` mas: namdvilad, ch`ven vart` samqarot`a g'mert`is gzavnilni.
gamoushvi ch`vent`an ert`ad israelis sht`amomavalni
[p`araonma] ut`xra: gana ch`venshi ar gagzardet` [o,musa] ch`vilobidanve da ch`vent`an ar gaatare sheni mravali clebi?
shen ki gaaket`e is rac` gaaket`e [mokali adamiani], rac` ch`aidine, da ert`i umadurt`agani xar.
[musam] ut`xra [p`araons]: me es mashin ch`avidine, roc`a gzasac`denilt`agani viqavi
gavik`ec`i t`k`vengan [madainshi], rodesac` shemeshinda t`k`vengan. axla ki micqaloba ch`emma g'mert`ma sibrz'ne da me hmk`mna ert`-ert` carmogzavnilt`agani
da is cqaloba, romelsac` maqvedri shen [o, p`araon] isaa, rom daimone israelis z'eni
ut`xra p`araonma: da ra aris samqarot`a g'mert`i?
ut`xra [musam]: [samqarot`a g'mert`i] isaa g'mert`i c`at`a da k`veqnisa da imis, rac` amat` shorisaa, t`u ki xart` darcmunebulni [amashi].
[p`araonma] ut`xra imat`, vinc` mis irgvliv iqvnen, nut`u ar gesmit`?!
miugo [musam]: igia t`k`veni g'mert`i da t`k`veni pirveli cinapari mamebis g'mert`ic`
[p`araonma] ut`xra didebulebs [ damc`inavad]: cheshmaritad, t`k`veni moc`ik`uli, romelic` t`k`vent`an aris gagzavnili ut`uod gizhia(anu ver azrovnebs t`u rogor upasuxos,da ambobs uazros)
miugo [musam] [g'mert`i, romliskenac` mogixmobt`] igia g'mert`i ag'mosavlet`isa da dasavlet`isa da imis, rac` amat` shorisaa. t`uki t`k`ven gons mouxmobt`
[p`araonma] t`k`va: t`u shen [o, musa] t`uki aiqvan vinmes g'mert`ad ch`ems garda, auc`ileblad gagxdi gamomcdeult`agan dilegshi
[musam] ut`xra: da t`u moval shent`an raime c`xadit`?
[p`araonma] t`k`va: modi misit`, t`uki xar mart`alt`agani.
da gadaagdo [musam] t`avisi kvert`xi da ik`c`a igi c`xad [uzarmazar] gvelad
da amoig'o [musam] t`avisi xeli [tansac`mlidan], da aha is [misi xeli] iqo t`et`ri [mt`varesavit` ganat`ebuli] maqurebelt`at`vis
[p`araomna] ut`xra t`avis garshemo didebulebs: cheshmaritad, es [musa] mc`odne jadok`aria.
surs rom gagaz'evot` t`k`veni mica-cqlidan t`avisi jadok`robit`. da ras brz'anebt`(ra azrisa xart` am sak`meshi)?
ut`xres: gadauvade musa da misi z'mac` [haruni] da cargzavne k`alak`ebshi shemkrebni
rat`a mogiqvanis shen [o, p`araon] qvela ganscavluli jadok`ari
da shekrebil ik`nen jadok`rebi cinascar c`nobili dg'ist`vis
xalxs et`k`va: sheikribebit` t`k`ven? [jadok`rebisa da musas shejibrist`vis]
egebis ch`ven mivqvet` jadok`rebs, t`u isini ik`nebian gamarjvebulni?
da roc`a movidnen jadok`rebi, mat` ut`xres p`araons: t`uki gavimarjvebt`, mivig'ebt` sazg'aurs?
(p`araonma) t`k`va: diax! [ik`neba t`k`vent`vis jildo] da amast`an ert`ad ik`nebit` ch`ems daaxloebulmqop`t`agani [t`u gaimarjvebt`]
[musam] ut`xra mat` [jadok`rebs]: isrolet` is, ris srolasac` apirebt`
imat`ac` [jadok`rebma] isroles t`aviant`i t`okebi da kvert`xebi da [jadok`rebma] t`k`ves: p`araonis didebas vp`ic`avt` mart`lac`, ch`ven gavxdit` gamarjvebulni
mere musam isrola t`avisi kvert`xi [romelic` gadaik`c`a did gvelad] da man gadaqlapa rac` mat` (jadok`rebma) sic`ruit` carmoach`ines
da jadok`rebi muxlmodrekilni daec`nen [qovlisshemz'le allahis cinashe t`aqvanisc`emit` sajdaze]
[jadok`rebma] t`k`ves: vircmunet` samqarot`a g'mert`i
g'mert`i musas da harunis

[p`araonma mat`] ut`xra: ircmunet` misi [musas] manam, sanam amis neba me mogec`it`? uechvelad igi [musa] t`k`veni up`rosia, romelmac` gascavlat` jadok`roba. male gaigebt` [o, jadok`rebo], roc`a jvaredinad dagachrit` xel-p`exs da ert`ianad gagakravt` jvarze
[jadok`rebma] ut`xres p`araons: ar aris problema! [rac` ar unda gagviket`o am k`veqnad] cheshmaritad, ch`ven vubrundebit` ch`vens g'mert`s!
cheshmaritad, ch`ven vimedovnebt`, rom gvapatiebs ch`veni g'mert`i c`odvebs da rom gavxdit` pirvelni morcmunet`agani
da zesht`avagonet` musas, rom g'amit` caiqvane ch`emi [morcmune] msaxurebi. ramet`u ukan dagedevnebian [p`araoni da misi jari]
da gaagzavna p`araonma k`alak`ebshi [xalxis] shemkrebni
cheshmaritad, eseni [israelis z'eni] mc`ire jgup`ia
da mat` ch`ven gangvarisxes.
cheshmaritad, ert`ad unda viqot` p`rt`xilni.
da gamoviqvanet` isini [p`araoni da mis jari] bag'ebidan da cqaroebidan
saganz'urebidan, da barak`iani adgilidan [egviptidan] [imist`vis, rom zg'vis cqalshi daxrch`obiliqven isini]
amgvarad, ch`ven davumkvidret` igi israelis shvilt`
da daedevnen [p`araoni da misi jari] mat` mzis amosvlisas
da roc`a ert`manet`i dainaxa orma jgup`ma, t`k`ves musas mxleblebma: uechvelad dagvecevian [p`araoni da misi jari[
[musam] ut`xra [mat`]: ara, ch`emt`an aris ch`emi g'mert`i da is scor gzaze damaqenebs [ch`veni gadarch`enisken]
da zesht`avagonet` musas: daartqi sheni kvert`i zg'vas. gaiqo da t`it`oeuli nacili uzamarmari mt`asavit` ag'imart`a
ch`ven movuaxlovet` [zg'vas] shemdeg sxvebi [p`araoni da misi jari]
da gadavarch`inet` ch`ven musa da isini, vinc` mast`an ert`ad iqvnen qvela
shemdeg davaxrch`et` [zg'vashi] sxva danarch`enebi [p`araoni da misi jari].
cheshmaritad, amashi aris sascauli [allahis z'levamosilobis], da mat`gan umetesni (p`araont`an vinc` iqvnen)ar iqvnen morcmuneni
da cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i namdvilad z'levamosili, shemcqalebelia
da caukit`xe [o, shuamavalo] mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] ambavi [shuamavali] ibrahimisa
[ert`xel] [ibrahimma] mamamiss da t`avis xalxs ut`xra: ras et`aqvanebit` t`k`ven?
mat` t`k`ves: ch`ven vet`aqvanebit` kerpebs da mudmivad vc`emt` mat` t`aqvans.
[ibrahimma] hkit`xa: gana esmit` t`k`veni, roc`a mat` uxmobt`?
an moak`vt` mat` t`k`vent`vis sargebeli, an gavnebt`?
miuges: ara, ch`ven vnaxet` ch`veni cinaprebi amgvarad ik`c`eodnen
[ibrahimma] ut`xra: gana gip`ik`riat`, ras et`aqvanebit`?
t`k`venc` da t`k`veni cinaprebic`?
cheshmaritad, isini [t`k`veni g'mert`ebi] ch`emi mtrebi arian, garda samqarot`a g'mert`isa.
romelmac` shemk`mna me, da scored igi damadgens cheshmarit gzaze
da is, romelic` machmevs da masmevs
da roc`a avad vxvdebi, is mkurnavs
romelic` momakvdinebs [am k`veqnad] da mere gamac`oc`xlebs [gankit`xvis dg'es]
da [is], romelic` z'alian minda [da vimedovneb], rom mapatios ch`emi c`odvebi gankit`xvis dg'es
g'mert`o ch`emo, miboz'e sibrz'ne [cinascarmetqveleba da c`odna] da shemaert`e mart`alt`a shoris.
da hk`men ch`emt`vis mart`ali mxsenebeli momaval t`aobebshi
da mak`c`ie imat`ganad, vinc` daimkvidreben netarebis samot`xes
da miuteve mamach`ems, ramet`u is iqo gzaabneult`agani(ibrahimma es vedreba gaaket`a sanam mist`vis c`xadi gaxdeboda rom misi mama jojoxet`is binadart`agan aris)
da nu shemarc`xven im dg'es, roc`a isini ag'sdgebian [gankit`xvis dg'es].
im dg'es, roc`a ar moutans sargebels arc` mat`i k`oneba da arc` shvilebi
imat` garda, vinc` carsdgeba allahis cinashe spetaki gulit`(guli romelic` ert` g'mert`s allahs sc`ems t`aqvans,da misi siqvarulit` ag'savsea)
da daaxloebul ik`na samot`xe g'vt`ismoshisht`at`vis.
da gamoch`enili ik`bena jojoxet`i gzas ac`denilt`at`vis [urcmunot`at`vis]
mat` et`k`mebat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs]: sad arian isini, rasac` et`aqvanebodit`,
allahis garda? gana shegecevian isini anda t`aviant` t`avs sheecevian?
da ik` ch`aigdebian isini [urcmunoni] da gzaabneulni [urcmunot`a cinamz'g'olebi]
aseve iblisis[satanis] jari, ert`ianad
itqvian ik` isini kamat`it`: mat` ik` [jojoxet`shi] itqvian, urt`iert`dapirispirebit` [daupirispirdebian ert`manet`s]
allahs vp`ic`avt`, ch`ven viqavit` c`xad gzaabnevashi
mashin roc`a t`k`ven gat`anabrebdit` samqarot`a g'mert`t`an,
mxolod damnashaveebma [romlebmac` mogvicodes rom mat`t`vis gvec`a t`aqvani garda allahisa] gvac`dines cheshmariti gzidan
da aravin gvqavs [dg'es] shuamdgomelni
da arc` t`anamgrz'nobi megobari
[o], neta kidev ert`xel gvk`onoda [am samqaroshi c`xovrebis] shesaz'lebloba, mashin ch`ven morcmuneni vik`nebodit`
cheshmaritad, amashi aris sascauli [allahis z'levamosilobis], magram mat`gan umetesni ar iqvnen morcmuneni
da cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i namdvilad z'lieria[romelsac` z'ala shescevs shurisz'iebis], shemcqalebelia[mat`t`vis vinc` moinaniebs]
c`rud sherac`xa nuhis xalxma shuamavlebi
da ai ut`xra mat` mat`ma z'mam nuhma: nut`u ar geshiniat` [allahis sasjelis]?
cheshmaritad, me var t`k`vent`an sando shuamavali.
geshinodet` [gap`rt`xildit`] allahis [sasjelisgan] da me damemorch`ilet`!
amisat`vis [cheshmaritebis motanist`vis t`k`venamde] sazg'aurs ar gt`xovt`, ramet`u ch`emi sazg'auri mxolod samqarot`a g'mert`t`an aris.
geshinodet` [gap`rt`xildit`] allahis [sasjelisgan] da me damemorch`ilet`!
t`k`ves [nuhis xalxma]:nut`u dagijerot` shen, mashin roc`a shens gzas mihqvebian mdabioni/dabali p`enis xalxi?
[shuamavalma nuhma] ut`xra: me ar mak`vs c`odna imisa, t`u ras aket`eben isini
mat`i angarishscoreba mxolod ch`ems up`alt`anaa rom gc`odnodat`
ar gavaz'eveb me morcmuneebs [rogoric` ar unda iqvnen]
radgan me mxolod c`xadi gamap`rt`xilebeli var
[nuhis xalxma] ut`xres: t`u ar shecqvet [shens mocodebas], nuh, mashin namdvilad ik`nebi k`vit` ch`ak`olilt`agan
[shuamavalma nuhma] t`k`va: g'mert`o ch`emo, ch`emma xalxma c`rud shemrac`xa [ar daijeres ch`emi]
gansaje ch`vens da mat` shoris, da gadamarch`ine me da vinc` ch`emt`anaa morcmunet`agan
da gadavarch`inet` igi [shuamavali nuhi] da isini, vinc` mast`an ert`ad iqvnen datvirt`ul kidobanshi
shemdeg davaxrch`et` qvela darch`enili.
