cheshmaritad, amashi aris sascauli [allahis z'levamosilobis], magram mat`gan umetesni ar gaxdnen morcmuneni
da cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i namdvilad z'levamosili, shemcqalebelia
adielebmac` uarqes shuamavlebi
da ut`xra mat` mat`ma z'mam hudma: gana g'mert`is ar geshiniat`?
cheshmaritad, me var t`k`vent`an sando shuamavali.
geshinodet` [gap`rt`xildit`] allahis [sasjelisgan] da me damemorch`ilet`!
amisat`vis [cheshmaritebis motanist`vis t`k`venamde] sazg'aurs ar gt`xovt`, ramet`u ch`emi sazg'auri mxolod samqarot`a g'mert`t`an aris.
nut`u qovel borc`vze uazrod nishans [mag'al nagebobas] aagebt` [rat`a itrabaxot`] da [amit`] daarg'viot` [sxvisi up`leba]
da ashenebt` sasaxleebs, t`it`k`os samudamod unda darch`et` [am k`veqnad].
da roc`a sjit` vinmes, sjit` mtrulad, rogorc` mch`agvrelni [umocqalod].
geshinodet` [gap`rt`xildit`] allahis [sasjelisgan] da me damemorch`ilet`!
da geshinodet` misi, vinc` mogc`at` qvelap`eri, is rac` ic`it`
man giboz'at` t`k`ven sak`oneli da z'eebi.
bag'ebi da cqaroebi
me vshishob t`k`vent`vis diadi dg'is sasjelisa
[urcmunoebma hudis eridan] t`k`ves: ch`vent`vis sulert`ia, shegvagoneb t`u ar iqavi shemgonebelt`agani
es mxolod ucindelt`a adat`-cesebia
da ch`ven ar vik`nebit` dasjilt`agani
da mat` is[moc`ik`uli hudi] c`rud sherac`xes cheshmaritad, amashi aris sascauli [allahis z'levamosilobis], magram mat`gan umetesni ar gaxdnen morcmuneni
da cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i namdvilad didebuli, shemcqalebelia
semudielebma c`rud sherac`xes shuamavlebi
da ai ut`xra mat` mat`ma z'mam saalihma: nut`u ar shegeshindebat` [allahis sasjelis]?
cheshmaritad, me var t`k`vent`an sando shuamavali.
geshinodet` [gap`rt`xildit`] allahis [sasjelisgan] da me damemorch`ilet`!
amisat`vis [cheshmaritebis motanist`vis t`k`venamde] sazg'aurs ar gt`xovt`, ramet`u ch`emi sazg'auri mxolod samqarot`a g'mert`zea.
nut`u t`k`ven [o, samudianelebo] darch`ebit` im qvelap`ershi ra ak` aris usap`rt`xod,
bag'ebsa da cqaroebshi,
da nat`esebshi, da p`inikis xeebshi, romelt`a naqop`i saamuria
da t`k`ven mt`ebshi kvet`avdit` saxlebs siamaqit`[da daxvecit`]?
geshinodet` [gap`rt`xildit`] allahis [sasjelisgan] da me damemorch`ilet`!
da nu daemorch`ilebit` zg'vars gadasult`a brz'anebebs [mmart`velebs, romlebic` moucodeben urcmunoebisa da mrvalg'mert`ianobisken]
vinc` avrc`eleben areulobas micaze da arap`ers ascoreben [ar k`mnian siket`es].
[samudianelebma] ut`xres: [o, saalih] shen mojadoebult`agani xar
shen aravin xar, t`u ara kac`i, ch`veni msgavsi. mash, moitane ert`i sascauli mainc`, t`uki mart`alt`agani xar

[shuamavalma saalihma] ut`xra: es aris [is] dedali ak`lemi [sascauli romelsac` mt`xovdit`] [da allahma qovladmag'alma gamoiqvana igi kldidan], mist`vis ik`neba cqali [cqaroebidan] ert` dg'es, xolo t`k`vent`vis dasalevi [cqali] gansazg'vrul dg'es
da nu sheexebit` mas [sascaulebriv ak`lems] boroti ganzraxvit`, rom ar geciot` diadi dg'is sasjeli.
mat` dakles is, da mere inanes.
da daatqda mat` sasjeli. amashi [shuamavali saalihis istoriashi] aris sascauli[da shegoneba], t`umc`a umravlesoba mat`gani ar iqvnen morcmuneni.
da cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i namdvilad didebuli, shemcqalebelia
lutis xalxma c`rud sherac`xa shuamavlebi
da ut`xra mat` mat`ma z'mam, lutma: nut`u g'mert`is ar geshiniat` [ ik`oniet` allahis sasjelis shishi, nu sc`emt` kerpebs t`aqvans]?
cheshmaritad, me var t`k`vent`an sando shuamavali.
geshinodet` [gap`rt`xildit`] allahis [sasjelisgan] da me damemorch`ilet`!
amisat`vis [cheshmaritebis motanist`vis t`k`venamde] sazg'aurs ar gt`xovt`, ramet`u ch`emi sazg'auri mxolod samqarot`a g'merzea.
nut`u t`k`ven midixart` [sk`esobrivi kavshirisat`vis] mamakac`ebt`an?
da miatovebt` c`olebs, romlebic` g'mert`ma shek`mna t`k`vens meug'let`agan? diax, t`k`ven zg'vargadasuli xalxi xart`
mat` ut`xres: t`u ar morch`ebi[am shens mocodebas] o, lut, ik`nebi gaz'evebult`agani
[shuamavalma lutma] ut`xra: namdvilad, me siz'ulvilis mk`onet`agan var t`k`veni k`medebis mimart`
[shuamavalma lutma mimart`a allahs] g'mert`o ch`emo! gadamarch`ine me da ch`emi ojaxi imisagan, rasac` isini aket`eben
da gadavarch`inet` igi [luti] da misi ojaxi ert`ianad.
garda moxuc`i k`alisa [lutis c`olisa], romelic` darch`a ukan ganadgurebult`a shoris [radgan ar ircmuna]
shemdgom gavanadguret` danarch`enebi [urcmunoebi]!
da movuvlinet` mat` [c`idan] [k`vis] cvima, da ra sashinelia es cvima mat`t`vis, vinc` gap`rt`xilebuli iqo
cheshmaritad, amashi aris sascauli [allahis z'levamosilobis], magram mat`gan umetesni ar gaxdnen morcmuneni
da cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i namdvilad z'levamosili, shemcqalebelia
aik`es binadrebma [shuamavali shuaibis xalxma] c`rud sherac`xes shuamavlebi
ut`xra mat` shu'aibma: gana g'mert`is ar geshiniat` [allahis sasjelis]?
cheshmaritad, me var t`k`vent`an sando shuamavali.
geshinodet` [gap`rt`xildit`] allahis [sasjelisgan] da me damemorch`ilet`!
amisat`vis [cheshmaritebis motanist`vis t`k`venamde] sazg'aurs ar gt`xovt`, ramet`u ch`emi sazg'auri mxolod samqarot`a g'mert`zea.
srulad daic`avit` sazomi da nu ik`nebit` damklebt`agani
da aconet` samart`liani sascorit`
da nu daaklebt` xalxs mat` kut`vnil nivt`ebs [nu moparavt` imas, rac` mat` ekut`vnis], da nu, gaavrc`elebt` uket`urebas dedamicaze
da geshinodet` imis, vinc` gagach`inat` t`k`venc` da pirveli t`aobac`
mat` ut`xres: [o, shuaib] shen mojadoebult`agani xar
da aravina xar shen [o, shu'aib], t`u ara kac`i, ch`veni msgavsi. da ch`ven vp`ik`robt` shenze, rom c`rut`agani xar
da mogvivline c`idan natexebi [sasjelad], t`uki mart`alt`agani xar
[shuamavalma shu'aibma] ut`xra mat`: ch`emma g'mert`ma uket` ic`is, rasac` aket`ebt`
da c`rud sherac`xes igi [shu'aibi], da t`avs daatqdat` bneli dg'is mtanjveli sasjeli. cheshmaritad, igi iqo im diadi dg'is sasjeli.
da daatqda mat` sasjeli. amashi [shuamavali shu'aibis istoriashi] aris sascauli, t`umc`a umravlesobam ar ircmuna.
da cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i namdvilad didebuli, shemcqalebelia
cheshmaritad, igi [qurani] zegardmovlenaa samqarot`a g'mert`isgan.
ch`amovida misit` [quranit`] [allahisgan] sando suli [angelozi jibrili]

shen gulze [o, moc`ik`ulo] [jibrili ukit`xavda quranis aiat`ebs shuamavals, is ki mat` mnishvnelobas xvdeboda da imaxsovrebda], rat`a iqo [o, moc`ik`ulo] shemgonebelt`agani [adamianebze da jinebze allahis sasjelis shesaxeb].
[gardmoevlina qurani] c`xadi arabuli enit`
cheshmaritad, igi [qurani] ra t`k`ma unda, moxseniebulia cina cignebshi

da gana ar carmoadgens mat`t`vis [mek`k`eli urcmunoebist`vs] sascauls [mtkic`ebulebas] is [rom qurani aris allahis cigni, xolo muhammadi allahis moc`ik`uli], rom ic`ian is [muhammadi bolo shuamavalia] israelis shvilebis scavlulebma[rogoric`aa abdullah bin salaam]?
da rom gardmogvevlina igi [qurani] vinme araarabze
da, rom caekit`xa [araarabs] is [qurani] mat`t`vis [qureishelebist`vis], isini mainc` ar ircmunebdnen mas
ase sheviqvanet` is [quranis mimart` urcmunoeba] c`odvilt`a [urcmunot`a] gulebshi
ar ircmuneben mas [qurans], vidre ar dainaxaven mtanjvel sasjels
da mova igi [sasjeli] mat`ze moulodnelad, mashin roc`a isini verc` ki igrz'noben [mas]
da isini itqvian [roc`a sasjeli mat` moevlineba]: nut`u ar mogvec`ema vada (rat`a movinaniot` da vircmunot`)?
nut`u isini ch`k`aroben ch`vens sasjels
nut`u ar ic`i [o, moc`ik`ulo], rom t`uki vac`xovrebt` mat` mravali clis ganmavlobashi,
da shemdeg mova mat`t`an is [sasjeli], rac` mat`t`vis dapirebuli iqo,
mashin is, rac` miec`at` sargeblobashi [t`undac` mravalcliani c`xovreba], ver ixsnis mat` [sasjelisgan]
da ch`ven ar gagvinadgurebia arc` ert`i sop`eli [misi mc`xovreblebi], sanam mas [im sop`els] ar moevlineboda gamap`rt`xilebelni [allahis shuamavlebi]
shesagoneblad, da ar vqop`ilvart` ch`ven usamart`loni
da ar ch`amodiodnen mast`an [muhamedt`an] [quranit`] shaitnebi [satanebi] [rogorc` amboben urcmunoni]
mat` es ar sheep`erebat`[es mat`i shesap`erisi sak`me ar aris] da arc` shescevt` amis unari
cheshmaritad, isini [shaitnebi] mosmenisganac` [quranis c`ashi] ki gandevnilni arian
da ar mouxmo allaht`an ert`ad sxva g'vt`aebas, t`orem ag'moch`ndebi dasjilt`agani.
da gaap`rt`xile [allahis sasjelisgan] sheni axlo nat`esavebi
da gadaap`are sheni p`rt`a [iqavi rbili] mat` mimart`, vinc` mogqveba morcmunet`agan
xolo t`u geurch`nen [o, shuamavalo] [ar miig'eben shens mocodebas ert`g'mert`ianobisken] ut`xari: me shorsa var imisagan, rasac` aket`ebt`
da miende z'levamosils, shemcqalebels
romelic` gxedavs shen, roc`a dgebi [g'amis loc`vebze]
da rogor asruleb loc`vis moz'raobebs mat`t`an ert`ad, vinc` muxlebze damdgaria [sejdashia]
cheshmaritad, igi qovlismsmeni, qovlismc`odnea
gindat` git`xrat` [o, xalxno], visze gardmodian eshmakebi?
isini [shaitanebi] gardmodian qovel tquilis mt`k`mel c`odvilze
isini [shaitanebi] gadmougdeben mosmenils [c`ashi] [jadok`rebs], da mat`gan umravlesoba [am jadok`art`agan] matquaraa
da poetebs mihqvebian gzaabneulni
nut`u ver xedav [o, shuamavalo] mat` [poetebs], rom qvel xeobashi daexetebian[xan k`ebashi xan ki c`udad xsenebashi]
da amboben [poetebi] imas, rasac` ar aket`eben?

garda mat`i [im poetebisgan], romelt`ac` ircmunes, siket`eebi aket`es da axsenebdnen allahs xshirad, da gaimarjve[mtrebze] mis mere, rac` usamart`lod moek`c`nen. xolo isini male sheitqoben, romelt`ac` usamart`lod moik`c`nen, t`u sad dabrundebian[gankit`xvis dg'es]!
ta, siin. es aiat`ebia quranisa da ganmartebuli cignisa [qurani]
[ quranis es aiat`ebi aris] cheshmariti gzis mach`venebeli da sasixarulo c`noba morcmunet`at`vis
romlebic` asruleben loc`vas [savaldebulo loc`vas], gasc`emen mocqalebas [zak`at`s] da mtkic`ed scamt` saik`iosi.
cheshmaritad, romelt`ac` ar scamt` saik`io, shevulamazet` mat` mat`i sak`meni da isini daexetebian [dabneulobashi, ver ansxvaveben siket`es borotebisgan]
scored mat` [amk`veqnad] miegebat` qvelaze c`udi sasjeli da scored isini ik`nebian saik`ioshi qvelaze up`ro cagebulni
da cheshmaritad, shen [o, muhammad] ig'eb qurans [allahisgan], romelic` brz'eni da qovlismc`odnea
ai ut`xra musam t`avis ojaxs: me c`ec`xli davinaxe, male mogitant` ik`idan ambavs, an mogart`mevt` ant`ebul nakverch`xals, egebis gat`bet`
roc`a miuaxlovda [musa] c`ec`xls, mas gamoec`xada: daloc`vil ik`na is, vinc` c`ec`xlshia [angelozebi], da is, vinc` mis garshemoa [musa], da ucmindesia allahi -- samqarot`a g'mert`i
hei musa, cheshmaritad, me var allahi, z'levamosili, brz'eni

da daagde sheni joxi [romelsac` marjvena xelit` icher]! da roc`a [musam] dainaxa, rom is [misi joxi] icqebda daklaknvas, t`it`k`os gveli qop`iliqo, shemobrunda, rom gak`c`euliqo, da [shishisgan] ag'ar miuxedavs ukanac` ki. [mashin, mas g'mert`ma ut`xra]: hei musa, nu geshinia! cheshmaritad, ch`ems shuamavlebs ch`emt`an ar eshiniat`
garda imisa vinc` ch`aidens usamart`lobas [borotebas,c`odvas], xolo shemdeg [moinaniebs da] shec`vlis borotebas siket`it` mashin, cheshmaritad, me var mpatiebeli, shemcqalebeli!
da ch`aide xeli [o, musa] shens jibeshi, amoig'eb mas [xels] t`et`rs uvnebels. ai zogi sascauli im c`xridan,romelic` gaegzavna p`araonisa da misi xalxs, uechvelad, isini urch`i [urcmuno] xalxia
da roc`a movida mat`t`an ch`veni sascaulebi, nat`eli xilvit` t`k`ves: es c`xadi jadok`robaao

da mat` uarqves es [c`xra sascauli], miuxedavad imisa, rom gulit` darcmunebulni iqvnen mat` cheshmaritebashi usamart`lobisa da k`edmag'lobis gamo. shexede [o, shuamavalo], rogor dasrulda mat`i sak`me, vinc` areulobas avrc`elebda micaze
da [me vp`ic`av,rom] vuboz'et` [shuamaval] davuds da suleimans c`odna, da t`k`ves: k`eba-dideba allahs, romelmac` gamogvarch`ia t`avis mravali morcmune msaxurt`agan

da sulaimanma memkvidreobit` miig'o [misi mamisgan] daudisgan [shuamavaloba, c`odna da mmart`veloba] da ut`xra [sulaimanma] t`avis xalxs: o, adamianebo! ch`ven sheviscavlet` p`rinvelt`a ena da mogvec`a qovelive, rac` gvesachiroeba. cheshmaritad, es [allahis aset`i cqaloba] ashkara siket`ea
da sulaimanisgan shekrebil ik`na misi jari jint`agan, adamiant`agan da p`rinvelt`agan [romlebic` ibrz'odnen allahis urch`t`a cinaag'mdeg], da isini mkac`r mcqobrshi imqop`ebodnen

da rodesac` [sulaimani da misi jari] miadgnen chianchvelebis vels, [sulaimanma moismina, rogor] t`k`va ert`ma chianchvelam: o, chianchvelebo! shedit` t`k`vens budeshi, rom sulaimanma da misma jarma ar gagsrison t`k`ven ise, rom t`vit`onac` rom ver igrz'non

[da shuamaval sulaimans] gaeg'ima mis sitqvebze gac`inebit` [radgan mas esmoda mat`i, da ganc`vip`rebuli darch`a imit`, rom chianchvela ap`rt`xilebda t`avis t`anamoz'meebs],
da t`k`va [mimart`a allahs vedrebit`]: o, ch`emo g'mert`o! sht`amagone, rom mudam gixdide madlobas im cqalobist`vis, romelic` momaniche me da ch`ems mshoblebs, da rom vaket`o ket`ili sak`meebi, romlit`ac` shen kmaqop`ili xar, da shemiqvane sheni cqalobit` shens mart`al msaxurt`a shoris
da [shuamavali sulaimani] t`vals avlebda p`rinvelebs [romlebic` mas daemorch`ilnen] da t`k`va: ratom ver vxedav op`op`s? [nut`u is vig'ac`is ukan imaleba] t`u igi ak` armqop`t`a shorisaa?
usat`uod davsji mas [op`op`s] mkac`ri sasjelit` anda davklav mas, t`u ar mova ch`emt`an is, c`xadi mtkic`ebulebit`.

da igi [op`op`ma] didi xnit` ar daaqovna da t`k`va:
me shevitqve is, rac` shen ar gec`odineboda, da movedi shent`an sabadan [iemenidan] sarcmuno c`nobit`
cheshmaritad, me vnaxe k`ali, romelic` mep`obs mat`ze, hboz'ebia qoveli da ak`vs didebuli taxti
vnaxe igi [mep`e k`ali] da misi xalxi et`aqvanebodnen mzes, magier allahisa, da gaulamazebia eshmaks mat`t`vis mat`i sak`meni, uc`dunebia isini gzidan da ar mihqvebian cheshmarit gzas

rat`a t`aqvani ar sc`en allahs, romelsac` gamohqavs dap`aruli c`at`a shina da k`veqanasa zeda, ic`is, rasac` malavt` da rasac` amzhg'avnebt` [da shaitanma es imist`vis gaaket`a], rom mat` ar ec`at` t`aqvani allahist`vis, igia romelsac` gamohqavs dap`aruli c`idan da micidan [cvima zec`idan da mc`enareebi micidan],
da ic`is qvelap`eri, rac` t`k`ven malavt` da rac` amzhg'avnebt` [g'iad aket`ebt`]
ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba [g'irseuli sat`aqvanebeli] garda allahisa, igia mp`lobeli didebuli taxtisa
[shuamavalma sulaimanma] ut`xra [op`op`s]: shevxedavt`, mart`als ambob t`u c`rut`agani xar

cadi am ch`emi cerilit` [sabaelebt`an] da daugde is mat`,
shemdeg ki ganeride mat` [dadek`i gverdit`] da shexede, ras daabruneben upasuxeben [ras itqvian am cerilis shesaxeb ert`manet`shi]
(dedop`alma) t`k`va: o, cinamz'g'olebo! momivida pativsac`emi cerili [z'alian mnishvnelovani cerili]

cheshmaritad, es cerili aris sulaimanidan,
[da is, ase icqeba]: saxelit`a allahisa mocqalisa shemcqaleblisa
rat`a ar iqot` ampartavnebi ch`ems cinashe [da am k`edmag'lobit` ar uarqot` ch`emi mocodeba], da modit` ch`emt`an morch`ilni [allahze] [sruli ert`g'mert`ianobit`a da sruli morch`ilebit`]

[dedop`alma] t`k`va: o, didebulno! mirch`iet` ch`ems sak`meshi,
vinaidan gadacqvetilebas ar vig'eb ise, rom t`k`ven ar iqot` amis mocmeni [anu, t`k`vens gareshe da t`k`vent`an sheut`anxmeblad]

mat` [upasuxes mas]: ch`ven z'ala gvak`vs [mxedarebi da iarag'i] da z'lieri gambedaoba [mtkic`e brz'olis suliskvet`eba],
t`umc`a gadacqvetileba shen gekut`vnis, [moip`ik`re shen t`vit`on] ras brz'aneb [da ch`ven mzad vart`, shevasrulot` sheni brz'aneba]

[dedop`alma] [gaigo, rom mat`i jari ver gauz'lebda sulaimanis lashk`ars], ut`xra mat`: mep`eni, roc`a dasaxlebashi ichrebian, angreven mas da mis binadart`agan qvelaze up`ro g'irseult` ak`c`even damc`irebulad. ai, scored ase moik`c`evian

da gavugzavni mat` [sulaimans da mis xalxs] sach`uk`ars
da davakvirdebi, ras moitanen dabrunebisas cargzavnilebi [ra pasuxit` dabrundebian].

rodesac` [dedop`lis cargzavnili] [sach`uk`rit`] mivida suleimant`an da gadasc`a is, man [shuamavalma suleimani] t`k`va: nut`u p`ik`robt`, rom simdidrit` shemecevit`? is, rac` allahma momanicha, uket`esia imaze, rac` t`k`ven mogc`at`. pirik`it` t`k`ven xarobt` t`k`veni sach`uk`rebit`

[da shuamavalma suleimanma ut`xra sabais dedop`lis carmogzavnils]: dabrundi mat`t`an [ch`emi pasuxit`]. ch`ven ki auc`ileblad mivalt` mat`t`an iset`i jarit`, romlis cinaag'mdegac` ver gauz'leben, da auc`ileblad gavaz'evebt` mat` ik`idan [mat`i k`veqnidan] damc`irebulebs da dakninebulebs

[shuamavalma suleimanma] ut`xra: [im jinebsa da adamianebs, romlebic` allahma mas morch`ilebashi misc`a]: hei, didebulno! romeli t`k`vengani momitans taxts manamde, sanam isini movidodnen ch`emt`an damorch`ilebulni?
ut`xra ert`ert`ma 'ip`rit`ma jint`agan: me mogitan [mis taxts], vidre adgilidan camodgebode [shuamavalo sulaiman]. da cheshmaritad, me amist`vis z'lieri var da sando

ut`xra iman, visac` hk`onda cignis c`odna: me mogitan imas, vidre sheni mzera ukan mogibrundebodes [sheiz'leba nishnavdes:1) sanam shors gaxedul t`vals ukan daabruneb.an 2) sanam t`vals daaxamxameb], da roc`a dainaxa igi [taxti] mis gverdit` dadgmuli t`k`va: es ch`emi g'mert`is mocqalebit`aa, rat`a gamomc`ados me madlieri vik`nebi t`u umaduri, vinc` madlieria, madlieria t`avist`vis, xolo vinc` umaduria cheshmaritad, ch`emi g'mert`i mdidari, xelgashlilia
[shuamavalma sulaimanma] ut`xra: sheuc`valet` mas t`avisi taxtrevani da shevxedot` scor [cheshmarit] gzas daadgeba [c`nobs t`u ara t`avis taxts] t`u imat`gani ik`neba, vinc` scori gzit` ar midis
da roc`a movida k`ali [dedop`ali] [shuamaval suleimant`an], hkit`xes: aset`ia sheni taxtrevani? miugo: gegoneba es isaa, da ch`ven gveboz'a c`odna masze ucin da ch`ven man morch`ilni [allahis]

da mist`vis dabrkoleba [ allahis rcmenasa da mxolod allahisadmi damorch`ilebashi) iqo is, rasac` t`aqvans sc`emda magier allahisa, cheshmaritad, igi [dedop`ali] urcmuno xalxidan iqo [igi gaizarda urcmunot`a shoris]

et`k`va mas [dedop`als]: shedi sasaxleshi. da roc`a dainaxa igi, egona damdgari cqali, da aicia misi tanisamosi p`exebze [rat`a gadasuliqo] ut`xra [sulaimanma]: es brolis sasaxlea. camoiz'axa [dedop`alma]: g'mert`o ch`emo, me usamart`lod movek`ec`i sakut`ar t`avs [rodesac` mravalg'mert`ianobas ch`avdiodi], axla ki davemorch`ile suleimant`an ert`ad, samqarot`a g'mert`s
da carvugzavnet` semudevelebs mat`i z'ma salihi: et`aqvanet` allahs! isini ki or jgup`ad daiqvnen da kamat`obdnen ert`manet`shi
[shuamavalma salihma] ut`xra: o ch`emo xalxo, ratom aqenebt` siaves siket`eze cin? netav patieba get`xovat` allahisat`vis, egeb shecqalebuli qop`iliqavit`
mat` [shuamaval salihs] ut`xres: ch`ven shent`an da shent`an mqop`ebt`an vakavshirebt` ubedurebebs! man t`k`va: t`k`veni bedi allaht`anaa! xolo, t`k`ven xart` gamoc`dis k`vesh mqop`i xalxi

k`alak`shi [al-hijrshi], sadac` c`xovrobda shuamavali saalihi [g'mert`is mshvidoba mas], iqo c`xra adamiani, romlebic` avrc`elebdnen areulobas dedamicaze [urcmunoebasa da c`odvebs] da arap`ers ascorebdnen [saert`od ar aket`ebdnen siket`es]

mat` [am c`xra kac`ma] t`k`ves ert`manet`shi: davip`ic`ot` allahi ert`manet`is cinashe, rom auc`ileblad mivadgebit` mas [salihs] da mis ojaxs g'amit` [shuag'amit` moulodnelad] da movspobt` mat`, shemdeg ki vetqvit` mis nat`esavebs: ch`ven ar vescrebodit` misi ojaxis dag'upvas, da namdvilad, ch`ven simart`les vambobt`!

ch`aip`ik`res xriki [rat`a moeklat` saalihi da misi ojaxi] da ch`venc` gavaket`et`et` xriki [mat`i boroti ganzraxvis cinaag'mdeg, rat`a gavanadgurot` mat`i gegma da davsajot` isini moulodnelad], xolo isini verc` ki grz'nobdnen amas.
da shexede [o, shuamavalo], rogori iqo bolo mat`i xrikisa, ch`ven gavanadguret` isini [es uket`uri adamianebi] da mat`i xalxic` qvela ert`ad
da ai, es mat`i saxlebia dangreuli imis gamo, ra borotebac` ch`aidines. amashi sascaulia xalxisat`vis, romelt`ac` ic`ian
da gadavarch`inet` isini, romelt`ac` ircmunes da eshinodat` [g'mert`is sasjelis]
da lutma, roc`a ut`xra t`avis xalxs: nut`u ch`aident` bilcsak`mes mashin, roc`a t`k`ven xedavt` [ic`it`], [ramdenad bilcia es k`medeba]?

nut`u t`k`ven ivlit` kac`ebt`an vnebit` k`alebis nac`vlad [ecevit` mamat`mavlobas c`xovelivit` vnebis dasaokeblad]? diax, t`k`ven xart` xalxi, romelmac` ar ic`is [akrz'aluli zg'vari imisa, rac` akrz'ala allahma]!

da sxva arap`eri qop`ila misi xalxis pasuxi, garda imisa rom t`k`ves: gaaz'evet` lutis ojaxi [shuamavali luti da morcmuneebi] t`k`veni dasaxlebidan. radgan isini arian adamianebi, romlebic` sicmindit` c`xovroben [ar dakavdebian mamakac`ebt`].

xolo ch`ven gadavarch`inet` is da misi ojaxi, misi c`olis garda, romelsac` adgili mivuch`inet` ch`amorch`enilebt`an [dag'upulebt`an] ert`ad [radgan igi kmaqop`ili iqo t`avisi xalxis mrude sak`mit` da exmareboda mat` amashi]
da movuvlinet` mat` [c`idan] [k`vis] cvima, da ra sashinelia es cvima mat`t`vis, vinc` gap`rt`xilebuli iqo
t`k`vi [o, shuamavalo]: k`eba-dideba allahs da mshvidoba mis msaxurebs, romelnic` man gamoarch`ia. allahi uket`esia t`u isini, rasac` t`anaziarad udgenen [c`ru g'vt`aebebs]?

[c`ru g'mert`ebi uket`esia t`u] is, vinc` gaach`ina c`ani da k`veqana da gardmoavlina c`idan cqali da ag'moac`ena misit` mshvenieri bag'ebi? t`k`ven ver gazrdidit` masshi[bag'ebshi] xeebs, gana aris allaht`an ert`ad sxva g'vt`aeba [romelic` daexmareboda mas t`avis sak`meebshi]?! diax, isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] arian xalxi, romlebic` ixrebian [cheshmariti rcmenidan]

[c`ru g'mert`ebi uket`esia t`u] is, vinc` daadgina dedamica mqarad [sac`xovreblad] da gaiqvana mis g'arebshi mdinareebi da daadga masze mqarad mdgomi mt`ebi da or zg'vas shoris ag'mart`a zg'ude, gana aris allaht`an ert`ad sxva g'vt`aeba? mat`ma [mravalg'mert`ianebis] umetesobam ar ic`is [allahis dideba da z'levamosileba]

[c`ru g'mert`ebi uket`esia t`u] is vin pasuxobs gachirvebulis vedrebas, roc`a mouxmobs mas da aac`ilebs siaves da gk`mnit` t`k`ven dedamicis memkvidreebad. gana aris allaht`an ert`ad sxva g'vt`aeba [romelic` igives aket`ebs]? ra mc`irea, rasac` sheigonebt`

[c`ru g'mert`ebi uket`esia t`u] is, vinc` gicinamz'g'vrat` xmelet`sa t`u zg'vis cvdiadshi da agzavnis k`ars
samaxaroblod t`avisi cqalobisa. gana aris allaht`an ert`ad sxva g'vt`aeba? uzenaesia allahi imaze, rasac` t`anaziarad udgenen.

[c`ru g'mert`ebi uket`esia t`u] is, vinc` pirvelad icqebs shek`mnas [shek`mnis arap`risgan], shemdeg ki imeorebs[gaac`oc`xlebs sikvdilis shemdeg] mas? is, vinc` sarch`os gaz'levt` c`idan da micidan, gana aris allaht`an ert`ad sxva g'vt`aeba? ut`xari: moitanet` t`k`veni mtkic`ebuleba, t`uki mart`alni xart` [rom allahs hqavs t`anamoziare z'alaup`lebasa da g'vt`aebriobashi]!
ut`xari [mat`] [o,shuamavalo]: aravin ic`is dap`aruli c`ashi da dedamicaze garda allahisa. xolo isini ver grz'noben, rodis ik`nebian ag'dgenilni [rodis dadgeba gankit`xvis dg'e]

magram, [rodesac` isini ixilaven gankit`xvis dg'is movlenebs] mat`i c`odna srulad ashkarad gaxdeba maradiuli c`xovrebis shesaxeb, magram isini [am c`xovrebas] [atareben] echvshi, up`ro metic`, isini brmani arian [mis mimart`]
da t`k`ves imat`, romelnic` gaxdnen urcmunoni: nut`u [sikvdilis shemdeg] ch`ven da ch`veni mamebi micad vik`c`evit`, [sasap`laodan] rogorg'a gamovag'cevt` [c`oc`xlad ag'dgenilni]?
ag'vgvet`k`va [ag'dgoma] ch`ven da ch`vens cinaprebsac` ucin [qvelap`eri rasac` gviqvebi]. es [danapirebi] mxolod [gamogonili] legendebia z'velebis [xalxebis]
ut`xari [mat`] [o, shuamavalo]: iaret` k`veqanaze [imogzavret` da dap`ik`rdit`] da naxet`, rogori iqo c`odvilt`a [urcmunot`a] ag'sasruli
nu damcuxrdebi [o, shuamavalo] mat`ze [mravalg'mert`ianebze] da ar shegeshindes [ar idardo] imis gamo, rasac` isini mzakvroben
[mravalg'mert`ianebi] [dasc`inian dapirebaze sasjelis shesaxeb] da amboben: rodis ag'sruldeba es dapireba, t`uki mart`als ambobt`?
ut`xari [mat`] [o, shuamavalo]: egeb, zogi ram, rasac` t`k`ven ach`k`arebt`, ukan mogqvebat` [zogiert`i sasjelis nacili]
da cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i siket`it` ag'savsea xalxis mimart`, magram mat`i umetesoba ar aris madlieri.
da cheshmaritad, shenma g'mert`ma namdvilad ic`is, rasac` malavs mat`i mkerdebi da rasac` amzhg'avneben[isini]
da ar arsebobs arap`eri dap`aruli arc` c`ashi, da arc` micaze, rom ar iqos c`xad cignshi
cheshmaritad, es qurani mout`xrobs israelis shvilebs sakit`xebis umetes nacils, rashic` isini ver t`anxmdebodnen
da cheshmaritad, igi [qurani] cheshmariti gza da cqalobaa morcmunet`at`vis.
cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i gansjis mat` shoris t`avisi msjavrit`. da igi z'levamosili, qovlismc`odnea
da miende [o, shuamavalo] [shens qvela sak`meshi] mxolod allahs [da is ik`neba shent`vis sakmarisi], radgan cheshmaritad, shen xar nat`eli cheshmaritebis gzaze

cheshmaritad, shen [o, shuamavalo] ver sheasmen mkvdrebs da ver sheasmen qruebs z'axils, roc`a isini zurgs ibruneben [amitom ar idardo imaze, rom es mravalg'mert`ianebi ar pasuxoben shens mocodebas, radgan isini ar ismenen cheshmaritebas, rogorc` ar esmit` mic`valebulebs da qruebs]
da shen [o, shuamavalo] ver daaqeneb scor gzaze brmebs mat`i gzaabneulobidan, ramet`u mxolod imas sheasmen, vinc` ircmuna ch`veni aiat`ebi da scored isini arian morch`ilni [allahis]
da roc`a ag'sruldeba sitqva mat`ze, ch`ven gamoviqvant` mat`t`vis micidan c`xovels, romelic` daelaparakeba mat`, rom adamianebs ar sjerodat` ch`veni aiat`ebisa
im dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es] shevkrebt` qoveli erisgan jgup`s, vinc` c`rud rac`xavda ch`vens aiat`ebs da isini ik`nebian dakavebulni [rat`a qvelani ert`ad shekribon da garekon angarishgebist`vis]

da rodesac` isini movlen [roc`a allaht`an ik`nen miqvanilni], man [allahma] ut`xra: nut`u t`k`ven uarqavit` ch`emi aiat`ebi [romlebsac` me vugzavnidi ch`ems moc`ik`ulebs] [t`undac`] mat`i c`odnis gareshe [t`undac`, mat`i arsis gaugebrad], an t`k`ven ras aket`ebdit`[mat` mimart`;ircmunet` t`u uarqavit` isini]?!

da ag'sruldeba sitqva [sasjelze] mat`ze imis gamo, rom usamart`lod ik`c`eodnen da isini ver itqvian verap`ers [ver shez'leben raime argumentis moqvanas, rat`a daic`van sakut`ari t`avi mz'ime sasjelisgan]
nut`u mat` [morcmuneebma] ver dainaxes, rom davadginet` g'ame, rat`a moesvenat` masshi, da dg'e xilulad? cheshmaritad, masshia sascaulebi morcmune xalxisat`vis

im dg'es ch`aberil ik`neba saqvirshi da sheshindebian [sikvdilamde], vinc`aa c`at`a [angelozebi] shina da vinc` k`veqanasa zeda, imat` garda, visac` allahi inebebs. da qvelani mivlen mis cinashe damdablebulni

da dainaxav mt`ebs[am k`veqnis dasasruls], romlebic` uz'ravad migach`nia, amoz'ravdebian rogorc` g'rubelni, [es moxdeba] allahis nebit`, romelmac` qvelap`eri srulqop`ilad shek`mna da cheshmaritad, igi ucqis imas, rasac` aket`ebt`
vinc` mova kargi sak`mit`, miig'ebs uket`es jildos. da isini im dg'is shishisgan dac`ulni ik`nebian

xolo vinc` [im dg'es] mova [t`avis g'mert`t`an] siavit` [mravalg'mert`obit`a da c`odvebit`] mat` saxeebit` ch`aqrian c`ec`xlshi, gana mogezg'vebat` rame, t`u ara mxolod is, rasac` aket`ebdit` [amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi?

ut`xari [o, shuamavalo] [xalxs]: nabrz'anebi mak`vs, rom vet`aqvano am k`alak`is [mek`k`as] g'mert`s, romelmac` is [k`alak`i] nakrz'alad hk`mna [t`avisi monebist`vis] [rom masshi ar dag'vriliqo sisxli, ar mieqenebinat` vinmest`vis ziani, ar enadirat` da ar moechrat` xeebi], mas ekut`vnis qoveli, da mebrz'ana rom viqo ert`-ert`i morch`ilt`agani.

da rom vukit`xo [xalxs] qurani.da vinc` cheshmarit gzas [allahis gzas] daadgeba, scor gzas adgas t`avisi t`avisat`vis [t`avis sasiket`od], xolo vinc` gzaabneulobashi ch`avardeba [gadaixreba cheshmariti gzidan], ut`xari: me mxolod shemgonebeli var.
da t`k`vi [o,shuamavalo]: k`eba-dideba allahs! igi gich`venebt` t`avis sascaulebs da t`k`ven sheic`nobt` mat`, xolo sheni g'mert`i uglisquro ar aris imis mimart`, rasac` aket`ebt`.
ta siin miim
es [is, rac` caikit`xeba] aris aiat`ebi ganmartebuli cignidan [quranidan romelic` cheshmaritebas ganmartavs]

ch`ven mogiqvebit` shen [o, muhammad] musas da p`araonis ambavs cheshmaritad [ise, t`it`k`os t`avad qop`iliqavi am istoriis mocme] im adamianebist`vis, romelt`ac` scamt` [rom qurani aris allahis mier gardmovlenili]

cheshmaritad, p`araoni t`avis k`veqanashi [egvipteshi] gaampartavanda [gaxda despoti] da t`avisi xalxi jgup`ebad gaxada [daqo], [da amas aket`ebda] mat`i ert`i nacilis [israelis shvilt`a] dasustebist`vis [damc`irebist`vis]. is klavda mat` vazhebs da c`oc`xals tovebda mat` k`alebs. uechvelad, is [p`araoni] iqo areulobis mt`esvelt`agani

ch`ven vindomet` cqaloba mogvec`a mat`t`vis, vinc` damc`irebuli iqo micaze [egvipteshi] [israelis shvilebi], rom gagvexada isini cinamz'g'vrebad [ket`il sak`meebshi] da memkvidreebad [shamis micaze] [p`araonisa da misi xalxis dag'upvis shemdeg]

da [ch`ven vindomet`] dagvemkvidrebina isini [israelis shvilebi] micaze [migvec`a mat`t`vis z'alaup`leba] da gvech`venebina p`araonist`vis, hamanist`vis da mat`i jarist`vis is, rasac` isini shishobdnen mat`gan [p`araonisa da misi jaris dag'upva da misi xelisup`lebis kraxi]

da ch`ven sht`avagonet` musas dedas [roc`a is daibada]: ]mshvidad) acove mas [shens shvils] z'uz'u' xolo roc`a shegeshindeba misgamo [rom sheiz'leba p`araonis xalxma moklas], mashin [ch`ade is kidobanshi da] ch`aagde is cqalshi [nilosis dinebaze,] da ar shegeshindes [rom is daixrch`oba an moklaven], da ar damcuxrde [misgan ganshorebis gamo]! uechvelad, ch`ven dagibrunebt` mas da vhk`mit` mas ert`-ert` moc`ik`ult`agan

da p`araonis xalxma [romelebmac` mas caacqda, roc`a kidobnit` nilosshi dac`uravda] aiqvana igi [musa], rat`a igi [bolos] gamxdariqo mat`t`vis mteri da mcuxarebis mizezi. uechvelad, p`araoni, hamani da mat`i orives jarebi iqvnen c`odvilni [mravalg'mert`ianebi]!

da p`araonis c`olma ut`xra [p`araons]: [es bavshvi ik`neba] t`valt`a nugeshi [sixarulis cqaro] ch`emt`vis da shent`vis! nu moklav mas; ik`neb mogvitanos siket`e, an shvilad mivig'ot` igi. xolo isini [p`araoni da misi xalxi] verc` ki grz'nobdnen [rom scored is gaxdeboda mat`i dag'upvis mizezi]

da musas dedis guli gaxda c`arieli [ag'arap`erze p`ik`robda am samqaroshi, garda t`avisi shvilisa]. lamis iqo gaemxila es [rom es misi shvili iqo], rom ara ch`ven mier misi gulis ganmtkic`eba, rat`a qop`iliqo morcmunet`agan [allahis ag't`k`mashi] [da masshi mtkic`ed darcmunebuli]

[musas dedam] ut`xra mis[musas] das [roc`a kidobani mdinareshi gaushva]: gahqevi mas [rom gaigo, ra mouva]! da man mas[musas] shoridan ut`valt`vala, xolo mat` [p`araonis xalxma] verc` ki sheamch`nies [rom is misi da iqo, da amisgamo ut`valt`valebda mas]

da ch`ven avukrz'alet` mas [musas] mez'uz'uri k`alebi [ise movacqet`, rom musa ver covda z'uz'us verc`ert`i mez'uz'urisgan] manamde [sanam dedast`an dabrundeboda]. da ut`xra man [musas dam]: gnebavt`, gach`venot` ert`i saxlis mc`xovrebni [ojaxi], romlebic` t`k`vens magivrad mouvlian mas da mast`an ket`ilni ik`nebian/mis ag'zrdaze izruneben?

da ch`ven davabrunet` igi [musa] mis dedast`an, rat`a misi t`valebi nugeshit` ag'vsebuliqo [rom qop`iliqo mshvidad] da ar damcuxrebuliqo ([misgan ganshorebit`] rat`a sc`odnoda[musas dedas], rom allahis ag't`k`ma cheshmaritebaa, t`umc`a mat`ma [mravalg'mert`iant`a] umetesobam ar ic`is

da roc`a [musam] zrdasrulobas miag'cia da sruli gaxda[gonebrivad da p`izikurad], ch`ven vuboz'et` mas sibrz'ne da c`odna [rat`a sc`odnoda allahis kanonis cesebi israelt`a sarcmunoebashi]. da amgvarad vajildovebt` ket`ilis mk`mnelt`

da shevida [musa] [p`arulad] k`alak`shi, roc`a misi mc`xovrebni uquradg'ebod iqvnen da naxa ik`, ori kac`i ert`manet`s ech`xubeboda, es misi momxret`agani iqo, meore ki iqo misi mtrebis rigebidan. misma momxret`aganma daxmareba st`xova misi mtris cinaag'mdeg. musam daartqa da mokla. t`k`va: es eshmakis sak`met`agania; cheshmaritad, igi c`xadi gzis ambnevi mteria
t`k`va [musam]: g'mert`o ch`emo, usamart`lod movek`ec`i sakut`ar t`avs. mapatie me. da [allahmac`] apatia [musas]. ramet`u igi mpatiebeli, shemcqalebelia
[shemdeg] [musam] t`k`va: g'mert`o ch`emo, imisat`vis, ra cqalobac` miqavi, arasodes vik`nebi me damnashavet`a shemce

da meore dilit` is [musa] kvlav ag'moch`nda im k`alak`shi [sadac` mkvleloba ch`aidina], shishshi mqop`i da p`rt`xilad mok`medi [qurad ig'ebda, ras ambobdnen adamianebi gushindel mkvlelobaze]. uc`eb [musam naxa] is [misi t`anamoz'me], romelsac` gushin daexmara, [dg'es ukve sxva adamiant`an ch`xubobda] da isev uxmobda mas [daxmarebisat`vis]. mashin musam ut`xra mas: cheshmaritad, shen ashkarad gzaabneuli xar [radgan ch`xubob mat`t`an, vinc` shenze z'lieria]

da roc`a [musam] isurva daertqa[z'lierad] mist`vis romelic` iqo mat`i mteri, ut`xra [mterma]: hei musa, nut`u gsurs, mec` iseve momkla, rogorc` is mokali gushin? egeb gsurs, rom iqo tirani [usamart`lo] k`veqanaze, da ar gsurs, rom iqo shemrigebelt`agani

movida [ert`i] [morcmune] kac`i [romelic` malavda t`avis rcmenas da iqo p`araonis xalxidan] [romelsac` musa ic`nobda] k`alak`is [shoreuli] gareubnidan ach`k`arebuli, da ut`xra: o, musa! uechvelad, didebulebi [p`araonis xalxidan] ganixilaven shenze, rom mogklan [im mkvlelobis gamo, rac` ch`aidine]. gadi [am k`veqnidan] [shens gadasarch`enad] radgan cheshmaritad, me shent`vis kargis mrch`eveli var
da igi [musa] gamovida ik`idan [p`araonis k`veqnidan] shishit`a da sip`rt`xilit` [ixedeboda, xom ar misdevdnen]. [musam] t`k`va: <<up`alo, gadamarch`ine borotmok`medi xalxisagan
da roc`a igi [musa] gaemart`a [gezi aig'o] medianis mimart`ulebit`, t`k`va: ik`neba, ch`emma up`alma scor gzaze mataros

da roc`a mivida [musa] madienis cqarost`an, dainaxa xalxis brbo, romlebic` sak`onels cqals asmevdnen. da mat`gan odnav moshorebit` dainaxa ori k`ali, romlebic` t`aviant` pirutqvs akavebdnen[cqlisken ar ushvebdnen]. [musam] ut`xra am or k`als: ra gagchirvebiat`? miuges: ch`ven ar vasmevt` [pirutqvs], sanam mcqemsebi ar caiqvanen [t`aviant` sak`onels], xolo ch`veni mama xandazmuli moxuc`ia
da [musam] daurcqula mat` [sak`oneli] shemdeg xis ch`rdils miashura da [z'alian mshierma] t`k`va: g'mert`o ch`emo, me mchirdeba is siket`e [sachmeli], romelsac` shen momivlen

da movida mast`an ert`-ert`i [im ori k`alidan], moridebit` da ut`xra: uechvelad, mamach`emi gez'axis, rat`a mogagos jildo imist`vis, rom ch`veni pirutqvi daarcqule. da roc`a igi [musa] mivida mast`an [mat` mamast`an] da uambo t`avisi istoria, man ut`xra: <<nu geshinia, shen t`avs davag'cie im xalxisgan, romlebic` usamart`loni arian [romlebic` ch`vens k`veqanashi z'alaup`lebas ar p`lobs]

mat`gan ert`-ert`ma t`k`va: mamach`emo, daik`irave igi [musa], radgan qvelaze sauket`eso imat`t`gan, visac` daik`iraveb, aris z'lieri [romelsac` sheuz'lia pirutqvis dac`va] da sando [visac` sheiz'leba t`amamad endo]

[mat`ma mamam] ut`xra [musas]: cheshmmaritad, minda, rom ch`ems or k`alt`agan ert`-ert`i shegrt`o im [pirobit`], rom shen jamagirobas gamicev [pirutqvis mcqemsad] rva cels. xolo t`u at` cels sheasruleb, es [ik`neba] shens mier gamoch`enili [sup`t`a siket`e]. da me ar msurs gagiz'nelo [at`cliani valdebulebit`], shen mnaxav t`u allahi inebebs, mart`alt`agans[shet`anxmebis shesrulebashi]

man [musam] t`k`va: es [rac` shen t`k`vi] ch`emsa da shens shoris iqos, am or vadat`agan, romelsac` shevasruleb [rva t`u at`i celi], ar [unda iqos] ch`emze zecola [ar momt`xovo meti], da allahi aris t`avmdebi [mocme da mc`veli] imisa, rasac` vambobt`

da mas shemdeg, rac` musam daasrula [mcqemsad mushaobis] vada [at`i celi] da gaemgzavra [madainidan egvipteshi] t`avis [axalgazrda] ojaxt`an ert`ad [rat`a ecvia nat`esavebs] [da amave dros p`araonisgan p`rt`xilobda], man turis mt`is mxridan shenishna c`ec`xli. man ut`xra t`avis ojaxs: <<darch`it` ak`, uechvelad, davinaxe [shors] c`ec`xli. ik`neb ik`idan mogitanot` rame ambavi, an ant`ebuli nakverch`xali [koc`onis gasach`ag'eblad], egebis gat`bet`
da roc`a igi [musa] mivida mast`an [c`ec`xllt`an], mas mouxmo xmam [allahisgan] xeobis marjvena mxridan, kurt`xeul koromshi, xis mxridan: o, musa! uechvelad, me var allahi, samqarot`a g'mert`i

da [ch`ven vut`xarit`] gaisrole sheni kvert`xi! xolo roc`a [musam] dainaxa igi [misi kvert`xi], iklakneboda t`it`k`os gveli iqo, zurgi ibruna da ukan ag'ar mouxedavs. hei musa! mobrundi da nu geshinia. cheshmaritad, shen usap`rt`xod mqop`t`agani xar

ch`aqavi [o, musa] sheni xeli ubeshi, da amoig'eb mas t`et`rs [t`ovlivit`] qovelgvari zianis gareshe, da miikari sheni p`rt`a [sheni xeli] shensken [rat`a gat`avisup`lde] shishisgan. ai es [joxis gvelad gadak`c`eva da t`ovlivit` t`et`ri xeli] aris ori mtkic`ebuleba sheni up`lisgan p`araonisa da mis didebult`a cinashe, radgan cheshmaritad, isini iqvnen urch`i [urcmuno] xalxi
[musam] t`k`va: g'mert`o, me mat`gan [p`araonis xalxidan] ert`i adamiani movkali da amitom meshinia, rom [t`u mat`t`an caval] isini momklaven

da ch`emi z'ma, haruni, ch`emze uket` metqvelia, amitom gamogzavne igi ch`ems damxmared, rat`a man daadasturos ch`emi simart`le [da auxsnas mat` is, rit`ac` me vamxileb mat`]. cheshmaritad, meshinia, rom isini uarmqop`en me [ar damijereben] [rom me mat`t`an allahisgan var movlinebuli]

da ut`xra [qovlad uzenaesma allahma]: ch`ven gavaz'lierebt` shens xels [mogc`emt` mxardacheras] sheni z'mit` [harunit`] da mogc`emt` t`k`ven ors mtkic`ebulebas [p`araonisa da misi xalxis cinashe], ise rom isini ver mogcvdebian [ver gavneben]. ch`veni sascaulebit` t`k`ven orni [o, musa da harun] da isini, vinc` mogqvebian, gamarjvebulni ik`nebit`
da roc`a mivida musa mat`t`an ch`veni c`xadi sascaulebit`, mat` t`k`ves: es mxolod gamogonili jadok`robaa. arap`eri gvsmenia amis shesaxeb ch`veni cinaprebisgan

musam ut`xra: ch`emi g'mert`i uket` ic`nobs imat`, vinc` t`k`ven misgan mogitanat` cheshmariti gza. da imas, visac` ek`neba sazg'aurad maradiuli samkvidro. cheshmaritad, usamart`loni [urcmunoni] ver moipoveben carmatebas

ut`xra p`araonma: o, didebulno, me ar vic`i t`k`vent`vis sxva g'vt`aeba ch`ems garda. hei haman! daant`e ch`emt`vis c`ec`xli t`ixaze da amige koshki, rat`a egebis davinaxo musas g'mert`i, t`umc`ag'a vt`ik`rob, rom igi [musa] matquart`agania.
da t`avi ganidides man [p`araonma] da misma lashk`arma k`veqanaze usamart`lod da egonat`, rom ch`ven ciag' ar ik`nebodnen dabrunebulni [sikvdilis shemdeg].
shevipqarit` is [p`araoni] da misi jari, da ch`avqaret` isini zg'vashi da shexede, rogori iqo usamart`lot`a ag'sasruli
da vhk`menit` isini [p`araoni da misi xalxi] cinamz'g'vrebad, romlebic` [t`avisi sak`meebit`] moucodeben [sxvebs] c`ec`xlshi [jojoxet`shi], da ag'dgomis dg'es mat` ver daexmareba

da vhk`menit` ise, rom amk`veqnad mat` [p`araons da mis xalxs] t`an sdevs cqevla [sasjeli da damc`ireba], xolo ag'dgomis dg'es isini sherc`xvenilt`agan ik`nebian[allahis cqalobisgan gandevnilni ik`nebian].

da vp`ic`av, vuboz'et` musas cigni- [t`ora] imis shemdgom, rac` davg'upet` pirveli t`aobebi, -rogorc` nat`eli gza xalxist`vis [ris mixedvit`ac` isini c`nobdnen cheshmaritebas], [aseve] rogorc` mart`ali gzamkvlevi da mocqaleba, rat`a mat` gaixsenon [is darigebebi, romlebic` am cignshia]

da shen [o, muhammad] ar qop`ilxar [im] mt`is dasavlet` mxares, roc`a ch`ven gadavcqvitet` musas sak`me [roc`a allahma gadacqvita misi gagzavna p`araonisa da misi xalxisaken rogorc` moc`ik`uli], da ar qop`ilxar amis damscret`agani [rom t`avad moqvebode amas].

magram ch`ven shevk`menit` [sxva] t`aobebi [shuamavali musas shemdeg] da mat`t`vis sic`oc`xle gaxangrz'livda [gavida dro da t`aobebi sheic`vala] [ise, rom mat` daivicqes shet`anxmeba, romelic` allaht`an hk`ondat` dadebuli]. da shen [o, muhhamed] ar qop`ilxar madainis mc`xovrebt`a shoris [ar c`xovrobdi mat`t`an], rom cagekit`xa mat`t`vis ch`veni sascaulebi [ch`veni cigni] [rat`a ic`ode misi ambebi], magram mainc` ch`ven viqavit` gamgzavnelni[sheni, da ch`veni gamxilebit` qvebi musas ambavs].

da shen [o, moc`ik`ulo] ar qop`ilxar turis mt`is mxares, roc`a ch`ven movuxmet` [musas] [shen ar qop`ilxar am ambis mocme], aramed iqo cqaloba sheni g'mert`isagan, rat`a gagebrt`xilebina xalxi, romelt`anac` ar mosula shemgonebeli [moc`ik`uli] shenamde, egebis mat` gaixsenon.

da rom ar t`k`van [urcmunoebma] roc`a mat` sheemt`xvevat` raime ubedureba imis gamo, rac` mat`ma xelebma caimz'g'olies [rac` mat` ch`aidines]: g'mert`o ch`veno, rom gamogegzavna ch`vent`an moc`ik`uli, gavqvebodit` shens sascaulebs [shens cigns] da vik`nebodit` morcmunet`aganni

da roc`a mivida cheshmariteba ch`veni ciag'idan [mivida shuamavali muhammadi cheshmaritebit`], [urcmunoebma] t`k`ves: netav, gvboz'eboda imis msgavsi, rac` musas eboz'a. gana ar uarqves is, rac` ucin musas eboz'a? da t`k`ves: es ori jadok`aria, romlebic` ert`manet`s exmarebian. cheshmaritad, ch`ven arc` ert` mat`ganisas ar vircmunebt`

ut`xari [o, shuamavalo] [am urcmunoebs, romlebsac` ar surt` quranis mig'eba]: moitanet` allahisgan cigni, romelic` up`ro cheshmariti ik`neboda [saxelmz'g'vanelod], vidre es ori [t`ora da qurani], da me mas mivqvebi, t`u mart`als ambobt`!

t`u isini ar gipasuxeben [o, shuamavalo] [ar mogitanen cigns, romelic` up`ro cheshmaritia, vidre t`ora da qurani], mashin ic`ode, rom [mat` ag'ar darch`at` aranairi mtkic`ebuleba da] isini mxolod t`aviant` axirebebs misdeven. da vin aris imaze up`ro gzaabneuli, vidre is, vinc` misdevs t`avis axirebas allahis xelmz'g'vanelobis gareshe? cheshmaritad, allahi ar uxelmz'g'vanelebs [cheshmaritebisaken] usamart`lo xalxs
da vp`ic`av, ch`ven mivitanet` mat`t`an sitqva, egebis mat` sheegonebinat`
romelt`ac` vuboz'et` cigni manamde [quranamde] [igulisxmebian cignis xalxidan isini, romelt`ac` islami miig'es], mat` misi [quranis] scamt`
da roc`a [cignis xalxs] mat` ekit`xebat` [qurani], amboben: vircmunet` is [qurani]! cheshmaritad, igia cheshmariteba ch`veni g'mert`isagan. ch`ven ucinac` morch`ilni [ert`g'mert`ianni] viqavit`

aset`ebs miec`emat` mat`i jildo ormagad [imist`vis, rom isini iqvnen morcmuneni t`aviant`i cerilebis da shemdeg ircmunes quranic`], da imist`vis, rom mot`minebas ich`endnen [cheshmaritebas misdevdnen]. da isini siket`it` igerieben borotebas da imidan, rac` ch`ven mivanichet` mat` [t`aviant`i nebadart`uli k`onebidan], xarjaven.
da roc`a gaigoneben p`uchsitqvaobas, zurgs ik`c`even misgan da amboben:,,ch`ven, ch`veni sak`meebi gvak`vs, t`k`ven t`k`veni sak`meebi. mshvidoba t`k`venda! ch`ven arap`eri gvesak`meba umec`rebt`an

cheshmaritad, shen [o, shuamavalo] ver daadgen scor gzaze [ver moiqvan rcmenashi] imas, vinc` giqvars. aramed allahi adgens scor gzaze, visac` inebebs. da man uket` ic`is isini, vinc` scor gzas misdevs

da [mek`k`elma mravalg'mert`ianebma] t`k`ves: t`u shent`an ert`ad [o, muhamed] mivqvebit` [cheshmarit] gzas [im rcmenas, rit`ac` moxvedi] [da uars vitqvit` ch`vens kerpebze], mashin ch`ven gamogvaz'eveben [sxva arabebi] ch`veni k`veqnidan [mek`adan]. nut`u ch`ven ar gavxadet` mat`t`vis [es k`alak`i] [mek`a] akrz'alul adgilad [sisxlis dag'vrist`vis] da usap`rt`xod [mat`t`vis, vinc` ik` c`xovrobs], mas[cminda k`ala mek`as] miecodeba naqop`i qvelap`risa, rogorc` ch`veni cqalobis [sakvebis] boz'eba. magram mat`i [mravalg'mert`t`iant`agan] umetesobam ar ic`is [am siket`et`a p`asi, rom iqos madlieri da morch`ili allahs].

da ra bevri sop`eli gavanadguret` romelt`ac` umaduroba gamoich`ines t`avisi c`xovrebis mimart`! [amk`veqnad davsajet` isini, mat`i urcmunoobis, umadurobis, da c`odvebis gamo], da ai mat`i sac`xovreblebi, [sadac`] mat` shemdeg [aravin] ag'ar c`xovrobs, garda mc`ireric`xovant`a [mogzaurt`a]. da ch`ven vart` memkvidreni [qvelap`ris].

da ar aris sheni up`ali iset`i, rom daag'upos [sikvdilit` dasajos] sop`lebi [mat`i mc`xovrebni], sanam ar cargzavnida mat` shoris [mt`avar k`alak`ebas an sop`elebshi] moc`ik`uls, romelic` caukit`xavs mat` ch`vens sascaulebs da ch`ven ar vart` iset`ni, rom davg'upot` sop`lebi, garda im shemt`xvevisa, roc`a mat`i mc`xovrebni iqvnen usamart`loni

[qvelap`eri] rac` t`k`ven mogec`at` es aris amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis cili [am samqaros carmavali siket`eebi] da misi mort`uloba. xolo is, rac` allaht`anaa [mat`t`vis, vinc` srulad morch`ilia misi] uket`esia da up`ro xangrz'livi [jildos mxriv] [samot`xe], nut`u ar dap`ik`rdebit`?

nut`u is, visac` ch`ven mivec`it` mshvenieri dapireba [imas, rom t`avisi morch`ilebisat`vis sheiqvanen samot`xeshi] da romelic` shexvdeba mas [imas, rac` mas dahpirdnen], msgavsia [tolia] imisa, visac` ch`ven mivanichet` amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis droebit`i siket`eebi da romelic` shemdeg ag'dgomis dg'es ik`neba moqvanilt`a shoris (jojoxet`shi)?

da im dg'es [sasamart`los dg'es], rodesac` igi [allahi] mimart`avs mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] da etqvis [gakic`xvis saxit`]: sad arian ch`emi t`anaziarni? [c`ru g'vt`aebebi, romlebsac` t`k`ven ch`ems tolad miich`nevdit`], romelt`a shesaxebac` t`k`ven amtkic`ebdit`?

itqvian isini, vis t`avzedac` ag'srulda [allahis] sitqva: g'mert`o ch`veno, eseni arian, romelnic` vac`dunet` ise, rogorc` ch`ven shevc`dit`. ch`ven uars vambobt` mat`ze shens cinashe. isini ch`ven ar gvet`aqvanebodnen [aramed et`aqvanebodnen eshmaks].

da et`k`mebat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] [gankit`xvis dg'es]: uxmet` t`k`vens t`anaziart` da isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] mouxmoben mat` [c`ru g'vt`aebebs], magram isini ar upasuxeben mat` da naxaven sasjels, [inatreben]netav mat` evlot` cheshmariti gzit`
da im dg'es, mouxmobs mat` igi da hkit`xavs: ra upasuxet` shuamavlebs? im dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es], rodesac` igi [allahi] mimart`avs mat`, da etqvis: ras upasuxet` moc`ik`ulebs?
da daibneleba mat` cinashe [daip`areba mat`t`vis] qovelgvari ambavi [gamart`leba da argumentebi] im dg'es, da isini ag'ar daekit`xebian ert`manet`s
xolo rac` sheexeba mat` [mravalg'mert`iant`agan], vinc` moinania, ircmuna da siket`e aket`a, egeb iqos netart`agani [am k`veqnadac` da saik`ioshic`]
da sheni g'mert`i k`mnis, rasac` inebebs da irch`evs. mat` ki arch`evani ar gaach`niat` [misi nebis sacinaag'mdegod], k`eba dideba allahs, cmindaa allahi da uzenaesi imaze, rasac` t`anaziarad udgenen
da shenma g'mert`ma ic`is, rasac` malaven mat`i mkerdebi [rac` ak`vt` sulebshi] da rasac` amzhg'avneben [asruleben nat`lad].

da igi aris allahi ar aris sxva g'mert`i [g'irsi t`aqvanisc`emisa] garda misi! mas ekut`vnis [qoveli] k`eba rogorc` pirvel [c`xovrebashi] [am samqaroshi], aseve ukanasknel [maradiul] [c`xovrebashi], mas ekut`vnis gadacqvetileba [is ganikit`xavs t`avis monebs] da misken ik`nebit` dabrunebulni [t`k`veni sikvdilis shemdeg, angarishisa da sazg'aurist`vis]

ut`xari [o, moc`ik`ulo]: p`ik`robdit` t`u ara [o, xalxo], rom t`u allahi gagixangrz'livebt` g'ames mudmivad ag'dgomis dg'emde vin aris sxva g'vt`aeba [romeli g'mert`ia], allahis garda, romelic` mogitant` t`k`ven nat`els? nut`u ar gesmit`?

ut`xari [o, moc`ik`ulo]: p`ik`robdit` t`u ara [o, xalxo], rom t`u allahi gagixangrz'livebt` dg'es mudmivad ag'dgomis dg'emde, romeli g'mert`i [ra g'mert`ia], allahis garda, romelic` mogitant` t`k`ven g'ames, rat`a masshi daisvenot`? nut`u ver xedavt` ]rom am qvelap`ers allahi ganagebs]?
da t`avisi cqalobit` daadgina t`k`vent`vis g'ame da dg'e, rat`a moisvenot` masshi da ez'iot` misi siket`e, da rat`a egebis iqot` madlierni [allahisa]?

da im dg'es [sasamart`los dg'es], rodesac` igi [allahi] mimart`avs mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] da etqvis [gakic`xvis saxit`]: sad arian ch`emi t`anaziarni? [c`ru g'vt`aebebi, romlebsac` t`k`ven ch`ems tolad miich`nevdit`], romelt`a shesaxebac` t`k`ven amtkic`ebdit`?

da [gankit`xvis dg'es] gamovqop`t` qoveli t`emidan ert` mocmes[allahis shuamavals] da vetqvit`[urcmunoebs]: moitanet` t`k`veni mtkic`ebuleba, da gaigeben, rom cheshmariteba allahs ekut`vnis. da gak`reba mat`gan is, rasac` isini igonebdnen [t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinaag'mdeg]

cheshmaritad, qaruni iqo musas xalxisgan da borotad ek`c`eoda mat` [iqo amaqi da mch`agvreli]. ch`ven ki vuboz'et` mas imdeni ganz'i, rom mat`i gasag'ebebic` ki emz'imeboda ramdenime g'onier kac`s [ramdenime z'lier kac`sac` ki uchirda mat`i tareba]. da ut`xra mas misma xalxma: nu ag'tac`debi [nu xar ampartavnulad gaxarebuli]! ramet`u allahs ar uqvars ag'tac`ebulni [isini, vinc` amaqoben imit`, rac` allahma mat` misc`a].

imit`, rac` allahma giboz'a, iscrap`e saik`io samqop`elisken [maradiuli c`xovrebis jildosken], da ar daivicqo sheni cili amk`veqnad [isargeble nebadart`uli k`onebit` da nu ik`nebi mp`langveli]. siket`e aket`e [adamianebis mimart`], rogorc` ket`ili giqo allahma [rogorc` man moganicha mravali k`oneba], da nu gaavrc`eleb k`veqnad uket`urebas, ramet`u allahs ar uqvars areulobis mt`esvelni

qarunma ut`xra [im adamianebs, romlebic` mas darigebas az'levdnen]: is, rac` me momenicha [ch`emi mt`eli simdidre], aris ch`emi c`odnis cqalobit`: gana ar ic`oda [qarunma], rom allahma dag'upa masze ucin t`aobebi, vinc` masze up`ro mtkic`e iqo z'alit`a da up`ro mravalric`xovanni? meamboxeebs ki ar hkit`xaven mat`i c`odvebis shesaxeb [radgan allahi qovlismc`odnea,aramed hkit`xaven gakic`xvisa da saqveduris miznit`]

da [qaruni] gamovida t`avisi xalxis cinashe samkaulebit`, da t`k`ves imat`, visac` surda amk`veqniuri c`xovreba: netav ch`venc` gvk`onoda msgavsi imisa, rac` qaruns hboz'ebia. igi [qaruni] namdvilad didi cilis mp`lobelia!

da t`k`ves imat`, romelt`ac` eboz'at` c`odna [c`odna allahis shesaxeb da misi shariat`is shesaxeb]: vai t`k`ven, allahis jildo umjobesia imist`vis, vinc` ircmuna da siket`e aket`a. da es [darigeba] mxolod mot`minebis mk`onet` miec`emat` [mxolod isini miig'eben mas da mxolod mat` ek`nebat` sargebeli].

da ch`avaqlapvinet` is[qaruni] da misi sac`xovrebeli dedamicas, da ar ag'moch`nda
mist`vis brbo, romelic` allahis garda daexmareboda mas.
da [t`avad] ver shez'lo t`avis daxmareba

da meore dilit` isini, romlebic` gushin mis [qarunis] mdgomareobas natrobdnen, ambobdnen: allahi uboz'ebs sarch`os, visac` inebebs t`avis monebidan, da usaz'g'vravs [sarch`os], visac` inebebs. rom ara allahis cqaloba ch`venzed, namdvilad ch`agvqlapavda [dedamica] ch`venc`.
cheshmaritad, ver miag'ceven bednierebas urcmunoni [arc` amk`veqnad, arc` axirat`shi]

ai isaa maradiuli samqop`eli [samot`xe] davadginet` mat`t`vis, romelt`ac` ar surt` gamedidureba [k`edmag'loba] dedamicaze da uket`urobis gavrc`eleba, xolo ket`ili dasasruli [samot`xe] g'vt`ismoshisht`at`visaa.
is, vinc` mova [gankit`xvis dg'es] ket`ili sak`meebit`, mas uket`esi miec`ema, xolo mat`, vinc` borotebas sch`adioda, miezg'ebat` [mxolod is], rasac` t`avad sch`adiodnen

cheshmaritad, is, vinc` dagakisra [o, moc`ik`ulo muhammed] movaleobad qurani [mis dac`vasa da xalxamde misi mitana], uechvelad dagabrunebs dabrunebis adgilas [mek`ashi].
ut`xari [o, moc`ik`ulo] [mravalg'mert`ianebs]: ch`emma g'mert`ma uket` ic`is isini, vinc` movida cheshmariti xelmz'g'vanelobit`, da isinic`, vinc` ashkara gzaabnevashia
da shen [o, moc`ik`ulo muhammad] [t`undac`] ar imedovnebdi, rom mogec`emoda cigni [rom gadmogec`emoda qurani], garda imisa, rom es aris sheni up`lis cqaloba. amitom nu ik`nebi urcmunot`a damxmare

da nu mogac`ileben isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] shen [o, moc`ik`ulo muhammad] allahis sascaulebs [quranis aiat`ebis] [xalxamde mitanisgan] mas shemdeg, rac` isini shen gadmogec`a. mouxme[xalxs] sheni g'mert`isken da [aravit`ar shemt`xvevashi] nu ik`nebi mravalg'mert`iant`agani [nu daexmarebi mat` da nu daet`anxmebi mat`].

da nu sheevedrebi [nu sc`em t`aqvans] allaht`an ert`ad sxva g'mert`s. ar aris g'vt`aeba [vinc` t`aqvanisc`emis g'irsia], garda misi! qvelap`eri ganadgurdeba [gak`reba], garda misi saxisa.
mas ekut`vnis gansja da mast`an dabrundebit` t`k`ven [angarishis gacevisa da sazg'aurist`vis].
alip` laam miim

nut`u p`ik`roben adamianebi, rom isini darch`ebian ise, rom t`k`ves: ch`ven vircmunet` -- da ar gamoic`debian [t`avisi k`onebit`a da sic`oc`xlit`)? [ara, isini uechvelad gamoic`debian allahis mxridan, rat`a gamoirch`nen mart`ali morcmuneni orpirebisgan]

da ukve gamovc`adet` isini, vinc` mat`ze ucin iqvnen [cina t`emebi, romlebsac` egzavnebodat` cinascarmetqvelni da moc`ik`ulni]. da allahi uechvelad gamoavlens mat`, vinc` iqo mart`ali [t`avis rcmenashi], da uechvelad gamoavlens matquarebs [rat`a gaarch`ios isini ert`manet`isgan]

an nut`u p`ik`robdnen isini, vinc` ch`adian c`odvebs [mravalg'mert`ianobas da sxva c`odvebs], rom isini ch`ven gadagvascreben [t`vit`on gadarch`ebian ch`vens sasjels]?
ra c`udad [arascorad] msjeloben isini!
vinc` imedovnebs allaht`an shexvedras -- mash, cheshmaritad, allahis mier dadgenili vada [shek`mnilt`a ag'dginebist`vis] uechvelad dadgeba. da igi qovlismsmeni da qovlisc`odnea.

xolo vinc` gairjeba [ jihads gaaket`ebs imist`vis, rom allahis sitqva iqos umag'lesi da sak`meebshi daemorch`ilos allahs], is gairjeba sakut`ari t`avist`vis [mas ecereba amist`vis jildo].
cheshmaritad, allahi sruliad ar sachiroebs samqaroebs [ar sachiroebs t`avis monebis sak`meebs da saert`od arap`ers]

da mat`, romet`ac` ircmunes da siket`eni aket`es [asrulebdnen mxolod allahist`vis imas, rac` allahma ubrz'ana t`vit`on da t`avisi moc`ik`ulis meshveobit`], ch`ven auc`ileblad cavushlit` mat` c`ud sak`meebs [mat`i sxva ket`ili sak`meebis gamo] da vuzg'avt` mat` imaze uket`esit`, rasac` isini sch`adiodnen [gavumravlebt` mat` jildos]

da vuanderz'et` adamians siket`e mshoblebis mimart` [mat`i sic`oc`xleshic` da sikvdilis shemdegac`]. xolo t`u isini [t`k`veni mshoblebi] dagaz'aleben, rom t`anaziarad damidgino is, risi c`odnac` ara gak`vs, nu daemorch`ilebi mat`. ch`emt`anaa t`k`veni dasabrunebeli [gankit`xvis dg'es] da mashin gac`nobebt` imas, rasac` sch`adiodit` [amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi]
xolo mat`, romelt`ac` ircmunes da sch`adiodnen mart`al sak`meebs, ch`ven auc`ileblad sheviqvant` mat` [samot`xeshi] mart`alt`a [allahis monat`a] shoris.

adamiant`agan arian iset`ni, vinc` ambobs: gvcams allahis, magram roc`a allahis gamo [cheshmariti rcmenis gamo] mat` miaqeneben tkivils, isini ig'eben adamiant`a [mravalg'mert`iant`a] gansac`dels, rogorc` allahis sasjels [ar it`menen] da shordebian rcmenas. xolo roc`a mova gamarjveba sheni up`lisgan [o, moc`ik`ulo], isini [crmenidan gandgomilebi] uechvelad itqvian: ch`ven t`k`vent`an viqavit` [o, morcmuneno] [gexmarebodit` t`k`vens mtrebt`an brz'olashi], nut`u allahi ar aris qvelaze uket` mc`odne imisa, rac` samqarot`a gulebshia? [rac` mis k`mnilebat`a gulebshia]?
da allahi uechvelad gamoavlens mat`, vinc` icama, da uechvelad gamoavlens matquarebs [rat`a gaarch`ios isini ert`manet`isgan]!

da ut`xres romelt`ac` iqvenen urcmunoni mat`, romelt`ac` ircmunes [miatovet` is rcmena, rit`ac` movida muhammadi]: gahqevit` ch`vens gzas [daic`avit` ch`veni rcmena] da vitvirt`avt` t`k`vens c`odvebs, magram ver itvirt`aven mat`i c`odvis nacilsac` ki. cheshmaritad, isini matquarebi arian.

da isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] uechvelad da auc`ileblad itvirt`aven sakut`ar tvirt`ebs [c`odvebs] da [aseve] sxva tvirt`ebs [c`odvebs imat`gan, visac` shec`domashi sheiqvanen an cheshmariti rcmenidan gadaaxvevineben] ert`ad sakut`ar tvirt`ebt`an [c`odvebt`an] [amast`an, ar moakldebat` c`odvebi mat`, vinc` mat` gahqva], da ik`nebian gamokit`xulni gankit`xvis dg'es imaze, rasac` igonebdnen [tquilze]

da ai, ch`ven ukve gavgzavnet` nuhi [shuamavlad] mis xalxt`an, da man gaatara mat` shoris at`asi celi ormoc`daat`is gamoklebit`. da moic`vat` isini carg'vnam [c`unamma] [allahma mouvlina mat` cqaldidoba, rogorc` gamanadgurebeli sasjeli], da isini iqvnen usamart`loni [sakut`ar t`avt`an]
da gadavarch`inet` igi [shuamavali nuhi] da isini, vinc` kidobanshi iqvnen, da gavxadet` igi [kidobani] sascaulad samqarot`at`vis [adamiant`at`vis]

da [gaixsene] [shuamavali] ibrahimi, roc`a ut`xra t`avis xalxs: t`aqvani ec`it` [mxolod] allahs da eridet` mas [mis sasjels] [sheasrulet` is, rac` man brz'ana, da t`avi sheikavet` imisgan, rac` man akrz'ala]! es t`k`vent`vis uket`esia t`u ic`it`

namdvilad, t`k`ven [o, ch`emo xalxo] t`aqvans sc`emt` allahis magivrad kerpebs da igonebt` sic`rues [kerpebs g'mert`ebs ucodebt`]. namdvilad, isini, visac` t`k`ven t`aqvans sc`emt` allahis garda, ar p`loben t`k`vent`vis sarch`os [aranairad ar gaz'leven sarch`os]. sarch`o ez'iet` allaht`an da t`aqvani ec`it` [mxolod] mas, da emadlieret` mas, mast`an dabrundebit` t`k`ven [am c`xovrebis shemdeg] [da igi mogagebt` t`k`veni sak`meebis mixedvit`]!

xolo t`u t`k`ven [o, adamianebo] tquilad ch`at`vlit` [imas, riskenac` gixmobt` ch`veni moc`ik`uli muhammedi, anu mxolod ert` allahze t`aqvanisc`emas[, [ic`odet`, rom ukve] uarqves [cheshmariteba, riskenac` moucodebdnen moc`ik`ulebi] t`k`venamde arsebulma t`emebma [da mat`ze gadmovida allahis risxva], xolo moc`ik`uli [muhammedis] movaleobaa mxolod mkap`io gadmoc`ema [imis, rit`ac` allahma moavlina igi].
nut`u mat` ar unaxavt`, rogor k`mnis allahi k`mnilebas [pirvelad] [ararsebobidan], shemdeg ki mas imeorebs [misi gak`robis shemdeg]? cheshmaritad, es allahist`vis advilia!

ut`xari [o, moc`ik`ulo muhamed] [imat`, visac` ar scams sikvdilis shemdeg ag'dgoma]: imogzauret` dedamicaze da naxet`, rogor daicqo man [allahma] k`mnilebis shek`mna [da es mist`vis ar iqo z'neli]. shemdeg allahi shek`mnis ukanasknel k`mnilebas[gaac`oc`xlebs xalxs xelmeored gankit`xvist`vis]. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlisshemz'lea
is dasjis [c`odvebist`vis], visac` inebebs, da sheicqalebs, visac` inebebs, da mast`an dabrundebit` t`k`ven

da t`k`ven [o, adamianebo] ver ik`nebit` dammarc`xebelni [allahisa t`k`veni urch`obit`] verc` micaze da verc` c`ashi, [t`avs ver daag'cevt` mis sasjels], da ar gqavt` allahis garda arc` mp`arveli [romelic` shegicqalebt`], da arc` damxmare [romelic` allahis sasjelisgan dagic`avt`]

da mat`, romelt`ac` gaxdnen urcmunoni allahis sascaulebisa da mast`an shexvedrisa [gankit`xvis dg'es], scored mat` gadaecurat` imedi ch`ems mocqalebaze [rodesac` ixilaven, ra sasjeli elit`] da scored mat` miegebat` mtanjveli sasjeli

da misi xalxis [moc`ik`uli ibrahimis xalxis] pasuxi [romelic` mat` misc`es mas] mxolod is iqo, rom t`k`ves [ert`manet`shi]: mokalit` igi [ibrahimi] an dacvit` igi! da [roc`a c`ec`xlshi ch`aagdes], allahma igi gadaarch`ina c`ec`xlidan [romelic` adamianebma aant`es] [gaxada es c`ec`xli sigriled da usap`rt`xod]. cheshmaritad, amashi [moc`ik`uli ibrahimis gadarch`enashi] aris sascaulebi morcmune adamianebist`vis

da man [moc`ik`ulma ibrahimma] ut`xra [t`avis xalxs]: t`k`ven aiqvanet` allahis garda kerpebi ert`manet`is siqvarulis gamo amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi [t`k`ven giqvart` ert`manet`i am c`ru g'vt`aebebisadmi t`aqvanisc`emisa da msaxurebis gamo]. shemdeg ag'dgomis dg'es t`k`ven uarqop`t` ert`manet`s [c`ru g'mert`ebi da isini, visac` sc`emdnen t`aqvans, ert`manet`s uarqop`en], da dascqevlit` ert`manet`s, da t`k`veni t`avshesap`ari ik`neba c`ec`xli, da t`k`ven ar geqolebat` [aranairi] damxmare
da icama misi [moc`ik`uli ibrahimis] lutma da t`k`va: cheshmaritad, me gadavsaxldebi [sop`lidan, sadac` ch`emi xalxi c`xovrobs] ch`ems up`alt`an, radgan cheshmaritad, is aris z'levamosili da brz'eni!

da vuboz'et` mas [moc`ik`ul ibrahims] [vazhi] ishaqi da [shvili shvili] iaqubi [ibrahimis sic`oc`xleshive], da davadginet` mis sht`amomavlobashi cinascarmetqveleba [mis sht`amomavlebs shoris davadginet` cinascarmetqvelni] da cigni, da mivec`it` mas misi jildo amk`veqnad [mart`lmorcmune vazhebi da kargi xseneba shemdgom t`aobebshi], da cheshmaritad, igi maradiul c`xovrebashi ik`neba, uechvelad, mart`alt`a shoris.

da [gaixsene] [o, muhammed] [moc`ik`uli] luti. ai, man ut`xra t`avis xalxs: cheshmaritad, t`k`ven sch`adixart` sibilces [mamat`mavlobas], romelic` t`k`venze ucin aravis uk`nia t`k`venamde samqarot`a shoris [arc`ert`i k`mnilebas ar ch`audenia msgavsi t`k`venamde].

nut`u t`k`ven midixart` [vnebit`] mamakac`ebt`an [sk`esobrivi kavshirit` siaxloves] [k`alebis nac`vlad] da uchrit` gzas [esxmit` t`avs sop`elshi gamvlel mogzaurebs] da t`k`vens shekrebebshi sch`adixart` dagmobils [dasc`init` adamianebs da mat` tkivils aqenebt`]? da misi xalxis pasuxi mxolod is iqo, rom t`k`ves: mogvitane allahis sasjeli, t`u mart`lat`mqop`elt`agan xar

man t`k`va [moc`ik`ulma lutma] [mimart`a allahs]: up`alo ch`emo, shemecie im xalxis cinaag'mdeg, romlebic` avrc`eleben uket`urebas [mouvline mat` sasjeli], [t`u isini gaagrz'eleben urcmunoebasa da c`odvebshi jiutobas]

da roc`a movidnen ch`veni gzavnilebi [angelozebi] [moc`ik`ul] ibrahimt`an sasixarulo ambit` [rom mas sheez'ineba vazhi ishaqi, da ishaqis shemdeg shvilishvili iaqubi], mat` ut`xres: cheshmaritad, ch`ven davg'upavt` am sop`lis mc`xovrebt` [sop`els, romliskenac` iqo gagzavnili moc`ik`uli luti]. cheshmaritad, misi mc`xovrebni usamart`loni
arian [radgan ch`ap`lulni arian c`odvebshi]

man [moc`ik`ulma ibrahimma] t`k`va: cheshmaritad masshi [am sop`elshi] aris luti [romelic` ar aris usamart`lot`agan]. [angelozebma] t`k`ves: ch`ven uket` vic`it`, vinc` masshia. ch`ven uechvelad da auc`ileblad gadavarch`ent` mas [moc`ik`ul luts] da mis ojaxs, garda misi c`olisa, da igi darch`enilt`a [dag'upult`a] shoris ag'moch`nda

da roc`a movidnen ch`veni gzavnilebi [angelozebi] lutt`an, igi shecuxda mat` gamo [radgan ar ic`oda, rom isini angelozebi iqvnen da eshinoda, rom misi xalxi zians miaqenebda mat`] da t`avi uz'lurad igrz'no [igrz'no, rom verap`rit` shez'lebda t`avisi stumrebis dac`vas]. magram [angelozebma] ut`xres: nu geshinia [ch`vensgamo] [es xalxi verap`ers dagvaklebs] da nu damcuxrdebi [imis gamo, rac` shegatqobinet`, rom ch`ven mat` davg'upavt`]! cheshmaritad, ch`ven gadagarch`ent` shen [o, lut] da shens ojaxs, garda sheni c`olisa, (radgan) igi darch`enilt`a [dag'upult`a] shoris ik`neba
cheshmaritad, ch`ven movavlent` am sop`lis mc`xovreblebze c`idan sasjels[k`vebis cvimit` ch`aik`olebian] imis gamo, rom isini urch`obas ich`endnen [allahis cinashe]
da davtovet` ch`ven misgan [sop`lidan, sadac` c`xovrobda moc`ik`uli lutis xalxi] nat`eli sascauli im adamianebist`vis, [romlebic`] dap`ik`rdebian

da madainelebs [ch`ven mivugzavnet`] mat` z'ma shu'aibi. man [moc`ik`ulma shu'aibma] ut`xra: o, ch`emo xalxo! t`aqvani ec`it` [mxolod ert`] allahs, da gk`ondet` imedi ukanaskneli dg'is [rom masshi miig'ebt` jildos t`k`veni t`aqvanisc`emist`vis], da nu ivlit` micaze, areulobis gamavrc`eleblad [imis ch`amdenad, rac` allahma akrz'ala]

da mat` [madienelebma] uarqves igi [moc`ik`uli shu'aibi] [ar icames, rom igi allahis mier iqo gamogzavnili], da moic`vat` isini z'lierma micisz'vram. da dilit` t`aviant`
saxlebshi gvamebad ik`c`nen

da [aseve] [ch`ven davg'upet`] [urcmuno] adielebi da samudielebi. da es t`k`vent`vis [o,mek`k`lebo] ashkara gaxda mat`i sac`xovreblebit` [imit`, rom isini dangreuli da dac`arielebuli iqo]. da sheulamaza eshmakma mat` t`aviant`i k`medebebi da gadaaxvevina mat` [rcmenis] gzidan, miuxedavad imisa, rom isini gamchriaxni [gonivrulni] iqvnen[sheez'lot` kargis da c`udis garch`eva, magram urch`obdnen ].

da [aseve] [ch`ven davsajet` amk`veqnadve] qaruni, p`araoni da hamani. da ai, movida mat`t`an [moc`ik`uli] musa nat`eli sascaulebit` [mtkic`ebulebebit`], xolo isini ampartavnobdnen micaze [ris up`lebac` ar hk`ondat`] da isini ar iqvnen gamscreni [ver shez'les ch`veni sasjelis t`avidan ac`ileba].

da qvela mat`gani davsajet` mat`i c`odvis gamo: mat`gan iqvnen isini, romelt`ac` movuvlinet` k`arishxali [k`vebit`] [visac` sheagonebda shuamavali luti], mat`gan iqvnen isini, vinc` moic`va g'rialma [z'lierma xmam] [isini, visac` sheagonebda moc`ik`uli salihi da isini, romelzedac` iqo gagzavnili moc`ik`uli shu'aibi], mat`gan iqvnen isini, vinc` ch`ven ch`avp`alit` micashi [qaruni], da mat`gan iqvnen isini, vinc` ch`ven davaxrch`et` [isini, visac` sheagonebda moc`ik`uli nuhi da p`araoni t`avisi lashk`rit`]. allahi ar aris iset`i, rom mat` mimart` usamart`lod moik`c`es, magram isini t`vit`onve ek`c`eodnen t`aviant` t`avebs usamart`lod.

magalit`i [k`medebisa] mat`i [mravalg'mert`iant`a], romlebmac` airch`ies allahis garda mp`arvelebi, hgavs magalit`s [k`medebisa] obobis, romelmac` aishena sakut`ari saxli [rashic` ez'ebs t`avis dac`vas]. xolo cheshmaritad, sac`xovrebelt`agan qvelaze susti [is, romelic` ver ic`avs verc` sic`xisgan, da verc` sic`ivisgan], uechvelad, obobis saxlia netav es sc`odnodat`

cheshmaritad, allahi ucqis [qvela] mat`gans, visac` isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] uxmoben mis garda [allahma ic`is t`u ras sc`emen t`aqvans mis garda]. da is aris z'levamosili [urcmunot`a dasjashi] da brz'eni [t`avisi sak`meebshi]
es magalit`ebi mogvak`vs xalxisat`vis da veravin gaiazrebs mat`, mc`odnet`a garda
allahma shek`mna c`ani da dedamica cheshmaritebit`. uechvelad, masshi sascaulia morcmunet`at`vis.

da ikit`xe is [o, shuamavalo], rac` cignisagan zesht`agegona [quranisgan] da srulqop`ilad sheasrule loc`va. cheshmaritad, loc`va[srulqop`ilad] krz'alavs siavens da uket`urobas. allahis xseneba ki up`ro udidesia da allahma ic`is, rasac` aket`ebt`

da nu ikamat`ebt` [o, morcmuneno] cignis xalxt`an [iudevelebt`an da k`ristianebt`an], garda sauket`eso [xerxit`] [allahis cignidan moqvanili mtkic`ebulebebit`, kargi zneobit`a da ket`ili sitqvit`], garda imat`t`an, vinc` sch`adis borots [vinc` c`dilobs ziani miaqenos islams da tkivili moutanos morcmuneebs]. [aset`ebt`an unda ibrz'olot`, sanam isini ar ircmuneben an ar daicqeben jizias gadaxdas morcmunet`at`vis, damc`irebul mdgomareobashi]. da [rodesac` vinme cignis xalxidan gekamat`ebat` im cheshmaritebaze, rac` t`k`ven ar ic`it`], ut`xarit` mas: ch`ven vicamet` is, rac` gardgmogvevlina ch`ven [qurani, romelic` sht`aegona ch`vens moc`ik`ul - muhammads] da is, rac` gardmogevlinat` t`k`ven [t`ora da saxareba]. ch`veni g'mert`i da t`k`veni g'mert`i ert`i g'mert`ia da ch`ven misdami morch`ilebi vart` [vemorch`ilebit` qvelap`ershi, rac` man gvibrz'ana da agvikrz'ala]

da aseve [rogorc` cignebi eucqebodat` cina shuamavalebs] gardmogivlinet` shen [o, muhammed] cigni [qurani]. xolo isini [israelis sht`amomavlebi], romlebsac` ch`ven mivec`it` cigni [da romlebic` kargad ic`noben sakut`ar cigns], ircmuneben mas [qurans]. da amat`ganac` [arabebidan] arian isini, romlebic` ircmuneben mas [qurans]. da ch`vens sascaulebs [quranis cheshmaritebas, masshi moqvanil mtkic`ebulebebs] ar uarqop`en garda urcmunonebisa

da shen [o, muhammed] misamde [quranis gardmovlinebamde] ar gikit`xavs aravit`ari cigni da [aseve] [arasodes] ar dagiceria [aranairi cigni] sheni xelit`, t`orem [t`u caikit`xavdi da ceras shez'lebdi] uechvelad sheeparebodat` echvi sic`ruis mimdevrebs [da itqodnen, rom qurani aris mxolod is, rac` shen caikit`xe cina cignebshi]

pirik`it`, es [qurani] aris mxolod nat`eli sascauli imat` mkerdshi [mexsierebashi], visac` minichebuli ak`vs c`odna, da ch`vens sascaulebs uarqop`en mxolod usamart`loni [isini, vinc` ic`ian cheshmariteba, magram jiutobis gamo ar ig'eben mas].

da t`k`ves mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebma]: ratom ar gardmoevlina mas [muhammads] sascauli misi up`lisagan [rogoric` iqo moc`ik`uli saalihis udabnos ak`lemi da moc`ik`uli musas joxi, rac` ch`ven shegvez'lo sakut`ari t`valit` gvenaxa]? ut`xari mat` [o, shuamavalo]: namdvilad,sascaulebi mxolod allaht`anaa [mxolod igi cqvets, rodis, vis da ra sascauli uch`venos], da me var mxolod c`xadi shemgonebeli

nut`u mat`t`vis [am mravalg'mert`iant`at`vis] ar kmara is, rom ch`ven gardmovavlinet` shent`vis [o, moc`ik`ulo muhamad] cigni [qurani], romelic` mat`t`vis ikit`xeba [imist`vis, rom ag'iaron sheni simart`le]? mart`lac`, amashi [quranis gardmovlinebashi] aris cqaloba da shegoneba im adamianebist`vis, romelt`ac` scamt`

ut`xari [o, moc`ik`ulo muhammad]: kmara allahi ch`emsa da t`k`vens shoris mocmed. is ucqis qvelap`ers, rac` c`ashia da micaze. xolo isini, vinc` icames sic`rue da urcmunoni gaxdnen allahis, scored isini arian cagebulni
da isini ch`k`aroben shens mimart` sasjels. da rom ara dadgenili vada, auc`ileblad movidoda mat`ze sasjeli. da ut`uod mova mat`ze igi moulodnelad, mashin, roc`a verc` ki sheigrz'noben amas
isini[ kerpt`aqvanismc`emlebi] moit`xoven shengan sasjelis dach`k`arebas, magram jojoxet`i namdvilad moic`avs urcmunot`
im dg'es sasjeli moic`avs mat` zemodanac` da mat`i p`exebis k`vemodanac`, da etqvis[ allahi urcmunoebs]: gasinjet` is, rasac` aket`ebdit`
o, ch`emi monebo, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! cheshmaritad ch`emi mica p`art`oa, mash mxolod me met`aqvanet`
qoveli suli igemebs sikvdils. shemdeg ki ch`vent`an dabrundebit`

xolo isini,romelt`ac` ircmunes da ket`il sak`mes sch`adiodnen ch`ven davamkvidrebt` mat` samot`xis ot`axebshi [sasaxleebshi], romlis k`veshac` mdinareebi miedineba. maradiulad darch`ebian masshi. ra shesanishnavia sazg'auri mok`medt`at`vis
romelt`ac` moit`mines da t`aviant` up`alze arian mindobilni

da ramdeni c`xovelia, romelic` t`avis sazrdos ar daatarebs [ar imaragebs cinascar] [da ramdenad bevrs agrovebs adamiani mat`t`an shedarebit`], allahi qoveldg'e az'levs sarch`os mat` da t`k`venac`. da is qovlismsmeneli, qovlismc`odnea
da t`u hkit`xav mat`: vin shek`mna c`ani da mica da vin daimorch`ila mze da mt`vare? ut`uod itqvian [mravalg'mert`ianebi]: allahma, da rogor arian isini mibrunebulni [cheshmariti rcmenisgan]
allahi ganap`art`oebs [zrdis] sazrdos t`avis monat`agan visac` isurvebs da amc`irebs mist`vis (vist`visac` surs). cheshmaritad, is ucqis qovelives shesaxeb
da t`u hkit`xav mat`: 'vin gardmoavlina c`idan cqali da gaac`oc`xla mica misit` misi sikvdilis shemdeg? ut`uod itqvian: allahma, ut`xari: 'k`eba dideba allahs. magram mat`i umetesoba ver azrovnebs
da es micieri c`xovreba arap`eria, t`u ara amao gart`oba da t`amashi. xolo cheshmaritad, saik`io samqop`eli, is aris namdvili sic`oc`xle, mat` rom ic`odnen

roc`a isini gemshi sxdebian, allahs uxmoben, gulcrp`elad mxolod mas uz'g'vnian t`aqvanisc`emas. xolo rodesac` allahi mat` xmelet`ze gaiqvans, isini t`anaziars udgenen [t`anamonacileebs udgenen allahs]

imit`, rom gamoavlinon umaduroba imis mimart`, rac` ch`ven vuboz'et` mat`, da rom isiamovnon [amk`veqniuri siket`eebit`], magram shemdegshi [gankit`xvis dg'es] isini mainc` sheitqoben [imas, t`u ra saxis sasjeli moumzada allahma mat` amis gamo]
nut`u isini ver xedaven, rom ch`ven vk`menit` usap`rt`xod harami [mek`k`a], mashin roc`a xalxs iparaven [itac`eben] mat`i irgvliv? nut`u sic`rues icameben da allahis cqalobas uarqop`en?
da vin aris imaze up`ro usamart`lo, vidre is, vinc` allahze moigona sic`rue, an uarqo cheshmariteba, roc`a is mast`an mivida? nut`u jojoxet`i ar aris urcmunot`a sac`xovrebeli?
xolo isini, romelnic` ibrz'vian ch`vent`vis [allahis gzaze jihads aket`eben], ch`ven ut`uod carvuz'g'vebit` mat` ch`veni gzit`. da cheshmaritad, allahi ket`ilismk`nelebt`an ert`adaa
elip` laam miim.
marc`xi ganic`ades romaelebma
uaxloes micaze [sparsebsa da arabebt`an axlos mdebare k`veqanashi, palestinashi], magram isini [romaelebi] mat`i [sparst`a] gamarjvebis shemdeg [isev] gaimarjveben.
ramdenime clis shemdeg. allahsekut`vnis [mt`eli] z'alaup`leba rogorc` manamde, aseve mis shemdegac`. da im dg'es [roc`a romaelebi gaimarjveben sparselebze] morcmuneni gaixareben
allahis daxmarebit`. is exmareba, visac` isurvebs da is aris qovlisshemz'le da shemcqalebeli

[da romaelebi gaimarjveben sparselebze] allahis dapirebisamebr [romelic` man muhammad shuamavals da morcmuneebs misc`a]. allahi arasodes c`vlis t`avis danapirebs, magram adamiant`a umetesobam ar ic`is.
isini ic`noben mxolod amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis garegnul mxares, xolo saik`ios shesaxeb daudevarni arian [ar p`ik`roben masze]

nut`u isini sakut`ar t`avebshi ar dap`ik`rdnen?! allahma shek`mna c`a, mica da is, rac` mat` shorisaa, cheshmaritebit`a da gansazg'vruli vadit`, sinamdvileshi mravali adamiani urcmunoa t`avis up`alt`an shexvedris mimart`

nut`u isini ar dadiodnen dedamicaze, rat`a exilat`, rogori ag'sasruli hk`onda mat`ze cin mc`xovrebt` [romlebic` ar daemorch`ilnen allahs]?! isini mat`ze z'lierebi iqvnen z'alit`, up`ro metad amushavebdnen micas da ashenebdnen masze [sasaxleebs], vidre eseni [mek`k`elebi] asheneben. da movidnen mat`t`an moc`ik`ulebi c`xadi sascaulebit`, allahi ar moek`c`eoda mat` usamart`lod, aramed isini t`vit`onve ik`c`eodnen usamart`lod sakut`ari t`avis mimart`

bolos, mat`, vinc` c`ud k`medebas sch`adiodnen[shirk`sa da sxva c`ovebs], dasasrulic` boroti mouvidat` [mat` daeciat` jojoxet`is satanjveli] imis gamo, rom uarqves allahis nishnebi [ar ircmunes isini] da dasc`inodnen mat`ze [allahis nishnebze].
allahi icqebs gach`enas [araraobidan k`mnis], shemdeg kvlav imeorebs mas [xelaxla k`mnis], xolo bolos t`k`ven mast`anve dabrundebit` [angarishebisa da sazg'aurisat`vis]!
im dg'es, roc`a dadgeba saat`i [gankit`xvis dg'e], damnashaveni [mravalg'mert`ianni, urcmunoni] sasocarkvet`ilni darch`ebian [allahis sasjelisgan xsnas veg'ar dainaxaven].

da ar eqolebat` mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] im dg'es [sasamart`lo dg'es] t`aviant` t`anamoziareebs shoris [visac` t`aqvans sc`emdnen] mp`arvelebi da shuamdgomlebi [c`ru g'vt`aebebi ver daic`aven mat`]. da [t`avad im] t`anamoziareebs [mravalg'mert`ianebs], romlebic` mat` t`aqvans sc`emdnen, [es c`ru g'vt`aebebi] uarqop`en [da mat`gan ganudgebian].
da im dg'es, roc`a dadgeba saat`i [sasamart`lo dg'e], isini [morcmunenic` da urcmunonic`] ganc`alkevdebian [(angarishis shemdeg): ert`ni miemart`ebian samot`xisken, xolo meoreni -- jojoxet`isken].

xolo rac` sheexeba mat`, vinc` ircmuna da aket`ebda ket`il sak`meebs [asrulebda imas, rasac` allahi ubrz'ana, da t`avs ikavebda imisgan, rasac` man aukrz'ala], isini samot`xis bag'ebshi netar ik`nebian.

xolo rac` sheexeba mat`, vinc` ar ircmunes da uarqves ch`veni nishnebi da shexvedra maradiul c`xovrebashi [ar ircmunes sasjelis dg'e, jojoxet`i da samot`xe], isini [aset`ni] ch`aqrilni ik`nebian [angelozebis mier] maradiul satanjvelshi [jojoxet`shi].

amgvarad [adidet` t`k`veni up`ali], t`k`vit`: didebulia allahi! [igi cmindaa qovelgvari naklisgan da ag'matebulia qoveliveze] roc`a t`k`venze sag'amo ch`amoep`ineba da roc`a gagit`endebat` [gant`iadisas].
misia dideba da k`eba c`at`a sivrc`eshic` da micazec`, g'amit`ac`[anu asris loc`vis dros adidet` da ak`et` allahi] da mashinac`, roc`a t`k`venze shuadg'e dadgeba!

mas [allahs] gamohqavs c`oc`xali mkvdaridan [adami cvet`idan, p`rinveli kverc`xidan, mc`enare t`eslidan] da gamohqavs mkvdari c`oc`xlidan [t`esli adamianidan, kverc`xi p`rinvelidan]. da is ac`oc`xlebs micas mas shemdeg, rac` igi usic`oc`xlo gaxdeba [cvimit` da mc`enareebit` ac`oc`xlebs da amshvenebs mas]. scored ase, [amgvari gac`oc`xlebit`] t`k`venc` ag'gadgenen t`k`veni samarxebidan ag'dgomis dg'es!

da mis sascaulebs shoris aris is, rom man shegk`mnat` t`k`ven [t`k`veni cinapari adami] micisgan. shemdeg, roc`a adamianebi [t`aobidan t`aobamde] gaxdit` modgma, t`k`ven mimoip`antet` micaze [allahis cqalobis z'iebashi].

da mis sascaulebs shoris aris is, rom t`k`vent`vis [o, mamakac`no] t`k`venive arsebidan [adamiant`a modgmidan] shek`mna cqvili [k`ali], rat`a simshvide hpovot` mat`t`an. da daamkvidra t`k`vens shoris siqvaruli da gulmocqaleba. cheshmaritad, amashi aris nishnebi [nat`eli mtkic`eba da shegoneba] mat`t`vis, vinc` p`ik`robs [msjelobs]!

da mis sascaulebs shorisaa c`at`a [usazg'vro samqaros, varskvlavt`a da planetat`a simravlis] da micis [sic`oc`xlisat`vis ase srulad mocqobili] shek`mna, aseve t`k`veni enebis sxvadasxvaoba [romlit`ac` saubrobt`] da t`k`veni p`erebis [kanis] mravalp`erovneba. cheshmaritad, amashi udavod aris nishnebi [sascaulebi] mc`odnet`at`vis.

da (aseve) mis sascaulebs shorisaa t`k`veni z'ili g'amit`ac` da dg'it`ac` [roc`a z'alas ikrebt`] da t`k`veni shroma, rom moiz'iot` is cqalobani, rasac` igi gasc`ems. cheshmaritad, amashi udavod aris sascaulebi mat`t`vis, vinc` ismens [ig'ebs shegonebas].

da mis nishnebs shorisaa isic`, rom is gach`venebt` elvas [da t`k`ven xedavt` mas] shishit`ac` [mexis dac`emis shishi] da imedit`ac` [rom noqieri cvima moitanos]. da igi c`idan cqals [cvimas] gadmoavlens da misit` ac`oc`xlebs micas mas shemdeg, rac` igi usic`oc`xlo iqo. cheshmaritad, amashi udavod aris sascaulebi moazrovne xalxt`at`vis.
misi sascavlebidanaa is, rom c`a da mica dganan misi brz'anebit`. shemdeg ki, roc`a is mogixmobt` micidan z'axilit`, mashinve gamoxvalt` [sasap`laoebidan] [gac`oc`xlebulni]

mas [allahs] ekut`vnis is, rac` c`ashia da micaze. qvelani morch`ilni arian misi.[urcmunonic` ki morch`ilni arian allahisa im ganmartebit`, rom sic`oc`xle da sikvdili, dag'liloba da dasveneba, sikvdilis shemdeg gac`oc`xleba... es qvelap`eri adamianis arch`evit` ar aris, pirik`it` mis organizmze allahis neba mok`medebs].

is aris, vinc` icqebs shek`mnas, shemdeg ki mas kvlav ag'adgens [ag'dgomis dg'es]. da es mist`vis [allahist`vis] kidev up`ro advilia. mas ekut`vnis umag'lesi ag'cera [srulqop`ileba] c`asa da micaze. is qovlisshemz'le, qovladbrz'enia

man magalit`i mogiqvanat`[kerpt`aqvanismc`emlebo] t`k`venive t`avebidanve: nut`u gqavt` isini, visac` t`k`veni marjvena p`lobs [t`k`veni monebi], t`anamonaciled imashi, rac` ch`ven giboz'et`, ise rom t`k`ven t`anascorup`lebianni iqot` mat`t`an? da geshiniat` mat`i[t`k`veni monebisa] ise, rogorc` geshiniat` sakut`ari t`avebisa[ert`manet`isa k`onebis gaqop`ashi]?! [rogorc` t`k`ven ar gqavt` monacile t`k`vens k`onebashi da c`olshvilshi, amgvarad allahsac` ar hqavs monacile t`avis mp`lobelobashi]amgvarad vxsnit` sascaulebs moazrovne xalxist`vis

pirik`it`, isini, vinc` usamart`loni arian [mravalg'mert`ianni], mihqvnen sakut`ar vnebebs c`odnis gareshe, xolo visac` allahi gzas aac`dens, vin daadgens mas scor gzaze?! da mat` ar eqolebat` damxmareni

mimart`e sheni saxe [mxolod] cheshmarit sarcmunoebas [daemorch`ile mxolod mas], [iqavi] hanip`i [ert`g'mert`iani], [rac` sheesabameba] mocqobas/bunebas [adamianisa], romlit`ac` allahma shek`mna xalxi t`avidanve [shek`mna adamiani midrekili cheshmariti sarcmunoebisken da misi sruli morch`ilebisken]. ar sheiz'leba allahis k`mnilebis shec`vla [nu shec`vlit` ert`g'mert`obas mravalg'mert`obit`]. es [ert`g'mert`oba da allahis kanonis shesruleba] aris scori [mart`ali] sarcmunoeba, magram xalxt`a umetesoba amas ver xvdeba [ar ic`is]

mimart`et` mas [monanebit`] da eridet` mas [mis sasjels] [sheasrulet` is, rac` man gibrz'anat` da gashordit` imas, rac` man agikrz'alat`], ag'asrulet` loc`va [scorad] [drois dac`vit`, up`lis cinashe simdablit` da sulit` mindobili] da nu ik`nebit` mravalg'mert`iant`agan

imat`gan, vinc` daanacevres t`aviant`i sarcmunoeba [shec`vales igi] da ik`c`nen dajgup`ebebad. qoveli dajgup`eba xarobs imit`, rac` mast`anaa [t`vlis, rom mxolod isini arian cheshmaritebaze, xolo sxvani -- shec`domashi].

da roc`a xalxs ubedureba sheexebat` [siz'nele an zarali], isini mimart`aven t`aviant` up`als da mxolod mas evedrebian [toveben sxvas, visac` adre t`aqvans sc`emdnen]. xolo roc`a igi daagemovnebinebs t`avis cqalobas [beds sheumsubuk`ebs, ubedurebas moac`ilebs da siket`es az'levs], -- mashinve mat`gan nacili t`avis up`als t`anamoziares uch`ens [kvlav ubrundeba mravalg'mert`ianobas da evedreba sxvas allahis garda].

rat`a ugulvebelqon da umaduroba gamoxaton im cqalobis mimart`, rac` ch`ven vargunet` mat`. isargeblet` (o, mravalg'mert`ianebo) [am cut`isop`lis siamovnebit`], magram mere t`avad sheitqobt` [ra sasjeli dagecevat`]!
an nut`u ch`ven mivgzavnet` mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] raime mtkic`ebuleba [sabut`i da gamart`leba], romelic` aucqebda mat` imas, rom nebadart`ulia allahs sxva sheadaron [t`anamoziarebad miich`nion]?

da roc`a ch`ven vagemovnebinebt` adamianebs [umetesobas] ch`vens cqalobas [janmrt`elobas, mshvid c`xovrebas, naqop`ierebas...], isini xaroben masze ampartavnulad [madlierebis nac`vlad]. xolo t`u ubedureba sheemt`xvevat` [daavadeba, sig'aribe, shishi] im qvelap`ris gamo, rac` mat`ma xelebma moimok`medes [c`odvebis gamo], -- mashinve sasocarkvet`ilni xdebian [allahis cqalobis mimart`]!

nut`u ver xedaven, rom allahi visac` isurvebs t`avis msaxurt`agan, imas p`art`o sazrdos az'levs, xolo visac` isurvebs uzg'udavs? cheshmaritad, amashi [sazrdos gap`art`oebasa da shezg'udvashi] udavod aris saacauli morcmunet`at`vis [vinc` ic`nobs allahis sibrz'nesa da cqalobas]!

mash, miec`i, [morcmuneo] nat`esavs misi up`leba [sheinarch`une mast`an nat`esauri kavshiri, gaucie daxmareba], aseve miec`i g'aribs da mgzavrs [vinc` gzashi gamoleulia]. es umjobesi sak`mea mat`t`vis, visac` [t`avisi ket`ili k`medebebit`] allahis saxe [xilva] surs. da scored aset`ni arian netarni [am k`veqanashic` da maradiul c`xovrebashic`].

da is, rasac` t`k`ven gaasesxebt` [gaaproc`entebt`] imist`vis, rom gamravldes [rom sargebeli mogitanot`, ik`neba es saproc`enti sesxi an t`undac` sach`uk`ari], -- allaht`an igi ar gamravldeba. xolo is, rasac` t`k`ven iz'levit` zak`at`idan, allahis saxis [misi ket`ilgancqobisa da xsnis] survilit`, -- scored isini arian, vinc` mart`la amravleben [sakut`ar k`onebas da jildos].

allahia is, vinc` shegk`mnat` t`k`ven [adamianno] shemdeg gamogkvebat`, mere mogakvdinebt` da kvlavac` gagac`oc`xlebt` [ag'gadgent` ag'dgomis dg'es angarishisa da sazg'aurisat`vis]. nut`u t`k`vens t`anamoziarebshi [visac` t`aqvans sc`emt` allahis garda] aris vinme, vinc` am sak`meebidan rames gaaket`ebs t`k`vent`vis? didebulia igi da ag'matebulia imaze, rasac` isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] t`anaziarebad udgenen!

micaze da zg'vaze gach`nda areuloba [gvalva, senebi da avadmqop`obani] imis gamo, rac` adamiant`a xelebma moimok`medes [mat` c`odvat`a gamo]. rat`a agemovnebinot` mat` mc`ire nacili imidan, rasac` t`avadve sch`adiodnen, rat`a [gons moegon, moinanion da] daubrundnen allahis morch`ilebas!
