t`k`vi: [o, muhammad, (urcmunoebs)]: moiaret` mica da shexedet`, rogori dasasruli eciat` mat`, vinc` t`k`venamde iqo [nuhis xalxi, adi, samudi da sxvani]! umetesoba mat`gani mravalg'mert`iani iqo [da scored mat`i urcmunoebisa da mravalg'mert`ianobis gamo dag'upulni ik`nen].

da mimart`e sheni saxe [guli da mt`eli arseba] mxolod cheshmarit sarcmunoebas, sanam dadgeba is dg'e [sasamart`los dg'e], romelsac` ar hqavs gambrunebeli allahisagan [veravin ver sheach`erebs mis mosvlas]. im dg'es [adamianebi] gaiqop`ian (or banakad).
vinc` urcmuno gaxda -- mis cinaag'mdegve shemoutrialdeba misi urcmunoeba. xolo vinc` ket`il sak`mes sch`adioda, mat` moimzades t`aviant`t`vis samqop`eli samot`xeshi.

(es moxdeba imisat`vis,) rom allahma daajildos isini, vinc` ircmunes da ket`il sak`meebs sch`adiodnen, t`avisi udidesi cqalobit`a [gauzardos mat` sazg'auri imaze metit`, vidre t`avad moimok`medes]. cheshmaritad, allahs ar uqvars urcmunoni!

da misi nishnebidanaa isic`, rom allahi [cvimamde] gzavnis k`arebs [g'rublian talg'ebs miak`roleben] ket`ili ucqebis maxaroblad, rat`a agemovnebinot` misi cqaloba [cvimis saxit`, romelic` ac`oc`xlebs micas mc`enareebit`]; rat`a xomaldebi mis brz'anebas daemorch`ilon da zg'vebze daiaron; rat`a t`k`ven ipovot` sazrdo misi udidesi cqalobidan da rat`a egebis madlierni iqot` [mis mier boz'ebuli am siket`eebisat`vis].

ch`ven ukve carmovgzavnet` shenamde (o, muhammad) (cinamorbedi) moc`ik`ulni t`aviant` xalxebt`an. isini modiodnen mat`t`an nat`eli nishnebit` (allahisgan) [sascaulebit`a da mtkic`ebulebebit`] (da moucodebdnen ert`g'mert`ianobisken). (magram bevrma mat`ganma ar ircmunes) da ch`ven shuri viz'iet`et` mat`ze, romlebmac` ar ircmunes (imit`, rom davg'upet` isini). da ch`venzea (valdebulebaa), daxmareba morcmunet`at`vis (vinc` moc`ik`ulebs mihqvnen).

allahia vinc` gzavnis k`arebs[da ara sxva vinme], (romlebic`) shemdeg ag'amag'leben [amoz'raveben] g'rublebs. igi ganp`ens [gaavrc`elebs] mat` [g'rublebs] c`aze, rogorc` is inebebs, da ak`c`evs mat` nacilebad. da shen xedav, rogor gamodis cvimis cvet`ebi g'rublebidan. xolo roc`a igi ugzavnis mas [cvimas] t`avis msaxurt`agan imas, visac` isurvebs, - mashin, isini xaroben.
t`umc`a manamde, vidre es mat`ze moivlineboda [manamde, vidre cvima gadmovidoda], isini sasocarkvet`ilni iqvnen.

da shexede (o, adamiano) allahis cqalobis kvals [imas, rac` cvimis shemdeg xdeba]: rogor ac`oc`xlebs mas [micas] (mc`enaret`a amoqvanit`) misi usic`oc`xlobis shemdeg! cheshmaritad, is [allahi, vinc` ac`oc`xlebs micas] ac`oc`xlebs mkvdrebsac` (ag'dgomis dg'es), da igi qovlisshemz'lea!

da t`u ch`ven gavagzavnit` k`ars (mavnebels mat`i nat`esebist`vis), da isini dainaxaven amas [t`aviant` nat`esebs] gaqvit`lebulad [gamxmarad], (mashin) isini, uechvelad, amis shemdeg umadurebi ag'moch`ndebian (im cqalobebis mimart`, rac` manamde allahma uboz'a).
vinaidan, cheshmaritad, shen (o, cinascarmetqvelo) ver sheasmen mkvdrebs, da ver sheasmen qruebs z'axils[xmas], roc`a isini zurgs ak`c`even [ver shemoabruneb mat` cheshmaritebisaken].

da shen (o, cinascarmetqvelo) ar xar is, [vinc` shez'lebs] brmebis t`aviant` gzaabneulobidan gamoqvanas. shen shez'leb allahis sitqva gaagono mxolod mat`, vinc` ircmunebs ch`vens nishnebs da (amast`anave) (aris) srulad mindobili (allahs).

allahia is, vinc` shegk`mnat` t`k`ven sisustidan [spermis cvet`isgan], shemdeg sisustis (bavshvobis) shemdeg moganichat` z'ala (srulclovnobisa), mere ki z'alis shemdeg gaz'levt` sisustes [moxuc`ebulobas] da chag'aras. is k`mnis, rasac` inebebs. da is aris qovlismc`odne, qovlisshemz'le!

im dg'es, roc`a dadgeba saat`i [sasamart`los dg'e] (da allahi ag'adgens t`avis k`mnilebebs), borotmok`medni [urcmunoebi] daip`ic`eben, rom mat` (samarxebshi) ert`i saat`ic` ar dauqovnebiat` [z'alian mokled moech`venebat` sap`lavebshi gatarebuli dro]. scored ase iqvnen isini gadaxrilni (cheshmaritebisgan) (micier c`xovrebashi)!

da etqvian isini, visac` naboz'ebi hk`ondat` c`odna da rcmena [angelozebi da cinascarmetqvelni]: t`k`ven iqavit` (t`k`vens samarxebshi) (shesabamisad) allahis gangebisa ag'dgomis dg'emde. ai - es aris ag'dgomis dg'e, magram t`k`ven (micier c`xovrebashi) ar ic`odit` (imis shesaxeb, rom is namdvilad dadgeboda).
da im dg'es ar sheecevat` mat`, vinc` usamart`lobas sch`adioda, mat`i mtkic`eba (gamart`leba), da arc` moet`xovebat` mat` raime monanieba[da allahis dakmaqop`ileba].

da aha, ch`ven ukve movuqvanet` adamianebs am quranshi qvelanairi magalit`i. da t`u shen (o, cinascarmetqvelo) mat` [xalxs] miuaxlovdebi (romelime) nishnit` [damamtkic`ebeli sabut`it`] (romlit`ac` dadasturdeba, rom cheshmaritebas k`adageb), uechvelad itqvian isini, vinc` urcmunoni gaxda: "t`k`ven mxolod sic`ruis mimdevarni xart`!"
ase daluk`avs allahi imat` gulebs, romelt`ac` ar ic`ian (rom is nishnebi da shegonebebi, rit`ac` shen mat`t`an allahisgan mosuli xar, aris cheshmariteba)!

da moit`mine (o, cinascarmetqvelo) (is cqena, rasac` sheni xalxi gaqenebs), vinaidan, cheshmaritad, allahis ag't`k`ma (imis shesaxeb, rom shen dagexmareba da dagajildoebs) cheshmaritebaa (da amashi echvi ar aris). da nu dagasusteben isini, vinc` ar arian darcmunebulni (ag'dgomashi,da ar gamoviqvanon mot`minebidan)!
alip` laam miim.
es [rac` ikit`xeba] brz'eni cignis [quranis] aiat`ebia
[es] gzamkvlevi da cqalobaa ket`ilismok`medt`at`vis
romlebic` asruleben loc`vas [savaldebulo loc`vas], gasc`emen mocqalebas [zak`at`s] da mtkic`ed scamt` saik`iosi.
isini arian t`aviant`i g'mert`is mier mit`it`ebul cheshmarit gzaze mdgomni, da isini arian carmatebulni.

da adamiant`agan arian iset`ni, romlebic` iz'enen gasart`ob saubars [qvelap`ers, rac` adamians allahis morch`ilebas ashorebs], rat`a c`odnis gareshe aac`dinon allahis gzidan da ak`c`ion is[allahis aiat`ebi] sasac`ilod. ai isini, mat`t`vis gamzadebulia damamc`irebeli sasjeli
roc`a ch`vens aiat`ebs ukit`xaven, igi ampartavnulad ibrunebs zurgs, t`it`k`os ar moesmina, t`it`k`os qurebshi siqrue hk`ondes [ar esmis]. mash, axare [o, moc`ik`ulo] mas mtanjveli sasjelit`
cheshmaritad, romelt`ac` ircmunes da ket`ili sak`meebi aket`es, mat`t`vis aris netarebis bag'ebi
isini masshi maradiulad darch`ebian. allahma cheshmariti ag't`k`ma ag'ut`k`va [mat`]. da igi qovlisshemz'le, qovladbrz'enia

man [allahma] shek`mna c`ani [da aag'amag'la isini] uqrdenod, rogorc` t`k`ven xedavt`, da gaadgina micaze mtkic`e [mt`ebi], rat`a igi [dedamica] ar sherqeuliqo t`k`vent`an ert`ad. da gaavrc`ela masze [dedamicaze] qvela saxis c`xoveli. da gardmoavavlinet` c`idan cqali [cvima] da ag'movac`enet` masze [dedamicaze] qvela mshvenieri [da sasargeblo] cqvili [mc`enaret`a].
es aris allahis k`mnileba. mash, mach`venet`, ra shek`mnes mis garda sxvebma?![ visac` mis garda t`aqvans sc`emt`] magram usamart`loni ashkara shec`domashi arian

da ch`ven mivec`it` luqmans sibrz'ne:[da vut`xarit`] rom allahist`vis madloba ag'evlina! da vinc` madlierebas ag'avlens, mxolod t`avis sasiket`od aket`ebs. da vinc` umaduri ik`neba[allahis cqalobis mimart`], ic`odes, rom allahi qovladmdidaria[da ar sachiroebs raimes vinmesgan], qovladk`ebulia[nebismier shemt`xvevashi]!
da aki, ut`xra luqmanma t`avis z'es k`adagebit`: hei, shvilo ch`emo! ar daudgino allahs t`anaziari, uechvelad, mravalg'mert`ianoba didi usamart`lobaa[qvelaze udidesi c`odva]

ch`ven vuanderz'et` adamians, rom mshoblebis mimart` [mat` sic`oc`xleshi da sikvdilis shemdegac`] ket`ili qop`iliqo, radgan deda atarebs mas [sakut`ar muc`elshi] sisusteze sisustit`, xolo misi mocqveta z'uz'usgan or celicadshia. [da vut`xarit` mas]: madloba shemcire me [allahs] da shens mshoblebs[sheni ag'zrdis gamo], ch`emt`an aris dabruneba[da qvelas avunazg'aureb imas rac` ekut`vnis madlierebis gamo]

xolo t`u isini [sheni mshoblebi] dazhinebit` gt`xoven, rat`a me t`anamoziare damidgino imashi, razec` aranairi c`odna ar gak`vs, mashin nu daemorch`ilebi mat` [orive mshobels]. t`umc`a am k`veqniur c`xovrebashi siket`e gamoich`ine mat` mimart` [imashi, rashic` c`odva ar aris] da [rcmenis sak`meebshi] mihqevi imas, vinc` ch`emsken moik`c`a [monaniebit`]. shemdeg ch`emt`an aris t`k`veni dabruneba da me shegatqobinebt` imas, rasac` aket`ebdit` [amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi]

shvilo ch`emo! t`uki [adamianis sak`me] ik`neba mdogvis marc`vlis conis toli da ag'moch`ndeba kldeshi, an c`ashi, an micashi, allahi gamoavlens mas [gankit`xvis dg'es]. cheshmaritad, allahi ket`ili da qovlismc`odnea

shvilo ch`emo! ag'asrule loc`va, ubrz'ane ag'iarebuli [ket`ili sak`meebi] da sheakave uarqop`ilisgan [c`odvisgan], da moit`mine is, rac` shegxvdeba. cheshmaritad, es im sak`meebidanaa, romlebic` mtkic`e gadacqvetilebas moit`xovs.
da nu ibruneb saxes xalxisgan [ampartavnobit`] da nu ivli micaze t`avmomconed. cheshmaritad, allahs ar uqvars qoveli k`edmag'ali t`avmomcone
mozomilad iare da daimdable xma. cheshmaritad, xmat`a shoris qvelaze arasasiamovno virebis xmaa

nut`u t`k`ven [o, adamianebo] ar gixilavt` [an ar dap`ik`rebulxart` imaze], rom allahma dagimorch`ilat` [sargeblobist`vis xelmisacvdomi gaxada] is, rac` c`ashia [mze, mt`vare, varskvlavebi, g'rublebi...], da is, rac` micazea [cqali, c`xovelebi, mc`enareebi, xomaldebi...], da uxvad moganichat` t`k`ven t`avisi cqaloba -- rogorc` xiluli [is, rasac` adamiani grz'nobs an ac`nobierebs], aseve p`aruli [is, razec` adamianebi verc` ki carmoidgenen]? da adamiant`agan aris iset`i [urcmuno], vinc` kamat`obs allahze [mis arsze, misi moc`ik`ulis arch`evaze, misi mier cignis gardmovlenaze] qovelgvari c`odnis gareshe, qovelgvari gzamkvlevis gareshe [ganmartebis gareshe] da qovelgvari ganmanat`lebeli cignis gareshe [romelic` allahis mier ik`neboda gardmovlinebuli da romelshic` nat`eli mtkic`ebulebebi da argumentebi ik`neboda] [quranis gareshe]?

da roc`a eubnebian:,,mihqevit` imas, rac` allahma gardamoavlina, isini amboben: [ara] pirik`it`, ch`ven mivqvebit` imas, razec` ch`veni mamebi vpovet`.da [nut`u isini mainc` mihqvebian t`aviant` cinaprebs] mashinac` ki, t`u shaitani moucodebdes mat` sasjelisken jojoxet`is alshi?

xolo vinc` allahs umorch`ilebs t`avis saxes [srulad emorch`ileba allahs], ket`ilismok`medi iqo, is ch`aeichida qvelaze mtkic`e saqrdens. da allaht`anaa qvela sak`mis dasasruli [misi k`mnilebebis] [is t`vit`on ganikit`xavs da miuzg'avs mat`]

xolo vinc` urcmuno gaxda nu dagamcuxrebs misi urcmunoeba. ch`vent`anaa mat`i dabruneba da shevatqobinebt` mat`, rasac` aket`ebdnen. cheshmaritad, allahma ic`is mkerdis shignit` arsebuli [rac` sulebshia]
ch`ven c`ota xans vaz'levt` mat` sargeblobis sashualebas [amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi], shemdeg ki [ag'dgomis dg'es] vaiz'ulebt` mat` [casvlas] sastik sasjelze [jojoxet`shi]
da t`u hkit`xav mat`: vin shek`mna c`ani da mica? isini uechvelad itqvian: allahma. t`k`vi: k`eba-dideba allahs! magram mat`ma umravlesobam ar ic`is.
allahs ekut`vnis is, rac` c`ashia da rac` micaze. cheshmaritad, allahi mdidaria [arap`ers ar sachiroebs] da didebulad sak`ebaria
t`u dedamicaze rac` xea kalmebad ik`c`eoda, da zg'va [melnad], romelsac` kidev shvidi zg'va sheemateboda, allahis sitqvebi mainc` ar amoicureboda. cheshmaritad, allahi z'levamosilia da brz'enia

t`k`veni shek`mna [o, adamianebo] da ag'dgoma [gansjis dg'es] iset`ivea [martivi allahist`vis], rogorc` ert`i adamianis [shek`mna da ag'dgoma]. cheshmaritad, allahi msmenelia [t`k`veni sitqvebisa] da mnaxveli [t`k`veni sak`meebisa]

nut`u ar xedav, rom allahs g'ame dg'eshi shehqavs da dg'e g'ameshi [ic`vlis dg'is da g'amis xangrz'livobas clis sezonebis mixedvit`], da man morch`ilad k`mna mze da mt`vare [arsebis sasargeblod da ket`ildg'eobist`vis]: t`it`oeuli mat`gani [mze da mt`vare] moz'raobs dadgenil vadamde [sasjelis dg'emde, roc`a es samqaro shecqvets arsebobas]... da cheshmaritad, allahist`vis c`nobilia rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt` [ic`is t`avisi k`mnilebebis qvela sak`me]

es [zemot` xsenebuli allahis z'almosileba, misi qovlismc`odneoba da misi daxmareba mis momxreebs] imitom aris, rom allahi aris cheshmariti [cheshmariti g'mert`i], xolo is, rasac` isini [mravalg'mert`ianni] mis garda uxmoben, es [qvelap`eri, rac` allahis garda aiqvanes g'vt`aebad] -- sic`ruea. da imitom, rom allahi aris uzenaesi [qvela t`avisi k`mnilebaze ag'matebuli], diadi [aravin da arap`eria masze didi].
nut`u ar xedav, rom xomaldebi zg'vashi allahis cqalobit` dac`uraven, rat`a daganaxot` misi sascaulebidan zogiert`i? cheshmaritad, amashi sascaulebia qoveli momt`meni da madlieri adamianist`vis.

da roc`a talg'a moic`avs mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs], rogorc` ch`rdili [rodesac` gemze dac`uraven], isini allahs evedrebian [gadarch`enas], morch`ilebas mxolod mas uz'g'vnian [ivicqeben qvela c`ru g'mert`s]. xolo roc`a is gadaarch`ens mat` da xmelet`ze gamoiqvans, mat`gan zogi ukan ixevs [vinc` sat`anadod madlobas ar sciravs allahs]. da ch`vens sascaulebs uarqop`s mxolod qoveli mog'alate da umaduri

o, adamianebo! shegeshindet` t`k`veni up`lis [sasjels] da eridet` im dg'es, roc`a mshobeli verap`rit` ushvelis t`avis shvils, da verc` shvili verap`rit` ushvelis t`avis mshobels [verc` mshoblebi da verc` shvilebi verap`rit` shez'leben ert`manet`is daxmarebas]! cheshmaritad, allahis ag't`k`ma cheshmaritebaa, amitom nu mogatquebt` micieri c`xovreba [nu gagitac`ebt` amk`veqniuri xibli], da nu mogatquebt` allahis shesaxeb matquara [satana]

cheshmaritad, allahi [aset`ia, rom] [mxolod] mas ak`vs c`odna saat`is shesaxeb [sasjelis dg'is dadgomis shesaxeb], da [mxolod] is moavlens cvimas [g'rublebidan] da [mxolod] man ucqis, ra aris sashvilisnoshi. magram arc`ert`ma sulma ar ic`is, ras sheiz'ens xval, da arc`ert`ma sulma ar ic`is, romel micaze mokvdeba. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismc`odnea da qovladshemec`nebulia!
alip` laam miim.
am cignis [quranis] gardamovlena, romelshic` echvi ar aris, samqarot`a up`lisganaa [qvela k`mnilebis up`lisgan] [da ara adamianisgan].

nut`u isini [mravalg'mert`ianni] amboben: man [muhammadma] t`avad moigona igi [qurani]? ara [es ase ar aris], es [qurani] cheshmaritebaa, romelic` gardmoevlina sheni up`lisgan, rat`a shen [o, moc`ik`ulo] sheagono xalxs [quraishelebs da sxva arabebs], romlebt`anac` shenamde ar mosula shegonebis momtani [o, muhammad], ik`neb scori gzit` iaron [gaigon cheshmariteba da ircmunon allahi]

allahi [is aris] igi, vinc` c`ani da mica da is, rac` mat` shorisaa, t`avisi sibrz'nit` ek`vs dg'eshi shek`mna [t`umc`a mas sheez'lo mat`i shek`mna ert` camshi, mxolod et`k`va:,,iqavi!], shemdeg amag'lda taxtze [rogorc` sheep`ereba mxolod mis didebas da ara k`mnilebat`a msgavsad]. t`k`vent`vis [o, mravalg'mert`ianno] mis garda araa arc` mp`arveli [vinc` allahis sasjels agaridebdat`], arc` shuamdgomeli [vinc` mis cinashe t`k`vent`vis shecqalebas moit`xovda]. nut`u ar isment` [am shegonebebs] [an ar dap`ik`rdebit` amaze]?

is [allahi] ganagebs qvela [k`mnilebis sak`mes] c`idan micamde [sadac` shemdeg xdeba qvela movlena], xolo shemdeg es [sak`me] mast`an brundeba ert` dg'eshi, romlis sidide [xangrz'livoba] t`k`vens mixedvit` at`asi clis tolia. [manz'ili c`idan micamde sheadgens xut`asi clis angelozis gzas. dashveba da amag'leba ert`ad sheadgens at`as cels,magram angelozi am drois manz'ils ert` dg'eshi kvet`avs]
is [allahi] aris p`arulis [rac` sulebshia damaluli] da ashkaris mc`odne, qovlisshemz'le [romelsac` veravin ver daamarc`xebs], shemcqalebeli [morcmuneebis mimart`],
is, romelmac` srulqop`ilad [brz'nulad da g'irseulad] shek`mna qoveli ram, rac` ki shek`mna, da daicqo adamianis [adamis] shek`mna t`ixidan,
shemdeg misi sht`amomavloba shek`mna susti cqlisagan [spermis susti cvet`isgan]

shemdeg igi gaascora [daasrula adamis sxeulis shek`mna] da sht`abera masshi t`avisi sulidan [sulidan, romelic` allahs ekut`vnis] [angelozis meshveobit`] da t`k`vent`vis, o, adamianebo, shek`mna smena, mxedveloba da gulebi. og'ond c`otas sciravt` madlobas [t`k`vens up`als qvela am cqalobist`vis, romelic` moganichat`]

da t`k`ves mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebma]: nut`u, rodesac` ch`ven [sikvdilis shemdeg] davikargebit` micashi [rodesac` srulad daishleba ch`veni sxeulebi], gana ch`ven auc`ileblad axal k`mnilebad [ag'vdgebit`] vik`nebit`? pirik`it`, mat` ar scamt` shexvedra t`aviant` up`alt`an [ag'dgomis dg'es].
ut`xari [o, moc`ik`ulo] am mravalg'mert`ianebs: sikvdilis angelozi, romelic` t`k`venzea danishnuli migibarebt`, [caig'ebs t`k`vens sulebs], shemdeg ki t`k`ven t`k`vens up`alt`an dabrundebit`

da netav dagenaxa, rogor t`avch`ag'unulni dganan c`odvilni t`aviant`i up`lis cinashe da amboben: up`alo ch`veno! davinaxet` da movisminet`. mogvabrune [micier c`xovrebashi], rom ket`ili sak`meebi gavaket`ot`. namdvilad vart` darcmunebulni [cheshmaritebashi, romelsac` ak`amde vuarqop`dit`]

t`u movisurvebdi, auc`ileblad mivc`emdi t`it`oeul suls mis scor gzas, magram ch`emi sitqva ukve dadasturda: da uechvelad avavseb jojoxet`s [urcmunoebit`] [rogorc`] jinebit`, ise adamianebit` qvelas ert`ad.

[mravalg'mert`ianebs et`k`mebat`]: gaisinjet` [sasjeli] imis gamo, rom daivicqet` am t`k`veni dg'is shexvedra [gankit`xvis dg'is] mosvla! dg'es ch`venc` dagivicqet` t`k`ven [gtovebt` jojoxet`shi shecqalebisa da daxmarebis gareshe]. gasinjet` maradiuli tanjva im sak`mis gamo, rasac` sch`adiodit` [dedamicaze] [urcmunoebas da mravalg'mert`ianobas]

ch`vens sascaulebs [aiat`ebs] mxolod isini ircmuneben, romlebic`, rodesac` sheaxseneben mat`, mqisve sujudze vardebian [allahis cinashe morch`ilebit`] da didebas ag'uvlenen t`aviant` g'mert`s da t`avad ar ampartavnoben

morcmuneebi zurgs ushoreben sacolebs [g'amit` dgebian loc`visat`vis], g'vt`is mimart` loc`uloben shishit` [misi sasjelisagan] da imedit` [misi cqalobisadmi], da imidan, rac` ch`ven mivanichet` mat` [dashvebuli k`onebidan], xarjaven [allahis gzaze - rogorc` savaldebulo, aseve nebaqop`lobit`i ket`ilsak`meebist`vis]

da arc`ert`ma sulierma ar ic`is, ra aris dap`aruli mat`t`vis [morcmunet`at`vis] t`valt`a netarebidan [im siamovnebebidan da sixarulidan, rit`ac` gaixarebs t`vali da guli], rogorc` jildo imis gamo, rasac` isini aket`ebdnen [mat`i morch`ilebisa da ket`ili sak`meebis gamo]
gana is, vinc` morcmunea [allahis morch`ilia, sheiz'leba gautoldes imas, vinc` urch`i [urcmunoa]? isini ar arian t`anascorni
rac` sheexeba mat`, romelt`ac` ircmunes da ket`il sak`meebs ch`adiodnen, mat`t`vis aris samot`xis bag'ebi sac`xovreblad, imist`vis, rac` isini aket`ebdnen

xolo isini, vinc` urch`obdnen [ar scamdat` da ar emorch`ilebodnen allahs], mat`i t`avshesap`ari ik`neba c`ec`xli [jojoxet`i]. qoveljerze, rodesac` isurveben ik`idan gamosvlas, kvlav abruneben mat` shignit` da eubnebian: gasinjet` c`ec`xlis sasjeli, romelsac` sic`rued miich`nevdit` [romelisac` ar gjerodat`]

ch`ven auc`ileblad davagemovnebinebt` mat` [am urch` urcmunoebs] axlo sasjels [amk`veqniur ubedurebebsa da gasachirs] up`ro didi sasjelis [saik`ioshi ki jojoxet`s], ik`neb isini daubrundnen [moinanion mat`i urcmunoeba da daubrunden allahis rcmenas]

da vin aris up`ro usamart`lo, vidre is, visac` sheaxsenes misi up`lis sascaulebi [allahis aiat`ebi da mtkic`ebulebebi], xolo shemdeg igi zurgs ak`c`evs mas [ar miig'o aiat`ebi da k`edmag'lobda t`avxedobit` mat` mimart`]? cheshmaritad, ch`ven shurs viz'iebt` [gansakut`rebuli sasjelit`] c`odvilebze [urcmunoebze]

ch`ven ukve mivec`it` (cinascarmetqvels) musas cigni [t`ora]. amitom nu ik`nebi (o, cinascarmetqvelo) echvshi mast`an shexvedris shesaxeb (musast`an, amag'lebis g'ames)! da gavxadet` igi [es cigni, t`ora] gzamkvlevad israilis [cinascarmetqveli iaqubis] sht`amomavlebist`vis.

ch`ven mat`gan [israilis sht`amomavlebs shoris] gavxadet` cinamz'g'vrebi, romlebic` ch`veni brz'anebit` scor gzaze aqenebdnen [xalxs]. [am cinamz'g'varobis xarisxs mat` miag'cies] imis gamo, rom iqvnen mot`minebit` gamz'leni [allahis brz'anebebis shesrulebashi, akrz'alulebis mitovebashi da am gzisken mocodebashi] da mtkic`ed darcmunebulni iqvnen ch`vens sascaulebshi.
cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i gansjis ag'dgomis dg'es mat` shoris [morcmuneebsa da urcmunoebs shoris] imas, razedac` ver t`anxmdebodnen.

nut`u mat`t`vis [urcmunoebist`vis] ar iqo gzis mach`venebeli [rcmenisken] is, rom ch`ven gavanadguret` mat`amde mravali t`aoba [hudis, salihis, lutis... xalxebi], xolo isini [urcmunoni], rodesac` shamshi mogzauroben, gadian im adgilebshi, sadac` isini [ganadgurebuli xalxebi] c`xovrobdnen. cheshmaritad, amashi [sasjelshi] namdvilad aris sascaulebi. nut`u isini ar moismenen?

nut`u ver dainaxes, rogor vushvebt` cqals (cvimasa da nakadulebs) gamxmari micisken [sadac` mc`enareuloba ar aris] da [misi sashualebit`] amogvqavs nat`esebi, romlit`ac` ikvebebian rogorc` mat`i pirutqvi, ise isini t`vit`onac`? nut`u ver xedaven? [rom rogorc` allahi ac`oc`xlebs micas gvalvis shemdeg, zustad aseve igi ag'dgomis dg'esac` gaac`oc`xlebs mkvdrebs?]
da amboben isini [urcmunoni]: <<rodis moxdeba es saboloo ganach`eni [ag'sasruli - gankit`xvis dg'e] ch`vensa da t`k`vens shoris, t`u t`k`ven [morcmuneni] simart`les ambobt`?>>
ut`xari mat` (o, cinascarmetqvelo): <<ganach`enis dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es] ar daexmareba urcmunoebs mat`i rcmena, da ag'ar miec`emat` mat` vada (sasjelis gadadeba)>>.
zurgi ak`c`ie mat` [o, shuamavalo] da daelode![rogor daisjebian isini] ramet`u isinic` elodebian [shens sikvdils da sasjels allahisgan romelsac` shen dapirdi mat`]

o, shuamavalo! geshinodes allahis (sheasrule is, rac` man dagibrz'ana, da ganeride imas, rac` man agikrz'ala) (rat`a morcmunenic` mihqvnen amashi shens magalit`s) da nu daemorch`ilebi urcmunoebsa da orpirebs. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismc`odne, brz'enia!
da mihqevi imas, rac` zesht`agegona sheni g'mert`isagan [quransa da sunnas] cheshmaritad, allahi mc`odnea imisa, rasac` aket`ebt`.
da miende allahs, ramet`u sakmarisia allahi mp`arvelad.

allahs ar ch`audvia adamianis mkerdshi ori guli (rogorc` amas zogiert`i mravalg'mert`iani amtkic`ebs). da t`k`veni c`olebs, romelt`ac` t`k`ven eubnebit`: <<shen ch`emt`vis dedach`emis zurgivit` xar>> [amit` sakut`ar t`avze krz'alaven c`olebs cinaislamuri ch`vevis mixedvit`], allahs ar gauxdia isini t`k`vens dedebad. da arc` t`k`veni shvilobilebi [vinc` t`k`ven ishvilet`] gauxdia t`k`vens shvilebad [radgan isini shariat`it` t`k`vens namdvil shvilebad ar it`vlebian]. es t`k`veni sitqvebia, t`k`veni pirit` carmot`k`muli, allahi ki ambobs cheshmaritebas da igi adgens cheshmarit gzaze.

mouxmet` mat` [shvilobilebs] mat`i mamebis saxelebit`. es - up`ro samart`liania allahis cinashe. xolo t`u ar ic`it` mat`i mamebi, mashin isini t`k`veni z'mebi arian rcmenashi da t`k`vens mier [monobidan]daxsnilni. da ar ik`neba t`k`venze c`odva imashi, rashic` t`k`ven uneblied shec`debit` (rodesac` vig'ac`as mis namdvil mamas ar miakut`vnebt`), xolo (c`odva ik`neba) mxolod imashi, rasac` t`k`veni gulebi ganizraxaven (rodesac` shegnebulad ucodebt` sxvis shvils t`k`vens shvils). da allahi mimtevebeli, mcqalobelia.

moc`ik`uli muhamedi morcmunet`at`vis up`ro axlobelia (rcmenisa da saero sak`meebshi), vidre isini ert`manet`ist`vis, xolo misi c`olebi - mat`i dedebi arian [moc`ik`ulis c`olebi g'irseulni da morcmunet`at`vis akrz'alulni arian ise, rogorc` sakut`ari dedebi]. da nat`esaobis mk`oneni [morcmunet`a shoris sisxlit` axloblebi] ert`manet`ist`vis up`ro axlos arian allahis cignis mixedvit` (memkvidreobis sakit`xebshi), vidre sxva morcmuneni da vidre muhajirebi. (garda amisa) t`k`ven shegiz'liat` ket`ili sak`me gaaket`ot` t`k`vens t`anmxlebt`an [sxva morcmuneebt`an] - (sheinarch`unot` mat`t`an kargi urt`iert`oba, daexmarot` materialurad, dautovot` anderz'it` rame da a.sh.). es cinascar aris dacerili cignshi [lavhul mahp`uzshi].
da ag't`k`ma avig'et` shuamavlebisgan, da shenganac` [gansakut`rebit`], nuhisgan, ibrahimisgan, musasgan, 'isasgan mariamis z'isgan, da avig'et` mat`gan mtkic`e ag't`k`ma.
rat`a iman gamokit`xos mart`alt` [shuamavlebs] mat` simart`leze [imaze, t`u rogor upasuxes mat` xalxma mat`i simart`lis mocodebas], xolo urcmunoebist`vis man moamzada mtanjveli sasjeli.

hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! gaixsenet` allahis cqaloba t`k`venze, roc`a t`k`vent`an movidnen jarebi (mravalg'mert`iant`a) [xandaqis brz'olisas], da mat` sheuert`dnen iudevelebic` da medinisa da misi shemogarenis orpirebic` (da mat` shemogartqes alqa). ch`ven ki gavugzavnet` mat` [am mtrul lashk`ars] k`ari (romelic` arg'vevda mat` karavs) da jarebi [angelozebi], romelt`ac` t`k`ven ver xedavdit`. (amit` mat`i gulebi shishit` aivso.) da allahi xedavs imas, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`!

(da gaixsenet`) roc`a isini [t`k`veni mtrebi] mogadgnen zemodan [xeobis zeda mxridan] da k`vemodan [xeobis k`veda mxridan], da t`k`veni t`valebi gasheshda (uzarmazari lashk`ris xedvit`), da gulebi qelamde agividat` (shishisagan), da t`k`ven allahze sxvadasxvagvarad daicqet` p`ik`ri [gagich`ndat` c`udi azrebi, t`it`k`os allahi shesaz'loa ar daxmareboda t`avisi sitqvis damkvidrebas].
scored im dros [im adgilas] gamoic`adnen morcmuneni (rat`a gamorkveuliqo cheshmariti morcmune orpirisagan) da z'lierad sheirqnen (shishit`a da sheshp`ot`ebit`)!

(da gaixsenet`) roc`a t`k`ves orpirebma da mat` [susti morcmuneebidan], romelt`a gulebshic` senia [echvi]: <<is, rac` allahi da misi moc`ik`uli shegvpirdnen, mxolod sac`dunebeli [motqueba] ag'moch`nda!>>

da ai, ert`i jgup`i mat`gan [orpirebidan] (morcmune medinelebs mimart`avda): <<o, iasribis [medinis] mc`xovrebno! ak` t`k`vent`vis adgili ar aris, amitom dabrundit` (sakut`ar saxlebshi, medinashi)!>> da (sxva) jgup`i mat`gani [orpirebidan] shuamavals st`xovda, neba miec`at` (dabrunebuliqvnen medinashi) da ambobdnen: <<cheshmaritad, ch`veni saxlebi dauc`velia>>. t`umc`a is [saxlebi] ar qop`ila dauc`veli. isini (am sitqvebs) mxolod gak`c`evis survilit` ambobdnen (brz'olis velidan).

da t`u (mtris jarebi) medinas qvela mxridan miadgebodnen da shemdeg mat` [orpirebs] gamosc`didnen [moet`xovat` uari et`k`vat` islamze], isini auc`ileblad dat`anxmdebodnen amas da ar daaqovnebdnen, garda mxolod mc`ire droit`

xolo mat` [orpirebs] allaht`an hk`ondat` dadebuli ag't`k`ma [dapireba] (misi moc`ik`ulis meshveobit`) manamdec` [xandaqis brz'olis cin], rom ar sheak`c`evdnen (mters) zurgs [ar gaik`c`eodnen brz'olis velidan]. da ag't`k`mis [dapirebis] shesaxeb allaht`an pasuxs auc`ileblad ageben.

ut`xari (o, shuamavalo) (am orpirebs): <<t`k`ven verap`ers gargebt` gak`c`eva, t`uki brz'olis velidan gaik`c`evit` sikvdilis an mokvlis shishit` [es t`k`vens sic`oc`xles ver gaaxangrz'livebs]. da aset` shemt`xvevashi [mashinac` ki, t`u gaik`c`evit`] amk`veqniuri sargebloba mxolod mc`iredit` gek`nebat` [mxolod im vadamde, rac` allahma t`k`vent`vis daacesa]>>.

ut`xari mat` (o, shuamavalo): <<vin aris is, vinc` dagic`avt` allahisgan, t`u is isurvebs t`k`vent`vis borotebas, an (vin sheach`erebs mas) t`u is isurvebs t`k`vent`vis cqalobas?>> da isini [orpirebi] ver ipovian allahis garda verc` mp`arvels da verc` shemces!

allahma ic`is shemkaveblebi t`k`vengan (allahis gzaze brz'olas) mt`k`melni t`aviant` z'mat`at`vis: <<modi ch`vent`an, (shemogviert`dit` ch`ven da miatovet` muhammadi, rat`a mast`an ert`ad ar daig'upot`)!>> xolo mat`gani [orpirebi] mamac`obas avlenen [brz'olashi monacileoben] mxolod c`ota xnit` (da isic` an t`valsach`inoebist`vis, an didebisat`vis, an sirc`xvilis shishit`).

isini z'uncoben t`k`vent`vis [o, morcmuneno] (t`aviant`i sic`oc`xlit`, k`onebit`, shromit`a da siqvarulit`, radgan mat` gulebshi siz'ulvili da mtrobaa). da roc`a shishi modis [brz'olis momenti axlovdeba], shen (o, moc`ik`ulo) xedav, rogor giqureben isini, da mat`i t`valebi trialebs ise, rogorc` imisi, vinc` sikvdilis cin gonebas kargavs. xolo roc`a shishi gaivlis, isini gcqevlian t`k`ven mkvet`ri enebit`, da ket`ilshi z'uncoben [saomar nadavlis gaqop`isas ich`enen sixarbesa da shurs]. aset`ebi - gulebit` ar qop`ilan morcmuneni, da allahma amao gaxada mat`i sak`meebi! xolo es allahist`vis advilia!

isini [orpirebi] p`ik`roben, rom jgup`ebi (urcmunot`a jarebi) jer ar casulan. xolo t`u (davushvat`) es shekrebili (jarebi kvlav) movlen medinast`an, mashin isini [orpirebi] isurvebdnen, rom qop`iliqvnen karavshi mc`xovreb (udabnos) arabebt`an [beduinebt`an] da mat`gan kit`xulobdnen c`nobebs t`k`venze [gaimarjvet` t`u damarc`xdit`]. xolo t`u isini [orpirebi] t`k`vent`an ert`ad ik`nebodnen, mxolod mc`ired ibrz'olebdnen (shishis, sirc`xvilisa da susti rcmenis gamo).
t`k`vent`vis [o, morcmuneno] allahis moc`ik`ulshi [mis sitqvebsa da k`c`evebshi] aris umshvenieresi magalit`i imat`t`vis, vinc` allahs da ukanasknel dg'es imedovnebs da allahs bevrs ixseniebs.

da roc`a morcmuneebma dainaxes mokavshireni [mtrebis gaert`ianebuli jarebi], romlebmac` medinas shemoartqes alqa, t`k`ves: <<es aris [gamoc`da da daxmareba], rac` allahma da misi moc`ik`ulma dagvpirdnen. simart`le t`k`va allahma (t`avis dapirebashi) da simart`le t`k`va misma moc`ik`ulma!>> da aman mxolod gaaz'liera mat`shi rcmena da morch`ileba.

morcmunet`a shoris arian adamianebi, romlebic` mart`alni ag'moch`ndnen imashi, rashic` allaht`an ag't`k`ma dades [allahist`vis mic`emul dapirebas asruleben da ich`enen mot`minebas brz'olasa da sirt`uleebshi]. mat` shoris arian iset`ni, romlebmac` ukve sheasrules t`aviant`i valdebuleba [ibrz'oles manam, sanam allahis gzaze ar daig'upnen, an gardaic`valnen rcmenashi gulcrp`elni], da arian iset`nic`, romlebic` elian [ert`-ert`s ori siket`idan - an gamarjvebas, an sikvdils allahis gzaze]. da mat` ar sheuc`vliat` [es ag't`k`ma] arap`rit` (gansxvavebit` orpirebisa).

rat`a allahma daajildovos mart`alni [morcmuneni] mat`i simart`lis gamo da dasajos orpirebi, t`u is isurvebs (ar misc`es mat` daxmareba monaniebisken misvlashi da isini urcmunoebad mokvdebian), an (isurvos) miig'os mat`i monanieba (da xeli sheucqos mat` amashi). cheshmaritad, allahi mpatiebeli, mocqalea!

da allahma uku ak`c`ia isini, vinc` urcmunoni gaxda [urcmunot`a gaert`ianebuli jarebi] (medinasagan), t`aviant`i bog'mit`, veranairi siket`e ver moipoves (verc` amk`veqnad da verc` maradiul c`xovrebashi). xolo allahma morcmuneni ixsna brz'olas [gaugzavna urcmunoebs k`ari da angelozebi]. da cheshmaritad, allahi z'lieria, z'levamosilia

da gamoiqvana man cignis xalxi [ebrauli tomi banu quraiza], romlebic` mat` [urcmunot`a gaert`ianebul jarebs] exmarebodnen, t`aviant`i gamagrebuli c`ixe-koshkebidan da ch`ausaxa mat` gulebshi shishi; nacils klavt`[mamakac`ebs, romlebmac` islami ar miig'es], xolo nacils [k`alebsa da bavshvebs] tqved aiqvant`.

da man moganichat` t`k`ven [o, morcmuneno] memkvidreobad mat`i mica [ebraeli banu quraizas micebi], mat`i sac`xovreblebi, mat`i k`oneba da (garda amisa) is mica, romelzec` t`k`ven manamde p`exic` ar dagidgat` [sxva micebi, romlebic` morcmuneebs am gamarjvebis shemdeg xvdat` cilad]. da allahi qovlismz'lea qovelgvar sak`meze!

o, shuamavalo! ut`xari shens c`olebs: <<t`u t`k`ven gsurt` amk`veqniuri c`xovreba da misi silamaze, mashin modit`, me mogc`emt` t`k`ven rac` gekut`vnit` [gank`orcinebis shemt`xvevashi] da gagishvebt` t`k`ven mshvenieri gashvebit` [zianis gareshe]>>

xolo t`u t`k`ven gsurt` allahi da misi moc`ik`uli da imk`veqniuri savane[mshvenieri jildo imk`veqniur c`xovrebashi], (mashin moit`minet` da ic`odet`, rom) allahma t`k`vengan gulcrp`el ket`ilismqop`elt` udidesi jildo gaumzada (iset`i, romlis gverdit`ac` amk`veqniuri siket`eebi arap`rad mogech`venebat`).
hei, moc`ik`ulis c`olebo! t`u t`k`vengan romelime ch`aidens ashkara sibilces [c`xad c`odvas], mas sasjeli gauormagdeba [orjer meti, vidre ch`veulebriv morcmune k`als]. da es allahist`vis advilia!

xolo t`k`vengani, vinc` sruliad daemorch`ileba allahs da mis moc`ik`uls da ket`il sak`meebs ch`aidens, ch`ven mas mivanichebt` jildos ormagad [orjer mets, vidre ch`veulebriv morcmune k`als] da gavumzadebt` mas uxv sarch`os [samot`xe].

o, moc`ik`ulis c`olebo! t`k`ven ar xart` iset`i, rogorc` sxva romelime k`ali. t`u t`k`ven sheushindebit` allahs [misi sasjelis shishit` ic`xovrebt`], mashin nu ik`nebit` rbilni sitqvashi [nu gamoavlent` sinazes saubarshi], radgan mogisurvebt` is, romlis gulshic` senia [midrekileba c`odvisa da akrz'alulisken]. da isaubret` sitqvit`, romelic` c`nobilia [shariat`it` nebadart`uli, ubralo da pirdapiri].

darch`it` t`k`vens saxlebshi [mizezis gareshe nu gaxvalt`] da nu gamoach`ent` t`k`vens t`avs, rogorc` gamoach`endnen [k`alebi] pirvel umec`rebashi [islamamde, rodesac` k`alebi ach`endnen t`aviant` silamazesa da mort`ulobas]. da ag'asrulet` namazi cesisamebr, gaig'et` zak`at`i [savaldebulo mocqaleba] da daemorch`ilet` allahs da mis moc`ik`uls. cheshmaritad, allahs surs mxolod is, rom t`k`vengan, saxlis mc`xovrebno (o, moc`ik`ulis ojaxo) [misi c`olebi da sht`amomavlebi], ganashoros sibinz'ure [qvela boroteba, c`odva] da srulad gangcmindot`.

da gaixsenet` is, rac` ikit`xeba t`k`vens saxlebshi allahis nishnebidan [quranis aiat`ebidan] da sibrz'nisgan [moc`ik`ulis nat`k`vamebidan] (da imok`medet` mat` mixedvit`). cheshmaritad, allahi aris ket`ili [t`k`vendami, radgan t`k`ven moc`ik`ulis saxlebshi mogak`c`iat`] da qovlismc`odne [radgan man gamogarch`iat` da agarch`iat` t`avisi moc`ik`ulis c`olebad, da morcmunet`a dedebad]!

cheshmaritad, muslimi kac`ebisa da muslimi k`alebisat`vis, morcmune kac`ebisa da morcmune k`alebisat`vis, morch`ili kac`ebisa da morch`ili k`alebisat`vis, mart`ali kac`ebisa da mart`ali k`alebisat`vis, momt`meni kac`ebisa da momt`meni k`alebisat`vis, g'vt`is moshishi kac`ebisa da g'vt`is moshishi k`alebisat`vis, mocqalebis gamc`emi kac`ebisa da mocqalebis gamc`emi k`alebisat`vis, momarxule kac`ebisa da momarxule k`alebisat`vis. umankoebis shemnaxveli kac`ebisa da umankoebis shemnaxveli k`alebisat`vis, allahis mravlad momxsenebeli kac`ebisa da allahis mravlad momxsenebeli k`alebisat`vis- allahma mat`t`vis gaamzada patieba da didi sazg'auri!

ar aris arc` morcmune kac`ist`vis da arc` morcmune k`alist`vis, roc`a allahi da misi moc`ik`uli muhammadi gadacqvitaven raime sak`mes [gamosc`emen gadacqvetilebas], arch`evani t`aviant` sak`meshi [morcmune ar irch`evs sxva gadacqvetilebas garda allahisa da misi moc`ik`ulis gadacqvetilebisa]. xolo vinc` urch`obs allahsa da mis moc`ik`uls muhammads, is c`xad gzaabnevashia ch`avardnili

da ai, shen [o, shuamavalo] ut`xari mas, visac` allahma uboz'a madli [misc`a rcmena] da visac` shenc` mianiche madli [monobidan gat`avisup`lebit` da shvilad aqvanit` zaid bin haarisa]: sheinaxe sheni c`oli [nu gank`orcindebi zainab bint` jahshze] da geshinodes allahis! magram shen, [o, muhammad] gulshi malavdi imas, rasac` allahi auc`ileblad gamoavlenda [shen ukve ic`odi g'vt`isagan, rom zaidi mas gank`orcindeboda da shen t`vit`on moiqvandi mas c`olad]. shen geshinoda, ras itqodnen adamianebi [orpirni], rom t`it`k`os muhammadi dak`orcinda t`avisi shvilad aqvanilis qop`il c`olze, mashin roc`a allahis unda up`ro metad geshinodes mas shemdeg, rac` zaidma t`avisi survili ag'asrula mis mimart` [moiqvana c`olad da hk`onda mast`an axlo urt`iert`oba], xolo shemdeg gank`orcinda, da rodesac` dasrulda zainabis idda [gank`orcinebis shemdeg savaldebulo molodinis periodi], ch`ven shegrt`et` igi shen, [o moc`ik`ulo] es imitom, rom morcmuneebs ar hk`onodat` siz'nele [sirc`xvili an dabrkoleba] t`aviant`i shvilad aqvanilebis qop`ili c`olebis mimart`, roc`a isini [es shvilad aqvanilni] ukve daasrulebdnen mat`t`an urt`iert`obas [moiqvandnen c`olad, ic`xovrebdnen da gank`orcindebodnen] da allahis brz'aneba auc`ileblad sruldeba

ar aris shuamavalist`vis [muhammadist`vis] c`odva imashi, rac` allahma daudgina mas [imashi, rom man ik`orcina shvilad aqvanilis qop`il c`olze]. es aris allahis dadgenili cesi cinamorbed cinascarmetqvelt`a shesaxebac` [aseve nebadart`uli iqo mat`t`vis]. xolo allahis brz'aneba aris cinascar gansazg'vruli gadacqvetileba [romelic` auc`ileblad shesruldeba]
romelnic` unaklod gadmosc`emen allahis cerilebs, eshiniat` misi [allahis]. da aravisi eshiniat`, garda allahisa. da sakmarisia allahi angarishmgebad
ar aris muhammedi aravisi mama, t`k`veni kac`ebidan, aramed igia allahis shuamavali da shuamavalt`a bechedia [bolo shuamavalia], cheshmaritad, allahi qvelap`rismc`odnea
hei, t`k`ven romelt`ac` ircmunet`! axsenet` allahi [gulit`, enit`a da sak`meebit`] mravalgzis xsenebit`
da ganadidet` is, dilit` da sag'amot`i

isaa [allahi], vinc` gloc`avt` [gaz'levt` cqalobas], da misi angelozebic` [gloc`aven; vedrebas aket`eben t`k`vent`vis], rat`a gamogiqvanon sibnelidan [uvic`obidan da shec`domidan] sinat`leshi [rcmenasa da allahis srul morch`ilebashi]. da is morcmunet`a mimart` mocqalea [amk`veqnadac` da saik`ioshic`] [is ar dasjis mat`, t`u daemorch`ilebian mas da mxolod misi kmaqop`ilebisken iscrap`vian].

mat`i misalmeba [am morcmunet`a] im dg'es, roc`a isini shexvdebian allahs [samot`xeshi], ik`neba: mshvidoba! [angelozebi mivlen morcmuneebt`an da miesalmebian mat`: <<mshvidoba [usap`rt`xoeba] t`k`venze!]. da allahs mat`t`vis gamzadebuli ak`vs uxvi jildo [samot`xe]
hei, moc`ik`ulo ch`ven cargagzavnet` shen mocmed, maxaroblad da shemgoneblad
allahisken momxmobad [mxolod misi g'mert`obis ag'iarebisken] misi nebart`vit` [misi brz'anebit`] da manat`obel shuk`urad,

da axare morcmuneebs, rom allahisgan ak`vt` udidesi madli da axare [o, shuamavalo muhammad] morcmuneni[romlebic` allahis kanonebit` mok`medeben], rom allahisgan mat`t`vis gamzadebulia didi cqaloba [samot`xis bag'ebi]

da nu daemorch`ilebi [o, shuamavalo muhammad] urcmunoebsa da t`valt`mak`c`t`, da miatove mat`i mxridan mosuli shecuxeba. miende mxolod allahs! da sakmarisia allahi rogorc` mp`arveli (amk`veqniur da saik`io c`xovrebashi]

hei, t`k`ven romelt`ac` ircmunet`! roc`a c`olad sheirt`avt` morcmune k`alebs, shemdeg ki gank`orcindebit` mat`t`an, manam sanam sheexebodet` mat` [intimuri siaxlove ar gek`nebat` mat`t`an], mashin ar gak`vt` valdebuleba mat`i mimart` raime vadis [iddis] dac`vaze, romelsac` it`vlit` mat`t`vis. magram daasach`uk`red isini [gansac`delis shesamsubuk`eblad] da gaushvit` isini g'irseulad, ket`ilshobilurad [uborotod da sheurac`xqop`is gareshe].

hei shuamavalo, ch`ven nebadart`ul vqavit` shent`vis meug'leni,
romelt`at`visac` migic`ia mat`i sasqideli, isinic`, romlebic` moupovebia shens marjvenas imisagan, rac` allahs shent`vis alap`ad mouc`ia, aseve asulebi sheni mamis z'misa da asulebi sheni mamidisa, asulebi sheni dedis z'misa da asulebi sheni deidisa, romlebic` shent`an ert`ad hijrashi camovidnen, da nebismieri morcmune k`ali, t`uki sakut`ar t`avs shuamavals usach`uk`rebs da t`uki shuamavalic` moisurvebs, gamonaklisia shent`vis, sxva morcmunet`a garda. ch`ven vic`it`, rac` davakisret` mat` t`aviant`i c`olebis mimart` da imat` mimart`, vinc` mat` marjvenas moupovebia, rat`a ar igrz'no aravit`ari shevicroveba. da allahi mpatiebeli shemcqalebelia

shen [o, shuamavalo] shegiz'lia, sheni survilit` ganerido nebismier mat`gans da daitovo shent`an is, visac` inebeb. xolo t`u moisurveb imat`gan ert`-ert`s, vist`anac` adre gadade [g'amis stumroba], shent`vis c`odva ar ik`neba, es neba [romelsac` allahi gaz'levs] up`ro shesap`erisia, rat`a isini [sheni c`olebi] iqvnen mshvidni, ar cuxdnen da kmaqop`ilni darch`nen imit`, rasac` shen mat` qvelas anicheb [rogorc` anacileb mat`t`an qop`nas]. da allahma ic`is, ra aris t`k`vens gulebshi [rogor giqvart` da rogor up`ro metad miiltvit` zogiert`isken]. da allahi qovlismc`odnea da qovlismt`meni [ar ch`k`arobs dasjas]

ar aris nebadart`uli shent`vis [o, shuamavalo] amis shemdeg sxva k`alebis [c`olad] mig'eba [im c`xris garda, romlebmac` airch`ies allahi, misi moc`ik`uli da saik`io], da arc` mat`i sxva c`olebit` shec`vla [verc` ert`s ver gaant`avisup`leb, rom mis nac`vlad sxva moiqvano], t`undac` mat`ma silamazem mogxiblos. garda imat`isa, romelsac` sheni marjvena p`lobs [monebidan]. xolo allahi qovelives met`valqurea.

hei t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ise nu shexvalt` shuamavlis saxlshi is, t`u sachmelad ar xart` mipatizhebuli da t`u micveul ik`enit`, shedit`, roc`a chamas daasrulebt` mere daishalet`, nu darch`ebit` salaparakod, cheshmaritad amit` acuxebt` shuamavals, mas erideba t`k`veni, magram allahs ar erideba cheshmaritebis da roc`a rames st`xovt` mat` [cinascarmetqvelis c`olebs an morcmune k`alebs], st`xovet` mat` p`ardis mig'ma [es rac` t`k`vent`vis dadgenilia aris up`ro cminda, da up`ro shors aris satanis c`dunebebisgan]. es up`ro cmindaa rogorc` t`k`veni gulebisat`vis, aseve mat`i gulebisat`visac`. da ar shegp`erit` t`k`ven allahis moc`ik`ulis shecuxeba, arc` mis sic`oc`xleshi da arc` mis shemdeg, da aravit`ar shemt`xvevashi ar sheiz'leba dak`orcindet` mis c`olebze mis shemdeg [radgan isini t`k`veni dedebi arian]. cheshmaritad, es [moc`ik`ulis shecuxebaa mis c`olebze k`orcineba] aris udidesi c`odva allahis cinashe
gind gamoach`endet` rames, gind p`aravdet`, cheshmaritad, allahi qvelap`ris mc`odnea

ar aris c`odva mat`ze [shuamavalis c`olebze da morcmune k`alebze], t`u isini [sruliad dap`arulni ar ik`nebian] t`aviant` mamebis, vazhebis, z'mebis, z'mebis vazhebis, debis vazhebis, t`aviant`i k`alebis [morcmune k`alebis] da imat` cinashe, visac` mat`i marjvena p`lobs [monebisa da mxevlebis], radgan mat`gan daxmarebis sachiroeba arsebobs. xolo geshinodet` allahis [sasjelis] [o, k`alebo] [nu gadaabijebt` im sazg'vrebs, rac` man daacesa]. cheshmaritad, allahi qvelap`ris mocmea [igi xedavs t`avisi monebis qvela k`medebas da shesabamisad miugebs mat`]
cheshmaritad, allahi da misi angelozebi loc`aven shuamavals. hei t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`, daloc`et` igi da miesalmet` misalmebit`.

cheshmaritad, isini, romlebic` usiamovnebas aqeneben allahs [mravalg'mert`ianobit`a da masze urch`obit`] [ebraelebi, romlebmac` t`k`ves: allahis xeli shekrulia, k`ristianebi, romlebmac` t`k`ves, rom ieso allahis z'ea, mravalg'mert`ianebi, romlebmac` t`k`ves, rom angelozebi allahis k`alishvilebi arian] da mis moc`ik`uls [ miaqenes usiamovneba sitqvebit`a da sak`meebit`] [isini, romlebic` mas ucodebdnen jadok`ars, poets da sxvas], allahma dascqevla isini amk`veqnad da saik`io c`xovrebashi da mat`t`vis moamzada damamc`irebeli sasjeli [maradiuli qop`na jojoxet`shi]

xolo isini, romlebic` morcmune kac`ebs da morcmune k`alebs usamart`lod aqeneben usiamovnebas [bralad sdeben imas, rac` mat` ar ch`audeniat`], - aset`ebi sakut`ar t`avze itvirt`aven c`iliscamebis tvirt`s da ashkara c`odvas [da amis gamo maradiul c`xovrebashi sasjels miig'eben].

o, shuamavalo! ut`xari shens c`olebs, shens k`alishvilebs da morcmunet`a k`alebs, rom ch`amoip`aron t`aviant`i mosasxamebi [daip`aron ise, rom mxolod ert`i t`vali darch`es xiluli, rat`a dainaxon gza, roc`a sachiroebis gamo gamodian]. es uket`esia, rat`a isini sheic`non [rogorc` t`avisup`ali da g'vt`ismosavi k`alebi] da mat` ar miaqenon sheurac`xqop`a. xolo allahi mapatiebeli [mat`t`vis, vinc` mas sinanulit` mimart`avs] da shemcqalebelia [radgan igi ig'ebs mat` monaniebas]

t`u orpirebi, da isini, romelt`a gulebshi aris seni [echvi], aseve isini, vinc` avrc`eleben chorebs medinashi [morcmunet`at`vis zianis misaqeneblad], ar shecqveten amas, mashin ch`ven mogmart`avt` shen [o, moc`ik`ulo] mat` cinaag'mdeg da gicqalobebt` ch`vens mxardacheras. amis shemdeg isini shens gverdit` medinashi ic`xovreben mxolod c`ota xans.
dacqevlilni ik`nebian. sadac` ki mat` ipovian, ik`ve sheipqroben da sikvdilit` dasjilni ik`nebian [orpirobis gamo, da uket`urobis gavrc`elebis gamo],
es aris allahis kanoni imat` mimart`, vinc` manamde iqo[orpiri xalxi]. da verasodes ipovi allahis kanonshi c`vlilebas.
xalxi gekit`xeba shen ag'sasrulis saat`is shesaxeb. ut`xari [mat`]: misi c`odna mxolod allaht`anaa. da ram gamc`nos shen? shesaz'loa, ag'sasrulis saat`i axlos iqos
cheshmaritad, allahma dacqevla urcmunoni da mat`t`vis gaamzada jojoxet`is c`ec`xli
isini masshi maradiulad darch`ebian. da ver ipovian verc` mp`arvels da verc` shemces
im dg'es, roc`a mat`i saxeebi c`ec`xlshi shebrundeba, isini itqvian [sinanulit`]: netav davmorch`ilebodit` allahs da davmorch`ilebodit` moc`ik`uls [muhameds]
da itqvian [urcmunoni] [gankit`xvis dg'es]: up`alo ch`veno! ch`ven davemorch`ilet` ch`vens cinamz'g'olebs da didebulebs, da mat` gadagvaxvevines cheshmariti gzidan
up`alo ch`veno! miec` mat` ormagi sasjeli da dacqevle isini didi cqevlit`
o, morcmuneno! nu ik`nebit` msgavsni mat`, vinc` acuxebdnen musas, magram allahma gaamart`la igi imisgan, rasac` ambobdnen mis shesaxeb, da igi iqo g'irseuli allahis cinashe
hei t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! geshinodet` allahis da t`k`vit` qovel shemt`xvevashi scori sitqva [rac` sheesabameba cheshmaritebas].
[mashin] igi gamogiscorebt` t`k`vens sak`meebs da mogitevebt` t`k`vens c`odvebs, xolo vinc` damorch`ildeba allahs da mis moc`ik`uls, cheshmaritad, miag'cevs did carmatebas

cheshmaritad, ch`ven shevt`avazet` amanat`i [valdebuleba, ndobit` ag'ebuli pasuxismgebloba] c`as, micasa da mt`ebs, magram mat` uari t`k`ves mis tvirt`ad ag'ebaze da sheeshindat` amis, xolo adamianma itvirt`a igi. cheshmaritad, igi iqo usamart`lo da umec`ari.

rat`a allahma dasajos orpiri kac`ebi da orpiri k`alebi, kerpt`aqvanismc`emeli kac`ebi da kerpt`aqvanismc`emeli k`alebi, xolo miig'os allahma morcmune kac`ebisa da morcmune k`alebis monanieba. cheshmaritad, allahi mpatiebeli, shemcqalebelia
qoveli k`eba mxolod allahs ekut`vnis, romelsac` ekut`vnis qvelap`eri, rac` c`ashia da rac` micazea, mas ekut`vnis k`eba saik`ioshic`. da cheshmaritad, igi brz'eni da qovlismc`odnea
man ic`is qvelap`eri, rac` shedis micashi da rac` gamodis misgan, da rac` ch`amodis c`idan da rac` adis masshi. is shemcqalebeli, mpatiebelia

da t`k`ves mat` romelnic` gaxdnen urcmunoni: ar dadgeba ch`vent`vis ag'sasrulis saat`i, ut`xari [mat`] [o, shuamavalo]: ara! vp`ic`av ch`ems up`als, uxilavis mc`odnes igi auc`ileblad mogecevat`! misgan ar p`aravs [ar darch`eba sheumch`neveli] certilisodena mtvris cona c`ashi da micaze, da arc` up`ro mc`iredi, arc` up`ro didi, garda imisa, rac` c`xad cignshia daceril[anu qvelap`eri lavhul mahp`uzshia dacerili]
imisat`vis, rom daajildovos isini, romelt`ac` ircmunes da ket`ili sak`meebi moimok`medes. mat`t`vis aris miteveba da guluxvi sazrdo.

xolo isini, vinc` iscrap`odnen ch`veni sascaulebis [quranis aiat`ebis] cinaag'mdeg, c`dilobdnen mat`i dasustebas [adamiant`a gadaqvanas allahis sitqvidan], mat`t`vis momzadebulia sasjeli umtkivneules satanjvelshi.
da xedaven [ic`ian] isini, visac` c`odna miec`a, rom is, rac` gardmogevlina shen [o, muhammad] up`lisgan [qurani], aris cheshmariteba da [is] carmart`avs qovladz'lieris da qovlad k`ebulis gzisken.

da t`k`ves urcmunoebma [ert`manet`shi k`ilikit`]: migit`it`od t`u ara kac`ze [gulisxmobdnen shuamaval muhammads], romelic` gac`nobebt`, rom t`k`veni sikvdilis shemdeg, roc`a srulad daishlebit` da gaxdebit` mtveri, t`k`ven kvlav ag'moch`ndebit` axal k`mnilebashi [ag'dgebit`]?

nut`u man [gulisxmobdnen shuamavals] allahze moigona sic`rue, t`u mas sigizhe schirs?
ara! [ sulac` araa ise, rogorc` urcmunoni amboben, radgan muhammadi aris mart`alt`a shoris mart`ali] xolo isini, romelt`ac` ar scamt` maradiuli c`xovrebis, saik`ioshi ik`nebian sasjelshi, xolo [amk`veqnad] imqop`ebian shoreul gzaabneulobashi.

nut`u isini [romelt`ac` ar scamt` maradiuli sic`oc`xle] ar xedaven imas, rac` mat` cin aris da rac` mat` ukanaa, anu c`as [romelic` mat` shemoexvia] da micas [romelzec` c`xovroben] [imisat`vis, rom dap`ik`rdnen, raoden didia allahis z'ala]? t`u visurvebt`, da vubrz'anebt` micas, rom sht`ant`k`os isini [rogorc` gavaket`et` es qarunt`an], an ch`amovugzavnit` mat` c`idan natexs [rogorc` es moxda cinascarmetqvel shu'aibis xalxt`an]. cheshmaritad, amashi [shegonebaa] cheshmaritad sascaulia qoveli monist`vis, [romelic`] allahs mimart`avs monaniebit`

da ai, ch`ven ukve vuboz'et` [shuamaval]) dauds ch`vengan gansakut`rebuli siket`e [cinascarmetqveloba, cerili da c`odna] [da vut`xarit` ch`ven]: he, mt`ebo! adidet` t`k`veni up`ali mast`an ert`ad [daudt`an], da ch`itebo, t`k`venc` ganadidet`! da rkina gavurbilet` mas [ise, rom mis xelshi igi rbili gaxda, rogorc` c`omi]

gaaket`e [javshnebi] grz'eli [rat`a kargad p`aravdes mebrz'olis sxeuls] da ganusazg'vre zoma rgolebs [rom ar iqos z'alian t`xeli, rat`a javshani ver daic`vas sxeuls, da aseve rom ar iqos z'alian sk`eli, rat`a javshani zedmetad mz'ime ar gaxdes]. da aket`et` siket`e [allahis morch`ilebit`], radgan cheshmaritad me vxedav imas, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`

da suleimans [davumorch`ilet`] k`ari, dilit` casvla misi ert`i t`vis manz'ili iqo da sag'amos ukan mosvlac` ert`i t`ve iqo. da mist`vis spilenz'i cqarosavit` vadinet`. da jint`agan iqvnen iset`ebic`, vinc` shromobda mis t`valcin, t`avisi g'mert`is nebit`. xolo imas, vinc` gadauxvevs ch`vens brz'anebas, vagemebt` c`ec`xlis sasjels

isini [jinebi] aket`ebdnen mist`vis rac` ki is moesurveboda: nagebobebi [saloc`avebi da mag'ali sac`xovrebeli shenobebi], k`andakebebi, t`asebi t`it`k`os cqalsac`avebi [romlit`ac` amoak`vt` cqali chidan] da uzarmazari, uz'ravi k`vabebi. [ch`ven vut`xarit`]: asrulet` [allahisadmi morch`ilebis sak`meebi] daudis modgmav, madlierebis nishnad [t`k`veni up`lisadmi] [imist`vis, rac` man moganichat`]!magram ch`em monat`agan c`otani arian madlierni!

roc`a ch`ven mas [suleimans] sikvdili ganvusazg'vret`, mis sikvdilze mat` [jinebs] verap`erma mianishna, garda micis ert`i c`xovelisa[chia], romelic` mis kvert`xs xravda. da rodesac` is[suleimani] daec`a, mashin gairkva jinebist`vis, rom sc`odnodat` dap`aruli, ar darch`ebodnen damamc`irebel satanjvelshi

, sabaelebis mkvidrt`at`vis[iemenshi] mat`i sac`xovreblebi sascauli iqo: ori bag'i marjvniv da marc`xniv[saidanac` mat` uxvi shemosavali mohqavdat`]. chamet` t`k`veni g'mert`is sarch`o da emadlieret` mas. [es]kargi k`veqanaa[barak`it`a da xeirianobit` savse, sac`xovreblad kargi] da [es]shemndobi g'mert`ia

da zurgi ak`c`ies[ar ircmunes,da arc` madlierni iqvnen ] da ch`ven carvagzavnet` mat`ze cqaldidoba da shevuc`valet` mat` is ori [naqop`ieri da lamazi] bag'i or [sxva] bag'ad, romelt`ac` hk`ondat` mcare naqop`i, da lotosi [xe, romelsac` naqop`i ar ak`vs] da c`otaoden sidris xis mc`enarit`

amit` [am shec`vlit`] mivaget` ch`ven mat` [sabaielebs]
imis gamo, rom isini gaxdnen urcmunoni [da umadurni]!
nut`u vuzg'obt` ch`ven vinmes [ase], garda urcmunot`a [da umadurt`a]?

da movacqvet` ch`ven mat` shoris [sabas mc`xovrebt`a, iemenshi] da im dasaxlebebs shoris, romlebzec` movavlinet` ch`ven cqaloba [shamis dasaxlebebze], xiluli [sascauli] sop`lebi [ert`manet`t`an dakavshirebuli gzebit`] da ganvsazg'vret` mat`shi gza [ase movacqet`, rom ert`i dasaxlebidan meoremde sheiz'leboda misvla z'lieri dag'lilobis gareshe]: iaret` mat` shoris [im dasaxlebat`a] dg'e da g'ame [nebismier dros, roc`a inebebt`] [iqot`] usap`rt`xod [cqurvilisgan, shimshilisgan da mtrebisgan]

da t`k`ves mat` [sabaielebi] [rodesac` mobezrdat` ket`ildg'eobit` c`xovrebis ert`p`erovneba]: up`alo ch`veno! gazarde manz'ili ch`vens mogzaurobebs shoris [dasaxlebebs shoris]! da [amit`] usamart`loba miaqenes sakut`ar t`avs. da gavxadet` ch`ven isini igavebad [dasap`ik`rebel istoriebad] (imat`t`vis, vinc` mat` shemdeg ic`xovrebs) da davglijet` nacilebad [gavp`antet` micaze ise, rom ag'ar dabrundnen]. cheshmaritad, amashi [imashi, rac` sabaielebs sheemt`xvat`] uechvelad arsebobs sascaulebi qoveli mot`minebis mk`onist`vis [siz'neleebshi] [da] madlierist`vis [allahisadmi] [misi cqalobebisat`vis]

da ai, iblisma daamtkic`a [sadac` mart`ali ag'moch`nda] mat`shi [mat`i k`medebebit`] t`avisi varaudi [imis shesaxeb, rom igi shec`domashi sheiqvans adamis sht`amomavlobas da rom isini daemorch`ilebian mas], da isinc` gahqvnen mas [urcmunoebasa da shec`domashi], garda ert`i jgup`isa [ric`xvisa] morcmunet`agan [radgan isini mtkic`e iqvnen allahisadmi morch`ilebashi]

da ar hk`onda mas [ibliss] mat`ze [urcmunoebze] [aranairi] z'alaup`leba [rom z'alit` daez'alebina isini urcmunoebaze da allahis daumorch`ileblobaze]. [t`umc`a allahma uzenaesma, t`avisi sibrz'nit`, neba dart`o ibliss ch`aegdo adamianebshi urcmunoeba da c`odvebi] mxolod imisat`vis, rom gagvec`no [gagverch`ia] isini, visac` scams saik`iosi mat`gan, da vin echvobs masshi [rat`a axdes is, rac` allahma ic`oda ukve ukunisidan da rat`a sheitqon es misi k`mnilebebma]. da [t`umc`a] sheni g'mert`i [o, muhammad] qvelap`ris damc`velia[mat`i k`medebebis shesaxeb qvela inp`ormac`ia ik`neba shenaxuli]

ut`xari [o, moc`ik`ulo] [am mravalg'mert`ianebs]: mouxmet` mat`, viszedac` amtkic`ebt` [t`it`k`os isini g'irsni arian t`aqvanisc`emis], allahis garda! [dagexmaron imashi, rac` gchirdebat`]. isini [vinebic` g'mert`ebad airch`iet`] ar p`loben [t`undac`] mtvris conis simz'imes c`ashi da micaze, da ara ak`vt` mat` [am c`ru g'vt`aebebs] ik` [c`asa da micaze] [aranairi] cili, da ar hqavs mas[allahs] mat` shoris [t`k`vens kerpebs shoris] damxmare [allahs ar schirdeba aravis daxmareba].

da aravis [aravit`ari] shuamdgomloba ar gamoadgeba mis cinashe, garda imat`isa, visac` nebas dart`avs igi. (rodesac` allahi qovlisshemz'le t`avisi gamoc`xadebit` mimart`avs romelime cinascarmetqvels, amas ismenen angelozebi, romlebic` c`ashi arian, da ganic`dian mis cinashe sashinel shishs]. xolo roc`a shishi moexsnebat` mat` gulebs, isini [angelozebi] itqvian ert`manet`shi: ra t`k`va t`k`venma up`alma? amboben: [man t`k`va] cheshmariteba, da is aris uzenaesi da diadi

ut`xari [o, shuamavalo] [am mravalg'mert`ianebs]: vin gaz'levt` sazrdos zec`idan [roc`a gaz'levt` sinat`les da gardamogivlent` cvimas] da micidan [roc`a ag'moac`ens mc`enareebs da moacqo masshi sasargeblo sabadoebi]? [t`u isini ar itqvian, rom es allahia]? mashin ut`xari: allahi gaz'levt` sazrdos. da cheshmaritad, [ch`ven shoris ert`i mxare] ch`vent`agani, an t`k`vent`agani an vart` scor gzaze, an c`xad gzaabnevashia

ut`xari: t`k`ven [o, mravalg'mert`ianebo] ar gkit`xaven imaze, rac` ch`ven [morcmuneebma] shevc`odet` [ch`vens c`odvebze], da ch`ven ar gvekit`xebian imaze, rasac` t`k`ven ik`mt` [radgan ch`ven ggmobt` t`k`ven da t`k`vens urcmunoebas]

ut`xari: ch`ven shegvkrebs ch`veni up`ali [gansjis dg'es], shemdeg ki shegvap`asebs cheshmaritebit` [samart`lianad]. da igi aris samart`liani msajuli da qovlismc`odne[romelsac` arap`eri ar gamoepareba]!

ut`xari: <<mach`venet` isini, visac` uk`mnidit` mas t`anamonaciled [t`aqvanisc`emashi]! o, ara! [sak`me sul sxvagvaradaa, vidre t`k`ven ag'cert`.] igi allahi z'levamosili [shurisgebashi mat`dami, vinc` sheuk`mnis mas t`anamonaciles], da qovladbrz'eni [t`avis sitqvebshi da sak`meebshi]

ch`ven mogavlinet` shen [o, moc`ik`ulo muhammad] mxolod mt`eli kac`obriobist`vis, rogorc` maxarebeli [allahis jildos shesaxeb] da shemgonebeli [misi sasjelis shesaxeb]. magram adamiant`a umetesobam ar ic`is [simart`le] [da isini ishoreben mas].
da amboben isini [es mravalg'mert`ianebi] [dac`invit`]: rodis ik`neba es dapireba [imaze, rom allahi shegvkrebs], t`u mart`alt`agani xart`?

ut`xari mat` [o, moc`ik`ulo]: t`k`vent`vis dadgenilia ert`i dg'e [t`k`vent`vis aris dadgenili ert`i ag't`k`muli dg'e], romelsac` ver gadaavadebt` verc` ert`i saat`it` [rom moascrot` monanieba] da ver daach`k`arebt` mas [verc` ert`i saat`it`] [is ar dadgeba im vadamde, romelic` allahma gansazg'vra]

da t`k`ves romelnic` gaxvdnen urcmunoni: ch`ven ar vircmunebt` arc` am qurans da arc` imas, rac` misamde ik`na gardmovlenili. netavi dagenaxa [o, muhammad], roc`a usamart`loni [urcmunoni] dadgebian t`aviant`i up`lis cinashe, isini ert`manet`s miubrundebian sitqvit` da etqvian isini, vinc` dach`agrulni iqvnen, ampartavant`a: t`k`ven rom ar qop`iliqavit`, ch`ven morcmuneni vik`nebodit`
etqvian ampartavanni dach`agrult`: nut`u ch`ven gadagaxvevinet` t`k`ven scori gzidan mas shemdeg, rac` igi t`k`vent`an movida? ara, t`k`ven t`avad iqavit` c`odvilni [urcmunoni]!

da itqvian sustni [mimdevarni] ampartavant`a [t`avis cinamz'g'olt`a] mimart`: ara, pirik`it`! g'amisa da dg'is t`k`veni xriki [t`k`veni mudmivi boroti zraxva ch`vens cinaag'mdeg] [ramac` am dag'upvamde mogviqvana] iqo is, rom gvibrz'anebdit` allahis urcmunoebas da mist`vis t`anaziarni dagvedgina [t`aqvanisc`emasa da msaxurebashi] [mravalg'mert`ianoba gveket`ebina]! da gauvlit` mat` sinanuli, roc`a ixiles sasjeli [rac` mat`t`vis momzadebulia]. da davadet` ch`ven jachvebi[borkilebi] urcmunot`a kisrebze [mat`i urcmunoebis gamo]. nut`u miegebat` mat` rame sxva, garda imisa, rasac` t`avadve aket`ebdnen? [es sasjeli ar aris arap`eri, garda mat`i urcmunoebis samagierosi]

da [ar qop`ila ise, rom] ch`ven romelime dasaxlebashi movavlinot` shemgonebeli [moc`ik`uli, romelic` moucodebs allahis rcmenisa da msaxurebisken], rom misi [dasaxlebis] mdidrulad mc`xovrebi mosaxleni [ganebivrebulni siamovnebebsa da gart`obashi] ar et`k`vat`: cheshmaritad, ch`ven ar vircmunebt` imas, rit`ac` gamogzavnilxart`

da t`k`ves mat`: <<ch`ven up`ro mdidarni vart` [t`k`venze] k`onebit`a da shvilebit` [da allahma mogvc`a es qvelap`eri, radgan kmaqop`ilia ch`venit`]. da ch`ven ar davisjebit` [arc` amk`veqnad da arc` maradiul c`xovrebashi]

ut`xari mat` [o, moc`ik`ulo]: cheshmaritad, ch`emi up`ali ganavrc`obs [zrdis] sazrdos, visac` inebebs [t`avis monat`a shoris] [gamosc`dis, madlieria t`u ara igi allahisadmi], da usazg'vravs [sazrdos] visac` inebebs [isev gamosac`delad, moit`mens t`u ara igi], [da es ar aris arc` siqvarulis da arc` siz'ulvilis gamo romelimes mimart`], magram adamiant`a umetesobam es ar ic`is

da arc` t`k`veni k`oneba, da arc` t`k`veni shvilebi ar dagaaxloebt` ch`vent`an [allaht`an] garda mat`isa, vinc` ircmuna da aket`ebda ket`il sak`meebs. scored mat` ek`nebat` ormagi jildo imaze, rac` mat` gaaket`es, da isini ik`nebian [samot`xis] ot`axebshi usap`rt`xod.

xolo isini, vinc` iscrap`vian ch`veni sascaulebis [quranis aiat`ebis]dasamarc`xeblad [c`diloben rom adamianebi allahis sitqvebidan gadaiqvanon], isini [aset`ni] ik`nebian [angelozt`a mier] jojoxet`shi cardgenilni

ut`xari: <<cheshmaritad, ch`emi up`ali ganavrc`obs sazrdos, viszec` inebebs t`avis monat`agan, da ganusazg'vravs mas, da rasac` ar unda daxarjot` [allahis gzaze], is shegivsebt` mas. da igi aris sauket`eso momc`emi sazrdosi

im dg'es, rodesac` is [allahi] shekrebs mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] qvelas [sasamart`lo dg'es], shemdeg ki etqvis angelozebs [saqvedurit` imat` mimart`, vinc` mat` t`aqvans sc`emda]: nut`u eseni [mravalg'mert`ianebi] t`k`ven [angelozebs] get`aqvanebodnen?

itqvian [angelozebi]: k`eba shen, [o, allah]! [aravin aris t`anascori sheni]. shen [o, allah] xar ch`veni mp`arveli [vinc` mp`arvelobas gvaz'levs, visac` vemorch`ilebit` da vet`aqvanebit`] [vgmobt` am mravalg'mert`ianebs]! aramed isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] jinebs et`aqvanebodnen, mat`i umravlesoba morcmuneni iqvnen mat`i [jinebis]

da dg'es [sasamart`lo dg'es] t`k`vengan veravin p`lobs sxvebist`vis sargebelsa da zians. da vetqvit` ch`ven romelnic` usamart`lobas ch`adiodnen: igemet` c`ec`xlis sasjeli, romelsac` t`k`ven uarqop`dit` [sic`rued miich`nevdit`]

da roc`a ekit`xebat` ch`veni c`xadi aiat`ebi, isini amboben: es aris mxolod kac`i, romelsac` surs mogashorot` imisgan, rasac` et`aqvanebodnen t`k`veni mamebi da amboben: arap`eria es t`u ara gamogonili sic`rue. da t`k`ves imat`, romelnic` gaxdnen urcmunoni, cheshmaritebaze [allahis cignze], roc`a is mivida mat`t`an: es mxolod c`xadi jadok`robaa

da ar mivec`it` ch`ven mat` [am urcmuno arabebs] aravit`ari cigni [quranamde], romelsac` sheiscavlidnen, da ar movavlinet` mat`t`an shenamde [o, moc`ik`ulo] shemgonebeli [romelic` gaap`rt`xilebda mat` ch`veni sasjelis z'alas]

c`rud sherac`xes igi imat`ac`, vinc` iqvnen mat`ze ucin, t`umc`a meat`edic` ar gviboz'ebia mat`t`vis[sheni eris mravalg'mert`ianebist`vis] imisa, rac` imat`[ucindel urcmuno erebs] vuboz'et`. c`rud sherac`xes[ucindelebma] ch`emi shuamavlebi [roc`a mat` simart`le moutanes]. [da me davsaje isini, ukve amk`veqnadve gavanadgure] mash rogori iqo ch`emi mrisxaneba

ut`xari [o, moc`ik`ulo] [am urcmunoebs]: me mxolod ert`s shegagonebt`: rom carsdget` allahis cinashe [gaip`ik`rot` simart`lis z'iebashi] or-ori an t`it`o-t`it`od, mere dap`ik`rdet` [allahis moc`ik`ulze] [ag'moach`ent`, rom] t`k`veni megobari [muhammadi] ar aris sheshlili. cheshmaritad, is [muhammadi] mxolod shemgonebelia t`k`vent`vis sashineli sasjelis cin.

ut`xari [o, shuamavalo] [urcmunoebs]: rac` me mogt`xovt` jildod, is t`k`venive sasargeblod aris [me t`k`vengan arap`ers vit`xov imist`vis, rom simart`le gamc`net`, aramed mxolod is, rom miig'ot` igi da mihqvet` mas]. xolo ch`emi jildo mxolod allaht`an aris, radgan is aris mocme qvelap`risa [xedavs da ic`is qvelap`eri]

ut`xari [o, shuamavalo] [mat`, vinc` uarqop`s ert`g'mert`obasa da islams]: cheshmaritad, ch`emi up`ali amarc`xebs [gamoashkaravebs da anadgurebs] [siqalbes] simart`lit` [t`avisgan motanili mtkic`ebulebebit`], da is aris mc`odne p`arulis [qvela saidumlos]
ut`xari [o, shuamavalo]: movida cheshmariteba [allahisgan] [ert`g'mert`ianoba da islami], [xolo sic`ruis gavlena gak`ra] da sic`rue ag'arap`ers carmoch`ens da ag'ar dabrundeba

ut`xari [o, moc`ik`ulo]: t`u me avc`debi scor gzas, ch`emsave sacinaag'mdegod avc`debi [sakut`ari t`avis sazianod], xolo t`u scor gzaze var, es ch`emi up`lis sht`agonebit`aa, cheshmaritad, is aris msmeneli[ t`avisi monebis sitqvebisa] da axlos mqop`i [imast`an, vinc` mouxmobs mas vedrebit`]

netav dagenaxa [o, moc`ik`ulo], rogor sheshindebian isini [urcmunoni], [rodesac` allahis sasjels ixilaven], roc`a ag'ar ik`neba gak`c`evis [gadarch`enis] shesaz'lebloba, da roc`a isini ik`nebian shepqrobilni [sasjelisat`vis] axlo adgilidan [allahisgan veravin t`avs ver daig'cevs].

isini [urcmunoni] [rodesac` maradiul c`xovrebashi ixilaven sasjels] itqvian: vircmunet` igi [allahi]! magram rogor miag'ceven [rcmenas] shoreuli adgilidan [aset` mdgomareobashi]? [rogor unda gaxdnen morcmuneni maradiul c`xovrebashi, roc`a ukve am k`veqniuri c`xovrebisgan shors ik`nebian?!]

xolo isini ukve urcmunoebi iqvnen misi [imashi, rac` mxolod axla ircmunes] manamdec` sakut`ar varaudebs gamot`k`vamdnen [ambobdnen shuamavalze rac` mas ar ekadreboda, da aseve ambobdnen, rom ar aris ag'dgoma, shekreba, samot`xe da jojoxet`i] shoreuli adgilidan [sul sxva mxridan, qovelgvari sap`uz'vlis gareshe am mc`dari varaudebist`vis].

da barieri ik`neba mat`sa da mat` survilebs shoris [urcmunot`a da imast`an, rasac` isini isurvebdnen;ar c`xovrebiseuli siamovneba, da arc` jojoxet`is tanjvisgan daag'ceven t`avs] rogorc` es gaket`da [allahis mier mat` cinamorbed jgup`ebt`an [cina t`aobat`a urcmunoebt`an]. cheshmaritad, isini imqop`ebodnen [roc`a dedamicaze iqvnen] mtanjvel da damabnevel echvshi [allahis moc`ik`ulebis, ag'dgomis, angarishisa da sazg'auris mimart`]

qvela k`eba ekut`vnis allahs, c`at`a da micis shemok`meds, romelmac` angelozebi shek`mna shuamavlebad [shuamavlebad misa da moc`ik`ult`a shoris], romlebic` p`loben or, sam da ot`x p`rt`as. is matebs k`mnilebashi imas, rasac` isurvebs. cheshmaritad, allahs qoveli sak`me z'aluz's [is qovlis shemz'lea ].

rasac` allahi gauxsnis adamianebs t`avisi cqalobidan [misc`ems sazrdos, cvimas, janmrt`elobas, c`odnas...] -- mist`vis ar ik`neba shemakavebeli [verc` ert`i ver sheushlis xels], xolo rasac` [t`avisi cqalobidan] sheakavebs, -- mis shemdeg aravin ik`neba momnichebeli [aravin misc`ems imas, rac` ar misc`a allahma]. igi qovlad dedebulia qovlad brz'enia [is, vinc` uxvad anichebs an akavebs t`avis cqalobas mxolod t`avisi sibrz'nis mixedvit`]

hei, adamianebo! gaixsenet` allahis cqaloba t`k`venze! [gadauxadet` madloba mas qoveli siket`isat`vis, rac` t`k`vent`vis moamzada!] aris ki sxva shemok`medi allahis garda, romelic` moganichebdat` sazrdos c`idan [cvimis movlinebit`] da micidan [cqaroebis, mc`enaret`a da micis naqop`is boz'ebit`]? araa sxva g'mert`i [g'mert`i, romelic` g'irsia t`aqvanisc`emis], garda misi! mash sait` miemart`ebit`?![misi rogorc` ert`adert`i g'mert`is ag'iarebisa da t`aqvanisc`emisagan]

da t`u isini [sheni xalxi] uargqop`en [o, moc`ik`ulo] [ar ag'iareben, rom shen allahis mier xar gagzavnili], mashin [gamoich`ine mot`mineba, radganac`] uarqop`ili ik`nen [aseve] shuamavlebi shenamde, da [mxolod] allahs ubrundeba [qvela] sak`me [romlebic` ukavshirdeba rogorc` am samqaros, aseve samudamo c`xovrebas]

hei, adamianebo! cheshmaritad, allahis dapireba [ag'dgomis, sasjelisa da sazg'auris shesaxeb samudamo c`xovrebashi] cheshmaritebaa. mash, ar mogatquot` amk`veqniur c`xovrebam [nu migizidebt` am c`xovrebis mac`duri siket`eebi], da nu mogatquebt` allahis shesaxeb mac`dunebeli [satana]

cheshmaritad, shaitani [satana t`k`vent`vis [hei, adamianebo] aris mteri, [amitom] is mtrad miich`niet`! is uxmobs t`avis partias [mis mimdevrebs] mxolod imist`vis, rom gaxdnen isini c`ec`xlis [jojoxet`is] binadarni

vinc` urcmuno gaxda, mat`t`visaa mkac`ri sasjeli [maradiul c`xovrebashi] xolo isini, vinc` ircmunes da ket`il sak`meebs ch`adiodnen [aket`ebdnen mxolod allahis gulist`vis imas, rac` ubrz'ana allahma t`vit`on an t`avisi shuamavlis mier],... mat`t`visaa miteveba [mat`i c`odvebist`vis] da didi jildo [samot`xe].

nut`u is, visi boroti sak`me [urcmunoeba, mravalg'mert`ianoba da sxva c`odvebi] satanam lamazad moach`vena da manac` is mshvenierad dainaxa, [msgavsia imisa, visac` allahma misc`a rcmena da mianicha mart`ali gza, da is kargs xedavs kargad, xolo c`uds c`udad]? cheshmaritad, allahi ubnevs gzas imas, visac` isurvebs [tovebs mas daxmarebis gareshe], da gzas uch`venebs imas, visac` isurvebs. mash, nu gaavseb shens suls dardit` mat` gamo [urcmunot`a gamo] [mat`i urcmunoebis gamo]. cheshmaritad, allahma ic`is, rasac` isini aket`eben [da sazg'aurs miagebs amisat`vis]

da allahia is, vinc` agzavnis k`arebs, [romlebic`] shemdeg aceven [amoz'raveben] g'rublebs, shemdeg ki ch`ven mivagdebt` mat` [g'rublebs] mkvdar [gvalvian] adgilebze da vac`oc`xlebt` amit` [cvimis cqlit`] micas [gaxmobil mc`enareebs] misi sikvdilis shemdeg. scored ase [am gac`oc`xlebis msgavsad] moxdeba ag'dgoma [mic`valebult`a] [ag'dgomis dg'es]

vinc` isurvebs didebas [rogorc` amk`veqnad, aseve samudamo c`xovrebashi], [nu it`xovt` mas sxvagan, aramed] allahs st`xovos, radgan allahs ekut`vnis qoveli didebuleba [da is miig'eba mxolod misadmi morch`ilebit`] [xolo vinc` didebulebas k`mnilebebshi ez'ebs, allahi mas daamc`irebs]. misken adis ket`ili sitqva [ert`g'mert`obis mocmobis sitqva, allahis xseneba da misi cignis kit`xva, quranis], xolo ket`ili sak`me [savaldebulo da nebaqop`lobit`i sak`meebis shesruleba] mas [allahi] zevit` scevs. xolo isini, vinc` borot sak`meebs xrikebit` sch`adian [c`ud sak`meebs ch`adian], mat`t`visaa mtanjveli sasjeli, da aset`t`a mzakvroba gancirulia

da allahma shegk`mnat` t`k`ven [hei, adamianebo] [t`k`veni cinapari adami] micisgan, shemdeg [daacesa, rom misi sht`amomavloba gamravlebuliqo] cvet`idan [naqop`ieri sit`xidan], shemdeg ki gagxadat` cqvilebad [kac`ebad da k`alebad]. da ver daorsuldeba k`ali da ver shobs, t`u ara
misi c`odnit`. da arc` ert`i arsebis sic`oc`xlis xangrz'livoba, da arc` xanmokleoba, ar aris cignshi dacervis gareshe [mast`an] [dac`ul dap`ashi]. cheshmaritad, es allahist`vis advilia. [advilia t`k`veni shek`mna, c`odna t`k`vens shesaxeb, da qvelap`eri ch`acerilia dac`ul dap`ashi jer kidev samqaros shek`mnamde]

da ver gautoldebian ori zg'va: es sasiamovno, tkbili, sasmelad vargisi, xolo es mariliani, mcare [sasmelad uvargisi]. da t`it`oeulidan [zg'vidan ikvebebit` t`k`ven axali xorc`it` [t`evzit`] da gamoak`vt` samkaulebi [margaliti, marjani], romlebsac` atarebt`. da xedav shen gemebs masshi, rogor c`uraven [zg'vis zedapirze], rat`a miig'ot` [sakut`ari] sazrdo misi cqalobidan [allahis zg'vis nobat`is mopovebit` da vachrobit`], da ik`neb iqot` madlierni [uzenaesi allahisadmi] [misi udidesi cqalobebisat`vis, romlebic` t`k`venze moavlina]

igia [allahi] mas shehqavs g'ame dg'eshi, da shehqavs dg'e g'ameshi. daimorch`ila mze da mt`vare da t`it`oeuli dac`uravs dat`k`mul dromde. es aris allahi, t`k`veni g'mert`i [ert`adert`i]. mas ekut`vnis [qoveli] z'alaup`leba [qvelap`erze] [qvelap`eri mxolod mas ekut`vnis, is sruliad ganagebs qvelap`ers da qvelap`eri xdeba mxolod misi c`odnit`a da nebart`vit`], xolo isini [vinc` arian kerpebi da gamogonili g'mert`ebi], romelsac` uxmoben mis garda [allahis garda], ver p`loben t`undac` xurmis kurkis nachuchs[kurkis garshemo apka]

t`u t`k`ven mouxmobt` mat` [kerpebsa da gamogonil g'vt`aebebs], isini ver ismenen t`k`vens moxmobas, da t`undac` gaegonat`, ar gipasuxebdnen t`k`ven, xolo ag'dgomis dg'es isini [visac` et`aqvanebodit` allahis garda] uarqop`en t`k`vens mravalg'mert`ianobas. da veravin gamc`bonbs shen [o, moc`ik`ulo], rogorc` qovlismc`odne [allahi].
hei, adamianebo! t`k`ven allahze xart` damokidebulni, xolo allahi mdidari [is aravis da arap`ers ar sachiroebs], qovladk`ebulia
t`u is isurvebs, gaganadgurebt` t`k`ven [hei, adamianebo] da moiqvans axal k`mnilebas [sxvebs, romlebic` srulad daemorch`ilebian mas].
da es [t`k`veni ganadgureba da sxvat`a moqvana] allahist`vis araa didi [araa z'neli].

arc`ert`i mtvirt`veli ar itvirt`avs sxvat`a tvirt`s [aravis daekisreba sxvisi c`odva] da, t`u mouxmobs damz'imebuli misi[tvirt`is,c`odvis] cag'ebist`vis, arap`eri ar ik`neba cag'ebuli misgan, t`undac` iqos misi axlobeli. shen mxolod sheagoneb imat`, romelt`ac` eshiniat` t`aviant`i g'mert`isa p`arulad, da dgebian loc`vad. vinc` ganicmindeba, sakut`ari t`avist`vis ganicmindeba da allaht`anaa dabruneba
da ver gautoldeba brmas [urcmunos, romelic` ver xedavs da ver sheic`nobs cheshmaritebas] mxedveli [morcmune, romelic` mihqveba cheshmaritebis gzas].
da [ver gautoldeba] bnelet`i [urcmunoebis] da nat`eli [cheshmariti rcmenisa].
da [ver gautoldeba] ch`rdili [sigrile] [romelic` ik`neba sazg'auri rcmenist`vis] da c`xeli sic`xe [romelic` ik`neba sazg'auri urcmunoebisa da c`odvebisat`vis].

da ver gautoldebian c`oc`xalni [visi gulebic` c`oc`xalia rcmenit`] da mkvdarni [vis sulebshic` urcmunoebaa]. cheshmaritad, allahi sheasmens [misc`ems gagebasa da cheshmaritebis mig'ebas] imas, visac` isurvebs, xolo shen [o, shuamavalo] ver aiz'uleb gaigonon mat`, vinc` sap`lavebshia [ver shez'leb urcmunoebs gaagebino cheshmariteba, iseve rogorc` ver aiz'uleb gaigonon mat`, vinc` sap`lavebshi imqop`ebian].
radgan shen [o, muhammad] mxolod shemgonebeli xar [is, vinc` allahis sasjels axsenebs da ap`rt`xilebs].

cheshmaritad, ch`ven gaggzavnet` shen [o, muhammad] cheshmaritebit` [rcmenit` da allahis kanonit`] rogorc` maxarebeli [romelic` gaaxarebs morcmuneebs samot`xit`] da gamap`rt`xilebeli [romelic` gaap`rt`xilebs urcmunoebsa da c`odvilebs allahis sasjelis shesaxeb]. da ar qop`ila arc`ert`i eri, romelt`anac` ar mosuliqo [gamap`rt`xilebeli] shemgonebeli [cinascarmetqvelt`agan].

t`u isini [es mravalg'mert`ianebi] uargqop`en shen [o, moc`ik`ulo muhammad] [ar ag'iareben, rom shen allahis mier xar gagzavnili], mashin [gamoich`ine mot`mineba, radganac`] isini, vinc` iqvnen mat`amde, [aseve] uarqves mat`t`an gagzavnili shuamavalni, mat`t`an modiodnen mat`i shumavlebi c`xadi argumentebit` [sascaulebit`, romlebic` mianishnebdnen imaze, rom isini namdvilad iqvnen cinascarmetqvelni], da cignebit` [rjulis gragnilebit`], da manat`obeli cignit` [rogoric`aa t`ora, p`salmuni da saxareba].
shemdeg me shemovipqari isini, romelnic` urcmunoni iqvnen [mivage sxvadasxva saxis sasjeli]. da rogori iqo ch`emi risxva [rom mat` t`avs daatqda damg'upveli sasjeli]

nut`u ar dainaxe, rogor gardmoavlina allahma c`idan [g'rublebidan] cqali [cvima], romlis meshveobit`ac` ch`ven gamoviqvanet` sxvadasxva p`eris naqop`ebi. da mt`ebshi aris bilikebi t`et`ri, cit`eli sxvadasxvap`eris, da z'alian shavi.

adamiant`a, c`xovelt`a da pirutqvt`aganac` arian sxvadasxvap`eris mis[zemot` xsenebulis] msgavsad. allahisa eshinia misi monebidan mxolod scavlult` [vinc` ic`noben mas, mis saxelebsa da t`visebebs, mis rjuls]. cheshmaritad, allahi didebuli, mimtevebelia!

cheshmaritad, isini, vinc` kit`xuloben allahis cigns [qurans] [da mis mixedvit` mok`medeben], da [droulad da cesisamebr] asruleben [savaldebulo] loc`vas, da xarjaven [sakut`ar k`onebas] [rogorc` savaldebulo, ise nebaqop`lobit`i siket`it` daxmarebis saxit`] imidan, rac` ch`ven mivanichet` mat`, p`arulad [adamiant`agan malulad] da ashkarad, imedovneben vachrobas, romelic` ar daikargeba [amit` isini allahis kmaqop`ilebas escrap`vian].

imist`vis, rom man srulad mianichos mat` mat`i sazg'auri, da daumatos mat` t`avisi cqalobidan. cheshmaritad, is aris mimtevebeli [vinc` miubrundeba mas monaniebit`] da madlieri [mat`i mart`al sak`met`a gamo]

xolo, rac` ch`ven sht`agagonet` shen [o, moc`ik`ulo] cignidan [quranidan], es aris cheshmariteba, romelic` adasturebs imas rac` [ik`na gardmovlenili] mis cinat` [cina cignebshi, romlebic` allahma gaugzavna cinascarmetqvelebs shenamde]. cheshmaritad, allahi t`avis morch`ilt`a shesaxeb uechvelad aris qovlismc`odne da mxedveli

shemdeg ch`ven vuanderz'et` cerili memkvidreobit` ch`vens morch`ilt`agan mat`, vinc` amovirch`iet` [qurani vuboz'et` moc`ik`uli muhammadis ummas]. mat` shoris arian isini, vinc` sakut`ar t`avs usamart`lobas uket`eben [c`odvebs sch`adian], da mat` shoris arian zomierni [asruleben savaldebulos da t`avs ikaveben akrz'alulisagan], da mat` shoris arian cinmscrebi [sxvebze] ket`il sak`meebshi allahis nebart`vit`. is [cignis minicheba da am rch`eul ummast`vis] aris didi cqaloba!
isini shevlen samot`xis bag'ebshi, sadac` sheimkobian ok`ros samajurebit` da margalitit`, da mat`i samosi ik` ik`neba abreshumis
da isini itqvian [roc`a shevlen samot`xeshi]: k`eba allahs, romelmac` mogvashora sevda! cheshmaritad, ch`veni up`ali mimtevebeli da madlieria
romelmac` dagvamkvidra samudamo samqop`elshi t`avisi cqalobit`, sadac` ar shegvexeba dag'liloba, da sadac` ar shegvexeba garja.

xolo isini, vinc` urcmunoni gaxdnen, mat`t`vis [momzadebulia] geenis c`ec`xli [jojoxet`i]. ar ik`neba mat`ze dadgenili, rom mokvdnen [ik` isini arasodes mokvdebian], magram arc` es sasjeli sheemsubuk`debat`. ase mivuzg'avt` qovel urcmunos.

da isini [urcmunoni] xmamag'la qvirian [shvelas it`xoven]masshi [jojoxet`shi]: o, up`alo ch`veno! gamogviqvane [jojoxet`idan], ch`ven gavaketebt` siket`es [savsebit`] sxva imas, rasac` vaket`ebdit` [ch`vens c`xovrebashi] [vik`nebit` morcmuneni da ket`il sak`met` damsak`mebelni]! [da allahi uzenaesi etqvis mat`]: nut`u ch`ven ar mogec`it` sic`oc`xle, rom gagxsenebodat` [mieg'o darigeba] mas, visac` sheez'lo gaxseneba [darigebis mig'eba]? da movida t`k`vent`an shemgonebeli [cinascarmetqveli]. igemet` [jojoxet`is sasjeli], radganac` usamart`lot`at`vis ar aris aravit`ari damxmare (romelic` ixsnis mat` allahis sasjelisagan)!
cheshmaritad, allahia mc`odne [qoveli] dap`arulisa c`at`a da micisa. cheshmaritad, man ucqis, rac` gulebshia [misi k`mnilebat`a].

igia [allahi], romelmac` shegk`mnat` t`k`ven [he, adamianebo] memkvidrebad [t`aobebad, romlebic` ert`manet`s c`vlian] micaze. xolo vinc` gaxdeba urcmuno t`avis cinaag'mdeg ik`neba misi urcmunoeba. da ar moutans urcmunot`a urcmunoeba mat` up`lis cinashe arap`ers, garda siz'ulvilisa [allahis risxvisa]. da ar moutans urcmunot`a urcmunoeba arap`ers, garda zaralisa [dakargvisa, dag'upvisa].

ut`xari [o, moc`ik`ulo] [mravalg'mert`ianebs]: ip`ik`ret` t`k`vens t`anamoziarebze [mc`dar g'vt`aebebze], romlebsac` evedrebit` allahis garda? mach`venet`, micis romeli nacilic` mat` [g'mert`ebma] shek`mnes? an ak`vt` ki mat` [t`k`vens g'vt`aebebs] cili c`at`a shek`mnashi? t`u ki ch`ven mivanichet` mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] [raime] cigni [sadac` nebadart`uli ik`neboda mravalg'mert`ianoba], da isini daeqrdnobian misgan c`xad sascauls [mtkic`ebulebas] [misi nebadart`uliobis shesaxeb]? ara! [es ase ar aris!] mxolod mac`durobas hpirdebian borotmok`medni [urcmunoni] ert`manet`s

cheshmaritad, allahi akavebs c`at`a da micas, rat`a isini ar gauch`inardnen. xolo t`u isini daicqebdnen gauch`inarebas, veravin sheakavebda mat` mis shemdeg. cheshmaritad, is shemcqnarebelia [agvianebs sasjels urcmunoebisa da urch`t`at`vis], mimtevebelia [mat`t`vis, vinc` inaniebs t`avis c`odvebs].

da isini [urcmuno quraishelebi] allahit` ip`ic`ebodnen t`aviant`i udidesi p`ic`it`, rom t`u movidoda mat`t`an shemgonebeli [moc`ik`uli allahisgan], auc`ileblad gaxdebodnen isini scor gzaze mavalni [cheshmaritebis miqolni da allahisadmi morch`ilebashi], vidre nebismieri [cina] eri. magram mas shemdeg, rac` movida mat`t`an shemgonebeli [moc`ik`uli muhammadi], aman mxolod kidev up`ro gazarda mat`shi dashoreba [cheshmaritebisgan]

[da isini ip`ic`ebodnen mxolod] k`edmag'lobit` micaze [adamiant`a cinashe] da boroti xrikebit`. magram boroti xriki moexveva mxolod mis mk`nelt`. nut`u isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] elian [am qvela xrikis ch`adenit`] raime sxva beds, garda cina t`aobat`a bedi [cina t`emebisa], [romlebic` mat`savit` iqvnen urcmunoebashi]? da verasodes ipovi shen allahis gzashi c`vlilebas [aravis z'aluz's shec`valos is, rac` allahma daadgina]! da arasodes ipovi shen allahis gzashi gadaxras [aravis z'aluz's gadaxaros allahis sasjeli arc` sakut`ari t`avisgan, arc` sxvisgan].

nut`u isini [urcmuno mek`k`elni da sxvani] ar mogzaurobdnen micaze [nut`u ar iqvnen iemenshi da shamshi] da [nut`u] ar dainaxes, rogori iqo dasasruli im [xalxisa, romlebic` ar daemorch`ilnen allahs], romlebic` mat`amde iqvnen [ra sheemt`xvat` adielebs, samudianebs da mat` msgavsebs]? xolo isini [adielebi da samudianelebi] z'lierebi iqvnen mat`ze [mek`k`elebze] [sxeulis] z'alit`. magram allahi ar aris iset`i, rom ramem daasustos igi, arc` c`at`a da arc` micasa zeda. [vinaidan] cheshmaritad, is [allahi] aris qovlismc`odne [mat`i qvela sak`mis shesaxeb] da qovlisshemz'le [imisat`vis, rom mouvlinos mat` damg'upveli sasjeli].

da t`u allahi dasjida adamianebs imist`vis, rac` mat` daimsaxures [im c`odvebist`vis, romlebsac` sch`adian] [mxolod amk`veqnad], mashin ar datovebda mis zedapirze [dedamicaze] arc` ert` c`oc`xal arsebas. magram is az'levs mat` vadas gansazg'vrul dromde [rogorc` amk`veqnad, aseve samsjavros dg'emde]. xolo roc`a dadgeba mat`i dro, cheshmaritad, allahi xedavs t`avis monebs [da miuzg'avs mat` imisat`vis, rasac` sch`adiodnen]
ia siin
[me, allahi] vp`ic`av brz'en k`urans.
rom shen [o, muhammed], uechvelad, xar moc`ik`ult`agani [visac` allahma gaugzavna t`avisi zesht`agoneba mis morch`ilt`agan].
scor gzaze [zustad iset`ze, rogorsac` misdevdnen cinascarmetqvelni shenamde].
zemovlinebulia z'levamosili, shemcqaleblisa.
rat`a sheagono xalxs, romelt`a mamebic` ar shegonebulan, ramet`u isini iqvnen ugulisxmoni

da me [allahi] vp`ic`av, rom ukve shesrulda [dadasturda] sitqva [sasjelis dapireba] mat` umravlesobaze [vinc` mt`eli c`xovreba urcmunoebashi ic`xovra da urcmunodve mokvda], ise, rom isini ar ircmuneben
cheshmaritad, ch`ven davadet` mat` [urcmunot`a] kisrebze borkilebi, da isini [es borkilebi] [mat` xelebs] ]qbebamde ucheren, da isini iz'ulebulni arian zevit` ascion t`avebi [da verap`ers xedaven].

da ch`ven davadginet` mat` [urcmunot`a] cin barieri da mat` ukan barieri [ise, rom ver gamodian urcmunoebidan rcmenisken], da davp`aret` isini, da [amitom] ver xedaven [t`avis urcmunoebis da k`edmag'lobis gamo].
da mat`t`vis ert`ia, sheagoneb t`u ara isini ar ircmuneben. [t`u allahi daushvebs adamianis shec`domashi ch`avardnas, mist`vis uvargisi ik`neba qoveli shegoneba da darigeba]

shen [o, muhammed] sheagoneb mxolod mat`, vinc` mihqva shexsenebas [qurans] da p`arulad shishobs mocqales [rodesac` aravinaa, garda allahisa, da mas ar xedavs adamiani, mas mainc` allahis ridi ak`vs]. mash, axare mas mitevebit` [allahisgan misi c`odvebisa] da uxvi sazg'aurit` [samot`xeshi shesvlit`].

cheshmaritad, ch`ven ag'vadgent` [qvela] mic`valebuls [ag'dgomis dg'es] da vcert` imas, rac` mat` [adamianebma] cinascar moimzades [rasac` ch`aidendnen], da mat` kvals [ket`il sak`meebsa t`u borot sak`meebs, romlebic` adamianist`vis icereba mis sikvdilis shemdegac`], da qoveli ch`ven ag'vnusxet` c`xad gzamkvlevshi [dac`ul dap`ashi].
mouqvane mat` [vinc` uarqop`s shens mocodebas] magalit`i sop`lis mc`xovrebzed [rat`a amit` darigeba miig'on]: roc`a mividnen mat`t`an moc`ik`ulni

aha, [jer] ch`ven gavugzavnet` mat` orni [shemgoneblebi] [romlebic` moucodebdnen mat` ert`g'mert`obisaken, uqvebodnen samsjavros dg'eze da samudamo c`xovrebaze], da mat` [im sop`lis binadrebma] uarqves isini [orive moc`ik`uli] da ch`ven gavamtkic`et` [gavamagret`] [is orni] [kidev] mesamit` [moc`ik`ulit`], da mat` [samivem ert`ad] ut`xres [sop`lis binadart`]: cheshmaritad, ch`ven t`k`vent`an gamogzavnilni vart`
[sop`lis binadrebma] t`k`ves: t`k`ven mxolod adamianebi xart`, ch`vensavit`. da arap`eric` ar gardmouvlenia mocqales [allahs]. t`k`ven mxolod tquils laparakobt`!
[moc`ik`ulebma] t`k`ves: ch`venma up`alma [romelmac` gamoggvgzavna] ic`is, rom ch`ven t`k`vent`an uechvelad gamogzavnilni vart`.
da ch`venze [allahma daakisra movaleoba] mxolod [mogacodot`] nat`eli [gasagebi] ucqeba.
