[sop`lis binadarni] t`k`ves: cheshmaritad, ch`ven davinaxet` t`k`venshi c`udi nishani [boroti cinat`grz'noba]! t`u ar sheikavebt` t`avs [t`k`veni mocodebisgan] [ar datovebt` t`k`vens mocodebas], mashin ch`ven auc`ileblad ch`agk`olavt` k`vebit` da auc`ileblad shegexebat` [mogicevt`] ch`vengan mtanjveli sasjeli

[moc`ik`ulebma] t`k`ves: t`k`veni c`udi nishnebi [boroti cinat`grz'noba] t`k`vent`anvea [es t`k`veni sak`meebia] [da ara ch`vengan]. nut`u, shegagoneben [imit`, rac` t`k`vent`vis siket`ea], [k`vebit` ch`ak`olvit`] imuk`rebit`?... diax, t`k`ven xart` xalxi, romlebic` gadametebulni xart` [urcmunoebashi da urch`obashi]

da movida k`alak`is bolodan [ert`i] kac`i ach`k`arebuli. [man gaigo, rom sop`lis binadart` surdat` daesajat` an moeklat` moc`ik`ulni]. man t`k`va: hei, ch`emo xalxo! mihqevit` moc`ik`ult` [romlebic` allahma gamogzavna t`k`vent`an].

mihqevit` mat`, vinc` ar gt`xovt` t`k`ven sazg'aurs [cheshmaritebisken mocodebist`vis gadaxdas] da vinc` midis cheshmariti gzit` [radgan isini mxolod allahisadmi t`aqvanisc`emasa da msaxurebas mogicodeben]
da ratom ar unda vet`aqvano [da vemsaxuro] imas, vinc` shemk`mna me da vist`anac` t`k`ven [qvelani] dabrundebit`?

nut`u mis garda [allahis garda] sxvebs g'mert`ebad mivig'eb [romlebsac` arap`ris z'ala ar ak`vt`]? t`u mocqale [allahi] inebebs ch`emt`vis borotebas [zianis moqenebas], verap`eri mat`i shuamdgomloba [gamogonili g'mert`ebisa] ver damixsnis [ver damic`avs zianisgan], da ver gadamarch`enen isini me.
vinaidan me mashin vik`nebi ashkara gzaabnevashi
cheshmaritad, me vircmune t`k`veni up`ali, mash momisminet` me. [amis shemdeg mast`an mic`vivdnen adamianebi, romelt`ac` is sheagonebda, da mokles igi]
[mas shemdeg, rac` is mokvda] mas et`k`va: shedi samot`xeshi! [da] man t`k`va [ukve netarebashi mqop`ma]: o, netav ch`emma xalxma ic`odes
is, rom mapatia me ch`emma up`alma da gamxada me pativc`emult`agan.

# da ch`ven ar carmogvigzavnia mis xalxt`an (romlebmac` mokles igi da ar miig'es cheshmariteba) mis shemdeg [misi sikvdilis shemdeg] zec`idan [angelozt`a] jari, da ar viqavit` ch`ven gamomgzavnelni (angelozebis).
da igi iqo mxolod ert`i sashineli xma da isini gac`amtverdnen [daig'upnen].
vai im monebs! ar mosula mat`t`an arc` ert`i moc`ik`uli, viszec` isini ar dasc`inodnen.
nut`u isini [romlebic` dasc`inian] ver xedavdnen, ramdeni t`aoba (mat`amde) ch`ven (ukve) davg'upet` da rom isini mat`t`an ag'ar dabrundebian?
da cheshmaritad, qvela [sasjelis dg'es] ert`ad sheikribebian ch`vent`an [angarishisa da sazg'aurisat`vis].
da sascaulia mat`t`vis [urcmunot`at`vis] mkvdari mica (romelzec` ar iqo aravit`ari mc`enare); ch`ven gavac`oc`xlet` igi da gamoviqvanet` ik`idan marc`vali, romlidanac` miirt`meven isini.
da ch`ven movacqet` masze [am micaze, romelic` mkvdari iqo] bag'ebi p`inikebisa da vazisa [venaxebi] da gamovushvit` masze [micaze] cqaroni (romlit`ac` ircqveba bag'ebi),
rat`a miirt`van mat` [ch`emma monebma] mat`i [bag'ebis] naqop`idan da is, rac` gaamzades mat`ma xelebma. nut`u isini ar ik`nebian madlierni (am usasrulo cqalobat`a gamo)?

qovlad didebulia is, romelmac` shek`mna qvela cqvili [klasebi da saxeobebi] imat`gan, rasac` mica amozrdis [mc`enaret`agan], da mat`t`agan t`vit`onve [mamakac`ebi da k`alebi], da imat`gan, rac` mat` ar ucqian [allahis sxva k`mnilebani].
da nishania mat`t`vis g'ame. ch`ven vxsnit` [vashorebt`] misgan dg'es, da ai - isini [xalxi] umal ag'moch`ndebian sibneleshi.
da (aseve nishania mat`t`vis is, rom) mze miedineba t`avisi sac`xovrisisken. aset`i aris dadgenileba (allahis) qovldaz'lierisa, qovlismc`odnisa.
da (aseve nishania is, rom) mt`vare ch`ven ganvsazg'vret` misi p`azebit`, vidre is (axlidan) ar dabrundeba (im saxit`), rogorc` (gamoiqureba) z'veli p`inikis toti [rogorc` ch`ans axali mt`vare].
mzes ar sheshvenis[ar sheuz'lia] rom daecios mt`vares, da verc` g'ame daascrebs dg'es, da qoveli [mze, mt`vare da varskvlavebi] dac`uraven [moz'raoben] c`is t`ag'ze.
da sascaulia mat`t`vis is, rom ch`ven gadaviqvanet` mat`i sht`amomavloba datvirt`uli kidobanit` [moc`ik`uli nuhis/noes].
da ch`ven shevk`menit` mat`t`vis [allahis monebisat`vis] misi msgavsidan [kidobnis msgavsidan] is, razec` isini sxedan (gadaadgilebist`vis) [mogzaurobisat`vis].
da t`u visurvebt`, davaxrch`obt` mat` da aravin eqolebat` shemce, da isini ar ik`nebian gadarch`enilni.
garda ch`veni mocqalebit`a da sargeblad gansazg'vrul zhamamde [sikvdilamde].

da rodesac` et`k`mebat` mat` [imat`, vinc` ar ig'ebs cheshmaritebas]: <<geshinodet` imisa, rac` iqo t`k`venamde, da imisa, rac` ik`neba t`k`ven shemdeg [sasjelis dg'es], rat`a egebis shecqalebul ik`net`!>>
da ar mosdit` mat` [urcmunoebs] arc` ert`i nishani [sascauli] mat`i up`lis nishnebidan, rom isini ar mibrunebuliqvnen mat`gan [zurgi ak`c`ies allahis nishnebs/aiat`ebs].

da rodesac` eubnebian mat` [iudevelt` an mravalg'mert`iant`]: <<gaig'et` ik`idan (k`onebidan), romelic` allahma moganichat` t`k`ven [miec`it` g'aribebs]!>> - isini, romlebic` gaxdnen urcmunoni, eubnebian morcmunet`: <<nut`u ch`ven davapurot` isini, visac` allahs, rom esurva, t`vit`on daapurebda (an k`onebas misc`emda)? t`k`ven (morcmuneni) (roc`a amas gvik`adagebt`) imqop`ebit` mxolod ashkara gzaabnevashi>>.
da amboben [urcmunoebi]: rodis dadgeba es ag't`k`ma [gankit`xvis dg'e] t`uki mart`alni xart`?

isini arap`ers ar elian, garda ert`i shemaz'rcunebeli xmisa [im saqviris xma, sadac` ch`aberavs angelozi israp`ili], (rodesac` dasruldeba es samqaro). is (moulodnelad) moadgeba mat`, mashin, roc`a isini ert`manet`t`an davoben [saero sak`meebze kamat`oben rogorc` sch`veviat`].
da ver shez'leben isini (rodesac` dadgeba sasjelis dg'e) (t`undac`) (datovon) anderz'i (vinmest`vis) da ver dabrundebian t`aviant` ojaxebshi (radgan sakut`ar adgilzeve daig'upebian).
da (shemdeg) (meored) ch`aberaven saqvirshi (da qvela suli daubrundeba t`avis sxeuls), da ai - isini gamovlen sap`lavebidan da t`aviant`i up`lisken gaeshurebian (rom mis cinashe carsdgnen).

isini itqvian: <<hoi, ubedurebav ch`veno! vin ag'gvadgina ch`ven ch`veni gansvenebis adgilidan [sap`lavidan]?>> (mat` pasuxad et`k`mat`): <<es aris is, rac` mcqalobeli dahpirda (t`avis monebs), da cheshmaritebas ambobdnen moc`ik`ulebi>>.
(da) sakmarisi iqo mxolod ert`i (z'lieri) xma [saqvirshi meore ch`aberva], da ai - isini [shek`mnilni] ch`ven cinashe carsdgnen.
da dg'es [sasjelis dg'es] arc`ert`i suli ar ik`neba dach`agruli arap`rit` [ch`atardeba samart`liani angarishi]. da arap`eri mogezg'vebat` imis garda, rasac` aket`ebdit`.
cheshmaritad, samot`xis mkvidrni dg'es [sasjelis dg'es] (moxarulni, bednierni) dakavebulni ik`nebian sak`meebit` (samot`xis netarebebis mig'ebit`)
isini da mat`i meug'leebi samot`xis (xeebis) ch`rdilebshi isxdebian sacolebze.
mat`t`vis ik` [samot`xeshi] (bevrgvari samot`xis) xilia da qvelap`eri, rasac` ki moisurveben.
(da et`k`mebat` mat`): <<mshvidoba t`k`ven!>> -- es ik`neba sitqva mcqalobeli up`lisgan.
(da urcmunoebs et`k`mebat` sasjelis dg'es): <<gamoeqavit` dg'es (morcmunet`agan), hei, damnashaveno (urcmuneno)!>>

# (da allahi etqvis urcmunoebs): <<nut`u me ar gamc`net` mc`neba t`k`ven (ch`emi moc`ik`ulebis meshveobit`), hei, adamis shvilebo, rom ar gec`at` t`aqvani shaitanist`vis? da rom cheshmaritad, is t`k`vent`vis ashkara mteria!>>
(da me gibrz'anebdit`,) rom (mxolod) ch`emt`vis gec`at` t`aqvani, es aris mart`ali gza.
da man ukve [shaitanma] ac`duna [c`domilebashi sheiqvana] t`k`vengan mravali. nut`u ar dap`ik`rdit` [rom ar mihqolodit` shait`ans?]
ai -- jojoxet`i, romelic` t`k`vent`vis iqo ag't`k`muli.
<<shedit` masshi dg'es -- imis gamo, rom urcmunoeba ch`aidinet`!>>
dg'es davudebt` ch`ven becheds mat` bageebs, da ilaparakeben ch`vent`an mat`i xelebi (imis shesaxeb, rasac` adamiani mat`it` aket`ebda) da daamocmeben mat`i p`exebi, imaze rac` moipoves [c`odvebze].
da rom gveneba, t`valis ch`ins cavart`mevdit`. da gaik`c`eodnen gzisken, magram rogor dainaxavdnen?

da ch`ven rom gveneba, gadavak`c`evdit` mat` [sxva k`mnilebad, magalit`ad k`va an c`xovelebi] imave adgilze (sadac` isini imqop`ebian), da isini ver shez'lebdnen casvlas (cin) da verc` dabrunebas (ukan).

visac` ch`ven gavuxangrz'livebt` sic`oc`xles (siberemde miqvanit`), mas ch`ven (kvlav) vabrunebt` mis bunebriv mdgomareobashi [rodesac` sustdeba misi gonebac` da sxeulic`]. nut`u ver mixvdebian isini (rom is, vinc` amas aket`ebs, z'alamosilia mat`i ag'dgomisat`visac`, da ver xvdebian, rom es k`veqana carmavalia da saik`io maradiuli)?
da ch`ven ar gviscavlia mist`vis [muhammadist`vis(allahma daloc`os igi)] lek`sebi, da arc` sheep`ereba mas es [poezia]. es aris mxolod shegoneba da nat`eli qurani.
imisat`vis, rom gaap`rt`xilos (quranit`) c`oc`xlebi, da rom ag'sruldes sitqva [sasjelis dapireba] urcmunoebze.
nut`u ver dainaxes [ver dap`ik`rdnen], rom ch`ven shevk`menit` mat`t`vis pirutqvi imisgan, rasac` ch`venma xelebma shemk`nes [t`vit`on allahma], da isini arian mat`i mp`lobelni [amit` sargebloben]?
ch`ven davumorch`ilet` mat` pirutqvi: zogiert`ze isini sxdebian [satransportod iqeneben], xolo sxvebs chamen.
da mat`t`vis [adamianebist`vis] pirutqvshi aris sxva sargebelic` da sasmelic` [rz'e]. nut`u ar ik`nebian madlierni?
da daidgines mat` g'vt`aebebi allahis garda, im imedit`, rom isini [kerpebi]daexmarebodnen.
ver shez'leben isini [c`ru g'vt`aebebi] mat` [t`aqvanismc`emlebis] daxmarebas, da t`vit`on isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] mat`t`vis [c`ru g'vt`aebebist`vis] gamzadebuli lashk`aria.

nu gag'onebs shen [o, muhammad] mat`i sitqvebi (rodesac` isini ar ag'iareben shens cinascarmetqvelebas da amboben, t`it`k`os xar jadok`ari, poeti an sheshlili). ch`ven vic`it`, ras malaven isini t`aviant` gulebshi da ras avlenen [g'iad]

nut`u ar daunaxavs adamians, rom ch`ven shevk`menit` igi cvet`isagan [sat`esle sit`xisagan], [shemdeg ki gansazg'vruli etapebis gavlis shemdeg srulqop`il adamianad ik`c`a?!] da ai, igi - ashkarad kamat`obs [jiutad edaveba], [amtkic`ebs, rom ag'dgoma sheuz'lebelia!]

da mohqavs mas [ag'dgomis uarmqop`els] ch`vent`vis magalit`ebi (anu adarebs shemok`meds k`mnilebas) da avicqdeba sakut`ari shek`mna [rogor sheik`mna t`avad cvet`isagan]. ambobs: <<vin gaac`oc`xlebs z'vlebs, romlebic` ukve dampali da ch`amoshlilia?>>
ut`xari (mas): <<gaac`oc`xlebs mat` is [allahi], vinc` pirvelad shek`mna isini (arap`ridan), [da amitom mist`vis meored mat`i shek`mna kidev up`ro advilia] da igi qoveli k`mnilebis mc`odnea.
romelmac` shek`mna t`k`vent`vis mcvane xidan c`ec`xli, da ai - t`k`ven misgan [am sheshisgan] ant`ebt` c`ec`xls.
nut`u is, vinc` shek`mna c`ani da mica arap`ridan, ver shez'lebs mat` msgavsis [adamiant`a] shek`mnas?! diax, ra t`k`ma unda shez'lebs, da is aris qovlis shemok`medi, qovlismc`odne!

da misi [allahis] brz'anebaa, roc`a mas surs raimes [shek`mna], mxolod imas eubneba: <<iqav!>> - da is xdeba. (zustad ase, mxolod ert`i misi sitqvit` moxdeba qvela mkvdris ag'dgoma da allahis samsjavroze shekreba)
da uzenaesia is[ qovlad ucmindesi da unaklo], romlis xelshia up`loba qvelap`erze, da miskenve dabrundebit` t`k`ven samsjavros dg'es!
vp`ic`av [me[allahi)] mat` [angelozebs], romlebic` (t`aviant`i up`lis t`aqvanisc`emashi) dganan mckrivebad
da vp`ic`av [angelozebs], romlebic` mtkic`ed devnian g'rublebs
da vp`ic`av mat`it`, vinc` kit`xulobs shegonebas [vinc` axsenebs allahs da kit`xulobs mis sitqvas]
cheshmaritad, t`k`veni g'mert`i, aris ert`i [ar arsebobs sxva g'mert`i garda misi],
is aris up`ali [shvidi]c`isa da micis da imisa, rac` mat` shorisaa da ag'mosavlet`ebis up`ali [mzisa da sxva c`iuri sxeulebis mbrz'anebeli]!
cheshmaritad, ch`ven shevamket` uaxloesi zec`a [samqaro] varskvlavebis silamazit`.
da dasac`avad qoveli meamboxe/urch`i satanisgan
ver ismenen isini [eshmakebi] umag'lesi sazogadoebis [angelozt`a] saubars, da t`avs esxmian mat` [eshmakebs] [elvebit`] qoveli mxridan.
rat`a ganidevnon isini [eshmakebi] (zec`iuri mosmenisgan), da mat`t`vis momzadebulia maradiuli sasjeli jojoxet`shi
(eshmakebi ver ismenen umag'les sazogadoebas) garda imat`gan [eshmakt`agan], vinc` scrap`ad moiparavs sitqvas [angelozt`a nat`k`vams], da mas mqisve misdevs mbzinavi, mp`rk`veveli almuri

hkit`xe mat` [o, moc`ik`ulo] [ag'dgomis uarmqop`lebs]: nut`u isini up`ro z'nelad shesak`mnelni arian, t`u is, rasac` ch`ven shevk`menit` [qvela sxva k`mnileba]? cheshmaritad, ch`ven shevk`menit` isini [mat`i mama adami] cebovani t`ixisgan
magram shen [o, moc`ik`ulo] gaoc`ebuli xar imit`, [t`u rogor uarqop`en isini ag'dgomis rcmenas] da amast`anave dasc`inian kidec`
da roc`a mat` sheagoneben, ar sheigoneben[urcmunoebi]
da roc`a isini xedaven nishans [sascauls], [romelic` mocmobs, rom shen allahis moc`ik`uli xar] dasc`inian
da t`k`ves mat` [urcmunoebma]: <<es [rac` shen moitane] mxolod ashkara jadok`robaa!>>
nut`u shesaz'lebelia, rom rodesac` movkvdebit` da micad da z'vlebad vik`c`evit`, mart`la ag'vdgebit`?
an (nut`u) ag'dgebian ch`veni pirvandeli mamebic` [ch`veni qvela cinapari]?
ut`xari mat` [o, moc`ik`ulo]: <<diax, (qvelani ag'dgebian samsjavros dg'es) da t`k`ven, [o mravalg'mert`ianebo] im dg'es ik`nebit` damc`irebulni!>>
es ik`neba mxolod ert`i xma [meore sheberva], da ai - isini ukve xedaven [samsjavros dg'is movlenebs]
da itqvian isini: <<vai ch`ven! es aris samsjavros dg'e!>>
(mat` etqvian): <<es aris sasamart`los dg'e [rodesac` allahi samart`lianad gadacqvets qvelas sak`meebs], romelic` t`k`ven sic`rued miich`niet`!>>
#(uzenaesi ubrz'anebs angelozebs): <<shekribet` qvela is, vinc` usamart`lobas sch`adioda, mat`t`an ert`ad mat`i msgavsebic` da isinic`, visac` isini t`aqvans sc`emdnen
allahis garda, da caiqvanet` isini jojoxet`is gzisken[anu kerpt`aqvanismc`emlebi]
da sheach`eret` isini (vidre jojoxet`s miag'ceven), - cheshmaritad, isini gamoikit`xebian [t`it`oeul sitqvasa da sak`meze]
(mat` etqvian): <<ra dagemart`at`, rom ar exmarebit` ert`manet`s?>>
ara! isini dg'es sruliad damorch`ilebulni ik`nebian
da miuaxlovdebian isini [urcmunoni] ert`manet`s, da gamokit`xaven[ert`manet`s daadanashauleben] ert`manet`s

isini eubnebian (t`aviant` cinamz'g'olebs): "cheshmaritad, t`k`ven
modiodit` ch`vent`an marjvnidan [rcmenisa da cheshmaritebis mxridan] (da carmogvidgendit` rcmenasa da morch`ilebas
allahisadmi rogorc` umnishvnelos, gvich`endit`
zizg's cheshmaritebis mimart` da c`t`omilebas
gvich`venebdit` lamazad)".
(mat`i cinamz'g'olebi) upasuxeben mat`: "pirik`it`, t`k`ven t`vit`on ar iqavit` morcmuneni".
da ch`ven ar gvk`onda t`k`venze z'alaup`leba. magram t`k`ven (o, mravalg'mert`ianno) (t`vit`onve) iqavit` xalxi, gadametebuli [zg'vars gadasuli c`odvebshi].

da axda ch`venze ch`veni up`lis sitqva [misi muk`ara],
(amitom) ch`ven (t`k`vent`an ert`ad) uechvelad vigemebt` (sasjels)!

da ch`ven dagabniet` t`k`ven [gagashoret` cheshmarit rcmenas],
radgan, cheshmaritad, ch`ven (t`vit`onve) viqavit` dabneulni.
da im dg'es isini [rogorc` cinamz'g'olebi, aseve mat`i mimdevrebi] t`anamonacileni ik`nebian sasjelshi (zustad ise, rogorc` am k`veqnashi iqvnen t`anamonacileni allahis urch`obashi).
cheshmaritad, ase vik`c`evit` damnashaveebt`an [t`an, vinc` urcmunoeba da c`odvebi airch`ia]!
radgan cheshmaritad, isini, roc`a mat` eubnebodnen: <<ar arsebobs g'mert`i [g'irsi t`aqvanisc`emisa], garda allahisa!>> - ampartavnobdnen.
da ambobdnen: "nut`u mart`la davtovebt` ch`vens g'mert`ebs (vig'ac`) poetis gamo, romelic` shepqrobilia?"
oh, ara! is (muhammadi) movida cheshmaritebit` da daadastura moc`ik`ulebis simart`le.
cheshmaritad, t`k`ven (o, mravalg'mert`ianno), uechvelad igemebt` mtanjvel sasjels!
da mogegebat` t`k`ven mxolod is [is c`odvebi], rasac` t`k`ven ch`adiodit` (k`veqniur c`xovrebashi).
garda allahis rch`euli msaxurebisa
isini miig'eben mat`t`vis ag't`k`mul c`nobil sarch`os (samot`xeshi)
(mravalp`erovan, gemriel) naqop`ebs, da isini ik`nebian pativshi.
kurt`xeul (maradiul) bag'ebshi
(mjdarni) nak`arg sacolebze (da mosaubreni) ert`manet`isken mibrunebuli saxit`.
mat` [samot`xis mkvidrt`] shemoivlian (samot`xis msaxurni) t`asebit` (samot`xis g'vinisa), romelic` (gamodis) cqarodan.
t`et`ri (p`erit`) da sasiamovno msmelt`at`vis.
ar aris masshi [samot`xis g'vinoshi] sigizhe [gonebas ar abnelebs] (gansxvavebit` amk`veqniuri g'vinisgan), da isini ar t`vrebian misgan.
da mat` (samot`xeshi) eqolebat` mzeradaxrilni [huriebi, romlebic` aravis uqureben t`aviant`i meug'leebis garda], didi da lamazi t`valebit`.
msgavsni xeluxlebeli kverc`xebisa[t`et`ri p`erisani romelt`ac` moqvit`alo p`eric` shereviat`].
da mat`gan zogi axlovdeba sxvebt`an, da ikit`xaven (ert`manet`s, rogor c`xovrobdnen micier c`xovrebashi).
mat`gan ert`-ert`i [samot`xis mkvidrt`agan] itqvis: "mqavda me (micier c`xovrebashi) (ert`i) megobari".
ambobda [is megobari dac`invit` da uarqop`it`]: "nut`u shen imat` shoris xar, vinc` cheshmaritad miich`nevs (ag'dgomas)?!"
nut`u (shesaz'lebelia, rom) roc`a movkvdebit` da micad da z'vlebad vik`c`evit`, mashin namdvilad gavsamart`ldebit`[da mogvezg'veba imis samagiero rasac` vaket`ebdit`]?
itqvis igi [morcmune] (imat`, vist`anac` is saubrobs samot`xeshi): "nut`u ar shexedavt` (sad aris axla is megobari)?"
da man shexeda da ixila igi jojoxet`is shuagulshi.
itqvis igi [morcmune] (t`avis urcmuno megobars): "vp`ic`av allahs! shen kinag'am mec` damg'upe".
da rom ara ch`emi up`lis cqaloba (imit`, rom man mach`uk`a rcmena da gamamtkic`a masshi), uechvelad, vik`nebodi dasjilt`a shoris (shent`an ert`ad).
(da itqvis morcmune): "nut`u ch`ven (ukve) (ag'arasodes) ag'ar movkvdebit`"?![sixarulis shedegad ambobs amas].
garda ch`veni pirveli sikvdilisa, da ch`ven ag'ar vik`nebit` dasjilni.
cheshmaritad, es aris diadi gamarjveba.
amgvari [didi siket`is] misag'cevad ishromon [ec`adon] momushaveni [micier c`xovrebashi].
nut`u es [samot`xis netareba] umjobesia, rogorc` nugeshi [allahis monichebuli sach`uk`ari], t`u zaqumis xe?

cheshmaritad, ch`ven gavxadet` igi [zaqumis xe] gamosac`delad usamart`lot`a [urcmunot`at`vis]. [urcmunoebi ambobdnen: t`k`veni megobari amtkic`ebs, rom jojoxet`shi xe izrdeba magram xom xe c`ec`xlshi icvis]
cheshmaritad, es aris xe, romelic` gamodis [izrdeba] jojoxet`is z'irshi.
misi naqop`i [imdenad maxinjia], rom hgavs eshmakebis t`avebs.
xolo isini sinamdvileshi [mravalg'mert`ianebi] chamen mat` [zaqumis naqop`s] da ivseben misit` t`aviant` muc`lebs.
shemdeg ki, cheshmaritad, mat`t`vis [ik`] aris sasmeli, c`xelshereuli dasalevi.
shemdeg ki, cheshmaritad, mat`i dabruneba auc`ileblad jojoxet`shi ik`neba.
radgan cheshmaritad, mat` naxes t`aviant`i mamebi [cinaprebi] gzaabneulobashi.
da isini mat` kvals scrap`ad gahqvnen [gaup`ik`reblad mihqvnen].
da ukve mat`amde [shens xalxamde, o muhammad] cina [t`obis] umetesoba gzas asc`da.
ch`ven xom mivavlinet` mat`t`an [im sazogadoebebt`an] shemgonebeli [romlebic` ap`rt`xilebdnen mat` sasjelis shesaxeb magram mat` uarqves isini]
da shexede, rogori iqo shegonebult`a ag'sasruli
allahis gulcrp`el msaxurt`a garda

da ai, ukve mogvmart`a [vedrebit`]
[cinascarmetqvelma] nuhma da ra shesanishnavad [ch`ven] vupasuxet` mis vedrebas
da ch`ven gadavarch`inet` igi [cinascarmetqveli nuhi] da misi ojaxi [garda misi c`olisa da ert`i shvilisa] didi mcuxarebisgan [didi carg'vnisgan allahis sasjelisgan].

da ch`ven ise movacqvet`, rom misi sht`amomavloba
darch`eniliqo [mas shemdeg, rac` misi xalxi daixrch`ven].
da ch`ven davtovet` masze [cinascarmetqvel nuhze] [kargi xseneba] ukanasknel t`aobebshi [mat` shoris, vinc` mas shemdeg ic`xovrebs]
mshvidoba [cinascarmetqvel] nuhs qvela samqaroshi [qvela angelozs, jinsa da adamians shoris]! [cinascarmetqvel nuhze k`mnilebebshi mxolod kargi xsenebaa]
cheshmaritad, zustad ase [rogorc` mivaget` cinascarmetqvel nuhs], vajildovebt` ch`ven ket`ilismok`medt` [allahis morch`ilebashi].
cheshmaritad, igi ch`veni morcmune msaxurt`agani iqo
shemdeg ki ch`ven davaxrch`et` sxvebi.
da cheshmaritad, misive t`emidan [igive rcmenisa da gzis, rogorc` cinascarmetqvel nuhi] iqo [shuamavali] ibrahimi.
ai, igi [shuamavali ibrahimi] mivida t`avis up`alt`an ubico gulit` [sulit`, romelic` t`avisup`ali iqo qovelgvari c`ru rcmenisa da c`udi zneobisgan].
ai, man [cinascarmetqvelma ibrahimma] ut`xra t`avis mamas da t`avis xalxs: ras sc`emt` t`aqvans?
nut`u, c`rus igonebt` [c`ru g'mert`ebs ag'iarebt`] da gsurt` t`aqvani sc`et`, allahis garda, [gamogonil] g'mert`ebs?
aba ras p`ik`robt` samqarot`a up`alze?

da man [ibrahimma] shexeda varskvlavebs
[p`ik`rit`, rogor darch`eniliqo k`alak`shi, roc`a xalxi cavidoda sakut`ar dg'esascaulze, rat`a daemtvria kerpebi].
da t`k`va: cheshmaritad, me avad var!
da mat` [misma xalxma] zurgi ak`c`ies mas [shuamaval ibrahims] [mis sitqvebis daijeres] [da cavidnen dg'esascaulze].

da [p`arulad] sheipara igi [cinascarmetqvel ibrahimi] mat` g'vt`aebebt`an [misi xalxis kerpebt`an] da ut`xra [dac`invit`]:
<<nut`u t`k`ven ar chamt` [im sakvebs, rasac` t`k`veni t`aqvanismc`emlebi gt`avazoben]?
ra gchirt` t`k`ven, ratom ar laparakobt` [ar pasuxobt` ch`ems kit`xvas]?
da miuaxlovda igi [ibrahimi] mat` [kerpebs], urtqamda mat` marjvena xelit` (amtvrevda mat`),
da mividnen isini [misi xalxi] mast`an [ibrahimt`an] ach`k`arebulni.
ut`xra: <<nut`u t`aqvans sc`emt` imas, rasac` t`avadve gamoch`ich`k`nit` [xisgan da k`visgan]?>>
xolo allahma shegk`mnat` t`k`ven da is, rasac` aket`ebt`>>.
(mravalg'mert`ovnebma) t`k`ves: <<aushenet` mist`vis [ibrahimist`vis] nageboba, (amoavset` is sheshit`, daant`et`) da ch`aagdet` c`ec`xlshi!>>
da ganizraxes mis cinaag'mdeg mzakvroba (misi mokvlis miznit`), xolo ch`ven davak`veit`et` isini [davamarc`xet`]
da t`k`va man [moc`ik`ulma ibrahimma]: <<me mivdivar ch`ems up`alt`an (ik`, sadac` t`avisup`lad shevz'leb mis msaxurebas), da is damadgens [scor] gzas>>. (da ase gadasaxlda igi shamshi).
(shemdeg man allahs mimart`a): <<up`alo ch`emo! mommadle sht`amomavloba, (romelic` ik`neba) mart`alt`agani!>>
da gavaxaret` igi momt`meni vazhit` (ismailit`)

da roc`a man [ismailma] miag'cia (aset` asaks), rom (ukve) sheez'lo siaruli da shroma mast`an ert`ad, ut`xra man [moc`ik`ulma ibrahimma]: <<o, shvilo ch`emo! cheshmaritad, me vxedav sizmarshi (gamoc`xadebas), rom gcirav shen msxverplad [allahist`vis], mash, shexede, ras p`ik`rob amaze>>. [ase surda moc`ik`ul ibrahims gaego, rogor shexvdeboda amas misi shvili.] man [ismailma] t`k`va: <<o, mamach`emo! gaaket`e, rac` shen gibraz'ana (allahma); (da) ag'momach`en, t`u allahi inebebs, momt`ment`agan>>. (da isini gavidnen minas velze da mividnen im adgilamde, sadac` unda moxdes msxverplshecirva uzenaesist`vis).

da rodesac` oriveni [cinascarmetqveli ibrahimi da misi vazhi ismaili] daemorch`ilnen [allahs] [sruliad daemorch`ilnen mas] da [mashin ibrahimma] daacvina igi [misi vazhi] shublit` micaze [imist`vis, rom shesaciravad sheecira]
da [am momentshi) ch`ven mivmart`et` mas [mivucodet` mas] [im mz'ime dros, roc`a ukve miaxloebuli iqo dana misi vazhis qels]: o, ibrahim, [shech`erdi]
shen ukve daadasture [sak`mit`] sizmari [cinascarmetqveluri xilva]. namdvilad, ase vajildoebt` ket`ilis mok`medt`
cheshmaritad, es iqo ashkara gamoc`da
da ch`ven shevc`valet` igi [ismaili] did shesaciravi msxverplit` [verz'it`]
da ch`ven davtovet` mis shesaxeb [ket`ili saxeli] momdevno t`aobebshi.
mshvidoba [cinascarmetqvel] ibrahims [allahisgan]
cheshmaritad, scored ase [rogorc` mivaget` cinascarmetqvel ibrahims] vajildoebt` ch`ven gulcrp`el ket`ilisk`mnelt` [allahisadmi morch`ilebashi]
cheshmaritad, igi [cinascarmetqveli ibrahimi] ch`ven morcmune morch`ilt`a [msaxurt`a] shoris iqo
da gavaxaret` igi [ibrahimi] ishaqit`, shuamavlad da [vak`c`iet` igi] mart`alt`agan.
da ch`ven davloc`et` [kurt`xeva movavlinet`] masze [ibrahims] da ishaqs. magram mat`i sht`amomavlobidan arian ket`ilis mok`mednic` da aseve ashkarad sakut`ar t`avs usamart`lod momk`c`evnic`.
da [aseve] ch`ven movuvlinet` cqaloba musas da haruns [mivanichet` mat` cinascarmetqveleba]
da ch`ven gadavarch`inet` isini oriveni da mat`i xalxic` didi mcuxarebisgan [damc`irebisgan, monobisgan da cit`el zg'vashi daxrch`obisgan]
da ch`ven davexmaret` mat` [mivanichet` sidiade, daxmareba da gamarjveba], da isini gaxdnen gamarjvebulni [p`araonsa da misi xalxze]
da ch`ven mivanichet` mat` ors [cinascarmetqvel musas da haruns] nat`eli cigni [t`ora]
da ch`ven carvmart`et` isini oriveni [musa da haruni] scor gzaze
da ch`ven davtovet` mat` shesaxeb [ket`ili saxeli] momdevno t`aobebshi
mshvidoba [cinascarmetqvelebs] musas da haruns [allahisgan].
cheshmaritad, scored ase vajildovebt` ket`ilisk`mnelt`
cheshmaritad, isini oriveni ch`veni morcmune morch`ilt`a shoris iqvnen.
da cheshmaritad, iliasi [aseve] iqo gamogzavnilt`agan [cinascarmetqvelt`agan].
ai, [ert`xel] ut`xra man t`avis xalxs [israilis sht`amomavlebs]: <<nut`u ar shegeshindebat` [allahis sasjelis]?
nut`u t`k`ven mimart`avt` [vedrebit`] ba'las[ba'lun, mat`i kerpis saxelia] da tovebt` [t`aqvanisc`emas] shemok`medt`agan sauket`esos,
[tovebt`]allahs, t`k`vens up`als da t`k`vens mamat`a pirvelt`a up`als [ romelmac` shegk`mnat` t`k`ven da t`k`veni cinaprebi da shesaz'lebeli gaxada t`k`veni arseboba]?

da mat` uarqves igi [ilias shuamavali] [ar ag'iares allahis cinascarmetqvelad]. da cheshmaritad, isini uechvelad moqvanil ik`nebian [allahis mier] [sasamart`lo dg'eze] [angarishis ch`asabareblad da sazrauris misag'ebad].
garda allahis rch`euli morch`ilebisa [vinc` allahma t`avisi cqalobit` gamoarch`ia imis gamo, rom mxolod mas ag'iarebdnen up`lad da g'mert`ad]
da ch`ven davtovet` mis shesaxeb [ket`ili saxeli] momdevno t`aobebshi.
mshvidoba [shuamaval] il iasins [iliass]
cheshmaritad, scored ase [rogorc` mivaget` shuamaval iliass] vajildoebt` ch`ven gulcrp`el ket`ilisk`mnelt` [allahisadmi morch`ilebashi]
cheshmaritad, igi [shuamavali iliasi] ch`veni morcmune morch`ilt`agan iqo.
da cheshmaritad, luti iqo gamogzavnilt`agan [shuamavalt`agan]
ai, ch`ven gadavarch`inet` igi [shuamavali luti] da misi mt`eli ojaxi [allahis sasjelisgan]
garda moxuc`i k`alisa [misi c`oli], romelic` darch`enilt`a shoris ag'moch`nda [t`avis xalxt`an ert`ad daig'upa t`avisi urcmunoebis gamo]
shemdeg ch`ven gavanadguret` sxvebi
radgan t`k`ven [o, mek`k`elno], cheshmaritad, gadixart` [t`k`vens savachro mogzaurobebshi] mat` gverdit` [im sop`lis gverdit`, sadac` c`xovrobda xalxi, romelsac` shuamavali luti ap`rt`xilebda] dilit`
da g'amit`ac`: nut`u ver ac`nobierebt` [rom igive sheiz'leba t`k`venc` dagemart`ot`]?
da cheshmaritad, iunusic` iqo gamogzavnilt`agan [shuamavalt`agan].
ai, [ert`xel] igi [shuamavali iunusi] gaik`c`a [t`avisi xalxisgan g'mert`is nebart`vis gareshe] [gabrazebuli mat`ze] gadatvirt`uli (xalxit`a da tvirt`it` savse] gemisken.
da man cili qara [sxva adamianebt`an ert`ad] da damarc`xebult`a shoris ag'moch`nda[kenchisqris shedegad gemidan zg'vashi gadaagdes
da is ch`aqlapa veshapma, da igi iqo gakic`xult`agani
da rom ara is, rom igi [manam, sanam veshapis muc`elshi ag'moch`ndeboda] iqo allahis gamdidebelt`a shoris [ gulmodgine t`aqvanismc`emeli t`avisi up`lisadmi da mraval ket`il sak`mis mk`neli],
usat`uod darch`eboda mis[veshapis] muc`elshi im dg'emde, vidre ar ag'sdgebodnen.
da ch`ven ki gamovagdet` igi [moc`ik`uli iunusi] c`ariel udabnoshi [ik`, sadac` arc` adamiani c`xovrobs da arc` rame izrdeba], da is iqo z'alagamoc`lili.
da ag'movac`enet` ch`ven masze gogris xe [moc`ik`ul iunusist`vis ch`rdilad da sakvebad].
da gavgzavnet` ch`ven igi [moc`ik`uli iunusi] asi at`ast`an, da up`ro metnic` iqvnen.[anu sadac` is ik`na gagzavnili, is mosaxleoba asi at`ass ag'ematebodnen ]

da ircmunes mat` [allahi da is cheshmariteba, rit`ac` movida mat`t`an da rcmenisken moucoda] [im momentshi, roc`a t`it`k`mis ukve unda mosuliqo mat`ze allahis sasjeli]. da gadavuvadet` ch`ven mat` [sasjeli] garkveul dromde [anu mat`i sic`oc`xlis vadis amocurvamde] [ag'ar movuvlinet` sasjeli].

hkit`xe mat` [o, moc`ik`ulo] [shens xalxs]: nut`u [p`ik`roben, rom] shens up`als hqavs k`alishvilebi, xolo mat` ki vazhebi?! [rogor miaceren allahs k`alishvilebs, romelt`a dabadebis t`vit`on eshiniat` da eridebat`?!]
[da hkit`xe mat`]: nut`u ch`ven k`alebad shevk`menit` angelozebi, da isini [es adamianebi] iqvnen amis mocmeni [escrobodnen ik` qop`nas]?
o, diax! cheshmaritad, isini t`aviant`i mogonili sic`ruisgan uechvelad amboben:
alllahma shva!>> - da [xolo] isini cheshmaritad matquarebi arian [rodesac` amboben imas, rac` t`vit`onve ar ic`ian].
nut`u [es asea, rom] man airch`ia [t`avist`vis] k`alishvilebi, xolo vazhebi datova?
ra gchirt` t`k`ven [o, xalxo], rogor gansjit`? [rogor shegiz'liat` allahs miacerot` k`alishvilebi, romelt`a qolac` t`vit`onve geridebat` t`k`vent`vis?]
nut`u ar sheigonebt` [rom allahs ar sheshvenis shvilebis aqvana] [vinaidan igi amaze uzenaesia]?
an ik`neb t`k`ven gak`vt` nat`eli mtkic`ebuleba [t`k`veni sitqvebisa da mogonilis dasamtkic`eblad]?
moitanet` mashin t`k`veni cigni (romelshic`aa allahisgan mtkic`ebuleba), t`u simart`les ambobt`.
da daadgines [moigones] mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebma] nat`esaoba mis [allahis] da jinebs shoris. xolo jinebma ki kargad ic`ian, rom isini [vinc` amas ambobs] cardgenilni ik`nebian [sasjelisat`vis].
cmindaa allahi [cmindaa igi da ag'matebulia] imisgan, rasac` isini [urcmunoni] miaceren mas.

garda allahis rch`eul morch`ilt`a [isini, visac` allahma t`avisi mocqalebit` shearch`ia imist`vis, rom mxolod mas ag'iarebdnen up`lad da g'mert`ad, da ar miacerdnen mas arap`ers, rac` mas ar sheshvenis]
cheshmaritad, t`k`ven [o, mravalg'mert`ianno] da is, rasac` t`aqvans sc`emt` [t`k`veni c`ru g'mert`ebi],
verc` ert`s t`k`vengans ver sheiqvant` c`dunebashi [ver sheiqvant` shec`domashi] mis cinaag'mdeg [allahis nebit` sacinaag'mdegod],
garda mxolod imat`isa, vist`visac` [ukve gansazg'vrulia] jojoxet`shi shesvla.
da [angelozebma t`k`ves]: ar aris ch`ven shoris arc`ert`i, visac` ar hk`ondes gansazg'vruli adgili [zec`ashi].
da cheshmaritad, ch`ven [vdgavart`] rigebad [allahis t`aqvanisc`emasa da morch`ilebashi],
da cheshmaritad, ch`ven uechvelad vadidebt` [allahs] [vambobt`, rom igi ag'matebulia t`vit` srulqop`ilebazec`].
xolo isini [mek`k`eli mravalg'mert`ianebi] [manamde, sanam allahi mat`t`an moc`ik`uls moavlenda] jiutad ambobdnen:
netav ch`ven gvk`onoda shegoneba cina [t`aobat`gan] [allahis cigni an misi moc`ik`uli],
mashin ch`ven uechvelad vik`nebodit` allahis rch`euli morch`ilni [ert`g'mert`is ag'msareblebi].
magram [roc`a mat` mouvidat` igive shegoneba, rac` cina t`aobebs mosdiodat`] [muhammadi movida allahis cignit` quranit`], mat` uarqves igi. da male isini sheitqoben [ra sasjelic` elis mat`]
da [ukve] sheuc`vlelia ch`veni sitqva [t`k`muli] ch`veni movlinebuli gzavnilt`at`vis [imis shesaxeb, rom]
cheshmaritad, mat` mienichebat` daxmareba [rogorc` mtkic`ebulebit`, ise z'alit`] [mat`i mtrebis cinaag'mdeg brz'olashi]
da cheshmaritad, ch`veni lashk`ari usat`uod isini gaimarjveben.
da gaeride [o, moc`ik`ulo] mat` [vinc` ar ig'ebs simart`les] garkveuli vadis bolomde [sanam ar amoicureba gadavadebis dro] [da mova allahis sasjeli]
da shexede mat` [da daelode], da isini ixilaven [ra sasjeli daatqdebat`].
nut`u isini ch`k`aroben ch`vens sasjels?
xolo roc`a igi [ch`veni sasjeli] ch`amova mat` moedanze [mat`i ezoebze], sashineli ik`neba dila mat`i, gap`rt`xilebult`at`vis
da zurgi ik`c`ie [o, moc`ik`ulo] mat`gan garkveuli vadis bolomde [sanam ar amoicureba gadavadebis dro] [da mova allahis sasjeli]
da shexede [da daelode], da isini ixilaven [ra sasjelic` daatqdebat`]!
didebulia sheni g'mert`i, g'mert`i z'levamosili imaze, rasac` miaceren mas
mshvidoba gzavnilebs [shuamavlebs].
k`eba dideba allahs samqarot`a g'mert`s
saad. <<me, allahi, vp`ic`av qurans, romelic` sheic`avs shexsenebas (xalxist`vis) [cheshmaritebas].
xolo isini, vinc` gaxdnen urcmunoni, imqop`ebian ampartavnebashi da ganxet`k`ilebashi [cheshmaritebast`an cinaag'mdegobashi].

ramdeni t`aoba gavanadguret` mat`amde [am mravalg'mert`ianebamde]! da mashin, roc`a sasjeli movida, mat` shehg'ag'ades [mimart`es monaniebas], magram ukve z'alian gviani iqo, rom t`avidan aec`ilebinat` igi.

da gaukvirdat` mat` [am urcmunoebs], rom movida mat`t`an [gamap`rt`xilebeli] shemgonebeli [moc`ik`uli muhammedi ] mat`ganve [mat`i sakut`ari xalxidan]. da t`k`ves urcmunoebma:
es [igulisxmes shuamavali] matquara jadok`aria!

nut`u man g'mert`ebi ert` g'mert`ad ak`c`ia? [nut`u amtkic`ebs, rom ar sheiz'leba t`aqvanisc`ema vinmest`vis, garda ert`isa allahis?] namdvilad, es [riskenac` is moucodebs] -- cheshmaritad saoc`ari sak`mea!

da cavidnen mat`gan didebulni [quraishebt`agan] [ert`i shekrebidan, sadac`shuamavali allahis loc`va da mshvidoba mas moucodebda mat` ert`g'mert`ianobisken], ert`manet`t`an saubrisas: cadit` [t`k`veni gzit` da t`k`veni rcmenit`] da moit`minet` t`k`veni g'mert`ebis gulist`vis! [gaagrz'elet` mravalg'mert`ianoba da moit`minet` mravali g'mert`is arseboba.] namdvilad, es [riskenac` muhammadi moucodebs] aris rag'ac`, rasac` surs [surs amit` gaxdes pativc`emuli da moipovos mimdevrebi]
ch`ven ar gvsmenia amis shesaxeb [imis shesaxeb, riskenac` moucodebs muhammadi ] bolo scavlebashi [k`ristianobashi]. es arap`eria, garda gamogonilisa
nut`u [es] mas [muhammeds ] [da ara vinme sxvas] ch`vens shoris vinmes moeuvlina shexseneba [qurani]? ara! isini arian echvshi ch`ems shexsenebaze! ara! mat` jer ar gausinjavt` ch`emi sasjeli!
an nut`u mat` xelt` ak`vt` sheni g'mert`is cqalobis saunjeebi uzenaesisa da uxvad mimnichebelis?

an nut`u mat` [am mravalg'mert`ianebs] ekut`vnit` z'alaup`leba c`at`a, micis da im qvelap`ris mimart`, rac` mat` shorisaa [imisat`vis, rom vismes rame mianichon an caart`van]? mash, avidnen isini t`okebit` [aichran mag'al c`aze], [rat`a ik`idan ganagon, vis ra misc`en da vis risi cart`meva moundet`!]

es jari [es matquarat`a jari] ert`xel ganadgurdeba, da isini arian [imave ric`xvis] dajgup`ebebidan [es mravalg'mert`ianebi iset`ive mtrobashi arian rogorc` cina t`emebis mravalg'mert`ianebi, romlebic` sakut`ari shuamavlebis cinaag'mdeg ag'imart`nen].

mat`amde [mek`k`is urcmunoebamde da sxva arabebamde] uarqves [t`aviant`i moc`ik`ulebi] nuhis xalxma, adielebma [shuamavali hudis xalxma] da p`araonma boz'ebis [piramidebisa da z'lieri lashk`ris] mp`lobelma.
da samudevelebi [shuamavali salihis xalxi], da lutis xalxi, da al-aik`is mkvidrni [shuamavali shua'ibis xalxi] es [xalxebi] iqvnen dajgup`ebani.
t`it`oeulma mat`ganma [im xalxt`agan] uarqo [allahis moc`ik`ulebi], da daatqda mat` ch`emi sasjeli!

da arap`ers elian isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi], garda ert`i gamanadgurebeli xmaurisa [saqviris xmaurisa, romelshic` ch`aberavs angelozi israp`ili], [rodesac` dasruldeba es cut`isop`eli]. amis shemdeg ki ukve ar ik`neba dabruneba [qvelap`eri ik`neba sheuk`c`evadi]
da t`k`ves mat` [dac`invit`]: g'mert`o ch`veno! daach`k`are ch`vent`vis ch`veni cili [sasjelisa] angarishscorebis dg'is cin[am k`veqnadve sic`oc`xleshive]!

moit`mine [o, shuamavalo] is, rasac` amboben isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi], da gaixsene ch`veni mona, [shuamavali] davudi z'alis mk`one [romelsac` hk`onda z'ala allahis mtrebis cinaag'mdeg] [da romelic` iqo morch`ilebashi mot`minebis mk`one t`avis g'mert`is cinashe]. cheshmaritad, is iqo mobrunebuli [momnaniebeli allahisaken], [rat`a moipovos misi kmaqop`ileba]
cheshmaritad, ch`ven davuk`vemdebaret` mas [shuamaval davuds] mt`ebi, romlebic` mast`an ert`ad adidebdnen allahs sag'amoobit`a da mzis amosvlisas.
da [davumorch`ilet` mas] p`rinvelebic`, [haershi] shekavebulni. qvela isini [mt`ebic` da p`rinvelebic`] qvelani mis[davudis] gamo morch`ilni arian[allahisa]
da gavamqaret` misi mmart`veloba, da mivanichet` mas sibrz'ne [shuamavloba, sitqvebsa da sak`meebshi simart`le] da gamchriaxoba [unari scorad gamoitanos gadacqvetileba da gamchriaxoba masshi]

da xom movida shenamde [o, shuamavalo] ambavi mch`xubart`a [ori ert`manet`shi mokamat`is], rogor gadaz'vrnen isini kedelze [da ara karidan] da ag'moch`ndnen saloc`avshi [im dros, roc`a cinascarmetqveli davudi allahs morch`ilebashi iqo dakavebuli?]

roc`a shevidnen davudt`an, da mas sheshinda mat`gan, ut`xres: nu geshinia! ch`ven ori mokamat`e vart`, da ert`manet`s usamart`lod movek`ec`it`. gansaje ch`vens
shoris cheshmaritebit`!da nu ik`nebi usamart`lo da gvich`vene scori gza! [scori gadacqvetileba]
(ert`ma mat`ganma) t`k`va: <<es ch`emi z'maa: mas qavs ot`xmoc`dac`xrameti c`xvari, xolo me mqavs mxolod ert`i c`xvari. da man t`k`va: momande[momec`i] igi me! da saubarshi z'alac` damatana

man t`k`va [shuamavalma daudma]: is namdvilad usamart`lod mogek`c`a, roc`a moit`xova sheni c`xvris miert`eba t`avis c`xvrebze. da cheshmaritad, bevr t`anamonaciles ert`manet`is mimart` gadameteba sch`vevia, garda mat`isa, vinc` ircmuna da ag'asrula ket`ili sak`meebi da isini c`otani arian. da mixvda davudi, rom ch`ven mas vc`didit` da it`xova man patieba t`avisi up`lisagan, daemxo muxlmodrekit` da dabrunda [monaniebit` mast`an]
da mivutevet` mas es [sak`me]. da namdvilad, mas ak`vs ch`vent`an siaxlove da sauket`eso dabruneba [gankit`xvis dg'es]

o, davud! cheshmaritad, ch`ven dagadginet` mmart`velad dedamicaze [moganichet` z'alaup`leba]. mash, gansaje adamianebs shoris cheshmaritebit` [samart`lianad] da nu mihqvebi survils [gadacqvetilebis gamotanisas], t`orem is gadagaxvevinebs allahis gzidan! cheshmaritad, mat`t`vis, vinc` gadauxvevs allahis gzas, mz'ime sasjelia [jojoxet`shi] imis gamo, rom daivicqes angarishis dg'e [gaxdnen uquradg'eboni]
da ch`ven ar shegvik`mnia c`a, mica da is, rac` mat` shorisaa, amaod. es aris mxolod imat` varaudi, vinc` urcmuno gaxda. xolo vai urcmunoebs c`ec`xlisagan [mz'ime sasjeli]
nut`u gavat`anabrebt` mat`, vinc` ircmuna da ag'asrula ket`ili sak`meebi, mat`t`an, vinc` borotebas avrc`elebs micaze? an nut`u gavat`anabrebt` g'vt`ismosavebs c`odvilebt`an?

cigni [qurani], romelic` ch`ven gardmogivlinet` shen, [o, shuamavalo] kurt`xeulia [masshi aris didi siket`e], rat`a adamianebi dap`ik`rdnen mis aiat`ebze da gaixsenon goniernma [is movaleobebi, romlebsac` allahi daakisrebs mat`]
da vuboz't` ch`ven [shuamaval] davuds [shvili] sulaimani. rogori mshvenieri monaa is [sulaimani]! cheshmaritad, igi [xshirad] mimart`avda [allahs]
da [ert`xel] carudgines mas [sulaimans] dg'is meore naxevarshi msubuk`ad mdgari c`xenebi[sam p`exze dganan, da meot`xe p`exis mxolod ch`lik`is cinamxare exeba micas]
da t`k`va (sulaimanma): <<shemiqvarda [amk`veqniuri] siket`e siqvarulit` allahis xsenebaze metad, vidre is p`ardit` ar daip`ara[c`xenebis qurebisas mzec` ch`avida da loc`vac` gamomrch`a]
damibrunet` isini [c`xenebi] ch`emt`an!" da daicqo mat`i [c`xenebis] cvivebsa da kisrebze xmlis gadasma.[arsebobs is azric`, rom man xeli gadausva mop`erebit` da ara xmali.]
da ukve gamovc`adet` [shuamavali] suleimani. da davagdet` mis taxtze sxeuli, mere moinania
man [sulaimanma] t`k`va: <<g'mert`o ch`emo! mapatie me da momaniche mep`oba [z'alaup`leba], romelic` ar sheep`ereba aravis ch`ems shemdeg. cheshmaritad, shen xar mommadlebeli
da [ch`ven vupasuxet` mis vedrebas da] davumorch`ilet` mas k`ari, romelic` misi brz'anebit` msubuk`ad [morch`ilad] k`roda ik`, sadac` mas surda
da [aseve davumorch`ilet` mas] satanebi qoveli mshenebeli da mqvint`avi
da [aseve davumorch`ilet` mas] sxvebi [amboxebuli shaiat`anebi], borkilebit` shekrulni [rat`a mat` ziani ar mieqenebinat` sxvebist`vis]

es [didebili z'alaup`leba da aset`i morch`ileba] ch`ven moganichet` [shen] [o, sulaiman]. mash, uboz'e (visac` inebeb) an nu misc`em [imas vist`visac` ar ginda], angarishis gareshe [shen sruliad t`avisup`ali xar shent`vis minichebulis ganacilebashi]
da cheshmaritad, mist`vis ch`vens cinashe aris siaxlove [vk`menit` is ch`vent`an daaxloebult`agani] da mshvenieri dabrunebis adgili [gansjis dg'es]
da gaixsene ch`veni morch`ili -- aiubi. ai, roc`a man shehg'ag'ada t`avis g'mert`s: cheshmaritad, shemexo me satana tanjvit`a da sasjelit`
daartqi p`exi sheni [dedamicaze] da amoxet`k`avs shent`vis cqaro! es aris c`ivi cqali banaobisa da sasmelad[rit`ac` shen ganikurnebi]

da ch`ven vuboz'et` mas [aiubs] misi ojaxi da imdenive mat` msgavsic` mat`t`an ert`ad, ch`veni cqalobisagan, da rogorc` shegoneba goniert`at`vis [rat`a ic`odnen, rom mot`minebas bednieri shedegi moak`vs]

da [ch`ven vut`xarit` mas]: aig'e xelshi mucha [xmeli balaxi] da daartqi mas [sheni c`ols] da nu daarg'vev [shens mier dadebul p`ic`s]! cheshmaritad, ch`ven vipovet` igi mot`minebit` ag'srulebulad. ra mshvenieri morch`ilia igi [aiubi] cheshmaritad, igi iqo [xshirad] allahisaken mobrunebuli [mt`xovneli]
da gaixsene (o, moc`ik`ulo) ch`veni morch`ilni - ibrahimi, ishaqi da iaqubi, (romlebic` iqvnen) mtkic`eni (allahis morch`ilebashi) da gamchriaxni.
cheshmaritad, ch`ven avirch`iet` isini, (gagvimqarebina mat` gulebshi) xsovna samqop`elisa (maradisobisa).
da cheshmaritad, isini ch`vent`an, udavod, arian rch`eult`a da sauket`esot`a shoris.
da gaixsene (o, moc`ik`ulo) ismaili, da al-iasa'a, da zul-k`ip`li. qvelani (isini) sauket`esot`a shoris arian.
es [qurani] aris shegoneba (shent`vis, o moc`ik`ulo, da sheni sazogadoebisat`vis). da cheshmaritad, mat`t`vis, vinc` g'vt`ismoshishni arian, uechvelad, ik`neba mshvenieri dabrunebis adgili.
(samot`xis) maradiulobis bag'ebi, romelt`a karibcheebi mat`t`vis gaxsnilia.
ik`, mqop`ni (samot`xis sarec`elebze), moit`xoven mravalnair naqop`ebsa da sasmels..
da mat`t`vis (samot`xeshi) ik`nebian t`aviant`i mzerebis damc`avni [huriebi, romlebic` ar uqureben aravis, garda t`aviant`i k`mrebisa], t`anatolni.
es aris is, rac` shegpirdat` t`k`ven angarishis dg'isat`vis!
cheshmaritad, es - uechvelad ch`veni sarch`oa, (romelsac`) ar ak`vs amocurva [romelic` ar daic`leba]!
es [qvelap`eri, rac` iqo ch`amot`vlili] -- (allahis moshisht`at`vis)! xolo usazg'vrod daumorch`ileblobashi mqop`t`at`vis, ra t`k`ma unda, qvelaze sashineli dabrunebis adgilia.
jojoxet`i, sadac` isini daicvebian, da (ra) sashinelia es (c`ec`xlis) sarec`eli!
esaa -- dae, daagemovnon igi -- adug'ebuli cqali da ch`irk`i (jojoxet`is mkvidrt`a sxeulebidan gamomavali),
da (mat`t`vis ik`neba) (aseve) sxva (sasjeli) amgvarisagan da (sxvadasxva) saxeobis.

(jojoxet`is mkvidrni ert`manet`ze gabrazebulni dascqevlaven da itqvian): <<es aris brbo, romelic` (t`k`vent`an ert`ad) iqreba (jojoxet`shi)>>. (mat` upasuxeben): <<ar aris mat`t`vis ket`ili misalmeba [etqvian cqevlis miznit`], cheshmaritad, isini daicvebian c`ec`xlshi!>>

itqvian (allahis daumorch`ileblobashi mqop`t`) (mat`i mimdevarni): <<pirik`it`, t`k`vent`vis nu iqos ket`ili misalmeba! t`k`ven dagvidginet` es [sibneleshi sheqvana], da ra sashinelia es samqop`eli!>>
itqvian (isini, vinc` mihqvebodnen urch`ebs): <<(o,) up`alo ch`veno! vinc` mogvich`ina es [c`duneba da shec`domashi sheqvana], gauormage mas sasjeli c`ec`xlshi!>>
itqvian (ug'vt`oni): <<ra xdeba ch`vens t`avs? ratom ver vxedavt` adamianebs, romlebsac` (micier c`xovrebashi) c`udebad (da ubedurebad) vt`vlidit` [igulisxmeben g'arib morcmuneebs]>>.
nut`u davc`inodit` mat` (shec`domit`)? t`u (isinic` ch`vent`an ert`ad arian), (magram) ch`veni t`valebi mat`gan mibrunebulia [ubralod ver vxedavt` mat`]?>>
cheshmaritad, es -- uechvelad, sinamdvilea [es auc`ileblad ik`neba] -- jojoxet`is mkvidrt`a davoba.

ut`xari (o, moc`ik`ulo) (shens xalxs): <<cheshmaritad, me mxolod shemgonebeli var t`k`vent`vis, da ar arsebobs aravit`ari g'mert`i (t`aqvanisc`emis g'irsi), garda allahisa, ert`adert`isa, qovlismz'levisa.
up`ali zec`ebisa da micis, da imisa, rac` mat` shorisaa, didebulisa, mravalmimteveblisa.
ut`xari (o, moc`ik`ulo) (shens xalxs): <<es [qurani] -- diadi ucqebaa,
(risganac`) t`k`ven ganeridebit`.
ar mk`onda c`odna umag'lesi krebis [zec`iuri angelozebis] shesaxeb -- t`u rogor davobdnen isini (adamis shek`mnast`an dakavshirebit`), (sanam allahma ar mac`noba amis shesaxeb).
cheshmaritad, ch`emt`vis sht`agonebulia mxolod is, rom me (t`k`vent`vis) var nat`eli shegonebis momc`emi>>.
(da mouqevi mat`, o, moc`ik`ulo, is ambavi) roc`a ut`xra shenma up`alma angelozebs: <<cheshmaritad, me shevk`mni adamians t`ixisgan.
xolo rodesac` me mas srulqop`il saxes mivc`em da ch`avberav masshi ch`emi sulidan, mashin daemxet` mis cinashe [pativisc`emis nishnad] muxlmoqrilni>>
da daemxnen angelozni pirk`ve, qvelani ert`ad.
garda iblisisa -- man gamoavlina ampartavneba da ag'moch`nda urcmunot`a shoris (allahis daumorch`ileblobis gamo).

ut`xra [allahma]: <<o, iblis! ram shegishala xeli, rom damxobiliqavi mis cinashe, vinc` me ch`emi xelebit` shevk`meni? nut`u ampartavnebit` aivse (o, iblis) (adamis cinashe) t`u iqavi amag'lebult`agani (sheni up`lis cinashe)?!>>
t`k`va [iblisma]: <<me uket`esi var masze [adamze]: shen xom c`ec`xlisgan shemk`meni, xolo is - t`ixisgan shek`meni>>.
(allahma) ut`xra: <<mash, gadi ik`idan! [samot`xidan] uechvelad, shen k`vebit` ch`asak`oli xar (cqeuli xar).
da, namdvilad, shenze ik`neba ch`emi cqevla gankit`xvis dg'emde>>.
t`k`va (iblisma): <<o, ch`emo up`alo! momaniche gadavadeba im dg'emde, rodesac` isini ag'dgebian [sasamart`lo dg'isat`vis]!>>
ut`xra (allahma): <<cheshmaritad, shen imat`gan xar, visac` gadavadeba miec`a.
im dg'emde, romlis dro (mosvla) c`nobilia (mxolod allahist`vis)!>>
(iblisma) t`k`va: <<shens didebas vp`ic`av! uechvelad, gzas avac`den mat` qvelas (adamis sht`amomavlobas),
garda mxolod sheni im monebisa, romlebic` shen mier arian rch`eulni!>>
(uzenaesma) t`k`va: <<es aris cheshmariteba (ch`emgan), da me mxolod cheshmaritebas vambob,
uechvelad, me avavseb jojoxet`s shenit` (o, iblis) da imat`it`, vinc` shen gagqveba -- qvelanit`!>>

t`k`vi (o, moc`ik`ulo) (am urcmunoebs): <<me ar gt`xovt` t`k`vengan amisat`vis [imist`vis, rom cheshmaritebas gaz'levt`] aravit`ar jildos, da (t`k`ven ic`it`, rom) me ar var imat`gan, vinc` t`avs sxvad asag'ebs>>.
es [qurani] -- mxolod shegonebaa samqaroebist`vis [jint`at`vis da adamiant`at`vis].

da, uechvelad, t`k`ven (o, mravalg'mert`ianebo) sheitqobt` mis ambavs [imas, rom qurani cheshmaritebaa] garkveuli drois shemdeg [islamis gamarjvebis shemdeg, roc`a adamianebi jgup`-jgup`ad miig'eben am sarcmunoebas, da aseve male gaigebt` rodesac` mokvdebit`]!
am cignis [quranis] gardamosvla aris allahisgan, didebulis da brz'enis.
cheshmaritad, ch`ven gardmovavlinet` shent`vis (o, moc`ik`ulo) es cigni [qurani] cheshmaritebit`; amitom et`aqvane (mxolod) allahs, sheni rcmena mt`lianad mxolod mas miuz'g'veni!

cheshmaritad, sup`t`a(mravalg'mert`ianobisgan t`avisup`ali) rcmena allahisaa! isini ki, romelt`ac` aiqvanes mis garda mp`arvelebi (amboben): <<ar vet`aqvanebit` mat`, t`u ara mxolod imitom, rom dagvaaxloon allaht`an up`ro metad>>. cheshmaritad, allahi gansjis mat` shoris imas, rashic` ver t`anxmdebodnen. allahi ar daadgens scor gzaze imas, vinc` matquara, umaduria.
allahs rom enebebina daedgina shvili, usat`uod, airch`evda imisagan, rasac` k`mnis, rogorc` nebavs. dideba mas, igia allahi ert`adert`i, z'levamosili.

man gaach`ina c`ani da dedamica cheshmaritebit`. mosavs g'ames dg'eshi da mosavs dg'es g'ameshi. daimorch`ila mze da mt`vare [k`mnilebebist`vis sasargeblod]. qvela dac`uravs gansazg'vrul vadamde. nut`u is ar aris z'levamosili, qovlismimtevebeli.

man shegk`mnat` t`k`ven (o, adamianebo) ert`i adamianidan [adamidan], shemdeg ki misgan shek`mna misi c`oli [eva] da moavlina t`k`vent`vis rva cqvili sak`oneli [patara da didi rk`osani cqvilebi: ak`lemi, xari, verz'i, t`xa]. igi [allahi] gach`ent` dedat`k`venis sashvilisnoshi, ert` k`mnilebas meoris shemdeg [gansazg'vruli ganvit`arebis etapebit`] sam sibneleshi [sam shreshi: muc`elshi, sashvilisnoshi da plac`entashi/momqoli]. ai, is aris allahi[am qvelap`ris shemk`mneli] t`k`veni up`ali; mas ekut`vnis meup`eba. ar aris sxva g'mert`i [t`aqvanisc`emis g'irsi], garda misi; da rogor xart` (cheshmaritebisagan) gadaxrilni?!

t`u t`k`ven (o, adamianebo) ik`nebit` urcmunoni, allahs ar schirdeba t`k`vengan arap`eri, da ar iconebs igi urcmunoebas t`avisi monebist`vis. xolo t`u t`k`ven madlierni ik`nebit`, mas es moeconeba t`k`vent`vis. da ert`i matarebeli (c`odvisa) ar daitvirt`eba sxvisi tvirt`it` [aravis daekisreba sxvisi c`odva]. shemdeg ki t`k`veni dabruneba t`k`vens up`alt`an ik`neba. da is gagic`xadebt` imas, rasac` aket`ebdit`. cheshmaritad, man ucqis is, rac` mkerdebshia [sulis sig'rmeshia] (misi k`mnilebebisa)!

# rodesac` adamians sheemt`xveva gasachiri, igi mouxmobs t`avis up`als (st`xovs daxmarebas), mimart`avs mxolod mas. xolo rodesac` igi (allahi) misgan aac`ilebs gasachirs da misc`ems cqalobas, igi ivicqebs imas, rom adre mas mouxmobda, da allahs gautolebs sxvebs, rat`a sxvebic` sheac`dinos (cheshmariti) gzidan. ut`xari mas (o, moc`ik`ulo): <<isargeble sheni urcmunoebit` mxolod c`ota xnit` [sanam sheni sic`oc`xlis vada dasruldeba], radgan shen (shemdeg) ik`nebi c`ec`xlis [jojoxet`is] mkvidrt`agan ert`-ert`i!>>

(es urcmuno uket`esia) t`u is, vinc` srulad uz'g'vnis t`avs (allahis t`aqvanisc`emas) g'amis saat`ebshi, damxobili da loc`vashi mdgomi, morch`ili, shishit` maradiuli c`xovrebisa da imedit` t`avisi up`lis cqalobisa? ut`xari (o, moc`ik`ulo): <<gana t`anascorni arisn isini, vinc` ic`ian (t`aviant`i up`ali da cheshmariti sarcmunoeba) da isini, vinc` ar ic`ian?>> magram (am) shegonebas ismenen mxolod gonierebi.

t`k`vi (o, moc`ik`ulo): <<o, ch`emo monebo, romlebmac` ircmunet`, geshinodet` t`k`veni up`lis (sasjelis)! mat`, vinc` am cut`isop`elshi siket`es aket`ebdnen, siket`e ek`nebat` (aseve momaval c`xovrebashic`). da (cheshmaritad) allahis mica ganieria (da shesaz'lebelia gadasaxleba ik`, sadac` t`avisup`lad sheiz'leba allahze t`aqvanisc`ema). cheshmaritad, momt`ment` miec`emat` mat`i sazg'auri usazg'vrod!>>
ut`xari (o, moc`ik`ulo) (xalxs): <<cheshmaritad, me mebrz'ana allahis t`aqvanisc`ema, rcmenis srulad mxolod mist`vis miz'g'vna,
da mebrz'ana me, rom vqop`iliqavi pirveli muslimt`agani ch`ems sazogadoebashi [vinc` allahs daemorch`leba]>>.
ut`xari (o, moc`ik`ulo) (xalxs): <<meshinia, rom t`u me ch`ems up`als veurch`ebi, dameceva did dg'es [sasamart`lo dg'es] sasjeli>>.
t`k`vi (o, moc`ik`ulo): <<(mxolod) allahs vet`aqvanebi, ch`emi rcmena [ch`emi t`aqvanisc`ema] mxolod mist`visaa>>.

mash, et`aqvanet` (o, mravalg'mert`ianebo) visac` gindat` mis garda (da shemdeg mixvdebit`, rogori ubedureba dagatqdebat` im dg'es, roc`a t`k`vens up`als shexvdebit`) ut`xari mat` (o, moc`ik`ulo): <<cheshmaritad, namdvil danakargshi mqop`ni isini arian, vinc` sakut`ari t`avebi da ojaxebi caages ag'dgomis dg'es. diax! ai, es aris nat`eli danakargi!>>

mat`t`vis mat` zemodan c`ec`xlis ch`rdilebi ik`neba da k`veshac` c`ec`xlis ch`rdilebebi ik`neba. amit` allahi ashinebs t`avis monebs. o, ch`emo monebo, geshinodet` ch`emi [sasjelis] (sheasrulet` ch`emi brz'anebebi da ganeridet` ch`ems daumorch`ileblobas)!
xolo isini, vinc` ganeridnen c`ru g'vt`aebas, rom ar et`aqvanebinat` mas, da miubrundnen allahs, mat`t`vis aris sasixarulo ambavi. amc`ne ki (o, moc`ik`ulo) ch`ems monebs ket`ili c`noba.

vinc` ismens sitqvas da mihqveba mis sauket`esos [sauket`eso sitqvas -- allahis sitqvas da shemdeg misi moc`ik`ulis sitqvas]! aset`ni arian isini, vinc` allahma caruz'g'va (cheshmarit gzaze), da aset`ni arian -- gonebis mk`oneni.
nut`u is, vist`visac` gardauvalia sasjelis sitqva [vinc` jiutad dgas c`domilebashi da cheshmaritebas erideba]... nut`u shen (o, moc`ik`ulo) gadaarch`en imat`, vinc` c`ec`xlshia?

xolo isini, romelt`ac` eshinodat` t`aviant`i g'mert`is, mat`t`visaa ot`axebi, romelt`a zemot`ac` sxva ot`axebi ik`neba mocqobili. mat`[im ot`axebis] z'irs mdinareebi miedinebian, t`anaxmad allahis ag't`k`misa. allahi ki ar c`vlis t`avis ag't`k`mas.

gana ar ginaxavs, rom allahma zegardmoavlina c`idan cqali da mohp`ina cqaroebad dedamicaze? mere amoiqvana misit` micidan nat`esi p`erad-p`eradi. mere chkneba igi da xedav mas gaqvit`lebulad. shemdeg ak`c`evs igi mas natexebad. cheshmaritad, amashi shexsenebaa gonebis mk`onet`at`vis.

nut`u is, visi gulic` allahma gaup`art`ova islamisat`vis da visac` ak`vs sinat`le t`avisi up`lisagan, [t`anascoria imisa, visac` allahma rcmena ar misc`a?] vai mat`, romelt`a gulebic` gak`vavebulia allahis xsenebisat`vis! aset`ni ashkara c`domilebashi imqop`ebian.

allahma gardamoavlina sauket`eso ambavi [qurani] -- cigni, romlis nacilebi msgavsia, da ganmeorebadi [sadac` ganmeorebit` aris moqvanili mtkic`ebulebebi da ganmartebebi, istoriebi da debulebebi]. misgan zhruanteli uvlit` imat` kans, romelt`ac` eshiniat` t`aviant`i g'mert`isa. shemdeg ki mat`i kani da gulebi rbildeba allahis xsenebisat`vis (roc`a ismenen samot`xis dapirebas). es aris gza allahisa. allahi amit` [quranit`] caruz'g'vis, visac` isurvebs. xolo imas, visac` allahi gzas aubnevs, aravin eqoleba scor gzaze damdgeni.

nut`u t`anascoria is, vinc` t`avisi saxit` igeriebs qvelaze mz'ime sasjels ag'dgomis dg'es, da is, vinc` samot`xeshi imqop`eba sixarulshi? da (im dg'es) borotebs [mravalg'mert`ianebs] et`k`mebat`: <<gemo gausinjet` im [c`odvat`a] shedegebs, rac` sheiz'inet` (cut`isop`lis c`xovrebashi)!>>
cinat` mat`amde mqop`ni uarqop`dnen (moc`ik`ulebs), da movidoda mat`t`an sasjeli ik`idan, saidanac` isini arc` grz'nobdnen [saidanac` arc` elodnen].
allahma agema mat` damc`ireba micier c`xovrebashi; xolo imk`veqnis sasjeli up`ro didia, netav ic`odnen!
da ai, ch`ven moviqvanet` adamianebist`vis am quranshi sxvadasxvagvari magalit`ebi, rat`a dap`ik`rdnen.
(da movavlinet` igi) qurani arabul enaze, qovelgvari naklis gareshe [ar aris masshi simrude da bundovaneba], egebis allahis sasjelis shishi hk`onodet`!

allahs mohqavs magalit`i: kac`isa [mona], romelsac` ert`droulad ramdenime batoni hqavs da romelzec` es t`anamp`lobelebi ert`manet`s edavebian (da es mona dabneulia, rogor daakmaqop`ilos isini qvelani), da kac`i [mona], romelic` ekut`vnis mxolod ert` adamians (da zustad ic`is, ra surs mis batons). t`anascorni arian isini magalit`it`? dideba allahs! magram mat` [mravalg'mert`iant`a] umravlesobam ar ic`is!
cheshmaritad, shen (o, moc`ik`ulo) momakvdavi xar [mokvdebi], da cheshmaritad, isini (agret`ve) momakvdavni arian [isinic` mokvdebian].
shemdeg t`k`ven (o, adamianebo) ag'dgomis dg'es t`k`veni up`lis cinashe idavebt`[da ik` gairkveva simart`le].

da vin aris up`ro usamart`lo [qvelaze c`udi adamiani], vidre is, vinc` allahze c`ruoda [tquils t`xzavda] da cheshmaritebas sic`rued t`vlida, roc`a is movida [ar ircmuna cheshmariteba, romelic` moc`ik`ul muhammedze ik`na movlenili]. nut`u jojoxet`i ar aris urcmunot`a sasup`eveli?

xolo is, vinc` cheshmaritebit` movida (sitqvebsa da sak`meebshi) [moc`ik`ult`agan da mat` mimdevart`agan] da ag'iara igi (rcmenit` miig'o da sak`meebit` ganaxorc`iela) -- scored isini arian moshishni (allahis sasjelis shishis mk`oneni).
mat` ek`nebat`, rasac` inebeben t`aviant` up`alt`an. esaa sazg'auri ket`ilismk`mnelt`a.

rom allahma apatios mat` qvelaze c`udi, rac` (am k`veqnad) ch`aidines (mat`i sinanulisa da c`odvebisgan ganridebis gamo), da daajildovos isini uket`esit`, vidre rasac` ch`adiodnen [rat`a mianichos mat` samot`xe].

gana allahi ar aris sakmarisi t`avisi msaxurist`vis (rogorc` mp`arveli da mc`veli)? da isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] shen gashineben mis [allahis] garda sxvebit`(kerpebit`). visac` allahi gzas aac`dens [tovebs t`avisi xemz'g'vanelobis gareshe], (mashin) ar arsebobs misi scor gzaze damdgeni [romelic` mas cheshmarit gzaze daaqenebs].

da visac` allahi cheshmarit gzaze daadgens, mas veravin aabnevs [veravin shez'lebs mis shec`denas]. gana allahi ar aris didebuli (da) ar aris shurismgebeli? [gana allahi ver iz'iebs shurs t`avisi k`mnilebebidan mat`ze, vinc` urcmunoebas sch`adis da ar emorch`ileba mas?]

da t`u shen (o, shuamavalo) hkit`xav mat` [am mravalg'mert`ianebs]: "vin shek`mna c`ani da mica?" isini uechvelad itqvian: "allahma". ut`xari (mat`): "gana dap`ik`rebulxart` imat`ze, romlebsac` allahis garda (mouxmobt`) evedrebit` [t`k`vens g'vt`aebebs] t`u allahs ch`emt`vis (rame) zianis moqeneba moesurveba, shez'leben ki (me) misi (am) zianisgan mixsnan? an t`u is t`avis cqalobas inebebs ch`emt`vis, sheakaveben ki (am) mis cqalobas? (isini auc`ileblad itqvian: ara, g'vt`aebebs amis gaket`eba ar sheuz'liat`) ut`xari: "ch`emt`vis sakmarisia allahi, mas miendobian mindobilebi

ut`xari (o, shuamavalo) (am mravalg'mert`ianebs): "o, ch`emo xalxo! imok`medet` (rogorc` gindat`) t`k`veni unarisamebr [ramdensac` shez'lebt`], (da) cheshmaritad mec` (ase) vimok`medeb (rogorc` ch`emma up`alma mibrz'ana). da male gaigebt`,
vis (ch`ven shoris) mouva damamc`irebeli sasjeli [sasjeli amk`veqnad], da viszec` darch`eba maradiuli sasjeli [sasjeli saik`io c`xovrebashi]?

cheshmaritad, ch`ven gardmogivlinet` shen (o, shuamavalo) cigni (qurani) xalxist`vis cheshmaritebit`. vinc` scor gzas daadgeba, t`avist`visve daadgeba, xolo vinc` gzas asc`deba, t`avisda sazianod asc`deba. da shen (o, shuamavalo) ar xar mat`ze pasuxismgebeli [shen ar xar pasuxismgebeli mat` morcmuneebad k`c`evaze] (shen mxolod allahis shuamavali xar da shen mat` gadasc`em imas, rac` man gibrz'ana)

allahi ig'ebs sulebs mat`i sikvdilis zhams da mat`, romlebic` ar momkvdaran, z'ilshi [z'ilis dros suli aseve tovebs sxeuls.]. shemdeg is itovebs imas, vist`visac` sikvdili ganusazg'vra da abrunebs sxvebs dat`k`mul dromde. cheshmaritad, amashia sascaulebi moazrovne xalxist`vis.

t`u mat` allahis garda (t`aviant`i c`ru g'vt`aebebi) shuamavlebad (romlebic` mas cinashe shuamdgomlobas gauceven) airch`ies? ut`xari (mat`) (o, shuamavalo): "gana (miig'ebt` mat` shuamavlad, rogorc` t`avad ambobt`), mashinac` ki, roc`a mat` [c`ru g'vt`aebebs] arap`eri gaach`niat` da arap`eri esmit`?"
ut`xari (o, shuamavalo): "qvela shuamdgomloba sruliad allahs ekut`vnis. mas ekut`vnis sruli meup`eba c`at`a da micaze, shemdeg mast`an dabrundebit` (gankit`xvis dg'es).

da roc`a mxolod allahi ixsenieba, zizg'it` ivseba gulebi imat`i, visac` ar scams saik`io. magram rodesac` mis garda sxvebi [mat`i c`ru g'vt`aebebi] ixsenieba, isini xaroben (radgan mravalg'mert`ianoba mat` survilebs sheesabameba).
t`k`vi: "o, allah, c`at`a da micat`a shemok`medo, uxilavisa da xilulis mc`odnev! shen gansji shens msaxurebs imis gamo, rashic` isini (micier c`xovrebashi) ar t`anxmebodnen".

da usamart`lobis ch`amdent` rom hk`onodat` qovelive, rac` dedamicazea [mt`eli simdidre], da kidev imdenive mast`an ert`ad, isini namdvilad shest`avazebdnen mas gamosasqidad (t`avis gadasarch`enad) sashineli sasjelis ag'dgomis dg'es. da mat` allahisgan eucqat` [caredginat`] is [sasjeli], romelsac` ar moelodnen (rodesac` dedamicaze c`xovrobdnen).
da [gankit`xvis dg'es] mat` gamoashkaravdat` mat`i sak`meebi, [allahis uarqop`a da urch`oba], romlebic` (micier c`xovrebashi) moipoves, da daatqdat` t`avs is [sasjeli], romelsac` (adre) dasc`inodnen.

da rodesac` adamians ubedureba sheemt`xveva, is ch`ven mogvixmobs (daxmarebis sat`xovnelad). shemdeg, rodesac` ch`ven mas ch`vengan cqalobas vanichebt`, is ambobs: "es me allahis c`odnis gamo meboz'a (rom me amas vimsaxurebdi)". ara, es gamoc`daa (romelshic` c`xadi xdeba, misi msaxurebidan vin aris madlieri da vin -- urch`i), magram umetesobam mat`ganma ar ic`is (es) (da amitom allahis gamoc`das mis sach`uk`rad ag'ik`vams)!
ukve t`k`ves (es) imat`, vinc` mat`ze ucin iqvnen, da ver gadaarch`ines isini (allahis sasjelisgan) iman, rac` mat` moixveches, (verc` shvilebma da verc` simdidrem).

da eciat` mat` ubedureba t`aviant`i boroti sak`meebis shedegebit`, romlebic` t`avadve ch`aidines. da vinc` amat` shoris usamart`lobas sch`adis, isinic` daitanjebian t`aviant`i boroti sak`meebis shedegebit` da ver shez'leben gamarjvebas (misi sasjelisgan t`avis dag'cevas).
gana ar ic`ian, rom allahi visac` surs, gauzrdis sazrdos da visac` surs, sheuzg'udavs? uechvelad, amashi nishnebia morcmune xalxist`vis.

ut`xari (o, shuamavalo): "o, ch`emo msaxurebo, romlebmac` sakut`ari t`avis cinaag'mdeg gadaametet` [c`odvebis gamo], nu gaic`ruebt` imeds allahis cqalobaze! cheshmaritad, allahi srulad apatiebs c`odvebs (mat`, vinc` moinaniebs, raoden mz'imec` ar unda iqos es c`odvebi): radgan cheshmaritad, is aris mpatiebeli, shemcqalebeli!

da miubrundit` (o, adamianebo) t`k`vens up`als (mdablobit`a da sinanulit`) da daemorch`ilet` mas, sanam sasjeli dagatqdebat` t`avs, (radgan) mashin [rodesac` sasjeli mova] aravin dagexmarebat` [aravin shegecevat`].

da mihqevit` sauket`esos, rac` t`k`veni up`lisgan gamoc`xadda [quranshi moc`emuli brz'anebebisamebr imok`medet` da t`avi sheikavet` imisgan, rac` masshi akrz'alulia], sanam sasjeli moulodnelad dagatqdebat` t`avs, rodesac` mas verc` ki igrz'nobt`,

rat`a (shemdgomshi) sulma [adamianma] ar t`k`vas: "oh, vai ch`ems ugulebelqop`as allahis mimart`. da me mxolod ert`-ert`i viqavi imat`gan, vinc` dasc`inoda (allahis brz'anebas, mis cigns, mis shuamavalsa da morcmuneebs)".
an (rom ar t`k`vas kac`ma): "allahs rom ch`emt`vis (scori gza) ech`venebina, namdvilad vik`nebodi g'vt`ismoshisht`agani ".

an (rom ar t`k`vas), rodesac` ixilavs sasjels (allahisas), romelic` moic`avs mas gankit`xvis dg'es: "oh, netav kvlav mk`ondes sic`oc`xlis shesaz'lebloba, mashin allahis morch`ilebashi ert`gult`agani vik`nebodi!"
pirik`it`, mogivida shen ch`emi aiat`ebi, magram shen isini sic`rued miich`nie, gadidguldi da iqavi urcmunot`agani.
da ag'dgomis dg'es ixilav mat`, romelnic` allahze sic`rues ambobdnen, saxeebi gashavebuli ek`nebat`. gana jojoxet`shi ar aris samqop`eli ampartavant`at`vis?

allah ki gadaarch`ens (jojoxet`is sasjelisgan) mat`, vinc` p`rt`xilobda (mis sasjels), radgan mat` ukve ebrz'ana, rom carmatebulni qop`iliqvnen. arc`ert`i boroteba ar sheexebat` [jojoxet`is sasjelis ert` nacilsac` ki], da ar damcuxrdebian (imis gamo, rac` t`aviant` micier c`xovrebashi dakarges).
allahia qovelives shemk`mneli da is aris qovelives ganmgebeli.
mas ekut`vnis c`at`a da micis gasag'ebni. xolo romelt`ac` ar ircmunes allahis aiat`ebi, scored isini arian cagebulni.
ut`xari: "nut`u allahis garda sxvas mibrz'anebt`, rom vc`e t`aqvani, hei, umec`arno?!"
da ukve sht`agegona shen da mat`ac`, vinc` shenamde iqvnen (o, shuamavalo): "t`uki shen t`anaziars daudgen (allahs), ut`uod p`uchi gaxdeba sheni sak`meni da cagebult`a shoris ag'moch`ndebi".
pirik`it`, (mxolod) allahs et`aqvane da iqavi madliert`agani.

da ver sheap`ases mat` allahi jerovnad. da mt`eli dedamica mis muchshi ik`neba gankit`xvis dg'es, da c`ani daxveuli ik`neba mis marjvenashi. dideba mas! da is didebulia imaze, rasac` mas ut`anascoreben.

da ch`aibereba saqvirshi da gons dakargavs qvela, vinc` c`at`a shinaa da vinc` micazea, garda imisa, visac` allahi inebebs. shemdeg kvlav ch`aibereba masshi da aha, isini camomdgarni ik`nebian da daelodebian (angarishebas).

da (gankit`xvis dg'es) mica ganat`deba t`avisi g'vt`is nat`elit`, da daideba cigni [t`it`oeuli adamianis sak`meebis cigni], da cinascarmetqvelebi (romlebic` daamocmeben t`aviant`i t`emebis cinashe, rom mat` miutanes is, rac` allahma ubrz'ana mat`) da mocmeebi [ceris angelozebs], da mat` shoris gadacqvetileba cheshmaritebisamebr [sruli samart`lianobit`] ik`neba mig'ebuli, da mat` aravit`ar shemt`xvevashi ar dach`agraven [arc` mat`i ket`ili sak`meebi sheumc`irdebat`, arc` daisjebian im borotebist`vis, rac` ar ch`audeniat`].
da qovel suls srulad miezg'veba imisat`vis, rac` moimok`meda. da man (allahma) qvelaze uket` ic`is, rasac` isini sch`adiodnen.

xolo urcmunoni jojoxet`shi ik`nebian ch`aqvanilni jgup`-jgup`ad (ert`manet`is miqolebit`); da rodesac` mivlen mast`an, misi karibcheebi gaig'eba da misi mc`velebi etqvian mat` [urcmunot`]: gana ar mogividnen t`k`vent`an (allahisgan) shuamavlebi t`k`venidanve (t`k`venive cridan), romlebic` gikit`xavdnen t`k`veni up`lis aiat`ebs da gap`rt`xilebdnen t`k`ven am t`k`veni dg'is shexvedraze [rom gardauvlad shexvdebit` gankit`xvis dg'es]"? isini [urcmunoni] itqvian: "diax, (movidnen da gagvap`rt`xiles)". magram sasjelis sitqva (allahis mier dapirebuli) urcmunot`at`vis mtkic`ea
[uc`vleli]!
da etqvian mat`: "shedit` jojoxet`is karibcheshi [jojoxet`shi], (da darch`it`) shignit` samudamod!" da (raoden) c`idia ampartavant`a samkvidrebeli!

da cauz'g'vebian mat`, vinc` t`aviant`i up`lis (sasjelis) shishobda [ert`g'mert`ianebs, romlebic` mas emorch`ilebodnen], samot`xeshi jgup`-jgup`ad. da rodesac` isini ik` [samot`xest`an] mivlen, da misi karibcheebi gaig'eba da misi mc`velebi [angelozebi] etqvian mat`: "mshvidoba t`k`venze! t`k`ven ket`ilni xart`! [t`k`veni sak`meebi ket`ili iqo da t`k`veni sazg'auric` ket`ilia!] shedit` (bednierebis samqop`elshi) maradiulad dasarch`enad!"

da isini [morcmuneebi] itqvian (rodesac` ixilaven, ra moumzada mat` up`alma samot`xeshi): "dideba allahs, romelmac` sheasrula t`avisi ag't`k`ma da mogvc`a ch`ven mica (samot`xisa) memkvidreobad. ch`ven davbinavdebit` samot`xeshi, sadac` movisurvebt`". da ra shesanishnavia imat`i sazg'auri, vinc` ishroma [vinc` gulmodgined emorch`ileboda t`avis up`als]!

da shen (o, shuamavalo) ixilav angelozebs, romlebic` gars ertqmian 'arshs (allahis taxts) da ganadideben t`aviant` up`als, k`ebit` amag'leben mas. da mat` [qvela k`mnilebas] shoris [cheshmaritebit`, sruli samart`lianobit`] gadacqdeba, da ik`neba nat`k`vami: "k`eba-dideba allahs, samqarot`a up`als (misi cheshmariti da samart`liani samsjavros gamo)!"
haa miim.
cignis zegardmovlena allahisganaa, z'levamosilis, qovlismc`odnis.
c`odvis mimtevebeli, monaniebis mimg'ebi, sasjelshi mkac`ri, siuxvis mp`lobeli. ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda misi. mast`anaa dabruneba.
aravin kamat`obs allahis aiat`ebze, garda urcmunoebisa. dae, ar shegac`dindos (o, shuamavalo) mat`ma moz'raobam amk`veqnad (mat`i mshvidi gadaadgileba da mshvidi c`xovreba).

mat`ze adre uarqves nuhis xalxma da mat` shemdgom mosulma t`aobebma. da qoveli t`emi ganizraxavda t`avisi shuamavlis cinaag'mdeg, rat`a sheepqrot` igi, da c`ru argumentebit` davobdnen, rat`a amit` cheshmariteba gaek`arcqlebinat`. mashin me shevipqari isini. da rogori (sastiki) iqo ch`emi sasjeli.
da ase gamart`lda sheni g'mert`is sitqva urcmunot`a mimart`, rom isini c`ec`xlis binadarni arian.

(angelozebi), romlebic` atareben taxts (mocqale allahisas) da (angelozebi), romlebic` mis garshemo arian ganadideben, ak`eben mas, da (srulad) scamt` misi, da it`xoven (allahisgan) patiebas morcmuneebist`vis: "ch`veno up`alo, shen moic`av qovelives sheni cqalobit`a da c`odnit`!" apatie mat`, vinc` moinania da gahqva shens gzas [islams], da daic`avi isini jojoxet`is sasjelisgan!"

up`alo ch`veno, sheiqvane isini edemis bag'ebshi, romelic` ag'ut`k`vi mat`, da(aseve sheiqvane) mat` mamat`agan, meug'let`agan da sht`amomavalt`agan mart`alt`. cheshmaritad, shen xar z'levamosili, brz'eni.
da daic`avi isini borotebisgan(t`aviant`i c`udi k`medebis shedegebisgan). da visac` daic`av im dg'es borotebisgan, shen ukve sheicqale igi. da es aris diadi gamarjveba.

cheshmaritad, urcmunoebi (rodesac` jojoxet`s sakut`ari t`valit` ixilaven da sheiz'uleben t`aviant` t`avs) jojoxet`is angelozebi dauz'axeben mat`: "cheshmaritad, allahis siz'ulvili (im dros), rodesac` (micier c`xovrebashi) rcmenisken mogicodebdnen da t`k`ven urcmunoni darch`it`, (imaze) didi iqo, vidre t`k`veni siz'ulvili sakut`ari t`avis mimart` (axla)!"

itqvian: "ch`veno g'mert`o! shen orjer mogvkali da orjer gagvac`oc`xle. ch`ven vag'iaret` ch`veni c`odvebi. nut`u ar arsebobs gamosavali (jojoxet`idan), (rom davbrundet` micier sic`oc`xleshi, rat`a vic`xovrot` sheni morch`ilebit`)?"

es (sasjeli) t`k`vent`visaa (o, urcmunoebo), radgan rodesac` mocodeba (loc`vit`) mxolod allahisadmi iqo, t`k`ven ar ircmunet` [uarqavit` monot`eizmi], xolo rodesac` mas t`anaziarebi gauch`ines (t`u allaht`an ert`ad sxvasac` ag'iareben g'vt`aebad da t`aqvans sc`emen) t`k`ven ircmunebt`(es allahist`vis miug'ebelia). gadacqvetileba (mxolod) allaht`an, uzenaest`an, didebult`an aris.

is [allahi] aris is, vinc` (t`avis qvela k`mnilebashi) t`avis sascaulebs gich`venebt` da (mxolod is) gigzavnit` sarch`os c`idan, magram mxolod isini, vinc` (allahis nishnebze dap`ik`rebas mihqveba), quradg'ebas ak`c`even (gap`rt`xilebebs) [da sargebels ig'eben am nishnebidan]!
mash, mouxmet` allahs, misdami rcmenashi gulcrp`elebma(da nu mouxmobt` sxva c`ru g'mert`ebs), t`undac` sz'uldet` urcmunoebs.

(allahs) (ak`vs) amag'lebuli sap`exurebi(igi qovlad amag'lebuli da uzenaesia (da is) aris 'arshis (taxtis) mp`lobeli. (da misi cqaloba t`avisi msaxurebisadmi iset`ia, rom is) gzavnis suls [gamoc`xadebas] t`avisi gadacqvetilebit`, visac` moisurvebs t`avis msaxurt`agan [arch`evs mat`gan t`avis cinascarmetqvelebsa da shuamavalt`], rat`a gaap`rt`xilos (xalxi) shexvedris dg'is shesaxeb.

im dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es], rodesac` isini (samarxebidan) gamovlen (da t`aviant`i up`lis cinashe cardgebian), mat` shesaxeb arap`eri daemaleba allahs [arc` ert`i sak`me, romelic` mat` t`aviant` micier c`xovrebashi gaaket`es, dap`aruli ar darch`eba]. (da allahi itqvis): "vis ekut`vnis dg'es meup`eba?" (da shemdeg itqvis): "ert`adert` allahs, qovlismz'levels!"

dg'es qoveli suli miig'ebs (srul da samart`lian) sazg'aurs imist`vis, rac` moixvecha [micier c`xovrebashi]. da dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es] usamart`loba ar ik`neba. cheshmaritad, allahi scrap`ia angarishscorebashi!

da sheaxsene mat` [o, shuamavalo] momavali dg'e [gankit`xvis dg'e], rodesac` gulebi (mis sasjelis shishit`) miuaxlovdebian mat` qelebs, (da) isini sheikaveben (t`aviant` risxvas, shishsa da sevdas) sakut`ar t`avshi. usamart`loebs [mravalg'mert`ianebs] arc` axlobeli hqavt`, romelic` daexmarebat`, da arc` shuamavali, romlis sitqvasac` daemorch`ilebodnen [romelic` mat`t`vis up`lis cinashe shuamdgomlobas gaaket`ebda da romlis shuamdgomlobasac` miig'ebdnen].
mas ucqis t`valt`a g'alati [ucqis, rodis shehqurebs adamiani akrz'aluls] da rasac` malaven gulebi.
allahi ki gansjis (adamianebs shoris) cheshmaritebit` [samart`lianad], xolo isini, viskenac` mimart`aven (evedrebian), arap`ers cqveten. namdvilad, allahi qovlismsmeni, qovlismxedvelia!

gana ar imogzaures mat` [mek`k`is urcmunoebma da sxvebma] micaze [gana ar iqvnen isini iemenshi da shamshi] da gana ar dainaxes, ra
eciat` mat`, vinc` mat` ucin iqvnen ['ads, samuds da sxvebs]? nut`u isini [adebi da samudelebi] up`ro z'lierebi ar iqvnen mat`ze [mek`elebze] (p`izikuri) z'alit`a da micaze datovebuli kvalebit` [t`aviant`i shenobebit`]? da allahma moic`va (dasaja) isini mat`i c`odvebis gamo. da mat` ar hqavdat` mp`arveli (romelic` ixsnida mat`) allahisgan.
es imitom, rom mat`t`an t`aviant`i shuamavlebi c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebit` modiodnen, magram mat` uarqves, da sheipqro isini allahma. uechvelad, igi z'lieria, sastikia sasjelit`.
da ase gamovgzavnet` musa ch`veni nishnebit` [sascaulebit`] da c`xadi mtkic`ebulebit`.

p`araons (egviptis mmart`vels), da hamanas (p`araonis mindoils), da qaruns (romelic` uzarmazar simdidres p`lobda). (magram mat`, t`aviant`i ampartavnebit`, uarqves allahis shuamavlis, musas, mocodeba) da t`k`ves: "(is) (musa) jadok`ari (da) matquaraa!"

rodesac` is [musa] mat`t`an [p`araont`an, hamant`an da qarunt`an] ch`vengan cheshmaritebit` movida, mat` (uarqves es sascaulebi da) t`k`ves: "mokalit` mat`t`an morcmunet`a z'eni da datovet` mat`i k`alebi c`oc`xlad (rat`a monebad ik`c`nen da gvemsaxuron)!" magram urcmunot`a zraxvebi (mxolod) c`domilebashia [mat`ive maxe mat`ve ubrundebat`]!
da t`k`va p`araonma: "damtovet`, movklav musas da dae, mouxmos t`avis g'mert`s! cheshmaritad, meshinia, rom is [mose] shec`vlis t`k`vens religias an areulobas moacqobs k`veqanashi (egvipteshi)!
da t`k`va musam: "cheshmaritad, me mivekedlebi ch`ems g'mert`s da t`k`vens g'mert`s qoveli ampartavnisgan, romelsac` ar scams gankit`xvis dg'is".

p`araonis ojaxidan ert`ma morcmunem, romelic` t`avis rcmenas (xalxisgan) malavda, t`k`va: "kac`is mkvlelobas apirebt` imis gamo, rom ambobs: 'ch`emi up`ali allahia'?" da man t`k`vent`an moitana nat`eli nishnebi [udavo argumentebi] t`k`veni up`lisgan? t`u is [musa] matquaraa, mashin misi sic`rue mis cinaag'mdeg ik`neba; xolo t`u is mart`alia, mashin t`k`ven mogecevat` zogi is (ubedureba), rasac` gpirdebat`. namdvilad, allahi ar uz'g'veba gzas gadametebult` [romlebic` zg'vrebs sc`debian] (da) romlebic` (allahze) tquilebs igoneben!

o, ch`emo xalxo! dg'es xelmcip`oba t`k`ven gikaviat` da micaze (egviptis micaze) sxvebze upiratesoba gekut`vnit`. da vin dagvic`avs allahis risxvisgan [sasjelisgan], t`u is ch`ven gvecveva?" p`araonma t`k`va: "me mxolod imas gich`venebt` [girch`evt`], rasac` t`avad vxedav [rashic` sargebels vxedav ch`emt`vis da t`k`vent`vis]; da mxolod simart`lis gzaze migit`it`ebt` [gixmobt`]".

da romelmac` ircmuna (miubrunda p`araonsa da mis didebulebs), t`k`va: "o, ch`emo xalxo! namdvilad, meshinia, rom t`k`ven (t`u musas moklavt`) ise daisjebit`, rogorc` isini, vinc` (t`aviant`i cinascarmetqvelebis cinaag'mdeg) amboxdnen".

iseve, rogorc` mouvidat` nuhis (noes) xalxs, 'ads, samuds da imat`, vinc` mat` shemdgom movida. da allahi ar aris is, visac` t`avisi msaxurebist`vis usamart`loba surs [is ar dasjis mat`, t`u isini c`odvebs ar ch`aidenen].
o, ch`emo xalxo! namdvilad, meshinia t`k`vent`vis (sasjelis) urt`iert`shez'axilebis dg'isa [gankit`xvis dg'isa, roc`a daxmarebist`vis ert`manet`s dauz'axeben].
im dg'es, roc`a zurgshek`c`eulni gaik`c`evit`, ar geqolebat` allahisgan damc`veli. da visac` allahi gzas aac`dens, mas ar eqoleba gzis mach`venebeli.

uechvelad, t`k`vent`an iusup`i movida ucin c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebit`, magram t`k`ven echvk`vesh aqenebdit` imas, rac` man mogitanat`, sanam ar gardaic`vala. da mashin ki t`k`vit`: "allahi mis shemdeg moc`ik`uls ar gamogzavnis!" ase ac`dens gzas allahi mat`, vinc` zg'vargadasuli (da) echvebshia (allahis ert`g'mert`ianobashi)!

romelnic` daoben allahis aiat`ebze qovelgvari mtkic`ebulebis gareshe, romelic` mat` moevlinat`. didad saz'ulvelia (es sak`c`ieli) allahis da morcmunet`a cinashe. ase adebs allahi becheds qovel ampartavani tiranis gulze!
da ut`xra p`araonma (musas dac`invit`): "hei, haman, aashene ch`emt`vis (mag'ali) koshki, ik`neb mivag'cio gzebs -"

zec`is gzebs, rat`a musas g'mert`s shevxedo. radgan cheshmaritad, me vp`ik`rob, rom is [musa] matquaraa (romelic` ambobs, rom ch`em garda sxva up`ali arsebobs, rom is zec`ashia da rom man musa t`avis shuamavlad gamogzavna). da ase (satanam) p`araonis boroti sak`meebi gaalamaza da igi (scori) gzidan gadauxvia. da p`araonis mt`eli xrikebi (mxolod) dag'upvist`vis iqo.
da t`k`va im morcmunem: "ch`emo xalxo! gamomqevit`, me gagiz'g'vebit` scor gzaze".
o, ch`emo ero! es micieri c`xovreba mxolod (droebit`i) sargebelia, xolo cheshmaritad, maradiuli sic`oc`xle mudmivobis samqop`elia.

vinc` amk`veqnad borots ik`ms [ar daemorch`ileba allahs], is saik`ioshi mxolod misi c`odvis shesap`eris sasjels miig'ebs. xolo vinc` siket`es ch`aidens, (miuxedavad imisa), aris t`u ara is kac`i an k`ali, da (amavdroulad) (aris) morcmune, aset`i adamianebi shevlen samot`xeshi da ik` dajildovdebianu uangarishod [sheuzg'udavad].
o, ch`emo xalxo! ratom aris rom me mogicodebt` t`k`ven xsnisken, mashin roc`a t`k`ven momicodebt` c`ec`xlisken?!
t`k`ven momicodebt`, rom uarvqo allahi da t`anaziarad mivuch`ino mas is, ris shesaxebac` arap`eri c`odna ar gamach`nia, me ki mogixmobt` qovladz'lierisken da qovladmimteveblisken.

uechvelad, is, riskenac` me momixmobt`, ar ak`vs mas mocodeba (sargebeli) arc` amk`veqnad da arc` shemdgom c`xovrebashi. da uechvelad, ch`veni dabruneba allaht`anaa, da uechvelad, gadametebulebi (urcmunoebi da mravalg'mert`ianebi) -- isini c`ec`xlis mac`xovreblebi arian!
t`k`ven kidev gaixsenebt` imas, rasac` axla geubnebit` (roc`a sasjels ixilavt`). da me ch`ems sak`mes allahs vandob. cheshmaritad, allahi xedavs t`avis monebs!
da ixsna igi (morcmune kac`i) allahma mat`i mzakvrobis borotebisgan da ecia p`araonis xalxs sastiki sasjeli.

c`ec`xli, romlis cinashec` isini(p`araoni da misi momxreebi) dila-sag'amos arian cardgenilni (gansjis dg'emde). xolo im dg'es, roc`a dadgeba saat`i (ag'dgomis dg'e), (itqvian): <<sheiqvanet` p`araonis xalxi qvelaze mz'ime sasjelshi!>>

da aha, kamat`oben isini c`ec`xlshi. da etqvian uz'lurni (mimdevrebi) mat`, romelnic` ampartavnobdnen (mat` liderebs): "cheshmaritad, ch`ven t`k`veni mimdevrebi viqavit`, xoda, shegiz'liat` t`u ara, rom c`ec`xlis nacili mainc` agvaridot`?"

da t`k`ves k`edmag'lebma (liderebma): "qvelani ert`ad vart` masshi (jojoxet`shi)! cheshmaritad, allahma ukve gamoitana ganach`eni monebs shoris (t`it`oeuls miuch`ina is cili tanjva camebisa, rasac` imsaxurebs)!"
da t`k`ves mat`, romlebic` c`ec`xlshi arian (jojoxet`shi), jojoxet`is mc`velebs (angelozebs): <<uxmet` t`k`vens up`als, rom shegvimsubuk`os ch`vent`vis sasjeli t`undac` ert`i dg'it`!>>

t`k`ves mat` (jojoxet`is mc`velma angelozebma): <<gana ar movidnen t`k`vent`an t`k`veni moc`ik`ulebi nat`eli mtkic`ebulebebit`?>> t`k`ves: <<diax, movidnen>>.t`k`ves (mc`velebma): <<mashin t`k`ven t`vit`on uxmet` (up`als)!>> magram urcmunot`a mocodeba mxolod shec`domashia(radgan urcmunot`a vedrebas da t`xovnas ar sheismens allahi im dg'es)!

cheshmaritad, ch`ven auc`ileblad davexmarebit` ch`vens moc`ik`ulebsa da mat`, vinc` ircmuna, amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi da im dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es], roc`a cardgebian mocmeni [roc`a angelozebi, cinascarmetqvelebi da morcmuneni daamocmeben im xalxis cinaag'mdeg, romlebmac` uarqves allahis moc`ik`ulebi].

im dg'es, roc`a ushedego ik`neba usamart`loebist`vis [urcmunoebist`vis] mat`i bodishi. mat` elit` cqeva-krulva [isini moklebulni ik`nebian allahis cqalobas], da mat`t`vis (gamzadebulia) sashineli samqop`eli [jojoxet`i]!
da (vp`ic`av, rom) mivec`it` musas xelmz'g'vaneloba [t`ora da sascaulebi] da davutovet` israelis sht`amomavlobas memkvidreobad cerili [t`ora].
rogorc` xelmz'g'vaneloba (simart`lisaken) da shexseneba gonebis mk`onet`at`vis.
mash, gamoich`ine (moc`ik`ulo) mot`mineba, ramet`u allahis ag't`k`ma cheshmaritia. it`xove shendoba sheni c`odvist`vis da adide sheni up`ali k`ebit` sag'amos da dilit`.

uechvelad, isini, romelnic` davoben allahis aiat`ebze, qovelgvari mtkic`ebulebis gareshe, romelic` mat` moevlinat`, mat` gulebshi sxva arap`eria, t`u ara ampartavneba, romelsac` verasdros miag'ceven. mash, allahs miende! uechvelad, igia qovlismsmeneli, qovlismxilvelia.
ut`uod, c`at`a da micis shek`mna up`ro didia, vidre adamiant`a shek`mna, magram adamiant`a umravlesobam ar ic`is.

da rogor sheiz'leba t`anascori iqos brma da mxedveli? aseve ar arian t`anascorni isini, vinc` ircmuna da ag'asrula ket`ili sak`meebi, da borotmok`medi [urcmuno]. raoden mc`ired ixseniebt` (t`k`ven amas) (ramdeni mc`ire sargebeli gak`vt` shegonebebisgan)!
uechvelad, saat`i [gankit`xvis dg'e] auc`ileblad dadgeba -- aranairi echvi ar aris amashi, magram adamiant`a umravlesobas ar scams!

da t`k`va t`k`venma up`alma: <<momixmet` me [vedrebit`], da me gipasuxebt` t`k`ven! cheshmaritad, isini, romlebic` ampartavnoben ch`emdami t`aqvanisc`emashi, shevlen jojoxet`shi damc`irebulni (da sheurac`xqop`ilni)!>>

allahia is, romelmac` dagicesat` t`k`ven g'ame, rat`a daisvenot` masshi, da dg'e - danaxvis shesaz'leblobad (nat`eli). uechvelad, allahi didi cqalobis mp`lobelia adamiant`at`vis, magram adamiant`a umravlesoba ar aris madlieri.
ai, aset`ia allahi, t`k`veni up`ali, qovlisshemk`mneli. ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba mis garda. mash, rogorg'a ak`c`evt` zurgs (cheshmaritebas)?
aseve arian ac`denilni(allahisadmi rcmenisagan da mxolod misdami t`aqv anisc`emisgan) isini, romelnic` uarqop`dnen allahis sascaulebs.

allahi -- is aris, vinc` dagidginat` t`k`vent`vis dedamica samqop`elad, c`a ki -- saxuravad, da gagip`ormat` da gagilamazat` t`k`veni saxe-pirebi, da giboz'at` ket`ili sarch`o. ai, aset`ia allahi -- t`k`veni up`ali!didebulia allahi -- samqarot`a up`ali!
is aris maradc`oc`xali, ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba mis garda. mash, mouxmet` mas, misdami rcmenashi gulcrp`elebma. k`eba-dideba allahs, samqarot`a g'mert`s.

ut`xari (mravalg'mert`ianebs): "me amekrz'ala t`aqvani vc`e mat`, romelt`ac` t`k`ven mouxmobt` allahis garda, mas shemdeg, rac` ch`emt`an movida c`xadi mtkic`ebulebani ch`emi g'mert`isgan. da me nabrz'anebi mak`vs, rom davemorch`ilo samqarot`a g'mert`s".

is aris, romelmac` gagach`inat` t`k`ven micisgan, shemdeg cvet`isgan, shemdeg sisxlis shededebuli koltisgan, shemdeg gamoqavxart` ch`vilebad(dedis muc`lebidan), shemdeg rom miag'ciot` t`k`vens simcip`es, shemdeg rom gaxdet` moxuc`ebi. da t`k`vens shoris arian isinic`, vinc` kvdeba adreve. da (qvela es etapi xdeba) rat`a miag'ciot` gansazg'vrul vadas (sic`oc`xlis dasasrulamde). da ik`neb gons moegot`.
is (allahi) aris, vinc` ac`oc`xlebs da klavs. da roc`a is gadacqvets raimes, mxolod etqvis mas: "iqav!" da isic` ik`neba.
nut`u ar ginaxavs (o,shuamavalo), romlebic` allahis sascaulebze (aiat`ebze) kamat`oben, rogor arian isini gzasac`denilni (cheshmaritebisgan)?
(eseni arian) isini, romlebmac` tquilad ch`at`vales cigni [qurani] da is, rit`ac` gavgzavnet` ch`veni moc`ik`ulebi, magram male gaigeben isini [es urcmunoebi] (t`aviant`i urcmunoebis shedegs),
roc`a (gankit`xvis dg'es) mat` kiserze ik`neba saqelurebi (c`ec`xlisagan) da jachvebi (p`exebze), da mat` jachvebit` gaat`reven
