mdug'are cqalshi, da shemdeg c`ec`xlshi, sadac` daicvebian
shemdeg etqvian mat`: <<sad arian isini, romelt`ac` t`anamonacileebad ag'iarebdit` [g'vt`aebad ac`xadebdit` da t`aqvans sc`emdit` allahis garda]?>>
allahis garda? itqvian: "dagvekargnen isini(ar ch`anan). ara, ch`ven manamde aravis vt`xovdit`"(aravis ar vet`aqvanebodit` allahis garda). ai, ase aubnevs gzas allahi urcmunoebs.
(etqvian): es (sasjeli) imis gamo, rom dedamicaze usamart`lod xarobdit` da imis gamo, rom lxinobdit` (k`edmag'lobit` ik`c`eodit`).
shedit` jojoxet`is karibcheebshi, samudamod ik` dasamkvidreblad. raoden saz'agelia ampartavant`a samqop`eli.

mash, moit`mine! cheshmaritad, allahis ag't`k`ma cheshmaritia. da an ch`ven gach`venebt` imis nacils, rasac` shevpirdit` mat`, an mogivlent` sikvdils, da isini mainc` ch`vent`an ik`nebian dabrunebulni.

da ch`ven shenamdec` carvgzavnet` shuamavlebi. mat`gan zogiert`is shesaxeb giambet` shen, zogiert`is shesaxeb ki ar giambet`. da arc` ert` shuamavals ar z'aluz'da sascaulis moxdena, allahis nebis gareshe. xolo roc`a mova allahis brz'aneba, sak`me (cheshmaritebit`) samart`lianad gadacqdeba da mashin ki caageben sic`ruis mimdevarni.
allahia, romelmac` shek`mna t`k`vent`vis pirutqvi, rat`a zogiert` mat`ganze amxedrdet` da zogiert`i mat`ganit` ikvebot`.
da mat`shi t`k`vent`vis sargeblebia; da imist`vis, rom t`k`veni sulebis sachiroebebisamebr (sasurvel micebs miag'ciot`), t`k`ven mat`ze [c`xenebze] da gemebze zixart`.
da is gich`venebt` t`avis nishnebs [mravalric`xovan mtkic`ebulebebs] da allahis romel nishnebs uarqop`t`?

gana ar mogzaurobdnen isini [mek`k`is urcmunoebi da sxvebi] dedamicaze [gana ar iqvnen iemensa da shamshi] da (gana) ar ixiles, ra bolo eciat` mat` [vinc` allahs ar daemorch`ila], vinc` mat` cin iqo [aditebs, samudianebs da sxvebs]? isini [aditebi da samudelebi] up`ro mravalric`xovanni iqvnen, vidre isini [mek`k`elebi], da up`ro z'lierni (p`izikuri) z'alit`a da micaze datovebuli kvalebit` [mat`i shenobebit`]. magram ver ixsna isini [allahis sasjelisgan] mat`ma monapovarma.

roc`a moc`ik`ulebi c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebit` mividnen mat`t`an, mat` uxarodat` is c`odna, rac` mat` hk`ondat` (da rac` ecinaag'mdegeboda moc`ik`ulebis motanils), da daatqdat` mat` is (allahis sasjeli), rasac` dasc`inodnen.
xolo roc`a ixiles ch`veni sasjeli, t`k`ves: "vircmunet` ert`i allahi da uarvqavit` is, rasac` t`anaziarad vudgendit` mas".

magram mat`ma rcmenam ver ushvela mat`, rodesac` mat` ixiles ch`veni z'ala [sasjeli], allahis ganch`inebit`, romelic` ukve daatqda mis msaxurt` [iseve, rogorc` ar ushvela cina t`aobebs, rodesac` allahis sasjeli daatqdat` mat`]. da mashin (roc`a sasjeli mova) urcmunoebi cagebulni darch`ebian.
haa miim
gardmovlenili mocqalisa da shemcqaleblisgan
cigni, romlis aiat`ebi axsnilia quranis saxit` arabul enaze mc`odne xalxist`vis,
maxaroblad da gamp`rt`xileblad, magram mat`ma umravlesobam zurgi ak`c`ia da isini ar ismenen

da mat` [urcmunoebma] ut`xres (muhammads): "ch`veni gulebi dap`arulia(sap`arebelshia) imisgan, riskenac` mogvicodeb, ch`veni qurebi ki qrua, da ch`vensa da shens shoris aris p`arda (romelic` gvishlis xels, dagemorch`ilot`). mash, imok`mede (sheni rcmenisamebr), radgan ch`venc` (ch`veni rcmenisamebr) vimok`medebt`!

ut`xari (o, shuamavalo): "me mxolod t`k`venist`ana adamiani var, romelic` sht`agonebas vig'eb (allahisgan), rom t`k`veni g'mert`i ert`adert`i g'mert`ia. mash, scori gzit` iaret` misken da st`xovet` mas patieba. da vai(ra dg'e elit`), mravalg'mert`ianebs,
romelnic` ar ixdian zak`at`s da uarqop`en (ar scamt`) saik`ios c`xovrebas (samot`xes da jojoxet`s).
cheshmaritad, romelt`ac` ircmunes da hk`mnes ket`ili sak`meni, mat`t`visaa sazg'auri ucqveti.
t`k`vi: "nut`u t`k`ven uarqop`t` mas, vinc` shek`mna dedamica or dg'eshi da udgent` mas t`anascorebs? scored isaa samqarot`a up`ali!"

da daadgina masze [micaze] mqari [mt`ebi], (romlebic` amodis) mis zemot` [misi zedapiris zemot`]; da barak`a ch`ado masshi, da gaanacila masze sakvebi (misi mkvidrebist`vis) ot`x dg'eshi [or dg'eshi shek`mna mica da kidev or dg'eshi moacqo masze mt`ebi da sakvebi] - t`anabrad (qvela) mat`t`vis, vinc` ekit`xeba (amis shesaxeb) (mis shesac`nobad).

shemdeg man mimart`a c`as, romelic` (mag dros) kvamli iqo, da ut`xra mas [c`as] da dedamicas: "modit` (ch`ems morch`ilebashi) nebit`, t`u uneburad!" da mat` [c`am da dedamicam] t`k`ves: "ch`ven nebit` movdivart`".

da man ori dg'eshi daamtkic`a isini [c`ani] shvidad da t`it`oeul c`as t`avisi sak`me daucesa. da ch`ven uaxloesi c`a (romelsac` ch`vens zemot` vxedavt`) mnat`obebit` [varskvlavebit`] shevamket`, da davic`avit` (eshmakebisgan, romlebic` c`ashi allahis sitqvas eparebian). aset`ia (allahis) -- didebulis, qovlismc`odnis -- gangeba!
da t`u isini [urcmunoebi] zurgs shegak`c`even, mashin ut`xari (mat`): "me gagap`rt`xilet` sasjelze, rogoric` daatqdat` 'adsa da samuds".

rodesac` mat`t`an [adt`an da samudt`an] movidnen shuamavlebi, cinac` da ukanac` [qoveli mxridan], mat` ut`xres: "ar et`aqvanot` aravis, garda allahisa". mat` t`k`ves: "t`u ch`vens up`als eneba, is namdvilad gamogvigzavnida zec`idan angelozebs, da ch`ven ar gvcams imis, rit`ac` shen (ubralo kac`i) xar gamogzavnili".

rac` sheexeba 'adis xalxs, isini usap`uz'vlod ampartavnebdnen dedamicaze da ambobdnen (ampartavnebit`): "vin aris z'alaup`lebit` ch`venze z'lieri?" gana ar dainaxes, rom allahi, romelmac` isini shek`mna, z'alaup`lebit` mat`ze z'lieria? da mat` (aseve) uarqves ch`veni nishnebi [mtkic`ebulebebi].

da ch`ven movuvlinet` mat` ['adielebs] ubedurebis dg'eebshi c`ivi da xmauriani k`ari, rat`a amk`veqnad sirc`xvilis sasjelis simcare egemat`. da namdvilad, saik`ios sasjeli up`ro damamc`irebelia da mat` aravin sheeceva!

rac` sheexeba samudielebs, ch`ven mat` scori gza vuch`venet`, magram mat` sibrmave [urcmunoeba] arch`ies scor gzas, amitom mat` damamc`irebeli sasjelis mexi daatqdat` t`avs imis gamo, rasac` isini sch`adiodnen.
da vixsenit` isini, romlebmac` ircmunes da g'vt`ismoshishni iqvnen.
da im dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es], rodesac` allahis mtrebi c`ec`xlisken sheikribebian, mat` (angelozebi) sheakaveben.

da rodesac` mast`an [jojoxet`t`an] mivlen, [isini daicqeben t`aviant`i urcmunoebis da c`odvebis uarqop`as], magram mat`i smena, mat`i mxedveloba da mat`i kani daamocmeben mat` cinaag'mdeg imis shesaxeb, rac` mat` [sic`oc`xleshi] sch`adiodnen.

da itqvian [allahis mtrebi] t`aviant` kans (saqvedurit`): "ratom daamocmet` ch`vens cinaag'mdeg?" isini [mat`i kanebi] itqvian: "saubris unari mogvc`a allahma, romelmac` aalaparaka qoveli arseba", da man [allahma] shegk`mnat` pirvelad da mast`an dabrundebit`.

da ar p`rt`xilobdit` (c`odvebis ch`adenisgan) imis shishit`, rom t`k`veni smena, mxedveloba da kani t`k`vens sacinaag'mdegod daamocmebdnen (gankit`xvis dg'es), aramed p`ik`robdit`, rom allahma bevri ar ic`oda imis shesaxeb, rasac` sch`adiodit`.
ai, am t`k`venma carmodgenam, romelic` t`k`vens g'mert`ze gk`ondat`, dagg'upat` t`k`ven da ag'moch`ndit` cagebult`a shoris.

da t`u isini [allahis mtrebi] mzad arian moit`minon (sasjeli), mashin c`ec`xli [jojoxet`isa] ik`neba mat`i (saboloo) t`avshesap`ari (romlidanac` isini arasdros gamovlen), da t`u isini moisurveben cqalobis mig'ebas (allahisgan) (misi risxvis shemdeg), isini ar ik`nebian im cqalobis mimg'ebt`a shoris

da ch`ven gamovgzavnet` mat`t`an [urcmunoebt`an] t`anamgzavrebi [eshmakebi] (jinebidan da adamianebidan), romlebic` amshvenebdnen mat`t`vis imas, rac` cin hk`ondat` [boroti sak`meebi amk`veqnad] da imas, rac` ukan hk`ondat`, da mat`t`vis gamart`lda sitqva (rogoric` it`k`va) mat`ze cin mc`xovreb t`emebze, (jinebidan da) adamianebidan (rom isini jojoxet`is maradiuli mkvidrni ik`nebodnen). cheshmaritad, isini cagebult`a shoris ag'moch`ndnen.
da urcmunoebma ert`manet`s ut`xres: "nu mousment` am qurans da misi kit`xvisas atexet` xmauri, ik`neb sz'liot` (muhammeds) (da is kit`xvas shecqvets)".
da ch`ven, uechvelad, vagemebinebt` urcmunot` sastik sasjels da uechvelad, mivuzg'avt` mat` imis uaresit`, rasac` sch`adiodnen.

aset`i ik`neba allahis mtrebis sazg'auri - c`ec`xli [jojoxet`i]! mat`t`vis ik` [jojoxet`shi] maradiuli sac`xovrebelia, ch`veni nishnebis (micier c`xovrebashi) uarqop`is sazg'aurad. {es aiat`ebi saubrobs allahis cinaag'mdeg ch`adenil did danashaulze, romelic` adamianebs qurans ashorebs, ushlis xels mis mnishvnelobaze dap`ik`rebasa da mis miqolashi, nebismieri shesaz'lo sashualebit`.}

xolo urcmunoebma (jojoxet`shi qop`nisas) t`k`ves: "ch`veno up`alo, gvich`vene is ori jint`agan da adamiant`agan, romlebmac` gzas agvac`dines. ch`ven mat` p`exk`vesh daviqenebt`, rat`a isini qvelaze dablebshi iqvnen [rat`a jojoxet`is p`skerze ag'moch`ndnen, sadac` udidesi sasjelia]!"

uechvelad, isini, romelt`ac` t`k`ves: "ch`veni g'mert`i allahia" da shemdeg simtkic`e gamoich`ines, mat`ze gardmoevlinebian angelozebi (sikvdilis cin): "nu geshiniat` da nu damcuxrdebit` (imis gamo, rom am samqaros tovebt`), ixaret` samot`xit`, romelic` ag't`k`muli gk`ondat`".

ch`ven vart` t`k`veni mp`arvelebi amk`veqniur c`xovrebashic` da imk`veqniurshic`. da t`k`vent`vis masshi [samot`xeshi] (ik`neba) (qvelap`eri), rasac` t`k`veni sulebi isurveben, da t`k`vent`vis masshi [samot`xeshi] (ik`neba) is, rasac` it`xovt`".
maspinz'lobad mimteveblisgan da shemcqaleblisgan
visi sitqvaa uket`esi, vidre imisa, vinc` allahisken moucodebs, siket`es aket`ebs da ambobs: "cheshmaritad, mec` ert`-ert`i mat`gani var, vinc` daemorch`ila [muslimi gaxda]!"
ket`ili da boroti t`anascori ar aris. gamoiqene siket`e da mashin is, vinc` sheni mteri iqo, axlo megobarivit` gaxdeba.

da es [sat`noeba] ar enichebat` aravis, garda im adamianebisa, romlebmac` gamoich`ines mot`mineba (imis mimart`, rac` ar moscont` da aiz'ules sakut`ari t`avi, gaeket`ebinat` is, rac` allahs uqvars); da es [sat`noeba, borots siket`it` pasuxis gac`ema] ar enichebat` aravis, garda im adamianebisa, romlebsac` ak`vt` didi xvedri.
xolo t`u eshmakisgan raime c`duneba shegexeba, mashin allahs mimart`e mp`arvelobist`vis. uechvelad, igia qovlismsmeni, qovlismc`odne.
misi ert`-ert`i sascaulia g'ame da dg'e, mze da mt`vare. t`aqvans nu sc`emt` mzes, nurc` mt`vares, aramed t`aqvani ec`it` allahs, romelmac` shek`mna isini, t`uki mxolod mas et`aqvanebit`.

da t`u isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] ampartavnebas ich`enen (allahis cinashe t`aqvanisc`emast`an dakavshirebit`), mashin isini, vinc` shens up`alt`an arian [angelozebi] (ar ampartavnoben amashi da), ganadideben mas g'amit`a da dg'isit` da ar scqint` amisgan(ar modundebian t`aqvanisc`emisgan).

misi nishant`agania, rom shen xedav micas damshrals, da roc`a gardmovavlent` masze cqals, igi iz'vris da ip`urch`k`neba. uechvelad, vinc` gaac`oc`xla igi, mkvdret`it` ag'madgenelia. uechvelad, igi qovlisshemz'lea.

cheshmaritad, isini, vinc` ch`vens aiat`ebs zurgs ak`c`even [ar ag'iareben quranis cheshmaritebas da c`diloben mis damaxinjebas], ch`vent`vis dap`arulni ar arian! vin aris uket`esi: is, vinc` c`ec`xlshi [jojoxet`shi] ik`neba ch`aqrili, t`u is, vinc` ag'dgomis dg'es [allahis sasjelisgan] usap`rt`xod mova? aket`et`, rac` gsurt` (o, t`k`ven, cheshmaritebis uarmqop`elno), radgan, cheshmaritad, is [allahi] xedavs, rasac` aket`ebt`!
cheshmaritad, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes shexsenebis [quranis] mis shemdeg, rac` igi mat`t`vis moevlina (sastikad daisjebian). da cheshmaritad, es [qurani] namdvilad didi cignia [allahis mier dac`uli]!
verc` ert`i sic`rue ver miuaxlovdeba mas [am cigns - qurans], arc` cinidan da arc` uknidan [arc` ert`i mxridan], (radgan qurani) (aris) brz'enis, sak`ebaris zegardmovlena.

(mravalg'mert`ianebi) geubnebian (o, shuamavalo) imaves, rasac` eubnebodnen shenamde mosul shuamavlebs. (amitom, moit`mine allahisken mocodebis gzaze). cheshmaritad, sheni up`ali mpatiebeli da mkac`ria sasjelshi!

da ch`ven rom is [qurani] uc`xo enaze shegvek`mna, isini itqodnen: "netav misi aiat`ebi (arabulad) ganmartebuli qop`iliqo!" uc`xo enisa(qurani) da arabi(muhamedi)?!ut`xari (mat`) (o, shuamavalo): is [qurani] aris saxelmz'g'vanelo (rom ar asc`det` scor gzas) da gankurneba (uc`odinrobisa da misgan gamocveuli daavadebebisgan) morcmuneebist`vis; xolo urcmunoebs qurebshi smena ar ak`vt`, da es mat`t`vis sibrmavea. eseni (mravalg'mert`ianebi) imat` hgvanan, visac` shoridan ez'axian".

da ch`ven ukve mivec`it` musas cigni [t`ora], da (mis xalxshi) mast`an dakavshirebit` carmoishva ut`anxmoeba. [zogiert`ma adamianma ircmuna t`ora, sxvebma ki ar ircmunes igi.] (da shenma xalxmac`, o, muhammad, igive gaaket`a qurant`an dakavshirebit`.) da rom ara sheni up`lis sitqva (rom is aravis dasjas ar ich`k`arebs), romelic` adre iqo nat`k`vami, mashin, uechvelad, (ukve amk`veqnad) mat` shoris gadacqvetileba ik`neboda mig'ebuli [is mat` shoris urcmunoebs dasjida da morcmuneebs gadaarch`enda]. da (cheshmaritad) isini amashi [quranshi] namdvilad sac`dunebel echvshi arian.

vinc` mart`lad ik`c`eva [ket`il sak`meebs aket`ebs], sakut`ari t`avist`vis ik`c`eva [siket`e mas daubrundeba], da vinc` borots sch`adis, sakut`ari t`avis sazianod sch`adis, da sheni up`ali ar aris usamart`lo t`avisi msaxurebis mimart`.

(mxolod) mast`an brundeba c`odna ag'dgomis dg'isa [mxolod man ic`is] saat`is [gankit`xvis dg'is mosvlis] shesaxeb. da arc` xe ig'ebs naqop`s t`avisi kvirtebidan, arc` mdedri p`exmz'imdeba da arc` shobs, garda misi c`odnisa. da im dg'es, rodesac` is mat` [mravalg'mert`ianebs] dauz'axebs (am sitqvebit`): sad arian ch`emi t`anamoziareebi [c`ru g'vt`aebebi, romlebsac` ch`emt`an aigivebdit`]? - isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi] itqvian: ch`ven (axla) [gac`nobet`], rom ch`ven shoris arc` ert`i mocme ar aris (romelic` daadasturebda, rom shen t`anamozirareebi gqavs)
da daemalat` mat` isini, rasac` ucin evedrebodnen da gaac`nobieres [gaiges], rom mat`t`vis (allahis sasjelisgan) t`avis dag'cevis gza ar arsebobda.
kac`i arasdros cqvets loc`vas (allahisadmi) da siket`es it`xovs (amk`veqnad), magram rodesac` boroteba sheemt`xveva, is sasocarkvet`ilebas miec`ema (alahis cqalobis mimart`) da imeds kargavs.

da t`u ch`vengan cqalobas vagemebinebt` mas [adamians] im gachirvebis shemdeg, romelic` mas sheexo, ut`uod itqvis: "es me mekut`vnis da ar mgonia, rom samsjavros saat`i dadgeba. da t`u ch`ems g'mert`t`an davbrundebi, uechvelad, me mast`an sauket`eso melis". mashin ch`ven uechvelad vamc`nobebt` urcmunoebs imas, rac` mat` ch`aidines, da uechvelad vagemebinebt` mat` sastik sasjels.

da rodesac` ch`ven kac`s vcqalobt` [janmrt`elobas, simdidres da a.sh.], is zurgs gvik`c`evs da ampartavndeba (uars ambobs cheshmaritebis mig'ebaze). magram rodesac` boroteba sheexeba, is grz'el loc`vebs kit`xulobs [allahs bevrs st`xovs]. {ket`ildg'eobashi t`avis up`als ivicqebs da mas mxolod gasachirshi ixsenebs.}

ut`xari (o, shuamaval) (urcmunoebs): "gana dap`ik`rebulxart`, rom t`u is (qurani) allahisgan aris da t`k`ven mas ar ircmunebt`, vin aris up`ro gzasc`denili, vidre is, vinc` cheshmaritebast`an g'rma ut`anxmoebashia?".

male ch`ven vach`venebt` mat` ch`vens nishnebs mt`el samqaroshi [qvelgan da qvelap`ershi] da mat`shive [imashi, t`u rogor shek`mna isini allahma], rat`a nat`eli gaxdes mat`t`vis(am nishnebis shemc`nobis shemdeg) rom is(qurani) aris cheshmariteba. gana sakmarisi ar aris, rom t`k`veni up`ali qvelap`erze mocmea?

o, diax! namdvilad, isini [urcmunoni] echvshi arian t`aviant` up`alt`an shexvedrashi [echvi eparebat` sikvdilis shemdeg ag'dgomashi]! o, diax, namdvilad, man qovelive moic`va (t`avisi c`odnit`, z'alit`a da sidiadit`)!
haa miim
'ain, siin, qaap`
ase sht`agagonebs shen da mat`, romelnic` shenamde iqvnen, allahi, z'levamosili, brz'eni.
mxolod mas ekut`vnis qovelive c`ashi da dedamicaze; da is uzenaesi, didebulia!
lamisaa c`ani gaipos mat` zemodan. xolo angelozebi adideben t`aviant` g'mert`s k`ebit` da shendobas st`xoven mat`t`vis, vinc` dedamicazea. uechvelad, allahi mimtevebeli, shemcqalebelia.
xolo mat`, romelt`ac` mis garda mp`arvelebi gaich`ines, allahia mat`ze zedamxedveli. da shen mat`ze pasuxismgebeli ar xar.

da amgvarad [rogorc` cina cinascarmetqvelebs], shenc` sht`agagonet` (o, muhammad) qurani, arabul enaze, rat`a sheaxseno k`alak`t`a dedas [mek`k`as] da mis garshemo mc`xovrebt`, da gaap`rt`xilo shekrebis dg'is shesaxeb, romelshic` echvi ar aris. (da rodesac` qvela arseba shegrovdeba) zogi (ik`neba) samot`xeshi [morcmuneebi], zogi ki (ik`neba) c`ec`xlis alshi [jojoxet`shi].

da allahs rom eneba, mat` ert` sazogadoebad ak`c`evda [qvela adamiani ert` rcmenas iziarebda], magram t`avis cqalobashi [rcmenashi] shehqavs, vinc` mas(allahs) surs. da usamart`loebs [urcmunoebs] arc` mp`arveli hqavt` da arc` shemce!
nut`u mat` mis garda sxva mp`arvelebi gaich`ines? magram allahia cheshmariti mp`arveli. is ac`oc`xlebs mkvdrebs da is qovlisshemz'lea.

da qvelap`eri, rashic` t`k`ven ver t`anxmdebit`, gadacqveta (unda ez'ebot`) allaht`an. ai is allahi(romelsac` is t`visebebi ak`vs) aris ch`emi up`ali, mas mivende(maszea ch`emi imedebi qvelap`ershi) da mas vubrundebi monaniebit`.

c`at`a da micis shemok`medi! man shegik`mnat` meug'leebi t`k`venganve da cqvilebi pirutqvt`agan. amit` is gagamravlebt`(da gac`xovrebt`). aravin aris misi msgavsi! da is aris qovlismsmeni, qovlismxilveli!
mas ekut`vnis c`at`a da micis gasag'ebni. igi uxvad anichebs sarch`os, visac` inebebs, da amc`irebs (cils) (visac` moisurvebs).. uechvelad, man qovelive ic`is.

man dagidginat` t`k`ven rjulad is, rac` ubrz'ana nuhs, da rac` shen sht`agagonet` (o, muhammad) da rac` vubrz'anet` ibrahims, musas da isas, rom: "daic`avit` rcmena da nu gaiqop`it` masshi". mz'imea carmart`t`at`vis is, riskenac` mat` moucodeb. allahi irch`evs t`avist`vis, inebebs visac`, da t`avisken gzas uch`venebs mas, vinc` inaniebs.

da gaiqves mat` (sxvadasxva religiebad da mazhabebad) mxolod mas shemdeg, rac` movida mat`t`an c`odna (allahisgan), mxolod urt`iert`shoris boroti shurit`. da rom ara sitqva, romelic` cinascar iqo gansazg'vruli sheni up`lis mier gansazg'vruli vadit`, mat` shoris ganach`eni ik`neboda gamotanili. da mart`lac`, isini, romlebmac` memkvidreobit` miig'es cigni [t`ora da saxareba] mat` shemdeg [imat` shemdeg, romlebmac` ut`anxmoeba sheitanes simart`leshi], - isini namdvilad imqop`ebian amis mimart` gonebasabnevel echvshi.

amitom moucode (allahis msaxurt`) amisken [cheshmariti rcmenisken] (o, shuamavalo) da mihqevi scor gzas, rogorc` gibrz'anes, da ar gahqve mat` vnebebs da t`k`vi: "me mcams imisa, rac` allahma gardmoavlina cerilshi [qvela im cignshi, romelic` allahma t`avis shuamavalt` gamouc`xada]. da me mebrz'ana, rom samart`liani viqo t`k`ven shoris! allahi ch`veni up`alia da t`k`veni up`ali; ch`ven ch`veni sak`meebi gvak`vs, t`k`ven ki -- t`k`veni sak`meebi. ch`vensa da t`k`ven shoris aranairi mtkic`ebuleba ar aris [t`k`vent`an kamat`i uazroa] (mas shemdeg, rac` cheshmariteba c`xadi gaxda). allahi (qvelas) shegvkrebs (ag'dgomis dg'es) (da samart`lianad gangvsjis). da mast`anaa dabruneba!"

xolo isini, romelnic` davoben allahis shesaxeb, mas shemdeg, rac` mas(islams) upasuxes(miig'es islami), mat`i argumentebi up`lis cinashe usargebloa da mat`ze risxvaa (allahisgan) (amk`veqnad), da mat`t`vis mcare sasjelia [jojoxet`i]!
g'mert`ia is, romelmac` gardmoavlina cigni cheshmaritebit` da sascori. da ra ic`i (o, shuamavalo), ik`neb saat`i [gankit`xvis dg'e] (ukve) axlosaa!

mis dach`k`arebas it`xoven isini, visac` misi ar scamt`, xolo morcmuneebs ki eshiniat` misi da ic`ian, rom is cheshmaritebaa. uechvelad, isini, vinc` (ag'dgomis)saat`ze davoben, shoreul c`domilebashi arian.
allahi lmobieria t`avis monat`a mimart`. igi sarch`os uboz'ebs, visac` inebebs. da igia qovladz'lieri, z'levamosili.
visac` imk`veqniuri mosavali surs, ch`ven gavumravlebt` mas t`avis mosavals. xolo visac` amk`veqniuri mosavali surs, ch`ven mivc`emt` mas ik`idan, da imk`veqnad mas cili ar ek`neba

an ik`neb mat` hqavt` t`anaziarni, romlebic` mat`t`vis religiashi daadgines is, rac` allahma ar daushva? da rom ara sitqva daqop`is shesaxeb, mat` shoris ukve ik`neboda gadacqvetili. namdvilad, usamart`loebs mtkivneuli sasjeli elit`!

ixilav usamart`loebs shez'rcunebult` imis gamo, rac` moixveches, da is ecevat` mat`. xolo romelt`ac` ircmunes da ket`ili sak`meebi aket`es, samot`xis bag'ebshi ik`nebian. mat`t`visaa, rasac` inebeben t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe. ai, esaa udidesi cqaloba.

es aris is, rit`ac` axarebs allahi t`avis monebs, romelt`ac` ircmunes da ket`ili sak`meebi aket`es. ut`xari: "me ar gt`xovt` amist`vis sazg'aurs, garda siqvarulisa axloblebis mimart`". da vinc` siket`es ch`aidens, ch`ven mas siket`es gavumravlebt`. cheshmaritad, allahi mimtevebelia, madlieria.

an isini itqvian: "man [muhammadma] allahis shesaxeb sic`rue shet`xza!" allahs rom eneba, shens guls dagiluk`avda, da allahi gaanadgurebda sic`rues da t`avisi sitqvebit` daadasturebda cheshmaritebas. cheshmaritad, man ic`is, ra aris (misi) k`mnilebebis gulebshi!
is aris, romelic` ig'ebs monaniebas t`avis msaxurt`agan da patiobs c`odvebs da ic`is, rasac` t`k`ven sch`adixart`
da pasuxobs (allahi)mat`, romlebmac` ircmunes da ket`ili sak`meebi aket`es, da igi t`avisi siuxvidan daumatebs mat`(t`avis cqalobas). xolo urcmunoebs --mat`t`vis ik`neba mkac`ri sasjeli [jojoxet`i].

allahs rom t`avisi msaxurebist`vis sarch`o gaemravlebina [miec`a mat`t`vis sachiroze meti], isini uechvelad ch`aidendnen borot sak`meebs dedamicaze, magram is amc`irebs [sarch`os] gansazg'vrul zomamde, rogorc` mas surs [zogiert`s mdidars xdis, zogiert`s ki -- g'aribs]: (radgan) namdvilad, igi qovlismc`odnea [ic`is, ra aris mat`t`vis sasiket`o], da qovlismxedvelia t`avisi msaxurebis mimart`!
da mxolod is [allahi] aris, vinc` cvimas mouvlens, mas shemdeg roc`a isini (mis mosvlaze) sasocarkvet`ilni arian, da gaavrc`elebs t`avis cqalobas. da is aris mp`arveli, sak`ebari!

da misi nishnebidan aris c`at`a da micat`a shek`mna da im c`xovelt`a shek`mna, romlebic` man mat`shi gap`anta. da mas z'aluz's mat`i (sikvdilis shemdeg, samsjavro dg'es cardgenisat`vis) shekreba, roc`a moisurvebs!
da rac` gansac`deli geciat`, t`k`venive xelit` namok`medaris gamoa, da is bevrs patiobs.
da t`k`ven ver sheasustebt` (allahis z'alas) dedamicaze [ver gaek`c`evit` mis sasjels], da ar gqavt` mp`arveli da arc` damxmare
da mis nishant`agania zg'vashi mt`ebivit` moc`urave xomaldebi.
t`u inebebs, daacqnarebs k`ars da isini gach`erdebian mis(zg'vis) zurgze. cheshmaritad, amashia nishnebi qoveli momt`menisa da madlierist`vis.
anda dag'upavs [daaxrch`obs] mat` imis gamo, rac` moixveches, da (aseve) is bevrs patiobs.
dae ic`odnen imat`, vinc` ch`vens nishnebs edaveba (qalbi argumentebit`), rom mat`t`vis (allahis sasjelisgan) t`avis dag'cevis gza ar arsebobs!
rac` ki ram geboz'at`, amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis sazrdoa. xolo is, rac` allaht`anaa, uket`esia da maradiuli mat`t`vis, romelt`ac` ircmunes da t`aviant` g'mert`s endobian.
da romelnic` eridebian did c`odvebsa da saz'agel sak`meebs, da rodesac` ganrisxdebian (vinmeze), patioben
da romelt`ac` upasuxes t`aviant` up`als da ag'avlines loc`va, da romelt`a sak`meebic` urt`iert`shoris t`at`birit` cqdeba, da imisgan, rac` ch`ven vuboz'et`, gaig'eben.
da isini, vinc` t`avdasxmisas sapasuxo zomebs ig'eben (da zg'vars ar sc`debian).
da borotebis sazg'auri msgavsi borotebaa. xolo vinc` apatiebs da morigdeba, misi sazg'auri allahzea. uechvelad, mas ar uqvars usamart`loni.
da namdvilad, vinc` (t`avs damtqdari usamart`lobis shemdeg) shurs iz'iebs, aset` adamianze ar aris saqveduri.
gza [gamoscorebisa] mxolod mat`t`visaa, vinc` adamianebs acqeninebs da dedamicaze usamart`lod borot sak`meebs sch`adis. aset`ebs mtkivneuli sasjeli moelis (gankit`xvis dg'es)!
xolo vinc` moit`mens da apatiebs, uechvelad, es udides sak`met`agania
da visac` gzaabneulad ak`c`evs allahi, mist`vis ar ik`neba mp`arveli mis shemdgom. da shen ixilav usamart`loebs, roc`a ixilaven sasjels, itqvian: "nut`u ar arsebobs ukan dasabrunebeli raime gza?"

da shen (o, shuamavalo) ixilav mat` cardgenilt` mis(jojoxet`is c`ec`xlis) cinashe, daxrilt` sirc`xvilisgan, dabla rom uqureben (shishisgan). da morcmuneni itqvian: "cheshmaritad, dazaralebulni isini arian, romlebmac` sashinel dg'es sakut`ar t`avs da t`aviant` ojaxebs (jojoxet`shi shesvlit`) ziani miaqenes!" ho, cheshmaritad, usamart`loebi mudmiv sasjelshi (jojoxet`shi) ik`nebian!

da mat` ar eqolebat` mp`arvelebi, romlebic` daexmarebodnen (allahis sasjelisgan gak`c`evashi) allahis garda. da visac` allahi (amk`veqnad) gzas aubnevs (t`avisi urcmunoebisa da uzneobis gamo), mist`vis (amk`veqnad cheshmaritebisa da imk`veqnad samot`xeshi moxvedris) gza ar ik`neba!

upasuxet` t`k`vens up`als (o, urcmunoebo), sanam dadgeba is dg'e [gankit`xvis dg'e], romlisganac` ukan dasaxevi gza ar aris allahisgan. im dg'es (gankit`xvis dg'es) arc` t`avshesap`ari gek`nebat` (allahis sasjelisgan) da arc` t`k`veni danashaulebis uarqop`as shez'lebt`!

magram t`u isini zurgs shegak`c`even, mashin ch`ven ar gagagzavnet` shen (o, shuamavalo) mat` meurved (romelic` mat` k`medebebs daic`avda da shemdeg allahisgan mat` gamo angarishs ch`aabarebda). sheni movaleoba mxolod gzavnilis mitanaa. da namdvilad, rodesac` ch`ven adamians ch`veni cqalobis gemos vasinjavt` (simdidrisa da sxva siket`eebis minichebit`), is masze xarobs, xolo t`u mas ziani [sig'aribe, avadmqop`oba da sxva] sheemt`xveva imis gamo, rac` misma xelebma moimok`meda, mashin adamiani umaduria (t`vlis t`avis ubedurebebs da avicqdeba allahis mier boz'ebuli cqalobani).
allahs ekut`vnis c`at`a da micis meup`eba. is k`mnis, rasac` inebebs. visac` inebebs, uboz'ebs k`alishvilebs, da visac` inebebs, uboz'ebs vazhishvilebs.
an ert`ad uboz'ebs mat` vazhebsa da k`alebs, da visac` inebebs, ushvilod tovebs. uechvelad, igi qovlismc`odne, qovlisshemz'lea.

da allahs ar usaubria kac`t`an, garda (mxolod) zesht`agonebis meshveobit` (romelic` mas gardmoevlina zesht`agonebit` sinamdvileshi an sizmarshi), an p`ardis mig'ma (rodesac` kac`ma is gaigona, magram ver ixila), an gagzavna shuamavali [jabrail angelozi], (romelmac`) misi(allahis) nebit` [adamians] aucqa is, rac` ineba(allahma). cheshmaritad, igi amag'lebuli, brz'enia!

da ai, ase sht`agagonet` shen suli(qurani) ch`veni brz'anebit`. shen ar ic`odi, ra iqo cigni da arc` rcmena, magram ch`ven igi(qurani) vk`menit` sinat`led, romlit`ac` vadgent` scor gzaze ch`vens monat`agan imas, visac` vinebebt`. da uechvelad, shen miut`it`eb scor gzaze.
allahis gzaze, romelsac` ekut`vnis qovelive, rac` c`at`a shinaa da rac` micazea. uechvelad, allaht`an brundeba qoveli sak`me
ha mim
vp`ic`av c`xad cigns
cheshmaritad, ch`ven is [cigni] vk`menit` arabul quranad (arabul enaze), rat`a dap`ik`rdet`(rat`a mixvdet` mis mnishvnelobas).
da cheshmaritad, is [qurani] ch`vent`an, deda cignshia [dac`ul dap`ashi], da is namdvilad amag'lebuli da brz'nulia!
gana zurgs vik`c`evt` t`k`vengan da shegonebas mogaklebt` imis gamo, rom zg'vargadasuli xalxi xart`(t`k`veni kerpt`aqvanisc`emlobit`a da sxva c`odvebit`)?
da ramdeni cinascarmetqveli carvgzavnet` cina t`aobebshi
da ar misula mat`t`an arc` ert`i shuamavali, rom ar dasc`inodnen mas.
da ch`ven davg'upet` vinc` mat`ze [qureishebze] z'lierni iqvnen, da cina t`aobebis magalit`ebic` cavida (mat`i urcmunoebisa da shuamavalt`a dac`invis gamo rac` daemart`at`) ukve ik`na naxsenebi.
da t`u hkit`xav mat`: "vin shek`mna c`ani da mica?" uechvelad getqvian: "isini shek`mna z'levamosilma, qovlismc`odnem".
romelmac` gagich`inat` t`k`ven dedamica brtqelad da gagich`inat` masze gzebi, rat`a scori gzit` iarot`.

da man ch`amoavlina cqali [cvima] c`idan zomieri raodenobit`. da ch`ven amit` [am cqlit`] gavac`oc`xlet` usic`oc`xlo [mshrali] mica. ai ase, gamoxvalt` [t`k`veni sap`lavebidan gac`oc`xlebulni] (gankit`xvis dg'es)!
da romelmac` shek`mna qvela cqvilebi [c`xoveli t`u mc`enare] da dagicesat` t`k`ven xomaldebi da pirutqvi, romlebzec` mgzavrobt`.
rat`a mot`avsdet` mat` zurgebze, shemdeg gaixsenot` t`k`veni g'mert`is cqaloba, roc`a masze mot`avsdebit`, da t`k`vat`: "dideba mas, vinc` dagvimorch`ila es, da ch`ven ar viqavit` amis shemz'leni
da uechvelad, ch`ven ch`vens up`alt`an davbrundebit`(sikvdilis shemdeg)

da mat` [urcmunoebma] zogiert`i misi msaxurt`agani mast`an t`anaziarni gaxades [mas shvilebi da t`anaziarni miaceres]. cheshmaritad, (urcmuno) adamiani ashkarad umaduria [g'iad uarqop`s allahis mier mist`vis boz'ebul cqalobebs]!

nut`u ggoniat`, rom man t`avisi k`mnilebidan asulebi aiqvana (t`k`vit`, rom angelozebi, t`it`k`osda, allahis asulebi arian) da t`k`ven ki vazhebis ch`uk`ebit` gamogarch`iat`?!(t`k`ven ki vazhebi giboz'at`?!)
roc`a ert`-ert` mat`gans axareben imas [k`alishvili sheez'inat`], rac` mocqales miacera magalit`ad [rom mas hqavs k`alishvilebi], misi saxe shavdeba da igi mcuxarebit` ivseba
nut`u mat` (allahs) miaceren [k`alishvils], romelic` mort`ulobebshi izrdeba da argumentshi t`avs nat`lad ver gamoxatavs?

da mat` [urcmunoebma] angelozebs, romlebic` qovladmocqalis (allahis) monebi arian, k`alebi [allahis k`alishvilebi] ucodes. nut`u isini [angelozebis] shek`mnisas damscre iqvnen? mat`i [c`ru] cameba ch`aicereba (sak`met`a cignshi) da mat` amis shesaxeb (gankit`xvis dg'es) hkit`xaven!
da t`k`ves: "usazg'vro mocqalebis mk`ones [allahs] rom eneba, mat` [mis garda sxvas] ar vemsaxurebodit`!" mat` amis shesaxeb arap`eri ic`ian da mxolod itquebian!
gana ch`ven mivec`it` mat` amis [quranis] cin raime cigni, romelsac` isini ic`aven(mtkic`ed)?
o, ara! mat` t`k`ves: "cheshmaritad, ch`ven vipovet` ch`veni mamebi, romlebic` garkveul gzas [scavlebas] mihqvebodnen, da ch`venc`, uechvelad, mat` kvals mivqvebit`".
da aseve, shenamde arc`ert` dasaxlebashi ar mogvivlenia shemgonebeli, rom mis p`up`unebashi mc`xovrebt` ar et`k`vat`: "ch`ven vpovet` ch`veni mamebi ert` religiaze da ch`ven mat` kvals mivqvebit`".
ut`xra: "t`undac` rom imaze uket`esi gzit` movedi t`k`vent`an, vidre is, razec` t`k`veni mamebi ipovet`?" mat` upasuxes: "cheshmaritad, ch`ven ar gvcams is, rit`ac` movlinebulni xart`".
da ch`ven shuri viz'iet` mat`ze [cinat` mqop` xalxze]. da shexede, rogori iqo mtquart`a ag'sasruli.
da aha, ut`xra ibrahimma mamamiss da t`avis xalxs: "cheshmaritad, me ar mak`vs cili imashi, rasac` t`k`ven et`aqvanebit`".
garda imisa, vinc` me shemk`mna, da is damaqenebs cheshmarit gzaze
da daadgina [ibrahimma] igi caruval sitqvad mis sht`amomavlobashi, egebis dabrundnen [ert`g'mert`ianobaze].

magram me [allahma] mat` da mat` mamebs neba mivec`i, gamoeqenebinat` [ar davach`k`are mat`i urcmunoebist`vis sasjelit`], sanam mat`t`an movida cheshmariteba [qurani] da ganmmartebeli mac`ne [muhammadi]!
xolo roc`a moevlinat` mat` cheshmariteba, t`k`ves: "es jadok`robaa da ch`ven misi uarmqop`elni [urcmunoni] vart`".
da t`k`ves: "ratom ar gardmoevlina es qurani ori k`alak`idan [mek`k`adan da taip`idan] romelime didebul kac`ze?"

gana isini anacileben sheni g'mert`is cqalobas? ch`ven gavanacilet` mat` shoris mat`i sarch`o-sabadebeli amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi da zogiert`i mat`gani zogiert`ze sap`exurebit` avamag'let`, rat`a ert`manet`i samsaxurshi ch`aeqenebinat`. da sheni g'mert`is cqaloba imaze uket`esia, rasac` isini agroveben.

da rom ara sashishroeba, rom adamianebi ert` sazogadoebad (urcmunot`a) ik`c`eodnen (im azrit`, rom adamianis simdidre allahis siqvarulis nishania), ch`ven namdvilad vuzrunvelvqop`dit` mocqalis mimart` urcmunot`at`vis saxlebs verc`xlis saxuravebit`a da kibeebit`, romlebit`ac` isini zevit` aivlidnen.
da mat`i saxlebist`vis karebs da taxtebs, romlebzec` camocvebodnen
da ok`ros samkaulebsac`. da qovelive es mxolod amk`veqniuri c`xovrebis seket`eebia, xolo maradiuli c`xovreba shens g'mert`t`an g'vt`ismoshisht`at`visaa.

da vinc` zurgs ak`c`evs shemcqnareblis shexsenebas [qurans], ch`ven davudgent` mas satanas [amk`veqnad], romelic` ik`neba misi t`anamgzavri [romelic` ubiz'gebs mas akrz'alulis ch`adenashi da ashorebs nebadart`ulisgan].
da uechvelad, isini [satanebi] ac`denen mat` [cheshmarit] gzas da hgoniat`, rom scor gzaze dganan.

da rodesac` is [urcmuno] mova ch`vent`an (gankit`xvis dg'es), itqvis: "o, netav qop`iliqo ch`emsa da shens [satanas] shoris ori ag'mosavlet`is [dasavlet`idan ag'mosavlet`amde] manz'ili! ra saz'ageli xar t`anamgzavrad!"

da (etqvian mat` gankit`xvis dg'es): "arap`rit` ar shegecevat` dg'es, radgan usamart`loba(mravalg'mert`ianoba da sxva c`odvebi) ch`aidinet` (dedamicaze), is rom qvela ert`ad daisjebit` (jojoxet`shi) [sasjeli t`k`ven shoris ar gaiqop`a da t`it`oeuls sakut`ari cili moxvdeba, da arc` t`k`veni kerpebi itvirt`aven t`k`vens magier sasjels ]."
gana shen qrus gaagoneb, an brmas daadgen scor gzaze da imas, vinc` ashkara c`domilebashia?
da t`undac` cagiqvanot` shen [amk`veqnidan] [o,shuamaval], ch`ven mat`ze shurs mainc` viz'iebt` [saik`ioshi]
an gich`venebt` imas, rasac` shevpirdit` mat`, radgan ch`ven mat`ze z'algviz's.
mash, mtkic`ed ch`aechide imas, rac` shen sht`agegona. uechvelad, shen scor gzaze dgaxar.
da uechvelad, igi [qurani] namdvilad xsenebaa(pativia) shent`vis da sheni xalxist`vis. da t`k`ven mogekit`xebat`(misadmi rcmena).
hkit`xe shenamde ch`vengan movlenil shuamavalt`: "gana mocqalis(allahis) garda davadginet` g'vt`aebebi, romelt`at`visac` t`aqvani unda ec`at`?"
da ch`ven carvgzavnet` musa ch`veni sascaulebit` p`araont`an da mis didebulebt`an. da man t`k`va: "cheshmaritad, me var samqarot`a g'mert`is shuamavali".
rodesac` is [musa] mat`t`an [p`araont`an da mis didebulebt`an] ch`veni sascaulebit` mivida, mat` dac`inva daicqes masze.

da arc` ert`i sascauli ar gvich`venebia mat`t`vis [p`araonist`vis da misi xalxist`vis], rom is up`ro didi ar qop`iliqo t`avis cinamorbedze. da movuvlinet` mat` sasjeli, egebis dabrunebuliqvnen [cheshmaritebaze].

da mat` [p`araonma da misma didebulebma] ut`xres (musas): "o, jadok`aro [isini cinascarmetqvel musas jadok`robis ostatad moixseniebdnen, rit`ac` ag'iarebdnen im sascaulebis sidiades, romlebic` man moiqvana]! shest`xove ch`vent`vis shens up`alt`an, im ag't`k`misamebr, romelic` man shent`an dado (rom gvixsnas sasjelisgan), da mashin [t`u is sasjels mogvashorebs] ch`ven namdvilad davadgebit` scor gzas!"

da rodesac` mat`gan sasjeli movxsenit`, aha, mat` daarg'vies t`aviant`i ag't`k`ma. [mas shemdeg, rac` cinascarmetqvelma musam allahs st`xova da allahma isini amk`veqniuri tanjvisgan ixsna, isini mainc` urcmunoebashi darch`nen]
da p`araonma t`avis xalxs shesz'axa da ut`xra: "nut`u me ar var egviptis mbrz'anebeli da am mdinareebis, romlebic` ch`ems k`vesh miedineba? gana ar xedavt`?"
gana me [p`araoni] ar var amaze [musaze] uket`esi, romelic` ug'irsia da z'livs metqvelebs?

da ratom ar ch`amoeqara mas (misi up`lisgan) ok`ros samajurebi (romlit`ac` sheez'lo t`avis mort`va), an ratom ar movidnen mast`an angelozebi, romlebic` t`an eaxlebodnen mas (da daexmarebodnen) (t`u is ac`xadebs, rom allahis shuamavalia)?
da man [p`araonma] t`avisi xalxi ugunurad miich`nia, da isini daemorch`ilnen mas(p`araons). cheshmaritad, isini (allahis mimart`) c`odvili xalxi iqvnen!
da rodesac` mat` gangvarisxes, ch`ven shuri viz'iet` mat`ze (scrap`i sasjelit`) da qvelani davaxrch`et` (zg'vashi).
da ch`ven isini [ch`az'irulebi] cinamorbedebad (mat`t`vis, vinc` mat` shemdgom movida da igive gaaket`a) da (shemagonebel) magalit`ad davtovet` momdevno t`aobebist`vis.
da rodesac` (mravalg'mert`ianebma) mariamis z'e [ieso] moiqvanes magalit`ad, shenma xalxma (o, muhammad) amaze ent`uziazmit` shehqvires.

da t`k`ves: "ch`veni g'mert`ebi uket`esni arian t`u is [isa, mariamis z'e]?" (da) isini mas [cinascarmetqvel isas] shent`an (o, muhammad) mxolod sadavod moiqvanen [magaliat`ad]. da isini arian xalxi, romlebic` (c`ru argumentebit`) kamat`oben!
is (shuamavali ieso) sxva aravinaa, t`u ara mona, romelsac` cqaloba (cinascarmetqveleba da shuamavloba) vuboz'et` da israelis z'et`at`vis magalit`ad davadginet` igi.
da ch`ven rom gveneba, dedamicaze t`k`vens adgilas angelozebs davadgendit`, romlebic` t`k`vens nac`vlad memkvidreebi ik`nebodnen

da uechvelad, igi [isa, mariamis z'e] aris saat`is [gankit`xvis dg'is] nishani [mis moaxloebaze]. amitom nu shegeparebat` echvi masshi [gankit`xvis dg'is mosvlashi] da (ut`xari mat`, o, muhammad): gamomqevit` me (rasac` me gadmogc`emt` qovlisshemz'le allahisgan)! es (aris) scori gza (samot`xisken).
da ar gac`dunot` t`k`ven eshmakma (t`avisi c`dunebebit` ch`ems morch`ilebisgan, rasac` gibrz'anebt` da gikrz'alavt`). cheshmaritad, is t`k`veni ashkara mteria.

da rodesac` isa (ieso) mkap`io nishnebit` movida, t`k`va: "me movedi t`k`vent`an sibrz'nit`, rat`a gangimartot` zogiert`i is, razec` t`k`ven shoris ut`anxmoebaa, da geshinodet` allahis da damemorch`ilet`
cheshmaritad, allahi ch`emi up`alia da t`k`veni up`alic`, mash, t`aqvani ec`it` (mxolod) mas! ai es aris scori gza.

da mat` shoris ut`anxmoeba gach`nda [zogi ambobda, rom ieso allahis mona da misi shuamavali iqo, sxvebi ambobdnen, rom is allahis z'e iqo, xolo zogi kidev ambobda, rom is t`avad g'mert`i iqo]! da vai mat`, vinc` usamart`loba ch`aidina [urcmunoeba] (iesos allahis an g'mert`is z'ed codebit`), mtkivneuli dg'is sasjelisgan [gankit`xvis dg'es isini
jojoxet`shi ch`avardebian]
nut`u [isini, vinc` iesos shesaxeb azrt`asxvaoben] moelian raimes garda [gankit`xvis dg'isa], romelic` mat` moulodnelad daatqdebat` t`avs, mashin, roc`a isini, verc` ki igrz'noben?
megobrebi (saqvareli adamianebi) im dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es] ert`manet`is mtrebi ik`nebian, garda g'vt`ismoshishebisa.
(da et`k`meba mat`, vinc` p`rt`xilobda): o, ch`emo msaxurno! dg'es ar shegeshindebat` (ch`emi sasjelis) da arc` damcuxrdebit` (imast`an dakavshirebit`, rac` dedamicaze c`xovrebisas ver moipove).
vinc` ch`vens sascaulebi ircmuna da (allahis) morch`ilni iqvnen
(da et`k`mebat` mat`): "shedit` samot`xeshi, t`k`ven da t`k`veni c`olebi(da qvela is vinc` rcmenit` t`k`vennairi iqo), rat`a (ik`) iqot` netarni

mat` (samot`xeshi) ok`ros churchlit`a da sasmelebit` moemsaxurebian. da masshi [samot`xeshi] ik`neba qvelap`eri, rasac` sulebi inatreben da rac` t`vals axarebs. da t`k`ven masshi [samot`xeshi] maradiulad darch`ebit`.
da es samot`xe, romelic` t`k`vent`vis memkvidreobad aris moc`emuli im [ket`ili sak`meebis] gamo, rac` (dedamicaze) gaaket`et`
t`k`vent`vis masshi (samot`xeshi) mravali (sxvadasxva) naqop`ia gamzadebuli, romelsac` shechamt`.
cheshmaritad, damnashaveebi [urcmunoni] samudamod darch`ebian [jojoxet`is] sasjelshi
mat` [urcmunoebs] ar miec`emat` shecqnareba (jojoxet`is sasjelisgan) da isini ik`nebian masshi sasocarkvet`ilni.
ch`ven ar movk`c`evivart` mat` usamart`lod, aramed isini t`avad iqvnen usamart`loni(sakut`ari t`avebist`vis).

da isini [urcmunoebi] mouxmoben (mas shemdeg, rac` allahma jojoxet`shi sheiqvana isini): "o, maalik` [jojoxet`is ert`-ert`i mc`veli]! shenma g'mert`ma mogvig'os bolo (rat`a am sasjels gadavurch`et`)!" man [maalik`ma, jojoxet`is mc`velma] t`k`va: "t`k`ven (jojoxet`shi maradiulad) darch`ebit`
(da et`k`mebat` jojoxet`is mkvidrt`): "ch`ven movedit` t`k`vent`an cheshmaritebit` (da agixsenit` is), magram t`k`veni umetesoba cheshmaritebis moz'ulea"

gana mat` [mravalg'mert`ianbma] ukve miig'es raime gadacqvetileba (im cheshmaritebis cinaag'mdeg, romelic` ch`ven mivuqvanet` mat`)? namdvilad, ch`venc` mivig'et` gadacqvetileba (mat`i dasjis shesaxeb)
nut`u hgoniat` (mravalg'mert`ianebs), rom ch`ven ar gvesmis mat`i saidumlo da p`aruli saubari? pirik`it`, ch`veni moc`ik`ulebi (angelozebi) mat`t`an arian da iceren.

ut`xari (o, shuamavalo) (shen xalxs, romlebic` amboben, rom angelozebi allahis k`alishvilebi arian): "mcqalobels (allahs) rom shvili hqavdes, mashin me pirveli t`aqvanismc`emelt`agani vik`nebodi (am shvilze, romelzec` ambobt`)". {magram allahs arc` meug'le hqavs da arc` shvili, amitom es sheuz'lebelia}
cminda aris c`at`a da micis up`ali, taxtis up`ali, imisgan, rasac` isini miaceren(allahs).
mash, miatove isini (o, shen, shuamavalo), t`aviant` sic`rueshi ch`ap`lulni da amk`veqnad gart`ulni, sanam dadgeba mat`i ag't`k`muli dg'e.
is aris, romelic` c`ashic` g'mert`ia da micazec` g'mert`ia(c`ashic` da micazec` g'irsi t`aqvanisc`emisa ). da is aris brz'eni, qovlismc`odne.
da kurt`xeulia is, visac` ekut`vnis meup`eba c`at`a da micisa da rac` mat` shorisaa. da mast`anaa c`odna saat`is da mast`an dabrundebit`.

xolo isini, romlebsac` mis [allahis] nac`vlad uxmoben, ar p`loben shuamdgomlobas garda mat`t`vis, vinc` cheshmariteba daamocmes, da mat` ic`odnen [angelozebsa da cinascarmetqvel iesos ak`vt` shuamdgomlobis up`leba, magram mat` mxolod im adamianebist`vis sheuz'liat` shuamdgomloba, vist`visac` allahi amis nebas dart`avs]
da t`u hkit`xav mat`, vin shek`mna isini, uechvelad itqvian: "allahi!" mash, rogorg'a arian isini shec`denilni?
da man [muhammadma] t`k`va (t`avisi xalxis shesaxeb, romelmac` mas ar daujera): "o, up`alo! cheshmaritad, eseni arian xalxi, romlebsac` ar scamt`!"
mash, zurgi ak`c`ie mat` da ut`xari: "mshvidoba!" ramet`u male gaigeben (rac` moelit`).
ha mim
vp`ic`av c`xad cigns
cheshmaritad, ch`ven gardmovavlinet` igi kurt`xeul g'ames. cheshmaritad, ch`ven vart` shemgonebelni.
amis ganmavlobashi [am g'ames], qoveli brz'nuli sak`me nacildeba (sic`oc`xlis xangrz'livobis, bedisa da sxva sakit`xebis shesaxeb mt`eli clist`vis, romlebic` ar ic`vleba)
ch`veni brz'anebit`; cheshmaritad, ch`ven vart` gamgzavnni (cinascarmetqvelebis da shuamavlebis)
sheni up`lis cqalobit`. cheshmaritad, is qovlismsmeni da qovlismc`odnea.
c`at`a da micis up`ali da imis, rac` mat` shorisaa, t`u t`k`ven mtkic`ed xart` darcmunebulni.
ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba mis garda. is ac`oc`xlebs da akvdinebs, t`k`veni up`ali da t`k`veni cinapari mamebis up`ali.
magram isini echvshi t`amashoben
mash, daelode im dg'es, roc`a c`a moavlens ashkara kvamls.
romelic` dap`aravs xalxs. (da mat` etqvian): es mtanjveli sasjelia.
(da xalxi itqvis): up`alo ch`veno, agvac`ile sasjeli, da cheshmaritad, ch`ven vircmunebt`.
saidang'a ek`nebat` mat` shegoneba, roc`a ukve moevlinat` c`xadi shuamavali?
mere zurgi ak`c`ies mas da t`k`ves: "ganscavluli, sheshlili!"
ch`ven mc`ire xnit` mogixsnit` sasjels, magram t`k`ven kvlav daubrundebit` [urcmunoebas].
im dg'es,(badris brz'olashi) roc`a udidesi z'alit` davartqamt`, cheshmaritad, ch`ven shurismaz'iebelni vart`.
da uechvelad, mat`ze adre gamovc`adet` p`araonis xalxi da moevlinat` mat` ket`ilshobili shuamavali [musa].
(da ut`xra mat` musam): "momec`it` allahis msaxurni (israelis sht`amomavlebidan) [cavidnen ch`emt`an ert`ad] (rat`a mxolod allahs t`aqvani sc`en), radgan me t`k`vent`vis sando shuamavali var."
da nu gaampartavndebit` allahis cinashe. cheshmaritad, me movedi t`k`vent`an c`xadi mtkic`ebulebit`.
da cheshmaritad, me mivep`are ch`ems g'mert`s da t`k`vens g'mert`s, rat`a ar ch`amk`olot`.
da t`u ar gcamt` ch`emi, mashin ganmeridet`

da (mashin), [mas shemdeg, rac` p`araonma da misma mimdevrebma ar c`nes musa allahis shuamavlad], man [musam] shest`xova t`avis up`als: "eseni (arian) allahis cinaag'mdeg amboxebuli (daumorch`ilebeli) xalxi!"(da imsaxureben sasjelis dach`k`arebas)
(da t`k`va allahma): "gamodi g'amit` ch`ems msaxurebt`an ert`ad (romlebmac` shen allahis shuamavlad gag'iares da gagqvnen), (da) namdvilad gamogekidebian (p`araoni da misi lashk`ari)".
da datove zg'va mshvidad: cheshmaritad, isini ch`az'iruli lashk`ari ik`neba.
ramdeni bag'nari da cqaro datoves mat`
da nat`esebi da sapatio adgilebi
da netareba, romlit`ac` tkbebodnen.
ase iqo da sxva xalxs davumkvidret` igi
arc` zec`as da arc` micas ar utiria mat`ze [p`araonisa da misi msaxurebze], da arc` vada miec`at` (sasjelisgan)!
da ch`ven vixsenit` israelis z'eni damamc`irebeli satanjvelisgan.
p`araonisgan (romelmac` mat`i z'eni mokles da mat`i k`alebi daamones). radgan namdvilad is ampartavani tirani da zg'vargadasult`agani iqo.
da ch`ven ukve avirch`iet` isini [israelis z'eni] (ch`veni) c`odnit` samqarot`a [sxva erebis] zemot`.
da vuboz'et` mat` sascaulebi, romlebshic` ashkara gamoc`da iqo
cheshmaritad, eseni (mravalg'mert`ianebi) amboben:
"arsebobs mxolod es, ch`veni pirveli sikvdili, da ch`ven ar ag'vdgebit` (gankit`xvisa dg'es)!"
mashin moiqvanet` ch`veni mamebi, t`u mart`alni xart`
isini uket`esni arian t`u t`ubba'is(pirovnebis saxelcodeba) xalxi da mat`ze ucindelni(ucindelebi:adisa da samudis xalxi)? ch`ven isini davg'upet`. cheshmaritad, isini c`odvilni iqvnen.
da ar shegvik`mnia ch`ven c`ani, dedamica da rac` mat` shorisaa sat`amashod.
ch`ven isini cheshmaritebit` shevk`menit`, magram mat`ma umravlesobam ar ic`is.
uechvelad, daqop`is (gankit`xvis) dg'ea mat`i qvelas dat`k`muli dro.
im dg'es, roc`a verap`rit` ushvelis axlobeli axlobels da arc` mat` ek`nebat` shemceoba
garda imisa, visac` allahi sheicqalebs. uechvelad, igia z'levamosili, mcqalobeli.
cheshmaritad, zaqquumis xe
(qvelaze metad) c`odvilis sachmeli
rogorc` gamdnari lit`oni, is (urcmunoebis) muc`lebshi ixarsheba.
rogorc` mdug'are cqlis dug'ili
(da etqvian): sheipqarit` igi da ch`aat`riet` shuagul jojoxet`shi!
shemdeg daasxit` t`avze mdug'are cqlis satanjveli
(da etqvian urcmunos): "igeme (es sasjeli), radgan, cheshmaritad, shen (xar) ag'zevebuli (xalxshi), pativc`emuli(damc`inavad etvian)!"
ai, es aris is, rashic` echvi geparebodat`
cheshmaritad, g'vt`ismoshishni usap`rt`xo samqop`elshi ik`nebian
bag'ebsa da cqaroebshi
imosebian cminda abreshumit`a da p`arch`it`, ert`manet`is pirispir.
aseve(sxva pativsac` mivagebt` mat`); da ch`ven mat` c`olebad shevurt`avt` t`valmshvenier huriebs.
ik` moit`xoven qovelgvar xils, dac`ulni (ar sheucqdebat` xili).
ik` sikvdils ar igemeben, garda pirveli sikvdilisa. da daic`va man [allahma] isini jojoxet`is sasjelisgan.
cqalobad sheni up`lisgan. ai, esaa diadi carmateba.
ch`ven is(qurani) shens enaze gavaadvilet`, rat`a mat` darigeba miig'on.
mash, daelode! cheshmaritad, isinic` momlodineni arian.
ha mim
cignis gardmovlena allahisganaa, z'levamosilisa da brz'enisgan.
cheshmaritad, zec`asa da micaze morcmuneebist`vis ashkara sascaulebia!
da t`k`vens shek`mnasa da im p`ak`tshi, rom man (dedamicaze) c`xovelebi gaavrc`ela - nishnebia mat`t`vis, vinc` darcmunebulia (allahisa da misi z'alaup`lebis arsebobashi).

da g'amisa da dg'is monac`vleobashi, da imashi, rac` gardmoavlina allahma c`idan sarch`od(cvima) da gaac`oc`xla misit` mica, misi sikvdilis shemdeg, da k`arebis monac`vleobashi, nishnebia moazrovne xalxist`vis.
es allahis aiat`ebia, romlebsac` cheshmaritebit` gikit`xavt` shen. mash, allahisa da misi aiat`ebis shemdeg romeli sitqvis ircmuneben isini?
vai(tanjva cameba), qovel c`odvil matquaras!
ismens allahis aiat`ebs, romlebic` ekit`xeba mas, shemdeg ki jiutobs ampartavnulad, t`it`k`os arc` mousmenia. mash, axare mas mcare sasjeli
da roc`a rames sheitqobs ch`veni aiat`ebidan, masxrad aigdebs mas. scored mat`t`visaa damamc`irebeli sasjeli.
mat` ukan jojoxet`ia da verap`rit` ushvelit` mat` is, rac` moixveches, da arc` is, rac` mp`arvelebad aiqvanes allahis magier. da mat`t`visaa sasjeli udidesi.

es [qurani] aris (cheshmariti) saxelmz'g'vanelo; xolo vinc` ar ircmunebs t`avisi up`lis nishnebs [ar ag'iarebs allahis cignis aiat`ebis cheshmaritebas], (mashin) isini (miig'eben) qvelaze mtkivneul sasjels.
allahi - is aris, romelmac` zg'va dagimorch`ilat`, rat`a gemebma masze misi brz'anebit` ic`uron, t`k`ven ki misi siuxvis z'iebashi iqot` da madlierni iqot`.

da man dagimorch`ilat` qovelive, rac` c`ashia [mze, mt`vare, varskvlavebi, g'rublebi,...] da qovelive, rac` dedamicazea [cqali, mc`enareebi, c`xovelebi,...] - es qovelive misgan (camosulia). cheshmaritad, amashi nat`eli nishnebia mat`t`vis, vinc` iazrebs!

ut`xari (o, shuamaval) morcmuneebs: apation mat`, vinc` ar imedovnebs allahis dg'eebs [apation mravalg'mert`iant`, romlebic` mat` tanjvas aqeneben], rat`a man [allahma] miagos aset` xalxs (sasjelit`) imisat`vis, rac` mat` moipoves [ch`aidines].

vinc` siket`es ik`ms, is sakut`ari t`avis sasiket`od ik`ms; xolo vinc` borotebas ik`ms, is sakut`ari t`avis sazianod ik`ms. shemdeg (t`k`ven, o, xalxo) t`k`vens up`alt`an dabrundebit` (gankit`xvis dg'es).

vp`ic`av, ch`ven mivec`it` israelis sht`amomavlebs cigni [t`ora], kanoni (romlit`ac` adamianebs shoris davebi cqdeba) da cinascarmetqveleba [rom cinascarmetqvel ibrahimis sht`amomavlobidan umetesi mat`t`an iqo gagzavnili], da ch`ven mivanichet` mat` cili ket`ildg'eobisa (sarch`osi) da upiratesoba mivanichet` mat` (im) samqaroebze [mat` droshi mc`xovreb xalxebze].

da ch`ven mivec`it` mat` [israelis sht`amomavlebs] c`xadi samxilebi (rcmenashi rat`a, cheshmaritebisa da gzasac`denilobas shoris gansxvaveba sheez'lot`). da mat` shoris ut`anxmoeba mxolod mas shemdeg daicqo, rodesac` mouvidat` c`odna, urt`iert`shurit`. cheshmaritad, t`k`veni up`ali ganikit`xavs mat` shoris ag'dgomis dg'es imis shesaxeb, razec` isini amk`veqnad ver shet`anxmdnen!

mashin ch`ven gich`venet` gza (o, shen, shuamaval), (romelic` exeba) cheshmariti rcmenis debulebebs (da romlit`ac` allahi kmaqop`ilia). amitom mihqevi mas da nu gahqvebi mat` neba-survilebs, romelt`ac` ar ic`ian!
cheshmaritad, isini verap`rit` dagic`aven shen allahisgan. da uechvelad, usamart`loni ert`manet`is mp`arvelebi arian, xolo allahi mp`arvelia g'vt`ismoshisht`a.
es [qurani] aris nat`eli nishani [mtkic`ebuleba] adamianebist`vis, (cheshmariti) saxelmz'g'vanelo da cqaloba adamianebist`vis, romlebic` darcmunebulni arian

nut`u mart`la egonat` mat`, vinc` borot sak`meebs sch`adiodnen, rom ch`ven mat` iseve movek`c`evit`, rogorc` mat`, vinc` (allahis) ircmuna da g'irseuli sak`meebi ag'asrula, da rom mat`i mdgomareoba c`xovrebashi da sikvdilis shemdeg ert`nairi ik`neba? raoden c`udad [mc`darad] msjeloben!
da shek`mna allahma c`ani da dedamica cheshmaritebit`, da rat`a miezg'os qovel suls imis mixedvit`, rac` moixvecha, da isini ar daich`agrebian.

gana ar ginaxavs is, vinc` t`avisi vnebebi gaixada g'vt`aebad? da allahma sheac`dina igi c`odnis miuxedavad, da daado bechedi mis smenasa da gulze, da daap`ara p`arda mis t`valebze. mash, vin daadgens mas scor gzaze allahis shemdeg? nut`u ar dap`ik`rdebit`?

da t`k`ves: "es mxolod ch`veni amk`veqniuri c`xovrebaa. vkvdebit` da vc`oc`xlobt`, da arap`eri gvg'upavs ch`ven, garda droisa". da mat` amis shesaxeb aranairi c`odna ar gaach`niat`, isini mxolod varaudoben.
da roc`a mat` ch`veni c`xadi aiat`ebi ekit`xebat`, mat`i mtkic`ebuleba sxva arap`eria, garda imisa, rom amboben: "aba, moiqvanet` ch`veni mama-papa, t`u simart`les ambobt`!"
ut`xari: "allahi gac`oc`xlebt` [amk`veqnad], shemdeg gakvdinebt`, shemdeg ki shegkrebt` (c`oc`xals) ag'dgomis dg'es, romelshic` echvi ar aris. magram adamiant`a umetesobam ar ic`is!"
da allahs ekut`vnis (qoveli) meup`eba c`at`a da micat`a; da im dg'es, rodesac` saat`i [gankit`xvis dg'e] dadgeba, mashin sic`ruis mimdevrebi dazaraldebian!

da shen (o, shuamaval) ixilav (gankit`xvis dg'es) qovel t`ems muxlze dach`ok`ils (allahis gadacqvetilebis molodinshi). t`it`oeul sazogadoebas t`avisi cignisken (sak`met`a ag'ceriloba) moucodeben. (da etqvian mat`): "dg'es miig'ebt` sazg'aurs imist`vis, rasac` dedamicaze sch`adiodit`".

es ch`veni cigni cheshmaritad metqvelebs t`k`vens sacinaag'mdegod [ak` aris t`k`veni qvela sak`me, damatebit`i t`u gamotovebuli arap`eria]. cheshmaritad, ch`ven vubrz'anet` (angelozebs), ch`aecerat` (qvelap`eri), rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebdit`.
xolo mat`, romelt`ac` ircmunes da ket`ili sak`meebi aket`es, t`aviant`i up`ali sheiqvans t`avis cqalobashi. scored es aris c`xadi carmateba.

xolo urcmunoebs (et`k`mebat`): "gana ar gekit`xebodat` ch`emi nishnebi (aiat`ebi)? magram t`k`ven gaampartavndit` da gaxdit` meamboxe xalxi (allahis nebis cinaag'mdeg) [urcmunoebi da mravalg'mert`ianebi]".
da roc`a it`k`va: "cheshmaritad, allahis ag't`k`ma cheshmaritia da ar aris echvi saat`shi", t`k`ven t`k`vit`: "ar vic`it`, ra aris saat`i, ch`ven mxolod vvaraudobt` da ch`ven darcmunebulni ar vart`".
da gamouch`ndebat` mat` boroteba imisa, rac` ch`aidines, da gars shemoertqmebat` is, rasac` dasc`inodnen.
da et`k`mebat`: "dg'es ch`ven dagivicqebt`, rogorc` t`k`ven daivicqet` t`k`veni am dg'is shexvedra. t`k`veni t`avshesap`ari c`ec`xlia da ar geqolebat` shemceebi".
es imitom, rom t`k`ven allahis aiat`ebi masxrad aigdet` da gac`dunat` amk`veqniurma c`xovrebam. amitom, dg'es isini ik`idan ver gamovlen da arc` miec`emat` sashualeba, rom patieba it`xovon.
mash, dideba allahs, c`at`a g'mert`s, dedamicis g'mert`s, samqarot`a g'mert`s
da mas ekut`vnis sidiade c`at`a shina da k`veqanaze. da is aris z'levamosili, brz'eni.
ha mim
cignis gardmovlena allahisganaa, z'levamosilisa da brz'enisagan.

ch`ven shevk`menit` c`ani da mica da is, rac` mat` shoris aris, mxolod cheshmaritebit` [da ara ubralod] da gansazg'vruli vadit` [romelic` mxolod allahma ic`is]. magram isini, romlebic` gaxdnen urcmunoni zurgs ak`c`even imas, risganac` ap`rt`xilebdnen.

ut`xari (o, shuamavalo) (mravalg'mert`ianebs): "gana dap`ik`rebulxart` imat`ze (g'vt`aebebze), romlebsac` allahis garda ixmobt` [evedrebit`]? mich`venet`, ra sheuk`mniat` mat` dedamicisgan, an zec`at`a shek`mnashi (allaht`an) ak`vt` cili? momitane cigni amaze [quranze] adrindeli, an raime c`odnis kvali (sheni mtkic`ebebis sasargeblod), t`u mart`lebi xart`!

da vin aris up`ro gzaabneuli, vidre isini, vinc` allahis garda sxvebs evedrebian, romlebic` ag'dgomis dg'emde ar upasuxeben mat` da mat`i vedrebebis ugulebelmqop`elni arian [mat` arc` ki ic`ian, rom mat` evedrebian].
da roc`a adamianebi shekrebilni ik`nebian, isini mat`i mtrebi gaxdebian da uarqop`en mat` t`aqvanisc`emas.
da roc`a mat` ch`veni aiat`ebi c`xadad ekit`xebat`, urcmunoni amboben cheshmaritebaze, roc`a is moevlinebat`: "es c`xadi jadok`robaa".

da nut`u itqvian isini [mravalg'mert`ianebi]: "man is [qurani] moigona [muhammadma]"? t`k`vi (o, shuamavalo): "t`u me gamovigone igi, t`k`ven ver shez'lebdit` allahis sasjelisgan ch`ems gadarch`enas. man [allahma] qvelaze kargad ic`is, rasac` t`k`ven ambobt`". is sakmarisia mocmed ch`emsa da t`k`ven shoris! da is aris mpatiebeli, shemcqalebeli

t`k`vi (o, shuamavalo): "me ar var siaxle [pirveli] shuamavalt`a shoris (romlebic` allahma gagzavna xalxt`an), da ar vic`i, ra moxdeba [ra moimok`medebs allahi] ch`emt`an da t`k`vent`an (amk`veqnad). me mxolod imas mivqvebi, rac` ch`emt`visaa sht`agonebuli; da me mxolod c`xadi gamap`rt`xilebeli var".

t`k`vi: "aba, ras itqvit`, t`u is allahisganaa da t`k`ven uarqavit` igi, da israelis z'et`agan ert`ma mocmem daamocma msgavsze, da ircmuna(qurani), t`k`ven ki gaamaqdit`? cheshmaritad, allahi ar daadgens scor gzaze usamart`lo xalxs".

da ut`xres urcmunoebma mat`, romelt`ac` ircmunes: "es rom siket`e qop`iliqo, isini ch`ven ar dagvascrebdnen masshi". da rodesac` ver pouloben cheshmarit gzas misi meshveobit`, itqvian: "es z'veli sic`ruea".

da masze [quranze] cin ch`ven ch`amovagzavnet` musas cigni [t`ora] -- gzamkvlevad (israelis sht`amomavlebist`vis) da cqalobad. da es [qurani] (aris) cigni, romelic` adasturebs cheshmaritebas (im cerilebisa, romlebic` masze adre allahis mier ik`na gamogzavnili), arabulad, rat`a sheagonebdnen mat`, vinc` borots ik`ms da sasixarulo ucqebad mart`lebist`vis (romlebic` allahs emorch`ilebian da gulcrp`elni arian t`aviant` rcmenasa da up`lisadmi morch`ilebashi).
cheshmaritad, romelt`ac` t`k`ves: "ch`veni g'mert`i allahia!" da shemdeg mtkic`ed dadgnen, ar ek`nebat` mat` shishi da arc` damcuxrdebian.
isini arian samot`xis mkvidrni, romlebic` masshi maradiulad c`xovroben (allahis cqalobit`) im sak`meebis sazg'aurad, romlebsac` isini aket`ebdnen.

da ch`ven vubrz'anet` adamians, ket`ilad moek`c`es mshoblebs; (radgan) dedamisi sirt`ulit` atarebs mas [muc`elshi] da shobs mas tanjvit` [ganic`dis mz'ime tkivils]; da misi tareba (muc`elshi) da z'uz'ut`i gamokveba oc`daat`i t`vea. da rodesac` is z'alas [gonebriv da p`izikur zg'vars] miag'cevs da ormoc` clamde miva, is (allahs t`xovnit` mimart`avs da) ambobs: "o, up`alo, sht`amagone, rom (qovelt`vis) madlieri viqo sheni cqalobist`vis, romelic` me da ch`ems mshoblebs gviboz'e; da rom (qovelt`vis) ag'vasrulo ket`ili sak`meebi, romlit`ac` shen xar kmaqop`ili, da momec`i siket`e ch`ems sht`amomavlobashi! cheshmaritad, shens cinashe vinanieb da me var ert`-ert`i muslimt`agani (morch`ilt`agani).

isini, visganac` vig'ebt` sauket`esos mat` mier namok`medari mart`ali sak`meebidan da vpatiobt` mat` c`ud sak`meebs, isini samot`xis mkvidrt`a shoris arian, cheshmariti ag't`k`misamebr, romelic` mat` (allahisgan) miec`at`.

da vinc` t`avis mshoblebs eubneba: "up`, t`k`ven! nut`u mpirdebit`, rom (sap`lavidan c`oc`xali) ag'vdgebi? magram ch`ems cin (dedamicaze) mravali t`aoba (adamianebisa) gardaic`vala (da arc`ert`i mat`gani jer ar ag'mdgara)! isini [misi mshoblebi] allahs evedrebian daxmarebas (da eubnebian mas): "vai shen! ircmune, radgan allahis ag't`k`ma cheshmaritia!" is (mshoblebs) eubneba: "es, rasac` meubnebit`, arap`eria, garda (gamogonili) z'veli xalxis legendebisa!"

isini scored iset`ebi arian, viszec` cheshmaritad vrc`eldeba sitqva (allahisa) im xalxebt`an dakavshirebit`, romlebic` mat` cin iqvnen jinebisa da adamianebisgan; cheshmaritad, isini ag'moch`ndnen cagebulni

da t`it`oeuls [rogorc` morcmunet`a, ise urcmunot`a jgup`s] (gankit`xvis dg'es) ek`neba t`avisi sap`exurebi imis mixedvit`, rac` gaaket`es, rat`a man [allahma] srulad miagos mat` mat`i sak`meebist`vis da isini ar daich`agrebian.

da im dg'es, roc`a urcmunoebs c`ec`xls carudgenen, etqvian: "t`k`ven daxarjet` t`k`veni siket`eebi micier c`xovrebashi da datkbit` mat`it`. amitom dg'es damamc`irebeli sasjelit` daisjebit` imis gamo, rom usamart`lod ampartavnobdit` dedamicaze da (alahisadmi) daumorch`ileblobis gamo".

da sheaxsene 'adis z'maze [shens xalxs], ai, man gaap`rt`xila t`avisi xalxi al-ahqap`shi, roc`a ukve iqvnen gamap`rt`xileblebi masze cin da mis shemdeg: "ar et`aqvanot` aravis, garda allahisa. cheshmaritad, me meshinia t`k`vent`vis didebuli dg'is sasjelis!"
mat` t`k`ves: "nut`u ch`veni g'mert`ebisgan dasashoreblad moxvedi sheni sic`ruit`? mogvec`i is, rasac` gvpirdebi, t`uki mart`ali xar".
(hudma) t`k`va: "cheshmaritad, c`odna mxolod allaht`an aris, me ki (allahisgan) (mxolod) imas gadmogc`emt`, rit`ac` movivline; magram me vxedav, rom t`k`ven uc`odinari xalxi xart`".

da rodesac` mat` ixiles is (uzarmazari g'rubeli), romelic` (horizontze) vrc`eldeboda da mat`i velebisken moemart`eboda, t`k`ves: "es g'rubeli cvimas mogvitans". (magram cinascarmetqvelma hudma ut`xra mat`): "ara (es sulac` ar aris cvima), es is sasjelia, romlis dach`k`arebac` moindomet` -- k`arishxali, romelshic` mtkivneuli sasjelia".
is anadgurebda qovelives t`avisi g'mert`is brz'anebit`. da mat`i sac`xovrisebis garda ag'arap`eri ch`anda. ai, ase mivuzg'avt` damnashaveebs(romelnic` allahis mimart` urcmunoebi da urch`ebi arian ).

da ch`ven mat` iset`i z'alaup`leba mivec`it`, rogoric` t`k`vent`vis ar mogvic`ia, da mivec`it` mat` smena, mxedveloba da gulebi. magram verap`eri ushvelat` verc` mat`ma smenam, verc` mxedvelobam da verc` gulebma, radgan isini uarqop`dnen allahis aiat`ebs, da gars shemoertqat` is, rasac` dasc`inodnen.
da uechvelad, ch`ven gavanadguret` sop`lebi, romlebic` t`k`vens garshemo iqo, da ch`ven ganvmartet` sascaulebi, egebis isini dabrunebuliqvnen (cheshmarit rcmenaze)

ratom ar daexmarnen mat` is g'vt`aebebi, romlebic` mat` allahis nac`vlad aiqvanes, rat`a mieaxlebinebinat`? pirik`it`, isini [c`ru g'vt`aebebi] mat`gan gauch`inardnen. ai, aset`ia mat`i sic`rue da is, rasac` igonebdnen!

da (ut`xari mat`, o, shuamavalo), rogor gamovgzavnet` shent`an jinebis ert`i jgup`i, rat`a qurani moesminat`. rodesac` isini mast`an(ik` sadac` qurani ikit`xeboda) mividnen, mat` [jinebma] ert`manet`s ut`xres: "gach`umdit` (da quradg'ebit` moisminet`)!" da rodesac` (quranis cakit`xva) dasrulda, isini t`aviant` xalxt`an dabrundnen shemgoneblebad.
t`k`ves: "hei, ch`veno xalxo! ch`ven movisminet` cigni, romelic` gardmoevlina musas shemdeg, romelic` adasturebs imas, rac` iqo mis ucin, da miuz'g'veba cheshmaritebisken da scori gzisken.
hei, ch`veno xalxo! upasuxet` allahis moc`ik`uls da ircmunet` igi. is mogitevebt` t`k`vens c`odvebs da dagic`avt` mtanjveli sasjelisgan.

da vinc` ar pasuxobs allahis mocodebas [ar pasuxobs allahis shuamavlis mocodebas], mas ar sheuz'lia (allahis) dasusteba dedamicaze(mas ar sheuz'lia rom allahi uz'luri gaxados, da misgan t`avi daag'cios) da mas ar hqavs mp`arvelebi mis [allahis] garda. aset`ni ashkarad shec`domashi arian!

gana ar p`ik`roben, rom allahs, romelmac` c`ani da mica (arap`risgan) shek`mna da mat` shek`mnashi ar daig'ala, sheuz'lia mkvdrebis gac`oc`xleba? diax, (allahist`vis qvelap`eri martivia), radgan cheshmaritad, mas qoveliveze z'ala shescevs!

da im dg'es, rodesac` urcmunoni c`ec`xlis cinashe cardgebian... (mat` hkit`xaven): "gana es (sasjeli) samart`liani ar aris?" isini itqvian: "diax, ch`veni up`lis saxelit` vp`ic`avt` (rom es sasjeli samart`liania)!" is itqvis: "mash, igemet` sasjeli imist`vis, rasac` uarqop`dit`".

mash, gamoich`ine mot`mineba, rogorc` it`mendnen mtkic`e nebisqop`is mk`one shuamavalni, da nu ich`k`areb mat`t`vis. im dg'es, rodesac` ixilaven imas, rac` dahpirdnen(tanjva-cameba), ise moech`venebat` rom, dg'is ert`i saat`is garda ar dahqves (amk`veqnad). (es) aris shegoneba (mat`t`vis da sxvebist`vis)! gana vinme ig'upeba (allahis sasjelit`), garda urch`ebisa?
xolo isini, romlebic` urcmunoebi gaxdnen da (xalxi) allahis [islamis] gzidan aac`dines - mat`i sak`meebi amao gaxda.

xolo romelt`ac` ircmunes da ket`ili sak`meebi aket`es da ircmunes is, rac` muhammads gardmoevlina - da is cheshmaritebaa mat`i g'mert`isgan - (allahi) caushlis mat` c`odvebs da gamoascorebs mat` mdgomareobas.
es imitom, rom urcmunoni misdevdnen sic`rues, xolo morcmuneni misdevdnen cheshmaritebas t`aviant`i g'mert`isgan. ase mohqavs allahs adamianebist`vis mat`i(morcmuneebisa da urcmunoebis) magalit`ebi.

xolo roc`a shexvdebit` urcmunoebs(meomrebs), kisershi(xmlebi) daartqit`, sanam ar daamarc`xebt` mat`. shemdeg ki magrad shekarit` borkilebi. da mere an sheicqalet`, an gamosasqidi aig'et`, sanam omi ar dadebs t`avis tvirt`s. asea es! da allahs rom ndomeboda, t`vit`onve iz'iebda shurs mat`ze, rat`a gamogc`adot` ert`manet`it`. xolo mat`, vinc` allahis gzaze daixoc`nen, is ar daukargavs mat` sak`meebs.
is mat` cheshmarit gzaze daaqenebs da mat` mdgomareobas gamoascorebs
da sheiqvans mat` samot`xeshi, romlis shesaxebac` ac`noba mat`.
hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! t`u t`k`ven allahs sheecevit`, isic` shegecevat` t`k`ven da gagimqarebt` p`exebs [mogc`emt` mxardacheras] (brz'olashi).
xolo mat`, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes - vai mat`! da amao gaxada mat`i sak`meebi.
es imitom, rom mat` sheiz'ules is, rac` allahma gardmoavlina, amitom man p`uchad ak`c`ia mat`i sak`meebi.
gana ar dauvliat` mat` [am urcmunoebs] k`veqana da ar unaxavt`, ra bolo eciat` mat`, vinc` mat` ucin iqo? allahma gaanadgura isini, da urcmunot`at`vis - igive (sasjeli) elis.
es imitom, rom allahi mp`arvelia imat`i, romelt`ac` ircmunes, da rom urcmunoebs ar hqavt` mp`arveli.

uechvelad, allahi sheiqvans mat`, romelt`ac` ircmunes da ket`ili sak`meebi aket`es, samot`xeebshi, romelt`a k`veshac` mdinareebi moedineba. xolo romelt`ac` uarqves, tkbebian da chamen, rogorc` pirutqvi chams, da c`ec`xlia mat`i samqop`eli.

ramdeni k`alak`i (iqo), romelt`a mc`xovreblebi up`ro z'lierebi iqvnen, vidre sheni k`alak`is (o, shuamaval) [vidre mek`k`is] mc`xovreblebi, romlebmac` gamogasaxles; ch`ven gavanadguret` da mat` ar hqavdat` damxmare!

nut`u is, vinc` t`avisi up`lisgan nat`el nishnebs [da mis ert`ianobashi rcmenas] eqrdnoba, iset`ivea, rogoric` is, visi boroti sak`meebic` (satanam) mimzidveli gaxada? mat` sakut`ar survilebs gahqvnen!

g'vt`ismoshisht`at`vis ag't`k`muli samot`xis magalit`i: masshia mdinareebi uc`vleli cqlisa, da mdinareebi rz'isa, romlis gemoc` ar ic`vleba, da mdinareebi g'vinisa, sasiamovno msmelt`at`vis, da mdinareebi gacmendili t`ap`lisa. da mat`t`visaa masshi qovelgvari xili da shendoba mat`i up`lisgan. gana hgavs imas, vinc` samudamod c`ec`xlshia da asmeven mdug'are cqals, romelic` mat` naclavebs glejs?

da mat` shoris arian iset`ebi, romlebic` gismenen shen [o, shuamaval] (da eseni mlik`vnelebi arian). da rodesac` shengan midian (sheni mc`nebebisa da k`adagebebis mosmenis shemdeg), eubnebian mat`, visac` c`odna miec`at`: "ra t`k`va axlaxan man (ch`ven mis sitqvebs quradg'ebac` ar mivak`c`iet`)?" eseni (t`valt`mak`c`ebi) arian isini, vis gulebsac` allahma bechedi daasva da romlebic` sakut`ar vnebebs mihqvnen.
xolo mat`, vinc` (cheshmarit) gzas mihqveba, is gaumravalp`erovnebs am gzis cheshmaritebas da mianichebs mat` (sat`noebas) sip`rt`xiles (c`odvebisgan).

nut`u isini sxva rames elian, garda saat`isa [gankit`xvis dg'isa], romelic` mat` moulodnelad daatqdebat` t`avs? namdvilad, misi zogiert`i nishani ukve movida (magram mat` mainc` ar miak`c`ies quradg'eba). da ra sargebels misc`ems es mat` mashin, rodesac` saat`i mat` daatqdebat` t`avs?

ic`ode, rom ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba allahis garda, da it`xove shendoba sheni c`odvist`vis da morcmune kac`t`at`vis da morcmune k`alt`at`vis. da allahma ic`is t`k`veni k`medebebis shesaxeb(dg'isit` rac` gaaket`et`) da t`k`veni gansasvenebeli(g'amit` roc`a isvenebt`, iz'inebt`).

da romelt`ac` ircmunes amboben: oh, netav qop`iliqo
gardmovlenili sura (romelshic` alahi gvibrz'anebs
vebrz'olot` urcmunoebs)!" magram rodesac` gardmoevlina c`xadi sura [romelshic` es nat`lad aris ganmartebuli], da masshi [am surashi] axsenebs brz'olas [brz'anebs allahis gzaze brz'olas], shen (o, shuamavalo) xedav, rogor iqurebian shensken sneuli gulis mk`oneni [romelt`a sulebshic` echvia, da eseni t`valt`mak`c`ni arian], sikvdilis shishit` savse t`valebit`. uket`esi ik`neboda mat`t`vis [sulebshi echvebis mk`onet`at`vis]

morch`ileba (allahisadmi) da (allahis kanonis shesabamisi) ket`ili sitqvebis t`k`ma! da rodesac` sak`me gadacqvetilia [brz'olis brz'aneba gac`emulia] (isini mas ecinaag'mdegebian an ar monacileoben), allaht`an (t`aviant` rcmenasa da morch`ilebashi) gulcrp`elni rom qop`iliqvnen, (es) mat`t`vis uket`esi ik`neboda
an ik`neb, t`u zurgs sheak`c`evt` (allahis cignsa da misi shuamavlis sunnas), dedamicaze sibilces gaavrc`elebt` (masshi urcmunoebis gamoch`enit`a da sisxlis g'vrit`) da ojaxur kavshirebs gacqvett`?
ai isini, romlebic` alahma dacqevla [t`avisi cqalobisgan moashora]. man qurebi dauxsho (rat`a ver gaigon, ra aris mat`t`vis sasiket`o) da t`valebi daubrmava (rat`a ver dainaxon cheshmariteba).
gana ar dap`ik`rdebian [es t`valt`mak`c`ni] quranze? t`u mat` gulebze saketebia (romelic` xels ushlit`, quranisgan raime miig'on)?

uechvelad, isini, romelnic` ukuik`c`nen (urcmunoni gaxdnen) mas shemdeg, rac` cheshmariti gza c`xadi gaxda mat`t`vis, satanam gaalamaza mat` (mat`i c`odvebi) da gauxangrz'liva mat` (mat`i sic`oc`xlis imedi)

es [is, rom isini kvlav urcmunoni gaxdnen] imitom aris, rom mat` ut`xres mat`, visac` sz'uldat` is, rac` allahma gardmoavlina [mravalg'mert`ianebisadmi]: ch`ven dagemorch`ilebit` zogiert` sakit`xshi (kerz'od, islamis mimart` mtrobashi,da muslimebis brz'olashi monacileobisgan shekavebashi). da allahma ic`is mat`i saidumloebebi [ganzraxvebi]
da rogori ik`neba mat`i mdgomareoba, rodesac` angelozebi mat` sulebs miibareben, (romlebic`) saxeebsa da zurgebze daartqamen mat` [umorcmoebs]?
es imitom, rom isini mihqvnen imas, rac` ganarisxebda allahs da sz'uldat` misi ket`ilgancqoba [mocqaleba], amitom man amaod ak`c`ia mat`i sak`meebi.
gana p`ik`roben isini, vis gulshic` sneulebaa [t`valt`mak`c`oba], rom allahi ar gamoach`ens [ar ach`venebs xalxs] mat` borotebas [shurs da siz'ulvils]?

da ch`ven rom gveneba, mat` [t`valt`mak`c`ebs] shent`vis (o, shuamavalo) gamovach`endit` da shen mat` (mat`t`vis damaxasiat`ebeli nishnebit`) amoic`nobdi da shen namdvilad amoic`nobdi mat` sitqvis shinaarsit` (romlis arsic`aa islamis cinaag'mdeg gamosvla da morcmunet`a dac`inva). da allahma ic`is t`k`veni [qvelas] sak`meebi (da t`it`oeuls miagebs imisamebr, rasac` imsaxurebs)!

da ch`ven auc`ileblad gamogc`dit` (o, morcmuneno)
(allahis mtrebis cinaag'mdeg brz'olis brz'anebit`),
rat`a gamovc`adot` t`k`vengan mebrz'olni (allahis gzaze)
[romlebic` daemorch`ilnen am brz'anebas] da momt`menni (t`k`vens rcmenasa da t`k`venze momdgar gasachirshi), [gavigebt`, vin aris t`k`vengan mart`ali da vin matquara]

cheshmaritad, isini, vinc` urcmunoni gaxdnen da (xalxi) allahis gzidan aac`dines da shuamavals [cin ag'udgnen] zurgi ak`c`ies, mas shemdeg, rac` mat`t`vis cheshmariti gza nat`eli gaxda [mas shemdeg, rac` ixiles sascaulebi nat`eli mtkic`ebuleba, rom muhammadi allahis shuamavali da mac`nea], isini allahs veranairad ver avneben, xolo is mat` sak`meebs amaod gaxdis

hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! iqavit` morch`ilni allahisa [gaaket`et` is, rac` man brz'ana t`avis cignshi], da
morch`ilni shuamavlisa [gaaket`et` is, rac` allahma brz'ana t`avisi shuamavlis meshveobit`], da nu k`mnit` t`k`vens namok`medars amaod

cheshmaritad, vinc` urcmuno gaxda da allahis gzidan aac`dines sxvebi, shemdeg ki mokvdnen urcmunod [ar moinanies t`avisi urcmunoeba], allahi arasodes apatiebs mat` (da ch`aagdebs mat` maradiul satanjvelshi, jojoxet`shi)!

da nu dasustdebit` (o, morcmuneebo), da nu moucodebt` (allahis mtrebs) zavisken [shet`anxmebis dasadebad] (brz'olis shishit`), roc`a t`k`ven xart` upiratesni [t`k`ven up`ro z'lierebi xart` da gaimarjvebt`]; da allahi t`k`vent`anaa [is dagexmarebat` t`k`veni mtrebis cinaag'mdeg], da is ar sheamc`irebs (jildos) t`k`veni sak`meebist`vis.
cheshmaritad, amk`veqniuri c`xovreba mxolod t`amashi da gart`obaa. da t`u ircmunebt` da g'vt`ismoshishni ik`nebit`, is mogc`emt` t`k`vens sazg'aurs da ar mogt`xovt` t`k`vens k`onebas.

t`u is (mt`eli) t`avisi k`onebis mic`emas gt`xovt` da amaze dazhinebit` mogt`xovt`, t`k`ven siz'unces gamoich`ent`, da (mashin) is (gamo)ach`ens t`k`vens siz'ulvils (allahis gzaze xarjebis gag'ebashi romelic` t`k`vens sulebshia).

aha, t`k`ven (o, morcmuneebo) xart` isini, visac` moucodeben, rom gasc`et` allahis gzaze [allahis mtrebis cinaag'mdeg brz'olasa da islamis gavrc`elebashi]. da t`k`ven shoris arian iset`ebi, romlebic` ishureben. da vinc` ishurebs, is mxolod sakut`ari t`avis sazianod ishurebs. cheshmaritad, allahi mdidaria, xolo t`k`ven g'aribebi xart`! da t`u t`k`ven (allahis rcmenasa da mis morch`ilebaze) zurgs sheak`c`evt`, is sxva xalxit` shegc`vlit` [gaganadgurebt` da moiqvans sxvebs], da isini t`k`vennairebi ar ik`nebian [isini srulad daemorch`ilebian allahsa da mis shuamavals].
cheshmaritad, ch`ven moganichet` shen (o, shuamavalo) c`xadi gamarjveba.
rat`a allahma mogitevos sheni carsuli da momavali c`odvebi, da srulqos t`avisi madli shenze da dagadginos scor gzaze.
da shegecios allahi z'levamosili shecevnit`

is [allahi] aris is, vinc` morcmunet`a gulebshi simshvide gadmoavlina, rat`a mat` rcmenas rcmena sheematot` [rat`a mat`i rcmena gaizardos]; allahs ekut`vnis c`isa da micis lashk`rebi [angelozebi, adamianebi da jinebi]; da allahi qovlismc`odne, brz'enia!

rat`a sheiqvanos morcmune kac`ebi da morcmune k`alebi samot`xis bag'ebshi, romelt`a k`vemot`ac` mdinareebi miedineba, rat`a maradzhams darch`nen mat`shi, da cashalos mat` c`udi sak`meebi [apatios mat`], da es allaht`an -- udidesi carmatebaa!

da rat`a dasajos t`valt`mak`c`i kac`ebi da t`valt`mak`c`i k`alebi, da carmart`i kac`ebi da carmart`i k`alebi, romelnic` allahze c`uds p`ik`roben. mat`zea borotebis cre [sazg'auri]. da ganurisxda mat` allahi, da dacqevla isini, da gaumzada mat` jojoxet`i. da ra sazareli samqop`elia igi!
da allahisaa c`at`a da micis lashk`ari. da allahi z'levamosilia, brz'enia.
cheshmaritad, ch`ven carmoggzavnet` shen mocmed, maxaroblad da shemgoneblad.

rat`a ircmunot` allahi da misi shuamavali, da daexmarot` mas (misi sitqvisa da mis mier boz'ebuli rcmenis amag'lebit`), da pativi sc`et` mas(moc`ik`uls), da dideba miagot` mas (allahs) dilit` da sag'amos.

cheshmaritad, isini (sahabebi), romlebic` ert`gulebis p`ic`s gaz'levenen shen (o, shuamaval) (hudeibiashi) (rom ukan ar daixeven), (sinamdvileshi) p`ic`s az'leven allahs. allahis xeli mat` xelebze mag'laa(roc`a isini brz'olis p`ic`s az'leven moc`ik`uls). xolo romelmac` daarg'vios (t`avisi p`ic`i), is mxolod sakut`ari t`avis sazianod arg'vevs mas. xolo romelmac` sheasrulos is, razec` shet`anxmda allaht`an [rom mot`minebas gamoich`ens mtert`an shexvedrisas], mas allahi did sazg'aurs mianichebs.

is beduini arabebi, romlebic` ukan darch`nen [romlebic` ar camosulan shent`an mek`as ek`spedic`iashi], rodesac` dabrundebi, getqvian (o, shuamaval): "ch`venma k`onebam da ch`venma ojaxebma mogvac`dines. ase rom, st`xove (allahs), mogvitevos (ukan darch`enis gamo)!" isini enit` amboben imas, rac` gulshi ar ak`vt`. ut`xari (mat`) (o, shuamaval): "vin aris t`k`vent`vis z'almosili g'vt`isgan, t`u mas t`k`vent`vis zianis moqeneba surs an siket`is motana?" ara (radgan isini itquebian, rom darch`nen t`aviant`i k`onebisa da ojaxebis gamo; isini darch`nen rcmenashi arsebuli echvebis gamo), (da) allahma ic`is, rasac` aket`ebt`!

pirik`it`, t`k`ven p`ik`robdit`, rom shuamavali da morcmuneebi arasodes daubrundebodnen t`aviant` ojaxebs [t`k`ven p`ik`robdit`, rom isini qvela daig'upebodnen]! da es (satanam) gagimshvenat` t`k`vens gulebshi, da carmogidginat` boroti p`ik`rebi (rom alahi ar daexmareboda t`avis shuamavals da morcmuneebs mat`i mtrebis cinaag'mdeg) da (t`k`ven) iqavit` xalxi, romelic` (dag'upvist`vis) ganciruli iqo.
xolo visac` ar scams allahi da misi shuamavali, echvgareshea, ch`ven urcmunot`at`vis movamzadet` almodebuli c`ec`xli.
da allahs ekut`vnis c`at`a da micis samp`lobelo. is miutevebs, inebebs visac`, da dasjis, inebebs visac`. da allahi mpatiebeli, shemcqalebelia.

ukan darch`enilebi itqvian, rodesac` t`k`ven (moc`ik`uli da misi t`anamgzavrebi) gaemgzavrebit` (xaibarisken) nadavlis misag'ebad (romelic` allahma dagpirdat` hudaibiis movlenebis shemdeg): "dagvtovet` [neba mogvec`it`], rom camogqvet`!" isini c`diloben (amit`) shec`valon allahis sitqva. (ut`xari, o, shuamavalo): "t`k`ven arasodes gamogvqvebit`! allahma ukve t`k`va es t`k`ven shesaxeb (kerz'od, uzenaesma allahma t`k`va, rom xaibaris nadavli mxolod imas miec`ema, vinc` hudaibiashi miig'o monacileoba)". mashin isini itqvian: "ara (es ase ar aris da allahs es ar ubrz'anebia), (shen ar ginda, rom ch`venc` camovidet` shent`an ert`ad, radgan) shuri gichiravs ch`vendami (da ar ginda, rom ch`venc` mivig'ot` nadavli)!" ara, (da) mat` mxolod mc`iredi esmit`.

ut`xari im beduin arabebs, romlebic` ch`amorch`nen: "mogicevt` brz'ola (zogiert`) xalxt`an, romlebsac` (z'ala da) sastiki risxva gaach`niat`. (an) t`k`ven ibrz'olebt` mat` cinaag'mdeg, an (sxvagvarad) isini danebdebian [morch`ilni gaxdebian;e.i. brz'olis gareshe miig'eben islams] (brz'olis gareshe). da t`u (allahis) morch`ilni ik`nebit`, allahi ket`il sazg'aurs [samot`xes] mogc`emt`, xolo t`u zurgs sheak`c`evt` (rogorc` adre sheak`c`iet` zurgi, rodesac` allahis shuamavlis t`anxlebit` ar caxvedit`), mashin is mtkivneuli sasjelit` dagsjit`".

ar aris c`odva brmaze, arc` kochlze, arc` avadmqop`ze (t`u isini morcmuneebt`an ert`ad allahis gzaze ar midian). magram vinc` daemorch`ileba allahsa da mis shuamavals, is sheiqvans mas samot`xis bag'ebshi, romelt`a k`vemot`ac` mdinareebi miedineba. xolo vinc` zurgs sheak`c`evs (allahis morch`ilebas da uars itqvis mis gzaze brz'olashi monacileobaze), is mas mtkivneuli sasjelit` dasjis.

(da) allahi kmaqop`ili darch`a morcmuneebit`, rodesac` mat` ert`guleba dagip`ic`es shen (o, shuamaval) xis k`vesh (hudeibiast`an, am dap`ic`vas ecoda: bai'at`urridvaan); da man(allahma) ic`oda, ra iqo mat` gulebshi, da mouvlina mat` simshvide da daajildova isini axlo gamarjvebit` (xaibarshi).
da uxvi nadavlit`, romelsac` isini (xaibaris iudevelt`agan) aig'eben. da allahi z'levamosilia, brz'enia

allahi shegpirdat` t`k`ven uxv nadavls, romelsac` (kidev) aig'ebt`. man daach`k`ara t`k`vent`vis es da sheakava xalxis xelebi t`k`vengan, rat`a es qop`iliqo nishani morcmuneebist`vis da (rat`a) man gich`venot` scori gza.

(aseve, allahma mogich`k`arat`) sxva (nadavli), (romlis) mopovebasac` ver shez'lebdit` [es morcmunet`a shemdgomi gamarjvebebia, rogoric`aa sparselebze, romaelebze da a.sh.], allahma moic`va isini [nadavli] (sanam t`k`ven aig'ebt` mat`), da allahi qovlisshemz'lea.
da t`u urcmunoebi (qureishelebidan) t`k`ven gebrz'olebodnen, isini zurgs shegak`c`evdnen(gak`c`eulni da damarc`xebulni). mashin mat` verc` mxardamchers ipovidnen da verc` damxmares.
allahis gankargulebisamebr, romelic` ukve adrec` momxdara [rogorc` is daexmara t`avis megobrebs cina t`emebshi]: radgan allahis gankargulebashi verasdros ipovi c`vlilebas!
is aris, vinc` sheakava mat`i xelebi t`k`vengan da t`k`veni xelebi mat`gan mek`k`is velze, mas shemdeg, rac` gamarjveba mogapovebinat` mat`ze. da allahi xedavs qvelap`ers, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

isini arian urcmunoni, romlebmac` (hudaibias dg'es) t`k`ven ukugak`c`ies cminda mech`et`idan [ar shegishves masshi] da sheakaves msxverplsaklavi c`xovelebi, rat`a ar mieg'ciat` t`aviant`i dakvlis adgilist`vis (cminda teritoriaze). da rom ara (susti) morcmune kac`ebi da (susti) morcmune k`alebi (romlebic` im dros mek`k`ashi imqop`ebodnen da sakut`ar t`avze shishis gamo rcmenas malavdnen) (da) romlebsac` ar ic`nobdit` da (amitom) sheiz'leboda p`exk`vesh gagetarebinat` (da gagenadgurebinat`) isini, da mat` gamo sirc`xvilshi ik`nebodit` ( ris gamoc` mogicevdat` materialuri anazg'aureba,an morcmune monis gamosqidva da gant`avisup`leba)(da allahma ar mogc`at` amis gaket`ebis neba), rat`a allahma sheiqvanos t`avis cqalobashi, visac` inebebs. (magram) t`u isini [susti morcmuneebi, romlebmac` t`aviant`i rcmena damales] gamoeqop`odnen (mek`k`is mravalg'mert`ianebs da miatovebdnen mat`), (mashin) ch`ven, uechvelad, davsjidit` mat` shoris urcmunoebs mtkivneuli sasjelit`.

roc`a urcmunoebma t`aviant` gulebshi ch`aides k`edmag'loba, umec`rebis k`edmag'loba, mashin allahma gardmoavlina t`avisi simshvide t`avis shuamavalsa da morcmuneebze da daavaldebula isini g'vt`ismoshishebis sitqvit`, da isini up`ro g'irsni da shesap`erisni iqvnen amisa(am sitqvisa). da allahi qovlismc`odnea.

allahma ukve sheasrula t`avisi ag't`k`ma t`avisi shuamavlis [muhammadis] mimart` (romelic` mas sizmarshi uch`vena) cheshmaritebit`: "t`k`ven auc`ileblad shexvalt` cminda mech`et`shi (momaval cels), t`u allahi inebebs, usap`rt`xod, t`avgadaparsulebi da shemoklebuli t`mit`, mravalg'mert`ianebis shishis gareshe!" da (allahma) ic`oda, rac` t`k`ven ar ic`odit`, da amis garda [cinascargansazg'vruli] iqo (kidev ert`i) uaxloesi gamarjveba [kerz'od, hudeibiis xelshekruleba da gamarjveba xaibarshi].
is aris (allahi), romelmac` moavlina t`avisi shuamavali scori gzit`a da cheshmariti sarcmunoebit`, rat`a igi qvela sxva sarcmunoebaze ag'amag'los. da sakmarisia allahi mocmed.

muhammadi allahis shuamavalia. xolo isini, vinc` mast`an arian [sahabebi], mkac`rni arian urcmunot`a mimart` da lmobierni ert`manet`is mimart`. shen mat` ixilav muxlmodrekilt`, micamde t`aqvanismc`emelt`, romlebic` ez'ieben allahis cqalobasa da ket`ilgancqobas. mat`i nishani mat` saxeebzea micamde t`aqvanisc`emis kvalisagan. eseni mat`i nishnebia [rogorc` ag'cerilia] t`orashi, xolo mat`i nishani saxarebashi aris (rogorc`) t`esli, romelic` ag'moc`enda da mas daexmara; is gamagrda [morcmuneebi gaz'lierdnen] da t`avis g'eroebze gamart`a, ramac` mt`esvelebi gaaxara, - rat`a mat` [morcmunet`a didma raodenobam] urcmunot`a risxva gamoecviat`. allahma mat`gan, vinc` ircmuna da siket`e ik`mna, patieba da didi sazg'auri [samot`xe] ag'ut`k`va!
hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! nu uscrebt` allahsa da mis shuamavals (gadacqvetilebis mig'ebashi) da geshinodet` allahis, radgan allahi qovlismsmenia, qovlismc`odnea!

hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! nu ag'imag'lebt` t`k`vens xmebs shuamavlis xmaze mag'la da nu mimart`avt` mas xmamag'la, rogorc` ert`manet`s mimart`avt`, rat`a p`uchi ar gaxdes t`k`veni sak`meebi ise, rom verc` ki mixvdet`.
uechvelad, isini, romelnic` xmas udableben allahis shuamavlis cinashe, scored isini arian, romelt`a gulebic` gamosc`ada allahma g'vt`ismoshishebist`vis. mat`t`visaa shendoba da udidesi sazg'auri.
cheshmaritad, romlebic` (xmamag'la) gez'axian (o, shuamavalo) sheni ot`axebis uknidan, mat`gan umetesoba ver azrovnebs (rogor sc`en pativi da mimart`on allahis shuamavals).
da rom moet`minat`, vidre shen gamoxvidodi mat`t`an, uket`esi ik`neboda mat`t`vis. da allahi mimtevebelia, mcqalobelia.
hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! t`u uzneo mogitant` raime ambavs, gadaamocmet` igi, rat`a umec`rebit` ar avnot` xalxs da shemdeg ar inanot` t`k`veni namok`medari.
