da ic`odet`, rom t`k`venshia allahis shuamavali. t`uki is dagemorch`ilebodat` bevr sak`meshi, ut`uod, gagichirdebodat`, magram allahma shegaqvarat` rcmena da gagilamazat` igi t`k`vens gulebshi, da shegaz'ulat` urcmunoeba, garqvnileba da urch`oba. ai, scored isini arian cheshmarit gzaze mavalni.
allahis cqalobit`a da madlit`. da allahi qovlismc`odnea, brz'enia.

da t`u morcmunet`a ori jgup`i ert`manet`s daupirispirdeba, sheariget` isini (o, morcmuneebo) (gadacqvetilebis misag'ebad allahis cignisa da shuamavlis sunnet`isken moucodet`). magram t`u ert`i (am ort`agan) t`avs daesxmeba meores, mashin ebrz'olet` t`avdamsxmels, sanam ar dabrundeba allahis brz'anebaze. da t`u is (am gadacqvetilebas) daemorch`ileba, mashin sheariget` isini samart`lianad da iqavit` miukerz'oebelni, cheshmaritad, allahs uqvars miukerz'oebelni!
cheshmaritad, morcmuneni z'mebi arian, amitom sheariget` t`k`veni ori z'ma. da geshinodet` allahis, egebis mogenichot` cqaloba (allahisgan).

o, t`k`ven, morcmuneebo! nu dasc`inian ert`manet`s morcmune kac`ebi (sxva)morcmune kac`ebs; shesaz'loa, isini [visac` dasc`inian] uket`esni arian mat`ze [vinc` dasc`inis]! da nu dasc`inian k`alebi ert`manet`s: ik`neb isini mat`ze uket`esni arian! da nu sheurac`xqop`t` sakut`ar t`avs [nu ilaparakebt` ert`manet`ze c`uds] da nu daark`mevt` ert`manet`s sheurac`xmqop`el zedmetsaxelebs. sazizg'aria, rodesac` rcmenis mig'ebis shemdeg adamians ucodeben "bilc saxels"! xolo vinc` ar moinaniebs (t`avisi dac`invis, c`iliscamebisa da sheurac`xqop`is gamo), scored is ik`neba usamart`lo (sakut`ari t`avis mimart`).

hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! eridet` umetes echvs. ramet`u zogiert`i echvi c`odvaa. da nu ut`valt`valebt` ert`manet`s da nurc` itqvit` ert`manet`ze av sitqvas(zurgs ukan). nut`u romelime t`k`vengani isurvebda t`avisi mkvdari z'mis xorc`is chamas? t`k`ven xom shegz'agdebodat` igi. da geshinodet` allahisa. uechvelad, allahi shemndobia, mcqalobelia.

he, adamianebo! cheshmaritad ch`ven shegk`menit` (ert`i) mamakac`isgan [adamisgan] da (ert`i) k`alisgan [havasgan], da gagamravlet`, da gak`c`iet` (sxvadasxva) erebad da tomebad, rat`a ert`manet`i sheic`not`. cheshmaritad, t`k`vengan qvelaze pativc`emuli [amk`veqnad da saik`ioshi sauket`eso da qvelaze g'irseuli] allahis cinashe aris qvelaze metad g'vt`ismoshishi. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismc`odne, qovlisshemc`nobia!

beduinebma t`k`ves: "ch`ven vircmunet` (allahi da misi shuamavali)!" ut`xari (mat`): "t`k`ven jer ar gircmunebiat` (srulqop`ili rcmenit`), aramed t`k`vit`, 'ch`ven davmorch`ildit`, radgan rcmena jer ar shesula t`k`vens gulebshi. magram t`u daemorch`ilebit` allahsa da mis shuamavals, is [allahi] ar sheamc`irebs t`k`vens namok`medars [is ar sheamc`irebs t`k`veni ket`ili sak`meebis sazg'aurs]." cheshmaritad, allahi mpatiebeli da shemcqalebelia

cheshmariti morcmuneebi mxolod isini arian, romlebmac` ircmunes allahi da misi shuamavali, shemdeg ki echvi ar shehparviat`(rcmenashi) da ibrz'odnen t`aviant`i k`onebit`a da sulebit` allahis gzaze. scored isini arian mart`alni.

ut`xari (o, shuamavalo) (am beduinebs): "gana t`k`ven ac`nobebt` allahs t`k`veni rcmenis shesaxeb (t`k`vens gulebshi), mashin roc`a allahma ic`is (qvelap`eri), rac` c`ashi da dedamicazea? da allahma ic`is qovelive
isini gaqvedrian, rom islami miig'es. ut`xari: "nu maqvedrebt` t`k`vens islamshi shemosvlas. aramed, allahma moganichat` madli, rom rcmenisken dagadginat`, t`u t`k`ven xart` mart`alni".
uechvelad, allahma ic`is c`at`a da micis dap`aruli. da allahi mxedvelia imisa, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
qaap`. vp`ic`av didebul qurans!
diax! isini gaoc`ebulni iqvnen, rom mat` [t`aviant` xalxs] shoris gamap`rt`xilebeli [muhammadi] gamoch`nda, da urcmunoebma t`k`ves: "es saoc`rebaa!"
gana shesaz'lebelia, rom rodesac` movkvdebit` da micad vik`c`evit`,(sic`oc`xles davubrundet`?)... es xom shoreuli [ararealuri] dabrunebaa!
radgan ch`ven [allahma] vic`it`, rasac` mica mat`gan ig'ebs da ch`ven gvak`vs cigni, romelic` (c`vlilebebisgan) dac`ulia (da romelshic` ch`acerilia qvelap`eri, rac` iqo da rac` ik`neba).
pirik`it`, mat` simart`le [allahis cigni] sic`rued miich`nies, rodesac` is mat` miuvida; da isini gaurkvevlobashi arian.
gana ar sheuxedavt` mat` mag'la arsebul c`as, rogor avashenet` da shevamket` igi, da rom mas aranairi naprali ar gaach`nia?
da mica, romelic` ch`ven ganvp`inet` da masze mt`ebi davamkvidret` da qovelgvari mshvenieri cqvili (mc`enare) ag'movac`enet` masze.
t`valis asaxelad da shesagoneblad qoveli momnanie monist`vis
da gardmovavlinet` c`idan kurt`xeuli cqali, da ag'movac`enet` misit` bag'ebi da mosavlis marc`vleuli.
da mag'ali palmebi, romelt`ac` ak`vt` mckrivebad ganlagebuli naqop`i.
t`avisi msaxurebis sazrdod, da ch`ven amit` (am cqlit`) gavac`oc`xlet` usulo (mshrali) mica. aseve (rogorc` cqlit` gavzardet` qovelive) (ik`neba) gamosvla (mkvdrebis c`oc`xlad ag'sdgoma)!
mat`ze adre uarqves nuhis xalxma, rasis mkvidrebma da semudelebma.
da adis xalxi, p`araoni da lotis z'mebi
da al-aik`as mc`xovreblebma [shu'aibis xalxma] da tubbas xalxma - qvelam mat`ganma uarqo g'vt`is shuamavlebi, da ch`emi muk`ara ag'srulda.

gana davsustdit` pirveli shek`mnis shemdeg? [gana allahis z'ala t`undac` mc`iredit` shemc`irda mas shemdeg, rac` man arap`risgan qvelap`eri shek`mna? anu, ar gagvchirvebia t`k`veni pirveli shek`mna, da ratom unda gagvichirdes t`k`veni gac`oc`xleba sikvdilis mere?!] magram isini mainc` echvshi rch`ebian axali shek`mnis [ag'dgomis] shesaxeb.
ch`ven shevk`menit` adamiani da vic`it`, ras ch`asch`urch`ulebs mas misi suli, da ch`ven mast`an(adamiant`an) up`ro axlos vart`, vidre misi saz'ile arteria.
roc`a ori mimg'ebi ig'ebs (angelozebi), marjvniv da marc`xniv mjdomni.
arc` ert` sitqvas ar carmot`k`vams, rom mast`an ar iqos mzadmqop`i met`valqure.
da mova sikvdilis t`roba(sikvdilis cina tanjva da tkivilebi) cheshmaritebit`. ai,(adamiano) rasac` shen gaurbodi.
da ch`aibereba saqvirshi. es aris ag't`k`muli dg'e.
da mova qoveli suli, da mast`an ert`ad mz'g'oli da mocme.
uechvelad, shen amis mimart` ugulisquro iqavi, da ch`ven agxadet` sheni sap`arveli, da sheni mzera dg'es basria.
da itqvis misi t`anamgzavri(angelozi): "ai, ra mak`vs gamzadebuli (mis cignshi)!"
ch`aagdet` jojoxet`shi qoveli jiuti urcmuno!
siket`is amkrz'alavs, zg'vargadasuls, echvians
romelmac` allahis t`anaziarad sxva g'vt`aeba gaich`ina, ch`aagdet` igi sastik satanjvelshi.
itqvis misi t`anamgzavri: "ch`veno g'mert`o! me ar amibnevia gza mist`vis, aramed t`avad iqo shoreul c`domilebashi".
ut`xra: "nu medavebit` ch`ems cinashe, me xom cinascar gaucqet` muk`ara".
ch`emt`an sitqva ar ic`vleba da ar var me monebis mch`agvreli.
im dg'es, roc`a vetqvit` jojoxet`s: "aivse?" da is itqvis: "kidev aris?"
da samot`xe miuaxlovdeba g'vt`ismoshishebs, arc`t`u ise shors.
ai, ra ag'get`k`vat` t`k`ven, qovel momnaniebelsa da damc`vels(allahis cesebis).
vinc` dap`arulshi mocqalisa eshinoda da momnanie gulit` movida.
shedit` masshi mshvidobit`. es aris dg'e maradiulobisa.
ik` ek`nebat` mat`, rac` inebon, da ch`vent`an metic`aa
da ramdeni t`aoba gavanadguret` mat`ze ucinares, romlebic` mat`ze up`ro z'lierni iqvnen da moiares k`veqnebi. gana iqo sadme gasak`c`evi?
cheshmaritad, amashi darigebaa mist`vis, visac` guli ak`vs, an qurs daugdebs da is mocmea.
da ch`ven shevk`menit` c`ani da dedamica da rac` mat` shorisaa ek`vs dg'eshi da aranairi dag'liloba ar shegvxebia.
moit`mine, rasac` isini amboben, da adide sheni g'mert`i k`ebit` mzis amosvlamde da ch`asvlamde.
da g'amit`ac` adide igi da (qoveli) sejdis shemdgomac`
da quri miugde im dg'es, roc`a mac`ne axlo adgilidan mouxmobs
im dg'es, roc`a moismenen qizhinas cheshmaritad. es aris gamosvlis dg'e.
cheshmaritad, ch`ven vac`oc`xlebt` da vamkvdarebt`, da ch`vent`anaa dabruneba
im dg'es, roc`a mica gaipoba mat`gan ach`k`arebit`(amovlen sap`lavebidan). es ch`vent`vis ioli shekrebaa.
ch`ven uket` vic`it`, rasac` isini amboben, da shen ar xar mat`ze moz'alade. mash, sheagone quranit` imas, visac` ch`emi muk`aris eshinia.
(me, allahi) vp`ic`av (k`arebs), romlebic` mimop`antaven!
da (g'rublebs), romlebic` tvirt`s (cqals) atareben,
da (navebs) cqalze msubuk`ad moc`uraveni,
da (angelozebs), romlebic` allahis brz'anebas anacileben!
cheshmaritad, is, rasac` dagpirdnen, simart`lea
da cheshmaritad, samsjavro dadgeba
vp`ic`av c`as, (lamaz) bilikebit` (varskvlavebit`) savses
cheshmaritad, t`k`ven urt`iert`sacinaag'mdego sitqvashi xart`
misgan is ac`deba, vinc` ac`denilia
daig'upnen matquarebi (romlebic` mxolod varaudebsa da gamoc`nobebze saubroben)
romlebic` up`skrulshi (urcmunoebisa da shec`domashi) udardelni rch`ebian.
kit`xuloben, rodis dadgeba samsjavros dg'e
im dg'es, roc`a isini c`ec`xlze gamoic`debian.
igemet` t`k`veni sasjeli! es aris is, ris dach`k`arebasac` it`xovdit`.
uechvelad, g'vt`ismoshishni bag'ebsa da cqaroebshi ik`nebian.
miig'eben imas, rac` mat`ma g'mert`ma uboz'a. cheshmaritad, isini amaze ucin ket`ilismk`mnelni iqvnen.
g'amis mc`ire nacils t`u iz'inebdnen
da gant`iadisas shendobas it`xovdnen
da mat` k`onebashi cilia mt`xovnelisa da gachirvebulist`vis.
da micaze nishnebia(mt`ebi, zg'vebi, mdinareebi, xeebi,...) mtkic`ed morcmunet`at`vis
da t`k`venshic` (aseve nat`eli nishnebia romlebic` amtkic`eben allahis qovlis shemz'leobas). nut`u ver xedavt`?!
c`ashia t`k`veni sarch`o da is, rac` ag't`k`muli gak`vt`(kargi ik`neba t`u c`udi).
c`isa da micis up`als vp`ic`av, rom is cheshmaritebaa, iseve rogorc` t`k`veni metqveleba.
xom mogivida ambavi ibrahimis pativdebul stumrebze (angelozebze)?
roc`a mast`an shevidnen da ut`xres: "mshvidoba!" manac` miugo: "mshvidoba! (ch`emt`vis) uc`nobi xalxi xart`".
da t`avis ojaxs miashura da nasuk`i xbo moitana(mas egona rom isini adamianebi iqvnen).
da cin daudo mat`. ut`xra: "nut`u ar shechamt`?"

da (rodesac` dainaxa, rom isini sakvebs ar chamdnen) man (ibrahimma) mat` mimart` shishi igrz'no (gulshi). mat` ut`xres: "nu geshinia!" (ch`ven vart` allahis mier gamogzavnili angelozebi) da misc`es mas (sasixarulo ambavi) c`odnit` savse bichis shesaxeb.
da (am ambis gagonebisas) misi c`oli (saxelad sara) muaxlovda (angelozebs) qvirilit`, (gakvirvebisgan) saxeze irtqamda xels da ambobda: "(rogor gavach`en, roc`a me ukve) moxuc`i da ushvilo k`ali var"
mat` ut`xres: "ase brz'ana shenma up`alma. cheshmaritad, is brz'enia, qovlismc`odnea!"
# man [ibrahimma] t`k`va (angelozebs): "ra aris t`k`veni sak`me [t`k`veni mogzaurobis mizani], o, shuamavlebo?"
mat` t`k`ves: "ch`ven cargvigzavnes meamboxe xalxt`an [cinascarmetqvel lutis xalxt`an, romelmac` uarqo allahis rjuli]".
rat`a mat`ze t`ixis k`vebi dagveshina
nishandebuli sheni up`lis mier zg'vargadasult`at`vis
da gamoviqvanet` ik`idan [sop`lidan, sadac` cinascarmetqveli luti c`xovrobda] morcmuneebi, romlebic` ik` iqvnen.
da ch`ven masshi (lutis saxlis garda) ver vipovet` sxva saxli, romelshic` (c`xovrobdnen) morch`ilni (allahisadmi).
da ch`ven davtovet` masshi [allahis mier gamogzavnili sasjelis] nishnebi mat`t`vis, vinc` mtkivneuli sasjelis shishobs.
da musashic`(nishania), roc`a carvgzavnet` igi p`araont`an c`xadi sabut`it`.
magram man [p`araonma] zurgi ak`c`ia (allahis shuamavlis shegonebebs) t`avisi mxardamcherebit` [t`avisi mimdevrebit`] da t`k`va (cinascarmetqvel musaze): "(an) jadok`aria, an sheshlili!"
da shevipqarit` is da misi lashk`ari da ch`avqaret` isini zg'vashi. da is [p`araoni] dagmobis g'irsia!
da (aseve) aditebis ganadgurebashi (nishania mat`t`vis, romelt`ac` eshiniat` mtkivneuli sasjelisa) amitom ch`ven mat`ze(aditelebs) gamanadgurebeli k`ari gamovgzavnet`,
(romelic`) t`avis gzaze arap`ers tovebs mtverad k`c`evis gareshe.
da (nishnebia) samudiant`a (ganadgurebashic`). mat` et`k`vat`: "igemet` (c`xovreba) gansazg'vruli droit`".
magram mat` zurgi ak`c`ies t`aviant`i up`lis brz'anebas [ar daemorch`ilnen mas], da mat` daatqdat` gamanadgurebeli sasjeli, mashin, roc`a uqurebdnen (t`valit` xedavdnen, rogor modioda igi mat`ze).
veg'ar shez'les camodgoma da verc` t`avis dac`va.
da nuhis xalxi (davsajet` ganadgurebit`) mat` cin(viszec` saubari iqo). namdvilad, isini (allahisadmi) urch`i xalxi iqo.
da ch`ven ag'vamag'let` c`ani z'alit` da, namdvilad, ch`ven vart` ganmavrc`obelni [c`at`a].
da ch`ven gavshalet` mica. da ra mshvenieri gamshlelni vart`
da qovelive cqvil-cqvilad gavach`inet`, egebis dap`ik`rdet`(rom g'mert`i ert`ia, da qovlis shemz'lea, ramet`u is aris am qvelap`ris shemok`medi)
mash, gaik`ec`it` allahisken! cheshmaritad, me t`k`vent`vis misgan c`xadi gamp`rt`xilebeli var.
da ar gaich`inot` allahis t`anaziarad sxva g'vt`aeba. uechvelad, me t`k`vent`vis misgan c`xadi shemgonebeli var.
aseve, mat`ze ucindelebt`anac` ar misula arc` ert`i shuamavali, rom ar et`k`vat` mist`vis: "jadok`aria an sheshlili!"
gana mat` ert`manet`s daubares es memkvidreobad (radgan qvela ase ambobs)? ara, isini zg'vars gadac`ilebuli xalxia!(da es aris mat`i saert`o qovel epok`ashi, anu zg'vars gadasvla da urcmonoeba)
mash, zurgi ak`c`ie mat`, da shen ar xar dasaz'raxisi.
da sheaxsene, radgan shexseneba sasargebloa morcmunet`at`vis.
da ar shemik`mnia jinebi da adamianebi, garda imisa, rom ch`emt`vis ec`at` t`aqvani.
da mat`gan aranair sarch`os ar vit`xov, arc` imas vit`xov, rom machamon. [mat`gan arap`eri mchirdeba, rogorc` batonebs schirdebat` t`aviant`i monebis shroma]
cheshmaritad, allahia sarch`os mboz'ebeli, z'alis mp`lobeli, mtkic`e.

cheshmaritad, mat`, vinc` usamart`loba ch`aidines (muhammadis uarqop`it`) (garkveuli) cili (sasjelisa) msgavsi t`aviant`i (cinandeli) t`anamgzavrebis (sasjelis cilis), romlebmac` uarqves cina cinascarmetqvelebi, dae, nu mach`k`areben (sasjelis movlenashi)!
vai(ganadgureba da ubedureba), imat`, vinc` ar ircmunes, im dg'isagan, romelic` ag'et`k`vat`!
vp`ic`av turis mt`as (romelzec` cinascarmetqvelma musam qovlisshemz'le allaht`an ilaparaka)
da cigns (qurans), dacerils
gashlil etratshi

da saxls, romelsac` stumroben [zec`iuri taz'ari, romelic` meshvide zec`aze mdebareobs, sadac` samoc`daat`i at`asi angelozi qoveldg'iurad shedis, rat`a ik` allahs t`aqvani sc`en, da amis shemdeg isini ik` ag'arasdros brundebian],
da amag'lebul chers [qvelaze axlos mqop`i c`a - samqaro]
da zg'vas ag'vsebuls
cheshmaritad, sheni up`lis sasjeli (o, shuamavalo) (romelic` urcmunoebs dahpirda) uechvelad dadgeba.
araa (aranairi z'ala) misi amridebeli
im dg'es, roc`a c`a z'lier sheiz'vreba(nishnad imisa rom es k`veqana dasasruls miuaxlovda)
da mt`ebi daicqeben moz'raobas (g'rublebivit`).
vai im dg'es imat`t`vis, vinc` sic`rued sherac`xavda,
romelnic` c`rusitqvaobashi ert`obian( da ar adardebt`, da arc` scamt` xelmeored gac`oc`xlebisa)
im dg'es, roc`a mat` jojoxet`is c`ec`xlshi uxeshad sheqrian
(da et`k`mebat` mat`): "es aris c`ec`xli, romelsac` uarqop`dit`"
nut`u es jadok`robaa, t`u t`k`ven ver xedavt`?
(da etqvian mat`): "daicvit` masshi! moit`ment` t`u ara, sulert`ia. t`k`ven mxolod imis mixedvit` miig'ebt` sazg'aurs, rasac` (dedamicaze c`xovrebisas) aket`ebdit`".
uechvelad, g'vt`ismoshishni (ag'moch`ndebian) samot`xeebsa da netarebashi.
datkbebian imit`, rasac` up`ali uboz'ebt` mat`. da up`alma ixsna isini jojoxet`is tanjvisagan.
(mat` etqvian): chamet` da svit` netarebit` t`k`veni namok`medaris gamo
isini micolilni ik`nebian mckrivad gacqobil taxtebze da ch`ven shevaug'lebt` mat` t`valmshvenier huriebs.

da romelt`ac` ircmunes da mat`i shvilebi rcmenashi mat` mihqvnen, - ch`ven mat` [morcmune mshoblebs] (samot`xeshi) shevuert`ebt` mat` shvilebs da ar shevamc`irebt` mat` sak`meebs [mshoblebis sazg'aurs] t`undac` mc`iredit`. qoveli adamiani aris t`avisi namok`medaris mz'evali.
da ch`ven davamatet` mat` (kidev up`ro meti) naqop`i da xorc`i, ra saxisac` ar unda moesurvebinat`.
ik` isini ert`manet`s p`ialas gaucvdian (zec`iuri g'vinit`) - amit` [am g'vinit`] arc` p`uchsitqvaoba ik`neba da arc` c`odvisken cak`ezeba.
da gars shemouvlian mat` chabukni, (romlebic` t`aviant`i silamazit`a da sicmindit`) hgvanan margalitebs, shenaxuls (sazg'vao nizharashi).
da isini ert`manet`s miubrundebian da shekit`xvebs dausvamen(ert`manet`s), (rogor daimsaxures allahisgan aset`i sazg'auri)
isini upasuxeben: "cheshmaritad, ch`ven gveshinoda (allahis sasjelis), rodesac` ch`vens ojaxebt`an ert`ad viqavit` [ch`vens micier c`xovrebashi]".
magram allahma shegvicqala da gvixsna mcveli k`aris tanjvisgan (jojoxet`is c`ec`xlisgan).
cheshmaritad, ch`ven cinat` vt`xovdit` mas (rom davec`vet` jojoxet`is sasjelisgan da moenichebina ch`vent`vis samot`xis netareba); radgan is cheshmaritad, ket`ilismqop`eli da shemcqalebelia!

da sheaxsene mat` (quranit`) (romelt`a mimart`ac` shen xar gagzavnili, o, shuamavalo)! da shen (o, shuamavalo), sheni up`lis cqalobit`, arc` mkit`xavi xar da arc` sheshlili (rogorc` mravalg'mert`ianebi c`rud gdeben brals).
an isini amboben (shenze, o, moc`ik`ulo): "(diax, is mxolod) poetia - movic`adot` misi bedis c`vlilebas [rodesac` mokvdeba da davisvenebt` misgan]".
ut`xari mat`: "daelodet` (ch`ems sikvdils), cheshmaritad, mec` t`k`vent`an ert`ad var momlodinet`a shoris [davelodebi, sanam allahis sasjeli dagatqdebat` ch`ems mimart` urcmonoebis gamo]!"
an (ik`neb) mat`i goneba ubrz'anebs mat`, rom ase moik`c`nen, an (shesaz'loa) isini arian adamianebi, romlebic` zg'vars gadavidnen (allahisadmi urch`obashi)?
an (isini) amboben: "man [muhammadma] is [qurani] (t`avad) gamoigona!" magram mat` ar scamt` (allahisa da mis mier gagzavnili shuamavlis)!
dae, moitanon amis msgavsi t`xroba [qurani], t`u mart`lebi arian (t`aviant` mtkic`ebulebebshi)!
an (nut`u) isini arap`risgan [shemok`medis gareshe] sheik`mnen, an t`avad arian sakut`ari t`avis shemok`medni?
an (ik`neb) mat` shek`mnes c`a da mica?! magram mat` ar scamt` (cheshmaritebisa;arc` samot`xis, da arc` jojoxet`is)!
an (gana) mat`t`anaa sheni g'mert`is saganz'urebi, an isini arian ganmgebelni?
an ik`neb mat` ak`vt` kibe (romlit`ac` zec`ashi adian da) ismenen (angelozt`a sitqvebs)? mat` shoris, vinc` ismens, movides c`xadi mtkic`ebulebit` (romelic` mat` simart`leze miut`it`ebs).
t`u mas [allahs] hqavs k`alishvilebi, t`k`ven ki (o, mravalg'mert`ianebo) -- vazhebi?
an ik`neb sazg'aurs st`xov mat` (allahisgan cheshmaritebis motanist`vis), da isini valit` arian damz'imebulni?
an mat` uxilavis (c`odna) ak`vt` da amas (xalxist`vis) iceren (da amc`noben)?
an ik`neb xrikis mocqoba surt`? magram urcmunoebs mat`i xriki mat`ve daubrundebat`.
t`u mat` allahis garda sxva g'mert`i hqavt`? gandidebulia allahi qoveliveze, rasac` mas [urcmunoebi] miaceren!
da t`u isini ixilaven (uzarmazar) natexs, romelic` c`idan (mat` dasasjelad) ch`amovardeba, itqvian: "(es mxolod) ert`manet`ze shek`uch`ebuli g'rublebia!"
datove isini (o, shuamavalo) im dg'emde, rodesac` mat` t`avs daatqdebat` (elvis dartqmasavit`) [sikvdilis dg'e].
im dg'es, roc`a verap`ers argebt` mat` mat`ive xriki da arc` shecevna ek`nebat`.
da uechvelad, usamart`lot`at`vis aris sasjeli amis garda, magram mat`ma umravlesobam ar ucqis.

da moit`mine (o, muhammad) sheni up`lis gadacqvetilebamde! radgan, cheshmaritad, shen ch`vens t`valcin xar [ch`ven mudam gxedavt` da gic`avt` mat`gan shenze mocqobili mzakvruli gegmebisgan]. da ganadide sheni up`ali, misi k`ebit` (qovelt`vis) rodesac` shen camodgebi!
da ganadide igi [allahi] g'amis ert`-ert` nacilshi da rodesac` varskvlavebi gak`rebian (gant`iadze).
vp`ic`av varskvlavs, roc`a is eshveba
arc` gzas asc`denia t`k`veni t`anamgzavri(muhammadi allahma daloc`os igi) da arc` shemc`dara
da arc` sakut`ari survilit` metqvelebs igi.
es [qurani] arap`eria, garda allahisgan sht`agonebuli zesht`agonebisa.
ascavla mas (muhammads) z'alze z'lierma (jibrilma)
z'alis mk`one (mshvenieri shexedulobis), romelic` gamart`ulad dadga
da is iqo umag'les horizontze(c`ashi)
shemdeg miuaxlovda (jibrili) da (dabla)ch`amoeshva
da is [jibrili] (moc`ik`ulisgan) iqo ori mshvildis manz'ilze, an kidev up`ro axlos.
da sht`aagona(jibrilma) mis(allahis) monas is, rac` sht`aagona (qurani)
ar c`ruobda guli imashi, rac` ixila.
nut`u mas edavebit` imaze, rasac` xedavs?(rac` man zec`ashi mogzaurobisas naxa)
da ixila man is (jibrili) meoredac`.
sidras (lotosis) ukidures zg'varze [meshvide zec`is zemot` mdgom uzarmazar xest`an, romelic` qvelaze mag'ali zg'varia micidan ag'mavalt`at`vis da uzenaesi allahisgan ch`amomavalt`at`vis]
mast`an aris (samot`xis) maradiuli t`avshesap`ris bag'i(samot`xe).
(da) aha, lotosi (alahis brz'anebit`) dap`ara rag'ac`am (didebulma, rasac` allahis garda veravin ag'cers].
mis [muhammadis] mzeras ar gadauxvevia (arc` marc`xniv da arc` marjvniv) da ar gasc`denia sazg'vrebs (imisa, rac` allahma ubrz'ana daenaxa)
uechvelad, man ixila t`avisi g'mert`is udidesi sascault`agani.
ginaxavt` al-lat`i da al-uzza?(ori kerpis saxeli)
da kidev mesame - manat`i?
gana t`k`vent`vis vazhi (sht`amomavloba), xolo mas [allahs] mdedrobit`i sk`esis (miich`nevt`), (angelozebs allahis k`alishvilebs rom ucodebt`)?
mashin es usamart`lo ganacileba qop`ila

isini [es kerpebi] mxolod saxelebia, romlebic` t`k`ven da t`k`venma mamebma daark`vit`. allahs ar mouvlenia mat`ze aranairi mtkic`ebuleba. da isini mxolod varaudebsa da sakut`ari sulebis survilebs mihqvebian, mashin roc`a mat` t`aviant`i up`lisgan mouvidat` scori gzis ch`veneba.
nut`u adamians (miec`ema) qvelap`eri, rasac` isurvebs?(c`ru g'mert`ebis shuamdgomloba allahsa adamians shoris)?!
(ara, ar miec`ema mas)cheshmaritad, allahs ekut`vnis maradiuli c`xovreba da pirvelic`
da ramdeni angelozia zec`ashi, romelt`a shuamdgomlobac` arap`rad gamodgeba, t`u allahi ar daushvebs (shuamdgomlobas) mat`t`vis, vist`visac` is inebebs da visit`ac` kmaqop`ilia!
cheshmaritad, romelt`ac` ar scamt` saik`io, angelozebs mdedrobit` saxelebs ark`meven.
da mat` amis shesaxeb arap`eri ic`ian; isini mxolod varauds mihqvebian, varaudi ki, mart`lac`, cheshmaritebis nacilsac` ki ver shec`vlis!
mash, zurgi ak`c`ie mas, vinc` zurgi ak`c`ia ch`vens gaxsenebas da arap`eri surs, garda amk`veqniuri c`xovrebisa.
es [mdgomareoba] mat`i c`odnis (da miscrap`ebebis) zg'varia. cheshmaritad, t`k`venma up`alma sauket`esod ic`is, vin gadauxvia t`avis gzas da sauket`esod ic`is, vin mihqva scor gzas.

da allahs ekut`vnis (qvelap`eri) c`at`a shina da (qvelap`eri) k`veqanaze, rat`a man miuzg'os mat`, vinc` boroti ch`aidina (shesabamisi sasjelit`) da (rat`a) daajildoos isini, vinc` siket`e aket`es sauket`esot`i.

romelnic` eridebian did c`odvebsa da saz'aglobebs, garda mc`ire shec`domebisa. cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i usazg'vrod mimtevebelia. man uket` ic`is t`k`ven shesaxeb, roc`a micisgan gagach`inat` da roc`a ch`anasaxebi iqavit` t`k`veni dedebis muc`elshi. amitom, nu ganadidebt` sakut`ar t`avs. man uket` ic`is, vin aris g'vt`ismoshishi.
xom ar ginaxavs is, vinc` zurgi ak`c`ia?
da gasc`a mc`iredi da z'uncobda?
gana mas [vinc` z'uncobda] ak`vs uxilavis c`odna, rasac` is xedavs?(anu mas ar ak`vs uxilavis c`odna, aramed is t`vit`on igonebs da allahs acers)
nut`u ar eucqa mas, rac` iqo musas cerilebshi?
da ibrahimisa, romelmac` sheasrula (rac` mas ebrz'ana)
rom arc` ert`i mtvirt`veli sxvis tvirt`s ar itvirt`avs(sxvis ch`adenil c`odvaze adamiani pasuxs ar agebs)
da rom adamians arap`eri ekut`vnis, garda imisa, rist`visac` ig'cvoda
da rom misi nag'vaci nanaxi ik`neba
shemdeg miezg'veba mas sruli sazg'auri
da rom shens g'mert`t`anaa saboloo dabruneba.
da rom scored is gac`inebs da gatirebs
da rom scored is amkvdarebs da ac`oc`xlebs
da rom man shek`mna cqvili - mamri da mdedri.
t`eslis cvet`isagan, roc`a gadmoig'vreba (sashvilosnoshi)
da rom maszea meored gac`oc`xleba(gankit`xvis dg'ist`vis)
da rom scored is aris, vinc` amdidrebs da akmaqop`ilebs
da rom isaa up`ali siriusisa [varskvlavi, romelsac` zogiert`i arabi sc`emda t`aqvans],
da rom scored man [allahma] gaanadgura pirveli aditebi [xalxi, vist`anac` shuamavali hudi iqo gagzavnili].
da samudis [xalxic` gaanadgura, vist`anac` shuamavali salihi iqo gagzavnili], da (is) arc`ert`i ar datova
da manamde nuhis xalxi. uechvelad, isini iqvnen qvelaze usamart`loni da qvelaze metad zg'vargasulni.
da amotrialebuli k`alak`ebi daamxo (lutis dasaxleba)
da dap`ara igi imit`, rit`ac` dap`ara (didi lodebit`)
mash, sheni up`lis romel siket`eshi shegak`vs echvi?
es [muhammadi] aris (zustad iset`ive) gamap`rt`xilebeli (rogorc` sxva gamap`rt`xileblebi) pirvelt`agan [cinandeli cinascarmetqvelt`agan].
moaxlovda garduvali(gankit`xvis dg'e)
allahis garda aravinaa misi amc`ilebeli
nut`u am sitqvis gikvirt` (quranis)?
da ic`init` da ar tirit`
da agrz'elebt` ampartavnobas
mash daemxet` allahis cinashe da emsaxuret` (da t`aqvani ec`it`) (mxolod mas)!
saat`i moaxlovda da mt`vare gaipo
da t`u isini sascauls ixilaven, zurgs sheak`c`even da itqvian: "es gaxangrz'livebuli jadok`robaa!"
mat` uarqves da t`aviant` vnebebs ahqvnen. da qoveli sak`me dadgenilia.(kargi ik`neba t`u c`udi qvelas miegeba is, rac` ekut`vnis)
da uechvelad, mouvidat` mat` c`nobebi(ambebi), romlebshic` shemakavebelia(urcmunoebist`vis damashinebeli istoriebi)
srulqop`ili sibrz'ne, magram ras argebs gap`rt`xilebani?
mash, zurgi ak`c`ie mat`! im dg'es, roc`a momcodebeli moucodebs sazareli ramisken
damdablebuli mzerit` gamovlen samarxebidan, t`it`k`osda gap`antuli kaliebi.
isini momcodeblisken (angelozi israp`ili) gaeshurebian. urcmunoebi itqvian: "es mz'ime dg'ea!"
mat`ze adre nuhis xalxmac` uarqo. da uarqves ch`veni msaxuri da t`k`ves: "sheshliliao!" da daemuk`rnen mas (rom k`vebit` ch`ak`olavdnen, t`u xalxis cheshmariti rcmenisken mocodebas ar shecqvetda).
da igi [nuhi] sheevedra t`avis up`als: "cheshmaritad, damarc`xebuli var [ver vecinaag'mdegebi urcmunoebs], amitom damexmare (mat`ze mat`i urcmunoebis gamo sasjelis movlenit`)!"
(da vupasuxet` mis vedrebas) da gavxsenit` zec`is karibcheebi cqlit`, romelic` g'varad moedineboda,
da gamovavlinet` cqaroebi micidan da sheercqnen cqlebi (zec`iuri da micieri) ukve dadgenili brz'anebisamebr.
da ch`ven davaqenet` igi [cinascarmetqveli nuhi] p`ic`rebsa da lursmnebze damzadebul xomaldze (kidobanze).
mic`uravda ch`veni met`valqureobit`, sazg'aurad mist`vis, vinc` uarqop`il ik`na(amdagvarad sheveciet` nuhs, da gavanadguret` misi urcmuno eri)
da ch`ven davtovet` igi, rogorc` nishani. magram aris ki vinme, vinc` darigebas ismens?
aba, rogori iqo ch`emi sasjeli da ch`emi gap`rt`xilebebi?
da (me [allahi] vp`ic`av, rom) qurani advili gavxade dasamaxsovreblad, magram aris ki vinme, vinc` quradg'ebas miak`c`evs (am cignis shegonebebs) [da sargebels miig'ebs misgan]?
aditebma uarqves (cinascarmetqveli hudi). da rogor iqo ch`emi sazg'auri (urcmunot`at`vis) da ch`emi shegoneba!
cheshmaritad, ch`ven gamovgzavnet` mat`ze [aditebze] c`ivi (gamanadgurebeli) k`ari dg'es, romlis ubedurebac` (shvidi dg'e da rva g'ame) gagrz'elda (sanam qvela daig'upeboda).
romelic` adamianebs z'irp`esvianad glejda, t`it`k`os amoz'irkvuli palmis z'irebi qop`iliqvnen
da rogori iqo ch`emi sasjeli da ch`emi shegonebani?!
cheshmaritad, ch`ven gavaadvilet` qurani shesagoneblad. mash, aris ki vinme vinc` sheigonebs?
samudma uarqo gap`rt`xilebani
da t`k`ves: "nut`u ch`vens shoris ert` kac`s mivqvet`? mashin xom ch`ven c`domilebasa da tanjvashi vik`nebit`!"
nut`u ch`vens shoris mainc`damainc` masze gardmoevlina shegoneba? ara, is matquara k`edmag'alia!
xval gaigeben, vin aris matquara, k`edmag'ali!

cheshmaritad, ch`ven movavlent` mdedr ak`lems (romelic` mat` t`vit`on it`xoves) (kldidan amosuls) (rogorc` sascauli da) rogorc` gansac`deli mat`t`vis [samudebist`vis]. amitom moit`mine mat` mimart` (o, salih)!

da ut`xari mat` (o, salih), rom cqali mat` shoris aris gaqop`ili [shens xalxsa da dedal ak`lems shoris]: t`it`oeulma t`avisi danishnul droshi unda dalios [ert` dg'es mt`eli cqali dedal ak`lems, meore dg'es ki -- mt`eli cqali xalxs].
da dauz'axes t`aviant` z'mas [da ubiz'ges mat` shoris qvelaze ubedurs, moekla mdedri ak`lemi], da manac` sheudga sak`mes da (mashin) gadauchra barklis ig'liebi (rom camoegdo da shemdeg daekla).
aba, rogori iqo ch`emi sasjeli da ch`emi gap`rt`xilebebi?!
cheshmaritad, ch`ven mat` [samudianebs] mxolod ert`i xma gamovugzavnet` [angeloz jibrilis mier gamoc`emuli mz'lavri xma], da isini mec`xoveleobist`vis gankut`vnili (mshrali) balaxis msgavsni gaxdnen.
da ch`ven gavaadvilet` qurani shesagoneblad. mash, aris ki vinme vinc` sheigonebs?
c`rud sherac`xa lutis xalxma shemgonebelni
ch`ven mat` k`vebis k`arishxali davatexet`, garda lutis ojaxisa. isini garizhrazhze vixsenit`.
cqalobad ch`vengan. ase mivagebt` ch`ven madliers.
da man namdvilad gaap`rt`xila isini ch`veni sasjelis shesaxeb, magram mat` echvi sheitanes gap`rt`xilebebshi.

da isini sheupovrad st`xovdnen [luts] mis stumrebs (romlebic` adamianis saxit` gamoch`enili angelozebi iqvnen, rom mat`t`an garqvnileba ch`aedinat`), da ch`ven davabrmavet` mat`i t`valebi. (da et`k`vat` mat`): "igemet` ch`emi sasjeli da shegoneba!"
da cheshmaritad, dilaadrian ecviat` mat` gardauvali sasjeli.
mash, igemet` ch`emi sasjeli da ch`emi shegonebani
cheshmaritad, ch`ven gavaadvilet` qurani shesagoneblad. mash, aris ki vinme shegonebis mimg'ebi?
da uechvelad, ecvia p`araonis ojaxs shemgonebelni.
mat` uarqves ch`veni qvela nishani da ch`ven shevipqarit` isini z'levamosilisa da qovlisshemz'lis shepqrobit`.

nut`u t`k`veni urcmunoebi (o, qureishelebo), uket`esni arian imat`ze (romlebic` t`aviant`i urcmunoebis gamo sikvdilit` daisajnen), t`u gak`vt` dac`vis cerili (romelic` ac`xadebs, rom allahi ar dagsjit`) cerilebshi (romlebic` cinascarmetqvelebs gadmoec`a)?
an ik`neb amboben: "ch`ven ert`iani, gamarjvebuli z'ala vart`(mek`eli urcmunoebi)".
male es shekreba (umorcmuno qureishelebis) damarc`xdeba da isini zurgs sheak`c`even. {da es asec` moxda badris brz'olashi.}
magram saat`i [gankit`xvis dg'is] aris mat`t`vis ag't`k`muli dro, da saat`i up`ro sashineli da mcarea (vidre sasjeli, romelic` mat` badrshi miig'es)!
uechvelad, meamboxeni gzaabnevasa (amk`veqnad) da alshi arian (saik`ioshi)!
im dg'es, roc`a mat` saxit` c`ec`xlshi ch`aat`reven [etqvian]: "igemet` jojoxet`is shexeba!"
cheshmaritad, ch`ven qvelap`eri shevk`menit` cinascar gansazg'vrit`
ch`veni brz'aneba mxolod ert`ia(ert`i sitqvis t`k`vit`), t`valis daxamxamebis msgavsad.
da ch`ven ukve davg'upet` t`k`veni msgavsni. nut`u aris vinme dap`ik`rebuli?
da qovelive, rac` mat` ch`aidines, cignebshia.
da qoveli, mc`ire da didi, ch`acerilia.
uechvelad, g'vt`ismoshishni bag'ebsa da mdinareebshi ik`nebian.
simart`lis savaneshi, qovlisshemz'le meup`is cinashe
mocqalem
ascavla qurani (adamians)
(da) man shek`mna adamiani
(da) ascavla mas sakut`ari azris gamoxatva.
mze da mt`vare (moz'raoben) (zusti) t`anmimdevrobit`,
da varskvlavebi (c`ashi) da xeebi (micaze) ixrebian (t`aviant`i up`lis cinashe).
da man [alahma] ag'amag'la c`a (micis zemot`) da daamqara sascori [samart`lianobisa] (da ubrz'ana t`avis k`mnilebebs, qop`iliqvnen mart`lebi).
rat`a ar gadaxvidet` zg'vars sascorshi (aconvisas)
da acone samart`lianad [scorad] da nu daakleb conas sascorze (rodesac` adamianebs auconit`)!
da daadgina mica t`avis k`mnilebat`at`vis
masze [micaze] aris (sxvadasxva) naqop`i da (aseve) palmebi p`ialebit` [gvirgvinis p`urc`lebit`] (romlidanac` naqop`i izrdeba)
da g'eroiani marc`vleuli da surnelovani balaxebi (rogorc` sakvebi t`k`vent`vis da t`k`veni c`xovelebist`vis).
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
man shek`mna kac`i [adami] mshrali t`ixisgan, mek`ot`nis t`ixis msgavsi,
da shek`mna jinebi sup`t`a [ukvamlo] c`ec`xlisgan
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
mzis ori amosvlis up`ali [zap`xulisa da zamt`ris mzis amosvlebi] da mzis ori ch`asvlis up`ali [zap`xulisa da zamt`ris mzis ch`asvlebi].
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?

man gaaert`iana ori zg'va (mariliani da mtknari),
romlebic` ert`manet`s ukavshirdebian.
mat` shoris aris (garkveuli) barieri, romlit`ac` isini [es ori zg'va] ar gadadian [am ori zg'vis mariliani da mtknari cqali ar ereva ert`manet`shi]
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
mat`gan (am zg'vebidan) gamodis margaliti da marjani
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
da mas ekut`vnis zg'vashi mt`ebivit` ag'mart`uli ialk`nebi.
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
qvela, vinc` maszea, gak`reba (mokvdeba)
da mxolod sheni up`lis saxea maradiuli, romelic` didebulebis da siuxvis mk`onea.
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
mas (allahs) evedreba qoveli c`at`a da k`veqanat`a shina. qoveldg'e is sak`meshia [mic`emit`a da cart`mevit`, amag'lebit`a da damdablebit`]
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?

male [gankit`xvis dg'es] t`k`vent`visac` movic`lit` [ch`avatarebt` angarishscorebas da sazg'aurs], o, ori saxeobis arsebebo [adamianebo da jinnebo,allahi moc`lilia qovelt`vis, magram ak` igulisxmeba muk`ara amnairi p`ormit`]!
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?

o, jinebisa da adamianebis sazogadoebav! t`u shegiz'liat` c`isa da micis sazg'vrebs gasc`det`, mashin cadit`! [t`k`ven ver gadalaxavt` c`iur sazg'vrebs da, amitom, ver gaek`c`evit` allahis z'alaup`lebas t`k`venze.] t`k`ven ver gadalaxavt`, garda z'alit` [allahis z'alaup`lebis k`vesh qop`nit` da mxolod misi nebit`].
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
t`k`venze moivlineba c`ec`xlis ali da kvamli da ver gaimarjvebt`(anu allahs ver gaek`c`evit` )
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
da rodesac` [gankit`xvis dg'es] c`a gaixsneba da gacit`ldeba, rogorc` (adug'ebuli) zet`i (an gamdnari tqvia).
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
im dg'es [gankit`xvis dg'es], rodesac` arc` adamianebs da arc` jinebs ar hkit`xaven t`aviant`i c`odvebis shesaxeb [ra c`odvebi ch`aidines] (radganac` sak`meebis cignebi caredgineba).
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
(angelozebi) amboxebulebs [urcmunoebs] mat` nishnebit` ic`noben, da daicheren mat` k`och`rit` da p`exebit` (da jojoxet`shi ch`aagdeben).
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
(da it`k`mis urcmunot`at`vis): "es aris jojoxet`i, romelsac` (sic`oc`xleshi) meamboxeebi [urcmunoni] sic`rues ucodebdnen!
isini ivlian (sasjelis mimg'ebni) mis [c`ec`xlsa] da mdug'are cqals shoris.
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
xolo visac` t`avisi g'mert`is cinashe cardgomisa eshinoda [erideboda c`odvebs], mist`vis ori samot`xea
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
gashlili totebi (romlebzec` naqop`ia dakidebuli)
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
oriveshi [am ori samot`xis bag'shi] ori cqaro moedineba.
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
oriveshi [am or bag'shi] (aris) cqvili [ori saxeoba] qvela xilis.
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
miqrdnobilni taxtebze, romelt`a sarch`uli sk`eli xaverdisaa, da orive bag'is naqop`i axloa.
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
mat`shi arian mzera daceuli k`alculebi,(romlebic` mxolod t`aviant` meug'leebs uqureben) romlebsac` mat`amde arc` adamiani da arc` jini ar shexebia.
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
isini [samot`xis huriebi] silamazit` hgvanan [cit`el] lals da korals
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
gana siket`is sazg'auri (amk`veqnad) siket`e ar aris (saik`ioshi)?
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
da mat` garda(mag ori samot`xis garda) kidev ori bag'ia
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
molurjo-moshavo
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
mat`shi ori mdug'are cqaroa
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
orivesshia (samot`xis) naqop`i, da palmebi, da broceulebi
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
mat`shi [am ot`x samot`xis bag'shi] (arian) ket`ilshobili, lamazi (garegnulad) (huriebi),
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
shavt`vala huriebi, karvebshi damalulni
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
romelt`ac` mat`ze cin arc` adamiani da arc` jini ar shexebia.
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
camocolilni mcvane balishebsa da mshvenier xalich`ebze.
mash, t`k`veni up`lis romel siket`es uarqop`t`?
kurt`xeulia saxeli sheni up`lisa, didebisa da pativis mp`lobelisa!
rodesac` movlena moxdeba [rodesac` saqviri gaismis ag'dgomis dg'es],
romlis dadgomasac` veravin uarqop`s [im momentshi veravin shez'lebs imis t`k`mas, rom samsjavros dg'is mosvla sic`ruea]!
(es movlena ik`neba) damamc`irebeli [miiqvans damc`irebamde] (allahis mtrebs) da amag'lebas [pativisc`emamde miiqvans] (allahis mxardamcherebs),
rodesac` mica sashineli sherqevit` ik`neba sherqeuli
da (roc`a) mt`ebi ch`amoishlebian da daishlebian
da gadaik`c`nen gap`antul, mc`ire nacilakebad.
da t`k`ven (o, adamianebo) sam jgup`ad ik`c`evit` (gankit`xvis dg'es).

marjvena mxares rom arian - (da) vin arian isini,
marjvena mxares rom arian?
da marc`xena mxares mqop`ni [qvela urcmuno, mat` shoris matquarebi], - (da) vin arian isini, marc`xena mxares mqop`ni?

da isini, vinc` sxvebze cinmscrebni arian (am k`veqnad rcmenis mig'ebashi da ket`ili sak`meebis ket`ebashi,) cinmscrebni arian (im k`veqnadac`, rat`a miig'on sazg'auri maradiuli sic`oc`xlisa da shevidnen samot`xeshi)
isini arian daaxloebulni(allaht`an)
(maradiul) netarebis bag'ebshi
jgup`i pirvelt`agan (shauamavali muhammadis umma da cinamorbedi ummat`ebidanac`)
da mc`iredni ukanasknelt`agan [shuamavali muhammadis t`emis momdevno t`aobebs shoris]
(mjdomare) taxtebze, nak`argi (ok`rot`i da z'virp`asi k`vebit`),
miqrdnobilni mat`ze [sacolebze], ert`manet`is pirispir
gars shemouvlian mat` maradqmacvili qrmebi [msaxurni]
t`asebit`, dok`ebit` (sasmelebit`) da chik`ebit` (samot`xis g'vino) (romelic` moedineba) (ucqveti) cqarodan
arc` t`avi astkivdebat` misgan [samot`xis g'vinisgan] da arc` dat`vrebian
da (mat`i msaxurebic` miutanen) naqop`s imisgan, rac` mat` airch`ies,
da p`rinvelis xorc`it`, romelsac` isurveben

da (mat`i meug'leebi ik` ik`nebian) shavt`vala da
didt`valeba (k`alculebi)[huriebi],

(romlebic`, t`aviant`i silamazit`a da sicmindit`)
margalitebivit` arian, shenaxuli (zg'vis nizharashi)

(da es samot`xis siket`eni miec`at` mat`) sanac`vlod (t`aviant`i up`lisagan) imisat`vis, rac` (t`aviant` micier c`xovrebashi) [mart`ali sak`meebisat`vis, romlebsac` mat` asrulebden rcmenit`a da c`odvebis mitovebit`].
ik` ar moismenen p`uch sitqvasa da arc` c`odvian saubars
aramed sitqvebi: "mshvidoba, mshvidoba!" (romlit`ac` qovlisshemz'le allahi, angelozebi da samot`xis mc`xovrebi esalmebian ert`manet`s)
da marjvena mxaris xalxi, vin aris marjvena mxaris xalxi?
(isini ic`xovreben) ueklo lotosebs shoris,
da (bananebs shoris), (romelt`a naqop`i) rigebad aris ch`amokidebuli,
da (maradiulad) gacelil ch`rdilebs shoris
da dasxmuli cqali (romelic` arxshi ar miedineba),
da (bevr) xils shoris

gaut`avebeli [romelic` arasdros
mt`avrdeba] da aravis mier da aravist`vis akrz'aluli ar aris
da amag'lebul sacolebze
cheshmaritad, ch`ven shevk`menit` isini [samot`xis k`alebi] gansakut`rebul arsebad.
da ch`ven vhk`menit` isini (maradiul) k`alculebad [romlebic` kvlav k`alculebi xdebian k`mrebt`an intimuri kavshiris shemdeg]
(k`mrebis mimart`) mosiqvaruleni [arasdros ig'lebian meug'leebist`vis sasiamovno sak`meebis ket`ebit`], t`anascorni [t`anascori da axalgazrda asakis]
(da es qvelap`eri) marjvena mxares mqop`t`at`vis.
bevrni pirvel jgup`t`a ric`xvt`agan [shuamavali muhammadis ummat`ze up`ro cinanndeli t`aobebidan;adrindeli shuamavlebi da mat`i mimdevrebi]
da mravalni - ukanasknelt`agan (shuamavali muhammadis ummat`is bolo t`aobebisgan)

da marc`xena mxares rom arian - (da) vin arian isini,
marc`xena mxares rom arian?
(eseni arian isini, vinc` ag'moch`ndebian) jojoxet`is c`ec`xlshi da (jojoxet`is) mdug'are cqalshi,
da shavi kvamlis ch`rdili (jojoxet`ur c`ec`xlshi),
(ch`rdili) arc` grili da arc` sasiamovno [sazareli garegnulad da arsebit`ad].
cheshmaritad, isini adre [micier c`xovrebashi] p`up`unebashi c`xovrobdnen [gart`obasa da siamovnebebshi ch`az'irulni]
da jiutad ch`adiodnen didi c`odvebs [urcmunoebasa da mravalg'mert`ianobas],
da ambobdnen (ag'dgomis uarqop`it`):,,roc`a movkvdebit` da vik`c`evit` mtvrad da z'vlebad, nut`u ch`ven kvlav ag'vdgebit` (sic`oc`xles davubrundebit`)?!
ch`veni pirveli mamapapebic` (romlebic` didi xnis cin daishalnen) (isinic` ag'dgebian)?!
ut`xari (mat`) (o, shuamavalo): "cheshmaritad, pirvelni da ukanasknelni [qvela, vinc` dedamicaze c`xovrobda da ic`xovrebs]
cheshmaritad, isini sheikribebian (cinascar gansazg'vrul) dg'es, romelic` (mxolod allahist`visaa c`nobili) [ag'dgomis dg'es]!
mashin, cheshmaritad, t`k`ven gzaabneulno (cheshmariti gzidan) da sic`rued miich`nevt` (imas, rac` allahma da shemdeg misma shuamavalma gac`nobat`),
auc`ileblad shechamt` (naqop`s) xidan, saxelad zaqqumi, (romelic` qvelaze sazizg'aria, is jojoxet`is p`skerze izrdeba).
da (sashineli shimshilisgan) gaivseben (t`aviant`i) muc`lebs misgan (zaqqumis naqop`it`),
da (z'lieri cqurvilit`) daleven (jojoxet`is) mdug'are cqals,
da svamen (ise bevrs), rogorc` cqurvilit` gamxdarni
es [qvela es saxis sasjeli] ik`neba mat`i [urcmunot`a] sazg'auri samsjavro dg'es.
ch`ven shegk`menit` t`k`ven (o, adamianno) (arap`risgan), mash, ratom ar ircmunebt` (ag'dgomis)?
xom ginaxavt`, rasac` t`k`ven gamoqop`t` (mamakac`is t`esls)?
t`k`ven k`mnit` mas [adamianis t`esls], t`u ch`ven vart` shemk`mnelni?!
ch`ven ganvsazg'vret` t`k`ven shoris sikvdili da ch`ven iset`ebi ar vart`, rom vinmem gagvascros [vinc` ch`ven shegvach`erebs]!
rom ch`ven shevc`vlit` t`k`vens iers (gankit`xvis dg'es) da ag'gadgent` (iset`i saxit`a da mdgomareobashi) ise, rom t`k`ven is ar ic`it`
da namdvilad ic`odit` pirveli shek`mnis shesaxeb, mash, ratom ar dap`ik`rdebit`?
gana dap`ik`rebulxart`, ras xnavt` (rasac` t`esavt`)?
t`k`ven zrdit` mas, t`u ch`ven vart` misi gamzrdelni?
ch`ven rom gveneba, namdvilad vak`c`evdit` mas mop`antul ch`alad [mogcqvetdit` mosavals], da gagikvirdebodat` (t`k`veni mosavlis bedze)
(ambobt`) cheshmaritad, ch`ven namdvilad ganvic`adet` danakargi.
up`ro metic`, ch`ven aseve moklebulni vart` (sarch`os).
xom gixilavt` cqali, romelsac` svamt`?
t`k`ven gardmoavlent` mas g'rublebidan, t`u ch`ven vart` gardmomvlenni?
ch`ven rom gvindodes, mlashed vak`c`evdit` mas. mash, ratom ar xart` madlierni?
xom ar ginaxavt` is c`ec`xli, romelsac` ant`ebt`?
t`k`ven ag'moac`enet` misi xe t`u ch`ven vart` ag'momc`enebelni?
ch`ven is shexsenebad davadginet`( rat`a shegaxsenot` jojoxet`is c`ec`xli) da sargeblad mgzavrt`at`vis
mash, dideba sheni didebuli up`lis saxels!
ara (mc`darni arian urcmunoni, rodesac` quranze c`uds amboben)! (me, allahi) vp`ic`av varskvlavebis ch`asvenebis adgilebs!
da cheshmaritad, es diadi p`ic`ia, t`k`ven rom ic`odet`
cheshmaritad, es [rac` cagikit`xes] uechvelad pativc`emuli qurania.
dac`ul cignshi (lavhi mahp`uzshi)
mas ar exebian, garda gancmendilebisa
gardmovlenilia samqarot`a up`lisgan
nut`u am sitqvas [qurans] ugulebelqop`t` (urcmunoebo)?

da t`k`ven t`k`vens cils (romelic` allahma mogc`at`) ak`c`evt` imad, rasac` sic`rued miich`nevt` (rom allahi gamogkvebavt` qvelap`rit`, rac` c`xovrebist`vis gchirdebat`). [allahist`vis madlobis gadaxdis nac`vlad, t`k`ven uarqop`t` misgan mig'ebul siket`eebis ag'iarebas!]
da ratom (ver ichert` t`k`vens sulebs sxeulshi), rodesac` is [suli] qelshi ag'cevs (gamodis da rodesac` adamiani kvdeba),
da t`k`ven im momentshi (momakvdav adamians) uqurebt`?
ch`ven [allahi] mast`an [momakvdavt`an] (ch`veni c`odnit` qovlis shemz'leobit` da angelozebit`) up`ro axlos vart`, vidre t`k`ven, magram t`k`ven ver xedavt` (angelozebs).
mash, t`u t`k`ven ar ik`nebit` gasamart`lebulni (allahis mier gankit`xvis dg'es)?
(mash,) daabrunet` is [suli] ukan (sxeulshi), t`u simart`les ambobt`?
xolo t`u is daaxloebult`agania
shveba, surneleba da netarebis samot`xe.
xolo t`u is [gardac`vlili] ik`neba imat`gan, vinc` marjvena mxares arian
mashin mas et`k`meba: mshvidoba (da simshvide) shent`vis, radgan shen imat`gan xar, vinc` marjvena mxares arian!
xolo t`u is [gardac`vlili] iqo mtquart`agan, gzaac`denilt`agan
mashin mist`vis ik`neba maspinz'loba (jojoxet`uri) mdug'are cqlit`.
da (maradiuli) cva jojoxet`is c`ec`xlshi.
cheshmaritad, es [rac` ch`ven giambobt` shen, o, shuamavalo], aris uechveli cheshmariteba, romelshic` aravit`ari echvi ar arsebobs.

amitom adide sheni g'mert`i didebuli saxelit`!
(da uarqavi qvelap`eri qalbi, rasac` urcmunoni allahis shesaxeb amboben, radgan allahi umag'lesia da ag'matebulia qvelap`erze, rasac` isini amboben -- umag'lesi ag'matebit`)
ganadidebs allahs qovelive, rac` c`at`a shinaa da k`veqanaze, da igia z'levamosili, brz'eni.
mas ekut`vnis c`at`a da micis xelmcip`eba. igi ac`oc`xlebs da amkvdarebs. da igi qovelisshemz'lea
is [allahi] aris pirveli [mis cin aravin qop`ila] da ukanaskneli [mis shemdeg aravin ik`neba] c`xadi(romlis zemot`ac` arap`eria) da dap`aruli, da is qovlisdmc`odnea

igi [allahi] aris is, romelmac` t`avisi sibrz'nit` shek`mna c`ani da mica ek`vs dg'eshi (t`umc`a sheez'lo mat`i shek`mna ert` camshic`, et`k`va mxolod:,,iqav!), shemdeg ki amag'lda taxtze [ise, rogorc` mxolod mis diad g'irsebas shehp`eris da ara k`mnilebebsavit`]. man ic`is qvelap`eri, rac` micashi shedis [qoveli t`esli, qoveli cqlis cvet`i] da qvelap`eri, rac` ik`idan gamodis [qoveli qlorti, qoveli umc`iresi nacilaki...] qvelap`eri, rac` c`idan ch`amodis da qvelap`eri, rac` masshi(c`ashi) adis [misi msaxurebis qvela sak`me da sxva].
da is [allahi] t`k`vent`anaa [t`avisi c`odnit`a da z'alit`] sadac` unda iqot`. da allahi xedavs qvelap`ers. [rasac` aket`ebt` -- arc` ert`i t`k`veni sak`me ar daikargeba].
mas ekut`vnis meup`eba c`at`a da micisa da allaht`an brundeba qoveli sak`me
mas g'ames shehqavs dg'eshi da dg'e shehqavs g'ameshi [celicadis sezonebis mixedvit` dg'is da g'amis xangrz'livobas c`vlis], da man ic`is isic`, rac` gulebshia [sulebshi] (misi k`mnilebebis)

ircmunet` allahi da misi moc`ik`uli (muhammadi allahis loc`va da mshvidoba mas) da daxarjet` (allahis gzaze) im k`onebidan, romelic` man t`k`vens gankargulebashi mogc`at`. xolo mat`gan, vinc` ircmuna da xarjavda, mat`t`vis didi sazg'auria.
ra gemart`ebat`, rom ar ircmunebt` allahs, mashin roc`a shuamavali [muhmmadi] gixmobt`, rom ircmunot` t`k`veni g'mert`i? da man xom ukve aig'o t`k`veni ag't`k`ma, t`uki morcmuneni xart`.

is aris, vinc` t`avis msaxurs (shuamaval muhmmads) ugzavnis c`xad aiat`ebs, rat`a gamogiqvanot` sibnelidan [urcmunoebidan] sinat`leshi [cheshmarit rcmenashi]. da cheshmaritad, allahi t`k`vendami t`anamgrz'nobi da mocqalea

da ra gchirt` t`k`ven, (o adamianebo) rom ar xarjavt` (t`k`vens k`onebas) allahis gzaze [allahis sitqvis amag'lebis sak`meshi], mashin roc`a allahs ekut`vnis c`at`a da micis memkvidreoba [qvelap`eri, rac` c`asa da micazea, bolos mas rch`eba]? t`k`venshi ver gat`anabrdebian isini, vinc` gamarjvebamde [mek`is gant`avisup`lebamde mravalg'mert`ianobisgan] xarjavdnen da ibrz'odnen (urcmunot`a cinaag'mdeg), da isini, vinc` amis shemdeg xarjavdnen da ibrz'odnen. isini allahis cinashe xarisxit` up`ro mag'lebi arian. da t`it`oeuls am ori jgup`idan allahma ag'ut`k`va sauket`eso [samot`xe]. da allahi qovlismc`odnea imashi, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt` [ic`is qvela t`k`veni sak`me]
vin misc`ems allahs ket`il sesxs [t`avis k`onebas daxarjavs mis gzaze, misgan jildos imedit`], rat`a man(allahma) gaumravlos mas (misi sazg'auri) da mist`vis iqos uxvi jildo [samot`xe]?

im dg'es [samsjavros dg'es], roc`a ixilav, rom morcmune kac`ebsa da morcmune k`alebs (rodesac` isini becvis xidze gadavlen -- gzaze, romelic` samot`xemde midis da jojoxet`zea gadebuli) cin gauz'g'vebat` mat`i nat`eli (gzas gaunat`ebs) da marjvena mxaresac` ek`nebat` (mat`i sak`meebis cignebi). da et`k`mebat` mat`: sasixarulo ambavi t`k`ven dg'es! (t`k`vent`vis momzadebulia) samot`xis bag'ebi, romelt`a k`vemot` [mag'ali sasaxleebisa da ch`rdilovani xeebis k`vesh] mdinareebi miedineba, ik` samaradisod darch`ebit`. es aris didi carmateba.

im dg'es [samsjavros dg'es], roc`a t`valt`mak`c`i kac`ebi da t`valt`mak`c`i k`alebi etqvian mat`, vinc` ircmuna (rodesac` morcmuneebi ukve becvis xidze ik`nebian):,,dagvelodet` [mogvibrundit` saxit`], rat`a t`k`veni nat`lidan avig'ot`!"
mat` [t`valt`mak`c`ebs] ironiulad et`k`mebat` (angelozebis mier):,,dabrundit` ukan da ik` ez'ebet` nat`eli!"
da (roc`a isini ukan brundebian, ag'moch`ndeba, rom) mat` shoris ag'mart`ulia mag'ali kedeli, romelsac` ak`vs karibche: shignit`a mxares [sait`ac` morcmuneebi midian] aris mocqaleba, xolo garet`a mxares [sait`ac` t`valt`mak`c`ebi arian] sasjeli

isini [t`valt`mak`c`ebi] shehg'ag'adeben mat` [morcmuneebs]:,,gana (amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi) t`k`vent`an ert`ad ar viqavit` (allahisadmi morch`ilebis sak`meebshi)? morcmuneebi upasuxeben:,,diax, (garegnulad) t`k`ven ch`vent`an ert`ad iqavit`, magram t`k`ven t`vit`onve ch`aigdet` t`avi c`dunebashi [t`k`veni t`valt`mak`c`obit` t`avi daig'upet`], elodebodit` (moc`ik`ulis sikvdils da morcmunet`a carmatebis shec`vlas), daechvdit` (sikvdilis shemdeg ag'dgomashi), da c`ru oc`nebebma [matquara imedebma] shegac`dinat`, vidre ar movida allahis brz'aneba [sikvdili] da allahis shesaxeb matquaram -- [satanam] mogatquat`

da dg'es ar miig'eba gamosasqidi t`k`vengan, o t`valt`mak`c`ebo, da arc` mat`gan, vinc` urcmuno gaxda. t`k`veni saboloo t`avshesap`ari ik`neba c`ec`xli [jojoxet`i] igi -- t`k`veni meurvea. da ra sashinelia is [jojoxet`i] rogorc` dabrunebis adgili!

gana ar dadga dro mat`t`vis, vinc` ircmuna, rom mat`i gulebi z'rcodes (da darbildes) allahis xsenebisas da im cheshmaritebis mosmenaze, romelic` man gardmoavlina [allahis cigni], da rom isini [morcmuneebi] ar daemsgavson mat`, visac` adre eboz'at` cerili [t`ora da injili], romelt`ac` dro gaugrz'eldat` [didi xani gavida mat`t`an gamogzavnili cinascarmetqvelebis shemdeg], ris gamoc` mat`i gulebi gak`vavda [mat` ag'ar usmendnen darigebebs, romlebic` allahis cignebshi iqo], da bevri mat`gani (gaxda) urch`i (allahisadmi).

ic`odet`, rom allahi ac`oc`xlebs micas misi sikvdilis shemdeg. ch`ven ukve gangimartet` t`k`ven sascaulebi, rat`a gons moegot`.(ic`odet` rom allahs sheuzlia mkvdrebis gac`oc`xleba, rogorc` micis gac`oc`xleba, da sheuz'lia sastiki gulebis morbilebac`)
cheshmaritad, mocqalebis gamc`em kac`ebsa da k`alebs, romelt`ac` allahs asesxes mshvenieri sesxi, mat`t`vis es siket`eebi gamravldeba da mat`t`vis ik`neba z'virp`asi jildo [samot`xe]

xolo isini, romelt`ac` ircmunes allahi da misi moc`ik`ulebi, scored isini arian mart`alni [isini, romelt`ac` daamocmes cheshmariteba, romlit`ac` movidnen moc`ik`ulebi, t`k`ves igi da mis shesabamisad ic`xovres]. da mocameebi [allahis gzaze dag'upulni] t`aviant` up`alt`an [samot`xeshi], ek`nebat` mat`i jildo da mat`i nat`eli (romelic` gaunat`ebs mat` gzas samsjavros dg'es). xolo isini, vinc` urcmunoni gaxdnen da uarqves ch`veni sascaulebi, isini arian c`ec`xlis mkvidrni [jojoxet`is].

ic`odet`, [o adamianebo] rom amk`veqniuri c`xovreba mxolod t`amashia (sxeulist`vis) da gart`oba (sulisat`vis), mort`uloba da ert`manet`t`an k`eba (sazrdosa da ket`ildg'eobis gamo), da scrap`va k`onebisa da shvilebis gamravlebisken. igi hgavs cvimas, romlis shemdeg amosuli mc`enareebi ag'ap`rt`ovanebs mat`, vinc` t`esls micashi malavs [micat`mok`medebs], shemdeg isini chkneba da xmeba, da shen xedav mat` gaqvit`lebuls (mas shemdeg, rac` mcvane iqo), xolo shemdeg isini namsxvrevebad ik`c`eva. xolo saik`io c`xovrebashi aris mkac`ri sasjeli (urcmunot`at`vis), da aseve allahisgan patieba da kmaqop`ileba (morcmunet`at`vis).
da amk`veqniuri c`xovreba [mist`vis, romelt`ac` saik`io c`xovreba davicqebuli ak`vs] mxolod motquebit`i siamovnebaa

iscrap`et` t`k`veni g'mert`isgan patiebisken da samot`xisken, romlis sivrc`e c`isa da micis sivrc`is tolia, gamzadebulia mat`t`vis, romelt`ac` ircmunes allahi da misi shuamavlebi. es allahis cqalobaa da uboz'ebs imas, visac` inebebs. allahi diad guluxvia (t`avisi morcmune msaxurebis mimart`).

ra ubedurebac` ar unda moxdes micaze [gvalva, shimshili da sxv.] an t`k`vens sulebshi [daavadeba, dachra da sxv.], igi ukve ch`acerili iqo adre (dac`ul p`urc`elze), vidre ch`ven mas shevk`mnidit`. cheshmaritad, es allahist`vis advilia!

rat`a ar idardot` imis gamo, rac` t`k`ven agc`dat` [rom ar t`k`vat`:,,o, netav ase movk`c`euliqavi, mashin ase ik`neboda"], da arc` ampartavnulad ar gaxarebuliqavit` imit`, rac` man mogmadlat`. da allahs ar uqvars arc`ert`i ampartavani [k`edmag'ali], k`edmag'lurad trabaxi (amk`veqniuri siket`eebit` sxvebis cinashe)
romlebic` z'uncoben da xalxsac` z'uncobisken moucodeben. da vinc` zurgs sheak`c`evs, cheshmaritad, allahi mdidari, qovladk`ebulia.

ch`ven ukve carvgzavnet` ch`veni shuamavlebi c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebit` da mat`t`an ert`ad gardmovavlinet` cigni da sascori, rat`a adamianebma samart`lianoba daic`van. da gardmovavlinet` rkina, romelshic` didi z'alaa da sargeblobani adamiant`at`vis, rat`a allahma ic`odes, vin sheeceva mas da mis shuamavlebs p`arulad. uechvelad, allahi qovladz'lieria, diadi.

da ch`ven carvgzavnet` nuhi da ibrahimi da davadginet` mat` sht`amomavlobashi cinascarmetqveleba da cigni. da mat` shoris [mis sht`amomavlobashi] arian, vinc` mart`al gzas mihqveba, magram bevri mat`gani urch`ia (allahisadmi)

shemdeg mat` kvaldakval mivaqolet` ch`veni shuamavlebi da mivaqolet` isa (ieso) mariamis z'e, da vuboz'et` mas saxareba. da mis mimdevart`a gulebshi ch`avdet` sibraluli mocqaleba da bermonazvnoba, romelic` mat` t`avad shemoig'es, ch`ven ar dagvicesebia igi mat`t`vis, garda allahis ket`ilgancqobis z'iebisa, magram mat` is (bermonazvnoba) sat`anadod ver daic`ves. amitom, mat`gan romelt`ac` ircmunes, mivec`it` t`aviant`i sazg'auri, magram bevri mat`gani urch`ia.

hei, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! geshinodet` allahisa da ircmunet` misi shuamavali. igi ormagad moganichebt` t`avisi cqalobidan da dagidgent` sinat`les, romlit`ac` ivlit`, da shegindobt` t`k`ven. da allahi shemndobi, shemcqalebelia.
rat`a cignis xalxma ic`odes, rom mat` aranairi z'alaup`leba ar gaach`niat` allahis cqalobaze da rom cqaloba allahis xelshia. uboz'ebs mas, visac` inebebs. da allahi diadi cqalobis mp`lobelia.

cheshmaritad, sheismina allahma im [k`alis] sitqva, romelic` gekamat`eboda t`avisi k`mris gamo da shesch`ioda allahs. da allahs esmoda t`k`veni saubari. cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismsmeni, qovlismxedvelia.

t`k`vengan isini, vinc` t`aviant` c`olebs eubnebian, rom isini (c`olebi) mat`i dedebis zurgebs hgvanan, c`odvas sch`adian, radgan isini (c`olebi) sinamdvileshi ar arian mat`i (k`mrebis) dedebi. mat`i dedebi mxolod isini arian, vinc` isini shobes. isini namdvilad amboben saz'rax sitqvebs da sic`rues.cheshmaritad allahi, shemcqnarebeli da mimtevebelia (mat` mimart`, vinc` c`odvis ch`adenis shemdeg gulcrp`elad moinaniebs)

da isini (k`mrebi), vinc` t`aviant` c`olebs eubnebian, rom isini [c`olebi] mat`i dedebis zurgebivit` arian da shemdeg uarqop`en nat`k`vams [gadacqveten k`orcinebis gagrz'elebas], (isini valdebulni arian, amis gamo gamosasqidi gadaixadon) morcmune monis (an morcmune mona k`alis) gat`avisup`leba, sanam isini [cqvili] ert`manet`s sheexebian [intimur kavshirs daamqareben]. es [allahis gadacqvetileba] aris is, rit`ac` t`k`ven (o, morcmuneebo) gap`rt`xilebt` (rat`a ar ch`aidinot` aset`i k`medeba), da allahma ic`is, rasac` aket`ebt`!

xolo vinc` ver ipovis(monas rat`a gaant`avisup`los), mashin zedized ori t`ve imarxulos, vidre ert`manet`s sheexebian(c`olk`marni intimurad). xolo visac` ar sheuz'lia, mashin samoc`i g'ataki daapuros. es imitom, rom ircmunot` allahi da misi shuamavali. da es allahis mier dacesebuli sazg'vrebia. xolo urcmunot`at`vis mcare sasjelia.

uechvelad, isini, vinc` ecinaag'mdegebian allahsa da mis shuamavals, damc`irebulni ik`nebian, iseve rogorc` damc`irebul ik`nen isini, vinc` mat`ze ucin iqvnen(ucindeli erebi da t`emebi romlebic` allahsa da mis muc`ik`ulebs eurch`ebodnen). da ch`ven xom gardmovavlinet` c`xadi aiat`ebi(sascaulebi). xolo urcmunot`at`vis damamc`irebeli sasjelia.
im dg'es, roc`a alahi qvelas ert`ad ag'adgens da amc`nobs mat`, rac` mat` ch`aidines(amk`veqnier c`xovrebashi). allahma ag'ric`xa is(rac` mat` ch`aidines), mat` ki daivicqes. da allahi qovlis mocmea.

nut`u ar ginaxavs, rom allahma ic`is, rac` aris c`at`a shina da rac` aris k`veqanasa zeda? ar arsebobs sami kac`is saidumlo saubari, rom is ar iqos mat`i meot`xe, da arc` xut`is, rom is ar iqos mat`i meek`vse, da arc` amaze naklebis da arc` metis, rom is ar iqos mat`t`an ert`ad, sadac` ar unda iqvnen. shemdeg amc`nobs mat`, t`u ra gaaket`es ag'dgomis dg'es. uechvelad, allahi qovlismc`odnea.

gana ar ginaxavs (o, shuamavalo) isini [medinas ebraelebi], romelt`ac` aekrz'alat` p`aruli saubari, magram shemdeg ubrundebian imas, rac` aekrz'alat` da p`arulad saubroben c`odvaze, mtrobasa da shuamavlisadmi urch`obaze. da roc`a shent`an modian, ise mogesalmebian, rogorc` ar mogsalmebia allahi, da t`avist`vis amboben: ratom ar gvsjis allahi imist`vis, rasac` vambobt`? sakmarisia mat`t`vis jojoxet`i, romelshic` shevlen. ra sazareli samqop`elia

hei t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! roc`a saidumlod saubrobt`, nu isaubrebt` c`odvaze, mtrobasa da shuamavlisadmi urch`obaze(rogorc` ebraelebi saubrobdnen), aramed isaubret` siket`esa da g'vt`ismoshishobaze. da geshinodet` allahisa, romlis cinashec` shekrebilni ik`nebit`.
uechvelad, p`aruli saubari satanisganaa, rat`a daamcuxros morcmuneni, magram is verap`ers avnebs mat` allahis nebis gareshe. dae, allahs miendon morcmuneni.

hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! roc`a getqvian (shekrebebze): "gaap`art`ovet` adgili", [rom sxvebsac` sheez'lot` dajdoma]! -- mashin gaap`art`ovet`, da allahi gagip`art`ovebt` t`k`vent`vis (am k`veqanashic` da samot`xeshic`). da roc`a geubnebian: "adek`it`!" -- mashin adek`it`. allahi ag'amag'lebs t`k`vengan mat`, vinc` ircmuna, da mat`, visac` c`odna miec`a, xarisxebit`. da allahi qovlismc`odnea imisa, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

hei t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! roc`a gsurt` saidumlod daelaparakot` moc`ik`uls, mashin cinascar gaig'et` mocqaleba t`k`veni saidumlo saubris cin. es uket`esia t`k`vent`vis da up`ro sup`t`aa (t`k`veni gulebist`vis). xolo t`u ver ipovit` (rasac` gasc`emt` mocqalebad), mashin amashi c`odva ar aris;
da cheshmaritad, allahi mimtevebelia, mocqalea

nut`u shegeshindat`, rom t`k`veni saidumlo saubari mocqalebit` dagecinaurebinat` (imis shishit`, rom gag'aribdebodit`, an rom satanam ch`agagonat`, t`it`k`os es zedmeti xarji iqo)? xolo roc`a t`k`ven ver sheasrulet` is, rac` t`k`ven gebrz'anat`,
da mas shemdeg, rac` allahma miig'o t`k`veni monanieba,
mashin gamoascoret` es: sheasrulet` loc`va droulad da sat`anado cesit`, gaig'et` savaldebulo mocqaleba [zak`at`i],
da daemorch`ilet` allahs da mis moc`ik`uls. da allahi qovlismc`odnea imisa, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt` (da is mogagebt` t`k`veni sak`meebis mixedvit`).

nut`u ar ginaxavs shen, o moc`ik`ulo, isini [munap`iqebi],
romlebmac` megobrebad (da mokavshireebad) airch`ies iset`i xalxi [iudevelebi], romlebzec` allahi ganrisxda?
isini arc` t`k`vengan arian [morcmunet`agan] da arc` mat`gan arian [iudevelt`agan]; da isini p`ic`s c`ruad deben (rom t`it`k`os morcmuneebi arian da rom shen allahis moc`ik`uli xar), da t`avadac` ic`ian, rom tquian imashi, razec` p`ic`s deben.
allahma mat`t`vis sastiki sasjeli gaamzada. uechvelad, raoden c`udia is, rasac` isini sch`adiodnen

mat` [munap`iqebma] t`aviant`i (c`ru) p`ic`ebi sap`arvelad gamoiqenes (rat`a mat`i urcmunoebis gamo ar moeklat`),
da amit` (t`aviant` t`avsac` da sxvebsac`) allahis gzidan -- islamidan ac`dendnen. mat`t`vis damc`irebeli sasjeli ik`neba (jojoxet`shi)!
mat`i k`oneba da shvilebi verap`ers argeben allahis cinashe; isini c`ec`xlis binadarni arian, da maradiulad ik`nebian masshi.

im dg'es, roc`a allahi ag'adgens mat` qvelas, isini mis cinashe p`ic`s dadeben (rom t`it`k`os morcmuneebi iqvnen), iseve rogorc` p`ic`s debdnen t`k`ven cinashe (o, morcmuneno), da isini [munap`iqebi] ip`ik`reben, rom es mat` daexmareba (allahis cinashe, rogorc` exmarebodat` morcmunet`a cinashe am samqaroshi). o, diax! cheshmaritad, isini (gadametebuli, ashkara) matquarebi arian

satanam sz'lia mat` da daavicqa mat` allahis xseneba,
(ase rom mat` miatoves allahis brz'anebebi). aset`ebi [t`valt`mak`c`ni] -- satanis partiaa (da misi mimdevrebi). o, diax! cheshmaritad, satanis partia damarc`xebulni da cagebulni arian (am k`veqnadac` da maradiul c`xovrebashic`)!
uechvelad, isini, vinc` ecinaag'mdegebian allahsa da mis shuamavals, scored isini arian qvelaze damc`irebult`a shoris.
allahma ch`aicera (zec`iur p`irp`itaze, anu daadgina rom): "cheshmaritad, me da ch`emi shuamavlebi gavimarjvebt`!" cheshmaritad, allahi qovlisshemz'le, didebulia!

shen ver ipovi, o moc`ik`ulo, iset` xalxs, romlebic` icameben allahs da bolo dg'es [sasjelis dg'es], rom uqvardet` isini, vinc` emterebian allahs da mis moc`ik`uls, t`undac` es iqvnen mat`i mamebi, shvilebi, z'mebi an nat`esavebi. aset` adamianebs allahma ch`acera mat` gulebshi rcmena da gaamqara isini sulit` misgan. da sheiqvans mat` bag'ebshi (samot`xeshi), sadac` k`vevit` mdinareebi miedineba, da ik` maradiulad darch`ebian [samot`xis bag'ebshi]. allahi kmaqop`ilia mat`it`, da isinic` kmaqop`ilni arian allahit` aset`ebi arian allahis partia. o, diax! cheshmaritad, allahis partia -- eseni arian bednierni [am c`xovrebasa da maradiulobashi]!
allahi adida qovelivem, rac` c`at`a shinaa da rac` k`veqanazea. da igia z'levamosili, brz'eni.

is [allahi] aris is, vinc` gandevna isini, romlebic` urcmunoni gaxdnen cerilis xalxidan [iudevelebidan, kerz'od banu an-nadiris tomi], mat`i sac`xovreblebidan pirvel shekrebaze. {es iqo mat`i pirveli gandevna arabet`is naxevarkunz'ulidan axlo ag'mosavlet`shi.} t`k`ven [o, morcmuneno] ar gip`ik`riat`, rom isini [iudevelebi] gavidodnen ([saxlebidan] amgvari ag'shp`ot`ebit`a da dasanaxi sirc`xvilit`). mat` [iudevelebs] ki ech`venebodat`, rom mat`i c`ixeebi daic`avda mat` allahisgan da rom veravin daamarc`xebda mat`. magram allahma moag'cia mat` ik`idan, saidanac` ar elodnen, da sheitana mat` gulebshi z'lieri shishi. da ai, isini gaanadgureben t`aviant` saxlebebs sakut`ar xelit` da morcmuneebis xelit`ac`. gait`valiscinet`, o gonierno,
(ra daemart`at` mat`).
da allahs rom ar daecera mat`t`vis gadasaxleba, ut`uod dasjida mat` amk`veqnad. da saik`ioshi mat`t`visaa c`ec`xlis sasjeli.
es imitom, rom isini sheecinaag'mdegnen allahsa da mis shuamavals. da vinc` allahs sheecinaag'mdegeba, uechvelad, allahi mkac`ria sasjelit`.

is palmebi (romlebic` banu nadiris iudevelebs ekut`vnoda), romlebic` t`k`ven (o, morcmuneebo) mocherit` (mat`i c`ixesimagris alqis dros) an p`esvebze datovet`, qvelap`eri es iqo allahis nebart`vit` (da allahis brz'anebit`) [amis gamo t`k`ven ar gekisrebat` danashauli] da rat`a man (allahma) shearc`xvinos urch`ebi.

da rac` allahma uboz'a t`avisi moc`ik`ulisat`vis rogorc` [samxedro] nadavli mat`gan [mat`i sakut`rebidan], amisat`vis t`k`ven ar dagchirdat` arc` c`xenebis, arc` ak`lemebis [gamoqeneba], magram allahi az'levs t`avis moc`ik`ulebs z'alaup`lebas, viszec` surs(da t`avs esxmian mters allahis davalebit`). da cheshmaritad, allahs z'aluz's qvelap`eri!

da is, rac` allahma (samxedro) nadavlad uboz'a t`avis shuamavals sop`lebis mc`xovrebt`agan [mravalg'mert`iant`a k`onebidan] (da amavdroulad ar iqo sachiro mxedrebze devna da samxedro shetakeba), - is (aset`i nadavli) (ar nacildeba meomrebs shoris, aramed) ekut`vnis allahs [ixarjeba qvela morcmunis saert`o ket`ildg'eobist`vis], shuamavals, nat`esavebs (moc`ik`ulis), oblebis, g'aribebisa da mgzavrebis (romelsac` gzashi p`uli gamoelia da mogzaurobis gagrz'eleba ar sheuz'lia), rat`a es ar ag'moch`ndes ganacileba (mxolod) t`k`ven shoris mdidrebs shoris. da rac` ki rames mogc`emt` shuamavali (ik`neba es k`oneba t`u misi brz'aneba), aig'et`, da rasac` gikrz'alavt`, sheikavet` t`avi. da geshinodet` allahisa, radgan allahi mkac`ria sasjelshi!

g'aribi muhajirebist`vis, romlebic` gandevnil ik`nen t`aviant`i saxlebidan da k`onebidan, ez'ieben allahis cqalobasa da ket`ilgancqobas, da exmarebian allahsa da mis shuamavals. scored isini arian mart`alni(rcmenashi gulcrp`elni).

rac` sheexeba mat` [ansarebs], romlebic` dasaxlebulni iqvnen [medinashi] da ircmunes mat`amde [muhajirebis mosvlamde], isini siqvarulit` da daxmarebit` ig'eben mat`t`an dasaxlebul muhajirebs da mat` gulebshi ar ak`vt` shuri [muhajirebist`vis minichebuli nadavlis gamo]. isini muhajirebs uceven upiratesobas sakut`ar t`avze,
(miuxedavad imisa, rom t`avad sig'aribes ganic`didnen an schirdebodat`). vinc` allahma daic`va siz'uncisgan, eseni mart`lac` bednierni ik`nebian (am c`xovrebashi da maradiulobashi)!

da isini, vinc` mat` shemdeg movidnen, amboben: "g'mert`o ch`veno! gvapatie ch`ven da ch`vens z'mebs, romelt`ac` gagvascres rcmenashi, da nu ch`agvideb gulebshi siz'ulvils morcmunet`a mimart`. g'mert`o ch`veno! uechvelad, shen lmobieri xar, mcqalobeli!"

nut`u ar ginaxavs isini, vinc` t`valt`mak`c`ebi gaxdnen, rogor saubroben t`aviant` z'mebt`an cerilis xalxidan, romlebic` urcmunoni gaxdnen [iudevelebt`an banu an-nadiridan]: <<t`u gagaz'eveben t`k`veni sac`xovreblidan, ch`ven auc`ileblad gavalt` t`k`vent`an ert`ad [medinidan], da ch`ven arasdros davemorch`ilebit` arc`ert`s da arc`ert` dros t`k`ven cinaag'mdeg brz'olashi. t`u vinme gamogicevt` brz'olas, ch`ven [munap`iqebi] auc`ileblad dagexmarebit` t`k`ven [iudevelebs].>> allahi ki mocmobs, rom isini ut`uod c`ruoben!

t`u isini [iudevelebi] ganidevnebian [medinidan], mashin isini [munap`iqebi] mat`t`an ert`ad ar gavlen. da t`u mat`t`an [iudevelebt`an] brz'ola daicqeba, isini [munap`iqebi] ar daexmarebian mat` (rogorc` amas hpirdebodnen). xolo t`u isini [munap`iqebi] mainc` daexmarebian, zurgs sheak`c`even [ukan daixeven], da shemdeg mat`t`vis [iudevelebist`vis] aravit`ari daxmareba ar ik`neba gaceuli.
t`k`veni shishi mat` gulebshi up`ro metia, vidre allahisa. es imitom, rom isini arian xalxi, romelt`ac` ar gaegebat` (allahis sidiade).

isini qvela ert`ad ver shegebrz'olebian, garda gamagrebuli sop`lebisa an kedlebs amop`arebulni. mat` shoris mtroba didia. shen isini ert`ianni ggonia, arada mat`i gulebi gaqop`ilia. es imitom, rom isini ugunuri xalxia.
mat` msgavsad, vinc` mat`ze c`ota xnit` adre iqvnen (qureishelebi). mat` igemes t`aviant`i sak`mis simcare(badris brz'olashi) da mat`t`visaa mcare sasjeli.

(iudevelebi roc`a t`valt`mak`c`ebs usmenen brz'olashi cak`ezebisa da daxmarebis dapirebis sak`meshi) isini [iudevelebi] hgvanan satanas: ai, man ut`xra adamians: "urcmuno gaxdi!" da roc`a is [adamiani] urcmuno gaxda, man [satanam] t`k`va: "cheshmaritad, me gshordebi shen.
cheshmaritad, me meshinia allahis -- samqaroebis up`lis!"
da mat`i orives(satanisa da misi morch`ili urcmuno adamianis) ag'sasruli is iqo, rom c`ec`xlshi moxvdnen, sadac` samudamod darch`ebian. da esaa usamart`lot`a sazg'auri.

hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! geshinodet` allahisa da dae, daukvirdes qoveli suli, ra gaamzada xvalindeli dg'ist`vis. da geshinodet` allahisa. uechvelad, allahma ucqis, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

nu daemsgavsebit` (o morcmuneno) mat`, romlebmac` daivicqes allahi, da (amis gamo) allahma daavicqa mat` sakut`ari t`avic` [shecqvites im sak`mis ket`eba, rac` gadaarch`enda mat`
jojoxet`shi maradiul darch`enas]. aset`ebi arian urch`ebi

ar arian t`anascorni c`ec`xlis mkvidrni da samot`xis mkvidrni(arc` amk`veqniur c`xovrebashi da arc` saik`ioshi). samot`xis mkvidrni arian gamarjvebulni(radgan isini aket`ebdnen ket`il sak`meebs, mat` aenazg'aurat` samot`xit`).
es qurani rom mt`ist`vis gardmogvevlina, shen usat`uod ixilavdi mas morch`ilad damxobils da dashlil-danacevrebuls allahis shishit`. da am igavebs vuqvebit` adamianebs, rat`a mat` dap`ik`rdnen.
isaa allahi, romlis garda ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba. dap`arulisa da c`xadis mc`odne. isaa mocqale, shemcqalebeli.

isaa allahi, romlis garda ar arsebobs sxva g'mert`i, meup`e, ucmindesi, mshvidobismqop`eli, ert`guli (t`avisi k`mnilebebis mimart`, t`avisi moc`ik`ulebis da mat`i mimdevrebis mxardamcheri), mp`arveli, z'levamosili, qovlisshemz'le, uzenaesi. cmindaa allahi imaze, rasac` mas t`anaziarad udgenen.
is aris allahi, shemk`mneli, gamch`eni, saxis mimc`emi. mas ekut`vnis umshvenieresi saxelebi. mas adidebs qvelap`eri, rac` c`at`a shinaa da k`veqanazea. da is z'levamosilia, brz'enia.

hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! nu gaixdit` ch`ems mtersa da t`k`vens mters megobrebad, romelt`ac` siqvaruls uc`xadebt`, mashin, roc`a mat` uarqves cheshmariteba, romelic` gec`xadat`. isini devnian shuamavalsa da t`k`venc`, imis gamo, rom ircmunet` allahi, t`k`veni g'mert`i. t`u t`k`ven gamoxvedit` ch`ems gzaze sabrz'olvelad da ch`emi ket`ilgancqobis mosapoveblad, t`k`ven p`arulad uc`xadebt` mat` siqvaruls, magram me qvelaze uket` vic`i, rasac` malavt` da rasac` ac`xadebt`. da vinc` t`k`vengan amas ch`aidens, is namdvilad asc`da scor gzas.

t`u isini [urcmunoebi] shegxvdebian t`k`ven, t`k`veni mtrebi ik`nebian da t`k`venken gaicvdian t`aviant` xelebs (rat`a mogklan an tqved ch`agigdon), da aseve t`aviant` enebsac` borotebit` (sheurac`xqop`it`) mogacvdian. da mat` surt`, rom t`k`venc` gaxdet` iseve urcmunoni, rogorc` t`avad arian.
verc` t`k`veni nat`esavebi da verc` t`k`veni shvilebi ver gishvelian. gankit`xvis dg'es is gangac`alkevebt` t`k`ven. allahi xedavs, rasac` t`k`ven sch`adixart`.

cheshmaritad, t`k`vent`vis shesanishnavi magalit`i iqo ibrahimsa da mast`an mqop`ebshi, roc`a mat` t`aviant` xalxs ut`xres: "ch`ven uars vambobt` t`k`venze da imaze, rasac` t`k`ven et`aqvanebit` allahis garda. ch`ven uargqavit` t`k`ven da ch`vensa da t`k`vens shoris gach`nda mtroba da siz'ulvili samudamod, sanam ar ircmunebt` mxolod ert`adert` allahs". garda ibrahimis sitqvebisa mamamisisadmi: "me shent`vis patiebas shevt`xov, magram me arap`eri shemiz'lia shent`vis allahis cinashe. g'mert`o ch`veno! shenze vart` mindobilni, shenken movik`ec`it`(monaniebit`) da shent`anaa dabruneba".
up`alo ch`veno! nu gvak`c`ev urcmunot`a sac`durad da shegvinde ch`ven, up`alo ch`veno! cheshmaritad, shen xar z'levamosili, brz'eni.
cheshmaritad, t`k`vent`vis mat`shia mshvenieri magalit`i, imist`vis, visac` allahisa da ukanaskneli dg'is imedi ak`vs. da vinc` zurgs sheak`c`evs, uechvelad, allahi t`vit`kmaria, qovladk`ebulia.
shesaz'loa, allahma daamqaros siqvaruli t`k`vensa da mat` shoris, visac` mtrobdit`. allahi qovlisshemz'lea. da allahi mimtevebelia, mcqalobelia.

allahi ar gikrz'alavt` t`k`ven mat` mimart`, romelt`ac` ar gebrz'odnen rcmenis gamo da ar gamougdixart` t`k`veni saxlebidan, rom siket`e da ket`ilgancqoba gamoich`inot` da samart`lianad moepqrot`. uechvelad, allahs uqvars samart`lianni.

allahi mxolod gikrz'alavt` mat`t`an (megobrobas), romelnic` gebrz'odnen rcmenis gamo, gagaz'eves t`k`veni saxlebidan da exmarebodnen sxvebs t`k`vens gaz'evebashi, rom daumegobrdet` mat`. da vinc` mat` daumegobrdeba, scored isini arian usamart`loni.

hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! roc`a t`k`vent`an modian morcmune k`alebi, gadasaxlebulni (urcmunoebis k`veqnidan islamis k`veqanashi), mashin gamosc`adet` isini (namdvilad arian t`u ara morcmuneni). allahma qvelaze uket` ic`is mat`i rcmena. da t`u t`k`ven mat`i sitqvebit`a da sak`meebit` sheic`nobt`, rom isini mart`lac` morcmuneni arian, mashin nu daabrunebt` mat` urcmunoebt`an [mat` urcmuno k`mrebt`an]: isini [morcmune k`alebi] mat`t`vis nebadart`uli ar arian, da isini [urcmuno kac`ebi] ar arian nebadart`uli mat`t`vis [morcmune k`alebist`vis]. da daubrunet` mat` [qop`il k`mrebs] is,
rac` mat` daxarjes (t`aviant` qop`il c`olebze sak`orcino z'g'venis saxit`). da t`k`venze, o morcmune kac`ebo, c`odva ar aris, t`u mat`ze ik`orcinebt`, roc`a misc`emt` mat` mat` cils
[sak`orcino z'g'vens]. da nu sheinarch`unebt` k`orcinebis kavshirebs urcmuno k`alebt`an, da moit`xovet` [mravalg'mert`iant`agan] is, rac` t`k`ven daxarjet` (sak`orcino z'g'venis saxit` im c`olebze, romlebmac` shemdeg rcmenas ganudgnen da mat` sheuert`dnen). da dae mat`ac` [mravalg'mert`ianebma] moit`xovon t`k`vengan is, rac` mat` daxarjes (t`aviant` qop`il c`olebze, romlebmac` shemdeg islami miig'es da t`k`vent`an movidnen). es aris allahis dadgenileba t`k`vent`vis. is ganach`ens gamoitans t`k`ven shoris. da cheshmaritad, allahi qovlismc`odnea, brz'enia.

da t`u romelime t`k`veni c`oli (rcmenas ganudga da) t`k`vengan [morcmuneebisgan] cavida urcmunoebt`an, da shemdeg t`k`ven miig'et` t`k`veni cili [urcmunoebze gamarjvebis shemdeg da samxedro nadavlis ag'ebit`], mashin miec`it` im morcmuneebs,
romelt`a c`olebic` cavidnen, imdenive (k`oneba), ramdenic` mat` daxarjes sak`orcino z'g'venis saxit`. da geshinodet` allahisa, romlisac` t`k`ven gcamt`!

hei, shuamavalo! roc`a shent`an movlen morcmune k`alebi, rat`a ert`gulebis p`ic`i dagidon, rom arap`ers gaut`anascoreben allahs, ar moiparaven, ar imrusheben, ar daxoc`aven t`aviant` shvilebs, ar moigoneben c`iliscamebas, romelsac` t`avadve shet`xzaven da ar shegecinaag'mdegebian ket`il sak`meshi, mashin miig'e mat`i p`ic`i da st`xove allahs mat`t`vis patieba. uechvelad, allahi mimtevebelia, mcqalobelia.

hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! nu daumegobrdebit`(t`anadgomas nu gaucevt`) xalxs, romlebzec` allahi ganrisxda. mat` ukve imedi gadaicures imk`veqniur c`xovrebaze, iseve, rogorc` urcmunoebma gadaicures imedi samareshi mqop`t`agan.
adidebs allahs qovelive, rac` c`at`a shinaa da rac`aa k`veqanazed. da igi z'levamosilia, brz'enia.
hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! ratom ambobt` imas, rasac` ar aket`ebt`?
didad saz'ulvelia allahis cinashe, rom ambobt` imas, rasac` ar aket`ebt`!
uechvelad, allahs uqvars isini, vinc` mis gzaze mckrivebad ibrz'vian, t`it`k`os mtkic`ed shekruli shenoba iqvnen

da aha, ut`xra musam t`avis xalxs: "hei, xalxo ch`emo! ratom mtanjavt`, roc`a ic`it`, rom me t`k`vent`an allahis shuamavali var?" da roc`a isini gzas asc`dnen, allahmac` mat`i gulebi gzas aac`dina. da allahi ar daadgens cheshmarit gzaze urch` xalxs.

da aha, t`k`va isam, mariamis z'em: "hei, israelis z'eno! me moc`ik`uli var t`k`vendami allahisgan, dammocmebeli imisa, rac` ch`emamde iqo t`orashi, da maxarobeli moc`ik`ulisa, romelic` ch`ems shemdeg mova, misi saxeli ik`neba ahmadi". xolo roc`a igi moevlina mat` c`xadi sascaulebit`, mat` t`k`ves: "es c`xadi jadok`robaa".
da vin aris imaze usamart`lo, vinc` allahze sic`rues t`xzavs, mashin, roc`a mas islamisken moucodeben? da allahi ar daadgens cheshmarit gzaze usamart`lo xalxs.
surt`, rom ch`aak`ron allahis nat`eli t`aviant`i bageebit`, magram allahi srulqop`s t`avis nat`els, t`undac` sz'uldet` es urcmunoebs.
is aris, romelmac` moavlina t`avisi shuamavali cheshmariti gzit`a da cheshmariti sarcmunoebit`, rat`a igi ag'amag'los qvela sarcmunoebaze, t`undac` es sz'uldet` carmart`ebs.
hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! xom ar migit`it`ot` ert` vachrobaze, romelic` gixsnit` mtanjveli sasjelisgan?
(es aris, rom) ircmunot` allahi da misi shuamavali, da ibrz'olot` allahis gzaze t`k`veni k`onebit`a da sulebit`. es t`k`vent`vis uket`esia, rom ic`odet`.
is shegindobt` t`k`vens c`odvebs da dagamkvidrebt` samot`xis bag'ebshi, sadac` mdinareebi moedineba, da sauket`eso savaneebshi maradiul bag'ebshi. ai, esaa udidesi carmateba!
da sxvac`, rac` t`k`ven giqvart`: shecevna allahisgan da axlo gamarjveba. da axare morcmuneebs!

hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! iqavit` allahis shemceni, rogorc` ut`xra isa, z'em mariamisa, mocap`eebs: "vin ik`neba ch`emi shemce allahis gzaze?" mocap`eebma upasuxes: "ch`ven vart` allahis shemceni!" mashin israelis z'et`a ert`ma nacilma ircmuna, xolo meore nacilma uarqo. mashin ch`ven davexmaret` morcmuneebs(isas/iesos momxreebs) mat`i mtrebis cinaag'mdeg da isini gamarjvebulni gamovidnen.
adidebs allahs qovelive, rac` c`at`a shinaa da rac` dedamicazea, meup`es, ucmindess, z'levamosils, brz'ens.

is [allahi] aris is, vinc` ucignur [arabebt`an] gamogzavna moc`ik`uli mat`i cridan [muhammadi] (mt`eli kac`obriobist`vis),
romelic` ukit`xavs mat` mis aiat`ebs [qurans], asup`t`avebs mat`
(c`ru rcmenebisa da c`udi zneobrivi t`visebebisgan), da ascavlis mat` cigns [qurans] da sibrz'nes [sunnas], t`umc`a isini manamde [mis mosvlamde] ashkara c`domilebashi iqvnen(kerpebs t`aqvans sc`emdnen, sisxls g'vridne, da nat`esaur kavshirebs cqvetdnen).

da aseve (igi gamogzavnilia) sxvebt`anac` mat`gan, romlebic` jer ar sheuert`dnen mat` [shemdgom t`aobebsa da sxva xalxebs].
da cheshmaritad, is aris z'levamosili da brz'eni!
es allahis cqalobaa, romelsac` uboz'ebs imas, visac` inebebs. da allahi udidesi cqalobis mp`lobelia.

imat` magalit`i, visac` daekisra t`oras shesruleba [iudevelebs], magram isini mas ar atarebdnen [ar asrulebdnen mis dadgenilebebs], hgavs virs, romelic` zurgit` atarebs cignebs(romlebic` mist`vis mxolod tvirt`ia). ra c`udia im xalxis magalit`i,
romlebmac` uarqves allahis nishnebi! da allahi ar miuz'g'veba scor gzaze im xalxs, vinc` usamart`loa [vinc` allahis mier dadgenili sazg'vrebi daarg'via].

ut`xari (o moc`ik`ulo): "hei, t`k`ven, romlebic` iudevelebi gaxdit`! t`u amtkic`ebt`, rom t`k`ven allahis axlobelebi xart` (da misi saqvarlebi) -- sxva adamianebis gamoklebit`,
mashin isurvet` sakut`ar t`avs sikvdili, t`u mart`lebi xart` (t`k`vens mtkic`ebashi)!"

magram isini [es iudevelebi] arasodes isurveben mas [sikvdils], imis gamo, rac` adre mat`i xelebit` ik`na ch`adenili
[mat`i urcmunoebisa da boroti sak`meebis gamo]. da allahma ic`is usamart`loni [borotmok`medni]!
ut`xari: "cheshmaritad, sikvdili, romelsac` gaurbixart`, ut`uod shegxvdebat`. shemdeg dabrundebit` uxilavisa da xilulis mc`odnest`an da is gamc`nobt` imas, rasac` sch`adiodit`".

hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! rodesac` mogicodeben paraskevis loc`vaze, iscrap`et` allahis xsenebisken da miatovet` vachroba. es t`k`vent`vis uket`esia, rom ic`odet`(mash gaaket`et` is, rasac` allahi gibrz'anebt` ).
da roc`a (paraskevis juma) loc`va dasruldeba, mashin gaip`antet` dedamicaze da ez'iet` allahis cqaloba da xshirad gaixsenet` allahi, rat`a carmatebas miag'ciot`.

da roc`a isini xedaven vachrobas an gart`obas, misken iscrap`vian da migatoves p`exze mdgomi(minbarze k`adagebisas). t`k`vi (o, moc`ik`ulo): "is, rac` allaht`anaa, umjobesia gart`obaze da vachrobaze. da allahi sauket`esoa mboz'ebelt`a shoris".

roc`a t`valt`mak`c`ebi shent`an modian, amboben: "ch`ven vamocmebt`, rom shen uechvelad allahis shuamavali xar". da allahma ic`is, rom shen uechvelad misi shuamavali xar da allahi mocmobs, rom t`valt`mak`c`ebi uechvelad matquarebi arian.

mat` t`aviant`i p`ic`ebi p`arad gaixades(ip`ic`ebian rat`a daajeron rom isini morcmuneni arian, amit` rom sxvebs t`valebi auxvion, da sikvdilit` dasjasac` rom gadaurch`nen) da ac`denen(es munap`iqi t`valt`mak`c`ebi xalxs) allahis gzas. uechvelad, raoden saz'agelia is, rasac` isini sch`adiodnen
es imitom, rom mat` ircmunes(p`ormalurad), shemdeg ki uarqves, amitom mat` gulebze bechedi daido da isini verap`ers xvdebian.

roc`a mat` xedav, mat`i sxeulebi gaoc`ebs(garegnuli ag'nagoba), da t`u ilaparakeben, shen usmen mat` nat`k`vams. t`it`k`os isini kedelze miqudebuli z'elebi arian(ar esmit` da arc` sargebloben sheni k`adagebit`). mat` qoveli qvirili t`avis sacinaag'mdegod miach`niat`(shishoben rom mat` sacinaag'mdegod rame ar it`k`vas). isini mtrebi arian, mash, eride mat`. allahma dascqevlos isini! rogor arian isini cheshmaritebas ac`denilni

da roc`a mat` [t`valt`mak`c`ebs] eubnebian: "modit`, rat`a allahis shuamavalma t`k`vent`vis shendoba it`xovos", isini t`avs atrialeben (ach`veneben, rom es mat` ar schirdebat`),
da shen xedav, rogor shordebian isini, da ampartavnebas avlenen.
sulert`ia mat`t`vis, shendobas st`xov mat`t`vis t`u ar st`xov, allahi arasdros sheundobs mat`. uechvelad, allahi ar daaqenebs scor gzaze urch` xalxs.

isini [t`valt`mak`c`ebi] arian isini, vinc` amboben (medinis mc`xovreblebs): "nu daxarjavt` mat`ze, vinc` allahis shuamavalt`an arian [mek`k`idan mast`an gadasaxlebulebze], sanam isini (mas) ar datoveben!" magram allahs ekut`vnis c`at`a da micis saunjeebi, t`umc`a t`valt`mak`c`iebs es ar esmit`.

isini [es t`valt`mak`c`ebi] amboben: "t`uki medinashi davbrundebit`, uechvelad z'lierebi [t`valt`mak`c`ebi am sitqvit`: "z'lierebi" t`avis t`avs gulisxmoben] ik`idan gaaz'eveben sustebs [morcmuneebs]". magram z'ala (dideba) ekut`vnis allahs, mis shuamavals da morcmuneebs, t`umc`a t`valt`mak`c`ebma es ar ic`ian.
hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! nu mogac`dent` t`k`veni k`oneba da shvilebi allahis xsenebisgan. da vinc` amas ch`aidens, scored isini arian cagebulni.
da xarjet` ik`idan, rac` giboz'et`, vidre romelime t`k`vengans sikvdili eceva da mashin is itqvis: "g'mert`o ch`emo! netav mc`ire xnit` gadamivado, rat`a mocqaleba gavig'o da viqo mart`alt`a shoris!"
da ar gadauvadebs allahi arc` ert` suls, roc`a misi dro dadgeba. da allahma ucqis, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.
adidebs allahs qovelive, rac` c`at`a shinaa da qovelive, rac` micazea. misia meup`eba da misia k`eba-dideba. da igi qovlisshemz'lea.

is -- allahia, romelmac` t`k`ven (o, adamianebo) (ararsebobidan) shegk`mnat`; t`k`ven shoris arian urcmunoni
