da t`k`ven shoris arian morcmunenic`. da allahi xedavs imas, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt` (da amis mixedvit` mogagebt`).

man cheshmaritebit` shek`mna c`ani da mica (da qvelap`eri, rac` mat`shia), [t`avisi sibrz'nisa da gansazg'vruli miznis shesabamisad]; t`k`ven (o, adamianebo adamianuri) saxe moganichat` da sauket`eso p`orma misc`a [adamiani bevr sxva k`mnilebaze up`ro lamazad shek`mna]. da mast`an aris dabruneba (sasjelisa da angarishis dg'eze).
man ic`is, rac` aris c`at`a shina da k`veqanasa zeda, da ic`is, rasac` malavt` da rasac` ac`xadebt`. da allahma ic`is, rac` gulebshia(kargi ganzraxva ik`neba t`u c`udi).
gana ar mosula t`k`venamde ambavi imat`i, vinc` ucin uarqo? da igemes t`aviant`i sak`mis simz'ime da mat`t`visaa mcare sasjeli.

es imitom, rom mat`t`an t`aviant`i shuamavlebi c`xadi mtkic`ebulebebit` modiodnen, magram mat` t`k`ves: "adamianma unda dagvadginos scor gzaze?!" mat` uarqves da zurgi ak`c`ies. allahs ki mat`i rcmena ar schirdeba -- radgan allahi mdidaria da k`ebis g'irsi.

urcmunoni amtkic`eben, rom isini arasdros ar ik`nebian ag'sdgenilni. ut`xari: "pirik`it`! vp`ic`av ch`ems g'mert`s, t`k`ven uechvelad ag'sdgenilni ik`nebit`, shemdeg ki geucqebat`, rac` ch`aidinet`. da es allahist`vis iolia".
mash, ircmunet` allahi, misi shuamavali da sinat`le (qurani), romelic` ch`ven gardmovavlinet`. da allahi ucqis, rasac` t`k`ven aket`ebt`.

(gaxsovdet`) is dg'e, roc`a is shegkrebt` t`k`ven qvelas saert`o shekrebis dg'ist`vis [samsjavros dg'e] -- es aris t`vit`motquebis gamzhg'avnebis dg'e. [am dg'es urcmunoni mixvdebian, ramdenad moitques t`avi]. da vinc` ircmunebs allahs da ket`il sak`meebs ag'asrulebs, is (allahi) gaasup`t`avebs mas misi c`udi sak`meebisgan da sheiqvans bag'ebshi (samot`xeshi),
romelt`a k`veshac` mdinareebi miedineba, da isini ik` darch`ebian marad, samudamod. es aris udidesi carmateba!
xolo isini, vinc` ar ircmunes da c`rud miich`nies ch`veni sascaulebi (aiat`ebi), ai, isini ik`nebian c`ec`xlis mkvidrni da darch`ebian ik` maradzhams. ra sashineli dabrunebis adgilia igi!
rac` ar unda ubedureba moxdes, is mxolod allahis nebit` xdeba. da vinc` ircmuna allahi, mis guls is (allahi) carmart`avs da allahma qvelap`eri ic`is.

da daemorch`ilet` allahs (qvelap`ershi, rasac` igi brz'anebs da krz'alavs) da daemorch`ilet` shuamavals (imashi, rasac` mas t`k`venamde moak`vs t`avisi up`lisgan). xolo t`u zurgs sheak`c`evt` (allahisa da misi shuamavlisadmi morch`ilebas), mash ic`odet`, rom ch`vens shuamavals ekisreba mxolod nat`lad gadmoc`ema.
allahi! ar arsebobs g'vt`aeba, garda misi. dae, mxolod allahs miendon morcmuneni.

hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! cheshmaritad, t`k`vens meug'let`a da shvilt`a shoris arian t`k`veni mtrebi, mash, eridet` mat`. da t`u apatiebt`, t`vals daxuchavt` da miutevebt`, mashin, cheshmaritad, allahi mimtevebelia, mcqalobelia.
t`k`veni k`oneba da t`k`veni shvilebi mxolod gamoc`daa, xolo allaht`anaa diadi sazg'auri.

mash, geshinodet` allahisa, ramdenadac` shez'lebt`, da isminet`, da daemorch`ilet`, da gaig'et` siket`e t`k`venive sulebist`vis. da vinc` dac`uli ik`neba sakut`ari sulis siz'uncisgan, scored isini arian netarni.
t`u t`k`ven allahs asesxebt` ket`il sesxs, is gagiormagebt` mas da shegindobt` t`k`ven. da allahi madlieria, shemcqnarebelia.
dap`arulisa da c`xadis mc`odne, z'levamosili, brz'eni.

hei, shuamavalo! roc`a k`alebs gaeqrebit`, gaeqaret` mat` dadgenili vadit` da ag'ric`xet` es vada. da geshinodet` allahis, t`k`veni g'mert`is! ar gaaz'evot` isini [c`olebi] t`aviant`i saxlebidan da arc` isini unda gavidnen, garda im shemt`xvevisa, t`u ashkara sibilces [mrushobas] ch`aidenen. esenia allahis sazg'vrebi. da vinc` allahis sazg'vrebs gadava, ut`uod, sakut`ar t`avs avnebs. da shen ar ic`i, shesaz'loa allahma amis shemdeg [am gank`orcinebis shemdeg] raime axali sak`me carmoshvas (da shen gadacqvito misi dabruneba).

da roc`a isini [gank`orcinebuli k`alebi] t`aviant` vadas miuaxlovdebian [roc`a 'iddis dasrulebis dro axlovdeba], mashin sheinarch`unet` isini (o, k`mrebo) [daabrunet` isini 'iddis vadis amocurvamde] sat`anado cesit` ket`ilad [mat`i shariat`it` dadgenili up`lebebis dac`vit` da adamianebshi mig'ebuli cesis mixedvit`], an ki dashordit` mat` [gaushvit`, roc`a mat`i 'iddis vada dasruldeba] sat`anado cesit` [zianis miqenebis gareshe]. da (c`olis dabrunebist`vis an saboloo dashorebist`vis) mocmed moixmet` t`k`vengan [morcmunet`agan] ori samart`liani mamakac`i, da t`k`ven, mocmeebo, ag'asrulet` mocmoba mxolod allahis gulist`vis (da ara sxva raime miznit`). amit` [imit`, rasac` allahi brz'anebs] shegonebulia is, vinc` ircmunebs allahs da ukanasknel dg'es. da visac` allahis shishi ek`neba (misi sasjelis), mas is(allahi) uboz'ebs gamosavals.
da mianichebs mas sazrdos ik`idan, saidanac` ar elis. da vinc` allahs miendoba, is sakmarisia mist`vis. uechvelad, allahi ag'asrulebs t`avis gangebas. allahma qovelives daudgina zoma.

t`k`veni c`olebidan isini, vinc` menstruac`ias ag'ar elian
[asakovani k`alebi, romelt`ac` menstruac`ia ag'ar ak`vt`] -- t`u echvi geparebat` mat`i mdgomareobis shesaxeb, mat`i vada sami t`vea; aseve mat`t`vis, visac` jer kidev ar hk`onia menstruac`ia
[z'alian axalgazrda c`olebist`vis]. xolo isini, vinc` orsulad arian, mat`i (gank`orcinebis) vada is droa, sanam t`aviant` tvirt`s ar dadeben [sanam ar imshobiareben]. da visac` eshinia allahis (misi sasjelis), is mas sak`mes gaaiolebs rogorc` am k`veqnad, ise maradiul c`xovrebashic`.

es [qvelap`eri, rac` it`k`va gank`orcinebisa da gank`orcinebis vadis shesaxeb] aris allahis brz'aneba, romelic` man t`k`vent`vis moavlina (o, adamianebo), rat`a sheasrulot` igi. da visac` eshinia allahis, mas is caushlis mis c`ud sak`meebs
[sheundobs c`odvebs] da gauzrdis sazg'aurs misi ket`ili sak`meebist`vis

daasaxlet` isini [t`k`veni gank`orcinebuli c`olebi] ik`, sadac` t`avad c`xovrobt`, t`k`veni shesaz'leblobis mixedvit`, da nu miaqenebt` mat` zians [gank`orcinebul k`alebs], mat`i shevicroebit` [nu aiz'ulebt` mat` gank`orcinebis vadis ganmavlobashi sac`xovreblis datovebas]. da t`u isini orsulad arian, mashin daxarjet` mat`ze, manam sanam ar imshobiareben. xolo t`u isini [gank`orcinebuli k`alebi] t`k`vens shvils achmeven, mashin miec`it` mat` mat`i anazg'aureba
(z'uz'ut`i kvebist`vis), da ert`manet`s shoris ket`ilad sheet`anxmet` anazg'aurebis sakit`xze, sat`anado cesis mixedvit` [gonivrul p`arglebshi]. da t`u gachirvebashi ag'moch`ndebit`, mashin mist`vis [mamist`vis] sxva k`ali gamokvebavs (mis bavshvs) [z'uz'ut`i].
mdidarma t`avisi k`onebidan ixados, xolo visac` mciri sarch`o ak`vs, imit` ixados, rac` allahma uboz'a. allahi aravis avaldebulebs imaze mets, rac` uboz'a. allahi siz'nelis shemdeg shvebas moavlens.
da ramdeni dasaxleba ganudga t`avisi g'mert`isa da misi shuamavlebis brz'anebas, da ch`ven mkac`rad movkit`xet` mas da davsajet` igi sashineli sasjelit`.
da igema man t`avisi sak`mis simz'ime da misi sak`mis dasasruli marc`xi iqo(am k`veqnadac` da imk`veqnadac`)
g'mert`ma mat`t`vis mkac`ri sasjeli moamzada. mash, geshinodet` g'vt`isa, gonierno, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! g'mert`ma ukve gardmogivlinat` shegoneba

shuamavali, romelic` t`k`vent`vis kit`xulobs allahis c`xad nishnebs [quranis aiat`ebs], rom gamoiqvans isini, vinc` ircmuna da ket`ili sak`meebi ag'asrula, cqvdiadidan sinat`leshi [cheshmaritebashi]. vinc` ircmunebs allahs da ket`il sak`mes aket`ebs, is sheiqvans bag'ebshi (samot`xeshi),
sadac` mdinareebi miedineba mat` k`vesh, da isini ik` marad darch`ebian [samot`xis bag'ebshi]. (da ukve) allahma mshvenierad moamzada mist`vis [mart`ali morcmunisat`vis] misi cili (samot`xeshi).

allahia is, vinc` shek`mna shvidi zec`a da mat` msgavsad(shvidi) dedamica. mat` shoris [c`at`a da micat`a] ch`amodis brz'aneba [allahis gamoc`xadeba], rat`a ic`odet`, rom allahi qovlisshemz'lea da rom allahi c`odnit` qovelives moic`avs [qovlismc`odnea].
hei, shuamavalo! ratom ikrz'alav imas, rac` allahma shent`vis nebadart`uli gaxada, roc`a c`dilob, sheni c`olebi daakmaqop`ilo (amit`)? magram allahi mpatiebeli, shemcqalebelia.

allahma ukve dagicesat` (o, morcmuneno) t`k`veni p`ic`ebisgan gat`avisup`lebis gza [da dagicesat` gamosasqidi: daapuro at`i g'aribi, an sheamoso isini, an gaat`avisup`lo ert`i mona, xolo vinc` amas ver shez'lebs, mashin imarxos sami dg'e]. allahi t`k`veni meurvea; igi qovlismc`odne, brz'enia.

da ai, moc`ik`ulma saidumlod uambo t`avis ert`-ert` c`ols [hap`sas] es ambavi. mas shemdeg, rac` man [hap`sam] es (misi meore c`ols, aishas) gadasc`a, allahma mas [moc`ik`uls] es [saidumlo] gaumxila da man [moc`ik`ulma] mas (hap`sas) ut`xra nacili imisa, rac` man t`k`va, magram nacili gamotova. da rodesac` man [moc`ik`ulma] amis shesaxeb ut`xra mas [hap`sas], man t`k`va: "vin gamc`no es shen?" man [moc`ik`ulma] t`k`va: "mit`xra qovlismc`odnem, qovlismc`nobelma (allahma)".

t`u t`k`ven orive -- hap`sa da 'aisha -- allahs mimart`avt` sinanulit`, mashin (es auc`ilebelia), radgan t`k`veni gulebi gadaixara (im sak`misken), rac` allahis moc`ik`uls ar surda. xolo t`u t`k`ven ert`manet`s mxars dauchert` mis cinaag'mdeg -- mashin uechvelad allahi aris misi mp`arveli, aseve (angelozi) jibrili da mart`ali morcmuneebi. da amis shemdeg angelozebic` exmarebian mas [moc`ik`uls] mat` cinaag'mdeg, vinc` mas acqeninebs da mtroben.

shesaz'loa, misma up`alma, t`u is [moc`ik`uli] t`k`vent`an gank`orcindeba, mas t`k`venze uket`esi c`olebit` ch`aanac`vlos -- srulad ert`gulebit` (allahze), morcmuneebit`, morch`ilebit`, momnanieblebit`, bevr t`aqvanismc`emlebit`, marxulebit` -- rogorc` ukve gat`xovilebit`, aseve k`alculebit`.

hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! daic`avit` t`k`veni t`avi da t`k`veni ojaxebi c`ec`xlisgan, romlis sacvavic` adamianebi da k`vebia. masze daqenebulni arian angelozebi, sastikni da mkac`rni, romlebic` ar eurch`ebian allahs imashi, rasac` is ubrz'anebs mat`, da asruleben imas, rac` ebrz'anebat`.
hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` uarqavit`! nu moimizezebt` dg'es! (t`k`veni urcmunoebit`) t`k`ven mogezg'vebat` mxolod imist`vis, rasac` sch`adiodit`.

hei, t`k`ven, romelt`ac` ircmunet`! moinaniet` allahis cinashe gulcrp`eli monaniebit`. shesaz'loa, t`k`venma g'mert`ma mogashorot` t`k`veni c`odvebi da shegiqvanot` samot`xeebshi, romelt`a k`veshac` mdinareebi moedineba, im dg'es, roc`a allahi ar shearc`xvens shuamavals da mast`an ert`ad morcmuneebs. mat`i sinat`le mat` cin da marjvniv imoz'ravebs. isini itqvian: "g'mert`o ch`veno, srulqavi ch`vent`vis ch`veni sinat`le da shegvinde ch`ven. uechvelad, shen qovlisshemz'le xar".
hei, shuamavalo! ibrz'ole urcmunot`a da t`valt`mak`c`t`a cinaag'mdeg da iqavi mkac`ri mat` mimart`. mat`i t`avshesap`ari jojoxet`ia da ra sazareli samqop`elia igi!

allahma magalit`ad mouqvana urcmunot`at`vis nuhis c`oli da lutis c`oli (imis sach`veneblad, rom urcmunot`a da morcmunet`a shoris nat`esaoba ver ushvelis mat` samsjavros dg'es). orive mat`gani -- nuhis c`olic` da lutis c`olic` -- gat`xovili iqvnen ch`veni mart`ali monebidan or monaze, t`umc`a mat` ug'alates mat` (rcmenashi). da mat`ma k`mrebma -- nuhma da lutma -- veranairad ver ixsnes isini allahis (sasjelisgan). da it`k`va am or k`alze: "shedit` orive c`ec`xlshi, mat`t`an ert`ad, vinc` shedis!"

da allahma magalit`ad mouqvana morcmuneebs p`araonis c`oli, roc`a man t`k`va: "g'mert`o ch`emo! amishene shent`an saxli samot`xeshi da mixseni p`araonisa da misi sak`meebisgan da mixseni usamart`lo xalxisgan!"

da (aseve allahma magalit`ad mouqvana morcmunet`at`vis) mariami, imranis asuli, romelmac` daic`va t`avisi sicminde (mas arc` ert` mamakac`i ar shexebia). da ch`ven (gavugzavnet` mas angelozi jibrili da) ch`avberet` masshi [mis samoselshi arsebuli napralidan] ch`veni sulisagan -- im sulisagan, romelic` ch`ven gvekut`vnis (romelic` jibrilma moitana). da man cheshmaritad miig'o t`avisi up`lis sitqvebi da misi cerilebi (romlebic` man t`avisi moc`ik`ulebist`vis moavlina) da igi iqo gansakut`rebulad g'vt`ismosavt`a shoris.
ris shesaxeb ekit`xebian ert`manet`s
udidesi ambis shesaxeb?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] cminda quranis shesaxeb.

translations.translation: romelzec` c`iloben isini?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] qureishelebi quranis shesaxeb ert`gvar gaurkvevlobasa da c`ilobashi imqop`ebodnen, nacils sjeroda, rom is iqo allahis cigni, nacils ar scamda igi, nacili ambobda rom es iqo jadok`ris sitqvebi, nacili ki amtkic`ebda rom qurani poetis mier shet`xzuli lek`si iqo, xolo sxvebi gaiz'axdnen, rom es iqo cinaprebisgan gadmoc`emuli zg'aprebi.

translations.translation: ara, male sheitqoben!
kvlavac` ara, male sheitqoben egeni!
gana ar davadginet` dedamica k`veshagebad,
da mt`ebi margilebad,
da gagach`inet` cqvilebad,
da davadginet` t`k`veni z'ili dasvenebad,
da davadginet` g'ame saburvelad,
da davadginet` dg'e sac`xovrisad,
da avaget` t`k`vens zemot` shvidi urqevi (c`a),
da davadginet` lampari[1] mogizgize,
translations.footnotes: [1] mze.

translations.translation: da g'rublebidan ch`amovavlinet` cqali uxvad,
rat`a misit` ag'movac`enot` marc`vali da mc`enare,
aseve xshiri(sheburuli) bag'ebi.
cheshmaritad, garch`evis dg'e[1] cinascaraa gansazg'vruli.
translations.footnotes: [1] gankit`xvis dg'e, rodesac` ganerch`eva jojoxet`shi an samot`xeshi camsvlelt`a vinaoba.

translations.translation: im dg'es ch`aiberebe bukshi[1] da moxvalt` jgup`-jgup`ad.
translations.footnotes: [1] islamis scavlebis mixedvit` k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis cin, israp`il angelozi bukis magvar saqvirshi ch`aberavs - rac` sic`oc`xlis dasasrulis zhamis dadgomas mianishnebs da qoveli c`oc`xali arseba sikvdils igemebs. ch`vent`vis uc`nobi drois shemdeg, angelozi meored ch`aberavs saqvirshi da qvela mic`valebuls suli daubrundeba, sap`lavebidan camodgebian, ert`iani t`avsheqris adgilisken gaemart`ebian da g'mert`is cinashe ganikit`xebian.

translations.translation: im dros zec`a gaixsneba da ik`neba karibcheni.
mt`ebi adgils ic`vlian da mxolod mirazhi darch`eba.
cheshmaritad, jojoxet`i ik`neba ch`asasap`reblad,
zg'vargadasult`a samqop`ad,
masshi dahqop`en ukunisamde,
masshi ver igemeben verc` sigriles da verc` sasmels,
garda mdug'arisa da ch`irk`isa.
sat`anado sasjelad.
uechvelad, mat` angarishgebis molodinic` ki ar hk`ondat`
da c`rud rac`xavdnen ch`vens aiat`ebs - mt`eli t`avgamodebit`,
ch`ven ki qvelap`eri ag'vric`xet` cignad.
mash, igemet` da arap`ers mogimatebt` garda tanjvisa!
cheshmaritad g'vt`ismoshisht`at`visaa carmateba,
bag'ebi da qurz'nebi,
aseve mkerdsavse t`anatoli k`alculebi
da savse p`ialebi.
ik` ar moesmebat` p`uchi sitqva da arc` sic`rue,
jildod sheni g'mert`isgan sakmao z'g'veni.
g'mert`isgan c`at`a da dedamicisa da rac` mat` shorisaa; mocqalesagan, da mis cinashe xmis amog'ebis up`lebasac` ar p`loben.
im dg'es mckrivad dadgebian suli[1] da angelozebi, xmas ver amoig'eben[2] garda imisa, visac` mocqalem neba dart`o da itqvis simart`les.
translations.footnotes:
[1] jibril/gabriel mt`avar angelozi.
[2] vinmes mimart` shuamdgomlobasa da k`omagobas ver gabedaven.

translations.translation: es aris dg'e cheshmariti da vic`as surs man t`avis g'mert`t`an misak`c`ieli airch`ios.
cheshmaritad, ch`ven gagap`rt`xilet` moaxloebuli sasjelis shesaxeb. im dg'es kac`i daxedavs imas, rac` mis xelebs gaumzadebia da itqvis urcmuno: oh, netav micad vk`c`euliqavi!
vp`ic`av, (urcmunot`a sulebis) xut`vit` amomc`lelt`
da (morcmunet`a sulebis) nazad mimbarebelt`
da moc`uravet`, (c`at`a sig'rmeebshi) mc`uravt`[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ak` xsenebul moc`uravet`a shesaxeb islamis scavlult`a ganmartebebshi ramdenime gansxvavebuli shexeduleba p`ik`sirdeba: 1. angelozebi, romlebic` morcmunet`a sxeulidan ise lmobierad ibareben sulebs, rogori siadvilit`ac` gadaadgildeba cqlis zedapirze sxvadasxva sxeulebi, 2. angelozebi, romlebic` allahis brz'anebis shesabamisad zec`idan dedamicisken daeshvebian da isev zec`ashi mag'ldebian, 3. mujahidt`a c`xenebi, romlebic` p`rt`ebshesxmulivit` miemart`ebian allahis gzaze, 4. mze, mt`vare, varskvlavebi da sxva c`iuri sxeulebi, 5. gemebi, romlebic` cqlis zedapirze adamiant`a sasargeblod c`uraven cqlis zedapirze, rac` allahis mier boz'ebul siket`et`agan ert`-ert`ia. ix. t`ap`sru beg'avi.

translations.translation: aseve mocinavet` jibrit`[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] angelozebi, romlebic` allahis brz'anebebis shesasruleblad ert`manet`s ejibrebian.

translations.translation: da sak`met`a ganmkargvelt`a[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ibni 'abbasi ganmartavs: eseni arian angelozebi, romlebic` uzenaesma allahma sxvadasxva amk`veqniuri sak`meebis gankargvit`a da mogvarebit` daavala. ix. t`ap`siiru beg'avi.

translations.translation: im dg'es shezanzardeba rqevadi,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] igulisxmeba israp`il angelozis mier bukis magvar saqvirshi pirveli ch`aberva, romelic` autaneli xmit` shez'ravs dedamicas, qvelap`eri micast`an gascordeba da c`oc`xali arsebebi sulebs ganuteveben. ix. t`ap`siiru beg'avi.

translations.translation: da mas mohqveba momdevno,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] saqvirshi pirvel ch`abervas moqveba meore ch`aberva. qat`ade ganmartavs:,,im dg'es shezanzardeba rqevadi da mas mohqveba momdevno" am oriveshi saqvirshi ch`aberva igulisxmeba, pirvelis shemt`xvevashi - allahis nebit` - suls ganutevebs qvela suldgmuli; xolo meores shemt`xvevashi - allahis nebit` - gac`oc`xldeba qvelap`eri. ix. t`ap`siiru taberi. abu hureira allahis shuamavlisgan gadmogvc`ems, rom saqvirshi pirvel ch`abervasa da meores shoris ormoc`ia; ar dauzustebia dg'ea t`vea t`u celi. (buxari, t`ap`siir h.n. 4935.)

translations.translation: gulni im dg'es saguledan amovardnilni,
mzerani misi - shishit` daxrilni.
amboben: nut`u mart`lac` ukumibrunebulni vik`nebit` ucindel mdgomareobashi?
gana mas shemdeg rac` ukve vik`c`evit` p`uturo z'vlebad?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] mkvdret`it` ag'dgomis uarmqop`elni gakvirvebit` da uarqop`it` ambobdnen, nut`u masshemdeg ag'vdgebit` da davubrundebit` ucindel mdgomareobas, rac` ukve ch`veni sxeuli gaixrcna, z'vlebi daip`shvna da gac`amtverdao.

translations.translation: mat` t`k`ves: mashin es dabruneba ik`neba cagebiani.
t`umc`a igia ert`i uec`ari dakivleba.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] saqvirshi meored ch`abervis xma, romlit`ac` kvdret`it` ag'dgeba qvela mic`valebuli.

translations.translation: ert`sac` naxaven rom micis zemot` imqop`ebian.
shent`an movida ambavi musasi?
rodesac` ixmo igi t`avisma g'mert`ma tuvas cminda xeobashi:
cadi p`araont`an, ramet`u is zg'vars gadavida.
da ut`xari: ar ginda ganicmindo?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ar ginda daamocmo rom ar arsebobs allahis garda sxva g'vt`aeba da ganicmindo shirk`isa da k`up`risgan?

translations.translation: dagakvaliano sheni g'mert`isken da ik`c`e (g'vt`is) moshishad?
shemdeg mas ach`vena udidesi sascauli.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] hasan al basris, mujahidis da qat`ades ganmartebit` udidesi sascauli aris,,kashkasha t`et`ri xeli" da,,kvert`xi". am sascaulebis shesaxeb sxva aiat`ebshic` vkit`xulobt`:,,shemdeg musam gadaagdo kvert`xi da igi ashkarad gvelad ik`c`a; mere xeli (ubidan) amoig'o da is iqo kashkasha t`et`ri maqurebelt`at`vis." (shu'ara, 26/32-33.) ix. t`ap`siiru taberi.

translations.translation: man ki c`rud sherac`xa da gaurch`da.
shemdeg zurgi ak`c`ia (uket`urebisken) scrap`vit`.
mere (xalxi) shekriba da ixmo,
shemdeg t`k`va: me var t`k`veni uzenaesi g'mert`i!
mere allahma samagalit`od dasaja imk`veqnadac` da amk`veqnadac`.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] imk`veqnad jojoxet`it` da amk`veqnda zg'vashi daxrch`obit`.

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, amashi chkuis sascavlia mist`vis, visac` eshinia (allahisa.)
t`k`ven up`ro rt`uli k`mnilebebi xart` t`u zec`a - romelic` man aago?
ag'amag'la misi kamara da gaaconascora igi.
misi g'ame daabnela da gamoiqvana dila misi.
amis shemdeg dedamica gaacqo.
misgan amoiqvana cqali da vel-mindvrebi misi.
da mt`ebi ganamtkic`a.
sargeblad t`k`venda da t`k`veni sak`onlist`vis.
da roc`a daicqeba udidesi t`avzardac`ema,(gankit`xvis dg'e)
im dg'es gaixsenebs adamiani t`u ras escrap`voda.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] rodesac` gadasc`emen misi namok`medaris davt`ars da naxavs ris gaket`ebas escrap`voda k`veqnad kargis t`u c`udis.

translations.translation: da xiluli gaxdeba jojoxet`i mist`vis, vinc` mas dainaxavs.
xolo, vinc` zg'vars gadavida
da amk`veqniuri c`xovreba amjobina,
cheshmaritad, jojoxet`ia misi t`avshesap`ari.
xolo, visac` t`avisi g'mert`is cinashe carsdgomis shishi hk`onda da piradi gemovnebisgan t`avi sheikava,
cheshmaritad, samot`xea misi t`avshesap`ari.
k`veqnierebis dasarulis saat`is shesaxeb gekit`xebian, rodis moxdebao?
shen saidan unda gc`odnoda rom gec`nobebina?!
misi c`odna mxolod shens g'mert`t`anaa.
cheshmaritad, shen mxolod shemgonebeli xar mat`i - visac` eshinia misi.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis saat`is gac`xadeba shens movaleobashi ar shedis. shen mxolod sheagoneb da gaap`rt`xileb mat`, visac` k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis eshinia, radganac` sheni shegoneba mxolod mat` argebt`.

translations.translation: roc`a is dg'e ixilon, t`it`k`os ert`i samxrobis an dilis meti ar gach`erebulan.
moig'usha da piri ibruna,
raki brma mivida mast`an.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] gadmoc`emebis t`anaxmad, ert` dg'es allahis shuamavali mek`k`el mocinaveebs, 'ut`ba bin rabi'as, abu jahl bin hishams, 'abbas bin 'abdulmuttalibs, ubei bin halep`s da mis z'mas umeias elaparakeboda. mat` allahis morch`ilebisken epatizheboda da mat`i mxridan islamis mig'ebis didi imedi k`onda. am dros mast`an 'abdullah bin ummi mak`t`umi mivida da ut`xra: o. allahis shuamavalo! mascavle is, rac` allahma gascavla. sibrmavis gamo man ar ic`oda rom allahis shuamavali sxvebs elaparakeboda, amitom shuamavlisgan dazhinebit` it`xovda quradg'eba mashinve misken miepqro. allahis shuamavals saxeze shecuxeba sheetqo, radganac` saubari ramdenjerme sheacqvetina. bolos isev im xalxs miubrunda, visac` esaubreboda da mat`i islamze mopatizheba gaagrz'ela. amis gamo uzenaesma allahma es aiat`ebi ch`amoavlina. allahis shuamavali mas shemdeg 'abdullah bin ummi mek`t`ums did pativs sc`emda; rodesac` dainaxavda ase etqoda xolme:,,salami mas, visi gulist`visac` g'mert`ma gap`rt`xileba momc`a." ix. t`ap`siru taberi da bag'avi.

translations.translation: da ra ic`i shen, ik`neb unda ganicmindos.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ik`neb shensgan mig'ebuli c`odnit` man unda ganicmindos c`odvisa da uc`odinrobisgan.

translations.translation: an ik`neb shegoneba mieg'os da sasargeblo qop`iliqo shegoneba mist`vis.
xolo vinc` (sheni shegonebis) sachiroebas ar grz'nobs,
shen mainc` misken miiltvi.
da arap`eri gakisria shen, t`uki ar ganicminda.
xolo, vinc` shent`an movida scrap`vit`
da aris g'vt`ismoshishi,
shen uquradg'ebod toveb mas.
ara![1] cheshmaritad, is[2] aris shegoneba.
translations.footnotes:
[1] ise ar aris, rogorc` moik`ec`i.
[2] qurani an konkretulad es aiat`ebi.

translations.translation: amitom, vinc` inebebs gait`valiscinebs kidec`.
(ag'nishnuli shegoneba) pativdebul p`urc`lebshia,
amag'lebulsa da qovlad cmindashi,
mceral angelozt`a xelit` ch`acerili,
pativdebult`a, ert`gulebit` morch`ilt`a.
mosaspobeli adamiani, raoden urcmunoa/umaduria.
(g'mert`ma) risgan shek`mna igi?
spermisgan, gaach`ina da t`an ganusazg'vra etapebi.
shemdeg gza gauadvila.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] a. gauadvila dedis muc`lidan gamosvlis gza, b. gauadvila scroisa da mrudis shec`nobis gzebi, g. qvela mat`gans im sak`misken mimavali gza gauadvila, rac` mat`i bediscerit` iqo gansazg'vruli. ix. t`ap`siiru beg'avi.

translations.translation: shemdeg moakvdina da sap`lavs miabara.
shemdeg rodesac` inebebs(allahi), ag'adgens mas.
ara, man[1] ar sheasrula is, rac` (g'mert`ma) ubrz'ana.
translations.footnotes: [1] urcmunom.

translations.translation: mash, shexedos adamianma t`avis sachmelsa,
rogori siuxvit` vacvimet` cqali.
shemdeg piri vuxsenit` micas napralebad.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] g'ivis ag'mosac`eneblad.

translations.translation: shemdeg masshi marc`vali ag'movac`enet`,
aseve vazi da samqura nedli balaxi,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] pirutqvis gamosakvebad.

translations.translation: zet`is xili da p`inikis xe
da bag'ebi xshiri,
xileuli da balaxebi,
sargeblad t`k`venda da t`k`veni sak`onlist`vis.
xolo, rodesac` mova gamaqruebeli xma,
im dg'es kac`i gaurbis t`avis z'mas,
aseve t`avis dedas da mamas,
kidev t`avis c`olsa da shvilsa,
im dg'es mat`gan qvela kac`s sakmarisi sak`me/sadardebeli ek`neba.
im dg'es saxeni gabrcqinebulni,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] morcmunet`a saxeebi.

translations.translation: mg'imarni, gaxarebulni.
im dg'es aseve ik`neba saxeebi mtver modebulni,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] sirc`xvilisa da mcuxarebisgan pirbneli urcmunoebi.

translations.translation: sibnele sheipqrobs mat`(saxeebs).
ai egeni arian urcmuno uket`urebi.
roc`a mze daigragneba,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] gankit`xvis dg'es mze daigragneba da nat`ebas daasrulebs, ris gamoc` cqvdiadi daisadgurebs. allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,gankit`xvis dg'es mze da mt`vare daigragneba." (buxari, bad'ul xalq, 4/3200.) visac` unda gankit`xvis dg'es gaec`nos ise, rom t`it`k`os sakut`ari t`valit` xedavs, man shemdegi surebi caikit`xos:,,roc`a mze daigragneba",,,roc`a zec`a gaixsneba" da,,roc`a zec`a gaepoba." (t`irmizi, t`ap`siir, 73/3333.)

translations.translation: da roc`a varskvlavebi ch`amoc`vivdeba,
da roc`a mt`ebi daiz'reba,
da roc`a make ak`lemebi upatronod darch`eba.
da roc`a mxec`ebi sheiqrebian,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] 'abdullah bin 'abbasi ganmartavs: c`xovelebs sikvdili sheqris ert`ad. mkvdret`it` ag'dgomis shemdeg qvela suldgmuli isev mokvdeba, garda adamianebisa da jinebisa. ix. t`ap`siiru taberi.

translations.translation: da roc`a zg'vebi aaldeba,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] 'abdullah bin 'abbasi ganmartavs: allahi mzes, mt`vares da varsklavebs dagragnavs da zg'vashi ch`ac`vivdeba. shemdeg mas uknidan k`arishxals carugzavnis, ise rom zg'vebi abobok`rdeba da bolos c`ec`xlad gadaik`c`eva. ix. t`ap`siiru taberi.

translations.translation: da roc`a sulebi dacqvildebian,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] omar bin xattabis, abdullah bin abbasis, qat`adesa da rabi' bin xuseimis ganmartebis t`anaxmad, qvela adamiani t`avis scort`an ert`ad ganamceseben, ket`ils ket`ilt`an, borots borott`an. ix. t`ap`siiru taberi.

translations.translation: da roc`a c`oc`xlad damarxul ch`vil gogonas kit`xaven,
t`u romeli c`odvist`vis moikla?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] carmamrt`i arabebi axalshobil gononebs sirc`xvilisa da gachirvebis shishit` c`oc`xlad marxavdnen.

translations.translation: da roc`a davt`rebi gaishleba,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] roc`a adamianis amk`veqnad namok`medar sak`met`a davt`rebi gaishleba, romlebic` angelozebma sheadgines. adamianis gardac`valebis shemdeg es davt`rebi ixureba, igragneba an ikec`eba da gankit`xvis dg'emde shenaxulia. gankit`xvis dg'es qvelas miutanen t`aviant` sak`met`a davt`ars, gaishleba da naxaven t`aviant` namok`medars. am dros adamiani itqvis:,,es ra cignia aset`i, rom arc` patara da arc` didi arap`eria gamorch`enili." (k`ehp`, 18/49.)

translations.translation: da roc`a zec`a aixdeba,
da roc`a jojoxet`i agizgizdeba,
da roc`a samot`xe daaxlovdeba,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] im dg'es samot`xe axlos ik`neba mis mkvidrebt`an.

translations.translation: (mashin) gaigebs suli t`u ra gaumzadebia.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] rodesac` zemot` ch`amot`vlili movlenebi moxdeba, mashin mixvdeba qvela suli t`u ra gaumzadebia saik`iod sakut`ari t`avist`vis - siket`is an uket`urebis saxit`.

translations.translation: ara, vp`ic`av, varskvlavebs, romlebic` (dg'isit`) k`rebian da (g'amit`) isev brundebian;
(orbitaze) moz'ravt` da k`robadt`,
aseve (vp`ic`av) g'ames, roc`a shemodis sibnelit` da isev uku brundeba,
da c`iskars, roc`a inat`ebs,
rom, cheshmaritad, is (qurani) aris pativdebuli shuamavlis[1] (mier ch`amovlenili) sitqva,
translations.footnotes: [1] es aris jibril mt`avar angelozis mier uzenaesi allahisgan ch`amovlenili sitqva.

translations.translation: z'levamosilisa, 'arshis mp`lobelis cinashe pativdebulisa.
mas hmorch`ileben zec`is mkvidrni,[1] aris sando.[2]
translations.footnotes:
[1] is aris mt`avar angelozi da mas hmorch`ileben danarch`eni angelozebi.
[2] aris sando da aranairi echvi ar arsebobs, mismier ch`amovlenil quranis aiat`ebshi, rom is samqarot`a gamch`enis sitqvebia.

translations.translation: da t`k`veni megobari,[1] ar aris sheshlili.
translations.footnotes: [1] rodesac` muhammed shuamavalma islamis k`adageba daicqo, urcmunoebma xmebi daqares, rom is iqo sheshlili.

translations.translation: man mart`lac` ixila igi nat`el c`is kabadonze.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis shuamavalma orjer ixila jibril mt`avar angelozi t`avisi namdvili saxit`, razec` araert`i sando gadmoc`emebic` mocmoben:,,ert`xel, rodesac` p`exit` gadavadgildebodi, zec`idan xma shemomesma. mashinve mzera zec`as mivapqre, davinaxe, rom angelozi - romelic` ch`emt`an hiras gamok`vabulshi iqo mosuli - zec`asa da dedamicas shoris taxtze ijda." (buxari, bad ul vahi, hadisi:4). 'abdullah bin mes'udi gadmogvc`ems:,,shuamavalma jibrili ixila da mas k`onda ek`vsasi p`rt`a." (buxari t`ap`siir, h.n. 4856).

translations.translation: da is ar aris z'unci idumalis ucqebashi.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] mas arap`eri daumalavs imisgan, rac` vahis saxit` zesht`aegona g'mert`isgan.

translations.translation: da is ar aris gandevnili satanis sitqva.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] qurani.

translations.translation: mash, sait` miemart`ebit`?
is mxolod shegonebaa samqarot`at`vis.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] cminda qurani ch`amovlenilia jint`a da adamiant`a samqars shesagoneblad.

translations.translation: (gansakut`rebit`) mat`t`vis, visac` t`k`vengan scor gzaze dadgoma surs.
da t`k`ven verap`ers isurvebt` t`u ar ineba allahma, samqarot`a g'mert`ma.
roc`a gaipoba zec`a,
da roc`a varskvlavebi gaibneva,
da roc`a zg'vebi azvirt`deba,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] zg'vebi abobok`rdeba, kalapotebs gadasc`deba da qvela ert`ian masad ik`c`eva.

translations.translation: da roc`a sap`lavebi amoqiravdeba,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] saubaria mkvdret`it` ag'dgomis dg'eze, roc`a sap`lavebi amoishleba da masshi mqop`i c`oc`xlad ik`nebian ag'dgenilni.

translations.translation: mashin mixvdeba qoveli suli t`u ra gaimzada samomavlod da ra moitova ukan.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] mashin qvela gaixsenebs imas, rac` aket`a siket`is an borotebis saxit` da samomavlod imk`veqniuri c`xovrebist`vis sakut`ari xelit` gaimzada; aseve imasac` gaixsenebs rac` ukan moitova da ar uket`ebia.

translations.translation: ei, adamiano! ram gac`duna sheni g'mert`is shesaxeb - qovlad guluxvisa?
romelmac` gagach`ina, ch`amogaqaliba da mogc`a t`anazomiereba[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] man gagach`ina, mshvenieri p`orma moganicha da mogc`a organoebi ert`manet`is t`anazomieri, romllebic` ert`manet`s avsebs, uxdeba da amshvenebs.

translations.translation: romelime p`ormit`, romelic` ineba shenma g'meg't`ma.
ara da ara, t`k`ven c`rud ac`xadebt` sarcmunoebas/gankit`xvis dg'es!
cheshmaritad, t`avs gadganan mc`velebi.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] met`valqure angelozebi, romlebic` ag'ric`xaven t`k`vens mok`medebebs da gankit`xvis dg'ist`vis inaxaven.

translations.translation: pativdebulni, mceralni.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] mat`t`vis didi pativia allahis mxridan aset`i samsaxuri da pirnat`lad iceren t`k`vens qvela mok`medebas.

translations.translation: (qvelap`eri) ic`ian, rasac` aket`ebt`.
cheshmaritad, sat`noni auc`ileblad ik`nebian ket`ildg'eobashi.
da uechvelad, c`odvilebic` auc`ileblad ik`nebian c`ec`xlshi,
masshi shevlen gankit`xvis dg'es.
da arc` gak`rebian egeni ik`edan.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] arc` ise daicvebian rom gak`ren da mat`gan arap`eri ag'ar darch`es da verc` garet` gasvlas moaxerxeben rom t`avi daag'cion jojoxet`is sasjels.

translations.translation: da ram gamc`nos t`u ra aris gankit`xvis dg'e?!
kvlav ram gamc`nos t`u ra aris gankit`xvis dg'e?!
im dg'es suli verap`ers p`lobs sxva sulis sargod; da im dg'is mbrz'anebloba mxolod allahs ekut`vnis.
vai sazom-saconis gamqalbebelt`![1]
translations.footnotes: [1] mkac`ri muk`ara sazom-saconi gamqalbebelt`at`vis, romelic` imk`veqnad moelit`.

translations.translation: romlebic` xalxisgan, rames t`u miicqaven srulad g'ebuloben.
xolo t`u mat` miucqaven an miuconian - miakleben.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] quranis sxva adgilebshic` gvxdeba a mnishnelobis aiat`ebi, mag:al israa:35. al an'aam:152. ar rahmaan:9.

translations.translation: nut`u egeni ar p`ik`roben, rom ert` dg'es uechvelad ag'dgenilni ik`nebian -
udidesi dg'isat`vis?
im dg'es xalxi samqarot`a g'mert`is cinashe carsdgeba.
ara! cheshmaritad, c`odvilt`a cigni sijjinshia.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] 'abdullahi bin omari, 'ata al-xorasani ganmartaven, rom es aris k`veskneli, sadac` imqop`ebian urcmunot`a sulebi da satanis msaxurebi. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: da ram gamc`nos t`u ra aris sijjini?!
cigni nishandebuli.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] bag'avi ganmartavs: es ar aris sijjinis ganmarteba, es gvamc`nobs c`odvilt`a cignis xasiat`s. qat`ade da muqat`ili ganmartaven, rom c`odvilt`a cignebi t`anamoazreebt`an ert`ad saert`o nishnit` dainishneba da amgvarad c`nobadi xdeba, rom eseni urcmunoebi arian. ix. t`ap`siru bag'avi.

translations.translation: im dg'es, vai c`rud shemrac`xvelt`,
romelnic` c`rud rac`xaven gankit`xvis dg'es.
mas sxva aravin sherac`xavs garda qoveli zg'vargadasuli, c`odvili.
roc`a ekit`xeba ch`veni aiat`ebi, ambobs cinapart`a zg'aprebiao.
ara, pirik`it`! t`aviant`i monaxvechi zhangivit` moedo mat` gulebs.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,uechvelad, rodesac` morcmune c`odvas ch`adis, es mis gulze shavi certilis msgavsad aisaxeba. t`uki moinaniebs, moeshveba da g'mert`s patiebas sheevedreba - guli gaecmindeba; xolo, t`u c`odvebis ch`adenas umatebs, shavi certilebic` imatebs. scored esaa zhangi, romelic` allahma axsena t`avis cignshi" (ibnu maaja, zuhd 29/4244.)

translations.translation: ara! cheshmaritad, im dg'es isini t`aviant`i g'mert`is (xilvisgan) ik`nebian garidebulni.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] aiat`i islamis scavlult`an nacilma ganmarta, rom isini garidebulni ik`nebian allahis cqalobas an allahi mat` saxeze ar shexedavs. scvalult`a umravlesoba ganmartavs, rom isini im k`veqnad allahis xilvas ik`nebian moklebulni. ix. t`ap`isru bag'avi.

translations.translation: shemdeg, isini ut`uod shevlen jojoxet`is c`ec`xlshi.
shemdeg etqvian:es aris is, rasac` t`k`ven c`rud miich`nevdit`.
ara! cheshmaritad, sat`not`a cigni 'illiinshia.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] 'illiini aris meshvide c`aze 'arshis k`vesh. ibni 'abbasma t`k`va: is aris mcvane peridotis dap`a, romelic` 'arshis k`vesh kidia da mat`i namok`edari sak`meebi maszea amotvip`ruli. ix. t`ap`isru beg'avi.

translations.translation: da ram gamc`nos t`u ra aris 'illiuni?!
cigni nishandebuli.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] bag'avi ganmartavs: es ar aris 'illiunis ganmarteba, es gvamc`nobs sat`not`a cignis xasiat`s - msgavsad c`odvilt`a cignisa.

translations.translation: mas amocmeben/xedaven daaxloebulni.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] uzenaes allaht`an axlos mqop`i angelozebi.

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, sat`noni auc`ileblad ik`nebian ket`ildg'eobashi.
savarz'lebze mqop`ni uc`k`eren.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] tkbebian samot`xis silamazeebis, mat`t`vis boz'ebuli siket`eebis an t`aviant`i gamch`enis c`k`erit`.

translations.translation: mat` saxeebshi ket`ildg'eobis brcqinvalebas amoic`nob.
miert`mevat` xalasi g'vino - beched dasmuli.
misi bechedi/bolo[1] aris mushki, scored amist`vis unda iscrap`odnen mscrap`velni.
translations.footnotes: [1] originali,,xit`am" (khtm) ornairad sheiz'leba iqos gagebuli, rogoc` bechedi aseve bolo, mup`essirebis ganmartebebshi orive mimart`uleba p`ik`sirdeba, amitom vec`adet` ch`vens t`argmanshi orive versia agvesaxa. ert`-ert`i ganmartebis t`anaxmad, imk`veqnad sat`not`at`vis mirt`meuli sasmiss mushkis bechedi asvia; xolo meore ganamrtebis t`anaxmad vinc` am sasmels dalevs, is bolos mushkis surnelebas sheigrz'nobs. uzenaesma allahma uket`esad ic`is.

translations.translation: misi nazavia t`asnimi.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] t`asnimi aris samot`xis ert`-ert`i gamorch`euli cqaro, romlit`ac` gazavebuli ik`neba ag'nishnuli sasmeli.

translations.translation: cqaro, romlisganac` svamen daaxloebulni.
cheshmaritad, isini, romelt`ac` daashaves,[1] dasc`inodnen mat`, romelt`ac` ircmunes.
translations.footnotes: [1] qureisheli carmart`ebi, romlbmac` g'vt`is cinashe upatiebeli danashauli ch`aidines da k`mnilebebi gautoles uzenaess.

translations.translation: da roc`a mat` ch`auvlidnen (ert`manet`s) t`val-carbit` mianishnebdnen damc`inavad.
xolo t`aviant` ojaxebt`an dabrunebisas, brundebian gaxarebulni.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] gaxarebulni brundebian, rat`a morcmuneebs dasc`ines da abuch`ad aigdes.

translations.translation: da roc`a mat` (morcmuneebs) xedaven, amboben: eseni mart`lac` gzasac`denilebi arian.
t`umc`a egeni mat`da sadarajod ar iqvnen cargzavnili.
xolo (gankit`xvis) dg'es isini, romelt`ac` ircmunes, dasc`inian urcmunoebs.
savarz'lebze mqop`ni uc`k`eren.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] savarz'lebze mokalat`ebulni uc`k`eren urcmunot`a mdgomareobas jojoxet`shi da ert`is mxriv dasc`inian mat`, meores mxriv madlierebas gamot`k`vamen t`aviant`i gamch`enis mimart`, romelmac` metis metad daup`asa mot`mineba da garja.

translations.translation: miezg'ot` t`u ara urcmunoebs imis gamo, rasac` aket`ebdnen?!
roc`a gaipoba zec`a,
qurad ig'ebs t`avisi g'mert`isas da asec` aris misgan mosalodneli.
da roc`a dedamica gaishleba/gashandakdeba.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis dg'es dedamicaze qvelap`eri t`anabar doneze gascordeba, ag'ar ik`neba ag'arc` mt`ebi da ag'arc` mag'lobi.

translations.translation: da (zedapirze) amoisvris, rac`aa mis shignit` da daic`leba.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] zedapirze amoisvris qvelap`ers, rac` micashia damarxuli da mic`valebulebi camodgebian.

translations.translation: qurad ig'ebs t`avisi g'mert`isas da asec` aris misgan mosalodneli.
ei, adamiano! uechvelad, shen miiltvi sheni g'mert`isken - t`avgametebit` da bolos shexvdebi mas.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] shens mier namok`medari ket`ili an boroti sak`meebit` nabij-nabij miicev sheni gamch`enisken da bolos mis cinashe carsdgebi shenive namok`medart`an ert`ad.

translations.translation: moispo(dacqevlilia) t`xrilis xalxi.[1]
translations.footnotes:
[1] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va: iqo ert`i xelmcip`e - im xalxt`agan, vinc` iqvnen t`k`venze adre. xelmcip`es qavda jadok`ari. jadok`ari rom moxuc`da xelmcip`es ut`xra, ert`i qmacvili gamomigzavne, romelsac` jados vascavlio. xelmcip`em mart`lac` gaugzavna qmacvili, romelsac` jados ascavlida. jadok`art`an mimaval gzaze ert`i beri c`xovrobda, romelt`anac` ert` dg'es qmacvilma sheiara, mis sitqvebs quri ugdo da moicona. qmacvils imdenad moecona beris naambobi, rom jadok`art`an mimavali qoveldg'e bert`an ch`amojdeboda da usmenda. shemdeg midioda jadok`art`an, t`umc`a dagvaianebis gamo jadok`ari bichs sc`emda. qmacvilma amis shesaxeb bers mouqva, berma daariga: t`uki shishob rom jadok`ari galaxvas gipirebs ut`xari rom ojaxis cevrebma shemaqovneso; xolo t`uki shishob rom ojaxis cevrebi gipireben galaxvas, mashin ut`xari, rom jadok`arma shemaqovnao.
qmacvili ase agrz'elebda garkveuli xani, ert` dg'es gzad shemoxvda ushvelebeli uxsenebeli, romelsac` xalxist`vis gza gadaeg'oba. qmacvilma gaip`ik`ra, rom dg'es unda gamovic`no jadok`ari umjobesia t`u berio. aig'o k`va da t`k`va: g'mert`o! t`uki beris gza shens cinashe up`ro mig'ebulia, vidre jadok`risa, mashin mohkali es uxsenebeli, rat`a xalxma gza gaagrz'elos! k`va isrola da mart`lac` mokla uxsenebeli, xalxma gaagrz'ela t`aviant`i gza. qmacvili bert`an mivida da momxdari uambo. berma ut`xra: ei, shvilo! dg'es shen ukve ch`emze z'lieri xar. ch`emt`vis gasagebia sheni mdgomareoba. shen auc`ileblad gelis gamoc`da da rodesac` gansac`delis cinashe ag'moch`ndebi, aravis ut`xra ch`ems shesaxeb.
qmacvili amieridan brmebs, ket`rovnebs da sxvadasxva daavadebebis mk`oneebs kurnavda. bolos amis shesaxeb xelmcip`est`an daaxloebulma pirma sheitqo, romelic` brma iqo. kac`i ut`valavi z'g'venit` mivida qmacvilt`an da ut`xra, rasac` ak` xedav qvelap`eri shent`vis shevagrove t`uki ganmkurnav.
qmacvilma ut`xra: me aravis vkurnav! uechvelad, mxolod allahi kurnavs. shen t`u ircmuneb allahs, me allahs shevevedrebi da is mogarch`ens.
kac`ma ircmuna allahi da allahma mart`lac` gankurna igi. kac`i cavida da xelmcip`is cin dajda, rogorc` adre jdeboda xolme. xelmcip`em sheamch`nia da ut`xra: vin dagibruna t`valt`axedva? kac`ma ut`xra: ch`emma g'mert`ma. xelmcip`e: shen ch`ems garda sxva g'mert`i gqavs? kac`ma miugo: ch`emi g'mert`ic` da sheni g'mert`ic` allahia.
xelmcip`em es kac`i sheipqro da manamde acamebda, vidre qmacvilis shesaxeb ar uambobda. mividnen qmacvilt`an da xelmcip`em ut`xra: ei, shvilo! rogorc` gavige shen jadok`robashi ise daxelovnebulxar rom brmebs da ket`rovnebs kurnav, ase da ase aket`eb.
qmacvilma ut`xra: cheshmaritad, me aravis vkurnav. uechvelad, allahi kurnavs. isic` sheipqres da manamde acames, vidre beris shesaxeb ar uambobda.
mividnen bert`an da ut`xres: dat`me sheni rcmena da daubrundi xelmcip`is rcmenas. berma uari ganac`xada. amaze xerxi it`xoves. xerxi moitanes, t`avis shuaze daades da orad gaqves, ise rom nacilebi z'irs dac`vivda. shemdeg mividnen mep`is axlobelt`an da rcmenidan ukan dabruneba most`xoves. amanac` uari ganac`xada. masac` t`avis shuaze xerxi daades da orad gaqves, ise rom nacilebi z'irs dac`vivda.
bolos qmacvilt`an miidnen da rcmenidan ukan dabrueba most`xoves. qmacvilma uari ganac`xada. xelncip`em amjerad t`avis jariskac`ebs miabara da ut`xra: caiqanet` igi ama da am mt`aze, aiqvanet`, rodesac` mt`is mcvervals miag'cevt`, t`u uars itqvis t`avis rcmenaze gaat`avisup`let`, t`u ara da mashin gadmoagdet` ik`edan. mart`lac` caiqvanes, aiqvanes mt`is mcvervalze. am dros qmacvilma g'mert`s sheevedra: g'mert`o! mixseni mat`i xelidan, rogorc` shen inebeb! uec`rad mt`a z'lier sheirqa da z'irs ch`amoc`vivdnen. qmacvili t`avisi p`exit` mivida xelmcip`est`an. xelmcip`em ut`xra: shens t`anmxlebebs ra mouvidat`? allahma mixsna mat`i xelidano - miugo qmacvilma. xelmcip`em amjeradac` gadasc`a qmacvili t`avis jariskac`ebs da ut`xra: gemshi ch`asvit` da zg'vis shuashi rom miag'cevt`, t`u t`avis rcmenaze uars ar itqvis, zg'vashi gadaagdet`.
qmacvili mart`lac` caiqvanes. qmacvilma g'mert`s sheevedra: g'mert`o! mixseni mat`i xelidan, rogorc` shen inebeb! uec`rad gemi sheirqa da qvelani zg'vashi daixrch`vnen. qmacvili t`avisi p`exit` isev mivida xelmcip`est`an.
xelmcip`em ut`xra: shens t`anmxlebebs ra mouvidat`? allahma mixsna mat`i xelidano - miugo qmacvilma. qmacvilma bolos xelmcip`es ut`xra: uechvelad, shen ver momklav, vidre ise ar moik`c`evi, rogorc` me getqvi. xelmcip`em ikit`xa: eg ra aris? qmacvilma auxsna: ert` adgilas shekribe xalxi, shemdeg xeze ch`amomkide, shemdeg isrebis ch`asadebidan ert`i isari amoig'e, mshvildshi moat`avse da t`k`vi: qmacvilis g'mert`is, allahis saxelit`! shemdeg mesrole. uechvelad, t`uki ase moik`c`evi, shen shez'leb ch`ems moklas.
xelmcip`em mart`lac` sheagrova xalxi, qmacvili xeze ch`amokida, shemdeg isrebis ch`asadebidan ert`i isari amoig'o, mshvildshi moat`avsa da carmot`k`va: qmacvilis g'mert`is, allahis saxelit`! shemdeg esrola da isari qmacvils sap`et`k`elshi moxvda. qmacvilma sap`et`k`elze xeli moikida, sadac` isari moxvda da mokvda.
amis shemxedvare xalxma ert`xmad daicqes qvirili: ch`ven gvcams qmacvilis g'mert`i! ch`ven gvcams qmacvilis g'mert`i! ch`ven gvcams qmacvilis g'mert`i! moaxleebi sascrap`od xelmcip`es eaxlnen da moaxsenes: xedavt`, rasac` eridebodit` da gaurbodit` scored is moxda. xalxma mart`lac` ircmuna. momxdarit` ganrisxebulma xelmcip`em g'rma da grz'eli t`xrilebi gaaket`ebina, zemodan rkinis gisosebi daadgmevina da shignit` c`ec`xli daant`obina. bolos gasc`a brz'aneba, rom vinc` t`avis rcmenaze uars ar itqoda shignit` ch`aegdot`. msaxurebi asec` moik`c`nen, bolos moiqvanes ert`i k`ali, romelsac` xelshi ch`vili bavshvi echira. t`xrilis piras misuli k`ali orchop`obda, radganac` c`ec`xlshi moxvedris z'alian eshinoda. am dros bavshvma ena amoidga da ut`xra: o, dediko! mot`mineba gamoich`ine, ramet`u shen cheshmaritebas adgaxar! (muslim, zuhd, 17/3005)
