da mt`ebs, t`u ra mtkic`ed ag'mart`ulan?!
da dedamicas, t`u rogor ganp`enila?![1]
translations.footnotes: [1] uzenaesi allahi am aiat`ebit` gvap`ik`rebs, rom ch`ems garda vis sheuz'lia ak`lemis gach`ena, zec`is amag'leba, mt`ebis ag'mart`va da dedamicis ganp`ena. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: mash sheagone, ramet`u shen mxolod shemgonebeli xar.
sulac` ar xar mat`i maiz'ulebeli.
xolo, vinc` piri ibruna da ar ircmuna,
mas allahi udidesi sasjelit` dasjis.
cheshmaritad, ch`vent`anaa mat`i misak`c`ieli,
shemdeg, diaxac` ch`venzea mat`i angarishgeba.
vp`ic`av garizhrazhs
da at` g'ames,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] mup`essirt`a umravlesoba ganmartavs, rom ak` igulisxmeba zul hijjes mt`varis pirveli at`i g'ame (qurban bairamis cina at`i dg'e). aseve gansxvavebuli versiebis t`anaxmad ak` igulisxmeba ramadanis bolo at`i g'ame an muharremis mt`varis pirveli at`i g'ame, romelic` 'ashuras at`dg'eulit`aa c`nobili. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: cqvilsa da kents,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ert`i versiis t`anaxmad cqvili gulisxmobs, k`mnilebebs, romlebic` cqviladaa shek`mnili, xolo kenti gulisxmobs allahs, romelic` ert`adert`ia da badali an t`anascori ar gaach`nia, da sxva versiac` arsebobs, rom ak` igulisxmeba ap`soliturad qoveli cqvili da qoveli kenti. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: aseve (vp`ic`av) g'ames, roc`a is midis.
nut`u ar aris sakmarisi es p`ic`i goniert`at`vis?
gana ar ginaxavs ra uqo shenma g'mert`ma 'ads,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] shuamavali hudis xalxs.

translations.translation: (k`alak` an tom) irams svetebians,
romlis msgavsic` meti ar gach`enila k`alak`t`a(an toms) shoris
da semuds, romlebic` xeobashi kldeebs kvet`dnen.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] semudelebi arian salih shuamavlis xalxi, romlebic` arabet`is naxevarkunz'ulis ch`rdilo-dasavlet`it` uz'veles k`alak`,,vadi al-qura"-shi c`xovrobdnen da xeobashi kldeebs kvet`dnen sac`xovreblad.

translations.translation: aseve p`araons obeliskebians,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] originalshi arsebuli sitqva,,al-avt`ad"-s (lwtd) ramdenime mnishvneloba ak`vs: obeliski, samxedro karvebis gasamagrebeli palo, shubi, rac` misi jaris mravalric`xonebaze da saxelmcip`os siz'liereze mianishnebs.

translations.translation: romelnic` zg'vars gadavidnen k`veqnad
da uamarav uket`urebas sch`adiodnen masshi.
amitomac` shenma g'mert`ma sasjelis mat`raxi[1] acvima mat`ze.
translations.footnotes: [1] mat` t`avs sxvadasxvagvari sasjeli acvima.

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, sheni g'mert`i met`valqurea.
xolo adamiani ambobs, rom ch`emma g'mert`ma pativi damdoo[1] - rodesac` mas sc`dis misi g'emrt`i, uxvad uboz'ebs da cqalobit` avsebs.
translations.footnotes: [1] g'meg't`ma pativi damdo da is momc`a, rasac` vimsaxurebdio.

translations.translation: xolo, rodesac` sc`dis da sarch`os umc`irebs, is ambobs, rom ch`emma g'mert`ma damamc`irao.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] mas pirvel shemt`xvevashi madliereba, xolo meoreshi mot`mineba avicqdeba.

translations.translation: sruliadac` ara![1] pirik`it`, t`k`ven pativs ar sdebt` obols
translations.footnotes: [1] ise ar aris, rogorc` carmogidgeniat`, arc` am k`veqnad mig'ebuli siket`eebi miut`it`bs imaze, rom allahi am adamianisgan kmaqop`ilia da arc` t`avs damtqdari ubedurebebi mianishnebs, rom g'mert`ma igi daamc`iara.

translations.translation: da ert`manet`s ar moucodebt` upovris dapurebas
da gametebit` miirt`mevt` memkvidreobas[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] halalisa da haramis ganusxvaveblad eup`lebit` obolt`a, dauc`velt`a da k`alt`a memkvidreobas.

translations.translation: da t`avdavicqebit` giqvart` k`oneba.
aramc` da aramc`! rodesac` sruliad daimsxvreva dedamica da gascordeba.
roc`a mova sheni g'mert`i[1] da angelozebic` dadgebian mckriv mckrivad.
translations.footnotes: [1] misi mosvlis namdvili raoba da rogoroba sheucvdomelia adamianis gonebist`vis, t`umc`a g'rmad gvcams, rom es ik`neba misi sidiadis shesabamisad, qovelgvari naklisgan dac`lili.

translations.translation: da im dg'es moitanen jojoxet`s, scored im dg'es sheigonebs adamian, magram rashi argebs mas shegoneba?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] rodesac` adamiani qvelap`ers c`xadad ixilavs sakut`ari t`valit`, gaixsenebs im shegonebebs, romlebsac` amk`veqnad ismenda da c`rud rac`xavda. is mashinve ag'iarebs im shegonebebs da sinanuli sheipqrobs, t`umc`a mas ukve dakarguli ek`neba amis up`leba, radganac` es ar ik`neba mok`medebis dg'e; aramed es ik`neba qvela mok`medebist`vis sazg'auris mig'ebis dg'e.

translations.translation: itqvis: netav droze mezruna (saik`io) c`xovrebist`.
xolo im dg'es misi sasjelis msgavsad veravin dasjis[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] saubaria allahis sasjelze, radganac` misi sasjeli qvelaze mkac`ri da maradiulia.

translations.translation: da verc` veravin daadebs borkilebs misi borkilis msgavsad.
ei shen, sulo damshvidebulo![1]
translations.footnotes: [1] morcmune, romelmac` sulieri simshvide moipova.

translations.translation: daubrundi shens g'mert`s shen misit` kmaqop`ili da is shenit` kmaqop`ili.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] shen misi jildot`i ik`nebi kmaqop`ili da is shens mier ganvlili c`xovrebit`aa kmaqop`ili.

translations.translation: mash, shedi ch`ems (gamorch`eul) msaxurt`a rigebshi
da (mat`t`an ert`ad) shedi ch`ems samot`xeshi.
ara! vp`ic`av am k`alak`s
rom, shen xar sruliad t`avisup`ali am k`alak`shi,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] es k`alak`i qovelt`vis iqo xelsheuxebeli, nakrz'ali zona, sadac` omi, sisxlis g'vra, nadiroba da balaxis moglejac` ki akrz'aluli iqo. amis miuxedavad carmart`ebma muslimebis mimart` enit` ag'ucereli sisastike gamoich`ines, muslimebi aiz'ules k`alak`idan gak`c`euliqvnen da bolos shuamavlis sic`oc`xlis xelqop`ac` ki dagegmes. amitom am allahma am aiat`it` muhammed shuamavals mek`k`as ag'ebis dg'es sruli t`avisup`leba mianicha, rasac` moqva mek`k`ashi jart`an ert`ad shesvla da k`alak`is ag'eba. ag'nishnuli nebart`vis shesaxeb allahis shuamavalma mek`k`as ag'ebis dg'es ganac`xada:,,uechvelad, es k`alak`i allahma im dg'es gamoac`xada nakrz'alad, rodesac` shek`mna zec`a da dedamica. amitom is k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis dg'emde allahis mier gamoc`xadebul nakrz'alad darch`eba. cheshmaritad, masshi omi aravist`visaa nebadart`uli, arc` ch`emt`visaa nebadart`uli, garda dg'is garkveuli monakvet`isa - msgavsi sak`c`ieli k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis dg'emde akrz'alulia allahis akrz'alvit`. ar sheiz'leba masshi eklis mocqveta, nadiris dap`rt`xoba da ar sheiz'leba dakarguli k`onebis ag'eba, garda im shemt`xvevisa t`u vinme gasac`xadeblad aig'ebs." muslim, hajj 22/1353.

translations.translation: aseve (vp`ic`av) mamasa da shvilsa.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] kac`obriobis mamas, adams da mis shvilebs, kac`obriobas.

translations.translation: ch`ven adamiani mart`lac` gansac`delisa da sirt`ulis garemoc`vashi gavach`inet`.
nut`u p`ik`robs, rom aravis z'aluz's misi z'leva?
(mkvexarad) ambobs: ag'urac`xeli k`oneba gavig'e.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] t`avs ik`ebs imit`, rom muhammed shuamavlis cinaag'mdeg sabrz'lovelad didz'ali k`oneba gaig'o.

translations.translation: gana p`ik`robs rom mas veravin xedavs?
gana ar mivec`it` mas ori t`vali,
ena da ori bage?
da ar gangvic`xadebia mist`vis ori gza?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] gza siket`isa da gza borotebisa.

translations.translation: magram mas ag'mart`is gadalaxva arc` ki uc`dia.
da ram gamc`nos t`u ra aris ag'mart`i?!
(es aris) monis/tqves gat`avisup`leba
an dapureba shimshilobis dg'es,
oboli nat`esavisa
an ukiduresad g'atakisa.
shemdeg imat`t`agani ik`neba, romelt`ac` ircmunes da ert`manet`s mot`minebas urch`even, aseve urch`even sibralulsac`.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,vinc` sxvas ar sheibralebs t`vit`onac` ar ik`neba shebralebuli." sahiihul buxari, adab 27/6013.

translations.translation: scored egeni arian marjvnis xalxi,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] morcmuneebi, romlt`ac` marjvena xelshi gadaec`emat` t`aviant`i namok`medaris davt`ari da marjvniv caiqvanen samot`xisaken.

translations.translation: xolo isini, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes ch`veni aiat`ebi/sascaulebi, egeni arian marc`xnis xalxi.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] urcmunoebi, romlebsac` t`aviant`i namok`medaris davt`ari marc`xena xelshi gadaec`emat` da marc`xniv caiqvanen jojoxet`isken.

translations.translation: mat` zemodan ik`neba c`ec`xli gamoketili.
vp`ic`av mzes da mis nat`ebis dros[1],
translations.footnotes: [1] allahma daip`ic`a mzeze, da mis ag'mosavlet`idan amosvlis shemdeg drozec`(duhas droze).

translations.translation: aseve mt`vares, rodesac` mas t`anhdevs
da dg'es, roc`a amohqavs igi[1],
translations.footnotes: [1] daip`ic`a dg'eze, roc`a is t`avisi sinat`lit` dedamicas anat`ebs.

translations.translation: aseve g'ames, roc`a mas buravs,
aseve(vp`ic`av) zec`as da rac` ki(allahma) aago,
aseve (vp`ic`av) dedamicas da imas rac` man(allahma) dap`ina,
aseve sulsa da rac`(allahma) srulqo
shemdeg mas (suls) t`avisi uket`ureba da g'vt`ismoshishoba sht`aagona,
mart`lac` gadarch`a is, vinc` gancminda igi,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] gadarch`enilia is, vinc` sakut`ari suli siket`it` shemosa da uket`urobebisgan shors dgomit` ganicminda.

translations.translation: xolo, namdvilad caago iman, vinc` (uket`urobebshi) ch`aap`lo igi.
c`rud sherac`xa samudis xalxma, misi usazg'vro t`vit`nebobit`.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] samudis xalxma c`odvebshi ch`ap`luli da usazg'vrod t`vit`neba nap`sisi c`dunebit`, c`rud gamoac`xades shuamavali saalihi da misi mocodeba.

translations.translation: rodesac` mat` shoris qvelaze ubeduri (ak`lemis dasaklavad) camodga.
mashin mat` ut`xra allahis shuamavalma (salihma): es allahis p`urak`lemia da nu shezg'udavt` cqurvili moiklas.
magram mat` c`rud sherac`xes igi, xolo ak`lemi dakles, amitomac` mat`ma g'mert`ma isini t`aviant`i c`odvebis gamo t`anascorad gaanadgura.
da shishi ar ak`vs shedegisa.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] hasan al-basri ganmartavs: uzenaes allahs mat`i ganadgurebis gamo aravisi shishi ar ak`vs. es shexeduleba aseve ibni abbasisganac` aris gadmoc`emuli. dahhak`i, suddi da k`albi am aiat`s shemdegnairad ganmartaven: es cinadadeba imis shesaxebaa, vinc` ak`lemi dakla anu mat`shoris qvelaze ubeduri da c`odvili camodga da saboloo shedegis gauazreblad dakla igi. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: vp`ic`av g'ames, rodesac` (sibnelit` aremares) buravs.
aseve (vp`ic`av) dg'es, rodesac` nat`els hp`ens (aremares).
da (vp`ic`av) mamrsac` da mdedrsac` rac` man (allahma) shek`mna,
cheshmaritad, t`k`veni scrap`vebi araert`gvarovania.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] zogiert`i t`k`vengani t`avisi sak`mit` samot`xisken miicevs, zogic` jojoxet`isken.

translations.translation: xolo vinc` gasc`a da g'vt`is moshishi iqo,
aseve icama sauket`eso,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] am k`veqnad gag'ebuli mocqalebis im k`veqnad anazg'aurebisa.arsebobs sxva azrebic`,magram es ganmarteba kontek`sts et`anxmeba,romelic` mocqalebis gag'ebaze saubrobda.

translations.translation: ch`ven mas gavuadvilebt` uadvilessa.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] aset` adamians gavuadvilebt` siket`is ket`ebas, da allahis gzaze k`onebis gac`emas, da carmatebul vqop`t` masshi, rac` uadviles qop`ashi ch`aaqenebs imk`veqnad.

translations.translation: xolo vinc` iz'unca da (madlis) sachiroebas ar grz'nobs
da c`rud miich`nia sauket`eso,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] c`rud miich`nia imk`veqniuri anazg'aureba.

translations.translation: ch`ven mas gavuiolebt` urt`ulessa.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] aset` adamians gavuadvilebt` borotebas, rac` urt`ules qop`ashi ch`aaqenebs imk`veqnad.

translations.translation: veras argebs misi k`oneba, roc`a (jojoxet`shi) gadaeshveba.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] k`oneba romelic` siz'uncis gamo dazoga da allahis brz'anebis shesabamisad ar gaig'o, imk`veqad jojoxet`is c`ec`xlidan ver ixsnis.

translations.translation: uechvelad, ch`venzea cheshmarit gzaze dakvalianeba.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] cheshmariti gzis scavleba da gac`xadeba.

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, ch`ven gvekut`vnis ukanasknelic` da pirvelic`a.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ch`ven gvekut`vnis isk`veqanac` da es k`veqanac`, amitom vinc` mat` ch`vens garda sxvasgan moelis, is did shec`domashia.

translations.translation: ai, me t`k`ven gap`rt`xilebt` c`ec`xlit` mz'vinvaret`i.
masshi aravin sheva garda qvelaze ubedurisa.
romelmac` (shuamavali) c`rud sherac`xa da (rcmenisgan) piri ibruna.
da mas ganarideben qvelaze g'vt`ismoshishs.
romelic` k`onebas gasc`ems, rat`a ganicmindos.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] zogadad scavlult`a umravlesoba t`vlis, rom uzenaesma allahma am aiat`shi abu bek`ir siddiqi igulisxma, radganac` is iqo qvelaze gamorch`euli morcmune, romelic` monebs gamoisqidida da t`avisup`lebas anichebda. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: da(romelic` k`onebas gasc`ems rat`a ganicmindos) imast`an aravis ak`vs sargebeli.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] is vinmes cinashe valshi ar iqo,da is t`avis ket`il sak`meshi aravisgan elis ramenair sargebels da samagieros, misi molodini mxolod allahis kmaqop`ilebaa.

translations.translation: mxolod uzenaesi g'mert`is (kmaqop`ili) saxis mopoveba scadia(t`avis k`onebis gac`emashi).
shemdeg ut`uod darch`eba kmaqop`ili.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] rodesac` g'vt`is cinashe miig'ebs jildos da t`avisi g'vaclis sazg'aurs.

translations.translation: vp`ic`av dg'is pirvel naxevars
da g'ames, roc`a mqudroeba shemodis cqvdiadit`,
(rom) ar migatova shenma g'mert`ma da arc` mogiz'ula.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] sahabe jundubi gadmogvc`ems, rom ert`xel jibril angelozma allahis shuamavalt`an (axali aiat`ebis gamoc`xadeba) daagviana, ris gamoc` carmart`ebma t`k`ves, rom, muhammedi misma g'mert`ma miatovao. amis shemdeg uzenaesma allahma shemdegi aiat`ebi ch`amoavlina:,,vp`ic`av dg'is pirvel naxevars da g'ames, roc`a mqudroeba shemodis cqvdiadit`, (rom) ar migatova shenma g'mert`ma da arc` mogiz'ula." (muslim, jihad 39/1797.)

translations.translation: shent`vis is k`veqana namdvilad uket`esi ik`neba vidre pirveli.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] pirvelshi amk`veqniuri c`xovreba igulisxmeba, romelsac` adamiani pirvelad gadis.

translations.translation: shemdeg, ut`uod giboz'ebs sheni g'mert`i da ik`nebi kmaqop`ili.
gana oblad gpova da ar shegip`ara?
da gza-kvaldakarguli gpova da ar dagakvaliana?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] romelmac` ar ic`odi ra iqo cigni, rcmena da shuamavloba da man gascavla.

translations.translation: upovrad gpova da ar gagamdidra?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] p`a rra ganmartavs: misi simdidre ar iqo k`onebis sibevre, aramed misi simdidre imashi mdgomareobda, rom mist`vis sakmarisi iqo da kmaqop`ilebas gamot`k`vamda im sarch`os mimart`, rac` allahma ucqaloba. namdvili simdidrec` scored es aris. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi. allahis shuamavali sxvadasxva hadisebshi ambobs:,,simdidre ar aris k`onebis simravle, aramed simdidre aris sulis simdidre." (buxari, riqaaq 15/6446),,cheshmaritad gadarch`enilia is, vinc` islami miig'o, sakmarisi sarch`o eboz'a da allahma mas kmaqop`ileba uboz'a imis mimart`, rac` mas misc`a." (muslim, zek`at` 43/1054).

translations.translation: amitom oboli ar dach`agro![1]
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis shuamavali ambobs:,,me da oblis mp`arveli samot`xeshi ai ase vik`nebit`." man sach`venebeli da shua t`it`ebit` anishna siaxlove. (buxari, adab 24/6005),,g'mert`o! uechvelad, me ori susti arsebis - oblia da k`alis - up`lebebis shesaxeb sip`rt`xiles movucodeb." (ibnu maaja, adab 6/3678).

translations.translation: aseve mt`xovnelic` ar gakic`xo!
xolo sheni g'mert`is cqaloba madlierebit` g'ag'ad-hqav.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] g'vt`is mier adamianisat`vis boz'ebuli cqaloba ut`valavia, magram echvgareshea, rom mat` shoris qvelaze z'virp`asi da gamorch`euli islamia. amitom islamis k`adageba an am sak`meshi xelis shecqoba g'vt`iuri cqalobis mimart` madlierebis gamoxatvaa. morcmune aseve ver ik`neba umaduri sxva danarch`eni siket`eebis mimart`ac`, rac` g'mert`ma mas ucqaloba. allahis shuamavali ert`-ert` hadisshi ambobs:,,vinc` c`otat`i ar aris madlieri, is bevrit`ac` ver ik`neba madlieri; vinc` xalxs ar uxdis madlobas, is allahsac` ar mouxdis madlobas; madlierebit` isaubret` allahis cqalobis shesaxeb da miatovet` umaduroba. jamaat`i aris cqaloba, xolo gaqop`a/ganxet`k`ileba aris tanjva." (ahmed bin hanbel, h.n. 18449).

translations.translation: gana ar gagivixsnia shent`vis mkerdi?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] shuamavluri c`odnit`a da sibrz'nit`.

translations.translation: da ar ch`amogxsenit` tvirt`i,
romelic` celsa gtexda
da ar avamag'let` xseneba sheni?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ezanis, qamet`is, t`ashahhudisa da xutbas dros. rogorc` abu sa'id al xudri gadmogvc`ems, allahis shuamavalma jibril mt`avar angelozs am aiat`is shesaxeb kit`xa da man ase upasuxa: uzenaesi allahi brz'anebs, rom sadac` me maxseneben ik` shenc` gaxseneben. ix. t`ap`siru taberi.

translations.translation: ramet`u, cheshmaritad, sirt`ules t`an axlavs siadvilec`,
cheshmaritad, sirt`ules t`an axlavs siadvile.
amitom rogorc`ki morch`ebi ert`s, mashinve sheudek`i meores.[1]
translations.footnotes:
[1] ibni 'abbasi, qat`ade, dahhak`i, muqat`ili da k`elbi am aiat`s ase ganmartaven: p`arz' namazs rom morch`ebi, sheni g'meg't`is mimart` vedrebas sheudek`, mas gulmxurvale vedrebit` st`xove, rom man mogc`es. hasan al-basri da zeid bin eslemi ganmartaven: rodesac` mtert`an brz'olas morch`ebi, sheni g'mert`is mimart` g'vt`ismsaxurebit` gaisarje. mansuri da mujahidi ganmartaven: rodesac` amk`veqniur sak`meebs morch`eb, g'vt`ismsaxurebebs sheudek`i da namazi sheasrule. ix. t`ap`siru taberi.
ibni mes'udi ganmartavs: rodesac` p`arz' namazebs, morch`ebi g'amis namazit` ganisarje. ix. t`ap`siru suiuti.
es ganmartebebi qvela scoria, radganac` muslims ar ak`vs uk`med dasakargi dro, rodesac` amk`veqniur sak`meebs morch`eba, g'vt`ismsaxurebebs unda sheudges, rodesac` g'vt`ismsaxurebebs morch`eba amk`veqniuri sak`meebit` unda dakavdes. man amgvari shromit`a da garjit`, uk`narobisgan shors, imk`veqniursa da amk`veqniurs shoris gaconascorebuli c`xovrebit` unda ic`xovros.

translations.translation: da (morch`ilad) escrap`e sheni g'mert`isken.
vp`ic`av leg'vsa da zet`isxilsa,
aseve sinas mt`asa,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] mt`a, romelzec` shuamavalma musam g'mert`s esaubra.

translations.translation: da am k`alak`s usap`rt`xosa (mek`k`as).
cheshmaritad, ch`ven adamiani shevk`menit` umshvenieresi p`ormit`.
shemdeg mivabrunet` igi mdabioebze up`ro dabla.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] rodesac` adamiani ar hmorch`ilebs t`avis gamch`ens, romelmac` aset`i pativi dasdo da sauket`eso k`mnilebad gaach`ina, shemdgom is t`avisi ugunurobit` c`xovelze up`ro dabla daec`ema. hasan al-basris, qat`adesa da mujahidis ganmartebis t`anaxmad, qvelaze dabal sap`exurshi jojoxet`is p`skeria nagulisxmevi. ix. t`ap`siru bag'avi.zogiert`i mup`assiris ganmartebit` ki ak` igulisxmeba xandazmuloba da g'rma sibereshi shesvla, ris shedegadac` is gonebrivad da p`izkurad k`veeit`deba. ix. t`ap`siir attabarii.

translations.translation: garda imat`, vinc` ircmunes da hk`mnes ket`ili, scored mat`t`visaa uklebi jildo - dauqvedrebeli.
mash ra gaiz'ulebs amis shemdeg, rom rjuls miich`nev c`rud?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] nut`u ver up`ik`rdebi, rom am qvelap`ris shemz'le allahs, shen mokvdineba, shemdeg kvlav gac`oc`xleba da angarishgeba sheuz'lia?

translations.translation: gana ar aris allahi qvelaze samart`liani msajuli?
ikit`xe sheni g'mert`is saxelit`, romelmac` gaach`ina.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] romelmac` gaach`ina qoveli k`mnileba.

translations.translation: (man) shededebuli sisxlisgan shek`mna adamiani.
ikit`xe! da sheni g'mert`i uguluxvesia,
romelmac` ascavla kalmit` (cera),
adamians ascavla is, rac` ar ic`oda.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] am suras pirveli xut`i aiat`it` daicqo cminda quranis ch`amovlineba, amis shesaxeb buxaris sahih hadist`a krebulshi asea mot`xrobili: morcmunet`a deda 'aisha gadmogvc`ems: allahis shuamavals pirvelad gamoc`xadebebi z'ilshi spetaki sizmrebit` daecqo. z'ilshi ise ar ixilavda sizmars, rom misi msgavsi dilis nat`elivit` ar gac`xadebuliqo. shemdeg mas ganmartoeba sheuqvarda. is hiras gamok`vabulshi ramdenime g'ames ganmartovebit` g'vt`ismsaxurobda - vidre t`avis ojaxt`an dabrundeboda mas shesabamisi sagzalic` t`an hk`onda gamzadebuli. shemdeg isev xadijast`an brundeboda, isev msgavsad imzadebda sagzals da kvlav hiras gamok`vabulshi brundeboda, ase grz'eldeboda vidre cheshmariteba ar gamoec`xadeboda. mas angelozi miuaxlovda da ut`xra: ikit`xe! man upasuxa: me kit`xva ar vic`i. man t`k`va: angelozma ise mz'lavrad shembocha, rom lamis sunt`k`va shemekra. shemdeg gamishva da mit`xra: ikit`xe! vut`xari: me kit`xva ar vic`i. man meoredac` ise shembocha, rom lamis sunt`k`va shemekra. shemdeg gamishva da mit`xra: ikit`xe! vut`xari: me kit`xva ar vic`i. man mesamedac` ise shembocha, rom lamis sunt`k`va shemekra. shemdeg gamishva da mit`xra:,,ikit`xe sheni g'mert`is saxelit`, romelmac` gaach`ina. (man) shededebuli sisxlisgan shek`mna adamiani. ikit`xe! sheni g'mert`i uguluxvesia." am gamoc`xadebit` allahis shuamavali xadija bint` xuveilidt`an dabrunda, shishit` guli ut`rt`oda da eubneboda; damaxuret`, damaxuret`! mas mart`lac` daaxures gadasap`arebeli da ise iqo vidre shishi ar gaec`leboda. shemdeg shuamavalma xadijas uambo mis t`avs datrialebuli ambis shesaxeb:,,ch`ems shesaxeb shishma shemipqro." xadijam ut`xra:,,ara, allahs vp`ic`avar, allahi shen arasodes shegarc`xvens. uechvelad, shen mchidrod gichiravs nat`esavuri urt`iert`obebi, uz'lurt`a sirt`uleebs t`vit`on itvirt`av, upovrebs kit`xulob, stumars umaspinz'ldebi da dazaralebuls exmarebi." shemdeg xadijam shuamavali, varaqa bin navp`al bin asad bin abduluzzast`an anu xadijas biz'ashvilt`an caiqvana. es pirovneba umec`rebis xanashi gak`ristianda, mas arameulad cera-kit`xva sheez'lo da mas sheez'lo saxareba daecera arameulad, ramdensac` allahi inebebda rom daecera. is amdroisat`vis ukve g'rmad moxuc`ebuli da brma iqo. xadijam mas ut`xra: o, ch`emo biz'ashvilo, usmine,,shens z'mis shvils". varaqam ut`xra: o,,,ch`emo z'mis shvilo" ra naxe? allahis shuamavalma qvelap`eri uambo rac` gadaxda. shemdeg varaqam ut`xra: es (angelozi) aris namusi, romelic` allahma musas ch`amouvlina. oh, netav c`oc`xali viqo im dros, rodesac` xalxi gagaz'evebs. allahis shuamavalma ikit`xa: nut`u isini me gamaz'eveben? varaqam upasuxa: diax, shens mier motanili moz'g'vrebis msgavsit` vinc` movida, qvelas mtroba gamouc`xades. im dg'es t`uki movescerebi auc`ileblad vik`nebi sheni damxmare da mxardamcheri. mas shemdeg didi dro ag'ar gasula varaqa gardaic`vala, t`anac` mag dros garkveuli droit` gamoc`xadebac` shech`erebuli iqo. (buxari, h.n. 3.)

translations.translation: ara, uechvelad, adamiani zg'vars gadava,
radganac` t`vit`kmarad xedavs t`avis t`avs.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] abdullah bin 'abbasma t`k`va: arsebobs ori saxis t`valxarbi, romlebic` arasodes gaz'g'ebian. eseni arian c`odnis mp`lobeli da amk`veqniuri upiratesobebis mp`lobeli, romlebic` ert`nairebi ar arian. c`odnis mp`lobeli qovelt`vis mocqale allahis kmaqop`ilebis gazrdaze zrunavs, xolo amk`veqniuri upiratesobis mp`lobeli, qovelt`vis siurch`eshi ep`loba. c`odnis mp`lobelis shesaxeb uzenaesi allahi brz'anebs:,,uechvelad, msaxurt`a shoris allahis ridi mxolod scavlulebs ak`vt`." (p`atir, 35/28) xolo amk`veqniuri upiratesobis mp`lobelis shesaxeb ki:,,uechvelad, adamiani zg'vars gadava, radganac` t`vit`kmarad xedavs t`avis t`avs." ix. ibni k`asiir, t`ap`siiru qurani'l-'aziim.

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, shens g'mert`t`an ik`neba dabruneba.
gana ar ginaxavs is, vinc` ukrz'alavs/abrkolebs
msaxurs, t`uki loc`vad dadga?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] mek`k`eli camart`ebi c`dilobdnen muslimebist`vis loc`vis sashualeba ar miec`at`, mat` shoris gansakut`rebit` abu jehili gamoirch`evoda. abu hureira gadmogvc`ems: ert` dg'es abu jehilma xalxs kit`xa: muhammedi t`k`vens t`valcin saxit` micas exeba? mat` upasuxes: diax. man t`k`va: vp`ic`av lat`sa da 'uzzas, rom t`u davinaze magas aket`ebs, auc`ileblad p`exs davadgam kisershi an saxes micashi amovasvrevineb. ert` dg'es mart`lac` miuaxlovda allahis shuamavals - radrosac` is namazs asrulebda - da kiserze p`exis dadgmas apirebda. ik` mqop`ebma sheamch`nies, rom moulodnelad man k`uslebis mimart`ulebit` ukusvla daicqo da xelebit` t`avis dac`vas c`dilobda. mas kit`xes: ra mogivida? man t`k`va: uechvelad, ch`emsa da mas shoris me davinaxe c`ec`xlis zg'ude, sashineleba da rag'ac` p`rt`ebi. shemdeg allahis shuamavalma t`k`va: rom momaxloeboda angelozebi mas organoebad daanacevrebdnen. scored am ambis shemdeg uzenaesma allahma am suras 6-19 aiat`ebi ch`amoavlina. (muslim, h.n. 2797.)

translations.translation: ras itqvi mashin t`uki (dabrkolebuli) cheshmarit gzas adgas
an g'vt`ismoshishebas k`adagebs?
ras itqvi mashin, t`uki (dambrkolebeli) c`rud rac`xavs da zurgs ak`c`evs?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] c`rud rac`xavs shuamavals da zurgs ak`c`evs mis moz'g'vrebas.

translations.translation: nut`u ver xvdeba, rom allahi xedavs?
ara! t`u ar moishlis, auc`ileblad vit`revt` k`och`rit`/shublit`.
matquara, c`odvili shublit`/k`och`rit`.
mashin mouxmos t`avis mxardamcherebs.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ibnu 'abbasi gadmogvc`ems: mac`ne namazs asrulebda, ra drosac` abu jehili mivida da ut`xra: xom agikrz'ale es? mac`nem loc`vas morch`a da abu jehili mkac`rad gakic`xa. amaze abu jehilma ut`xra: uechvelad, shenc` kargad ic`i, rom ch`emze meti mxardamcheri ar gqavs. amaze uzenaesma allahma shemdegi am suras 17-18 aiat`ebi ch`amoavlina. allahs vp`ic`avar, t`uki is t`avis mxardamcherebs mouxmobda, allahis zebanebi auc`ileblad sheipqrobdnen mas. (t`irmizi, t`ap`siir 84/3349.)

translations.translation: ch`venc` movuxmobt` zebaniebs.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] jojoxet`is mc`veli angelozebi, romlebic` arian mrisxaneni, arap`ershi eurch`ebian gamch`ens da zustad asruleben imas, rac` ak`vt` nabrz'anebi.

translations.translation: aravit`ar shemt`xvevashi! ar daemorch`ilo mas, sejdeze daemxe da dauaxlovdi.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,adamiani g'mert`t`an qvelaze axlos mashin imqop`eba, rodesac` igi sejdes asrulebs." (muslim, salat` 42/482.)

translations.translation: cheshmaritad, ch`ven igi (qurani) qadiris g'ames ch`amovavlinet`.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ibnu 'abbasma t`k`va: uzenaesma allahma, qurani lavhu mahp`uzidan ert`ianad ch`amoavlina amk`veqniur zec`aze arsebul g'irsebis saxlshi da shemdeg ak`edan 23 clis ganmavlobashi nacil nacil ch`amoevlineboda shuamavalt`an. ix. ibnu k`asiir, t`ap`siiru qurani'l'-aziim.

translations.translation: da ram gamc`nos, t`u ra aris qadiris g'ame?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] uzenaesi allahi sura baqaras 185-e aiat`shi brz'anebs:,,ramadanis mt`varea is, romelshic` qurani ch`amoevlina" am aiat`ze daqrdnobit` scavlult`a umravlesoba t`anxmdeba im azrze, rom qadiris g'amis ramadanis mt`vareshia. t`umc`a ramadanis konkretulad romeli g'amea igi, amis shesaxeb scavlult`a shoris c`ilobaa. c`ilobis mizezi is gaxlavt`, rom arc` quranshi da arc` sunnet`shi konkretuli mtkic`ebuleba ar mogvepoveba, arsebuli hadisebi mxolod zogad minishnebebs sheic`avs:,,t`k`ven gecviat` ramadani, mt`vare barak`iani... masshi aris iset`i g'ame, romelic` at`as t`veze up`ro xeiriania." (annasaai, siam 5/2106),,qadiris g'ame, ramadanis bolo at`i g'amis kent ric`xvebshi ez'ebet`." (buxari, h.n. 2017),,vinc` mas ez'ebs, man igi (ramadanis) bolo shvid g'ameshi ez'ebos." (buxari, h.n. 2015),,qadiris g'ame oc`dameshvide g'amea." (abu davud, shahru ramadan 3/1386) qadiris g'amis dap`arulobas da mis dakonkretebit` gauc`xadeblobas scavlulebi imit` xsnian, rom xalxma meti gulmodgineba gamoich`inon ramadanshi g'vt`ismsaxurebis mimart` da marto ert`i konkretuli g'amit` ar shemoip`arglon. amis msgavsad dap`arulia paraskev dg'es vedrebis qabulobis saat`i, shua namazi qoveldg'iur xut` namazs shoris, uzenaesi allahis udiadesi saxeli (ismi azami) t`avis umshvenieres saxelt`a shoris, misi kmaqop`ileba uamrav morch`ilebat`a shoris, rat`a xalxma qovelgvari morch`ilebis mimart` didi quradg'eba gamoich`inon da misi risxva sxvadasxva siurch`et`a shoris, rat`a xalxma qovelgvari siurch`is mimart` didi sip`rt`xile ik`onion. man aseve dap`ara k`veqnierebis dak`c`evis dro, rat`a misi ridit` xalxma meti gulisxma hqon g'vt`ismorch`ilebashi. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: qadiris g'ame at`as t`veze up`ro xeiriania.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] g'vt`ismsaxurebit` gatarebuli qadiris g'ame, at`asi t`vis g'vt`ismsaxurebaze uket`esia, romelshic` qadisirs g'ame ar imqop`eba. allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,vinc` rcmenit`a da jildos molodinit` qadiris g'ames g'vt`ismsaxurebashi gaatarebs, mas epatieba, rac` t`u c`odva ch`audenia carsulshi." (buxari, iman 25/35.)

translations.translation: masshi[1] t`aviant`i g'mert`is nebit` daeshvebian angelozebi da suli,[2] qoveli sak`mis(ag'srulebis)t`vis.[3]
translations.footnotes:
[1] am g'ames.
[2] jibril mt`avar angelozi.
[3] allahis shuamavalma t`k`va:,,rodesac` qadiris g'ame ik`neba, jibril angelozi angelozebis garkveul jgup`t`an ert`ad daeshveba da qvela msaxurs daloc`aven, romelic` mdgomare t`u mjdomare uzenaes allahs axsenebs. xolo bairamis dg'es anu ramadan bairamis dg'es, uzenaesi allahi angelozebs etqvis: ei angelozebo! ra aris gasamrjelo mojamagirisa, romelmac` pirnat`lad sheasrula t`avisi sak`me? isini etqvian: o, g'mert`o ch`veno! misi gasamrjelo aris damsaxurebuli jamagiris gadaxda. allahi etqvis: ch`emo angelozebo! ch`emma msaxurebma mat`ze dakisrebuli p`arz'i (ramadanis marxva) pirnat`lad sheasrules da axla gulmxurvaled mevedrebian. vp`ic`av ch`ems sidiades, uzenaesobas, guluxvobas da ch`ems ag'matebul adgils, rom ut`uod shevismen mat` vedrebas. shemdeg itqvis: cadit`! uechvelad, me t`k`ven gapatiet` da uket`urobebi siket`eebad gadagik`c`iet`. isinic` shin c`odveb mitevebulni dabrundebian." (beihaqi, shu'abu'l-iiman, h.n. 3444.)

translations.translation: usap`rt`xo da mshvidia igi gat`enebamde.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] sahabe ubei bin k`a'bma qadiris g'amis shesaxeb t`k`va:,,es is g'amea romlis g'vt`ismsaxurebashi gatarebac` allahis shuamavalma gvibrz'ana. is aris (ramadanis) oc`dameshvide g'ame. misi nishnebia: dilit` mze kashkashis da sxivebis gareshe p`ermkrt`ali amova." (muslim, salat`u'l-musap`irin 25/762.)

translations.translation: ise ar daig'upebian[1] cignboz'ebult`agan da carmart`t`agan isini, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes, vidre ar miuvat` c`xadi mtkic`ebuleba,
translations.footnotes: [1] originali -,,munp`ak`k`iina" (mnfkyn): pirdapiri mnishvnelobit` gamijnulni, gandgomilni, ganc`alkevebulni ch`amoc`ilebulni da msgavsi mnishvnelobis matarebeli sitqvaa. z'irit`adad t`argmnebshi da t`ap`sirebshi ait`is t`argmna da ganmarteba sitqvis am mnishvnelobis shesabamisad xdeba, ris t`anaxmadac` aiat`is shinaarsi ik`neba:,,cignboz'ebult`agan da carmart`t`agan vinc` ar ircmunes (t`aviant` mc`dar rcmenas) ise ar gaec`lebian vidre ar miuvat` c`xadi mtkic`ebuleba." ch`ven am aiat`is t`argmnisas ag'nishnulis sitqvis mnishvnelobebs shoris avirch`iet` dag'upvis mnishvneloba, romelic` ornairad sheiz'leba ik`nas gagebuli da t`ap`sirebshi meore mesame versiadaa shemot`avazebuli: 1. ise ar daig'upebian anu ar gardaic`vlebian rom mat`t`an ar mivides cheshmariti gzis mach`venebeli c`xadi mtkic`ebuleba allahis mier carmogzavnili shuamavlis moz'g'vrebis saxit`. 2. im k`veqnad dag'upult`a anu ganadgurebult`a shoris ise ar ag'moch`ndebodnen mat`t`an allahis cargzavnili shuamavali rom ar misuliqo c`xadi mtkic`ebulebit` anu quranit`. ix. sa'labi, alk`ashp`u val-baian; bag'avi, ma'alimu'l-t`anziil; qurtubi, jami'u'l-ahk`ami'l-quran; shavk`aani, p`at`hu'l-qadiir.

translations.translation: shuamavali allahisagan, romelic` cminda cerilebs ukit`xavs,
masshia mtkic`e cignebi.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] scori da samart`liani dadgenilebebi.

translations.translation: mxolod masshemdeg daiqvnen isini - romelt`ac` cigni eboz'at`, roc`a c`xadi mtkic`ebuleba miuvidat`.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] cignboz'ebulebs momavali shuamavlis daxasait`eba ag'cerili k`ondat` t`aviant` cerilebshi da isini manamde inarch`unebdnen urt`iert` t`anxmobas mis shesaxeb, vidre allahi muhammed shuamavals carmogzavnida shuamavluri misiit`. rodesac` mas shuamavloba daekisra, mat`shoris ganxet`k`ilebam ich`ina t`avi da nacilma ag'iara misi shuamavloba, nacilma uarqo.

translations.translation: mat` sxva arap`eri k`ondat` nabrz'anebi,[1] garda xalasi rcmenit`, hanip`ebad[2] allahis t`aqvanisc`emis, namazis shesrulebis da zak`at`is gac`emisa, ai es aris rcmena cheshmariti.
translations.footnotes:
[1] t`aviant` cignebshi.
[2] originali -,,hanip`i" (Hnyf): qovelgvari c`ru rcmenisgan da carmart`uli sak`misagan gandegili da urqevi monot`eizmit` cheshmaritebisken mltolvare.

translations.translation: uechvelad, romelt`ac` ar ircmunes cignboz'ebult`agan da carmart`t`agan, jojoxet`is c`ec`xlshi ik`nebian maradzhams. scored egeni arian k`mnilebat`a shoris qvelaze c`udebi.
cheshmaritad, romelt`ac` ircmunes da hk`mnes ket`ili sak`meni, scored egeni arian k`mnilebat`a shoris qvelaze kargebi.

mat`i gasamrjeloa t`aviant`i g'mert`is cinashe, caruvali edemis bag'ebi, romlis k`veshac` mdinareebi miedineba, masshi ik`nebian maradzhams. kmaqop`ilia allahi mat`gan da isinic` kmaqop`ilni arian misgan, es qvelap`eri mist`visaa, vinc` moshishia t`avisi g'mert`isa.
roc`a sherqeul ik`neba mica z'lieri rqevit`a
da amoqris dedamica t`avis mz'ime tvirt`sa,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] mic`valebulebs, damalul saganz'urebs t`u sxva saidumloebebs, rac` micis ciag'shi adamianebma ch`ap`les.

translations.translation: da itqvis adamiani: ra emart`eba mas?
im dg'es is moqveba t`avis ambebs.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] moqveba da daamocmebs im qvelap`ers rac` uket`ebia damians mis zurgze, kargsac` moqveba da c`udsac`.

translations.translation: radganac` shenma g'mert`ma ubrz'ana mas.
im dg'es jgup`ebad gamova xalxi, rat`a ech`venot` t`aviant`i namok`medarni.
ase rom, vinc` iotisodena siket`e k`mnas, ixilavs mas
da vinc` iotisodena boroteba ch`aidinos, isic` ixilavs mas.
vp`ic`av k`oshinit` mochenavet`,
(nalebit`) c`ec`xlis mp`rk`vevelt`,
gant`iadisas moierishet`,
ik`aurobis koriantelshi gamxvevt`,
da (mtris razmis) shuagulshi mkvet`elt`,
rom adamiani z'alian umaduria t`avisi g'mert`is mimart`,
uechvelad, t`vit`onac` mocmea amisa,
uechvelad, is z'lier moqvarulia ket`ildg'eobisa.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] k`onebisa da p`up`unebis mimart` z'lieri siqvarulis gamo siz'unce sz'levs da uchirs samadlod ramis gag'eba.

translations.translation: nut`u man ar ic`is, rom rodesac` gamoshvebul ik`neba is rac` sap`lavebshia,
da gamzhg'avndeba is, rac` gulebshia,
cheshmaritad, mat`i g'mert`i im dg'es mat` shesaxeb qvelap`ris mc`odnea.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] zejjaji ganmartavs: ra t`k`ma unda uzenaesma allahma rogorc` im dg'es, ise im dg'is garda sxva dg'eebshic` qvelap`ris mc`odnea. ak` shemdegi shinaarsit`aa nat`k`vami: uzenaesi allahi mat` im dg'es t`aviant`i umadurobis gamo dasjis. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: (al qaari'a) kakuni.[1]..
translations.footnotes: [1] samqaros dasarulis sashineli da uzarmazari xma, romelic` adamianebis gulebsa da qurebs daukakunebs.

translations.translation: ra aris kakuni?
da ram gamc`nos, t`u ra aris kakuni?
im dg'es gap`antuli peplebivit` ik`nebian,
da ik`neba mt`ebi ach`ech`ili matqlivit`.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] msuk`i moz'raobashi.

translations.translation: xolo visi saconic` imz'imebs,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] visi namok`medari siket`eebic` mz'ime ag'moch`ndeba.

translations.translation: scored is ik`neba kmaqop`ili imier c`xovrebashi.
xolo visi saconic` imch`atevs,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] visi namok`medari siket`eebic` mch`ate ag'moch`ndeba.

translations.translation: scored misi dedaa havia[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] havia aris jojoxet`is ert`-ert`i saxeli. rogorc` deda ise ch`aikravs mas jojoxet`i gulshi.

translations.translation: da ram gamc`nos, t`u ra aris igi?
igia c`ec`xli agizgizebuli.
gautac`nixart` dagrovebashi urt`iert` jibrsa.
sanam ar mixvedit` sap`lavebamde.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] moxvechasa da simravleshi urt`iert` jibris zhinma imdenad gagitac`at`, rom sanam gons moegebodit` sikvdilma mogiscrot` da sap`lavshi ag'moch`ndit`.

translations.translation: ara, shemdeg gaigebt`.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] male gaigebt`, rom momxvecheloba, simravle t`u qvela sxva trabaxida jibris mizezi carmavalia, rashic` t`avdavicqebit` iqavit` ch`ap`lulni da caruvali cheshmariteba ugulebelhqavit`.

translations.translation: ara da ara, shemdeg gaigebt` mart`lac`.
aravit`ar shemt`xvevashi, t`k`ven rom gc`odnodat` mt`eli sic`xadit`.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] es qvelap`eri rom gc`odnodat` mt`eli sic`xadit`a da guldajerebit`, mashin ase ar moik`c`evodit`.

translations.translation: vp`ic`av, rom t`k`ven auc`ileblad ixilavt` jojoxet`s.
shemdeg mas auc`ileblad ixilavt` mt`eli sic`xadit`.
shemdeg usat`uod mogekit`xebat` im dg'es qoveli siket`is shesaxeb.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] gankit`xvis dg'es adamians qoveli siket`is shesaxeb moekit`xeba, gaac`nobiera t`u ara rom is iqo g'vt`is mier boz'ebuli cqaloba, sakmarisi madliereba gamoxata t`u ara mat` mimart` da rashi gamoiqena es siket`eebi. abu hureiras mier gadmoc`emul hadisshi allahis shuamavali ambobs:,,uechvelad, gankit`xvis dg'es msaxurs pirvelad rac` moekit`xeba, es aris (g'vt`is mier boz'ebuli) siket`eebi. mas ase etqvian: gana ar giboz'et` janmrt`eli sxeuli? gana ar dagacquret` c`ivi cqlit`?" ix. t`irmizi, t`ap`siir, 88/3358. ibni mes'udma t`k`va:,,sikeet`eebi, romlebic` adamians moekit`xeba, eseni aris usap`rt`xoeba da janmrt`eloba." taberi, jami'u'l-beian, 30/284. ibni 'abbasma ganmarta: am aiat`shi xsenebul siket`eebshi sxeulis, quris, t`valis da a.sh. janmrt`eloba igulisxmeba. uzenaesma rat`k`maunda t`avis msaxurze uket` ic`is, t`umc`a mat` mainc` kit`xavs, rom es qvelap`eri sad, ra sak`meshi gamoiqena. mat` es qvelap`eri moekit`xebat`, radganac` aiat`shi brz'anebs:,,cheshmaritad, smenac`, mxedvelobac` da gulic`, qvela mat`gani pasuxismgebelia." taberi, jami'u'l-beian, 30/286.imam tabaris piradi azri ki is aris rom allahi adamians pasuxs qvela siket`eze most`xovs. ix. t`ap`siir attabari.

translations.translation: vp`ic`av zhams,
cheshmaritad adamiani zaralshia,
garda mat`i, romelt`ac` ircmunes, hk`mnes ket`ili da cheshmaritebas urch`even ert`manet`s, aseve ert`manet`s urch`even mot`minebas.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] mot`minebas g'vt`ismsaxurebashi, amk`veqniuri sac`durebis da t`avs damtqdari ubedurebebis mimart`.

translations.translation: vai, qvela mkilavsa da mk`irdavs.
romelic` k`onebas agrovebs da it`vlis.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] romelsac` momxvechelobis meti arap`eri ainteresebs.

translations.translation: hgonia, rom misi k`oneba samaradisod ac`oc`xlebs mas.
aravit`ar shemt`xvevashi, is usat`uod mosrolil ik`neba hutamashi.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] originali:,,hutama" (HTm@) jojoxet`is ert`-ert`i saxeobaa, romlebic` lecavs da amsxvrevs qvelap`ers, rac` masshi moxvdeba.

translations.translation: da ram gamc`nos t`u ra aris hutama?
allahis c`ec`xli mogizgize,
romelic` gulis sig'rmeebsac` scvdeba.
uechvelad igi gamoketilia mat`ze[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ch`arazulia misi karebi da shig mqop`t` gamosvlis qvela sashualeba mokvet`ili ak`vt`.

translations.translation: cagrz'elebul svetebs shoris.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] scavlult`a ganmartebebis t`anaxmad eseni aris c`ec`xlis svetebi, romlebic` garemoic`avs mat` an boz'ebi, romlebic` ch`aketil karebs amagrebs. ix. t`ap`siru beg'avi.

translations.translation: gana ar ginaxavs ra uqo shenma g'mert`ma spilos t`anmxlebt`?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] sura mogvit`xrobs istoriuli movlenis shesaxeb, romelic` 570-571 cels moxda. gadmoc`emebis t`anaxmad, iemenis mep`e ebraham iemenis savachro da religiur c`entrad gadak`c`eva gadacqvita, amisat`vis shesabamisi taz'aric` aago, t`umc`a mezobeli k`veqnis k`alak` mek`k`ashi arsebuli k`aaba amas xels ushlida. k`aaba shuamaval ibrahimis droidan moqolebuli hajobis anu religiuri piligrimobis c`entri iqo, romelic` savachro k`aravnebist`vis metad mnishvnelovan certils carmoadgenda. ebrahas ag'nishnuli c`entris iemenis k`alak` sanashi gadatana ecada, am miznis sisuruleshi mosaqvanad k`aabas dangreva da ganadgureba ganizraxa. mraval ric`xovani jari moamzada da k`alak` mek`k`asken gaemart`a, jars cin spiloebi miuz'g'vodnen. k`alk`ashi shesvlist`anave, g'vt`iuri sascaulit` uamravi ch`itebi mop`rindnen, romlebic` klanchebit` da niskartebit` k`vebs ezidebodnen da k`aabas dasangrevad mosul jars ushendnen. amgvarad k`aabas dangrevs mzakvrulma gegmam marc`xi ganic`ada da ebrahas jari ganadgurda. ix. t`arix ibni hisham; t`arix taberi.

translations.translation: gana p`uchad ar ak`c`ia mat`i xrikebi?
da mat` miusia p`rinvelt`a gundi,
romlebic` alizis k`vebs ushendnen mat`
da isini ak`c`ia sak`onlis mier dag'echili da p`exk`vesh gat`elili marc`vlovnis p`ot`lebis msgavsad.
qureishis xelsheuxeblobist`vis,
mat`i zamt`arisa da zap`xulis usap`rt`xod mogzaurobist`vis,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] qureishelebs arabt`a shoris didi pativisc`ema hk`ondat` imis gamo, rom isini iqvnen cminda k`alak` mek`k`as mkvidrni sadac` cminda k`aaba arsebobda. mat` z'irit`adad savachro k`aravnebis ori mimart`uleba k`ondat` arch`euli, zamt`robit` iemenis mimart`ulebit` da zap`xulobit` damaskos mimart`ulebit`. uzenaesi allahis cqaloba iqo am mogzaurobis usap`rt`xoeba, rist`visac` madlierebis gamoxatva morcmunet`a valia. am magalit`ze qvela morcmune unda davp`ik`rdet`, rom is siket`e, carmateba an am carmatebis xelshemcqobi garemoebebi - rac` ch`ven gvxvda cilad - udavod g'vt`is mier ch`vendami boz'ebuli cqalobaa da diadi gamch`enis mimart` madliereba unda gamovxatot`.

translations.translation: t`aqvani sc`en am saxlis g'mert`sa,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] k`aabas.

translations.translation: romelmac` isini daapura shimshilisas da usap`rt`xo hqo shishisgan.
gana ar ginaxavs is vinc` rjuls c`rud miich`nevs?[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] c`rud miich`nevs gankit`xvis dg'es, rom is pasuxismgebeli ik`neba amk`veqnad namok`medar qvelap`erze.

translations.translation: scored is aris igi, vinc` xels kravs obols[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ch`agravs obols da ar az'levs sashualebas, rom miig'os t`avisi up`lebebi.

translations.translation: da arc` sxvas moucodebs upovris dapurebas.
vai im mloc`velt`,
romelnic` t`aviant`i namazis mimart` arian ugulisquro,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] gadmoc`emis t`anaxmad allahis shuamavals kit`xes namazis mimart` ugulisqurobis shesaxeb da man upasuxa, rom es aris drois gaqvana da namazis dagvianeba. (beihaqi, sunen al-k`ubra, h.n. 3164.) ibni 'abbasma p` am aiat`is shesaxeb ase t`k`va: ak` nagulisxmevia p`arisevlebi, romlebic` xalxt`an ert`ad namazs asrulebdnen, t`umc`a xalxs rom gashordebodnen namazs ar asrulebdnen. ix. t`ap`siru taberi, da aseve ak` muslimic` igulisxmeba t`uki isic` t`avis droze ar sheasrulebs loc`vas. ix. t`ap`siir ibn k`ac`iir.

translations.translation: romlebic` mok`medeben sxvat`a dasanaxad[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] roc`a namazze dgebian, - dgebian zantad, xalxis dasanaxad da ar axseneben/ixseneben allahs, garda mc`iredisa.

translations.translation: da umc`ires siket`esac` ki zg'udaven.
cheshmaritad, ch`ven giboz'et` k`evseri.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] ut`valavi siket`e, cqaloba, samot`xeshi ert`-ert`i mdinare. enes bin malik`i d gadmogvc`ems: ert` dg'es allahis shuamavali ch`vens shoris ijda da ch`aez'ina. shemdeg t`avi camocia da ig'imoda. ch`ven mas vkit`xet`: o, allahis shuamavalo! ratom ig'imi? man t`k`va: c`ota xnis cin ch`emze sura ch`amoevlina. man sura k`evseri caikit`xa da t`k`va: ic`it` ra aris k`evseri? ch`ven vut`xarit`: allahma da misma shuamavalma uket` ic`is! man t`k`va: uechvelad is aris mdinare, romelic` diadma g'mert`ma ag'mit`k`va. misi siket`eebi z'alian bevria, is aris auzi sadac` gankit`xvis dg'es ch`emi ummet`i sheikribeba, misi churcheli varskvlavebisodenia. ert`-ert` msaxurs misgan ganarideben. me vitqvi: g'mert`o is ch`emi ummet`idanaa. is metqvis: shen ra ic`i eg ra siaxleebis mket`ebeli iqo shens shemdeg! (muslim, salah 14/400.)

translations.translation: mash iloc`e sheni g'mert`ist`vis da qurbani dakal,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] aiat`is t`argmani shesrulebulia ahli sunnas scavlult`a umravlesobis ganmartebebis shesabamisad, romlis mixedvit`ac` loc`vit` qoveldg'iuri xut`i namazi an bairam namazi igulisxmeba. xolo sitqva,,nahr" (nHr) mkerdis zeda nacils nishnavs, sadac` qeli uert`deba mkerds. xshirad es sitqva qurbnis daklast`anaa gaigivebuli, radganac` ak`lemis daklisas scored sxeulis mag nacilshi archoben danas. ak`edan gamomdinare ahli sunnas scavlult`a umravlesoba ganmartavs, rom aiat`is am sitqvit` qurbnis daklaa nabrz'anebi. arsebobs sxva up`ro susti shexedulebebic`: 'ali bin abu talibi: ak` igulisxmeba namazze qop`nisas marjvena xelis marc`xena xelis zemodan mot`avseba da orives ert`ad mkerdze dadeba. abu ja'p`eri gadmogvc`ems: ak` namazis sacqisi t`ak`biris dros xelebis mkerdis simag'leze camoceva igulisxmeba. ix. t`ap`siru taberi.

translations.translation: uechvelad, sheni moz'ule aris mokvet`ili.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] aiat`i gulisxmobs muhammed shuamavlis moz'uleebs, romlebic` ambobdnen, rom is iqo sht`amomavlobidan mokvet`ili, radganac` misi vazhishvili gardaic`vala da gvaris gamgrz'elebeli ar hqavda. sinamdvileshi shuamaval muhammedis saxeli k`veqnierebis ag'sasrulamde darch`eba morcmunet`a gulebshi da mas qovelt`vis eqoleba mimdevari, xolo misi moz'ule mtrebi mart`lac` mokvet`ili ag'moch`dnen rogorc` sht`amomavlobisgan aseve ideologiasac` ag'ar sherch`a mimdevari.

translations.translation: t`k`vi: hei, t`k`ven, urcmunoebo!
me arc` axla vet`aqvanebi imas, rasac` t`k`ven et`aqvanebit`.
aseve, arc` t`k`ven et`aqvanebit` imas, rasac` me vet`aqvanebi;
da arc` mere vik`nebi imis mot`aqvane, rasac` t`k`ven et`aqvanebit`.
aseve, arc` t`k`ven ik`nebit` imis mot`aqvane, rasac` me vet`aqvanebi.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] es exeba im xalxs, romelt`a shesaxebac` allahma t`avisi dausabamo c`odnit` ic`is, rom arasodes gaxdebian ert`i g'mert`is mot`aqvaneni.

translations.translation: t`k`veni rjuli t`k`ven da ch`emi rjuli me.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] rodesac` allahis shuamavalma islamis k`adageba daicqo, qureishelma carmart`ebma araert` xerxs mimart`es misi am moz'g'vrebidan shesac`denad. amat`gan ert`-ert`i iqo shet`avazeba, romlis t`anaxmadac` ert`i celi shuamavals t`aqvani unda ec`a mat`i kerpebist`vis da shemdeg ert`i celi t`vit`on et`aqvanebodnen ert`adert` allahs. shedegad orive mxare ert`manet`is rjulze garkveul gamoc`dilebas miig'ebdnen da daakvirdebodnen, amgvarad romelic` up`ro xeiris momtani ik`neboda im rjuls airch`evdnen. amaze shuamavlis pasuxi iqo:,,allahma damip`aros, rom mas rame t`anavuziaro!" amis shemdeg carmart`ebma t`aviant`i cinadadeba c`ota shearbiles da ut`xres:,,raki asea sul mc`ire ch`vens kerpt`agan zogiert`s pativisc`emit` xeli mainc` gadausvi da ch`venc` sheni vircmunot`, shens g'mert`s vet`aqvanot`." amaze shuamavalma upasuxa:,,davelodebi t`u ras mivig'eb ch`emi g'mert`isgan." am ambis shemdeg uzenaesma allahma sura k`ap`iruni ch`amoavlina. ix. siirat`u ibni hishaam, 1/362; t`ap`siru taberi, ibni k`asir, bag'avi.

translations.translation: roc`a mova daxmareba allahisa da gamarjveba,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] gamarjveba gulisxmobs qureishel carmart`t`a damarc`xeba da mek`k`as ag'eba, rac` xareba iqo devnilobashi mqop`i mek`k`eli morcmuneebist`vis. mek`k`as ag'eba hijret`is merve cels ramadanis mt`varis 20 ric`xvshi moxda (11/01/630).

translations.translation: da ixilav xalxs, romlebic` jgup`-jgup`ad shedian allahis sarcmunoebashi,
mashin didebit` axsene sheni g'mert`is unakloeba da patieba shest`xove mas. cheshmaritad, igi usazg'vrod mpatiebelia.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] 'abdullah bin 'abbasma t`k`va: rodesac` es sura ch`amoevlina, allahis shuamavali mixvda rom es iqo minishneba misi gardac`valebis siaxlovisa. (ahmed, al-musned, 1/217.) qat`adem t`k`va: am suras ch`amosvlis shendeg allahis shuamavalma ori celi ic`oc`xla. ix. t`ap`siru taberi.

translations.translation: xelebi gauxmes abu lahabs, gauxma kidec`.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] saubaria shuamaval muhammedis biz'a abu lahabze, misi namdvili saxelia 'abdu-l'uzza. is da misi meug'le gansakut`rebit` gamoirch`evodnen shuamavlisa da misi moz'g'vrebis mimart` mtrobashi. qvela arap`ers ishurebdnen imist`vis, rom muhammed shuamavlist`vis t`undac` mc`ireoden mcuxareba da tkivili mieqenebinat` an xalxi islamisgan daebrkolebinat`. sura icqeba cqevlit`,,xelebi gauxmes" es arabuli gamot`k`mis ert`-ert`i p`ormaa, rodesac` amboben nacils da gulisxmoben mt`lians. ak` konkretulad xelebis gaxmobaze up`ro mt`lianad mospoba ganadgurebazea saubari, rogorc` p`izikurad aseve ideologiuradac`. saquradg'eboa is p`ak`tic`, rom sura sakmaod adre islamis pirvel clebshi, mek`k`as periodshi ch`amoevlina. abu lahabs da mis ojaxs sakmaod didi dro k`onda, rom p`ormalurad mainc` mieg'o islami da es sura gaec`ruebina, t`umc`a isini bolomde islamis mtrebad darch`nen da zustad axda uzenaesi allahis sitqva. islamis pirvel clebshi abu lahabis garda sxva mravali mtrebi qavda, romlebmac` mogvianebit` islami miig'es, mat` shoris abu sup`ianma islamis bolo clebshi, mek`k`as ag'ebis dros ag'iara islami. t`umc`a abu lahabisa da misi c`olis shesaxeb imt`avit`ve gac`xadebuli iqo rom isini bolomde urcmunoebad darch`ebodnen da imk`veqnad jojoxet`is mkvidrni ik`nebodnen.

translations.translation: mas arc` t`avisi k`oneba gamoadga da arc` monapovari.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] arc` k`oneba gamoadga g'vt`is nebis cinashe da verc` shvilebma ushvela, verc`ert`ma ixsna igi allahis sasjelisgan.

translations.translation: aalebul c`ec`xlshi sheva is
da misi c`oli - sheshis mzidavi[1] -
translations.footnotes: [1] gadmoc`emebis t`anaxmad abu lahabis c`oli p`ich`xs da eklebs qrida gzebze, sadac` muhammed shuamavals unda gaevlo, amit` misi vneba da shecuxeba undoda.

translations.translation: kiserze palmis bochkosgan dagrexili t`oki ek`neba shebmuli.
t`k`vi: is, allahi ert`adert`ia,
allahi samedia,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] qovlad unaklo da qovlad damoukidebeli, romelzec` qvelap`eria damokidebuli, xolo t`vit`on arap`erzea damokidebuli.

translations.translation: arc` ushobia da arc` shobila,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] allahs - uzenaes g'mert`s arc` shvili hqolia da arc` mshobeli

translations.translation: da verc` veravin ik`neba misi badali.
t`k`vi: shevep`arebi gant`iadis g'mert`sa,
imat` siavisgan, rac` man gaach`ina,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] nebismieri k`mnilebisgan mosalodneli sap`rt`xisa da siavisgan morcmunes mp`arveli da mshveleli mxolod ert`adert`i allahia, mas unda sheep`aros, mas unda evedros.

translations.translation: da cqvdiadi g'amis siavisgan, roc`a ch`amocveba irgvliv[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] kerz'od im sap`rt`xeebisa da siavisgan, romlebic` up`ro xshirad g'amit` ich`ens t`avs, rogoric`aa mtac`ebeli c`xovelebi, qach`ag'ebi, k`urdebi da sxva, romlebic` g'amis cqvdiadit` sargebloben da naklebad xilvad garemoshi c`diloben t`aviant`i araket`ili zraxvebis sisruleshi moqvanas.

translations.translation: da naskvebze mberav dedabert`a siavisagan,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] jadok`rebis siavisgan, romlebic` kvanz'ebs naskvaven da zed suls uberaven, rom adamianebi moajadovon. jados, jinisa da t`valis cinaag'mdeg brz'olashi sura p`alaq da naasi ert`-ert`i sauket`eso sashualebaa.

translations.translation: aseve moshurnes siavisgan, roc`a shurianobs.
t`k`vi: shevep`arebi adamiant`a g'mert`sa,
adamiant`a mep`es (mat` baton-patronsa),
adamiant`a g'vt`aebasa,
echvis mt`esavi veragis siavisagan,[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] satanis siavisgan, romelic` echvs t`esavs morcmunet`a gulebshi, rodesac` isini allahis xsenebas (zik`rs) moscqdebian, xolo garbis da imaleba, roc`a isini allahis xsenebas (zik`rs) sheudgebian.

translations.translation: romelic` echvs t`esavs adamiant`a gulebshi[1] -
translations.footnotes: [1] morcmunet`a deda sap`ia bint` hueie gadmogvc`ems: ert`xel allahis shuamavali i't`ik`ap`shi imqop`eboda. g'amit` mis sanaxavad mivedi, c`ota vilaparaket` da shemdeg camovedi. isic` ch`emt`an ert`ad camovida, rat`a gamovec`ilebine. sap`ia, usama bin zeidis saxlshi c`xovrobda. am dros moshorebit` orma ansarelma kac`ma ch`aiara, rodesac` mac`ne sheamch`nies ach`k`arebit` cavidnen. mac`nem mat` dauz'axa: nu ch`k`arobt`, is hueies k`alishvili sap`iaa. mat` t`k`ves: subhanallah, allahis shuamavalo! man ut`xra: uechvelad, satana adamianis sxeulshi gadaadgildeba, saidanac` sisxli mimoik`c`eva. me shemeshinda, rom satana t`k`vens gulebshi c`ud p`ik`rebs ch`aagdebda. (buxari, 3281.)

translations.translation: adamiant`a da jint`agan.[1]
translations.footnotes: [1] adamianisa da jinisgan mosalodneli siavisgan, romlebic` shesaz'loa t`aviant`i sak`c`ielit` satanas ucevdnen samsaxurs da t`vit`on ecevodnen morcmunet`a gulebshi echvis gag'vivebas.
